name: Causality Ability Generation
description: The user is able to get an ability based on their actions. This means they could do something and it can lead to an ability. There is a tradeoff. The action must have a meaning to it. An example wold be punching a man in a fight. Since that punch is an action, the ability would be something like enhanced strength. All ability last as long as the effect of the action.
summary: The ability to gain temporary abilities based on one's actions.
strengths: Gain abilities
Abilities are boosted by effect of action and decision that caused the action.
weaknesses: Abilities last as long as the effects of actions.

name: Weaponverse
description: Upon obtaining this ability, a personal dimension forms on the planes of your soul, housing any weapon that you have seen or imagined, even guns. You can configure the appearance of this separate plane and even pull it into this dimension allowing for a fortress-type armory. Upon summoning a weapon, a hole in space will form, linking local reality with your weaponverse, and any number of weapons that you have the energy to summon will appear.
summary: The ability to Pull any imagined weapon from a separate personal dimension or armory.
strengths: Can summon any weapon you have the capability to imagine or create within your mind.
Can potentially summon infinite numbers of weapons.
Summon weapons instantly.
weaknesses: Can be extremely draining to summon large numbers, leading to death.
Can be harmed by summoned soul-rending weapons.
Some weapons lead to collateral damage.

name: Return To Self Genesis
description: Simply put, the ability to return to normal any damage that you create. This ability applies to only your damage, however. You can choose which things to return and which things not to return.
summary: The ability to repair and heal any damage you cause
strengths: Helps out if a lot of collateral damage has been caused by you.
You can choose to heal your surroundings and not your enemy.
You can return the dead back to completely normal and healed. Said people will have no memory of what happened around their death..
weaknesses: Can't heal damage caused by others.
Can be incredibly taxing.

name: Shattersoul
description: Upon activation of this ability, you can remotely detonate any weapon that you have touched. You can even cause weapons you are currently handling to shatter when swung.
summary: The ability to cause any weapon you handle to remotely explode.
strengths: Powerful ability that usually serves as a trump card.
Can't be harmed by your own explosions.
Can be used on bullets.
weaknesses: The collateral damage will be massive for some weapons.
The ability to be protected from weapon explosions does not extend to others.

name: Situational Adaptation
description: It is basically a highly limited "have every super power" power. Your power would be adapting, meaning your power randomly changes to a given situation. For example, if you need to save a person falling from a building, you'd have the power of flight. Need to get a bomb out of a crowded area? Teleportation.  As soon as the problem is solved, it goes away.
summary: The ability to have a superpower useful in a given situation
strengths: Eliminates predictability when fighting foes.
Since you cannot choose your power, getting an unusual power for a given situation forces you to think outside the box.
Who knows. You might get omnipotence.
weaknesses: You cannot choose the power you are given, so it may be challenging.
You are powerless outside of situation when you need to save someone or stop a bad guy(No donut summoning)

name: Ability Reader
description: Well to tell it simply you'll be able to see anyone's type of power and skill which gives you an edge but beyond that it's just more insight so you know what your up  against and the display is like pop up icons.
summary: The ability to See your  opponents/ally's powers and  skills.
strengths: Know what power/skill they have.
Works with a picture of person.
Helpful in need to know bases.
weaknesses: Works only with sight.
Multiple  opponents might cause icon confusion.
Can't tell how powerful that power/skill is.

name: Probability Falsification
description: The user will have the ability to manipulate probability by falsifying certain information. The user can shroud factors and variables that affect the likely end results of events in order to create a new probability. They can also use it make people miscalculate their plans and strategies. The user can create false factors and information in order to create an event that is not real. In short, the user can create an illusion through probability.
summary: The ability to hide or create false information, factor, or variables that affects probability..
strengths: Manipulate probability through removed or falsified factors
Create illusion
weaknesses: Probability manipulators/ perceivers could be able to see through this ability.

name: Angels Power
description: Having massive wings and  creating any kind of angelic weapon that you can think of.  Having the strength of an archangel or in really tough times become the size of which a normal angel in real life in the bible are 35 feet so about 65 feet. You are the fast thing that flies by flying around the world in  30 seconds and can shift to the spiritual realm. Not allowed to satan your purpose is to obey God. This is the Angels power. You can only get it if you are born with it and you get it by God.
summary: The ability to be half human half Archangel
strengths: Demons fear you.
You can shift to spiritual realm.
You can pull spirits right out of hell or out of body if granted by God.
weaknesses: Darkness is weakness.
Magic is a weakness.
You can be summoned by God at any time and are ordered to do his works.

name: Probability Field Adaption
description: The user allows one to adapt. By tapping into the probability field, the user's body is able to adapt in order to defend themselves from unknown events. Since probability is unpredictable, the user is constantly adapting, increasing/ decreasing in strength. This ability works well against lucky individuals/probability manipulators. The user can adapt to  an individual's luck. Probability manipulators are changing probability, so the user will instantly adapt to those changes.
summary: The ability to adapt based on the likelihood of might happen to you
strengths: Able to adapt based on things that might happen to you.
Adapt to a person's luck/ probability manipulator.
Could reach a new level of power when every single probable thing has been calculated.
weaknesses: Adaption is usually unpredictable.

name: Memory Sword
description: With this ability you can access the tactical skills of anyone who previously wielded the sword.
summary: The ability to Wield a sword and access the tactical knowledge and sword skills of previous wielders.
strengths: Access the skills of previous users.
Gain tactical skills and knowledge you might not possess.
Can instantianiously learn new skills.
weaknesses: Is useless if you are the first user.
Only works with swords.
Can grant useless ineffective and outdated tactical knowledge.

name: Healing Stone
description: When you become fataly injured you can go into a deep slumber. In that state your body will become stone-like. As you rest you will heal at a accelerated rate and within a 9 hour period you will be totally healed.
summary: The ability to Heal yourself by going into a stony  slumber.
strengths: Can recover from injury faster than normal
Can heal any physical injury no problem.
weaknesses: Will be vunarable in your stone state.
Must complete your full hibernation to be fully healed.

name: Hero Choosing
description: User is capable of choosing main character of the story, granting him/her luck and (possibly) happyend. Usually, this ability also allows user to watch choosen one anytime, like person watching movie.
summary: The ability to choose the choosen one.
strengths: Grants target luck.
You can use this ability on yourself too.
weaknesses: Good character can become bad character. Then it's trouble.

name: Useless Invisibility
description:
User of this unfortunate ability can turn invisible when nobody is watching.
You can stay invisible as long as you want, but if you come to other person's field of view, you'll turn visible.
summary: The ability to be invisible when no one is watching you.
strengths: At least you have superpower.
You'll turn back to visible state only if one who sees you is same species (you'll stay invisible if only animals are "watching" you).
weaknesses: If you are in someone's field of view while invisible, you'll turn visible.

name: Instinctive Reality Warping
description: This is pretty basic. The user can warp reality through reflex. When something is coming at the user, the user's reflexes will then warp up a wall or a shield or something to protect them. The user can also use this in combat, warping their body to become strong and fast. This ability only affects the user and the immediate area around them.
summary: The ability to warp reality based on one's instincts and reflexes.
strengths: Warp reality to protect yourself
Use it in fights
weaknesses: Short range
Only works on user, no one else

name: Spectral Death Weapons
description: With this power, you can summon any weapon. The weapons will be colored black and red, and will be made out of a unique material with the essence of death. You can also choose to imbue your weapons with the Death Mark. This means that the weapons have an aura of death - if they harm someone, the victim will have an essence of death that surrounds their soul.  This means that the victim cannot die, and will be locked permanently in a prison inside their mind, unable to perceive reality.
summary: The ability to summon any weapon from a plane of death.
strengths: You become a powerful warrior.
You instinctively have great skill with the weapons you summon.
weaknesses: If you injure yourself with your weapons, you will bestowed with the Death Mark yourself.

name: Power Versatility
description: This ability will allow the user to make their other abilities work in any situation even in a situation that would be highly illogical. An example would be if someone was injured,and the user only has fire manipulation. The user with this ability could change this ability to use it in way to heal them. It is still fire manipulation just used in odd way. That is how illogical this ability can make it. It can only do one situation at a time and one ability at a time.
summary: The ability to make any ability apply to any situation.
strengths: Make any ability become useful in any situation.
weaknesses: One situation at a time.
One ability at a time

name: True Sword Mastery
description: The user imagines themselves as holding a sword and focuses their resolve to cut something within the range of that "sword". The "sword" will cut what the user intends and other weapons can be parried with that "sword". "Sword" can be any length but posture will have to be adjusted. The user can also increase the "cutting range" of any object held in their hand and use it as a sword. Intangible objects like fire and abstracts can be wielded if user has required secondary abilities.
summary: The ability to use anything as a sword including nothing
strengths: Not handicapped by the lack of a weapon and no need to carry one
Can increase the cutting range of smaller objects--useful if that object is something's weakness
The "sword" is not solid and only what the user intends to cut will be cut
weaknesses: Must be able to physically wield the sword(or wield it using other powers)
People with good instinct can sense the "sword" and avoid it
Requires ability to imagine the sword in your hands and decent swordsmanship

name: Waveform Manipulation
description: It is the ability to change the energy of a wave into another. Like sound into light, heat or gamma ray and vice versa. It is the ability to change any type of wave found on the electromagnetic spectrum to another and manipulate anything that follows a wave pattern.   Rule: New wave/energy will follow its inherent nature.
summary: The ability to convert one form of energy wave into another.
strengths: Adaptable and versatile
Can intensify or weaken to power of other energy
weaknesses: Must carry a source or create with your body.
Can only convert into 1 energy form at a time.
Controller can be overwhelmed by multiple energy/waveforms at once

name: Jumper
description: This is a very rare form of teleportation. A person can create psionic 'jump-scars' by using their mind to bend space-time. They appear as clear 'cracks' in midair, that can lead to any location on Earth that a person chooses. Some jump-scars have a short or long delay period, depending on their size.
summary: The ability to teleport to any location on Earth.
strengths: This is a very versatile power to have!
Escape from enemies in mere seconds, or become a very tricky opponent!!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control

name: Superpower Manifestation
description: This ability allows the user to make any physical power and manifest it into a physical form. These manifestations do not take the form of living creatures more like objects or supernatural forces, unless it was an animal transformation ability. This means the user doesn't possess these powers. Example, The user created heat vision. This ability makes it physical manifestation of heat vision like two red dots. The user can fire those dots as twin fiery beams of death.
summary: The ability to create superhuman abilities in a externalized form.
strengths: Manifest any physical ability
Control those powers
weaknesses: Some manifestation can be unpredictable.

name: Imaginative Causality
description: The user is able imagine an action and this ability makes the effects happen in real life. For example, the user needs to karate chop a block of wood. The user first imagine chopping the wood in two(the cause), and his ability makes the wood in real life to be actually cut in half (the effect). The user and everything effected by this power is placed in the exact positions of how things would be like after the imagined action.
summary: The ability to imagine any action in one's mind in order to create the effects in the real world.
strengths: Complete any action and subsequent effecst by thinking it.
If you imagine traveling to a different location, you will be teleported there.
Very effective in conjunction with strategies.
weaknesses: If you imagine yourself being hurt, you will be. (If you don't master it. )
If the user imagines an action that seems impossible, the user will suffer.

name: Rapid Cell Regeneration
description: This ability doesn't just speed up healing, it allows you to pretty much never get sick at all, Slows down aging to the point that you pretty much live forever theoretically.
summary: The ability to heal from any wound instantaneously.
strengths: Heal Instantaneously.
Never sick
Slowed or stopped aging when the power is active.
weaknesses: You are everlasting thus everyone you know and love will pass, you won't.
You will have to bear the weight of forever for you may possibly live forever.
You might feel misunderstood by those around you because of this ability.

name: Electricity
description: If you shoot electricity balls then it will just electrocute whatever it hits, if there is something that doesn't work then you can power it up so it works or you can heal people and can just electrocute stuff,if you run out of power then you can drain power from Machines and stuf.
summary: The ability to can shoot electricity bolls, give power to stuff that doesn't have power, you can take power and you can…
strengths: Can fight bad guys off that are trying to attack citizens.
You can heal people who are injured.
If there is something that doesn't work then you can power it up
weaknesses: You can hurt citizens.
You can drain citizens power which will kill them
You could electricute citizens.
tags: These powers can be very dangerous
they need to be used for good not for bad.

name: Instant Learning
description: This power allows you to instantly and perfectly learn, and permanently retain, any knowledge and skills about any and all subject simply by thinking about them, all of which without any problem, difficulty or deformity.
summary: The ability to instantly and perfectly learn any subject.
strengths: Never need to go to school again, always able to learn any and every skill imaginable.
No need for a dictionary as you will be a human dictionary.
Create new inventions, and learn any and all languages extremely easily.
weaknesses: Does not make you well practiced, have to practice with the knowledge and skills you gain.
Might become annoyed if people start to look to you for all of the answers.

name: Single Solution Causality
description: This ability is good for those who believe in those miracle tools and cures. This ability changes causality and chance in order for anything to be the solution to any problem. Example, I use this ability on a hammer. "A bomb is going to blow" I throw the hammer and it somehow defuses it. "Alien Invasion" Throw my hammer at them and they all perish. That is what this ability does.
summary: The ability to warp causality in order to make a single object or method become the solution to any problem.
strengths: Make anything be the solution to any problem
Solve anything
weaknesses: None, but people could get bored if you use the same item or method.

name: Axiokinesis
description: With this power, you can manipulate how valuable something is to someone. This can apply to either everyone, or just a specific person/people. For instance, you could get things for super cheap from people by depreciating the value of those things in their eyes, or get people to want something by increasing its value. This works on people too; you can make yourself inexplicably valuable to your enemies, stopping them from harming you, or make someone value themselves less, leading to depression.
summary: The ability to manipulate the value of things
strengths: Basically get almost anything you want for little to no cost
Protect yourself from people
Make people not care about themselves
weaknesses: Won't affect people without any concept of value
Can make life a little too easy

name: Memory Tap
description: Just by touching the target you can tap into every single moment of their life that they can remember.  You can travel back in time to a chosen moment.  You have a period of 6 hours to change whatever you want about that memory before you are transported back to the present day.  While you are in the memory, the reality that contains the memory's owner is frozen.  If the owner of the memory dies while you are in the memory, you will be transported back to the present day.
summary: The ability to travel back in time to the memory of another person.
strengths: You can do this to anyone.
This power is easy to master.
weaknesses: You could get stuck in a paradox if you mess with the space time continuum.
You can still die in the memory.

name: Advanced Regeneration
description: Able to regenerate bodily damage, making the damaged area stronger each time it is healed. Broken bones become stronger each time they are healed, muscles and tendons become more resilient, etc. Fatigue is virtually eliminated, as lactic acid build up in the muscles is eliminated. Aging is slowed to the point where an individual doesn't appear to age at all, due to the body constantly regenerating the gradual decay of the aging process.
summary: The ability to regenerate bodily damage
strengths: Longer life span.
Come back stronger after each injury.
weaknesses: Outlive everyone close to them.

name: Imagination Manifestation
description: The ability to manifest your imagination into a physical being that only you can see. It will appear to you as a creature of your choosing. Its power levels will be based off of how wild your imagination is. Imagination manifestations can pull things into reality out of nowhere and will protect/obey its owner at all costs. Imagination cannot be destroyed by any physical means.
summary: The ability to manifest your imagination into a physical being only you can see.
strengths: An invisible, invulnerable creature that will always protect/obey you.
They can take anything you can imagine into reality.
If your imagination is wild, the manifestation is powerful!
weaknesses: If you have no imagination, the power is useless.
If you have a wild imagination, it might be hard to control.
Imagination crushers

name: Grandmaster Of All
description: Chess, competitive sports, martial arts, mathematics, painting, music - you name it. This power gives you all the required knowledge, experience, mental and physical aptitudes to be extremely skilled at everything. You will gain a Grandmaster level for each of these skills, which would be anywhere between the 1st to 10th current best in the world. You can improve each skill even more with practice, but without practice it will eventually revert to the state when you first gained it.
summary: The ability to be extremely, superbly talented at everything.
strengths: Your skills will never deteriorate beyond the level you gained them at.
Top-notch physical capabilities and obviously superhuman mental capacities.
Improved physical appearance. Hey, you can be at least the 10th best model in the world!
weaknesses: You're not necessarily the best in the world for any skill (although you're pretty darn close)
People may begin to question how you gained all these abilities if you show too many of them.
Unless you have other powers that change this, you still age at a normal rate.

name: Storage
description: With this power you can turn any object into a storage container for any skill, power, talent, memories, or knowledge, even personality trait/defect, or mental disorders. Whoever possesses the storage object has access to any and all things stored inside it. Which means potentially someone use a power stored inside like green lantern ring, or be hindered by a Obsessive compulsive disorder, or even haunted by someone's memories of torture and abuse. The object can be used to store for many people
summary: The ability to store info, powers, skills, mental defects, personality traits, memories or talents in objects
strengths: Store powers, and skills in any object.
Hace access to powers you don't possess, use other people's knowledge and experiance to succeed.
Get of Defects/traits, memories or Mental diseases you don't want.
weaknesses: If you find an object that has memories of being tortured, has a mental disease.
If you use the object so often you forget it's not your power or skills, then lose it.
Some memories or mental disease might stick with you forever.

name: Videogame Reality
description: With this ability, you can make anyone and anything from any and all videogames real. Anything that you summon from a videogame keeps their videogame physics. Anyone you summon from a videogame keeps their personality and skills. The more familiar you are with videogames, the more useful this power becomes to you. You can also summon energies from videogames. And you can always send it back to the videogame.
summary: The ability to make anything and anyone from any videogame real.
strengths: Able to summon energies, artifacts, characters, and more from videogames.
Anything summoned from a videogame follows that game's laws of physics.
Works with any videogame.
weaknesses: If you're not familiar with videogames.
If you have never played or heard about videogames.
If you don't know what a videogame is.

name: Aether Manipulation
description: Aether manipulation is the ability to manipulate the aether. Some applications are Transcendent Physiology: As a wielder of the fifth element, users will ascend into a powerful Demigod. Ethereal Form: User will become composed of the element and gain power that rivals other ethereal beings. Absolute Existence: User will possess control over their own existence to a very high extent. Shapeshifting: User will possess complete psionic control over his/her body.
summary: The ability to manipulate the Aether.
strengths: You are nearly invincible
you have lots of applications
weaknesses: You can be hurt
You can not give powers to people
You can be killed by someone who manipulates the nether and or manipulates the aether

name: Physics Rejector
description: When you have this ability, physics doesn't apply to you. It's automatic. So, no need to activate it. Do anything that physics says you can't like: Flying, running through walls, teleporting, the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to do anything you want because physics doesn't apply to you
strengths: Break physics
Run through gravity
Do all that's not forced down (this is a proverb)
weaknesses: There's no con, so have fun.

name: Tele Automation
description: This ability acts like a factory. The user wants something down and this ability automatically does the rest. Example, the user wants the house to be clean everyday before he gets home. The user's ability will kick in and everything in the user's house will begin the the process of clean with a telekinetic force controlling it. This can make anyone a one many production crew. All you need are the materials to help perform the tasks.
summary: The ability to control any form of orderly process or system automatically via telekinesis.
strengths: Won't need to do tedious tasks
Be your own factory. (High productivity)
Automatic ( No humans, No Machines)
weaknesses: Have to have materials for certain task.
Not full telekinesis, it does things in an orderly manner and not by the users will.
Not good in instant combat. (Better in strategic warfare. )

name: Materialized Luck
description: The user will have great luck. This luck will appear in the form of a specific element like earth, fire, water, substance like acid, chlorine, or any other materials. Everything good that happens will always involve it in someway. This ability gives partial control over the power to sense luck is coming from an element.
summary: The ability to possess extraordinary luck that takes on the form of a material.
strengths: Gain powerful luck.
Since this luck is more mundane, you will control more of your luck.
weaknesses: This luck may be weaker than real luck.

name: Bio Energy Communication
description: The user will have the ability to change their bio-energy into frequencies that they can us to communicate with other living things. With time, they will be able to gain new uses for this power like using those frequencies on one target and cause headaches, vertigo, or death. You can manipulate sound through your frequencies to enhance or weaken them.
summary: The ability to communicate through one's bio-electrical field.
strengths: Communicate with other living things
Manipulate sounds
Create frequencies with different effects
weaknesses: Can't communicate with machines (at first)
Can be disrupted with a large amount of concentrated radio waves.

name: Anti Gravity Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can utilize the force that is anti-gravity. Since this is the opposite of gravity, instead of pulling things towards you, you push them away. Wave your hands, and a wall is torn apart. About to be attacked? Throw them outward! You can even force things to come to you by putting anti-gravity pushing behind them. You even can make yourself fly by making your body exert anti-gravity, but breathing could be an issue when you do that. The options are almost limitless!
summary: The ability to create and control anti-gravity
strengths: Push objects that pose a threat away from you, and even push good things towards you!
Rip even the strongest of materials apart.
Combine Earth's gravity with the right amount of anti-gravity, and you get zero-gravity
weaknesses: May push air away from you or someone else, and they may asphyxiate.
Might accidentally rip apart someone or something you hold valuable.
Make people's ears pop.

name: Imagination Creation
description: This power causes a boundary to surround you and anyone else you want. You can make the boundaries go as far as you want when you are using this power. You can imagine ANYTHING and it will happen within the imagination field. And only your imagination becomes reality. You can use what you imagine to hurt someone or use what you imagine not to, it's your imagination.
summary: The ability to bring what ever you imagine to life within an area.
strengths: You can imagine or think of anyone you want, or make up a person
You can imagine or think of anything you want, or make something up
You can live your life's greatest and wildest desires and fantasies without harming the real world
weaknesses: This may give you headaches depending on how much or what you imagine
Anyone else whose in the boundary with you will either be jealous of you or ask you to do a lot

name: Real Gamer
description: With this power you can use any item that can be used in a video game. Magic mushrooms, poke balls, Maxwell's notebook, Link's swords and many more items and weapons can be brought to the real world with this power. When you're done with the items you can send them back to wherever they came from. You can only summon items from video games that you have played.
summary: The ability to use items from video games
strengths: You can have any item from any video game
weaknesses: You can only summon items from video games that you have played

name: Reality Coder
description: This ability allows the user to bring up a virtual keyboard and augmented reality display overlaying their vision. An empty prompt appears before them. They can summon objects and change the properties of things by typing code into the prompt. For example, "import Glock_17" would cause a Glock 17 pistol to appear. Anything can be done, but many functions and objects must be programmed before being used, otherwise the system doesn't know what you're trying to do. Comes with a virtual help file.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality with a programming language
strengths: Can summon virtually anything, and change the properties of objects
Can create programs for any situation and execute them at will
Cannot be seen using it (aside from the user typing at an invisble keyboard)
weaknesses: Must create programs and define functions and objects
Have to memorize everything you've defined or be constantly refering to the help file
Must learn how to write code

name: Self Manipulation
description: With this power, you can transform your body and manipulate its features. You can turn your body heat to a thousand degrees farenheit or more to be defended or turn yourself into fire and launch it. You can either use your bioelectricity as a weapon or turn into lightning and shoot it. You can also change your regular body and increase its strength and youth.
summary: The ability to greatly change and control your body.
strengths: You are extremely powerful.
weaknesses: You must be creative.

name: Physical Understanding
description: This contact based power will allow the user to understand the physical capabilities of any machine. It will understand how it works, how to use in perfectly, and all internal pieces within the machine.
summary: The ability to understand the inner workings, and physical aspects on any machine.
strengths: Allows the user to understand the use of any machinery like guns or vehicles
Can reconstruct past objects that he or she has touched.
Can physically take apart and rebuild any object
weaknesses: No battle purpose other than creating weapons and using basic attacks

name: Energy Manipulation/Control
description: Most Energywielders are separated into light and dark. LightWielders can naturaly flow energy through their bodies quickly and continuously but weak in power. DarkWielders can collect and focus energy and release it in precise and powerful blasts but cant be fired quickly. Their specializations do not make them good or evil. The 3 types of energy are Electricity(dark preference), Photons(light preference), and Plasma. Only EnergyWielders can control all types of energy.
summary: The ability to control many forms of energy
strengths: Power over many types of energy
Can be used in creative ways
Can be pulled from anywhere(no need of a source)
weaknesses: Can only use one type at a time
Not all types of energy are effective against all enemies
Rigorous training is required to use higher level energies without a focus.

name: Clearance Schmearance
description: With this power you can have access to any top secret file, facility or person. No need for a badge, password, ID or retina scanner just activate this power and go find what you're looking for. This power works with but is not limited too Governments, agencies, secret societies, secret clubs and satanic cults.
summary: The ability to have access to anything
strengths: You can have access to anything
weaknesses: You still have to find where the information you're looking for is being held
^But you have access to that information too so...
Not much use in physical combat

name: Tactile Cryokinesis
description: This ability is extremely powerful. A person can control ice in whatever way they desire. Ice shards and slabs can be formidable weapons. Advanced users can even overcome fire, heat, or even lava-based powers, provided they are in proximity of any ice or water source. This power allows regeneration at advanced levels.
summary: The ability to control ice while either in direct contact with it, or in close proximity
strengths: Be a near-invincible fighter!
Use ice trails to escape from enemies faster, and also slow them down.
Enemies will find you to be a VERY tricky opponent to fight!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control.
This power requires either direct physical contact, or a proximity of no more than 200 feet to work

name: Power Automation
description: With this ability, one can program their abilities to act in a certain way in a given situation. Active powers can act without any intervention on your part. However, to use this power, one must have acquired Power Programming, though mimicry is permitted.
summary: The ability to greatly extend the capabilities of Power Programming to allow automation of your powers.
strengths: Live a life with normal perception but still enjoy the benefits of enhanced perception of the world.
Activate or deactivate superpowers according to a given situation using Josh's Power Switchboard.
Use active powers while unconscious.
weaknesses: You need to have Power Programming, but it may be mimicked.
Does not enhance the capabilities of your powers.
Useless without other powers; even if you also have Power Programming, you need powers to program.

name: Superhuman Energy
description: Ever felt tired or lazy? With this superpower, you can have a lot of energy. Energy to do your homework, run across a bridge, dance. You can activate and deactivate this power at will. Don't overactivate this power, or you'll be hyper, paranoid, hypervigilant and will not sit still. You can stay up a few hours past bedtime. If you're extremely sleep deprived and forget to turn off this superpower, instead of staying awake, you'll fall asleep and awaken hours later temporarily confused and hyper.
summary: The ability to have increased levels of mental and psysical energy when you activate this power.
strengths: Have energy to do anything.
Activate and deactivate this power at will
Stay up for up to 4 hours past your bedtime.
weaknesses: You WILL fall asleep if you're extremely sleep deprived.
Overactivating this superpower could lead to hypervigilance, hyperness, and paranoia for a while
If you sleep while this superpower is activated, you'll wake up temporarily confused and hyper.

name: Theory Of Relativity
description: You are able to control gravity; you may increase it or decrease it. For example, you may pin targets to the ground, or levitate objects. Or else, you may create your own gravity, and make flying objects orbit around you. You may use this as a form of psychokinesis, pulling and pushing targets.
summary: The ability to manipulate gravity and forces.
strengths: There is no limit to the area that you cast your power upon.
If you try hard enough, you may lift extremely heavy objects such as cars with lack of gravity.
You can activate this power to you yourself, thus being able to fly.
weaknesses: It requires a lot of skill to actually perform this skill. Even through practicing, you can mess up.
Your weakness is electricity or radar.
You may not increase gravity and decrease it at the same time, even if the targets are different.

name: Infinite  Weapon Arsenal
description: this ability allows you to carry infinite amount weapons with you
summary: The ability to carry an infinite amount of weapons
strengths: you never run out of weapons
you're basically invincible in armed combat
the weapons are weightless when carried
weaknesses: so many weapons to choose from may be hard for someone

name: Omnipotent Power Mimicry
description: You can have every power in the world. You are also able to sense when a new power has been discovered, and you will know what it is. But you can only use one power a day, e.g. when someone needs to be saved from a moving train, you can choose to use super speed, but you are then stuck with that power until the end of the day (12:00 am).
summary: The ability to have every power in the world
strengths: You have every power in the world
You can sense when a new power has been discovered
You can choose what power you want to use
weaknesses: You can only have one power a day
You have to choose wisely

name: Shifting Elements
description: A advanced combination of telekinesis and alchemy. Through simple hand movements, you can lift something up, change their shape, size, properties and state of matter.
summary: The ability to change and control all know elements through hand controls
strengths: Makes you very dangerous and powerful.
Because you can control yourself, you can enhance and rebuild yourself.
It enables flight and other powers derived of the main powers.
weaknesses: If you don't understand physics/chemistry, you can't do that much.
The kryptonite of this power is fermium.

name: Ultimate Shapeshifting
description: You can shapeshift into any living, non-living (except corpses and such), or inanimate object you want, even something of different sex! If the thing you turn into has memories (such as elephants, humans, dolphins, or computers), you gain those memories in that form, but only while in that form. Also, when in a form that retains memories, the memories of that person or object (computer, etc. ) update psychically.
summary: The ability to become anything.
strengths: Shapeshift into any living, non-living, or inanimate object you want.
Impersonate anyone you want :P You are indetectable and untrackable.
Disguise yourself as anything from a speck of dirt (not recommended) to a tree to hide from anyone!
weaknesses: Heavy mental stress from memories and such can lead to mental problems. (In 30% of people)
Changing into inanimate objects can lead to temporary side effects, such as half-shifting.

name: Psychic Powers
description: Every day when you wake up, you'll have a psychic power. This psychic power will change every day. You can only have one psychic power each day. These psychic powers include but are not limited to: psychokinesis/telekinesis, telepathy, clairvoyance, levitation, astral projection, precognition, ect. because there are only so many psychic powers, the you will eventually re-attain psychic powers that you have already had before.
summary: The ability to have a different psychic power every day
strengths: New psychic power every day
weaknesses: Allowed only one psychic power a day

name: Reality Effect Manipulation
description: This ability does not controls realities/dimensions just its effects on things within it. In some cartoon and anime shows when a character(s)enters a different dimension and they get stronger or weaker. This ability manipulate that those effects. The user can make himself stronger and other as well. He can be creative when dealing with enemies. The user can make their reality feel like poison or acid to them and no one else would suffer to the effects.
summary: The ability to control or change how realities/dimensions affects people, objects, or etc. to give them effects.
strengths: Make you or other things stronger or weaker.
Give unique effects to targets or yourself.
Never be the victim of effects of alternate realities/dimensions
weaknesses: The effects are only temporary if the user away from target.
Has a limit on targets when using this ability on multiple targets.
Does not controls realities/dimensions only its effects on things within it.

name: Molecular Machinery
description: A person with this power has the ability to create nanomachines out of particles in the air. Also known as Synthesis. This power allows the user to create many things that are only possible in a lab and some impossible. For example they could create machines that would improve the efficiency of their own body or create tiny energy generators that are highly efficient. The only limit to this power is the inability to manipulate after a certain size and the available resources in the air
summary: The ability to create tiny functional nanomachines out of loose particles floating in the air
strengths: Can create any nanomachine as long as you have the necessary comp
Can become creative with this power
Also comes with the ability to sense microscopic things within surrounding air
weaknesses: Machines only have a single purpose after being created and the creation must happen in your hands
Need to have some understanding of chemistry to avoid dangerous reactions
Can't create gigantic objects only nanomachines

name: Elemental Life Force
description: This ability gives one a life force of an element. This is different from aura. Auras surrounds a person, while a life force is the spiritual energy of a person that keeps a human alive. The user will run on an element like fire, water,Copper, Helium,etc. If they are near an element of that matches to their life-force, then they get stronger. Of course, if you see fighting animation, the user can releases life-force to perform elemental attacks.
summary: The ability to be powered by a life-force of a specific element (natural or periodic).
strengths: Power up by element(natural or periodic)
Create Elemental life-force attacks
weaknesses: If you use it up, you die

name: Self Existence Manipulation
description: Did you ever looked in the mirror & said "I wish was something else"? Then fret no more! With this ability you can recreate everything in your life from your body and your soul, to the very fabrics of your essence the made you real. Imagine the possibilities of being your own creator; now you can decide if you can die or not. Decide how you are seen, heard, or felt by others? Or not at all. Or remake from how your life began. This ability also enables the creation of new super abilities.
summary: The ability to manipulate or recreate how you exist in this universe
strengths: The possibility of becoming one's own designer is limitless.
Death will be ultimately impossible for someone who can decide if he can die or not.
Can create new abilities for yourself
weaknesses: Transformations are permanent
Requires so much imagination it is utterly useless to someone who thinks with his fist

name: Elemental Iris
description: You can control elements such as fire, water, earth, air. And can change elements just by blinking and thinking of an element, which will change your iris color to that elements color. Power can be evolved to control more than the classical elements, for example lightning, metal etc.
summary: The ability to control elements
strengths: Can burn, freeze, or electrocute by blinking.
No side-effects
Powers won't work unless you want them to.
weaknesses: Takes lots of practise to evolve to power

name: Infinite Supply
description: The ability to give an item or container an infinite supply.  I. E: An infinite amount of water in a bottle
summary: The ability to give any item/container an infinite supply.
strengths: Limitless supply of ammunition in a magazine
Feed Africa
Unlimited McDonalds
weaknesses: Concentration is needed for larger objects
Not all effects are permanent
Taxes

name: Function Mimicry
description: This ability can make someone the ideal carry-on tool. An example would be if the user mimicked the function of a hammer. Then they would be able to pound things like a hammer. You will have some of the strength and/or weakness of the tool that you mimicked. You won't actually turn into the object. You'll just be able to do what the object does. You can even absorb materials that one of the mimicked functions need like bullets if you had mimicked the function of a gun.
summary: The ability to mimic an object's primary function.
strengths: Can mimic any object that has a function.
No more need for object.
Have some of the strengths of the object.
weaknesses: Have some of the weakness of the object.
Only works on objects that have a function.
You need to understand the function and how it works.

name: Teleportation
description: With this ability, you can teleport yourself to anywhere in the world.  If you've seen the movie "Jumper", you teleport in a similar fashion.  That movie was horrible, by the way.  Anyways, you might be worried about teleporting while moving, or teleporting onto a moving vehicle.  That's all taken care of.  Your teleportation ability keeps you from teleporting into situations where you could get killed.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself to any location.
strengths: Go anywhere, anytime, instantly
Never be late for work--as long as you can get your ass out of bed
You can totally mess with your friends
weaknesses: Car rides seem slow as hell
You might be considered dangerous

name: Electric Powered Strength
description: A person with this power can achieve many physical based powers including superstrength and speed by absorbing electricity. This also renders the user immune to any electrical attacks since all electric attacks only serve to strengthen/heal the user. The user can also absorb electricity actively through touching objects with electricity-later on they can do this from farther distances.
summary: The ability to absorb electricity to heal and/or boost natural physical capabilities to superhuman levels
strengths: Can eat electricity or absorb it through your skin with no problems-this includes draining batteries
Once you get a good charge going you can go on even footing with superstrength users
Can drain the power of machinery or batteries and even powe through touch to accelerate your healing
weaknesses: No ranged attacks-can't shoot lightning etc, but can still throw objects
Need a source of electricity to get power from but you naturally have some degree of extra strength
Absorbing electricity is subconsious so you need to active control it to not drain your electronics

name: Hacking
description: This power enables the user to easily hack into any computer network, password or hand-held device, to access   information the user needs. This works on electrically activated doors and stuff like that.
summary: The ability to hack anything
strengths: Can get any info from anywhere
Never forget your password
A job is ready set up at the F.B.I
weaknesses: Doesn't help fight anything
Limited when accessing networks by computer capacity

name: Petrifactive Hibernation
description: The user can transform themselves into a statue in order to heal and be prevented from further harm, and returns to normal when they have fully healed.
summary: The ability to enter a dormant state as a statue, from which the user emerges fully rejuvenated.
strengths: Cannot feel any pain when in statue form.
Advanced users may be able to become unbreakable stone (thus negating the first con).
weaknesses: In statue form, the user may be chipped, damaged or completely fragmented.
If the user is not experienced, they may not be able to restore themselves.
Others may be able to restore the user before they have fully healed.

name: Portal Mastery
description: Your body acts as a doorway to the inside of a worm-hole, except with total control. Portals to anywhere in the universe or simply a portal to keep people trapped in dead time (can be used to trap enemies or transport people as you can bring them out of it no matter where you are. ) When inside, time ceases to exist. There is no aging, no starving- time simply stands still.
summary: The ability to open portals to anywhere you can see in your mind, for travel or isolation in suspended time.
strengths: Easy access to place you can see in your mind.
You have an easy alternative to killing bad guys (if it's not your thing. )
Can carry an infinite number of people within yourself. Could one day save the entire planet.
weaknesses: If you are knocked unconscious as you enter your portal, you'll be that way forever and never return
Know where you're opening a portal to. If you open one and step out onto the sun, you die.
Opening multiple portals puts an overwhelming amount of stress on your mind and could knock you out.

name: Ultimate Kinesis
description: You can fully control any element or substance, such as fire, water, metal, space, time, blood, and many others.
summary: The ability to control any element known to man.
strengths: Can defeat anyone.
Controlling any power is easy.
Impressing your friends could never get any easier.
weaknesses: You can only control five elements at a time.
Combining powers takes time.
You can be a threat to your loved ones.

name: Space/Time Manipulation
description: Einstein once theorized that space and time were linked. He was right. A person with Space/Time Manipulation can slow, speed or stop time. They can also travel through time and teleport.
summary: The ability to manipulate space and time
strengths: See what really happened in all those battles
Go to all the great cities free of charge
No contest in fights
weaknesses: Takes monumental effort to use
Cannot rewrite history, as the universe protects itself and sends you back
If you touch your past self, you will die in an explosion

name: Lexiconicy
description: How cool would it be to have any object you ever wanted? With the Lexiconicus power, that is possible! All you have to do is write the word out, and clap your hands together, and presto the written word actually becomes what it stands for. No pencil or paper necessary! You can write the word in mid-air with your finger! Need to escape a sticky situation? No problem, just "write" the word 'jetpack', clap your hands together and you instantly have a jetpack to blast out of the area with!
summary: The ability to transform a written word into the actual object
strengths: You can have anything
Add on an adjective to enhance the word
weaknesses: Must be able to spell, major backfire if spelled incorrectly
Only works with nouns (people, places, things)

name: Door To Anywhere
description: With this ability you can turn any door into a portal that connect to any door of your choosing anywhere in the world. The portal closes as the door does and cannot be reopened except with this ability. This ability also applies to anything that acts like a door, including chest lids or cupboards.
summary: The ability to use any door as a portal to any other door in the world.
strengths: Go anywhere with a door
Evade enemies easily
weaknesses: Others can follow you through your portals if the door does not close.

name: Answers
description: With this power whenever you ask someone a question while looking directly at them they will automatically give you a truthful answer. If you're looking at a person through a window, glasses, or a screen this power does not work.
summary: The ability to cause people to truthfully answer any question you ask them while look at them
strengths: You can make people answer any question truthfully
weaknesses: You have to be looking at them

name: Indestructability!
description: With this ability, you are immune to most kinetic damage. Your bones and blood become infused with a new element which is aware of you. Your teeth and skeleton become about 220 times stronger than steel. Your body mass stays the same. Your blood and organs become a "smart fluid" and will become 8 times tougher than steel when you scream "Indestructability! ", or when extreme danger is detected. You shut off the power mentally or by saying indestructability off.
summary: The ability to be immune to kinetic attacks when you activate this power.
strengths: Bones become 220 times tougher than steel while maintaining a degree of flexibility.
You can make the rest of yourself indestructable by yelling "Indestructability! "
Can be turned off. Permanent indestructable bone and teeth!
weaknesses: If someone else discovers the secret element/drinks your blood, they can turn durable/indestructable
Only stops kinetic force. Power is infused with bone(it has to in order to work).
Your bone and blood cells still depend on calcium for other things. Permanent indestructable bones!

name: Memory/Sight  Jump
description: The person with this power is able to teleport to places which he or she has been too. The person cannot jump or teleport to places they have not seen or been to. There is no distance restriction for this power. If you have seen the place or been to the place you want to go, you can go there. When they jump, they leave no traces of smoke or light whatsoever
summary: The ability to jump or teleport to places you have visited in the past
strengths: Can travel to anywhere in the world as long as you have been there
Can stop enemies who are creatures of habit.
weaknesses: Cannot go to places you have not seen or been to

name: Comic Word
description: If you say boom looking at a car it explode. If you say whoosh looking at something that thing will fly. And so on.
summary: The ability to say comic words and make them happen
strengths: No physical exhaustion.
Can be done from a safe distance.
You get to read comics!!!!!
weaknesses: If some one shuts your mouth it is useless.
Does not work with food in mouth.
Say it by mistake would activate it.

name: Great Good Videogames Orders
description: create any terrific game that the owner of this superpower wants, regardless of whether video games were lousy before using this superpower and regardless of whether video games were once so good that can not be further improved. You can create any game, whether for video game consoles or Internet.
summary: The ability to have any terrific game that you want created
strengths: You can not make bad games
No need for lousy games since no effort is needed to create really good ones
No real limit on this super power's games
weaknesses: You could get in trouble for copyright infringement
You can also create a very short game
If your games are terrible they will switch to something better

name: Desiderium
description: Desiderium is latin for "desire" . The user knows exactly what people desire, and can make those desires come true if they choose to do so. By focusing on a specific person, the user can know their every desire, from the smallest ones, to the greatest one of all. If the user wants to, they can make desires come true, except the desires to cause harm or death to others, or to take a persons free-will away. The user can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes.
summary: The ability to know exactly what people desire, and make them come true
strengths: Know exactly what other people desire
Make desires come true
User can use this power on themselves, which would be like granting their own wishes
weaknesses: Can't make desires come true if they cause harm or death to others, or take a persons free-will away

name: Ultimate Technopath
description: With this power, you are basically a god. Since our society is so dependent on machines, any piece of technology anywhere is within your power. You can control a nigh limitless army of technology that can continue to grow if you set up a few factories and program them to mass produce. The only problem with this power, you need absolute focus. If you're surrounded and battling six war fronts at once, your brain will shut down as if a computer from too much lag.
summary: The ability to control any technology anywhere in the galaxy
strengths: Godly in this time
Control all tech
Other technopaths can't touch this, you overpower them.
weaknesses: Focus, you need lots of it.

name: Force Manipulation
description: You can control gravity, electromagnetism and all types of force. You can control friction and slow things down, gravity to make things weightless. This is only limited by your imagination. Also, you have a more advanced control over these forces.
summary: The ability to manipulate all forces
strengths: Levitate your car in traffic
Make surfaces slippery
Pretty dangerous
weaknesses: Too dangerous for supervillians

name: Perfect Self Control
description: With this power, you have complete and utter perfect, easy, and continuous control over yourself, thus preventing you from ever being controlled, manipulated, and corrupted by outside forces. As a side effect of having this power, you also have perfect, easy, and continuous control and use of any and all of your special, superhuman, and supernatural powers, abilities, skills, and talents too.
summary: The ability to have perfect control over one's self.
strengths: Never be controlled, manipulated, or corrupted by anything ever again.
Never lose control of any of your powers.
Have extraordinary willpower that is beyond anyone or anything.
weaknesses: Nothing bad whatsoever.

name: Natural Talent Power
description: With this power you can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers. For instance if your natural talent is singing you will become the best singer ever and your singing will be hypnotic. If your natural talent is baking you will make the best breads and other baked goods ever and they will be able to cure diseases. If your natural talent is writing you will become the best writer ever and whatever you write will become true.
summary: The ability to increase your natural talents
strengths: You can increase your natural talents to the point where they become super powers
weaknesses: You cannot increase the natural talents of others

name: Personal Realm
description: With this power, the user can create a world outside of this dimension. This world will have the user's own rules, laws of physics, look, etc. A portal must be made on a "marker" in this world that has a counterpart in the user's world. The marker can be either a tree, a rock, a doorway, etc., but there is only one marker. You can make as many realms as you want, but only one at a time.
summary: The ability to create your own realm.
strengths: Cool place to hang out
In your realm, you are a god
If the real world is about to be destroyed, you can bring people to your world and save humanity
weaknesses: Takes lots of practice, meditation, and work to make the world and portal stable
If the portal is destroyed, there is no way into or out of your personal realm
The only portal into the realm cannot be moved.

name: Body Reformation
description: When any of your body parts explode or get cut off,  they'll desintegrate into clouds.   Those clouds will then gather automatically to reform your body to it's original form.   Even if your whole body gets divided into countless pieces, you'll still reform.
summary: The ability to completely reform your body
strengths: Killing you permanently will become difficult
You won't ever permanently loose any of your limbs, or head
weaknesses: The pain before you would need this power
This power has no offensive purpose

name: Master Of Combat
description: The user is able to learn any form of martial arts that currently exist just by reading the martial arts or hand to hand combat moves from the respective manuals . However, the user is only able fully master a total of eight forms of martial arts
summary: The ability to instantly learn any form of martial arts just by looking at its basic movements
strengths: Can combat any opponent hand to hand.
Dont need to spend hours on training.
Easily defeat weak opponents that are horrible at hand to hand combat
weaknesses: The total of martial arts that can be mastered
Not strong enough to combat the major powerhouses

name: Shadow Walking
description:
Basically, you could walk into a shadow of an alleyway by your house, and walk out of an alleyway in Paris or something. Zing! 

Or even walk into a shadow here, and come out of a shadow on the dark side of Mars! (or any planet)

The only downside is you might get lost in the 'Shadow Realm' you have to pass through.
summary: The ability to teleport through shadows
strengths: Shadows are basically everywhere
Super-easy to walk into people's houses
Cool party trick/ good for escaping
weaknesses: You might get lost getting from place to place
If you fell into a shadow, you might end up on Mt. Everest.................
Probably not the easiest power to control

name: Psionic Energy Manipulation
description: This ability is, basically, the psychic equivalent of induced radioactivity. A person can absorb limitless amounts of psionic energy without harm, and emit it at will in small amounts or in a huge blast similar to a shockwave from a supersonic jet. You can even control bursts of energy in your hands, similar to small atomic explosions, like what someone with induced radioactivity could do.
summary: The ability to absorb and emit powerful psionic energy at will from both the mind AND the body
strengths: No psychic could ever hope to read your mind or control you!
Your power is great in a fight!
You could eventually develop psychic powers with enough practice!
weaknesses: Psionic energy bursts can be lethal to others
Extreme levels of power can fatigue you very quickly, and gradually weaken your power

name: Elemental Weapons
description: With this power you can create weapons out of air, water, fire, and earth, along with variations of the elements like storm or ice. As long as you are near the element, you can create any type of melee weapon you want. You could make a whip out of storm clouds, a mace out of rock, a trident out of water, or a sword of fire. The weapons are solid, but they retain properties of the element you created it from. For example, fire weapons can burn, ice weapons freeze, and storm weapons can shock.
summary: The ability to form weapons out of the elements
strengths: Can create any type of melee weapon you want, including shields
The weapons are solid and nearly indestructable
Weapons keep elemental properties (fire burns, ice freezes, etc. )
weaknesses: Need to be near the element to create a weapon
Limited to melee weapons, no guns, bows, etc

name: Unlock True Potential
description: You have the power to unlock someone's true potential.   You might do this by some personalized ritual or by placing your hand on that person's head and scanning for the hidden power within that person.   When you unlocked someone's true potential then that person will have all his/her abilities increased to the potential maximum for that person.
summary: The ability to unlock someone's true potential
strengths: The person with unlocked potential will be gratefull
weaknesses: You can only unlock the true potential of someone else

name: Tactile Superpower Creation
description: This ability allows one to use material/Living thing and give it a different use.  The limit is the user's creativity, and what kind of material or thing it is?  Example, The user was holding a #2 pencil. Now, he can turn it in to an ability like Lead beam, wood bombs, or even a combination. If a user touches another super-being, they can use their abilities as well.
summary: The ability to turn anything the user touches into an external superpower that they can use.
strengths: Create new powers
Take control of anything and make them useful
Use another super being's abilities
weaknesses: Limited by user's creativity
Limited by what kind of material/ living thing it is
Must be able to touch something

name: Hysteresis
description: Also called Effect Delay, Lag Inducing, Delay Inducing, Delay or Lagging, this is the ability to psychically cause a quantum-mechanical lag in time between causality and the resulting effects. One with this ability could cause a gun to go off seconds, minutes or hours after the trigger is pulled, or could cause a bomb to go off far after the detonator is pushed (or delay an explosion after methane has been introduced to a flame). One with this ability could even delay the reflexes of foes, etc.
summary: The ability to induce a metaphysical delay between cause and effect
strengths: Delay harmful biological/chemical reactions (explosions, acid burn, poisoning, disease symptoms etc)
Delay physical reactions (reflexes, body's processing of sensory stimuli, gag reflex, etc)
Delay mechanical/technological/electronic reactions (tripping motion sensors, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot delay something unless you know the cause and its projected effect (NCN)
Cannot delay effects indefinitely (must set time period--seconds/minutes/hours/days, etc) (NCN)
Unpredictability and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Solar Eater
description: This ability allows you to absorb the energy generated by stars by absorbing the energy it will produce in years to come, up to a maximum of 6000 years per day.  As such the star in question will age at a faster rate.
summary: The ability to absorb potential energy generated by stars.
strengths: An immense energy supply everyday.
It will take a long time before draining a star of all its energy.
If you're not immortal, or can't reicarnate, you don't have to worry about the consequnces.
weaknesses: It will take a long time before draining a star of all its energy.
You have to be within it's light range to use this ability
If you are immortal, pray that you can still survive on a planet deviod of life.

name: Thought Weaponary
description: Create and manifest all types of solid/normal weapons by use of mental energy. Any weapon you create can have any effects you want, evben ones that are fictional (within boundaries).
summary: The ability to manifest various types of weapons through your imagination.
strengths: Through your imagination you'll able to create and manifest any weapon imaginable.
The weapon you create can have a number of special attacks you choose
weaknesses: You must focus for your weapons to manifest from your imagination/mind.
Manifesting any weapon from your mind can tire you out.
Manifesting too many weapons in a short amount of time will result in a coma or death.

name: Library
description: With this power it will be as if you've read every single book ever written be it a picture book, comic book, novel, encyclopedia, bible etc. You will be able to quote and understand any book without ever even seeing it. You can also read the books in your mind.
summary: The ability to know the contents of every single book ever written
strengths: You have every book ever written in your mind
You can read books in your mind
You don't ever even have to see the book
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Magno Solar Absorption
description: This ability allows you to absorb the sun's energy, and the energy of it's magnetic field, through UV exposure. You can store that energy in your mind and body indefinitely without harm, and emit it at will to create magnetic fields, fireballs, ultraviolet rays for weaponry, and also heat generation.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy and magnetism of the sun for a weapon
strengths: You are naturally immune to the harmful effects of this power, so sunburns and cancer are history!
You can control vast levels of magnetic energy for any desired use, even to fly!
You can develop other powers such as pyrokinesis with time and practice
weaknesses: An extremely deadly power in the wrong hands!
Magnokinesis and pyrokinesis are difficult to harness at first
Your ultraviolet weapon can be deadly to everyone around you

name: Density Control
description: You can manipulate your density to any range. From incredibly dense, indestructible body to ghostly intangibility. You can get hit by a car and not get hurt or let the car pass through you.
summary: The ability to become intangible or indestructible
strengths: Great for pranking people
Can't be hurt by bullets
Can sink and rise from the ground
weaknesses: You might fall if you become dense on a high building
Tag will never be the same

name: Words Of Power
description: This ability could be very powerful, if developed. It allows the user to change words, no matter what form they're in, into reality. When they first start out, the user would have to right down the word and then say it. For example, they could right down "sword" and then say it, and a sword would appear where you wrote it. After more development, the user could simply say "sword" and it would appear. After this, all they would need to do is think it. This can work with any word or language.
summary: The ability to turn words into reality
strengths: Words to reality
Very powerful
Can work with any word or language
weaknesses: Almost no one progresses to the thought stage.
Some words will take a lot out of you (death, life, destroy, etc. )
Takes time to develop

name: Will Power
description: Imagine you or someone you know is in a life or death situation and it is impossible to escape by normal means, well as long as you have the will and desire to save you or the other person, you can. Similar to the green lantern ring, the stronger your will and determination, the faster, stronger, and more durable you are. Can also be triggered by sudden anger.
summary: The ability to will yourself to accomplish feats of superhuman strength, speed, and durability
strengths: Do the impossible with enough determination
The greater the motivation, the greater the power
weaknesses: No willpower, no abilities
Some injuries will be sustained no matter how durable you become

name: Tactile Efficiency
description: The overview says it all. The user is capable to make any object work better with him than anyone else through touch. A gun would be able to shot farther and able to hit a target. A computer can be used for hacking. Etc.
summary: The ability to make any object or tool work/perform better when you are touching it.
strengths: All objects/tools can be used better to almost supernatural levels.
weaknesses: Touch activates the power.

name: Omni Solid Manipulation
description: You have complete control over all solids. It doesn't matter what kind of material it is, as long as it's solid, you can control it. Earth, trees, metal, objects, you name it. You can destroy something and put it back together, stop the momentum/velocity of something. You can even control humans' bodies/motor functions with this power. You could cause a lot of destruction with this power or use it for good, and enforce world peace.
summary: The ability to manipulate anything that is a solid or is solid matter.
strengths: Cause massive destruction and devestation by causing the very terrain to burst asunder.
Control ANY solid matter, no matter how small or large.
Form armor weapons even MINIONS out of solid matter.
weaknesses: You might be worshipped as a god.
If no amount of solid matter is nearby.
You only control solids with this power, nothing else.

name: Enhanced Teleporting
description: The user of this ability can teleport themselves and objects through time and space. The person has to be touching the object but does not have to travel with it. The user of this ability must concentrate on the place and/or time they want to teleport to.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself and objects through time and space
strengths: The user can teleport through time
The user can teleport anywhere
weaknesses: The user can time travel but does not have any other time-controlling abilities

name: Limited Reality Manipulation
description: The limitations are: cannot directly affect the lives of others and no dictatorship.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality with certain limitations
strengths: Manipulate reality
weaknesses: Cannot directly affect the lives of others
No dictatorship

name: Mimic
description: You can copy an opponent's power by many means. All bad features of powers are taken away. These powers are with you forever and cannot be mimicked by another person with this power.
summary: The ability to mimic almost anything.
strengths: Many abilities.
Almost unbeatable.
All bad self-harm powers have bad features taken away.
weaknesses: You are a copycat.

name: Shape Shifting
description: With this ability, you can morph yourself into any shape or size.  You can take on the appearance of other people, change into the shape of inanimate objects, and recollect yourself instantly (i.e. if you're glass and you shatter).  Just in case, you will always know how to "reset" into your original form (the way your body looks right now).  You can't increase your mass, but you CAN decrease your mass by leaving some behind.
summary: The ability to morph yourself into any shape or size.
strengths: Make yourself ridiculously good-looking
Spying on people
Morphing into someone else
weaknesses: You'll probably want to keep your ability a secret

name: Regeneration
description: At will, you can rewrite your DNA to take on a completely random, but human appearance. Your height, figure, skin and hair colour can all change. You gain a slightly different personality but keep your memories, due to nature vs. nurture. You automatically use this power when mortally wounded, though, if you die too quickly, you cannot regenerate. If you are about to die of old age, you regenerate into a different form. The new form taken is usually younger, and is always of the same gender.
summary: The ability to reincarnate and heal
strengths: Very difficult to be killed
Can change your appearance as much as you want
Can live forever if you want, unless you suppress your power
weaknesses: Have to watch everyone else die
People will have trouble getting used to your new face
You may prefer a previous appearance, which you can't get back

name: Location Mimicry
description: If you are underwater you may gain Breathe Underwater,  Hydrokinesis power, etc. This power basically aids you in the environment you are in. It doesn't help you fight, but makes you more comfortable, in a way.
summary: The ability to gain powers to aid you in the environment you are in.
strengths: You gain powers to aid you.
weaknesses: Doesn't aid you in battle.
No defense or offense protections/advantages/etc.

name: Quantakinesis
description: One with this ability can psychically manipulate the quantity of nearly anything they encounter. Adding grows matter in size, or fuses different bodies of matter together. Subtracting shrinks matter in size,, or separates matter into different bodies. Multiplying generates numerous copies of whole bodies of matter. Dividing causes matter to split into smaller copies. One can also use fractions, integers, squares/cubes, roots, absolute value, equations, inequalities, logarithms, etc.
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate numbers and quantities
strengths: Change how much of anything you have (infinite food, flawless counterfeiting, etc. )
Perfect combo of Size Shifting, Replication, Fusion and Fission, if used on self
Affect matter with fractions, squares/cubes, roots, logarithms, matrices, equations, roots,etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't improve your actual math skills, or control the outcomes to math problems...
Cannot affect space or time until developed (NCN)
Cannot reduce matter to zero, or divide by zero until developed (NCN)

name: Bullet Generation
description: The power holder is able to actually make/create bullets for firearms or various reason, of all types, and sizes, from nothing or by shaping the existing matter or energy.
summary: The ability to generate bullets
strengths: Make bullets anytime
Carried firearms can be loaded with bullets
weaknesses: Bullets have to be fired to be effective
May be limited to only making what the user knows

name: Ability Access
description: The holder innately knows about all available abilities of any kind, can know everything about them, can choose to acquire them, from something like a Universal Database. No Omni powers, limit is ten per day. The user cannot have powers forcefully added and also comes with enhanced memory to remember powers.
summary: The ability to gain abilities from a mental link.
strengths: Can add powers freely to yourself (ten per day)
Alternative to god level abilities
You choose powers (cannot be forced to take self destruction powers)
weaknesses: Only ten daily
No god level abilities

name: Astrakinesis
description: Also called Ectokinesis or Psychic/Astral/Spirit/Spiritual Energy/Ectoplasm Manipulation, this is the psychic ability to manipulate ectoplasm, psychic and astral energies (and ectenic force, which allows telekinesis). One with this ability can summon and launch astral, psychic or ectoplasmic energy as rays, concussive beams, astral shrapnel, etc. This ability could even be used to perform or induce Astral Projection, augment certain psychic abilities and affect spiritual manifestations with ease
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate psychic energy, ectoplasm and ectenic force
strengths: Induce or prevent Astral Projection (by yourself and others) and enhance certain psychic abilities
Cause ghosts and spirits to manifest, keep them from manifesting, and harm them with ease
Cover everyday objects in astral energy to use as weapons
weaknesses: Can't manipulate magic
Can't communicate with or control ghosts (even though you can harm or rejuvenate them)
Can't totally destroy a spirit (similar to the first law of thermodynamics)

name: Self Matter Manipulation
description: Let me give you some examples, in case you don't understand. You could go up to a tank and absorb it into your body. You would look and feel the same... But you could instantly generate the turret on your back and blast away.   Also you could absorb a piece of candy and then endlessly keep creating that piece of candy in your hand/mouth/anywhere on your person.   Absorb a diamond and have diamond like skin. Absorb bullets when they are being shot into you.   An ultimate physical ability.
summary: The ability to absorb things into your body then from your body dispense infinitely what you have absorbed.
strengths: Never go hungry, because you can dispense what you absorbed.
Become ultimately powerful and dangerous.
Endless possibilities.
weaknesses: Can't stop mind control

name: Tactile Electrokinesis
description: This is a very powerful, and very rare, form of electric manipulation. You can touch objects such as sockets, tasers, switches, etc. , and absorb their power. With it, you can create lightning that is controlled by your mind and/or your willpower. You can create electrical balls, bolts, arcs, and almost anything else related to them. There is no limit to the control time of this power.
summary: The ability to control electricity by touching objects powered by it
