strengths: You are naturally immune to your power, even when in contact with water or metal.
Is extremely powerful.
Can be learned and controlled in a very short amount of time.
weaknesses: Strong negative emotions can sometimes make you lose control.
A very dangerous power in the wrong hands!
Despite limitless control time, you always need to touch electrical objects to activate this power.

name: Peak Human
description: With this power, your body would naturally be a perfect specimen of human development and conditioning, which you would never need to maintain whatsoever. Your strength, endurance, agility, speed, reflexes, durability, healing, and intelligence would all be at the highest limits of natural human potential. And you would have complete and utter immunity to any and all illnesses, diseases, disorders, disabilities, poisons, radiation, and the effects of intoxication by alcohol.
summary: The ability to be at the highest limits of natural human potential.
strengths: Physical and mental attributes all be greater than any ordinary human being.
Immune to any illness, and disease.
Never need to exercise to stay in shape.
weaknesses: Can never become drunk.
Not superhuman, but at a level just below it.

name: Water Bender
description: (Water is the element of change) you can manipulate water at will. The source of your power is the moon. With the moon you are ate are strongest. With the full moon you are unbeatable. During the sun you are at your weakest. Air is your weakness. When you master water bending you can blood bend. Know your history
summary: The ability to become a water bender from Avatar the Last Air bender the animated television
strengths: You the power to heal
You can blood bend at higher levels
You can manipulate water
weaknesses: You have a deep distrust and hatred at the fire benders
You hate all fire benders
Blood bending is the most darkest of bending (be afraid)

name: Gravity Manipulation
description: A Gravity Manipulator can use their mastery of gravity for many effects. They can make an object so heavy it collapses under its own weight, or so light it floats. They can cause artificial gravity on walls or ceilings, make a ring of supergravity around themselves that serves as a shield, and with practice, bend light around an object making it invisible. They can even make a single mote of dust colapse and make a black hole, but it usually collapses after five minutes, and knocks them out.
summary: The ability to mentally control gravitational fields
strengths: Very versatile
Impressive to watch
There is nothing you cannot affect
weaknesses: Mainly fueled by emotion, but does take concentration
Crushing things that shouldn't be crushed
Black hole can get a bit out of control

name: Space Time Warp
description: You can warp the space-time continuum at will. You can bend reality however you want. You can create black holes and worm holes. You can time travel and appear at any location in the universe. If your falling to your death you can warp space so that you appear on the ground.
summary: The ability to warp the fabric of the space-time continuum in any way
strengths: You can destroy planets and galaxies
You can bend reality around any projectile so it misses you (bullets, lasers, light)
You can send out warp shockwaves that obliterate matter.
weaknesses: If the space-time continuum ceases to exist, so does your power.

name: Crystallokinesis
description: Also called Ligurokinesis or Crystal Manipulation, one with this ability can psychically control gems, precious stones, minerals, and crystals. This means one can grow crystals and mineral deposits, summon them from one's surroundings (including salt and sugar), and form them into constructs like weapons, armor, shields, barriers etc. The user can alter their size, color, etc as well. At the higher levels, one can even change one type of mineral into another, or extract them from living bodies.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate gems, precious stones, minerals and crystals
strengths: Gems, precious stones, minerals and crystals can now be used as weapons
At the higher levels, even change one type of crystal, gem, mineral or precious stone into another
Great power for a jewel thief
weaknesses: Cannot turn non-crystalline matter into crystal (or vice versa)
Shooting crystal projectiles (bullets, shards, shrapnel, etc) requires accuracy
Everybody expecting expensive gifts (since you can summon diamonds and other precious stones)

name: Seasonal Elements
description: This power allows you to control the major elements as well as the minor elements, depending on the season of the year. Summer: Earth/Nature; Fall: Fire/Lava; Winter: Water/Ice; Spring: Air/Lightning.
summary: The ability to control the elements based on the seasons.
strengths: Control many different elements.
Control the major elements along with the minor elements.
weaknesses: You can only control them when it's the right season.
You can only control one element at a time.
Example: you cannot control air and lightning at the same time, even if it is spring.

name: Electrical Transport
description: The user is able to travel through electrical lines , phone lines or anything that has electrical flowing through it. The traveling source must be continuous. If the line is not continuous , the user is able to remain in electrical transportation form for a 100 feet before reverting back to normal.
summary: The ability to travel using electrical lines, phones lines or anything that has electricity flowing through it.
strengths: Good mode of transportation in the cities
Good for sneaking into building or spying
weaknesses: No electrical cables in rural areas

name: Clockout
description: This ability is perhaps the most fortunate of the chronokinetic abilities. Not only can you travel through time, but both your departure destination and your arrival destination enter a state of temporal stasis when you do. Your "home time" doesn't move forward, and you can do whatever you like in your "destination time". When you return to your home time, time returns to normal
summary: The ability to travel through time, effectively freezing time upon departure and arrival
strengths: Travel to any time (past or future)
Time freezes at your departure point and your destination
If you're good, you can keep time frozen for a short time after you come back
weaknesses: Requires concentration until you develop it (which can get tiresome)
Time controllers can mess up the use of this ability
People with Time Defiance can resist the temporal stasis

name: Pencil Control
description: Whatever you write down will happen.
summary: The ability to make whatever you wrote down come true.
strengths: You would be able to have any superpower or do anything.
You would control almost everything.
Easy to use.
weaknesses: It only works with a certain pencil.
It can only be used once every hour.
If you have a messy handwriting, things won't turn out well.

name: Healing Touch
description: With this ability, you can heal anyone who's afflicted with some sort of illness or wound.  They'll be brought back to 100% health--all you need to do is touch them and they'll instantly be healed.  And of course, you can heal yourself.  No bringing back the dead, though.  Think about it, you might be worried that sexy girl at the bar has something you don't want to catch, but all you've gotta do is give her the healing touch and you're in business!
summary: The ability to completely heal anyone afflicted with any disease or injury.
strengths: Surprise visits to hospitals
You, your family and your friends will always be healthy
Get paid the big bucks to heal people
weaknesses: Everyone who's sick will want you to heal them

name: Manipulate Water
description: You can do anything with water. Freeze it, make it burn, make it steam, have a drink, use it for travel, form ice for making a magnifying lens, use a magnifying lens to burn stuff. Uses any water available to do your bidding to the molecular level. Like arrange the molecules so adhesion brings something up a wall, make stairs or a bridge, or bend light
summary: The ability to manipulate water into anything
strengths: You can make shields of ice or water, lens of ice, steamers, etc
You can force water from or into something like the air
You can control the density, location, temperature, and molecules
weaknesses: Some stuff comes with the water
Doesn't work in very dry areas
The more water you try to manipulate, the more concentration needed

name: Accelerated Healing
description: With this ability, if you get cut, injured, break a bone, etc., you will fully heal within 10 seconds.  You will still have to endure the pain, but you'll feel just fine 10 seconds later. Also regenerates limbs that are cut off.
summary: The ability to heal rapidly from any injury.
strengths: Extreme sports
Rough sex
Jumping out of a 5th story window
weaknesses: Surgical procedures might be difficult

name: Shape Shifter Reality
description: You can turn into person you wish and reality will change around you. Your records will change and you will be a new person. Records will appear for your new form for what you may need or want. It means you have your own place and things your new form would own. People would get memories or would be changed to match your new form. Even your history would be new, but old to everyone else. You can be any age or gender or race.
summary: The ability to shape shift your form and make the world believe that is who you are.
strengths: Start a new life you will want.
Be able to live any type of life you wish
Know what it is like to be a new person
weaknesses: Everyone will forget your true form

name: Power Of Imagination
description:
A simple (but also complex) power that enables the user to turn their imaginations into reality. Your limit is your own imagination and subconscious, because if you think that something is impossible, it will be impossible to you. 
Can also be used to create imaginary creatures and realms that you can control, but this is limited by your logic.
This power could be a gift or a curse depending on the user's own mind and imagination. If you're a dreamer, then this power is absolutely for you.
summary: The ability to turn your imagination into reality
strengths: Can create imaginary friends and realms
Can create new powers by using power
Optimists and daydreamers will find this REALLY useful
weaknesses: People might think that you're crazy if you talk to your imaginary friends
Logical people might not be able to do a lot of things
You can't do anything that you think is impossible

name: Bio Modification
description: You become whatever you want to be, by changing your actual DNA, not just shape-shifting, any ability you want  can be coded into your DNA. IF you can imagine it, you can have it. Only rule you have to remember, is knowing what you have done before. Because you change your DNA, any and all mods will be transferred to your offspring.
summary: The ability to manipulate your dna to change yourself in any way you desire
strengths: Any superpower is yours when you want it.
Invulnerability to practically anything can be coded in
Can rule everything and everyone
weaknesses: Might create a monstrous image if care isn't taken in
DNA might end up messed up so you will need an undo function
Have to remember what abilities you added

name: Avatar Abilities
description: Can control air, fire, earth, and water
summary: The ability to control the four main elements
strengths: Can control elements
Also have super speed and "blood bend"
Can unleash unimaginable power when in "Avatar State"
weaknesses: Can't release self from the world

name: Weapon Summoning
description: This ability grants you the power to summon any weapon(even fictional) into your hands and use it against your opponent. Swords, guns, even light sabers will be at your command, and you will be unstoppable.
summary: The ability to summon any kind of weapon in existence.
strengths: Ready at every moment for a fight
Any weapon you choose
weaknesses: Drains life power, so you cannot use it repeatedly
Makes you tired after repeated use
Might summon the wrong weapon

name: Regenerative Hydrokinesis
description: Regenerative hydrokinesis is one of the strongest known healing powers in nature. With it, a person can fully heal any wounds, ailments, or diseases they may have, as well as others they choose.
summary: The ability to control water to become a healing agent
strengths: One of the strongest forms of healing known to exist
Any injury or disease can be fully healed, and severed or malformed limbs fully regenerated in hours
Works as long as you are near, or immersed, in water
weaknesses: Healing is the only thing you can do with this ability
This ability cannot work with impure water

name: Tactile Magnokinesis
description: This is a very rare form of magnetic manipulation. You can control metal by physical contact with it, or by close proximity to a magnetic field. You can never be harmed by your power, and this is a versatile ability in combat. You can even control the metal in the Earth's core by willpower. A secondary aspect of this ability is flight, which works through magnetic repulsion, exactly like Magneto's ability from 'X-Men'.
summary: The ability to create & control magnetic fields through physical contact or close proximity to metal
strengths: One of the strongest forms of magnetic manipulation known to exist
Is a passive ability, so concentration is never needed to use and maintain it
You can be an extremely skilled and deadly fighter to any enemy!!
weaknesses: You have to touch a metal object to create the energy connection
Flight takes time to learn to control

name: Weaponry Intuition
description: Any object that you hold in your hands can be turned into a weapon by you. The point is that you will know stuff like how to perfectly create a weapon and know how to use it. An example would be sharpening the end of a toothbrush perfectly and using it as a stabbing weapon or modifying a staple gun to fire staples with as much force as a shotgun. Anywhere, anytime, anything, you will find a way to transform the object into a weapon.
summary: The ability to use any object as a weapon
strengths: Best. Assassin. Ever.
Knowledge on how to perfectly use your newly made weapon.
Anything you wield. (paperclip of DOOM)
weaknesses: It doesn't make you Peak Human.
It's only objects small enough that you can actually wield. (No skyscraper weapon)
The power might go to your head and make you become an assassin.

name: I'm Already Finished!
description: Any tough work due next month? What about your graduate thesis, or that novel you were always planning to send to your editor? Want a gourmet meal or a dreamed-up video game? No matter how long or how expensive the undertaking is, you can have a free, finished product within a few seconds.   Here's how it works. Reality is your love slave. If someone asks you about a task you were assumed to be working on, and you choose to answer, "I'm already finished," you'll have the end product. Period.
summary: The ability to immediately have a expertly completed task or workpiece completed when someone asks you for it
strengths: Money and time mean nothing.
If people can make it, -you- can have a free customized version all for yourself.
You can be lazy all day and overachieve in any topic you want.
weaknesses: Someone has to -ask- you about the task. You could ask them to ask you though.
You still have to be subtle, or people might get suspicious.
Task has to be something a person can conceivably do on their own given infinite time and resources.

name: Battlefield Adaptation
description: With this power, you will be able to become stronger in a field of battle. Due to numerous battles and wars being fought in said fields, all the energy, hatred, aggression, and experience from all the fights before strengthens the combatants, allowing them to fight on equal or superior grounds with their opponents. Each battle fought strengthens the user physically, mentally and tactically, slowly turning them into a One-Man Army.
summary: The ability to adapt to the conditions of a battleground, and grow stronger with each battle
strengths: Slowly turn into a One-Man Army
Be prepared in just about any form of battle
weaknesses: The user needs some strength and agility to be more effective

name: Rainmaker
description: With a thought, rainmakers can create, control, or disperse rainstorms. They can help people across the world by ending droughts or averting storms. This power also has combative applications. Rain can be used to blind opponents and make fighting difficult. Floods can wash your enemies away. Summon hail to crush your opponent, or bury them in snow. Experienced rainmakers can solidify their rain into constructs. Rain water meteors or spikes, use rain as shields, the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to summon and manipulate rainstorms
strengths: Help avert natural disasters by relieving droughts or preventing storms and floods
Create conditions that make it impossible for your enemies to fight while you are unaffected
True masters can create aquatic blades, dragons, and other constructs to descend on foes
weaknesses: Controlling rain in an area requires your physical presence
Not full water manipulation or full weather manipulation
Until you learn how to evaporate your rainwater, there's a risk of creating floods when you fight

name: Shadow Kinetic Great Force
description: The user can absorb potential energy around them in order to turn it into a shadowy kinetic repulsive force that can be very devastating. The user will need to absorb a lot of energy in order to make force that powerful.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize potiential energy to create a powerful force.
strengths: Powerful attack
Decent defense
Immoblizes opponents or any object
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving
Need a lot of power

name: Superhuman Habit
description: A person with this ability can specialize in any one action or a limited set of closely related actions and turn that habit into something supernatural in nature. For example a user can practice a single punch repeatedly such that using that punch will generate superhuman amount of force and the amount of force generated continues to grow with every repetition of the same action. Eventually the user may have to limit the times they perform that action because it may become too powerful.
summary: The ability to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of any one action you perform repeatedly
strengths: Can specialize in any one specific action turning that action superhuman in nature
Can be used to gain accuracy, speed, power, efficiency, and other attributes for any action
A customizable power able to adapt it to any one action you desire
weaknesses: May becomes impractical to use overtime ie it becomes overkill
Only applies to one action or set of actions
Action may be useless for current situation

name: Ability Reality Application
description: The user has the ability to turn mundane and physical powers into cosmic phenomenons that have a place in reality. An example of this would be the user having the ability to possess a power punch. With this ability, he can now summon a fist made of metaphysical energies to strike his enemies. This can strain reality if used to many times at one, but give it time, and reality will adjust.
summary: The ability to turns one's physical abilities/powers into reality warping ability.
strengths: Turn any physical power into a force of reality
Control the range of the effects
Reality will adjust to it
weaknesses: No Reality themed abilities
Reality can be damaged if used too many times at once

name: Feather Weight Touch
description: A person with this power is able to make any object or item as light as a feather, regardless of how big or heavy it is. For example, someone with this power will be able to lift a car like it was only as light as a feather. If the item or object leaves the hand or hands of the user, the item or object will return to its normal weight. If the user were to use the item he or she is touching as a weapon, the enemy would feel the full weight of the object.
summary: The ability to make anything as light as a feather by touching it.
strengths: Can easily carry heavy items or objects. Do no need to hire moving men if you were to move houses
Can combat crime
Can be a good first responded in the event of a collapsed building,
weaknesses: None

name: Vision Of Fictional Situation
description: This superpower allows its owner to see how they behave and how they react fictional characters in the position you want, for example Mario departed too fat or Mickey this in a storm only indoors. The results of these situations can be seen.
summary: The ability to see a fictional character in any situation you want
strengths: You can see a fictional character in any situation you want
This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
There are no limits to find out to see what would happen with any fictional character
weaknesses: This superpower only allows viewing and not make it happen, it can be as advantageous as awful
You can see things that can only be seen by mature or adult.
This superpower no use to attack

name: Nuke Clap
description: The owner of this power wields the force of a nuke in his hands. When the owner claps hard enough, a huge blast wave shoots out with the power of a 5 megaton nuke. You don't want to be on the receiving end of this. But if your body can't handle the force of it, then it's a horrible idea to use it.
summary: The ability to Clap with the force of a nuclear blast
strengths: It is very damaging to enemies
It's so much fun to use
weaknesses: It destroys everything in a 20 mile radius
Unless your body can handle the force of it, it will kill you.

name: Dimension Manipulation
description: With this power you could enter, control, and create any dimension. This includes hammerspace, the nightmare dimension, the dream dimension, a dimension of your very own etc. You can change your dimension into whatever you want. In there, you are god. There are also an infinite number of dimensions to explore and control. Ones such as the bacon, mime, maze and almost anything else you can think of. This is all yours to control.
summary: The ability to enter, create, and control different dimensions.
strengths: You have your own dimension.
There's not much you can't do.
You can create and distroy anything.
weaknesses: You might get lost in some dimensions.
You might run out of ideas for new dimensions.
Different dimension,different scientific laws,and different reality.

name: Transmutation
description: You could take a pencil and change it into a high tech rocket. As long as you can clearly imagine it you can change something into it. And it does not have to be realistic, so it could be a futuristic weapon or robot. It could even be nonreal things like monsters. Refrigerators to time machine. Cat to mutant saber tooth tiger. Anything means anything!
summary: The ability to change ANYTHING into ANYTHING else one can clearly imagine
strengths: Becoming the best saleman ever...endless inventory from junk!
Could have anything you want!
You can create and destroy anything.
weaknesses: You must have something to change first.

name: Tactile Sensory Absorption
description: By touching an object the user emits a field that gathers information based on the surface area. A whole newspaper can be read by one sustained touch by understanding the ridges of ink and indentations. People can be detected by touching the floor and emitting field, though if they are suspended in air they would be undetected.   at low levels works in pulses on small objects high levels capable of large areas, radar, vibro-analysis, stresspoint exposure
summary: The ability to gather all information of a surface from a single touch
strengths: High spatial awareness & 3d mind imaging
Able to identify weakspots on touch
weaknesses: Sensory overload if untrained in use

name: Gravity Direction Manipulation
description: This power bends space, but gravitational fields are unaffected. This will result in apparently changing the direction in which gravity pulls. To illustrate: imagine a civilization in a river. The current would be gravity. Now, the ability wielder would be able to rearrange everything, with the current going the same way, eg: they turn the civilization upside down so that the current appears to pull up, making everything fall into the sky. This power could be used for telekinesis and flying.
summary: The ability to manipulate the direction of gravity's pull by bending space.
strengths: Could be used for telekinesis, flying, projection into space.
Would be really cool to make gravity pull upwards so that everything falls into the sky.
Cause chaos easily.
weaknesses: Difficult to use.
Could easily kill oneself, if say, made oneself fall three strories to the roof of a big building.
Limited use.

name: Will Materialization
description: This ability utilizes the mind of the user to materialize his will in the physical world. This enables him to create a myriad of weapons in all forms and sizes he can think of with their own unique abilities. Anything formed by this ability is impervious to change; It will remain as it is in form, composition, ability, purpose, its place in the universe, and its existence in time and space as long as the person 'wills' it to be. The user also perceives everything in the midst of his creations.
summary: The ability to give form or materialize the willpower of the user
strengths: Materialize almost anything you can think of.
Your creations will retain their characteristics no matter what as long as you will it.
Because it originated from your willful mind your creations enable you to perceive your surrounding
weaknesses: Entirely dependent on the willpower of the user making it hard to master.
The speed of materializing an object is dependent on the user's familliarity or knowledge
Imagination is your friend but it is also your limiting agent.

name: Kinesis Collection
description: With this power you are able to manipulate just about all types of 'kinesis' powers from Telekinesis to Chronokinesis. Basically, you are able to use every legitimate kinesis power that is on this site
summary: The ability to use all 'kinesis' powers
strengths: You can use a lot of powerful powers.
You can use multiple at the same time.
weaknesses: Doesn't grant you immunity to kinesis powers of others.

name: Obedience Manipulation
description: This ability can make anything obey to the user even non-living things. The user can make things obey to anything else if they want. This ability can make anything disobedient as well. This could cause anarchies in kingdoms. The effects only go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.
summary: The ability to make anything obey or disobey anything eles.
strengths: Absolute control
weaknesses: Effects go away if the user is not mentally focusing on the victim.

name: Impenetrable Skin
description: Nothing can penetrate your skin, not bullets, blades, needles, ect. In addition, your skin is immune to pain and burn marks. Having this power does not make your skin stiff, your skin is as flexible as usual, it just cannot be penetrated (or burned). Also, if you possess this power, than your bones become unbreakable. This power makes you indestructible and immune to pain, but not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury.
summary: The ability to have impenetrable skin
strengths: Skin is immune to penetration, burn marks, and physical pain
Unbreakable bones
weaknesses: Not immortal; you can still die by any means that isn't caused by physical injury

name: Telekinesis Via Sight
description: Normal telekinesis can work eventhough you cannot see the object you want. For example, if you left you cup behind you you can use telekinesis to bring it to you. However, with this power you must be able to see you cup or the object you want, then only will the user be able to use this power. Anything in the user's field of vision can be moved telekinetically. If the user were to move, resulting in the object he or she is currently levitating to go out of sight, he or she will drop the object.
summary: The ability to move thing with their mind as long as they can see it or have eye contact with it
strengths: Can move things with your mind
Dont need to get your hands dirty
Easily defeat opponents by just looking at them
weaknesses: If you are blinded even temporarily your powers will stop working
Cant use this power in very dark places

name: Accelerated Probability
description: Ever played soccer and wonder how to kick the ball into the goal? With this ability, you can slow things down, see the path before you, and move there with super speed. Once in probability mode, you can see every outcome and mathematically manipulate the odds in your favor!
summary: The ability to predict every outcome.
strengths: Slow down time
Foresee every outcome
Move at super speed to get things done
weaknesses: The ability works consciously (f.y.i you do not predict things constantly)
Can only use super speed in probability mode
You can only physically change the odds (Jet Li using a human shield in The One)

name: Mimicry
description: With this ability, you can mimic the appearance or abilities of any object, person or creature you can clearly imagine. However, you also take on the weaknesses of that object/person. One drawback of this ability is that it's much harder to mimic something you've never seen before, and you CANNOT mimic something which doesn't exist.
summary: The ability to mimic the appearance or skill of any object, person or creature.
strengths: You can transform, and/or gain the ability of any person/object/creature you can clearly imagine.
There is no time limit to how long you can stay in your mimic form.
You inherit all the strengths of your target.
weaknesses: You can't mimic something which doesn't exist. (Ex: a wizard. )
You also inherit the weaknesses of the target.

name: Weapon Manipulation
description: One with this ability can psychically manipulate anything that is intended as a weapon (to hurt, harm or injure). Axes, knives, spears, harpoons, swords, guns, shanks, clubs, whips, bombs, etc. Are all under the user's power, and can be moved around and controlled as though by normal Telekinesis. This can be used to wield the weapon for yourself, or relieve others of their weapons, or even cause a gun to jam up and backfire on its holder. Any weapon is under your complete and total control.
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate anything that is intended to be a weapon
strengths: Makes aim and dodging a breeze (bullets, arrows and crossbow bolts are also considered weapons)
Take weapons away from your foes, and call your weapon to you if you lose it
Do that cool "Matrix" thing where you make the bullets stop in mid-air and drop to the ground
weaknesses: Will not work on any item unless it is intended to be a weapon at the time of its construction
Will not even work on a weapon if was made to be just a display or something
People with MythPower: Olympian Arsenal have weapons that are immune to this ability

name: Control Elements Of Nature
description: With this ability, you can use fire, water, wind, earth, and lightning bolts to your advantage as long as that element was around you. For example, in a rainstorm, you could create water walls. If it's windy out, use the air to fly! Etc...
summary: The ability to control the wind, earth, fire, water, and lightning around you
strengths: These elements are almost ALWAYS available.
This power is great for revenge jokes, or just plain revenge.
weaknesses: Have the potential to cause a tornado, hurricane, typhoon, etc..
Having this power comes with great responsibility.

name: Telepathic Suggestion
description: You can have anyone do whatever you want. Or anything, that is, which has life. You have to picture that person doing what you want them to do, which sends them a mental suggestion of the task to them in their mind. This has a 0. 03% chance of failing.
summary: The ability to make other humans or animals do what you want by thinking of it.
strengths: Everyone is at your command.
Could suggest people into giving you what you desire.
Have animals accompany you, including dangerous predators.
weaknesses: It fails 0. 03% of the time.. Could get hurt while trying to tame animals, etc.
You have to get a picture in your head of the suggestion's result for it to work.
Much more difficult if you do not have eye-contact with the person / target.

name: Physics Application
description: This power allows you to create your very own laws of physics and apply them to yourself or others. You can gain an edge in battle or make a law that gets more work done for less effort. These laws can replace existing ones or coexist with them and you can make as many as you want. You have a perfect memory of all the laws you created and once one law is made you can instantly recreate it at another time. However the laws can not interfere with the workings of superhuman abilities.
summary: The ability to create your own laws of physics to apply to yourself or others.
strengths: Make up your own laws of physics.
Can make a law to boost your chancees of winning.
Have an exact memory of laws you created and can recreate them when you wish.
weaknesses: At first you can only make laws similar to existing ones.
You cant do more powerful laws in the beginning.
Thinking of new physical laws could take a while.

name: Ancient Element Manipulation
description: The ancient elements go in categories starting with the main ones: 1)water, fire, earth, and wind. 2)ice, metal, and lightning. 3)pure light and pure darkness. 4)spirit and mind. This order is also the order of easiest elements to master to hardest elements to master and the order in which the user masters the elements.
summary: The ability to manipulate the ancient elements
strengths: Water, fire, earth, wind, ice, metal, lightning, pure light, pure darkness, spirit, mind
weaknesses: Order of elements: easiest to master to hardest to master

name: Book Of Everything
description: A person with this power has the complete encyclopedia. They can look up anything in the book. The information is constantly updated. Also you can rip out pages in the book. The ripped out pages will also be updated. Other than ripping the book is indestructible. This book does not tell you the future however it does tell you some secrets that are kept from the public. In addition this book is small enough to fit in a person's pocket, but can expand to fit the user's preference.
summary: The ability to have a pocket sized book with which you can research an topic that you will ever need to research
strengths: Handy encyclopedia
The book cannot be destroyed though you can rip pages off and separate the book
The book updates itself over time so that the facts are accurate
weaknesses: People can steal pages from the book and that page will be gone forever until they put it back
Some entries are blank because there is nothing that can be said about it

name: Lucky Strike
description: Alter probability to make the unexpected expected. With this ability, you can be almost certain the traffic light will turn green when you get there, that you will run into certain people under very unlikely circumstances, and that the lottery numbers you picked just might beat the odds. You can manipulate probability so that, if it's unlikely, it will suddenly become the next most likely thing to happen.  What are the odds you'll win that sweepstakes to live at the playboy mansion? You decide!
summary: The ability to manipulate probability, causing unlikely things to happen or likely things not to happen.
strengths: Make amazing things very likely to happen to you
Alter the odds of someone sharting
Turn the odds in your favor
weaknesses: With all this luck it might become boring
But, it probably won't!

name: Ghosting
description: At any time you can activate any combination of the powers of invisibility, phasing, and supersonic flight (though supersonic flight requires you to be in phasing mode). You can cause other objects to be affected as well, so you can fly at supersonic speeds in a car or make you and your friends invisible. The limit on your speed is only limited by how fast you recognize the landscape.
summary: The ability to posses the perceived abilities of a ghost: phasing, invisibility, supersonic flight
strengths: Travel to any location as fast as you desire
Eavesdrop like a pro
Walls and doors: no longer a problem
weaknesses: Affecting other objects requires physical contact
Won't work while asleep or unconscious

name: Power Writing
description: When anything descriptive is written on your skin, you instantly become as the word describes. You can write the words on, or someone else could do it. As the ink fades the described effect weakens, and if the writing disappears it wears off. A tattoo would have a more permament effect. For example, if someone wrote 'drunk' on your arm, you'd instantly become drunk. If you wrote 'super-strong' on your body, you'd get super strength. Drawings have no effect
summary: The ability to change your nature by writing on your skin
strengths: Can give yourself virtually any superpower
Can make yourself 'good-looking', 'healthy', 'rich', 'immortal' etc.
There's a lot of space on your body to write
weaknesses: Someone could write something really bad on you eg. 'dead'
Unless you re-write a description or go over the ink again, the effect will wear off
You'd have to be careful not to accidentally doodle on yourself, or write memos on your hand

name: Photographic Reflexes
description: Athletes have to train for years to throw a football perfectly, perform a championship gymnastic routine, or any other athletic skill. A person with Photographic Reflexes (also called Photographic Muscle Memory) can perfectly replicate any physical event after watching it only once. This means any martial art move, any Olympic dive, and every perfect free throw is totally inside their range. However, superhuman events are not.
summary: The ability to replicate any physical act after watching it once
strengths: Become the star quarterback
Become an amazing gymnast
Be a martial artist extrordinare
weaknesses: Cannot replicate superhuman feats (i.e. flight)
Can still be hurt
Cannot replicate what you haven't seen

name: Physics Distortion
description: Physics covers every physical event, so Physics Distortion is very powerful. Its users can bend natural laws to run up walls, make an object keep its energy and fly in a straight line, change the direction of flying objects, slow down time for objects, and even create a field of megaspace around themselves where space is so condensed traveling an inch in the field is like traveling a mile in our world. It is only distortion, so no natural laws may be broken. It also takes practice.
summary: The ability to bend the laws of physics for a short while
strengths: Run up walls (mess with gravity)
Slow down time for objects (mess with time)
Create condensed megaspace fields (mess with space)
weaknesses: Is only distortion, can't break any laws
Takes practice to consistently do the same thing
Only for about 1 hour consistently

name: Body Snatch
description: This power allows you to "jump" into a person's body (taking your own with you) and you have full control over them. In addition, you have all their memories and once you leave they will have no recollection of what you've done. However, someone with strong will or psychic abilities can resist you from entering. Some psychics might even be able to fight you once you possess them. Otherwise this power works well on most people and if they die you just jump out unharmed.
summary: The ability to hijack and take someone's mind and body
strengths: Full control of another person's body (including their powers)
Victims don't remember anything
Your body isn't left behind and you'll physically be safe
weaknesses: Those with exceptionally strong will can resist you from entering
Some psychics can use their own powers against you

name: The Nexus Key
description: The nexus key is made of a cosmic material, but you may control vast mystic forces, enabling you to create a keyhole shaped portal to travel to countries and through realms, timelines, planets, parallel universes, even to go inside a computer or human bodies and fire disruptive energy beams. The appearance of the nexus key changes depending on who wields it.
summary: The ability to use it to travel to countries, through realms, timelines, planets, and alternate dimensions.
strengths: Can change your size whenever you use this key to go inside human bodies and computers
Could go exploring in what it's like in alternate timelines.
weaknesses: It can be use for extreme evil.

name: Self Attribution
description: This power means that whatever certain attributes you have can be turned into superpowers. Such as you are overweight so you gain a gravitational field or you are skinny enough to slip between atoms or dimensions. It even counts for geneological attributes such as making a slight resistance to disease into virus immunity. It can even give some powers from psychological or ancestry traits.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on physiological, psychological, and other aspects of yourself.
strengths: There could be some good geneological powers.
Many powers.
weaknesses: Immeasurably rare to have a immortality trait.
Some powers you just can't get.
Might not get good ones.

name: Satori
description: This power is used by coming into contact or sending energy waves (radius of 10 Miles). It can heal physical wounds from the slightest scratch, to mutated or severed limbs, cancer, and cure 'in-curable' diseases. It also heals emotional wounds, and can grant ineffable and utter joy and happiness to yourself and others. It can change malign intents into benign intents. It also heals people from their anger, frustration, and any other negative emotions.
summary: The ability to heal wounds, memories, emotions, and give ineffable happiness to yourself and others.
strengths: Extremely Beneficial.
Make this world a better place.
Can cure any negative emotion or physical state.
weaknesses: If your intention is to harm, this power is completely useless.
Hard to focus on other things when power is in use.
The farther away someone is, the less control you have.

name: Metal Kinesis
description: You can control any metal by making it bend, twist, break, float, slide, etc without even touching it! You can also turn objects into metal, but this effect only lasts 24 hours.
summary: The ability to control metal and turn any object into any metal.
strengths: You can control any piece of metal with your mind.
Stop your enemies by turning them into metal.
You can stop metal bullets and secretly steal metal coins.
weaknesses: When you turn something into metal, it lasts only 24 hours.

name: Lifeforce Mimicry
description: Lifeforce is the force existent in living beings that allows them to live. This power lets you turn into this force to manipulate it. You can bring life to inanimate things, heal, and much more. You can also resist death powers because of your abundant life force. If you wanted to, you could take the life from someone or infuse them with life to make them more powerful. In this form you regenerate from damage and can heal from previous injuries. You can also increase your lifespan.
summary: The ability to transform into and generate lifeforce.
strengths: Heal and regenerate.
Unaffected by death powers or ones that manipulate your lifeforce.
Take life.
weaknesses: Long lifespan does not mean immortality or invunerability.
A standoff with death or a reaper.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Spacetime Indemnity
description: This ability renders a person unaffected by the constraints imposed by the forces that represent time/space. Action, perception, experience, when & where he exists in the universe is free to be controlled. This enables one to: move into any space in the known universe with just a single step, perform multiple tasks in different places simultaneously in no time at all, exist in past, present, future simultaneously, act freely even if time stops & exist even in the absence of space.
summary: The ability to be liberated from the physical constraints of time and space.
strengths: Nothing or no one in the universe is far enough or fast enough to escape from you.
You are beyond any speed in the universe & everything you do is completed in the blink of an eye
Abilities that manipulate time and space does not affect you.
weaknesses: This ability does not manipulate time and space around you.
You always change history over and over again and nothing really stays the same.
May drive someone to the edge of insanity due to the overwhelming experience.

name: Tychokinesis
description: This ability is very powerful, because of all the applications. First off, it's more controlled by your subconscious mind then your conscious. It will affect things you're subconsciously thinking about, like paying the rent. But after you gain more control over it, you can become very powerful. Not only can you control chance short-term, but long-term as well. For example, you can warp chance so that everyone who lives in a certain house will constantly be losing their car keys.
summary: The ability to manipulate probability and chance
strengths: You can control probability and chance
You can be very powerful
Long-term warps are possible(without constantly focusing on them)
weaknesses: At first, your subconscious mind is more in control then your conscious.
The larger the warp, the more it takes out of you

name: Umbrakinesis
description: The ability to shape shadows into a 3 dimensional form.  The shadow can only stretch so far.  Shadows can connect to other shadows.  You can only manipulate shadows within a certain range, about 10 feet without connecting to another shadow, but the shadows can stretch farther than that range.  The more light there is, the weaker the shadow is.
summary: The ability to manipulate shadows.
strengths: Can suprise and kill an enemy before they even knew what was going on.
Can cut through steel with shadows
weaknesses: Weakened shadows in the sun
Limited range

name: Full Heal
description: Like the description says, heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
summary: The ability to heal any wound at the blink of an eye.
strengths: Heal wounds.
weaknesses: Nothing.

name: Anabolic Power
description: This ability allows one to tamper with their own powers. They can take two or more simple powers (powers that have only one effect, like basic Pyrokinesis or Aerokinesis) and combine them together to form a more complex and powerful ability, i.e. Pyrokinesis + Aerokinesis gives you the ability to create flaming winds.
summary: The ability to synthesise a new complex power from two or more simple powers.
strengths: Make more complex and powerful abilities.
Can combine multiple powers.
weaknesses: Only works with simple powers.

name: Portal Cutter
description: Someone with this power can use any sharp object such as knives, broken glass, barbed wire, etc to create portals from one area to another. The one making the cut has to concentrate on where they want the portal to go to or the destination will be raandom. The portal will automatically close after the one who made it goes through.
summary: The ability to use sharp objects to create portals from one place to another by slashing
strengths: Perfect escape route since the portal closes when you go through.
weaknesses: Need defensive powers since you'll always be the last one to go through in a group.
Accidentally going into a war zone.

name: The Shield Of Time
description: The shield of time is a mechanism that can control time. It takes concentration to control it, and mastery over it can make you nearly unstoppable.
summary: The ability to control time.
strengths: Never have to wait, you can speed forward to when it is your turn.
Never be late
Can be used as real shield
weaknesses: You don't know what happened during the time you skip
It stops time only in this dimension
Freezing everything including yourself will result in a permanent stop in time

name: Phasing
description: People with phasing don't respect doors. Or walls. Or floors, or ceilings, or cars, or buildings, because they don't have to. At the slightest thought, they become immaterial, and objects pass right through them without stopping. They keep from sinking into the ground by a type of electron repulsion.
summary: The ability to pass through solid objects
strengths: Ultimate thief
Can ignore hallways and go straight to your room
Freak people out
weaknesses: No offensive powers
Unable to phase more than twice your own mass
EMPs can disrupt electron repulsion

name: Dream Realization
description: If you can DREAM it, you can DO it! UGH, so cheesy! But I digress. If you are dreaming and you find yourself doing something you can't normally do, if you remember it when you wake up, then you can do it. This can potentially make you very powerful. Your powers may be as useful as flight or as ridiculous as transforming into a Sailor Moon outfit. This does not apply to objects or events in your dreams, and you can only use powers that you exhibit. You are also incapable of lucid dreaming.
summary: The ability to gain any power that you exhibit in a dream
strengths: Potentially quite powerful
Allows for a unique array of powers that reflect your personality
Much easier to explain your dreams to people
weaknesses: Can only use abilities after you dream them
Does not apply to objects or events
If you only dream in third person you are outta luck

name: Metalkinesis
description: This power is NOT magnetic! The ability to manipulate, create and control metal is highly unique. With Metalkinesis, your thoughts control what you do with the metal. You can use a bullet to create a shield, adding metal seemingly by magic. Create full body armour or convert the metal to liquid form without heat. Extreme heat or cold weaken your abilities, yet you can use them in space. As you age, this power and the control over it grow. It is wise to combine this power with immortality.
summary: The ability to create and control metal.
strengths: An armour is always available.
You can make any weapon with your thoughts.
You can absorb metal and save it for later.
weaknesses: Planets or areas without metal weaken you.
Very big magnets or heroes with magnetic powers make using your power unwise.
You are vunerable to extreme heat or cold when in metal armour.

name: Metamorph
description: A metamorph is anyone who can manipulate their own molecular structure. This lets you become anyone or anything as long as they have the same amount of mass. So they couldn't become something much larger than themselves but, by condensing their atoms, they could become smaller. Some metamorphs become immortal by morphing into a younger version of themselves. A word of caution is necessary here. The more they morph they harder it becomes to return to their true form.
summary: The ability to alter your own molecular structure at will
strengths: You can become anyone or anything as long as they have they same amount of mass.
Immortality
Other powers could be gained (turning into a winged demon capable of flight)
weaknesses: The more you morph the harder it is to return to your true form.
When you condense yourself, you are just as heavy. This could give away a diguise (a 140lb vase)
Can only morph yourself not others

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Traitor
description: With this power, you can bring other people's shadows to life and command them to fight for you. When you animate a person's shadow, it separates from his body and becomes 3-D. The shadow is intangible unless you will it to be solid, making it virtually invulnerable. You can animate multiple people's shadows, giving you command over a shadow army. As your power advances, the shadows will even have the powers their original owners have.
summary: The ability to animate and command other people's shadows
strengths: Shadows have all the skills and, at higher levels, even the powers of their original owners
You can keep the shadows in a pocket dimension and summon them back at any time
Potential for a super-powered, near-invulnerable shadow army
weaknesses: Giving shadows the powers of their original owners takes experience
Commanding large numbers of shadows can be difficult and takes great focus

name: Telepathy
description: A person with telepathy can place his thoughts in the heads of others. They also have mind-reading talent and can attack others using only their thoughts.
summary: The ability to communicate mentally with other people
strengths: Can communicate without speaking
Can pick brains for information
Can fight without having to hit anyone
weaknesses: Unable to affect physical world
Can be blocked by other telepaths
Often mistrusted and feared

name: Force Absorption
description: Abiltiy to absorb and stockpile physical force/kinetic energy in any form, including gravity and telekinesis. Can stockpile this force to use in any way desired like transferring it to a mountain and making it shoot to the moon (depending on how much has been stored. Can use power to freeze things by absorbing the movement of the atoms. This relies on forces that potentially influence user, and user must be in direct contact with the force.
summary: The ability to absorb any physical force like momentum, gravity, kinetic energy, heat,... Etc.
strengths: 100% projectile and cut proof, basically impenetrable.
Can be used to fly
weaknesses: Useless against energy attacks like fire or electricity

name: Chronos Blood
description: With this power you can create and control the Blood of Chronos, a liquid metal pearl-colored substance. You can make it appear from any part of your body. You can cover all your body with it, and then harden it and make a powerful armor, or you can make a melee weapon with it. The Chronos Blood metal is very strong, almost as strong as a diamond and its very light, so you can move freely while covered with it. It is also a non-magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
summary: The ability to create and control a liquid metal substance and then harden it and use it as a weapon or armor.
strengths: A very powerful defensive and aggressive power.
The Blood of Chronos is almost as strong as a diamond and it's very light, perfect as armor.
Chronos Blood isn't a magnetic metal, so magnetism wont affect it.
weaknesses: People with Liquid Control Powers will be able to manipulate it, even if its in solid form.
Blood of Chronos can be frozen in liquid form.

name: Imagination Creek
description: Welcome to the Imagination Creek! You start off with a simple white plane of nothingness. Decide anything you want by imagining it. This is your personal realm and literally anything is possible. Anything. Create a universe, create gravity or others physical forces or not. It doesn't matter because this infinite realm is yours to imagine. This is different than your everyday brainstorming. When you enter the imagination creek, you are actually in it and you will feel and experience everything...
summary: The ability to create a personal realm of infinite space, accessible by entering your own thoughts.
strengths: Create anything you want and interact with it, without boundaries
When in the Creek, reality's time will not pass
Accessible anytime and again, anything is allowed
weaknesses: Only you can enter the Creek (no actual people from reality, but you can make up people)
No one else can see it; no way of bringing it to reality

name: Personality Superpower
description: A person with this power gains a superpower based on their personality. For example, if you have a magnetic personality, you gain Magnetism. If you are a flexible person personality-wise, you can gain an elastic body.  You can only have one power with this ability and your ability can be unique because it is rare that someone will have the exact same personality as you. However, a person with multiple personalities can have more than one power, but can only access one at a time.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower based on your personality
strengths: The power will always become natural to use since it is based on your personality
If you have a split personality, you can have multiple powers
Split personality can give you multiple powers
weaknesses: It's based on your personality

name: Planetary Empowerment
description: The person with this power , by stating the name of a planet; will gain the different powers each planet has to offer. If you shout Mars (invulnerability), Earth (geokinesis), Jupiter (electrokinesis), Mercury (super speed), Venus (florakinesis), Saturn (psychokinetic powers), Ketu (Umbrakinesis), and finally Rahu (illusions). When the planets are alligned, the power and effectiveness of each power doubles
summary: The ability to be empowered by the planets in our solar system.
strengths: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Huge arsenal to take down the powerhouses
weaknesses: You only can use 9 sets in a day ( 1 set is equivalent to all 9 planets )
Magic is one of your biggest enemies

name: Extrasensory Teleportation
description: This power will instantly sends you to a place based on what you decided to do. Example: A person decided to go to the movies, they'll teleport to the movie theater. A person may be able to teleport anywhere, but it means nothing if they don't where to go. That's what makes this teleportation unique.  With advanced training, the user can stop the teleportation at will.
summary: The ability to teleport based on what your next course of action or decision.
strengths: You won't be late.
With training, stop teleportation or teleport ahead of time
weaknesses: Without training, teleport anytime.

name: Supertime
description: With this power, your molecules vibrate so fast and you move so fast that everything around you seems to stop, even time. You can win a race or get revenge. If someone touches you while you're going into supertime, they move as fast as you. But once you turn it off, they return to reality too.
summary: The ability to move so fast that time seems to stop
strengths: Win races
Get revenge
Pull awesome pranks
weaknesses: Tempted to evil
Well that's just about it

name: Dc Superpowers
description: You could have an amazing array of powers with this one. You would have the exact powers of five different DC characters, of your choice. Credit to Vault since this is just the DC-version, with pretty much the same wording, of his Marvel Superpowers.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of five DC characters of your choosing
strengths: You could be like an amazing hero
weaknesses: Might not be five DC characters you want powers from

name: Personal Quantum Calculation
description: When faced with a personal choice, you are able to instantly calculate the consequences of all possible courses of action. The power is limited only to your own choices--you cannot predict the future for another's course of action. You can see the chain of consequences from the point you commit to the action to the point of your death--you can't see how your actions will affect the world after you die.
summary: The ability to predict consequences for all possible courses of action for oneself
strengths: You have the power to choose not to make any mistakes.
You know what personal choices can positively affect others.
You no longer have any need to worry.
weaknesses: The power can easily lead to a life of no risk, which can lead to a life of deep boredom.
The power doesn't help the situation when all courses of action lead to negative consequences.
You can make decisions that benefit the world for the short term, but harm it after your death.

name: Vectors
description: The ability to control invisible and telekinetic arms capable of slicing human flesh, bone and even metal. They are also capable of deflecting projectiles, such as bullets. Vectors are incredibly strong, and can lift extremely heavy objects.
summary: The ability to control invisible, telekinetic arms
strengths: Great way to go on a killing spree.
Only people who share this power can see these "vectors"
weaknesses: Limited range.
Unable to stop certain projectile weapons.
Your vectors cannot stop another user's vectors

name: Physical Shape Shifting
description: Almost like Tonks in HP. You can change only the physical features of your body. (ex. Changing your hair color, length, type or doing your own nose job. ) It's probably good to keep a picture of the person you wish to look like. When you change yourself you must have the desired body part clearly in mind (ex. Hair or nose) before transforming. Remember- You can also change skin color too!
summary: The ability to change only your physical apperance
strengths: Great for spy work! You can look like any person you wish to be.
Never get zits.
Never need a haircut (or a nose job. )
weaknesses: The killer is in the details, so do a lot of research about your person!
Your voice remains the same.
You will not magically become the person you wish to be. You'll just look like them.

name: Blacksmith's Hands
description: A master blacksmith uses the heat of a forge to form metal into any shape he wants. This power lets you do that with your bare hands. At will, your hands are covered in fire, allowing you to heat and then physically bend any metal you want. You are unaffected by the heat. As you grow stronger, you can shape metal with your mind; simply touch it and imagine what you want in to look like. You can bend metal, break it, stretch it, crumple it, the possibilities are only limited by your imagination
summary: The ability to create heat and shape metal with just your hands
strengths: You can bend, break, or reshape anything made of metal: weapons, locked doors, cars
At higher levels, users can develop pyrokinesis, allowing them to control the flames they create
At higher levels, you can simply touch metal and will it to assume whatever shape you want
weaknesses: Requires physical contact with metal even at higher levels
You are only immune to the heat you create, not to other sources of heat
At lower levels you have to physically shape metal; you only gain mental control at higher levels

name: Artifical Intelligence Creator
description: With this power you can create your own AI. You can give the AI tasks and it will preform them with a level of speed and detail unseen in humans. They are able to learn and master skills extremely quickly. Task them to write books, make games,do your assignments for you, or play the stock market at a level of detail no human could match. They will always be loyal, unless your create one not to be. Also you cannot use your PC while they are performing a task, as they will be using it.
summary: The ability to create artifical intelligence contructs and control them
strengths: Have your AI write books, make games, produce animations
Can learn process and master information and skills for optimum results
Live off their work
weaknesses: You cannot use your PC while they work
In order to learn, they can chew though your bandwidth
The wrong people might get suspious

name: Electrophite
description: As an electrophite, you will be able to harness the power of electricity. You will be able to direct it and manipulate it to your will. With time, as your powers develop, you will be able to create electricity from nothing and eventually travel as electricity. You can even travel through power lines and outlets. Unfortunately, this power takes a long time to control, but a relatively short time to develop
summary: The ability to control electricity and manipulate it.
strengths: You can harness and eventually create electricity
Lightning fast travel
Most of the world has electricity to harness
weaknesses: The power is controlled by your emotions. If they are wild, so are your powers
Initially you will be overloaded with power, so you need to learn how to control it fast
Anything touched by your electricity will most likely die, even loved ones

name: Photographic Deduction
description: A person with this power does not have enhanced sight but instead has superhuman processing of anything seen visually. For example, if they see someone moving their hands to draw something you can create an image of what they are drawing in your head without even being able to see the canvas. This also allows the user to read lips. Continued usage can lead to nigh prerecognitive abilities.
summary: The ability to figure out connections in whatever you seeing and process them in your head extremely fast
strengths: By looking at someone moving their pencil you can figure out what they are writing
You can read lips
weaknesses: You will be tempted to cheat in tests because looking at people's movements give you the answers

name: Tactile Georegeneration
description: With this ability, a person can absorb the energy from the Earth through physical contact, turning it into a powerful form of healing. Everything, from the most minor of injuries to the deadliest of diseases, can be healed, or severed/malformed limbs totally regenerated, in a matter of minutes!! Advanced users of this power can even go as far as slowing down, stopping, or reversing every effect of aging, both internally and externally. You can, however, stop this power to let enemies suffer.
summary: The ability to use the Earth's energy to fully heal yourself or others
strengths: You can be the world's greatest doctor!
This power always strengthens itself, even when not in use, as long as you are in contact with earth
No more aches & pains!!
weaknesses: You need to have physical contact with natural ground for the power to work
You could accidentally heal an enemy if you aren't careful
This power starts off weak, only healing minor injuries at first

name: Materialization
description: The user is able to turn imaginary thoughts into real matter. Just from imagining them, a person would be able to create an infinite amount of swords, money, or even their own world.
summary: The ability to create matter from imagination alone.
strengths: What you create is 100% just up to your imagination.
There is no limit as to what or how many of something you create.
Your wildest dreams may come true.
weaknesses: Creating something from nothing goes against the laws of nature.
Due to the above, reality will begin destroying whatever you made as soon as it is made.
Even a tiny scratch can destroy your object if you did not imagine that scratch possible beforehand.

name: Psychic Strategy
description: Also known as Quantum Precognition or Stochastic Precognition, this is the ability to perceive all the probable outcomes of a situation in hypertime. The user can also sense which outcome is more likely to come to pass. In addition, if the power develops, you can sense how to alter situations to affect the future, perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision you make (called Butterfly Effect Observation), or avoid telepathy by pretending that the probabilities you perceive are your thoughts.
summary: The ability to perceive all probable outcomes of a situation, and otherwise perceive probability
strengths: Perceive all probable outcomes of a situation (and which one is most likely)
Perceive the ultimate conclusion of a decision (and how to alter situations to affect outcomes)
Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPowers enhance this power greatly
weaknesses: Unpredictability (unless you have a Probability/Chance/Luck-based MythPower)
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the psychic perception
Sometimes the perception isn't in hypertime (immoblilzing you like Precognition til the vision ends)

name: Claircognizance
description: Claircognizance is one of the most powerful abilities. With this ability, you can gain knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge. Interestingly, when actively using this ability, you also can find something that has not happened, and you can also get another evolved human's abilities. You can also get these abilities in a random way or passive way. You also can find about location, history, person's characteristic, and everything that you want to know.
summary: The ability to acquire knowledge without ever experiencing an event that could have given you that knowledge
strengths: You can become a great people for country or world
You can be a psychic for the greater good
You can be the most powerful heroes in this universe
weaknesses: You can be the most powerful villain in this universe
You can get information that you don't want to know in a passive way or random way
Many people who will come to you for bad or good reason cause they think you're dangerous

name: Stop Time
description: You have the ability to stop time. What is meant by this is that any living thing will be frozen in time, excluding plant life, while you still move at normal time. There is a restriction, you cannot move any living thing except for plant life.
summary: The ability to stop the progress of time
strengths: Avert human and machine disasters
Make bank withdrawls and then go about your business
Do some fun time up-skirting
weaknesses: Living things are frozen, so non living things are still in motion

name: Logic Defying
description: Unlike Physics Rejector, or Physics Distortion which allows you to only defy the laws of physics, a person with Logic Defying has the ability to defy any type of logic in existence. That means that you can defy the laws of chemistry and biology or any other science as long as you don't believe that the laws apply to you. However, even the user themselves doesn't have any way to explain what they can do- they can do anything they want as long as they don't believe otherwise.
summary: The ability to defy any sort of logic as long as you don't believe that it applies to you
strengths: Nothing applies to you, or you choose what laws apply to you and what doesn't
You can do everything in Chuck Norris jokes just because you can
You can even skip any type of restrictions anyone put on you
weaknesses: Limited by a person's logic

name: Cell Generation
description: This power allows you to create cells in your body. You can even create new types of cells with unique properties. If you are injured create stem cells to turn into necessary ones or create the lost cells. If you are in a hostile environment you could create a cell type that heals you quickly or increases muscle power. If there is poison in your body you can make new immune system cells. Even make cells that take in oxygen more eficently.
summary: The ability to create biological cells for your own body
strengths: Works well with tissue generation and control.
Heal rapidly or go offensive.
Create new cell types to suit your needs.
weaknesses: Cant make magical cells.
Must have a somewhat decent knowledge of cells.
These cons cant be negated.

name: Empathic Telekinesis
description: With empathic telekinesis, a person can move things with their mind by creating links to others through empathy. The powers can then be used by that person to help and protect other people they choose. It has the same properties and versatility as vector telekinesis.
summary: The ability to gain powerful telekinetic abilities through empathic connections with others
strengths: Can only be used by good people
Is extremely powerful
Can be learned and controlled in a very short amount of time
weaknesses: Confused or negative emotions negate the power

name: Transmechanization
description: "Scrap" is another word for junk, though in this case it is useable and not useless. You can transmechanize an old car into a massive cannon or even a pile of wooden planks mixed with old engine parts into a speed boat. You can also turn a complex machine into another complex machine (example already used with the old car). However, there's no guarantee the machine will work properly (refrigerator to jetplane), and not EVERYTHING is "scrap".
summary: The ability to turn "scrap" into a machine or turn a machine into a different type of machine using your mind.
strengths: Can create cool machines from just about anything
Can transmechanize the machine, even if the machine is being used
No blueprints, which means no one can steal your creation.
weaknesses: Must be formed from multiple objects, or one complex object (can't make cannon out of just one can)
Does not work on stones, bricks, or organic material (even if decayed or dead), except for wood.
No guarantee it will work right (example: turning a refrigerator into a jetplane)

name: Every Kinesis
description: The ability to replicate any kinesis power: All the known abilities and also any new ones. If someone adds one that you don't have (yet), you can use it through this power. This also improves every aspect of your other (hard copy) kinesis powers, but only if you have Stackable Abilities.
summary: The ability to replicate any kinesis power.
strengths: Can have any kinetic power
Will be able any new kinesis of which you do not yet have a hard copy
weaknesses: Anti Power Mimicry

name: Will Projection
description: Most people can only will their own bodies. This ability allows you to will anything around you. But you must practice, because your will is just as strong as everyone elses at first. If you can build up your will, you'll be able to do more than move things. You can even will things to change into something else, as long as your not creating or destroying life. After mastering this, you could even will things into existince. But you still must follow the rule, no creating or destroying life.
summary: The ability to project your will onto anything or anywhere around you.
strengths: You can do almost anything if you can muster up the will
weaknesses: No creating or destroying life.

name: Pure Energy
description: With your hands, you have full control over direction. If you can't use your hands for some reason, then use your eyes. If you want to blast in all directions, use your entire body. You can use this energy as a shield or a platform of energy for transportation. How this energy is looks is pretty much your choice (transparant, translucent, solid, and color choice). But, to blast any energy at all, you must use 100% concentration.
summary: The ability to blast pure energy from your eyes, hands, and/or entire body
strengths: Can blast energy from hands, eyes, and/or entire body
Pure energy
weaknesses: Requires 100% concentration, nothing less

name: Virtuoso Reaction
description: Say that you caused a fire and you don't know how to put it out. With this power, your brain will begin to calculate the thoughts and ideas on how to put out the fire. Then, your body will follow your brain's lead in which it would put out the fire skillfully. This ability doesn't last long; once the situation is over, you will lose the knowledge that you gained.
summary: The ability to respond to any situation with advanced skills and knowledge of an expert.
strengths: Gain knowledge.
Be ready for anything.
weaknesses: You will lose the knowledge after the situation is over.

name: Radiation Immunity
description: With this power you can be immune to any of the affects of any kind of harmful radiation. You will be able to function as if there is no harmful radiation at all. Even applies to UV light causing sunburns and melanomas
summary: The ability to be immune to any kind of harmful radiation
strengths: You are immune to harmful radiation
You (unconsciously) decide which radiation is harmful
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Imaginary Energy Manipulation
description: What do I mean by "Imaginary Energy". Well, in one episode of "American Dad" a guy mention that he could manipulate his own "Sexual Energy". We all know there is no such thing. The guy just sang an moved his body in an erotic fashion. The point is this ability could make that energy real. That is one part of the fun. The user can make up energies as well with their own effects and powers.
summary: The ability to make energies that don't actually exist real and control it
strengths: Bring fake energies real
Make up your energies
Control them
weaknesses: Using two or more energies in the same area might cause an terrible explosion.
Can't create an energy that is actually real.

name: Probability Transportation
description: This ability works like this. The user wants someone to catch on fire. The ability allows him to send that person to a place were there is fire like a house on fire or the sun. This ability is not an exact science, because it sends the person to the place were likelihood of being on fire is high. It is good for sending people away and teleporting.
summary: The ability to make something happen to someone/thing by sending them to places where the likelihood is very high.
strengths: Send people or themselves away to places that you something specific to happen to them.
Teleportation application
weaknesses: Not specific on location most of the time
Might be affected by Probability Manipulation or luck based powers

name: Data Realization
description: Using the DNA of creation, you have the ability to create objects, feelings, people and many other things out of nothing. Also, it is possible to create and destroy the world in the blink of an eye. Most of the powers are being controlled by your own emotions, and mostly, the bearer is unaware of the power.
summary: The ability to create objects/events from nothingness
strengths: Be able to have everything you want
Be able to recreate what you do not like
Be able to make your own world at your own liking
weaknesses: When under emotional pressure, the power could get the better of you
You might be unaware of this power

name: Touch Of Knowledge
description: If you want to read a book but don't have the time, just simply touch the book and it will be as if you have read it. This also works on movies and if you touch someone you can pick and choose what you want to copy from them. Also, if you touch a computer and go on the internet, there is nothing you can't learn and it is untraceable.
summary: The ability to gain knowledge by touching it
strengths: Can learn anything
Doesn't steal knowledge from people
You absorb in a millisecond
weaknesses: Must touch the object
That's it

name: Nonlinear Time Perception
description: You can see the past, events that have already happened, you could solve all history's unanswered questions or have the greatest history textbook memory there is! You can also see the present, no change there. But most of all you can see the future, and change or perform different actions to shape the future as you wish. With training and concentration you can look into a certain person's or object's past or future.
summary: The ability to see past, present and future at any given time.
strengths: See the past and everything in it.
Shape the future to your will with your actions.
Helpful for people with bad memories.
weaknesses: You cannot change the past.
Shaping the future can have consequences. Some small, some dire.
You WILL see how your loved ones die.

name: Powermatrix
