description: This superpower provides you an extremely cool, awesome, original, indestructible, and comfortable gauntlet. Which grants you complete & utter access, use, and information of all your superhuman powers & abilities via hardlight holographic displays. That also allows you to organize all of the superhuman powers & abilities that you possess. The gauntlet itself can become invisible and intangible when every you want. And is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply
summary: The ability to have an indestructible gauntlet that provides you access to all your superhuman powers and abilities
strengths: A gauntlet that allows you at access and utilize all of your superhuman powers and abilities.
Able to view information about your superhuman powers and abilities and organize them as well.
The Gauntlet is powered by an infinite & unlimited clean, safe, and efficient power supply.
weaknesses: Does not provide you any superpowers, only the ability to access and utilize the ones you have.
The gauntlet can not be removed unless you are dead or your arm is removed.

name: Hypertime
description: Your molecules move so fast that you move at superhuman speeds. Enough that time "stands still". In REALITY the people around you are moving slower. If anything comes in contact with you during activation they are just as fast as you and they don't need to stay in contact.
summary: The ability to move so fast time "stands still"
strengths: Perfect revenge
Cheat on tests and you can't get caught
Win races
weaknesses: If someone else has this power and turns it on at the same time as yours, they are just as fast
Liquid nitrogen can knock you out of hypertime
You'll be tempted to commit crimes

name: Time Relativity
description: With this power you can make any person experience time for a relatively shorter or longer time than everyone else. One can make good times last years and bad times last seconds, and appear to be super fast by time go faster relative to your opponent, and one can talk to people for hours and for them only think it has been couple seconds. Electronics and other living things fall under this power, as well. While making relativity shift your body's needs (food, water, ect)still go at normal speed.
summary: The ability to control the passing of time for a person
strengths: Always have enough time to do what you want.
Parties don't end until you want them to.
Finish work in last five seconds after procrastinating.
weaknesses: Can't relive things you have made relatively shorter without another power.
Only you or the person you are affecting can notice the change in time relativity
Have to eat, drink, sleep eventually

name: Psionic Tactility
description: This ability allows you to control others through physical contact, but unlike tactile hypnosis, you can use telepathy instead of your voice. You can also control someone's thoughts, memories, and emotions, read their minds and memories, and also control their physical actions.
summary: The ability to read & control the minds of others you touch
strengths: A very versatile form of mind control
Is strong enough to override most healing powers except for regeneration
Psychics will find this a very useful ability
weaknesses: Someone with regenerative powers is immune to this ability
Cannot be used against empaths
May cause painful static feedback if someone is strong enough to resist telepathy

name: Beast Humanoid Shapeshifting
description: This ability allows you to become any existing animal, in a half-human form. This allows you to shift into forms such as half-tiger, half-lion, half-wolf, half-bull, etc. Makes for some interesting combinations.
summary: The ability to shapeshift to become any animal-human crossbreed.
strengths: You sustain the intellect of man while having the strength, cunning and agility of your animal.
weaknesses: You take on the mentality of the beast more and more the longer you stay in this form.

name: Resurrection Man
description: Death is the final obstacle and you've dodged it. When anyone with this ability dies, they resurrect shortly after, but changed. They will have a new superpower. The new ability is completely random, but sometimes it has something to do with how they die. For example, if you die in a fire, you might resurrect with the power to control fire. But if they were to die again, they would lose the fire power and resurrect with a new one. Also, the first time you die, you won't age past that point.
summary: The ability to resurrect each time you die with a new ability.
strengths: Even in this strange form, it's immortality.
Gaining new powers after each resurrection.
Sometimes the power relates to the death.
weaknesses: You must die to gain a new power
Losing a power you liked.
Immortality is a gift and a curse.

name: Infinite Energy Storage
description: With this ability, you can store an infinite amount of energy inside of yourself. With practice, you can control how much of that energy you use. You can handle using a nearly infinite amount of energy without harm. Limited to the energy you have stored inside. You can still get hurt from energy based attacks.
summary: The ability to store an infinite amount of energy within yourself.
strengths: Store an infinite amount of energy inside of yourself.
Be able to safely use a nearly infinite amount of energy.
Control how much of your energy you use.
weaknesses: Limited to the energy you have stored inside.
You can still get hurt from energy based attacks.
You need practice to control the amount of energy used.

name: Communication Scanner
description: Whenever an exchange of information is taking place through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can scan and understand the message. Knowledge of the language being used is not needed, though you won't necessarily get the subtexts when inside knowledge is required. It works on any type of communication means, including body language, electrical wires, fiber optics,... As long as the message is being transferred to a compatible receiver.
summary: The ability to detect, scan and understand a flow of information.
strengths: You are undetectable to 'muggle' ways of detecting intrusions.
You can even read someone's thoughts when they are thinking to themselves.
You can get your hands on private information.
weaknesses: A compatible intended receiver of the message is needed, that is one who can understand the message.
You won't get the subtext if some prior knowledge is needed to fully understand it.
You can't bypass any encryption algorithms, including the 'muggle' ones.

name: Soul Weapons
description: Everyone's soul is different. So, with this power, you will have the perfect personalized melee weapon based off of your soul. The weapon will reflect the soul of the person. If you are a good person, it will have a bright aura. If you are evil, it will pulse with darkness. The weapon will always feel balanced and right in the user's arms. The weapon is unbreakable and can be manifested and unmanifested whenever the user desires. These weapons will damage the foe physically.
summary: The ability to have a particular melee weapon appear in your hand, based off of your soul
strengths: The weapon can only be used by the owner and the owner's lover
The weapon is perfectly balanced to the person and unbreakable
The weapon is created based off of the person's soul
weaknesses: The weapon will always be the same. It will never change based on needs, lifestyle, etc.
Good people are damaged by evil weapons and evil people are more damaged by good weapons(also a pro)
You aren't instantly good with your weapon. You will still need to train to be good with it

name: Dragon Lord
description: This power gives you the abilities of a dragon. Also, you can control dragons as well. You can breathe fire, create fire balls, and grow and retract wings.
summary: The ability to have the powers of a dragon and control dragons.
strengths: You can grow wings.
You can make instant toast.
Dragons will be at your command.
weaknesses: You might accidently burn people or things.
The dragons might destroy people or places.
Your back will be sore after retracting your wings.

name: Morph
description: You have the ability to change any type of object into anything you want when touched. With this ability, you can't morph any living creature. This ability is difficult to master considering it is tied to your emotions and mind (you need to be at peace with yourself before truely mastering it).
summary: The ability to change anything when touched
strengths: Once mastered, your power will become invincible
Can get you out of any situation or trap
Can disguise your physical appearances
weaknesses: Has no effect on living things
Is difficult to master
Your emotions can ruin your powers

name: Superhuman Mimicry
description: With this power, you can have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers. With their powers, you will have the same amount of control as them. If you are taking the appearance of an animated character, then you will look however you imagine that character looking if he/she was real. Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever.
summary: The ability to have the powers and appearance of any fictional character with superpowers
strengths: Have the same powers and appearance as any fictional character with superpowers
weaknesses: Once you have become a character, you are stuck with that character's powers and appearance forever

name: Nature Manipulation
description: The basic elements of nature are earth, water, wind, and light. The user can manipulate or blend in with: stone, sand, dirt, most liquids, ice, snow, wind, weather, light, and natural disasters. Because this power is nature-based, insects and animals appeal to the user. Light is tricky, the user can generate and bend light to a certain extent. The user can survive in any natural environment on earth. This power also gives the user healing abilities.
summary: The ability to manipulate the elements of nature
strengths: Manipulate earth, water, wind, light, and heal.
Appeal to insects and animals
Survive in any natural environment on earth and/or blend in with different environments
weaknesses: You may be considered a Tree Hugger

name: Mind Writer
description: With this power, you can see into the minds of those around you, alter their memories, erase or even wipe them clean and make your own in their head. It's not some silly 'they don't know ANYTHING' power, they still retain the basic functions, knowledge and human interaction, but their knowledge of who they are, who their family is, likes and dislike can be meddled with. Note it may take you some time to reform a person from scratch. You can also take their knowledge.
summary: The ability to alter, implant fake memories or erase someone's mind all together and reform it
strengths: Alter people to follow you fanatically, no special memory needed, it will simply be in their nature
Gain knowledge from your enemies and turn them into slobbering fools
Remove traumatizing memories from victims
weaknesses: Must be within 50 meters of the person. Time stops as you use it. And you must see them
Might make a mistake. You can erase their memory multiple times, but might erase something important
Must plan ahead meticulously to know what will be in an altered memory

name: Phantasmic Mimicry
description: You have a massive archive of passed people that you can choose anyone from to gain their knowledge, skills strength and also to mix their appearance with yours.
summary: The ability to use the ghost energy of any dead person to gain their knowledge, skill and physique.
strengths: Choose from any dead person.
You only take part of that persons apperance.
It is completely temporary.
weaknesses: People will notice the appearance changes.
Concentrated spectrum waves will negate the power.

name: Bio Energetic Force Aura
description: This power allows you to create a force field around your body that grants you flightand superhuman strength, as well as superhuman durability and can be used as a way to heal by manipulating your own bio-energy to speed up the healing process. You can also generate concussive bio-energy blasts, as well as being able to survive pressures of any type (water, atmospheric, etc. )
summary: The ability to generate a localized force field around yourself
strengths: Can protect
Used both offensively and defensively
Highly useful
weaknesses: Can be affected by certain forms of energy

name: Reality Mimicry
description: The user becomes a portal between the our normal reality and their reality. They can teleport things in and out of his reality including character in their reality. If anything from our reality stays in the user's reality for too long that thing will become part of that user's reality forever and if that thing is a super being, the user gains their powers. Reality warpers can really hurt the user. The user can be in portal form to absorb attacks safely.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become the reality in one's fantasies,
strengths: You can teleport anything in your reality through to our reality and vice versa.
Absorb attacks
Gain powers of victims
weaknesses: You can still be physical harmed when you are not in portal form.
You are very susceptible and weak against Reality Warpers.

name: Reality Rift
description: This could be either one of the most blatantly powerful abilities or a very understated power, all in how you use it. A person with Reality Rift can tear holes in the fabric of reality connecting two locations; these holes do not close until something passes through them. These can either be huge gaping portals to space or tiny tears only big enough for a hand. One of the most suble ways to use this power is to create a rift just behind one door, walk though it, and come out another door.
summary: The ability to create portals in between locations
strengths: Fast, effective teleportation
No distance limit
Can be huge and epic or tiny and understated
weaknesses: Rifts don't close until something goes through
Must open first portal with hand
No physical powers

name: Temporal Rewind
description: Embarrassing moments--we all have one or two or ten in the course of our lives. Temporal Rewind can indirectly solve these. The user (through focused concentration) can reverse time and fix/avoid events. This means that you didn't break that glass, call her a man, or step in front of that taxi. The tricky thing about this power is that other people will cloudily remember the original event, not unlike deja vu. However, most people will pass it off as just that unless they know what to look for.
summary: The ability to reverse time back to a specific point
strengths: Resetting recent events
Redoing a fight
Preventing a death, fixing a conversation
weaknesses: Requires concentrated focus
30 minute maximum use at first
Headache can result from prolonged/intense use

name: Chronokinesis
description: Also called Time Manipulation or Time Control. As we all know, the power of controlling time is like having a remote control to the world. Pause it, slow it down, rewind, fast-forward and even travel through it. Not to mention, the ability to set time in a loop, in desired. Even control time around specific objects and areas. Accelerate time around objects to break them down; freeze time around enemies to immobilize them for allies; accelerate time around yourself for Superhuman Speed, and more.
summary: The ability to control the flow of time in various ways
strengths: Going back in time, you can meet your past self, possibly creating an endless army of past selves.
Speed up or slow opponents down. Also freeze people (place them in a state of stasis)
Hopping through alternate timeline to alternate timeline to see how some things can play out.
weaknesses: Be careful with that time travel. You might go too far and lose your place in time.
Careful. You might land in one timeline and think it's your own. Don't lose your grip on reality...
Enemies with Time Defiance, Hypertime Chronopathy and similar powers can serve as a foil

name: Outside Energy Manipulation
description: The ability to construct shapes with solid energy, create energy blasts, and make force fields; the only hitch is that they cannot create energy on their own and must be near an energy source (A lighter, the sun, even the moon) in order for their power to be effective.
summary: The ability to control and use energy from other energy sources
strengths: The bigger the energy source, the greater the power
Almost anything around you can be used as energy
weaknesses: The smaller the energy source, lesser the power
Energy cannot be created
Energy-Suppressing abilities

name: Omni Gas Manipulation
description: This is a deadly and powerful ability. With it, you can control ALL gases. Chlorine, oxygen, plain air, etc. You could bring down any manner of disaster by the air (tornadoes, air blasts, places without ANY gases at all, etc.), even rip out the air from someone's lungs. In addition' the user can solidify and compress gases into weapons, armor, etc., that can easily repair themselves. Even sound can be manipulated by manipulating the vibration of gases. Even some complicated things come easily.
summary: The ability to manipulate any and all gases.
strengths: Have control of all the air in the atmosphere.
Cause huge disasters, bring or destroy clouds via air barriers, etc.
Form weapons or armor out of gasses and repair them instantly.
weaknesses: You can only manipulate gases with this power.
It takes some concentration to manipulate whole atmospheres.
If you are in outer space with no gasses

name: Opportunity Repeat
description: This ability allows the user to be able to get the same opportunity again, if he failed to take it the first time or if you want to do it again. If you missed a dead line for a paper, this ability will open up that opportunity again. If you were a assassin who missed the perfect shot, this ability will make it so your target will be in the perfect spot to make that shot again, etc.
summary: The ability to repeat any opportunity that you or others were given.
strengths: Never miss a opportunity again
If mastered, you can make the opportunity came back instantly.
weaknesses: Without training, all the bad opportunities will keep showing up.
Without training, it will take time for an opportunity to return again.

name: Information Enchantment
description: With this power, one can give information supernatural properties, mainly effects on the reader/viewer/etc. The limitation, however, is giving new powers, although it can channel the effects of your other powers, such as using Friendly Power Gifting to give anyone who reads a particular sign one of your powers. Other examples include making something impossible to remember or impossible to learn to certain individuals.
summary: The ability to bestow supernatural properties on information itself.
strengths: You can contain the effect to a particular medium, so it does not spread.
Advertise anything and have it granted to those who read it.
The only limit is your imagination.
weaknesses: Effect may not last recreation by the human mind unless precautions are taken.
You cannot grant new superpowers with this, though you can simulate them.
This power cannot be modified by other powers, although you can use your powers through this.

name: All Good
description: All good is a passive, unconscious power that functions as a very specific manipulation of reality. Upon receiving this power, your entire future will be rewritten. You won't have direct control over how your life changes, but at the end of it, you are guaranteed to be able to look back on your life and say it was a good one.
summary: The ability to control reality unconsciously in accordance with your deepest desires.
strengths: Your life will be good.
The reality alteration will come from your own mind, and will be tailored specifically to what you consider a good life.
weaknesses: There's a side effect - you will forget receiving this power, and will never know you have it.
It resists all but the very strongest counters.

name: Memory Wipe
description: You can help people be at peace by wiping their mind of their worst most horrific memories by letting those memories into your mind. You may even change villains into good people this way but you'll have their memories.
summary: The ability to take someone's worst memories from them to give peace.
strengths: Helping people be at peace
Potentially reforming criminals if their past horrors male them become criminals.
weaknesses: You'll have to live memories of being, shot stabbed, raped, and any other number of horrible acts do
Pain from all these memories is real in your mind forever.
You'll spend most most you free time and money on Psychiatrists. Or kill yourself.

name: Moral  Based Ability Granting
description: The user can give abilities to themselves or others based on lessons and morals that they learned. I don't mean like if you learn something from in school and now you have a power. I mean lessons about life like this for example. You fought someone bigger and stronger than you, and you figured out you need to out-think than out-muscle him. With that "Might is not always right" mentality, your ability kicks in and gives you enhanced intelligence to defeat your opponent's brawn.
summary: The ability to grant abilities to oneself or others based on life lessons or morals.
strengths: Gain new and unique abilities based on the morals that you learned.
As long as you hold those morals, the abilities are permanent
Read parables and stories that have morals
weaknesses: Ignorance can prevent you from learning morals

name: Lightning Speed
description: The more you run the faster you become. You will generate enormous bio-electrical energy which gives you superhuman speed. 1. You run at subsonic speeds in a bio-electric cocoon. 2. You move at supersonic speeds emmitting a bio-electric trail. 3. You become imbued with massive bio-electrical energy and move with the speed of light. Linear flight is possible and doing damage is a must.
summary: The ability to move superhumanly fast with Lightning Speed
strengths: With early use of your power you could run through a wall protected by your bio-electric cocoon
Stopping to punch something is no problem just keep punching and you will still build energy, speed
Lightning impact and invulnerability, punches, kicks, ramming does massive damage
weaknesses: Magnets and must keep moving to keep your powers once you stop you return to normal human stage
At stage 1 hitting things that attract electricity will damage them but will slowly drain energy
Using powers for 51hrs straight causes you to permanently be energy go into space and dissipate

name: Reality Key
description: This power gives you the key to reality, a device so complex it doesnt have a shape but instead takes the form your mind imagines for it. The device is so complex that it will never be fully understood. The key becomes linked to the user's soul and commands are entered depending on what form the key takes, though it is unknown what the command may do. Since the key is linked to the user's soul, the key can respond to basic instructions, but stray thoughts can change the outcome.
summary: The ability to own the key to reality that allows you to do nearly anything.
strengths: Nearly anything is possible.
May be able to cause things that break the laws of reality.
So complex that other powers cannot affect the key.
weaknesses: Will never be able to fully understand how to use the key.
Random effects of the key may be undesirable.
May lose patience before learning a command you require.

name: Fictional Copy Cat
description: Use the abilities and technological advances of any fictional character!  Become as powerful as Superman, or a strategist like Batman.  Use Iron Man's armor, or have Spider-Man's reflexes and spider powers.  You could even use Thor's hammer, or adapt and evolve like Goku and Vegeta!
summary: The ability to use the powers, talents, and gadgets of fictional characters.
strengths: Have Superman's powers!
Become smart and a martial arts guru like Batman
Have Darkseid's Omega Beams or Thanos' Infinity Gauntlet
weaknesses: You will have their weaknesses
May become too powerful
Too many abilities to remember

name: Universe Adaption
description: This ability is good for those who travel across the omniverse. The user will be able to absorb a bit the universe(that they are in)'s essence/theme. This will cause the users body to adapt in gaining abilities based on those essences/themes. For example, if the user would be in a universe were people have superpowers, the user will gain ability(s) that allows him to manipulate those abilities or increases the chance of gaining an ability(s) through different causes.
summary: The ability to gain a certain ability(s) depending on what universe, reality, or dimension you are in.
strengths: Gain ability(s)
This ability could also increase your chance in certain subject based on those worlds.
weaknesses: It is an active ability, you will have to activate it.
You have to have some form of travel to go to new worlds
Abilities last as long as you stay in that world

name: Restoration Bubble
description: Forms a large circular bubble, which will restore anything inside it to its original state. Can be expanded to form a large sphere or can be thrown. Ecological disaster? Large site of destruction? Not anymore...
summary: The ability to form a bubble with healing energy
strengths: Good for cleaning up after oil spills or war time destruction
Restores and repairs all forms of pollution, including radiation
Natural disasters are no problem
weaknesses: Has random effects on people, if they're standing in the explosion

name: Superpower List Link
description: Want your powers in real life? Then participate in this experiment. According to the parallel universe theory, there should be a universe in existence where powers acquired on the site in this reality are acquired in reality there. If this power works, the holder will grant their powers to any alternate reality counterpart who knows of this power and wants the powers.
summary: The ability to gain the powers in your profile in real life.
strengths: Gain the powers in your profile.
If this power is negated, it's effect remains the same.
Even if this doesn't work, it is still a groundbreaking experiment.
weaknesses: No power of you own can affect this, not even Con Negation or Ability Cancellation.
Most likely won't work.
You have to acquire this power to use it -no power mimicry, reality manipulation, etc.

name: 100% Efficient Movement
description: When your body pushes against something, exactly half of the energy produced pushes against your body in an opposite direction. With this power, any punches, pushes and shoves are 100% efficient, as this waste energy is redirected into your target. You are now essentially twice as strong and as fast as any human your strength and build. You also now cannot damage your own tissue from over-exertion, e.g. you can't break your hand by punching a concrete wall. The wall will instead by more damaged.
summary: The ability to redirect the kinetic energy your body endures when it moves
strengths: You are as fast and as strong as any other human
No danger of damaging yourself with your superstrength
No sore hands or broken hands after a fight, which happens more often than you think
weaknesses: Attacks from others hurt you just as much
This isn't a particularly impressive power
You need to build up your strength by working out

name: Digital Conversion
description: Also called Digitization, Digitalization, Data Conversion or Cybernetic Conversion, one with this ability can psionically convert matter and energy into digital data. This allows one to travel through cyberspace via a technopathic version of Astral Projection, as well as use electronic devices for storage, shelter and travel (via electronic wires and Wi-Fi signal connections). Not to mention, digital data may also be psionically converted into physical matter and energy equivalents, at will.
summary: The ability to convert matter to and from digital data
strengths: Convert self and others (including objects) into digital data, at will
Travel cyberspace via Technopathic Astral Projection (use electronics for storage/shelter/travel)
Convert digital data into physical matter/energy equivalents (bring cybernetic data to life)
weaknesses: Technopathy can affect digitized matter (to manipulate it, damage it or even delete it)
At the lower levels, the ability affects ONLY you, ONLY others or ONLY objects
If an electronic device is destroyed while digitized matter is inside of it, the data is trapped

name: Arch Demon
description: Users with this ability either is or can transform into a demon. Most commonly user retains their general form but with some additions; horns, retractable claws, fangs, tail, wings, more muscular body and can have colour changes, mainly red, blue or black. You can also summon lesser demons, use demonic energy for spells or energy attacks.
summary: The ability to become a demon
strengths: Vast energy powers
Summon other Hellish creatures
Fly
weaknesses: Your'e not neccesarily evil, but the powers push you that way
Strong Angelic/Good beings can beat you

name: Vitakinesis
description: A person with Vitakinesis can heal themselves when they have pains and cuts. You can also heal others that need it. Or heal plants. And for your information, this is actually a REAL ability. Anyone can use. But don't do it when emotional! ;)
summary: The ability to heal oneself, other people and plants
strengths: Heal yourself when hurt
Don't have to go to the doctor's! :D
Real fun!
weaknesses: Can't use it when emotional!
Don't use it the opposite way (relates to #1)
Same thing as #1, because there are not a lot of cons for this ability

name: Unbreakable Spirit
description: While many seek to dominate and break the will of others through evil, unspeakable methods, they will find you undefeatable. With this power, all your emotions still exist but can never defeat you. Nothing can control your mind or drive you insane. You can hold the One Ring in your hand for years without budging a finger. You'd laugh at Ctulhu and poke his tentacles with a stick. And the cruellest, most vile forms of torture known to man wouldn't draw so much as a whisper from your lips.
summary: The ability to have such a strong will that your mind and emotions can never be broken or manipulated
strengths: Ever heard of Batman? Pssh. Guy's a wuss.
Imagine the distilled blood of several hundred thousand Spartans flowing through your veins.
Best for last: Infinite stimulus threshold. The worst chemicals, pain, or pleasures can't break you.
weaknesses: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING.

name: Blind Luck
description: Go on and try giving the dice a roll, just remember to close your eyes and you'll get any number you hope for every time. With this power you create your own luck. Getting shot at? No problem, just run forward with your eyes closed and you'll be unscathed every time. Nuclear bomb about to go off above you? Close your eyes and a satellite will knock it out of the air and into some remote location where it won't cause trouble. If your already blind, you won't even need to close your eyes.
summary: The ability to be extremely lucky when you can't see
strengths: Ridiculously lucky
Need i say more?
weaknesses: Need to have eyes closed for this power to work, or be blind

name: Electrical Storm
description: Absorb electricity from around you, e.g. power lines or living creatures. You can use it to zap enemies or use its electrical vibrations to move objects around. You can also make your mind as fast as lightning. If you think hard enough, your body will become electrical, preventing bullets from hurting you.
summary: The ability to absorb electricity from around you and use it to your will
strengths: Slows down your mind to think of what to do next
As long as you absorb electricity, you're not tired
If enough is absorbed, you can take out a small city!
weaknesses: Takes a long time to master your power
Cannot be constant

name: Summon
description: All you would have to do would be imagine the creature you want to summon and pick an area. In the area a magical sign(varies per creature)will appear and glow really bright than flash out. In its place would be the creature you imagined. The creature would be under your control and have one small magical power(you choose). You could make more than one of the same creature at one time depending on its size. The smallest it can be is 1cu foot and the largest is 10cu feet. You can also vanish them
summary: The ability to summon creatures from your imagination
strengths: Can summon any magical creature you can imagine that is at your control
The summonings are fast and cool to watch
The smaller the creature the more you can make at once
weaknesses: Summonings are hard to hide.
People will want magical pets
Can't summon objects

name: Superhuman Reflexes
description: You can react to events nearly instantaneously.  "Think fast!" will be a slow and annoying practical joke.
summary: The ability to react almost instantly.
strengths: Dodge things
Impress your friends with your leet Whac-A-Mole skills
weaknesses: Laughing early at people's jokes

name: Invisibility
description: Everyone knows this one.  You can become transparent so that people see right through you.  Be careful though--people can still run into you and getting covered in flour or any other dust gives you away.
summary: The ability to become invisible to the naked eye.
strengths: Sneak into places
Locker rooms with hotties
Become a badass spy
weaknesses: Getting run over by a truck
Locker rooms with old wrinkly people
Getting caught

name: Speed Absorption
description: You can take a speeding bullet for example and turn it around and shoot it at your enemy.
summary: The ability to stop any motion coming at you with your mind and reverse it.
strengths: You can take away any speed of an object and turn it around
You can always hurt your enemy because you can backfire anything back at them
weaknesses: NONE

name: Life Force Manipulation
description: With this ability, you could easily analyze any organism's biological make-up simply by looking at it. You can read and interpret the health, special abilities, and personality of any entity, as well as manipulate the life force in it. You can pour your life energy into a living thing in order to heal it, or absorb another living thing's life energy simply by touching it, thereby gaining their memories, special abilities, and strength. This will weaken the target or even kill it.
summary: The ability to read organic substances and transfer life force by touch.
strengths: Quickly analyze something's health, personality, or any skills/superpowers they might have.
Heal any injury through physical contact.
Gain the health, memories, and skills of the target, weakening or killing them.
weaknesses: Healing weakens you as much as it strengthens the target.
Life extraction may manifest in a lust for life force.
May have difficulty controlling the power, resulting in accidental damage upon physical contact.

name: Projective Teleportation
description: This power is like telekinesis, but the objects that are moved disappear from their place and appear in another, without the user touching it and with just a mere point of a finger/hand and directing where the object will appear.
summary: The ability to move objects by bending space
strengths: When moving, the objects are more accurately to go to the user without physical interference
Unpredictable attacks, the user can teleport enemies and objects anywhere within their line of sight
No need to touch objects to teleport them.
weaknesses: The range of the power is small in scale depending on how far the user's sight is
The user cannot projectively teleport the objects or humans to other places out of their sight
The power usually would not be effective that much to users with sight problems or in the dark

name: Intuitive Inventing
description: Someone with this superpower can create almost any device imaginable. This is the uncanny and almost empathic ability to understand machines and to perceive "mechanical energy. " One can create fantastic futuristic devices, including cybernetic systems, holograms, and elaborate computer and fiber-optic systems.
summary: The ability to be able to invent anything they can imagine
strengths: Can replace limbs with robotic limbs
Can make a teleporting machine to travel
Able to make a machine to give or take powers away
weaknesses: Takes time to make
Cost a lot of money to buy supplies

name: 100 Percent Brain Efficiency
description: Humans generally use only 10% brain capacity or maybe less, and within the 10 percent it is possible for errors to occur. With this power, the user can use the maximum amount of brain capacity allowed without intruding on the subconscious functions like breathing. The user also has no errors in thought, they will not freeze up when thinking about things. The user can exhibit near clairvoyance due to being able to perceive more things about their environment in shorter time. Does not grant ESP.
summary: The ability to use your brain with 100 percent efficiency
strengths: Can process information faster and retain it
Immune to error in the mind-includes illusions and mind control can also tell if mind is being read
Quick prediction and analysis-also allows user to dodge bullets if the body is fast enough
weaknesses: Contrary to popular belief, does not give you psychic powers
A great brain does not equal a great body
You will find regular things not challenging enough

name: Talent Of Healing
description: By simply laying your hands on something, that animal, plants, fungi, or other entity will heal. You also gain a natural knowlege of medicine and can heal a persons auras and other energies. A bonus of this is that you can reverse the aging process and can unlock a persons potential or unlock their abilities.
summary: The ability to have a natural ability to heal people and other things
strengths: Description can't be shortened and pros can't be negated.
Knowledge of medicine
Reverse aging and unlocking potential
weaknesses: None

name: Magical Door
description: With this power, you are able to summon a magical door which leads to any place you want to go. Wanna see another country? Locked yourself inside the house? Do you need a certain object? Do you want to find somebody? Think about the door and it will appear out of nowhere. Go through it and you'll find the thing you seek. The door leads only to places on Earth, places that exist. You can make the door disappear too, and with practice, you can create multiple ones.
summary: The ability to summon a door which can be used for teleportation
strengths: Get anywhere, anytime.
Travel around the world, meet celebrities.
weaknesses: Never open up a door that leads to the bottom of the ocean.
If there's no room for the door, it can't be summoned.

name: Ultimate Programmer
description: AI for games, robots, satellites, research, space station facilities, etc. Anything you want to program you can, even to the point in which the AI has human creativity and intelligence as well as morals. Even graphics can look so realistic you can't distinguish them from real scenes or people.
summary: The ability to program any piece of electronics/tech one wants in any way one wants
strengths: Have a computer with which you can discuss philosophy.
People might pay loads of money for an AI you programmed.
weaknesses: May become a reclusive or taciturn nerd.

name: Antibacterial Body
description: Because your body is antibacterial, you can clean surfaces by touching them with your hands, feet, tongue, or any other part of your body! As a bonus, you are immune to almost any disease since harmful germs die as soon as they get on you!
summary: The ability to kill germs & clean surfaces with your own body
strengths: Clean surfaces with your own body parts.
Immunity to almost any disease!
You're like a living block of soap!
weaknesses: It's not quite impossible for you to get sick...
You can still be stained by discoloring substances like paint. Rinse yourself to wash them off.

name: Stealth Mode
description: With this power, your aura dampens down and becomes harder to sense. Also, any sound you make is slightly muted and harder to detect. Your smell also becomes more similar to that of the environment's and your footsteps are lighter than normal, leaving footprints that are harder to see. Your mind also becomes less likely to be found by a mind reader/detector.
summary: The ability to become more stealthy in multiple ways
strengths: Harder to detect.
Can be underestimated in a fight, due to the 'weak' aura.
weaknesses: Doesn't do anything about visibility.
Just lowers the possible ways to detected, doesn't eliminate them.

name: Mending Minds
description: You can hack into people's mind and change their mind and tempt them to do other things while you're not completely controlling them.
summary: The ability to make people do stuff without completely controlling them.
strengths: You can make your crush have a crush on you.
You can make your mom get you whatever you want!
You can make your enemies hurt themselves.
weaknesses: No bad things

name: Codebreaker
description: This ability allows someone to break any code. With it one would be able to access any secret hidden from them, be they in a computer or elsewhere, by instinctively knowing how to break the "code" to get to it. The solution to the "code" could be anything from the correct computer password, to the exact things you need to say to get someone to tell you something.
summary: The ability to learn any secret.
strengths: You will be able to hack into virtually anything.
If you suspect someone is keeping something from you, it would be a simple matter to find out what.
The eventual ability to make codes and store secrets so that none could get at them.
weaknesses: It could be emotionally damaging to know what others really think of you.
This ability would eventually cause the user to see the world in numbers and symbols.
It only works if you know something is hidden away.

name: Data Manipulation Entity
description: Anyone with this power has a near god-like power to manipulate the universe. However, it can only be used for an object or in a closed space. A closed space is created by creating a large program to create a realm outside of normal reality. This power is limited because it needs large setup time and it cannot create something out of nothing. Normal use without closed spaces can range from increasing your own strength values to giving properties to items, such as homing capabilities
summary: The ability to manipulate the data of the universe
strengths: You have near god-like reality bending powers
You can change variables within objects or turn objects into other things
If you release your full power, you can also manipulate time
weaknesses: You cannot create anything new, you must use already existing objects
You can only use this power to manipulate small variables, unless you prepare a closed space
In order to activate full power, you must have the permission of the integrated thought entity

name: Infinite Knowledge
description: Simply means that you know everything. Anything anyone on Earth learns or discovers is instantly added to your knowledge bank. You leave no questions unanswered. The future and such are still a mystery to you and other people's histories and personalities are not necessarily included, but essentially, everything known by man is known by you.
summary: The ability to possess the full spectrum of human knowledge.
strengths: Know everything.
Ace tests like a madman
Never surprised by anything you learn
weaknesses: No physical offense or defense.
Cannot read minds.
Doesn't look cool.

name: Fire And Ice
description: Not much to describe here; you use the power of fire AND ice simultaneously. It has unlimited uses and various effects. Sometimes, it will even summon the two dragons Ergolek and Kralissan. This power is more for show than for go, considering it is almost impossible to control. Fortunately, the worst backfire is cross-cancellation where one cancels the other effects, though you won't even get hurt by it, except by 2 degrees (inside a building, collapse the roof and get buried in debris)
summary: The ability to simultaneously use the powers of fire and ice for various effects.
strengths: Occasionally summons the Great Dragon of Fire Ergolek and the Great Dragon of Ice Kralissan
Has various effects
Looks cool
weaknesses: Difficult to control
Occasional cross-cancelation (fire melts ice but the ice freezes the fire at the same time)
Dragons may fight each other instead of an enemy

name: Cosmic Manipulation
description: Sure, their are people who can bend space and rip through time, but true power is in the stars. This ability allows you to manipulate cosmic energy and space matter. Cosmic energy is orange and can be manipulated into shapes or used as raw power. The surface of shaped cosmic energy looks like the bottom of a still pool, with lines wavering all around it. Space matter is things like meteors, black holes, comets, and stars. You can also fly through space unharmed. However, you cannot move planets.
summary: The ability to manipulate cosmic energy and space matter.
strengths: Manipulating and shaping cosmic energy
Controling space matter and space travel
Very, very powerful
weaknesses: Cannot move planets
Might accidently destroy a planet or star

name: Ultimate Authority
description: With this ability anything you can order anything to do what you want. This includes inanimate objects. However, the longer the command the less the power your command has, so it's best to stick to a few words. This ability takes intense concentration to work. The level of concentration varies, depending on if the object could normally do this. Meaning that living objects are easier to control than inanimate objects, or space. Orders can also include effects such as, Burn, Freeze, or Age.
summary: The ability to order anything to do what you want.
strengths: Order anyone to do anything
Can also convey orders telepathically.
weaknesses: Takes intense concentration.
Refrain from cursing at all times, they may be considered orders.

name: Digitalization
description: The ability to turn your entire body into a digital holographic form. Users may be able to hack into any computer based objects (computers, cell phones, satellites, exc. ), become intangible, cover their body in a digital armor and project weapons from their body. Limited to users imagination and energy. Users can draw energy from any electrical device they touch. Experienced users can also regenerate when touching an electrical device.
summary: The ability to digitalize yourself on a subatomic level.
strengths: Users are immune from deseases.
Extreamely difficult to harm.
Users can shape digital vehicales around body(tanks, jets, cars exc. )
weaknesses: Inexperienced users can get trapped in a single object(computer, cell phone, car exc. )
Users can be fatally wounded if infected with a virus
Users may have to reprogram theirselves if they get wet or catch a virus

name: Energy Morph
description: You could morph any part of your body into an energy that you could will into any form you can imagine. The energy is transparent and can be any color you want. You can even separate the energy from your body in the form of objects and projectiles. For example, you could form a sword then reform your hand around the handle. Morphing your hands is the easiest but not your limit.
summary: The ability to change your body into an energy you can reshape at will.
strengths: Very useful power.
The energy is nearly indestructible.
weaknesses: You can not morph all of your body at once.
Need to be creative to reach your full potential.

name: Fortune/Misfortune Smiles Upon
description: This is a test of one's greed or thankfulness. You are able to bestow upon a person either riches or "Help Me" cardboard signs. You smile at a person who is poor and they will immediately become rich. But you can take it away from them at any time if they choose to be selfish, ungrateful and use their newfound wealth unwisely. As for the upper class, you can frown upon a person of greed and snob, making them lose their money and power. If they prove they can change ways, smile at them :D
summary: The ability to make people go from rags to riches and vice versa
strengths: Give someone a chance that they can give back to the world
weaknesses: Can't make yourself richer or poorer with the power

name: Plasma Control
description: With the ability to control matter made up of a high amount of energy, or plasma, you would essentially become a very powerful being. Plasma is the least common form of matter on earth, but it is actually the most common of all the universe. Such examples are stars, auroras, and nebulas. So you would be able to not only control high amounts of energy, but also gather it. But it would take you a while to control such vast amounts of energy.
summary: The ability to control any form of plasma such as the sun, lightning, fire, and other objects that are plasma.
strengths: Control an almost unlimited supply of energy.
Create high energy objects such as lightning.
weaknesses: Time is needed to control that energy.

name: Psychometric Regeneration
description: This healing ability is very powerful. You can use psychometrics to see when and how someone was injured, and heal them by taking control of their memories of the incident, and thus stimulating that person's natural healing process by triggering the brain's natural defenses against the threat they were exposed to.
summary: The ability to heal people by understanding the history of any injury or disease they had or do have
strengths: If the person has a healing power, this ability naturally stimulates it to start working
You can search through the person's memory if they cannot recall it, and find it for them
The healing process can fully regenerate severed or malformed limbs in as little as 30 hours
weaknesses: A person with psychic or mnemonic powers could slow your power down, but not weaken it
If the person has powers similar to your psychometry, painful psychic static feedback could result

name: Blood Temperature Manipulation
description: You can control the temperature of someone's blood making them hot or cold you can kill them by making them really hot and exploding them or really cold and freezing them. You can also use this power on yourself
summary: The ability to control the temperature of someones blood.
strengths: Can make yourself the tempature you want.
weaknesses: Takes alot of concetration

name: Kinetic Speed
description: The ability to absorb kinetic energy (eg: from being punched, falling, voluntarily striking surface) and release it at will, usually in the form of superspeed. Can store the energy absorbed in body for later use. While storing and using energy the hero vibrates quiet rapidly, causing some discomfort.
summary: The ability to absorb kinetic energy and release it at will
strengths: Opponent's energy can be used against them.
Energy from using superspeed causes more energy.
weaknesses: Can cause some pain if too much energy is stored
Vibration while using the power can be uncomfortable

name: Indestructible!
description: Heal ridiculously fast from any physical damage, burns, bullets, amputations, etc. If a generous portion of your body is destroyed & one cell remains, the cell will regrow your entire body. You will steadily build a tolerance to most conventional injuries. Reattach limbs or grow new ones; your will controls every cell. Your bones will become nigh unbreakable and your skin will toughen. You will double peak human physiology. You will even learn to block out pain completely at will.
summary: The ability to be indestructible and build up a pain tolerance
strengths: Be unstoppable. Walk thru lasers, razors, run thru infernos, shed frozen tissue
Eventually (+/- one jupiter year) you will freak enemies out by taking their worse and smiling
Grow rhino-like skin, lift a metric ton, bones will be like thick galvanized rubber.
weaknesses: You are not invincible. Mentats hurt you & you could still be injured and even destroyed.
If your pain centers are off, touch will be off as well and it will take days to come back
Your body density & hair will grow. Eventually you will look like a pale Wolverine reject

name: Superiority
description: With this power, even the Hulk and Doomsday will have trouble! The moment you encounter someone with an ability that you can use, you will surpass all of their talents. "Anything you can do, I can do better" will no longer be a joke!
summary: The ability to surpass the powers and talents of others.
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and smarter than anyone!
Win at everything forever!
weaknesses: You will become a real world Mary-sue/Gary-stu
Nobody likes a Mr. /Ms. Perfect

name: Psychometric Muscle Memory
description: A person with this power has an unique form of psychometry that allows for the user to absorb skills from the objects they touch. They can use the object with the skill of a previous owner. In addition, they also can tell how the object was made by copying the skills of the person who made it. Once the user has absorbed all the skills they can use their acquired skills on similar objects. With practice, you can learn how to absorb someone's skills by touching them.
summary: The ability to gain skills by touching an object that someone used before
strengths: You can gain skills very easily
You also know how to recreate any object you touched by copying the creator's skill
You can also absorb skills by touching people-if they somehow let you
weaknesses: You now want to touch everything to gain more skills
It is pretty expensive to buy things that were previously used by pros
You can only absorb skills involving the object you touched

name: Elemental Influencers
description: Fire, water, earth, air. In a way, these are the substances that make up our world. Anyone with this ability can empower and weaken the elements in their natural forms. Influencers could turn a ripple into a tsunami, build a spark into a roaring fire, or force a breeze to grow into hurricane level winds. The flip side to this gift is that the user can also dampen and weaken the elements, stopping choatic earthquakes, gusting tornadoes, and distructive fires in their tracks.
summary: The ability to empower and weaken the natural elements
strengths: Influencers can empower and weaken the elements to their advantage
Can create various effects
Unique power.
weaknesses: Can only control the elements to a degree.

name: Elemental Transmogrification
description:
Ability to transform parts of your body or your entire body into any of the basic elements. You can use more than one ability at once, so long as they're not touching (ie. Fire on one arm, electricity on the other). 

Usable elements include: Fire, Water, Air, Electricity, Metal, Earth
summary: The ability to take on the form of the basic elements at will
strengths: You are the master of the elements
Can adapt to many different scenarios
Be the life of all the parties
weaknesses: Contradicting elements can harm you when used together
Certain elements are harder to control than others (ie. Rock slows you down)

name: Immortality Manipulation
description: Immortality can come in many forms. Lets see, anti-aging, resurrection, preservation and the weird one where you just don't die from wounds. Someone with this power can grant or remove any of these, and choose between which they grant. Physical contact is necessary and this ability can be used on yourself. You can even make up your own forms of immortality. Also you can change the kind of immortality someone has
summary: The ability to control immortality, in any of its forms.
strengths: Can grant any form of immortality and it can't be removed from you.
Can choose what form you grant and can make up your own kinds
Can be used on yourself AND can take back immortality from others.
weaknesses: Physical contact is necessary.

name: Mirror Teleport
description: Imagine you are surrounded by hundreds of soldiers or a few other superheroes and you're about to get the beating of your lifetime. Just pull out a mirror and walk through it and you walk out of whatever other mirror you want. You are able to pull people through with you too, but it will drain your energy twice as much for everyone you pull in. Unfortunately, the first mirror will show what the mirror you come out of is facing.
summary: The ability to walk into any mirror and walk out of any other mirror you've seen
strengths: You can get anywhere with a mirror really fast
If your foe breaks your mirrors, they'll have really bad luck
You will dominate in the house of mirrors
weaknesses: You'll appear in a lot of bathrooms
Foes can see where you teleport to
Big cost of buying a lot of personal mirrors

name: Weapon Evolution
description: Just think of it, you could even pick up a Knife/Dagger and morph it into a Sword/Saber, a Claw Hammer into a Warhammer, a Tomahawk into an Axe, and any small weapon you can think of transform and supersizing it into your very own weapon on your own brutal and fatal arsenal.
summary: The ability to transform and supersize any small weapon into your weapon for combat.
strengths: Lots of different weapons
weaknesses: Evolution has to resemble the original weapon, no forming a big gun out of a toothpick

name: Supernatural Sense
description: You hear the sound of thunder in your head that alerts you something Supernatural is in the area of where you are or something Supernatural could happen.  This includes but not limited to Demons Vampires, Ghosts, Sorcerers, people using dark magic,demon possession of a human or animal, a person summoning a demon or decided to summon a demon.
summary: The ability to be alerted when something Supernatural is where you are
strengths: The Sound of the Supernatural Sense is Loud so hard not to hear it
Useful for fighting Supernatural Enemies
If loud noise or something else prevented you from hearing it, it will repeat until you hear it
weaknesses: It doesn't tell you spefically what Supernatural it is in the area
Sorcerers and Others very Powerful Can Block It
Can disturb you when on vaction, sleeping, eating at a restaurant, seeing a movie, etc

name: Power Wash
description: The user is able to heal any damaged cells, broken tissues, stressed materials, and mental strain to which they have suffered by focusing a stream of energy to bathe over their body. They are "washing" away the harm.
summary: The ability to clense oneself of wounds, physical and mental.
strengths: Can heal physical and mental obscurities.
Can be used on other people, if the user allows.
Can introduce a form of immortality.
weaknesses: Telepathy can cause drawbacks, if not shut the ability off completely.
User can still be killed by any conventional weapon.
The ability doesn't make the user invincible.

name: Invisible Force Manipulation
description: There are many invisble forces of nature. There is wind (or air), gravity, and even heat. This ability will allow you to control it.
summary: The ability to control any invisible forces of nature.
strengths: Able to control invisible forces.
weaknesses: You won't control any invisible creatures, people, or spirits.

name: Knowledge Absorption
description: Knowledge is power. A Knowledge Absorber can take someone else's knowledge by physical contact. This lets them find information, use stolen scientific/math/physics knowledge, or even determine the location of people. This ability does not work well with applied skills. Just because the user knows how to do something does not mean that they can do it.
summary: The ability to drain or copy the knowledge of others
strengths: Find information
Use stolen science/math/military info
Can merely copy info or rip it out of their head
weaknesses: Requires touch
Requires more concentration the harder they resist
Does not work well with applied skills

name: 5th Dimension Notebook
description: A person with this power has a notebook that can manipulate reality. The notebook has power over reality in anything below the 5th dimension-that means it affects both space and time. The user can either create characters or weapons in their notebook and bring them to life or change aspects of the real world to the words/pictures written. Pictures drawn in the notebook have more power. The book comes with a pen that has powers itself. The book has 100 pages and things written are permanent.
summary: The ability to have a notebook that you can use to manipulate reality
strengths: You can manipulate reality to a certain extent-creating heroes and weapons, etc.
It also comes with a pen to write with that can also function in the real world to draw doors
You can give the notebook a password so only you can use it
weaknesses: You only have 100 pages and there is a limit to what you can create-no omnipotent characters
You can't use it when it closes to recharge
Anyone can use it as long as they know the password and have the pen

name: Matter Minions
description: You can manipulate any form of matter into a living creature that you can choose to be under your control. You have a limitless amount of life energy that you use to animate matter and give it a living consciousness. If your matter creatures are damaged to the point of "death", the energy inside them is released and it sends out a shockwave, damaging nearby matter. You can use your life energy to heal yourself and other beings.
summary: The ability to give matter life and control it
strengths: You can have an army of random objects
You can also animate large forms of matter (buildings, mountains, planets)
You can heal yourself
weaknesses: You can't control biological beings

name: Refresh
description: If there's any pollution anywhere on this planet, or some negative addictions inside of a person like drugs, alcohol, and even junk food, you have the power to erase it by releasing a glowing Refresh logo that spins around the user and then goes inside it, instantly wiping out all forms of pollution. You can also free anyone who's mind controlled by any villain.
summary: The ability to renew or revitalize anyone and/or everything around you.
strengths: You can become a greater help to the environmental community.
Rid a person of various addictions that are inside of them.
Can choose what negative influence you want to get rid of
weaknesses: Crooked goverment officals can come after you.

name: Comic Book Mimic
description: The name of this superpower has 'comic book' in it because the most common way to use this superpower is to copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books. Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics. The user must see an image of the superpower being used by a fictional character before he/she can replicate it. If the user acquires too many superpowers, they will all disappear and the user will have to acquire a whole new set of superpowers.
summary: The ability to replicate the superpowers of fictional characters
strengths: Copy, replicate, or mimic the superpowers of characters from comic books
Powers can also be copied from television, novels, etc. based on comics
weaknesses: The user must see an image of the superpower being used before he/she can replicate it
Aquires too many superpowers, they'll all disappear and you'll have to aquire another set of powers
How many you can acquire before you have to start over, is different for every user

name: Shape Metamorphosis
description: You can shapeshift into any living or non-living solid matter. However if you change into another person with a different power you won't be able to possess their specific power. Shapeshifting into any animal or mytholgical creature of any size. So you can change from a gigantic dinosaur into a microscopic bacteria. Cool!!
summary: The ability to change yourself into a different shape, person.
strengths: You can be anything and/or anyone you want to be.
You can change into a microscopic bacteria so no-one can see you.
weaknesses: Changing into another person doesn't make your voice sound like their's.
You can't change minor specifics. It's either everything or nothing.

name: Forcefield Body
description: Your entire body is made of force fields from a visible level down to your DNA. You have any strengths and weaknesses that an actual forcefield would have. If you take too much damage at one time, you will overload and die. With time and practice, you can control your force field body to do other things. Fly, reshape your arms into force blades, extend short-ranged tractor beams,... Anything that would work with a force field.
summary: The ability to have a body that is made of force fields.
strengths: You're a solid energy being.
This power combines with other force field powers (i.e. Impenetrable Field).
With time and practice, you can fly or reshape your force field body.
weaknesses: Energy draining powers will weaken or kill you.
The powers Barrier Melting and Wall Tearer will kill or hurt you.
As a force field, you'll have a finite damage limit.

name: Forcefield Projection
description: Force without mass is the greatest weapon. A person with Forcefield Manipulation can project durable, translucent fields of energy that will naturally form into bubbles unless mentally directed to do otherwise. They can be used as a shield or an offensive weapon.
summary: The ability to project and manipulate fields of energy
strengths: Easy to win fights
Even easier to defend yourself
Very versatile
weaknesses: Can be overloaded
Takes practice to use offensively
Takes focus

name: New Shift
description:
From particle to stellar red giant, shift into anything in the universe. Split into endless copies of yourself. You could be your own armour, sword, gun. You could shift into becoming a star, replace our sun. Note: Making copies of yourself compromises your density & takes awhile to replenish. Transforming into something as massive as the sun or a blackhole would take hours to develop necessary energy to mimic a true one. You no longer require oxegen. 
You could shift into a whole new universe.
summary: The ability to shape-shift & replicate into absolutely anything in the universe.
strengths: You are the ultimate shape-shifter capable of shifting into any fluid, solid or energy
Mitotically create COPIES of yourself; you could carry weapon that are part of YOU
At rest your body is of amorphous consistency rendering you immune to sharp & blunt trauma
weaknesses: Susceptible to absolute zero temperatures & you have no superhuman form of energy projection
Unless you touch the duplicates of yourself they are stuck in whatever form they've shifted into
When shifted immune to the fluid, solid or energy a duplicate has become not the true element

name: Ground Manipulation
description: Also called Ground Control, this is the power to manipulate the earth BENEATH ONE'S FEET. The user can't pull rocks up from the earth, and can't manipulate any AIRBORNE or HELD earthen objects. However, the user isn't at a disadvantage with this power; they can still cause monstrous tremors, make the ground ripple and cause constructs to be formed from the earth, as long as they remain in contact with the ground. You can even cause the earth to part, for easy tunneling.
summary: The ability to control the ground beneath your feet
strengths: Make the ground shake, crumble and ripple at will
Displace ground for effective digging
Form constructs (spikes, walls, pillars, etc.) as long as they stay in contact with the ground
weaknesses: Can't hurl rock through the air (or above ground AT ALL)
Can't manipulate rock that is hurling (or being hurled) at you
Power may be untamed at first, causing earthquakes, tremors, etc.

name: Reactive Knowledge Gain
description: Tied up with very hard rope and there is a bomb in the room? This power helps you by allowing you to gain knowledge of how you could break the rope and disable the bomb. There are limits of this power though, this power only helps you escape not win battles, and you gain knowledge as you need it, not as you want it.
summary: The ability to gain knowledge as you need it.
strengths: Gain knowledge as you need it!
weaknesses: Doesn't help you win battles.
Only when you need it, not wan't it.

name: Creation
description: The power of 'Creation' allows you to (once per day) create any object, creature, item, weapon, armor, vehicle (including spaceships), or place (like a house or city) that you can imagine. The object may be living or non-living, of nearly any size, of any complexity, and of any materials imaginable. The object will have all the abilities, attributes, traits, limitations and weaknesses that you 'assume it' to have. The object may be reality based: like a car, or fictional: a Star Ship Enterprise.
summary: The ability to create any object microscopic to global in size and in complexity
strengths: Gives you 'Godlike' power.
weaknesses: Before you can use 'Creation', you must have had the power 'object creation' for 2 years first.
You can only use this power once per day.
The created object may not be smaller than an atom, or larger than the planet earth.

name: Existence Manipulation
description: This is the fraternal twin of Self-Existence Manipulation. It allows you to control the existence of everything, but yourself. To put it more simply, you can control what things are. You are not the creator of all, but more like the molder. All of existence is yours to control.
summary: The ability to manipulate existence
strengths: Near unlimited power.
Can control existence of all things.
weaknesses: You cannot control your own existence
You have much power, but need even more control.

name: Hydrokinesis
description: Water is everywhere. Imagine being able to control it. Creating crushing geysers, floating streams, and even using water pressure to cut through things is in the range of a Hydrokinetic.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate liquids
strengths: Very versatile
Powerful and shocking to watch
Can be used to manipulate bodily fluids (to degree)
weaknesses: Cannot create water
Cannot destroy water
Cannot manipulate more than 100,000 gallons effectively

name: Energy Form
description: Flesh & blood is weak as an energy form; you don't have those weaknesses. You can emit & control all types of energy & not be hurt by most attacks. Your energy form has no limits on your abilites. You can pass through anything that emits energy, even when you are destroyed. As long there is any part of you left, you can reform yourself. You don't age & can gain the properties of different energies. You can phase through objects at will, you can levitate or fly. You can stay transformed forever.
summary: The ability to transform into a being of pure energy
strengths: You have no limits on your abilities
You can reform when destroyed
You can emit and control energy
weaknesses: You can be trapped in places that are made to hold you
When you are in energy form you are vulnerable to energy absorption powers
You will be considered a freek

name: Scanning
description: With this power, you can make any plan foolproof. Find out what's wrong with any patient and be the world's best doctor. Or even fight super heroes/villains and use their weakness against them, winning the battle without even trying.
summary: The ability to see any weakness, flaw, or mistake by simply looking at something.
strengths: Pin point weaknesses, flaws or mistakes
Ace quizzes
Ultimate doctor, never lose any fight, unless you don't feel like winning. (pfft)
weaknesses: ..... Not really a power you can use without preparation

name: Top 10 Power Mimicry
description: The holder of this ability could be a very powerful person, as they have the top ten most wanted powers on the Superpower List. Unfortunately, once the preferences change, you get a new ten powers. Remember, the top ten may not be your favorites. However, if you do not like an ability, you can suppress it. If this is one of the top ten, you get the other nine and the eleventh.
summary: The ability to have the top 10 powers.
strengths: Getting some really good powers.
Having ten at a time!
You can suppress powers you don't want.
weaknesses: Not everyone has the same preferences.
Some powers are redundant -who wants Space/Time Manipulation and Teleportation?
The powers may change too fast for you to get experience.

name: Supreme Earth Elementalist
description: You can summon Earthquakes of any size. You can Geologically change the grounds and the mountains within minutes. You can make grounds fertile from years of famine. You can grow trees that are higher than redwoods. Your body can transform into trees, rocks, metals or into soil. You can grow very nasty thorns from your own body. You can mold any soil into any rock, stone, or gem.
summary: The ability to rule over every aspect of Vegetation, Minerals and Soil
strengths: You can create seeds of new species of plants from your mind
You can easily make a path through a mountain
Making precious metals and stones are as easy as making pies
weaknesses: Fire is deadly
You'll make dirty footprints on someone's clean carpet
Doing Geology manipulation can kill someone if you're not careful

name: Zero Point Energy Field
description: If you've ever played Half-Life, or seen Syndrome's rays in the Incredibles, you will automatically know the practical uses for this power. A person with this power can shoot and "energy field" that can either blast things away or pick up and drag items closer to you. With this type of power you can turn things in your surroundings into deadly weapons as well as move heavy objects around your house.
summary: The ability to create the effect of a gravity gun by blasting energy from your hands
strengths: Pick up items to use as deadly weapons
Pick up heavy items from afar and carry them
Pick up people and prevent them from moving
weaknesses: People can dodge your initial energy blast
Needs to be creative

name: Chronospheres
description: With this ability you gain the power to forms spheres in you hands. Inside these spheres time either moves faster, is slowed down, or completely stopped at your discretion. You may then fire the sphere, at which point it will expand to encompass whatever it hits. Spheres will remain until banished by the user.
summary: The ability to create spheres in which the flow of time is different.
strengths: Stop time in a certain radius.
Speed up time in a certain radius.
Slow time in a certain radius.
weaknesses: You are just as vulneable to the spheres as anyone else.
The spheres will encompass only what they hit.

name: Perfect Eyesight
description: With this power you can allow yourself and other to have 20/20 vision. However when this power is used on somebody it causes them to loose all eye/sight related super powers such as laser vision, video eyes, eye grenades, etc. Even when you use this power on yourself you loose all of your eye/sight related super powers except for this one. This power also make sure the person this power is used upon's eyesight never become less than perfect no matter what happens to his/her eyes.
summary: The ability to allow yourself and other to have perfect vision
strengths: You can give yourself or other perfect vision
You can use it on enemies and cause them to lose their eye/sight related powers
The person this is used upon can never lose their perfect vision
weaknesses: When this power is used the person it is used on loses all of their eye/sight based powers

name: Power Personification
description: With this power you can choose one of your powers and create a physical form for it. Once this is done you can only use that power through the new personification. Luckily it has no mind or thoughts of its own, instead acting as an extension of your own body and responding to your thoughts and feelings as though it were your own arm. The form the power takes when personified depends on both the power and the user, and it can be dematerialized and hidden within the users body at any time.
summary: The ability to personify one of your powers into physical form.
strengths: Attack from two seperate directions.
Seperate a power that has a negative drawback from yourself while still getting the benefits.
It behaves exactly how the power it used to be did, but it can now punch people as well.
weaknesses: Because you're connected you take any damage the personification does.
You can only ever have one power personified.

name: Transformers: Rapido
description: With this power you automatically hold a higher rank than everyone else in the room. If a person that ranks higher than you in your organization walks into the room your rank and clearance level automatically increase. So if you were to walk into a room with the President or some other head of state you would automatically have a higher rank than them and be able to command them.
summary: The ability to outrank everybody
strengths: You outrank everybody
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Never Ending Shopping List
description: This power allows you to summon a small white roll of paper that will never run out. All you have to do is write the correct name of something you can buy and it will be delivered to your house, free of charge, the next day when no one is looking. Your purchase will always be left outside your house, as close to the doorstep as possible. If you tear part of the list off you will be expected to pay for everything written under the tear off point. If the list is destroyed, you pay for everything.
summary: The ability to order anything you could possible want, free of charge, just by writing it down
strengths: Order anything you can buy and have it deliverd to your house, free.
weaknesses: The list can not be unsummond once it appears, and will eventually get very long from use.
If the list is torn or destroyed, you "pay" for everything you wrote that is no longer on the list.
There are some things that are not for sale.

name: Physically Perfect
description: Physically, meaning your body. This qualifies as looks and strength. This power allows the user to be extremely good looking and have amazing strength. Also, although you don't need to, if you take care of your body, in return your body will become resistant to physical harm and your appearance will become so attractive that you'll be able to take control over the will power of others. You'll be physically perfect.
summary: The ability to be physically perfect
strengths: Extremely good looking
Amazing strength, maybe resistant to physical harm
Control the will power of others
weaknesses: Mental imperfections remain

name: Dimensions Of Fiction
description: In addition to our own home reality, an infinite number of alternate realities based upon the works of fiction exist. This power allows the user to open and close safe & stable interdimensional portals at will. These portals can be used to travel instantaneously to any point, place, & time within these alternate realities.
