They can take anyone & anything with them into and out of any of these alternate realities, and also back to one's home reality.
summary: The ability to open portals into alternate realities that are based upon the works of fiction
strengths: Alternate realities includes all forms of fiction portrayed in all forms of medium.
All alternate realities appear portrayed in live action, just like our home reality.
Can change events within any alternate realities and have adventures alongside your favorite heroes.
weaknesses: Might have bad experience in some dimensions.
Might change things for the worst within the dimensions, including our own.
Could bring evil villains or zombies home with you.

name: Inertia Manipulation
description: Inertia is the resistance of any physical object to a change in its state of motion or rest when it is acted upon by an external force. Those who can control inertia are able to control the outside resistances and make the object immune to such things like wind resistance or gravity, allowing them to redirect, speed up, slow down, or even entirely halt an object in mid-air. This can be used to hit harder, run faster, and even curve the direction of things like bullets.
summary: The ability to control the inertia of any object.
strengths: Able to halt incoming attacks
Able to choose a destination an object is going
Able to increase the user's own physical speed and strength
weaknesses: Without any resistance, the object will continue on forever
The user moving at superhuman speeds doesn't mean the user can perceive at a superhuman rate
An object must be in motion before it can be redirected, stopped, or sped up

name: Diamond Water
description: With this power you can transmute water into diamonds at will. It doesn't matter what kind of water, it all becomes the same kind of diamond. Not ruby, not emerald, not amethyst or that topaz crap. Diamonds. Not gold, not silver, not any other metals. Not to mention, the diamonds generated from the water, you can manipulate to form constructs, shoot at foes, and other cool stuff. 'Nuff said.
summary: The ability to transmute water into diamond, and manipulate the diamond you made from the water
strengths: Um, hello...DIAMONDS!
Water is one of the most abundant elements on earth
Control the diamonds you form from water
weaknesses: Only works with liquid water
Only makes diamonds (if you don't like diamonds, too bad)
Only manipulate diamond that is made from water

name: Words To Items
description: A person with this power can turn their words into objects. They can get whatever they say out loud. For example if they say sword they can get a sword. If they are more specific they can get better items. For example if they wanted a gun but they wanted something that can shoot faster they can state Gun that shoots at lightspeed or is always faster than target. However the limitation of this power is that it cannot create people. The objects will disappear after a while.
summary: The ability to change words into items as long as the sentence begins with I want.
strengths: Get any weapon or device by saying it
Can get anything as long as it is not unique
It doesn't matter how fast you say it or what language you say it in
weaknesses: If people stop you from talking
Having an item doesn't mean you are proficient with it
No surprise because they will expect whatever you pull out

name: Game World Reality
description: The game must have a setting. Monopoly would just work. The game can be a board game, RPG, card, computer, online or miniatures. The nature laws of a game reality can be entirely based on the game rules or based on real world laws or somewhere in between. If you can die in the game you can die in the game world. Objects can't be taken from a game world. However you could bring 100 fire elemental miniatures to a D&D world and have a 100 elementals ready to serve you.
summary: The ability to create worlds in an alternate reality based on games.
strengths: A game where death never happens.
Actually live out your favorite game fantasies.
weaknesses: Any dangerous game realities. Warhammer 40000, Rifts, horror games.
You can't leave with objects found in the game reality.

name: Change Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to controls the an aspect of change. This involves shapeshifting, evolution, matter transmutation,invisibility etc. The user has absolute power over them. The user can't control the things that he changes except himself. He can also reverse the changes and make any changes positive or negative. he can make things consistent or inconsistent. This power is the master control of all changing powers. The user can even stop change as well.
summary: The ability to control all aspects of physical change.
strengths: Change anything
Neutralize all changelings' powers
weaknesses: Can't control things that change.
Unlike reality warping, the user can't change stuff from a planet to universal scale without...
... killing himself. It takes years of training.

name: Approvability
description: This ability allows people around the user to speak nothing but positive things about him. This also makes people approve on your action even when it is down right cruel or evil. This can allow you to do almost anything within your power.
summary: The ability to be approved by everyone, even when you don't deserve it.
strengths: To be approved by all
All deeds will be accepted
weaknesses: Limited range

name: The Watch Of Destiny
description: The Watch of Destiny is a mystical object created by Father Time. If you obtain this you may see or control someone's age or fate. You can't lose this object because whoever possesses it will have it attached to their skin. The only ways to get rid of it is to die or cut your wrist off.
summary: The ability to control a being's fate.
strengths: Make it so a bully is two years old.
Make a supermodel make out with you.
Make your family discover a gold mine.
weaknesses: It hurts a lot to get it removed.

name: Pyrokinesis
description: A person with Pyrokinesis can ignite oxygen in the air, creating a fire sustained with willpower. These fires can be directed, manipulated, and generally had a lot of fun with.
summary: The ability to start fires with your mind
strengths: Revenge
Never need kerosene again
Win every fight
weaknesses: Revenge
Still can be burned
Losing your temper can really have consequences

name: Freeze Time
description: With this power, you can freeze time, except for yourself, for up to one hour.
summary: The ability to freeze time.
strengths: Freeze time.
Not be bothered by anyone.
Get places fast (but not to you).
weaknesses: You can't drive anywhere.
Nothing will work. E.g. Your pages won't turn or the computer won't turn on.
It is only for an hour.

name: Castling
description: Castling is a form of teleportation where you exchange your location with someone else's. You switch places. It gets its name from the Chess move where the Rook and King simultaneously - The King moves into a safer location, and the Rook moves into a more dangerous area where it can either defend the king or take a more active, aggressive role.
summary: The ability to teleport and exchange locations with another individual
strengths: If you are in danger, exchange places with your foe
If ally is in danger, exchange places with them to protect them
weaknesses: Make sure you know where you are teleporting into or else there can be trouble
May exchange locations and one or both of you may not be able to deal with the new problems

name: Glossa
description: Speak any language without having to learn it. For instance if you wanted to travel to France but can't speak it, with this power you'll be unstoppable.
summary: The ability to speak any language without having to learn it.
strengths: You can vist those places you've always wanted to go.
You'd get an A+ in Spanish, French, Chinese or whatever your taking.
Don't need years of training!
weaknesses: You can't turn it off

name: Mind Creation
description: When you're walking and someone is going to shoot you, you can create a shield of any kind and deflect it, or you can summon something else.
summary: The ability to create any weapon using your mind and hand motions.
strengths: It's easy to pull out a weapon without any struggles.
You can be prepared for any battle.
they can't steal your weapon.
weaknesses: Your hands will get tired.
When shocked you won't think straight.
You won't know what will be the right weapon.

name: Magic Symbols
description: Sorcery is the art of using magical symbols to gain control of other supernatural powers. This ability gives you knowledge of those same symbols. All you would have to do would be draw the symbol somewhere and then focus your energy on it. The symbol will then glow and give you the power the symbol represents. Depending on how much of your energy you direct at the symbol the longer your power will last.
summary: The ability to use magical symbols to obtain other powers
strengths: You know hundreds of magical symbols and what they represent
The symbols can be drawn anywhere. The floor, a piece of paper, your iPod, the wall, etc.
weaknesses: While you are very powerful you can't do everything

name: Speed
description: Speed will allow the user to run on water as his quick footwork avoids breaking apart the water's surface tension; run up walls before gravity takes its toll; vibrate molecules so fast that light fails to reflect them off, rendering him invisible. Further vibrations will allow your molecules to vibrate in their fixed positions above the speed of sound, allowing the body to move faster than Mach 4. Pushing the limits even further will cause the body to move at light speed, perhaps faster.
summary: The ability to move at high speeds capable of passing through the barrier of light.
strengths: Running around the world 7 times in a sec (light speed) to deliver a matter-shattering punch.
Enjoy the wind and freedom of speed.
Quick reactions to dodge allowing yourself no harm.
weaknesses: Need to train the perception of speed to avoid splattering innocent bystanders
Requires high stamina to run long distances.
Try not to trip. XD
tags: Speed Jet Sonic Burst Pistol Gattling Gun

name: Distance Manipulation
description: A person with this ability can manipulate the distances between any 2 points at will. However, space does not look warped at all. The only indication that change has been made is when people realize that they are going nowhere. I.e. if they try to move, they still feel like they are moving, until they realize that they only moved a few inches or not at all. The user can use this to "teleport" by shortening the distance between 2 points, allowing them to go miles with just a step.
summary: The ability to change the distances between any 2 points at will without creating perceptions of change
strengths: Similar to teleportation--literally walk miles with 1 step--watch out for walls though
"Stop Bullets" They are still moving but it looks like it is stopped in place
Create an area of infinite(near infinite) distance to trap people
weaknesses: No spacial sense comes with it--you see exactly what other people see when you make changes
Does not grant superspeed--no matter what it looks like
Time and gravity flows normally in distorted space--could be a good or bad thing

name: Nature Hero
description: When activated, you have access to every living species of animal on Earth. You can also draw strength from them and aquire their abilities. Since you are the Nature Hero, they obey your every command and operate on a "hive mind", meaning you can control an entire army of these beasties.
summary: The ability to evolve living creatures, tame them, and mimic their abilities.
strengths: Evolve a whale to an ocean fortress.
Mimic a tiger, bat, chameleon, wolf, and become a super predator.
See through the eyes of a hawk.
weaknesses: You are only capable of mimicking four different animals at one time.
Operating a "hive mind" could be frustrating.

name: Overpower
description: Control Gravitation, Nuclear forces & Electromagnetism. You could manipulate every item in the known universe. Well, everything you can see at least. You sense, control & alter subatomic particles. Change the properties of matter. Convert energy into gravity or vice versa. Change ice to flame in a blink of an eye. If you are brave, you could even create subatomic particles. All this power will have dire consequences, like everyone thinking you are a god.
summary: The ability to manipulate subatomic particles
strengths: Strip energy, gravity, matter, nuclear forces down to subatomic levels & change them into any form
See everything at a subatomic level, invisibility, diguises & shape-shifters cannot fool you
Separating subatomic particles will produce unlimited raw energy which, of course, you control
weaknesses: You can not change yourself. You must physical see the object you are affecting.
Complex organisms (like humans) tend to die if shape-shifted incorrectly, you cannot create life
Creating new particles makes you feel like you are being ripped apart & burning alive simultaneously

name: Ultraviolet Pyrokinesis
description: A person with this power can wield flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum. This means that the flame is practically invisible except for the hint of distorted air currents. The flames are so hot and powerful that they can cause most things to sublime instead of melt. The user is aware of the location of their own flames and with practice can focus their flame so that it needn't be so destructive. The flame is fueled by user willpower as opposed to O2 and does not harm the user.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that can only be seen in the ultraviolet spectrum
strengths: Practically invisible to the naked eye except for distorted air patterns
Can sublime substances instantly---turn to gas
The user has required secondary powers
weaknesses: Its very dangerous to use
Can't use it to light torches----it will burn it out

name: Time Travel
description: A Time Traveler doesn't need a DeLorean or special chair to navigate the timeline. The only thing they require is a bit of focus to travel through time. They have less restrictions on their power than a Space-Time Manipulator; time travel takes less out of them, they can interact with their past and future selves, and they can even influence present events by messing with the past. However, they cannot teleport.
summary: The ability to move forward and backward in time
strengths: Requires moderate focus
Can interact with past and future selves
Can influence present events by going into the past
weaknesses: Cannot teleport
Fighting your future self
May change future for worse

name: Body Supremacy
description: Also called Body Mastery or Free Motion, this ability allows you a freedom of movement that is uninhibited by an unawareness of what your body can do. As such, you can use your body in various ways that would normally require practice first. Effortlessly do back flips, handstands, cartwheels, various fight moves, go from a supine position to upright in one move, and many other athletic feats. In addition, your motions cannot be dominated or otherwise controlled by anyone except you.
summary: The ability to have total awareness, familiarity and control of all the motions made by your body
strengths: Totally aware and familiar with every move you make (swim speed equals land speed, etc. )
Move by the most efficient means; get the most out of every move you make (conserve stamina)
Foes cannot take control of your motions by any means other than pure brute physical force
weaknesses: Control of the body doesn't mean Shapeshifting, Rapid Regeneration or Longevity/Immortality
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Immutability (can still be altered, etc. )
Resisting bodily domination isn't same as Psychic Immunity (mind can still be read)

name: Power Of The Hercules Beetle
description: The user is able to lift up objects 850 times heavier that the user's body weight. For example, if your body weight is 60kg , you can lift up objects as heavy as 19,000 kg. This power also grants the user the ability to fly.
summary: The ability to lift up objects 850 times than your body weight as well as fly
strengths: Super Human Strength
Has the ability to fly
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: None so far has been observed

name: Shadow Kinetics
description: The user can use anything solid to get potiental energy: rocks, objects, people. It only works if they stand still enough. Once the energy is absorbed, the user gains more kinetic energy which boosts their speed and agility. The reason why I called it "Shadow Kinetic" is because not only the victim of this ability can't move because there isn't enough potiential energy to turn into kinetic energy, but when they see the user moves, it'd be like they were a living shadow because they can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potential energy of any solid thing to boost the user's speed and agility.
strengths: Boost speed and agility.
Immobilizes opponents.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving.

name: Earth Bender
description: (Earth is the element of substance) you can manipulate the earth. The source of your power  Is the earth. Water is your weakness. When you master earth bending you can metal bend.
summary: The ability to become a Earth bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
strengths: You can sand bend
You can metal bend at higher levels
You can earth bend
weaknesses: You have a deep hatred and mistrust against fire benders
You like to eat bugs
You have a deep desire to kill fire benders

name: Digital Duplication
description: Your eyes scan any object whether they are physical or a mere representation. You are then able to duplicate the item perfectly from material around them.
summary: The ability to scan an object, then perfectly duplicate it in reality.
strengths: Near endless possibilities
Able to adapt to certain situations
weaknesses: Useless in pitch black situations
Material used must be of exact mass

name: Power Adaptation
description: If you get thrown from a building, you are probably thinking ''oh crap'' right? Nope! With this power you'll probably get the power to fly or wall crawl or teleport to save yourself. If a car is falling on you, you'll probably get superstrength or time stop of superspeed to get out of the way.
summary: The ability to get a random power to help you in the specific moment
strengths: The powers you use in the moment you keep
They might be really good powers
weaknesses: You only get to keep five powers so once you get power #5 you stop adapting

name: Precognitive Reflexes
description: With this ability, your mind is constantly in-tune to the forces of fate. As such, your body warns you of future events without being distracted by those pesky visions. In other words, if you need to do a certain movement (within your physical capability) in order to avoid danger, or otherwise help you out, then it will be done. This ability makes combat a breeze, because you don't even have to consciously think about it; your subconscious reflexes will kick in to do all the work for you.
summary: The ability to have one's reflexes facilitated through a subconscious perception of the future
strengths: Your subconscious always perceives the immediate future, often bestowing Superhuman Reflexes
Once you develop your power, it can be used for more than just combat (tests, sports, etc. )
This is just as effective against probability manipulation as Unpredictability
weaknesses: If you can't control it, may make social situations awkward or annoying
The strongest sense manipulators can distort the subconscious perception
If you decide to override your subconscious perception, may lead to disastrous conscequences

name: Psychic Static Telepathy
description: This is an extremely rare form of telepathy. A person can augment the electricity in other people's brains, thus creating 'psychic static', which thus augments their thoughts and memories. Psychic static is similar to ordinary static electricity, but is much stronger. Strenuous use of this form of telepathy can result in feedback, much like a microphone next to a speaker. This power is highly versatile in that a person can create illusions that distort other's physical and mental perceptions.
summary: The ability to control brainwaves to read the minds and memories of others
strengths: One of the strongest forms of telepathy known to exist
Psychic static can augment received thoughts from others
They cannot feel the energy, and won't know you are looking into their mind
weaknesses: This power is difficult to control at first
This power can cause migraines and/or nosebleeds if not consciously controlled
Trying to read other psychics is near impossible due to the nature of this ability

name: Technologically Endowed
description: You will completely understand everything that is remotely technology. You will also have a sense of feelings for it, and it will all be under your control. When your human body dies, you'll still be alive in everything that's electronical, so you'll never die. In our world, where technology is becoming more and more like us, adaptive and a force to be reckoned with,... I give you this.
summary: The ability to completely control and be with one with technology
strengths: Control all technology and electrical machines and devices
Understand everything about it
Have knowledge of anything that is stored in a memory device or anything thats considered technology
weaknesses: Might lose respect for life
You know almost everything in the world, now what?

name: Sinister Luck
description: With this power, you can make yourself unnaturally lucky by stealing the luck from others. However, the luck that you drain from others will only last for 24 hours, so once your luck is back to normal, find someone nearby and suck out all of their luck.
summary: The ability to drain the luck from others to increase your own.
strengths: Win the lottery
Every gamble will work in your favor
Drain the luck from others like a parasite
weaknesses: Without their luck, people will fall into despair
Bad things will happen to them more often
Casinos may accuse you of cheating

name: Supreme Fire Elementalist
description:
You have control of anything hot and burning. From magma to lightning. You can manipulate fire, or you can generate fire from your own body. You can mold magma with your bear hands you can walk over magma with your bear feet. You also can turn your body into a mass made of Magma. You can redirect lightning, as well as become a body of lightning. 
you can breath fire, as well as throwing fire.
summary: The ability to have supreme powers of Fire and extreme heat.
strengths: Fire cannot burn you
You can control it
(If your powerful enough) you can master lightning
weaknesses: It takes a while to master lightning
Objects and people around you are more likely to get burned
You have to have super reflexes in order to redirect lightning

name: Heat Manipulation
description: Heat is one of the main forms of energy. This power allows you to manipulate it in almost any way you can think of, giving you tremendous power. You can shoot blasts or waves of pure heat. You can will heat into shapes or weapons  You could even freeze something by removing the heat from it. Naturally, you are also immune to the effects of heat, so you can never be burned again.
summary: The ability to manipulate heat.
strengths: You can completely control heat
You can create shapes and weapons out of heat
You can't be hurt by heat
weaknesses: Heat shapes wont be totally soild
There is such a thing as too warm

name: Purpose Inducement
description: This ability allows the user to give a purpose to something or change its pervious purpose to something that fit the user or other's needs. This is done by warping the reality of that thing without changing much of it's physical existence.  For example, changing the purpose of a venus flytrap from catching insects into store energy. Another example would be to giving a person the purpose of being your minion. This effect only last for several hours or more.
summary: The ability to create or change a purpose or function of person, object, or ability .
strengths: Give something a specific purpose no matter how strange it is.
Change the purpose of something
Affects powers
weaknesses: Only last for a short while
Cannot change their physical appearance.

name: Bio Finite Control
description: You can manipulate biological aspects of yourself e.g. manipulate biological clock (your age), control your mass and size, so you can control the amount of space you occupy by affecting your size. Electrical resistance etc. can also be controlled (the amount of current passing through your body if ever struck by lightning). This is a defensive power.
summary: The ability to manipulate the biological aspects of oneself.
strengths: Potential to live forever.
Can control all finite elements of one's own body.
weaknesses: Can not affect others, it is a self-casting ability.
The uses of this ability are not limitless.
Can not time travel, teleport, conduct electricity e.g.

name: Water Control
description: You can control water sources and alter the physical state between its phases. You can bring it from air, ground, trees, plant and obvious areas. It can be used to walk on water, travel underwater, grab objects and control people.
summary: The ability to control all forms of water, i.e. mist, fog, ice, steam, etc.
strengths: You control an element
Looks really cool if you have control
weaknesses: Lack of water in area
Lack of control of larger attack

name: Primalism (Primal Lord)
description: This infinite ancient power has existed since the very beginning of life and time itself. No one, not even Gods knows where this unimaginable force came from. It is rumored to be the power core of the cosmic balance called 'The Balance of Creation'. Becoming a Primal-Lord. One who is bestowed with this great power can create new life in the universe, revive anyone who is dead and start off any species evolution. With this power, he/she is considered to have God status.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate both the essence of life and evolution itself
strengths: Able to create any new life and give life to those that are deceased
Start off any species evolution
You'll be the deity of Life (also known as a Primal-Lord). So, you'll be very, very, very powerful.
weaknesses: Causes great cosmic calamity to creation itself if the user is too power crazy of being like a God
Reviving those who are evil (like Hitler) or a species that died out naturally (like the dinosaurs)
If you change the natural laws of life for the wrong reason, you'll be stripped off of this power

name: Plasma Generation
description: You can generate plasma bolts, like in The Sorcerer's Apprentice, and other things with plasma. You can create a plasma, like electricity to power your house, create plasma shields to protect you from any kind of attack, etc. The uses are only limited by your imagination.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate plasma
strengths: Don't need to pay your electricity bills
Great for self-defense
Powerful ability
weaknesses: Dangerous if you're a supervillain

name: Omnilingual Translator
description: The user is able to translate any language in the known universe, no matter how obscure or ancient the language is. The user is able translate any language, however when the text is removed from the user, he has no recollection or any knowledge about the language he or she just translated. In a nutshell, the user cannot save the language and only can translate it.
summary: The ability to translate any language in the known universe
strengths: Good for archeologist on Earth
Good at determining alien languages
weaknesses: Not combat oriented

name: Auto Dodge
description: This ability lets you dodge everything that is in motion towards you. For example, bullets and punches can be dodged. This ability is automatic so you must dodge no matter what. Even if you try really hard you must dodge. No one can ambush you since even if you don't see an object your body will dodge it subconsciously. This ability also means that you mostly can't be touched so you won't be able to hug anyone. This ability is active even when asleep.
summary: The ability to dodge anything and everything that can threaten you
strengths: Can even dodge bullets and perform superhuman feats in order to dodge
No one can ambush you
Can also learn how to counter at the same time as dodging
weaknesses: Can't be touched-You automatically dodge hugs and high fives
Your muscles still get tired if you dodge continuously

name: Solar Electrical Generation
description: With this ability, the user's skin generates electricity when exposed to the sun, effectively becoming a solar panel. One can use this energy with energy-based powers, fire it at people or simply charge electronics. The more sunlight they are exposed to, the stronger their ability. The more experienced the user becomes and the stronger their ability is, the better the conversion rate.
summary: The ability to generate electricity while in sunlight.
strengths: Electrokinesis when in sunlight.
Go for a walk in the sun and charge your electronics.
Charge other powers.
weaknesses: Only works when in the sun.
May not generate much power in cold climates.
Could be dangerous if you have not yet learned to control it.

name: Fly
description: The ability to fly, thats pretty much it.
summary: The ability to fly. (no arm flapping required)
strengths: No need for a car or a plane.
weaknesses: Airplanes
Hitchhikers
tags: now you don't need your dreams for this

name: Reactive Adaptation
description: Reactive Adaptation allows the person using this power to "react" to their environment or other factors relativly quickly. In the same way that insects become immune to a pesticide over several generations, the user of Reactive Adaptation becomes immune to whatever they are exposed to. For example, if burned multiple times, the person may become fireproof...or they may develop the ability to expel water to put out the fire
summary: The ability to become immune to whatever you are exposed to
strengths: Hard to be hurt the same way more than a few times
Can easily develop superhuman atributes by need
weaknesses: If killed, the power is useless

name: Molecule Manipulation
description: You can make things out of thin air. For example, to imprison anyone in a cage, etc. You can control molecules and atoms, meaning you can turn metal into gold, water to petroleum, carbon dioxide to oxygen, speed up and slow down their vibrations and anything you can think of.
summary: The ability to control molecules and atoms
strengths: Make things out of thin air
Turn water to ice
Deadly
weaknesses: Powered by emotion and concentration (mostly emotion)
Can't control energy particles

name: Energy Transfer
description: This is a simple, complex, and powerful ability. It allows you to transfer energy of any kind to anything else. For example, if you had a lit candle and a ball. You could transfer the energy from the flame to the ball, causing it to burst into flames or move(you can also change the type of energy). Or you could use the energy to promote change around you. If you could generate enough energy, you could create a powerful storm, send yourself through time, or even create new life-forms.
summary: The ability to transfer energy from one thing to another
strengths: Very powerful and has almost limitless uses
Can do almost anything if you have the energy
Can heal yourself and others with the energy around you.
weaknesses: The bigger the transfer of energy, the harder it is.
Can only do as much as the amount of energy you have allows

name: Nosokinesis
description: One with this ability can psychically control microscopic pathogens of any kind. This means the user can generate any kind of bacteria or virus at will, alter their numbers, their potency and their speed of production. The user can also intensify/suppress illness (in self and others) or intensify/suppress their symptoms. At the higher levels, one can even turn one kind of pathogen into another, make new ones, change how they are spread (airborne, contagious, etc) or kill them at will.
summary: The ability to manipulate disease-inducing pathogen (bacteria, viruses, etc. )
strengths: Generate and manipulate any kind of microscopic pathogen (virus, bacteria, rogue protein, etc. )
Become immune to them (and have the ability to kill them at will)
Change their properties for one's own purposes
weaknesses: Disease Immunity
Disease Absorption
At the lower levels, you'd better stick with lesser illnesses (no immunity)

name: Conduit
description: When energies of other superpowers are directed at you, your body becomes a conduit for these powers. They pass through you and out again in your chosen direction. As certain powers pass through you, they may energise you. Users with high willpower are able to keep the power contained in themselfs for a short period of time instead of having to release them imediatly. (note: you do not keep the power only redirect it)
summary: The ability to channel energies or powers directed at you
strengths: Deflect energy blasts, elemental attacks and other powers back at their users
Immune to many powers
Channel energies such as electricty or magnetism if you can find a constant source
weaknesses: Does not work on all superpowers (physical attacks for instance)

name: Superhuman Speed
description: Superhuman speedsters can run at speeds of up to Mach 1 for extended periods. Their thinking processes, hand movements, eye motion, and reaction times are similarily faster. These energies are fueled by either massive amounts of food or an absorption state during sleep.
summary: The ability to move at above-human speeds
strengths: Never be late
Have fun in dodgeball
Thievery
weaknesses: Need to eat all the time
Normal life seems slow
May be kidnapped by FBI and studied

name: Destiny Alteration
description: The person with this power can change the future. At any given time you can activate the power, see the future and change it however you like. You start off by being able to change small events or affect a few people, but with training, you could change global or even universal events.
summary: The ability to change destiny
strengths: Can change any event.
Can stop some one from being destined to die.
weaknesses: Takes up lots of strength to change events on a grand scale.
You might make the world worse, but usually, if you are careful, it'll turn out okay

name: Substance Transmutation
description: This ability allows you to change the substance material of anything you come in contact with. You could turn air into laughing gas, lead into glass, or water into soda. Imagine making gold nuggets out of gravel, or vanilla ice cream out of snow. You can turn foes into iron statues, mud into gasoline, carbon dioxide into helium, or ice into plutonium. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to change an article from one substance to another.
strengths: You can generate a lot of valuable material.
You would never run out of food.
weaknesses: The object you transmute will still have the same size and shape as it did before.
The object you transmute will still be the same temperature it was before.

name: The Gambler
description:
With this ability you can win any bet no matter how ridiculous as long as you can get someone to agree to bet you. For example if you bet someone that you can lift 500lbs, you can. But if they do not agree on the bet you are out of luck. 
Note that bets should be carefully worded as techicalities still count and the outcome is not always what you hope for
summary: The ability to win any agreed upon bet
strengths: Never lose a bet
Can igrnore laws of physics to win bets
As long a some one agrees to bet you, you can do anything
weaknesses: You must have someone to accept the bet to suceed
Bets work to the letter, eg 'A bullet cannot kill me ' means that you could still be gravely injured
Winning the bet does not force the other party to pay up, they may try to stiff you

name: Awakened Mage
description: After having your magic power awakened, you can cast spells personalized to you from your spellbook. The spellbook describes each spell in detail. As your magic power grows, so does the spellbook and the number of spells you cast. Which spells you get are determined by how you use the spells you already have.
summary: The ability to cast your own personalized spells
strengths: Can cast a wide range of spells
Spells are custom to your personality and habits
weaknesses: Can't choose what spells you get

name: Reflexive Precognition
description: A person with this power can see a moment in time or action before it actually happens, giving them more time to react, making it appear as if they have amazingly quick reflexes.
summary: The ability to see moments in time before they happen
strengths: Amaze people with your reaction time.
Never make a wrong move.
Never be caught off guard.
weaknesses: You aren't surprised by anything anymore.

name: Mending
description: Also called Reconstruction/Rebuilding/Repair or the Fix-It Effect, this is the psychic ability to fix broken/damaged inanimate objects, by touch, word, thought or gesture. One with this ability can fix bent/scratched/dented/warped/melted items back to perfect working condition, at will. In addition, one can undo cracking damage, or cause broken parts to pull back together. One can also undo water, burning or acid damage, at will. One can even repair complex systems (ie electronic devices).
summary: The ability to repair and fix damaged inorganic matter, at will
strengths: Repair any bent/dented/scratched/warped/melted item, at will (even uncrumples paper, ie dollars)
Repair cracked items; if broken, item's pieces can rejoin, or each piece regenerate a new copy
Undo water/fire/acid damage; replair complex systems like electronics
weaknesses: Put other mechanics and repairmen out of business (awful for the economy)
Does not affect living/organic matter (to use on plant matter, must be processed wood/paper) (NCN)
Erases electronic information stored in the broken part, unless accompanied by Technopathy (NCN)

name: Power Ring Summon
description: With this power you can summon any color power ring featured in DC comics (green, blue, indigo, orange, red, white, black, yellow, pink/violet) and use them to fight (or commit) crime. They work the same way they would in the comics. Once you summon them you cannot send them back and are forced to keep them.
summary: The ability to summon any color power ring
strengths: You can summon any power ring from DC comics
They can do anything they can do in the comics
weaknesses: You cannot send them back once you summon them

name: Aura Claws
description: The claws have a color that is the same as your aura because they are formed from your aura. The are sharper than the sharpest katana ever and will ignore the skin during attacks to deal internal damage to your enemies body.
summary: The ability to create claws around one's hands or emitted from the tips of one's fingernails
strengths: It's really hard for anyone to determine the extent of the damage that you have dealt.
Your enemy has to cut themself open in order to determine how much damage you've done.
weaknesses: The claws can be blocked by anything that has been created from an aura.

name: The Ice Dragon
description: The user has the power to transform at will into a huge ice blue dragon that can control ice, water, and high temperature blue fire at will, and also use these powers to heal both oneself and others, regardless of their ailment or injury. The user can also live forever if they desire. They also have extremely powerful telepathic and telekinetic abilities.
summary: The ability to shift into a powerful 'ice dragon' form with power over fire, ice, and water
strengths: Can control ice, water, and blue fire at will, and also be granted immunity to any lethal force
Can control every aspect of the human mind with their telepathy
Can move and control objects with their mind via telekinetic 'vectors', and also fly in human form
weaknesses: The three elemental powers(ice, fire, and water) are all hard to manifest and control at first
Can be lethal to other people when used offensively
Healing of either oneself or others is slow to work at first

name: Earth Empathy
description: Like a tree with water, an Earth Empath sucks up raw energy from the planet's core. While standing on dirt, they can bench press 70 tons; on asphalt or something man-made, 30 tons; while wearing shoes, 10. They are also mildly invulnerable while exercising their power. However, prolonged seperation from the planet can kill them and soil pollution has an adverse affect on them.
summary: The ability to draw power from standing on the ground
strengths: While standing barefoot on dirt, can bench 70 tons
Mildly invulnerable while standing on the ground
Become unmovable just by taking a strong stance
weaknesses: Less strength/invulnerability while in the city, wearing shoes, etc.
Soil pollution has a physical affect on you
Prolonged seperation from the planet can kill you

name: Time Dilation
description: While the user is unable to stop time, they can make time go slower for themselves. When activated, everything else moves very, very slowly compared to the user. In effect, other people think you are moving at high speeds. You also avoid most problems of super speed, such as friction. You can move things in slowed time, but things you touch will react with the relative speed in real time. You can also make other people faster with this power if so desired.
summary: The ability to make time go slower relative to the user
strengths: Great for daily life-do things at a leisurely pace
The next best thing to time stop
Make attacks too slow to matter
weaknesses: The user cannot dilate time to get more sleep
The power only works on yourself and things you touch, but does not work on machines
If you get stabbed from behind while using this power, your death will be slow and painful

name: Transference
description: The wielder can transfer stamina, energy, strength and health to themselves or allies by draining it from opponents. This can physically wear out the opponent if a transference is made.
summary: The ability to transfer human neccesities to oneself and others
strengths: Transfer peoples stamina, health, energy and strength to the wielder or allies
Transfer fatigue, wounds and damage to other people
Strong combatant at close range
weaknesses: The transference can only take place through touch
The wielder can only transfer one thing at a time
Weak against long-ranged attacks

name: Aptitude Intensification
description: The bearer of this power has all of their innate,natural, and acquired skills increased to inhuman levels. They are automatically gifted in all range of skills they possessed beforehand and will be able to do anything they had practiced perfectly and effortlessly. In addition ALL of ones natural aspects(Strength, sight, speed, etc) related to the bearers specific skills will be increased as well. When developed the user needs only to learn the basics of a skill and instantly become good at it.
summary: The ability to increase all of ones innate or acquired skills and aspects.
strengths: It requires relativity little effort to  learn and master new skills.
Most people have some skill in most anything, even simple things can lead to aspect enhancement.
Any skills will have their related aspects enhanced as well.
weaknesses: Before your skills are increased you must actually HAVE skills to speak of. NCN
Those with one-upmanship abilities can still trump you.
Useless if one possesses no useful skills.

name: Mnemonic Reality Bending
description: If you have memories of good times gone, this power lets you go back, and relive them, or you can switch time so the event is yet to come. You can also bend reality to make your wildest and best dreams come true!
summary: The ability to manipulate time based on your memories and your dreams
strengths: Relive good times in your past
Make impossible things that you want to experience, happen
This power is only limited to your imagination!
weaknesses: If you're not creative, this power can be weakened
Sometimes it goes dormant if you can't remember good things that happened
This power is useless if you aren't the creative type

name: Cosmic String Manipulation
description: After getting this power, you can see the cosmic strings that form reality floating around everywhere. You cab change anything you want just by grabbing whatever the string is connected to and tugging it how you want it to be. However, you can only affect solid objects and liquids, and you have to be close enough to something to grab the string in order to affect it, and close enough to see it in order to pick something out in specific AND change it.
summary: The ability to bend reality by tugging on 'cosmic strings'
strengths: Can make the world be the way you want it.
Travel through time, space, and dimension. Transmute junk into anything you want.
Shapeshift into your ideal form, and mess with your own string to give yourself other powers.
weaknesses: Need to be close to the object; liquids are hard to manipulate and gasses are almost impossible.
While you will automatically get some proficiency with this, you can still mess things up.
Since you can not affect pure air, you need to make time/space/dimensional portals on a surface.

name: Shadow Portals
description: You can disappear into a shadow and move from one shadow to another while remaining unseen.
summary: The ability to not be seen when in shadows and to teleport to other shadows.
strengths: No limit to how long you can use it
Can go from place to place as long as a shadow is there
weaknesses: People will know that you're gone
Drains your energy

name: Object Summoning
description: You can make any object appear anywhere by saying a noun. Proper nouns are not allowed. As an example you could say "desk" and cause it to fall on your enemy. You could also say "fire" and set your enemy ablaze. Adjectives are allowed; for instance, "flaming desk". However, the object has to come from somewhere so it has to exist, and it also takes that object away from its owner. Also, anytime you say a noun without concentrating, it appears at a random location near you.
summary: The ability to make an object appear by saying its name
strengths: Very low effort ability
Easy to use
Can also be used for teleportation
weaknesses: Difficult to speak normally
Restricted to the boundaries of reality
Not allowed to summon Jessica Alba (hahahahahah)

name: Motion Termination
description: A person with motion termination is able to cause anything that is in motion to completely stop moving. For example if a ball is thrown and this power is used to stop the ball, it will freeze in mid air. Having the power is like having access to an on/off switch. The object remains stopped until the user decides to allow it to move again. More advanced users would be able stop every object or person within a certain area without having to think of every individual thing in that space.
summary: The ability to cause objects or people that are in motion to cease moving
strengths: Stop harmful projectiles in mid air
Stop anything, including people, from moving
Can be used to kill people by stopping their hearts
weaknesses: If you forget that you stopped something, it will remain stopped until you remember to allow movemnt

name: The Shadow Dragon
description: A person can control physical darkness and shadows, but this power is not at all evil. The person simply uses their mind to control it, and can become a powerful Shadow Dragon, similar in appearance to a Night Fury, with powers over a black fire that only they, or whom they choose, is immune to, and they can also use the fire to fully heal themselves or others. They can use the black fire in human form, are immortal, and have invisibility just like Peter Petrelli, but it blocks sound and heat.
summary: The ability to have all the powers over shadows and darkness
strengths: The powers of the Shadow Dragon can be used in human form, and are augmented by moonlight
You have extremely powerful 'black pyrokinesis', regeneration, invisibility, and vector telekinesis
They can easily overpower even the strongest light, manmade or natural, except for the sun
weaknesses: The sun is the only source they are powerless against
The shifting of human to dragon, and use of the powers, only works at night
Prolonged exposure to light stronger than the moon, if using the powers, weakens the user

name: Fate Change
description: Gives you the ability to see into the future ten days. Once you know what will happen to you or someone else, you can choose to change it. Ex: If you see you will die in the future, you can change that event. This power cannot be stolen. You would either see the event of the power getting stolen taking place and change it. If someone goes back in time, it cannot be stolen in the past, unless they are in a time period where you exist and had not changed that time even earlier in the past.
summary: The ability to change the fate of you or others around you
strengths: Can live forever if you change your future so that you do not age, every ten days
Cannot be stolen.
Can make sure your enemy will die.
weaknesses: Must change your time in advance. If you are already dead, it is to late.
Would make an unstoppable villan.
Can be replicated

name: Psychometric Telekinesis
description: With this power, a person can telekinetically control objects that they have previously seen or used, whether recently or in the distant past. It also works if the person relies on either their memory, or psychometry itself, to recognize an object. A secondary aspect of this ability is called telekinetic breakdown, where either one touch, or intense concentration without physical contact, can either partially or completely separate an object into it's individual parts(such as a handgun).
summary: The ability to move things with your mind that you have seen or have used
strengths: One of the strongest forms of telekinesis known
People with telepathy or intuitive aptitude can learn to control this ability much faster
Is extremely versatile once the person learns to control it
weaknesses: Confused or forgotten memories of objects you try to control will weaken this power
Memories of an object can be no older than one month

name: Mind Projection
description: You would be capable of projecting an astral version of yourself into another's mind. This ability would allow you to change and alter your opponent's choices and to explore their inner thoughts.
summary: The ability to project yourself into another's mind and alter their decisions or choices without their awareness
strengths: Control another's mind
Explore to find your opponent's weaknesses
To be able to make others believe your every word
weaknesses: Useless info
Family and friends might not trust you
You could possible become a control freak about everything around you

name: Conscience Manipulation
description:
Right through history the several psychopathic killers have murdered, raped and hurt without guilt, without anything holding them back. Until now. 

Having this ability means a psychopath's mind can be altered in such a way that he/she is GIVEN a conscience. Furthermore the amount of guilt someone feels when doing a certain action can also be manipulated. Even a person's ethics can be given a healthy boost by making alterations or additions to his or her conscience.
summary: The ability to manipulate another persons conscience.
strengths: Guilt can be altered as to cause extreme psychological discomfort when performing certain actions
Even psychopaths now have chances to live normal lives.
weaknesses: Your own conscience cannot be changed.
Short term alterations are temporary but do not cause any damage to your own conscience.
Changing a conscience forever chips away at your own and the lost piece cannot be recovered.

name: Perspective Manipulation
description: Anything you see, no matter how near or far, you may pick up and place it anywhere else in view. To you, it will always be the size it looks when you viewed it from where you are standing, but in reality the further away you place it, the bigger it will become. Move closer to it to see its true size. Want to make a pencil massive? Pick it up and place it in the distance. Want to shrink a tree? Pick it up and move it closer to you.
summary: The ability to manipulate the perspective of objects
strengths: Can grow or shrink anything in view.
Can pick up anything from a distance.
weaknesses: Only works on things in view.
May be hard to restore something to its original size.

name: Information Absorption
description: Everything is written down somewhere. An Information Absorber knows this for sure. By merely staring at a CD, encyclopedia, video cassette, or even a carved stone slab, they can memorize the information on it. This memory fades 100 times slower than a regular memory. Some users have allowed themselves to become overloaded, mostly by trying to absorb the Internet.
summary: The ability to absorb information from CDs, books, etc.
strengths: Only need to stare at its surface
Fades 100 times slower than usual memories
Very large storage capacity
weaknesses: Need to look at its surface for as long as it takes
Memory will fade eventually
Not infinite; can be overloaded

name: God Of Inventing
description: With this power you can make ALL kinds of objects and advanced in the invention, improvement to old technology. You can use advanced strategy on how would your invention can be used. You are the worlds greatest Inventor and scientist, engineer, strategist.
summary: The ability to be the world's greatest scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician and a master strategist
strengths: You can make almost anything.
You can improve old technology.
You might get rich by selling your inventions.
weaknesses: People want to use for themselves.
You're not a real god, you're still just a man.
You can still be killed.

name: Surgical Precision
description: A person with this power has superb hand-eye coordination undeterred by fear or nervousness. In addition this power gives the user the ability to be calm when performing any operation. For example they can perform surgical operations with the utmost precision. In addition this power also works for any action taken. For example you can also learn to throw objects with the utmost precision and learn to play instruments with precision.
summary: The ability to be extremely precise in completing any action
strengths: Perform surgeries that are considered impossible
Works even when nervous or in state of fear
Applies toward any action you do.
weaknesses: Doesn't give you medical knowledge

name: Geokinesis
description: Geokinetics can turn the ground they stand on into a weapon. They can mentally cause rocks to levitate, cause shockwave damage with a seismic stomp, and even know where the fault lines in an area are.
summary: The ability to manipulate rocks, soil, and earth
strengths: Looks awesome
Can bring down a building in all of two seconds
Become the best constructor ever
weaknesses: Useless against metals
Useless against processed earth, i.e. bricks
Useless if seperated from ground

name: Light Jump
description: With this power when you jump your body turns into light and you appear in another location of your choosing that is in a straight line from the direction that you jumped. This power can be activated while in midair just by moving your feet. You must know where you are jumping to before you can change into light and you can not jump to a solid area, such as jumping inside a wall. There is a three second cool down for this power between jumps.
summary: The ability to jump in a flash of light and appear in another area.
strengths: Jump to any location as long as you know where it is.
You move at the speed of light.
You can jump again in mid air just by moving your feet.
weaknesses: Only works in a straing line in direction you jumped.
You must know where you are jumping too.
Has a three second cool down.

name: Pick A Power
description: You simply think of a power and it's yours. But you can change it into any other power you want. And you can only have one at a time. There is no power you can't have. From shape-shifting to acid snot, super hearing to super speed, it's yours. You can even have fun making some up!
summary: The ability to change the power you have.
strengths: You can have any power you want.
You can have any power you want.
You can... oh forget it.
weaknesses: Nothing, and even if you can think of something bad, there is a power to fix it!

name: Metal Materialization
description: You can pull metal out of thin air and bend it. Your hands must be free to use this power.
summary: The ability to make any metal out of thin air and twist it into shape
strengths: Don't need any in the environment
Metal can capture enemies without you moving
weaknesses: Must use hands

name: Nature Wrath
description: You may be able to fly because you can make the winds maintain your weight (just like Storm). You can wrap enimies with vines plus you can wrap trees around yourself to make yourself a monster!
summary: The ability to control all natural things like plants, winds, and etc.
strengths: Animals love you!
You can fly!
You can give your enimies poison ivy!
weaknesses: Your weakness is fire and acid rain so you can't fight weather manipulators.
You are green when power in progress.
You have to practice to level up.

name: Reality Changing
description: The ability to make what you want to happen from what really should happen. For example, if a bookcase fell over, before it hit the floor you could make it reappear in the same spot with a wave of a hand. Other things you could do are make a light explosion and control others' powers. For example, if someone can phase through objects, you could get them stuck in the object they're phasing through.
summary: The ability to change what could happen into what you want to happen, which is something someone least expects.
strengths: Control power
Can fix anything
weaknesses: Can never unwarp what you have already warped

name: Ultimate Version Telekinesis
description: With this power, you have telekinesis that can affect any part of the universe or all of the universe at once. The strength of the TK is equal to your own physical strength and is applied over the affected area.
summary: The ability to move anything in the universe as long as you know where it is
strengths: You have infinite range telekinesis
Your telekinesis lets you move things around the universe proportionally to your strength
If you concentrate on one point, your telekinesis strength is multiplied.
weaknesses: You can only focus on one part to do things, affecting the whole universe cancels itself
Does not come with omniscience or remote viewing and you must consciously control it
When concentrating on one object, you cannot defend yourself because you are too focused

name: Energy Leech
description: You can live forever or heal your wounds with energy outside your body. You can take energy from organisms or other energies, like fire, light or wind. This should only be done in great need as taking energy from organisms, no matter how small the amount of energy taken, kills any organism you use it on instantly. Needs physical contact to work. It takes years of practice to touch people without killing them.
summary: The ability to live forever and heal your own wounds with energy outside your body
strengths: Can live forever through energy transfusions
Can kill enemies with a single touch
Can heal yourself and others
weaknesses: Needs physical contact to work
Kills instantly
Needs years of practice to be able to touch people

name: Enchanted Elements
description: The 4 Enchanted Elements are as follows: Watch-Fire, a fireball that will find a target and attempt to kill them; Dancing-Seas, a hypnotizing water that will entrance a target and drown them; Vile-Vines, living plants; Anger-Winds, which will paralyze a victim entirely.
summary: The ability to produce the 4 Enchanted Elements
strengths: Dancing-Seas is a good way to kill somebody
Anger-Winds will paralyze the victim and they can't fight back
All 4 Enchanted Elements obey their master/summoner and will not attack anyone on your side
weaknesses: Watch-Fire can miss a target
Dancing-Seas will not work on people who are immune to hypnosis
Vile-Vines can't catch someone with super speed

name: Dragon Heart
description: If you are hurt, in distress, or simply want a better life, you can call upon one star of your choosing. It will come to you as a mythical dragon, who then will give half of it's own heart to you. As long as the dragon lives, so will you. You can heal from any wound or illness in a matter of minutes to hours, have greater strength, agility, and stamina, and also be much wiser than most people. You and your dragon can communicate telepathically, and have a powerful empathic connection.
summary: The ability to gain powerful supernatural abilities/immortality through bestowal and possession of a dragon's heart
strengths: The dragon will only aid people who are good
You can have a great friend and ally
You are immortal as long as the dragon lives, and vice versa
weaknesses: If either one is hurt, the other will feel the pain just as much
You are only partially immortal
If you both die, you will merge and transform back into the star from which the dragon came

name: Photographic Power Mimicry
description: Once you see a power being used, you mimic that power even if you don't know that it is an actual power. After this, you will completely understand the power that you wield. You can hold limitless powers.
summary: The ability to mimic powers when you see them in action.
strengths: You can mimic powers that you see in action. (Even powers you can't actually see like telepathy)
Gain limitless abilities.
Have complete control over the power.
weaknesses: You have to SEE it in action. (Your vision has to be CLEAR)
You gain the abilities weaknesses if they're vital to the ability being used.
Complete control doesn't effect some abilities. (Intuitive Aptitude, etc. )

name: Mind Control Via Sight
description: The person with this power is able to control the will power of people while they are within the user's sight. You can control as many people as there is within your sight if you want to.
summary: The ability to control the willpower of people when they are within your sight
strengths: Can control over a large group of people by just looking at them
weaknesses: If you turn away, then your control over them is cut
If you are blinded, this power will be negated

name: Energetic Hands
description: The user can will their psychic energy into their hands. When energized, they can block psychic attacks by parrying them with their hands. Any physical attacks like punching will also harm the opponent's mind. Energetic hands display the color of the user's psychic aura when in use.
summary: The ability to project psychic energy into the hands
strengths: Block or deflect psychic attacks
Injure the opponent's mind and body simultaneously
No actual energy loss from use of this power
weaknesses: Still need to get close to opponent to punch them
Very obvious when in use
Can't block some types of attacks

name: Volatile Construct
description: The user can create and launch bombs, explosives and other volatile constructs that have various yields, ranging from small explosions to near-nuclear blasts. These bombs may be composed of energy, element, biological matter, or simply normal bombs.
summary: The ability to generate bombs and explosives
strengths: Create explosives from energy, element or users body
Control the fuse time, or detonate at will
User may have Selective Invulnerability to explosions
weaknesses: User may limited on how many they can produce at a time
May not be immune to the effects
Un-exploded bombs may have to be defused

name: Change Circles
description: With this power you can form a two dimensional circle in your hands, expanding it to any size you wish, before placing it on any large enough surface. You then state your desired change, such as "everything within the circle turns to gold" or "gravity within the circle is multiplied 100X. " This becomes true within the circle, and applies to everything encompassed by it. To destroy a circle, the user must take part of it and break it, causing the effect to cease. Only the user can do this.
summary: The ability to place circles on things that change one aspect of the world within them.
strengths: Rewrite any one aspect of the world within your circles.
weaknesses: The circles interperate things literally, so watch how you word your changes.
A circle can only be placed on a surface big enough to hold it.
Everything within the circle is effected by the change in a column extending forever.

name: Potion Creation
description: This power allows you to brew potions with many effects. You don't have to be magical to make them, it's just that magic-users are more adept at it. You can get lots of ingredients and brew an awesome potion. They can have many effects! You can also make splash potions (throwable potions held in bottles of non-damaging glass). Potions could be in the form of stew, soup, jelly, pills, candy, or just a basic drink like most. It all depends on how you want to make it!
summary: The ability to brew potions.
strengths: Get a boost in power with a potion.
Your combat is affected very positively so you can fight better.
You can even make a potion which gets you better grades!
weaknesses: Sometimes potions have negative effects.
If you brew it wrong, it could backfire badly.
Not all potion effects last forever...

name: Finite Power Manipulation
description: The user has a power that is capable of tipping the scales of most situations. The user can give anything a limited power that can be enough to fulfill a task. Since, it is finite, the probability of it failing are still possible. The user in a fight can boost their power to almost match the opponent, but it is up to the user that will decide the winner. The user can power machines enough to almost run the time that they need.
summary: The ability to create, induce, or infuse power that is "just enough" for any situation.
strengths: Power boost
Change the course of any situation to a bit of your favor
Power up other things with limited power
weaknesses: It is limited power
You have to think wisely to utilize its "full" potential

name: Jet Propulsion
description: Also called Propulsion, Rocket Flight, Jet Flight or Jetting, this is the ability to propel oneself into flight with a psychic energy aura. One with this ability projects an aura of psionic heat and force across their body, with propulsion focused through the hands and/or feet. In addition, this aura also protects the user from heat damage, friction damage, and sight impairment at high speeds. In essence, the user becomes a living missile, because they can crash into things and emerge unharmed.
summary: The ability to produce an aura that allows high-speed flight, like a living rocket
strengths: Aura allows user to fly at high speeds, and to blast/burn foes in close combat
Aura protects user from friction, heat, sight impairment and impact in flight
When developed, user gains a sense that lets them home in on targets
weaknesses: Launch time is delayed by a few seconds, until developed
Launch path can be difficult to control, until developed
If you use your power to crash into things, people might make you pay for the damage

name: Closed System Generation
description: A closed system prevents transfer of mass or energy across it. The user of this ability prevents any mass or energy from moving across a field that they generate. In addition, a person in a closed field is unaffected by all forces exerted from objects outside the system including gravity. Closed system cannot be moved even by its user and can only be turned off. Since you cannot exert action on the field, the field itself cannot exert any reaction so all energy that comes in contact disappears
summary: The ability to create a "closed system" field
strengths: Can be used as a force field--technically it's an "anti-force" field
Can be shaped like anything--and looks like generating darkness
Absorbs all impacts without exerting forces back (the energy just disappears into another dimension)
weaknesses: Does not create structures of energy or armor--it is just like a stationary area of nothingness
Airtight barrier, also blocks light, and cell phone reception (don't surround yourself with it)
Because of con 1 you cannot walk on it(you can however use it to break your fall)

name: Time Jumper (Lineage)
description: You can travel though time by riding the minds of you ancestors and you descendants. You cannot directly control the people jump into but you can communicate with them and influence their thoughts to some degree.
summary: The ability to travel through time by way of ancestors and descendants
strengths: Traveling through time. Get to know your Family before and after your life.
Keep and eye your Children long after you die
Gaining information by convincing your Ancestors to help you maybe even complete unfinished busines
weaknesses: Limited by genetic family members.
Some of the people you maybe go insane.
You cannot completely control anyone you visit.

name: Mystical Zodiac Gauntlet
description: The person with this gauntlet is able to harness the power of the Chinese Zodiac. There are 12 Chinese Zodiacs and the user get one Zodiac power bestowed on them every month. It will change to another power when the month ends and when the new months begin. Dragon (pyrokinesis), rabbit (superspeed),ox (super strength), rooster(flight),monkey(super reflexes), dog(invulnerability), snake(invisibility), rat(size-alteration), horse(healing),pig(unbreakable skin), tiger(tiger traits), sheep (phasing)
summary: The ability to bestowed the powers of the Chinese Zodiacs when in possession of this gauntlet
strengths: Can take on powerhouses on some scenarios
Hard for enemies to adapt with powers keep changing every month
weaknesses: The user can be depowered if the gauntlet is removed from him or her
The user does not know what power he or she receives every new month until he or she uses it

name: Symptoms Reader
description: With this power all you have to do is see a person's symptoms and you'll instantly be able to diagnose them. Accurately and everything. Take that doctors!
summary: The ability to instantly diagnose someone based on their symptoms
strengths: You can diagnose people instantly and accurately
weaknesses: Doctors will probably hate you
Not much use in physical combat

name: Aversion Field
description: An invisible field constantly rotates around your body, preventing anything that is aimed directly at you from hitting you. Bullets will just miss you, punches and kicks will never land, etc.
summary: The ability to avoid being directly hit by anything
strengths: Never lose a fist fight
Enjoy bank robberies without the worries of gunshots
weaknesses: Indirect attacks like bombs, light flashes, etc cannot be avoided

name: Psammokinesis
description: Sand is just a material composed of small finely divided rock. Psammokinesis allows you to control it. You could cause sandstorms, create beaches at lake-fronts or use sand to grab your opponents. Surf the desert like it's the sea, create a giant sand castle or simply keep the stuff out of your shoes. This ability has limitless applications.
summary: The ability to manipulate sand
strengths: Can manipulate sand
weaknesses: Can't control glass or larger rocks

name: Unlimited Ammunition
description: Any cannon, bow, gun, slingshot, etc will have more ammunition replace the fired ammunition the instant the used ammunition is fired.
summary: The ability to have unlimited ammunition for any weapon one fires
strengths: You can just keep firing at will and never need to buy more ammunition.
Saving lots of money.
weaknesses: Your superiors might wonder why you never need to get more ammunition.

name: Psychic Energy Construct
description: With this power, you can build or create any animated character or object under your psychic control.  Energy-robots, energy-pliers, energy-motorcycle, energy-Santa....whatever!   You're limited by your imagination and will power, but everything else is fair game!
summary: The ability to create and control characters and objects made of energy
strengths: Anything or anyone you want!
Anything or anyone you want under your control!
Anything or anyone with any ability you want under your control!
weaknesses: Your fatigue affects your constructs' abilities.
You can only create as many as you can keep under control.
Your will power is the only limit to the constructs' strength.

name: Picture Extraction
description: For the ability to work, one must have a picture of any size with them. Proceed to use your free hand to touch the picture. Your free hand will "go into the picture's dimension" where you can pull the object out into our reality. Once the object is pulled out, the picture surface will turn blank and the object will appear and interact in our reality. One example is, if you wanted to pull out a hot and attractive woman from a picture, this ability will allow you to bring her out into our reality.
summary: The ability to pull any object from within a picture out into our reality.
strengths: Any object or person pulled out will retain its original features, dimensions, and attributes.
The user can use any command phrases such as "open sesame" to pull the object out.
weaknesses: If the picture surface is destroyed, the object extracted will permanently remain in our reality.
The user can use any command phrases such as "close sesame" to return the object into the picture.

name: Healing  Mist
description: The mist will slowly heal all wounds, ailments, diseases, curses, etc of everyone inside the mist.
summary: The ability to produce a mist that heals all those within it
strengths: Heal everyone with a ravaging killer disease, it can't gain immunity to this power.
Bad cut from a rusty knife? No matter! Just produce this mist and everything will be fine.
The holder of this power is essentially immune to all diseases.
weaknesses: It's a slow, slow, slow heal.
The people who want to take advantage of someone with this power for their own gain.

name: Mythical Weapon Summon
description: With this power you can summon and use any weapon used in any mythology, from Excalibur to Poseidon's trident and anything in between. When you get the weapon, you automatically know how to use it and when you're done with the weapon, you can send it back to wherever it came from.
summary: The ability to summon any weapons use in any mythology
strengths: You can summon any mythological weapon
You automatically know how to use the weapon when you get it
weaknesses: If you take the weapon of a God they might come for it and destroy you

name: Drawing The Future
description: You can cause future events to happen by drawing or painting scenarios. You cannot control the events that lead to the drawn situation, or the consequences, unless you draw those too. Your drawings can't violate the laws of physics, unless they involve superpowers that can do so. Anybody controlled by drawings do not realise they are being controlled until it is pointed out to them, believing all events are natural.
summary: The ability to control the future by drawing it
strengths: You can control minds and reality far away and even in the future
As long as you hide your drawings, you could even hide your power from all
You can control your life so it turns out how you want
weaknesses: It is impossible to draw and control all the consequences of events you draw
Your power is slightly limited by your artistic ability. Greater detail ensures more control.
You cannot completely warp reality

name: Instantaneous Evolution
description: The user of this power is able to instantly adapt or evolve to survive in the current environment that he or she is in. This power cant be used at the user's will. This power only becomes active when the user is in danger. For example, if the user if in a burning room , the user will gain fire proof skin to protect him or her from the flames
summary: The ability to instantly adapt or evolve to survive in a current environment
strengths: Can survive in any environment
Great defense
weaknesses: Can't call up power unless in mortal danger

name: God's Algorithm
description: You immediately know the shortest possible way to solve a problem.   For example:  * You are given a scrambled Rubik's cube and you would know the minimal moves needed to solve it.  * Someone asks you directions, and you'll know the shortest path to the location.
summary: The ability to know the optimal way to solve a problem
strengths: Know the shortest solution to any problem
Solve puzzles faster
weaknesses: Puzzles rarely pose an entertaining challenge
The shorted solution to a problem isn't always the best solution

name: Lygokinesis
description: Lygokinesis is the power to produce an energy that is completely in your control. You can make it into anything you want from swords to robotic suits its up to the limits of your mind. The energy will appear similar to the type that the green lanturn makes but with two differences. One it is not hard light its your own energy. Two it dosen't have to be green it can be any color you want.
summary: The ability to produce and control raw energy
strengths: Very useful power
Can be any color you want
Can be anything you want
weaknesses: The energy dosen't have much detail

name: Memory Manipulation
description: With this ability, you can erase other people's memories from any given time span, like in Men In Black.  You can also enhance memories they have, such as childhood memories or things they can't remember, and create false memories of things that never happened.
summary: The ability to erase or enhance the memories of others.
strengths: "Undo" things that you've done by making people forget them
Make hookers think you've already paid them
Be the sneakiest lawyer or the best lover by manipulating people's memories
weaknesses: There's a possibility you'll become a control freak

name: Phase Transformation
description: With this ability, you can undergo a transformation that makes all of your natural and supernatural abilities more powerful. The side effect of this ability is that it takes more energy than your normal form. You can also go through stronger levels of phases, but each one drains your energy more than the last.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation which makes all of your abilities stronger.
strengths: Great for a sort of 'last stand' situation.
You can go through multiple levels of phases.
weaknesses: Requires more energy for each phase that you undergo.

name: Dream Walker
description: You are able to control another's dream and cause physical harm and even death through this.
