This is essentially the conscious part of your brain talking to the sub-concious part so you do not actually get any real sleep through this so you cannot do this every single night. Your body is also still vulnerable. The person whose mind you're invading cannot wake up unless they are awoken violently.
summary: The ability to move through and control the dreams of others.
strengths: Control your own dreams
Cause physical harm to others using their dreams
Become a real Freddy Krueger
weaknesses: Get very tired due to lack of real sleep
Body vulnerable

name: Quantum Leap
description: Also called Ability Shifting, this is the ability to acquire different abilities every day. One with this ability cannot choose which abilities they acquire, as the abilities change either based on their emotions, or just randomly. One with this ability may, one day, have a deadly sonic scream, and the next day, have telepathy. This ability only lasts roughly 18-20 hours (at most a full 24-hour span).
summary: The ability to use random powers everyday
strengths: Start your day with Superstrength, end with Telepathy
Abilities MAY change based on emotions or situation (but only once)
Abilities range through the full spectrum (physical, mental, empathic, magical, etc)
weaknesses: Can't control when power changes, or what power you get
Can't sense when power changes, or what power you get (unless you also have Chaos Sense)
Can't control intensity of power

name: Regulating Power Beam
description: This power allows the user to release a beam that changes power levels to what the user wants to do: destroy, energize or stun. The beam must connect to the living creature or object to be able to regulate itself within a range of 1 to 10. 1 would stun a microorganism, 5 would energize any machine and 10 would destroy a planet in time.
summary: The ability to fire a beam that adjusts itself to the right amount of energy to either destroy , energize,or stun.
strengths: Powerful stunner or energizer.
Powerful energy beam.
Can be regulated.
weaknesses: Must make contact with target to regulate the amount efficiently.

name: Power Multiplex
description: This form of ability replication is rare. Unlike normal ability replication, this version of the power allows a person to hold onto multiple abilities right from the start, thus making it very useful. However, despite having many powers, you can only access them in 'sets' at any given time.
summary: The ability to replicate multiple abilities from others by physical contact
strengths: Hold onto more than one ability at a time, right from the start
You can switch between powers if you want, or even use them simultaneously!
Absorption takes no more than a few seconds
weaknesses: You have to touch a person to gain their power
You can only hold up to a maximum of nineteen abilities
You cannot take abilities such as empathic mimicry or other forms of power replication

name: Musical And Sound Manipulation
description: Without doing anything, you can generate music and sound by wanting it. Your voice is perfect and you have an innate ability to sing. Using an instrument or singing greatly augments your power. You can cause people to sleep, wake, become confused, be calm, snap out of confusion, be attracted to or repelled from others, and shoot sonic blasts and waves with sounds and music. Even in space, the energy and aura of what sound or music you want will affect them.
summary: The ability to cause many different effects with music/sound.
strengths: Can make a profit.
Make your enemies dance.
weaknesses: Have to learn to play an instrument.

name: Trident Of Poseidon
description: The Trident of Poseidon is a weapon with a mahogany handle infused with powdered diamond for strength, a solid gold base, and prongs of pure silver. When first summoned, it appears as a small pen, which then permanently links to it's first wielder, but only if they are good, with rightful and just intentions. The person can control water in any way they choose, and also use it to heal even the deadliest injuries or ailments in mere hours. The trident will always return to the user if misplaced.
summary: The ability to control water with Poseidon's trident
strengths: The trident permanently links with the first person who wields it, and only if they are good
It can make them near-immortal!!
Power limitation is only in the wielder's imagination, so enemies better watch out!!
weaknesses: None

name: Electromaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you switch into a form which grows and becomes stronger the more electricity you consume. You become an electric monster, and gain more abilities as you gain strength. These abilities include thunderbolts, sonic screeches, releasing electric surges, and having some control over magnetic fields. These abilties swell as you feed on electricity. However, if you're hit with enough water, you'll short out, and revert to normal. You have a mild immunity against physical attacks.
summary: The ability to change into a form which grows and gains power from electricity
strengths: Grow and gain strength from electricity.
You have a variety of abilities, from electrical surges to shock-screeching
Can easily find sources of power in a city.
weaknesses: Water gives you a short-out, weakening you and possibly causing you to revert.
Once you revert, the electricity you consumed is lost
Transforming requires some concentration.

name: Psionic Blade
description: An energy invisible blade with a velocity of 50 meters per second of any size and number that cuts through the exterior part of any substance or things. A clear focus mind is vital to initially activate this ability which approximately takes 15 to 30 seconds and a reactivation gap of 4 seconds. This has known cutting limits to a maximum of 7 inches (17. 78 cm) thickness or diameter of iron steel and point of target of 20 meters.
summary: The ability to create an invisible blade slicing through any objects by using the mind.
strengths: Element of surprise: unseen attack measure
Moderate to long distance target
No limits on size and number of psionic blades
weaknesses: Time consuming mind unlocking process
Limitation on target's distance and thickness
Complete mind exhaustion after one hour battle

name: Elemental Forces
description: With this power, you can summon, control, heal and dismiss the Elemental Forces at will, all of which are in your complete and utter control. They are all extremely powerful forces of good. The Elemental Forces happen to look like extremely cool, awesome, unique, and original versions the Summons from the various Final Fantasies. They include Odin, Alexander, Belias, Shiva, Bahamut, Hashmal, Fenrir, Ixion, Famfrit, Phoenix, Typhon, Ultima, and Ragnarok.
summary: The ability to summon the Elemental Forces.
strengths: All Elemental Forces have a wide variety of special powers, abilities, skills, and talents.
All Elemental Forces have the Ultimate Attacks that they have in the Final Fantasies.
All Elemental Forces have extremely awesome summoning sequences.
weaknesses: Can only summon one Elemental Force at a time, though they can be instantly swapped out.
Can cause a lot of destruction if not careful.

name: Genesis Gem
description: It is the polar opposite to the Exodus Gem. It has the power to restore life and could create a universe in your image, but, whenever a timeline, a planet and/or a universe is destroyed, you can restore it to its natural state. Also, you can have a complete awareness and control over space, matter, energy, reality and time around you.
summary: The ability to use it to create your own universes and restore all life.
strengths: Could become a god.
weaknesses: None.

name: Telesynthesis
description: With this power, you can use raw materials to assemble and create objects with your mind. All you need to do is gather the ingredients, think of the item you'd like to synthesize, and the ingredients will be transformed into the object. The more complex the object, the more practice and concentration required. So when you need a toothbrush, grab a few plastic bags and you're all set. Sunny out? Make a ridiculously gigantic sombrero! Need a glass of water? Use rocks and the water in the air!
summary: The ability to create objects with your mind using raw materials
strengths: Endless possibilities for synthesizing objects
Life threatening situations become walks in the park
Transforming your Ford Focus into a Ferrari
weaknesses: All ingredients must be present, otherwise synthesis will be incomplete
Complex objects (like electronics) require great skill and concentration
Synthesizing life costs other lives

name: Creation Training
description: This power allows you to use any power that you create. However, before you train at it, your powers will be very weak. Training involves practicing with the power until it becomes more potent. The amount of training required for a power to reach its full potential varies, but is never more than three months worth.
summary: The ability to use any power you create through training.
strengths: You can have a wide variety of powers.
Training at powers generally helps you to understand them better.
weaknesses: If you have this power, the only way to get powers you create is by training.
Training tires you and it takes time.

name: Focus Manipulation
description: This ability can make anyone gain or loss focus on what they want. This will help the user avoid attacks from their opponents. This ability can make anyone a powerful marksman or someone who really needs glasses.
summary: The ability to control anything's accuracy including oneself.
strengths: Gain Accuracy
Can avoid opponent's attacks
Can make people loss focus on their goals or pay attention to you.
weaknesses: effects only lasts for 3 days

name: Planetary Avatar
description: Control the acid rains of Venus, the volcanoes on Mars, the hurricanes on Jupiter, the storms of Neptune and all others.
summary: The ability to generate and control any natural phenomena from any planet
strengths: Can travel through and survive in outer space
Can control weather on earth
Can keep oneself comfortable
weaknesses: Aliens are always trying to capture your powers.
When you die, your powers go to the closest person.

name: Arcana 11: Justice
description: In any conflict, be it physical or social, between two people or groups of people, you can cause the result of the conflict to always be a tie. A coin toss would end with the coin falling on it's edge, two sports teams would end up with exactly the same scores, no matter how long they played. This power ignores any differences in respective skill- A chess grand-master could be rendered unable to defeat a chess novice.
summary: The ability to cause the most neutral possible outcome in any conflict.
strengths: You can determine the balanced outcome of almost any fight or conflict, including your own.
You can make certain that you never actually lose a fight.
weaknesses: This power has no ability to actually make anyone succeed at anything.
This power doesn't work when a single person is involved, such as in solitare.

name: Enhanced Progression
description: Everything takes time, they say. Not always true; a person with Enhanced Progression can adapt to a task much more rapidly than an average person. Martial arts training may take half the time, Newtonian calculus might become a weekend project, weightlifting gradients might pass by faster, and so on. This does not mean they are smarter or stronger. Rather, they must expend less time and effort to get the same results. There is a con--they cannot become superhuman in any area.
summary: The ability to learn or adapt much faster than normal.
strengths: Acquire new skills with prodigious speed
Lifelong commitments are no longer necessary
Become a master of karate, physics, weightlifting, etc.
weaknesses: Not inherently smarter or stronger
Still must spend some time learning the task
Cannot become truly superhuman in any area

name: Transdimensional Architect
description: As soon you enter a building you can make any existing room or corridor bigger. You can add new rooms,corridors,staircases,stairways and floors. You can grow or shrink new rooms and corridors. You can give stairways and staircases as many steps as you want. You can rearrange any thing you added. You can't kill or trap anyone. Try and crush someone, he will reappear outside the building. When you leave the building,it reverts back to normal. Anyone who had been in a lost area will be outside.
summary: The ability to temporarily change the inside of any building without making the outside bigger.
strengths: Make that economy hotel room bigger than a palace.
Lose anyone chasing you by making a broom closet near infinite in size.
Put a 5 mile long corridor between yourself and a foe.
weaknesses: The wilderness.
People might start saying "Here comes Captain Building! "

name: Legend's Armory
description: With this power, you can wield any weapon or magic object from myth and legend. You could summon Poseidon's trident to control water, or smite your enemies with Thor's hammer. You could summon a cloak of invisibility or a flying carpet. As you get more experienced with this power, the easier it is to control more powerful objects. With all the magical items in the myth of the world, the possibilities are virtually endless.
summary: The ability to summon objects from myth and legend.
strengths: Wield a variety of powers from different objects
No limit to amount of objects you can summon (even summon the Argo)
Could give allies objects that enhance their powers
weaknesses: Have to be able to control objects you summon
Can't summon creatures
Can't summon buildings

name: Biokinesis
description: Control living thing. Alter them in anyway you wish, on a macro, cellular, genetic, and even molecular,atomic, or subatomic level. Alter any traits they have. Grant them brand new abilities or traits. Create new living matter, using already existing lifeforms and matter. Destroy existing life as well. Even use his ability on yourself.
summary: The ability to control life, biology, and genetics.
strengths: Can remove any diseases or other biological problems.
Can control, change, enhance, and destroy anything biological.
GIve yourself other biologically based powers.
weaknesses: Can't cotnrol anything that isn't biological.
If one doesn't know much about biology, its use can have unintended effects
You can't become instantly superintelligent, only gain the mental ability to be superintelligent

name: Complete Blood Control
description: With this power, the subject can absorb and metabolize blood like a leech through physical contact. Transfusions are also possible. You will be immune to all other blood-based powers such as acid blood, explosive blood, vampirism, etc. You are able to control people like puppets with blood or just plain blow them up from the inside out. You may use your blood as a weapon by shooting it from a cut at high, concussive pressure.
summary: The ability to have complete control of blood
strengths: You will never be HIV positive.
Any destructive blood or blood-based power doesn't affect you.
You have a powerful, biological weapon.
weaknesses: Blood doesn't nourish you.
A regular hemokinetic has more control of blood.
You can still die from blood loss, non-blood based damage/illnesses/toxins, etc.

name: Bodily Energy Unification
description: Humans produce many kinds of energy. Heat energy, kinetic energy, the energy from food or cells, etc. This ability combines them into a unified force that still have the properties of the energies that formed it. The user can then manipulate the new energy as the user pleases. Any outside energy that makes contact with the user will be temporarily absorbed and added on to the new energy. The new energy will act out all the energy that formed it so the user can function normally.
summary: The ability to combine all the energies in one's body to create a new energy and manipulate it.
strengths: New form of energy.
Manipulate it.
Energy has all the properties of combined energies.
weaknesses: Energies are combined forever, but you will still function like a normal human.

name: Shadow Seconds
description: This ability is for stealth or avoiding conflicts with enemies. The user makes themselves go to another plane of existence for a couple seconds. Like in Charmed, in that time, the user is in some kind of dimension where they can see and hear things but not interact with the normal world. Physics still applies (if you leave, go through a door), but while in non-existence, people (even psychics) and computers will not be able detect the user for those few seconds.
summary: The ability to be in another plane of existence so that the user won't be detected for a certain amount of seconds.
strengths: Stealth.
Avoid trouble.
Psychics won't spot you.
weaknesses: Physics still applies.
Lasts for a couple of seconds.

name: Shadow Clone Technique
description: Always wanted to watch movies and play video games at the same time? Well now you can! With this ability you can split yourself in two. If you possess more than one superpower they will be split amongst the clones and if you only have one, the power will get weaker as it's potency will be split into the clones. The power of this ability is based on the creativity of the user, example he can use a clone to throw him in the air.
summary: The ability to create clones of yourself by splitting your powers in two
strengths: Can distract foes by attacking from all directions at once
Can be very useful for spying as when they are unsummoned all information comes back to the user
weaknesses: Superpowers are split amongst the clones and/or are weakened by them
Takes a lot of willpower to make more clones
Clones can be destroyed with one good hit

name: Sight Jacking
description: See through the eyes of another organism via psychic connection. You don't need telepathy or empathy to use this power, however it does help to find a target to use it on. This power only works within a 2 mile radius. A very useful ability to have if you are blinded during a fight. Of course, this ability wont work on someone who is already blind and cannot be used on the dead. This power only works one way; therefore, while using sight-jack, your true body is left blind and open to attack.
summary: The ability to psychically see through the eyes of another, (human, animal, etc. )
strengths: See through the eyes of enemies, allies and loved ones. Both animal and human alike.
Great for spying and gathering information.
If you are blinded or are already blind, seeing becomes possible!
weaknesses: Cannot see through the eyes of those who are already blind or dead.
While using this power, it leaves your own body blind and open to attack.
Range, 2 mile radius. If your target moves out of range, you connection to your target will break.

name: See It Know It
description: This power allows you to see things and their answer. For example, if you are stuck on a test, you can use this power and see the answers glow from your point of view. Like if the answer to the test is A, you would see the A bubble glow up. In the case of problems requiring steps to be performed, you will see them solve themselves right in front of your eyes, so you can repeat the steps.
summary: The ability to see things progress before your eyes
strengths: You will always get A
You can solve the hardest problem as it will solve right in front of your eye.
weaknesses: People would dump all their work on you

name: Soundwave Control
description: A person with this powercan control all forms of pressure waves in the air. They can project sound as a weapon as well as change their voice. They can also use sound wave as a boost to reach near sonic levels of speed. Sonic boosted jumps are possible. Soundwaves can be amplified or distorted. They can even prevent sound from occuring for a 1 mile radius as well as produce wonderful music rivalling the best musicians. They also can sense any disturbances within soundwaves for a 5 mile radius.
summary: The ability to create and control soundwaves for various effects
strengths: Sonic weapons
Find out where people are through soundwave disturbance (sort of like super-hearing)
Boost your own abilities by using sonic energy
weaknesses: You can break the eardrums of bystanders
Doesn't work in space
Soundproof material

name: The Superpower List
description: Why have one when you can have them all? This ability allows you to gain every ability posted on superpowerlist.com . Every time a new one is added, that's yours now as well!
summary: The ability to gain abilities posted on "The Superpower List"
strengths: You get every power posted on the superpower list!
Conflicting abilities can be swapped at will between themselves.
weaknesses: A power must be added to the list before it is usable.
You don't know when you get a new power.
Powers you add don't count.

name: Seeding
description: This power allows the user to grow anything. To use this power you must first acquire a piece of the thing you wish to grow, such as a chip off of a building, a spark plug, or a hair or fingernail clipping. Plant this object in the ground and treat it as you would a seedling. In a matter of weeks (or longer, depending on what you are trying to grow) you will have a fully formed replica of the thing you acquired the "seed" from. Living creatures grown this way will have no memories.
summary: The ability to grow something from anything.
strengths: Grow yourself a car, spacecraft, computer, or a whole building.
Bring extinct creatures and dead people back to life.
weaknesses: Living beings grown this way will have no memories and behave on instinct
Grown humans will have to be taught.
You must care for what you are growing as if it is a plant.

name: Magnokinesis
description:
Use your hands or even your thoughts to create and control metal, magnets, and magnetic waves. This is a very simple ability and can be very useful. Your able to easily hack into computers, screw with compasses etc. 

You have to learn to control metal, and work towards it. This ability doesn't come to you when you first have this power.
summary: The ability to manipulate or even create and control magnetic waves and eventually, metal.
strengths: You can hack into computers
You can control and mold metal at your will.
It is very useful if your evil!
weaknesses: Hard to control.
You have to work to control metal.

name: Technomancy
description: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic. This ability lets you make devices advance to that point. Your power is easly confused with magic, but is immune to all powers that affect it. Conversly, your power is still affected by technopathic powers. You create a machine that can do virtually anything a mage, wizard, witch, sorcerer, sorceress, seer, or other magic user could do.
summary: The ability to change technology to make it so advanced that it gets confused with magic
strengths: Magic-ish powers.
Immune to magic affecting powers.
weaknesses: Technopaths will try to use your technology.
You have to have some device to advance.
Learning how to use the technologies and/or machines might be difficult.
tags: any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic

name: Controlled Time Manipulation
description: One with this ability can reverse, pause, or slow time in any given area. This ability could be used to heal fatal wounds, and repair bridges and buildings. The ability only affects the object or person of focus. One with this ability could accelerate the aging of an enemy, making them crumble to dust, or could freeze them where they stand, without affecting time as a whole.
summary: The ability to control time in a given area
strengths: Excellent for combat and high risk scenarios
Healing teammates when they are injured by reversing the wound's timeline
Any obstacle can be easily dispatched
weaknesses: Requires massive concentration for smaller scale use

name: Velocity
description: The ability to control velocity, pure and simple. Velocity is the speed and direction a object is moving. You can do many things with it. You could simply move things around, but the more creative the better. By controlling your own velocity, you could make yourself fly into the air. Or you could cancel somethings velocity, make it freeze where it is, even if it's in the air. You might even use velocity as a sort of force blast, blasting things away from you at high speeds.
summary: The ability to control velocity
strengths: Controlling one of the most powerful forces in the world
Many uses
weaknesses: Velocity control will leave you tired at first, but the more you use it, the less tired you will be.
Might accidently cancel your own velocity sometimes

name: Terra Forming
description: The ability to control any rock element (can raise or lower a solid landmass), any liquid element (can multiply liquid to create a lake or ocean), any wood element (can manipulate one plant root to stretch as far as you want to create an ecosystem). You can manipulate the weather and climate around an area to make it foggy, rainy, or hot.
summary: The ability to manipulate the elements to create a perfect "world" of your desire
strengths: To create an entirely new world based on what you want it to be
Can upraise a landmass out of the ocean and create an island with any type of ecosystem
weaknesses: Cannot create wildlife to roam free in your world

name: Vision Manipulation
description: To activate you have to make eye contact with your opponent, then concentrate on them, think of anything, your opponent will then find themselves seeing that thing. Great for: torture, interrogation, just plain having fun with it. You will also be able to make them see their WORST NIGHTMARES right in front of them. Can be turned off by will, or if someone else attacks you.
summary: The ability to make your opponents see things that aren't there
strengths: Can trick your opponents
Makes them see things that aren't there
Can make them see their worst nightmare
weaknesses: Tires your eyes
Must make eye-contact
Can be disrupted by someone else

name: Teleportation Imbuing
description: With this ability, the user can make an item, such as a watch, teleport the holder to your current location with a selected action, e.g. rubbing it. Alternately, you can make it teleport you to an object. The user can also control the objects and render them normal. The owner of the ability decides whether the object travels with the user. There are no energy or time requirements for the ability.
summary: The ability to make teleporting objects.
strengths: Make infinite teleporters.
Never need public transport or a car again.
Can give a "Trojan Horse" gift to an enemy.
weaknesses: Can't travel through time.
Have to be in a desired location.
Others can use the item (could be a pro).

name: Mastermind
description: A person with this ability can choose one type of minion, such as ninjas, zombies, or robots, and summon them to follow his command. At first only a small amount of low ranking minions can be summoned but the more the power is used a larger number and higher ranked set of minions can be summoned. The mastermind can also cast upgrades onto weaker minions to make them more powerful as higher ranked minions are able to be summoned. The minions will follow the mastermind unquestioningly.
summary: The ability to summon minions and upgrade them.
strengths: Summon and train your favorite type of minion.
The minions will always follow your commands exactly as you want them too.
Can upgrade weaker minions so they do not become useless.
weaknesses: Once a type of minion is chosen it cannot be changed.
The higher ranked a minion is, the less can be summoned.
Available minions start out weak, and higher ranks must be trained.

name: Crystal Kinesis
description: If you need to smash through a wall, cover yourself in crystals and/or diamonds.
summary: The ability to shoot crystal bullets out of one's body and cover oneself in a retractable crystal armor.
strengths: Can be indestructible.
You never have to reload.
Can smash through walls.
weaknesses: Easy to miss.
Crystals will break off.
You will look weird when covered in crystals.

name: Energizer Bunny
description: The ability to convert kinetic energy into potential energy, and vice versa. Basically, with this power, you can stop two speeding cars from colliding by converting all their kinetic energy into potential energy. You can also pull the potential or kinetic energy out of anything and shoot it at people as energy beams.
summary: The ability to manipulate kinetic and potential energy
strengths: Shoot energy beams at your enemies! Mwahaha!!!
Turn kinetic energy into potential energy (i.e. stop things from moving)
weaknesses: No power over human life force
Converting one type of energy into another takes a lot of strength, focus, and human energy
Can't affect yourself (you can't wave your arm and use that kinetic energy, for instance)

name: Creator
description: When you make your world, you also make what's in it and control it. After you make your world and the things inside of it, you can use the objects as a weapon without harming it and also without killing it.
summary: The ability to destroy, create, and control your own world
strengths: It will protect the good
It helps with travel
It's very strong
weaknesses: Sometimes unstoppable
Goes in a different way sometimes
Loses strengh sometimes

name: Unblockable
description: A person with this power has his path always clear. Unlike unstoppability he cannot ram into objects. Instead the objects such as obstacles will be compelled to move out of your path or open so that you can enter. Even people cannot block your path unless they can resist this power. This power can be perfectly non-lethal in usage. However this only applies to things that can move out of your way or open for you. Unlike Path Maker,Things like walls and trees that are rooted will not move for you.
summary: The ability to never have the path of the road in front of you be impeded
strengths: Locks, drawbridges, and steel doors open before your presence and allow your passage
Cars cannot block your path---ie can't be hit in an accident--the cars will slide to the side
Football---no one can tackle you (from the front)
weaknesses: Cannot be used to attack people since they become compelled to move away from your path
Conventionally immovable objects such as walls or trees

name: Spacial Beam Banish
description: This is a space manipulation move where you put your trigger and middle finger together against your head, then concentrate on a location to send an a object or person to. Then you fire at the target with the tip of your fingers. The beams cause pain depending how long you charge it and with enough practice, you can use the beams to transport larger objects, like planets.
summary: The ability to fire a beam of  space energy to to send things away to a different location
strengths: Send things to another demension
Use it on yourself to go on trip free vactions
Send an enemy to the sun
weaknesses: Need the space element to use it
Alot more consinstration on larger object
Hard to use on an large group of people

name: Requiem Drive
description:
Upon physical contact with another person, the user can put the target to sleep in mere seconds. When the victim re-awakens, they will feel extremely dizzy. 
In addition, if the user cannot physically touch the target, they can chant a small verse while focusing on said target to knock them out from afar.
summary: The ability to render a person unconscious through touch
strengths: Tired of someone talking? - put them to sleep.
Want to sneak past a security guard or two? Problem solved
Suffering from insomnia? Use it on yourself!
weaknesses: Not much use if multiple opponents come at you all at once
Cannot be used to kill. Which is bad if your opponent wants your head.
May not actually work on its owner, so insomniacs may need sleeping pills.

name: Divine Protection
description:
The Universe basically wants to help you. You will be protected from anything and everything. 

Bullets will miss. Knives will bend. Anything that wants to do harm to you will be prevented. 

Will not work if you tempt the power. You will die if you try to commit suicide.
summary: The ability to be protected by an unknown force
strengths: Someone up there likes you
Will protect you from unknown threats
weaknesses: Overprotection
No offensive ability
Will not protect you from yourself

name: Omnicheat
description: Omnicheat is the ability to cheat anyone or anything in existense. This ability can cheat (but is not limited to) the following: games, rules, space/time, simensional separations, other abilities, logic, omniscience, omnipotence, mind body and spirit, magic, death, and your own limitations. This renders the totality of the universe's laws and other people's abilities virtually useless, void or unapplicable to the user.
summary: The ability to cheat on anyone or anything in existence whether physical, spiritual, psychic etc.
strengths: Cheat the rules of reality and all the forces in the universe
Cheat other abilities by simply changing how those abilities work on you or making them useless
You can even cheat death itself
weaknesses: Everybody hates cheaters.
You can cheat only ten times per day
Takes the fun out of everything you do because you can simply "cheat your way" to victory

name: Aero Augmentation
description: This power allows you to enhance how you interact with one force of air (lift, thrust, drag, weight), and devalue its counter force. Lift makes you lighter allowing levitation, thrust makes you faster, drag makes you slower (useful if you need to make an immediate stop), and weight (gravity) makes you heavier. This power is very useful for aerial combat.
summary: The ability to change how you interact with the forces of air
strengths: Combining thrust and lift allows you to fly (not levitate, actual flight)
You can achieve super speed and flight
weaknesses: Not an ability meant for combat (doesn't mean you can't though)
No defensive abilities

name: Theatrical Instancy
description: With this power, when you watch a movie you have the ability to bring the characters to life to be your servants. If you want an army of 300 Spartan and the star wars republic army, and you watched there movie, you would be able to have them as your army. You can summon your favorite superheroes and villain to work together to do your bidding. You could watch the movie Superman with Superman. This power doesn't effect the movies from which you summoned the character.
summary: The ability to bring characters to life that you have seen in movies
strengths: You can get more than one movie involved in your creation
You can combine different movie characters into a more powerful being than in the movie
You can have the power of one character put into your own body
weaknesses: You can't use cartoons or animation in your creation
If you take the power of a character, you can't summon that character
You can't summon religious gods

name: Weather Manipulation
description: If its raining, you can make it rain 10 times harder; if it's hot and sunny, you can make the rays of the sun more intene and thus raise the temperature. But you can also do the opposite, make it rain less hard or make the weather less summer-like
summary: The ability to manipulate the conditions of the current weather
strengths: You can get more of the current weather-type
You can get less of the current weather-type
weaknesses: You can only increase the current weather
It can be dangerous

name: Chemical Necessity Generation
description: The user can create chemicals that act as some of the necessities that living creates need to survive. They can create a chemical that a become a food like substance. They can satisfy anyone. Water and oxygen can be other things that can be made when none of it isn't around. Their is one issue with it. When the effects start to dissipate, the chemicals become a poisonous. Non-lethal, of course, but it can leave the one to use these chemicals become ill for short moments in time.
summary: The ability to create chemicals that act as necessities that any being needs to have to survive.
strengths: Create chemicals to use to survive
Eventually learn to manipulate
User will develop immunity to poison effects
weaknesses: Products will become poisonous while used

name: Tactile Psammokinesis
description: This power allows a person to control sand at close range. It is slightly stronger than the normal form of this ability due to psionic energy emanated from the individual when in concurrence with any sand source. A user of the power can even infuse their body with it to increase or decrease their mass, strength, and power. They can also create sandstorms, tornadoes, etc.
summary: The ability to control sand when in contact or close proximity to it.
strengths: You have near-limitless regenerative capability when in or near any form of sand.
You can be a formidable combatant to an enemy.
You cannot be destroyed.
weaknesses: You can only control minute amounts of sand at first.
Water, heat, and wind can all weaken you.
If you are inexperienced, this power can fatigue you very quickly if amplified.

name: Super Time
description: Able to control the time vortex and gives super speed and strength
summary: The ability to control the time vortex.
strengths: can go back in time
Super speed
Can go into the vortex of space
weaknesses: Can disrupt the pfuture
Can change the past
Can kill you if used wrong

name: Sublimation
description: With this power, you can become a hazy mist that blinds anyone within range and gives you the power to phase through objects, intangibility, and of course, blinding.  With this power, you cannot feel pain, and it is very helpful in escaping dangerous situations. Unfortunately, you only have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
summary: The ability to change your body into mist
strengths: You can blind opponents
You have the powers of phasing and intangibility
Easily escape dangerous situations
weaknesses: You have an hour before you MUST change back to your true form.
You can accidentally blind allies.
Retreating is not always a good thing to do.

name: Chorokinesis
description: The ability to affect the dimension of space on a physical object or person. Its effect on the subject is similar to teleportation, it moves from one space to another without using time. (All other dimensions on the object stay the same--length, width, depth, and time). In other words, this ability allows you to teleport yourself and other objects instantaneously.
summary: The ability to control the dimension of space
strengths: Go anywhere you want.
Move anything you want so you don't need to move.
weaknesses: You cannot control any time aspects.
You could teleport into a solid object which would probably kill you.
Objects and people stay in the exact position they were in just a different place.

name: Strength In Numbers
description: With this power you can create up to 12 clones of yourself and each of them have super strength. Note you yourself don't have super strength only your clones do but you have complete control over your clones. Also if one of the clones dies you can simply recreate it.
summary: The ability to create up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
strengths: You can have up to 12 super strong clones of yourself
There is no time limit on the clones
The clones are under you complete control
weaknesses: You yourself don't have super strength
The clones are not invincible

name: Energy Converter
description: With your left hand, you can absorb any kind of energy. Thermal, electrical, kinetic, light, sound, psychic, chi, you name it. You can absorb from the general area, or from something/someone in particular. Once absorbed, it can be converted into any other type of energy and fired from the right hand in the form of a powerful beam. You can choose how much energy to put into the beam, but it's max power depends on how much energy you've stored up.
summary: The ability to absorb energy, change it, and redirect it.
strengths: You can absorb any kind of energy from any source.
By absorbing all of somebody's body heat, you could effectively freeze them.
The beam can consist of any energy in existence (that you know of).
weaknesses: Absorbed energy doesn't add to your physical strength.
You can't absorb kinetic energy from getting hit, unless you block with your left hand.
Lefties may have trouble aiming (but with enough practice, they could become ambidextrous).

name: A Dragon's Ring
description: With this power, you can summon the silver dragon ring from 'The Sorcerer's Apprentice' to use as an extremely versatile source of power. It's main power is unlocking the mind's psychic power, thus granting the person access and control of it. Other secondary powers include pyrokinesis, phasing, enhanced speed and reflexes, regeneration, and super strength.
summary: The ability to summon a special dragon ring as a supernatural aid
strengths: Have nearly-limitless psychic power!
Be near-immortal
The ring binds with the first person who wields it, and only if they are good
weaknesses: Unlocking the ring's full power takes time and practice
You can only remove the ring through willpower

name: Illusionary Fear
description: The person with this power is able to make a person's fear come through via an illusion. The enemy becomes trapped in an illusion of the thing that fear the most. A person with a significant will power can overcome the illusions of fear.
summary: The ability to make the user's enemies fear come through via illusions
strengths: Illusions can be used to trap enemies in the worst fear
Can stall enemies
Can prevent enemies from stealing something
weaknesses: A person with significant will power can escape this power

name: Cell Control
description: This is one of the most gruesome and bloody abilities. It allows the user to control their own cells like a metamorph can control their atoms. This allows you to make many genetic weapons. For example, you could change your arm into a fleshy spike tipped with a jagged head of bone. Or you could take your hand and turn it into a whip. You can even change your cells' form from animal to plant. So you could use photosynthesis and other plant-related powers. You can even increase cell generation.
summary: The ability to control your own cells.
strengths: You can make tons of cell weapons (Bone spike shooter)
You can even change your cells' form and increase cell generation.
weaknesses: It's a gruesome and bloody ability.

name: Xenoglossy
description: This literally translates to "foreign tongue". You can understand and speak any human language, like Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, French or Cambodian. Any one of the over 1000 different languages found around the world. You cannot communicate with animals, plants, aliens, etc.
summary: The ability to understand and speak any human language.
strengths: Speak any human language.
Understand any human language.
weaknesses: You can't speak to animals or plants.
You can't speak to aliens either.

name: Influence Adaption
description: The user has the ability to withstand any influence and be able to pass it of to influence other things. This means the user can be immune from emotion manipulation to mind control. Then the user can use those abilities to control or free other people from another being's influence.
summary: The ability to adapt and utilize any form of influence.
strengths: Influence immunity
Gain influence-based abilities
weaknesses: Influence abilities only last as long as one is near the source of the influence.

name: Phase Diver
description: A person with this power has the ability to turn any solid they touch into its liquid state or any liquid they touch into its solid state. Obviously this power can be used in many creative ways. Some examples include going through liquid walls. Trapping people by pulling them into cement and then hardening it.
summary: The ability to turn solids into liquids or liquids into solids by touch
strengths: Solids into liquids - Swim on land, go through walls,
Liquids into solids - Trap people in swimming pools
Everything that changed state will start to revert to previous shapes and have the same temperature
weaknesses: You still need to breath when swimming through any liquid

name: Energy Weapon Generation
description: This ability allows for the hero or villain to create a weapon made of energy, with the right amount of focus. The weapons appears in the hand, glowing in the color of the users choosing. The weapon may only be weilded by the user and has twice the lethality of normal weaponry. An energy sword would cut through more than a normal sword but not everything. The weapons are created by syphoning off the user's energy. So too many, too big or too powerful of a weapon causes the user to pass out
summary: The ability to create any weapon made of pure energy.
strengths: Any weapon any time
Highly lethal weapons
weaknesses: Drains own energy
Requires focus so faster generation is harder

name: Activation And Deactivation
description: This is the ability to imbue objects and systems with the energy they need to perform their functions. For example, the function of a paper airplane is to glide through the air from one place to another. You can make that happen. There isn't any limit to the kinds of systems you can activate. Mechanical, electrical, biological. This means you can even activate abilities in another person. The flip side is that you can also deactivate systems around you.
summary: The ability to activate and deactivate various objects and systems
strengths: You can activate and deactivate objects and systems around you.
Tons of different uses
You can even activate and deactivate abilities in others
weaknesses: This ability is heavily connected to emotion, and can be hard to control.
You can't force an object or system to go beyond it's capabilities.

name: Force Extension
description: Grab any item and smash an opponent with it from any range. This ability extends the force from the object you are wielding to the target point. However, there is a range limit of about 50 meters of extension from the tip of the object. More advanced users can create multiple extensions to create various effects, like a small wall of defence, and also the ability to slightly exaggerate the force, making it stronger than it would normally be. But you have to swing the object for this ability.
summary: The ability to extend the force of an object that you are using.
strengths: Extend the force of any object that you use, including blunt, pierce and slash forces
More advanced users can make the forces stronger and make more extensions
Use both offensively and defensively
weaknesses: Must be wielding an object.
Have to visualise where the extension comes from
Acts as a physical extension, so energy beings are immune.

name: Child Of The Night
description: The ability to grow claws and be able to run at God-like speeds during the night. Once the sun rises, you become a regular person. This power is inherited through genetics. Running in the night is like a drug for the Children of the Night and produces extreme pleasure. Direct contact with the sunlight could cause slight discomfort. The Children of the Sun are your enemies.
summary: The ability to grow claws, be able to run at God-like speeds, and be almost invincible during the night
strengths: Become an insanely powerful creature of the night
Feel the icy wind against your body as you run through the night
Be able to eliminate any enemies
weaknesses: If you are in the middle of a battle and the sun comes up, you are screwed
The sun slightly causes you to be discomfortable
The Children of the Sun are powerful while you are a weak human

name: Wing Manifestation
description: The user of this power is able to grow wings that can be used for flying. However, the wings that are grown is dependent on what animal or insect with wings which are near the user. For example, if there is a bald eagle near by, you would get a wing structure of a bald eagle. The wings that are manifested are proportianate to the user's size and will enable them to fly
summary: The ability to grow wings that can be used for flight
strengths: The user can with limits depending on the type of wing
Can defend against rear attack
weaknesses: Not independent flight, air and thrust is still needed
Defect or injury to wing may cause flight to be erratic

name: Ambidextrous Elements
description: This power is designed to combine the four traditional elements. Combining the elements can also enhance (Water and air become a hurricane) or decrease (Fire and water become steam) their combat effectiveness. With concentration, you can use two elements at the same time to defeat your opponents.
summary: The ability to control a different element with each hand.
strengths: Great for combat.
Control over Air, Water, Fire, and Earth.
Affecting air pressure can change the weather.
weaknesses: Combining elements in one spray can disable their effect. (mainly water and fire)
Overuse can lead to fatigue.
You must always be within sight of the element you plan to use.

name: Mastery Of Explosions
description: The ability to create, control, manipulate and absorb explosions. With this, you can: Fly- By creating small explosions at the base of your feet and stabilizing with other small explosions. Defend- By exploding any danger coming at you. Does not affect energies. Attack- Melee or energetic. By creating explosions from your fist to blow up someone's face or even just blow up their head from afar. It also allows you to stop explosions, including the explosions in guns, pistons in cars, etc.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate explosions
strengths: Can blow up anything and everything.
Can stop explosions, rendering cars, trucks, guns, anything with explosions useless.
Protection from physical harm.
weaknesses: Useless when unconscious.
Property damage.
Energy exhaustion.

name: Concussive Force
description: A hand-to-hand power where one forces out a large amount of energy out of one's hands, or feet, creating a sonic boom-like thing. This will destroy most things in its way.
summary: The ability to create strong force blasts.
strengths: Incredibly destructive.
Superior to Sonic Blasts.
weaknesses: Can damage an unconditioned body.
Unstable.

name: Aura Bullet
description: The bullets are composed of condensed energy from your own aura and can travel at speeds of up to 1000 metres per second. You can fire them from either your mouth by making the actions of spitting something out or from your fingertips. Also, you have to fire the bullets right when you create them. The color of the bullets is the same as your aura's color.
summary: The ability to create and fire off bullets using one's own aura
strengths: The bullets give off no telltale smoke when fired so no one can trace them back to your hiding spot.
The bullets dissolve after a few minutes so they can't be traced back to you.
weaknesses: You can't store the bullets for later use.

name: Selective Temptation Immunity
description: This ability grants the user with an immunity to temptation in any form. To be tempted to do something, they must choose to do so. These temptations can be financial, superhuman, biological, mental or otherwise in nature.
summary: The ability to be immune to any unwanted temptation in any form.
strengths: You will not go mad with power (unless you want to).
You are immune to unwanted seduction.
You are harder to manipulate.
weaknesses: Does not help against most forms of mind control.
You must consciously choose to be susceptible to something.
If you remain immune to metabolic temptations, you still need to fulfill those needs.

name: Omnipresence
description: Like an omniscient god, you get to witnes events happening in other parts of the world, even across galaxies.
summary: The ability to see everything happening anywhere.
strengths: Your enemies can run, but they can't hide.
weaknesses: Information overload could give you severe mental strain.

name: Illusion Manipulation
description: The term illusion refers to a specific form of sensory distortion. Unlike a hallucination, which is a distortion in the absence of a stimulus, an illusion describes a misinterpretation of a true sensation.
summary: The ability to alter the perceptions of another
strengths: Make people believe what you want them to believe
Can affect any of the senses; ie. Sight, sound, touch, taste, or smell
weaknesses: You can only do this while you're within seeing distance of the person
It has to be a conscience action

name: Technopathy
description: A person with Technopathy can control any form of computer-based device. They can mentally write computer programs, manipulate data streams, and use their abilities to infulence real-world events.
summary: The ability to communicate mentally with electronics
strengths: ATM machines are now the same thing as free money
Write e-mails with your mind
Make everyone's cell phone ring at once
weaknesses: Powerless without technology
Computer viruses
Firewalls

name: Tactile Hypnosis
description: This ability enables you to make someone do what you want by touching him and giving a verbal command. The person you touch will preform the command unless he is restrained somehow. This ability may not work on pepole who are superhumanly durable or have a healing factor.
summary: The ability to make someone do what you want by touching him
strengths: Make pepole do what you want
You can control the actions of others
You can make people obey the verbal commands you give
weaknesses: Ability is limited by touch
May not work on pepole who are superhumanly durable or have a healing factor
You must use verbal commands to make this ability work

name: Pyromaniacal Form
description: With this abilty, you can switch into a pyromaniacal form, which allows you to grow and gain power from fire. Once in this state, your body represents a figure completely engulfed and shaped in flame. You gain more fire-like abilties as you feed off fire, and they also adapt as you feed. These abilities include fire breathing, fire balls, and surges of flame. You can revert to normal form at any time, however, if you're cooled down enough, you will automatically revert.
summary: The ability to switch into a form where you grow and gain power from fire
strengths: You gain abilities such as fire-breathing, fire-balls, and releasing fire.
You are immune to most physical attacks
You can revert to your normal form at any time.
weaknesses: At the beginning of your form, you will be vunerable to most harm, espescially water.
Once you revert to normal form, your pyromaniacal form resets in size.
Mental attacks can still easily damage this form.

name: Nature Zone
description: Creates a zone that promotes the growth of nature. Plants and animals inside the zone will grow faster and healthier. If the area has been cleared of natural wildlife and vegetation, then both will be attracted to return to the area. While the zone is active technological creations will be less effective and man made objects will begin to degrade. Specific plants can even be manipulated to grow faster normal and in a specific way. Animals will also act friendlier to humans.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes the growth of nature.
strengths: Cause animals and plants to return to an area.
Manipulate plants to grow faster and in a specific way.
Animals will act friendlier to humans.
weaknesses: Technological creations and man made objects begin to fail.
Others can manipulate plants against you.
Animals can still be dangerous even though they will normally act friendly.

name: Goal Achievement
description: This power allows the user to know every detail of every one of their own goals, as well as every detail of how to achieve specific goals. Example: a shapeshifters goal is to "upgrade" their appearance without making any huge changes, but still satisfying their needs. With this power, the shapeshifter would know exactly how to achieve this specific goal. Combining this power with other powers is an advantage, although this power still works on users without any other powers.
summary: The ability to know exactly how to achieve your goals
strengths: Know every detail of every one of their own goals
Know every detail of how to achieve specific goals
Combining this power with other powers is an advantage
weaknesses: Users without any other powers are more limited as to what goals can be achieved

name: Weakness Manipulation
description: Someone's weakness(including any of your own)can be changed to something else. You can also alter the severity of a weakness. You can make the severity of the the weakness no worse than a bad skin rash to a almost instant death reaction. You can match a weakness with someone's powers or give someone a weakness that contradicts a power they have. A icy weakness for ice power user or a friction weakness for a super fast runner. Changes like these aren't permanent however.
summary: The ability to change someone's weakness and/or the severity of the weakness.
strengths: Change your or a friend's weakness at will.
Make a weakness you have you no worse than a allergic reaction.
Make a foe's weakness into a deadly one.
weaknesses: Some weaknesses will only be temporary.
You can't negate a weakness with this power.
You have this power but so does your enemy.

name: Phoenix Ability
description: The ability to use the abilities of a phoenix. You can create fire, lift 10x your own weight, your tears have healing powers, and when you die you will turn into ashes and be born again.
summary: The ability to use the abilities of a phoenix
strengths: Cook popcorn in your hands
No need to use stoves
You will always have a light
weaknesses: Without practice you could burn someone else
Born again means that you turn into a baby

name: Accuracy
description: The ability to take any object, like a dagger, a throwing star or even a ball, and hit your target no matter where you throw it. So, you could throw something right, but if your target's on the left, it turns left. Unfortunately, you have to be able to focus on the object and where it's going to hit.
summary: The ability to hit something no matter where it is
strengths: Will never miss a target
Bend laws of physics
Able to join a lot of sports and be the best
weaknesses: Wouldn't use a gun; hard to focus on a bullet
Your emotions might distract you

name: Periodic
description: With this superpower, you can control all the elements in the periodic table of elements with your mind. Control gold, gallium, oxygen, iodine, lithium, uranium, neon, plutonium, and many many more. There are over 100 elements. Works best with a chemistry reference table or chemistry knowledge.
summary: The ability to control all the elements in the periodic table of elements with your mind
strengths: Control every element on the periodic table of elements.
Control valuable metals and tough metals.
Works best with a knowledge of chemistry.
weaknesses: Can not control energy of any kind.
Can not control plasma.
Can not control ghosts.

name: Darkness Manipulation
description: A user of this superpower can do the exact opposite of someone with Photo-Kinesis; they can decrease the amount of light and create 'flashes' of total darkness. They can also cloak themselves to hide during the night and can become completely invisible when in shadows. An adept user would be able to 'melt' into the shadows and could travel between them easily. An extremely adept user would be able to create the illusion of the Sun dimming in the sky by creating a planet-wide veil of darkness.
summary: The ability to manipulate darkness and shadows
strengths: You can avoid detection by manipulating shadows.
It can be used without other weaponry.
You can play upon human's natural fear of the dark.
weaknesses: This can be cancelled out by someone with Photo-Kinesis.
More advanced aspects require a large amount of mental strength.
Extreme aspects could lead to madness and insanity.

name: Future Sight
description: Every time you imagine yourself performing a certain action, you see its outcome. The vision is experienced through the POV of your future self with all of your 5 senses. You don't suffer from the physical pain experienced in the vision nor any other negative effects other than the reaction to the content of the future can harm you. You can analyze multiple scenarios simultaneously and branch them from each other. While being in a vision state you are fully aware of your surroundings.
summary: The ability to see the result of any action performed by oneself in the close future
strengths: Get an answer to the every "What if..?" question that has been bugging you
You now live your life like a video game ("Oops, I died. Oh well, I'll try again")
Seeing in the darkness, light-speed reflex...- find new uses by stretching your imagination a little
weaknesses: You may want to try out some scenarios that you wouldn't even consider doing in the real life.
If you know everybody's reaction, people will feel unrealistic to you.
If the unescapable death will come close, you'll know it.

name: Ultimate Upgrader
description: This ability lets the user access ultimate versions of their ability at will. Ultimate abilities are abilities that have been honed so much that their power is at max and their possibilities to do things increase. However, it comes at a price with having glaring weaknesses and chances to leave a trail of destruction. A person must know how to absolutely control their abilities to use ultimate abilities effectively. You can switch back to non-ultimate forms with the original level of power.
summary: The ability to evolve/devolve your own powers to/from its ultimate form
strengths: You get to use an upgraded version of your own power
You can switch between the ultimate and non-ultimate form
weaknesses: Ultimate abilities have glaring weaknesses such as indiscriminate paths of destruction
Ultimate abilities are harder to control than any other superpower and can be fatal to the user

name: Viral Regeneration
description: The Viral Regeneration power allows for rapid repair of injuries. It works by absorbing microbes in the immediate vicinity. They are then reprogrammed by the immune system to repair cellular damage or bodily injuries.
summary: The ability to heal small injuries by reprogramming bacteria to repair them.
strengths: Almost invicible, as any damage will be repaired quickly.
Prevents you from getting sick.
weaknesses: Germ-killing substances can counteract this power.
Can't repair fatal injuries.

name: Sports Week
description: On Monday, you are an excellent football (soccer) player. On Tuesday, you are an excellent basketball player. On Wednesday, you are an excellent roller skater. On Thursday, you are an excellent gymnast. On Friday, you are an excellent swimmer. On Saturday, you are an excellent golfer. And on Sunday, you are an excellent tennis player. However, you will only be good at these sports during the indicated day, your capacities will be back to normal on the other days.
summary: The ability to be extremely good at certain sports on certain days of the week.
strengths: You will be excellent even if you don't have the right anatomy for it.
The date is the one of the time zone you're in.
Being excellent at a sport also means coming up with great strategies and being a good teacher.
weaknesses: If a match you're playing on a good day is reported to the day after.
You will only be good at these seven sports. You can't change them.
You will only be good for one day per week.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Existence Affinity
description: The user has the ability to be stronger, faster, and more durable by something specific that exists; the  only limits is how many of them do exist, how significant the thing, or both. Example: If a smoker truly loves or desires cigarettes, the user will become more powerful by the number of cigarettes that exist in their vicinity.
summary: The ability to become stronger by something specifically that exists in their surrounding..
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and more durable.
Numbers are the key.
weaknesses: If that specific thing doesn't exist anymore, user is back to normal strength.

name: Energy Ball
description: This ability allows the user to basicly create energy balls. The energy appear very similar to cosmic energy, but it comes in more than just orange. It comes in red, blue, orange, green, yellow, black, grey and others. Each color can do different things. After creating the sphere, if it comes into hard contact with something, it will burst. Lets say you made a red ball. If it bursts, whatever it hit will burst into flames.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate spheres of energy of varying kinds.
strengths: Tons of colors can be used.
Spheres can be made around your hands(Red sphere/human flamethrower)
weaknesses: Stranger colors will be a surprise the first time you use them.

name: Weather Control
description: With this ability, you can change the weather to be sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, icy--you name it.  Just as long as it isn't catastrophic.  None of this Noah business.
summary: The ability to have full control over weather.
strengths: Great weather when you want it
Be the best weather reporter in the world
weaknesses: Causing draughts
Flooding if you let it rain too long
Crazy wedding planners

name: Dimensional Room Upgrade
description: When you use this power on an enclosed space, the inside of the area becomes a new dimension that is larger on the inside than on the outside. The dimension inside will be an upgraded version of whatever was in the area previously. So, if you upgrade a kitchen, you could have a kitchen of any size with appliances and supplies, even if they were not in there originally. You can have multiple dimensions inside the created dimension, such as if you used it on a house and then on rooms in the house.
summary: The ability to make an upgraded dimension inside an enclosed space that is an upgraded version of that space.
strengths: As much space as you need.
Have a really awesome house.
Larger dimensions may have more interesting things inside them.
weaknesses: People will want you to continuously make dimensions for them.
Cannot make dimensions smaller than the enclosed space.
Have to have some stuff in enclosed space or you'll just get a big empty box.

name: Accelerating Thinking Process
description: One with this ability has a thinking process that keeps accelerating, allowing them to think more and more in the same amount of time. As a side effect, their movements get faster -- as fast as humanly possible though, so do their reflexes and reactions, and they can readjust their movements in a split second, allowing them to have very precise movements. After a while, their thinking process gets so fast their perception of time is slowed down, allowing them even more time to think.
summary: The ability to think faster and faster as time goes by.
strengths: You get more and more time to think thoroughly.
You could clearly see the speedsters' movements, allowing you to block and evade them.
You could do impressive acrobatic moves, as you can readjust your movements while in motion.
weaknesses: Passive ability. You need active concentration to slow down your thinking process to a human level.
You consume more energy, so you need to eat and rest more.
Your body cannot get superhumanly fast,. So, after a while, your body will seem slow to you.

name: Visual Muscle Replication
description: With this power, whatever you imagine you can do in your head. Your body will do it. For example: you see a Jackie Chan feat that you want to do plus a few more of your own added. Now you can do it. This power is limited to your flexibility and realisticness. So you can't fly.
summary: The ability to perform any feat you can imagine.
strengths: Your muscle will be A LOT stronger. You bone will be lighter too.
Got pushed of a building, you'll be fine. Just imagine how you will land, your body will do it.
Do cool stuff, like qua-tripple spin on a skateboard even though you nerver skateboard before
weaknesses: You can't do superheroes feat. So if you want to jump like spider man, you''ll be like him for 2 sec

name: Fortune Cookie
description: Tired of having bad luck or not having any date? Well lucky you! With this power, you can create any fortune cookie with anything written and whoever reads it will be affected. For example: Mom reads a fortune cookie stating "You will become hot and sexy" and poof!! You got a hot and sexy mother. Be warned though, the effects are permanent.
summary: The ability to make a fortune cookie with anything written in it come true
strengths: Be a wonderful match-maker
Have everyone's mother become hot and sexy
Be worshipped as the Fortune Cookie God
weaknesses: Might want some "Unwanted Effects"
Can't use on yourself more than once a day
Might read the words "fat and ugly"

name: Overdrive
description: The user of this ability can change the cellular constitution of their own body to function faster or better, for example, change muscle cells to red blood cells for faster circulation. Or to change white blood cells to muscle cells, effectively making themself stronger but prone to more diseases. Changing cell constitution burns energy. They can also transform into an Overdrive body, making themself 300% more efficient, stronger and faster.
summary: The ability to change the cellular constitution of the body to function faster
strengths: Can change cellular constitution to become faster or stronger.
Overdrive Mode can make your other powers 300% more efficient and powerful.
Cellular regeneration is possible for skilled users.
weaknesses: Changing your cells burns energy so you have to eat a lot.
You can change too many of your cells, if unskilled, which is dangerous.
If you stay in Overdrive Mode too long, you will die from lack of energy.

name: Overclocking
description: A person with this power can increase their own abilities both natural and or superpowers for a period of time in exchange for side effects later. For example using this power you can increase your strength past its limit or increase your stamina and concentration. You can also increase the computing power of your brain. If you have superpowers you can also increase their power using this ability. The user receives a backlash of fatigue and hunger after using this ability.
summary: The ability to increase your own abilities beyond your normal scope for a period of time with side effects later
strengths: Increase your abilities when you need it the most
Decrease time needed to train or study in exchange for fatigue later
You can control how much you are overclocking and can tell when the backlash occurs
weaknesses: Backlash some time after use of this power
If you overuse this ability it is bad for your health

name: Utopian Hallucination
description: With this power you can cause someone to believe that they are in their personal utopia. As far as they are concerned, the world is their definition of perfect and nothing is bad or wrong. However in reality it is all in their head and the person's body remains in a coma like state until you free them. You cannot use this power against yourself and a person with this power cannot be subjected to it.
summary: The ability to cause someone to believe they are in their personal utopia
strengths: You can cause a person to believe they are in utopia
Non-violent takedowns
weaknesses: It is all in their head.
Victim is placed in a coma

name: Arceusforce: Sky
description: The user of this ability can channel the power of the heavens of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Flying-type. The user's skin turns periwinkle, their irises turn white and pupils turn sky blue. Under their avian guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Flying-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Flying attacks such as Aerial Ace, Drill Peck, Brave Bird, Hurricane and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Flying form.
strengths: The user can resist supernatural combat, insect and plant-based attacks. Immune to earth attacks.
Generation and manipulation of wind and avian aura to use Flying attacks.
The user gains feathered wings to fly like a bird.
weaknesses: The user is weak to electric, mineral and ice-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form
If grounded, the user can be hit by earthen attacks.

name: Karma Manipulation
description: Now, this ability is the ability to manipulate others' karma, that means that you can make good things or bad things happen to someone, for example if someone is good to you, you can just concentrate on good things happening to them, and then they'll like win on dozens of scratch tickets, or if they are bad to you you can think bad things and their car will crash, but they never die, and there are some rules, bad things will only happen to them if they deserve it.
summary: The ability to manipulate other people's karma.
strengths: You can control others karma.
You can reward or punish people who deserve it.
weaknesses: You don't know how it will happen, you can only chose whether it is bad or good.
If they are not bad people, and you try to make bad things happen to them, it will go back onto you.
You cannot change your own karma only other people's.

name: Electrokinesis
description: With this power, you can create and command electricity in any form. You can hurl lightning bolts, recharge your appliances etc.
summary: The ability to generate & manipulate electricity
strengths: Dead batteries? Not anymore.
If you generate your own electricity, power companies can't steal as much of your money.
Good in a fight. Especially if you can control the voltage well.
weaknesses: I imagine swimming won't be fun.
Can be pretty deadly to those around if you lose control.
When you run out of power...

name: Resurrection
description: Able to come back to life fully healed after you have died
summary: The ability to come back to life after you die
strengths: Can do whatever you want without fear of death
Live forever
weaknesses: Have to see loved ones die

name: Transduction
description: The user is able to convert any form of energy in equal amount to any other form he pleases.  Using the power drains/depletes his surrounding of the energy he absorbs. The user needs a constant supply of energy and cannot store it. He also is helpless in a environment without energy. At the height of his ability, he is able to use atomic power. But overuse or a lack of energy in the envir causes a residual antimatter, a dangerous entity, unless the energy is replaced within 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to change one form of energy to another
strengths: Use energy forms according to situation
Can use any form of a particular energy
Manipulate and discharge in any way he pleases
weaknesses: Cannot function in energy depleted environment
Can use equal amount only
Can't create energy

name: Instant Hypnosis
description: You'll be able to stand and emit hypnotic waves from your eyes. If the waves hit the opponent then they shall start to walk up to you, then they let you command them to do whatever you want.
summary: The ability to unleash ultrasonic waves from your eyes then to control people affected
strengths: You can tell them their most secrets.
weaknesses: It'll wear off once they snapped out or splahed on with water.

name: Copy Cat
description: Copy cat is exactly as it is titled. You can copy any power that you see, or hear about within a matter of seconds. However, you can only copy cat 25 powers before it disappears, and you are unable to copy any more powers, so you have to be careful about which powers you want to copy.
summary: The ability to copy any power you hear, or see.
strengths: Can have multiple powers
Can choose which powers you want to copy
weaknesses: It takes you longer than most to master each power
You must HEAR or SEE this power in use
With each power you take in, this power itself gets weaker

name: Youth Manipulation
description: This power allows alteration of how old or young a person looks or acts. For example, you could make a ten year old suddenly have an aching back or make yourself 21 for the rest of eternity. You can also subtly change how they think. For example, you can make someone in their 90s slowly over the course of weeks or months think like they did as a toddler.
summary: The ability to change how old or young a person looks or acts
strengths: You can live forever by making your body look the same age constantly.
Using this on an annoying classmate or teacher.
weaknesses: If you can't undo the effects.
If you can't control the effects of this power for some reason.

name: Earth Bio Power
description: With this power you have the ability of every species on Earth and you also have powers of viruses as well. A person with this power has unlocked his own genetic code giving him every ability possible by genetic manipulation. They can access all biologically possible powers within nature including flight. However the user is blocked off from powers not observed in nature, such as telekinesis.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of every living species on earth-(all naturally occuring powers)
strengths: You can access all the powers naturally occuring in nature
You will have immunity to diseases and viruses-since you have their powers as well
You still look human-but can shape shift to gain body parts like wings or extra arms
weaknesses: Cannot use any other power-this one power is already too powerful
Can still be beaten by superpowered means or by technological means

name: Titanium Scale Skin
description: Your skins changes to chrome Titanium and grows titanium scales all over the body except on the head, hands and feet. A tail with scales might also grow depending on the person but when changing back to human form, the tail disappears. The skin also provides great invunerability and durability. There are also 5 retractable claws on each hand.
summary: The ability to have titanium skin covered with scales
strengths: Enhanced invunerability and durability
Great agility and speed
Claws can slice through anything except for titanium armour
weaknesses: Difficult to learn how to use a tail

name: Mechassimilation
description: Bond with any metal or metallic object within 800 yards, pulling them to you from a distance. The metal parts will wrap around your body by themselves as they bond to you, attaching and arranging themselves according to your thoughts. You can also dismantle other machines for more parts, and not just metal itself. You can combine those machines to your body WITHOUT disassembling them, and become a Transformer! Physics still affects you however, so be careful how much metal you bond with!
summary: The ability to bond metal parts, or machines of any kind to your body in the form of armor or weapons
strengths: Bonding with machines is a better idea than just raw metal, as you can strengthen your body.
Metal bonded to your body becomes almost a second skin, and will not come off. Great for protection!
