Iron Man made easy! Make yourself a battlesuit made entirely of android parts by mere thought!
weaknesses: Intense psychic control and focus is needed to draw in metal from a distance.
Metal broken, or severed from your body in any way cannot be salvaged, and must be replaced.
Dismantling a working machine renders it useless, and after that, can only be used for parts.

name: External Duplication
description: Can copy anything you are in physical contact with that does not exceed 15ftx15ft(objects exceeding will be created incomplete). While in contact with object you perform a "psychic scan" which creates an identical copy that is stored within your subconscious, and can be recreated anytime you wish.
summary: The ability to create a copy of almost anything you are in physical contact with.
strengths: Infinite resources (Water, Food, Money, Weapons, Fuel)
Recreate precious/rare items (Antimatter, Superpowered Items)
Never need to carry anything on you (Entire wardrobes, sheds full of items, etc.)
weaknesses: Remembering everything you store! Be sure to write it all down just in case.
Copying a broken/potentially dangerous object ex. A leaking nuclear missle.
Can only create any item if there is enough space for it to appear in.

name: Elemental Plane
description: With this power you gain a connection with an elemental plane of your choice. You can enter and exit the elemental plane at will and create portals to bring objects across. The elementals inside the elemental plane will not try to harm you but you will have to tame them to get them to follow your commands. You can also craft elemental artifacts while within the elemental plane. Lastly you will be able to use elemental magic that is connected to your elemental plane.
summary: The ability to have a connection to an elemental plane of your choice.
strengths: Able to open portals to enter and exit an elemental plane.
Have the ability to tame elementals and craft artifacts.
Can develope an ability to use elemental magic for the elemental plane.
weaknesses: Can only connect to one type of elemental plane and cannot change.
Have to be able to tame elementals.
Takes time to develope powers and craft strong artifacts.

name: Mental Capacity
description: By surpassing your mental capacity/limitations, you gain what some would call "psychic abilities" such as moving things with your mind (including yourself), mental communication/influence, telekinetic forcefield, and spiritual detection (dead or alive). The telekinesis has a weight/size limit of that equal to two large automobiles, but with practice, you can lift more weight/size. You must know the person you are mentally communicating with/influencing.
summary: The ability to surpass your mental capacity/limitations
strengths: Moving things with your mind (including yourself)
Mental communication/influence
Telekinetic forcefield, and spiritual detection (dead or alive)
weaknesses: You must know the person you are mentally communicating with/influencing
Telekinesis has a weight/size limit (but with practice, you can lift more weight/size)

name: Calculated Moves
description: When in danger or combat situation, your mind analyzes calculates the surrounding are in a nanosecond or less. You instantly scan the area & opponents & determine the best course of action. From punching physics like how much strength to put in & the damage it will do to throwing something or shooting. Its like you have Terminator eyes to some extent. You won't have different imaging settings like x-ray, night vision or thermal etc. Just split second decision making processor.
summary: The ability to make precise calculated moves in combat
strengths: You're a human strategic super computer
weaknesses: Your mind is the only thing advanced really. No other superhuman attributes.

name: Psychic Seismic Shockwaves
description: By hold one's index fingers to the temples, closing the eytes and focusing, you can unleash a powerful, devastating shockwave across the land and not be injuried by it. The shockwaves have a ripple effect an are similiar to earthquakes and tremors.
summary: The ability to send invisble and destructive shockwaves with your mind
strengths: Shockwaves are devastatingly powerful
Shockwaves can't physically injure you
You can control the power and distance of the wave
weaknesses: Horrible headaches can come from doing it too much
Physical and mental energy will eventually drain if done too much, causing mental strain.
Being stressed and distressed helps with the power.

name: Kinesis Adaptation
description: Kinesis Adaptation, also called Adaptive Kinesis is a variation of Reactive Adaptation in which the user's "kinesis" power changes, based on the materials he comes into contact with; if the user were to touch water, he would gain the power to manipulate water (the power to manipulate fire if he touched fire, and so on). However, if the user touched an obscure material, he could choose between just manipulating that substance/material/element and going back to normal Telekinesis
summary: The ability to gain different "kinesis" powers based on the materials one touches
strengths: Touch water, control water; touch fire, control fire, and so on
Touch the most prevalent element in one's environment (never at a total disadvantage in fights)
Also gain adaptations against that element (water: aquatic adaptation, fire: fire resistance, etc. )
weaknesses: One element at a time
If an object has Telesthetic Immunity, you can't control it
No touching people to control them (unless the power is HIGHLY developed)

name: Children Of Absorption
description: You can take someone's powers by touching them. You can also absorb energy like heat or light(ning). At most, you can absorb/hold two kinds of energy and one power at a time. By default, all people who have this power have deep purple eyes and purple colored blood.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy and/or power of someone/something
strengths: Absorb anyone's power just by touching them
Absorb energies like heat or light(ning) and mix them up to create deadly/original powers
Get cool purple eyes and purple blood by having this power
weaknesses: Could be identified as a Child of Adaptation by your purple eyes and blood
Have to touch the material, person, or energy to get absorb other powers
Get purple eyes and purple blood by having this power (very noticeable)

name: Consequence Manipulation
description: What happens if you didn't study for a test and you  knew you are going to fail? This ability makes your cause "Not studying for a test", and changes the effect "getting an F" to "getting an A". If the consequence is negative like that, you or someone else will suffer another kind of way. This works on your decisions as well. This ability can even negate effects from anyone's actions or decisions. In short, nothing will happen no matter what anyone does.
summary: The ability to manipulate or negate the effects of your or anyone else's actions or decision.
strengths: Able to make positive consequences more enjoyable.
Able to change the effect of your actions.
weaknesses: Might suffer if you change a negative consequence to a positive consequence.
Only works if action or decision has been made.

name: Shadow Controlling
description: Control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people or move poeple if they have shadows on them). You can completely control them, making your range limitless. You are at your strongest at night and your weakest in the middle of the day. Your shadow DOES NOT have to be touching other shadows to control them.
summary: The ability to control all shadows and make them have essence (they are able to hold stuff or crush people)
strengths: Can crush people.
Can pick stuff up with an extra set of extendable hands (shadows).
Nearly invincible if you wrap your shadow around yourself.
weaknesses: Your shadow can never be an exact copy of you.
There has to be a little bit of light for anything to throw a shadow
Shadows can follow you around.

name: Power Of The Fruit
description: The user is able to gain different powers depending on what fruit he or she eats at the beginning of the day. Apples give superstrenght, oranges give invulnerability, bananas give elasticity, peaches give flight, pears give superspeed. Must be the real deal, no vitamin supplements or pills etc.
summary: The ability to have different powers depending on what fruit you eat at the beginning of the day
strengths: Good because different type of powers
Good at preventing scurvy
weaknesses: Might not have time to eat the fruits
Might not like the fruit

name: Body Armory
description: Using this power you can make every part of your body turn into a different weapon. You can turn your arm into a sword, your leg into a AK-47, your tongue into a Colt... Any limb and any weapon! BUT, the bullets must be made of something, like your bones, and when you shoot a bone bullet on someone it will take time until this bone grows back again. This ability is very useful, but you might kill yourself if you turn your head into a bazooka, so be careful.
summary: The ability to transform any part of your body into a weapon.
strengths: Infinite weapon choices, mutiple weapons at the same time
You are never unarmed.
Reload very fast
weaknesses: Some weapons are heavy.
You use part of your body as bullets (or arrows, or missiles... ) too.
You can kill yourself turning a specific part of your body into some weapons (like a bazooka).

name: Trait Replication
description: Lets say you envy one persons looks, another persons personality, another persons talent, and another persons skills & abilities. With this power, you can replicate all of those traits from other people. Also, for physical traits, you could take one persons say, face and body structure and another persons eye, hair, and skin color/tone.
summary: The ability to replicate the traits of other people
strengths: Replicate peronality traits, physical traits, and more
weaknesses: May end up looking or acting too similar to somebody else
Just traits, no superpowers

name: Realitive Alteration
description: Your enemy's attacks are turned into illusion and your thoughts or tricks and illusions become real attacks. This means that, while affected by this, even death becomes an illusion. This also means that your own thoughts can become attacks of a certain power level. Some powers can evade this and this does not always allow you to evade attacks or make them.
summary: The ability to change attacks and actions into illusions, and thoughts into attacks
strengths: Specialized version of Power of Imagination
Win a fight unharmed by standing still
Mastery of this lets your chance of succes increase.
weaknesses: Does not always work.
Some powers can evade you or attack beyond time.
No concentration/imagination

name: Sleep On It
description: You need to study for the big test tomorrow but you have to hit the hay? With this power, all you have to do is put the book you want to gain knowledge from under or on top of your pillow, even in your pillow case is fine, or by using the book as a pillow. If it is the kind of book you need to find the meaning of what the author is trying to say, you'll know it immediately. It'll practically be second nature.
summary: The ability to gain any knowledge and information a book can give by sleeping on it
strengths: Be an amazing cook and make food just like in the pictures
Detailed understanding of history and various famous texts
Learn skills, like operating and repairing from entire medical textbooks
weaknesses: Your head might get sore from sleeping on a book
Only works on books
Unlikely, but you might get a book with false information.

name: Martial Arts Master
description: You have the power to have an intimate knowledge of the inner workings of fighting styles and as such, you can learn them at an incredible pace. At the higher levels, you can mesh fighting styles together to become nigh undefeatable.
summary: The ability to learn and master martial arts far quicker than a normal person
strengths: Don't need lots of time to learn fighting styles
Can combine fighting styles at higher levels
If getting beaten, you can change to a different fighting style
weaknesses: Useless at long range
You have to fully concentrate to learn the martial arts
It is not instant mastery

name: Golden Feeling
description: Every time you're feeling happy, exited, love, or any old good feeling, jewels and sheets of gold will emerge from your body on your chest, back, legs, or along your arms. The process is painless, and your skin looks as though the wealth was never there at all once removed. The amount generated depends on the intensity of the positive feeling, and will be continual so long as you are experiencing it.
summary: The ability to exude gold and jewels from your body whenever you're experiancing positive emotions..
strengths: A positive person will get almost constant money.
You're safe from kidnappers looking to use you because you only create goild when happy.
It extream cases, the wealth can act as natural armor.
weaknesses: A negative person would not get much use out of this power.
A positive person will also have to scrape themselvs off regularly.

name: Super Contingency Effect
description: This ability is great for those who are those classic bumbler or failures. This ability can turn there actions of disaster to actions of success. The user is able to create a supernatural effect that makes their failed actions succeed. For example,say the user throws an object at someone, but it failed. His ability will create an effect to make it work. The effect could be like a burst of energy that bounces the object back the target. I said it would be supernatural not subtle.
summary: The ability to generate a positive effect to make any failed action succeed.
strengths: Make any action succeed
Learn how to weaponize it
It could manifest in many ways, even in the form of a temporary ability
weaknesses: Can be difficult to fail if you want to

name: Energy Blasts
description: Energy Blasts power alows you to create energy, blast energy, and create weapons with energy. For example: if your dad's boat hit a rock, you can lift the boat off the rock, AND patch up the hole. Or say a giant robot is wrecking the city: you can trip it, pin it down, then slice it down with an energy sword. Some techniques take practice.
summary: The ability to shoot energy from every part of your body
strengths: You can make weapons.
You can make energy shields.
weaknesses: You still need to train.
You can't always control it

name: Reflective Teleportation
description: With contact, the user can easily move from a mirror, a puddle of water, a tile or anything else that they can see themselves in to any other reflective surface in existence.
summary: The ability to teleport from any reflective surface to another reflective surface.
strengths: Can easily be almost anywhere
Water can be enough of a reflective surface to teleport through
weaknesses: Moving surfaces create problems
You may not know where you are
Some places lack reflective surfaces

name: Universal Bonding
description: The ability to merges with things such a animals, objects and elements, allowing wielder of power to enhance senses manipulate the elements and completely enhance body.
summary: The ability to merge and de-merge anything and everything to ones self
strengths: Insane speed and strength
Near indestructible
Can control any thing around you
weaknesses: Share the weaknesses of what you merged with
Body mutates to a hybrid of the merge
Uses allot of energy

name: Mitosis Manipulation
description: This power(also called Mitokinesis) gives the user total control over mitosis(the division and replication of cells). The user can speed up, slow down, concentrate, make efficient, halt, and even REVERSE mitosis in themselves or others. This allows the user to rapidly regenerate as well as harm others by undoing their mitosis or stop people who shapeshift by mitosis. You can even make mitosis more efficient to heal wounds in seconds or slow the aging process down.
summary: The ability to control the process by which cells divide and replicate.
strengths: Heal AND slow the aging process in yourself and others.
Easily wound a foe by reversing the multiplication of their cells to create whole new wounds.
Concentrate mitosis in one place for quick healing or repair.
weaknesses: If your foe has a biological manipulation power.
Most shapeshifters dont rely on mitosis.
In the beginning only basic manipulaation can be done.

name: Endermic Healing
description: This ability can cure any disease, illness, or injury, but your skin must come into contact with the injured person's skin. Also, it is involutary until you learn to control it
summary: The ability to heal someone through contact with the skin
strengths: Others are healed to perfect health
weaknesses: Does not work on self
Must be able to touch other person
Is involuntary at first

name: Shadow Speed
description: It is best used at night or in a forest where shadows or darkness are predominate. While in shadows/darkness you have the ability of super speed.
summary: The ability to able to move exceedingly fast within shadows
strengths: If your wearing black you're almost invisible
Can attack without being seen due to the stealth of the shadows/darkness
Great move for ninjas (let's face it who doesn't like ninjas)
weaknesses: Does not work in light, only in shadows

name: Omnistrength
description: You make the gods look like little girl guides. You'll be the strongest person alive and break the unbreakable. This power does not have any effects on how much damage you can withstand. So, if you try to flick steel, it will break, but you will break a nail and feel pain. To deal with your superior muscle, your skin is harder and is very difficult to pierce (you still feel pain). Your bones can also withstand the pressure of heavy lifting
summary: The ability to be the strongest person alive
strengths: Stronger than an army of Kryptonians
A bullet to the face wouldn't kill you
You'll never break a bone
weaknesses: If you get internal injuries, you can't go into surgery
You still feel pain
More with this power (evenly strong) or One Upmanship-esque abilities (they are stronger)

name: Card Stack Abilities: Queen
description: Access the power of the elemental spirit of space in order to completely control the third dimension. Create wormholes out of thin air and alter the space around an object to make it explode or compress into an atom. Create barriers out of space or warp to a different area to avoid an attack. Basically anything that involves space, you have control over it.
summary: The ability to completely control space
strengths: The ability to warp anywhere you want.
Absolute control over space.
Make your enemies compress or explode with a single thought.
weaknesses: Accidentally destroying everything around you because of a space distortion
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Kinetic Deflection
description: Your body is surrounded with an impenetrable force field. When kinetic force is exerted onto you, say a bullet shot at you, the force field absorbs that exerted force energy & deflects it with a greater kinetic force. So that bullet shot at you bounces off you & shot another way with greater momentum. Making it a super bullet. This is also applied to attacks. Sending the assailant flying back.
summary: The ability to create impenetrable force field that deflects any exerted kinetic force with greater power
strengths: Nigh invunerable
weaknesses: Your exerted force is not amplified

name: Energy Armor
description: You can create a field of energy around yourself which forms into different kinds of armor, any kind of weapon, or an animal shape around you. If you make a bird shape, then you can fly, and if you're injured badly then the energy will form a shield around you that will heal you. The armor is almost completely invulnerable, and while you're in it then your mind will come out of your body and you will control the armor.
summary: The ability to create armor, weapons, and other things out of pure energy around yourself
strengths: You can heal while in the armor
The armor and weapons almost impenetrable/ unbreakable
You can gain the ability of whatever you are, so if you take a bird form you can fly.
weaknesses: YOU get an out-of-body experience so when you go back it feels weird
THe problem is the one thing that can break it
Sometimes you can't control it from turning on

name: Starlight Hero
description: When activated, you acquire the abilities to travel at incredible speeds and blast enemies with rays of light. You can also intensify your strength by absorbing heat and various types of radiations, such as UV rays (ultraviolet rays), thermal, solar, etc. The more radiation you absorb the more you grow in strength, speed, power, and durability alike. Not only is this power offensive but also defensive; you can shield yourself and others with a starlight shield.
summary: The ability to produce luminous energy blasts of plasma and augment your strength by absorbing heat and radiation.
strengths: Explode into a nova and quickly draw yourself back together.
Travel at lightspeed and send enemies packing with "nova punches"
Cannot gain cancer from radiation.
weaknesses: Nova explosions around civilians. (need I say more? )

name: Persuasion
description: You may make any living thing believe what you say. You may make them do what you tell them, however, you may not interfere with free will or true love.
summary: The ability to persuade a living thing to believe whatever you tell them
strengths: They'll believe anything you say!
weaknesses: You must be either looking them in the eye or touching them to persuade them.

name: 10x Thinking Speed
description: You can think ten times faster than you do now. So, what takes you one minute to think about now will be thought through in six seconds. You will not necessarily reach better conclusions, but you'll get there faster.
summary: The ability to think 10 times faster than normal
strengths: Outsmart your enemies!
Beat the calculator!
weaknesses: You might come across as a besserwisser...

name: Mnemonic Telekinesis
description: This ability lets you gain the telekinetic powers of any fictional character who has it, from TV, books, and movies. You immediately gain their power when you think of them, and have it permanently, although it can be suppressed at will, but never lost. If you have a photographic memory, and thus recall the character and his/her abilities easily, you will gain the power more easily as a result. You can even create power combinations(Johnny Drake/Sylar, Jean Grey/Grant Borrows, etc.).
summary: The ability to have telekinetic powers through memories of characters from tv, movies, and books who have it
strengths: Having a photographic memory allows easy access and use of this ability
Have the same level of control as the character(s) you think of
A user cannot be harmed by their own power, and can also choose to pass immunity to others
weaknesses: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands
You cannot gain the powers of someone you don't remember clearly

name: Lawless
description: Laws are very pesky things. This power is like a law-begone. It allows you to break ANY law, without facing any consequences. Depending on what kind of law you're breaking, this power will act in different ways. Saying you are robbing a store. This might erase the memories of your face or simply blur your image while commiting the crime. But this doesn't stop there. You can also break physical laws, like gravity and friction. If you are daring, you might go as far as breaking the universal laws.
summary: The ability to break any law, free of consequences.
strengths: Never, ever get in trouble.
Can consciously choose which law you want to break.
weaknesses: You never know how exactly this power might save you from the consequences

name: Second Thoughts
description: Let's say you were shot by a gun, still awake, and you just want to go back to that last moment and change it! It's sort of like time travel only more limited. You cannot go back thousands of years in the past to change some large event, only a minute is your limit. You will be able to do the same fight with someone countless times, memorizing their every move, feeling no pain after traveling back, eventually winning. A TV villain weakling did this on Batman and won, making a fool of him.
summary: The ability to take back a previous action.
strengths: Eventually win almost every fight.
Even the best fall eventually
You are the only one with knowledge of this displacement.
weaknesses: You cannot perform this ability if you die, so avoid explosions.
If a fight is inevitable no matter what you do , you'll always lose.
The shame of having to do a fight hundreds of times to win it.

name: Superhuman Awareness
description: Falling. Tripping. Missing the last step on the stairs. Missing the first step on the stairs. Superhuman Awareness ensures that its holder never has to worry about these things. A person with it can sense where everything around them is, and how far away it is. This grants them an amazing sense of balance, extraordinary accuracy (judging distances), and a good idea of all weapons and exits. With time, this ability can sense weaknesses. However, this ability needs at least a glance at the area.
summary: The ability to be perfectly aware of your surroundings
strengths: Enhanced accuracy (accurate distance judging)
Enhanced balance (know just how much to lean)
A good idea of where the exit is
weaknesses: Requires at least a glance at the area
No other superhuman attributes
Might not be able to dodge in time still

name: Happenchance
description: This power increases the odds of something happening by 50%. With this power, you can have limited control over luck and chance. However, you can only use this power ONCE PER DAY. Using this power does not guarantee that the perceived event will happen, but increases the chance of it happening by a significant amount.
summary: The ability to make the odds of something happening a lot greater.
strengths: Increases the chance that certain things will happen.
This is limited tychokinesis.
This power is very controllable and reversible.
weaknesses: You can only use it once per day.
No guarantee that the perceived event will happen.
Results may vary*

name: Interruption Inducement
description: This ability allows a user induce interruptions. Example, if you were about to be blasted by someone's energy attack, this ability can interrupt that by any means necessary before the attack is made, may it be a tree falling on the attacker or reality changing. The inducement can change into materializing when needed. This is a passive ability most of the time, but if you master it, you have a good chance to activate it when you focus.
summary: The ability to induce, cause, or materialize anything with the purpose to interrupt anything.
strengths: Interrupt any attack
Interrupt any process or progress
Interrupt any unwanted conversation
weaknesses: Might be interrupted by your own ability at times, if you don't master it.

name: Mind Control Immunity
description: With this power, you are immune to any and all forms of mind control, provided they are not mundane in nature. You are not, however, immune to hypnosis, persuasion or temptation, at least as long as they are not superhuman in nature (the power of persuasion, for instance, would count as mind control). However, mundane forms of mind control still work, so you must remain wary of such things.
summary: The ability to be immune to all forms of non-mundane mind control.
strengths: Immunity to mind control.
Complements Selective Temptation Immunity perfectly.
Passive.
weaknesses: Only works against mind control.
Only works if the form of mind control is superpower or magic based.
Like all powers, this can be compromised in various ways, so do not rely on it entirely.

name: Likeness Control
description: This powers user is able to control any likenesses of themselves such as shadows, reflections, pictures, live video etc. Independently from their true body by locking "eyes" with it. These likenesses can interact fully with the likenesses of alike thing to affect them, such as the user's shadow strangling another man's shadow resulting in the other man's death. Only one likeness may be controlled like this at a time. After you give up control, the likenesses go back to their normal places.
summary: The ability to control your own likenesses.
strengths: Attack from infinate range so long as you have something depicting your target and you.
Confuse people by making a picture move, or you in a video do something different.
Statues of yourself can be controled in this manner.
weaknesses: You must lock eyes, or a rough approzimation of where they would be, with a likeness to control it.
Likenesses in picture and video will only be able to affect things that are on screen with them.
A likeness has to be recognizable you in order for you to take control of it. No stick figures.

name: Superhuman Ingenuity
description: What would you do if stuck in a kitchen with heat-seeking death robots? Well, if you had Superhuman Ingenuity, you would light some paper, stick it to the robots with fridge magnets, and leave. People with this ability can see the connections between objects in a subconscious way. So in a situation, they can combine an aerosol and a lighter(a torch), or a sock and bar of soap(a flail), or cayenne pepper, vinegar, and baking soda(some tear gas)without even thinking. MacGyver would be proud.
summary: The ability to have superhuman skill in devising solutions to problems
strengths: Never be at a loss
Everything is a weapon
Impress people by fixing their car with a dozen eggs
weaknesses: No other superhuman attributes
May be bugged by needy people
May be tempted to use abilities for mischief

name: Deus Ex Machina
description: "God from the machine" is what it means. When you're trapped in an inescapable dangerous situation, you just yell out "Deus ex machina" & a person or thing will appear out of nowhere & help you out. In simple terms, its a "get out of jail free card"
summary: The ability to produce a "miracle" to get you out of an impossible situation
strengths: A reality bending power that gets you out of trouble
weaknesses: Must yell out "Deus ex machina" to work

name: One Man Army
description: You'll have the mind of a hardened soldier, the brain of a army technician,the body of a perfect soldier. And with your vast combat skills and creativity you would be able to take down multiple opponents with your knowledge on fighting, creating weapons, defusing bombs, creating bombs and weapons out of simple materials, tactics, pyschology. The army always develops so anything new will instantly be yours. You also have a rank of 5 star general, so you will have the perks they get.
summary: The ability to preform many tasks and have the abilities, knowledge and the minds of army personnel
strengths: Make weapons out of practically anything
Become a great ally
weaknesses: Become a great foe

name: Ability Resistance Adaptation
description: With this ability, you adapt from superpowers used against you. For example, if someone with Pyrokinesis hit you with flame, it would increase your resistance to it. Being attacked again would make you invulnerable to that attack. If your foe decided to attack you a third time, your body would adapt to using it as a fuel, and instead absorb the attack, giving you power and energy. Using it against you again would allow you to harness that ability to an extent.
summary: The ability to adapt to super-powers used against you.
strengths: Adapt to super-powers used against you.
For each time it is used against you, you adapt to that ability. The adaptations are below.
1. Resistance. 2. Invulnerability. 3. Absorption. 4. Ability to harness the superpower.
weaknesses: No effect if the ability used on you is beneficial.
You only gain the adaptation after you've been struck.
You can still be harmed if knocked out in the first 2 strikes.

name: Shadowy Retreat
description: With this ability, when engulfed in darkness, you have the ability to vanish, and reappear nearby in perfect condition. This eliminates any harm you may have taken, or any illnesses you may have. It does not, however, have the ability to restore broken or lost bones.
summary: The ability to jump into the shadows to completely restore your condition.
strengths: The shadows are now your friend. Hurray :)
weaknesses: Being badly injured on a sunny day. :(

name: Mind Reader
description: With this ability, you can read others' thoughts.  Anything the person is immediately thinking is accessible to you.
summary: The ability to know what other people are thinking.
strengths: Know what people's true intentions are
Raid the casinos!
Like Mel Gibson, you can potentially bang Helen Hunt
weaknesses: Sometimes, ignorance is bliss
You might read someone's thoughts and ruin the plot to a good movie
Revealing secrets you didn't want to know about

name: Symbiotic Armor
description: The symbiotic armor has the ability to give information as well as suggestions to the person who is wearing it. Another feature of this armor is that when the user of this armor is in danger, the armor will automatically form around the user in armor-mode. The armor also has the ability to self regenerate and repair itself.
summary: The ability to wear a symbiotic armor that gives the wearer information as well as suggestions
strengths: Symbiotic in nature
Can't die easily
Armor is self regenerating
weaknesses: No superhuman capabilities

name: Create Cosmic Gizmo
description: With this power, you could hold together with rubber bands an egg beater and a box knife and control gravity. This power will give your gizmos control or manipulation powers. Gizmos can also have powers like time travel, force field, teleportation, quantum intangibility or any similar powers. Your gizmo must have one moving part and you must be turning this part to make the gizmo work. The Imagination Crusher power will stop this power. Technology control powers won't work on any gizmo you make.
summary: The ability to create cosmic objects that only work for you and have certain powers.
strengths: Gadgets that only work for you and are unaffected by technology control powers.
Control the forces of the universe with things found in your home.
weaknesses: The Imagination Crusher power.
If you can't think like a child, this power may not work.
Someone who could paralyze you.

name: Orb
description: It is called orbing. You can orb out of the room or across the world. You can stand in front of a book, hold out your hand and say "book" and tada! It's in your hand.
summary: The ability to teleport in a flash of blue sparkles. You can also teleport items toward you.
strengths: Go almost anywhere.
Get things that are out of reach.
Doesn't waste time with walking.
weaknesses: Anti-Orb spell will cancel out the effect.
Needs time to master.

name: Speed Of Thought
description: A person with this power can go at the speed of thought. The faster you think the faster you can go. If this is attempted you can go as fast and maybe even faster than baseballs and cars since you can process their speed in your head. Basically if you can see an object/know where it is you can go as fast or faster than it since your thoughts can process where it is meaning that your thoughts are faster than said object/person.
summary: The ability to go as fast as you can process information
strengths: The faster you think the faster you are
Even if you can't think very fast this still makes you faster than normal
You can practice mental training to increase your speed
weaknesses: Not as fast as speed of light(unless you can think that fast)
If someone/thing moves faster than you can think such as a bullet

name: Aura Powers
description: Everybody has an aura surrounding them, this ability allows you to use it as a blast of energy and the ability to heal others, and to float/fly by repelling the aura around you (kinda like a magnet repels like poles). Also, you can use it as a form of a weak telekinetic attack by repelling the person's aura hard enough.
summary: The ability to use your human aura as energy to attack and/or heal others.
strengths: The blast of energy can create heat or have charecteristics of fire.
The blast of energy can also freeze things or have characteristics of a freezing power.
You can heal people and yourself quickly by "healing the aura." Also, you can fly by repelling auras
weaknesses: It's more for the "hero" type, so if you use your power for evil you might not like it.
You cannot instantly heal someone. It takes about a half hour to completely heal someone,

name: Mirror Portals
description:
In the same style as using Floo powder to get from fireplace to fireplace in Harry Potter, this power allows you to enter mirrors and teleport instantly into another mirror of your choice. 
Training would allow you to use less and less reflective surfaces; windows, puddles, TV screens, pianos, the possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to use mirrors as portals to get to other mirrors
strengths: You can easily get away from your foes, especially if you always carry a waist-size mirror with you.
If you only put your eye through the mirror, you can spy on others.
You can build a secret warehouse that is only accessible with a mirror.
weaknesses: Mirrors are usually only found in bathrooms.
The mirror has to be big enough for you to fit through; it better not break!
For it to be really useful you'll have to carry a heavy mirror around with you.

name: Cold Absorption
description: Though previously thought to be a violation of the laws of physics, one with this ability can literally absorb cold. If the particles in the air move slow enough that they only produce a temperature less than 70 degrees Fahrenheit, they can be absorbed into the body with no harm to the user. This makes room for warmer particles in the air (thus raising the temperature). In addition, the cold may be released at will as blasts of frigid "cold energy".
summary: The ability to absorb cold from surroundings and unleash absorbed cold
strengths: Violate one of the laws of physics!
Good to raise the temperature in a cold place.
Release absorbed cold (radiating it from the skin, through a touch, or through Freezing Breath)
weaknesses: Violate one of the laws of physics (Poor eggheads will go crazy trying to figure out how it's done)
Absorb too much, and lower-leves users could freeze.
Temperature manipulators can limit how much cold you have to absorb

name: Conditional Ability Bestowal
description: This ability is certainly a boon. By giving someone superhuman abilities with this power, they in turn give you their undying allegiance (whether they want to or not). This can be used to make your power-bestowing finally do some work for you, instead of just letting all the other superhumans have all the fun.
summary: The ability to grant abilities, with the consequence that ability-granted individuals fall under your control
strengths: People get powers
People who get their powers from you also become loyal to you
The effect can be reversed (and redone if you regret the reversal)
weaknesses: Cannot work on already-superpowered beings
If untrained, can't decide what powers they get
Sometimes requires contact

name: Reflective Invisibility
description: This is a very interesting power to have. A person can turn themselves invisible, either partially or completely, by touching a mirror. The light around the person will be absorbed into their reflection, turning it into a shadow, but their real body will disappear. The person can still interact normally with objects, but people won't know they are there until the power is deactivated. This form of invisibility is exactly like Peter Petrelli's, but sound and thermal detection are impossible.
summary: The ability to turn yourself invisible by touching a mirror
strengths: Sneak up on enemies totally undetected!!
Works both day and night!
Scare people with a sinister shadow reflection!
weaknesses: Cannot work with broken mirrors or pocket mirrors.
Can be weakened by both sunlight, and by electricity over 200 volts.
You are not invisible to others who have this power, or any light-based power.

name: Willpower Strength
description: With this ability, you can gain infinite amounts of strength by will. The only limit to this power is this user's willpower. You can slap over trucks, put craters in steel, and possibly even move buildings.
summary: The ability to summon enormous amounts of strength by will
strengths: There's no limit to your strength
Top scores in P. E.
Great if you are strong willed
weaknesses: You may be dangerous in fights, could possibly kill someone
If your will isn't strong, the ability will be powerful, but won't reach full potential
People may wonder how you can lift objects hundreds of times your body weight

name: Memory Control
description: You can steal and erase other people's memories. You can also recall any memory perfectly and never misremember. It works to a range of 4 feet away. You can steal others' memories to get whatever information others have and review their memories instantly
summary: The ability to steal and erase other people's memories
strengths: You can make people forget themselves and you
You can tell when people are trying to tell you bull**** stories to you or lie
If the other person has had sex, it's like free porn
weaknesses: Cameras will still remember you
If your girlfriend forgets you, it'll be really hard to get her in the sack
You might find memories you wish you hadn't

name: Tactile Power Counteraction
description: This is an extremely powerful form of immunity. A person can match, and thus nullify, any offensive power an enemy uses against them, such as pyrokinesis. If the enemy uses it on you, the moment you touch them, you will absorb the part of that person's power which grants them immunity, and thus be immune yourself.
summary: The ability to build immunity to an attack by absorbing the enemy's power through physical contact
strengths: Once you absorb a person's power immunity, it is permanent!
Catch a foe off guard by faking your injury or death!
They cannot feel the absorption, and skin-to-skin contact isn't always necessary.
weaknesses: This is a 'tactile' ability: You ALWAYS need to physically touch your opponent to activate it

name: Metamorphic
description: When activated by will, the user becomes a 'pupa' but does not physically change. However they are restricted in movement and are extremely vulnerable before they enter the 'cocoon' stage. The user is completely immobile until they become an 'adult'. Adult stage brings a massive increase in agility and attack power, and a modest increase in defensive abilities. The user evolves faster when near enemies. The buffs last for two days. Metamorphing can take up to one full week at its slowest.
summary: The ability to increase combat abilities through metamorphisis
strengths: Long wait, but has a massive payoff in the end
Buffs don't go away for two full days and the cycle can be repeated immediately
weaknesses: Faster evolution requires some risk
Completely helpless until adult stage is reached

name: Ability Manifestation Control
description: This ability allows one to control their ability in the way of how it emerges. There are many methods and ways an ability could manifest itself like through physical mutation, magic, interaction with a object/technology, or even through in enhancements. This ability makes the user summon their power through any of those methods or others. Since there are many methods, many abilities will be different. There is a time limit since you can only use one manifested ability at a time.
summary: The ability to manipulate how one's abilities manifest.
strengths: Access new abilities through different methods.
Having an adaption ability would be useful
weaknesses: Limited time use for each abiltiy
If you use the same method to manifest an ability, you only get the same ability as before.

name: Intermolecular Force Control
description: You can control how strongly or weakly matter clings to other matter. This ability isn't the ability to rearrange, destroy or create atoms and molecules. This is the ability to change the adhesion between objects. You could use this power on a fast running villain and all they'll do is run in place. You could climb up a wall made of frictionless material. You can keep a machine gun from firing or 'glue' someone's hands together. This power only works on solid matter.
summary: The ability to control the strength by which matter clings to matter.
strengths: Guns or any thrown weapons are rendered useless against you.
You can make the most uneven surface slicker than ice.
You can 'glue' any solid object to the ground or a wall.
weaknesses: Foes not made of solid matter.
Energy weapons.

name: Black Hole Breath
description: With this ability, you can suck in any living matter and absorb its talent, ability, or power.
summary: The ability to suck in any living matter and absorb its talent, ability, or power.
strengths: Any power you find!
weaknesses: None

name: Potential Channeling
description: This ability allows one to turn one's full potential into a form of powerful energy and infuse it to one part of their body, items, other people,  and abilities. This will make them very powerful and even destructive.
summary: The ability to channel one's full potential into anything else.
strengths: Make your physical form more powerful
Make items, other people, and abilities more powerful
weaknesses: Usage can be draining.

name: Advanced Dimensional Control
description: By absorbing energy from large temporal rifts, the user of universal dimensional control can create a dimension which he or she can control to an extent and when finished, destroy it. Also they have the Ability to move from any dimension at will. Unforutunaly; this leads to self-inflicted harm which can lead to fatal wounds and death due to the required energies to create a parallel dimension. Also the user cannot create life forms using this power or send items from one dimension to another.
summary: The ability to create, control and destroy parallel Dimensions
strengths: You can create your own Parallel dimension to control like a god.
You may change any aspect of it at will and move to different dimensions.
And then destroy any you have made, thus returning to the Main dimension.
weaknesses: The user can die from creating Parallel dimensions.
Life or new elements or Compounds cannot be made using the Parallel dimensions
And Temporal energy is required for one to be created; something the user does not have.

name: Blue Pyrokinesis
description: Blue flames are hotter than red flames. A person with this power can create and manipulate blue flames. Aside from the usual perks of pyrokinesis this ability also gives you the required secondary powers to not burn yourself with this ability.
summary: The ability to create and control blue flames
strengths: Much hotter than red flames
You have the required secondary powers
It looks way cooler than red or yellow flames(in my opinion)
weaknesses: It is hotter so unless you are good at using it you might burn others

name: Optical Reality Negation
description: With this power, one has the ability to negate/destroy reality within their line of sight. This power can be used to destroy specific parts of an object or the entire structure in general. You can also bounce your power's optical aspect off of reflective surfaces.
summary: The ability to destroy anything that is within your line of sight.
strengths: You can easily win staredowns.
You are dangerous around mirrors.
Anything you see is an easy target.
weaknesses: You are limited by the range of your sight.
Any obscured object can not be destroyed.
You will become mentally exhausted after over use.

name: Fireproof Body
description: Your body can't get burned, suffer damage or feel pain from fire, radiations and heat. Excessive heat and smoke don't bother you. You have the upper hand against most fire manipulators, since they tend to rely more on their abilities, neglecting physical training. This power can be used offensively by throwing burning objects and fire breathing (the art, not the power) since you don't have the limitations that every fire breather has. On the other hand, your clothes can still be damaged.
summary: The ability to be invulnerable to fire, heat and radiations.
strengths: You will survive in the near future when heatwaves will be commonplace.
You can easily escape a fire and protect people from severe harm.
You can also use fire to attack.
weaknesses: Your clothes may be damaged or you may end up being naked after a fire.
Electricity can't burn you but you can get shocked.

name: Upgrader
description: Whatever you touch when saying "upgrade" (doesn't have to be loud) instantly advances the item to a more modern version as it would be 100 years in the future (doesn't include people or animals). Can work on people when they are using a superpower which upgrades the power.
summary: The ability to upgrade anything you touch.
strengths: Futuristic
Impress your friends
Easy to control
weaknesses: Have to say "upgrade"

name: Imperceptibility
description: Also called Incorporeality, this is the ability to psychically avoid being detected by any of the five conventional senses (sight, touch, hearing, smell, taste). This allows the user to access Invisibility (inability to be seen), Intangibility (inability to be touched, also referred to as Phasing), Inaudibility (inability to be heard), Inodorosity (inability to be smelled) and Inodorosity (inability to be tasted). And usually, the user can choose whether to be partially or entirely undetected.
summary: The ability to evade all of the five senses
strengths: Invisibility
Intangibility
Inaudibility and Inodorosity
weaknesses: Insipidity (how often will a superhuman come along and try to taste you? )
Not imperceptible to those with ESP
If you have to choose between being entirely perceptible and entirely imperceptible

name: Lightning
description:
A person with Lightning is a living dynamo. Their abilities include:
*Generating lightning bolts
*Recharging appliances
*Producing an EMP
*Releasing a massive electric shockwave
summary: The ability to produce electricity
strengths: Recharge your iPod whenever
Defy authority
Protect what you love with little effort
weaknesses: Still affected by electricity
If you're wet, your bolts will shock you
Lightning is drawn to metal

name: Plasma Heart
description: Your heart has been replaced with an alien heart that pumps plasma-charged blood around your body. As a result of this, you can phase the plasma through your veins to create plasma blasts, beams or shields. It also allows the electric energy in the plasma to escape and let you glide when jumping, like an electromagnetic pulse.
summary: The ability to generate plasma shields, beams and orbs
strengths: Plasma powers
Gliding when jumping from great height
Improved healing factor
weaknesses: Dangerous when fired at people, it can cause burns or worse.
Time is needed to recharge after expelling large amounts of plasma
Alien hearts can cause side effects

name: Power Bestowed By Intelligence
description: The user will gain an ability depending on what their intelligence is. For example, spatial intelligence would give the user a spatial- based ability. Another example is if they had naturalist intelligence, they would be able to get a nature- based ability.
summary: The ability to gain a power depending on what is your strongest intelligence. (Multiple Intelligence Theory)
strengths: Have a power that matches your intelligence.
weaknesses: Any weakness that power has.

name: Firefox & Thunderbird
description: The person with this power is able to call upon either the fire spirit Firefox or the thunder spirit Thunderbird. However, the user cannot use both spirits at the same time. The basic form of this power is that the user can use the powers associated with the spirit of fire or thunder. The ultimate form is that the user can transform into the element spirit themselves.
summary: The ability to use the fire spirit, Firefox and the thunder spirit, Thunderbird
strengths: Can transform into the animal spirit of fire or thunder
Can control fire
Can control thunder/ lightning
weaknesses: Cannot use to power simultaneously
Powerful magic users can disable power with powerful spells

name: Viral Blast
description: Power from the black arts. The user can throw viral energy blasts from his hands. When the blast touches a target, he becomes sick and dies within 3 hours if not healed by a healing power or magic. If the target has powers, he can resist up to 6 hours, but s/he also dies if not healed by healing powers or by magic.
summary: The ability to throw a viral energy blast that slowly kills
strengths: Kills pretty much everything in a sick way
User may choose the potency of the poison in his blasts
It could wear down/defeat stronger opponents
weaknesses: You are not immune so if it's reflected, you die
May only fire up to 50 ft
Drains the user's life force if used too often in a short period

name: Arm Shield
description: This power can help with defence and attack when it comes to battling other people as a extra ability the shield can't be destroyed.
summary: The ability to abiliy to create a shield from your arms
strengths: Improves defence
Can be used for attacking
Is indestructible
weaknesses: Only used on your arms

name: Jack
description: Blatantly steal superpowers, positions of power, skills, items, significant others. Someone's got a better power than you? A better car? A better life? Jack'em. Look them in the eye and say Jack, tell them what you are taking and it can all be yours. You're not only rewriting history, you're remaking reality.
summary: The ability to jack anyone for powers, position, IQ, skills or significant others.
strengths: Jack superpowers, IQ, skills, jobs instantly. IQ and skills are yours forever.
Possessions such as weapons, property, vehicles, armor, degrees, etc.
You can even Jack significant others, girlfriends, boyfriends, friends and family
weaknesses: Powered abilities and jobs supplant each other. Must be sure you want to lose what you have.
IQ and skills are instantly learned giving you a killer headache each time you Jack someone
Each thing must belong to someone before you Jack it. Cannot jack human senses.

name: Solar Manipulation
description: With this ability, you are able to manipulate and use solar energy, a common resource. You can store it for up to 24 hours, and unleash it in the form of a concentrated beam, or a blast around the radius of your body. Another use for this ability would be to supercharge solar-powered devices, for example, a solar panel. This solar energy can also be used as a source of heat in cold areas. Fortunately, you can determine the amount of solar power you can release, ranging from harmless to fatal.
summary: The ability to manipulate and use solar energy.
strengths: Supercharge solar-powered objects.
Release solar energy in concentrated beams, or blasts which are released in your radius.
You may use the solar power as a source of heat, and control the amount of solar energy you release.
weaknesses: You may accidentally release a harmful amount of solar power.
All solar energy that you can't maintain/store is instantly released around you.

name: Warp Speed
description: One with this ability can run so fast, that they jump from this dimension or time, to another. You can jump from here to the past, to the future or to an alternate reality (and then jump back). Too bad, you can't use this power for regular superspeed (you automatically accelerate to warp speed).
summary: The ability to run with such great speed that one jumps from this dimension/time to another
strengths: Run incredibly fast
Jump into different dimensions
Jumpt into different times
weaknesses: Can only use this power for travel (unless you maybe smack your enemy on the way out)
Have to have enough room to move (if you don't, you'll bump into stuff before you can warp)
People who can travel to different dimensions can try to follow you

name: Super Dexterity
description: Super Dexterity allows one to have dexterity at superhuman levels. This means they can hold up to 8 objects in just one hand, mimic anyone's handwriting, even write two different people's handwriting at the same time, even by using two pens with the same hand. It also allows pandexterity, which includes being able to write with not only your right and left hand but also your feet, your mouth, even between your eyelids and stomach area. Not to be confused with super strength.
summary: The ability to increase your dexterity to superhuman levels.
strengths: You can hold multiple objects in just one hand.
Pandexterity is just plain cool
You can mimic anyone's handwriting
weaknesses: Not to be mistaken with super strength

name: Object Mimicry
description: The user of this power is able to take on the properties of any object the touch and gain whatever abilities that come with the object they have touched. For example, if you touch a tyre you become rubbery and bouncy in nature due to the rubber. The user's ability to mimic the object is dependent on how much of the object is present.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of any object the user touches
strengths: Objects around posses certain different qualities giving different types of power
There are always objects around that can be mimicked
weaknesses: Cannot mimic two objects at the same time
How long and how good you can mimic abilities depends on how much of the object is present

name: Supreme Water Elementalist
description: You can manipulate water, or generate it from your body. You are always Hydrated, and can turn into a body of liquid to seep in through tiny cracks or holes in walls or floors. You can summon rogue waves with your mind. You can absorb water from anything wet. You can turn into ice, as well as into a Jelly consistency (however if you're in cold regions and turn into ice, it will take almost forever to move). You can surf with your bare feet and can also walk on water.
summary: The ability to possess every aspect of water and liquid
strengths: No surfboards or wipeouts anymore
You can last 500 times in the desert than a camel.
You can sense vibrations miles away
weaknesses: You might have overactive sweat glans
You have a hard time moving in cold regions if you choose to turn in water
The far away vibrations can disturb your sleeping at night

name: Electrical Mimicry
description: Your flesh and blood body is relatively limited. Electricity is much less so. Electrical Mimicry allows you to transform into a human-shaped lightning bolt that can travel through electrical wires, fly, emit bright light, and electrocute things.
summary: The ability to turn your body into electricity
strengths: Fly
Able to go many places you normally couldn't
Able to use electricity to heal your lightning body
weaknesses: Water causes unconsciousness or death
Magnetism is your new gravity
Unable to safely touch people in lightning form

name: Aerokinesis
description: A person with Aerokinesis has control over the air in their immediate area. They can generate 200 mph gusts and make 50 yard air-boosted leaps. Even air pressure is not outside their range. They can make it greater and crush things, or decrease it so they can do things with less air resistance (i.e. run fast).
summary: The ability to manipulate air and other gases
strengths: Very versatile
Not easy to fight against
Allows user to go to many inaccessible places
weaknesses: Cannot fly
Cannot create air/gases
Cannot destroy air/gases

name: Alchemy
description: You can alter the natural elements, changing them from one substance into another.  Scientists have studied the science of "alchemy" for years, attempting to transmute iron into gold, or other elements into gold.  Now you can!  Remember chemistry?  You can change any element into another element with no thinking involved!
summary: The ability to change matter into other forms of matter, such as sand into gold.
strengths: Become rich by changing things into gold, silver, platinum, etc.
Pimp your ride--everything chrome!
weaknesses: Too much gold in the world reduces its value.
If your power becomes public, you will probably need protection

name: Existence Displacement
description: The ability to cause your physical being or the physical being of anyone or anything else to be removed from the plane of existence, and then to be able to bring it back, at will.
summary: The ability to blink yourself or anything else solid in and out of existence.
strengths: You can dodge ANYTHING
Ability to leave the room during awkward moments
weaknesses: Can only keep them out of existence for a short time until the ability is developed
You can only remove a single thing at a time, any more and the other one is lost forever
Can only remove from existence if you know the exact location in the universe of where a thing is

name: Story Power
description: Great to use with story teller power. Basically if you read the story, and you have the general idea of how the power is used, you can copy it.
summary: The ability to recreate a power from any story you have ever read.
strengths: Man that's alot of options!
Great for people who like to read
Having the book with the story increases the powers copied from that story
weaknesses: Powers have their weaknesses.
Read, read, read

name: Concept Beam
description: Here is an example. The user would like to use the concept of order. They will be able to turn that concept into energy and that energy is released into a beam. That beam then becomes an Order Beam. When it hits something, it makes it more predictable or organized. There are many other concepts and ideas that can be used as well.
summary: The ability to turn any concept or idea into an energy beam that applies that concept to a certain extent.
strengths: Powerful energy beam.
weaknesses: The effects don't last long.

name: Telepsychic Wings
description: You can manifest telekinetic razor-sharp wings from your back composed of pure mental energy which spans about sixteen feet from wingtip to wingtip at its highest intensity. You can fly anywhere undetected too, very difficult to track, even by very powerful telepaths. Those wings can fire Psychic flechettes which are able to stun or kill.
summary: The ability to sprout telekinetic razor-sharp wings of pure mental energy.
strengths: You might become a divine psychic.
weaknesses: Those wings will eventually wear off in about 576 hours.

name: Tactile Vector Telekinesis
description: This form of telekinesis is extremely rare. You can control objects with telekinetic vectors that are first created by physical contact with the object. It's vastly useful in the hands of experts, and connections between the mind and a desired object take no more than three seconds. There's an unlimited time frame of control, and you can maintain or terminate it at will. A side effect is pale amber fire seen around objects moving at high speed due to molecular control, a basis for this power.
summary: The ability to create psychic energy appendages to control objects, by first touching that object
strengths: Move huge objects of immense weight with ease, and fly by riding long projectiles like snowboards!!
You cannot be harmed by the psionic fire created at advanced control levels
Despite being a 'tactile' ability, this form is as powerful as Jean Grey's telekinesis!!
weaknesses: Takes time to learn to control
A very dangerous power in the wrong hands!
Despite limitless power time, you always need to touch an object before it can be controlled

name: Upgrade
description: This power can only be used once for every year you have been alive each day. I. E. If you are 15 you can use it 15 times each day until you turn 16. You can upgrade things together but not apart and not everything will come out cool if you do,like a pencil-fridge would not be very useful. Broken stuff will be fixed
summary: The ability to make any item one step better than it is
strengths: Can turn the "rest" into the "best"
Can upgrade things together
Could eventually become cyborg
weaknesses: Can't split them back apart (might be a bad idea to combine people)
People will wonder how you traded your ps1 for a ps3
Limmited number of uses

name: Most Wanted Superpower
description: The user always has the most wanted superpower on this website, no matter what it is. And if the most wanted superpower changes, then the user loses the previous one, and gains the current most wanted superpower. The amount of control depends on the user and the superpower.
summary: The ability to always have the most wanted superpower on this website
strengths: Most wanted superpowers are awesome
weaknesses: User loses the previous power if the most wanted superpower changes

name: Animal Empathy
description: Think of it this way, you wanna be like spider-man without having to be bitten by a radioactive spider. Now you can by being empathic to spiders. But it get's better. You can combine species. Grow limbs with lizard power, have chameleon sight. Have radar sense of a dolphin. Almost anything is possible with this power. You just have to know about the animal and then bam! You can use its power.
summary: The ability to use traits from animals
strengths: A lot of potential
Can use any animal. Even the extinct ones.
Combine powers (spider's eyes with chameleon sight), had one to sneak up on.
weaknesses: You can't turn into the animal.
You can't use mythical creature's power because they don't exist.
You might have to do a lot of reseach before you go into battle with this power.

name: Author Power Mimicry
description: Many people create a power, but never acquire it. With this power, you don't need to -it does it automatically. However, it will get the powers you made whether you want them or not, so watch out if you made something like cracktart. On the other hand, if you made a really good power like Ability Sponge or The Power of Imagination, this is a very useful ability to have.
summary: The ability to use any power you created.
strengths: Have all the powers you made.
Have multiple powers.
Really good if you made a lot of useful powers.
weaknesses: Not very useful if you aren't creative.
Awful if you made a really bad power like cracktart.
Only acquires powers you made.

name: Symbolic Clothing
description: It as it says on the tin. You can acquire powers based on whats on your clothes. Doctor Who:Time Lord abilities, Cross: angelic abilities, Money: Currency Conjuring etc etc. Iron-ons also included.
summary: The ability to have powers depending on the objects on your clothing
strengths: Shirt, Pants and Shoes can make powers
Clothes can be bought cheap
Iron-on's for pants and shoe decals even spray paint makes powers
weaknesses: No Shirt Pants or Shoes No powers
No money for clothes No powers
If you like plain T-shirts

name: Depth Perspective Telekinesis
description: Makes depth perception your weapon. If a car is far enough away to look 2 inches long, you can reach out and manipulate the car as if it was shrunk to 2 inches. It extends to held objects, so if you hold a newspaper and make hitting motions at a person who looks one inch tall, the effects work accordingly.
summary: The ability to psionically manipulate objects as if they were the size depth perception makes them look.
strengths: The farther away from the target, the more powerful it is.
Very destructive.
weaknesses: VERY DESTRUCTIVE!

name: Sunlight Absorber
description: With this superpower, you can absorb sunlight just like Superman and use it to fuel your energy and give yourself superpowers. You can think of any powers you want.
summary: The ability to absorb sunlight and use it for superpowers
strengths: Can have unlimited energy
Can have any powers you want
weaknesses: Clouds and shade are your weakness

name: Metallokinesis
description: You will mentally control all metal sources. You will be able to summon metal from the ground, shape and form metal into different constructs, like a suit of armor, shields or weapons. You can also repel metal projects from hitting you. You can even break and repair metal objects, or manipulate its properties (density, conductivity, color, etc.). This is not using Magnetism or Magnetokinesis.
summary: The ability to manipulate metal mentally
strengths: Control over metal
Can form it into armor and weapons
Can manipulate its properties
weaknesses: May be affected by magnetic power
May be affected by electric power

name: Boomerang Touch
description: An object tagged with this ability will always return to you. The object will reappear in your possesion no matter where you leave it or place it. When it returns it may do so in several ways. It might reappear in your inventory or in your hands. If you own a house it may reappear there.
summary: The ability to cause any object to always return to you magically.
strengths: Never lose important object.
Objects reappear quickly
weaknesses: May be creepy to have an object constantly reappear near you.

name: Mental Escape
description: With this power, you can easily escape from any prison with only your imagination. If you are in handcuffs or trapped on an island surrounded by sharks, all you have to do is imagine yourself escaping and you will be free.
summary: The ability to escape from anything by imagining.
strengths: Get out of jail everytime.
Bad guys can never capture you.
Get out of all boring conferences.
weaknesses: Won't help you fight.
Won't work if you can't imagine escaping.

name: Psychometric Terrakinesis
description: This form of terrakinesis is very rare. A person can control any form of earth that they have previously worked on, as when farming. They gain total control of that section of earth, and their psychic link to it can be maintained or terminated at will.
summary: The ability to control earthen minerals you have had previous contact with
strengths: Psychometric connections make this an extremely powerful form of terrakinesis!
You can extract minerals to use for healing, weaponry, and even artistry!
Is very easy to control once it is mastered
weaknesses: Use for weapons and artistry take sufficient practice
If you can't recall memories, you could easily lose control

name: Messianic Aura
description: A person with this power can cause people's good attributes to be dominant while people are in their presence. Even hardened criminals become repentant when under the affects of this power. Anything that has a conscience immediately tries to do good things or what they think is good. It can induce generosity and sharing as well. Even animals are affected by this power and will not attack you. Plants are also affected. Even bacteria and viruses are affected.
summary: The ability to cause good attributes to be dominant in your presence
strengths: Spread peace and win a Nobel Prize
Eventually you can use your reputation to do other things
Works on animals, plants, bacteria, fungi, and viruses--ie you can also stop any disease temporarily
weaknesses: People might want to follow you around
You are also affected by your own power at all times--so no using powers for evil
Only directly affects things nearby you

name: Superhuman Agility
description: Agility is a mix of balance, coordination, speed, reflexes, and strength. A person with Superhuman Agility can leap off walls, backflip with ease, and perform with a gymnast's grace in any environment.
summary: The ability to change the body's position at superhuman levels
strengths: Looks awesome
Very intimidating
Can be used without much suspicion
weaknesses: You are not that strong
No resistance to injury
Can still make mistakes (header into wall)

name: Friction Manipulation
description:
Friction is a force that stops the movement of two touching objects. These objects do not move because of electromagnetism. By controlling friction, you can make things "sticky" or "slippery", including yourself. 
You can do this to objects that you have touched as well. You need to be conscious to keep these things in the state you want them to be (although you don't need to think about it). They will revert to there normal states when you sleep or are knocked out.
summary: The ability to control the friction of your own body and of objects you touch
strengths: Stick to any surface, allowing you to climb up walls or walk on ceilings.
Move things more easily by making them slippery.
When you're frictionless, you are immune to all physial attacks unless they hit your center of mass.
weaknesses: Unless you also have superstrength, climbing up walls will be difficult.
Still weak to fire, explosions, drowning, or any non-physical attack.
Actively changing which body part is sticky and which is slippery may get confusing.

name: Computer Interface
description: You can control a computer to do anything you want, or transfer yours or someone else's conscious mind into any electrical device capable of containing it.
summary: The ability to control or transfer someone's conscious into computer.
strengths: See through any camera no matter the distance.
Trap enemies' minds in a storage device.
Put your own mind into a highly destructive robot.
weaknesses: Accidentally losing the mind you are transfering.

name: Reanimation
description: This ability allows one to undo any sort of effect as the ability Animation, Glaciation, Petrifaction, Vitrification or the like. Anything that makes inanimate objects ANIMATED, or makes living things INANIMATE will be negated. This also works to undo death-inducing abilities and paralyzing/immobilizing abilities (and return the dead back to living beings). In addition, it means Glaciation, Petrifaction, Vitrification, insta-kill, paralyzing and immobilizing abilities fail to work on the user.
summary: The ability to bring things back to their original state of animation
strengths: Reanimate the dead (as living people, not zombies), undo Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification
Return animated objects back to normal (they can't attack you)
Immune to Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification and Insta-Kill/immobilizing/paralyzing abilities
weaknesses: Can't animate objects with this ability, unless they've been animated before
Some user DO reanimate the dead as zombies, but this power doesn't let you control them
Some with this ability aren't immune to Petrifaction, Glaciation, Vitrification, etc.

name: Calorie Power
description: Every 2000 calories you eat increases you body mass to to the equivalent of 1 pound of strength. You are able to lift 1 pound per 2000 calories. It is evenly distributed throughout your body. But you never lose strength or mass. Constantly gaining weight to the point you would not e allowed on elevators and certain roads.
summary: The ability to have each calorie you eat increase your muscle/body/bone mass.
strengths: Gradually stronger and eventually indestructible from the out side.
Never lose strength.
More you eat, the better you are.
weaknesses: Will become extremely heavy.
Skin wil become impenetrable good/bad--surgery.

name: Passive Superpower Aura
description: This power enables one to bestow themselves with an incredible ability. This power must be passive, however and affects everyone within 10 meters. However, you can also apply it to certain groups, like all adolescents or all females. A "group" can also include just yourself or just others. You can only give one at a time, but it can be multifaceted and switched immediately. It can also grant negative powers as weaknesses, such as a poison or induced susceptibility to sunlight.
summary: The ability to give yourself and others nearby a passive ability of your choice.
strengths: Great team support ability.
Can be a specialist weapon.
Can target groups.
weaknesses: Only one ability at a time, although it can be multifaceted.
No Con Negation or similar powers can be used on this.
Only passive abilities.

name: Mentally Triggered Explosions
description:
Fire is fun! But explosions are better. With this ability a person could concentrate on what it is they want to blow up, and then, depending on the strength of their focus, an explosion would rock the object.

Think about this ability, you could come across an impenetrable wall of stone keeping you out of the enemy's base. Boom! No more wall.
Peons are shooting at you! Boom! Disabled the guns.
Plus, the explosions don't harm you, but the shrapnel might...
summary: The ability to make explosions with your mind
strengths: Revenge, blow up the neighbor's mailbox
The detonation can be anywhere
You control the size of the explosion
weaknesses: The detonation can be anywhere
The first few tries might injure somebody. Bad.

name: Empathic Metamorphosis
description: This ability allows the user to become a untouchable adversary due to the emotions inside them. The more emotion and/or the stronger the emotion the more powerful they will become(i.e. rage induces fires and or strength).
summary: The ability to change your power or appearance by the emotions inside you
strengths: Can become virtually anything
Any power is theirs for the taking
Adaptive in any battle
weaknesses: Is emotionally based; no emotion or not getting the desired emotion will make you weak
Metamorph into something dangerous (i.e. cannot control emotion)
If you cannot control your emotion you can lose control of the power

name: Ghost Field
description: Make portable and movable fields that make things intangible for however long you want. Make a field around a bullet so it can go through walls or innocent people and become tangible right before hitting your opponent. Make a field around yourself in a sphere to protect you from any physical harm, or make a skin-tight field around yourself to phase through walls, people, weapons, or objects. When phasing objects become invisible, so you could phase into a tree and make a little peephole.
summary: The ability to make fields of intangibility
strengths: Be immune to physical harm
Hide easily
Don't need to hurt innocents or go around walls
weaknesses: Can't go through force fields
Energy weapons
Non-physical superpowers

name: Thief's Power
description: This power makes you ambidexterous to steal or pick pockets in most positions. You gain an innate knowledge of parkour and karate to fight out of situations. To sneak in and out of art museums you gain invisibility that is voluntary and your sense of balance is doubled so that you can evade security cameras. This power also allows you to know what elements, such as gold, something is made of to tell how much it's worth. Finally, you have eternal youth to continue stealing valuable objects.
summary: The ability to become an expert thief.
strengths: Get rich easily.
Almost impossible to get caught.
You become excellent with knives and throwing stars.
weaknesses: Eternal youth doesn't help against bullets.
People will hate you.

name: Magnetism
