description: Magnetism is a universal force keyed to nickel, iron and cobalt. A person with Magnetism can repulse, levitate, attract, and manipulate these metals using only their mind. They can also repel their body iron from the Earth's core and float, although they cannot fly.
summary: The ability to manipulate magnetic fields
strengths: Best bank robber ever
These metals are fairly common
Limited only by will
weaknesses: Useless without metal
Weakened by EMPs
Limited control over less magnetic elements

name: Equilibrium   Healing
description: Equilibrium allows the user to restore and maintain balance in any given situation. This ability is dynamic, altering depending upon the current requirements to maintain balance. In the case of biological damage, it can be used to heal wounds. This ability will naturally try to return biological lifeforms to their peak state. This means it will force regeneration of all damage, no matter how long ago it occurred. Can also heal mental illness. Can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to restore biological lifeforms to their peak form
strengths: Can heal all damage done to self
Can heal any injury done to others
Can heal even mental illnesses
weaknesses: Healing is involuntary once active
Will naturally heal everyone, even enemies
Extensive healing can leave the user drained

name: Monthly Wish
description: This lets you get 1 wish on the first week of every month that will come true. At midnight of the day a week after the start of the month the wish is gone... No stockpiling to have 2 in the next month... Also this wish can not harm the earth intentionally (no blowing up the planet) and can only affect one person directly (your wish is for someone to die this would only directly affect that person... But you couldnt do an earthquake cause would harm/affect several people)
summary: The ability to get one wish at the beginning of every month
strengths: Every month you get one wish you want that will come true
You could do or get almost any one thing you want
Anything with lasting effects lasts until end of month
weaknesses: It only lasts until the end of the month if it has a lasting effect
Cannot directly harm more than one person or the earth
Only get to choose a wish at the first week of the month (till midnight start of 8th day of month)

name: The Light Side Of The Force
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Jedi can harness this energy for any purpose from telekinesis to mind control and beyond. The ability to connect to the Force is related to the concentration of Midi-chlorians in one's cells.
summary: The ability to harness the natural energy of life for nearly infinite uses.
strengths: You get an awesome lightsaber
You can lie during droid hunts
You can throw people with your mind
weaknesses: Sith, stormtoopers, droids, bounty hunters, and giant worm-people try to kill you
You can never marry
The government expects you to do all of the front-line fighting in every conflict

name: Dark Lightning
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black lightning or any color you wish as long as it is dark (no bright colors). You can shoot bolts of pure dark energy at anything, from your hands or eyes or even legs to either destroy or just shock the target depending how much you focus it and the power being used. With practice you could increase your speed using the dark energy. You won't be able to control electricity in any way, only counter it and can still be shocked.
summary: The ability to generate dark energy in the form of lightning
strengths: Become really scary (not sure if that is a good thing)
Never need a weapon again, at least not for fighting
Can increase speed but needs practice
weaknesses: Running out of energy, thus forcing you to draw more power than you can handle wich could backfire
This is not electrokinesis so you won't be able to control electricity and are not immune to it

name: Data Beam
description: With this power you can create a beam of data that alters reality by changing the data of the objects it touches. Any type of data can be used to change objects, such as making things peaceful with peace data, setting things aflame with fire data, and changing to substance of something with a specific type of mineral data. The power can be trained to control range of beam and to control what the beam touches.
summary: The ability to create data beams that alter reality.
strengths: Can use any type of data.
Strong ability that can rewrite the code of anything.
Can change data to gain advantages in situations.
weaknesses: Removing the added data is difficult, without appropriate power.
Affects everything the beam touches.
Have to understand how the data will affect certain things.

name: Inthinkieous Createomious
description:
You can think anything to happen and it does. You have an english paper to type up? Just think it. Dog has to go out, just think it and done. Its usefull in every situation. Have a few extra pounds? 
BOOM! 
not anymore!
summary: The ability to think things to reality
strengths: You can complete tedious tasks without moving
Create unworldly inventions
Be a hero
weaknesses: You have to have logic behind the imagination(Like the english paper has to be written by you in
order for you to think it typed)
You learn no life values or skills

name: Head Rushed
description: You want to learn about something, you power activates and the information about it rushes into your head so fast you literal convulse. All information no matter how closely or vaguely connected it be to your targeted topic will be in your mind permanently.
summary: The ability to instantly learn everything about any one thing by simply wanting to learn about it.
strengths: Learn about anything you need to know.
weaknesses: The rush of information makes your entire body convulse uncontrolably until you've learned it
You could become addicted to learning, thus your mind will eventually rip itself apart.
You cant turn it off ever, no matter how many times you want to know how it works you wont learn it.

name: Induced Evolution
description: With this power you can evolve or users of this power call; "advance"; things to you own desire by harvesting nearby resources. You can advance weapons to more powerful ones or when your driving a vehicle "advance" it into a airplane or evolve your self where you can breathe underwater. This power is interruptible. The more large and complex a target of "advancing" is, the more time it will take to advance and the more energy it will drain. When you advance something you cannot change it back.
summary: The ability to evolve or "advance" one's self, people, animals, plants, and objects physically and mentally
strengths: Advance a gun into a bazooka
Have flight, breathing and other powers.
Great when you have a getaway car; advance it into a plane
weaknesses: Limited energy no matter what.
Cannot change targets back.
Longer time for more complex and larger targets

name: Metal Substance Manipulation
description: Touch anything with metal in it (while thinking of wanting the metal) and the particles will separate and float into your pores. You can also suck metal out of the earth/dirt, since it possesses metal particles.
summary: The ability to suck up metal into one's skin and later use this metal by turning it into whatever you want.
strengths: You almost always have a source of power.
Can store metal in oneself instead of carrying it around.
Can make any metal object appear.
weaknesses: Must flex part of body where you want metal to come out and then think of what you want it to become
Can only store certain amount of metal in your body at a time.
MIGHT run out of metal, but as you can take it from the ground, it is highly unlikely.

name: Light/Dark Energy
description: You can only use light energy when exposed to light and dark energy when exposed to the dark. Both energies can be used to blast energy and/or create force-fields of energy. Light energy can be used to travel as/with light, fuse with light, inflict positive emotions/thoughts, and generate heat. Dark energy can be used to travel as/with darkness, fuse with the dark, inflict negative emotions/thoughts, and generate cold. Both energies can be used as explosives. Power is greatest during eclipse.
summary: The ability to manipulate light/dark energy
strengths: Manipulate light energy when exposed to light
Manipulate dark energy when exposed to the dark
Manipulate dark and light energy during eclipse
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate dark energy unless exposed to the dark
Cannot manipulate light energy unless exposed to the light
Eclipse isn't very long

name: Temporal Sense Manipulation
description: A person with this power can alter anyone's sense of time. For example, they can make it feel like an hour while it has only been a minute. In addition, you can temporarily freeze their sense of time, leaving them staring blankly still stuck at that moment. Conversely, you can also accelerate people's sense of time to give them sensory framerate acceleration - in fact, you can even make their sense of time go faster than their body can handle.
summary: The ability to alter a biological objects sense of time
strengths: Make it look like you can stop time
Can make plants blossom early - fool the biological clock
Can grant people sensory framerate acceleration
weaknesses: Cannot stop a bullet or speed/inertia
Physics still applies
Mental strain in doing this - needs practice to alter for longer periods

name: Call Of The Olympians
description: You have the incredible power to have the abilities of any Greek god. This includes the Twelve Olympians and the minor gods. You can only call upon one god's power at a time. You don't summon the god to you, just their power, such as the speed of Hermes, the intelligence of Athena, or the ability to control the skies like Zeus, you get the idea. Once you call upon one god's power, the one you are possessing goes away.
summary: The ability to call upon the power of the Olympians in your time of need.
strengths: You can have the power of the Greek gods.
You can have many powers.
You can call upon the major and minor Greek gods.
weaknesses: You can only have one god's power at a time.

name: Sharingan
description: You don't need to worry about forgetting anything if you have your Sharingan on! Also known as the "Mirror Wheel Eye", the Sharingan can copy anything, as long as you don't need a specific genetic structure for it. You can also perform hypnosis. But be warned, your Sharingan is nearly useless under any condition that reduces visibility. Also, if you want the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend. And if you want the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of yo brother.
summary: The ability to copy and memorize anything that does not require another person's genetic structure
strengths: Learn, and remember, anything you want!
Creep out your enemies!
weaknesses: Anything that blinds you makes the Sharingan useless
To get the Mangekyou Sharingan, you must kill your best friend
To get the Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan, you must take the eyes of a brother w/ a Mangekyou Sharingan

name: True Sight
description: True Sight is the ability that lets one see what is really there. Example: If the person who hones this power meets with a shapeshifter, he/she would see past the shapeshifter and see what the person is really like. Also, he/she can see how the person really is. The person who has this ability has eyes the color of gold.
summary: The ability to see what is really there
strengths: You can see past any charade.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
You can see how someone really is, contrary to what they say or how they act.
weaknesses: The powers are somewhat involuntary, to avoid this the bearer must wear sunglasses.
You can be affected indirectly.
To get the full extent of the power, eye-to-eye contact is necessary.

name: Source Inducement
description: The user is allowed to create a link to any thing and make them an power source for the user can draw all his strength from. When away from the source, the user gains enchanced natural abilities, energy projection, and any properties or powers the source has. When the user is closer, they become stronger, but the source will become weak until it becomes inert or dead.
summary: The ability to induce or create link between you and a person/object/power/etc. and make your source of power.
strengths: Link with other things to make them your power source, and you can link up with multiple things
Power yourself up.
You can allow other to gain power from it
weaknesses: Dangerous for the source if the user is to close
The source can be depleted.

name: Sage Power
description: This power allows the user to absorb chi from the immediate surrounding and channeling it to produce energy constructs, blast or Buddhist themed defensive figures that will protect the user
summary: The ability to absorb chi from the surrounding and channeling it.
strengths: Chi is present anywhere
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
weaknesses: Body of the user is not made invulnerable.
Great control needed to absorb the energy
Will only last a little while, before needing replenishing

name: Seasonal Powers
description: This power gives you different abilities for each season. In the spring, you can control plant life, talk to animals, and heal people. In the summer you can control light and summer storms (rain, wind, lightning, etc. ) In the fall you can wield red-gold flames and control darkness. In the winter you can control water, ice, and winter storms (snow, sleet, hail, wind, etc. ). It gives you a wide range of abilities that would be strong in each season.
summary: The ability to have different powers depending on the season
strengths: Stop hurricanes and blizzards
Hide in shadows and scare people for Halloween
Start awesome gardens in the spring
weaknesses: Needing another season's powers
You might not want a garden

name: Intuitive Aptitude
description: Understanding is something that we all need more of. A person with Intuitive Aptitude can instinctively and subconsciously comprehend any kind of system---biological, mechanical, social, complicated or simple. However, the user is also driven to understand as much as possible.
summary: The ability to analyze and understand the workings of complex systems
strengths: Be an amazing scientist
Understand why people do what they do
Understand how other superpowers work
weaknesses: Desire to understand may make you a monster
No other superhuman attributes
May take time to understand massive systems (i.e. the universe)

name: Superhuman Intelligence
description: With this ability, your intelligence, creativity and attention span are far above ordinary genius level.  You can assess, analyze, synthesize, deduce and solve nearly any problem with lightning speed, accuracy and objectivity. This extends into nearly any field of study one encounters, including social interaction (meaning you realize that people would find an arrogant, know-it-all brainiac to be annoying, and you'll know how to keep humble, despite your intelligence).
summary: The ability to have intelligence far above genius level.
strengths: Use your brainpower to change the world
Solve problems, like cancer or this morning's Sudoku
Write killer rap song lyrics
weaknesses: The simple things in life may not feel fun or funny to you--you'll probably see them coming
People constantly hounding you for answers
People may get jealous of you and try to do you harm

name: Dream Recreation
description: With this power you can enter into the world of a dream you previously had allowing you to re-experience the dream world with greater clarity. In addition to having greater clarity, you can stay in the dream longer than you did originally to experience new things. To activate this power simply think of its activation when you sleep and you will enter into a world with a menu of your dreams to choose from. To exist a dream simply wish yourself to wake up. Time in dreams is not equal to real time.
summary: The ability to enter into a dream you have had before.
strengths: Re-experience your favorite dreams.
Do not have to do the same thing you did the first time you dreamed.
Can stay in the dream for as long as you wish.
weaknesses: May not want to exit the dream.
You may not have many good dreams.
Can not experience new dreams while in the world of your old dreams.

name: Jacket Of Wonders
description: You're wearing a jacket where you can pull, any item you think of out of the inside jacket pocket.  You can only pull the items out if you are wearing the jacket. So don't have to fear pick-pockets. But if some-one else gets their hands on the jacket, you lose this wonderous ability.
summary: The ability to pull any object you want, from your inside jacket pocket.
strengths: Pull any item you want out of the jacket.
No-one else can pull items out of the jacket as long as you are wearing it.
Won't outgrow the jacket. It grows to the size of the wearer.
weaknesses: Must be wearing the jacket to pull the item out.
The jacket has the power, so make sure no-one else wears it.
Anyone else can wear the jacket.

name: Portal Phasing
description: To portal phase you must touch the object you are phasing through. The object must be wider than the person, or else, the object phases through the person. When phasing out of an object, you can phase out of any side of that object or anything touching that object. Owners of this power can't phase through people.
summary: The ability to phase into an object and out of any side of it or any other object touching it.
strengths: Getting to other places is faster
Thanks to gravity every inanimate object is touching the ground
There is no place you can escape from
weaknesses: The power doesn't work if the owner is evil
The owner of this power shouldn't have other powers
If you have other powers, you age quicker

name: Think Fire
description: With this power you can set people on fire with your mind just by thinking of the person on fire. You can even put the fires you create out with your mind. You could also change the colors of the fires you create for your own amusement.
summary: The ability to set people on fire with your mind
strengths: You can set enemies on fire with your mind
You can put the fires you create out with your mind
You can change the colors of the fire
weaknesses: You can only use fire to set people on fire
You can only put out fires you created with this power
You can only change the colors of the fires you create with this power

name: A Z Powers
description: With this power you can have a power from each letter of the alphabet. The power has to be on this site and if you decide to change one of your power for another of that letter (i. E. Switching Acid Pee for Ability Snatch) all of your powers are changed to a different one from their respective letters. You cannot have a power that starts with a number or symbol (! Or 5 Faces Of Darkness).
summary: The ability to have one power from each letter of the alphabet
strengths: You can get 26 powers one for each letter of the alphabet
weaknesses: If you change one of your powers all of your powers are changed
The power has to be on this site
You can't get a power that starts with a symbol or number

name: Pantheon By Day
description: Read any myth or legend, touch the desired character's name & mimic their powers and abilities. For one day your former life will be forgotten by all and you will look exactly like the mythological or legendary figure. You could do this only once a day. There is no returning to your former self that day. You have the power until you sleep or 24 hours after you became Myth or Legend.
summary: The ability to mimic the powers and abilities of myth and legend
strengths: Phenomenal amounts of possibilities, all powers and abilities of the mythical person
Includes gender changing, growing appendages (such as wings) and paraphernalia materializing
Works on historical figures also if they have become legend
weaknesses: Story must be over 70 years old, widely told and known by at least one culture
Must be able to read, and touch the character's name
Everyone forgets you exist and knows you only by the character's name or names for the day
tags: Son of Re and Strange Visitor

name: Emotion Commotion
description: It uses the emotion and converts it into any element blast by physical contact or you can throw it onto an enemy. Emotion - Element: Anger - Fire; Depression - Ice; Fear - Lightning; Love - Purity; Evil - Corruption; Courage - Earth. However, some emotions cancel each other out. Example, Depression and Anger, Love and Evil, Courage and Fear
summary: The ability to create elemental attacks (depending on the current emotion).
strengths: You can keep foes at bay.
Can help express emotions.
Help in serious situations (ex: Gang fight)
weaknesses: Need to control emotions
Might hurt friends/family (if lost control)
In trouble, if one has emotion problems

name: Dark Matter
description: Dark matter is a form of matter unlike any other. No light can pass through it at all. This ability allows you to create and control the dark stuff. When you make it,it will appear as a black cloud/smoke. You can then use it for a variety of effects. You could make a shield against light based powers. And by surrounding something with it you could move the target. Also with time you could surround your self with it(not your head)and fly. Dark matter also has many other unique properties.
summary: The ability to create and control dark matter
strengths: You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man
You can use it to move stuff, make a shield, fly,etc.
Dark matter has many unknown properties for you to discover and put to use
weaknesses: Dark matter isn't totally solid so moving things will take practice.
You can't use it as a sheild for anything but light
You can control one of the most dangerous forms of matter known to man

name: Clean Up Power
description: Like cleaning up your room, you can zap something to make it appear were you want it or where it's supposed to be. Can also be used to clean something. Get rid of filth, get back something you have lost or clean up a big mess: this power does it all for you.
summary: The ability to make something disappear and then appear where it is supposed to be.
strengths: Clean up faster
You can have more time to do things with your family and friends
If your brother or sister hides something of you, zap where it was at and it will appear
weaknesses: People will start to notice that you are getting things done faster than you normally do.
You might zap something you don't intend to zap
You might zap something and use the wrong effect of this power.

name: Speed Reading
description: If you never have time to read, you can just touch a book and immediately know every word.
summary: The ability to memorize an entire book just by touching it
strengths: You can read through an entire library in a half hour (instead of the normal year)
You'll be the smartest kid in your school
Never have to read at a normal pace again
weaknesses: Yeah, right!

name: Spirit Magic
description: Spirit magic is also called divine magic, depending on who is talking. Whatever the name, it is the act of channeling the power of a spirit to do great tasks. Some even draw a spirit within themselves, as this sometimes works better(and the spirit can speak to you and give you advice and knowledge). To channel or absorb a spirit, you must focus on everything around you, then a spirit will come to you and you can channel its power.
summary: The ability to employ spirit magic.
strengths: Can do almost anything, depending on the strength and power of the spirit.
Can even absorb a spirit (if they allow it) and gain their knowledge as well.
weaknesses: Spirit magic is a very misunderstood branch of magic, and is slightly hard to explain scientifically

name: Chained Lightning
description: The lightning will hit the first target with several volts of electricity and each successive target after that will get half the voltage. The initial amount of electricity depends on the user and how well they have mastered this power. Using this power will drain large amounts of energy from the user.
summary: The ability to fire lightning from one's hand that hits one target then others.
strengths: You can choose how many targets there are and in what order they are hit.
weaknesses: Hitting multiple targets will decrease how harmful this power is on each successive target.

name: Danger Sense Fighter
description: If you are in danger, you will be able to become an extreme fighter. When using this power, you have to think about a fighting style. You'll then become a master of the style that you have thought of. The downside is that it only lasts for a short period of time. You can merge two fighting styles.
summary: The ability to turn into an extreme fighter, when in danger
strengths: Amazing fighter
Can morph two fighting styles to make better
Be able to defend yourself
weaknesses: Lasts for a short period of time
If you merged fighting styles, you have even less time to fight

name: Sun Angel
description: Sun angels can use pyrokinesis, able to fly,and anger inducement. Unlike moon angels they are strongest during the day.
summary: The ability to become a sun angel
strengths: Pyrokinesis can control both blue and orange flames with enough practice
Powers are strongest during the day
Very likely to be worshipped
weaknesses: Getting tired of worship
Moon angels could kill you in your sleep
You can only control one power in the night

name: Articulation Manipulation
description: With this power, words take on physical actions. For example, saying "Strike" would produce a blast that strikes whatever's in front of you while. "Obey" would make anyone within the soun of your voice obey whatever you say. The problem, however, is that you bound by the rules of language. E.g. if you say "Strike" without thinking of the correct term of voice, you will be struck.
summary: The ability to use words to perform physical action.
strengths: Always win arguments
Never lose debates
weaknesses: If you can't speak, your powers useless
Not using correct form will backfire
Your range is limited to the sound of your voice

name: Reality Cube
description: Also known as Inconsequential Omnipotence or the Virtual Room, this power gives the user omnipotence, but the user is confined within a 1-mile radius when activated and any changes are always undone when the power is deactivated. Also, the power will deactivate anyway over time. The only thing that people can keep is personally gained knowledge or skills. Mainly uses for illusionary purposes or training. The cons cannot be negated by any power.
summary: The ability to create your own reality within a 1-mile radius and bring other people into it
strengths: Inside the other reality, you control everything. Also, the time is slower than outside time.
You can use it to simulate training for your other powers-nothing gets destroyed in real life.
Learn other people's powers and weaknesses by testing them and hide your real powers.
weaknesses: The reality cube will crumble because of the surrounding reality.
After the reality cube crumbles, everything returns back to normal-like nothing ever happened.
Can't really kill anyone, heal anyone, etcetera-none of the real things that omnipotence gives you.

name: Vibration Control
description: With this power you can create vibration with you body,create vibrations,slicing(for example with a group of vibration you can slice in a half a piece of any metal,diamant and other materials). Also,with vibrations of sound you can nature sounds,melodies and other things. A big wall of vibrations of sound it's possible too if you need to slice a house or something bigger than you. The vibration you create may be detected by sensor enemies or other type of GPS. Maybe you could make an earthquake.
summary: The ability to create vibrations by your body
strengths: Can slice or break anything,with any measure(of vibration) without hurting yourself.
Any favourite melody/sound could be listened any time without an mp3 or something.
An earthquake may be possible.
weaknesses: The enemies could find you.
Needs concentrating and time for practicing.
You may slice something accidentaly whitout practicing enough.

name: Telelocation
description: Essentially, the ability to answer any question that starts with the word "where." Once you have a concrete target - the criminal in hiding, the assailant waiting to ambush you, the kid on the milk carton, your TV remote - you can sense where it is. This is not 'tracking' that requires your quarry to have left a physical trail as it moves, but a psychic 'homing device' that tells you where it is right now. Advanced power levels may include the ability to see the location site (clairvoyance.)
summary: The ability to be able to find anything lost, missing, or hidden.
strengths: Track down any loved ones kidnapped or taken hostage.
Be hugely successful as a treasure hunter, or a private investigator
Never lose anything again, ever.
weaknesses: By going straight to a target, you can miss a lot of valuable information about it.
Locate physical items only - you can't ask "Where is the best restaurant in town?"
Must be consciously activated - you don't get alerts that something of interest might be near.

name: Luck Enchantment
description: Every 24 hours you can enchant 1 person with good luck. Your power has an immediate effect, bringing something positive to that person's life within the minute. The duration of the enchantment is random, however, but lasts no less than one month. Each day, something positive is guaranteed to happen to the enchantee and no bad events relating to that person or their friends or relatives will occur. Of course, the definition of good luck is relative to the person being enchanted, so choose wisely.
summary: The ability to enchant yourself and others with long lasting good luck
strengths: Bless others with good luck and fortune
You can bless yourself to protect you and your loved ones
You will be seen as holy by some
weaknesses: Casinos won't be too happy to see you
You're not holy--it's just a sweet superpower
You'll never lose in a fight--luck will always be on your side

name: Conceptual Manifestation

Any illusion goes--a chair, a snowball, a car, a naked hobo, a swarm of bees--you're only limited by your imagination. You can control every aspect, from how they move to when they appear/disappear. The more stars in the sky the more powerful the user becomes. For example a starry night on Earth will result in the user having the ability to fly and shoot energy bolts. EXAMPLES: A section of water can be moved without warping the water. Fire can be moved without being affected by the air. description: This ability can make a person become a living force. This of course means they will also be visible unlike most real forces are. This will not only give them traits of the force they are mimicking, but also gives them manipulative abilities over the force that they produce. In their force form, they are either intangible or invulnerable, but they can be hurt if presented the the force's natural weakness or anything that could affect it.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become any kind of force.
strengths: Manipulative capability.
Intangible or invulnerable in force form.
weaknesses: Intangible or invulnerable won't work....
....against force's natural weakness or anything that could affect it.

name: Kinetic Duplication
description: The user is able to duplicate his or herself everytime he or she is hit by a force that is half or more than their body weight. The duplication that takes place everytime they are hit cannot be controlled. For example, sometimes one duplicate is produced, or at times twenty duplicates are produced. Each of the duplicates can produce their own set of duplicates when they are hit. Only knocking out the original will get rid of all the duplicates. All the duplicates are controlled by the original.
summary: The ability to duplicate one self every time the user is hit
strengths: Good at multi tasking
Good at distracting someone
Your own army
weaknesses: Number of duplicates cant be controlled

name: Flaming Web
description: This can work with good or evil. If your enemy has ice powers this may take their ice powers.
summary: The ability to generate flaming webs to keep your enemies from escaping
strengths: Defeats enemies
Since web take ice powers, you get new powers!
STICKY!!!
weaknesses: If your enemy has fire powers they could brake the web
Sometimes webs come out uncontrollably
May stick to you

name: Liquid Shift
description: With this power you can change your body into a liquid. In this liquid form you can hide in small or tight places and you can cause people to slip.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a liquid
strengths: You can hide in small places or slide under doors
You can cause people to slip
weaknesses: You can't really fight villains in liquid form

name: Universal Mix Up
description: Using this power, you can change reality by swapping the elements of other, alternate universes. Here's an example: You are walking down the street, and you slip on a banana peel, which knocks you into the street. You then get hit by a truck and are sent to the hospital. With this power, you can swap the moment in time when you slip on the banana peel in this universe with a moment from an alternate universe where you don't step on the banana peel at all, altering reality in your favor.
summary: The ability to change reality by altering the elements of parallel universes.
strengths: Dodge every attack aimed at you, even if you're clumsy and feeble.
Always win battles, even against the strongest heroes.
There are an unlimited number of parallel universes to choose from and swap with.
weaknesses: The people from other universes may despise you if they figure out your secret.

name: Light Wolves
description: The wolves will always be a bright white color and can rip and shred objects and enemies to bits. The wolves can only go a distance of 20 metres or as far as the eye can see whichever is further away. Also, the wolves can ignore the reflective properties of mirrors.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves made of light
strengths: Strong creatures under your control.
The light wolves can harm the wolves created with 'Shadow Wolves'.
weaknesses: Enemies with light manipulation can take control of and/or destroy your wolves.
The light wolves can be harmed by wolves created with 'Shadow Wolves'.

name: Water Resurrection
description: All physical wounds will close,you will come back to life, and your body will be brought back to full stamina when your dead body is fully immersed in water.
summary: The ability to come back to life only when fully immersed in water
strengths: A battle in the ocean.
weaknesses: The older you are the harder it is to find something on dry land that can hold enough water.
This power does not come with Water Adaptation.

name: Multi Physics Planets Creator
description: With this power, you start by making a universe different to our own. You will always be able to access this universe with this power. Now, you make planets and star systems. However, every planet you make has a different set of laws of physics than the next. You might go to a planet that has a small star orbiting as a moon, and then travel to a cube-shaped planet. You cannot control what the laws of physics will be, you just know that they will be different to the last.
summary: The ability to make planets with different laws of physics.
strengths: Make a universe with multiple laws of physics.
Interesting holiday destinations.
You will always be able to access and travel through the universe with this power.
weaknesses: Random laws of physics, meaning you can't control what they will be.
Could get lost - Are you good at making maps of the universe?
Bad if someone deactivates this power, even momentarily.

name: Ailment Manipulation
description: This power is randomised, so you can't control what ailment you give to people, however this power can make people either, sleep, poisoned, blinded, paralysed, confused, frozen and burn. This power's effect will wear away after a few minutes, depending on how long you touched them for or how much force you used on them.
summary: The ability to cause status effect to others by touch or energy waves
strengths: You can either affect one person or many with the energy waves
You can watch the people you hate suffer
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You could hurt the people that you love
If you touch someone for too long it could kill them
You can't control what ailment you give to what person

name: Dragon Katana
description: (This katana was made from adamantium and bathed in dragons blood) the first is that the wielder Becomes immortal, second is that the wielder gains the power Aura absorption, third is that the wielder Gains dragon skin but without the wings, fourth is that you can summon the dragon of doom, fifth that anyone that is killed by katana becomes part of the katana.
summary: The ability to wield a katana that does five things
strengths: Youre immortal
You have a great weapon
You are a mass murderer
weaknesses: Mythological weapons that includes the spear of destine
If you lose the katana you lose the powers
Linda Tavara version of Aura absorption but without the contact port. You still have to kill them t

name: Spatial Aid View
description: This ability allows the user see the world, literally, in a different way to solve problems or to any kind of difficult. For example, the user needs shut off several hidden overheated generators, but he can't find them. With this ability, the user changes his visual perception from the building he was in to a visual perception that is simple like a barren wasteland with these big rocks that represent the generators. This ability can change the boring view of the user to something more fun.
summary: The ability to change one's visual perception in order to solve, overcome obstacles or just for pleasure.
strengths: Help solves problems
Good in fights to find enemy weak point
Makes life more interesting
weaknesses: Overuse will result temporary damage to eyes (glasses needed in healing).

name: Movie Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character from any movie even if its a made for TV movie or a direct to video/dvd movie. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. When you're done with them you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a movie
strengths: You can summon any character from any movie ever made
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might try to kill you if its a villain

name: Destination Tag
description: A person with this power can manipulate reality to send anything to anywhere within 24 hours. They would need to write the address or coordinates on the object and this will manipulate reality to cause a series of events that will end up with the object in the location in 24 hours. This includes sending it to other star systems if you got the coordinates right. If you write 2 addresses on an object, the object will somehow break apart into 2 objects.
summary: The ability to write an address or coordinates on any object and it will reach there in exactly 24 hours
strengths: No need to pay for shipping
Cannot trace you back since the way it gets there is random
Can even send to other star systems as long as you got the coordinates right
weaknesses: Wrong Address(no way for returns)
If you write 2 addresses on an object that object will break apart into 2 with the 24 hours
Hazards of shipping(ie your object may get destroyed along the way)

name: Stealth Deception
description: Never fail again. Aquire infinite knowledge about any subject at will.
summary: The ability to cheat on any contest without the possibilty of being caught
strengths: Always win intellectual conflicts
Never get caught
weaknesses: Must use a broad topic or will not get what you want
Will erupt in flames if you lose any contest. (including sports)

name: Survivability Control
description: So you aquired this power. Now what? You can now control anyone's ability to survive (either by improving it or worsening it). The only requirements is that you have the person in your field of vision, and that you haven't already used it 3 times that day (yes, it's restricted). By improving someone's ability to survive, they no longer need as much water, food, etc. By lessening their survivability, they now have to eat and drink constantly to keep up good health.
summary: The ability to control anyone's ability to survive
strengths: Defeat your enemies easier by making them weaker
Keep your allies healthy in times of crisis
Finally put that small sandwich in the fridge to good use
weaknesses: If you've already used it 3 times the day and you're cornered; you're not in luck.
Cannot use this power on yourself
Cannot prevent anyone near death from dying, only prolong their life a while.

name: The Hole
description: With this power you can throw anybody you want down a bottomless pit where they will be in a constant state of falling until either they die of shock or starvation or something or you free them. You can also place the pit or move the pit wherever you want. If there is no once currently in the hole it disappears until you want to use it again. You can send multiple people down the hole at once.
summary: The ability to be able to throw anybody you want down a hole
strengths: You can send anybody down a bottomless pit
Only you can free them
You can send multiple people down the pit
weaknesses: If you forget about the person in the pit they could die of starvation

name: Animal Enchantment
description: Animal enchantment is a very rare power. An animal enchanter can combine an element with an animal. Ex: fire plus wolf equals a wolf with fire for fur who can breathe a jet of flames. The animal you enchant will be your protector and your friend. However you may only enchant 3 animals at a time. If you try to enchant a fourth animal the first will lose his/her power.
summary: The ability to give an animal an elemental power.
strengths: Having pets with powers.
Having powerful guardians.
weaknesses: You need to enchant the right animal with the right element.
The enchantment process can take up to 90 mins.
You can only enchant 3 animals at a time.

name: Positivity Construct
description: This ability allows one to create constructs withfrom their own positive attitude. The more positive, the better. When the user shows any sign of negative feelings, the constructs will fall apart.
summary: The ability to create constructs out of one's positive attitude.
strengths: Create constructs
More positivity equals more powerful constructs.
weaknesses: Negative attitudes will break apart your constructs.

name: Telekinetic Touch See
description: This is a version of TK with a very specific use, similar to echolocation but more effective in darkness. The user generates a 90 ft radius field of millions of semi-tangible touch sensors that allow him to perceive all physical objects in range. Unlike echolocation, however, it is silent and can navigate around objects; ergo, if the user is in a warehouse full of boxes and an attacker is hiding behind them, the user can navigate his TK field to search all available areas within range
summary: The ability to telekinetically perceive your immediate surroundings
strengths: Can detect ambushes in close proximity without giving away his position
Can perfectly perceive environment in total darkness
Undetectable to anyone but the user
weaknesses: Enclosures/containers can still evade the sensor field
Powerful telekinesis users and telepaths might sense the field
Only 90' range as a beginner - may be increased with practice/proficiency

name: Metaphysical Mutation
description: The user is able to mutate their metaphysical side. So, their physical self won't experience the change. They will have all the power of a mutated monster but will look normal to the normal eyes. They will appear to have telekinetic abilities but it is just their metaphysical body doing the work. If mastered, the user will be able to evolve metaphysically.
summary: The ability to mutate metaphysically.
strengths: Have the power of a mutated monster
Look normal to most people
Learn to evolve your metaphysical side
weaknesses: Hard to control mutated metaphysically side
Can be seen by people who can sense metaphysical or control metaphysical thing

name: Paralysis Touch
description: Just by touching a part of somebody you can stop them from using their body parts of which is touched. If need be the touched part can temporarily be or fully paralyzed. Can also heal someone of paralysis that you have paralyzed or was born that way
summary: The ability to stop parts or all of somebody just by touch alone
strengths: Can stop someone in thier tracks
Can heal someone of paralysis
Can touch items that can pass on the effect
weaknesses: Takes time for paralysis to start working
Can paralyze yourself if taking on to much of the paralysis when cureing

name: Quantum Procrastination
description: In quantum physics, a single particle, such as an electron, can follow all possible paths as long as it is not observed. You can apply this to a limited extend on a macro scale and avoid problems with observers. You follow two paths; if you did and did not procrastinate.
summary: The ability to procrastinate while simultaneously performing your intended task.
strengths: Get work done no matter what.
Can be turned on and off at will.
Even achieve the physical effects of doing a task, such as losing weight or developing muscle.
weaknesses: You cannot do anything with this power except avoid the effects of procrastination.
You are still limited to one non-procrastination task.
Not as useful for those who are self-motivated.

name: Bless This Mess
description: With this power you can increase the amount of lucky chances, coincidences, and miracles that occur in an area by how decrepit, polluted, and filthy it is. These lucky chances directly benefit any person currently in that area. The area can be as small as a cabinet or as large as a city, provided the vast majority of the area is dirty. If the area is improved, the excess luck goes away and return to a normal amount of luck.
summary: The ability to make an area luckier the more dirty and decrepit it is.
strengths: Be really lucky in dirty places.
Bless whole negiborhoods, towns, or cities that have fallen on hard times.
weaknesses: Blessing only works on dirty areas.
As such, your blessing will inevitable fade as the area is reinvigorated.

name: Ocean Lordship
description: This is the ability to control everything in the ocean and the ocean itself. This does not mean you can generate things like life. But you can mutate life in the ocean to match a different description. You can also make ocean plants grow at your will.
summary: The ability to control the ocean and everything in it
strengths: You can go to the beach without fear of getting bitten by a shark.
When you go surfing, you can make big waves.
You can ride dolphins.
weaknesses: If there is a tsunami you will be blamed if people know about your power.
When you hear about shark attacks you might fill guilt because you could have stopped it.
People could try to assasinate you because they are jealous of your awesome power.

name: Mass/Density Manipulation
description: With this power, one can control both the mass and density of an object, including themselves. They may apply changes to the whole object or merely parts. Potential effects primarily include changing the size of an object, but one can just as easily make their bones super-dense to resist injury.
summary: The ability to alter an object's mass and density to generate a large array of potential effects.
strengths: Change an object's size via altering mass, density or both.
Alter durability of an object by manipulating density.
Make an object incredibly heavy or incredibly light.
weaknesses: Powers such as Immutability offer defense.
While you can expand existing supplies, you cannot create or duplicate them.
The full potential of this power i difficult to realize without some creativity.

name: Darkness Empowerment
description: A person with this ability will be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when in total darkness. The user will be granted enhanced speed, reflexes, strength,the ability to see in the dark and the ability to blend into the darkness to escape
summary: The ability to be granted enhanced abilities during the night or when the user is in darkness
strengths: Fighting crime at night is no problem at all
weaknesses: No enhanced abilities during the day

name: Fire Proof Skin
description: This is a type of immunity! Fire cannot burn your skin. However, extremely hot temperatures (hotter than 350 degrees Fahrenheit) can still hurt you! So Beware!
summary: The ability to not be burned by mere fire
strengths: Mere fire cannot burn your skin.
You can withstand temperatures up to 350 degrees Farenheit without taking damage.
weaknesses: Temperatures hotter than 350 degrees Farenheit can still cook you.
You're more vulnerable to ice attacks.

name: Myth Power: Ananeosis' Amnesty
description: Ananeosis, in Greek myth, is the goddess of renewal and restoration. As such, channeling her allows one to access Rapid Regeneration. In addition, one can psychically heal others to an optimum default state, by touch, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically mend scratched/dented/bent/broken/damaged items, by touch, at will. One can also restore spoiled, rotten, stale or moldy food to a perfectly fresh state, at will. One can even psychically restore lost/repressed memories, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ananeosis' command over the essence of renewal and restoration
strengths: Access Rapid Regeneration and heal others to peak physical health, by touch, at will
Psychically mend broken/damaged items, and restore spoiled/rotten/moldy food to fresh state, at will
Psychically restore memories, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically renew ammunition, food rations, etc into infinite supply until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically suppress/negate others' Healing and/or Rapid Regeneration, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically revive subjects from the dead (can only prevent/undo death's decay) (NCN)

name: Manakinesis
description: Manakinesis is the ability to manipulate and affect the force of magic, and also prevent those with the magic-based powers, like Sorcery, to not harm you with their powers, this includes Spell based powers. This does NOT include manipulation over physical (genetic) or mental powers. i.e. having wings are physical, or telekinesis (mental). Manakinesis is not a magical power, it is a "-kinetic" based of power, that controls the force that allows those with magical based powers to work their magic.
summary: The ability to manipulate magic, and mystical power, and those who possess magical based powers.
strengths: You can lessen the effectiveness of a spell caster / mage's power by decreasing their access to the "mana force"
Manakinesis can allow you to tap into magical based powers, and use them.

If a magical powered person is prevented from using magic by another manakinetic, then you can counter that by giving that person the force that control magic, depending on how much stronger with the Manakinesis you are.
weaknesses: Manakinesis not being a magical based power, means another manakinetic can't be stopped by your power alone.
This power defines magical based powers as being influenced by a singular, natural force, that connects it with the super-powered universe.
Doesn't protect against physical based or mental based powers.

name: Daily Reset
description: With this power you are able to go to sleep at the end of the day (for example) and wake up when you first did that day and relive that day a second time. This power can only be used once per day, so therefore you only get two runs of that day, the first initial run and the second when you use the power. Your memory remains normal. In order for the power to work, you must fall asleep before the end of the day (midnight) if not the power does not work.
summary: The ability to fall asleep and wake up when you first woke that day.
strengths: Relive every day twice.
Win every race, bet and lottery, dominate the stock market.
Always have a second chance within the immediate future.
weaknesses: Your ability to exploit this power is based on your memory.
You must fall sleep within 24 hours of waking up, if you doze off after midnight then you go to the next day, also not great if you have trouble getting to sleep.
You might get disorientated and lose track which run through you are on for that day.

name: Super Absorbency
description: If you touch any object you can absorb it's essence into your being.  You can do this with any object, whether it be a sword or a chocolate-unicorn-baby.
summary: The ability to absorb ANYTHING
strengths: You can use any weapon that you can absorb
weaknesses: There is a 50 - 50 chance that you will get injured by the object that you absorb

name: Empathy Weapon
description: By activating this power, you can imprint a copy of someone's personality on your soul just by looking at them, then create a weapon mimicking a copy of that personality. The strength of the weapon depend on its its strengths and weaknesses, as well as its personality's likes and dislikes. The name of the personality's owner will be inscribed upon the weapon somewhere.
summary: The ability to create a weapon from someone's personality.
strengths: You can use your enemies' personalities against themselves, resulting in a sure kill.
Capturing an enemies personality has a chance to capture their powers in the weapon.
weaknesses: Capturing too many personalities leads to a memory overload...
...meaning that you have to release some every one in a while.

name: Object Fusion
description: You have the ability to fuse any object with your body for as long as you would like.  Through contact with the object and a desire to fuse with it, it will become attached to your body and you will gain control over it.  For example, fusing a gun to your body will allow you to fire it with a mental command.  You can even fuse yourself to objects much larger than yourself, such as vehicles, and still have complete control.  You can separate yourself from an object at any time.
summary: The ability to temporarily fuse objects with your body.
strengths: Modify your body to accomodate any situation.
Take direct control of powerful weapons and vehicles.
Separate yourself at any time.
weaknesses: Many objects would have little use when fused to you.
The number of objects that can be fused with at once is limited by your body's surface area.

name: Bowel Manipulation
description: You can control using ones mind others poop. You can make someone crap there pants at any force. You can also control your own.
summary: The ability to Control ones own and others bowel.
strengths: You can make others crap there pants.
You can embarass enemies.
You use your mind so no one will no who did it.
weaknesses: The poop will have a strong smell.
Many find this power gross.
Regular poops will intense.

name: Iconoclast
description: Anyone or anything that has become fairly well-known to the public eye is capable of being damaged by you simply through touch, with the amount of damage ranging from complete disintegration to mild blunt trauma, depending on the fame of the item as a pop culture icon. This only applies to specific objects/people/images, in that, just because everyone knows what a gun is, does not give you any particular power over it.
summary: The ability to destroy popular culture icons through touch
strengths: Can destroy those annoying pop culture icons.
Beat up the popular kids at school easily.
Hold power over some of the most powerful people in the world; the bigger they are...
weaknesses: Doesn't work on generic objects, however well-known in concept.
If not careful, could touch and damage things you didn't mean to; no shaking the hand of your fav celebrity!
Can never become a famous person yourself.

name: Captain N's Super Powers
description: Captain N is the character of cartoons about games.  All skills can do video game characters using a joystick can do it to himself the character named Captain N with his Official Nintendo Entertainment System Joysticks. Captain N's weak point is that by using his super powers lot must be recharged for re-use.
summary: The ability to have super powers like the fictional character named Captain N
strengths: You can do any moves and atacks from playable Nintendo Entertainment System videogames moves and atacks.
You can do attacks using your Official Nintendo Entertainment System Zapper Gun
weaknesses: This have a weak point, the wake point is that by using his super powers lot must be recharged for re-use.
This superpower only works with the Official Nintendo Entertainment System Zapper Gun and Official Nintendo Entertainment System Joystick
You can do any moves and atacks from playable Nintendo Entertainment System videogames moves and atacks only.

name: Superhuman Endurance
description: An industrial robot has nothing on a person with Superhuman Endurance. They can run for days, lift weights for days, fight for days, and are no more physically fatigued than when they began.
summary: The ability to never become tired or fatigued
strengths: Become the ultimate marathon man
Win every fight by tiring them out
Get millions in overtime
weaknesses: Can still be hurt
Need to sleep
Are not super-strong, super-fast, etc.

name: Damage Control
description: With this power, one creates a field the size of 100 meters where the amount of damage inflicted is controlled. Any type of damage: cellular, blunt, slash, pierce, crushing force, psychic, psychological, dimensional, spiritual, even damage to the ego.
summary: The ability to control damage inflicted and received
strengths: By setting damage to 0% everyone around you is invincible to all types of damage
By setting damage to higher than 100% all people will have critical hits
Your power can work at the cellular level through concentration
weaknesses: You cannot heal injuries or disease, you can only delay it
If someone cannot breathe, they will still die
The effects of the field also apply to you

name: Bizarre Hydrokinesis
description: A person with this power can give bizzare properties to water. For example they can make ice be soft. People will sink into it like water but cant get out because they are stuck in ice-not snow. The can make the layer outside of water be separated by dimensions so to be uncuttable and intangible. They can also make steam solid like a wall. Water plasma can simulataneously combust and snow is hot. These characteristics cannot be turned off but the user can switch water states easily.
summary: The ability to control water while giving it abnormal characteristics
strengths: Goes against conventional knowledge of water
Ride on steam, trap people in ice, uncuttable water structures, exploding water plasma
Other parts of the water such as heat, speed, or direction can be controlled normally
weaknesses: You must have water
You have to use the bizarre properties when controlling water
You have to remember the properties or else you might do the wrong thing

name: Bubbles Of Unreality
description: This allows you to create a "bubble" in which you can control anything you want, and bring yourself and others inside. You could spend years in the "bubble" without any time passing in the real world. There would be no permanent physical effects when someone leaves, but they would remember everything that happened like it was a dream, and retain any skills they learned. This does not include any musculature needed to perform the skill, just the knowledge of how to do it.
summary: The ability to create temporary mini-worlds outside of our time and space.
strengths: You have a place to think or relax whenever you want it.
You always have time to learn new skills.
You can live out fantasies or express frustration without permanent consequences
weaknesses: You cannot directly affect the real world.
You might live out your ideal life, and then have to return to this one.
Could be addictive.

name: Commander In Chief
description: You can command anyone or anything to do anything! Just say the word and any object or person will do as you say if it is within their capabilites. For example, if someone can't read Arabic, you can't command them to, and you can't tell a car to fly away, but you can tell it to drive you wherever you want.
summary: The ability to command anyone or anything to do what as you say, within their capabalities
strengths: Always getting your way
Anything or anyone under your control
weaknesses: Your command has to be within the person or object's natural capabilities.
Could be worshipped by others

name: Repertoire Of Knowledge
description: If you have this ability, you automatically possess knowledge of a certain skill set or field of study. One may automatically be born with skill in cooking, technology, athletic prowess, how to play a particular game, how to fight, but it usually implies something that one may end up doing in one's lifetime (the knowledge is already present, so when a situation arises, you're prepared); sometimes, the user can psychically scan the collective subconscious to gain new skills and knowledge
summary: The ability to access innate knowledge of skills
strengths: Tests are a breeze
Wondering which wire will defuse the bomb? Now ya know...
Go into a career field requiring your expertise
weaknesses: If your field of knowledge is on a dumb topic
If you're stuck in a situation not pertaining to your knowledge or skill set
If you're nervous, you may forget the knowledge or trip up on certain skills

name: Danger Sense
description: It's not paranoia if they really are out to get you. A person with Danger Sense sometimes develops this mindset. They can tell when something that could potentially harm them is near, like a wet patch of ground, an enemy fist, or even a slightly putrid hamburger. This Danger Sense is usually linked with their reflexes, so they can dodge without looking at the object. However, it cannot be turned off and their reflexes are still human--a bullet will still hit them.
summary: The ability to detect impending harm
strengths: Universal--anything from a fist to bad food
Linked with reflexes
Never being surprised
weaknesses: Reflexes still at human levels
May become a touch paranoid
Unable to be turned off

name: Elemental Infusion
description: This ability is a real gift. It allows you to infuse anything with any of the elements. This includes fire, air, water, earth and lightning. It also includes the other elements such as darkness and light. For example, infusing a spear with lightning. The spear will then crackle with electricity, and electrocute anything it touches. It can then also shoot lightning from its tip. This can be done to anything and with any element.
summary: The ability to infuse things with any of the elements.
strengths: Creating elemental weapons
Can even be used on animals
With practice, you can even do this to yourself
weaknesses: Cannot be reversed
If the object is destroyed, it loses its element

name: Psionic Field Manipulation
description: WIth this power, you control twelve arms that can be used in any way imaginable. The arms vibrate fast enough to cut through steel and flesh and can also act nimble enough to pick up small objects like coins. They can multitask to perform things such as cooking, typing and making objects. They are also strong enough to support multiple tons and can deflect speeding bullets. Each arm also acts as another limb and can be used to feel your enviroment.
summary: The ability to control twelve psionic arms.
strengths: Do a lot at once
Always know what's around you
weaknesses: Any damage inflicted to the arms affects you both mentally and physically
Each action requires you to think about moving the limb
Any lost arm takes nearly a year to regeneate.

name: Levitation
description: Indian gurus have been doing it for thousands of years, but never on this scale. Levitation enables the user to make objects as much as half a ton lighter than air, thus making them float. The objects can then be lifted as easily as balloons. They can also make themselves float. However, there is no thrust that comes with this; the objects will drift aimlessly unless acted on by an outside force. Also, prolonged usage causes intense migraines.
summary: The ability to make yourself and other objects float
strengths: Can levitate up to 1000 pounds
Move normally heavy objects
Float above normal life or danger
weaknesses: Objects levitated will drift unless pushed in a direction
Requires some active focus
Prolonged usage causes intense migraines

name: Skill Mimicry
description: It takes all sorts of skills to make a society run. A Skill Mimic can tap into that. By merely standing near a person, they can take on their applied skills: surgery, martial arts, plumbing, etc. This has a range of 2 football fields and is limited to applied skills--no theory or mental skill.
summary: The ability to take on the skills of the people around you
strengths: Able to take on any applied skill
Being surrounded by skilled people
Martial arts, plumbing, archery, etc.
weaknesses: 2 football field range
Limited to applied skills
Being surrounded by unskilled people

name: Technological Omniscience
description: This ability grants the power to use any technology, from any dimensional plane / condition.
summary: The ability to use any technology via touch.
strengths: Use any technology, even beyond Earth Physics.
Can pass driving tests and wield weaponry like an expert.
weaknesses: Virtually a human weapon.
Unlike Technointegration, cannot be reversed.
Cannot use melee weapons, only mechanical-based.

name: Lady Luck
description: Your predecessors have spanned history for over thousands of years. The Greeks called the first and greatest Lady Tyche, and then the second Lady came into power, known to the Romans as Fortuna. The most recent Lady has conferred all her powers to you - and you may use them as you wish. As the current Lady, you are immortal until you pass your powers on to another, and can bestow infinite fortune to yourself and those you favor in a case-by-case basis. Chance means nothing to you.
summary: The ability to be an infinite source of luck.
strengths: Infinite luck!!! Dice games, lotteries, cards, raffles, et cetera - you can make them all succeed.
You may appear wherever some event's outcome depends largely on chance.
Limited immortality in the sense that you don't grow old.
weaknesses: Becoming the Lady turns you into a stunningly beautiful woman. Even if you started out male.
Your limited immortality does not mean you can't be killed.
The luck you grant will fade unless you apply more power. You can't make anything permanently lucky.

name: Astra Manipulation
description: A great manipulative ability. Very fast, and easily castable. However, it is hard to control due to it being so fast. Can be greatly increased when a violent storm is near. Not useable in a non-electrical area though.
summary: The ability to control lightning and thunder at will.
strengths: Great offencive ability.
Easily createable.
Highly destructive. (For supervillans.)
weaknesses: Could cause shock.
Not good against water.
Difficult to control for beginners

name: What If
description: Imagine if everything and everyone has been altered in ways you have never imagined. With this power you canLike you can. Change history, control reality etc. by saying the phrase "What If". You'll get mental records of the new situation and all the consequences (a la the movie Butterfly Effect), and you can always undo them (like restore points).
summary: The ability to change reality and alter history by saying the word What If.
strengths: A great use for saving lives and altering fates
Automatically become aware of the new situation and all the consequences
Can always return to an unaltered reality
weaknesses: Might use it to corrupt the universe.
Can become a ego-megalomaniac.
Reality Anchoring

name: Cat Landing
description: With this ability, you can jump from the highest buildings and be completely unharmed if you land on your feet. You can jump from an airplane and be perfectly fine by landing on your feet. If you don't land on your feet, the impact of the fall could hurt you.
summary: The ability to be unharmed from any landing if you land on your feet.
strengths: Not get hurt from the impact of the fall.
Jump from the highest places and be perfectly fine.
weaknesses: You have to land on you feet, or the impact of the fall might hurt you.

name: Ultimate Body
description: If your opinion of the perfect body is one that would make even Aphrodite jealous, this power would give you that body. If your idea of the perfect body is one with infinite dexterity you would get that. This power will give the holder anything that they think is part of their perfect body, but it only applies to the physical body. You only get to use this power once to get your perfect body. Once you use this power you can never again use physically altering powers on yourself ever again.
summary: The ability to have the body that you think of as the perfect body
strengths: You get whatever physical body you want.
Anything physical for your body is up for grabs.
Con: You can't make your body too powerful or your mind will shut down from managing too much power.
weaknesses: Your idea of the perfect body may change later in life.
Other people can change what you look like with powers but you cannot.
Transformation is defined as anything altering what your body looks, feels, sounds, or acts like.

name: Pan Dimensional Existence
description: Use this power and every dimension that can harbor an intelligent existence will suddenly have a version of you. A heavenly version, a hellish version, a nightmare dimension version, a kystian version, etc. This power doesn't make versions of you in every timeline in this dimension or other dimensions. You can communicate with these other versions of yourself, one at a time only. You can visit them with a dimensional travel power and they won't be hostile to you.
summary: The ability to exist in every dimension where intelligence can exist.
strengths: Insider knowledge of other dimensions.
weaknesses: If the heavenly version of you and the hellish version of you met...
If a kystian version of you meets any of the non-kystian versions of you.
If someone forces you to communicate with all versions of you at the same time.

name: Power Of The Epic Heroes
description: You have the strength of a hundred men, five times the speed of a cheetah, the ability to fly two times faster than a falcon.
summary: The ability to become a superhuman
strengths: Fly
Speed
Strength
weaknesses: Not original
Dangerous when not controlled

name: Genetic Skill Retention
description: This ability allows the individual to intuitively learn any skill after thinking about that particular skill, but only if their ancestors knew that skill. For example, if your ancestors were martial artists, and you happened to stumble upon anything related to that specific style of martial art, whether it be a word, a video, or a demonstration, you would instantly know how to use that skill.
summary: The ability to retain skills or traits from your ancestors.
strengths: You can intuitively know how to use any skill that any ancestor had.
You can learn multiple skills and keep them.
You can read a book and usually be guaranteed a new skill.
weaknesses: You can't receive skills from any relative in your generation (or further ahead).
People may notice if you just pulled a skill out of nowhere.
You may forget a skill if you don't practice.

name: Stealth
description: A person with Stealth is security's worst nightmare. With active concentration, they can become totally silent and partially invisible. This partial invisibility means that from a distance, they resemble a darkish blob. Even up close, facial features are obscured. However, the user is not totally invisible--they must still use cover if in an exposed place. The silent aura that surrounds a Stealthy person hides all the sounds of motion and reduces a gunshot to a mere coughing noise.
summary: The ability to become partially invisible and partially silent
strengths: Sneaking around
Partial silence can bring a gunshot down to a cough
Partial invisiblity obscures body shape at a distance
weaknesses: Can still be hurt
Not totally silent
Not totally invisible

name: Energy Sourcing
description: With this power, you can draw power from large or small but abundant sources of energy, such as turning kinetic energy into physical blasts or healing yourself with energy drawn from living plants or animals in the surrounding animals.
summary: The ability to draw power from large or small but abundant sources of energy.
strengths: Heal yourself.
Use energy for energy blasts or beams.
weaknesses: Might kill plants or animals the that the energy is drawn from.

name: Bioenergetic Conversion
description: Bioenergetics is the study of how energy relates to the human anatomy. Normally, people can only absorb chemical energy; a Bioenergetic Converter can metabolize electricity, heat, light, etc. The user does not get stronger, but can use the energy instead of food. Furthermore, they can convert the absorbed power into a more useful form. Chemical energy can become electricity, heat can become light, and so forth. There is of course the issue of unreleased energy gradually becoming fat.
summary: The ability to metabolize, store, and release energy
strengths: Absorb any form of energy
Use metabolized energy instead of food
Convert energy to a more useful form and release it
weaknesses: Cannot operate on reflex
Energy stored for a long time will be made into fat

name: Light Speed
description: When used, every person place or thing will seem to stop moving except for you. Breathing in air will feel like breathing in molasses and the ground will feel like ice, but you will put out so much force that  your touch will be able to destroy objects.
summary: The ability to exist on the borderline of time temporarily by moving fast as the speed of light
strengths: Stop existance
Destroy anything with a touch
Become more powerful then The Juggernaut
weaknesses: Hard to breathe
Very hard to control movement
And could destroy someone you care about

name: Jack Of All Trades
description: Your washing machine breaks down, wish you were a plumber? Lights on the fritz and wish you could re-wire the house? With this power just think of the problem and you can instantly learn skills to solve it, become a carpenter, architect,cook, martial artist you name it. More than just knowledge, this power makes you feel well-practiced at the art. Be a one-man maintenance crew, but you can only have a few skill sets running at once, dependant on their complexity.
summary: The ability to do what it says on the tin, learn any and every skill
strengths: Never have to call the handy-man again, save money
Build or sabotage your way out of most problems
Easy to get work
weaknesses: Can only run a certain number of skill sets at a given time
Could become confused between skills if they are similar and both active
Doesn't neccesarily arm you with the tools and materials you may need

name: Advanced Omnitrix
description: The Omnitrix is a watch that gives you control over the alien DNA within it. You can transform into any of the aliens with just a thought. You have control over the evolution of the Aliens and can use prehistoric or future versions of the aliens within. Hybrids can also be made by combining any of the aliens DNA. The clothes you wear are transformed into clothes wearable by the aliens.
summary: The ability to have full control over the DNA of 10,000 Aliens.
strengths: Can transform yourself into any of the 10,000 aliens.
Can use prehistoric or future versions of the evolution of the aliens.
Can create hybrids of the aliens within the Omnitrix.
weaknesses: So many aliens that you will not know all the powers that you have.
If the Omnitrix is broken you may be left with the default of only 10 aliens.
You can not add new aliens to the 10,000 within the watch.

name: Create Darkness
description: You have the power to create clouds of darkness that are so thick only you can see through (exceptions are people who have night vision or people who create light as a power.) The darker you make the darkness, the more it will drain you. Also, the longer/wider it is, the more it will drain you.
summary: The ability to create a darkness only you can see through
strengths: You can create darkness/shadows whenever you want
Sneaking around/eavesdropping will be so much easier
It will be easier to deal with headaches/migraines
weaknesses: If it's midday and if there's a shadow in a well-lighted area, people will know you're there
If you are against eavesdropping/stealing/spying, it is kinda useless
Most people with this power will be evil

name: Power Of The Ant
description: The user is able to lift up objects 30 times heavier than the user's weight. For example, if you weight 60kg you can lift up 1800kg with this power.
summary: The ability to lift up objects 30 times heavier than your body weight
strengths: Super Human Strength
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: Cant fly

name: Superhuman Pilot
description: A person with this power can drive any vehicle extremely well and give "superhuman" abilities to the vehicle they are driving. They have an aura that covers the vehicle they are piloting. They can drive any vehicle well from cars, to tanks, to mechs, to spaceships. Any vehicle they drive can be driven faster and has more power. Also, they do not need gas. The user has full control of their vehicle at all times and are able to pull off extremely hard maneuvers.
summary: The ability to drive any vehicle extremely well without former training and also give a vehicle superpowers
strengths: You can drive very well
Your vehicles will have superhuman abilities (more speed, power, bulletproof, break physics)
You never need gas
weaknesses: No powers unless in a vehicle
Vehicle can still be destroyed

name: Evolutionary Armory
description: Evolution is the best inventor, tinkering with organisms to make powerful toxins, deadly claws, and powerful muscles. An Armory can tap into these adaptations and manifest them on their own body. This allows them to use a bear's claws, a bee's venom, or even a shark's electricity-sensing.
summary: The ability to manifest the natural weapons of any creature
strengths: So much potential
Can even use extinct animal's adaptations
Combine adaptations (claws coated with neurotoxin)
weaknesses: Cannot add too much muscle to body
Cannot actually become the creature
Must be aware of creature and adaptation
