name: Reality Is A Story
description: You can shift reality to fit a story. From as basic as "there are werewolves" to as complex and the stories of King Arthur. Keep in mind that changes you do not intend for will occur, such as vampires appearing as well, or your neighbor being a werewolf or magician himself. The roles are either brought into existence or select a random person. However, if you use a specific character name, the person who exists with that name will have a very high chance of being in that role.
summary: The ability to change reality to fit any story.
strengths: Can change reality to suit needs
Can give yourself great power if used correctly.
weaknesses: Reality change is very limited
May end up harming others unintentionally

name: Bioelectrical Bolts
description: A person can use bioelectrical energy from a living being to generate naturally. It can project lightning bolts of up to 10 billion volts. It travels at speed of lightning up to 500,000 feet per second.
summary: The ability to generate and project bolts of bioelectrical lightning
strengths: Can control electronic devices and machines
weaknesses: not effective on rocks

name: Hot Matter Manipulation
description: With this power, you can control anything! The catch: It needs to have a lot (or at least a mild amount) of heat in it for you to control it. You control matter with varied difficulty, but the less heat it has, the harder it is to control, until it's impossible. This means you can control anything that is hot easily, but beginners only start with atoms and not subatomic particles.
summary: The ability to manipulate all matter, provided it has some degree of high temperature.
strengths: Control things like steam, plasma, lava and things at thousands of degrees easily!
Control matter as hot as the sun.
You can also control colder matter, but it could be very difficult.
weaknesses: You can also control colder matter, but it could be very difficult.
You can't make things hot with this power, only control them if they are there.
Useless in a really cold scenario, unless it has something warm in it.

name: Enhanced Memory
description: Most people remember around 55% of what they read or see. Imagine 100%. Reading a Spanish-English dictionary and becoming fluent, never forgetting an appointment or date, remembering what it was like as a baby...the possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to possess total recall in your memory
strengths: Never need memory aids
Become fluent in every language
Immune to Memory Manipulation
weaknesses: Still may not understand what is read
Not able to replicate physical events w/o training
May never give yourself a break for mistakes

name: Magic Minion
description: Every mage has their own minion. A minion (this is the most common name) is a being created entirely of magic. Depending on who created it, they will look and act differently from another mage's minions. The creator has complete control over them and can summon as many as they have the power for. The way the minions act and look like will depend on the mage's personality.
summary: The ability to create magical minions.
strengths: Can create an army of servants to do your bidding
They are based on your personality, so you're bound to like them.
They are always loyal to you.
weaknesses: Can only summon as many as you have the strength and power for.

name: Lunar Invincibility
description: If you have this power, you can do anything you want while the full moon or new moon is out
summary: The ability to do anything you want during a full or new moon
strengths: Do whatever you want
Be more extremely powerful than any other human
Impossible to be defeated 2 nights in a month
weaknesses: Can only use this power on a full or new moon
If not trained properly, you can't use this power when the moon is blocked (by clouds)

name: Aging Loop
description: You get to an age in your life when you feel too old. You will loop back to your age of choice and begin again. This will continue for as many loops as possible. You are semi immortal. Age and disease will not kill you but anything else that can, will.
summary: The ability to reach a certain physical age and then revert back to a younger age.
strengths: Live young, forever possibly,,,,,,
Age and Disease can never get to you.
weaknesses: Kill can mean killed in many other ways.
You cannot loop back when you want. The aging loop must be over 20 year span. 20 to 40 for example.
Your mind ages like everyone else. When you're 120, in you're mind you'll be a crabby old man.

name: Blackfire
description: Dark fire is super-heated, close to the heat of the sun. The dark matter (almost like telekinesis) contains it and directs it. It is solid due to the dark matter in it. Can be manipulated into shields/barriers, spikes/bolts, streams and waves. It is super strong but hard to control and keep contained. Has a huge drain on the human body and requires top training and massive self-control.
summary: The ability to generate black fire from the body
strengths: Super-heated to the temp of the sun
Solid as diamond
Extremely powerful
weaknesses: Huge drain on the body, only for high level mutants/heroes
Hard to control and contain due to the heat and dark matter
Due to the power, you are on your own

name: Time Extension
description: This ability grants the users the ability to isolate theirselves from the effects of time. In this way, you'll have more time to do whatever you want to do: more times for deadlines, sleep more, travel further etc. Think like Guldo's power, but without holding your breath. You must know what you use it for, like travelling to a certain destination. Then it will end and time will resume, unless you let time resume before that.
summary: The ability to produce more time for actions
strengths: You now have an extended deadline since you can still finish that report in 0 seconds
1 way time travel
weaknesses: This power is limited by a person's age since you cannot freeze yourself in time
Can lose track of time

name: Ambient Energy Absorb
description: Your power lets you absorb all the ambient energy around you, like electricity, radiation, light, heat, magnetic fields, etc. and then rechannel that energy elsewhere in your body.  You can redirect it as superhuman strength or speed, invulnerability, or the power even lets you direct the energy back as a compressed beam.
summary: The ability to absorb light, heat, magnetic fields, radiation, etc, and channel it to other areas like strength
strengths: Power source is everywhere
Limitless potential
weaknesses: Your power creates "cold spots" where no ambient energy is
You can short electronics out by absorbing more ambients than they have to give

name: Ultraman
description: Ultraman's power is derived from the distance between his current location and the sun. For example, if he is on Earth, he has superhuman capabilities like super strength, invulnerability, flight, heat vision and super breath. When he is on Mercury, those powers are tripled, on Venus it is double and on Mars his power is reduced to peak human capabilities. His only weakness is iridium, a rare metal on Earth.
summary: The ability to become Ultraman , the ultimate example of a superhero
strengths: Very powerful on Earth
Ultimate symbol of good and justice
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: If transported to another planet far from the sun, will become normal human
Will lose all power when exposed to iridium

name: Save
description: You can save your life just like you would save in a game and you can then later "re-load" this save if you so choose.  This immediately sends you back in time to when and where you were when you saved.  You retain anything you may have learned before you re-loaded however you do not retain any injuries or other physical trauma you might have experienced.
summary: The ability to save your life as you would save a game.
strengths: Can't make a bad choice
Always correct
Can avoid death
weaknesses: Must save in advance

name: Bone Morphing
description: This ability allows the person to morph there bones into weapons or other forms such as a beast or a different human form, for a limited time, the less bones used the more time you can use the ability. This ability can allow you to slice through almost anything.
summary: The ability to morph bones into many weapons or forms
strengths: Have weapons that can cut through steel
Can use up to one hour or more
weaknesses: Can only be used a limited time before having to rest
The more bones you morph, the less time you have to use the power
Rest may take half an hour before reuse

name: Accelerated Evolution
description: There are certain places on the planet where humans cannot live easily. Accelerated Evolution allows the user to manifest ways to get around that. Gills and webs for under the sea, reduced water usage for the desert, more efficient lungs and a hairy coat for Mt. Everest, etc.
summary: The ability to quickly develop adaptations to harsh environments
strengths: Never be hot or cold again
Be the best mountain climber, marathon runner, etc.
Live comfortably anywhere
weaknesses: Pretty disturbing to watch
Obvious
Involuntary

name: Elemental Body
description: The usable elements are fire, water, earth, wind, spirit, ice, energy, metal and life. You can use the element to make constructs of the same element i.e. a wind shield, an earth horse. Once the user loses conciousness, the wreathing element will disappear. Each element has an ability that goes with it: fire-heat resistance; water-water breating; earth-stone skin; spirit-6th sense; ice-cold resistance; metal-iron skin; energy-high metabolism; life-living things.
summary: The ability to wreath the body in an element of choice
strengths: It is a great offensive and defensive power
It can be used to create physical constructs of elements
Each element has an accompaning ability that is accessed by constant use of the element
weaknesses: Takes a while to switch from one element to another
Once an element is unused, the constructs made with that element disappear
Constant use of a certain element will weaken the other elements or change them

name: Goku Evoultion
description: When you are defeated, the foe was stronger than you, so with this power, exactly 5 days after you lose yo become 1 percent stronger than them.
summary: The ability to evolve or become stronger when defeated.
strengths: Become stronger than any opponent!
weaknesses: You can not become stronger than a god, or have the same power level as them.
They would probably become stronger in 5 days........

name: Shadow Wielding
description: A person who has the power of Shadow Wielding can make anything that they can think of, like armor or weapons. However, their power is only full if they are surrounded by darkness and they cannot move while they are activating their ability.
summary: The ability to bend pure darkness into any form or weapon
strengths: To have instant armor and weapons
Enpowered for the whole of the night
Useful in a team
weaknesses: Vulnerable to foes with super speed
Can't be used in daytime
Not useful without a team to guard while power activates

name: Superhuman Strength
description: With this ability, you will have the perfect physique and will be able to lift over a million pounds.  You will be incredibly strong, but will have absolute control over how much strength you're applying.  For the ladies, this ability applies to you too, but you won't look too muscular.
summary: The ability to have extraordinary strength.
strengths: Easily dig a pond in your back yard
Olympic gold medals up the wazoo
You can cash in on your abilities and become wealthy
weaknesses: You have almost no competition, which can be fun

name: Energy Claws
description: With this power you can create huge waves of blue cutting energy from your fingers, just by moving them. Those waves are one of the sharpest blades that ever existed and they are powerful enough to cut adamantium. If you don't be careful while using this power you will destroy everything around you in seconds.
summary: The ability to create huge waves of cutting energy from your fingers just by moving them.
strengths: You can destroy nearly anything
The energy waves are really big, and dodging them is not easy.
weaknesses: Hard to control.
Greatly tires you.

name: Unconscious Force Field
description: With this ability, while you're asleep or unconscious, you generate a field of protection around you which keeps you from harm. Anyone / anything that attempts to harm you will be forced back. Fortunately, it can determine what poses a threat, and what doesn't.
summary: The ability to be protected by an energetic field while asleep / unconscious.
strengths: No one can ambush you while you're 'knocked-out'.
The field is invisible.
This ability never makes mistakes. Ex: Someone waking you up will not be forced back.
weaknesses: Only protects you while you are unconscious.

name: Clear Pyrokinesis
description: Blue fire is supposed to be the hottest flame humans can produce with modern technology. Well, now you can with your mind create a flame that burns hotter than any other flame. However, the flame has no visible coloring on any type of vision, not even thermal imaging.
summary: The ability to create and control fire that is so hot it cannot be seen
strengths: You can use a flame that trumps all flames that have come before it.
weaknesses: Not even you can see the flame.
Your enemies will be laughing until they're burned by an invisible flame.
'Hahaha! Your stupid power has no effect on me! You're totally use-AAAAH WHY DOES IT BURN?!?

name: Naturespeak
description: One with this ability can communicate psychically with nature itself. This means that one can become instantly familiar with his surroundings, talk to plants and tell them to grow, and even talk to the skies to change the weather. In addition, the connection is so deep that the earth can respond to one's emotions and desires (blossoming with flowers and calming weather when happy, making skies stormy when angry, shifting the landscape to gain the advantage in a fight, etc. )
summary: The ability to communicate psychically with nature
strengths: Communicate with and command earth's environment psychically
Earth responds to your emotions
Earth will defend you from potential threats (and is aware of how to tell friend from foe)
weaknesses: If your power is weak, emotions may overreact and the power may go out of control
Doesn't allow you to communicate with animals (go figure, hehe)
DO NOT pollute if you have this power

name: Voice Of Destruction
description: This ability is a complex one, in that it is both sonic and not sonic. It is sonic because it indicates the voice, and yet not sonic because it does not amplify sound in order to attack. Instead it converts the user's voice into entropic kinetic energy. In effect, it destroys or distorts matter anytime the user opens his mouth to utter a sound. Even a loud sigh disrupts the air. In addition, it makes the user's voice harsh and dissonant to anyone within range of hearing it.
summary: The ability to produce a powerful and destructive sound with one's voice
strengths: Voice disintegrates matter for as long as you speak (and the louder, the greater the damage)
Surpass any silly sound resistance or manipulation
Disorient hearing beings without need for sonic-level volume
weaknesses: Invulnerability (until the power develops to the higher levels)
Vibration Channeling and Protected Hearing
Until the power is honed, it is best you keep your mouth shut...

name: Unity Force Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to manipulate the forces that allow things to unite literally or metaphorically.  Not only, the user can just fuse or defuse stuff, but they can prevent fusion. The user can make things that are assimilated or absorbed by something else not happen or vice versa. This ability also affect communities as well, in a different sense. The force that the user has can even cause a union of humans or animals to disperse or gather at the user's will.
summary: The ability to control the forces that allow things to fuse, assimulate, or connect.
strengths: Fuse or defuse things with a mystical force.
Disperse or gather groups of humans, animals, or other beings.
Cancel absorption, fusing, or combination-based powers of any kind.
weaknesses: None for now.

name: 12 Elements
description: My 12 elements: water, fire, earth (plants, metals, rock (processed or not)), wind/air, lightning, ice, light, darkness, spirit, illusion, creation (conjuring, inventing), and psychic (telekinesis, telepathy, levitation, foreseeing, psychic energy). The first six are easiest to master. The four after that are more difficult. The last two are the hardest to master, especially psychic. Creation allows the user to conjure solid objects only, but can be used to conjure some of the other elements.
summary: The ability to manipulate my 12 elements
strengths: Lots of elements to control
Some elements are easy to control
weaknesses: Some of the elements are hard to control

name: Graphic Deduction
description: This power allows you to holographically see the solution to a problem worked out in front of you. You naturally understand what the holographics are showing you, giving yourself a sort of false super brain by following the solutions the holographics present. The holographic solutions are always correct. Only you can see the holographics produced by this power.
summary: The ability to see the solution to problems holographically.
strengths: The holographics will always show you the correct solutions.
You will naturally understand the holographics.
Even if it's above your natural understandings, such as Quantum Mechanics.
weaknesses: Only you can see the holographics.
You are not super smart, just the answers to problems are given to you (it can't solve conundrums)
If you go blind then this power is useless.

name: Inherent Factual Omniscience
description: This power allows to give the correct answer(s) to any question where the answers are facts. Wether they asked it him/herself or someone else. It doesn't give knowledge about the future because that's not yet a fact.  That fact isn't automatically known to you unless someone asks the right question.  For example, someone can ask you how to make a device, and you'll know how. But you won't know a hitman is aiming at you when the question wasn't raised if you're being targeted.
summary: The ability to know the correct answer to any question about a fact
strengths: No more secrets
Asking the right questions will give you the knowledge about anything
If knowlegde is the key to power, then you have the key to ultimate power
weaknesses: If your power is found out you'll be a target for any organization or goverment
You won't know automatically if someone is about to kill you
You might be branded as a nerd. Even with an IQ below 60.

name: Nightmare Maker
description: Travel into and control dreams, even harm or kill the host.
summary: The ability to travel into dreams and bring someone's greatest fear to life
strengths: Make someone's fears attack them.
Attack someone in their dream.
weaknesses: Nightmares out of control.
Dreams come true, even nightmares.

name: Predictability
description: Its a bit like mind reading without all the personal details. You can know what people are going to say, do and how they will react to situations. You will be able to be very persuasive because they react differently according to what you say.
summary: The ability to know what people are going to do, say and how they will react.
strengths: You can tell when people are lying
Know what to say to people in order to get what you want.
You can help people because you will know what they want easily.
weaknesses: Life can get a bit boring

name: Night Color Vision
description: You can reap the awe inspiring benefits of this superpower. You can finally see the beauty and colors of a moonbow, instead of seeing things in black and white in the dark. However, this is not night vision. Night vision is black and white, although clearer. Special cameras are the only anything that can detect this awesome spectrum of colors. You will finally see the different colors of a nocturnal rainbow! Enjoy.
summary: The ability to see in color at night even in really dim light
strengths: See the color spectrum at night! See in color even in dim light.
See the colors of a moonbow. See a nocturnal rainbow instead of a white streak of light.
The perfect compliment to night vision(which is colorless).
weaknesses: The colors may not be too bright in a moonbow
You don't have night vision
You don't see better at night or see shapes any better

name: God Of War
description: God of War is the ability for one to have all knowledge of all types of physical combat. Wrestling of any kind, any type of martial arts, weapons combat, you name it.
summary: The ability to use any form or style of fighting that has ever existed.
strengths: Heighten reflexes and incredible movement speed.
Knowledge of the highest combat strategies.
Presence.
weaknesses: You're not invincible or anything, you're human and CAN be hurt.
You take playful wrestling with your girlfriend way too far.
Constant butt whooping can be tiring.

name: Nemesis
description:
With this power, you can adapt your powers to be able to fight a particular opponent. To do this, you need to be able to see your target and call out whatever name they are known by, making them your "Nemesis". You instantly gain powers best suited to battle them. 

The moment your Nemesis is defeated and unable to continue fighting, you lose all powers and can declare a new Nemesis.
summary: The ability to gain powers to fight a specific opponent.
strengths: Right powers to stop your nemesis
Versatile
weaknesses: You cannot decide what powers you gain
Cannot declare new Nemesis until they are unable to continue fighting
When Nemesis switches with another person, your powers might not be able to stop the new threat

name: Kinetic Mimicry
description: Kinetic Mimicry is the ability to mimic the kinetic energy contained within anything in your range. This means you can mimic the speed and reflexes of any superspeeder, no matter how fast they are. And you can mimic the strength of any being, human or animal, no matter HOW strong they normally would be over you. And you automatically gain the adaptations needed to survive the power and force you can produce at the time.
summary: The ability to mimic the kinetic energy of anything in your vicinity
strengths: Mimic the fastest beings alive (at the higher levels, combine your speed with theirs)
Mimic the strongest beings alive (at the higher levels, combine your strength with theirs)
At the higher levels, also mimic other movement type abilities (swimming, flight, jumping, etc)
weaknesses: Does not diminish foes's strength or speed
Mimicry is not permanent until the very highest levels
At the lower levels, mimicry limited to things in your range WHICH YOU CAN SEE

name: Solid Regenerative Blood
description: Solid Regenerative Blood not only heals you at a super accelerated rate, but it also makes you quite tough. S. R. B. Makes your skeleton diamond hard, your skin and tissues durable enough to withstand bullets shot from over ten feet, creates a pain cap that allows you to feel only up to a moderate amount of pain and will completely regenerate up to your entire body from a single drop of blood. (biggest chunk regenerates, all other chunks dissolve into goo, wound severity determines heal time)
summary: The ability to regenerate from as little as a single drop of blood
strengths: Makes you tough.
Caps the amount of pain you can feel.
You can fully regenerate from a single drop of blood.
weaknesses: Regenerating from a single drop of blood can takes about a year.
Regenerating lost lims entirely takes about a month, stabs and such take about 5 minutes.
Can not regenerate wound while object remains in wound.

name: Hyper Revolution
description: The Hyper-Revolution power involves the control of kinetic energy. If you use it on an object, that object will spin at the maximum speed its atoms can withstand. If an object is large enough, its gravitational field will pull in other objects.
summary: The ability to cause things to rotate at max speed.
strengths: Can essentialy create black holes with enough material.
weaknesses: Is contact-based.

name: Rise Of The Lightning Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a lightning dragon. You can shoot lightning bolts from your mouth, you're super strong, you can fly, you have sharp teeth and claws, you have a deafening roar and very hard armor like scales that cover almost your entire body. In dragon form you are unable to communicate except for in the language of the dragons unless you have the power Dragon Language in which case you have the ability to talk to humans in their language.
summary: The ability to turn into a lightning dragon
strengths: You can turn into a lightning dragon
You have a variety of powers outlined above
weaknesses: You can't speak english

name: Psionic Wolf
description: Summon a wolf created from the energy of your own mind, which exists in the form of a silvery-black mist shaped like a wolf, with glowing amber eyes. It is immortal and intangible to everyone and everything, except it's creator and master. Communicate telepathically with the wolf, and also sense it empathically. It has phasing, telepathy, clairvoyance, telekinesis, and invisibility, some of which it can pass to it's master if desired. Moonlight strengthens the wolf, and you can merge with it.
summary: The ability to create and control a psionic entity in the form of a wolf
strengths: When merged, the wolf is your companion and protector
Upon merging, the wolf can partially bestow it's own immortality and powers to it's master
The wolf is at your command, but can protect others you choose as well
weaknesses: If your mind is breached by someone with psychic powers, the wolf can be weakened
It's powers and physical abilities can be detected or weakened when your mind is breached
This power only works at night, or during either a full moon or lunar eclipse

name: Spatial Storage
description: Between this dimension and the next, small pockets form. You have gained the ability to open a rip into them, but not fully into a new dimension. Your ability only lets you open a rip from your location into said dimension, however you have more than one "Pocket" and you can have more than one rip open at once. Such as, you could turn one pocket into an office, and have the rip in a janitor's closet back in the office building, but when the person walks in, the door leads to your office.
summary: The ability to temporarily open a rip in reality into a small pocket dimension.
strengths: Could be used to have a portable inventory of weapons to choose from.
If you're fast enough, could send bullets to a pocket dimension instead of hitting you.
Can be used for transportation.
weaknesses: Rips can only be opened at your current location
Transportation would require you having been to your destination and leaving a rip.
Requires energy to make a rip, but sustaining rips is very easy.

name: Fractured Healing
description: This ability is influenced by emotion, making it very unstable. The user can heal injuries at an astounding rate, and also possesses the power to kill.
summary: The ability to heal or kill other living things with a touch.
strengths: Heal near-fatal wounds with ease.
Both healing and offensive capabilities
weaknesses: The ability is touch activated
Negative emotions can cause death if someone is touched.

name: Animate Art
description: The ability to breath life in to artwork,and summon it from the page it is printed on. This power does have a limit on duration, size, and quantity of summonings based on practice and natural skill. Animated works will take on a personality according to their appearance so, for example, you can't animate a caveman with the brains of Albert Einstein. The Artwork will be completely loyal to the Summoner and means of controlling the artwork are again determined by practice and natural skill.
summary: The ability to bring paintings and other artwork to life.
strengths: Being able to make up for physical shartcomings of the Summoner.
Able to adapt to different situations.
weaknesses: Having to carry/find artwork to animate.

name: Elemental Resistance
description: A lesser form of invulnerability. Allows the user to completely resist any elemental damage, no matter how great. Does not apply to physical damage unless elementally charged in some way.
summary: The ability to resist any elemental force (fire, cold, lightning, etc. )
strengths: Can't be hurt by fire.
Can't be hurt by cold.
Can survive lightning strikes.
weaknesses: You can still get shot.
You can still get stabbed to death.
Only works for the five elements: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Lightning damage

name: Positive Ability Feedback
description: A person with this power can gain any ability they get hit with only to be a better superpower user than anyone whose power they absorbed. The user has the ability to copy any superpower they get hit with. They must experience the power in its totality with their body in order to copy it. Now this is great for weaker powers that don't kill you, but useless for anything that can kill you in one shot. Also the user must be conscious to copy the ability-so no waking up with the ability later.
summary: The ability to copy the powers of other people except make it better at the same time but have to get hit first
strengths: Your version of someone's power is always stronger
Your version of the power also negates most of the cons
You can use several absorbed powers at once and combine powers together
weaknesses: You have to get hit with the ability first and you take all the damage of the ability
You have to be alive and conscious to copy any ability that you get hit with
More powerful and complicated abilities take multiple hits to absorb

name: The Memory Will Never Die
description: This power lets someone gain superhuman strength and healing powers from memories of their family and friends. It can be enhanced if you have telepathy, but evil people with psychic powers can weaken this ability, unless the memories are crystal clear to the user, and thus are made indelible.
summary: The ability to gain super strength, speed, stamina and healing powers from memories of your family and friends
strengths: Telepathy used to focus on the memories can exponentially strengthen this ability
Strong memories can make you near-invincible!
A side effect is a heightened memory, and clarity of the senses
weaknesses: Evil psychics can weaken this power, and thus your strength, unless you can fight it

name: Deathwrapped Gifts
description: Ever thought about how dying is so useless and time wasting? No, well here's something anyways! D. G is a passive ability that activates when you die. It bring you back to life in your original body! If that wasn't good enough you also receive a side power based on how you met your untimely demise! Por ejemplo, if you got your head cut off for some odd mafia related reason you would gain a power revolving around slicing or separation. Yep, with D. G you'll realy be looking forward to death!
summary: The ability to be reborn with a power related to the way you died in your previous life
strengths: Immortality is always a plus, right?
There are so many different side abilities you could receive. So try and collect them all!
You'll always be reborn in your original body.
weaknesses: You still feel pain.
The power you have in a previous life will always go away when you start the next life.
It's kind of random what power you will get.

name: Photon Manipulation
description: With the ability to control light, you will have plenty of abilities. Illusions would be the first on the list. Concentrating light into a laser for offence. With enough pressure, you would even be able to add concussive force into your light based attack. The illusions won't be solid however, and any "clone" of yourself or others would not be able to take damage or make sound. With a little imagination, this power can go a long way!
summary: The ability to control all forms of visible light
strengths: Both offensive and Defensive abilities.
Change your appearance
Awesome illusions/mirages
weaknesses: Offensively limited
illusions are just that, illusions

name: Ability Introduction
description: With this ability, you can gain any superpower at will. However, you can only have one at a time, and you can't switch to a superpower that you've used before. You can have any ability that you can imagine, EXCEPT Omnipotence, or Omniscience. For example, Telekinesis would be fair game, but if you switched to Super Strength, you would be unable to switch to Telekinesis again.
summary: The ability to switch to different abilities at any time, as long as you've never used them before.
strengths: Multiple options of superpowers, as you can switch to almost any ability at will.
Every ability that you switch to will be a new experience.
weaknesses: Can't switch to a superpower more than once, so your options are lowered.
You should have some way to keep track of the powers that you use.
You can't use Omnipotence, or Omniscience.

name: Positive Compulsions
description: You will be compelled to do exactly the perfect thing at any given moment. For example, if a building near you is going to be set on fire at 5:00pm, from the time you wake up till the time the fire is set you will have the urge to go to the building and stop the fire before it gets out of control--even though you don't know about the fire yet. You won't be compelled to do anything you are incapable of doing, like running in the building at 5:20 and carry out 50 people on your back.
summary: The ability to have the urge to do whatever leads to the overall best outcome
strengths: Always "know" to bring an umbrealla even if seems like a sunny day
Can't lose in a video game if you don't even need to learn the controls
If you meet your soulmate you won't let them slip through your fingers
weaknesses: People may suspect you setting things up so you can fix them
May be compelled to do odd and seemingly pointless things
You might not like the Greater Good (Charmed / Smallville)

name: Brain Control
description: This ability allows the person to manipulate and control any person that they wish, and with a single thought can "persuade" them to obey and commit their master's will and wish. The more powerful that person is, the more people that person can control.
summary: The ability to manipulate someone's mind
strengths: Control a person
"Never can get your hands dirty."
The more powerful, the more population control
weaknesses: Occasional headache
With more practice, headaches occur more often
Takes a lot of brainpower, too much exhaustion

name: Serpent's Tongue
description: Every single lie, deceit, trickery, and con you do/tell becomes undetectable.
summary: The ability to lie without being detected.
strengths: People will believe in you, even how unbelievable your lies are.
Easily persuade someone to be sympathetic with you.
Use it to turn the tables around!
weaknesses: It still a lie. That means that every lie you said is fake/untrue
If used too much, you might get used to telling lie.
Could make some situations complicated.

name: Suspended Rebirth
description: Usually used for more powerful beings, if your fatally struck, your body becomes a gelatin cocoon after one hour, inside the cocoon a new body gets created, making you stronger than before. Your soul is also in a suspended state, therefore you have no idea of whats happening outside your cocoon. The only way to destroy someone with this power is to incinerate them.
summary: The ability to regenerate
strengths: New body
More powerful new body
weaknesses: Vulnerable
Can't be left alone.
Takes time to achieve new body.

name: Object Creation
description: Everyone remembers that one time when they wanted a small toy for Christmas-- a doll, a pocketknife, cowboy boots. An Object Creator can make these objects and others like them using their mind. This isn't limited to toys-- grenades, handguns, knives, and all sorts of neat stuff are creatable. There are some catches: the object has to be less than 15 pounds, it takes a massive amount of concentration, and it can't be too complex (no laser guns).
summary: The ability to create small objects with your mind
strengths: Weapons
Toys for Christmas
Decks of cards for long trips
weaknesses: Massive amounts of concentration
Cannot be larger than 15 pounds
Cannot be overly complex

name: Adaption
description: Your body automatically adapts to any situation. If you're in a dark place for a long time, you get night vision. Stepping into daylight won't hurt because of your body adapting. You gain dense bones after getting in a fight, etc. However, it responds to the body's needs, not the mind's, so you won't get invisibility or camouflage. Also, you can't get rid of any of the adaptions, and you can't control what adaption you'll get for the situation.
summary: The ability to have your body adapt to anything
strengths: Literally ready for most situations
Eventually no weapon or disease can harm you
weaknesses: Can't remove adaption (might have gills, rhino skin, etc)
Can't control what you'll get
Won't respond to mental needs (don't want to be seen, etc)

name: Cryokinesis
description: This is the power to generate and manipulate ice and cold. Lower the temperature to as much as -200 degrees Celsius. Form constructs like armor, weapons, shields, barriers and slides by freezing moisture in the air. Control ice, snow, hail, and cold air with frigid precision. Even start avalanches and snowstorms, given the right environment and proper training.
summary: The ability to generate and manipulate cold and ice
strengths: Use cold and ice as a powerful weapon
Cold Immunity (Immune to own power and external cold)
Pretty impressive ability (even potentially alter weather or stop all activity in the region)
weaknesses: Not particularly spectacular
Heat and fire are a big weakness
Fueled by concentration, not emotion

name: Visual Imagination
description: By digging into your brain's visual stimuli, you can create an extremely detailed world in your mind. One analogy of it is like playing your own video game in your head. It's only stable if the user can control their thoughts fairly well. Also, you have to be in a meditation-like state to use this power.
summary: The ability to control what you see.
strengths: Make detailed worlds.
Useful with architecture or house design.
weaknesses: Have to be in a meditation state.
Your thoughts have to be stable.

name: Dimensional Double Life
description: This ability is good for spies, warriors in battle, or some lazy bums. This ability into two duplicates. One duplicate is the one that lives in our universe, doing regular thngs and stuff. The other duplicate is in that parallel universe where no one can see or hear you. That duplicate's job is to perform the user's true intention or objectives. That duplicate is hidden in that universe so nothing could stop it. This parallel dim. Is different. The duplicate can interect in both worlds. See pro2
summary: The ability to split into two parallel selves in order for one to perform the user's true intentions while hidden.
strengths: Perform your true intention without interruption.
The other duplicate interects physically through touch by choice. If not, he phase through stuff.
When objection is complete, the two unite.
weaknesses: Dimensonal abilities or device could find the other duplicate.

name: Neuroburst
description: The Neuroburst power lets the user generate a concentrated electrical pulse inside a target being. This pulse can disable a person's nervous system, leaving them unable to fight. Weaker versions of this power cause pain in the nervous system. It can be long-dstance or contact-based.
summary: The ability to short out a human or animal nervous system.
strengths: Can prevent the target from attacking.
May be able to cause paraylisis.
weaknesses: Contact-based Neuroburst requires contact with bare skin.

name: Kinetic Boost
description: When you boost up your energy you can create a speed force and shock-waves your body gets stronger and you get faster.
summary: The ability to boost up your kinetic energy
strengths: Shock waves
Telepotation
Speed force
weaknesses: Some times it may not work if you are tired
It can give you a sugar rush
Can only go is speed force once a day

name: Reading Duplication
description: Some examples, if you were to read a book about gambling, you could go to Vegas and win limitless amounts of money. Or you could read about Someone with super powers and get the powers of that individual
summary: The ability to do or imitate anyone, anything, or any action you read about
strengths: Information grants strength
Can be used to get out of almost any situation or make oneself invincible
Increases intelligence with every use of the power
weaknesses: Powers gained are temporary
Can be rendered useless if blinded or illiterate
All uses of powers must be planned in order to have proper material to read

name: Super Jumping
description: This power allows you to jump to a height of up to a mile. This is useful to get an aerial view of a target. A direct landing on a target causes them damage, yet you will be unharmed. When you land, the impact will cause tremors that extend to 3 miles away from the landing zone. When in midair, you are immune to air resistance. Plus, it's fun!
summary: The ability to jump to great heights and cause tremors when you land.
strengths: Jump to a height of a mile.
You can cause tremors.
It's Fun!
weaknesses: None

name: Repulsive Wave
description: This is one of the more unique abilities. A person with Repulsive Wave can create a shockwave from their hands that pushes objects away. This can range from as little as a hard shove or as much as a powerful maelstrom which strips flesh to the bone and sends cars flying for half a mile. This ability can only be produced from your hands.
summary: The ability to produce a directed wave which hurls objects away
strengths: Powerful deterrent
Is directed by your hands
Ranges from 'hard shove' to 'strip flesh'
weaknesses: Need hands to direct wave
May be regarded as menace

name: Infinite Memory Palace
description: A memory palace is a mental method typically used by mnemonists and memory champions to organize and easily recall information. While it normally takes a long time to build and sustain in one's mind, this ability gives its user their own personal self-organizing memory palace with an infinite amount of rooms to store any information. With time and practice, the user can even populate each room with made-up or important characters to give more life to their palace and help recall information.
summary: The ability to have a memory palace with infinite rooms, corridors and floors.
strengths: You have Enhanced Memory and each memory palace is different from one person to another.
Protects against memory intruders, as they will have a hard time navigating through the palace.
If this power is stolen, mimicked or negated, stored information will remain in your memory.
weaknesses: If this power is negated or stolen, you'll have a hard time recalling information.
People with extraordinary memory are generally considered as creeps.

name: Nanotech Upgrade
description: The person with this power is able to upgrade vehicles or take over electrical objects by the use of an a nanotech arm. When in use to upgrade vehicles,a cable will come out from the arm; the more cables, the higher/faster the upgrade. The arm shoots a cylindrical bullet that releases nanites which override the electrical object programming. The arm is almost indestructable
summary: The ability to have a nanotech arm that can upgrade vehicles or take over other electrical objects
strengths: Good for upgrading your beat up car
Good for upgrading your car to catch fast villains
Can infiltrate and take down enemies that use a lot of tech as their arsenal
weaknesses: An EMP burst will short out the arm.
The arm can be destroyed or ripped apart from the user if a huge amount of strength is used

name: Doorman
description: This power allows you to create, control & manipulate multiple teleportals that allows your whole self or your body parts or other people & objects to cross to another area instantly. Think of the power that Spider-Man's villain The Spot has. If you are at A & B is in the way of C, the portals allows you to bypass B all together. But be careful, making & controlling the holes takes concentration, you have to close them or they could become black holes.
summary: The ability to create wormhole portals to travel instantly through
strengths: Create & control wormholes
Teleport your self or your body parts or anything else vast distances instantly
weaknesses: Creating & controlling the portals takes effort
Have to close the portals after using them or could become potential uncontrolable black holes

name: Unconscious Invocation
description: This power means that when you feel in danger, a pysical projection of your subconscious will defend you in anyway. For instance, if someone is about to shoot you, a being that is the manifestations of your inner desire of self preservation will appear and protect you from harm. This thing can do just about anything depending on your strengh and bravery. You won't be able to use this ability at any other time than when you're in danger. This manifestation can look like an animal/you/whatever.
summary: The ability to summon a protective force when in danger
strengths: You'll be protected from anything/anyone.
No one will want to mess with you.
Having some feeling of security
weaknesses: If you have been knocked out, your power won't work
If you have been heavily drugged, your power won't work as well
Having doubts about your power won't make your chances of being saved high

name: Physics Distortion Waves
description: With this power you disperse waves of energy like substance that has the ability to distort the physics of whatever it hits. For instance, if you shoot someone, anything you can thing of (that is against the laws of physics) will happen. The person could turn inside out, his weapon could melt, he could be frozen right at the spot! But there's a catch, the result is unpredictable. So you could make him a living fire ball, or if you hit yourself you could turn into talking chicken!
summary: The ability to send out waves that can distort physics
strengths: Freeze enemy's in their tracks
Break the laws of physics to be better at things, like sports
You could make yourself fly
weaknesses: Make enemy's more powerful
Possibly freeze or doom yourself
Effects unpredictable

name: Bi Time
description: This ability was inspired by the word "Bilocation", to be in two places at once. This ability allows its user to live in two time periods at once. The user of today can also be seen in the past or future as well. They are the same person. They think, feel, and act the same, but with possible forms of mannerisms depending on the time period they are in. This has future changing capabilities. If the one of users died, The other as well. Since, they are the same person.
summary: The ability to be in two different time periods at once.
strengths: Be in two different time periods at once
Manipulate the future
weaknesses: The time period the user is in is random unless one of them has a time machine.
When one dies, the other dies as well.

name: Power Reinvention
description: The user has to be near the person once to copy and reinvent their power. For example, if someone had the power to change the size of their hands, the user then copies the power then recreates it to becomes the user's unique version of that power. Now, the user can shoot a beam that makes anyone's hands big.
summary: The ability to absorb the essence of other superpowers and reinvent it to become a new power.
strengths: Gain many powers.
The powers you get are permanent.
weaknesses: The person's power that you absorbed is not taken away.
The power is not chosen by the user.

name: Ambient Temporal Field
description: This power can create a field of "ambient time" around things or people. In a place where no time exists the field can allows the user to move freely, because they have their own time to rely on. The field itself is influenced by the user and can change depending on their will. It can also isolate things, like a room, from the effects of time or isolate anything but the thing/room from the effect of time. So you can choose to let time pass inside or outside the field.
summary: The ability to generate a field of ambient time around things and people.
strengths: A personalized field of time.
Can act as protection in an area with no time AND can protect against time freezes.
Exclude things from time
weaknesses: Time manipulators can still manipulate your field.
If your stuck in a place without time AND space.

name: Radiation Energy Blast
description: The user is able to shoot radiation energy bolts and beams from his or her hands. The radiation will only effect the person it hits. The radiation will not affect, the user's allies as the user does not emanate radiation from his body unless he or she uses the power.
summary: The ability to shoot radiation energy
strengths: Very powerful power
weaknesses: Carbon will render this power useless
Unknown side effects to user in the long run

name: Mathematical Manipulation
description: With this power, 1 plus 1 equals 3! This power enables you to manipulate mathematics within a radius of 50 metres. The entire logic of math is changed with this power, and it will make complete sense, no matter how absurd. And get this: You can change what happens in reality by messing up math! For example: Moth flying times (speed of moth plus mass of your lunch)equals moth growing larger! And afterwards, you can revert maths back to its normal, logical self. 5 minus 3 equals 56!
summary: The ability to manipulate mathematics
strengths: Change the rules of mathematics, so what wouldn't normally make sense is absolutely correct!
Radius of 50 metres, and reversible.
Change trajectories, angles, aims, people's minds, etc.
weaknesses: You might want to know a lot about math, so that there is more for you to warp.
You might not want to reverse the effects, but sadly you have to.
People might not get this power

name: Fire Manipulation
description: A person with this power can use existing heat source & amplify it & manipulate it. They can't create fire, just control it. Craft it into shapes & move it. You can even surround yourself, but you can still get burnt & die of smoke inhalation.
summary: The ability to mentally control fire
strengths: Control fire
Amplify heat source
Move & make shapes out of fire
weaknesses: Not immune to burns
Not immune to smoke inhalation

name: Vehicle Transformation
description: This power allows you turn a vehicle into another vehicle. Got an old, battered car that needs replacing? Just turn it into a brand new one, whatever kind of car you want! Or you could turn a rotting rowboat into a motor boat, or a cruise shp! Need to go into battle? Turn your vehicle into a tank, a fighter jet, a battleship! Turn a bad guy's get-away car into an old horse and carriage. Respond to an emergency with a police car, ambulance, or fire truck. You can even use a rocket.
summary: The ability to turn any vehicle into any other vehicle
strengths: Free Ferraris, cruise ships, and private jets from broken cars, rowboats, etc.
Fight on land, on sea, and in the air
Make enemy vehicles useless
weaknesses: Can only transform vehicles into other vehicles
Can't turn something into a vehicle that doesn't exist

name: Jedi Mind Tricks
description: Anybody with this power can fool gullible people into believing what they say. They will repeat what you just said as if it were truth. This can also work if you wave something of value over someone else since they become more susceptible to this power when this happens. This is a weak form of verbal hypnotism.
summary: The ability to fool the weak-minded
strengths: Fool the guards to let you out
Get away from small accidents
The other person is left dazed after you finish using this power
weaknesses: You will probably become a con artist

name: Mirror Manipulation
description: The person with this power is able to manipulate the properties as well as reflection of mirrors. This means that the user of this power is able to travel or teleport using mirrors, trap their enemies inside mirrors in a mirror dimension as well as conjure up illusions with mirrors
summary: The ability to manipulate the reflection as well as the properties of mirrors
strengths: Can travel using mirrors, that are almost everywhere in the city
Can trap enemies in a dimension inside the mirrors
Can conjure up illusion in mirrors to confuse enemies
weaknesses: If there are no mirrors around, this power doesnt work

name: Animal Translator
description: With this power you can talk to animals and understand what they're saying. This power works on all animals including humans so you will be able to understand foreign human languages as well as speak to birds, insects, fish, arachnids, mammals, reptiles, amphibians etc. Being able to talk to animals does not mean that they are under your control but you can ask them to help you in battle and they might help. You can turn this power off so you're not constantly hearing what animals are saying.
summary: The ability to understand what animals are saying and talk to them in their language
strengths: You can understand and talk too all animals
You will understand even human foreign languages
You can turn this power off if you want
weaknesses: The animals are not under your control

name: Mind Set
description: By controlling one's mine he/she will be able to set their mind in to an object revealing to them what has happened in the past to that specific object. This also in turn gives you all information on what the object is about. Example: Setting your mind into a computer can give you all it's info like age, data etc. You may also use this against opponents by stealing any battle strategies and such other things.
summary: The ability to gain information from any device or organism through mind connectivity
strengths: Steal info. From others
Store memeory in your brain
weaknesses: You have limited storage space
You may lose memeory
Brain damages may occur

name: Liquid Neon Hydrant
description: With this superpower, you can shoot liquid neon out of your palms and freeze things instantly. You can shoot up to 25 gallons of liquid neon per second. You are limited to 1000 gallons of neon per day. At first, you can only dispense 10 ounces per second of liquid neon.
summary: The ability to shoot liquid neon out of your palms and freeze things instantly.
strengths: Shoot liquid neon out of your palms.
Freeze things.
It's supercold.
weaknesses: You have to practice to develop this superpower.

name: Light Bridge
description: The user can create a path a light between two locations. The path must be connected to an object at two opposite ends though to form a bridge. If the points the bridge is connected to is moved the bridge dissipates. The light bridge can be used as a shield or to cut through objects that are located between the two points. The user must see where to place the light bridge. Only a limited number of bridges can be created at one time.
summary: The ability to make a solid path of light between two points.
strengths: Create a path between two locations.
Can be used as a shield or to cut through objects in the bridge's way.
The light bridge will stay until it is deactivated or broken.
weaknesses: Has to be connected at two points, so no platforms in the air.
Can be destroyed by breaking the points the bridge is connected to.
Only a few light bridges can be produced at one time.

name: Lightning Armor
description: The user is able to generate an immensely powerful lightning armor around his or her body. The lightning armor makes lightning attacks almost impossible to hurt the user of this power. The armor also super charges the neural synapses. This means that the user can react faster to danger and push their body to their extreme limits, granting them extreme powers
summary: The ability to generate a lightning armor around his or her body.
strengths: Transonic Speed
Electric-enhanced strength
Immune to electrokinetic users
weaknesses: User may get the feeling nobody can beat them

name: Shield Of Light
description: This power allows a person to summon the silver pendant with the jade gemstone, that Lucian, leader of the Lycans, wore in 'Underworld'. It is completely indestructible, and can return only to its first wielder if ever misplaced. The source of its power lies in the gemstone at its center, which can be connected to the person's mind at will. They are granted self-regeneration, pyrokinesis, healing, telekinesis, flight and superb fighting skills.
summary: The ability to wield special powers from Lucian's silver pendant
strengths: The pendant can only be worn, and its powers wielded, by a good person.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis and telekinesis, are very good powers to fight with.
Have partial immortality in addition to superb fighting skills!
weaknesses: Takes time to unlock the pendant's full power.
Some powers, such as pyrokinesis, might be dangerous.

name: Crystal Generation
description: The crystals generated are clear in color, similar to a diamond, and can be as durable as the generator wishes. They can be formed into weapons or other objects or used to create a bridge etc. The generator may also create an armor around them.
summary: The ability to generate crystals of varying strengths from or around your body.
strengths: You can become pretty much invulnerable to most things if used correctly.
Useful for creating objects that aren't too complicated to use.
weaknesses: Doesn't enhance your physical traits.
Although the crystals are light, they can increase your weight if used too much.

name: Bullet Time
description: When fighting, you can slow down the perception of time making everything slow movement to sped up. You have from a micro-second to a minute of added reflex, agility, & speed as time slows. Countering an attack or dodging. As your time manipulation ends, everything starts to speed up till its normal. You don't have all the power like in the Matrix or 300 & the One, just half. Not super strength or fly. Just a little bending of physic laws.
summary: The ability to manipulate & slow time in combat
strengths: Slo-mo fighting
Added speed & agility of up to a minute
weaknesses: Only have a short time frame of power
Not as powerful as seen in bullet time fighting movies

name: Chance Of Success
description: Increases the probability of your bet successfully becoming true only if you bet on the outcome with the lowest probability of occurring. The outcome is not guaranteed to occur with this power but those with mastery of this power can cause the probability to increase to 50%. Works on any bet that is made with other people. Works on the lowest probability outcome out of a set of outcomes that you are aware of.
summary: The ability to increase probablity if you bet on the outcome with this lowest probability of happening.
strengths: Have a higher chance on winning bets that you would normally lose.
Can be used to make a lot of money.
Can have different effects depending on what is being bet on.
weaknesses: If a bet has two outcomes with equal chance of happening then this power does nothing.
Can only raise probability to 50% so you can still lose.
Only works on the outcome with lowest probability.

name: Tissue Generation And Control.
description: With this power, you can create biological tissues that can give you new or stronger abilities. You can make more muscle tissue to be stronger or can create the tissue of an electric eel's electric organ for biological zapping powers. You can regenerate if you're hurt, but this will require many tissue regenerations. You do have to have bulky arms if you add more muscle tissue. You can however make the created tissues go away at will.
summary: The ability to control and generate biological tissue.
strengths: Don't have to consume water or food.
Can get other creative powers like electric eel organ tissue or bone spikes.
Can be super strong in seconds.
weaknesses: Must have imagination.
Have to be logical, tissues can make energy out of nothing but no super magic or other weird tissue.

name: Event Cloak
description: Unlike classic invisibility cloaks, which bend light around an object, an event cloak would open up a time gap in the light by slowing its speed, and then sealing it again to hide all traces of activity within the gap. It works like crossing a special highway where some cars slow down, creating a jaywalker-friendly, vehicle-free gap, before speeding up again to re-establish the seamless flow of traffic. Event cloaking would allow you to do pretty much anything without anyone knowing.
summary: The ability to create a time gap within light
strengths: Rob a bank in broad daylight becaue no one can see you, or any of your actions for that matter
No one can prove you ate the last cookie
Security cameras are useless since you and anything you do is hidden within the light
weaknesses: Motion sensors
You can still make noise, so it's best to do things quietly

name: Cheat Code
description: Cheat codes are no longer just for video games; with this power, you can use cheat codes for real life. Skip - Next significant stage in your life. Redo - Do over a stage in your life again. 2nd Chance - Like having many lives; basically, you cheat death.  You can do any cheat code that you can relate into your life. Cheat codes for life aren't actual codes--you just input the code into your mind.
summary: The ability to use cheat codes in real life.
strengths: Can use cheat codes when playing sports, taking test examinations etc.
Skip boring moments of your life.
Redo your mistakes.
weaknesses: Skipping stages in your life defeats the purpose of your life.
Cannot control what happens when skipping stages.

name: Gift Of Dionysus
description: You can enchant any body of liquid (within a container, cup, etc., it cannot be directly from the tap). You can turn a regular glass of tap water into an elixir that heals all wounds, a love potion, an invisibility serum, or spike the drinks of others and have an army of slaves. You must be touching the object which contains the liquid, or the liquid itself. The maximum amount of liquid you may enchant is limited by your weight, e.g. if you weighed 100kg, then the limit you may enchant is 100L.
summary: The ability to manipulate and enchant water, or any body of liquid with magical qualities
strengths: Cure diseases. They can also be made to work for a limited time FYI
Make yourself and others smarter, younger, fitter, give them powers even!
An army of eternally loyal slaves to do your bidding
weaknesses: Could get into the wrong hands,
If you give you friends powers, it could corrupt them and they might go on to tell others about you
Use it as many times as you like but the amount you can enchant is limited by your body weight

name: Shadow Kinetic Pulse
description: The user can steal the potiential energy then merge it into a grayish kinetic pulse. The objects and living things will be blown away especially those that can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a shockwave.
strengths: Powerful shockwave attacks
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Mobile Invisibility
description: Someone with this power can be invisible, but only while they are moving around. Until the higher levels of this power are reached the holder of this power cannot control whether they become invisible or not while moving around. Automatic functions of the body do not count as movement.
summary: The ability to be invisible while you're moving around
strengths: Can sneak around, but only while moving around.
Makes the whole body invisible regardless of what is moved.
If you have Superhuman Stamina.
weaknesses: Some users can only make the body part they're moving around invisible.
Forgetting that you have to move around for this power to work.

name: Willpower Mimicry
description: The Will, is the most powerful primal inner force that can exist inside any conscious being. It is the power that drives our ability to choose & act. Even though it is unseen or unheard at most times, its manifestations in the physical realm is undeniable. A person with this ability is a very formidable opponent; being able to transform himself into pure willpower he has omnipotence over his own will & actions & can control the freewill or actions of others living and non-living alike.
summary: The ability to transform into pure willpower.
strengths: Time, Space, & anything in it is a slave to your freewill. Induce them to act according to your wish
When you are in this form you are intagible, indestructible, and unpercievable by the 5 senses.
You are immune to all types of control or attack that targets the mind.
weaknesses: When in this form both body and soul is rendered nonexistent.
You cannot directly attack anything or anyone with this form, you can only control them.
People that possess strong willpower can resist you.

name: Peak Human Potential
description: Also known as peak human physical condition, this is the ability to reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter. This primarily involves the vastness of human feats such as athleticism or combat, with marksmanship included.
summary: The ability to reach a level of physical fitness beyond that of a superb Olympian or fighter.
strengths: Your strength would be at the pinnacle of human perfection.
You would be able to run and move at speeds superior to those of any Olympic athlete.
Your musculature would be considerably more efficient than that of an average human.
weaknesses: Your strength would not be superhuman.
Your endurance and stamina would be limited.
You would still be susceptible to illness and injury as any normal human is.

name: Immunity
description: You will never get sick ever again.  You will always be healthy in terms of viruses and diseases.
summary: The ability to be immune to all viruses and diseases.
strengths: Never have the flu, a cold, or get sick for that matter.
Immune to cancer
Less co-pays!
weaknesses: You can still get injured (but with no infection!)

name: Fourth Dimensional Existence
description: We live in a 3-D world. But there are more D's than meet the eye. A person with this ability exists in 4 dimensions. This allows them to do many feats, like stand outside the 3rd dimension and thus become invisible and intangible, knock people into the 4th dimension, see inside people's bodies, defy natural laws, and do many other impossible acts. If you need an analogy, think of a 3-D man interacting with a 2-D universe.
summary: The ability to exist in the fourth spatial dimension
strengths: Do the impossible
Multiple applications (invisibility, intangibility, etc.)
Can find many mysteries of the universe
weaknesses: May alienate you from our dimension
May become cold and detached
Can lose some emotional capacity

name: Green Light
description: A green flashing aura that greatly heightens your speed, reflexes and intellect (all things that require neurotransmission).
summary: The ability to generate a green aura that speeds your cognition and reflexes.
strengths: Think fast.
Worlds fastest reflexes.
Make complex plans instantly.
weaknesses: Your perceptions make other things seem slow

name: Water Adaptation
description: Also, when you are in the water flaps of skin will come out from between each finger and toe in order to increase your swimming ability.
summary: The ability to be able to breathe underwater and withstand any level of water pressure
strengths: You can swim better.
You can stay underwater as long as you need.
weaknesses: The pressure part only applies to water.

name: Lightning Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a large dragon with black scales and yellow eyes from an alternate dimension. The dragon along with being able to fly, being super strong and having sharp teeth, claws and a loud deafening roar, can also shoot lightning bolts out of its mouth. The dragon is under your complete control and you can send him back to its home dimension when you're done with him.
summary: The ability to summon a dragon that shoots lightning bolts out of its mouth
strengths: You can summon a lightning shooting, super strong, sharp toothed, flying dragon
He's under your complete control
weaknesses: If he's killed you loose this power

name: Money Tree V7
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time but it produces as much money as you want it to produce in any type of currency. This money tree also cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself and the when you break the branches off they turn into swords.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces an infinite amount of money
strengths: You can have as much money as you want
The tree cannot be destroyed by anyone other than yourself
The branches can turn into swords
weaknesses: You can only have one at a time

name: Hydra Regeneration
description: In Greek Mythology, the Lernean Hydra was a creature that would grow two heads whenever one was cut off. With this power, whenever a head, arm, or leg is severed from your body, two more will grow in its place. When you no longer desire the additional appendages, they will be absorbed into your body. Extra heads provide an increased field of vision, and extra arms have a number of functions. Additional heads do not think independently and are all controlled by a single consciousness.
summary: The ability to mimic the healing abilities of the mythological Hydra.
strengths: Immunity to decapitation and limb loss.
Increased field of vision from extra heads, as well as various applications for extra arms.
Extra heads and limbs are easily disposable if undesired.
weaknesses: Any extra legs will only get in your way (but they can easily be absorbed back into your body).
Generally makes you look like a freak (but again, this can easily be fixed).

name: Special Energy Body Repair
description: When a part of your body is damaged, you can create an energy-based version of it. While the original one is healing, you can do normal things again. The energy actually heals that part as long it is injured. This power can repair missing limbs as well. This ability can also do organs as well.
summary: The ability to replace damaged body parts with energy-based ones while the real ones heal.
strengths: It heals your body parts.
You can do normal things while you are still injured.
Does organs as well
weaknesses: None.

name: Speed Of Light
description: Smoke your frinds. Save the day.  Run at the speed of light!
summary: The ability to run incredibly fast
strengths: save the day
smoke your frinds
make new friends
weaknesses: hurting people
creating wind storms

name: Invisibility Bestowal
description: You can turn just about anything temporarily invisible by touching them and willing it. Of course, you can turn yourself invisible too by willing yourself invisible. You are able to see the things that are turned invisible; not only the things you turned invisible, but also those done by others.
summary: The ability to turn things invisible.
strengths: Practical jokes: "He touched my hair and now I'm bald!"
Turn foe's gadgets invisible. Especially effective against Batman.
Turn teammates invisible.
weaknesses: You'd be the one suspected whenever something's missing.

name: Poison Immunity
description: You are immune to all poisons with this power. This includes mental and physical poisons as well as moral ones.
summary: The ability to be immune to any poison
strengths: Immune to poisons without need to build up resistance.
You can eat fugu safely! It's a Japanese delicacy of pufferfish.
You'll never be greedy, angry, or ignorant (3 Buddhist Poisons).
weaknesses: Won't have the thrill of not knowing whether the fugu was incorrectly prepared.
Might get the physical only version.
Can still get killed by a poisoned dagger slitting your throat.

name: Ecokinesis
description: Anything that has to do with nature like "storms" or anything that relates to storms and their effects you can control with this power. You can become a "Force of Nature."
summary: The ability to become one with nature and control it. "Force of Nature"
strengths: You can control the weather
Dazzle your onlookers
weaknesses: Can get out of control

name: Alter
description: With Alter, you can change into nearly any other substance. Don't like all the traffic? Become fire and melt everything in your way. Gone fishing and dropped your stuff in a lake? Become iron and sink to the bottom, then become air and float back up. Other forms include Ether, Sand, Light, Argon, and Electricity. You always retain your shape, however.
summary: The ability to turn your body into different substances
strengths: Gain a variety of powers
Limited by your creativity
weaknesses: You retain your human shape

name: Realizer
description: You can take any living thing from a game and make it real.
summary: The ability to make any game characters or creatures become real
strengths: Can have an army of minions
Can meet your favorite character
weaknesses: If you don't have control, they can run wild

name: The Human Element
description: Allows you to draw energy from groups of people around you and you can use that energy to heal yourself or others,give yourself a boost eg. If your feeling tired it will wake you up.
summary: The ability to draw energy from people around you
strengths: Useful if you live in a big city.
People drinking coffee are almost unlimited power sources.
You can use it on your enemy to make them tired or have fatigue.
weaknesses: If there is not a crowd or group of people near you you can't use this power.
It's hard to control and you might use it on yourself by accident.
ONLY humans.

name: Durable Life Span
description: The person is indestructible to any damage.  He/She can never die from getting shot, stabbed, electrocuted, burned, or even get inflicted with ALL of the diseases in the world. Even when the person gets Radioactively vaporized, the person will rapidly regenerate.  However, there's a difference between being Immortal and having a Durable Life Span. Even though He/She is Indestructible, the person can still age and die from old age.
summary: The ability to be resistant of ANY damage imaginable.
strengths: You are Indestructible to any harm imaginable.
Since you have a longer life span, you age a lot slower. So you can live up from 150 to 310.
weaknesses: You are still susceptible to old age.
Since you are still susceptible to old age, you die of old age.

name: Momentum Charge
description: Charge any object or person with "momentum energy" then release it forcing them forward at massive speeds.
summary: The ability to charge objects with momentum
strengths: Works on any object you touch, including air.
Can charge yourself, increasing jump capacity
Turn objects or people into projectiles
weaknesses: Only works on objects you touch
Must release a certain amount of energy every 24 hours to prevent discomfort

name: Ambient Empathy
description: Your physical attributes including strength, speed, durability, stamina, and healing will increase depending on how much ambient energy you absorb, e.g. photons, radioactivity, heat, magnetism etc. depending on the user and their experience and will power this ability can be limitless
summary: The ability to increase physical capabilities through interaction with ambient energies
strengths: Easy energy source for enhanced stats
limitless potential even potentially surpassing supermans strength
weaknesses: If not controlled properly, will short circuit electrical devices
Cannot redirect as beams or whatever
Requires a strong mind and training

name: Attunement To Time
description: This power makes the user totally attuned to time and temporal energy, as well as time being attuned to them (consciously and unconsciously). This means that the user's thoughts are rapidly acted out by time, this even applies to subconscious thoughts. This means that not only will the time be like an extra limb to the user but it will change rapidly like they themself had been going to in the first place. In addition, the user can sense some of the nuances of time (being attuned to it).
summary: The ability to be totally attuned to time and temporal energy.
strengths: You can rapidly and easily change time.
Time has a tendency to protect you (due to a subconscious need to survive).
You can sense the nuances of time and how it flows.
weaknesses: If the user's internal clock is messed up, then time will act differently for them.
Similarly, if the user has a different perception of time, then that will be what time is for them.
Time even acts to SUBCONSCIOUS thoughts.

name: Data Collect
description: By looking at something, you are able to gain all the information regarding that object, person or element you've looked at. As long as it's a direct eye contact for 60 seconds
summary: The ability to collect data and use the knowledge to your advantage
strengths: You can use the information as intel for your bosses
You are able to find out the target's weaknesses
You can use the information to build something useful for you if it's a blueprint
weaknesses: If it is covered by something like a cloth, then the power is negated
You can't use this power without glasses.
You have to have direct eye contact for 60 seconds, no glances or one second sight

name: Tele Grabbing
description: What if you had the ability to grab food, clothes, even money out of the TV and make it reality? If you're hungry you can just walk up to the TV, grab a pizza and eat it right then and there in your own living room! Now THAT'S room service! And since whatever you grab will be duplicated, the object will be in your hand as well as the TV. And no one will notice
summary: The ability to grab anything out of the TV
strengths: You don't have to wait to get what you want
The bigger the TV, the bigger the object you can pull out
No one in the TV notices you grabbing objects
weaknesses: You can't grab objects larger than your TV
When grabbing out of the TV, you may grab something you didn't want
You can't stick your entire body in the TV

name: Diamond Shards
description: Someone with this ability can impale several different people with the shards and puncture even the hardest metals on Earth. The power takes small portions of the carbon material already in your body and transmutes them into energy, so the more you use it, the less of your "self" you leave behind.
summary: The ability to shoot diamond-hard bolts of energy.
strengths: Nearly unstoppable energy attack
Impossibly sharp
Can shoot up to 10 shards at one time
weaknesses: The transmutation of the carbon atoms in your body leaves you weak
