It can make pervious theories that failed work as explained.
weaknesses: You have to explain your theories before they can come true.

name: Repetitive Prowess Evolution
description: With this power you can get better at doing something the more you do it, but at a superhuman rate. If something takes you hours, days, years to master, you can now do it in minutes, hoursm days etc. Examples: Video games, sports, instruments, singing, writing, etc.
summary: The ability to get better at something at a superhuman rate the more you do it.
strengths: You can impress your friends and family.
People will look up to you.
Barely anything will be difficult for you.
weaknesses: You get really emotional and hate losing or doing a bad job.
You keep wanting to do more things and get better at them.
Life can get boring when you're good at everything.

name: Angelic Possesion
description: You can have your body transformed into your angelic body that you get in the afterlife. Your senses will be sharper. You can fly (once you get used to your body). You will have superior healing abilities. Light will radiate off of your body or absorb into your body if you are evil. You can also see auras and detect whether a person is good or evil. You also get your soul weapon while in your angelic form. (see power Soul Weapon) In this form, your wings are your weak spot.
summary: The ability to take the form of your individual angelic body
strengths: Superior senses, healing abilities, and you can fly. You can only be killed by decapitation
You can detect other angels based off of their glow. You can also detect good and evil people
You can revert back to your human form when you wish
weaknesses: Your wings are very vulnerable to getting hit. It feels like you got the wind knocked out of you
The deeper the wound, the longer it takes to heal
Just because you can heal doesn't make you invincible. The more you are hurt, the slower you are

name: Paxinator
description: With this power you can cause a 200 year period of peace to occur in any country that you stay in for at least twenty four hours. You can cause world peace if you go to every country for a period of twenty four hours within two hundred years. However as soon as the two hundred years are up the country/ies that you cause peace for will immediately be attacked by another country. If all the other countries are currently in their own state of peace at the time the country will be attacked by aliens
summary: The ability to cause a period of peace in any place you stay in for at least 24 hours
strengths: You can cause world peace
weaknesses: You have to stay in the place for twenty four hours
As soon as the two hundred years are up the country will automatically be attacked

name: Arcana 19: The Sun
description: You may generate large amounts of any single kind of energy (Such as Heat or Psychic Energy). You may not choose not to generate energy, though you may choose how much energy you generate. Energy generated by this power bubbles off of you without harming you or anything you wear. Any people capable of manipulating the type of energy you generate will find their abilities more powerful while the are near you. (A pyrokinetic would be more powerful while you generated heat, etc).
summary: The ability to generate huge amounts of energy.
strengths: You can create large amounts of energy without much cost to yourself.
You can enhance the powers of your allies, or give them more energy to work with.
You may attack people simply by touching or going near them.
weaknesses: Generation of energy is not control over energy.
You may only generate one type of energy a time.
You may not select which people use the power you make.

name: Shadow Empathy
description: Humanity has a natural fear of the dark, with a few marked exceptions. A Shadow Empath has an emotional link to shadows; darkness will always be found near them like water at the beach. This means that when they are distressed, afraid, or angry, the shadows will rise up and flood the area. The target of the negative emotions gets cut off from light, sound, and air so long as the user is distressed. With practice, the user may even be able to shape the shadows into tendrils or shadowballs.
summary: The ability to possess an empathic connection to darkness
strengths: When distressed, shadows will rise to protect
Cuts off all light, sound, and air to the target of the negative emotions
With time, the user can form tendrils or shadowballs
weaknesses: Automatic, like a reflex
May not be able to save an airless victim in time
With darkness surrounding you all the time, might become ostracized

name: Powerful Doubts
description: This power allows you to do almost anything, as long as someone says you can't. Let's say your friend says that you can't walk on walls. Instantly, you will forever be able to walk on walls. Or if someone says you won't live forever, you will become immortal. However, if you say that you can't do something, nothing will change. Only when someone else doubts you, will you be able to prove them wrong.
summary: The ability to do anything someone says you can't
strengths: Can gain great powers
Your friends can increase your power
weaknesses: People will have power over you (you can't disobey me, you can't live, etc)

name: Infernal Rebirth
description: This ability allows you rise up from the sable-coloured flames in a form three times stronger than the last. Each form will consist of fire and a more fearsome appearance every time this ability is in effect. Your primary abilities will consist of fire projection, flight, enhanced speed, strength, intelligence, and durability. With each death you increment in all fields of combat and so does your "rebirth rate".
summary: The ability to detonate when taking lethal damage and colescing back into a stronger form.
strengths: Incinerate your target(s) with bursts of flame
Rise and rise again each time you are struck down, stronger than before
weaknesses: You are still vulnerable and suspectable to damage.
High powered water and ice based attacks easily extinguish your flames

name: All Heart
description: Having this power greatly improves your circulatory system's performance. Your veins get wider, your heart gets bigger, and you have a much larger reservoir of blood. Consequently, you're a little taller and fleshier than most people, and you have a much higher endurance.
summary: The ability to enhance your circulatory system.
strengths: Bigger oxygen reserves in your blood.
Easier to avoid heart attacks and other circulatory problems.
Much harder to bleed to death, seeing as how you probably have an extra liter.
weaknesses: Nothing really, except that you're a bit taller and heavier.
Easy to be targeted by Hemokinetics and such

name: Numerical Superiority
description: Speak any number that you could actually write on paper. That is your enhancement to your abilities. Irrational numbers can be used to enhance your powers provided you have a full understanding of how big they are. You can speak smaller numbers to give manageable levels of power.
summary: The ability to boost a power by speaking a number.
strengths: Fully controllable power levels.
Infinite levels of power-provided you have a mathematics degree.
weaknesses: You can be muted.
You can't change power levels underwater or in space.
Someone could reduce your IQ so low you couldn't count over 10.

name: Rubber Kinesis
description: The user is able to create liquid rubber from his or her mouth , the rubber will then solidify into an object with rubbery qualities after it has left the mouth, for example a rubber wall, a rubber bullet or a rubber ball or protection sphere. The user of this power also has the ability to control anything that has rubber like properties.
summary: The ability to create as well as control all forms of rubber
strengths: Good against electrokinesis users
Good for stopping villains
weaknesses: Objects constructed are not usually strong enough to take down superhouses

name: Thermochemical Energy
description: Thermo: heat. Chemical: chemical. Thermochemical: an explosive, fiery form of energy. A person with Thermochemical Energy is a natural thermochemic dynamo, able to release it at will in order to: fly at jet speeds, throw thermochemic punches, and even protect themselves from harm. However, it takes a while to get the hang of, and it demands a lot of concntration and energy of the user.
summary: The ability to release large amounts of thermochemical energy
strengths: Can fly at jet speeds
Throw thermochemic punches
Can protect yourself from harm
weaknesses: Takes a while to get the hang of it
Demands concentration
Demands energy

name: Lightning Riding
description: this power allows someone to use lightning as transportation as well as to summon it to strike at will.to use this power the rider simply summons lightning to strike him/her self they then contol where it goes. this allows them to travel at great speeds to great distances. they can also summon the lightning to strike any target at will.
summary: The ability to "ride" and summon bolts of lightning
strengths: travel at great speeds
summon lightning
immunity to all types of electicity and heat
weaknesses: eye protection needed while riding
can only summon lightning while outside
must wear protective clothing

name: Wings
description: You get to fly as fast as a peregrine falcon with its wings, or the hovering of a hummingbird's. You could retract it, but who would want that? Oh, and be sure to uncover your shoulder blades; you wouldn't want those wings to rip your shirt, would you? A good knowledge of some birds would help.
summary: The ability to have (almost) any type of wings you want.
strengths: You get to fly to work/school/that business meeting/whatever
Totally nail that part of the angel from that Broadway play
No more Maine-to-Florida-round-trip fees!
weaknesses: Have to go bare-shoulder-blade
Might be scouted for advertisements
Can't get metal wings, plastic wings... Etc.

name: Potential Kinesis
description: Through direct touch this power can charge objects with potential energy which will convert into the type of energy (energies) that object emits. for example, charging a torch will emit heat and light energy. Objects that don't convert energy will kinetically move. Potential-kinesis allows conversions into the following energy: Kinetic (Movement) Heat (Thermal) Electrical Light (Radiant) Nuclear Chemical Sound Cosmic Magnetic Elastic and gravitational potential energy.
summary: The ability to charge objects with potential energy.
strengths: Unlimited power supply.
Multiple domestic, Entreprenurial and combat uses.
Like many powers in one
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate the forms of energy emitted
Cannot control variations (Speed, direction, temperature, etc)

name: Molecule Rearrangement
description: You can rearrange someone's molecules to be whatever you want--but it only lasts 1 hour. You cannot change someone into the same thing twice in a row. The thing you turn them into must be about the same size.
summary: The ability to rearrange your own or somebody else's molecular structure
strengths: It would help to unarm enemies
You could change enemies into something weaker
weaknesses: Only works on people

name: Spike Creation
description: Create spikes from any solid material. If a guy holds a gun up to you, you can sprout a spike from the gun to stab him. You can make metal spikes from a metal, wooden spikes and even fabric spikes. You can make and throw needle or spear like spikes. If you make contact with someone, you can grow a spike from their bones.
summary: The ability to create different width and length spikes from any solid object
strengths: You can make deffensive walls and then send spikes from the spike wall
You always have a weapon
weaknesses: You must be able to see the target material and it has to be within a mile of you
It only works on solids. Liquids and gasses won't work
Sand won't work because of it's shifty nature, thus not holding shape

name: Perfect Immortality
description: This power is the ultimate gift and curse. It's the ultimate gift because you can never die by any means and you are invulnerable to all kinds of damage, can never get sick and you stop ageing after you turn 30. Also, you will adapt to survive in whatever environment you are in and you will never have to eat, breathe or drink and you will never get tired. It's the ultimate curse because everybody else will die while you'll live forever. In fact, you will survive after the universe is destroyed.
summary: The ability to never age, get injured, sick, or die.
strengths: You will never die
You will never get injured
You will never get sick
weaknesses: It doesn't stop people from trapping you
Everybody else will die

name: Pyric Mimicry
description: Your flesh and blood body is limited; subjective to gravity, physical damage, and other forces. Fire is nothing but energy. A person with Pyric Mimicry can turn their body into a fiery, human-shaped form at will. This renders them mostly invunerable to physical damage, lets them fly, ignite objects, and discharge blasts of fire. However, it also makes them very vunerable to cold and extinguishers.
summary: The ability to turn your body into fire
strengths: Fly
Shooting flame jets
Can use fire to heal your flame body
weaknesses: Intense cold can kill you
Fire extinguishers can kill you
Unable to safely touch people in flame form

name: Shadow Clones
description: This lets you make copies of yourself and send them off in directions to confuse opponents
summary: The ability to make ghost copies of yourself
strengths: Good for confusion
Instant party any time and never lonely
Make a fake army to scare opponents
weaknesses: These clones cant really do anything but move
They cant attack or protect you
Anything that strikes them goes through because they are ghosts

name: Dimensional Exchange
description: Say that your most prized possession was broken and there is no way to fix it and it can't be replaced. If you have the Dimensional Exchange power, then you can swap your broken item with the same item from another dimension; only the item you get is not broken
summary: The ability to swap things in one dimension with any other similar dimensions
strengths: If your stuff breaks, you don't have to worry
weaknesses: The other versions of yourself won't be happy

name: Super Senses
description: You can hear, see, touch, taste and feel flawlessly. You can listen into any conversation in your office and help spread the gossip. Or read the newspaper by feeling the ink raised on the paper. You can learn how to tune out sounds and voices. Also, you can learn how not to smell bad smells, though it will take much practice to learn how to do that.
summary: The ability to amplify all of your senses
strengths: Your senses are amplified
Can tune out loud sounds
Learn how to not smell bad smells
weaknesses: Bad smells
Loud sounds

name: Ability Imbuing
description: An Ability Imbuer has a unique power. They can make normal objects superpowered objects with concentration. This takes time--75 minutes or so--but the results are spectacular. Electric swords, an indestructible jacket, a gun that can never miss, etc. This is more effective the closer a connection you have with the object--objects you made yourself will keep their powers for centuries. Other objects may lose their abilities in a year or so. This does not work on people.
summary: The ability to imbue objects with superpowered attributes
strengths: Electricity-generating swords, indestructible jacket, etc.
More effective the closer the connection you have it with it
Self-made objects keep their abilities for centuries
weaknesses: Takes somewhere around 75 minutes
Less important objects lose their abilities in a year
Does not work on people

name: Cognitive Variable Analyses
description: This applies to a current situation or a hypothesized situation. You are able to see all the lines of causality and their effect and what they lead onto. Example, you need to make a decision - will you go left or right? - well in your mind's eye, you can see exactly what will happen within the next 24 hours and each other child path stemming from the parent path. The situation doesn't just have to involve you - you can see anybody's paths.
summary: The ability to understand and perceive all the variables in a given situation
strengths: Never make the wrong decision again
The time it takes to analyse any amount of variables - takes one second for every step down a path.
Extreme insight and foresight
weaknesses: Risk of becoming obsessed and lost in your thoughts - obsessing about ''What If" scenarios
The further ahead you look - the more time it takes - a second for each step or ''child path''

name: Corrodium Effect
description: You grow corrodium crystals on your body. Using these crystals you can mutate living organisms that come into proximity of you.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of corrodium
strengths: Mutate living things
Super strength
Launch corrodium from your body
weaknesses: Some creatures are uneffected by the corrodium

name: Shadow Wolves
description: The wolves are pitch black in color since they originated from shadows. They can rip and shred any enemy you are fighting. You can control their individual movements but you can put them into an autonomous mode if you need to. There is a maximum radius of 20 metres that they can be from you. If you have no need to have them around, they will simply melt back into the shadows.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves made out of shadows
strengths: Strong creatures under your command.
The wolves are made out of shadows so they can't be killed.
This was inspired by two things: the user Shadowulf1 and 'Shadow of the Wolf'.
weaknesses: Second pro is null and void if the enemy has this power, 'Aura Wolves,' 'Light Wolves' or Umbrium.
The wolves are restricted in how far they can go from you.
Long-range fighters can just attack you from outside 20 metres and be safe.

name: Energy Booster
description: With this power you can boost the energy output in every energy source. You get the power from the sun. You can only use this power in direct sunlight or else it will use your own life force.
summary: The ability to boost any energy source.
strengths: You can make you or anyone else immortal by boosting their life force.
Can shatter light bulbs.
Will never have to pay for new batteries again.
weaknesses: The sun charges your power so you can't use it at night or in a windowless room.
You will get a horribly painful shock if you try to use your power on wet ground.
If you get very angry you can blow yourself up with as much energy as an atom bomb.

name: Network Telekinesis
description: This power allows you to spread a psychic network that you can channel telekinesis through (though only in one direction). The user can choose whoever is connected to the network to channel telekinetic energy through so that THEY are the ones using telekinesis, not you (you however, control it). This allows for suprise attacks as well as ones over a long distance. Only you and the people you directly connect can spread the network and, at first, you can only make a small network.
summary: The ability to form a psychic network that you can channel telekinesis through.
strengths: No matter how many people you channel through, the telekinetic power is still the same.
You can attack from a distance and utilize several telekinetic forces at once.
If you become skilled, your network can become huge.
weaknesses: You can only control the telekinesis of however many people you can concentrate on.
If you don't concentrate while channeling, then the telekinetic power acts randomly.
Your skill level determines how large the network can become.

name: Sleeping Recovery
description: A person with this power is able to recover from anything as long as they are given enough sleep. The severity of the conditions determines how much sleep they need. In addition, they will automatically wake up when they are refreshed. Cannot cancel death however.
summary: The ability to heal all wounds when sleeping
strengths: You can heal all your wounds and feel refreshed when you wake up
Even wounds made while you sleep will heal, albeit slower
weaknesses: You cannot do anything while you are asleep
Hospitals will want to experiment on you

name: Psychomagnetic Manipulation
description: You can generate powerful psychomagnetic energy into four forms: a deflective barrier which deflects any projectile and most physical attacks, an inescapable psychomagnetic prison which can detain anything at any time, even moving objects, a psychomagnetic pulse, which is a burst of energy like an explosion, and finally, psychomagnetic interference, which blocks other psychomagnetic based powers such as induced psychomagnetism, precognition, empathy, telepathy, etc.
summary: The ability to create powerful psychomagnetic fields.
strengths: Difficult to be harmed.
Stops people knowing your future unless you want them to.
weaknesses: Difficult to control and can be unpredictable.
Wears you out and is easy to overextend yourself.
Can't be restricted, nullified or absorbed.

name: Kinetic Energy Rebound
description: The power to send back any kinetic energy of one's choosing back at the source at ten to a hundred times the original power. No matter how much kinetic energy is coming at you, you can send it back with more power. If superman was to try and punch you while you are using this power, he would be hit by the energy from a punch that is a hundred times stronger than the one he threw. There is no limit to what amount of kinetic energy you can rebound.
summary: The ability to send kinetic energy back at the source.
strengths: Can win a fight just by standing around there.
Can deal out epic levels of damage.
Can bring even the strongest foes to their knees.
weaknesses: Only works on kinetic energy.
If you are using the power and a friend or a loved one gives you a pat on the back, they could die.
If two users of this power were to clash, they would be locked in an endless loop.

name: Magic Creation
description: There are a lot of different types of magic. Each needs energy to work them. Anyone with Magic Creation can supply that energy and direct it into anything. People, weapons, jewelry, clothes, & anything else you can think of. For example, you could take a necklace and hold it in one hand. With the other hand you would create fire magic energy (it would appears as a glow, red in this case) and then direct it into the necklace. Now anyone who wears it can use fire magic until the energy runs out.
summary: The ability to generate different types of magic energy and store the energy in objects.
strengths: Can use any type of magic
Can give magical powers, weapons, clothing, or objects to anyone
No limit to how much energy you can make
weaknesses: There is a limit to how much energy stuff can contain though
Can't directly give yourself energy; you have to use other stuff
You can't take energy away from something. You have to use it up.

name: Perfect Style
description: Basically when you utilize this power you know how to use all your abilities(natural and super) in a way that suits how you want to fight. Ex. If you want to fight with minimal movement or fight with a style similar to Capoeira then you'll know just how to do that. The style will fit with how fit you are, how thick or thin, how tall you are, etc.
summary: The ability to fight in a style that perfectly suits how you want to fight
strengths: You'll know the perfect way to use your powers in a generalised situation.
Having a style similar to a martial arts is possible as noted by the mention of Capoeira.
weaknesses: Someone who knows exactly how to counter you.
Mind-readers.

name: Wolf Style Technique
description: Can turn into a wolf, summon wolves and dogs, have claws, enhanced strength, enhanced speed, can partially turn into wolf, can make fur sharpen and stand up like spikes, can talk to dogs and wolves.
summary: The ability to turn into a wolf, summon wolves and dogs, have claws, enhanced strength, enhanced speed, and more
strengths: Can talk to dogs and wolves
Stomach can handle raw meat
Still contains some enhanced strength in human form
weaknesses: If someone sees you transform, you could be labeled as a werewolf.
Staying in wolf-form too long can make you lose your humanity and come to your instincts.

name: Sunlight Manipulation
description: With this, you can make weapons from mere sunlight. You can create shields of sunlight and you can make energy constructs, etc. You're always powerful under the sun. A high level user can learn to produce sunlight as well.
summary: The ability to control and produce sunlight
strengths: You're powerful all day long
Best against vampires
Never use a night light again
weaknesses: Must be very experienced to produce sunlight
Might accidentally blind someone

name: Cartoon Powers: Ben10
description: With this power you can turn into a member of any fictional alien species from any comic, book, movie, video game, tv show etc. You can stay in alien mode for up to ten minutes and then you can't turn into another one for another ten minutes. You have all of the powers of the aliens along with gaining their average intelligence. After a lot of training you will be able to extend the time that you can stay in alien form for.
summary: The ability to turn into a member of any fictional alien species
strengths: You can turn into a member of any fictional alien species which is over a million different forms
Some of your forms (cybetronian, kryptonian, tetramand) are extremely powerful
weaknesses: You can only stay in alien form for up to ten minutes without training

name: Ability Skill:Material Revival
description: This ability revives those who have the ability to produce any kind of material, matter or energy. If they are killed, they can scatter/disperse like the material energy/they produce or mimic. They can then reform the material/energy into their original form and revert back to normal. Good examples are Majin Buu and the T-1000.
summary: The ability to revive oneself by being the matter/energy they produce if they have an ability to create it.
strengths: When you die, you can reform/revive
Regain your original form.
Also works if you can mimic an material/energy
weaknesses: Only works when you're killed.

name: Human Transformer
description: When you touch people, you can enable them to turn into machines which suit their appearance and personality. So someone who's a construction worker might turn into a bulldozer, jackhammer, work truck etc. They can't control their transformation but since it is affected by the above factors, it may change over time. You can always undo the ability/transformation
summary: The ability to turn people into machines
strengths: Turn yourself and teammates into awesome transformers
Turn into a spy drone when feeling stealthy or a tank when angry
If your form has appendages, you can move them; like refrigerators can open etc.
weaknesses: Alternate forms dependents on appearance and personality
Takes about 10 seconds to transform so they might just shoot you while parts of you are still human
You may get angry and want to turn into a fighter jet but instead become a crossbow

name: Sticking To The Shadows
description: This power allows you to make shadows take on the properties and consistency of a sticky adhesive, such as tar or rubber cement, impeding or trapping anything that touches them. This power does not apply to the darkness of nighttime, but specifically for shadows caused by a light source.
summary: The ability to make shadows sticky.
strengths: Get things stuck in shadows.
weaknesses: Does not work with the absence of light, only with shadows caused by light.

name: Lipid Manipulation.
description: With this power, you can levitate, transmute, transfer and otherwise control lipids. For instance, you could control certain hormones, transfer fat from one individual to another or turn fat into biodiesel. One could even manipulate the cell walls of an individual, allowing levitation and harming of a person. The myelin sheath on neurons could be controlled, allowing you to paralyses an individual or relieve symptoms of multiple sclerosis.
summary: The ability to control lipids such as; fats, waxes and some vitamins.
strengths: Miriad of uses.
Limited control over the biochemistry of others.
Physical contact allows extraction and implantation of lipids.
weaknesses: You may need to learn what lipids are before using this power. Luckily, it is only an Internet searc
Physical contact is necessary at least at first for lipid extraction or implantation.
You need a lot of material to produce a decent amount of biodiesel.

name: Arcana 14: Temperance
description: You may separate bits of your mind from the central portion of your mind. You can place emotions, memories, compulsions or thoughts inside these partitions; while they are there, your central mind is unaffected by them. Memories are forgotten, thoughts are ignored, emotions are unfelt. You may also use partitions as shields against mental attacks or possession. Those are affected rather than you; possessors are sealed away until you release them. You may reunite partitions with yourself at will.
summary: The ability to partion off parts of your mind.
strengths: Can ignore worrisome or negative thoughts.
Can become immune to mental assaults or emotional attacks.
Can selectively inflict amnesia.
weaknesses: Overusing this power may result in your mind become full of more holes than swiss cheese.
You may forget why you forgot something.
You may seal away so many emotions that you no longer wish to have them back.

name: Psionic Storage
description: More of a 'supplemental' power than a 'primary' power. (Not intended as a crime fighting power, but could be used that way). Simply touch any object, item, creature, or person, (and in a flash of light), you store it in your mind, until you are ready to summon it back into reality. While the item or creature is stored, it does not age and is completely safe. Store ALMOST anything: a hot dinner, an animal, a person, a weapon, a car, a house, or even a 747 jet or skyscraper. (Not a city).
summary: The ability to store any physical object in your mind.
strengths: You can store as many things in your mind as you want. Very small items store faster! Like bullets
If planned correctly, the power could be used as a weapon, (even capturing enemies).
You can 'store' yourself, moving into an alternate universe of your own creation.
weaknesses: You can only store one object every minute. (60 an hour)
You can not store an entire city. (at least not in a single flash)
A few people might suspect you are a thief?

name: Inanimate Object Potential
description: This means the user can "upgrade" any inanimate object. Not just technology, but anything inanimate. Example: instead of a back-breaking mattress on the floor, how about a king size super-comfortable bed with a dozen feather pillows and a soft, warm, plush blanket? And that's just a random example!
summary: The ability to make any inanimate object reach its full potential
strengths: Turn everything you own from cheap and crappy to "would-be" very, very expensive things
weaknesses: Being envied for your very, very expensive things

name: Infinity Manipulation
description: If you have this power and good concentration, you can banish objects to infinity. You can wrap infinity around yourself and have any incoming attacks go into infinity. You still need to breathe, so poisonous gases will affect you. You can 'infinity-jump' anywhere that is within your line of sight instantly. You can travel to infinity yourself at will. Infinity itself is actually a bizarre dimension that can be affected by other dimensional powers or traveled to with dimension travel.
summary: The ability to manifest and manipulate infinity itself.
strengths: Any damage-including that of nuclear explosion-goes into infinity.
A short range infinity-jump ability.
Sending dangerous objects and people to infinity.
weaknesses: Someone can kill you with poisonous gases.
This power needs concentration.
This power has no offensive abilities.

name: Situational Evasion Perception
description: This power gives you the ability to instantly sense the best path to escape from any situation. The situations could range from how to best maneuver through a crowd of people or a maze to how to best dodge eight knives that have been thrown at you to how to escape from a straitjacket. You must have seen your destination before you can know the best path to it, and the path would be within your physical abilities.
summary: The ability to sense the optimal path to escape from any situation
strengths: Know how to escape from any situation that you are able to
Can also sense the best path for other people or objects to take to escape from their situations
weaknesses: Must be physicaly able to escape from the situation in order to see the path

name: Perfect Diplomacy
description: You can act as an intermediary for two people. If you tell someone the name of a person, they will completely understand the life, philosophy, motives, etc of that person. You do not have to speak to both at the same time, and they do not have to be present at the same time, but they do have to know each other personally and face-to-face. You must speak to both parties within 24 hours of each other, or the first party will forget the other's perspective. You cannot use this power on yourself.
summary: The ability to get two individuals to completely understand each other's perspective
strengths: You have the opportunity to work towards world peace.
People won't be able to stress your life by triangulating you anymore.
You have the opportunity to become popular with more and more groups of people
weaknesses: Mutual understanding doesn't guarantee people will get along
People may overwhelm you with solving all their disputes

name: Back To Square One
description: With this power, you can be near indestructible if you are awake. This can negate anything that people throw at you.  When someone shoots at you, the action is done but the consequence-someone getting hit and possibly dying, is negated.
summary: The ability to negate the consequences of any action that you choose
strengths: Indestructible
With greater control, you can selectively negate consequences-such as preventing side effects
You can choose not to negate your own consequences
weaknesses: You must be awake to use the power
You must know the consequences to negate them
Cannot negate death but you can negate things that induce death

name: Bioabsorption
description: You need physical contact to absorb biomass. Once biomass is absorbed it goes to a extra-dimesnional pocket inside you that holds up to 100 tons of it in biostasis. You can't genetically alter what you absorb but can extrude mixed biomass from your body. Say you absorbed a tiger and a octopus,you could extrude a tentacle with a tiger's jaw on the end of it. You can just expel biomass(i. E the tiger) alive and intact to make room for more or different biomass.
summary: The ability to absorb biomass into your body and extrude it as limbs,weapons or armor.
strengths: A power limited only by the biomass you've absorbed and your imagination.
A life preserving extra-dimensional space is useful by itself.
You don't kill what you absorb,you can release it alive and intact.
weaknesses: Finding the best animals,plants,fungi and bacteria to absorb.
You need physical contact to absorb biomass.

name: Matter Teleportation
description: One can teleport anything within reasonable size from one known location to another, as long as that object is not human.
summary: The ability to teleport non-human matter.
strengths: One can transfer any object to or from a location.
One can disarm an opponet from a distance
Carrying anything is unecessary, as one can walk to a location and teleport it there.
weaknesses: Larger objects require more effort
Does not work on humans.
You must know exactly where the object you want to teleport is.

name: Redirect Ambient Energy
description: There is energy locked in objects all around us. Your average cup of coffee has 303 degrees Kelvin thermal energy; your average uranium atom can devastate a city. A person who can Redirect Ambient Energy can take energy from an object via their hand and send it through their other hand as thermal blasts.
summary: The ability to draw up energy and immediately project it
strengths: Massive power everywhere
Takes little effort to use
Very deterrent
weaknesses: Must maintain physical contact with object
Must not lose control, or risk atomic explosion
Limited to amount of energy in object

name: Overshadow
description: You can take over a person and be see through but not invisible.
summary: The ability to take over people's bodies
strengths: Can make enemies humiliate themselves
Make a person you like tell the other they are with you
weaknesses: If power turns off you'll be in the body forever!
Might overpower you and make you its slave
Only last when you use it too much

name: The Sword Of Space
description: With the sword, you can cut holes through dimensions and live in your own private dimension. You can make a cut and travel anywhere, though some dimensions may not be breathable.
summary: The ability to cut holes through dimensions, and travel through them.
strengths: No need for a car.
Can use it as a regular sword.
No need to take the garbage out, you can send it to another dimension.
weaknesses: The holes you can create are permanent.
It takes a little while to control where you are.
You can't see the place you are traveling to.

name: Living  Lightning
description: Using this power, the user can create constructs made from living lightning. These constructs take the form of animals and are just as powerful and fast as the animals they take the forms of. When they make contact with something the user can have them shock the target.
summary: The ability to create living lightning
strengths: Can shock your enemies with a giant gorilla
Don't need to touch foes to use powers
Don't need to direct your lightning
weaknesses: Not as fast or powerful as actual lightning
Can't generate fake animals
Can only make 3 constructs at a time

name: Technical Superpowers
description: The user can say the name of a superpower aloud, which will allow them to attain it, but the name of the superpower must be the technical/scientific term for the superpower or they won't get it. The limit of superpowers the user can attain depends on the user's willpower.
summary: The ability to attain a superpower if you state the technical term for it
strengths: Attain superpowers by stating technical/scientific terms for them
Some people are good with technical terms
weaknesses: The limit is the user's willpower
Some people aren't good with technical terms
Powers cannot be attained without technical/scientific terms for superpowers

name: Variant
description: You are not alone. Meet Variant an unseen force of who is, by all conventional means, indestructable. Variant is you on steroids. It can do anything you can do autonomously, invisibly. Passively Variant is an extra pair of eyes and hands. In a fight Variant is an automatic double-team. Variant has no need of sleep and could watch over you always. You are always mind-linked and control Variants actions pseudo-subconsciously. It's like hard-shaped telekinesis.
summary: The ability to have an invisible, indestructable version of yourself accompany you
strengths: Variant is you with 2 times your physical attributes
It is invisible in EM spectrum and durable enough to survive a mountain drop on top of it
Variant is an extension of your senses, see what it sees etc. Send it on missions, control its moves
weaknesses: You must stay within 1760 yards of Variant for it to operate at full strength.
If its invisibility is compromised, it slowly loses its invulnerability factor
Variant fights like you. If you fight like a runny-nosed 1st grader, so will it.

name: Perfect Vision
description: The one possessing this ability is capable of extracting any information from someone or something just by looking at it. Also enables someone to determine something / someone's weakness very quickly. Also enables the user to gain 360 degrees of vision field.
summary: The ability to gain information just by looking at something / someone
strengths: Very useful ability if you are a spy
Could determine enemies' weakness just by looking at them
weaknesses: Strains your brain and could cause fatal stroke with prolonged use
You might gain a lot of unusable information

name: Life Injector
description: You can inject life into other people that are dying. You can make them live longer by constantly injecting life into them.
summary: The ability to inject life into other people.
strengths: Saves people.
weaknesses: Will get tired after a few injections.

name: Mental Intunement
description: Psychics are people with their brainwaves intuned to something other than their own bodies. A pyrokinetic's brainwaves are intuned to heat and fire. A hydrokinetic's are intuned to water. This ability allows you to intune your own brainwaves to anything around you. This is basically the abilily to gain any psychic ability there is, one at a time.
summary: The ability to intune your brainwaves to different things
strengths: You can gain almost any psychic ability
Can become very powerful
weaknesses: Can only gain one power at a time.

name: Human Control
description: You can make any HUMAN do your bidding at any time and at any given place.If you get knocked unconscious or get a coma you have a chance of losing control(this does not include sleeping or dreaming).You can only control people you know exist. People not under your control may try to kill you.
summary: The ability to be able to control anyone (except animals)
strengths: Get revenge
Rule the world
Never be unhappy again
weaknesses: getting bored
possibly losing control if you get knocked out
people not under your control may try to kill you

name: Sonokinesis
description: Also known as Sonokinesis and Audiokinesis, this ability allows you to produce any level of sound and control any sounds. this ability can be used to amplify sounds, diminish or deplete sounds, block sounds, carry sounds over extreme distances and at high enough levels produce tremors through sound vibration. At extraordinary levels, may break the sound barrier, resulting in phenomenal effects (Sonic Boom, etc).
summary: The ability to generate or manipulate sound waves.
strengths: Control thunder.
Want some quiet time? Put up a sound blocking barrier.
Too cheap to pay your cell phone bill? You don't need one!
weaknesses: The body can only sustain so high a level of sound.
May unintentional harm others.
I hope your windows are shatter-proof.

name: Reality Highlighting
description: With this ability, by highlighting text or any form of language, you can make it come true. There's limitless possibility to this skill, since you can write simple sentences and Highlight them to make them real. However, if what the writings mean are unclear or have hidden meanings, there's no telling what could happen if you highlight them.
summary: The ability to highlight anything and make it come true.
strengths: Use a highlighter to make anything a reality.
weaknesses: Shouldn't take notes in highlighter.
Messages must be clear or there's no telling what could happen from highlighting them.
Must have a highlighter.

name: Video Game Character Summon
description: With this power you summon any character from any video game (Mario, Pacman, Derek Jeter) or App (The Doodler, Red Angry Bird, Om Nom) whenever you want. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. This power also works for athletes who've appeared in sports video games. When you're done with them you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a vido game
strengths: You can summon any video game or app character ever created
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might want to kill you

name: Shrapnel Dubre
description: You can manipulate metal in all things, but as you draw it out it becomes a spear or shard shape. If you punched the ground, there would be a massive series of metal spikes that would rise out of the ground in a circle around you. Or, you could put your hand on someone's chest, and draw out all the iron in their blood into a little shard which you pull out of their torsos! Or even just put your hand on the ground and pull out a metal javelin and chuck it at someone!  Also your eyes turn metallic
summary: The ability to make metal spikes/spears/shards sprout out of the ground or buildings.
strengths: It's super dangerous/ awesome
Easy to use (the ground is basically everywhere, right? )
Looks cool!
weaknesses: You must touch what you want to 'shardify'
You might get sliced by your own blades
Can't use it in water/outer space

name: Geo Metamorphosis
description: Think of your body as a living rock, magma running through your veins and whatnot. This power allows you to change into anything from sandstone to steel, including diamond, a form that is unbreakable and packs a painful punch. Turning into rock will also give you super strength, and the ability to turn into sand makes for quick attacks, and in magma form you can really heat things up. You can also turn back into human form at any time, and in your normal form, you will still have super strength.
summary: The ability to transform your body into any form of rock or mineral, including metal and sand
strengths: Super strength and invulnerability
Turning into sand makes up for slow mobility
Ability to mold rock body into different shapes, i.e. knife or hammer shapes
weaknesses: Diamond and steel forms are hard to maintain without perfect concentration
Slow mobility when in a solid form
If you stay in rock form for too long, you may not be able to change back

name: Empathic Terrakinesis
description: Users of this ability have vast control over the earth and it's elements via empathic links to others, such as friends and family. Their ability is unaffected by a person's physical presence or absence as long as they maintain the empathic link to that person. A user can even control mineral-based substances such as ink to create drawings/tattoos. Someone can also telekinetically lift, move, and propel dirt and rocks, and move vast amounts of earth with only their mind.
summary: The ability to control geological elements and substances through empathy
strengths: A very useful power for an empath
Always be a formidable fighter, with the power of the earth under your feet, in your control!
Use this power for both self-regeneration and healing of others
weaknesses: Creation of mineral inks takes practice and knowledge

name: System Activation
description: No batteries required. A System Activator can turn on anything just by touching it: cars, televisions, and electric toys are excellent examples. They can also reverse their power and deactivate existing systems. Most spectacularly, they can partially re-activate lost or stolen superhuman abilities. Unfortunately, they may not be able to turn on the support structures as well (i.e. the stronger bones that come with Super-Strength.).
summary: The ability to jump-start any pre-existing structure
strengths: Turn on cars, appliances, electric toys, etc.
Can reverse power and deactivate existing systems
Can re-activate lost or stolen superhuman powers
weaknesses: System must exist in the first place
Linked with emotion
May not re-activate superhuman support structures (strong bones, etc.)

name: Aeromaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a creature which grows and gains power from air. As you become stronger, you can cause tornadoes, cause furious winds in a certain direction, suck objects into the center of your body, and blast them out. If fire enters the spinning vortex, you can send it out as a fire storm. You also have the ability to levitate.
summary: The ability to change into a form which grows and gains power from absorbing air.
strengths: Grow and gain power / abilities from absorbing air.
Cause tornadoes, cause furious winds, suck in air, release it, and levitate.
You aren't affected by most methods of barm.
weaknesses: Once you revert, you lose all the effects you gained while in this form.
You are susceptible to mental harm and psychic attacks.
You can only levitate to a certain height above the ground. (Depending on your size. )

name: Plasma Whips
description: With this power you can summon and control two whips of pure energy. The whips originate in your palm and can extend up to 50 yards. The whips give off intense heat and cause great damage, but if you don't want to cause damage you can cause the whips to only give off mild heat. You can use the whips to slice, burn, and/or grab objects or people. You can use them to grab a building to stop a fall or twirl one in a circle to act as a shield.
summary: The ability to wield two whips of energy
strengths: Whips are deadly, versatile, nearly unbreakable weapons
Can control amount of heat whips give off to cause more or less damage
Can mentally cause whips to expand or grab something
weaknesses: Whips can only extend 50 yards

name: Impact Shield
description: With this power, you can pad yourself with a transparent layer of space that prevents fast moving solids and liquids from impacting with you. Basically, only slow moving objects can touch you. This protective layer is 3 inches from your skin and can be turned on and off at will.  While it requires active thought to use, it can be targeted to specific areas of your body if so desired. So go ahead, run into that spray of bullets like you've always wanted to!
summary: The ability to shield yourself from fast moving solids and liquids
strengths: While in use, you're impervious to bullets and other angry fast moving objects
Objects that hit your impact shield stop moving
Never get punched, stabbed, axed, or pooped on by seagulls again!
weaknesses: Slow moving blades
Requires active thought to use
Gases (even fast moving ones) aren't affected by your barrier

name: Life Renewal
description: Start a new life as anyone/anything at any age with any qualities/appearance/attributes in any situation that is in the present. They don't have to exist. You MUST change your appearance and situation, otherwise it won't work. You don't remember past lives and have to discover your abilities. You will always discover them and you will always have this ability. Could make it so you get to use this power on the event of your death.
summary: The ability to start a new life as anything you want
strengths: Immortality - can invoke power upon death
Be anyone/anything at any age with any powers/appearance/attributes in any situation you want
Always discover powers before death
weaknesses: Don't remember past and must discover powers
Must be in the present

name: Gravitational Resistance
description: The power to be immune to gravity so you can jump and not have to come down, fly, walk on air and you have a very slim chance of falling.
summary: The ability to be immune to gravity.
strengths: You can fly.
weaknesses: If someone shoots you, you can still die.

name: Shadow Soldier
description: With this ability, you can make your shadow 3D, solid & have it completely under control. While your shadow is doing stuff it would have all the powers of a shadow mimic, but it can be separated from the wall. Your shadow does have a will of its own. Its only will is to follow your commands, so you don't have to always focus on it. You can tell it to do anything from making you sandwich to beating up someone, it's fair game. When your shadow is doing something for you, you don't have a shadow.
summary: The ability to control your own shadow.
strengths: When people ask "Where's your shadow?" you can say he's out
Always have a friend. That just happens to be under your control.
Have you own servant with powers.
weaknesses: When using your power, your shadow is gone
If there is no light touching you, your shadow fades just as it does normally

name: Precognitive Blast
description: Precognitive Blast is the ability to generate a blast out of energy from the future and fire it at foes; or it may fire at the subject before they know that danger is near; or it may channel the precognitive power (normally used to find future information) into a blast which may induce visions of the future.
summary: The ability to fire a blast of precognitive energy as an offensive attack
strengths: Finally, an offensive use for precognition
It's actually a concussive attack
May induce visions of the future
weaknesses: It only works on people
People might not take you seriously ("Precognitive blast? ")
If your power goes off before you realize danger is present, you can't consciously stop it

name: Nycto Kinesis
description: The one thing you must know about this power is, it is strongest at night. As the sun goes down your power grows allowing you to create portals from the darkness, bind people, sever limbs, create appendages from the darkness, or tie ones soul to darkness bringing out the worst within them. Sunlight however is the one thing that can stop or even destroy the darkness thus making these attacks useless but without it you can even cloak a lightbulb and thus create more darkness.
summary: The ability to manipulate darkness in relation to the light/dark ratio and time.
strengths: Becomes more potent as the sun goes down
Complete manipulation of darkness when at night and in complete darkness
Only sunlight can stop the darkness of some of the attacks
weaknesses: Power is weakest at midday
Sunlight can stop the darkness of some of the attacks (solar energy shield to keep from being bound)
You obviously can't hide the sun in darkness (remember that solar energy thing I was talking about?

name: Possession Virus
description: When you make skin to skin contact with someone, you can by choice infect them with a psychic virus that spreads your hivemind into their body. You can now simultaneously and easily control their body at the same time that you use your's, possessing their actions and senses. Each person you recruit is essentially you, as your mind is distributed equally among your subjects, so you can't die even if your original body is destroyed. You absorb memories of someone you overwrite, so you can mimic.
summary: The ability to forcibly recruit others into your hivemind by touching them
strengths: You can create an army with which you have total control over
You are now essentially immortal, as if one body is destroyed all the rest carry on with your mind
You can perform many actions at the same time with all your bodies
weaknesses: You may feel distanced from others
Some memories you overwrite may be traumatic
Can be resisted

name: Celtic Invocation: Cernunnos
description: By calling on the power of Cernunnos, by invoker has power over all beasts and birds. The invoker may take the form of any animal, as long as they've been seen before, even if by a picture. At higher levels, they may even change other people. The invoker may also command animals, as long as it doesn't over-ride their instincts. You can't ask a turtle to fly, or a cat to kill itself. The commands must act within their normal personality.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Cernunnos, the Horned God.
strengths: Fly like a butterfly, sting like a bee, but for real.
You're loved by all beasts.
You're highly respected among all invokers.
weaknesses: You can't talk to the animals, only command or take their shape.
You can't command or change into mythical creatures.
You might have stong urges to become vegan, or extremely carnivorous.

name: Redo
description: Whether you say or do something wrong or whether you fail to say or do something right, you can simply redo it.  If you choose to redo an event from 10 years ago, you are now stuck living in that new alternate timeline and time.  So, sure... redo your first love, but now you're only how old?!  Then again...
summary: The ability to redo any event from your life.
strengths: Ensure a pretty mistake free existence (to everyone else's perception)
Enjoy that "last" delight over again.
You can be as young as you want.
weaknesses: The drive to make everything perfect may consume you.
You can't redo a redo.  You can't go back to the future.
The movie "Groundhog Day" may start to annoy you.

name: Paragon
description: A paragon is capable of superhuman strength, near invulnerability, superhuman speed, flight, and energy projection. Your powers allow you to survive in harsh conditions and temperatures both high and low. You will adapat to any location your battles ensue such as: underwater, deserts, mountains, domestic, darkness, volcanoes, rainforests, jungles, skies, and the vacuum of space.
summary: The ability to become a model of perfection.
strengths: Virtually invincible.
Certain conditions and locations will evolve you for adaptations.
weaknesses: You are a model of perfection. You powers render power negating obselete.

name: Electroreception, Active
description: With this ability, your body generates a weak electic field, usually 1 - 2 body lenghts, but longer is possible. You can sense the environment by the distortions generated by the other objects within the field. You can identify and discriminate between objects by thier different resistance and capacitance characteristics. Works best in aquatic environments, but o. K. On land.
summary: The ability to sense your surroundings through detecting distortions in an electic field
strengths: Orient yourself in the dark or low-light areas
Supplements or replaces your other senses
Detect hidden friends and foes
weaknesses: Objects that generate powerful electical fields may disrupt this ability
Someone with electroreception may sense you using this ability
Objects with an electical resistance similar to the surrounding medium are nearly undetectable

name: Ink Shaping
description: The main function of ink is to create. It's used to create pictures and stories on paper. Someone with Ink Shaping takes that to a new level. They can conjure objects and creatures from ink. Beginners will find it easier to conjure things from ink if the ink is in the form of what they're conjuring. So, if they are trying to conjure a sword, it'd be easier to do so if they have a picture of a sword. All creature conjured from ink are controlled by the Shaper.
summary: The ability to conjure object and creatures from ink
strengths: You can create objects and creatures from ink
It's easy to conjure objects from pictures and tattos
You can control the creatures you conjure.
weaknesses: Conjuring things directly from ink can be difficult.
It's dangerous to conjure more than three thing from ink at a time

name: Timeline Hopping
description: At will, you can jump to an alternate timeline, by focusing on something in your present timeline that could have gone differently, and then going to the timeline where it was/is different. This takes a significant amount of time to perform (about ten minutes), but can take you to just about any timeline. With practise, you can shorten the required 10 minutes with leaps and bounds. You'll always remeber you're original timeline os you can get back.
summary: The ability to travel to alternate timelines
strengths: Escape danger to an alternate timeline
Gather supplies from an alternate timeline
Live out dreams or figure out what could have been
weaknesses: You can be sent to another timeline if someone has Temporal Destination Control

name: Evolutionary Strength
description: Evolutionary Strength is the ability to build up strength in seconds. This is enough power to fight Superman. This power lasts over long durations of time, between 12-24 hours max. You could start lifting 5 tons in 15-30 seconds by using your muscles. Example: You attempt to pull a car which will hurt your muscles, but within seconds, you should be able to pull it NO PROBLEM. You temporarily have to lift, push or pull in order to build up strength.
summary: The ability to build up strength rapidly
strengths: Becoming stronger than any entity across the universe
Having the power to fight entities like Superman
Becoming the strongest in the universe
weaknesses: It can wear off within an amount of time
You are still vulnerable to fire, radiation or any other element
You need to keep working out every hour in order to keep up your strength

name: X: The Extraordinary Blueprint
description: The X blueprint is a schematic of your own body. With it you could grant yourself amazing powers and abilities by adding to or altering the sketch & by adding notes. Manipulate age, height, weight or muscle mass (like dense skin, telescopic eyes, enlarged limbs to name a few. The blueprint is on a highly durable linen which can only be destroyed by gaseous flame.
summary: The ability to grant yourself superpowers with a detailed blueprint of you
strengths: Get amazing powers by adding sketches & notes
The more detailed the note or sketch the more powerful you are (lessens chance of weakness)
Heal by simply erasing the affected part and redrawing it (which tickles a bit)
weaknesses: Adding too many powers at once will send you into a violent roid-rage leading into a coma
If someone gets a hold of the print they could control you
Keep the print away from gaseous flame. If the blueprint is destroyed, you are destroyed.

name: Hypno Mist
description: You can spew some hynotic mist that comes out from your mouth that causes the victim to be tranced under you control and he or she becomes brainwashed.
summary: The ability to breathe out hypnotic haze from you mouth that cause your foe to become under your control.
strengths: A strange use for brainwashing.
weaknesses: It can be worn off by a snap of a finger or spalsh in the face with water.

name: Full Body Bullet Proof
description: If you have this power your entire body is automatically bullet proof and cannot make yourself unbullet proof. You are immune to the effects of any type of bullet.
summary: The ability to become bullet proof
strengths: Your entire body is bullet proof
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by darts, arrows and other types of weapons

name: Second Best
description: Instantly gain the knowledge, skill and understanding of any task you attempt at the level of world's second best. You could be the world's second best chef, or the world's second best fly fisherman, or the world's second best lover, or the world's second best fighter pilot, ect. (this power does not change physical attributes or grant additional superpowers. You may know how to be the world's second best runner, but you will not instantly become as fast as the world's second best runner. )
summary: The ability to be the second best in the world at any given task for the duration of the attempt at the task
strengths: Fix anything! Win at carnival games! Pick locks! Hack a computer!
Pilot anything! Sell tupperware! Paint award winning paintings! Write a novel!
Win at chess! Diffuse an explosive! Win at dance competitions! Do your own taxes!
weaknesses: Does not give you the strength or speed that usually would accompany things like martial arts.
Does not grant fireballs when attempting to throw fireballs despite being really good at it.
Ther is always someone better at this than you.

name: Phantasm
description: By utilizing electical power to speed up molecular motion one could phase through solids, merge with liquids, vanish into the air, etc. Could render earthly attacks useless like fire, water/ice/wind, weapon basically tangible techniques. Spacial distortions, voids, time and even sound and light can still damage.
summary: The ability to accelerate molecules to acquire a ghost effect.
strengths: Contact with enemies can cause seizures
Can be used as a possession
Others can be made this way through contact
weaknesses: Avoid touching loved ones
May accidentally phase through the ground
Anything that can damage can also trap you in this state

name: Ground Block
description: This ability allows you to pull walls out of the ground in any direction, width, height, and density.
summary: The ability to raise walls out of the ground
strengths: Slows enemy down
Instant house
Barricade
weaknesses: It's out of the ground so only semi-easily destroyed earth
Takes longer to make bigger walls

name: Object Reanimation
description: Object Reanimation is the ability to create other objects ny reanimating the molecules and the molecular structure of another object, either from mind or touch. This creates the idea of getting an object you might need, say a ballpen, from another object that you might use later. This is limited to the volume of the object you are reanimating. Say you want a knife, and start reanimating a ballpen. The result would either be a small knife, a weak and brittle knife, or no knife at all.
summary: The ability to create other objects by reanimating the molecules of other objects
strengths: You can create an object you want at anytime
You have the power to change an object that might be a threat
You have the power to make an object much or less useful
weaknesses: You are limited to the volume of the object
The item you reanimate does not ensure great quality
You might change something you don't want to change

name: Biomantium
description: With this power, your tissue becomes adamantium. Since it is your tissue, you can move as normal. This power can be turned on and off but upon turning it off you need to re-charge for a short time before re-activation. Adept users can shorten the time it takes re-charge. This power is low impact when it is on. Since it is passive, the user doesn't need to expend any energy to keep it going.
summary: The ability to change you skin in to adamantium, an indestructible metal
strengths: You're covered in adamantium
Almost nothing can hurt you
weaknesses: When it's on, you're magnetic
Mental attacks work the same

name: Air Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain abilities and superpowers depending on the quality of air that he or she breathes in. If the air they breathe in clean mountain air, they will get superhuman abilities, if they breathe in air with only moderate or little amounts of pollutants they will only get enhanced capabilities. If they are exposed to air with high smoke and pollutant content they will be powerless
summary: The ability to be empowered by the air that we breath in.
strengths: Air is ever present throughout the world
weaknesses: Cleanliness of air is not what is used to be
Can be easily defeated by people who use smoke powers

name: Speed Of Darkness
description: You run as fast as darkness, and everyone knows darkness is faster than light, thats why theres a void of darkness.   You ignore collision because your body, clothes and equipment will become a shadow who can penetrate anything while running.  While running everything becomes slow motion for you.
summary: The ability to move as fast at darkness
strengths: Ignore collision
Faster than light
Get to places in a blink of an eye
weaknesses: You may run too fast and fall down a cliff or any high places by accident

name: Time Recycling
description: This ability allows the user to "recycle" the time he used in the past in order to pause or fast forward time. This means erasing past events in the user's life. The erased time is then converted into extra time for the user. Then he can add it to his time in the form of time frees or an "event replay". A event replay is when the user can replay the event that happen to him in the past but in the present. It may be different though since the user is in a diferent time or place.
summary: The ability to erase moments of one's past in order to convert into add extra time in one's present moment.
strengths: Have extra time
Replay certain moments
The user can chose what moment he wants to erase.
weaknesses: Classic Time Warning: Change the past, change the future

name: The Earth Power
description: As long as you're touching the ground you can absorb energy from it. This energy can be used to recharge yourself, gain strength, heal, shoot energy blasts, and other such things. Also, you can store this energy in yourself so that you don't need to absorb it from the ground. This is good because if you're seperated from the ground you can't use your powers. To use this power you must imagine energy flowing from the ground, through your legs, and into your body.
summary: The ability to absorb and channel energy from the earth
strengths: You can gain energy rapidly and use it in different ways
You can store the energy in yourself
There are other ways you can channel the earth's power
weaknesses: You must be touching the ground to absorb the power.
It takes concentration to absorb energy

name: Laser Emission
description: Laser is an acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation. It's really an extremely powerful ray of light. A Laser Emitter can produce a laser from their fingertip that can pierce a 2 foot block of steel--or generally anything else.
summary: The ability to generate powerful lasers from your fingers.
strengths: Can pierce most anything
Looks very cool
Powerful offensive skill
weaknesses: Almost no worth as a defense
Takes concentration
Maximum range 70 yards

name: Person Creator
description: With this power you can create people, or recreate existing/fictional people, and alter their/give them personalties in any way you wish. You can also alter their looks according to your liking and they're also completely under your control. You can make as many as you want, but only a hundred of them can exist at once.
summary: The ability to create people
strengths: Make an army of people that will do whatever you say.
Hang out with friends.
weaknesses: A hundred people can be (re)created and exist at once.

name: Vicarious Reality
description: A vicarious reality is where people prefer Star Wars over everyday life, or someone who plays World of Warcraft once too often. As a superpower, you can trade places with these fictional characters, such as Dante from Devil May Cry, or Neo from the Matrix. Plus, you will have the powers, skills, and memories of the fictional character you trade places with.
summary: The ability to trade places with fictional characters.
strengths: Become your favorite fictional character
Escape reality for a while
weaknesses: You may not want to come back to the real world
You may have to fight Freddy Krueger or Lex Luthor

name: Ice Blasts
description: Freeze your enemies in their tracks with ice from your hands.
summary: The ability to shoot blasts of ice from your hands
strengths: Stop enemies,
Make icicles to stab your enemies,
Make awesome ice sculptures,
weaknesses: Licking the ice would be a bad idea,
Doesn't work well against fire,
Ice will eventually thaw,

name: Percussive Maintenance
description: A person with this power can fix anything by hitting them. TV broken--just give it a light tap and it will be fixed. Rogue robots---punching them will also fix them. Person being mind controlled--punching them reverts them back to their original self. Someone has a headache punching them also fixes the person up. However even if the object is fixed they still receive damage from your punch so if you overdo it, it will still break.
summary: The ability to fix anything by hitting them
strengths: Fix things---a universal interpretation of the word fix
Excuse to hit things
Can be used on anything and everything including people
weaknesses: If a part is missing this will not regenerate the lost part
If the thing that needs fixing is on fire or is otherwise unhittable---or unadvisable to hit
Cannot change the inherent properties of an object--no upgrades or modifications

name: Multi Jump
description: Double jumps have nothing on you. With this superpower, you can jump and then jump again in the air. You can jump again and again in the air. You have to practice and time your jumps. You get higher with each jump in the air. You need to develop your jump stamina or you will only jump a few times.
summary: The ability to jump and then jump again and again in the air.
strengths: Jump, then jump again and again in the air.
With every jump in the air, you get higher and higher.
If you time your jumps, you get the most out of this power.
weaknesses: If you don't time your jumps, it's harder to get higher.
If you don't practice, you will not be used to jumping or get too high in the air.
If you don't jump while in the air, it will not work.

name: Energy Bow
description: When activated, you can create a ball of energy. Then, you can pull on the ball to create an arrow. Finally, release it to fire an energy arrow.
summary: The ability to create a ball of energy out of which you can shoot arrows
strengths: Fire pure energy arrows
weaknesses: If you're facing a fast opponent

name: Healthy Hands
description: You now have the power to physically reach into someone's body and pull out anything keeping them sick, be it a tumor or something bacterial or viral. People will start to come to you with their problems and maybe even pay you!
summary: The ability to reach into someone's body and pull out anything that ails them.
strengths: Need an organ transplant for one of your family members? Now it's free.
Become a world famous doctor.
People you save may owe you favors or reward you.
weaknesses: You have to find something to do with whatever you pulled out.
You have to build up a great immune system to be able to withstand diseases.
Doesn't work on yourself.

name: Object Displacement
description: Now you see it, now you don't. A person with Object Displacement can 'drop' nearby objects out of our reality with a wave of the hand, making them totally nonexistent. When they bring displaced objects back, they reappear in exactly the same location moving at the exact same speed in the exact same state as it left. The more heavy an object is, the harder it is to shift; speed is less of a factor but still influences the difficulty of the displacement.
summary: The ability to shift objects into a parallel dimension
strengths: Killer magic tricks
Displaced objects return in the exact same state they left
Can be used at a reasonable distance (10 yds)
weaknesses: Must get a clear thought in at the object, nothing rushed
Displaced objects return at the same velocity
Speed and weight affect the difficulty of the displacement

name: Water Combustion
description: You can cause nearby bodies of water to combust, making the water burn similarly to oil. Larger masses of water require greater focus. You can ignite the amount of water in an Olympic-sized swimming pool with difficulty and extreme focus.
summary: The ability to cause water to combust
strengths: The human body is about 57% water. What would happen if you combusted all of that.
Droplets of water suspended in air will create an explosion when combusted
Can turn any stream of water into a flamethrower, so carry around a super-soaker for self-defence
weaknesses: You can't ignite very large bodies of water eg. Lakes
Having the power to kill others at will could make people fear you

name: Music Manipulation
description: You can control & manipulate music with this power. Change the volume of the music. Change the way it sounds. You can make a guitar sound like a trumpet, for a limited time. Change the pitch of voices; a soprano can be deepened to a mezzo-soprano! A bass can be raised to a tenor! You can even create synth sounds! Ever heard of Sound Forge?
summary: The ability to manipulate music
strengths: Control the volume of music, make it quiet so you don't disturb pesky music-haters!
Change the way musical instruments sound, like a synthesizer!
Make it louder & easier to hear.
weaknesses: You can't manipulate music that is too far away, such as a distance of 3 miles.
Don't make the music too loud or you could go deaf!
Not everyone loves music.

name: Super Physique
description: You can train and have good physique and get more muscle but never lose the old you have. Even when you get old, the powers stay. You never get tired and you do not need to sleep. However, you need to recharge your body with water and food at some point after the human limits. But the great thing is, you stay fit all the time, never needing to train. This is not like the power Contained Metabolism, because there you don't need to eat.
summary: The ability to keep running and moving without ever getting tired.
strengths: Never get tired
No need to train your body
No need to sleep
weaknesses: Need to eat and drink
You can get injured
You can die when the internal organs stop of old age

name: Money Magnet
description: You can activate this power and control the strength of the magnetism; you must have some of the type of currency you mean to attract or repel. By type I mean American money, Monopoly money,etc.
summary: The ability to attract currency (money) like a magnet, or repel it
strengths: You can atract all american currency with a penny.
Throw people by repeling the money in their pocket
weaknesses: If you have no money of the desired type.
If enemies are broke
You might get pummeled by large amounts of change

name: Ultimate Tk(Space Time)
description: With this power, you can use your hands to grab space-time. You can use space as a shield and you can create slides and other things out of space. When you touch someone else, you can rip apart their bodies via "space cutting. " You can even grab time frames where an attack exists and crush it. You can rip open a portal then rip open time/space for your exit. You can create artificial gravity by creating a funnel toward an object. Be creative and you could do more things
summary: The ability to have tactile kinesis over time and space
strengths: Your hands are the ultimate weapon
You can do virtually anything with your hands
weaknesses: You are only limited by your creativity and your willingness to mess around with the universe
If you do not immediately undo what you have done, it could lead to consequences
You can only bend what you can see

name: Super Human
description: A super human is able to go far beyond the limitations of their mind and body to be able to perform all manner of actions. This power gives its holder super enhanced versions of the following: strength, speed, reflexes, agility, acrobatics, endurance, toughness, senses and mind. This allows the holder to lift extremely heavy objects, leap huge distances, run at high speeds and withstand all forms of physical and mental attacks to a certain extent.
summary: The ability to lift objects, jump great distances, run extremely fast and be supremely tough
strengths: Strong, fast, agile and tough
Enhanced intelligence
Prepared for all manner of situations
weaknesses: Takes a long time to learn how to control
Can only improve with training, but con 3 is still valid
Very strong and fast but those with just super strength are a little stronger and likewise for speed

name: Monospecies Omnipotence
description: When you get this power, you think of a single species of animal. You have complete control over this species.
