You could gain its attributes, turn into it, turn individuals of it into humans or human/animal hybrids, turn humans into individuals of it, give others its attributes, mind control it, spawn/summon it, destroy it, give people were-it powers or curses, edit attributes of individuals (only within the bounds of the species, though). Any animal-related power you can think of.
summary: The ability to completely control one animal species
strengths: Get a large variety of powers AND the ability to grant powers to others
Of course, the animals (of this species... ) absolutely love you and follow your orders
So you can keep them as pets, too, and impress people
weaknesses: One species. You can't change the basic form of the species, either, you're stuck with it.
Thinking of a relatively useless species
You still can't, say, travel through space, teleport around, reshape matter, etc.

name: Biological Absorption
description: Through this power, you are able to absorb the powers of another being. As well as powers, you absorb their energy and DNA, enabling shapeshifting and healing.
summary: The ability to absorb the complete biological structure of another being
strengths: Gain many powers
Enables healing
Shapeshift to max 1 other form to evade pursuers
weaknesses: The process of absorption almost always kills the person being absorbed
Due to the volatile nature of the users DNA, their DNA degrades hundreds of times faster than normal
Because of this, they need to take at least one person a week to stay in top shape.

name: Vector Terrakinesis
description: This ability lets a person control earth, like normal terrakinesis, but with a big difference: "vectors", or invisible telekinetic appendages, allow the user far more dexterity and control than the normal form of this ability, letting them control rocks or earth far too heavy for a normal terrakinetic to handle. The vectors also allow you to effortlessly slice rocks, even granite, in seconds!! This ability can even still work if a person using it is physically separated from earth.
summary: The ability to use telekinetic vectors, or energy appendages, to control geological elements
strengths: Have extremely strong and precise control over geological elements!
You can use the vectors to channel earth energy into others, to heal them
You can be an extremely skilled and deadly fighter to any enemy!!
weaknesses: Using more than 4 vectors at once causes both physical and mental strain
Evil people with this ability are extremely dangerous!
Your power is weakened sufficiently if you are in an urban environment

name: Power Duplication
description: You can duplicate giving the clones a random superpower
summary: The ability to duplicate with super powered clones
strengths: An army of superhumans at your disposal
Can get rid of clones at any time
weaknesses: Clones might get to powerful

name: Aura Shield
description: If done properly, this can protect you from any attack; physically or mentally.
summary: The ability to create a shield out of your aura
strengths: Protection from anything
weaknesses: Can only protect you if used properly
Cant deflect arrows yeah it sucks

name: Time Code Mastery
description: In any universe you are inside of, there are two 'time codes'. One allowing travel to the future, and one allowing travel to the past, which are used by reciting the code out loud, and then stating the destination time. You know what the two codes are, and can change them at will, along with how time travel via the codes works (for example, what happens if you create a paradox while traveling by using the code). Anyone who knows a code can use it, but they'll be stuck unless they have both.
summary: The ability to control the two codes allowing time travel
strengths: Not only time travel, but time travel you can allow your friends to use, and revoke it, too
You know what happens if you create a paradox, since you can change that aspect, so no worries
If anyone gets the code and you do not want them to, you can just change it, and it'll be useless
weaknesses: Someone can use the code before you can change it (particularly if you don't know about them)
They could even erase your existence, preventing the code from being changed
If you don't give someone both codes, they'll be stuck without either help or another way to travel

name: Silvertongue
description: Using this power while you are reading out loud you would be able to read characters and objects out of books. People can even change the events of reality using this power. You can read yourself into and out of books too, along with others. I do not own Inkheart, and to be honest this is where the idea came from.
summary: The ability to read people and characters into and out of books
strengths: You can read your favorite character out of books.
No more paying for items, read aloud a grocery list or catelog and you're set!
You can read youre enemy into a book with a terrible ending.
weaknesses: When you read yourself or someone else in or out of a book, someone has to take your place.
You have limited control over which character or object comes from the book.
You can easily accidentally read someone into a book.

name: Marked Omnipresence
description: With this power, you are omnipresent in any area you have been at will. This avoids the problem of seeing things you do not want to and reduces the risk of an Omni Vampire. Unfortunately, you cannot interact with the viewed area.
summary: The ability to be omnipresent in any area you have visited.
strengths: View any area you have visited since acquiring this power.
You can choose what areas you view.
Useful for manipulation; get someone into a place you have been and you can watch them.
weaknesses: If you view an area with an Omni Vampire present, you suffer the consequences.
You must have been there already and some powers can hide what you see, such as Unpredictability.
This power cannot be modified in any way, including Con Negation or an Enhancement power.

name: Eternal Eclipse
description: With this ability, the user can generate high amounts of dark energy and gravity. Dark energy (at Full Body Transform) allows the user to do nearly anything, from complete destruction, to time/space travel, to infinite knowledge. Gravity allows the user to create things like black holes, or the user could even collapse a star to create a supernova. There are three forms to this ability: Human Form, Angelic Form (comes with two black wings and an exploding darkness spear) and Full Body Transform.
summary: The ability to govern the powers of dark energy and gravity
strengths: Not just for bad guys
Power to become an energy being
In Full Body Transform you gain the ability to regenerate as long as there is a particle of you left
weaknesses: Angelic Form and especially Full Body Transform are hard to master
If you stay in Full Body Transform for too long, you will be stuck that way permanently
Tread CAUTIOUSLY around energy absorbers (don't forget you have gravitational powers, so use them! )

name: In My Pocket
description: For all those times people ask you for an odd item when you're stuck in a jiffy, such as needing superglue, a pen, a calculator - or to be more creative, a lightsaber, the first issue of X-Men Giant Size to credit cards, etc. ANYTHING that's requested basically.  Also, the probability of you being able to possess the object through natural means is inverse to the object's potential to malfunction, i.e. it may be likely to have a pen handy, but not a Harrier Jump Jet - so expect malfunctions.
summary: The ability to have any item or object in close proximity upon request by another person
strengths: You are always equiped
You would become the most useful guy/gal in the world
The more people you know, the more items it's reasonable for you to have access to
weaknesses: Someone else MUST request the item before you can materialize it
The probability that you could possess the object is inverse to the usefulness of the object

name: Ability Replication
description: An Ability Replicator is a highly adaptable and unpredictable foe. By touching another superhuman, they can copy their abilities: Telepathy, Super-Strength, even Flight is not beyond them. The downside is that they can only hold on to one power at a time; with extensive time and practice it might be able to be expanded to 2 or 3.
summary: The ability to copy the superpowers of others by touch
strengths: Can copy foe's superpowers
Surprise factor
No superpower beyond you (Telepathy to Super-Strength)
weaknesses: Can only hold on to one power at a time
Must touch target
Getting stuck with an awful power

name: Big Brother
description: With this power you automatically know when somebody is watching you. Makes it perfect to know when you can't/should use your powers. Also gives you the location of the watcher (deities and higher beings not included).
summary: The ability to know when you're being watched
strengths: You know when you're being watched
You know when you shouldn't use your powers
weaknesses: Doesn't include deities and higher/celestial beings

name: Total Remote Viewing
description: You can see past and present activities anywhere on Earth and other planets. You can even find planets with other humanoid life.  You can also view three things, in three places, at once.
summary: The ability to use remote viewing in its strongest form.
strengths: You can find anybody, and anything.
You can see past and present things.
weaknesses: You can only see either past or present things.
Some things are better left unseen.

name: Contemporary Magic
description: A person with this power has the ability to do magic to create any effect that is currently possible with current technology. For example they can shoot fire in an arc that looks like a flamethrower and can blow dry their hair using magic.. Anything that you can do with current technology is possible for you to do. The user is limited by current technology because although you can mow your lawn with magic it is only just as fast as the highest technology lawnmower that there currently is.
summary: The ability to use magic to create any effect as long as it is possible with current technology
strengths: Easy to hide your powers--people probably think you are some sort of Batman
Your power is only limited by current technology
You can use the effects of the best technology for free
weaknesses: Kinda useless since you can't really do anything technology can't already do
Don't really know what current technology can do so you have to read magazines to learn new "spells"

name: Void Lightning
description: The lightning will create empty space when it hits something, but air is unaffected by the lightning. You still need a medium for the lightning to travel through.
summary: The ability to fire lightning from one's hands that creates a void when it hits something
strengths: This lightning doesn't cauterize wounds. Good if you want to kill.
weaknesses: Creates an opening for someone to use 'Lightning Void'.

name: Transfearmation
description: Sure the Scarecrow has developed a fear inducing gas that he uses on his victims. He can induce specific fears or cause his victim to experience their own worst fears. What if you have this power to shapeshift into the worst horrifying monster, demon, alien, mutant, a person, or anything else that most evildoers fear most.
summary: The ability to transform into any person, creature, animal, or a thing that your enemies fear most.
strengths: might be a good use against bullies.
weaknesses: you could give some elders heart attacks

name: Remote Viewing
description: By closing your eyes and concentrating, you can revisit any past event and witness it exactly as it happened.  You can see what is CURRENTLY happening anywhere in the world (and universe) as well.  Watch any game, concert, or event as if you were actually there!  Unravel mysteries that have been lost in time!  What really happened to the dinosaurs?  What really happens at strip clubs??  The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to see any past or present event through your own eyes.
strengths: See anything that happened or is happening
Revisit moments you were too drunk to remember
weaknesses: Some things are better left unseen
You might potentially spend a lot of time remote viewing

name: Particle Accelerator
description:
With this power you can speed up the molecules to produce various effects. 
For, example you can create heat by speeding molecules in the air or you can make things explode by speeding up their molecules. 

You can also create a vibrating saw by making the molecules around your hand speed up so you can plow through anything, and as the name implies you can create a particle gun to shoot particles by speeding up particles that are already slowly moving toward the target
summary: The ability to increase the speed of molecules and atoms and other subatomic particles
strengths: Explosions and Fire(Heat)
Particle gun and saw
Alchemy, by particle acceleration
weaknesses: You can only speed up particles but you cannot change the direction
If you creates an explosive element with the particle gun you could very well blow off the earth

name: Multiverse Travel Knowledge
description: You know how travel to parallel universes works, and how to do it. You will be able to build, with parts from just about anywhere (at least with fairly modern technology), any sort of machine you can imagine that allows one to travel to an alternate universe/reality/timeline. It could be handheld, a vehicle, cybernetic (only if that tech is available, though). It can vary from creating a one-way portal once to one world, to jumping to anywhere inside of any universe you choose.
summary: The ability to know how to build machines to travel the multiverse
strengths: You can travel to any alternate universe, and be able to give others machines to do it
Or teach worlds how to do it
You can go meet fictional characters, get fictional weapons, whatever you can think of
weaknesses: If your machine breaks somewhere with little or no technology, or with a hostile populace
Someone can steal your machines, or figure out how they work
Or stick bamboo under your nails until you tell them how it all works

name: Cryptid Caller
description: You get to call upon the creatures mankind believes does not exist, like the Loch Ness monster, Sasquatch, etc.
summary: The ability to call upon the creatures of myth to do your bidding
strengths: Can call upon some really powerful allies
They never turn their back on you
Can become unstoppable
weaknesses: Some people may try to expliot you
Must be a strong believer
Must know exact name of cryptid you try to call upon

name: Character Creator
description: The ultimate power for aspiring authors or crazy fangirls. A person with this ability can recreate fictional characters or create their own as long as they have enough information.
summary: The ability to replicate characters from movies/books or to create your own.
strengths: You're own Edward Cullen.
A bunch of hot guys.
A bunch of hot girls.
weaknesses: You can't return them.
The questions that people will ask you.

name: Shadow Manipulation
description: Shadow Manipulation is a rare ability not to be confused with Shadow or Shadow clones. Shadow energy is a power source that can only be past from 1 shadow caster to another. Once obtained the user can travel through shadows at the speed of light. They can also fire blasts of the dark energy in the forms of black/gray fire,lightening bolts,or raw energy.(Raw energy may back fire and cause serious damage to the user.) The user can also summon Shadow weapons.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate shadow energy
strengths: Great for Escapes
Power not limited to day or night
Shadow Energy is almost unstoppable
weaknesses: A back fire may kill the user
Hard to control where you'll end up when using shadow travel
Power may start to take control of the user

name: Rules Of The Room
description: With this power, you can make rules that must be followed by anyone who enters the room. You write the rules within a rulebook that you must read to people after they enter the room. You must clearly state the rules before they are in effect. If someone disobeys the rules, they will die. The rules must be able to affect everyone. For example you cannot write "Only I can attack", but you can write "No violence" or "A punch for a punch". Also, you can ban superpowers, except this one.
summary: The ability to set up an area where your rules must be followed
strengths: "No violence" is good for protecting you, "A punch for a punch" is good if you have superstrength
The rulebook can regenerate
You can also create a game with the rules
weaknesses: You must follow your own rules and they must be able to affect everyone
You cannot make exceptions, unless they can be utilized by everyone
You have to be very specific to cover loopholes

name: Urban Empathy
description: The city: full of artists, businessmen, and culture. For an Urban Empath, it's the home of something else as well--their abilities. While in a city, they gain strength, agility, and intelligence relative to its inhabitants. If they live in a major city they can stop a semi, freerun through the urban jungle with reckless abandon, and outwit anyone who crosses their path. However, they are uneasy around large amounts of plant life, cannot grasp simple technologies, and get ill when in pure air.
summary: The ability to become superhumanly strong, agile, and intelligent while within a city's limits
strengths: Strong enough to bench a firetruck
Agile enough to freerun on the tallest buildings
Canny enough to outwit any normal person
weaknesses: Powers quickly dissipate as user leaves a city
Strength of powers relative to inhabitants of the city
Adversely affected by the presence of plant life and pure air

name: Avatar Of The Universe
description: You will age but only if the universe will be someday die;otherwise your immortal. Your immune to anything that the universe is immune to. Reality altering powers will affect you. Antimatter doesn't affect you. Black holes can affect you.
summary: The ability to link together with the universe.
strengths: Immune to everything but reality alteration.
weaknesses: Destroyed by reality alteration,but who wouldn't be?

name: Impenetrable Field
description: This power is the ultimate gift, and the ultimate CURSE! You are surrounded by a permanent shield that is impenetrable. No power can get through it. It takes care of all your needs like air, food, water, warmth, keeping you cool, bathroom, etc. But nothing can get in, and you can't get out. That means you can't enjoy much anything. No sex, no kissing, no wine, nothing. Not even snacks. Your clothes are always different when you wake up.
summary: The ability to have absolutely nothing happen to you.
strengths: The ULITMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't die by trauma
weaknesses: The ULTIMATE SHIELD
Nothing can get through it
Can't kill yourself.

name: Fear Inducing
description: With this ability, you can induce fear in any living thing with emotions. You can choose the intensity of the fear, which can also determine how long the being is in the state of fear. This is done mentally, and you can use it on large areas. You can induce fear without visual contact. However, it requires more concentration.
summary: The ability to induce fear in any living thing.
strengths: You can get anyone frightened.
weaknesses: Has no offensive use on its own.

name: Telekinetic Storm
description: If this power is activated, the user will begin to levitate, along with all objects within the user's vicinity. These objects will suddenly start moving at high speeds around the user in a large cylinder shape. Telekinetic waves will start to blast outwards from the user, which resemble powerful gusts of wind, but affect others internally, as well as externally, and can cause a number of affects on the human body, varying from telekinetic force, to cuts, to disintegration of the body.
summary: The ability to create a telekinetic storm
strengths: Levitation (of user and other objects)
Telekinetic waves/blasts
Can cause telekinetic force, cuts, disintegration (on others)
weaknesses: Can be destructive to suroundings

name: Newton's Third Law
description: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction unless this power is involved. Normally when a force is applied to an object and equal force is applied to what caused the force. With this power you can strengthen, weaken, or negate either the original or the reactive force.
summary: The ability to control kinetic reactions.
strengths: Negate the force applied to you when you use force on something.
Double the force of a blow to your opponent if they hit you.
Break through a wall because it wont react to your force to stop you.
weaknesses: Would fall through floor if the floor didnt supply a reactive force to hold you up.
Would easily break objects accidentally if power was not controlled.
People could be easily hurt just by touching you and having their force multiplied.

name: Infinity Sneakers
description: The infinity sneakers are a pair of shoes that allows you to move with greater super speed & defy gravity, this can include walking on walls, flying, floating, and being able to move with blinding speeds appearing as a blur. I can also you of impending danger.
summary: The ability to use them with great speed and defy gravity.
strengths: You are immune to earthquakes while wearing them.
Move faster than a speed of light & sound.
weaknesses: Could trip on evil-made obstacles.
Only immune to the shaking of the earth, not to the destruction and parting of the earth
Can be stolen

name: Power Cards
description: You can put any chosen powers into cards but there are four conditions. 1. The being who has the power(s) involved has to allow you to put them into the card(s). 2. The power is removed from the person (not copied) and is then pasted. 3. 1 power per card. 4. Anyone can then use the power the card contains ONLY while they own the card. FYI this power can NOT be altered at all.
summary: The ability to put powers into cards
strengths: Can help people who don't want to have powers anymore.
You can use the power the card contains.
You can use this on all your horrible powers and give their cards away.
weaknesses: Person has to be willing.
Power is permanently removed.
Anyone can use the cards.

name: Energy Void
description:
Rules:
1. You do not get the energy it is gone.... Forever
2. You must come into contact with said energy or the energy's source, however you are not damaged by the energy... Example: put you hand into a fire you will not get burned. 
3. Energies include: magic, elemental, life, so on so forth. 

 This power is not something you can turn on or off once your body comes into contact with the energy or it's source it will be absorbed. This can be canceled by clothing
summary: The ability to absorb forms of energy
strengths: Immune to being hurt by said energy
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both
weaknesses: Cannot cast magic or use any magical powerful items
Automatic cannot be switched off : considered both

name: Reaper's Scythe
description: If you want someone dead, then all you have to do is slice. You can also use your scythe to slice into midair, and open a rift to anywhere in the world.
summary: The ability to use a scythe as a supernatural tool for killing and travel
strengths: You can be at home and kill someone anywhere in the world.
You can go on a vacation without having to pay.
weaknesses: You need a scythe.
You need to know where you want to go before you slice.

name: Telepathy Via Sight
description: The person with this power is able to read minds as well as send people information mentally whenever a person or a group of people is within their sight. If the person they are mind reading or sending information goes out of the user's sight, then he losses the mind reading and information link.
summary: The ability to read people's mind or send people information whenever they are in your sight.
strengths: Can read minds
Good for getting information as well as sending information
weaknesses: Cannot use this power against someone with Mental Shielding
A power that only can be used primarily surveillance, not combat effective.

name: Neutral Matter Manipulation
description: What is "Neutral Matter"? It is matter that is found between the Matter/Anti-Matter worlds. It is immune to the effects of both of two matters. The user can summon it from its own reality to control it. This matter is only good for defense, because Neutral Matter will repel itself and any other matter. It cannot touch Matter/Anti-Matter nor they cannot touch it. The user can touch.(Warning: This is Babeltalk's version of what neutral matter is?)
summary: The ability to summon and control neutral matter.
strengths: Control a new kind of matter and you can summon the energy of that world as well.
Have a powerful defense
It is immune to the effects of both Matter and Anti-Matter
weaknesses: Maybe something outside the realm of science like magic can defeat it.

name: Card Powers
description: With this power you can use the power of card suits. Clubs gives you increased luck. Spades allow you to turn your hand into melee weapons. Hearts makes people fall in love with you at first sight. Diamonds grant you an indestructible skeleton made of diamond. You can only channel one card power at a time.
summary: The ability to channel the powers of card suits.
strengths: Have incredible luck in a fight.
Your melee weapons or indestructible skeleton may come in handy.
Always get the girl.
weaknesses: Can only channel one power at a time.
Diamond skeleton may increase your weight, giving you incorrect readings from a scale.
When you activate the hearts power, fangirls/fanboys will crowd around you.

name: Avatar Creation
description: This ability grants the user the ability to manipulate his aura and make a warrior 5x bigger than the person to cloak him/her. The avatar is powered by the persons aura/desire to win which can be good or bad. One can also generate weapons with aura as well, to be wielded by the avatar. The user can actually model how the avatar looks by manipulating his/her aura.
summary: The ability to create a warrior made of aura to cloak the body
strengths: You have a portable arsenal that you can summon at will
You gain a physical advantage when outnumbered
You can generate any weapon to suit your situation
weaknesses: The avatar is fueled by the user and he/she aura.
If the user becomes badly injured or loses the will to win the avatar will disintegrate into nothing
The avatar is particularly weak against aura or magic based attacks.

name: Circlism
description: By drawing a circle in the air with your fingers and imagining it to be whatever it will form, it is only limited by your imagination.
summary: The ability to make circles of anything
strengths: Can create circle weapons of any type
Can create circle anything from what ever substance
Can create multiple circles at any one time
weaknesses: Size is restricted to the ability to draw with fingers
You have to think about what it is going to be made from
You need to have a clear picture inside your head in order for the circle to form

name: Psychometric Power Absorption
description: This very rare ability is a curious mix of empathic mimicry and psychometrics. A person can mimic and later absorb abilities of people who have touched and/or used objects that the person with this power comes into contact with. There is no limit as to the number of powers that can be absorbed, nor is there a limit on the types of powers that can be absorbed.
summary: The ability to emulate the powers of others by touching an object they had previously been exposed to.
strengths: A very useful power for an empath.
Is extremely powerful.
Can be harnessed and controlled in a very short amount of time.
weaknesses: Is useless if the memories you collect do not involve people using abilities.

name: Starlight Camouflage
description: At night when the stars are shining, whether there is cloud cover or not, you gain complete invisibility. Your senses are heightened and you gain increased athletic abilities.
summary: The ability to be invisible at night
strengths: Invisible if the stars are shining
Can be a ninja
Get extra sensory powers
weaknesses: Uncontrolable
Cannot be seen even indoors
Cannot see yourself

name: Power Of The Bat
description: Aster being bitten by a radioactive fruit bat, the hero or heroine or villain develops abilities of a bat. Abilities include echolocation, enhanced agility, enhanced balance, enhanced hearing, enhanced smell. The person bitten does not take any physical characteristic of a bat and would stilt look like a normal human being. Therefore, no big bat wings or any bat physiology
summary: The ability to have abilities of a bat
strengths: Powers very good for crimefighting or to commit crime
Good for fighting at night as the user does not need eyes to 'see'
weaknesses: Cannot take down powerhouses one on one

name: Staff Of Montezuma
description: This staff is made from coconut timber. This staff is bathed in gold and is covered in jewels. This staff can turn things into gold.
summary: The ability to possess a staff that can turn things into gold
strengths: You have more gold than Midas
You can feed a nation by turning a mountain into gold
You'll never be poor
weaknesses: This staff cant torn living things into gold
You are a gold maniac
Everyone will want this staff

name: Celestial Consciousness
description: A telepathic branch of power that allows you to transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies including, but not limited to stars, planets, moons, even nebula.  Requiring immense energy and focus, once your consciousness has transferred you can move through space, as a conscious star, and can exert control over your gravitational influences.
summary: The ability to transfer your consciousness to celestial bodies.
strengths: Control the power of the sun with your mind.
Control the celestial properties, and forces that the body you transfer into can control.
weaknesses: Leave your body defenceless, and unconscious during the period of transference.
Further the celestial body, the more focus required.

name: Ventriloquism
description: With this ability you are able to project your voice from any living creature that is within visual range. When doing so the person or living creature is completely unaware of what is taking place.
summary: The ability to project your voice.
strengths: Create a diversion...
weaknesses: Making non-human creatures talk can be unnerving to others
If a person is asked what they said, they are unable to repeat it as they were unaware of what they had said while under control

name: Compassionate Gaze
description: When someone commits such an atrocious and vile and corrupt deed, that many could consider unworthy of forgiveness, and they show no sign of remorse, guilt, or any attempt towards redemption. You can gaze upon their soul and fill their hatred, and loathing with true compassion for their victims and the crimes they committed against them.
summary: The ability to gaze upon a soul who has committed a heinous act, and fill their heart with compassion.
strengths: Bring out a redeeming quality in some of the most heinous villains, for the atrocities they've committed.
You would instinctually know when someone holds no remorse for an ill-deed committed, so this power can't be misdirected.
weaknesses: This power is very specific, and purposeful, and would hold no value in a majority of super-powered contexts.

name: Kinetic Charging
description: Kinetic energy: the energy of motion. A Kinetic Charger can increase an object's kinetic energy by touch. The next time the object touches another, it will explode. This makes everything and anything a dangerous weapon. You must touch the object to make it charged.
summary: The ability to charge matter with explosive kinetic energy
strengths: Totally voluntary
Next time charged object touches another, it will explode
Everything is a weapon
weaknesses: Must touch to charge
Takes more energy to charge larger objects
Cannot uncharge objects

name: Repetitive Damage
description: Whenever you cause a damage to something or someone, the same amount of damage will keep being dealt again and again. For example, if you cut something with a knife, new cuts will keep opening afterwards. If you punch someone, they will keep being struck again and again. The new damages are exactly the same as the original one and appear around the same area and outward. The frequency of appearance is linked to both the violence of the damage and your experience with this power.
summary: The ability to make any damage you deal repeat itself indefinitely.
strengths: You can deal great damage with a single hit.
Continuous damages can be increased. For example, the effects of poison can increase dramatically.
The effect continues even if you deal a new damage. So, you can overload regenerators and healers.
weaknesses: Useless if the original damage has no effect in the first place.
You need to be present, or else the damages stop appearing.

name: Electrical Absorption
description: The most electricity a human can take is 400,000 Watts. A person with Electrical Absorption can store up to ten times that without harm. In addition, they can later release that energy at will.
summary: The ability to absorb electrical energy harmlessly
strengths: Become the best electrician ever
Give Taser freaks a taste of their own medicine
Can store huge voltage indefinitely
weaknesses: Can run out of juice without much warning
Is possible to absorb too much power and hurt yourself
Emotional outbursts may activate a discharge

name: Aspect Humanization
description: A few examples of different aspects: anger, fear, happiness, jealousy, heroism, insanity, intelligence, ignorance, religion, future predictions and past self. The more diversified you are, the more you get.
summary: The ability to give different aspects of your personality human form to fight for you
strengths: They can have different abilities depending on how you see your emotions.
There can be a lot of them
The more you know yourself the more powerful you become
weaknesses: You can't be confused about who you are or they may attack you
You may only have one loyal aspect
If you ignore who you are it is useless

name: Pan Dimensional Teamwork
description: If you have the Pan-dimensional Existence power, then this power will let you call up to five of your other dimensional selves to work together as a team with you. This power will make them work together, no angelic version of you fighting a demonic version of you. This power will keep your team in this dimension for as long as you like. You can swap out team members at any time. A kystian version of you for a sharke version of you. A sharke version for an infinity dimension version of you.
summary: The ability to summon up to 5 of your other dimensional selves.
strengths: So many dimensions, so many possible team combos.
weaknesses: It will take time to learn which team combos work and which don't.
An amoral way of thinking may be the only one to have the best team combos.

name: Animate Inanimator
description: A person with this power can change any living thing within sight into a non-living thing as long as the non-living object has roughly the same mass. That means you can change your enemies into chairs or even turn them into weapons that you can throw. You can also turn one animate object into multiple objects that are lighter. If you throw one, the other objects will follow the first object till the 5-foot limit and the creature will reform and hit the intended target-you can throw giants!!!
summary: The ability to change anything living to anything non-living thing and back
strengths: Change your enemies into chairs or multiple footballs and then kick them
Change animals into swords, clubs, guns, etc. To use against people further away
As long as the mass is the same, you can also change the person into multiple objects
weaknesses: If you throw the object farther than 5 feet, the object(s) will bunch together and reform
The power wears off if the object is 5 feet from you
As an inanimate object, the creature/person becomes indestructible

name: Ancient Beast: Phoenix
description: The power is split into three types; Phoenix-form, Human-form and Hybrid-form.   The Phoenix-form allows flight, control over fire and reincarnation.   The Human-form allows control over fire and reincarnation.   The Hybrid-form allows control over fire, flight and reincarnation but the powers are much more powerful than in Human- or Phoenix-form.
summary: The ability to have the powers of a phoenix.
strengths: Unkillable.
If someone disagrees, burn them to ashes!
You can FLY!
weaknesses: Eternal life isn't very fun after a couple of thousand years.
The burns on your clothes aren't very funny.
Watch out for heavy rain fall.

name: Intraceability
description: When you walk, you leave no footprints. Items left behind are free of scent or identification (such as a name or address); it is much like invisibility where a person cannot be seen, but in this case the person cannot be followed by the use of evidence left behind. However, they still can be recognized by a witness and found by what the witness said. The intraceability doesn't activate until the person leaves the scene (or as long as they are standing in one spot they have a footprint).
summary: The ability to leave nothing behind that would allow anyone or anything to follow you.
strengths: Cannot be followed via tracking (prints, markings, scents, IDs)
Throw a party and trash the place, then leave and it's like you were never there.
As long as you keep distance, your enemies will never catch you
weaknesses: Cannot use markings to find your way back
Still visible and thus can be recognized by witnesses
No one can find you by tracking, including those who can help you.

name: Terrestrial Light Pulse
description: There is a light pulse that flows through planets. With your hands and your mind, you can summon up this earthly light pulse to grow the tallest and freshest vegetation on even the most Barren lands. You can clean the lakes and rivers from any pollution. You can even bring back animals and humans back from the dead (as long as they were recently dead).
summary: The ability to use the light pulse of the planet to rejuvenate almost Anything
strengths: You are the replenisher of the Earth and other planets.
You can turn moldy food back into their freshest state.
You can also use it to heal wounds on your self, or others. And bring back people from death.
weaknesses: You can't create a made up plant. Plus a planet has to have some remote sign to sustain some life.
Revive the dead as soon as possible. Because when it completely deteriorates, it's harder to do so.

name: X Men
description: The overview pretty much explains it all. Even if the mutant is dead. Also you get complete control over their powers. But there's only one problem: The user can only use up to 3 powers at a time.
summary: The ability to possess/control up to 3 superpowers that any mutant from the x-men movies, comics, and series have.
strengths: Everything!
weaknesses: Limited power usage at one time, but no biggie!

name: Enemy Skill
description:
The person with this ability is like a copycat or a mimic, but with a difference. They can use the skills and abilities of their enemies, when their enemy uses that particular skill on them. You can only use the last ability used on yourself. 
E. G. A fire breather uses their ability on you so you can breather fire until someone shoots lightning at you, then you can shoot lightning. 
This power isn't just limited to your enemies, your allies could heal you, giving you healing powers.
summary: The ability to learn and successfully manipulate the skills and abilities of your enemies.
strengths: Copy the previous power used on oneself, to its full potential.
Can copy any ability used on yourself, as long as it doesn't kill you in the process.
weaknesses: Can only use the most recent ability, used on oneself.
Can only copy up to one skill at a time, they change each time a new ability is used on you.

name: Cold Current
description: You can do everything like firing out cryobolts. It shocks and freezes the opponent solid at full force. Also, you can create large frostbolts that will sweep across everywhere, damaging your opponents and leaving them paralyzed and frozen.
summary: The ability to fire bolts of ice that freeze and electrocute your enemies.
strengths: You can give your enemies the shocking chills.
weaknesses: None.

name: Time Manipulation Knowledge
description: You know how manipulating time works. This includes, but is not limited to, speeding up time, slowing it down, rewinding it, traveling through it, seeing the future, the past, jumping to other timelines, etc. You have a complete knowledge of how to build things to do this, and what materials you'll need/when they're available. Finally, if someone has an innate ability to interact with time, you will know how to awaken it, control it, how to train them, and how to disable them.
summary: The ability to know how to build time machines
strengths: A plethora of time powers are available to you
You can also make them availble to others, and look like a genius while you do it
Comes with an understanding of temporal mechanics- helps you with paradoxes
weaknesses: Of course, someone can steal the machines
Or analyze them
Or beat you with a pipe wrench until you explain it

name: Beat Resoundance
description: When this power is used every sound wave that your ears process with become a potential weapon. All you have to do is focus on the soundwave and it will be at your disposal.    You can make them into any shape or form such as orbs shields disks or just simple raw waves. You can adjust their density to be non damaging to extremely lethal.   If your deaf then this power is of no use to you. Plus anything that can diffuse sound can diffuse your constructs.
summary: The ability to project any sound heard into a solid form
strengths: Have the power of soundwaves at your fingertips
Even use your voice as a weapon
Always be prepared for any defense situation
weaknesses: No use if deaf
Doesn't work on sound diffusing surfaces

name: Avatar
description: It is like a secondary body for your brain. The avatar is usually a more advanced humanoid. It gives the user access to siddhis, a form of psychic magic. It lets the avatar use levitation, creation of physical constructs, use of the original five elements, see into the past, present and future, bilocation (split body), make the body impervious to harm for a short time, attain a higher level of consciousness. If the avatar is killed, the human body sustains a similar wound.
summary: The ability to create your own avatar
strengths: The avatar is stronger and more powerful than the human
They can learn to access siddhis after a long use of the avatar
Constant use of the avatar will let the human gain use of both sides of the brain
weaknesses: If the avatar is killed, it cannot be recovered
If the avatar is killed, similar wounds will happen to the human
The human may not want to go back to its human body

name: Puppet Mastery
description: Controlling other people is something we all like to do, whether we want to admit it or not. A person with Puppet Mastery can manipulate the movements of other people as they please-- making them jump, run, dance, freeze in place or even hurt and kill themselves is only a gesture away.
summary: The ability to control other people's motor functions
strengths: Controlling others
Stopping small groups of assailants
Saying, "Stop hitting yourself!" over and over again
weaknesses: Not something you can use covertly
Larger groups require more mental strength
Can become vengeful and wrathful

name: Tele Builder
description: You can look at something, pick it up using your mind, and turn it into something different that works and is reliable. To do this, you can close your eyes, or hum, or whatever it takes to make you concentrate. The new device you have created can be whatever colour you like. This ability is sometimes called telekinetics, but that is only the ability to move things with your mind, not build them. Good luck!
summary: The ability to build something fool-proof and reliable with just your mind
strengths: You can make a device in the space of five minutes
You can turn even a crumb into a complete suit of armour, for example
The devices work smoothly and without problems
weaknesses: The devices disappear after an hour
The devices may fall apart if not put together properly (it takes practice!!! )

name: Elaborate Planning
description: A person with this power has the ability to make the most convoluted schemes ever and have them succeed. They MAY take many years and may involve time travel, messing with the continuum, meating alternate versions of yourself, ruining the lives of countless others all in the name of doing one simple action. But they don't have to, they can also be short, concise plans executable for someone without any further powers. However, mind readers etc. will not even be able to understand your plans.
summary: The ability to make unnecessarily elaborate plans that have a 99.9% success rate
strengths: Your plans always work (99.9%)
Your plans can never be understood until you reveal it
People will underestimate you, giving you the win
weaknesses: Sometimes your plans involve doing stupid things
Your plans may take many years to accomplish versus making a regular plan
Could put a lot of planning into a few simple tasks

name: Ageless
description: With this power, you will never look a day over 30, but your lifespan is indefinite. So long as no outside forces kill you, you can live for thousands of years. Also, you heal 50% faster than normal people, and naturally regrow lost limbs. It takes about a month to regrow a lost finger, and almost a year to get back a lost arm. But that's just a drop in the ocean to you. You may not look so healthy all the time, though. Also, you will be inexplicably fated to meet any others with this power.
summary: The ability to live indefinitely, unaging, with some regenerative capabilities.
strengths: Live indefinitely
Immune to death by "natural causes"
Enhanced regeneration (Note: Other regenerative powers will override this one, though)
weaknesses: Not indestructible
Danger and the paranormal seems to be drawn to you
May develop depression and a cynical attitude from living so long

name: Unlocking Fingersnap
description: By clicking your fingers, you unlock any door or lock that you are focusing on. If you focus to a greater degree, the handle will turn and the door or lid will open as well.  This power works on electronic locks and systems as well, allowing you to bypass locked car doors, etc. However, the doors must have a mechanical element to unlock.
summary: The ability to unlock doors and objects by snapping your fingers
strengths: No jail cell can hold you ever
Could become a master thief without any tools
You're a really useful guy to have around
weaknesses: Locks that use magnets are resistant to your power
Can't unlock pin-encrypted devices, like phones or computers
Not a tremendously impressive ability

name: Vive Chacun
description: With this power you can control how long people live. From only 1-year-old to 1000+ years-old. As long as they die sometime. You can also control how they die. By "they" I mean anyone or everybody or someone or him or her, etc.
summary: The ability to control how long people live
strengths: Controling death
weaknesses: Cannot control how they die

name: Paralysis Point
description: With this power you can paralyze people by pointing at them. The victim will be unable to move as long as you are pointing at them. It doesn't matter how far away you are from them or which finger you use to point at them. You also can't turn this power off so whenever you point at anybody they become paralyzed. You can also point at multiple people at once and they will all become paralyzed.
summary: The ability to cause people to become paralyzed when you point at them
strengths: You can paralyze people by pointing at them
You can do it with any finger and from as far away from the person as you want
You paralyze multiple people by pointing at multiple people at the same time
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off
Once you stop pointing they unfreeze

name: Synapse Manipulation
description: In the nervous system, a synapse is a structure that permits a neuron to pass an electrical or chemical signal to another cell. Basically, the user can manipulate the electrical or chemical functions between neurons. For example; electrical synapses conduct nerve impulses faster such as defence reflexes. Chemical synapses are crucial to the biological computations that underlie perception and thought. They allow the nervous system to connect to and control other systems of the body.
summary: The ability to control neurons and command them to do your bidding
strengths: Control a human body from within
Have the great advantage in battle
weaknesses: Negative emotions trigger this if unexperienced

name: Psychic Bubbles
description: A film of psychic power wraps around the air and forms a sphere, in the same way that soap creates bubbles. Any number or sizes of bubbles can be made, but they are all perfect spheres. Change the size of the bubble to create a super-dense marble, or a low-pressure atmospheric bubble that will create a gust of wind when popped. Or just make a large one around yourself for a quick, 1HP forcefield. The possibilities are endless.
summary: The ability to wrap spheres of psychic power around portions of the atmosphere and control everything within.
strengths: Very versatile - only your imagination limits what you can do with the bubbles, really
Perfectly transparent - only you or other psychics will know what's going on
Quick shield - doubles as a weak forcefield, dust screen, underwater air bubble, whatever!
weaknesses: You can't control what it is you capture in the bubble - whatever's in the air, is in there
The bubbles are flimsy against other psychic power, and another psychokinetic can pop them with ease
Who would be intimidated by invisible bubbles, really?

name: Technointegration
description: Resistance is futile: best line ever. And a Technointegrator can pull it off. By touching a piece of technology (telephone, computer, chainsaw, nanites, etc.) they can merge their best qualities with the machine's best qualities, making a 'cyborg-esque' being. They can also use the abilities of the technology they used: making calls, computing quickly, having a deadly chainsaw for a hand, etc. They can only absorb 3 technologies at a time and are still vunerable to disease.
summary: The ability to merge your biology with a technological device
strengths: Can use the abilities of the technology
Can merge with any technology
Able to remove the technology at any time
weaknesses: 3 different technologies at a time
Still vunerable to disease
Only as strong as your technology

name: Super Transformation
description: This power lets one transform into a more powerful being that increases ones overall fighting prowess and boosts existing powers. Drains a lot of energy; have to transform back when energy is spent.
summary: The ability to transform into an ascended version of ones self
strengths: Become more powerful
Everything is increased from its original state
weaknesses: Can use only once every day
Can only activate it when strength levels meet the requirements
Uses a lot of energy to activate

name: Elemental Archer
description: Bow and arrows formed from such elements such as fire, water, earth, etc. Years of practice are needed to harness more the elements.
summary: The ability to form a bow and arrow out of the elements
strengths: Never run out of ammuniton
Long and close range weapon
Can be any form of a bow such as long bow bow or cross bow
weaknesses: Accuracy and proficiency do not come with the bow
More advanced elements harder to control

name: Mental Control
description: This is your basic mind-control superpower. You touch someone, tell them to do something, and they will obey, no questions asked. But, there's a small twist. You must truly mean what you're saying when you're controlling someone's mind.
summary: The ability to control anyone's mind.
strengths: You can make anyone do anything you want. Nuff said.
weaknesses: You need to touch them and really mean what you're saying.

name: Genetic Conjugation
description: Unicellular organisms can perform an act called conjugation, wherein they take up DNA from a second bacteria. Individuals with Genetic Conjugation can also do this. With simple physical contact, they can 'swap' nucleic acids with a second organism--trading traits for skin pigmentation, eye color, bone density, muscle growth, etc. The traits do not appear right away, rather, they take a period of time to respond--the old manufactured proteins must be flushed from the system.
summary: The ability to trade genetic material with another organism
strengths: Trade traits for muscle density, skin pigmentation, etc.
Can pass acquired traits down to offspring
Can't be felt
weaknesses: New genes not immediately in effect
If a developmental stage is past for you, no genes will change effects of that stage
Cannot take up learned skills

name: Arrow Strike V2
description: With this power you can shoot arrows from your hand that can pierce through anything. You have an unlimited supply of arrows and the arrows cannot hurt you.
summary: The ability to shoot arrows from your hand that can pierce through anything
strengths: You can shoot arrows from your hand
You have an unlimited supply of arrows
The arrows can't hurt you
weaknesses: You can't make the arrows disappear

name: Color Shirt Power V2
description: With this power you can gain powers depending on the color or colors of the shirt or shirts you are wearing: Maroon: fire breath. Silver: invincibility. Gold: money rain. Violet: shapeshifting. This list applies to all shade of the color in question. Once you take off the shirt, you lose the powers. The colors of your pants, shoes, socks, hat, jewelry, other types of clothing do not have any effect on this power.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on the color(s) of the shirt(s) you are wearing
strengths: You can get cool powers just for wearing a shirt.
If you wear more than one shirt or your shirt has more than one color, you get more than one power.
weaknesses: The color of your pants does not have any effect on this power.
If you're not wearing a shirt, you get no powers (unless you have other powers).

name: Stare Of Truth
description: With this ability, no one can ever lie to you... Unless you aren't staring at them. Your gaze will simply be too horrific and paralyzing for anyone to lie to you.
summary: The ability to get the truth out of someone by staring at them.
strengths: You get the truth, yey.
weaknesses: You are scary.

name: Invisible In The Shadows
description: This power allows you to become invisible when you are standing in shadows or darkness. You control when you become invisible and at night you can be practically invisible anywhere.
summary: The ability to become invisible in the presence of shadows and darkness
strengths: you can be invisible
good for sneaking up on people
good for being an assassin
weaknesses: only works with shadows or darkness near you
once you run out of shadow you can't go anywhere
tags: invisible in the shadows or darkness

name: Medical Zone
description: With this power, you designate a zone to become a medical zone where only healing can take place and nobody can be harmed. While inside the zone any physical or mental harm will be reversed and absorbed so that the person is healed instead of becoming hurt. Also while in the zone any mental problems will begin to fade and physical imperfections will be improved. If within the zone long enough even limbs can be regrown. People inside the zone are immune to any negative force used against them.
summary: The ability to create a zone where only healing can take place.
strengths: No harm while in zone. Ultimate safe area.
Will be healed instead of hurt from attacks.
Mental and physical problems will be fixed.
weaknesses: Can not hurt others even if you wanted to.
Zone could become safe haven for criminals looking for safety.
Power negators can still do what they want.

name: Psionic Energy Armor
description: You are protected with your mind as you psychically create armor for yourself. Its as strong as a tank & boosts your strength. You can also shield people around you & vehicles you are in. Though all of this takes great mental concentration & if you sustain to much damage, your armor will become weak & fade leaving you mentally exhausted & unprotected.
summary: The ability to produce psychic energy armor
strengths: Create durable armor from psychic energy
Shield people & items
weaknesses: If taking to much damage, the armor disappears

name: Time Spark
description: With this ability, a person can control time via a special metal cube called the 'Time Spark'. It resembles the All Spark from 'Transformers', but has no symbols, except for an Egyptian eye, on all sides. The user psychically sees into the past and future, and can open a silver vortex known as 'The Time Twister' to escape enemies, trap them in eternal dimension limbo, or mess up their life through alteration of that person's perception of time.
summary: The ability to use a mirrored metal cube to harness power over time
strengths: Escape to a better timeline
Banish enemies into eternal limbo
Know the best moments in life yet to come!!
weaknesses: This power is unimaginably destructive in the wrong hands!
Using the Time Spark's full potential takes practice
Time Defiance

name: Hibernation
description: You get hurt bad enough to be killed. No problem. Just enter a sleep state, heal, and come back. Also slow your aging process in order to live longer, physically much stronger, faster, and younger than normal humans.
summary: The ability to heal fatal injuries by hibernating and slow aging process.
strengths: Completely indestructible while hibernating.
Extremely hard to kill
Stay stronger, faster, and younger for more time than normal people.
weaknesses: Decapitation, instant death
You can be hurt as easily as normal humans, So train to be a better fighter/survivor
Hibernating may last days or even weeks depending on how badly you're injured.

name: Micro Gravatic Fissure
description: You can throw or leave suspended in the air small 'time bombs' that will cause an implosion of gravimetric force. This force creates shock waves that pull towards the 'time bomb' causing kinetic damage and causing loose objects to be drawn towards it. The 'time bombs' go off after you stop concentrating on them / at your command. The larger the bomb you create, the more draining it is upon you. Tiny 'time bombs' can be thrown in a spray with an effect of bantering at your enemy. Chargeable.
summary: The ability to create small balls of Gravity Implosion like micro black holes.
strengths: Causes Kinetic Damage proportional to how close the target is to the 'time bomb'
Can cause loose objects to be flung in the direction of the imploding 'time bomb'
Used in series, it can cause someone / something to be pulled. (e.g. Pulled off roof)
weaknesses: Collateral Damage.
Gravity implosion affects everything nearby, trailing off effect with increasing range.
If boosted, blackholes might not self-collapse immediately.

name: Starcrafter
description: This power is the ability to control the stars and space: including contracting and expanding atmospheres, going supernova, and even create stardust. Star distance measure power level. If body and power usage are not within equilibrium, the body will heat up and shut down.
summary: The ability to control power of stars and dark matter.
strengths: Control of thermal emission
Atmospheric shifting
Control over dark matter
weaknesses: Star distance measures power level
Complete darkness is a weakness
If the body is to hot it will destroy everything around it

name: Multitask
description: Also known as Assembly Line Brain. The user has the ability to do many activities at once with the same mental efficiency of doing only one task for each task. The user is able to process information in their brain for each task without the details confusing them. Another side-effect is that the user also never forgets anything that they were supposed to do. The user can also increase his efficiency in one task by splitting up the single task into multiple simpler tasks.
summary: The ability to do multiple activities at the same time without decrease in mental efficiency for any task
strengths: You can do everything you want to in a day-and even more
You can do many jobs at once without problems at either job-you also have full concentration on each
You can fight multiple opponents with no sweat-you would feel like you are only fighting one person
weaknesses: If you got everything done and there was nothing else you needed to do in the day-kind of boring
Activities must be closeby and within reach-limited only by physical constraints
You remember that you have to do your chores

name: Virtual Melding
description: For any amount of time up to 24 hours from started (with the same amount of time you spent using as recharge time), you can meld yourself with a custom character of your creation in a virtual world (gaming, online profiles, offline games. This character can also be fine tuned a tiny bit to fit you (make yourself thinner to fit the character hair length, type and color).
summary: The ability to for a time meld your self with one of your custom game characters
strengths: You gain their powers
You can look like your dream person
Good in fights cause you will always have the weapons and spells you like most
weaknesses: Someone else has this power and their character is better than yours
If it's a long fight you could lose powers after 24 hours and start getting beaten

name: Lucernae Marque
description: The subject is able to give a superpower to someone else drawing on his/her skin a luminous symbol by spreading his/her hands. The color and shape of the "tattoo" and the power acquired vary from person to person, and they are determined by genetic factors. Everytime the power is turned on the symbol will shine.
summary: The ability to give superpowers to other people by drawing a shiny symbol on their skin..
strengths: The symbol is removable, so the power is not permanent if not liked.
weaknesses: The process of drawing consumes a big quantity of energy and leaves the subject very tired.

name: Total Silence
description: Are you terrible at sneaking about because you are a loud person? With Total Silence, no one will hear you, even if you are scratching chalkboards along the way!   WARNING: Scratching chalkboards is not recommended because, as the user of this ability, you could still hear them.
summary: The ability to be unheard in any action you take.
strengths: You can be loud and destructive while still maintaining steath!
You can shout insults at people without them taking notice.
weaknesses: People can still see you, so don't get too crazy.

name: Cosmality
description: You can control the mind of anyone you choose. You can see anything that has happend to the person. You will be able to put things in the person's head that would drive them insane. And you can take their knowledge and and their powers.
summary: The ability to see the thoughts of others and unhinge their minds
strengths: You can destroy people's minds
You could create an army of all the people you are controlling
No one would have chance to destroy you
weaknesses: You have to be at least within 1000 miles of the person
It takes a lot of power
It takes a lot of energy

name: Reincarnation Determination
description:
With this power you can access all the abilities of previous reincarnations and can reincarnate to whatever you desire as long as that person does not yet exist

You have "immortality" since you can't "die" just reincarnate.
summary: The ability to reincarnate into anyone as well as keep all your memories and abilities
strengths: If you reincarnate into a rich person you can leave your money to your next reincarnation
If you reincarnate into an individual with superpowers then you can have multiple powers
Spite your enemies by reincarnating into their offspring
weaknesses: You can still die
If you accidentally attach yourself to someone who is immortal then this power is negated
You can only reincarnate into humans or demigods, so no reincarnating into a god or demon

name: Scan
description:
This ability allows you to find out about every single detail about any one person no matter how irrelevant.
You have total knowledge of there strengths, weaknesses, attributes and other status info. But you must focus all your thoughts on that person.
summary: The ability to analyze the strengths, weaknesses and other info on anyone.
strengths: Know everything about a person.
Use persons weaknesses to your advantage.
weaknesses: Sometimes it's best not to know about someone.
Must focus all thoughts and mind on that one person.

name: Metal Manipulation
description: A user of this ability can create a construct with metallic minerals, create armor, control iron in someone's blood, dismantle mechanical devices. A user who possesses this ability must be in contact with the ground in order to use this power properly, being separated from the ground will abruptly halt this power.
summary: The ability to manipulate the Japanese element of Metal as long as you're in contact with the ground
strengths: Protection from Damage
Weapon usage
Constructs
weaknesses: Limited power range
Obvious weakness
Usage of power makes someone vulnerable to attack if not already protected.

name: Postcognitive Telepathy
description: Postcognitive Telepathy is the ability to perceive the thoughts of others way after they have come up with them. The time one receives thoughts afterward can vary as randomly as with normal Postcognition. In addition, the reception is not simply receptive. One with this ability can also dominate minds in the past, implanting telepathic compulsions and illusions for later on (as far back in time as he can hear thoughts, he can project thoughts as well).
summary: The ability to perceive the thoughts of others after they are thought of
strengths: Perceive thoughts in the past (how far back in the past can be improved in time)
Implant thoughts in the past (including suggestions and illusions)
Bypass present mental defenses
weaknesses: Doesn't allow one to actually see the past
Seers with Telepathy can predict past mental attacks
If mental defenses are always up

name: Fire Walking
description: With this power, any fire becomes a doorway. You can step through fires as small as match-heads and appear out of any other fire in the world. In addition, this power renders you and anyone you teleport with immune to the fire's harmful effects, such as burning and smoke inhalation.
summary: The ability to teleport through fire
strengths: Teleport between any two points of fire.
Become the ultimate firefighter.
weaknesses: Must have fire to teleport through.
Any fire you set to teleport will stay where you set it. You could burn something down.

name: Effect Empathy
description: This ability allows you to absorb and mimic a power's effects or side ability. For example, if someone had the ability to turn to water. The user of this ability will mimic the hidden powers of that power. The user would gain the power to be as unstable as water or to slip through cracks, but not turn to water. Another example would be, if you copy Rogue's side effects of her power, you would be able to have people's memories and powers without the need to touch to absorb their life force.
summary: The ability to gain the powers of the effects and hidden abilities of a primary ability.
strengths: Able to mimic the hidden powers of other powers.
Won't need to do any conditions to use the hidden power.
weaknesses: Beware of mimicking bad side effects.

name: Oblivion
description:
Using this ability, you create a force field around an area, however the larger the area, the more effort is required. You cause devastating explosions within that area that erase everything within from existance. 
Your supremely powerful with Oblivion.
summary: The ability to create a force field around an area, and obliterate everything within.
strengths: No limit to the size of area, that you are destroying.
Everything on the inside of the shield can not leave; and visa versa,
weaknesses: No way of reversing this power.
Larger the size of area, more effort required.

name: Absorption
description: The power to absorb/be absorbed into materials/minerals. You can also manipulate your body into new shapes--except for your brain, heart and major organs. Ex: You can absorb the materials of a gun. When you are attacked, you can morph your hand into a gun from the stored materials. Or, you can absorb a boulder and turn your body into a rock hard protective suit. Or, make a sword and shield of whatever you want. Or absorb and make wings for yourself. You can do whatever your imagination wants.
summary: The ability to absorb materials/minerals into parts of your own body.
strengths: Can manipulate and change your body into new shapes.
Can move through walls by absorbing your way through them.
Can obsorb non-solid objects.
weaknesses: Powers are temporary.
Shape manipulation is not always exact.
Power requires a large amount of energy.

name: Attunement To Space
description: This power is a strange one. Instead of just manipulating space it causes you to become totally attuned to space. This causes space to quickly and precisely act to the users thoughts as if it were an extra limb. It also allows the user to sense disturbances in space as well as the nuances of space itself. Due to being attuned space also responds to unconscious thoughts causing changes much faster than normal as well as giving space the tendency to protect the user from harm.
summary: The ability to be totally attuned to space and spacial energy.
strengths: Acts on both conscious and unconscious thoughts so you can warp space quickly.
You have space bend to your will for attack, defense, travel, or storage.
You can detect the nuances and disturbances of space.
weaknesses: You cannot easily control the warps from unconscious thought AND they come faster than normal warps.
Much,MUCH harder to figure out and properly utilize than manipulation.
Your own warps might be interfered with by space trying to protect you.

name: Bio  Em Field
description: The person with this power is able to generate a bio EM field. With this bio-EM field, he or she is able to wreck havoc on EM powered equipment, generate bio electric energy, and track people using by their bioelectrical pulse
summary: The ability to generate a bio-EM field to wreck havoc with EM powered equipment
strengths: Can screw up with enemies' electrical equipment
Can enter enemies' hideout undetected
weaknesses: Does not destroy the equipment, simply screws it up

name: Relationship Manipulation
description: Relationship manipulation is the power to manipulate the emotional bonds between individuals, partners and couples. The user has influence over the emotional ties between people in the sense that they can both loosen and secure these ties. You can make partners turn away from one another, disband groups and friendships, but also can strengthen the bonds that bind one person to another. The effects of this power are long-lasting and fade depending on how long a person has been exposed.
summary: The ability to manipulate relationships.
strengths: You can get the partner of your dreams.
Build a dream team.
Get rich friends.
weaknesses: Unlikely, but someone can learn you're doing it.

name: Air Bender
description: (Air is the element of freedom) you can create and manipulate air. Your power source is the air. Your weakness is fire. You have an advantage over the other elements. As a Air bender You are peaceful and forgiving
summary: The ability to become a Air bender from the Avatar the Last Air bender animated television series
strengths: You have an advantage over the other elements
As a Air bender you are peaceful and forgiving (pro & con)
you can shadow bend at higher levels
weaknesses: You have more hatred against the fire nation than the other nation
Shadow bending is one of the darkest forms of bending
Air feeds fire

name: Remote Hearing
description: Like Remote Viewing, you can use one of your senses to spy on targets. But with this, you can only hear what's happening, not see it. So, if you develop your hearing so that you can recognize sounds, you will overcome that little disability.
summary: The ability to hear what's happening in other places
strengths: Can hear what people do when they are alone.
Can train yourself to recognize sounds
weaknesses: Can only hear things, not see them

name: Genetic Control
description: Person can change their own or another's genetic structure.  This enables the person to grant themselves new powers based on others abilities.  Would work extremely well with a genetic perception power, but if you have the equipment to take samples and analyze them, you'd still be able to to any genetic advantage anyone had.
summary: The ability to control and change the genetic structure of self or others.
strengths: Improve Genetic structure.
Potentially could be theri own experiment in search of genetic perfection.
weaknesses: Need to know what you are doing, or could kill yourself or others.

name: Dream Reality Warping
description: Also allows the user to release anesthetic into their body so as to allow them to fall asleep. Can create a powerful force field to subconsciously protect them while they are dreaming. Could potentially be a powerful weapon if a telepath (or dream manipulator) were to manipulate their dreams to affect the real world.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality through dreams.
strengths: Can potentially do anything.
Invincible while asleep.
Can fall asleep whenever.
weaknesses: Dreams are unpredictable without the aid of a telepath (or a dream manipulator).
Unable to do anything while asleep.
Could be very dangerous.

name: Sinister Empowerment
description: In X-Men, Apocalypse is the first mutant. It is said that most mutants got their powers from him over time. With this power, you can give people powers, but only one at a time. You can wait until they master their powers, or you can increase them so that when they are powerful enough, you can steal it from them!
summary: The ability to bestow superpowers, then steal them back.
strengths: Become a powerful supervillain
Give people powers, then steal it from them
weaknesses: You can only give them one power at a time
You can only steal powers that you have bestowed

name: Weather Controlled Powers
description: It all matters on the weather outside. If you are in the desert you would be able to control fire, if there is a tornado going on you will have wind powers, if there is a hurricane you will have wind and water powers.
summary: The ability to have a power that matches the weather
strengths: You will never be bored of the same power
A lot of choices to save the world with
All really good powers
weaknesses: If you live in a climate that doesn't change that much you will have it until it changes
If you are say flying because of your wind powers and the weather changes you will probably fall
You might have a power that won't help you in the situation

name: Power Hold
description: This makes all your powers including this one virtualy become one with you so that they cannot be seperated from you, isolated, have their effects reversed by Forced Reversion or other powers, be under someone's control or be denied your access. You can freely use your powers even under hypnosis and you cannot be astrally or otherwise evicted from your body. Your powers can affect your body in their designated ways, unaffected by powers that cancel their effects.
summary: The ability to be virtualy one and the same with your powers
strengths: You cannot be seperated from powers, you can always use them.
Beat Omnipotent Power Blocking and forced reversion, or just reverse.
Works perfectly with Power Safety!
weaknesses: None.

name: Shadow Kinetic Basic
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into give them extra energy to keep them going through their activities. Other than that, it just immobolizes opponents or objects before they move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to give the user extra energy.
strengths: Extra energy
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Cancer Manipulation
description: The power is simple, power over cancer. The user can create cancer in him and other living creatures. The user can make the cancer grow to kill his opponents or make the cancer grow out his skin to turn them into tentacles.  The most useful part of this ability is that the user can remove it painlessly or painfully.
summary: The ability to create, control and remove uncontrolled division of abnormal cells.
strengths: Control cancer
Give enemies cancer.
Remove cancer
weaknesses: To the unprepared, the cancer the user put inside him could kill him.

name: Endurance Manipulation
description: This ability will go through some evolutionary changes before reaching the final phase. First, you will secretly drain the endurance from others so that you can withstand more things than anyone else. The next phase is when you have extra endurance, you can use all of it in a physical tackle. The final phase is the full on manipulation of it all. This will make you "INVINCIBLE" if you focus on it, and you can destroy your enemy by taking away their stamina.
summary: The ability to control the endurance (or stamina) of yourself and others through an evolutionary process.
strengths: Control the endurance of yourself and others.
Hidden Ability #1: If you absorb the endurance of those with a healing ability, you can have it.
Hidden Ability #2: If you absorb the endurance of those who are invincible, you'll be as well.
weaknesses: It is an evolutionary process.
Anything absorbed by this ability will go away in a short time.

name: Customed Persona
description: Instantly become a vigilante, costumed defenders and/or villian. You have to think about something (a person/theme etc.) and you will instantly get the costuime and equipment that goes with it. Not a superhero with powers (Green Lantern, Superman), just "real" equipment (Batman etc.)
summary: The ability to instantly assume a costumed persona based on anything, complete with equipment/weapons.
strengths: Instant morphing
Comes with equipment and weapons etc.
weaknesses: Once you assume a persona, it won't have any real powers.
It requires imagination/a good memory

name: Illusory Form
description: One with this ability can assume a form of illusory energy.
