This form prevents anyone from knowing what the user truly looks like, because all they see is what they expect the user to look like, or what he wants them to think he looks like. In recording devices, his voice is garbled and his appearance is blurred.
summary: The ability to assume a form that is subject to interpretation
strengths: No one knows what you look like (get away with anything)
No recording device (surveillance camera, audio recorder, etc) can track your true identity traits
You become invisible to people who are immune to illusions
weaknesses: Your true form can be seen with Clairvoyance and Reality Perception
Your true voice can be heard by Clairaudience
The power Disillusion can revert you back to normal

name: Elemental Prosthetics
description: When this ability is active, you are capable of utilizing the four classical elements, plus the periodic table elements, as replacements for lost limbs. The prostheses are capable of retaining the abilities; meaning, if you replace your arm with fire, you would be able to absorb fire and project it. If an elemental prosthesis is destroyed, you can create another one. Your genetic code has been modified to the extent where you have all the elements in memory.
summary: The ability to replace severed limbs with elemental prostheses.
strengths: Can instantly select another element.
Use the environment to your advantage.
Create a titanium prosthesis and crush your foes.
weaknesses: The elements can still be destroyed or extinguish.
You are still vulnerable.
Some elements don't mix. (resulting in an EPIC FAIL)

name: Fictional Reality Hopping
description: You are able to enter any fictional show's, video game's, or book's reality. You can spend an infinite amount of time doing so: while using this power, time in the real world/reality is stopped. When entered, you gain similar powers to the main characters. You must have one memory of the visual appearance of the reality. Can bring things/ living beings with you into the fictional reality, but not take things from that reality back to your own.
summary: The ability to switch between realities.
strengths: Can gain superspeed in Sonic the Hedgehog.
Can gain multiple powers in Heroes.
You can take things/people with you into the dimension
weaknesses: Could have to fight evil-doers.
Can't take stuff from that dimension back with you
If you die, you get outed and have to wait 24 before using this power again

name: Weapon Body
description: Morph your body into tons of different weapons. Shoot bullets from your mouth, or make an AK-47 grow out of your chest. The weapons can't detach from your body, but you only need to want your weapons to fire to do so. You can make lots of different weapons grow out of your body, or make a lot of the same weapons shoot at the same time. You can make energy weapons grow out of your body as well. You can't make actual armor or walls, but the metal or plastic of the weapons you grow can help.
summary: The ability to create weapons on your body
strengths: Never need to carry a gun
Be a living super tank
Act like a shield
weaknesses: Your weapons might get jammed by a superpower
Can only make guns, no swords
Can't make actual armor

name: Cause/Effect Reversal
description: An effect must be preceded by some causes it to happen, but with this power you can make the effect happen first and the universe will retroactively make up the most logical cause based on what you wanted to do.   For example, if you decided you wanted to cook a huge dinner and used this power, you would immediately have a huge dinner cooked in front of you. The universe would then work backwards, subtracting the ingredients from your kitchen and hitting you with the fatigue from cooking.
summary: The ability to reverse the law of cause and effect.
strengths: Make it so that any action absolutly suceeds, immediately.
Save time.
weaknesses: Actions taken must be physically possible by you.
All energy it would take to cause the effect is subtracted from you all at once.

name: Intuitive Duplication
description: People with this ability can duplicate any power or ablity that the user wants once its used against them by understanding how that power works.
summary: The ability to duplicate any power that is used against the user.
strengths: Can pick which power you want so you wont duplicate one that you dont want.
No limit on how many you can duplicate.
Have complete control over the power or ability once duplicated.
weaknesses: Can only duplicate one power or ability at a time even if the other person has multiple powers.
Must accually touch the other person to duplicate some powers.

name: Shadow Claws
description: You can turn your hands into shadow claws that can penetrate almost any substance or material.
summary: The ability to make your hands become shadow claws
strengths: It is good for fights
The claws can come out at will
weaknesses: It might put someone in the hospital

name: The Sandman
description: With this ability, you can have full control over dreams, whether they're yours or someone else's.  You name it--you can make anything happen.  You can create pleasant dreams, confusing dreams, or nightmares if you feel it necessary, and you can use your ability on someone from any distance away.
summary: The ability to have full control over your dreams and other people's dreams.
strengths: Have some pretty damn good dreams
Never have a nightmare again
Communicating with people through their dreams
weaknesses: Only trouble is, gee whiz, you might want to dream your life away.

name: Astral Being
description: When projecting your physical body and conscious mind go comatose. Your astral body is able to interact with things in the ether: spirits, living auras, divinities, and other astral bodies. The form you take changes with personality, morality, and force of will. Astral bodies are tethered to their physical bodies and their purpose for entering the ether by a silver cord. It takes years of practice to create distance between bodies, impose a clear goal, or act in the physical realm.
summary: The ability to become concious of your astral body and project from your physical body.
strengths: Request aid from ghosts, gods, and other astral beings.
Influence decisions and life forces of living beings.
Bring your astral body into the physical realm with enough practice.
weaknesses: Leaves you highly physically vulnerable.
You might not remember what you were supposed to do in the ether.
Actions you take might attract unwanted attention from higher powers.

name: Pan Dimensional Self Exchange
description: With this power you change your body into the version of your body from a different parallel dimension. You gain the abilities, skills, and weaknesses of the other version of yourself that you are turning into. When you change bodies you will have the clothes and personal items of the other version you are turning into. (If they have a sword with them normally you would gain their sword while changed into that version). You will not gain their personality however.
summary: The ability to turn your body into the body of one your other-dimensional selves.
strengths: Infinite dimensions to choose from.
Will have all the training of the version you are turning into.
If the version you are changing into uses any special items you gain those items.
weaknesses: Have to wait a short period of time to recharge before you can change again.
Skills get lost and replaced when you change into a different version of yourself
Will have to handle any weaknesses of the version you change into.

name: Symbiotic Suits: The First
description: The First is a symbiotic suit that enhances your strength, your healing time, your reflexes, your speed, your vision, your sense of smell, everything, to that of a superhero's. You basically become super you. If you have any natural powers, they become amplified. By the way, The First replicated (had kids) some of whom were different, and some of whom were the same.
summary: The ability to have every natural skill enhanced.
strengths: Super Everything
Amplified super powers
weaknesses: Weakness: Sonic Vibrations & others with a version of The First
Only applies to natural skills
Symbiote will probably try to take over every once in a while

name: Ice Walking
description: Ever wanted to be like Ice Man and make a path of ice to skate on in mid air? Well, now you can. Freeze the ground under your feet and build it up so you can make a path above the ground. Slide/skate around, cross a lake in the middle of summer and never fall into water. It can be turned on and off at will.
summary: The ability to freeze anything that touches your feet
strengths: Instant skate ring
Make a path of ice in the air (transportation/hard to reach places)
weaknesses: Only works with feet
Intense heat/fire

name: Current Situation Intuition
description: This power is very useful and it can get one through nearly anything one encounters. Be it financial problems or life-death situations, and many other things, one knows exactly what to do. One with this ability has a greater mind, thinking of the consequences for a certain decision to get out of that certain situation. This power is always on.
summary: The ability to know everything about any situation one is in, be it anything.
strengths: Know exactly what to do.
weaknesses: Suffer the consequences of the decison one takes to get out of the situation.

name: Custom Organism Creation
description: With Custom Organism Creation, you have the power to create your own species of organisms which could eventualy evolve into your allies, viruses, or whatever you want. You control the shape, size, abilities, and features of your organism.
summary: The ability to create new species of organisms
strengths: Create allies to help you in battle.
Create viruses to destroy your enemies.
Use them to accomplish your goals.
weaknesses: Evolution could lead to unintended traits.
Others could raise your organisms under their command.

name: Possibility Manipulation
description:
You can look at yourself in parallel universes and imitate your parallel self's skills/abilities/powers for a limited amount of time. This means that it's possible to become the very best you could possibly be for a short time, although doing something like that would take more energy than taking something minor (like the skill to cook teriyaki as opposed to the power to stop time).
Only one ability/skill/power can be taken at any given time, although with enough skill you can switch quickly.
summary: The ability to take skills from parallel yous.
strengths: Become the best you could possibly be
Have a wide variety of powers on call
Be good at almost anything
weaknesses: You can only take one skill at a time
There's a limit to how long you can keep a skill

name: Strong Force Manipulation
description: No exaggeration, this ability may be the most powerful physics-based skill. It allows the user to attempt to influence the strong force--which holds together atomic nuclei. A person with this power could make objects disintegrate into thin air or make protons/neutrons from the environment incorporate into chemical elements and vice versa. Due to the power in the strong force, users can usually only influence objects through direct contact, with immense focus, and only temporarily.
summary: The ability to tinker with the interaction that holds protons to neutrons
strengths: Hold the key to a fundamental force of physics
Make objects float apart into airborne atomic dust
Make atomic elements exchange protons/neutrons with the air, transmuting them into other elements
weaknesses: Takes immense focus, much energy or effort, and direct contact
Usually ages user prematurely due what it takes out of you
Disintegrated objects snap back into shape immediately afterward

name: Rapport Inducing
description: A person with this power can get along with anyone by being in sync with them and become able to see how they view the world as well as developing mannerisms to complement the mannerisms of anyone they like thus inducing the other person to like them. This can be used as precognition in fighting since you can simply move along with their movements a la dancing. This power can induce trust very quickly and it can be used to gain friends and customers as well.
summary: The ability to be able to get along with anyone at will and build trust easily
strengths: Can see the worldview of anyone and be able to show them your worldview
Can become anyone's dance partner including the ability to dance to dodge people's attacks
Can get you into any group of friends you want
weaknesses: Just because you can get along with everyone doesn't mean you will want to
Harder to get along with multiple people at the same time
Cannot be in sync with two parties that have opposite viewpoints at the same time

name: Axis Access
description: This ability allows you to move along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane. X-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move horizontally (side-side). Y-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move vertically (up-down). Z-Axis Travel would let you distort space to move forward or backward. And Coordinate Travel would allow you to combine any two of these effects at a time, for more dexterous maneuvering. This ability is often accompanied by a Geometric Sense.
summary: The ability to psychically move oneself along the spatial axes of existence
strengths: Relocate yourself easily along the spatial axes of existence, like a point on a coordinate plane
Relocation is fairly quick; it looks like teleportation (and Y-Axis Travel allows levitation)
Often accompanied by the power to perceive space geometrically (makes using this power efficient)
weaknesses: Not as efficient as true teleportation
Not as efficient as normal Spatial Manipulation (can't distort space to avoid bullets or the like)
Spatial Manipulation can make this power act erratically

name: Fire Empathy
description: Warming up used to be something reserved for athletes. A Fire Empath gains power from large sources of heat--a bonfire, a space heater, the blazing sun--and channels that energy into enhanced strength, speed, durability, senses, and reflexes. As a side effect, the user is totally fireproof. Of course, if there is insufficient heat no enhancements will be available, and cold will affect them more than most people.
summary: The ability to draw energy from sources of heat
strengths: When sufficiently warm, develop enhanced strength, speed, etc.
Can draw power from space heater, sweltering day, cigarette lighter
Fireproof
weaknesses: If there isn't enough heat, no powers
Cold affects you more
Might not know how much strength you have

name: Multiple Changeable Vision
description:
This ability you can see normally and just blink and you can see in x-ray vision, heat vision, microscopic vision, zoom-magnification vision. You can switch between your visual sight by blinking and focusing on which vision you would like to access at that point.
You can not use two different visions at once. E.g X-ray vision and night vision.
summary: The ability to change the way your eyes see.
strengths: Look at the world in multiple ways.
weaknesses: Can't access more than one vision at once.

name: Unpredictability
description: The user is unaffected by Tychokinesis (when touching a luck-manipulator, their powers short-circuit), and their moves cannot be predicted by Danger Sense, Precognition, Divination or Telepathy (even Combat Telepathy). The user is excluded from prophecies; his moves are hard to determine by Psychic Strategy, Imaginative Deduction, Quantum Deduction or other psychic means, except Omniscience. By simply existing, the user may change things that have been predicted/prophesied
summary: The ability to resist the forces of fate and probability
strengths: Probability manipulation can't affect you directly
Moves can't be predicted (a good foil for those with Superhuman Reflexes and the like)
Mess up prophecies and premonitions of the future
weaknesses: Probability manipulation can still affect you INDIRECTLY
Sometimes your unpredicted presence makes no difference in prophecies
Omniscience still 'sees' you

name: Necromancer
description: Necromancy is the magical art of rasing the dead. With this ability you can animate corpses and skeletons, see and talk to ghosts, and use your power over death in many ways. All corpses and skeletons you animate are under your control. And while they do have their own will, ghosts will usally do as you say. They can move things, phase, turn invisible, and use other ghostly powers. You can also sense when people you know die by reading their life forces.
summary: The ability to control the dead, death, ghosts, ect.
strengths: Can control corpses, skeletons, and ghosts
Ghosts have many powers and are usally obedient
Already being dead, corpses and skeletons can't die
weaknesses: Kinda a freaky power
Knowing when a friend or family member will die just sucks
You will be naturally feared

name: Power Safety
description: When you get this power, all your powers including this one become immune to negation, draining, mimicking, stealing, trapping you if you have them, inhibitation, sealing, being taken away or destroyed, being targeted by harming effects specific to your powers, being eaten, deactivated, made useless and many other protections. Your aura cannot be stolen or destroyed or sealed away.
summary: The ability to have your powers immune to harming effects.
strengths: Do not fear myth eater or killer.
Virtually invincible with strong abilities.
weaknesses: None, unless you don't want powers.

name: Espermaniacal Form
description: With this power, you grow and gain power by consuming psychic energy. This includes gaining power from mental activity in your area. You take the form of a creature spiraling with energy. As you grow, you gain more psychic abilties, such as telepathy, telekinesis, and eventually powers such as mind control. These powers adapt and become greater as you consume psychic energy, making them much more effective. You have an immunity (and need) for psychic energy, but susceptibility to physical harm.
summary: The ability to grow and gain power from consuming psychic energy.
strengths: Become immune to, and absorb psychic energy. (This includes mental activity in your area. )
Increase in size and power as you absorb the psychic energy around you.
Gain abilities (Telepathy, Telekinesis, Mind Control, Telekinetic Blasts, etc) from psychic energy.
weaknesses: Susceptible to physical damage.
Once you revert to normal form, you lose all the size and abilities that you gained.
If you're not constantly fueled with psychic energy, you revert to normal form.

name: Word Of Power
description: The subject becomes stronger and more resistant than normally possible everytime he/she hears a specific word said by someone else. This word could be every word spoken in any language or dialect. The subject can chose the word that activate his/her power, but only after a deep self-persuasion and autogenic training. The duration of the power is three or four hours.
summary: The ability to obtain a superhuman strength everytime someone says a specific word.
strengths: The word chosen by the subject could be ANY spoken word all over the world;
The word can be changed anytime.
weaknesses: The duration of the power is limitated;
The power doesn't work if the subject him/herself pronounces the word;
The effect of the word is not combined.

name: A Friend To All Non Humans
description: Non-human beings will always like you and never attack you, and they will always want to help you at any time. Must have had 'Animal Attraction' for 2 years to gain this.
summary: The ability to be such that no non-human will ever attack one.
strengths: You will have friends everywhere you go.
weaknesses: Humans might wonder why you are surrounded by animals and other creatures.

name: Perceptible Stress
description: Just as infra-red vision displays hot areas as red and cool areas as blue, someone with this power would literally be able to see areas of high and low stress concentration in an object. With this ability, you could tell when and where something was about to fracture (such as a platform or bridge), and assess the safety of a range of things before you used them. An intensely practical power.
summary: The ability to see the mechanical stress in an object as colour gradients.
strengths: Very practical, could be life-saving in a number of situations.
Relatively voluntary, as you need to focus to truly see the stress.
An engineer's dream power. Well, this and anything with steel and explosions.
weaknesses: Watching the inevitable as you see a bridge about to collapse wouldn't be fun...
Not too useful in combat, although spotting stress concentrations in armour could show weaknesses.

name: Shadow Kinetic Change
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them and direct the energy into the user's genetic code. This causes the DNA to kinetically move to the user's will. The changes only last on the amount of potiential energy is absorbed.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to cause a biological change of the user's body.
strengths: Change your DNA
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Strategy Affinity
description: This ability is very good for thinking- types. The user is capable of becoming stronger, faster, and more destructive when he thinks or hears a strategy or plan. The more complex it is and likelihood of that plan to work, the stronger the user become. The user will know how strong he got as well.
summary: The ability to become stronger when one thought up or hears a strategy.
strengths: Become stronger, faster, and more destructive.
Know that your or other's plan will work.
weaknesses: Complexity is Key to power up.

name: Conflict Style Manipulation
description: There are five known styles of conflict. They are Avoidance, Accommodation,Competing, Compromise, and Collaboration. This ability allows the user to control one or all of them. They can change people's conflict styles into anything else. They can make a competitive jerk into shy guy who avoids conflict. With more experience, the user could acquire new abilities based on the styles he changed to or on others.
summary: The ability to change and control one or all aspects of conflict styles.
strengths: Control aspects of conflict styles
Change others' conflict styles
With experience, gain abilities based on those conflict styles.
weaknesses: Beware the competing conflict style, it could be the most uncontrollable

name: Fictional Character Chatter
description: The user can talk with any fictional character that is willing to talk to you. You picture the character in your mind and you can try to talk to them; it's up to them to allow this and talk back.
summary: The ability to converse with any fictional character
strengths: Infinite ways to know your characters, you can know the way you want.
This superpower can make you feel very accompanied
This superpower lets you know things that only fictional characters know
weaknesses: Limited to fictional characters and their knowledge

name: Bibliokenesis
description: Also called: Literacy Manipulation  The user has the ability to manipulate all forms of physical literary objects that are printed, written or drawn (books, comics, magazines etc. ), including their physical forms/materials and anything written, printed, illustrated, or drawn in them.   In extreme cases the user may have access even to the media that doesn't truly exist, but is only mentioned in other media or imagined to exist.
summary: The ability to manipulate books, manuscript pages, and text paper
strengths: Transform a written word into the actual object
Trap people/objects in the books
Break the fourth wall and rewrite your own story!
weaknesses: User who doesn't have a book handy is helpless
Books aren't the most portable or compact objects.
Usefulness depends of the quality (fashion magazine vs RPG Bestiary) and quantity (single book vs li

name: Sympathetic Vision
description: To use this power, you need to close your eyes and concentrate on a precise person or animal, it doesn't need to be someone or an animal you're familiar with. When you open your eyes again, you'll be able see exactly what that person or animal is seeing. Their eyesight won't be affected and they shouldn't notice anything. Obviously, if that person or animal is blind, not gifted with eyes, sleeping, unconscious or just dead, you won't see anything until you cancel the effect of your power.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of someone else's.
strengths: Peek into anyone's private life without being noticed.
Works wherever the other person or animal is.
weaknesses: You can't see what's in front of you, so don't move while you use this power!
When the target blinks, you'll see a flash of black which can feel odd at first.

name: Internal Solar Fusion
description: Your body houses an ultra-bright star, and can utilize the fusion taking place to draw on limitless energy reserves. You are also able to project various solar energies, such as magnetic bursts, heat waves or streams of supercharged ions. This is an incredibly destructive power. The user can also utilize all of that moments solar potential to create a devastating supernova pulse. The solar energy can be utilized to make light, heat, to heal the user, or even to fly.
summary: The ability to manipulate solar fusion and its effects.
strengths: Limitless energy means that you never need to sleep.
A most destructive superpower. It can quite possibly destroy planets.
weaknesses: This power makes the user physically and mentally unstable.
The user can "Overheat". This causes them to disintegrate to dust after going nuclear.

name: Hypnotism
description: No watch-and-chain necessary, a Hypnotizer can put a target into a trance by staring into their eyes. This state also leaves the target highly susceptible to suggestions, like "Kill your boss", "You are now a Democrat", or "Every time you hear James Brown's music, you will start to sing along at the top of your lungs." This is limited to 1 hypnosis at a time.
summary: The ability to put people into a trance of extreme suggestibility
strengths: Amass a hypnotized following
Get someone to fight for you
Convince someone to do something humiliating in public
weaknesses: 1 hypnosis session at a time
Cannot make anyone do something they really don't want to
Must establish eye contact

name: Submit Gain
description: With this ability, any and all normal/special/supernatural/superhuman powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects and weapons that you submit to the superpowerlist website, you instantly, perfectly, and permanently gain it at any point in time that you want. All of which without any problem, difficulty, or trouble of any kind, and also regardless of any powers, abilities, skills, talents, items, objects, or weapons that are added to the superpowerlist.
summary: The ability to instantly and permanently gain any powers you submit to the Superpowerlist website.
strengths: Instantly and permanently gain any powers you want no matter what they maybe.
Instantly and permanently gain any powers even if they don't get added to the superpowerlist.
The creator of Submit Gain automatically gains this power no matter what, because of its nature.
weaknesses: Does not work on powers submitted before Submit Gain was created.
The Get This Power button will never appear for anyone who has this power.

name: Mirror Image
description: You can leave a mirror image of yourself at your current location that will perform only the last action that you were doing. The mirror image will look exactly like you, including having a copy of any item you had, and will be near impossible to tell apart from you. You can have as many mirror images as you have energy for and can dismiss the mirror images at any time. If you are doing a chore the mirror image will continue until it is done, or if using a weapon it will continue to do the same.
summary: The ability to leave a mirror image of yourself at your location.
strengths: Leave a mirror image to continue doing an action for you.
Can have several mirror images all copying you using your powers at a foe.
Can leave a mirror image as a decoy.
weaknesses: The mirror images can only do one action or command.
Have to be at the location that you want to leave your mirror image.
The mirror images can be destroyed easily.

name: Supernatural Magical Powers
description: It is the ability to use magical forces to varying degrees. Often used to simulate other powers, such as mind control and elemental attacks.
summary: The ability to use magical forces to varying degrees.
strengths: You would be one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
You could read minds.
You would have shape shifting.
weaknesses: If you were to have severe hand injuries, you would be unable to control your magic properly.
You would be weakened by mortal wounds.
Without experience, your spells would be as powerful as intended.

name: Fear Illusion
description:
You don't change shape only illude people to see you as what they fear the most.
Example: If someone is afraid of spider you can make that person see you as a spider.
If someone is a afraid of heights you can illude their surroundings by make it seem as if they're at the ledge of a cliff.
summary: The ability to make people see you as what they fear the most.
strengths: You can scare the living daylight out of everyone.
Nobody can scare you.
weaknesses: You can't use your power on yourself.

name: Bookend
description: By touching a book you may summon characters and plot important objects to assist you. If what you summoned is destroyed it returns to the book, but you are unable to summon it again. You must be touching the book to summon from it. Summoning last up to 24 hours and can be dismissed at any time. Pervious summons remember you. Anything or anyone summoned retains all traits that it had in the book so it would help to have read the book before summoning from it.
summary: The ability to summon characters and plot devices from books.
strengths: Access to powerful allies and weapons
weaknesses: Must convince character to assist you
Might summon something hostile
Must be touching the book to summon from it

name: Under Blades
description: You can, at will, release these retractable two-foot long metallic blades from under your wrists. The skin between your wrists tears and bleeds, but the blood loss is quickly halted by your healing factor. You can unsheathe blades at once, although you must keep your wrists straight at the moment your blades pass from under your arms. When unsheathed, the blades are entirely within your wrists, allowing you to bend them when they are extended. The blades are made of metal and can slice anything.
summary: The ability to extend large blades protruding from your wrists.
strengths: By grinding your blades against each other, you can fire sparks of energy towards your enemies.
Can use your wrists for swords.
weaknesses: None actually.

name: Psychic Map
description: This ability comes in two manifestations. The first is perhaps most beneficial, and it implies that the user possesses a map of the whole universe in his mind. However, the second manifestation is not without its benefits; it implies that the user has a map of the location they are in when the power manifests, and the map expands as they travel from that point. This manifestation also allows one to scan any location on his mental map, to observe anything that is currently in that area.
summary: The ability to house a psychic "map" within your mind
strengths: (First manifestation) have a map of the entire UNIVERSE in your mind (know how to get ANYWHERE)
(Second manifestation) have a mental map that builds from the point your ability manifests
(Second manifestation) locate anything in the areas you've registered in your mental map
weaknesses: (First Manifestation) only extends to your current dimension
(Second Manifestation) only extends to places where you've been
(Both) Can't be used to find someone/something that's been cloaked

name: Shadow Watch
description: Any shadow that is cast you will be able to spy through from shadow you are near. Eavesdrop on people from the shadows. You do have to picture either the person or area you want to look at & the closest shadow maybe to small to view through.
summary: The ability to use shadows as windows to look through
strengths: Shadows are your windows
weaknesses: You have to imagine what person or area you want to view
The shadows may not have a great view

name: Vector Control
description: With this power, you can change the direction of anything under the laws of physics. For example, you can change the vectors of bullets and forces like lightning. You can also change the direction of natural forces, such as gravity and air resistance, to make yourself a little faster as well as increase your own power by directing all the force of your punch into one concentrated point.  However, you cannot change the direction of aging since that falls under biology.
summary: The ability to control anything's direction
strengths: Takes 0 energy to activate this power and you can set to default to reflect back
Reflect enemy attacks
Concentrate you own power
weaknesses: You need to be good at math/physics to use this power at its fullest
If you are physically unfit, this power cannot really augment your strength at all
If you do not know where something is, you cannot manipulate its direction

name: Problem Solver
description:
Can solve any problem, puzzle, equation. Absolutely anything without flaw.
In order to solve the problem you must first analyze the situation and go through a sometimes time consuming thought process.
summary: The ability to find a solution to any problem without failure.
strengths: Can find the solution to any problem
weaknesses: Can be time-consuming
Doesn't make you a genius or smartest in the world.

name: Elemental Reconfiguration
description: You're at a disadvantage in an elemental battle? Simply change your or your opponent's elemental type to get the upper hand. However, the changes follow a very precise order. Every possible element is arranged in an immutable cycle, which can be followed in either direction. For example, if you want to change a fire mimic into a water mimic, you can see them progressively change to a wood mimic, then a smoke mimic, a plasma mimic, a tornado mimic and a sound mimic before becoming a water mimic.
summary: The ability to change the elemental attribute of a superpower, a spell or even a magical artifact.
strengths: Combine this power with an elemental one, and you can have many elemental version of that power.
Change a defensive fog-type power to the offensive lava-type or poison-type version.
Choose any element from a wide variety, such as darkness, shadow, radiation, sand, stone, mud,...
weaknesses: There's no logic behind the cycle, so it can take some time to get a desired element.
Some "elements" aren't counted, and you must be in the vicinity to keep the changes active.
You could give your opponent a very strong element before reaching the desired weaker one.

name: Limited Reality Warping
description: You can warp reality, but once you have performed an act, you can never use your power in that way again. For example, if you turn something to gold, you can never turn something else to gold again. Your power is not endless, as you cannot destroy the universe or affect an entire planet, etc. You can warp reality in different ways for similar effect, such as turning one enemy into smoke, then turning another one into water vapour. You do not have to speak for your power to work.
summary: The ability to warp reality, but never warp in that way again
strengths: Can do basically anything you want
It will be rare that you will want to use your power in a way you have previously used
The ways your power can be used in combat, transport, etc. are endless
weaknesses: Must make sure you do not carelessly use up a useful warp
May not be able to reverse an unwise warp
Have to remember how you have used your power before

name: Control Shadow
description: The shadow ring has the ability to call shadow beasts by saying :Let there be darkness, with the ring you can control shadow beasts and help you in your combats.
summary: The ability to call shadows with your ring of darkness
strengths: You don't need to be in a shadow
The opponent can't cut it nor shoot it
It can only be attacked with psychic powers or the ring of light
weaknesses: You can only call two-three beasts at a time
It can beaten with the ring of light or with a magical attack
You need to be in darkness to operate it

name: Sonographic Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to process sounds that they hear in their brain, allowing them to decipher the exact action that causes the sound. This could allwo them to reproduce it. Also known as perfect or absolute pitch. Not only can you use this to learn how to play instruments quickly, you can also tell what people are typing just by listening to it. You can also use this to change dialects quickly by understanding the necessary movements ofyour speech organs.
summary: The ability to process sounds in your mind in a superhuman fashion allowing you to figure out people's actions
strengths: If you hear someone typing, you can tell what they are typing
You have perfect pitch with this ability, letting you play instruments by ear
weaknesses: This only works if there is a set pattern of sounds for a certain action
If there are many sounds at the same time this ability might fail
You have to hear a sound at least once in order to use it as a reference

name: Vacuum Simulation
description: This ability can be deadly for the user can make space come to Earth. They will be able to suffocate any living creature with power. The mist will cover everything in a blanket of darkness and airlessness. The user, of course, can survive this, training his lungs up to the point that they will gain "Vacuum Adaptation" so they can live in real space. The user can manipulate it and make it solid.
summary: The ability to create a mist-like void that imitates the effects of space and manipulate it.
strengths: Suffocate or knock people out.
Manipulate it.
Eventually gain "Vacuum Adaptation".
weaknesses: Doesn't effect those who have "Vacuum Adaptation".

name: Disaster Manipulation
description: You can stop a storm, control earthquakes, and change tsunamis into tiny waves. You can control any natural disaster and also cause them.
summary: The ability to control any type of disaster.
strengths: You can make a storm so you don't have school
Save millions of lives
weaknesses: Might accidentally create one
This is powered by 30% concentration and emotion for the rest

name: Passion Eye
description: Passion Eyes allow you to have complete and utter control of the victim you use it on. In order for passion eyes to work, your eyes must meet theirs; then they become servant-like and do as you say. Passion eyes wears off based on the victim's mentality. The stronger the mind, the quicker it wears off.
summary: The ability to hypnotize and have complete control over the one you use passion eyes on.
strengths: You have servant like people that cater to you
They actually fall in love with you, which means they are willing to risk their lives for you
weaknesses: If someone's blind, it won't work
If you dont care about the one you used passion eyes on, you will see them as annoying and obsessive

name: Power Of Hard Work
description: Anyone with this power has the ability to gain simple abilities that can transcend peak human potential naturally through hard work. For example, through training, you can gain the ability to shatter mountains and run on water or jump on air. You can even gain superpowered intelligence by studying hard. There is no limit to how much you can train your acquired power, though it gets increasingly harder. Also, if you have existing superpowers, you can train them faster when you have this power.
summary: The ability to gain superpowers naturally through training and improve training speed
strengths: You can gain superpowers naturally
You learn faster depending on the amount of effort you put in
Normalization fluid does not negate acquired superpowers since they were your own training
weaknesses: You have to gain superpowers through your own hard work, sweat, and tears
If you are lazy, then this ability is pointless

name: The Opportunity To Learn
description: Once you get the power, your mind erases everything that you learn socially, but not at school. As you grow stronger everyday, things will be easier and come more naturally to you.
summary: The ability to learn anything that is possible
strengths: Awesome education
Smart creations
weaknesses: Need to sleep to rest the mind

name: Tactile Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to tell a lot about anything by feeling it. For example, it is possible to find a lot of secret messages on the wall comprised of words that have been previously erased, you can feel the indentations caused by the writing. I if the person is adept, they can use this ability to figure out the composition of the top layer of any object. In addition they can feel cracks on the wall to find an object's weak point.
summary: The ability to recognize patterns in whatever you are touching revealing aspects not seen with the visible eye
strengths: Can find secret messages on walls-even those that may have been "erased"
By touching some materials you can figure out what it is made of - including type of wood
Figure out weaknesses in a wall then attack those spots to break it
weaknesses: You need to have a reference to figure out what material it is made of
Even if you figure out the weakest part of the wall you need to have strength to break it

name: Psionium (Destructive Metal)
description: This metal can be turned into any form the user wants it to be in and is fully immune to all psionic effects and powers. However, at lower levels the user can only make the metal resistant to psionic effects and powers and can only have it be partially be in the shape they want it to be in.
summary: The ability to create and control a metal that is immune to all psionic powers and effects
strengths: Covering yourself with the metal will protect you from all psionic effects and powers.
weaknesses: The metal can still be affected by magic.

name: Fusion
description: Tired of having to go to the bathroom every ten minutes? Tired of having to leave the tv during commercials to go into the kitchen to get a snack? Well say no more, because with this power, you can fuse the toilet with a lay z boy chair and your remote with the fridge. It even works on people. Make your brother a sandwich. Literally! The possibilities are endless. The only way to change 'em back is by concentration on the two separate targets. No one will be able to change them back otherwise.
summary: The ability to fuse anything or any two people with anything within 5 feet
strengths: Fuse a cat and a dog for twice the fun and ignorance.
Fuse a gun with a sword in case the zombie apocalypse starts.
No one can reverse it but you.
weaknesses: Concentration to defuse things
Could fuse the wrong things, like a tank and an air bus
Takes about five seconds to charge for each use.

name: Energy Spike
description: This ability gives the user control over the energy that lies dormant in the body. By concentrating, the user can create spikes of energy throughout the body. If you can't fight, then you can use this power to strengthen your body by hiding the energy spikes under your skin. If you want to kill someone, then this is your power. And if you want to reach high places, then draw the energy to either one of your hands and place your hand on the ground or a wall and a spike or spikes will come forth.
summary: The ability to create spikes of energy from the energy that lies within one's body.
strengths: If someone had a gun to your head, you can kill that person or guard yourself.
Using the energy in your body, you are able to make the spikes appear anywhere on your body.
You can create a body armor from the energy spikes.
weaknesses: Using the energy spikes can take a major toll on your body, unless you train yourself.
If you didn't want to kill the person trying to rob you, then it was a mistake using your power.

name: Petrifaction
description: One with this power can transmute a subject into solid stone with a look, touch or some other method. If a subject is turned into stone, the affect can usually be reversed by the user as long as the subject remains intact, i. E. Not broken, smashed, weathered, etc.
summary: The ability to turn matter into stone.
strengths: An effective way to get rid of an enemy or nuisance
The 'statue' might go nice with the garden
To be rid of someone for good, just get a sledgehammer
weaknesses: If the 'statue' is destroyed the effect cannot be reversed
May be triggered subconsciously (acidental petrifaction)
Would be difficult to move or destroy

name: Tangibility
description: A person with this power can make things that are intangible become tangible/solid just by touching it. Make ghosts tangible and attack them as if they were real persons, learn how to shape tangible/solid balls of air and use them as weapons; the possibilites are endless...
summary: The ability to make intangible things tangible/solid
strengths: Literally grab/touch air - use it as monkey bars, platforms or as offensive balls of air
Intangibility is useless against you
Make ghosts real, never fall in a pit etc.
weaknesses: Only make things tangible - can't make things intangible

name: Weakening
description: This ability i got from a reminder of Wabisuke from bleach... Whatever you hit/touch you can make it weaker by an amount that varies based on your choice. The stronger your power, though, the more you can weaken something.
summary: The ability to weaken whatever you touch
strengths: You always win physical fights
Can destroy almost anything in an instant with a touch
You would always be stronger than your opponent (weight lifting, hand wrestling, etc. )
weaknesses: Can cause deaths from making them so weak their body cant support themselves
Have to actually touch the thing you want to weaken (can't be something intangible)
Doesn't increase your own strength so you would have a false sense of massive power

name: Surface Grinding
description: This ability allows you to grind, or generally slide on any surface. Think of it as riding a skateboard without the skateboard. Any solid surface can be used to ride. Your body basically propels sideways in a skating position. Your feet will automatically follow the surface until it ends or you jump off. You can also follow any distinct line, such as a road lane. So if you use a spray paint can to create your own path, the speed is determined by the length; the longer you go, the faster you get.
summary: The ability to grind, or generally "ride", on any surface at extreme speeds
strengths: It is a cool way to travel and can make for some cool trick grinds
You can get up to 100-200 mph while grinding and stopping can be instant
You can also grind as an attack, either by using the momentum to attack or by "hand grinding" them
weaknesses: You can't grind on water or air
Very durable shoes, one with metal bottoms, are needed to withstand the friction caused by grinding
Surface grinding at extreme speeds can cause damage to the surface

name: Weapons Master
description: With this power you can know how to use any type of Weapon both magical and normal. You can also know how to use anything as a Weapon. You'll be a a master of the Sword,Spear and all Weapons and know how to use them. You can also know their strengths, weaknesses.
summary: The ability to know everything about any weapon and how to use anything as a weapon
strengths: How to use any type of weapon, both magical and normal.
Know how to use anything as a weapon
weaknesses: You can still be killed
You can still be killed

name: I Want...
description: If you say,"I want _____", then clearly state what you want, then you'll get it. Just make sure that you really mean what your saying before saying it. At first, you'll only be able to ask for things that you NEED. Then you'll be able to ask for things that you WANT (has to be something that already exist). If you get really good at using this power, then you can ask for things that you want, but don't exist. Remember, word choice is key!
summary: The ability to get what you want
strengths: Now you can have whatever you want
weaknesses: At first, you only get what you need
Be careful what you wish for
Karma

name: Physical Overdrive
description: This gives you the ability to temporarily turn off all the limiters in the human body. This means any and all physical limiters are gone meaning you have an insurmountable amount of strength and speed. This ability also takes of the limiters on the brain, allowing 100% of to be used witch in turn gives you superhuman level smarts and senses.
summary: The ability to put the user's body into a temporary state that breaks all the limiters in the human body.
strengths: Remarkable amount of strength
Unsurpassable speed
Beyond this world IQ and superhuman senses
weaknesses: Limit of use: 10 minutes
Going beyond limit will damage body. After 30 minutes there will be damage that can not be fixed.
Beyond an hour means certain death after leaving overdrive mode.

name: Immortality
description: Immortality is a gift and a curse. An Immortal is unable to die or even age--when the ability is first manifested, the holder stays that age forever. Their hair and nails continue to grow. Though they cannot die, they are not invunerable nor do they heal faster: if they are hit by a train or decapitated, they must wait for recovery. Users may also develop an aloof mindset or even become despairing.
summary: The ability to be unable to age or die
strengths: Live forever
Do everything you want to do in life
Ultimate adversary
weaknesses: No healing factor
May develop a distant, arrogant mindset
Still feel pain

name: Gust
description: With a flick of your hand, you can ride the wind to your wildest destinations, blow all the leaves from your lawn, or blast away the bad guys in your way.
summary: The ability to project powerful gusts of air in any direction.
strengths: Easy outdoor travel.
weaknesses: Limited control of element.

name: True Nature
description: This power transforms people into their true forms.  True forms are beings greater than humans that exist solely for their true natures. All of their attributes are enhanced, and human parts are more attractive. Each has multiple distinct abilities, and other general powers. Most appear half-human, but they can also appear nonhuman or human. Their bodies and powers are manifestations of their true natures, and no two forms are the same. Feel free to post a comment if you are at all confused.
summary: The ability to unlock people's true nature and release their true form. Read full description.
strengths: Enhanced attributes and tons of power for you or anyone else
Can use on anyone and still keep ability - even if you use on yourself
Transformations are awesome to watch!
weaknesses: True forms can be very dangerous
Never know what form they will take
TRUE NATURE CAN NOT BE REVERSED!

name: Tactile Florakinesis
description: Florakinesis is the ability to control and manipulate plants. With this power, all you have to do to obtain florakinesis is to touch a plant of your choice and concentrate. You can control any plants that you have touched. Also, if you concentrate as you touch soil, you can cause a plant of your choosing to grow. Unfortunately, this power can only be used once per day, until it develops.
summary: The ability to control plants by touching them
strengths: You can obtain florakinesis by touching plants
Any plants that you have touched can be controlled
Touching soil can cause a plant to grow
weaknesses: It can only be used once per day, until it develops.
You HAVE to touch a plant to control it
Touching poisonous plants is not a good idea!

name: Telepathic Alarm
description: A passive form of telepathic power, that alarms you when anybody on Earth plans to do you harm. If one of your enemies is thinking about hurting you, your telephatic sense will give you a signal.
summary: The ability to know when anyone wants to do you harm
strengths: You have more time to get ready to any attack against you.
weaknesses: If you have too many enemies, you may get a headache because of the "voices".

name: Empathic Hydrokinesis
description: This power works by creating powerful psionic energy when a person feels strong emotions such as fear, anger, elation, etc. That energy can then be channelled into any desired source of water, thus granting the person total control of it, so as long as they remain in their heightened emotional state. They can create tsunamis, waterspouts, floods, and anything else desired with water.
summary: The ability to manipulate water through strong emotions
strengths: Use water as an extremely versatile weapon!
Can overpower fire if used with strong enough emotions
You can protect people without fear of them ever being harmed by your enemy!
weaknesses: Is extremely dangerous unless consciously controlled

name: Wait For It...
description: First, you must start saying something. Then, before you finish, you say, "wait for it. " Time will stand still. Nothing will age, including you. Nothing will move except you and things moved by you. However, frozen objects are harder to move, being unaffected by gravity or wind resistance, but being heavily affected by static friction with the fabric of time. The only way to unfreeze time is to speak or to die. The first thing you say will unfreeze time by finishing your sentence.
summary: The ability to freeze time until you finish your current sentence.
strengths: Can keep yourself from aging.
No aging means no need for sleep or food.
Can do all sorts of things with frozen people and things.
weaknesses: Must remain completely silent (vocally) while using this power.
Moving objects is roughly five times harder than usual.
Accidentally tripping and shouting out in pain while trespassing, unfreezing and alerting everyone.

name: Master Locksmith
description: This ability allows you to create a lock anywhere you can imagine one or, if there is already one there, pick it with your mind.
summary: The ability to make or pick locks at will
strengths: Never blocked out of anywhere
Keep posessions safe by making really complex locks
Never get locked out of anything again because no need for a key
weaknesses: If they use bars to hold the doors you cant pick it
You can still lose the object you lock
You could still get caught breaking in

name: Synthetics
description: With this, you can make synthetic things for various purposes without using any tools whatsoever. You can make artificial food by assembling together made-out-of-nothing proteins or generating meat from quickly created cells. You can change your DNA by inserting new proteins into it. You can extend or make permanent your youth and life. You can make primitive things as a whole, like a small piezoelectric stick as a weapon or contact lenses.
summary: The ability to create synthetic things for many purposes.
strengths: Can make materials out of nothing or isolate them.
Very versatile, such as genetic modification, artificial diamonds and spray on tan and pale parlor.
Can change appearances with organic or synthetic plastic surgery, also eternal youth.
weaknesses: Be creative or it will not be very effective.
People who like naturally-made things may hate you.

name: Sanctum Sanctorum
description: You become the mightiest magician in the cosmos, a Sorcerer Supreme, just like Stephen Strange/Doctor Strange, and thus on level with cosmic entities. You gain mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
summary: The ability to become one of the Sorcerers Supreme
strengths: Become one of the mightiest magicians in the cosmos
Mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
On level with cosmic entities
weaknesses: Dependent on magic, sucks if foes are immune to it
Have to find ways to indirectly affect magic-immune foes
Not being able to handle so much power

name: Shadow Damage
description: With this power you damage objects by damaging their shadows. This does not amplify force. Hitting the shadow of a building will produce the same amount of damage as hitting the building normally. Stomping on the shadow of a human, however, will have stunning effect. This makes it easy to fight people from a distance. You can also shoot someone without leaving the bullet inside of them. However, your best times are dawn and dusk. Midnight and high noon do not work well for you.
summary: The ability to damage an object through its shadow
strengths: Fight from a distance
Shoot without a trace
Stomp on heads with minimal effort
weaknesses: Doesn't amplify force
Only good at certain times of the day
May have to appoint a sidekick to hold a flashlight

name: Mirror Moving
description: They say mirrors contain the exact opposite of your life in our "world". And that what you do here is the exact opposite of the mirror world. By using this power you change the outcomes of what ever mistakes you do here in our "world" or completely change the events that may have caused you distress and problems. It's sort of reality warping but with the limits of a parallel universe being affected.
summary: The ability to control your parallel universe
strengths: You can change the result of any thing like getting a low scores in test then use
The power to switch the "universes" and get a high score. You could also change the outcomes of
Wars,fights and even gambling bets in which if you lose here you can win if you switch the universes
weaknesses: Can alter the death of others but cannot alter your own death
Positive results for you may cause negative outcomes for others
Can destroy the veil of the two universes with constant use and can cause great strain to the user

name: Superweapon Creation Knowledge
description: With things easily available to you in your hometown, this power allows you to build: thermonuclear weapons, suitcase thermonuclear weapons, "salted" thermonuclear weapons, neutron bombs, EMP weapons, chimera viruses, recreations of any natural pathogen, chemical weapons, super-tanks that hurl nuclear bombs like firecrackers, super-cannons, missiles which can be loaded with any of the above, and just about any sort of bomb or weapon of immense power you can imagine.
summary: The ability to know how to create WMDs and superweapons with common resources
strengths: If you're a super villain, or want to have your own nation.
Or, if you like your government, you could claim to be a scientist and sell the designs
You could probably figure out a heroic use for a thirty-foot tall Hunter-Killer robot
weaknesses: The sort of power that even if you're a hero, you'll want to hide
Not only can your stuff be stolen, but it can do A LOT of damage, and you're not protected from it
You'll either be terrified 24/7 of your stockpile going off, or terrified of a slip mid-manufacture

name: Wind Absorption
description: The user is able to absorb the wind in his or her surrounding and release it upon the enemy. The power of the wind released is dependent on how strong the wind is. If it is a mild breeze than the user can only release a jet of compressed air, if the wind is gale and strong, the user can release a human sized tornado.
summary: The ability to absorb wind from the surrounding
strengths: Wind is ever present
Eco friendly
weaknesses: Weak against fire
Not very powerful if there is no powerful wind

name: Olive Green Power Ring
description: The user is able to form constructs, force fields, shoot beams or bolts of energy that comes from the mysterious energy of peace. The ring only chooses people who are peaceful in nature or strive for peace and at the same time having a distaste for war or any senseless violence. The only weakness of the ring comes from the energy of senseless violence. The ring's symbol is an olive branch. The Olive Green Peace corps sign central battery is located on peaceful planet where nature is abundant.
summary: The ability to use the mysterious olive green energy of peace
strengths: Can make construct out of pure energy of peace
Can make other be calmer in situations, making them more peaceful in nature
weaknesses: Must recharge the ring
Weak against the power of senseless violence ( the color blood red )

name: Twist
description: Basically, by twisting the space around you, any attack will slide off you, making you impossible to hit. It does not work on attacks aimed at the mind, such as mind control, mind reading etc.
summary: The ability to twist the space around you.
strengths: Can't be hit by any physical attack.
weaknesses: Can be hit by attacks aimed at the mind.
Only works when you want it to.

name: Property Imbuing
description: With this power, you can "program" an element with a particular property, within limits. There are restrictions on properties, but you still have a lot of freedom. You could make an element turn movement into electricity, a lightweight but superdense material or a material which could withstand the temperatures and pressures of the inside of the sun. You can also change one element into another. The time it takes depends on what you are converting. It takes a lot of concentration to perform.
summary: The ability to design chemical elements with desired properties.
strengths: Make armor nearly indestructible.
Turn trash into gold.
Have lots of freedom.
weaknesses: Requires a lot of concentration.
It isn't ability imbuing -you are giving objects properties, not powers.
Some properties cannot coexist -its best to just give each object one property.

name: Emotion Based Weapons Creator
description: The weapons look different based on the emotions that are being used as a base but all the weapons have 3 things in common: a power core, restraints, and being extremely powerful. The power core provides power to the weapon (like electricity to a computer) and if broken the weapon is destroyed and rendered unusable. The restraint prevents the weapon from being at full power and going on a rampage in its true form. Each weapon is powerful enough to destroy a city.
summary: The ability to create weapons based on the feelings of oneself or others
strengths: The weapon could be anything from a spear to a laser gun.
The weapon chooses its wielder. May be a con.
weaknesses: You might not be able to use the weapon even though you made it.
Never ever let a restraint be destroyed or everyone around the weapon will be killed.

name: Human Puppetry
description: A maximum range of 85 feet is the length of the threads. These threads can be made visible for the user's amusement. Each finger releases one thread and controls entire limbs or, for more advanced user's, entire sections of the nervous system. Each movement of the fingers is a movement of the body. These threads can only be severed through loss of concentration.
summary: The ability to create psychic invisible threads that attach to a organism and manipulate it's movements.
strengths: The maximum amount of 'puppets' is 500
It is not limited to humans. It controls all living bodies
No being can resist these psychic bonds
weaknesses: They are severable
The power exhaust the user and can even induce a coma
At some point the people you manipulate become emotionless and soon just empty shells of themselves

name: Energy Solidification
description: This ability isn't right for those who are really attached to their electronics, but if you are not, then you can use it in many ways. You can use energy to create a solid construct, like turning off a nuclear bomb by changing it's core into a solid rock.
summary: The ability to turn energy into solid matter.
strengths: Make the energy into a solid weapon.
Able to expand the energy before it becomes solid.
This ability affects all sources of energy.
weaknesses: If not trained, it could destroy or shut down electronics.

name: Skin Produced Diamond
description: With this power, you gain diamond's most well-known characteristic which is to be unbreakable. Your muscles become used to diamond's weight and gain superhuman strength.

strengths: Your defence is flawless against any kind of attack
Superhuman strength
You can get richer by selling your home-made diamond
weaknesses: Your weight becomes astronomical!
You can't swim in water
And you're very very visible

name: Vehicle Shapeshifting
description: From flesh to metal, you can be any vehicle on land, sea and in the air.
