strengths: Go anywhere you want
weaknesses: Last one hour a day

name: Situational Defenses
description: With this ability, your body will defend itself against anyone or anything that attempts to harm you. For instance, if someone were to throw a fist at you, your skin may become razor-sharp. If someone tried to slice off one of your arms, for example, you skin would become extremely dense and simply ruin the blade. If you obtained any disease, your body would be able to easily defeat it.
summary: The ability to gain natural defenses based on offensive situations
strengths: This power protects your body physically, and mentally
You can take almost any type of punishment, and still be left without a scratch
No average being can cause any sort of harm to you
weaknesses: This only triggers when you're attacked, or your body is in danger
You can still be harmed if your body is attacked extremely quickly, or is extremely damaged
If anything can seriously injure you, you will be unaware

name: Carbon Manipulation
description: Can control only carbon atoms, however in order to control the atoms you must direct them with your hands. Takes a lot of concentration the bigger the object or the denser you are making the object.
summary: The ability to control carbon atoms
strengths: can kill in an instant
can turn skin into diamonds
control over most objects in the universe
weaknesses: overpowered
can't be used if you have no arms

name: Oblivious
description: You are unaffected by things that would change your feelings or thoughts toward something (girlfriend, TV show, etc. ) You cannot be brainwashed because it affects your thinking. You are unaffected by love potions because they affect your heart. Others scenarios are included.
summary: The ability to not be affected by charm spells, hypnotism, brain washing, etc.
strengths: You cannot be manipulated by someone else.
You cannot be hypnotized or charmed.
weaknesses: Can still have thoughts read, just not manipulated
You may not understand other people's feelings; Cold hearted or stone heart.
You might be also seem to be absent minded, dumb,or very mean. Not that you are.

name: Camouflage
description: You can change the coloration of objects to make them harder to see. For example: change the color of your skin and clothing to blend into the forest. You can change the coloration/texture of any surface, by either touching or looking at it, with the application of the camouflage in mind. If you wanted to hide in the forest, think "forest", and the object you are touching/concentrating on will change color and/or texture instantly. This also allows you to create fake models of things to hide in.
summary: The ability to make anything imperceptible
strengths: Can mock up hollow rocks or dead tree stumps to hide in
Can hide anywhere at any time
Works on other people, and happens naturally when sleeping
weaknesses: Can't hurt enemies with it
Doesn't make you invisible, just really hard to see
Won't work if you don't know what environment you're in, or if you are in an empty room/box

name: Book Synchronization
description: This ability allows you to copy the abilities and skills of characters of books. These include short stories, manga, novels, etc. As long as it has been officially been published, you can use it. Also, you don't have to read the entire book to use it as a power, but it might be a good idea to do so.
summary: The ability to do anything associated with books and written stories
strengths: Use the powers of characters from your favorite books
Bring characters from books to life and have them fight for you
If you own the book, you grow stronger
weaknesses: You MUST know the name of the book
You can't do anything extreme (like being God)
If an enemy knows more about the book, you might lose

name: Dna Equivalence
description: When you can turn into any creature that bites you, Mosquitos are way less irritating! Once something bites you, you can turn into it at will, anytime you want. You are still susceptible to anything venomous, but surviving it would have extreme benefits.
summary: The ability to turn into your own equivalent of whatever creature you want, providing it bites you first.
strengths: Sneak around, go werever you want, get bitten by other supers and absorb a fraction of their powers.
Really, who hasn't regretted being human at least once?
weaknesses: You can still get infections. Invest in polysporin and band-aids.
If it can't bite you, you can't morph into it. That lifelong dream of becoming a moth? Not likely.
Anything too powerful that's biting you will probably kill you before you can morph.

name: Morality Meter
description: Infamous,Fable,MassEffect. The list goes on with moral decisions in games, But what about seeing them in life. Most people are irrational in certain areas and don't think with their brain. With Morality Meter your perception of time stops and you will be able to see a good neutral and bad choice you can possibly do. Friend being a royal pain? Don't know what to say to someone to not hurt feelings? Not with Morality Meter. It happens automatically and gives you the most appropriate response
summary: The ability to see every moral choice you can possibly do in a situation.
strengths: Can choose what moral choices to make.
Can be the most rational person in a situation.
Never say something you would take back ever again.
weaknesses: Time stops and moral conundrums might get annoying after a bit.
If you feel angry you can choose bad choices
You can be too much of a goody two-shoes

name: Expression Realization
description: With this power, one can induce a literal version of any expression. The expression "use it or lose it", for example, could be exploited to lose weight or strip an enemy's powers. The only restriction is the target performing the required action (in the case of depowering an enemy, not using the targeted power).
summary: The ability to manifest a literal version of any expression.
strengths: Creativity can give this power a lot of uses.
The more expressions you know, the more powerful you are.
Unusual; harder for an opponent to predict and therefore counter your attacks.
weaknesses: The target must complete a certain condition.
The expression cannot be made up.
The strength is the weakness.

name: Tailor Maker
description: You can design the most  practical and stylish costume for anyone with a power. The costumes you make, conjures itself around the person you are tailoring for. The costume you design works practically for the kind of power they have for example someone who generates flame and hot fire, their costume will be heat-resistant. With time your costumes can enhance and boost the power of the individual you are tailoring for. You can also control whether the person can no longer wear your costume.
summary: The ability to make the most efficient, practical and stylish costume for anyone who has a power.
strengths: Costumes tailored are practical, and can be as stylish as you choose to design.
With enough practice the costume can enhance or boost the power of the individual you make the costume for.
You can also 'turn off' this power on the individuals you tailor for. Example: If you can boost the power of the individual, you can also stop that enhancement.
weaknesses: A background power for someone on a super hero team. No real, personal, combative capabilities.
If you enhance a person's power with the costume they design, they could turn against you, if they went rogue.

name: Repair Fire
description: This power allows the user to summon golden flames that revert broken objects to their 'repaired' state. For example, using them on a broken window will repair the window. The power allows for a fairly arbitrary definition of 'repaired' - if the flames are used on ordinary glass, it is possible to revert it to its 'unprocessed' state of sand and assorted chemicals as long as the user decides that they're applying the flames to 'broken' sand, rather than fixed glass.
summary: The ability to summon golden flames that fix broken things.
strengths: Fix broken objects with ease.
Heal peoples injuries.
weaknesses: If the flames are used on computers or other electronics, it will wipe the data on them.
Excessive use of the flames will tire the user out.

name: Lie Detector
description: With this ability, you will always know whether someone is being genuinely honest with you or just giving you a line of bull.  You'll also be able to detect which parts of a story are stretches of the truth or near-truths, although you won't automatically know the actual truth unless the person tells you.
summary: The ability to know for certain whether someone is telling the truth or lying.
strengths: Have a much easier time trusting people who consistently tell the truth
Accusing people of thinking you're hot, then catching them in a lie when they say no
You have the ultimate upper hand when playing poker and negotiating with salespeople
weaknesses: Sometimes not knowing the truth is better

name: Superhuman Leaping
description: A person with Superhuman Leaping has a sort of specialized Super Strength. Instead of the strength being in the upper body, a Superhuman Leaper has enhanced leg muscles and bones. They can jump up to seventy-five feet straight up, 150 feet in a long jump, and they can survive most falls. They have no enhanced arm strength and no other superhuman attributes.
summary: The ability to jump great heights and distances
strengths: 75 feet straight up, 150 foot long jump
Can survive most falls
Good for escapes
weaknesses: No enhanced upper body strength
No other superhuman attributes
Confined spaces

name: Super Person Copy
description: Any super-person from a TV show, movie, book, comic, etc. , the user can pick one, and have all their powers. The super-person can be anything/anyone that has superpowers (alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. ) But, the user can only pick one super-person, that's it. But the good part is the user get's ALL of that super-person's superpowers.
summary: The ability to possess the superpowers of a super-person
strengths: Have all the powers of any super-person
Super-person can be an alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. (superpowers required)
weaknesses: User can only pick one super-person.

name: Selective Intangibility
description: A person with this power can make selective parts of their body intangible at a time. For example, they can make only their head intangible to dodge a punch to the head. When a person phases through someone and becomes tangible again, their body parts will fuse temporarily through space-time until the person becomes intangible again. Objects grabbed by the user can become intangible as long as the hands are intangible as well.
summary: The ability to make only certain parts of your body intangible at will
strengths: Hostages can be punched through
You can make things you touch fully intangible
You can immediately make any part intangible, including the head, without any consequences
weaknesses: You cannot make your whole body intangible at once
You need to concentrate on which body part to make intangible

name: Metaphysical Change
description: This ability allows the user to twist another's ability upon physical contact of the person. The change is not harmful nor disastrous upon change. However, the ability will no longer be the same as the ability the other user had before. It will most likely be the opposite. The target user does not keep their old power but is bestowed with a new one. However, it is different from Power Bestowal (or anything similar) in the sense that a new power is not added to the user, only changed.
summary: The ability to force an ability user's ability to distort and become another random ability.
strengths: Change a potentially annoying power to something else.
Change an unwanted power to something perhaps useful.
weaknesses: The target's power may be... Even more annoying afterward
Need to develop new strategy to face new power.

name: Insomniac Strength
description: The longer you stay awake, the more your strength and invulnerability increase. When you are asleep or have just woken up, you are baseline human, but two hours after waking up you will be impervious to small arms fire, and able to throw people around one-handed. You become tired as fast as normal people, but stimulants can help keep you awake. At full power you could withstand a tank shell or a napalm attack, and benchpress a commercial jet.
summary: The ability to become stronger and tougher by staying awake
strengths: For most of the day you have considerable powers, and by night you're a serious force
Can take stimulants such as caffeine if you really need to use your full power
When you're so tired you can't focus in a fight, your invulnerability will still protect you
weaknesses: You need to shave etc in the first half-hour you're awake, before your hair becomes indestructible
You could be fairly easily killed early in the morning
You find it difficult to use your full strength, as you'll be very tired by then

name: Incognito
description: With this power, at will you can go completely incognito in an instant.  In a mirror you might look the same, but in incognito mode, nobody will recognize you, and they won't be able to recall what you looked like.  You won't leave fingerprints, hair, or any incriminating evidence for that matter. And, to make things better, you won't appear at all on cameras or in photos.  So go ahead, go incognito and rob the bank!  But just make sure you've hired a good getaway driver.
summary: The ability to become completely anonymous--nobody will recognize you and you'll leave no tracks.
strengths: Easily get away with certain things
Become a kickass spy
Avoid annyoing ex-girlfriends (or ex-boyfriends)
weaknesses: You might be tempted to break the law, and often
You can still get caught (however, they won't know who you are)

name: Uncontrollable Energy
description: Harness anger, hope or even determination into energy. This energy can sometimes be uncontrollable.
summary: The ability to harness anger, hope or determination into energy
strengths: You can have lots of power
Enables you to do more inhuman things
weaknesses: Sometimes uncontrollable

name: 0 G: Zero Gravity Reduction
description: This ability can be used for many things. It obviously allows the user to reduce gravity, however, it is not only use to levitate oneself. You are also capable of making others float, and objects. However, at the higher bands, you can reduce the gravity within structures to the point that bonds are loosened and they are effectively vaporized
summary: The ability to reduce gravity to zero for various effects
strengths: Float/"fly"/levitate, and reduction in gravity helps in jumping and agility
Levitate other things
Reduce gravitational attraction to the point people fly away or objects are vaporized
weaknesses: Can't control your levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't control object's levitation path until you develop your ability
Can't vaporize objects until you develop your ability

name: Gliding
description: You could be able to harness the power of flight with minimal effort and minimal resistance

No machinery is needed
You can go as far as you want to
weaknesses: You will need a running start
This ability takes time to fully master
People will be able to see you from the ground or otherwise

name: Half Succubus/Incubus
description: Someone with this power will have boosted strength, speed, and magical power though mostly for illusions. They will also have fangs, claws, a pointed tail, and wings as well as a beautiful/handsome appearance (no zits, smooth skin, slender, well-built, etc). They will also give off pheromones that attract the sex that they are interested in.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-succubus/incubus
strengths: You will always look good and never have to work on your appearance.
You can attract anyone you want for a mate
You always have claws to fight with if something goes wrong.
weaknesses: If you for some reason have this power but don't like people, everyone will be attracted to you.
Note: It would be half-succubus for females, half-incubus for males.
Someone who has no feelings or is immune to pheromones.

name: Manual Adaptation
description: Reactive Adaptation allows you to become immune to something after being exposed to it a few times. With Manual Adaptation, why wait? You can willingly become immune to threats as soon as they attack you! You can make yourself immune to high voltage attacks, bullets, and nuclear blasts as soon as you wish it. Also, your body and mind will become stronger as a result.
summary: The ability to choose your physical and mental weaknesses.
strengths: Be invincible!
Choose what can harm you
weaknesses: It's a Mary Sue ability
You must be aware of the threat

name: Matter Conversion
description:
The ability to change the state of matter of any living or non-living matter.
Example: You can cause people to melt or you can turn steam into ice.
You can even change objects to their plasma state.
summary: The ability to change the state of matter with any object.
strengths: You can melt people you hate.
You can make ice cubes instantly on a hot day.
weaknesses: Might by accident melt someone you like.

name: Talent Thief
description: If the victim has the ability to pilot a plane, when you use this power, you will immediately receive that power as well. Steal any abilities a person has (superpowers don't count).
summary: The ability to steal any abilities of the victim.
strengths: Jack of All Trades, Master of All
Never lose the victim's powers!
Become amazingly powerful.
weaknesses: Choose a bad person? You're stuck with his talents forever.
Ego.
Choose a person with piloting skill, cannot steal someone else's piloting skills.

name: Painting Master.
description: With this ability you can paint a scene of a certain person thing or place, and whatever you painted will happen. If it a time is not specified with the painting it will occur before Twelve a. M. If you think of a person and randomly paint something you will paint a picture of what that person is doing at that exact moment, a later moment, or an earlier moment in time.
summary: The ability to control reality with your paintings
strengths: Make anyone do whatever you want by painting them in a picture.
See what other people are doing whenever you want.
You can paint anything you want with perfect clarity.
weaknesses: Never draw cartoons. Ever.
How the scene occurs, and what happens afterward is not controlled by the first drawing.
You have to complete the drawing for it to take affect.

name: True Luck
description: Someone with True Luck was born under the watch of fate, God, or some other power that keeps them safe.  They never get hurt, or sick, or cheated when it can possibly avoided.  It seems as though the laws of causality and probability will bend (if not break) to give them a shot.  However, it's also not under that person's control; and the powers that be are notoriously fickle.  They don't like it when someone tries to exploit them, meaning you can't try to win at blackjack with this.  Good Luck.
summary: The ability to exist in a perpetual state of good luck.  Sort of.
strengths: Nothing bad really ever happens to you, it's avoided in some way or another.
You will always be provided for, i.e. you'll aquire money, food, shelter... whatever you may need.
Various perks gained from 'good' outcomes that occur to you, as long as it was unintentional.
weaknesses: Nothing particularly 'good' can happen to you, especially if you try to plan for it.
Your definition of positive, and fate's definition, may not always match.
Since you're not in control, you may wind up being confused about what's happening and why.

name: Endless Blood
description: With this power the user will never run out of blood within his bodily system. Any lost blood is immediately replaced without needing any energy from the user. The blood will be the same blood type as the persons normal blood. Open wounds will continually bleed until the wound is closed. This power is normally always on, so the supply of blood can not be turned off. The blood can be used to fuel other blood related powers.
summary: The ability to have a endless supply of blood.
strengths: Never fear blood loss.
Can donate an infinite supply of blood.
Always have a supply of blood for other blood related powers.
weaknesses: Can not be directly controlled by the user through this power.
If wounds do not close the bleeding would never stop.
The blood will be the same as your normal blood.

name: Power Crystals
description: Power crystals are crystals of great power. They can be (if done properly) used as energy sources, but can also give great powers to humans. With simple exposure, you could gain any sort of power. But depending on how someone is exposed to them, they can have different effects. You can also manipulate them, so you could use them as weapons or structures. You can even control when they are activated (glowing), meaning when they can grant abilities.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate power crystals.
strengths: You can control and shape power-granting crystals
Studying different kinds of exposure could allow you to control what they do to people
weaknesses: Sometimes the crystals can have bad effects

name: Unstoppability
description: With this power you can charge through anything, be it a dense wall, or a living foe. A person with this has inertia to keep going for however long the user likes (although they can get tired and stop of the their own will, and can sometimes be moved by outside forces), and though any obstacle, to reach any target, or just to tackle a foe with phenomenal force.
summary: The ability to charge straight through any subject
strengths: Can go through anything.
Can stop whenever one chooses too.
When charging through living foes, their bodies and left in shreds, bits, pieces, etc.
weaknesses: Can still tire.
Can still be stopped my outside forces ( psychics, a person with persuasion, etc)
The damage of Unstoppability

name: Weekly Wonder
description: With this power, every new day means a new power for you. Each day of the week brings you a specific new power untill the day ends.  Monday - Increase Gravity on others, making them slow and sluggish.  Tuesday - Control wind.  Wednesday - Aquakinesis, control water.  Thursday - Geokinesis, ability to control earth.  Friday - Laser Vision.  Saturday - Electricy Generation, generate and control electricity.  Sunday - Pyrokinesis, ability to control fire. Power wanes with the setting sun.
summary: The ability to have a different power depending on the day of the week
strengths: Each day is a new power
Control over multiple elements and powers (over different days)
weaknesses: You have to plan based on what power you'll have the next day
Somtimes hard to remember what power you have.

name: Phasing Extension
description: The ability to go through solid matter without any harm. This ability also extends to other items, even when they are out of your hands for a short period of time. If you threw a baseball across a 20 yard field, within 15 yards it would uncontrollably phase back into solid matter. It depends on how strong or weak your ability is: If you are focused and have much, then the object will be phasing for a longer period of time.
summary: The ability to phase yourself and objects while out of your hand
strengths: You can phase
Other objects can be out of your hand and still be phase
The stronger the person, the longer the phasing effect lasts
weaknesses: The phasing of other objects only last for a short period of time
It takes concentration to phase an object while out of your hand
You cannot un-phase the object once it is out of your hands

name: The Door
description: Just think of the door and it will come down anywhere and anytime. Through the door you will find weapons, cars, food, meds, and tech. Only you can enter though. Anything and everything is in there and you can sort it like in "The Matrix." The downfall is that you can't spawn other superpowers.
summary: The ability to spawn a door to a supply room wherever and whenever you want
strengths: Any weapon you want, including guns, ammo and melee wepons
Any car you want plus you can put guns on the cars too
You can hide in there if needed
weaknesses: Only you can enter
Can't get other superpowers

name: Superhuman Perception Zone
description: Using this power makes you omniscient on a certain area of range. When using this ability you can see every single detail of every single thing around you. You know what is everyone thinking, what everything is made of, everything in this small zone. Although its really powerful, this ability makes you really tired and while using it, you fall in a deep sleeping state.  The initial range of the power is a small living room, but it can be increased. The sleeping state lasts at least 30 minutes
summary: The ability to become totally omniscient on a small specific area.
strengths: If you are in a criminal scene, you can solve the crime in seconds using this power.
You can locate a hidden person or a lost object.
Using this power you can solve the Da Vinci's code easily!
weaknesses: While using this you become really vulnerable, so you might need to have someone to protect you.
This ability makes you exhausted and using it too much could ruin your mind.
Increasing range is very dangerous; 30 minutes can't be shortened.

name: Lie Realization
description: A person with this power can turn other people's lies into truth. As such reality bends to make it true. If history has to be rewritten then an alternate universe is created where the lie is true. Only the lying person is aware of the change. If the person that told the lie admits what he said was a lie, either in person or in a journal after death etc, there will be a backlash that reverses the effects of this power and goes back to the moment that lie happened.
summary: The ability to turn other people's lies into truth
strengths: No one can lie to you if you don't want them to
Make things you want to hear true
If people flatter you, you can make what they say true
weaknesses: Does not come with lie detection ability
Does not work on your own lies
If someone starts telling the truth this power gets reversed

name: Infinite Stamina
description: You can exercise all day long and never get tired. You can run a long distance race at your fastest sprinting pace. If you can do something once you can do it millions of times. Unfortunately you can't ever sleep. Also, you have to actually work for a while to be strong and you still won't be super strong. If you're slow you'll still be slow you just won't ever get tired. But if you put in some work you'll be like a batman who doesn't ever have to take a break.
summary: The ability to never get tired
strengths: You can exercise for hours without fatigue standing in your way
People who stand in your way will eventually get tired and give up
You are always energized and alert
weaknesses: You can't sleep
Requires work to become useful

name: Tactile Thought Projection
description: This is a Twilight power. Tactile thought projection is the ability to place the user's thoughts and memories  into another person's mind. This power allows the user to project his or her thoughts into  another person's mind in the form of vivid pictures, thoughts and feelings, and requires  physical contact. It works best in communicating with others when words are not  suited to the purpose. One can hijack the user's power to access his/her dreams by  placing their hand on their faces.
summary: The ability to project aspects of your mind.
strengths: Showing people your life story.
Non verbal communication.
weaknesses: Mind invasion while you sleep.
Physical contact needed.

name: Immune System Enhancement
description: With this power, your immune system, along with other aspects, is immensely increased to keep you safe. Your white blood cell count skyrockets along with other things and you are immune to AIDS, and poisons. You can breathe out or excrete a poison to kill "germs" and other things, and your body heat can go up to three hundred degrees fahrenheit without harm. You heal quickly and have one hundred times as strong connective tissue.
summary: The ability to have your immune system increased with other aspects.
strengths: Virtually invulnerable to disease.
Heal quickly.
Versatile.
weaknesses: No sick days.

name: It's The Thought That Counts
description: With this power whenever someone thinks of you you become stronger
summary: The ability to become stronger whenever someone thinks of you
strengths: Whenever someone thinks of you you get stronger even if they're thinking of you badly
weaknesses: The extra strength wears off as soon as nobody is thinking about you anymore

name: Shadow Combination
description: To attatch yourself with your own shadow, making yourself light, 2D, and invisible in other shadows.
summary: The ability to combine yourself with your own shadow
strengths: Can fly
Easily looked past
Can escape through cracks between doors
weaknesses: Cold - if done for too long will result in hypothermia
If you don't concentrate you will float away
Everything looks blurry and unfocused - hard to concentrate

name: Dragon Morph
description: When you morph into a dragon, you possess every characteristic of the mythological creature. You can fly at super speeds, breathe fire, super sight and hearing, and the super strength of a dragon. You just have to concentrate in order to morph into the dragon creature.
summary: The ability to morph into a dragon creature.
strengths: Possess many separate abilities at once.
Ability to breathe fire, fly, strength, super senses.
weaknesses: Can only use dragon powers in dragon form.
Can not stay in dragon form forever.

name: Reaper's Light
description: This ability allows you to create a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow. Paralyzed victims become frozen in whatever position they were in when the light appeared. When the light is has waned, victims do not rember it happened and continue as if it never happened. You can enter the light after it has been activated and not be affected. Killing the user of this ability while it is active will kill all caught in it.
summary: The ability to generate a bright light that paralyzes anyone caught in its glow
strengths: Freeze victims for a clean getaway or a clean kill
weaknesses: Some can avoid being frozen by blocking the light when it is first deployed.
Dying while it is active kills all affected by it.

name: Musical Influence
description: The subject who owns this power has a deep affiliation with music, so deep that he/she can acquire a superpower every time he/she listen to a specific song. The power he/she obtains depends from: 1. The meaning of the song; 2. The text, the melody and the rythm of the song; 3. The subjective emotions inspired by that song to the owner.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by listening to a specific song.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as the existing songs;
The most appreciated is the song, the most powerful will be the received power.
weaknesses: A silly song will give a useless power;
The song must be listened entirely.

name: Aura Communication
description: You can send messages to and recieve messages from anyone who is either at least one centimetre in your aura or has you at least one centimetre in their aura. Noone can stop the messages from being sent or recieved.
summary: The ability to communicate with others by way of contact with auras
strengths: Instant uninterceptible communication during combat!
weaknesses: Messages will go in a straight line and will be recieved by anyone who is in between you (to con 2)
(from con 1) and the intended reciever as long as they are also within your aura.

name: Photoshop
description: A Photoshopper can copy, paste, add effects, merge, change colors, and otherwise edit people and objects.
summary: The ability to modify just about anything
strengths: Retouch your face
Erase your annoying sibling's mouth
Select all the water in a flooding area and delete!
weaknesses: People expect you to fix their flaws
You can't copy and edit the power.
If you have no artistic talent, you might mess things up badly and not be able to fix it.

name: Magical Weapon Creation
description: This ability works by creating a weapon of your choice and adding a single magic type. For example, you can choose a sword and fire magic. You can choose even modern weapons such as a pistol or machine guns, or even futuristic weapons, but those will take a lot more concentration. Also, when you choose a weapon, you can only add one magic type to it. For example, if you chose a spear, you can't add both ice and lightning to it. You can, however, change the magic a weapon has.
summary: The ability to create magical weapons of any kind.
strengths: Can create any weapon and add any magic to it, healing, fire, ice, etc.
Can change the magic on a weapon, whether immediately or later.
Can activate magic powers upon will, and manipulate them to your will.
weaknesses: Magic works better with melee weapons and does not work as well with futuristic weapons.
You cannot add more than one magic per weapon.
You have to direct the magic through your weapon.

name: Weapon Draw
description: Just put your hand on the screen and think about the weapon. And you have the weapon you want.
summary: The ability to take a weapon from any computer game
strengths: Any weapon you want in your hand
You can have a car if you have a car game
weaknesses: The computer might be too far to touch it

name: Ability Snatch
description: This only works if you are within, at least, ten-feet away from your "victim." Once you're near, your "victim" will lose their ability and you will be able to use it.
summary: The ability to temprarily steal the abilities of others.
strengths: You can negate an opponent's ability, without any physical contact.
You can snatch more than one ability.
You'll be immune to physical-contact powers (ex. super strength)
weaknesses: There's a limit to the amount of abilities that can be snatched (just like a normal thief).
Powers, other than physical-contact powers, will be difficult to snatch.
You'll lose your obtained ability(s) when you're at a certain distance away from your "victim."

name: Rod Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It is more effective at very low light intensity. With it, you have an enhanced night vision, but you can't see if there's no light at all. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into special signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. This power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
summary: The ability to see better in the dark, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
strengths: You can see in the dark better than a normal human being, provided there's enough light.
You can electrocute someone if it's dark enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
weaknesses: It can work at high light intensity, but there'll be a cooldown period before it works in the dark.
Because of con 1, this power can be disrupted by flashes of light.
In bright light, you can only create very low-voltage electrical impulses.

name: Mirage Inducing
description: Mirage Inducing is a version of Illusion in which the user can generate illusions which last, and are completely real, as long as targets don't know that they are illusions. One with this ability could cause any type of illusion they desire, but the second someone calls out "it's not real! " or shakes subjects out of their deluded state or subjects see the illusionist working his power, the illusions wear off entirely (until they can go unnoticed again).
summary: The ability to conjure illusions that are real as long as people think they are
strengths: Cast powerful, convincing illusions
They can affect and interact with the environment as though they were real
Requires little concentration, and the power gets much stronger over time
weaknesses: Partly requires others' mental power (belief, fear, etc) or one's own self-delusion to work
If subjects are shaken out of their deluded state or catch the user casting the illusion
Perspicuity (Mental Immunity), Anti-Telepathy and similar abilities provide immunity

name: Vicarious Superman
description: This is a sinister version of the Superman Spell. You transfer your mortal limits into any person, place, or thing you desire. By getting as far away from them as possible, you become a powerful demigod, but you will start to lose your powers in their presence. If the vessel is damaged, you will be as well.
summary: The ability to transfer your mortality into an object and become a demigod.
strengths: Be a god among men
Any limits you have will be transferred to the vessel
weaknesses: Your vessel is your kryptonite
If it is damaged, you will be as well

name: Spirit Shifting
description: The ability to become a ghost at will. When user becomes a ghost, their body turns into an object (example: necklace. ) When they want to be a mortal again, the just have to touch the object. Spirit-shifters can become ghosts at any time, but they can only stay ghosts for short periods of time (about 30 minutes. ) If they stay longer, they be taken to the spirit world.
summary: The ability to become a ghost at will
strengths: Can go through objects
Can communicate with ghosts (to get information)
Can easily spy on people
weaknesses: Shifting forms requires lots of concentration
If their object is lost, so is their human body
If they stay a ghost too long, they get taken to the spirit world

name: The Power Of Random
description: You can change your power whenever you want but you can't control what power you get. With some training and practice you might be to control what type of power it is. You know,mental,biological,supernatural,ect. But without you could get any no matter what.
summary: The ability to change your power randomly whenever.
strengths: Many uses.
Unique power!
Can control what type of power you get with practice.
weaknesses: Get a stupid power.

name: Typhoon Master
description: This ability is about calling a typhoon whenever or wherever you want it. You can tell where the storm will be but you can control where the lightnings will strike, the direction of the wind blow and the hardness of the rain. Well you can call a storm far away from you, where you know your enemy is. Useful when it's hot outside, LOL! Every minute that the typhoon is summoned will decrease your strength as a human being. When the typhoon you created is so strong, you can't control it anymore.
summary: The ability to call a typhoon whenever, wherever.
strengths: It's useful when it's hot outside.
Can use it far away from you.
You can feel so powerful with this!
weaknesses: You can also be hurt when not properly controlled.
You can kill a person or thousands of them.
You can destroy a whole nation!

name: Mark Of Hati
description: In Norse mythology, hati was one of the wolf brothers (the other being skoll) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, hati devoured the moon God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Moon God and can use elements like water, dark, and gravity and can become more powerful at night.
summary: The ability to become a lunar lycan
strengths: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Power of a moon god
Stand up against gods and devour them
weaknesses: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong during the day

name: Complete Physical Mastery
description: Someone possessing this power can alter and regulate their bodily functions at any time. Increase your metabolism to prevent gaining weight. Turn off your body's ability to register pain. Increase your body's production of lactic acid to prevent fatigue. Increase production of bodily cells for accelerated healing. Be aware of the position of the body, any diseases or foreign materials in it, their center of gravity and tissues.
summary: The ability to be aware of and manipulate all of the processes of one's body.
strengths: Enhanced balance, healing, reflexes, and instincts
Immunity to poison and being controlled
Total control over bodily processes (heartbeat, breathing, etc.)
weaknesses: Using this power to its full potential requires intricate knowledge of how your anatomy works.

name: Temporal Communication
description: A person with this power can talk with the past or the future by connecting with and electronic device. They will send the electronic waves backward or forward in time to call people. For example, you can call your future self to ask for the answers to homework or where a bomb is or how they defeated someone. You can also call the past and risk creating a temporal paradox. However if a paradox is created the user of this power is unaffected by the paradox and retains their memory and their body.
summary: The ability to communicate with the past or the future through electronics(email, phone, text, etc. )
strengths: Calling the future is similar to prerecognition
Calling the past to fix temporal paradoxes or create them
Even if a paradox is created you will not be affected and retain all memories
weaknesses: You need to have a communication device
If phones don't work in the future
You don't know what phone number to call in the past or future

name: Elemental Wolves
description: The wolves will be composed completely out of the element of your choice and have sharp fangs and claws. Choosable elements are Fire, Water, Earth, Wind, Wood, Ice Lightning, Metal, Sand, and any element on the Periodic Table. You only get to choose one element for ALL the wolves you make. Once the choice is made it cannot be changed. The wolves can go for a range of up to 50 metres from your position.
summary: The ability to create and control wolves of any one element
strengths: You can choose your wolves' element.
The wolves can be powerful soldiers.
The wolves have all the strengths of their element.
weaknesses: The wolves have all the weaknesses of their element. Alteration powers have no effect on this power.
Element chosen cannot be changed even with other powers nor can the number of elements be increased.
Your wolves can be hijacked by someone who can control the wolves' element.

name: Draconic Fire
description: The fire of an extremely powerful dragon is such that only regular fire can put it out. The holder of this power can use this extremely powerful flame for any cause that they may desire.
summary: The ability to create and control a fire that can only be put out by other fires
strengths: Enemies have to literally fight fire with fire.
Water just makes this fire stronger.
weaknesses: The weakest flame from Pyrokinesis can put out your fires.

name: Modern Science
description: Science has many great powers. It has carried us through many problems. You can control and invoke the forces of any modern day science. This includes physics, biology, chemistry, astronomy, psychology, and geology.
summary: The ability to manipulate the forces of modern day science.
strengths: Very powerful
As science evolves, so does this power.
weaknesses: May not understand your power at first

name: Blade Manipulation
description: The power to control bladed objects around you including knives, swords, axes, spears, anything with a blade. The power also includes having the ability to protrude blades out of your body (like wolverine on a bigger scale). Can create armor out of the blades protruding. Becoming unconscious can cause an uncontrollable flurry of bladed objects which would have to be controlled by your mental will. This can also be cause by high amounts of bodily harm or trauma.
summary: The ability to control bladed objects and protrude blades from body parts
strengths: Can deflect and create a shield of blades
Surprise attacks
weaknesses: Losing control can create an uncontrollable flurry of blades
Unconsciousness causes bad 1
Can sometimes control body

name: Soundwave Skin
description: You create the soundwaves by screaming which will cover and protect you. The soundwaves will cause anything that touches them except for you to be blasted backwards by a shockwave from the sound. While the sound is protecting you, you are immune to any loud noises that would hurt your ears to the point of nearly deafening you.
summary: The ability to protect oneself with soundwaves that are right on top of one's skin
strengths: Sound-damage immunity combined with a barrier.
weaknesses: Powers that annihilate other powers. Ex: Power Burning or Negation.
Your throat will hurt while using this power.

name: Delete This Shadow Flight
description: It'll be a lot cooler if you were like Johnny Cage from Mortal Kombat, but not only not like he does his famous Shadow Kick you would fly into the skies leaving a black or green trail behind you.
summary: The ability to fly across the air anywhere at a steady speed, you would move faster, and leave a black trail.
strengths: No one will be able to catch you.
weaknesses: Same as a regular flying power

name: Dislikes Disappear
description: Anything that you dislike about a person, place, or thing, you can get rid of. This power also works on yourself. Also, let's say you don't like your voice. It wont just disappear, but instead it will change according to your preference (in this case, whatever voice you would prefer or want/like best).
summary: The ability to rid any person, place, or thing of all the things you dislike about it
strengths: Get rid of anything you dislike like about a person, place, or thing
Things you dislike change according to your preference (whichever alternative you would like best)
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Exterior Materialization
description: You could change your skin (exterior) into any material you touch.
summary: The ability to change your exterior to any material you touch.
strengths: You could change your skin
You will never be naked
You couldn't be hurt
weaknesses: Careful what you touch
Can't really feel anything

name: Thought Breaker
description: If you want to break something such as someone's bones or breaking a light, all you have to is think about it and will it to happen.
summary: The ability to break things with a simple thought in mind.
strengths: You can break an enemy's bones with a simple thought
You can not be accused of something that you didn't touch
It's the thought that counts
weaknesses: If you think of something and will it to happen it will happen.
You have to control your thoughts a little more when you are angry

name: Elemental Arms
description: You are able to turn your arms into rocks or tornadoes. You can also have arms of water. You can't have elements on your arms for a long time, and there's a 1-hour cooldown when you're done. It can become dangerous if you put 3 elements together.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into some of the elements
strengths: Can have two different elements like one fire arm and one stone arm
Can combine two elements
Can use both arms as an element
weaknesses: 1-hour cooldown
If you put more than two powers together, chances are it would amputate your arm

name: Master Storyteller
description: You have the ability to craft amazing stories, most ideas you have you can flesh out into full stories. Be a best selling novelist or screenwriter, be able to think up the best alibi or excuse.
summary: The ability to entrance and entertain people by crafting amazing stories
strengths: Be a best selling Novelist, Screenwriter or Director
Entertain millions with your work
Live in luxury thanks to your works
weaknesses: You might prefer being in the limelight rather than a behind the scenes person
Fame might not be for you
While many will adore your works, there will always be critics

name: Psi Armor
description: When activated, this power covers you in a layer of psionic energy that negates physically based psychic attacks, such as telekinesis or pyrokinesis. Any attempt at using such powers on you fails, with the attack just bouncing off or sliding past. However, this does not prevent indirect attacks, such as throwing a car with your mind. It also is ineffective against any kind of mental attack, such as telepathic mind control.
summary: The ability to create armor that protects from some kinds of psychic attack.
strengths: Protection from pesty kinetic powers.
Allows you to fight psychics more easily.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect from indirect attacks
Or from telepathy.

name: Man
description: Control movement, mind and bodily elements of humanity, as well as augment any natural feature of a human being including yourself, as long as you sit on throne.
summary: The ability to control every aspect of humanity
strengths: You have all humanity as an army, as long you had contact with them
You reduce backstabbers by controlling their minds so that they have undying loyalty to you
You can enhance any part of a normal human into a deadly weapon.
weaknesses: Does not work on animals, human hybrids or non humans.
You sit on a throne at all times in order to keep the humans you've met under your control
You will have to met them first

name: Hormone Manipulation
description: With this power, one can control hormone production. Production levels return to normal over time, but can be restored at will, provided they have not yet returned to normal levels; otherwise it needs to be applied again. In yourself, however, levels are constantly maintained. As bonuses, one can sense hormone levels and diseases related to them such as type 1 diabetes as well as cure said hormone disorders, even when the levels must adjust for specific conditions.
summary: The ability to manipulate hormones.
strengths: Cure hormone-related disorders, such as diabetes type 1.
Alter hormone levels to control factors as you desire, such as quantities of fat and muscle.
You can instantly reverse any changes you have done to a person's hormone production.
weaknesses: Effects wear off over time unless maintained.
You cannot cure a hormone-based disease if the individual has no allele for it.
You can only control hormones, not other proteins such as enzymes.

name: Triumvirate
description: You have the ability of flight, durability, and energy projection, but there is a catch. You cannot use all 3 abilities at full strength once. You can use one ability at full strength, two abilities at medium strength, or three at a relatively weak strength. Flight at its strongest allows Mach 2 speeds. Your durability at its strongest allows you to block virtually all physical attacks and most high energy attacks. Your energy blast at its most potent could level a city block.
summary: The ability to fly at extreme speeds, be super durable, and fire energy blasts, but not at the same time.
strengths: You can fulfill several rolls on a battlefield that you can change as the situation calls for it.
Using all 3 you could still fly faster than most, withstand low caliber fire, and shoot lasers!
You can be a Lightning Bruiser, Mighty Glacier, Glass Canon, Fragile Speedster, Stone Wall, and etc.
weaknesses: If somebody uses rock when you're using scissors.

name: True Intentions
description: Using this ability you can see the true intentions of someone. You can tell if someone is good or evil, but you can't tell the 'level' of good or evil someone is on. You will unconsciencly judge yourself. Also, there is no 'in the middle' because people who are like that are either good or evil and it is being hidden by other actions. (hoped that answered some questions)
summary: The ability to see if someone is good or evil
strengths: It's impossible to have bad friends, you could see if they were evil.
Comes in handy in political situations.
You see someones true nature and intentions.
weaknesses: People who know of your powers will most likely try to exploit you. (not always)
You become very self-conscious, due to the fact that this power makes you judge yourself.
Knowing that people you love are evil can be a big burden.

name: Intelligence Mimicry
description: There are different types of intelligence. For example, there is Naturalist Intelligence or "Nature Smart". This ability lets the user mimic and add on to his amount of that intelligence for ten hours. This can allow the user to mimic the instincts of animals, the powers of those who can read minds or see the future.
summary: The ability to analyze and mimic by touch any creature's strongest form of intelligence.
strengths: Gain more intelligence.
Gain animal instinct.
Gain some psychic powers.
weaknesses: Each mimicked intelligence, instinct, or psychic power lasts for ten hours.

name: Elemental Seance
description: Spirits of the four elements exist all throughout nature, protecting and preserving pieces of their respective elements. Those who wield this power, called Druidic Elementalists or DEs, have the ability to commune with these spirits. In return for helping them to preserve and heal nature, they will assist you. They each posses properties of their elements. A special ability DEs posses is to manifest them physically so that they may assist you. They may also merge with them, but this is a rarity.
summary: The ability to commune with and control the elemental spirits of nature, and allow them to manifest physically.
strengths: You can heal and protect nature.
You have elemental spirits that can aid you in many things, both physical and mental.
You may always have a friend in nature.
weaknesses: You have to make a deal with them to be able to gain their trust and help.
Manifesting them physically takes a lot of energy and may make you tired.
They may turn on you if you go back on your word.

name: Muscular Enhancement
description: With this power, all your muscles gain a much greater degree of strength without being bigger. A child with this could easily lift two hundred pounds. You can also run, jump and climb faster and longer because your muscles won't tire out as easily. You can rip sheet metal. You also live longer because your smooth muscles work better and your respiratory and cardiovascular muscles keep you going longer. Your muscles are also immune to tranquilizers.
summary: The ability to have increased muscular power.
strengths: Live for hundreds of years.
Almost no effort needed for physical hard work.
Take longer to tire out.
weaknesses: Not a long-range attack power.
Immune to muscle relaxants at doctors.

name: Psionic Blast
description: Using this power, you can blast psychic energy at a person or group of people. This energy psychically attacks the mind causing either pain, memory loss, unconsciousness to even brain death if you use that much power. The downside is it takes great mental concentration and it is possible to easily exhaust yourself. Also, you cannot read or communicate psychically, its just used for offensive and defensive attacks.
summary: The ability to blast powerful psychic energy.
strengths: Attack people's minds.
weaknesses: Takes great  focus.
Easily become fatigued and weak if you used too much power.
Not telepathic.

name: Psychic Aim
description: It's almost like "spider-sense" or the movie Next with a twist. You get a glimpse of the future of your target and where they will be. So you already know where to shoot or kick or punch, hitting them perfectly. It mostly just works in danger-type situations, like combat. The vision, which seems long, is really a micro-blink. You also just have normal reflex so you barley miss getting hit cause of your power. The ability works up to a mile radius all around.
summary: The ability to have have psychic premonition of your targets in order to perfectly strike them
strengths: Can predict where to shoot
Fight your intended target perfectly
weaknesses: Only works in combat
Psychic vision up to mile radius
Normal reflexes. You only dodge attacks because of premeditated knowledge

name: Location Memory
description: Just by being in an area, you instantly learn everything that had happened in that square mile in the past year. You can dim it down so it does not distract you but you can not turn it off.
summary: The ability to learn what had happened in the past at any location.
strengths: Be an awsome detective.
Learn what you forgot about the party last night.
Find out who stole your car and where they went.
weaknesses: No physical ability.
Going to public restrooms.
Still having to go find your stolen car.

name: Significance Manipulation
description: This ability can rearrange the importance or desirability any living thing, any object, any concept, and anything else including the user. The user could make make the ugliest of men the most desirable or the president to be as important as a bug that was squash. This ability can get specific in what thing is important to certain group. In a fight, the user can make their attack so significant in an universal prospective that it causes more damage than it should.
summary: The ability to change the amount of importance or desirability of anything.
strengths: Make anything important or desirable
Make anything unimportant or undesirable
Can increase damage of one's attack by making it significant.
weaknesses: Changing the desirability of anything too high will result in magnetic-like attraction.
Changing the significance of anything too low will result in fading from existence.

name: Myth Power: Kronos' Craft
description: Kronos (Cronos, Cronus, Khronos, Chronos, Chronus), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of time. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate the flow of time, and psychically travel through time, at will. One can also psychically perform feats of Telepathy and Telekinesis across time, at will. One can even psychically project temporal energy blasts, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Kronos' command over the essence of the passage of time
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically access Chronokinesis and Time Travel, at will
Psychically access Temporal Telepathy and Telekinesis, project Temporal Blasts, at will
weaknesses: Temporal anomalies and paradoxes are likely to ensue, if timeline not altered carefully (NCN)
Anachronism, Unpredictability and Attunement to Time provide resistance (NCN)
Time Defiance, MythPowers based on Kronos' parents, siblings and offspring provide immunity (NCN)

name: Essence Conduit
description: The user can create a telepathic link to all things that have an essence. With the connection, they will be able to create a duplicate of the thing they are connected to with their own essence. Depending on the thing they are copying, the user will lose a certain amount of themselves but will control the duplicate. If the duplicate is destroyed, the original will not die for it is the users essence. You will be restored in the process.
summary: The ability to connect to anything that has an essence and create and manipulate a duplicate with your essence.
strengths: Be connected to all things that have an essense.
Create a duplicate to control.
Can make more than one duplicate as well as have different duplicates at the same time.
weaknesses: Uses a certain amount of essence to create a duplicate.
Beware of using all of your essence.

name: Wormhole Color
description: It's as simple as taking a can of paint and splashing it on the wall! If you make a similar painting somewhere else, you have a wormhole connecting the two markings. The colors have to match to each other, meaning you can have 2 wormholes per color shade. If you paint more,it cancels the first one you made. You can determine it the paint should be a wormhole or not.
summary: The ability to create wormholes with paint.
strengths: Teleport to places you've already been.
Other people can't go through unless you're touching them.
Get away from situations with a splash of color.
weaknesses: You need paint.
You also need to paint in the location you're heading to.
People grabbing onto you can use the portal.

name: Shadow Wrap
description: With this power shadows wrap around your forearms and will harm anything that comes near you with hostile intent. You cannot control the shadows in any way as they are automatically controlled by your mind's desire to protect itself.
summary: The ability to have the shadows wrap around one's forearms in order to protect oneself
strengths: A good defensive power.
Don't need to concentrate to use this power.
weaknesses: Can't control the shadows protecting you.
The shadows automatically attack anyone with hostile intent nearby even if it is not towards you.

name: Nonexistence
description: This is the temporal ability to erase oneself from the time-space continuum, and thus not be bound to the "boundaries" of what is physically possible in the material realm (it would only allow defiance of space and time, and the like, not things like Summoning or Reality Bending). Not to mention, all memory of the user will be erased (they will not appear in pictures or prophecies, and there will be no evidence of their existence other than their presence), until they phase back into space-time.
summary: The ability to move outside of space-time, giving the impression of not existing.
strengths: Immunity to time manipulation, bodily alteration, reality bending and recording devices (no traces).
Loss of bodily needs to eat, drink, sleep and breathe.
Defy space-time (walk up walls, teleport, leave people's memories when you leave their presence).
weaknesses: People with Chronokinesis can make this permanent.
Might get annoying if people forget who you are as soon as you leave their presence.
Makes robberies and such too easy (MIGHT get boring).

name: Force Of Balance
description: Balance is a force to be reckoned with. When a part of our world is unbalanced, it has a certain effect. For example, when you unbalance the energy in the air, it will re-balance itself, and doing so, will discharge energy, in the form of heat or, if enough energy is disturbed, lightning. Or you could unbalance the land and cause earthquakes, or unbalance the functions of the body, and cause disease and sickness.
summary: The ability to balance and unbalance various things
strengths: Can control a force of nature
Very powerful and has many uses
weaknesses: If you can't control your powers, you could destroy everything

name: Mystical Hourglass
description: The user with this special hourglass pendant, that can be rotated for the sands of time to count down, can be a paragon until the time runs out. After that, the user must turn back the hourglass in the other direction and wait until the sands of time count downs again before using it again. Usually the power would last for an hour, and the time taken to recharge the power will also take an hour
summary: The ability to become a paragon until the sand in the hourglass finishes
strengths: You are a paragon.
Can go head to head with most powerhouses.
weaknesses: When the time runs out, you are in deep trouble
Takes the same to restore the user's power

name: Sound Displacement
description: A person with this power can remove the sound produced by any action including speaking. They can remove the sound of their footsteps and even the sound of an explosion. In addition they can then place the sound that they captured in a new location. They do not need to place the sound immediately somewhere else and can store the sound for prolonged periods of time.
summary: The ability to take away sound produced by anything and place that sound anywhere
strengths: Completely silent movement--useful for sneaking around
Can later place that sound anywhere--misdirection
Protection against sonic based attacks
weaknesses: Needs practice to use effectively

name: Choshech (Darkness)
description: Black smoke clouds cover your body filling your lungs and everything you do is done a thousand times faster, stronger, and more powerful. For example, you can run 1000 mph, your skin can become as tough as concrete, you can also jump a thousand miles farther. Those are just some of the things this power has to offer.
summary: The ability to do everything a thousand times better.
strengths: Can run at 1000 mph
Skin is as tough as concrete
Are 1000 times stronger than you already are
weaknesses: You might hurt someone by accident with this power

name: Digital Power Acquisition
description: By implanting a wireless neural implant in the brain, the user can 'program' their body (with a computer) to acquire superpowers. Based on this code, the implant constructs synthetic viruses to take the modified genes to the body, thereby imbuing the power. Any mistakes in the code could be fatal, but the implant can also convert from power to code, thus creating a central database of working abilities. The imbuing process is long and painful, though, 11+ hours and a lot of pain. Is it worth it?
summary: The ability to digitally acquire superpowers via a neural implant.
strengths: No limit to the amount of powers you can obtain.
The type of power limited only by your programming knowledge.
If a partner has this you can share abilities.
weaknesses: Imbuing process is long and painful.
Quite easy to make mistakes in the coding, so must be heavily debugged.
Technopaths. This power can be Self-Negated to defend against this though.

name: Full Frequency Hearing
description: You can tune your ears sort of like a radio. You can have normal hearing or change your ears to a different frequency to pick up police radio and even cell phone conversations. You need to develop the skill to be able to use it correctly. You cannot broadcast yourself, you can only listen to what others are broadcasting.
summary: The ability to hear anything being broadcast on any frequency with your own ears.
strengths: You will never need a radio again.
You can listen to people's cell phone conversations.
You can hear what police are doing.
weaknesses: Takes a few weeks to learn how to tune out some broadcasts.
People might be afraid to talk on a cell phone if they know you are nearby.
You cannot broadcast yourself.

name: Gravitational Attraction
description: This ability allows you to create a gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want to attract. The attracted object will rotate around you no matter how heavy it is.
summary: The ability to create gravitational attraction between yourself and anything you want.
strengths: You can make anything rotate around you and use it as a protection against incoming attacks.
weaknesses: You can't really manipulate the speed of the objects circling around you.

name: Luck Steal
description: A person with this power has the ability to steal people's good luck and fortune and give it to other people. Their right hand steals luck while their left hand gives luck. Thus the user needs to wear gloves all the time to prevent accidentally transferring luck around.
summary: The ability to steal people's luck through touch and give luck to other people
strengths: Perfect assasin-people die by natural causes/accidents
Can use stolen luck to give yourself luck or give others luck
weaknesses: You have wear gloves on your hands
You need to touch people to use this power

name: Reforming Psionic Entity
description: When this power activated, your human body was disintegrated and you became an incorporeal psionic entity as your true form. You automatically telekinetically draw in and hold together objects from nearby surroundings to form a new humanoid body, such as sand, water, earth, plants and masonry.  When this body is destroyed, you automatically begin to make another one. Your appearance stays very similar, you just appear to be made of a mix of debris. When angry, you create a larger, stronger form.
summary: The ability to create a body from the surrounding environment
strengths: You are now immortal. If you are destroyed physically, you rebuild yourself
Your environmental forms have advantages, e.g. steel muscles, rock skin
Cannot tire as you have no actual muscles, and cannot get ill or age
weaknesses: You will no longer be able to pass as a human
Cannot commit suicide if immortality becomes too much
Cannot taste food, experience touch, etc.

name: Toonforce
description: With this power, you can warp reality for comedic effects, defying every law in existence for the sake of laughter. You can do anything as long as it is funny. Thus, the only limit to this power is if the action is funny. You can also interrupt fights with funny intermonologue and you can break the 4th wall. You also get a hammerspace full of objects to induce laughter. You can also survive getting flattened like a pancake. This power can only be used when someone else is present.
summary: The ability to warp reality to create comedic effects
strengths: Be like Bugs Bunny
Virtually unstoppable unless facing a superior toonforcer
weaknesses: You can only use this power in the presence of others
You need to be partially insane to use this power correctly
Sometimes you will look ridiculous, but you are supposed to be

name: Alert Spheres
description: There is not much to say about this ability. The user produces the orbs that stay where the user places them mentally. When any moving object comes near it, they will be triggered and attack the object. They also make a thunderous sound to warn the user.
summary: The ability to generate stationary energy orbs that will strike any moving object.
strengths: Good guards
Warns you
weaknesses: Will not move when placed
Cannot make exceptions, also strikes allies

name: Shadowveil
description: This is like Tosen's bankai from Bleach. This lets the person create a black dome or sphere around them and makes everyone not touching the user of this power lose 4 of their 5 senses (only one you keep is touch)... It is a repeating dome so you cant just keep running in a line to escape it
summary: The ability to create an area made of complete darkness
strengths: They lose almost all of their senses unless they can find you and keep hold of you
You can make everyone trapped in it practically useless while you and anyone touching you are fine
Can make your opponents fear you (especially when scared of the dark) and gain great advantage
weaknesses: A big shadow dome thing is rather obvious that something is happening there
Its around yourself and made of darkness so you cant see out until you end it
Anybody that goes in cant leave till its dropped and lose senses unless touching you

name: Static Strength
description: With this ability, by touching electricity, you can consume it and gain strength. Your body also thrives with electricity, giving you a chance that you may shock someone. Feeding off large amounts of electricity will allow you to perform extremely powerful and electrical attacks. If you feed on too much electricity, you may hunger more and more for electricity until the hunger becomes unstoppable.
summary: The ability to gain power and strength from feeding off electricity
strengths: Electricity gives you a boost in physical strength, and also gives you a lot of static.
It sometimes has a nice taste to it.
weaknesses: Feeding off electricity is addictive.
You could accidentally give someone a shock, even while not fully-powered.

name: Empathic Self Healing
description: By using this ability, the person can transfer any wound or illness they have to another person as long as they are near them.
summary: The ability to heal yourself by transfering the wound or illness to another person.
strengths: Can hurt anyone you don't like by harming yourself.
weaknesses: Have to transfer it onto another person.
The person using this ability still feels pain.

name: Genetic Break Through
description: This ability allows the person to see their genetic code and change one part of it permanently. Like, for example, someone could change their code to keep on growing the rest of their life. Another example is that a person could change their code to continually raise the percentage of their brainpower. This ability is so life changing that you can do it only once.
summary: The ability to change one part of your genetic code forever.
strengths: You can unlock a hidden power within your genetic code.
You can change any part of your genetic code.
weaknesses: It is permanent
You can do it only once.

name: Newton's Second Law
description: Force is equal to mass times acceleration. With this power you can change the mass or acceleration of an object to change the net force applied to the object. The direction of acceleration can also be controlled in the X Y or Z planes. Mass is harder to change in the object than the acceleration of the object is.
summary: The ability to control mass and acceleration to create a force.
strengths: Mass can be increased or decreased in any object without changing volume.
Acceleration can be applied in any direction to move an object
Acceleration can be used to cancel out forces like gravity.
weaknesses: Mass is more difficult to change.
Large changes in mass may hurt the object you are changing.
Will have to take into account the forces already acting on the object.

name: Ambush Detector V2
description: With this power you will instantly know if somebody is planning on ambushing you. You don't have to be near the person or even know who the person is but if they want to ambush you a faint beeping will go off in your head and you will know wear the ambush is set up, who planned the ambush and who is part of it.
summary: The ability to instantly know if someone is planning on ambushing you
strengths: You will know if someone want to ambush you
weaknesses: Not much use if nobody wants to ambush you

name: Temporary Total Mimicry
description: A person with Temporary Total Mimicry is to be watched at all costs. They can totally mimic another person: appearance, any skills they may have, and even their superhuman abilities. As such, they are one of the biggest threats to any organization. However, the ability takes some concentration to activate, has a time limit of an hour, and a range of a football field.
summary: The ability to take on the form, skills, and powers of another person for an hour
strengths: Mimic the strongest person there
Absorb all the skills they might have
Even lets you use any powers they may have
weaknesses: Concentration to activate
Time limit of an hour
Range of a football field

name: Forced Choice
description: You are able to sense when someone in your vicinity has to make a decision, as well as the choices they have if there are any. You can then force them to select any choice you want. Unless they can detect mental intrusions, the victim will be left with the feeling that they made a free selection, whether it turns out to be a good or a bad one. Even if someone made up their mind about something, the slightest hesitation is an opening to make them change their decision.
summary: The ability to force someone's choice.
strengths: Your victim will have the feeling that they made their choice on their own.
You can affect any choice, whether it's talking to a girl, choosing a card, commiting a suicide,...
You can use this power on yourself. It reinforces your determination to do whatever you want to do.
weaknesses: A weak form of persuasion. You can only affect someone if they have a decision to make.
Even if you made up their mind for them, they can still hesitate and change their choice.

name: Hell Jump
description: This ability allows the user to jump extremely far, extremely quick. Not only that but the user can "rebound" in mid-air to redirect his/herself. Another, and key element of this ability, is that while in use, the person becomes "supercharged", where their atoms spin in place, causing them to "push" away anything in their path, with enough force to rip a man in half, or turn a tank inside out. At the highest level of mastery, the user can wrap through objects/beings, and continue the jump.
summary: The ability to jump high and quickly, tearing through any obstacles.
strengths: Similar to and faster than the Flight ability
Highly offensive ability
Multiple uses.
weaknesses: Extremely hard to control at first.
Hazard to allies unless user is an experianced user. (15 years +)
Uses the users energy.

name: Plasma Knives
description: The Plasma Knives are similar to butterfly and automatic knives, but you can shock your opponetns with them. You coluld also charge them up and fire plasma-bolts with them.
summary: The ability to use them to stab and shock your enemies.
strengths: Can use them like a combination of taser and knives.
weaknesses: Not a good thing against water-type foes.

name: Entity Inability
description: With this ability, you can freeze a living person or entity, disabling their ability to act in any way. All of their senses will be turned off - basically it's as if they're not alive. Once in this state, it cannot be reversed unless the user reverses the effect, or the state wears off. (Depending on skill level, it can take 5 hours to a month for it to wear off. )
summary: The ability to freeze a living person/entity into a state where they can't do anything.
strengths: Freeze someone in motion to make an escape.
They can be moved. You could think of them as either 'dead' or paralyzed. It's a mix of the two.
You can do whatever you choose to them while they're in this state. *Eheheheh*
weaknesses: Effect wears off either when the user chooses it to, or when it wears off. (Varies by skill level)
Not one of the most 'moral' powers in the world. (Lol)

name: Appearance Alteration
description: An Appearance Alterer is a government coup waiting to happen. They can reshape skin, hair, and vocal cords any way they want to; no color is beyond them. They literally smooth out someone's face, making it blank, then rebuild it in whatever pattern they please. They can also affect other parts of the body too, adding tattoos, adding or taking away hair, or even adding animal parts (claws, fur, etc.). The effect lasts for 48 hours, can be removed by extreme trauma, and cannot be used on yourself.
summary: The ability to physically alter the appearance of other individuals
strengths: Creating spies that look like people in the establishment
Making women hotter
Able to add claws, spines, etc. as weapons
weaknesses: Lasts for 48 hours
Can be removed by extreme trauma
Cannot be used on yourself

name: Arcana: 1 The Magician
description: With this ability, you have the capacity to manipulate any kind of energy after you figure how. This means repeated observation of the energy. Watching it naturally (a fire or lighting) could take weeks. A faster method is observing someone manipulating it. Once the power is learned, you don't gain the control most get. You have to learn how to control it. The upside is that there is virtually no limit to how strong the manipulation can get. You can go from lighting matches to burning cities.
summary: The ability to learn how to manipulate energy.
strengths: Learn any kind of energy manipulation.
