Use kinetic energy to use super-strength, Biological Energy for healing, even Psionic Energy.
weaknesses: Can't directly manipulate matter.
Can't learn all kinds of super powers.
Can take a while to learn the ones you want to learn.

name: Pack Invulnerability
description: This is the power the flickerspawn have. This power requires at least one other person you trust and has trust in you. This power will work for up to five other people. This power won't work if you or a member of your group already has an invulnerability. This power works by touching each member of your group. All of you now are invulnerable. For someone to kill one of you or hurt one of you, your entire group has to be hurt or killed at the same time.
summary: The ability to be part of a group and only being able to be hurt or killed as a group.
strengths: Great for a team of heroes.
Great if one of your team can turn invisible or teleport.
Great if everyone on the team has super speed.
weaknesses: Bad for a team of villains.
Bad if your team is fighting in close quarters.

name: Eco Grow
description: Make flowers bloom and trees grow big and strong. With this power with the touch of your hand any dead flower or plant and watch it come to life at an alarming rate.
summary: The ability to touch any plant and have it come to life
strengths: Help grow a garden
Help stop global warming
Grow your pumpkin REALLY BIG for the pumpkin contest :)
weaknesses: Requires touch

name: Love Manipulation
description: Love is one of the most powerful powers because it can destroy people and make them only focused on love. You can make yourself and others attractive and you can make people fall in love. You can also sense when people are in love and when they are not. See, love is like a magnet; with this power you can have an army of people willing to do anything for you even if it kills them.
summary: The ability to manipulate love and hypnotize people with your beauty.
strengths: Can get anything you want
Can get hot guys or girls
Can be really attractive
weaknesses: You have to face havings thousands of people coming up to you a day
Your beauty can make people do anything for you

name: Music Induced Abilities
description: Music holds power over all of us. A person with Music-Induced Abilities takes that to the next level. When they listen to music, they develop an ability that varies with the genre of music. Translation? Classical music lets them create Force-Fields, dance music grants them Luminescence, rock lets them Induce Explosions, blues lets them Phase, metal gives them Super-Strength, etc. The ability ends as soon as the song ends, and it takes a while to kick in at first.
summary: The ability to gain different abilities by listening to different types of music
strengths: Put your iPod to good use
Different genres grant different abilities
Surprise factor
weaknesses: Ends with the song
Takes a few seconds to kick in
Loving the ability the genre gives you but hating the music

name: Were Anything
description: You can be anything or anyone ... if there is a full moon. You could change into a werewolf, but why stop there? Why not change into a super(hu)man? a super werewolf with wings and a suit of armor? Don't get carried away, because you could end up being an Abomination for the night.
summary: The ability to change into anything you desire under a full moon
strengths: Be anything
You could be super strong
It doesn't even have to exist
weaknesses: The transformations hurt the first few times
You may not always be in control
You will fell exhausted in the morning.

name: Velocity Displacement
description: The user is able to transfer and/or manipulate the speed and direction of any moving object. This ability has two specific targets, the initial object and the target object. The initial object must be moving for this ability to take effect, whereas the target may or may not be moving. The magnitude of this ability lies solely upon the initial objects velocity. The user can change the direction, but not how fast. This also negates the target's previous velocity, allowing complete control.
summary: The ability to transfer the speed and direction of one object to another object
strengths: Can move with unbeliveable speed
Can force objects to be repelled, shifted, or become stationary at a moment's notice
The user can combine multiple velocities into a single velocity
weaknesses: The initial object MUST be moving
Cannot change the speed, only its direction and the object it affects
Stopping a jet in mid-flight isn't the best idea

name: Electron Kinesis
description: A person with this power has the ability to control electrons. They can utilize electrons from any element. However, it is more difficult to remove electrons from noble gasses. They cannot control elements themselves, only electrons. However, even with that limitation, they can still do many things. They can create static electricity by transferring electric charges. They can also induce chemical reactions. Also, they can bend electrons to create an electron cannon.
summary: The ability to control electrons for various effects
strengths: Can make static electricity by transferring charges between atoms
Cause reactions to occur
Can bend electrons to create an electron cannon
weaknesses: Not immune to own shocks
Cannot control electric charge, only direct it
Needs a calm mind to control electrons correctly

name: Fractal Crystalline Body
description: You have all the strengths and weakness of a living crystalline being plus fractal abilities. You regrow any lost body mass and any lost body mass grows into another you. Your new selves have your intelligence but are your slaves and share your fractal abilities. Shattered into 500 pieces you grow a new body and you have 499 new allies. If for some reason you switch back to human form or have this power negated, your crystal clones vanish.
summary: The ability to become a crystalline form with fractal abilities.
strengths: You become an army if someone inflicts damage on you or you jump off a tall building.
It requires total destruction or your existence being erased to kill you.
weaknesses: A power that can freeze, banish or trap you without damaging you.
Someone who could control or manipulate your crystalline body.
Any power that can stop you from damaging yourself.

name: Fractal Shard Burst
description: With this power, besides the initial cutting damage, any shards that pierce flesh will grow inward into the flesh of an opponent as daggers. These daggers shatter if touched or moved or if the victim moves around causing each shard to grow into a new dagger. The only way to safely remove a dagger is by teleporting it from the victim or targeting the dagger with a pinpoint attack that will destroy it in one piece. This power has an effective range of 300 ft. You are immune to this power.
summary: The ability to shoot a burst of fractal crystalline shards from your hand.
strengths: Effectively paralyse a foe you hit with this attack.
One dagger can grow into 50 or 60 daggers.
Regeneration may work in a way to cause daggers to grow in an opponent.
weaknesses: Regeneration might work to eject a dagger from an opponent.
Opponents immune to an attack of this nature.

name: Movement Stopping
description: With this power, you can prevent someone from flexing specific muscles, causing them to stop dead in their track when they attempt to move these muscles. You can even disable complex actions, such as snapping one's fingers, opening a bottle or flipping the finger. You can only prevent voluntary movements, so you can't stop someone's heart, involuntary breathing or reflexes. However, you need to actively keep the effect going, or else, it will wear off.
summary: The ability to prevent someone from completing a movement.
strengths: You can even affect the muscles involved in the voice, to impede their speech.
Many powers require you to do certain gestures or actions, which you can easily prevent.
weaknesses: You can only affect voluntary movements.
You need to actively concentrate to stop your target's movements.

name: Quick Fix
description: Have you ever accidentally knocked over something fragile, or blurted out something you did not mean to, and then instantly realize the mistake you made? With this power you can correct the mistake you made without any consequences. As long as you realize the mistake within a couple seconds of it occurring you can warp reality to make the right outcome occur. If you do not realize your mistake soon enough then this power has no effect.
summary: The ability to correct a mistake if you realize it soon enough.
strengths: Fix your accidents.
Never blurt out the wrong things.
Warp reality to create the correct outcome.
weaknesses: Have to realize the mistake you made.
If you do not realize soon enough then this power has no effect.
If you think that you could never make a mistake then this power is useless.

name: Hallucagenic Lygotation
description: Creates darkness around a person, making the world seem "pitch black." They then are haunted by their worst fears. The caster may use it on more then one person if they have enough training using it. The victim will die if killed by a hallucination. (They will die in the way the hallucination kills the victim. Only way to stop this power is by having Telekenetic powers, or to reverse the casting.)
summary: The ability to create an overwhelming darkness that brings out a person's worst fear, making them hallucinate.
strengths: Easily trainable.
Manipulative.
Great for super villans
weaknesses: Unstable at times.
The power can be reversed.
You cannot move while casting.

name: Arachnomancy
description: You have three benefits with this ability. One. You can study the web patterns of the spiders and see a short distance into the future/past. Two. You can summon and control the actions of a horde of spiders. The horde can be a mixed bag of different species and genders. Your power stops any natural behavior that would prevent a mixed horde of spiders from working with each other. Thirdly, you can share the senses of and communicate psychically/empathically with any spider.
summary: The ability to control arachnids for attack, perception and seeing through time.
strengths: Command massive hordes of arachnids (not just spiders, if you develop your ability).
You can look at a web and see a brief distance into the future or the past.
Sense what arachnids sense, communicate with them psychically and empathically
weaknesses: Spiders are easily squished.
All spiders don't have deadly poison.
You'll need to find a free or cheap source of insects to feed your spider horde.

name: Soul Invasion
description: With this power, you can inhabit any soul-carrying vessel (body) and passively share its experiences or take direct control. Upon transfer, your memories and knowledge are carried with you, and you can acquire the knowledge and memories of your host. You can choose to passively join the other soul in its vessel, temporarily take control, or forcibly eject (and therefore kill) the other soul. You can exist outside of a vessel until you find one to inhabit.
summary: The ability to exist as a soul that can invade and control other bodies.
strengths: Immortality
Possibility of complete domination over others
Ability to be whoever you want
weaknesses: No body of your own
Limited by the physique of your host
No personal identity unless you live as someone long enough

name: Shadow Guardian
description: You unconsciously give life to a Shadow Guardian as a result of your mental energy being uncapped. This Guardian will protect you by any means necessary so Guardian control via thought command is a must if you didn't want it to kill. You can merge with your Guardian and share its darkforce energy which allows for numerous shadow-based abilities, such as shadow slipping. A byproduct of this power is a passive mind over matter ability which gives you an extremely high pain threshold.
summary: The ability to use Darkforce energy through your Shadow Guardian
strengths: A Guardian that protects you at all times
Use of darkforce
weaknesses: Difficulty in controlling an angry Guardian
Your Guardian can influence your personality
Your Guardian isn't bound by morality

name: Astral Shape Shifting
description: The person changes into ALL supernatural forms of life. The user can turn into a ghost or spirit (without experiencing death) to explore the Spirit World and come back to the normal world at will. The user can also transform into the spirits of the Elements. The user can also become an angel, a demon, a grey spirit and (temporarily) an Immortal being that can shake hands with Deities. Commonly the ones who practice "Spiritual Converse" (strongly enough) are more likely to receive this gift.
summary: The ability to transform into ALL forms of spirits
strengths: The user can be a source of vast energy to living things and the Elements.
The user can receive knowledge and more powers from these realms.
If the person is powerful enough, He/She can take a spirit of the deceased back to the normal world.
weaknesses: It drains the user's energy (temporarily). And they lose more body mass.
The realm of Elemental spirits and nature spirits is very hard to get the hang of.
If the user dwells too long as a spirit, the physical aspect fades away and will never come back.

name: Sugar Rush
description: One with this ability is often considered quite the lucky dog. With every bit of sugar they intake, they will only get stronger, faster and more durable. And if they take in enough, they will go into a berserker rage that tears through most foes with relative ease. Not to mention, they can intake sugar to regenerate, and no sugar they ingest will affect the body negatively (no diabetes, no tooth decay).
summary: The ability to gain heightened strength, speed, stamina, reflexes and agility with the consumption of sugar
strengths: Sugar you intake increases your strength, speed, durability, stamina and reflexes
Ingesting sugar heals you (and you can never get any disease/condition from high sugar intake)
If you intake enough sugar, it sends you into a berserker rage that can take out really strong foes
weaknesses: Berserker rage is just like ANY berserker rage (dangerous for friend AND foe)
After the berserker rage, you crash HARD
You can still be in trouble if your sugar is too LOW

name: Writers Faith
description: This power gives you the ability to make anything and everything that is written or that you wrote come true and happen no matter what, whenever you want, after you write down the words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " Note: in order to be able to use this power, you have to have faith in God, the Father who gave his one and only son to save us from the wages of sin, thus the reason for the words.
summary: The ability to make anything that is written come true and happen with your faith.
strengths: This power will work on any medium, whether it is paper and pen, a computer, a wall, etc.
Need faith in God, the Father, to make this power work.
Can make anything that is written or you wrote come true and happen.
weaknesses: Atheists are never able to use this power.
Have to be careful what you write for it will come true.
Words "For With God All Things Are Possible! " have to be exact. Including the " ".

name: Aerial Combustion
description:
You aim, you focus(think the air explodes) and it explodes! 
Although you can only do this once every 289 minutes, it is possible to destroy anything as long as you have a visual feed of the location, for example camera feed is sufficient. WARNING : The explosion reaches as far as your sight so if you trigger the explosion from your own eyes, you might want to be behind a shield.
summary: The ability to make air explode.
strengths: You can make air just go boom!
Perfect for hitting people who have shields, as long as there is air behind that shield.
Air is everywhere so you can pretty much make any location go kabooom!
weaknesses: Selfdamage is possible.
Useless in space.
Does not pentrate shields but explodes from within the shield so don't aim next to your victim.

name: Memory Force
description: Using all your memories and emotions, you can send all of it to your palm and send out a blast of energy.
summary: The ability to generate memories and emotions into force.
strengths: You can use good memories and happiness as a shield.
You can also use a memory and emotion to increase your agility.
You can also use a memory and or emotion to increase your speed.
weaknesses: Using too much force and memories can make you tired for a few minutes.
Using it on machines can malfunction a machine and may even destroy it.

name: Elemental Shield
description: With this ability, you are able to create a shield of nateral elements. Don't be upset if you're thinking that all you can do is create a shield, because you can take chunks of your shield and toss them like missles at your opponent. You can also create shields for things other than yourself. Wind can be created at your feet to make you fly. Don't forget that you can mix elements like water and earth to create mud.
summary: The ability to create a shield of natural elements
strengths: You can block almost anything
You can escape attacks
weaknesses: You can only use elements that you are around.
Each shield has a weakness

name: Bullet Of Compression
description: You can absorb anything into your hands (five objects each) that gets stored in each of your fingers (thumb included). Then, at will, you can open up the "cap" on the end of your finger and either fire the compressed object like a bullet, of just let it fall out. With the latter, you can then return to normal size the object you compressed without having any harm be done to it.
summary: The ability to store compressed things in your hands and shoot them
strengths: Shoot bullets from your fingers: "finger gun"
Can store anything in a compressed space
Can absorb any solid (including bullets that somebody else shot or somrthing they threw)
weaknesses: Can only store 5 things
If you get your finger cut off, it won't work for that finger (you lose storage space permanately)
It has to be absorbed through your hans, so don't get those cut off...

name: Sensikinesis
description: Sensikinesis is the ability to control the physical and mental senses of other people. This comes in very handy when fighting a superhero, or villain, that relies on his/her senses for their abilities. Superstreght, for example uses the sense of touch. Say you where to take away their sense of touch, their powers would be rendered useless. It would be considered "Unfair" if you where dueling someone with hand-to-hand combat, it would be cheating to make your senses unparalell.
summary: The ability to control the senses of other people.
strengths: You could blind a whole room to escape a sticky situation.
You could paralise a person set on destroying you.
You could greatly increase your senses so you would be a unparalell fighter.
weaknesses: It takes a little to work, and do again. Much like you have to wait for it to recharge
If you increase your senses too much you could be too confident and misjudge your opponent.
Your powers ware off if you leave them for too long. About 6-7 hours they will last.

name: Missiles
description: With this power you can cause missiles of any size or power to hit anything or anyone you want. You are immune to the effects of the missiles you create; this includes the explosion and, if there is any, nuclear radiation.
summary: The ability to cause missiles of any size to hit wherever you want
strengths: You can make missiles of any size or power level to hit whatever you want
You are immune to the effects of your missiles
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by other missiles
You might accidentally hurt innocent people with your missiles

name: Phenomena Rejection
description: One night, you are walking late after a midnight party with your friends. You talk about the future and all that stuff. Suddenly, a mugger comes and tries to mug you. Your best friend fights him and he gets shot. Wouldn't it be great to have this power. It consists of rejecting any events by warping time with in a barrier. Its combined with memory reversal, time reverstion, barrier, and erasure of matter.
summary: The ability to reverse time and space anywhere with in 5 km radius.
strengths: You can avoid death
protect your feveryone you love
Save humanity.
weaknesses: Be death
Be excluded by family and friends
Eradicate humanity.

name: Age Control
description: This power through touch allows you to age a person till they are dead & dust or de-age to genetic ooze & anywhere in between. Either way, you absorb & extend your lifespan & minorly de-age yourself.
summary: The ability to age or de-age a person by touch
strengths: Control over age in another person
Extend your lifespan
Minor de-age in yourself
weaknesses: Has to touch & hold a person for the power to work

name: Stasis Field Projection
description: A person with this power can be the best neutralizer. While this power can be used offensively to create swords and other weapons, the main function is to trap and capture targets. You can use the field as a forcefield or you can wrap it around a target to freeze them in time. When frozen, they will not age and you can maneuver the bubble of frozen time. The stasis field also acts similar to an EMP which prevents nearby electronics from functioning. People in stasis can be revived later.
summary: The ability to project stasis fields and control them
strengths: Stasis fields have near infinite durability and you can use it as a weapon
Can neutralize anything surrounded by stasis field-they are frozen in time
Can act as an EMP
weaknesses: If you put yourself in full stasis, it will be very hard to get you back
The stasis field requires concentration from the user
You cannot attack people in stasis fields, they are protected by your barrier

name: Psychic Photography
description: When you take pictures of someone, their deepest secrets show up on the photographs as a colorful cloud twirling around them with relevant pictures and words in it. The cloud reflects the nature of the secrets and the person's feelings. A thin part represents doubts or suspicions. A massive part represents a heavy or important secret. Dark colors are for shame, guilt or sick intentions. Light colors are for lightheartedness or innocent secrets. Bright colors are for important promises or vows.
summary: The ability to capture people's secrets on photographs.
strengths: Every paparazzi and tabloid's dream.
Discover anyone's secrets.
Works with any type of camera.
weaknesses: The results are not always explicit and are open to interpretations.
The target has to be isolated in the picture or there will be clusters of secrets.

name: Negative Energy Absorption
description: This ability allows one to absorb negative energy and redirect it if chosen.
summary: The ability to absorb and/or generate negative energy.
strengths: You can absorb other's negative emotions
You can purge others from negative energy and thoughts
You can redirect the absorbed energy as an energy blast
weaknesses: If used too much, one can become overhelmed by negative energy and become evil

name: Splicer
description: The Splicer ability allows you to splice any thing living or non-living together. You can choose the new species' traits, defects and abilities.
summary: The ability to splice anything together.
strengths: You can make new species.
You can make the species' traits the way you want.
The species doesn't have to be all alive.
weaknesses: It could be uncontrollable.
It may not survive.

name: Gift: Summons
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using summoning powers than other beings. Thus their summoning powers are better than most other being's powers and it is harder to unsummon their summoned beings. However, someone with this power can only recieve summoning powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at summoning powers
strengths: Almost no one is as good at summoning as someone with this power.
Summons are harder to undo.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the unsummoning aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only summoning powers now.

name: Librarian
description: Can summon any book to hand that person is aware of- has either seen it, knows specifically what it's called or what it is. Can also choose to return or keep the specific book after summoned.
summary: The ability to instantly summon any known book to hand
strengths: Instant source of information
More robust books can be utilised as a weapon in a pinch
weaknesses: Limited to the books the person is aware of
Limited help in dealing directly with villans

name: System Manipulation
description: A system is a set of interacting or interdependent entities forming an integrated whole. Put simply, this means different things working together for a purpose. Many, many things fall under this, if not all things. Now, all power must have boundaries and limits. The limits of this power is that the user must have a basic understanding of the system to be able to control it. For example, you could control your genetics because biology is a system.
summary: The ability to manipulate and control any and all systems.
strengths: A lot of power
Can do almost anything
weaknesses: You must have a basic understanding of the system you' want to control.

name: Immutability
description: One with this ability cannot be transformed into another form, genetically altered, shrunk, expanded, weighed down or affected by Obliteration or Reality Bending. All attempts to do so are null and void. In addition, he cannot be vaporized, liquefied or the like. His body is entirely resistant to unnatural change (even magical body alteration). However, he can still age, and is still vulnerable to conventional harm (guns, knives, bad comedy).
summary: The ability to resist all unnatural physical change
strengths: Your body is immune to powers like Biokinesis, vampiric or therianthropic conversion, etc.
Cannot be aged, de-aged or reduced in intelligence, looks, or size
Cannot be vaporized, liquefied or affected by Reality Bending directly
weaknesses: Still vulnerable to normal harm
Still age
Still feel pain

name: Aura Wolves
description: The wolves look as though they are not fully solid, but they are fully capable of ripping an enemy apart tooth and nail. Their coloring differs dependent on what one's aura is like and they have their own personalities. Also the wolves cannot go outside the radius of where one's aura can be felt.
summary: The ability to create wolves from one's own aura
strengths: A giant aura radius.
The wolves can be great allies and companions.
weaknesses: Having the power No Aura.

name: Georegeneration
description: A hero who is constructed out of rock or some other mineral can heal oneself using nearby minerals. Its appearance would then be changed depending on the mineral used. As an example, if asphalt is used in the healing process, a stronger, black body would be constructed. After a certain amount of time, the new body would shed away, leaving the default rock body underneath.
summary: The ability to be a huminoid rock hero who can heal using surrounding minerals
strengths: Potential immortality
weaknesses: Finding yourself broken without any nearby minerals

name: Master Of The Will
description: A more accurate way of describing this is the ability to not only continue to live but fight, exercise,think and so on through sheer will power. These people could be completely burned, frozen paralyzed, on deathbed, smashed, virtually anything and still have the strength to get up. Mental attacks are difficult, if not impossible due to this willpower. These people will never stop till their goal is complete.
summary: The ability to survive through will
strengths: Form of immortality
Dangerous even with body in pieces
Looks at the worst situation without fear
weaknesses: Won't look to good missing an arm and your legs
Give up and you die
May be covered with stitches

name: Shadow Shield
description: You are able to call forth a shield which can control the shadows and darkness. You can teleport through shadows and make them come to life. You also get night vision in dark places. You can only do this when you wield the shield. Your powers are stronger at night.
summary: The ability to wield a shield which can control shadows/darkness
strengths: You can teleport through shadows
You can control shadows
You get night vision in dark places
weaknesses: You need to wield the shield to have the powers
You are only stronger at night
Your weakness is Light

name: Amalgamative Touch
description: Whenever you touch something, be it a person or an object that entity will pulse with a green surge of electricity every few seconds until you come into contact with another entity. An ominous green light will fade in and out from the two points of contact until you bring your hands together, at which point the two chosen objects will float towards each other and either fuse completely making something new or fuse partially so both functions may still be used.
summary: The ability to combine many different entities or objects into one.
strengths: Make new animals or objects from already existing stuff.
No need for glue.
Make everything better and more efficient.
weaknesses: When you disassemble or destroy something you have fused, you experience some backlash.
Puts some strain on your mind.
Other people can use the things you fuse.

name: Singularity Beam
description: The beam will destroy anything made of normal matter or energy. It won't affect anything that is immune to changes in the laws of physics or things that defy the laws of physics. Hence, immutability and physics rejector will protect the user from this beam. Invulnerability would also stop this power. Someone who is intangible in some way would also be unaffected. The beam will destroy a foe made of air or energy and keep going until it hits something solid or liquid which will stop the beam.
summary: The ability to generate a beam from your hand that duplicates the effects of a black hole core.
strengths: Destroy anything made of normal matter or energy.
The beam only stops when it hits something solid or liquid.
weaknesses: Someone with immutability, quantum intangibility, space-time indemnity, physics rejector,
Invulnerability or any powers that are similar to these powers.
Any foe who isn't made of normal matter or energy.

name: Surpass Strength
description: This is an ability that will even give Superman a hard time. This ability allows the user to gain strength to when fighting an opponent or obstacle and continue to gain more until they gain enough to crush them  You'll be able to take down any strong guys, even if those guys were actually stronger than you.
summary: The ability to gain more strength when confronting an enemy or object.
strengths: Able to defeat strong opponents.
Able to crush objects.
weaknesses: The only way to gain more strength is to go hand-to-hand with the enemy or object.
Trying to handle mind-blowing weight could result in a full body strain.

name: Light/Darkness Expansion
description: This power only works if you have a considerably good or bad alignment. In that case, you can scan any individual's heart to look for a small amount of goodness (if they are not on the good side) or evilness (if they are not on the dark side). If there is some, you can amplify it a lot so that person gets a total change of alignment. You can even use this power to know which alignment someone really is and if someone is a traitor.
summary: The ability to feel the faint amount of goodness/evilness in someone's heart and expand it
strengths: Works on neutral individuals too.
Easily recruit people to the good/dark side.
weaknesses: Only works if you have a huge amount of goodness/evilness in your heart.
The effects are cancelled if you die or if you lose your power.

name: Heat Absorption
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Heat Eater but is more advanced. Instead of taking in heat energy for food, the user uses up stored heat energy for the use of releasing it at a later time. The user can control both how much heat they can absorb and how much heat they give off with practice. Also, with practice, the user can manipulate pressure and wind to a certain degree by heating and cooling air.
summary: The ability to absorb heat from surroundings and unleash absorbed heat
strengths: You can absorb heat from surroundings-causes temperature to be cool or freeze things
Can release stored heat either slowly like a hairdryer or quickly like a heat ray
Can also manipulate pressure/wind with practice
weaknesses: You have to absorb heat first in order to release heat-set pattern in using power
Less useful in cold climates for obvious reasons
Stored heat slowly dissipates from the body when not using the heat for other purposes

name: Universe Control
description: You will be able to make black holes, more stars, control where stars and planets are, and if it's too hot outside, you can cool the sun down.
summary: The ability to create black holes and control the universe's celestial objects.
strengths: Cool down a sunny day
Make your own constellations
Make your own new inhabitable planets
weaknesses: You might accidentaly destroy the earth if you're not careful!

name: Create Time Loop
description: You can create a personal temporal prison for someone or something. The person or object vanishes and repeats an amount of time chosen by you endlessly... Until the end of time itself.
summary: The ability to put someone or something in an endless and repeating period of time.
strengths: Enemies gone forever.
End nuclear war.
Eliminate toxic waste.
weaknesses: You have to plan ahead to use this power.
Enemies will try to kill you from a distance.

name: Bending Shield
description: When activated this power makes long-range physically-based attacks go in a semicircle around you. This prevents the damage from actually affecting you in the first place. This power CANNOT be made to affect mental attacks instead of physical ones and is not passive.
summary: The ability to make attacks go around you instead of through you
strengths: Attacks won't hurt you.
weaknesses: Only affects distance-based attacks.
Does not affect telepathic attacks.
Unaffected by Con Negation and similar powers.

name: Prescience
description: This power enables one knowledge of future events before they even exist. This isn't like your ordinary future-seeing power. No. This specifically says "Knowledge". You are seeing the future. You simply know. You can use this power to tap into any timeline that isn't present or past.
summary: The ability to knowledge of future events before they exist
strengths: Knowledge of the future
Gain advance technology via recreating them
Be the cool prophet
weaknesses: Like the present. The future always changes
No lamscience or sufsience, future only
Might freak knowing when and how you die

name: The King's Champion
description: The King's Champion power compells a single individual to become devoted to serving and protecting you permanently. This compulsion lasts untill the champion dies. In the case of the champion being killed, the champion's killer becomes the next individual compelled to be champion. If the champion dies in any other way, or if you kill the champion yourself, you may then compel another individual to become your champion. You may have no more than one champion at any given time.
summary: The ability to compel a single being to protect and serve you untill killed, in turn, compelling whoever killed it
strengths: Always have a champion to protect and serve you.
Each time your champion is killed, you gain a more powerful champion.
Free butler, maid, jester and bodyguard.
weaknesses: This power involves lots of slavery and death.
This power permanently ruins the lives of others.
Champions can be needy with thier compulsion to serve and make sure that you're O. K.

name: View Grower
description: When viewing a watermelon you can grow it without the danger of explosion. Or shrink it until you can no longer view it. Using an magnifying glass or microscope enhances powers. You can only grow people evenly. You cannot just increase someone's height, but you can grow a body part such as each leg individually to increase height.
summary: The ability to enlarge or shrink anything in sight
strengths: More food for less
Grow peoples body parts; cheap plastic surgery
Enemies can be shrunk to action figure size
weaknesses: Controlling it---overly sensitive power
People wanting you to grow there wifes breast's secretly
Trying to help starving people. Just can't get to them all.

name: Dragon Master
description: With this power you can control the mighty dragons even summon them from anywhere you want. If there a dragon you can control them but only if your stronger than them. If they are stronger than you they can break free and attack you. One who has this power after a time can fashion himself a dragon form with powers that any dragon they have encountered has even modify there own form to there liking in essence they become a dragon with a human form as well.
summary: The ability to control dragons.
strengths: Can control dragons
Can become a dragon
Can summon dragons
weaknesses: Dragon stronger than you can break free and kill you
May end up hated and or feared by those you care for
Might end up hunted by dragon slayers.

name: Ultimate Armor
description: With the ultimate armor you are invincible to anything and everything. However you can still be moved. No special powers go past the armor, not even spacial or time powers and it negates abilities that travel through a medium such as shock waves. Telepathy is also useless and objects on the other side of the armor cannot be controlled. The user can also go without necessities indefinitely. The user cannot move at all when the ability is activated nor activate any other abilities.
summary: The ability to materialize an unbreakable armor that provides ultimate protection
strengths: You are invincible to everything but only when your power is activated
You are very heavy so not many people can lift you.
You can "live" indefinitely as long as your ability is active and you can still talk
weaknesses: You cannot use your other powers when activated and you cannot move
If you deactivate it you can get hit, such as throwing them into a lake
If you stay in the armor form too long you will eventually lose your ability to think

name: Cyber World Traveller
description:
This ability you can travel inside the internet via a computer terminal with internet connection. Instead of viewing a monitor screen; when accessing the world wide web. 
You can literally visit those web pages. Online video games only seem more real (just don't run out of lives). 
The rules of the cyber world apply to you too. 
With this power you can leave from any terminal that has internet access. So in theory can be used to teleport.
summary: The ability to travel into the cybernetic, internet world.
strengths: Have access to every website in the world.
Has teleportation potential. (Like into top secret military bases, area 51).
Obtain valueable bank account detail from everyone across the globe.
weaknesses: Cyber world rules apply to you.
Can only go into the cyber world via a computer terminal with internet access.
Security programs may find you as a threatining computer virus.

name: Shadow Absorption
description: Able to absorb someones shadow at will.  This renders the person who's shadow was absorbed dead.  A person's ability will automatically be gained when their shadow is absorbed.  People who possess this power are a threat to people who can mimic shadows.
summary: The ability to absorb shadows (and abilities)
strengths: Grow stronger with every shadow you absorb
Gain multiple abilities
weaknesses: You can kill people close to you

name: Mind Melding
description: You can link any two minds together to have them think exactly the same, or alter a chain of thoughts the other person thinks. Much like regular thinking, except thinking for someone else.
summary: The ability to change or trade another's thoughts
strengths: You could help a friend cheat on a test, or give their thoughts to yourself
You can make two people angry at one another, or the exact opposite
You can play with your rivals', and friends', minds by sending weird messages
weaknesses: If you link to someone else's mind, they can hear you also
Tuning into another person's mind shuts out all hearing except for their mind

name: Super Cryptography
description: This power allows you to decode any code, mostly by patterns you do not even need the cypher to decode it. Also, you can find patterns in anything whether it is by looking at someone's past actions or numbers or anything. This power is useful to a detective or private investigator or anyone needing to decode anything. This power also makes you bilingual in a way, considering you do not need to understand the language of the code to understand it. You can also create amazing codes.
summary: The ability to decode any code and find any pattern
strengths: You can decode any code even if it is in a language you do not understand and create the best codes
You can find patterns in anything
You would be an amazing detective and amazing at predicting people's actions
weaknesses: You can see patterns where they do not exist
If you do not wanna be an investigator/ cryptographer, this power is kinda useless
People will get annoyed when you call them predictable

name: High Hopes
description: Make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
summary: The ability to make the things that you get your hopes up for happen for real
strengths: You don't need to worry about getting your hopes up
weaknesses: What you get might not be as good as what you would have gotten

name: Deepest Desire
description: This power grants you the ability to cause anyone's deepest desire to come true. This is very similar to granting wishes, but some rules apply: you can only use this power once per person, you cannot use this on yourself, and the person may have no control over what their deepest desire is (they might not even know what it is). When using this power, you'll hear a badass sound so you know it worked. But choose wisely, though. If their deepest desire is for you to be dead... Well, you'll be dead.
summary: The ability to make anyone's deepest desire come true.
strengths: Bring people's deepest desires into reality
Your powers aren't merely an illusion; they're real
You will garner respect and reverence!
weaknesses: Someone's deepest desire might change physics or disrupt the natural order of things
Using this on depressed people. They might not be desiring the happiest things.
You can't use this on yourself. The only way it affects you is if someone else desires it.

name: Fallproofing
description: Also called Fall Protection or Fall-Induced Invulnerability, this is a specified form of invulnerability in which one cannot take damage from any fall, no matter how high up, or what you land on. When the user's mind subliminally perceives that they are falling, the user's invulnerability is triggered to keep the user from dying from the impact of the fall. After the user perceives that they are no longer falling, their vulnerability goes back to normal.
summary: The ability to be totally invulnerable to tripping or falling damage
strengths: Makes skateboarding, bike-riding and rock-climbing way more fun
Makes skydiving A LOT more fun--no more need for that pesky parachute
If you trip or fall off of something, you can just get back up, no matter HOW far you fall
weaknesses: If you ever try to commit suicide by hanging yourself or jumping off a building, good luck
Landing from a fall or being tripped still hurts, even if you don't get a bruise or scratch
Bottomless pits REALLY suck

name: Crystallization
description: With this ability, a person is able to make crystals from any substance that is physically attached to the physical world (like leaves, rocks, skin, and even blood). The crystal material is like steel on the outside. If the user traps a person with this ability, they can decide whether or not the object will be crystallized or it being a hollow crystal and just trapping that person. The crystals can also vary in size and shapes. The crystal itself is very durable from the inside and out.
summary: The ability to make and control a variety of crystals and crystal structures.
strengths: Crystalize anything
Almost unbreakable to any attack
Can win a fight without actually hurting anybody
weaknesses: May lose control and crystal anything in a 5-mile radius
If not in control, anything the user touches will crystalize and disintegrate with it
Very weak to ultrasonic waves, and light, if pointed to the user, will cause temporary blindness

name: Sliders
description: With a special remote control you can go to other worlds that are based on your world's time just not actually yours.
summary: The ability to open portals to other dimensions
strengths: See new/other places on other worlds
weaknesses: If you change the time limit you could be lost in other dimensions

name: Demonic Immunity
description: This power grants you total immunity and protection from that which is demonic or infernal. They cannot directly affect you in any manner. When they try to use their powers on you it does no damage. This also allows you to ignore the affects of any demonic weapon or magic that is used against you. You can defy demonic or infernal contracts and protections that you come by and can easily harm the strongest of demons. Even if your life depended on them you could continue to live.
summary: The ability to be immune to that which is demonic or infernal.
strengths: You do not have to fear harm from demons or infernal creatures.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
Your soul cannot be taken by them.
weaknesses: They can harm you with regular weapons like guns.
You can be affected indirectly.
No protection against that which is not demonic or infernal.

name: The Midas Touch
description: Just imagine it. You could turn anything you want into gold, silver, platinum, diamond, pearl, white gold and so much more. You could turn a plain old stick into a gloden scepter just by the wave of your hand. You could have untold riches.
summary: The ability to turn any object into any mineral of your choosing
strengths: You will become rich
When you touch an object it only changes if you want it to
You could turn your house to gold
weaknesses: There aren't any

name: Hollowing Essence
description: This ability allows you to steal and store the essence of anyone or anything. This process leaves behind nothing but a hollow shell of the absorbed object. The stolen essence is stored in your body, but this ability does not give you contol of that essence.
summary: The ability to steal and absorb the essence of anything, leaving behind a hollow shell.
strengths: Steal essence
Kill any living thing
Get to keep the stolen essence
weaknesses: Hollow shell is left behind
Ability does not give you control of the stolen essence
Can be countered/resisted by certain abilities

name: Alternate Temporal Bridging
description: This power is a complex and dangerous one. It gives the user the power to connect the different timelines for storage, travel, etc. When the user creates a connection, it forms a link between the two timelines with portals at the ends. Going into one of these portals will take you to the other timeline. However, you have no control about what comes through the portal (it could be a very dangerous other timeline). At the more advanced levels, you can connect many timelines at once.
summary: The ability to create connections between this timeline and others.
strengths: Connect timelines together for a variety of uses.
You could gain advanced technology from a timeline ahead of ours.
You can send enemies to a dangerous timeline.
weaknesses: You have no way of knowing what is in an alternate timeline.
Things can come through the timelines at the other side.
Only at ADVANCED levels can you connect multiple timelines at once.

name: Raikatana
description: The Raikatana is a legendary move that is very strong. The user's inner energy is transformed into lightning that is condensed and transformed into a glowing yellow blade that sprouts from the user's hand. Anything that gets hit by the blade is electrified. This technique is strong enough to slice metal. The Raikatana makes a very distinct noise of chirping electricity and roaring thunder whilst attacking.
summary: The ability to create a sword made entirely out of lightning.
strengths: It is strong enough to slice through metal.
Good for close range combat.
If you cut your opponent, even slightly, they will be electrified and probably unable to move.
weaknesses: This power fails against earth based techniques, being lightning.
The faster you move the louder the sword gets.
You can not use other techniques while you have the sword activated.

name: Electro Shielding
description: Create a field of Electricity to cover your body and others. Very few things can phase through it without being destroyed or in pain. Does not hurt the weilder of the shield nor the people inside it. The shield may expand to massive size depending on the wielder's strength. No one can stop the shield unless inside the shield or The weilder gives up.
summary: The ability to create a shield of Electric charge and power.
strengths: Protect your self
protect others around you and love ones
stop bullets from hitting you
weaknesses: may hurt others
Dont use in rain. may electricute yourshelf
massive strength in a persons hands

name: On The Bright Side
description: You can control the energy of light. Turn it into balls of energy and toss it at people, or just use it as your own personal flashlight!
summary: The ability to control light
strengths: Light is usually around most of the time
When it's bright, it's powerful!
weaknesses: Whenever you take the light from somewhere, it doesn't come back for awhile after use
The weaker the light, the weaker your powers.
It drains your energy when there is no light around.

name: Countdown
description: Whenever you count down from 10 to 0 whatever you were touching when you reached 0 explodes. You are immune to the effects of the explosion though everyone else around you can be injured or even killed. You can blow up enemy bases by touching one of the walls of the base and counting down from 10 to 0. It even works on humans, animals and other living things. It only works if you star counting down from so if you start from 11 nothing happens also if you go past 0 to -1 noting happens.
summary: The ability to cause whatever you're touching to explode when you count down from 10 to 0
strengths: You can cause things to explode by counting down from 10 to 0 and you're immune to the efffects
It even works on living things
If you change your mind midway you can either stop or just keep going past 0 to -1
weaknesses: It happens whenever you count down from 10 to 0 unless you're not touching anything

name: Power Filter
description: This power allows you to obtain a temporary copy of any power you encounter, simply by touching the person who has it. You can only hold one power at a time, and the power only lasts 24 hours. The best part of this power is that if you currently hold a copied power and you wish to keep it, you can permanently place it into an object, such as a weapon or clothing. So long as you have the object, you have the power. The more powerful the power, the bigger the object needs to be.
summary: The ability to absorb and use any ability you encounter, and then place it in an object.
strengths: Use any power you find.
Keep the ones you want by putting them into objects.
Objects work with only the people you want them to work with.
weaknesses: Can't hold more then one power at a time.
Carrying around lots of objects can get tiresome.
You don't really have a power of your own.

name: Machine Body
description: With this power you can make any part of your body into a machine at will. Flesh becomes metal, veins become wires, bones become cables and any number of combinations, then back to normal. Like this, you can interact and manipulate electronics directly. It can be used to turn even a simple cell phone into a super computer.
summary: The ability to turn individual parts or all of ones body into a machine.
strengths: Any body part can be used.
Direct interface with electronics.
No security system can stop you.
weaknesses: VERY freaky to watch.
Can't be used on the run.
Does not make you invulnerable.

name: Light Mimicry
description: The speed of light is 299,792,458 meters a second. A Light Mimic can become light and travel this quickly at will. When they travel, they have some control over their direction. Being sent through a prism splits them up into six different people with one mind. However, they can be washed out by a stronger source of light, can never completely stop, and are subject to all of light's natural laws (i.e. mirrors)
summary: The ability to turn your body into light
strengths: Can travel at 299,792,458 meters a second
Have some control over their direction
Going through a prism splits you up into 6 bodies
weaknesses: Can be washed out by stronger light
Can never totally stop/slow down
Subject to natural laws (i.e. mirrors)

name: Digital Manipulation
description: This is nothing like Technopathy. Technopathy controls machines, Digital Manipulation controls the data. You can extract data from computers and place it in the real world. You can even create vortexes to the cyber world, transform real-world objects to data, access the Internet and software without computers, transform into data, control computer viruses, viral immunity, and even shoot and create data without any technological assistance. Another term for this power is Cyber Manipulation.
summary: The ability to control digital information.
strengths: Never use a computer to go to Facebook, YouTube, etc.
Best way to cheat on a test
You're deadly in a computer store
weaknesses: You always start with control over data
You only shoot 0's and 1's at beginner's level
The virus in the cyber world might harm you in the real world

name: Gun Manipulation
description: For this power a gun is any weapon that has a trigger, fires bullets, and uses gunpowder or gas as a propellant. Thus an AK47 can be used but not a lasergun or crossbow. A low-level user of this power can create one gun at a time and is unable to control the gun while a high level user can create 1000 guns at a time and control each individually. This power can only be gained by hitting 1000 cans that are thrown into the air without missing a single can using a pistol. You are allowed to reload.
summary: The ability to create and control any gun
strengths: Can be very powerful at higher levels.
weaknesses: Very weak at first and this power does not give any boost to your aiming capabilities.

name: Postscience
description: You can have knowledge of the past. You instantly learn how, when, where, who, why and what of the things that happen in the past. Want to know the answers to a test? Wait until the test is passed out, and you'll know. This power however cannot tap into the present or future.
summary: The ability to have knowledge of the past
strengths: Know history.
Solve crimes and mysteries.
See who was right in an argument.
weaknesses: Past only. No futuristic equipment? LAME!!
Involuntary
Don't see the past, just know it.

name: Un Foreign
description: By having this power you can hear all languages as if they were your native language, never again will you be frustrated with not understanding an others language, cant say the same for them though ^_^
summary: The ability to hear all languages as if they were your native language
strengths: Never be confused by another language.
Useful in foreign countries. (Kinda)
All around better comprehension skills.
weaknesses: They may not understand you.
Learning a foreign language will be near impossible.
Not really a battle notable power.

name: Subconsciencial Form Shifting
description: When this power is activated you lose your body and just have a body of no distinct appearance.  This ability has two modes.  1) You can pick something to look like (e. G. Hottest female) and you will look like that to everyone. It will be different for everyone, and it works even if the person doesn't concisely know what it looks like.  2) You pick a specific body from someone and become it physically, with all of it's attributes.  You can look at someone and know their version in either mode.
summary: The ability to turn yourself into things from subconsciences. Please read full description.
strengths: Immortality - Don't have to age or get sick or have normal needs in a specific body
Gain powers
Be the hottest person on the planet or your enemy's worst nightmare
weaknesses: Lose your body
Cannot merge or modify forms

name: Hyper Strike
description: With this ability, your attacks can be sped up to past the speed of sound. At that velocity, a hit with your fist could shatter any bone in your opponent's body or break through stone. Slashing with the blade of your hand or foot could slice through someone like a knife.
summary: The ability to accelerate parts of your body for devastating blows.
strengths: Deliver powerful attacks with any weapon that involves physical contact
High speed could also be used to block
Your body is extra durable so as to prevent you from shattering your hand when you punch
weaknesses: Can't be used for super-speed movement, as it lasts only a fraction of a second
Doesn't increase your reflexes

name: Reality Reincarnation
description: This ability allows a user to be reincarnate in different universal version of yourself. Most of the time you will look like yourself and sometimes you look different. You could wind up being a slave or a conquer, a animal man or an advance human. You won't know.
summary: The ability to be reincarnated in a different universe.
strengths: Be recarnated in a new world.
Gain experience
weaknesses: Unless you are immortal or have some special condition you can only do it once.

name: Implosion
description: With a hand gesture of crushing, you make objects fall onto/into themselves into nothingness. A building, car or person will start to cave in from the inside out till there's nothing left of it. Where it goes from there is a mystery--like the other side of a black hole. All you know is: it was there, you imploded it, now it disappeared.
summary: The ability to destroy things by making them collaspe on themselves
strengths: Make things suck into themselves till gone
You can clear an obstacle blocking you from your destination by imploding it
weaknesses: You have no clue where your imploded things go to

name: Weaponize
description: With this ability, you can effectivly turn anything into a "gun." By agitating the molecules in an object and causing them to explode in controlled, directed bursts. Bigger objects need more control to keep them from just exploding out in all directions.
summary: The ability to agitate the molecules of any object and cause them to explode in a desired direction
strengths: Anything is a gun for you.
Never be unarmed
Two words: Building Gun
weaknesses: Might turn a necessary object into a gun
Hard to control with larger objects

name: 9 Lives
description: You have the power of the urban myth of a cat having nine lives. You get nine chances to live if anything should happen to you. If you die, depending on how severe the injury was, it could take from 9 seconds to 9 hours for you to revive completely healed. You also have some luck to spare your life. If in a death situation, depending on your will to live, you can get out of it without dying, but it's pushing luck & not always reliable. You still age normally and eventually will die permanently.
summary: The ability to have 9 lives & luck of a cat
strengths: Can die 8 times & live before dying one last time forever
Will be healed instantly after coming back to life
Have a bit of get out of death luck
weaknesses: Age normally
May take some time to revive after death
Your luck factor is random & may not work all the time

name: Shatter
description: People with this ability, called "Shatterers," can break anything by touching it with their right hand and saying "Shatter. "
summary: The ability to break things
strengths: Fights are relatively easy
It is an impressive ability
Everyone wants a "right hand of death"
weaknesses: DON'T sleeptalk
You always need to watch what you say... "Oh, crap, I shattered a glass... " this just won't do
Many will fear you

name: Panmnesia (Total Recall)
description: Interchangeably called Panmnesia, Hypermnesia, Total Recall or Perfect Memory, this is the ability to easily remember (and recall) everything that one has ever experienced, learned or encountered in one's lifetime, regardless of how you acquire the information (visually, verbally, via smells, etc. ). This includes everything from the time the user's power manifests (and the power may be present from birth).
summary: The ability to remember everything that one has ever experienced in one's lifetime
strengths: Remember important facts, figures, dates, times, events, etc. (and recall them at will)
Even if you get distracted from doing a task, you don't forget important things you have to do
Memory cannot be manipulated externally (but is also not consciously present all the time)
weaknesses: If power is weak, all of one's memories WILL always be consciously present (mental bombardment)
Your memories CAN be manipulated (fairly rare, but it happens)
Doesn't mean you automatically understand info (remedied by memorizing definitions/formulas, etc.)

name: Idiosyncratic Theft
description: This ability will strike people were it hurts, their hearts. What is tucked inside their heart, their prized possession. This ability takes it away so that the user can control it. Basically, the user has a partial mind reading ability that only allows them to know what is their target's most prized thing nothing more. This ability can be dangerous, because the user can develope a coveting problem if not stopped.
summary: The ability to obtain a another person's most prized possession (power, person, or object) and control it.
strengths: Take a person's most prized possession
Use it as a shield against the victim
Use it to bargain with your victim
weaknesses: Might develope a coveting disorder

name: Evolver
description: Evolution is a very powerful tool of life. With this ability, your genetic structure is programmed to continue to evolve and mutate in positive ways. This means every once in a while, you'll develop a random genetic based ability. You will know when this happens because every time it happens you'll feel flashes of hot and cold. These mutations are uncontrollable and are almost always positive. So you'll never know when or how you will evolve.
summary: The ability to randomly evolve and mutate.
strengths: You might develop an anti-aging mutation.
Could become very powerful
Almost any ability is geneticly possible
weaknesses: Some mutations are just plain useless

name: Geometric Perfection
description: Although one might think this is useless, if it were to be applied to a user of projectiles, this person would become godly. Perfect Geometric recognition would allow someone to bounce bullets off of almost any solid object. Like Cyclops from Marvel, he could almost be the perfect sniper, as now wind, drag, objects, and any physical thing is now instantly added into his or her immmediate thought process. Basically, it almost ensures never missing a target, without really needing to concentrate.
summary: The ability to have a perfect understanding of physics and geometry.
strengths: Become a scientist/scholar/researcher
Can easily predict where projectiles are going
Instantaneous reactions since thought process is no longer a variable
weaknesses: Based on number of projectiles
Still not the most amazing power

name: Music Generation
description: With this power you can cause any song to start playing out of nowhere. Everybody around you will hear the song until you either change decide to change it or stop the music completely.
summary: The ability to make any song start playing randomly
strengths: You can cause any song or musical composition to start playing out of nowhere
Everyone around you will hear the song but they will have no idea where it's coming from
You can change the songs or stop the music completely whenever you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Seismokinesis
description: You can create and manipulate earthquakes. No one can come close! You can make quakes anywhere and can even creake sinkholes. Your shockwaves will scare your enemies.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate earthquakes
strengths: Amazingly powerfull
Destructive prowess with little effort
weaknesses: Could kill everyone
Overuse results in lack of control

name: Zonifying
description: Teacher: Blah blah blah blar blah blah. Lily:(zoned out). Teacher: Lily, when did Marco Polo travel to China from Italy? Lily: Why, 1217, ofcourse (smiles sweetly). Teacher: (scowls)
summary: The ability to zone out in class, but somehow remember all of the important points
strengths: Help with school!
You will become smart
weaknesses: You're bored.

name: Bioelectricity Absorption
description: This ability allows you to absorb others' bioelectricity, making the brain unable to send charges to your limbs and organs so they can do what you want and what they're suppose to. For example, when you want your arm to move or when your heart beats. You can also absorb others' bioelectricity to make your limbs and organs move and work faster.
summary: The ability to absorb others' bioelectricity
strengths: You can cause an enemy to be immobilized
You and your body can work faster
weaknesses: If no one's around you, you are powerless (unless you have other abilities)

name: God Of Words
description: Tired of being wrong all the time?  Well, with this power, anything and everything you say will automatically come true!  Simply say "I know the answers to this test" and the answers will flow into your mind!  Also use this ability to get back at people who hurt you or improve your bank account with a whisper!
summary: The ability to always be right.
strengths: Always be right
Your word is law
Make yourself into a super being with a word
weaknesses: Must watch what you say
May affect reality in unwanted ways
Don't be like Timmy Turner

name: Power Ritual
description: Basically, you can create rituals that can give people powers. One ritual can only ever give one specific power. Ex. One ritual could give Telepathy while another ritual gives Immortality. The better the power is the more complicated or physically-damaging the ritual is. Also, only someone with this power can perform or initiate the rituals on others. 'Omni' powers are beyond what any ritual can give and thus cannot be gained.
summary: The ability to give people powers by performing rituals on them
strengths: People will probably pay to gain powers.
weaknesses: You have to think up multiple rituals if you want to help others gain multiple different powers.
Strong powers are harder to gain.
This power will not do anything for powers that can only be gained one way.

name: Powerful Breath
description: You can blow fire, ice, gas, or wind at any pressure or force. Fire can range from melting ice to evaporating water, ice can range from freezing solids to freezing gasses, gas can poison your target in seconds, and wind can range from bending trees to causing storms. The effect of your breath is actually almost infinite, since you have large lungs and you can suck in large amounts of air to charge up the pressure/force at one time. Can also increase the maximum volume of your voice.
summary: The ability to blow different types of breath, such as fire, ice, gas, wind, etc.
strengths: Cool down your dinner instantly.
Warm up the cold weather
Blow sulfur on some jack.
weaknesses: Easily noticed

name: Heat Strength
description: With this power your strength level rises with the temperature in your present location. If you turn up the heat in your house you become stronger or if you travel to a hot place you become stronger. You also become weaker in the cold so if you're fighting a villain in the winter or in Canada or something you'll probably lose if this is your only power.
summary: The ability to become stronger depending on how hot it is in your location
strengths: You become stronger depending on how hot it is in your present location
weaknesses: You become weaker if it's cold

name: Yin And Yang Manipulation
description: Yin, the passive, healing element. Yang, the aggressive, harming element. With this ability, you have a mastery of both. This means that you can impart yin energy into subjects to heal them, to heighten their defenses against illness and harm, or even deflect yang attacks. With yang, you can do just the opposite. Hurt foes with a blast or beam, weaken foes physically and deflect the effects of yin. The two naturally cancel one another out, and thus are useless being used against each other.
summary: The ability to alter the elements of yin and yang
strengths: Yin energy can be used to heal (yourself and others), raise defenses and deflect yang
Yang energy can be used to harm (blasts, beams, enhanced strikes), lower defenses and deflect yin
Yin energy can induce good bahvior, Yang energy can induce bad behavior
weaknesses: Yin is harmless, so it can't be used to harm AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yin)
Yang is harmful, so it can't be used to heal AT ALL (in case you're more skilled at Yang)
Yin and Yang used together is a null attack (no harm is taken, no damage is healed)

name: Dream Invader
description:
This ability allows you to invade another person's dream. You can only use this ability while asleep and your victim must be asleep too.
While in their dreams you can cause a person to have unbearable nightmares or you can lock a person inside their dream.
summary: The ability to invade another's dream.
strengths: Make people you hate have nightmares.
weaknesses: You have to be asleep to use your ability.

name: Invictus
description: This power is based on your growing inner energy. Belief in yourself, confidence and ego power you to great extremes. You are as strong and indomitable as you believe. Immunity to fire, cold and disease if you believe you are. If you boost your confidence enough, you will be able to defy gravity, physics, logic. No one can tell you what you can and cannot do.
summary: The ability to be powered by your own confidence and ego
strengths: Initially you will be as strong, as fast, and as tough as you believe
Boost your ego enough and you will be able to fly, walk up walls, crap gold, drink lightning
Enemies and projectiles will bounce off you when they feel your awesome aura
weaknesses: Doubt is your greatest weakness
Beings with Telepathic, Superiority, Surpass or Evolutionary powers give you problems
Aging will slowly cause your confidence to wane no matter how powerful you become

name: Elemental Fist
description: The user, with the aid of a special gauntlet, is able to form an elemental fist using an element that is nearest to him. The elements are fire, earth, wind & water.
summary: The ability to transform your fist into whatever element you want
strengths: Able to counter almost element
weaknesses: Easily defeated if up against the wrong element

name: Wish Magnetism
description: The user will be able to attract the benefits of any one who made a wish that's coming true, or a reality warper who is warping reality. This ability has a near universal range. Any wish can become the user's and he can take all the benefits leaving the wisher or reality warper with the consequences. The user can redirect the wish if he doesn't want it. The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.
summary: The ability to attract or redirect the benefits of any person's wish or desire.
strengths: Take a person's wish or desired reality.
Redirect wish
weaknesses: The effects of warped reality and certain wishes will were off.

name: Florakinesis
description: This is a very simple psionic ability. It allows the user to manipulate plants around him as an extension of their own body. However, this ability doesn't allow the user to create plant-life, but does allows you to accelerate plant-growth. You can even promote plant life in an area, as long as their was some there before, creating a sort of super-garden.
summary: The ability to control plant life.
strengths: Controlling plant life.
Tons of interesting plants
Trees are included here
weaknesses: Cannot create plant life from nothing

name: Statue Animation
description: This power allows you to channel your own life energy into statues. The abilities of the statues are dependent upon what they depict: a horse will not be sentient but a human will, a gargoyle or bird will be able to fly, and statues of gods or superhumans will retain their powers. The statues can be made of anything from stone to ice.
summary: The ability to bring statues to life under your control.
strengths: Army of statues for you to command
Statues can appear inanimate and ambush enemies
Statues are stronger and more durable than real-life counterparts if made of rock or metal
weaknesses: Only works on statues of animals, not abstract sculptures or other inanimate objects
If broken once, statues cannot be reanimated
Statues are fragile if made of ice or glass

name: Weapons From The Dark
description: You can turn your own shadow into weapons, both melee and long-ranged, such as swords or sniper rifles.
summary: The ability to turn shadows into weapons
strengths: Variety of weapons depending on the imagination of the user
Strongest during the night
Nearly invincible in well shaded areas
weaknesses: Weapon may shatter depending on surrounding light
Weapon mass depends on shadow size
Weak against flashlights

name: Life And Death Control
description: You might not be able to control your powers sometimes unless you practice a lot. When you are using this power, you might feel rage or love. The undead might attack the living people you are controlling.
summary: The ability to bring back the dead and control them, and control people that are alive too.
strengths: You could bring back the people you love.
Control anybody, even animals.
Be able to make your enemies do whatever you like.
weaknesses: You might feel rage and maybe go too far because of it.
The undead might try to attack you for waking them up from their deep sleep.
You might not be able to control your powers most of the time.

name: Mark Of Shock
description: The user plants a mark in the target that allows him to electrify him from any distance. They can control the intensity of the shock and as an added bonus, the target attracts other electric-based attacks.
summary: The ability to electrocute people from distance
strengths: Good to inmobilize
Easy kill
weaknesses: Needs physical contact to place the mark
The mark can be removed
Emotions might affect the discharge

name: New Reality Vortex
description: You can create vortices that take you to a new reality that is either much better than this world, or horrible. Are you alone, without a family, and want a new start? Cornered by bullies or thugs? This power lets you escape. But you can also pull in enemies, sending them into a barren, desert-like place similar to Erebus, the dark netherworld crossed over when going into Hades, from which there is no escape. You, on the other hand, can always end up in a better place if you choose it!
summary: The ability to create vortices that lead to another dimension that is either good or bad
strengths: Getting rid of enemies? No problem!!
Live a better life in a happier place if this one doesn't suit you!
You can choose, and therefore control, whether the endpoint is in a good or bad place
weaknesses: Vortices are weak when you first acquire the power
They will open unintentionally if you don't control the power
You need to consciously focus on either the good or bad destination

name: Atomic Bond Manipulation
description: With this ability one could do pretty much anything one chooses. Want to use it for good? Make weapons cease to be... then turn them into bonds for the bad guys. Evil's your style? Rip people apart just by looking at them, or torture them one atom at a time.
summary: The ability to manipulate molecules and atoms at will
strengths: Manipulate matter
Free Energy!!!
Weapons are worthless
weaknesses: Can't create things, atoms and molecule have to be formed already

name: Blessing Of Morpheus
description: Morpheus is the Greek god of dreams and sleep. His blessing allows you to have various effects over his realm. You can control your own and others' dreams, and mentally enter another's dreams. Also, you can force people and things to sleep and control for how long they do.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Morpheus
strengths: Controlling dreams
"Sleeping" people and things(turning off a TV, shutting down a car, etc. )
weaknesses: Until you can control your power, everything around you will sleep.

name: Transcendent Dominator
description:
With a simple grabbing gesture of the hand this power enables you to instantly snatch a super powered target and use him as an acquired ability. 

This removes the target from this realm, sending him into a non dimensional pocket within your existence where he will remain in a mindless/non-sentient and will-broken state as a superpower for you to use for all of eternity.
summary: The ability to manipulate, take possession of, and use a super powered being as an acquired ability.
strengths: Gives access to all abilities the target has acquired.
This ability ignores space/distance between you & the target. In effect it also disregards barriers.
Ideally useful against targets with 'Power Hold' because of their existence as one with superpowers.
weaknesses: Can only be used against super powered beings.
Effects cannot be undone. Targets with powers like Craktart or suicidal abilities are threats.
Range: 10 miles around the user. Beyond that this power is useless.

name: Ability Countermeasures
description: If a person with Ability Countermeasures were facing a Pyrokinetic, they would develop Cryokinesis. If they squared off against a Speedster, they would be able to Slow Time. Ability Countermeasures is the ultimate nemesis: it finds a way to nullify any ability's advantage.
summary: The ability to produce a superpower for every superpowered problem
strengths: Become the weapon of last resort
The more powerful they are, the more powerful you are
Could potentially beat down the Hulk
weaknesses: Only lasts as long as the threat lasts
If faced with many powered foes, get the ability to Teleport
Only works with powered foes

name: Neuron Revival
description: With this ability, you can make every neuron that ever died in your head to reform and revive. Neurons are not immune to poison damage.
summary: The ability to make every neuron in your brain that ever died to reform and revive.
