strengths: Bring dead and destroyed neurons back to life.
weaknesses: Neurons are not immune to poison damage.

name: Duplicity
description: By simply tapping into the power of Loki, one would have the ability to harness any capability that helps to deceive or trick people, and start chaos; the primary ones being the power of shapeshifting, illusion, lying with a straight face (and no bodily changes) and the power to subliminally compel people to believe one's lies in the same way a person with psychic persuasion (mind control) subliminally compels you to follow their orders.
summary: The ability to have the power of Loki and harness the forces of deception and trickery
strengths: Pwn lie detectors (the machines and people with the power)
Never get caught doing mischief
Make enemies turn against each other
weaknesses: Sometimes you have to worship Loki to get these powers
Um, nothing else, it's like a god power.

name: Lung Adaptation
description: Carbon monoxide poisoning, nerve gas, even drowning have claimed thousands, if not milions of lives. A Lung Adaptor never has to worry about that. Without even thinking about it, they can automatically breathe any gas or liquid safely: tear gas, water, etc. They can also hold their breath for hours--days--at a time. Unfortunately, this offers no resistance to ingested or skin-absorbed poisons.
summary: The ability to hold one's breath indefinitely and to breathe anything safely
strengths: Breathe tear gas, carbon monoxide, etc. without harm
Use nerve gas as a weapon with no fear of death
Win every breath-holding contest
weaknesses: No resistance against ingested poisons
No resistance against skin-absorbed poisons
Still as vunerable as a normal person to damage

name: Fictional World Interblending
description: With this power, the user can fuse the real world with the world of fiction. You can fuse the world with any type of fiction: video games, etc. The new world will contain elements of both worlds, so it is possible to meet fictional characters. Nobody will die but they may be different in the new world. For example your best friend can now be your worst enemy. Everyone will eventually forget the previous world. If multiple fictions are fused, the world will be divided into different parts.
summary: The ability to fuse the real world with fiction
strengths: Create a world with superpowers/magic
If the fictional world has something that you excel at
You can meet fictional characters
weaknesses: Making superheroes also makes supevillains and can cause monsters to form and kill people
Can cause chaos because everybody becomes different and some things are altered
You can't control elements of the new world and you cannot use fiction made by yourself

name: Super Athlete
description: With this power you can be unbeatable at any sport; from baseball to race car driving to laser tag.
summary: The ability to be unbeatable at any sport
strengths: You can't be beaten in any sport
weaknesses: You can't use your sports skills in battle, such as paintball sharpshooting with a real gun

name: String Manipulation
description: You can control any physical string. The string can be of any material, whether it is cotton, cow hide, steel, diamond, etc. You can only manipulate strings within a radius of 1000 metres.
summary: The ability to manipulate physical strings
strengths: All strings of all materials are under your control.
If you can make fire strings they are under your control.
weaknesses: Effective range of 1 kilometre.

name: Power Mix
description: Because of this power, the greatest powers could be combined. But, contrasting powers may take more than just power, one must have creativity and imagination. An example is fire plus water. A liquid which burns is acid. Also, combining great powers may drain out a person's energy. Using combined powers may also take time and energy. It is also forbidden to combine powers not of one's level and combine power plus a combined power.
summary: The ability to mix different superpowers.
strengths: One could use a very powerful combo of attacks based on opponent's weakness.
Powers around may be sources of ideas.
Defense can be combined with offense.
weaknesses: Drains energy.
Time-consuming.
Many rules to follow.

name: Super Soldier Serum
description: Makes you stronger, faster, smarter, enhances your senses. Makes you an enhanced human, not superhuman (not smart enough to read or control minds, as fast as the Flash or as strong as the Hulk).
summary: The ability to have all your normal attributes increased
strengths: Makes you way stronger than an average human.
Senses are way more alert you can almost never get caught off guard.
Makes you way more durable.
weaknesses: All traits are increased, even anger. It increases irritability.
Cannot control powers, serum is part of you forever.
The super soldier serum shortens life, at most you can an average age of 35.

name: Vicarious Impulse
description: Impulses: bio-electric energy produced by the brain as to allow movement and thought. The user is able to speed up, slow down, completely stop, and even steal impulses from others in order to cause the target's brain and body functions to cease just by thinking so. Seizing impulses, the user can store knowledge of the target alongside their own, be it special abilities or memories.
summary: The ability to manipulate thought processing
strengths: Sever a target's motor functions
Send a target into a vegetative state
User learns by taking skills
weaknesses: User might be the victim of their own attack against a target who has reversal talents

name: Matter Into Armor
description: The ability to touch any solid matter and it covers your body, turning it into armor
summary: The ability to touch matter and turn it into armor.
strengths: Can absorb anything solid like stone, metal, rubber and anything else that is solid.
You could absorb mostly stone if you were in a fight
Metal is useful for strong attacks
weaknesses: You can't absorb liquid or gas

name: Artifact: Imperium Graphices
description: When you say "Adeat", a drawing pad and a magical feather pen appears. Whatever you draw instantly comes to life (such as birds, pillows, people, televisions, etc. ). The more detailed your drawings, the better they will be.
summary: The ability to bring your drawings to life.
strengths: Can use your drawings as shields or decoys.
Can summon weapons or shields.
Can summon things to fight for you.
weaknesses: 1% of the damage your drawing takes goes to you.

name: Glaciation
description: This is not the power to freeze; the user actually psychically transmutes matter into ice. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into ice. In addition, if a subject is turned into ice, they can be returned to normal at will, as long as the ice hasn't melted or been shattered.
summary: The ability to turn matter into ice
strengths: If you don't want a person to be turned into ice, you can use the power to just freezer-burn them
May be accompanied by an immunity (or at least high resistance) to cold
User may sometimes be able to also affect non-living matter
weaknesses: You can't return a person to normal if they shatter or break
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental glaciation)

name: Animal Matter
description: If you think about a snake, you become a snake. If you think about a wolf, you become a wolf. This is a cool superpower to have!
summary: The ability to become any animal you see or think of.
strengths: You can communicate with other animals.
You have the same abilities the animal you have chosen has.
You can use animals to attack your foes.
weaknesses: If your head hurts, the power doesn't work.
You can only become an animal for a limited time, otherwise you stay the animal you are forever.
It hurts while you transform.

name: Bio Enhancing Technopathy
description: A technopath has a great understanding of machines which would lead to huge advances in technology. By injecting millions of nanobots into yourself and/or giving yourself bionics, you can use your technopathy to constantly alter your body and powers. Get the nanobots to rapidly build jet boosters into your feet or lasers into your eyes, or "repair" you. They could harvest metal from nearby or it could be stored within your body. Rapidly adapt to each situation and become a tactical war machine.
summary: The ability to alter yourself via technopathy and nanobots or bionics
strengths: Easily enhance and repair yourself
Internal communications, internet, data storage etc
Many super-powers at your fingertips
weaknesses: May take concentration to organize large numbers of the nanobots
Requires an initial flair of invention and willingness to use self as a human guinea-pig
May feel extremely strange having add-ons built internally.

name: Equilibrium
description: You have the combined physical prowess of whatever you're fighting. Up against 100 men? You'll have their combined strength, speed, stamina, agility, etc. However, with every enemy you take out, you're abilities decrease in response to the decreased enemy force. No matter what, your mental abilities remain the same.
summary: The ability to be the physical equal of whatever force you're fighting
strengths: You'll always be just as physically powerful as your enemy.
You can respond to a large variety of threats.
weaknesses: Your abilities constantly fluctuate.
Long, drawn out fights due to equal abilities.
If you're up against a physically weak super-genius, you'll most likely lose.

name: Cartoon Physics (Toon Physics)
description: We've all seen cartoons defy human physics for the sake of comedy. Well, imagine if you had the same powers. To defy gravity until you notice so. To access hammerspace (to produce objects from seemingly out of nowhere). To slow one's fall for a safe landing. To travel into drawings, cartoons, TV, movies and cyberspace at will. To pick up and use holes like tangible objects. And most important, the user can't die, since that isn't funny. Though, he can still feel pain, only not that much.
summary: The ability to adhere to absurdly more lenient laws of physics
strengths: Be a human cartoon by defying the laws of human physics
Inability to die, aging and injury are impermanent, and feel less pain than normal
Sense of humor automatically improves
weaknesses: Can only be used in comedic situations (until developed)
Still feel pain
You'll be the laughing stock of the superhero community

name: Position Switching
description: This power enables you to instantly exchange your physical location with anything or anyone you are pointing at and concentrating on. It is not possible to only affect a part of an object, a person or a group of objects which are tightly fixed to each other, they will be moved as a whole. It works on any thing, except if it is bound to the Earth, i.e. if it is so heavy it cannot be humanly possible to move or if it is interlinked with the ground or something also bound to the Earth.
summary: The ability to exchange your position with anything or anyone you want
strengths: Like teleportation, except you have a finer and safer control on your moves.
Escape any situation AND put something or someone else in your place.
weaknesses: You must have a direct visual contact with whatever you want to switch with.
You can only teleport within your visual field.

name: Sentience Granter
description: This ability gives objects the ability to be self-aware, talk, and move(either levitation or rolling/walking).  You can also take away their sentience.  All objects have a predisposition to their owner, they will attempt to return to their owner.  You can use this power to have money continuously come back to you.
summary: The ability to give sentience to inanimate objects
strengths: If there are no witnesses you can question the evidence itself
You can convince objects to work for you. And, if you lose them, they will come back to you
You can have the book teach you by talking to it
weaknesses: Some objects will have annoying personalities or destructive tendencies
It's weird to talk to objects and will freak other people out
If all the objects joined to take over the world.

name: Water Works
description: With this power you are able touch and join with water at its various phases: Liquid, Solid or Vapor, changing your body into water. You control each and every water molecule you bond with. You could easily control your body at varying temperatures. You are able to combine with other water molecules and become stronger. You could become tsunami sized tidal waves, artic glaciers, a giant iceberg or pounding rain, or an avalanche.
summary: The ability to merge with water at any of its phases
strengths: Touch a form of water and become that form of water, controlling its strength and motion
Merge with various sizes of water becoming enormous tidal waves, jagged icebergs or storm systems
Virtually invulnerable as a polymorphic liquid, a super-heated vapor or any size or form of iceberg
weaknesses: In fluid forms you could be contained
Unwillingly be changed to different states by one with temperature manipulating abilities
If submerged or buried in a form of water you subconsciously merge with that form of water

name: Omnidirectional Blast
description: Tired of fighting against someone who just dodges your every move. Well, now with the omnidirectional blast you can hit everything up to a 5 mile radius all at once. The blast is concussive and can hit multiple times if the target is close by you. This power can also be used like a forcefield blasting everything around you away. The user can make the blast intangible at certain areas in order to protect things they don't want to hit. After use the user has to recharge.
summary: The ability to selectively attack everything up to a 5 mile radius all at once
strengths: No dodging your attack
You can choose what does not get affected by your attack if mastered
Blast is near instantaneous
weaknesses: You have to know what you don't want to hit
People will now want to stay clear of you-not really good if you want to be a hero
The blast is weaker the farther from the center.

name: Mastery Of The Great Ice Aura
description: This superpower allows you to become a master of the art of using ice as a power. This ability is acknowledged by a glowing aura of faint ice around the possessor. This superpower is extremely hard to master and therefore only the best can use it. Upon mastering it, go to the Temple of the Ice Being. There, you will be granted by the Ice Being the legendary Frostmane. This icy cloak gives the wearer invincibility to frost, water and fire. It also designates them as a master of ice.
summary: The ability to completely control ice as a weapon
strengths: The ability to use ice as a combat tool
The ability to forge weapons and armor out of ice, as well as variants of ice walls.
The Cloak of the Ice Being, Frostmane
weaknesses: Extremely hard to master
Fire is a sworn enemy of Ice

name: Vacuum Control
description: You can create spaces devoid of any air in any shape or size you want.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate vacuums
strengths: You could put out any fire instantly
The human body doesn't do well in vacuums, so you could fight with that
Using your control over vacuums, you could propel yourself in any direction
weaknesses: Hopefully, there weren't any people in that burning building you just sealed inside a vacuum
You, unfortunately, are human as well
You had better pack an airbag and parachute, you aren't impervious to falling damage

name: Neuro Kinesis
description: Pain, touch, perception of cold, all of it can be administered or removed using Neuro-kinesis. A telepathic ability, the user can force enemies into submission through intense pain, sexually stimulate a person to get them into a comedic mishap or even just lessen the effects of cold or heat on another person mildly. This power has several different uses and can be used primarily to cause or ease pain, making it suitable for good or bad people.
summary: The ability to alter physical feeling.
strengths: Can change your or others' perceptions of the immediate environment.
Never have to worry about feeling hot, cold or in pain ever again.
Can make death less painful for others or yourself (or more, if that's cool with you).
weaknesses: Can form an addiction to numbness.
Pain is natural and needed for a healthy body. Being always numb could lead to potential death.
If someone else has this power, they are immune to its effects.

name: Enhanced Effect
description: The user of this power is capable of achieving more effect from any action than the effort they put into it. In addition any effect achieved through the users actions may apply to realms beyond those it characteristically impacts. Touch, language, and action may bypass the material realm, affecting beings on other planes or merely being increased to heightened levels(e.g. whispering could become as loud as shouting, tapping to striking, etc). The influence of this power is determined by intent.
summary: The ability to increase and apply the affect of all your actions to matter or energy.
strengths: Tactile Manipulation of matter and energy( Tearing through steel can be as easy as tearing paper).
At higher levels influence the astral, and divine realms as easily as you could the physical.
Extends to communication, allowing the user to converse with anything that communicates.
weaknesses: Applies only to touch until higher levels. NCN
Despite the power to communicate with almost anything it does not give omnilinguism. NCN
Some effort IS required to actually trigger the effects of the power.

name: Mirroring
description: Mirroring is the ability to change somebody's reflection in a reflective surface; when you change their reflection, their body changes to match the reflection. You can use this to turn people into almost anything; other people, animals, plants, objects, etc. You can make them stay that way as long as you want, but can also change them back.
summary: The ability to alter the appearance of others by changing their reflection
strengths: Reflective surfaces are now useful in combat (puddles, windows, mirrors, etc.)
Turn people into whatever you want
Can reverse the effects if you want
weaknesses: Can only affect your OWN appearance if your power develops
Can't manipulate glass or reflective surfaces other than changing what they reflect
Some CAN'T reverse the effects of their power

name: Key Of Infinity: Dimension Key
description: Turn the key in midair or in a keyhole, and a door will appear. Think of a dimension (This counts alternate universes, like if you would have worn red socks instead of blue ones) and go through the door. You'll appear there! But without the Key of Space or Key of Time, you'll appear randomly in the past/future and/or in some random place
summary: The ability to use a key to go to a different dimension
strengths: Going to alternate dimensions
Having fun in them
weaknesses: Might appear randomly without other keys
Might die when appearing randomly

name: Snap You're Gone V2
description: With this power you can send people to other planets by snapping saying their name and the name of the planet you want them sent to. This power does not allow them to breathe in space so if they can't they'll probably die when you send them to a different planet. The planet does not have to be in your solar system or galaxy but is has to be in your universe. You can bring them back by saying their name and the name of the planet they came from. This power works on corpses and animals as well.
summary: The ability to teleport people to other planets by snapping
strengths: You can send people to other planets
Get paid by NASA to send astronauts to Mars
weaknesses: This power does not allow people to breathe in space

name: Mystic Eyes Of Death Sight
description: Full title: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception. Upon activation, their owner may "perceive death" in the form of red lines and dots. The user in question is the only one who can see, touch or use these lines and dots. Lines be traced with any held blade which cuts the line and inflicts damage which cannot be healed or repaired. Dots can also be pierced by sharp weapons, which effectively erases that object or creature from existence. The user's irises will glow blue when these eyes activate.
summary: The ability to destroy anything by perceiving and cutting its mystic weak points.
strengths: These eyes allow their users to destroy nearly anything that has a concrete, physical existence.
Users will have 100% accuracy and superhuman speed when attempting to cut or pierce a line or dot.
The depth of a cut is always magnified. Ex: Users can easily slice through boulders thrown at them.
weaknesses: A user must fight with a held blade to use this ability. There is no benefit for ranged weapons.
Using blunter objects to sever or pierce, such as fingers, will require much more effort.
Size is the only limit: extremely colossal targets, such as planets and moons, cannot be destroyed.

name: Holey Man
description: With this power, you can create holes that lead nowhere, or portals that can lead to wherever you want.
summary: The ability to create tactile holes and portals.
strengths: It's very easy to kill a person with this power.
Your portals can lead anywhere you want.
weaknesses: It's very draining to create a long-distance portal.
You need a very clear mental image of the place your portal leads.
Don't send two people in at a time, a 'la The Fly.

name: Pyropathy
description: Pyropathy is a specialized form of telepathy which only circles around fire. With this power you would be able to start fires in someones mind which can cause mental explosions or sweating because you are heating the hypothalamus. This is definetely not to be confused with pyrokinesis. You could also burn someone's memory away, create illusions of fire, and in some cases see the future through fire(Pyromancy).
summary: The ability to stimulate anything fire related into the mind of someone else
strengths: It can be very useful against those wo are afraid of fire
Can erase people's memories
You could heat an ally if there are close to hypothermia
weaknesses: Can cause severe headaches
May accidently erase too much of a persons memory
Can be activated by extreme anger so you might harm others unintentionally

name: Solar Electricty Ball
description: By absorbing an unlimited amount of sunlight one can produce immense amounts of electrical power. One can also fuse the energies of solar and electricity to increase the power, but this takes time and practice. The power has less limited energy during the day when the sun is out but the energy is more limited at night.
summary: The ability to generate a ball of intense electrical and solar energy by absorbing sunlight
strengths: Immense electrical reserves
Super powerful technique
Can fuse energies of solar and electricty
weaknesses: Ball is unstable and could explode before use
Radiation exposure
Uncontrolable electrical discharge

name: Superhuman Disability Bestowal
description: With this power, you can make yourself unable to do something, such as die or lose your powers. The user can apply these to willing individuals. An individual is capable of the desired action as long as they want to be. However, this power cannot compromise someone ability to choose what they want, such as making them incapable of existing. In addition, one can forcibly enable others to do things normally blocked by this power.
summary: The ability to make yourself or other willing individuals incapable of something.
strengths: This power has as many uses as you imagination can come up with.
Become immune to many things.
You can apply the benefits to others.
weaknesses: You cannot defend yourself from other enabling you to do certain things.
This power cannot be modified by your other powers.
You cannot use this on someone who does not want to be affected.

name: Control Brightness
description: The Light ring has the ability to call light beasts by saying :Let there be lightness, with the ring you can control light beasts and help you in your combats.
summary: The ability to call light with your light ring
strengths: The light beasts are stronger than the shadow beasts
The opponent cannot shoot it or cut it
It can only be attacked with psychic abilities
weaknesses: You can only call two-three beasts at a time
It can beaten with the ring of darkness or with a magical attack
You need to be in partial light or complete light to operate

name: Arceusforce: Fist
description: The user of this ability can channel the fighting spirit of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Fighting-type. The user's skin turns mahogany, their irises turn tan. Under their brawny guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Fighting-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Fighting attacks such as Mach Punch, Hi Jump Kick, Aura Sphere, Close Combat and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Fighting form.
strengths: The user can resist insect, darkness and mineral-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of chi and aura for Fighting attacks.
The user gains knowledge of combat as well as a more advanced physical condition for combat.
weaknesses: The user is weak to fairy magic, psychic and wind-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form

name: Randomize Door
description: This power allows the user to, upon opening a door, randomize the out location to any other door in the universe. For example, you could open your front door and come out of the closet of a French mansion. The output location is random and the connection between door A and door B only exists for as long as the door is open, becoming normal once the door is closed. If one is displeased by whats on the other side of the door, one need only close it and reopen it to try for somewhere else.
summary: The ability to randomize the output location of any door.
strengths: Make a quick escape to anywhere, from anywhere.
Create a stable portal to some place amazing by keeping the door open.
weaknesses: It's random where it puts you out.
It only works on doors.
Things can get strange when it connects two doors of different sizes.

name: Arceusforce: Judgment
description: The user holds a mighty force with this power. Their hair becomes white, skin becomes golden and eyes become green with burning red pupils. They have all of the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Normal-type. They gain supernatural condition as well as the ability to generate raw energy for attacks such as Hyper Beam and Giga Impact. With intense training, the user can transform into other elemental types and summon Arceus' almighty Judgment, a powerful light shower of the elements.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus, creator of the Pokemon universe.
strengths: The user is immune to spectral attacks in default form.
Generation of raw energy for various attacks.
BOW TO THE SHEER FORCE OF JUDGMENT!!!!
weaknesses: The user is weak to supernatural physical combat in default form.
This power may be too powerful for the user. (Especially Judgment)
Intense training is required to access the other elemental forms of Arceus as well as Judgment.

name: Arcana 18: The Moon
description: You possess an aura that enhances mental powers, imagination and creativity within in. The longer a person remains within the aura, the strength of the enhancement increases, however, prolonged exposure to the aura can have negative effects. This can include dream-like states, hallucinations, poor emotional control, odd delusions and eventual psychological meltdowns. This can be prevented by taking a break from the aura. You may allow the aura to affect or not affect you as you desire.
summary: The ability to enhance mental powers and creativity.
strengths: You may enhance your or allies creativity, imagination or mental powers.
You can cause people to dissolve into insanity just by being around them.
Your aura expands when you are exposed to its effects.
weaknesses: You are not immune to the negatives of prolonged exposure.
Insanity caused by this power can cause random outburst of telepathic noise or illusions.

name: Derailment
description: A person with this power has the ability to get others to think the same thing as them for 10 seconds. For example, you can derail a serious conversation by talking about getting burgers, then the other party will start discussing about burgers until they realize that you just tricked them again with this power. The power lasts for 10 seconds, but the other party might continue to be in the same train of thought after 10 seconds is up. They might actually want burgers now that you suggested it.
summary: The ability to pull others into your own train of thought for 10 seconds
strengths: Derail conversations and get people to help you
Its hilarious to use just like a comedy gag---try not to laugh at the stuff you get to happen
Can work on groups of people
weaknesses: If not trained this power might happen subconsciously(which can be terrible)
After 10 seconds, the other person(s) realizes what they are doing
If the user's thoughts are too complicated this power will not work

name: Lawman
description: As a Law-maker, the user can create a condition/consequence system, and bind it to a chosen area. When the condition is met, the consequences follow. These systems can be used to varying ends, either passively or actively. In this example, "All those who display aggression will be restrained", the active condition "aggression" leads to the consequence "be restrained". A passive condition, "Any over the age of 25", can have the consequence of "cannot exit the building".
summary: The ability to establish and enforce supernatural laws
strengths: Grants a great deal of influence over your surroundings; creativity is key
Multiple laws can be enacted in a single area, and consequences are supernaturally enforced
Time restraints can be added ("Between the hours of noon and 5pm... ")
weaknesses: This ability takes time and effort to use; the more influence the law has, the more difficult it is.
Areas in which this ability is used are static; once activated, they cannot be moved by choice
Loopholes and anti-law abilities can disrupt law systems.

name: Program Creation
description: With this power, you can create any type of program that can do anything. I do not mean you can create a program that can manipulate reality or something. I mean you can create a program that can hack systems or manipulate systems. When I say, you can create any program I mean you think of it and it is created.
summary: The ability to create any type of program.
strengths: You can hack any type of system.
You can give a virus to someone's network if you don't like them.
You can make easy money by creating apps.
weaknesses: People might kidnap you to exploit your power.
People might become jealous of your awesome programs and kill you.
You might create a program so advanced the government might see it as a national threat.

name: Epigenetic Manipulation
description: With this power, one can detect and control gene expression. Potential applications include deactivating genes for dominant traits, deactivating unwanted traits and capabilities, such as weight gain and much more. If a power is genetic, it too may be deactivated. This power also bestows the ability to sense activity of a gene and what a gene does.
summary: The ability to sense and manipulate gene expression.
strengths: Deactivate unwanted traits.
Works on both the user and others.
Prevent disease.
weaknesses: Cannot alter most existing physiology, except in specific situations.
This power offers no knowledge or understanding of genetics.
It could very easily kill the target.

name: Mechanic Kinesis
description: Ability to mental control and augment cars, augmentation would take a period of time depending on how the car is changed. The ability to change the form of their cars from guns to robots. The form appearance and abilities would be dependent on car. A mental connection with his would allow his body to be augmented by the abilities of one car at a time, but to a smaller degree. However, the number of cars he could control at one time would be limited. And his cars being damaged would reduce power
summary: The ability to control cars in a multitude of ways.
strengths: Not needing a to refuel
Different car for different situations
Can use the cars for combat
weaknesses: Powers rely on users cars being around
Whatever weakness the car has is the users weakness as well
Number of cars able to be controlled at once is limited

name: Causality Interception
description: The user has the ability to stop or alter the effect of any action by putting something literally in the middle of it. An example would be the user saw someone about to be punched in the face and he just so happen to see a teddy bear in the corner. The user can use this power to make the teddy bear take the punch. Thus altering the end result of the action.
summary: The ability to change, or nullify the effect of any cause by placing an outside object to intercept the process
strengths: Alter or stop any effect to any action.
Send things in between the action maker and action receiver
Teleportation application
weaknesses: Could make a bad effect become worse

name: Book Nitro
description: This power allows you to go into the world of a book. You could end up changing the whole story line and if someone reads it, YOU will be in the book. There are no loop holes. You can't get stuck. BUT you can die or be discovered. You can take as many people as you want with you and bring people back with you.
summary: The ability to Transport yourself into a book
strengths: You can be IN a book.
You can become a main character
You can bring the characters back if you persuade them.
weaknesses: You might ruin the whole plot.
You could die.
You could be discovered.

name: Text Commands
description: With this power, you are able to write and type hypnotic commands that people will automatically obey upon reading them.  Whether something you write is actually a command is entirely up to your intent while you write it.   You can be as vague or specific as you want with your commands.  Upon completing their tasks, people will not remember reading your commands and will have thought they acted on their own unless you specify otherwise in their command.
summary: The ability to write and type commands that people will perform upon reading them.
strengths: People will follow your written commands automatically.
You can determine whether something your write is a command or not.
By default, people will not remember being controlled upon completing their tasks.
weaknesses: Will not work if the target does not have the required knowledge to perform the task.
Will not work if the command is physically impossible for the target to perform.
May result in controlling people you never intended on controlling if the wrong people read your commands.

name: Geological Empathy
description: Geopathy is the ability to connect ones self with earth materials. The person can feel the earth and everthing that is happening to a specific area. The ability can also change geological objects and materials by projecting the landscape as a hologram, which then can be used to change it.
summary: The ability to connect to, feel, and control earthly materials
strengths: You can see and feel the earth.
You can talk to the earth.
weaknesses: Sometimes you may hear many voices if you are near a lot of geological materials.

name: Time Pass
description: When activated, you will turn transparent and you cannot be harmed by physical mean, but you can be hurt by magic or mystical means. It only lasts five minutes and needs one minute cooldown.
summary: The ability to "pass" in and out of time
strengths: "Pass" out of time itself
Cannot be harmed by physical means
Turn almost invisible
weaknesses: Can be harmed by magic and mystic means
Only lasts five minutes
One minute cooldown

name: Delete This Cryptokinesis
description: combo of powers.
summary: The ability to render objects unseen.
strengths: Invisiblity
Can make other things invisble too.
weaknesses: requires touch

name: Irony: Relaxed Super Humanism
description: A person with this ability will literally try to just relax and slack off when in a fight. This is because the lesser the effort he puts into the act the more it becomes more powerful, faster, or effective. For example if he is fighting someone as strong as Superman he will need only 0.000001 percent of his total strength in order to deliver his killing blow. Another good example is when he wants to move fast all he's got to do is go extremely slow to the point where he's almost not moving all.
summary: The ability to gain unparalleled strength, speed, concentration, etc. the lesser the effort put into the act.
strengths: Do nothing and you become so strong to the point where you become immovable and invulnerable.
Its so fun to use only little to almost no power at all against your enemies when they're using 100%
Being relaxed has a lot of health benefits.
weaknesses: You look like you're not doing your best at all.
Your friends think you're just being lazy.
You are only at your most powerful when you're not doing anything at all.

name: Icy Crysmal Detonation
description: This ability allows you to detonate an explosion of ice around your target. You can also channel a small portion of the explosion to your fists for minimal damage. When the torrents of ice hit your target, it will consume them and spread all over them, devouring them like tar. You are also capable of projecting the ice in missile-like constructs.
summary: The ability to discharge an explosive corrosive mass of ice.
strengths: Detonate yourself like an "icy nuke".
Consume the target with ice.
The ice is incapable of harming you, so no worries.
weaknesses: The explosion technique is dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Temperature Manipulation
description: The more heat you absorb, the more you can release from yourself. However, if you do not have any excess heat absorbed, you cannot use this ability. Unless you have mastered this skill, you cannot really absorb a significant amount of heat from objects below room temperature. You can also freeze things so cold that they can snap as a result. Heightened adrenaline levels may also result in inadvertent heat bursts
summary: The ability to absorb and release excess heat from yourself
strengths: You can cool down a hot object without any problems
The excess heat you gain from the above can be stored for later uses
You are immune to excess or deficient body heat-related problems
weaknesses: If you absorb too much heat, you begin to burn up inside
To fully heat up or cool down an object, you must be touching it
If you get too hot, you start to glow red, and this is not good for subtlety

name: Human Floppy Disk Drive
description: It's extremely rare to find a computer with a floppy disk drive nowadays. Mainly because we stopped using them. So, this power changes you into a human floppy disk drive. Just insert a floppy disk in your mouth. It allows to read the data contained in it. You can also format the disk, an important step for those data containers. And you can also save data on it, such as memories, thoughts, information, etc.
summary: The ability to read data contained in a floppy disk, format the floppy disk or save data on it.
strengths: You can save datas on floppy disks in case you're the victim of a memory wipe.
If you find a floppy disk but don't have an adequate computer to use it.
weaknesses: Floppy disks have a very, very small memory capacity.
Floppy disk are hardly found anywhere, except in attics, labs with obsolete equipments, etc.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Altor's Shield
description: You can be safe from any illusions, mental manipulation, telekinesis, any time control, any sort of powers as long as you're inside the shield. Kind of like nullification, but that'ss only while youre inside the shield. The shield is also physical, so if someone tries to hit you while you're in the shield, they'd be repelled. It takes little time to erect the shield, like 30 seconds. The shield will stay as long as you are conscious and you will it to.
summary: The ability to shield yourself from any other super power or anything physical.
strengths: You are safe from any attacks
You can protect others with this
You won't be defeated
weaknesses: If you're taken by surprise, then you will most likely lose
You can only protect those standing close to you
You have to erect your shield

name: Outta Sight, Outta Mind
description: Outta Sight, Outta mind, right? This lets you make anything you want, *Poof* Disappear. No matter the size, or what its made of, You can make it invisible for as long as you want. No restrictions, just don't forget to make the object visible again. It doesn't have to be the whole object, it can be just a finger or toe or hair. It can even be something or someone on TV.
summary: The ability to make anything invisible for as long as you want.
strengths: Rob banks without getting caught on camera.
Make Secret item (Cherished or handed down) Invisible so no one will steal it.
Make anyone or anything you see on TV disappear.
weaknesses: Can Still be seen on thermal detectors, or heartbeat sensors.
Can still be Injured while invisible.
May accidently make National monuments disappear.

name: Common Knowledge
description: This power allows you to learn about anything you want as long as it is common knowledge of the population around you. Common knowledge being things that are generally known or could be easily researched, things that have already been discovered or learned by other individuals. This power does not give knowledge of secrets or personal lives as that is not common knowledge. If the info is not part of the common knowledge of people around you anymore, then you have to relearn it a different way.
summary: The ability to gain access to any information that is common knowledge.
strengths: Will already know anything that an university would be able to teach.
Masters of this power can access the common knowledge of an entire planet.
Will eventually become an expert at every new discovery
weaknesses: Have to choose what you will learn.
Cannot learn secrets, personal events, or new discoveries, unless many people know around you.
If the common knowledge of the population around you changes, your knowledge changes too.

name: Juggernaut
description: To use your power, you have to run. Once in a speeding motion, you build up a kinetic energy force. the force of a charging rhino, bulldozer, train, & wrecking ball combined. You'll have that increased strength & speed. A force to be reckoned with. Demolishing almost anything & everything in your path. Though it is hard to stop, almost exhausting.
summary: The ability to become an almost unstoppable force when running
strengths: Increased strength & speed
Demolish anything in your path
weaknesses: Hard to stop

name: Cartoon Powers: Captain Marvel
description: With this power you have the wisdom of Solomon, the strength of Hercules, the stamina of Atlas, the power of Zeus, the courage of Achilles and the speed of mercury
summary: The ability to have the powers of SHAZAM
strengths: You have all of the powers of Captain Marvel and the rest of the marvel family
You have super speed, super smartness, super strength, super stamina, super courage + lots of power
You don't have to say SHAZAM to access these powers
weaknesses: You don't have all of Shazam's powers

name: Dead Aim
description: If you have an eye thats dead, (right or left) doesnt matter which one. Then you could end up with this power. It's a mystery how you get it though. Anyway, that dead eye is regenated and from that point on your aim is perfect every time. If it is possible, you'll hit your target;  no matter how far or unlikely.Pefectly every time.
summary: The ability to have perfect aim, with all guns, bows, spears, and other projectile weapons, if one eye is dead.
strengths: Hit targets perfectly every single time, with any waepon you can shoot or throw
Your range is greater than the even the best Military training can provide.
No limit for the kind of weapon of your choice.
weaknesses: You are blind in that eye, Unless you're aiming at something. No if you're completely blind.
Does nothing for handheld close range weapons. Your depth perception doesnt change.
You do suffer entense headaches in the beginning. Takes lots of getting used to.

name: The Musician
description: Pick up any musical instrument or sing any song and it becomes a solid sound-energy construct, anything your mind can conceive of for offense or defense. A concussive blast, blades, loyal soldier(s), a hammer the size of a building, vice grips, steps so you can walk on air. The constructs are only visible if you want them to be or if your opponent has some type of above normal senses. All you need is one note. Assassin, Hero, or incredibly rich entertainer. You choose.
summary: The ability to convert sound into any type of solid sound & energy construct(s)
strengths: You can create constructs of any size or shape. Most effective with lots of ambient noise and energy
Sing and play simultaneously & continually for your strongest weapons, shields, etc.
Intuitively play any musical intrument & sing any song perfectly
weaknesses: Ability must begin as music, you need air & surrounding energy to create constructs
Useless in a vacuum (outer space). Weak effectiveness vs the deaf or vs the blind
Can never play or sing for fun. Again, it will always become a construct capable of hurting someone

name: Quick Change
description: This power allows the person to copy any patterns or clothes on them or somewhere else. The power simply works by turning yourself invisible and becoming what is seen through you. Example: By becoming invisible and standing in front of a brick wall your skin and clothes become a brick pattern. This also work for clothes and accessories. Simply stand in front of what you want to where and use the power to wear it.
summary: The ability to become invisible and copy what you see through you
strengths: Wear anything or be anything at anytime.
Change skin,hair,eyes,nose etc.
Awesome camouflage
weaknesses: May stay permanant
Can only copy certain things

name: Computation
description:
People with computation could be the most accomplished people on the planet. They can solve complex equations and scenarios in their head, mimic movements with perfect precision, and have amazing memories.

Don't be misled. You cannot interact, merge, or control technologies, let alone surf the net.

Your body would be the hardware your brain's software commands. Vocal cords as speakers for example.

This is a great power that unleashes human potential.
summary: The ability to do anything a computer can do. Only better!
strengths: Smart Beyond Belief
Make a lot of money (game theory, probability, etc)
The body can function as computer hardware
weaknesses: No additional hardware. Your chest isn't going to be a printer.
Lame nicknames like Data and Hal.
Some social awkwardness

name: Walking Panacea
description: With this power, you can transform water into a drinkable cure for any affliction. For all intents and purposes, it's still water, but it also contains the cure. To use this power, you need to be touching someone or something with the affliction. The water can only "hold" one cure at a time, and the afflicted person must drink one cup of your cure for it to work. You can make unlimited quantities.
summary: The ability to develop a cure for any affliction.
strengths: Cure the world's diseases
You may be seen as holy
Your presence isn't required after the cure has been made
weaknesses: One cure at a time
Requires you to be touching someone with the affliction
You need water to start with

name: Antimatter Gauntlets
description: With these black gauntlets you can harness the explosive power of antimatter within the palms of your hands. They can be used to create  And manipulate antimatter into any form shape or size.If you wear the gauntlets long enough you could absorb the certain energies within them to gain immunity to antimatter explosions
summary: The ability to use them to create and manipulate antimatter
strengths: Can gain immunity from antimatter explosions
Destroy anything in your path
weaknesses: People will label you as a terrorist
the miltiary will hunt you down for them
blowing up your planet

name: Gift: Flames
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling fires and flames than other beings. Thus their fire- or flame-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of fire from them. However, someone with this power can only receive fire-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of flame and fire
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over fire as someone with this power.
Fire-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only fire-based powers now.

name: Molecule Separation
description: You can separate your molecules so that you can become invisible and things can pass through you, but you can't go through walls or anything like that. With your molecules separated, you become light and can somewhat fly or float, too. If you become too emotional, your molecules could separate without you wanting them to and if you are invisible and you become shocked or become emotional, they can come back together.
summary: The ability to separate your molecules so you become invisible.
strengths: Become invisible
Can fly somewhat
weaknesses: Could become invisible without you wanting to.
Could become visible again without wanting to.

name: Breathe Underwater
description: You are able to go underwater forever and actualy breathe as if you had gills.
summary: The ability to breathe underwater.
strengths: You can stay Underwater for as long as you like.
You can search for Sunken Treasure off the Florida coast.
You can visit the Nude Beaches for a close-up view
weaknesses: You might forget that you're Underwater
You can get overloaded with Treasure.
You might get caught Peeping at the Nude Beach and have to Register as a Sex Offender

name: Contagion
description: Also called Contagious Contact, one with this ability can project and receive numerous mental and bodily conditions simply by touching subjects. One with this ability can project or receive thoughts, emotions, behaviors, psychic imprints, compulsions or the like. In addition, they could also project or receive illnesses.
summary: The ability to pass on and receive conditions by touch
strengths: Project thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints onto others by touch
Receive (hear or sense) thoughts, emotions, behaviors and psychic imprints of others by touch
Pass on (or receive) illnesses, skills and superpowers
weaknesses: At the lower levels, conditions passed on involuntarily (accidentally sicken others, etc. )
At the lower levels, conditions received involuntarily (accidentally take on sickness, etc. )
At the lower levels, being compelled is much easier (they just have to touch you)

name: Nanotech Armor
description: You can produce a suit of cyber armor made of sentient nanobytes that covers your body. Its nearly indestructible yet you're still very agile. It also increases your strength & speed.
summary: The ability to produce cyber nanotech armor suit.
strengths: Nearly indestructible yet still agile
Increased strength
Increased speed
weaknesses: Affected by EMP
Sentient nanobytes might become to self aware & turn against you

name: Flesh Manipulation
description: As opposed to controlling blood or the brain this ability lets a person take full control of a person's flesh(or soft tissue). In addition flesh that is dead can also be manipulated. Flesh can be ripped from the body and be transplanted in other parts of the body-- for example manipulating flesh to cover someone's mouth or eyelids. Your own flesh can be manipulated as well to create more muscles or weapons.
summary: The ability to control flesh and muscles
strengths: Control anything biological and some undead as well
Make your muscles bigger by manipulating them
weaknesses: Does not grant full control over a person's body
People can still think while manipulated

name: Energy Imbuing
description: An Energy Imbuer could be wearing a WMD and you would never know it. Their ability enables them to 'charge' any object with raw energy. Once the energy is in the object, the way it is first released will determine the way the remainder will be released. The result? Rods that release electricity on impact, rings that pack a kinetic punch, and so on. Now while anyone can use these objects, only the user reverse the process--deenergizing the objects to revitalize themselves.
summary: The ability to store your own energy in objects
strengths: Energy can be released (radiation, kinetic, heat, etc. )
You can reabsorb energy you have stored to revitalize yourself
Personal effects become weapons
weaknesses: Anyone can use an energized object
May not have enough energy to charge anything
Only one type of energy an object

name: Elemental Opposites
description: With this power you can send out an aura that can turn anything you wish into its elemental opposite. An elemental opposite would be things like Light to Dark, Fire to Ice, and Wood to Metal. The object that is changed will still function like it originally was but will be made out of a new substance. A tree will still grow like a tree but would be made of metal. Changes can be reversed with aura as well. Changes are permanent unless affected by another power.
summary: The ability to change an element into its elemental opposite.
strengths: Can change anything into its elemental opposite.
Change things into the opposite of what people can control.
Changes are permanent unless you or another person uses powers to change substances back.
weaknesses: Can only change a substance into its opposite, nothing else.
Changing substances of attachs does not necessarily mean you will not get hurt.
The opposite of a substance might be no more help to you than the origenal.

name: Super Perception
description: One can instantly see out of place things that one would have to either be alert for or trained to find.  Behaviors like tics, nervous habits, and even faked emotion stand out to the user.  Even things like a missing or unusual objects and a different physical atmosphere becomes apparant.  This power is almost completely visual, in that the user must be able to see to perceive through his/her other senses.
summary: The ability to notice instantly suspicious or out-of-place things
strengths: You can tell when people are acting suspiciously
You instantly recognize hidden messages
Easily win at Where's Waldo and Eye-Spy
weaknesses: Not all perceptions necessarily indicate danger
Sometimes you wish you didn't notice some guy picking his nose
It helps if you're not blind.

name: Emotional Aura
description: With this ability, you produce an aura that effects those around you based on your mood. If you're in a joyful state, it increases the energy of you and those near you, and gives them a good mood. If you're disappointed or sad, it will cause others to feel sad. While angered, the aura becomes strong, and instead of sharing your emotions, it puts others into state of fear. A strong negative aura can cause others to be put into a state of shock.
summary: The ability to produce an aura which varies based on your current emotions
strengths: Joy increases the mood around you, and boosts the energy of you and others
Anger will create an aura that increases your strength, but will make others fear you greatly
All emotions effect those around you, and usually positively after both you and them
weaknesses: Great negative emotions can cause chaos around you, such as shaking of the ground, etc.
Friends may favor you for your ability, and not you as a person
Difficult to control, just as regular emotions are

name: Transforming Touch
description: You can transform into anything by just touching it but it might have some side effects like when you touch a piece of paper your body is pure paper.
summary: The ability to transform into anything you touch
strengths: When You touch your enemy you have all his powers and looks
When You touch a metal fragment you'll become that certain metal
When you touch an animal you'll turn part human part that animal
weaknesses: only half of your body transforms
everything you touch you turn into
whatever weakness you touch has that is your weakness

name: Residual Energy Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to control energy and radition that remains in one place when its main source is no longer there. The user can see the residual energy and then able to make them more visible.  The energy/radiation won't have the effects that it had when it was whole. No radiation poisoning, No heat from energy.
summary: The ability to sense and control faint energies/radiation.
strengths: Control energy/radiation that is faint to the human eye.
Use psionic ghosts to talk about what the people they belong to said in that moment
weaknesses: The reactivation of multiple residual energies/radiations at once could cause a massive explosion.
Residual energies/radiations don't have the effects of its former sources.

name: Aura Ball
description: The ability to launch a powerful ball of your aura at an opponent, which hurts a lot
summary: The ability to launch a ball of your aura
strengths: May send opponents flying backwards
Hurts real bad(not you)
Powerful
weaknesses: Only damages human/creatures
Can only hurt if praciced (but will freak people out)
People will want to hang around you (may include stalkers)

name: Magic Mimicry
description: When you transform into your magic form, you are still human shaped but you will glow a different color, be slighty transparent, and crackle with energy. You can focus this energy into bolts, blasts, shockwaves, ect. It will have a different effect everytime you hit something with your energy. It could change it, bring it to life, destroy it, make it vanish, or something completely random. With time and practice you could probably contol the effect as long as it's within your limits.
summary: The ability to transform into magical energy
strengths: Your magic form looks cool
You can focus your energy with varying effects
It's mimicry, with more
weaknesses: Controlling the effects is very hard
Must be in magic form to use your powers
You have a limited amount of energy before you revert to human form.

name: Contortion Inducing
description: One with this ability causes subjects to not only become flexible, but to actually contort. That means that the subject's body will begin to twist against his will, into strange, perhaps yoga-like, positions; they will twist, turn, bend and contort until they are completely immobilized. Obviously, aside from entertainment purposes, this is rather useful for both combat and defense.
summary: The ability to psychically induce involuntary contortion of foes into awkward and odd positions
strengths: Make enemies twist into strange positions

Very powerful

incredibly dangerous

Choking isn't a big deal

name: Power Using
description: This power will let the person having this gift use any power the person wants to use. The power can only last a short time. The longer the power is in use, the more it becomes part of them. If the person goes over their time period, the power they have will stay and it will be their only power.

Can stick hair through keyhole, die, then be on other side!
weaknesses: Easy access for villains.
Every 50 times you do this, fate takes a random person.

name: Lightning God
description: A blinding speed that makes you the master of gravitational space. You can see nano light particles, hyper movement and sound vibrations in slow motion.

strengths: Multi-task.
Excellent offensive and defensive measure.
weaknesses: For each use, you loose 1 minute of your lifespan.

name: Eschaception
description: The ability to sense/know the end of something. This includes (but is not limited to): the end of a statement, conversation, era, storm, and war. It also allows the user to sense death (the end of a life). It is a specialized form of claircognizance and does not involve any visual aspects.

PROFIT from telling people when they will die.
Know when a war will end.
weaknesses: The end of something is never a surprise.
Fatalistic in nature.

name: Tactile Pyrokinesis
description: A person can control fire by touching something associated with it (a lighter, paper, wood, etc.), and mentally focusing on the fire it could fuel, thus absorbing the object's power. The air around their free hand will start heating, eventually igniting. They can create fire over one or both hands, without touching the object, and create floating fireballs to launch, alongside blazing jets!! Orange fire is the most common created, and creating rarer high-temperature blue fire takes time.
summary: The ability to mentally control fire by touching objects associated with it and focusing on fire
strengths: Generate fire by absorbing the power of anything that is flammable, with no need for outside sources

A user cannot in any way be harmed by their own fire, and can also choose to pass immunity to others
weaknesses: A very dangerous power in the wrong hands

name: Void Weaponry
description: Summons an indestructible and unlimited substance that can be crafted into anything you can imagine! This can also be an extension of yourself, i.e. tentacles, spikes, bullets,wings. The more concentration you have the more powerful the objects are. At maximum concentration you will have the power to make this indestructible material into powerful minions with thoughts and powers of your choosing! The material can also be converted into a gas, solid, & liquid. Gives strength, flight & durability

Flight and overtime durability, strength, flight, and mind

name: Soundwave
description: You could make their heads explode, you could make their ears bleed. You could cancel out sounds and make sounds.

strengths: You can fly
You can block
You can kill
weaknesses: None
None
None

name: Kill Shift
description: With this power you can turn into anybody that you've killed. You can imitate their voice and mannerisms perfectly and you have access to all of their memories and knowledge along with your memories and knowledge.

description: This power allows you to produce items made by fictional businesses in books,movies,tv shows, etc. There are limits though, you can only obtain 5 fictional factories at any given time.

name: Emp Control
description: EMP control is a deadly ability, seeing that the world is overrun with technology. With this ablity one takes control over an EMP or Electromagnetic Pulse. name: Super Adaptive Tissue
description: A person with this power can take anything and make it part of their body. In addition no undesired side effects, like rejection, will occur and they are in full control of implanted part. This power also works on internal organs. The implant must be a "part" if it is still attached to the whole it cannot be attached. You can also hide objects within your own tissue to use later. D

name: Lucid Dreaming
description: A person with this power always has lucid dreams. This lets them control every aspect of their dream. In addition they can use this power even when they are pulled into someone else's dream in ways such as mind contraption. When two lucid dreamers exist in the same dream the person with the stronger mind and willpower becomes dominant. In a lucid dream you are invincible because your thoughts become reality. As long as you believe what you are doing you can do anything.

strengths: Take that Freddy Krueger--you can beat him at his own game

name: Lord Of Oblivion
description: By deleting a piece of reality and then controlling the void that replaces it, you alter reality. You can only have three changes retained at once, plus however many you can focus on. If you lose focus on one that isn't 'saved,' the piece of reality and everything connected to it disappears (death with no afterlife). If you SUDDENLY lose focus, not only does it disappear, but it is replaced by a chaos demon with similar powers that will attempt to destroy reality. Changes must be in line-of-site
summary: The ability to alter reality by controlling the void of non-existence

description: What is your opinion of the perfect person? Whatever it is, with this power, you can become that person. You'll have your "imaginary perfect person's" looks, talents, and everything else.

strengths: Become your own perspective of the perfect person

Be happy

description: Can 'reach' in to a person's mind and 'turn on' their powers. This results with them gaining powers and you becoming a little tired. You can only use this power on those with no powers.

I can open that safe for you
Three words, superbouncy bouncy balls

description: Everyone has a deep sadness and everyone has a deep joy. name: Genie Summon
description: With this power you can summon a genie. The genie is under your complete control until it grants you three wishes after it does that the genie disappears and you have to wait a period of 365 days until you can use this power again. There are a few restrictions regarding what you can wish for, you can't wish to have super powers, for more wishes, for somebody to fall in love with you, to become a god, to become a genie or for somebody to die.

weaknesses: Once it grants you three wishes the genie disappears and you can't summon a new one for a whole year

Angel forms always have platinum hair so you can't go unnoticed anywhere at all, so for your own safety you can't stay in angel form forever & normal weapons can still hurt you.

strengths: Be a hero... Or not
Ultimate seducer
Unstoppable

He mastered the Seven Songs of Wizardry, Changing, Binding, Protecting, Naming, Leaping, Eliminating, and Seeing. He could also command things with his mind, and see without his eyes. He knew the language of trees, and could heal any wound. This ability allows you to control and channel all of these powers. You may not understand this gift at first, but when you do, you will grow even more powerful than Merlin.

weaknesses: Have to be a Butterfly hybrid
Have to sleep for 24 hours after use
Can be blown away by a strong wind

name: Water Empathy
description: 'Swims like a fish' barely covers the extent of a Water Empath's abilities. When they are covered in water, their healing, strength, speed, and reflexes are doubled. They also: know their exact location (latitude/longitude) while on water, have a natural "Waterproofing" that keeps them and anything they are touching warm and dry and oxygenated underwater, and can even find underwater people. Also, they swim like a fish. However, they do not have hydrokinesis and are powerless without water.
summary: The ability to gain various enhancements by being in contact with water
strengths: Doubled strength, speed, and healing
Know where they and other people are while at sea
Have a "waterproofing" that keeps them dry and breathing
weaknesses: No hydrokinesis
Powerless when out of water
Physically hurt by water pollution

name: Primordial Sense
description: The Primordial sense is a sixth sense possessed by animals in nature that alerts them of dangerous weather like hurricanes. It's not a premonition or predicition it's more of a feeling or sense that alerts you of near future danger or when danger is lurking around you.
summary: The ability to sense near-future danger in time to flee.
strengths: You are able to flee from the danger in time.
You can save other people from the danger.
weaknesses: People might not believe in the danger you sense.

name: Telesympathy
description: A person with this power does not have telepathy. They have no power over a person's thoughts based on reason. Instead, they have the ability to read people's emotions, motivations, and values. The person immediately knows what kind of person they are talking to and whether they are inherently good or bad in nature. In addition, they can send their emotions to others, so that others can understand their own emotions.
summary: The ability to tell and understand others' motivations, emotions, and values
strengths: You will be an excellent psychologist and can persuade people to turn good/evil
You understand people-something that millions, maybe billions of people can't do
This works in any language, since emotions and goals are universal
weaknesses: Another Pro: You can convey your own emotions back to others, similar to giving a speech
Doesn't work on machines and is less effective on completely rational people
You might be swayed to your opponents side, unless you have a strong will

name: Tachyon Force
description: Being imbued with Tachyon particles enables you to control tachyonic energy. Move, react and see faster than the speed of light. Become invisible to anyone who cannot stop time even when you are not moving. Dodge lightning and lasers. You can nullify teleporters. If something makes contact with you, solid, fluid or energy, it will either be metabolized, disintegrate or explode. Time travel may be possible.
summary: The ability to control tachyon particles
strengths: Move faster than the speed of light
Become invisible, impalpable and invulnerable at the same time
Cause things to disintegrate or explode
weaknesses: You are not able to move at less than lightspeed unless you revert to normal
Reverting to normal takes a monumentous amount of concentration
No control over what happens when you make contact with something in your tachyonic form

name: Egyptian Gods: Monthu
description: Monthu is the Egyptian falcon god of war. He is usually depicted as a falcon-headed man, but turns into a bull-headed man when angered. Users will be able to fight with speed, precision, and strength, as well as have superhuman reflexes. Users will also have the ability to morph into either a bull or a falcon, which are both powerful and deadly creatures.
summary: The ability to have superhuman reflexes and fight well.
strengths: Be extremely fast and accurate while fighting.
Have superhuman reflexes.
Transform into two awesome animals.
weaknesses: Animal transformations are very draining in energy.

name: Emotion Negation
description: With this power you can negate people's emotions. You can make it so that a person will never be angry or sad or happy or scared etc. You can give people back their emotions whenever you want.
summary: The ability to negate people's emotions
strengths: You can negate people's emotions
You can negate villain's emotions for anger making them good
weaknesses: You can't negate your own emotions

name: Planet Energy Absorbsion
description: The ability to absorb energy from plantets. The kind of energy you absorb depends on what planet it comes from. Example: Neptune: Water, Mars:Rock, Earth:Life, Venus:Plants. You can project the energy at foes, surround yourself with energy,or make a sheild with the energy. When you are finished with the energy, you must return it to the planet in which it came, or else the planet will die. With Earth's life energy, you may heal people to a certain extent.
summary: The ability to absorb enegy from planets
strengths: Absorbtion time is really fast
The more planets you know, the more types of energy you can use
Heal people to a certain extent
weaknesses: You must return the energy
After keeping the energy for a long period of time, it grows weaker
You may not use more than one planet's energy at a time

name: Air Cannon
description: Capability to compress air around the user to create a dense sphere of compressed air. The sphere will explode when touched, releasing an energy equal to 10 High Explosive Grenades.
summary: The ability to compress air to get a very dense sphere of compressed air
strengths: Very powerful ability to cause a wide area damage
Become hell pitcher (throw the sphere and see what remains from your enemies)
Become an untrackable terrorist
weaknesses: The sphere is unstable, could explode even with a light touch
Unusable when the air is not present (in space or underwater)
Require a very intense concentration to maintain the stability of the sphere

name: Healing Bomb
description: You could heal anyone, one bomb at a time. Take a second to infuse mud with your healing energy. Your healing bomb explodes on contact with any living thing. You could heal injuries, sickness, replace limbs. You can heal your teammates and repel enemies away from them. You will be an irreplaceable ally.
summary: The ability to turn a ball of mud into a instantaneous healing explosive
strengths: Completely heal anyone in an instant
Anyone caught in the blast radius will be instantly healed of their injury, illness.
You get to throw mud and make pretty sizeable explosion
weaknesses: Could accidentally heal enemies
Need to treat mud with your healing energies to make the bomb work
Bombs don't damage people but does throw them off their feet & does property damage

name: Movie Synchronization
description: With this power you can do anything that you see in movies. You can also make the characters that are in the movie, appear and fight for you.
summary: The ability to do anything associated with movies.
strengths: Copy the powers and abilities of characters in movies.
If your a movie addict, then this is the perfect power for you.
Summon characters that appear in the movie to fight for you.
weaknesses: You can't do anything too extreme (like being God).
You have to have seen the movie and to summon a character you must know their first name at least.
If someone else knows more about a movie than you do, they can find your weaknesses.

name: Emotion Absorption
description: By using eye contact, you can absorb the emotions of those around you and turn it into a variety of powers. Superstrength for anger, water manipulation for depression, invisibility for fear, superspeed for happiness or nervousness, etc.
summary: The ability to absorb the emotions of those around you and turn them into superpowers.
strengths: The more people around, the better
The innocent people are your power source
Even your enemies give you a power
weaknesses: Depressed people will become suicidal
Many people become emotionless
Those close to you are affected

name: Angelic Presence
description: Anyone you encounter will be calmed/fascinated by you and believe that you are an angel. Also they will welcome you into their homes as they will believe that it will bring them good luck.
summary: The ability to have a presence that is angelic
strengths: You may not have any enemies, just people who want to gain your favor.
People may think you're good, even when you're not.
weaknesses: Someone has to know you really well in order for this power to not affect them.

name: Flash Mnemonics
description: This ability is extremely rare, and very powerful. You can recall people you've met or thought of before, and also recall any kind of power or ability that someone had. It works through 'flashes' of someone you've seen or met, or of someone using an ability, such as regeneration or telekinesis. The user can then rely on the memory they have of someone to activate the same ability that that person displayed. It is different from empathic mimicry in that you rely on memory instead of empathy.
summary: The ability to recall people and/or powers through memories when in a dangerous situation
strengths: Flashbacks of abilities allow split-second replication of a power
Can be used in any dire situation
Once a person recalls someone, they get their ability permanently
weaknesses: Does not work if you aren't in a dire situation
You might remember someone with a dangerous ability

name: Call Of The Guardian
description: A spirit, usually a type of demon, when called upon takes a physical form and aids you in battle. The spirit can have two physical forms. For example, a wolf demon will have the form of a majestic powerful wolf, and a cute cuddly puppy form.
summary: The ability to call upon your guardian spirit.
strengths: Aids you in battle
Is bound to you for life
If your reincarnated, it will take a new form too
weaknesses: You to are bound to it, therefore you feel its pain if its hurt
Only have one guardian

name: X Men Powers
description: With this power you can gain all of the powers of any superhero who was or is an X-Men. However you can only use the powers of one hero a day. Once you choose the hero you are stuck with his or her powers for a full 24 hours.
summary: The ability to have the powers of one X-Men every day
strengths: You can gain the powers of any X-Men
weaknesses: You can only use one a day

name: The Butterfly Effect
description: Just like in the movie you could go back in your life and choose to fix things in your past, see what really happened during certain moments, play out different scenarios, etc.
summary: The ability to go back into specific places in your life through the memory of that moment
strengths: Fix mistakes that you or others have made
Have fun with the question"what could have happened"
weaknesses: Can only  go as far back as your first memory
If you die in a memory, you will be completely erased from the world

name: Autopyro
description: By thinking of something on fire, it will light on fire for real. That something will not burn, but the fire can burn other people or things.
summary: The ability to light things on fire (including yourself) without physically harming them/you
strengths: You can light yourself on fire to fight, a la Human Torch
You will be fine afterwards
The fire is still real and can burn other people
weaknesses: The fire can still burn other people
It can cause immense panic
It can expose you

name: Rpg Stats Holograph
description: Anytime you see someone you can also see a holographic display of the stats the person would have as an RPG character. The display shows the level, HP, strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom, and charisma of the person. It will also show what class they would be as a roleplaying character. The holograph will last for as long as you want it to.
summary: The ability to see holographs with people's stats as roleplaying characters
strengths: You know who is more powerful than you and can avoid fights with them.
You're the only one who can see the holographs.
weaknesses: Having this power on auto will fill your vision with the holographs and make you go crazy.
Can be resisted

name: The Lycan Within
description: You can become the 'second-generation' werewolf from 'Underworld', called a Lycan, and have superbly enhanced senses, strength, stamina, and reflexes. Wolfsbane vastly enhances regeneration if used on wounds, and also augments your senses and strength if directly consumed, or the aroma inhaled briefly.
