You are immune to normal silver, and can extract bullets by consciously focusing on them, but the liquid silver nitrate is very dangerous, working by destroying the brain's regenerative power.
summary: The ability to shift into a powerful werewolf form
strengths: People can have senses and reflexes far beyond any human or animal
You retain some human thought and reasoning
Your werewolf form makes you the perfect crime-fighter!
weaknesses: Some people might fear you as a werewolf (Lycan)
Normal silver is harmless, but the chemical silver nitrate, in doses over 200 mg(2 ml), is lethal
Smaller doses of silver nitrate(from 20-199 mg) hinders regeneration and shifting, and dulls senses

name: Shadow Blade(S)
description: This is a very useful ability that may require practice to master.   What it does is that you focus the shadow energy around you and fashion it into a blade or two. These blades can take any shape or size.
summary: The ability to summon up blades of different size, shape, and style for the shadows around and inside of you
strengths: Helps in bad situations
Gives you a good weapon to fight with
Can be any size of style of any sword, even fictional
weaknesses: Could summon the blade inside of you, if your inside shadows are the only ones available
These blades could act on their own

name: Biological Immortality
description: An individual with Biological Immortality is unique in many ways. First, they stop aging after their first child is born. Second, they are undistracted by any trauma directed against them--a Biological Immortal can lose limbs, vital organs, and parts of their head and continue to function. Third is that they will not naturally heal; gaping wounds will remain for months. Even simple paper cuts must be bandaged.
summary: The ability to be unfazed by any physical trauma
strengths: Effectively immortal
Can lose important pieces (chunks of head, etc. ) and still function
You are no longer very stoppable
weaknesses: Effectively immortal
Will not naturally heal
May become egotistical and maniacal

name: Air Travel
description: You turn into air and can ride air currents or create your own to travel on. It can be difficult to turn back to your original form again the first time. It takes practice to create your own air currents.
summary: The ability to turn into air to travel extremely fast
strengths: Can escape dangerous situations.
Can't fall to your death.
weaknesses: Is difficult to revert to your original form the first time you change
Takes practice to create air currents

name: Chaos Manipulation
description: You can suddenly see and manipulate the negative energy that causes chaos. You manifest the negative energy in your hands, so in order to cause chaos, you must touch the target or expel the negative energy in the form of a "chaos bolt" This ability only affects people or objects in negative ways. People and animals could experience weakness, aging, random cuts and bruises, sickness, and/or death. Objects will become broken, rust or weakened. Plants will wilt. Nothing is safe from your abilities.
summary: The ability to see the possibiltiy of chaos and cause it or force chaos in a non-chaotic situation.
strengths: Nothing and no-one is safe from your powers.
The chaos can get worse the longer you touch someone with negative energy
Great for Revenge in any way. Have someone trip on the floor or fall through it.
weaknesses: No choice to see chaos probability, can cause you to become insane
temptation to cause chaos, it builds if you don't use your abilities
needs hands to manipulate the negative energy and eyes to see chaos possibility

name: Lightning Vortex
description: One hand becomes positive, the other negative. Electricity will start to flow between both hands and your body. The longer you can keep the circuit going the stronger the final blast will be. Ex: 1 minute can destroy a house while 1 hour can destroy a town. Maximum destructive power is a full city which takes five hours. All that will be left of whatever is hit will be a crater. While charging the user's body will be immune to all harmful electrical effects.
summary: The ability to charge up electricity then fire it off in a blast
strengths: You can destroy enemy bases from a long distance away.
weaknesses: If your circuit is broken by an someone else your body will get huge amounts of electricity running
(cont) rampant through it and you will most likely die.
It takes a long time to get to maximum charge.

name: Magic Garnet Summon
description: This ability allows you to summon an ancient magical garnet necklace, that gives powerful magical abilities to the wearer. The garnet gives the wearer the ability to summon crimson energies that can be formed into different constructs. It also gives you the ability to transmute anything into garnet, or to summon large amounts of non-magical garnet out of nowhere. Only the pure of heart can use the magic. You can make the necklace disappear at any time.
summary: The ability to summon a garnet necklace that gives the wearer magical powers.
strengths: Summon a powerful magical artifact.
It grants the user many powers.
Only the pure of heart can use it.
weaknesses: You could lose it.
Only one garnet necklace at a time.

name: Terra Sapiens
description: With this power, you can transfer your intelligence, personality and conscience into the Earth, or any other planet you are standing on. You can see everything that happens on the planet, feel everything, smell everything, etc. You can see what happens on one side of the world, and use the Earth to talk to people there. You can then go back to your old body.
summary: The ability to transfer your conscience, intelligence and personallity into the Earth or any planet you are on
strengths: Talk to relatives or friends on the other side of the world to your physical body.
See if anything is happening dangerously.
weaknesses: You'd be in pain if people are currently mining out of you, an things like that.

name: Omni Substitution
description: The user can act as a substitute for anything another person needs him to be, a power source, transportation, e food or a person of a certain profession. At first, this ability only activates when the need for a substitution is issued. The user can master it so that they do not need another person to issue the need for substitution.
summary: The ability to become a substitute of anything.
strengths: Become a substitute for anything else.
Have all the abilities of the thing you are substituting for.
weaknesses: Without training, the ability does not activate until substitution is needed.
The abilities of the thing you are substituting for are temporary.

name: Cardboard Enhancement
description: Have you ever pretended that a cardboard tube was a sword, or spyglass? Have you ever gone on an imaginary flight in a cardboard box rocket ship, or used one as a time machine?   This power makes it so that cardboard takes on the properties of what you imagine it to be. A tube really is a spyglass, a cardboard sword will really cut, a cardboard box "drives" along the ground like a race-car, and the walls of a cardboard box fort really will stave off attack.
summary: The ability to have cardboard act as the thing you're pretending it is.
strengths: If you can imagine something that cardboard can imitate, it acts as that thing.
Operatinbg a cardboard box is as easy as it was when you were a kid.
As in, you don't need to know how to fly a real rocket ship to fly a cardboard box imitating one.
weaknesses: Cardboard reverts back to normal if it gets wet.

name: Temporal Restoration Field
description: TRFs allow you to reload points of time. By creating a TRF and restoring it, you will be taken backwards in time to that point. Minor restoration fields can be used to repair objects or heal people by restoring it to an earlier state, without the need to create a TRF for them. You can duplicate things by reloading their TRF too. Also comes with an innate understanding of TRFs, enough so that someone with sufficient engineering skills might be able to make a TRF Machine with your knowledge/help.
summary: The ability to manipulate "Temporal Restoration Fields"
strengths: Load a gun with one clip, then just reload the TRF from its loaded state when it runs out.
Hopeless situation? Want to time travel? Load a TRF. Someone injured? Reload the state of their body
See a nice car/weapon/whatever? Reload its TRF and have it.
weaknesses: Loading a TRF made in the future takes you back to that future, regardless of changes to the past
Can't go back further than when you got the power, you go back to the place you made the TRF
You must have encountered an object to duplicate it, it must have been functioning once to repair

name: Temporal Artifact: Matchbook
description: The matchbook contains any number of matches you choose. You can make as many of the books as you want, and anyone can use them and the matches within. You must use up or destroy a book to be rid of it though. When a match is lit, time pauses for everything save the holder, anyone touching them, anything they're carrying, and the air around them. You can move objects, but you can't bring new things into paused time. When the *FLAME* goes out, time is restored, but a match can only be used once.
summary: The ability to spawn time-pausing matchbooks at will
strengths: True time pausing, in a convenient gift form. You can have unlimited matches in a book.
The flame carries the power, so you can have a lot of extra time if you can get a candle.
You can steal, kill, work, etc. in zero seconds. Or, even better... You can light a dark area!
weaknesses: The summoned books can be stolen, watch out in particular for books with unlimited matches.
Water doesn't flow. If you start a fire, it can take a while to put out and get people killed.
If you're not careful when moving things/people, they'll go flying/break bones.

name: Death Transfer
description: When you are dying because of a bullet wound, sword stab or any other reason, you can spare your life at the expense of another life by just thinking of the unlucky victim. Your injury is instantly healed and the victim takes the hit for you. If you do not think of someone while you are dying from a lethal blow, a random person will be chosen for you.
summary: The ability to transfer a lethal blow onto somebody else.
strengths: Never die from physical attacks
Injury is instantly healed: you can be healed from cancer by transferring it.
Can do life-risking stunts without fear of dying
weaknesses: If you do not think of someone when dying, a random civilian dies. A friend or family member can die
Can still die from age or disease
Does not transfer pain or damage if not lethal.

name: Retrocognitive Projection
description: One with this ability needs only to be in an area for an instant, and they can pick up on psychic vibrations left behind by others who have been there. This psychic-vibration channeling allows the projections of a 3-D holographic image of the area's past. This can be used on any are previously visited by sentient/animated/living beings (people, ghosts and undead, plants, robots, aliens ALL count)
summary: The ability to produce images of the past of an area
strengths: Project the past of an area (who committed a crime, who took the cookie from the cookie jar, etc. )
Looks like the event is really happening (great form of illusion that few are immune to)
Psychic imprints are left in areas all the time
weaknesses: If a place has never been visited before, you could only project the scene of you visiting
If power is undeveloped, can't control how far back into the past to project (Stone Age, 1850's etc)
True Sight is able to see through this projection (the only powerc that CAN)

name: Strike Delay
description: With this power you can delay the strikes of your attacks until you choose to trigger them. Your initial attack dose no damage, but you can then choose to trigger the strike whenever you want. Say you punch someone 3 times in the face with this power. It would be as if they had not even gotten punched. But, you could then trigger those punches at a later date. This power also works with objects and space. You can leave an attack hanging in the air to catch someone off guard.
summary: The ability to delay the impact of your attacks.
strengths: Control when your attack connects.
Works with any type of damage from physical or weapon strikes to energy blasts.
Set traps by leaving attacks hanging in space until called upon.
weaknesses: You can not trigger individual attacks. When you trigger they all strike at once.

name: Bookworm Immunity
description: Matter of any form, energy of any form, psionic or magical damage, if you can understand how an attack might work you're immune to it. Viruses, poisons, venoms and also bacteria. This power will protect you from deadly gases, but not let you survive vacuum. However, it would let you survive extreme cold or heat. If you can grasp how reality altering works, then no one could erase you from reality. Know how telepathy works and no one could erase any knowledge from your mind.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by anything you can understand.
strengths: Most non-psionic or non-magical things will be easy to learn about.
The easiest immunities just require Internet access.
weaknesses: Reality alteration could require a genius level IQ.
Knowledge about something esoteric, like magic, could be hard to find.

name: Short Term Memory Eraser
description: It allows you to wipe out someone's short-term memory before the information has a chance to be consolidated in the long-term memory. You do not have to touch your target; you just need to be in their vicinity, allowing you to erase many people's short-term memory at the same time. Be aware that if some information had time to form enough connections with the long-term memory, the person will experience a sense of presque vu, as the information has disappeared but the connections still remain.
summary: The ability to erase someone's short-term memory.
strengths: You can erase anyone's memory of the last seconds or minute.
You JUST did something wrong? Quick! Wipe out everyone's memory!
You know how frustrating it is to feel you just forgot something but can't remember it at all?
weaknesses: There's a short time frame before a recent memory is either forgotten or remembered for a long time.
You can't select which information to erase. There's not much information to choose from anyway.
It's much less effective on people with Enhanced Memory, Infinite Memory Palace or Digital Mind.

name: Life Absorption
description: With this ability, you can steal life from any living organism, giving you it's life, and leaving you more powerful than before. For example, you could steal life from a wolf, or even from a tree. It increases your physical performance every time you use this ability, making you potentially very powerful. Life that you steal from slowly withers away as you become stronger.
summary: The ability to steal life from living animals or other forms of life
strengths: Take the life of any living organism and steal it for yourself, such as animals, plants, even grass
Increases your life and physical performance, making you potentially extremely powerful
If you're still in your growing stage, it will increase the rate of your growth if you use it often
weaknesses: The life which you steal it from slowly withers away as you become stronger
You could accidentally use this ability on someone that you know (though it can be switched off)
Leaves you with a lust to absorb more life

name: Heaven's Light
description: You raise your hands towards the sky and say the following words: Heaven release thy wrath!  And as the last word leaves your mouth the sky unleashes a beam of pure light on the chosen location you had in mind, making an explosion when it hits something within the radius of the blast (100 feet).
summary: The ability to make a divine light explosion.
strengths: Great to send those who form a treat against you on a holiday.
You can blast anything at any time at any location.
Light also blinds those who prefer darker locations.
weaknesses: If they interrupt you when you are saying the words, the attack is canceled.
You can't hit your target if there is no sky.
If you think about yourself while saying those words you WILL kill yourself.

name: Nanotechnosis
description: The tiny robots that you control can be programmed to build, destroy and cover yourself with metal
summary: The ability to control tiny robots
strengths: Can change anything metallic into something different, e.g. a car into a cannon.
Can have artifical abilities, e.g. super strong and fast
Can't get hurt by a high fall or a big explosion
weaknesses: Have to keep your memories in a computer
Can be hacked
Becomes weak when wet

name: Controle De Les Spirte
description: You can stop everything that is going on in this person's body and mind, including the heart. They're your own personal puppet. You can control up to 1000 people doing this. In battle, it'll be easy to kill your opponent. You can go into their mind and see their memories. You can't control them for more then 5 minutes though. Not even a mental shield can break this. It is strong and will cause awful pain to the victim once it is over. You will receive a headache after though.
summary: The ability to control someone's mind, body, soul, heart, and thoughts.
strengths: You can control anyone
You can control as much as 1000 people at once
You can kill them by just stopping their heart
weaknesses: You lose your common sense and mercy when you are doing this
You get a headache after
You lose at least 100 brain cells.

name: Induced Explosion
description: A person with Induced Explosion has one of the more dangerous abilities. By mentally damaging the atomic structure of an object, they make it so unstable it has to blow up. This ability is not limited to combustibles--wood, plastic, even metal can be made to blow up. However, it is limited to solids and takes active concentration to use.
summary: The ability to make objects explode
strengths: Blowing up cars
Can explode any solid object
Intimidation factor
weaknesses: No real peaceful use
Cannot make liquids/gases explode
Getting angry

name: Rare
description: Being rare is useful and enjoyable. You can be immune to mimickers because you can have the trait of being one of a kind. You can be protected like rare things so you can have wards etc. You can also use the rare things general attribute of being loved so that people are kind to you and will like you. You can also increase your value to people so many more positions are now available to you. Other attributes of rare things can also be valid for you
summary: The ability to manipulate the aspects and attributes of rare things in yourself.
strengths: Pros cant be negated.
It is good to be valuable.
weaknesses: Can be affected by power sacrifice.

name: Internet Celebrity
description: You can control, summon, and manipulate the Internet/Internet-related things. You can go inside the Internet into a Tron-type world of websites, summon Internet memes, and other stuff. For example, you could summon the 'Stop the rock' meme and cause a huge boulder to chase your enemies.
summary: The ability to control, summon, and manipulate the Internet.
strengths: Nearly limitless due to the Internet's expanse
This website is included, so you can grab any power off of here!
Transportation into other computers
weaknesses: Your strength depends on the connection in the area.
Must have a browser installed, working, and open to move around computers
Some memes would be extremely chaotic to bring into the real world.

name: Atomicity
description: Also called Indivisibility, one with this ability has a powerful defense. The user's body cannot be divided by any means. This means that his body cannot lose limbs, cannot be dismembered, cannot be vaporized, cannot have its soul forcibly removed, cannot have powers forcibly stolen and cannot have positive psychic links broken. In fact, it even prevents inconvenience with joint conditions, because the joints are designed to keep the body perfectly together, for the rest of the user's life.
summary: The ability to resist being forcibly divided
strengths: Prevents dismemberment, power theft and Astral Eviction (makes psychic links unbreakable)
Never worry about joint problems
Doesn't disallow Anatomical Automatism, Astral Projection or other voluntary separation powers
weaknesses: Doesn't prevent ALL types of damage (acid, fire, electricity, psychic attacks, etc. )
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a physical level
Sometimes, the indivisibility only works on a mental level

name: Sonic Bomb
description: You take a deep breath and blast the sound from your body. Your body will amplify the resulting sound in the area, making the blast bigger. The bigger the sound you make, the stronger the reaction.
summary: The ability to blow up an area with sound waves
strengths: people can never touch you as use it
in a life or death situation you can stop the bad guys
the military can't touch you
weaknesses: you can't use a big wave in big public areas
you have to watch your tone at people
you can't be too loud or you could destroy a big area

name: Power Source
description: This power is sort of a telepathy/empathy-based power. The user can create a mental link with any superpowered being. Now, the user can tap into that power and store it somewhere in their mind. Now, the user can use that power whenever they want. The amount of powers the user can hold in their mind depends on their mental strength. If the user were to store too much power in their mind, it would most likely cause permanent brain damage, and judging on the amount, can possibly destroy the user.
summary: The ability to take power from the source of anyone's power.
strengths: Tap into other superpowered beings powers.
weaknesses: Limits to amount of power being stored in the mind.

name: Entropy Manipulation
description: A person with Entropy Manipulation can control how focused the energy of an object is. If they decrease the amount of concentrated energy avaliable the remainder bleeds off as heat and the object can thus do less work; in simple terms, packs less of a punch. Bullets become hard blows, hard blows become light powderpuffs. While dispersal takes less energy/focus, concentrating energy requires much focus. The effects, however, are amazing; thrown pins can pierce a human head. Effects are temporary.
summary: The ability to make energy more usable or more dispersed
strengths: User gains command over integral natural force
Can disperse work energy into heat (punches into powderpuffs)
Can concentrate heat into work energy (powderpuffs into punches)
weaknesses: Requires basic grasp of Second Law of Thermodynamics for full potential
Much harder to coalesce energy than to disperse it
Objects that undergo dispersion warmer; objects that undergo concentration colder

name: Tornado Teleport
description: You are in a praying position spinning like a tornado, literally drills yourself into the floor & reappear in front or behind of your foe. You can even spin and vanish to another location.
summary: The ability to spin & disappear in front or behind your opponent.
strengths: It can be of great use to confuse and surprise your enemies.
weaknesses: None

name: Hole Creation
description: This power enables you to open a hole on any surface you're concentrating on, through a process of displacing its material away. Any hole you created stays open if you stop concentrating on them. You can expand the hole or deepen it, move it around or even close it by reversing the process and allowing the material to move back into place. Any object caught in the hole while it's closing can either stop the process if the material is too soft or friable, or be crushed if the material is harder.
summary: The ability to open holes through any layers of material and to manipulate them
strengths: Reach whatever is inside a closed container or behind a wall.
Go through any wall by creating a passage through it.
Trap anything or anyone by opening a hole beneath them.
weaknesses: Don't forget about your holes on the ground. You could fall accidently!
Only works on inorganic matter.

name: Electrostatic Charge
description: Electrostatic Charge is a unique ability. The user can produce massive amounts of electricity from their body--up to 300,000 volts, which is enough to kill 10 men. But, they can only put this into metal. Therefore, if they have no metal, they cannot release any electricity.
summary: The ability to charge metal with electricity by touch
strengths: Up to 300,000 volts
Electrified swords, iron pipes, etc.
Can recharge batteries
weaknesses: Can only release electricity into metal
Can only absorb half of what you generate
Must touch metal

name: Dimensional Teleportation
description: You can go straight to where you would be in the exact same spot in another dimensions.
summary: The ability to teleport to other Dimensions
strengths: You can go to a different dimension before you are killed
You can get tons of friends all over the dimensions
You might end in a girls' locker room
weaknesses: You might go into space
You need to wait 1 hour until you can go to another dimension
Something bad happens to what dimension you leave

name: Accelerated Test Taking
description: With this power you can take any test, quiz or questioner at an accelerated pace. You still get all the answers you would've gotten had you took more time to think about the questions and then go over your work. It take you about three and a half seconds to complete each multiple choice question. Ten seconds for short answer and about a minute to do essay questions.
summary: The ability to take tests or quizes at an advanced speed
strengths: You can take tests at an accelerated pace
You get the same answers
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
It still take some time just not as much

name: Master Of Inventions
description: The user is able to invent something that is unique that can be either used for offensive or defensive purposes. This power also covers the planning phase. The user cannot build inventions of other people at a 100%
summary: The ability to invent something unique
strengths: Good at inventing gadgets
Unique inventions, only you can use it or only allies
weaknesses: Can't reverse engineer enemy gadgets perfectly

name: Big Bang
description: With this power all you would have to do is point at an object and yell BANG! the object would create an explosion that damages all matter in a three yard vicinity of that spot leaving a black hole leading to oblivion or command the hole to suck in all matter and stop after the things you don't want are gone. Then all you would have to do is concentrate on what you want in place of the hole and you just and you just created a whole object out of nothing.
summary: The ability to obliterate one or many objects in one area and fill it in with your own creation
strengths: You could destroy an entire evil fortress or superhero headquarters in a mere moment
You could create impossible things
You can start the world anew and rule it
weaknesses: The more mass you destroy and create the more of your energy you waste
You can't use this ability to recreate yourself in total perfection because you will be destroyed
You can't use it on the time space continum or everything will fall apart

name: Decentralization
description: Decentralization allows the user to voluntarily expand himself across several parallel realities or dimensions. When split, damage is only applied to "slices" directly affected. If you were to split many times immediately before a blast, for example, you could let only 1/1000'th of you take the damage, and re-merge essentially unharmed. At least one "slice" must remain in the reality of origin, and the thinner spread the user is, the less he is affected by, or can affect, his surroundings.
summary: The ability to split your existence between multiple realities.
strengths: Quick reflexes can make for effective invulnerability.
Can be used to make one less noticable, which is perfect for stealth.
Can be used to make decoys.
weaknesses: The thinner a user is spread, the less he can sense and interact with any given reality.
The thiner a slice is, the easier it is to destroy; even weak attacks can be lethal if synchronized.
If one slice is obstructed, all slices are obsructed. Obstructions may exist in other realities.

name: Darksiders: Serpent Road
description: The Serpent Road is a sub-space where you must walk along a stone path in an empty void. Just pick the location you wish to travel to, and you will be taken into the Serpent Road. Once you make it to the portal at the end of the road, you will be at your destination.
summary: The ability to travel miles within seconds.
strengths: Travel from Seattle to New York City in one minute!
Never have to pay for plane tickets ever
weaknesses: This is not teleportation; you still have to do some form of travel

name: Answer Me
description: With this power, everyone has to answer a question you impose and cannot attack you while they are answering questions since their mind is preoccupied.   After the question is answered the person forgets that he/she answered the question.  If the other person does not know the answer then the other person will go into a trance and will move to find the answer.  If it is a math problem the other person will go into "calculator mode" and attempt to calculate the answer
summary: The ability to make anyone answer your question truthfully
strengths: Get info on people and person forgets that he/she answered
Forced calculation-make anyone into a human calculator
Can be used to blackmail or prevent blackmail
weaknesses: You can only get what people think is the right answer
If the answer cannot be answered then other person's mind becomes entranced
If you ask a rhetorical question this ability activates even on yourself

name: Electrified Fire
description: Anyone it touches will be electrified and burned simultaneously. The fire is of a medium temperature, closer to normal fire than the blue of stars. The temperature differs for each person.
summary: The ability to create and control fire that has lightning surrounding it
strengths: Getting burned/electrocuted is bad enough separately but simultaneously has to be 100 times worse.
weaknesses: You can never separate the lightning from the fire (may be a pro).

name: Selective Invulnerability
description: The user of this power can be only invulnerable to one specific threat to his or her life. For example, if a user of this power chooses to be invulnerable to being injured by physical contact, then powers like super strength has no effect on them. But if the get hit by a concussive beam then they will become vulnerable and get injured
summary: The ability to be invulnerable to a specific thing only
strengths: Invulnerability
weaknesses: Only invulnerable to one certain power
Easily defeated if weakness is known

name: Matrix
description: With it you can collect as much information about something as you want. You can also train or relax as long as you want. You don't physically go there as only your mind taken. You even remote control your body! It is in essence a computer / virtual world on demand.
summary: The ability to step into and out of a virtual world
strengths: Unlimited access to information
Play games in "reality"
Do whatever you want on the computer.
weaknesses: Your body is left in the real world
You die if your body does

name: Moreaumancy
description: You can exactly fuse together between man and beast by turning any animal into a human being and/or human being into any animal species with glowing gestures of your hands.
summary: The ability to turn animals into humans or humans into animals.
strengths: It might be kind of cool to some.
weaknesses: It might be kind of gross at some times.
Some might never accept transformations.
You'll be forever branded as an outcast.

name: Shadow Stealing
description: You can steal people's shadows with this power, and when you do, they not only lose their shadow, but they lose their reflection, their voice, their emotions and their opinions (as well as their need to blink, eat, sleep, rest or breathe). It's like they don't exist (and nobody can perceive them except you). And that's perfect, because during this time of "nonexistence", they become entirely loyal to you, and do whatever you want.
summary: The ability to steal the shadows of others, gaining total control over them
strengths: Steal a person's shadow, and they become totally-loyal servants
They lose their emotions, their opinions and their need to eat, sleep or breathe
Only you can perceive them (and you can control them mentally)
weaknesses: Some users can't communicate mentally with their minions (looks like you're talking to yourself)
Umbrakinetics, Immutables and people with Fixed Forms can keep their shadows
The subjects that become your minions aren't mindless, but they try to follow you everywhere

name: Dark Wing
description: You can fly. Your wings can't be hurt but can be injured. In rage mode, your true wings would show up (from 2 pairs of black angel wings to 6 of them), and if you're fat, ugly or short haired, when in normal wing mode, your body will change, but it could hurt a lot!
summary: The ability to fly, defend yourself, counterattack the enemy and enter a "rage" mode
strengths: You can fly.
Your wing can defend you.
When your wing is injured, the blood that flows out burns everything it touches.
weaknesses: When in rage, you can't choose whom to attack, even if friend or foe.
When in normal mode, you get a little bit tired.
When the wings get in/out of your body, it's so painful.

name: Gift: Shadows
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling shadows and darkness than other beings. Thus their shadow- or darkness-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of darkness from them. However, someone with this power can only receive shadow-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of shadows and darkness
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over the shadows as someone with this power.
Shadow-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only shadow-based powers now.

name: Laser Vision
description: One with Laser Vision can shoot lasers out of their eyes. There are seven different colors of lasers you could shoot. Red, blue, yellow, pink, white, black and green.  Red lasers burn things with extreme heat. Blue lasers vaporize things. Yellow shocks things. Pink kills things. White heals things. Black kills things. Green makes nature-like things appear.  There is a firing limit of 10 lasers a day.
summary: The ability to shoot lasers from your eyes
strengths: You can finally be FIRING YOUR LAZOR!
You can heal your friends.
You can burn/shock/vaporize/lill the Villain.
weaknesses: Your lasers bounce off mirrors and other things that reflect light.
Accidently healing the Villain/Bully/BadGuy you're fighting. Accidently killing people you like.
Limit of amount per day fired.

name: Nephilim
description: The Nephilim, also known as the "fallen ones", were the offspring of fallen angels and humans. You are capable of utilizing any powers or abilities your ancestors may have had. These abilities may refer to the natural elements, spirituality, and magic. Although you are not a full-blooded angel, you are still quite powerful.
summary: The ability to inherit the powers of your angelic relatives or bloodline.
strengths: Easily vanquish foes with rays of light.
A fearsome warrior in strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance alike.
Wield enchanted swords imbued with light or darkness.
weaknesses: You are only half-angel.
You do not possess wings, your flight is limited and is considered a glide.

name: Tolerance
description: This power lets you build up a tolerance to most things, even negation of powers. You have to endure the thing to tolerate it and this power can't be negated for obvious reasons. You can build up a tolerance to damage or poison, and tolerances last forever.
summary: The ability to build up a tolerance to most things.
strengths: Tolerance to negation.
Tolerances last forever.
weaknesses: Tolerance does not mean immunity.
Just a small tolerance.

name: Size Shifting
description: Having this power, you will be able to increase  or decrease your size. To being as tall as a 100 story building down to the size of a molecule. The drawback is that you can't grow & shrink rapidly or your body structure will become unstable.
summary: The ability to grow or shrink at will
strengths: Become a giant
Shrink to the size of an ant
weaknesses: can't size shift rapidly or body structure will become unstable
1,000 ft. is the max limit you can grow to
Cannot shrink past the size of a molecule

name: Auto Locking
description: This is a mental power that allows you to lock things by just thinking about them. For example, say you forgot to lock your house. Poof!... The door automatically locks. Even better, this isn't confined to doors and other things with locks on them. Anything that can be opened can be auto-locked. Only you can open something that's auto-locked. This power is very useful for protecting valuable objects.
summary: The ability to lock anything automatically.
strengths: Automatically lock anything by thinking about it.
Only you can unlock the locked item
Useful for protecting valuable items
weaknesses: Unlocker, Janus' Key etc.

name: Fairy Maker
description: People often refer to a "(something) fairy" as a joke or expression to say something is almost magical. For example, upon learning that junk mail was very flammable, someone joked "it's like a combustible fairy visits my mailbox and gives me gifts". You just think of a description for a fairy (and any other details you want, but they have to be tiny female humanoids with brightly colored insect wings), its typical task, and snap! The fairy will soon visit you in the night to bestow its benefits.
summary: The ability to make a fairy for any task
strengths: Can get anything you can make a fairy for, and you can befriend them/have them serve other tasks
Have lots of little friends to call upon, if you befriend all the ones you make
You can steal their wands for magical effects, or eat them to regain health (they'll ALL hate you)
weaknesses: You can call upon fairies as you want, but their first post-creation visit is always in the night,
While you're in bed (though not necessarily when you're sleeping).
If you don't make it specific, they'll also delever gifts to other people, based on some criteria
tags: kind of creepy sneaking in like that

name: Steam Blaster
description: You could send out a flow of radiating steam to damage opponents. Can be used both in the air & on the ground. It is extremely effective against water and ice type adversaries. Against fire, not so much...
summary: The ability to send out waves of steam to damage foes.
strengths: Extremely useful for melting frozen obstacles.
weaknesses: It does not affect fire type foes.

name: Gifting Or Giving A Gift
description:
The limits of this ability are not known. With this ability you can give any man woman or living creature any thing they desire from immorality to flight. 
in order to gift or bless someone a payment must be made to you. Payment can be what ever you choose such as a piece of paper. Or money. Or even the individuals soul
summary: The ability to bless or gift anyone with any gift he or she desires
strengths: You will be loved by everyone you bless or gift
weaknesses: You can not give yourself a gift.
All though. You can requre as payment the individual to give the gift back to you at anytime you
Choose allowing you to aquire said gift

name: Legendary Pokemon Summon
description: With this power you can summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon from any generation of the series. They are under your complete control and removing them from their universe will not cause their universe to go into a state of chaos as the capture of legends usually does. You can only summon up to four legendary pokemon at a time and when you're done you can just send them back.
summary: The ability to summon any of the 47 legendary pokemon
strengths: You can summon any legendary pokemon
You want cause the Pokemon universe to fall into a state of chaos
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: You can only summon up to four at a time

name: Light Immunity
description: Light-based powers and techniques can't harm you but they can still help you.
summary: The ability to be immune to the harmful effects of light
strengths: Eliminates a weakness if you are a vampire.
Eliminates a good number of MythPowers from affecting you.
weaknesses: No, this power will not make you invisible (No Con Negation).
Darkness and shadow-based powers are not considered light-based by this power(No Con Negation).

name: The Chamber Of Understanding
description: With this ability, all you have to do is state the words "I'll be in The Chamber of Understanding! " like professor Farnsworth fro Futurama. The chamber has a disco ball inside and different types of music that plays inside of it. The chamber has an endless supply of oxygen, the perfect temperature/humidity level, and blocks out distractions. The chamber is made out of a transparant, durable material that's harder than glass. Understand chemistry, the cure for cancer, world peace, and the truth.
summary: The ability to make a chamber drop out of nowhere that allows you to understand things better.
strengths: Understand things you never thought possible.
Be at peace within the chamber. No distractions!
You can understand very helpful and abstract subjects more.
weaknesses: Although it takes less time, it may still take a really long time to understand something.
You still need to study or you might not have enough information to understand.
Secret societies run by insane people might stop you from thinking and understanding. Thought police

name: Natural Probability Replay
description: This ability allows one make something that does not appear normally and makes it become more naturally. Here is a perfect example. Lightning strikes near you and then you use this ability. Now, you can summon lightning as reoccurring thing. As in, It will happen more often and probability will accept it as the norm, and the user can have control over that as well.
summary: The ability to make things that do not occur naturally become common place and control it.
strengths: Make things that do not usually occur in nature or probabilty become common place.
Have full control over these new natural phenomenons.
Make something that happen only once become a natural occurrence.
weaknesses: You can only control new occurrences not nature or probability itself.

name: Vacuum Seal
description: With a touch, you can seal/unseal an object in a vacuum. When used on food, it can keep it fresh and bacteria-free. Vacuum-sealed objects are also completely insulated, and as such are incapable of being affected by wind, sound, fire, or any other thing that is dependent on air to exist or move. When used on living beings, it suffocates them, and causes various other disturbances to their biological systems. You, however, are immune to the effects of vacuums (although you still need to breath).
summary: The ability to seal objects in a vacuum, preserving them and insulating them from the air
strengths: Can keep food fresh simply by touching it
Can make objects insulated against air-related things
Can incapacitate most enemies with a touch
weaknesses: If sealing yourself, you better take a big breath first
Needless to say, enemies who can survive vacuums are unaffected by this power
If you seal yourself, you won't be able to hear anything, since sound is reliant on air

name: Temporary Weapons Knowledge
description: With this power you have complete knowledge on a weapon and how to use a weapon, assuming a couple of conditions are met. One if that you have to be holding the weapon and the second is that you only have this knowledge while you're in danger. As soon as the danger is gone or you let go of the weapon you lose the knowledge.
summary: The ability to have complete knowledge of any weapon that you are holding while you are in danger
strengths: Knowledge of weapons
weaknesses: Only works while you're holding the weapon
Only works while you're in danger

name: Mental Route Navigation
description: This power allows an individual to instantly find a path to or from any point instantly, either between that point and their current location or between two other locations. This factors in not only mundane routes such as driving or walking, but also factors in things like public transportation and allows for the supernatural, such as finding a path to a different time or reality. It even factors in side benefits, such as support of local business or exercise.
summary: The ability to think of a location and find a suitable path to that point.
strengths: Factors in cost (monetary and otherwise) as well as timetables.
You can find any possible route, unless actively hidden, almost certainly through non-mundane means.
You immediately know of a short list of the best options, rather than having to do it manually.
weaknesses: Almost entirely useless if you have other travel-related powers, such as teleportation.
Only useful for travel; no point if you are not travelling or are satisfied with your current route.
Does not warn you of most dangers along the route.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow Double
description: With this power, you can separate from your shadow, turning your shadow into a duplicate of yourself. This shadow duplicate has your exact appearance, knowledge, skills, and powers. It can function by itself exactly like you would, but it is also completely obedient to you. You can use the shadow duplicate to be in two places at once, or you can double your chances of winning a fight. If the shadow duplicate dies, you are left unharmed
summary: The ability to turn your shadow into a duplicate of yourself
strengths: Two of you is better than one, be it for difficult fights or conflicting obligations
The shadow can do everything you can do, and it will do whatever you tell it to do
You are unharmed if the shadow duplicate is harmed
weaknesses: Neither you nor the duplicate will cast a shadow while this power is in use
You can only summon one duplicate at a time
If your shadow duplicate dies, you must wait half an hour to summon a new one

name: Diamond Mimicry
description: Diamonds are forged in the depths of the earth and are the hardest substances known to man. A Diamond Mimic can convert their body into solid diamond at will. They become extremely hard to injure, tireless, able to support great weights, and resistant to temperature changes. However, this diamond body has no super-strength of its own, only being able to support weight. Also, it has a flaw. Striking this flaw will cause them to shatter.
summary: The ability to turn your tissues into solid diamond
strengths: Become nigh-invunerable + tireless
Able to support great weight
Impervious to temperature change
weaknesses: No super-strength; only able to support weight
Diamond body has a flaw; will shatter if struck
Unable to swim

name: Dark Flame
description: This ability allows you to generate dark energy in the form of black fire or any dark colors (again nothing bright). You can project dark flames from your entire body and even cause objects to melt. You can also shoot dark fireballs of course. With practice you could fly by channeling the dark energy through your body. You won't be able to control fire in any way, so you will still get burned.
summary: The ability to generate dark energy in the form of fire
strengths: Do like the human torch, "Flame on! "
Can intimidate your foes
Can fly but needs practice
weaknesses: Lose control of your power
Running out of energy to burn
This is not pyrokinesis so you won't control fire and are not immune to it

name: Inanimate Intangibility
description: This can only be used on non-living things. In other words, you can't use it on humans, animals, or plants unless their already dead. You can make walls, floors, clothes, or anything else non-living intangible. The intangibility is activated by what you touch, regardless of what you touch it with. You can touch something with your hand, foot, head, and any other part of your body to make it intangible.
summary: The ability to make any non-living thing intangilble
strengths: Make any non-living thing pass through anything else
Pass through walls and floors
Protect or take away anything non-living
weaknesses: May get killed or have things fused in you if you make things tangible while passing through you
May have other objects fall through to where you don't want it or break
Can't make living things intangible

name: Intuitive Comprehension
description: Knowledge is power, and understanding is the key to knowledge. An Intuitive Comprehender needs to only look at a serial number, acronym, or abbreviation and the facts will come to their mind. When they see it, they must stare at it for a moment; in a flash they will know what it means. This ability does not work on the spoken word or drawings.
summary: The ability to immediately understand any list of symbols
strengths: Know the difference between M80 and E80
Looking at a serial code lets you know what it is and where it was made
Learn if you should visit the CMF or not
weaknesses: Must get a good look at the number string
Does not work on the spoken word
Does not work on drawings

name: Periscopic Vision
description: A periscope is a device with a mirror in it. The mirror reflects light so that you can see around corners and other objects. With this ability, you are able to utilize the power of the periscope with your eyes to look around corners and other obstacles without revealing yourself or your location. You would be the ultimate spy.
summary: The ability to see around objects without moving.
strengths: See around objects without being seen.
You would become a great spy.
weaknesses: Prolonged use may cause eye damage....
...  Speak to your eye doctor to see if this power is right for you

name: Ice Lightning
description: The lighting is so cold that the bolts may freeze. It's light blue in color.
summary: The ability to make ice cold lighting
strengths: Freezes
weaknesses: May kill!

name: Dryad Or Death
description: Use this power if you know you are about to die to become a dryad, or if someone else is about to die then you can make them a dryad at the cost of your own health. A dryad is a tree spirit that is assigned to one species of tree and if someone on earth harms that species of tree, then getting revenge on them will make you stronger.
summary: The ability to transform into a dryad or tree spirit when you're about to die.
strengths: You don't die.
You get protection from your tree species.
weaknesses: You're not there because you're a spirit
If someone harms your tree species and
you don't get revenge within a month you go into a killing frenzy.

name: Diamond Tail
description: With this power you can grow a tail made out of diamonds. You can use the tail as weapon or to trip people. The tail can also be detached to be used as a melee weapon or to sell to make some extra money. Once you detach it you can instantly grow another one so you can have multiple weapons or make lots of money by selling several of them or you can do both and still have a tail growing out of your back.
summary: The ability to grow a tail made out of diamond
strengths: You can grow a tail made out of diamond which you can use to trip people or hit people
You can detach the tail to use it as a sword or sell it for money
Once you detach it you can still grow a new one
weaknesses: Growing the tail is painful (but detaching it is not)

name: Fungus Mastery
description: This power gives the user the power to control any type of mycelium which means that they control fungus. In addition this also lets the user sense where fungus are since the fungus would be in their field of control. They can also cause mold to grow faster.
summary: The ability to control any type of fungus
strengths: Can summon tons of underground mycelium to attack opponents
Find truffles easily
Cause your enemies houses to be filled with mold
weaknesses: If you are allergic to mushrooms or other fungi
Cannot control spores after release-only lets you control mycelium

name: Friendship Powered Abilities
description: A person with this power has the ability to gain powers everytime they make a friend. Also they start with the ability to make people more likely to be friendly towards you after talking to them. You can get good powers by meeting great friends. Caring personality equals healing, aggressive personality equals pyrokinesis, cold personality is ice. Shocking personality is electricity. The list goes on and on and no two powers are completely identical. You can only use one ability at a time.
summary: The ability to gain an ability every time you make a friend as well as make friends more easily
strengths: You start with heightened charisma when you have this power.
You get more powers everytime you make a friend
Powers reflect your friends' personality
weaknesses: If your new friend has a disgusting personality, the power you gain will be disgusting too
You can't change people's personalities but all the powers are expected to be positive effects
Some people just won't become your friend and losing friends or your memories means loss of power

name: Teleport To Friend(S)
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your friend(s) are/is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe.
summary: The ability to teleport to where one's friend(s) are/is located at
strengths: You can help your friends whenever they need help.
weaknesses: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.
If you only have imaginary friends then this power is useless.

name: Pursuit
description: With this ability, anything is possible. If you pursuit it, you can do it. If you constantly pursue thoughts and concepts, they will become a reality. For instance, if you always want to fly, you may gain the ability to float, or grow wings. If something is troubling you, pursuiting thoughts of it ending may make the problem go away. There is no end to what your mind can pursue. However, more specific abilities or concepts take more concentration, and everything takes time to become a reality.
summary: The ability to make things come true by continuously pursuing them
strengths: Pursuit your dreams, your goals, and they will come true
weaknesses: Nothing can happen instantly, it takes a real want for something to come true
Things can be awkward without being specific, and pursuing more specifically takes more effort

name: The Paths Of Magic: The Wizard
description: The Path of the Wizard, or the Path of Will, is the first of the five paths of magic. Wizards are mages that use nothing but will to do magic. Naturaly, wizards are the most powerful of mages, due to the fact that they are almost all-powerful and are only limited by imagination. Very few have the power or the talent necessary for wizardry. This ability grants you a special talent for wizardry.
summary: The ability to have special talent for wizardry.
strengths: Wizardry will come easily to you.
Almost no limits.
weaknesses: Cannot break the universal laws

name: Jail Immunity
description: With this power you will never be sent to jail for any crime from loitering to murder. You won't even be taken to court or be put on trial. Additionally you cannot get a speeding or parking ticket and are more or less immune to the laws of any country.
summary: The ability to never go to jail for a crime
strengths: You will never be arrested, take to court, put on trial or receive parking tickets, speeding tickets
Or fines
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Ice Mimicry
description: You're like Iceman but you don't have cryokinesis, you just turn into freezing ice. Everything you touch will be frozen. The colder it gets, the more strength & mass you gain. You can even protrude spikes from your body bad of icicles & you can heal instantly from injuries like knife & bullet wounds. Of course, heat will be your downfall & if you gets to hot, you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted.
summary: The ability to convert your body into freezing ice
strengths: Turn into walking super snowman
Produce icicle spikes on your body
Freeze injuries & heal instantly
weaknesses: Heat
Too much heat & you turn back to normal, weak & exhausted

name: Solaris
description: With this power, you are able to be in superheat form, which is when you are completely blazing and you can super-melt anything you touch. You can also control what temperatures you would like to use.
summary: The ability to harvest the power of the sun.
strengths: Can cook your own food without oven.
weaknesses: Can't control the sun.
Works with your emotions.

name: Price Label Substitution
description: With this superpower, you can move the decimal point on any price tag. For example, something costs $250, but you change it to $2. 50 and BAM! It's yours for the new price! The best thing is, shop owners feel compelled to sell it to you at your price. They can't claim it was a miss-print. The only limitation to this power is that you must leave at least one digit before the decimal point. The lowest you can go is, say $2. 70. You can't change it to $0. 27.
summary: The ability to move the decimal point on price tags
strengths: Buy anything you want at a reduced price
Shop owners can't refuse to sell you the reduced item
You can buy a $5m mansion for $5. 00
weaknesses: Might become a shopoholic
You'll have heaps of useless stuff
You might get greedy/corrupted by this power

name: Psychic Sound
description: A person with Psychic Sound can create sound waves made out of pure psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can affect the world like normal sound waves but are unaffected by Sonokinesis. The psychic sound waves can also be used to affect other things using psychic energy. The psychic sound waves can also be used to talk to others in a sort of false telepathy. Can also choose which individuals can hear or are affected by your psychic sound waves.
summary: The ability to create sound waves made out of psychic energy.
strengths: Use sound waves that are unaffected by sonokinesis.
Use sound waves to also affect psychic related objects.
Can use the sound waves to create a sort of false telepathy.
weaknesses: Affected by other psychic powers.
If your focus is lessened then your power weakens.
Works similiar to sonokinesis.

name: Inundation
description: This ability is QUITE unpleasant for the person on whom it is used. It causes an overload of every sense the user has. One with this ability causes the foe to lose control over his senses and train of thought, so that every sensory stimulus in range is constantly in his mind. Combine that with the fact that his thoughts no longer form coherently into cognition he can understand (thoughts and memories emerge/disappear randomly, emotions constantly changing) and the foe is left a mind-numbed mess.
summary: The ability to overload a foe's mind and senses
strengths: Overload a foe with his own thoughts, memories and emotions (can't focus them into coherent thought)
His senses go haywire and everything he picks up on is very strongly present in his mind
Often knocks the foe unconscious within a few seconds
weaknesses: If one's power is too strong, it causes coma or even death
If the power can't be undone at will, you might feel bad using your power (MIGHT)
If the power is uncontrolled, it can go off randomly

name: Synergy
description: Also called Synergistic Perception, this is the psychic ability to add the sense capacity of others onto oneself. The user (usually) starts off with normal senses, but when around others with normal or superhuman perception (like Telescopic Vision), THEIR senses can increase to superhuman levels. If they were around five people with normal perception, for example, the user could increase his perception five times. However, the user does this AT WILL, so as to prevent sensory inundation.
summary: The ability to add the sense capacity of others onto oneself
strengths: Friends with Precognition, Telescopic Vision, X-Ray Vision, Superhuman Senses, etc.
Even the senses of normal people can increase your senses
Even borrow the senses of MACHINES design to "sense" things (radar, sonar, GPS, etc)
weaknesses: If you can't control the sensory magnification, you'll be overloaded
If your sensory magnification occurs randomly (can't choose the person whose senses you use)
Doesn't take the subject's senses away

name: Quetzalcoatl
description: When activating this ability, you gain the following: superhuman strength, speed, near invulnerability, acute olfactory receptors, and keen sight. You can also metamorphose into a feathered serpent or a humanoid feathered reptile. Your claws are nigh indestructible and skewer through targets with ease. As a result of acquiring Quetzalcoatl's powers, your life prolonged a hundred years (possibly more). Your feathers can also be utilized as razor-sharp flechettes.
summary: The ability to bestow upon yourself the abilities of the Aztec god Quetzalcoatl.
strengths: Virtually immortal.
Change into a feathered serpent for possible flight.
Serpentine anatomy/physiology offers higher elasticity and a tougher skeleton.
weaknesses: Still susceptible to attack. (still vulnerable to stronger enemies)
Limited shapeshifting.
Your feathers are dangerous to use around civilians.

name: Electronic Fog
description: A person with this power can create the effect of the Bermuda Triangle anywhere by creating electronic fog. Within the fog electronics don't work and people caught in the radius will be blinded and their sense of space and time is distorted. Compasses are broken too. After a while things will deteriorate. You are immune to any and all negative effects of your own power.
summary: The ability to create and control the fog that makes up the Bermuda Triangle
strengths: Disrupts electronics
People can't see through the fog and will suffer spacial and temporal disorientation
You are immune to the effects of your own power
weaknesses: Only useful for killing or sneaking

name: Reflecting Shield
description: Basically, what happens is long-range attacks go in an almost full circle around you. Just enough so that they get returned back to the same place they were launched from. This works on all long-range attacks whether natural, supernatural, etc.
summary: The ability to make long-range attacks return to their users
strengths: Eliminates one field of combat for the enemy. Fields of combat: long-, medium-, and close-range.
All long-range attacks natural, supernatural, etc.
Returns the attack back to the enemy.
weaknesses: Only helps in long-range fighting.

name: The Animal Glyphs
description: The day you were born and the position of the stars determine the twelve animals that not only describe you but reside within. Twelve Glyphs beamed into your brain represent the twelve animals. Then all you do is draw the glyphs wherever even in midair with your finger. However depending on the quality and work put into the glyphs determines the power and duration of the transformation.
summary: The ability to draw two glyphs each representing an animal then you transform into a combination of the animals.
strengths: Possibility of having twelve awesome animals at your disposal.
If you can draw well then the power of the transformation is doubled
The combined animals becomes stonger then just one alone
weaknesses: Possibility of having twelve bad animals at your disposal.
Takes time to do not good in a sneak attack
If you cant draw then the power will be halved.

name: Guardian Powers
description: While guarding things you will have superhuman strength, speed, senses, and invulnerability to make you into the best possible guard. It doesn't matter what you protect so long as you know what you are guarding.
summary: The ability to have certain powers only when guarding things
strengths: If you already have the powers in the description, you will still have them when not guarding.
weaknesses: Most likely going to end up guarding things for others.
If you don't know what it is you are guarding.

name: Eye Of Awakening
description: You are impervious to mind tricks, controls, and any illusion. You even repel the Shadow Of Mara.
summary: The ability to repel the even the most powerful mind controls and illusions
strengths: You are Impervious to any mind control, and illusion.
You can duplicate this power and bestow it on others.
You can even use it as a shield on thousands of people.
weaknesses: If you use your other powers for evil, this power is temporally disabled.
Be wise before bestowing on this to someone else.

name: Own The Spear Of Destiny
description: He who holds the spear of destiny holds the fate of the world in his hands. Owning the spear causes you to fall into positions of high power, and have fate make you incredibly lucky and immortal for the duration of your ownership. Notable users include: Longinus - a roman soldier who used it to pierce Jesus and caused him to die; Peter Bartholomew - used it to summon an army of angels and won a battle in the 1st crusade; Hitler - used it to gain political power and nearly conquered the world.
summary: The ability to control the fate of the world
strengths: You gain positions of power very quickly, most of your goals succeed
Fate will protect you, assassinations will fail, you will escape danger, you won't ever get sick
Anyone you impale with the spear will surely die, it pierces all forms of armor and metal.
weaknesses: If you lose the spear, you die.
The spear chooses its owner. The spear can choose another and leave you any time
You will be long remembered, for good or bad.

name: Vending
description: With this ability, you will be able to create vending machines out of thin air, for literally any item.
summary: The ability to create vending machines for anything.
strengths: Vending machines for anything.
Literally.
They are created out of thin air.
weaknesses: Need exact change
1 cent per trade (money for object).
Need enough room.

name: Acid Spark
description: It may sound bizarre, but you can fire light-green corrosionic bolts of energy from your fingertips or the palm of your hands which could dissolve through anything and even melt off a person.
summary: The ability to fire green electrical bolts that will burn through anything.
strengths: Weird new electrical power to have.
weaknesses: Doesn't work in water.

name: Blessing Of Gaea
description: Gaea is the oldest goddess there is. She is the earth goddess and her blessing allows you to gain powers over the earth as well. Besides basically controling it, you can use the earth to heal. Whenever you are wounded, instead of blood, sand will pour out. That sand will then collect over the wound, heal it, and fall away. You can also turn things into any material from the earth and sense things using vibrations from the ground.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Gaea
strengths: You can control the earth and anything from it
You can change anything into any material from the earth
You can heal and sense things through the earth
weaknesses: It looks weird whenever you get hurt

name: Healing Aura
description: You can emit an invisible aura that heals all organic beings around you. No effort is needed, but things heal faster if they are close to you, e.g. a broken limb will fuse completely in 4 hours if the sufferer stays in the same house as you, but you can only just suppress any viruses someone down the road has. You benefit from the aura as well, staying in perfect health at all time, never feeling ill and healing even from life-threatening injuries in 2 hours.
summary: The ability to unconsciously heal things around you
strengths: Can keep self, roommates and nearby loved ones in great health
Very difficult to be killed
Could stay overnight in hospitals and heal most of the ward by morning
weaknesses: Once you leave an area, those there can get sick again
Can't cure genetic diseases
Can still be killed quickly, e.g. shot in the head

name: Ability Commutation
description: You're using a power but then realize you need to change it for another one. You would normally need to stop using the current one and then activate the one you want, possibly becoming open to attack. With this power, you can instantly switch from one power to another, without needing to fulfil the conditions to stop the current one and to start the new one, if conditions are required. However, the switch will be broken if the next power has effects that entirely depend on those conditions.
summary: The ability to instantly switch a power you're using to another one, bypassing the condition to activate the latter
strengths: You won't lose time switching between superpowers the normal way.
You won't need to fulfil the conditions to activate the next one.
Rapidly switching from an offensive power to a defensive power.
weaknesses: The switch will break if the next power has effects that depend on the conditions of activation.
To use this power, a superpower must already be activated, which can be short in time.
Switching a superpower for this one or this one for another doesn't count.

name: Gaia's Blessing: Translator
description: This power allows you to talk to anything organic or on the periodic table only rule is that you must always watch what you say because this power is always active and all metals must listen to you animals, plants,and non metals have a choice
summary: The ability to talk to all things in nature
strengths: Never get hit by cars again
Always have a pencil
You can have a pet panther
weaknesses: People might think your delusional if they see you having a conversation with a turtle at the zoo
If you insult any animal or tree the may hurt you
If you wish someone dead and an animal hears you that person may die

name: Lullatrick
description: With this power, if you sing any lullaby, you will put anyone (except those with a power that prevents then from sleeping) to sleep immediately. You can only sing at "full power" to one target at once, but the others will feel a little drowsy. It affects anyone in the immediate surrounding, even those with you.
summary: The ability to sing a lullaby able to put someone to sleep
strengths: Put (almost) anyone to sleep easily
Good to soothe a crying sibling/baby in the middle of the night
Also good if you are cornered.
weaknesses: Will affect you and anyone with you at the moment, even if you don't aim it at them
Might be a little difficult to choose targets if you are cornered
You do not get any knowledge of lullabies from this - if you do not know any lullabies, too bad...

name: Game God: Card
description: With this ability the user can become basicly omnipotent with card games.  This allows Summoning beings/objects from cards, into the real world to serve you you can summon six thousand copies of each card. You can also designate one copy as a leader, and dominate its mind, making a copy of your mind, you can act through it.  Beings cannot battle each other, you can dismiss them at will, they do not require food, water, and you can revive the dead beings.
summary: The ability to summon monsters from card games.
strengths: Armies of pokemon if you want.
Mind copies.
Normal armies will wet their pants.
weaknesses: You need cards.
You will look childish.
Good cards cost money.

name: Bio  Overshadow Proximity
description: This ability allows the user to make anything physical into an organic version of the user. Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this. The things that changed will bare similarities to the user like color of his skin or have his face, etc. The user is also able to telepathically control them and capable of giving them feelings. The things will stay that way as long as the user is near them. There is a certain amount of space that this ability affects.
summary: The ability to turn everything around you into the organic equvalant of oneself and manipulate it.
strengths: Make things be more like you
Control over them
weaknesses: You will have certain amount of space that this ability affects.
Intelligent beings, air, energy, spirits, and God are not affected by this.

name: Negativity Deconstruct
description: The user is capable of destroying things with their negative attitude. The more negative the user is, the more destructive he/she becomes. Positive attitudes will diminish its power. It will look like Phoenix's disintegration attack from The Last Stand and it breaks down all forms of matter.
summary: The ability to deconstruct things with one's negative attitude.
strengths: Destroy things with your negative attitude
weaknesses: Positivity weakens it

name: Connection Of The Animals
description: If you're found caught with an aggressive dog, talk calmly. If you have the power, the dog will calm down and listen to you, although you cannot actually understand what it says in its language. But you can understand through seeing its actions and situation. Upon a word or signal, you may summon an animal to your aid.
summary: The ability to calm down, speak to animals, and summon them
strengths: Summon animals to your aid
Animals will not hurt you
You are able to understand them
weaknesses: May not always work
Cannnot understand their language
Summoning happens rarely

name: Matter Trait Inducement
description: This ability will allow you to create new breeds of matter with their own special characteristics. Take a glass of water; just by touching it, think of the flammability of gaseous matter and it will become flammable, but still be drinkable.
summary: The ability to give one form of matter the traits of a different form of matter.
strengths: Able to make new breeds of matter.
weaknesses: The effects might last forever.

name: Underwater Exploration
description: As soon as you hit water, you turn invisible or turn into a mermaid/merman. Your choice!
summary: The ability to become a mermaid/merman or turn invisible once you hit the water.
strengths: You can breathe underwater
Perfect for sneaking up on your friends in the pool
You can talk to fish
weaknesses: People might get freaked out if they see someone swimming around with a fin

name: Bronze Skin Transformation
description: In bronze armored form, you have the strength, which enables you to lift at least 160 tons under extreme conditions. You have the stamina, which means that you will tire much, much slower than regular human beings and can continue exerting yourself for hours without tiring. While in this state, you also do not require food, water or air to sustain yourself and can withstand high impact assaults as well as extreme temperatures. You can even use your fingers to pick locks or safes.
summary: The ability to convert the tissue of your entire body into an organic bronze substance.
strengths: Bronze is a mixture between Gold and Silver.
The bronze skin is so hard and brittle you can bend anything.
weaknesses: You can't jump.
Won't be able to eat, drink, sleep, and breathe while in armored form.

name: Sleep Control
description: Having trouble getting to sleep? Don't want to deal with some annoying person? Want to stop bad guys before they even do anything? Then this power is right for you! Just think about making someone fall asleep, and they will! No matter their current circumstances, and they'll stay asleep for as long as you please.
summary: The ability to put people to sleep on command.
strengths: Able to put yourself to sleep.
You can stop your foe by making them take a permanent nap.
Get for revenge.
weaknesses: They can still hurt you if you don't use your power first.
They'll wake up eventually if you don't think of how long they'll sleep.
Only works on humans.

name: Fall
description: With this power you can make someone collapse on the ground just by saying "Fall" and then pointing at the person or saying the person's name. The person can get up whenever they like and you can use this power on as many people as you like as many times as you want.
summary: The ability to make people fall
strengths: You can cause people to collapse on the ground
weaknesses: The person can just get back up

name: Pressure Vision
description: You are able to produce large amounts of pressure from your eyes. This allows you to crack slabs of cement, warp metal, turn lumps of coal into diamonds and even break people's bones. You can shoot it in bursts or a long powerful beam to hit from a distance.
summary: The ability to produce large amounts of pressure from your eyes.
strengths: You can warp metal.
Turn lumps of coal into diamonds.
Produce large amounts of pressure.
weaknesses: You can only shoot in bursts or powerful beams.
The blast can only come from your eyes.

name: Tactile Telepathy
description: You can hear any thinking creature's thoughts and transmit your thoughts to them by skin-to-skin or skin-to-conductor-to-skin contact
summary: The ability to hear thoughts or transmit thoughts to others by touch.
strengths: You can know what people are thinking.
You can show people exactly what you mean.
weaknesses: You must be toughing it's body with your skin or a good conductor that is touching both beings.
Can't be turned off.
You might not always want to know what people are thinking.

name: Planar Intangability
description: Planes are the layers of reality that exist on different levels than our own. This power grants the user the ability to selectively become intangible to these different planes. This allows the user to travel time, space, and evade attacks on different planes. Because space and time function differently based on the plane you can traverse these in a limited manner. Also because most actions exist on only one plane you can evade ALL actions on a plane you're intangible on.
summary: The ability to selectively become intangible on the different planes of reality.
strengths: Easily evade single or few-plane attacks.
Limited space and time travel.
Become intangible on the spiritual plane to resist possession.
weaknesses: If you have no knowledge of the mechanics of different planes.
Reality benders.
Attacks that are multi-plane.

name: Lateral Repulsion
description: A person with this power can cause anything they touch to become charged to repel anything from it like a magnet. The effect can be undone by touching it again. Like lateral magnetizer, heat has no effect on the repulsion. You can fly with this power by charging your hands to push the ground/air or alternatively use this to blast away people. Newton's 3rd law applies when using this power so you need to be careful to prevent backlash. You can selectively change the amount of repulsion possible.
summary: The ability to cause surfaces you touch to repel objects similar to a magnet
strengths: You can selectively use this power on only your hands to fly by pushing the ground
