You do not have to acquire the same abilities and can learn your own unique powers as long as you stay within the theme of the class. You are allowed to have multiple "accounts" of classes which you are allowed to switch between, but you must level each separately. Class armor can also be obtained as you level up a class.
summary: The ability to level up as a fantasy Role Playing Game class character.
strengths: Many Classes to choose from, and many abilities to be learned.
Can have multiple "accounts" to switch between many classes.
Can obtain class armor to increase your powers if you level up high enough.
weaknesses: Limited to staying within the theme of each class.
Each RPG class "account" has to be leveled separately.
Level Cap is 100.

name: Name Strength V2
description: With this power whenever you say a person's first and last name they will gain superhuman strength and invulnerability for 24 hours. You don't have to be near the person or even ever have met the person.
summary: The ability to give other people strength by saying their name
strengths: You can give people super strength by saying their name
weaknesses: You cannot use this power on yourself

name: Range Analysis
description: This power can only be used on a power user. When you use it, you can sense the maximum range they can reach with their superpowers. Maximum range, meaning the range they can reach at their full potential. You'll know the shape and dimensions of that area of effect and sense where it is relative to your position. At the beginning, the power will only return the information about all powers combined. With experience, you'll be able to discriminate the area of effect of a specific power.
summary: The ability to detect the area of effect of a power user.
strengths: Obstacles can create safe spots within the area of effect.
Know exactly where you have to go to be out of reach from a dangerous user.
Use it on yourself to discover your potential.
weaknesses: At the beginning, you won't know with which powers they can strike your location.
You won't know whether the effect will be dangerous, benefic or completely harmless.
Powers that enhance one's capacity will be ranged 0, but what they can do will far outreach it.

name: Mad Genius
description: With this power the angrier you are the more intelligent you will become. Frustration and anger will make you a master strategist, scientist, engineer, inventor, mathematician & musician. Your IQ will be immeasurable.
summary: The ability to let your anger fuel your brain, intellect and intelligence
strengths: Anger increases your brainpower, let your ire grow until you have no intellectual rival
Their will be no code, crime or strategy you couldn't unravel
If angered enough you could outmatch any intellect, machine
weaknesses: Only happens when you are angry
Unangered you are prone to absent-mindedness
Brain matter may constantly grow to grotesque proportions

name: Dermal Microspines
description: This ability allows you to form small (nearly microscopic) spines anywhere on your skin. The spines are nearly indestructible and sharp. These small spines can produce a multitude of effects. They can allow you to cling to walls, use your skin like sandpaper to harm your opponents by tearing skin, or even allow them to break off in your opponent causing intense pain.
summary: The ability to create near microscopic spines on your skin
strengths: Wall Climbing
Your skin is now a weapon
No hugs from people you don't like
weaknesses: Hard to get close to people
Hand to hand combat required
Sometimes you can't suppress it...

name: Lodekrio
description: Anything you touch, you may become. You may become a car, or a building. If you wish, you may even be your cousin, the guy down the street, the president, even.
summary: The ability to become anything you touch, organic or inorganic
strengths: Become anyone, anything
Master of disguise
If you're touching two things at once, you may choose which to be
weaknesses: No body of your own
Kill innocent people, if you becomes too big of an item/animal

name: Titan's Grip
description: With this power you can focus your energy in your hands creating a dark red energy that lets you crush or hold things in your hand without losing your grip. The focused energy increases the strength of your punches causing them to hit with the force of a large meteor. The force can also be focused into a melee weapon, such as a sword, to greatly increase its destructive force. The melee weapon would become indestructible, weightless to the user, and would also glow with same energy.
summary: The ability to have increased hand strength and brawling abilities.
strengths: Power of a titan.
Increased strength with fists and melee weapons.
Never lose your grip on your weapon.
weaknesses: Only increases strength in hands.
May crush things by accident often.
Dark red energy gives away when you are using power.

name: Energy Flux Field
description: A field surrounds your body in which all forms of energy are constantly in flux turning you into a walking natural disaster. Everywhere you go destruction will follow as you tear everything to pieces with fluctuating kinetic, electromagnetic and thermal energies. With concentration the power can be repressed so that everyday activities can be preformed. Strong emotions cause the energy field to increase and affect a larger area.
summary: The ability to generate a field of constant energy flux around your body
strengths: Complete destruction of enemies
Great destructive rampages
Affects nearly EVERY type of energy
weaknesses: People avoid you
Mostly places you as evil

name: Shattering
description: A person with Shattering is a china shop's worst nightmare. By pointing and focusing, they can make solid objects break into a million pieces. This is easier the smaller and brittler the object is, although it can be performed on all solid objects.
summary: The ability to make solid objects break or burst suddenly into pieces
strengths: Anything is a fragmentation grenade
Nothing can really block it
Range only affected by sight
weaknesses: No effect on liquids or gases
Harder the larger it is
Harder the less brittle it is

name: Dimensional Doom Mirror
description: This ability summons an empty 500 meter dimensional sphere that creates a copy of anyone or anything trapped in it. The copies possess all of the abilities and physical attributes of the original. The only thing that differs between original and the copy is that the copy is mindless and its actions are guided by the user to mimic the actions of the original. If for any reason the original and copy collide with each other both will be deleted in mind, spirit, and body.
summary: The ability to summon a sphere that creates copies of everything in it
strengths: The abilities of the original and the copy will cancel out each other
Only the user of this ability is exempted from its rules
Uses the ability or actions of the opponent against them.
weaknesses: If the copy and the original touch, both are annihilated

name: Reader
description: French, Spanish, Japanese, Creole, Ancient Egyptian, any language that can be written, the holder of this power can understand in its written form. It does not matter how old or complicated the written language is, the holder of this power will understand it. The words will automatically translate to a language that the holder of this power already knows in their mind.
summary: The ability to read and understand any language without prior training
strengths: Can read and understand any written language.
Can act as a one-way translator.
Dictionaries can be useful for writing things out if they are fully in the other language.
weaknesses: Can't speak or write the languages witjout training.
If you want to translate to a language you don't know, you must have samples of the writing on you.

name: Invulnerability Defiance
description: Invulnerability is often thought to be the end-all, beat-all in defense, capable of withstanding all manner of physical damage, no matter how strong or powerful. This ability counteracts it. One with this ability harms invulnerable subjects and superhumanly durable subjects just like he can harm normal people (often requiring no extra force). In addition, any weapon the user wields will be able to harm invulnerable or durable subjects for as long as they are held by him.
summary: The ability to bypass Invulnerability and Superhuman Durability when attacking
strengths: Harm durable supers as though they had normal durability
Harm invulnerable supers as though they had normal durability
Any weapon you wield will hurt them, too
weaknesses: Weapons will only hurt invulnerables when directly held by you (bullets still don't work, etc)
Sometimes, it only acts like a downgrade (invulnerability treated like superhuman durability, etc)
Invulnerables with Power Negation, or with Power Negation Immunity

name: Power Based Surrogates
description: Allows you to create a new body from one of your superpowers. The new body can be any age, gender or style and comes with clothes and items that go with the power used to make the Surrogate. While controlling the Surrogate, you can only use the power used to make it, though with enhanced strengths. Surrogates that are not in use are stored in a separate dimension where they slowly heal. People with mind enhancing powers may be smart enough to control multiple Surrogates with different powers.
summary: The ability to switch to and control a new body based on a superpower you possess.
strengths: Spare bodies in case one is damaged.
Power is enhanced in Surrogate form.
Can become a new person.
weaknesses: Cannot use other powers, unless you exit the Surrogate.
What power you will be using is easily predictable.
Increasingly hard to control multiple Surrogates.

name: Unbreakable Guard
description: Catch anything moving at rates that normal people would have a tough time with. The only way you can use this technique though is by sitting down and catching with your feet, like Yoshimitsu in Soul Calibur 4.
summary: The ability to catch anything from bullets to swords and anything in between
strengths: Unbreakable guard!
Catch arrows, swords, knives bee stings, anything
Your feet never get injured
weaknesses: Have to be sitting down to catch anything.
Can't use your hands and expect the same result

name: Self Density Control
description: The user can change his body density and mass. This allows the user, when light, to move more quickly and leap long distances. When heavy, the user has great physical strength and rock-hard durability.
summary: The ability to control the density of one's own body.
strengths: You can eat as much as you want; the extra weight won't affect you!
Ever need to hammer a nail in? Just use your finger!
You can get paid handsomely to do normally impossible physical labour if heroics is not for you.
weaknesses: Shifting from light to heavy too often will put much strain on your bones, making it painful to move
The extra power might result in un-intentional property damage, which'll come out of your pocket.
While lightly dense, you're extra vulnerable to injury.

name: The Greek/Roman Effect
description: You can warp reality by Sayning two or three different Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals which you can use to create dimensional portals, force fields, transmute objects, freeze objects, burn objects or simply etc. If you say Phi Beta - You get Tactile Aerokinesis, Alpha Gamma Sigma - Green Geyser Ground-Shaker.
summary: The ability to call on a different power by shouting out 2 or 3 Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals.
strengths: You can warp reality by Sayning two or three different Greek Alphabets or Roman Numerals
create dimensional portals, force fields, transmute objects, freeze objects, burn objects
Green Geyser Ground-Shaker
weaknesses: None.

name: Money Controller
description: Never be affected by poverty or a recession anymore!  With this superpower, you can bestow riches upon yourself and others with ease!
summary: The ability to generate money with your mind
strengths: Become a multi-trillionaire!
Can make other people rich as well
weaknesses: People may mooch off of you

name: Viral Strength
description: Touch one person and infect them with a geophysical virus that allows you to add their physical prowess to yours, as long as they are on the Earth's surface. When they touch other people, they also add to your strength. The virus spreads and every muscle in your body becomes stronger with every infection. Imagine starting the virus at a concert or sporting event, in a school, wherever people are gathered.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength by spreading a geophysical virus
strengths: Handshakes, hugs, accidental bumps, even a pat on the back add to your power
Touch as many people as you can, spread your viral effect faster and reach your desired strength
You will probably average a lifting capacity of 27,272 tons, run over 12,000 mph
weaknesses: If you or the people you infect are airborne you are not as strong as when they are grounded
The day before the infection dissipates you are too powerful to touch anything without crushing it
Every 28 days the viral effects stop and you must start the process again

name: Talisman Amplification
description: You have millions of talismans that represent every power on this website. You insert these talismans into a hole in your suit to obtain that superpower, but be warned, you can only carry 10 talismans with you at a time, and you can only use the talismans one at a time, so you can only have one power at a time. If you wish to switch powers, you must switch talismans. Also, your powers are greatly amplified, i.e. if you use super speed you have super ultra lightning fast speed.
summary: The ability to use talismans representing every power on this website to obtain that power.
strengths: You can have every superpower on this website.
Your powers are amplified even more than the original power.
weaknesses: You can only use the talismans one at a time.
You can only carry 10 talismans with you at a time.

name: Moon Warp
description: Whenever the full moons up, most people grow hair and paws. Your ability is much cooler - the fuller the moon, the easier it is to alter the very fabric of space. Unfortunately, you have no power during the new moon, and as the moon gets fuller you glow with power. So people will know when you are powerful or weak.
summary: The ability to gain power over reality when the full moon is up.
strengths: Reality Changing/Warping during the full moon.
Almost never totally powerless.
Waxing moon makes your power increase.
weaknesses: You can only affect what you can perceive.
Waning moon saps your power.
No power in the day unless you can see the moon.

name: Waveform Mimicry (Wave Form)
description: Instead of being able to manipulate different kinds of waves, one with this ability can become a living wave and use his own body as an attack. Become a carrier wave and dive into the ground to become a living earthquake; dive into the water and become a living tidal wave; fly through the air as a normal vibration or a living sound wave; if one is really talented, they could even turn into a thought wave to dominate a foes thoughts (and use minds for a quick, convenient mode of travel).
summary: The ability to assume the form of any kind of energy wave
strengths: Turn into any kind of wave (radio wave, light wave, sound wave, magnetic wave, carrier wave, etc. )
Extremely powerful attacks, and extremely fast and efficient travel
Sometimes allows you to perceive different types of waves in human form
weaknesses: Better know the properties of that wave (don't turn into a soundwave in a soundproof room)
People who can manipulate waves
Some with this ability can only become one type of wave

name: Halo Energy Rings
description: You can summon a ring or mutiple rings of energy which charge up and detonate at physical contact when launched as projectiles towards one or multpile opponents. You can combine your rings into one weapon (like a huge halo energy hula hoop).
summary: The ability to summon halo rings of atomic energy, blasting your opponents to pieces at contact
strengths: Good when being out numbered.
Good for long distance attacks.
Good for destroying or signifigantly damaging anything that stands in your way.
weaknesses: You can only summon up to 5 rings
Rings can only be reused after they explode
You must not lose control of the rings, otherwise you have to charge up new rings.

name: Shadow Kinetic Bolt
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into a shadowy kinetic lightning bolt that can zap any target
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a kinetic lightning bolt
strengths: Powerful lightning bolt
Immoblizes opponents or any object
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Matter State Shift
description: With this ability, the user can alter their own material state to that of a solid, liquid, gas, or plasma. Users keep their molecular constitution but still manage to maintain their identity while being dispersed as a liquid or gas. Users can also take on states that lie between matter phases, such as turning themselves into supersolid material.
summary: The ability to shift one's own material state.
strengths: Change state to solid, liquid or gas
The user can still manage their identity while being dispersed
weaknesses: Users may be put at risk of molecular damage if they change their state of matter too rapidly
Users cannot change into other elements, only change their own state of matter.

name: Instant Attachment
description: A person with this power can grab an object and make it touch another object and the two objects will be stuck forever(unless sufficient force breaks one of the objects away from the location of sticking). For example, someone with this power can use this to create impossible works of art with objects that seemingly defy gravity. This power is also practical for close range combat sticking opponents to walls, pinning people's hands to tables, and other more creative uses that embarrass.
summary: The ability to make an object you touch stick to another object it is touching permanently
strengths: Useful in arts and crafts, engineering, surgical applications, and more
Useful in close range combat
This power cannot be undone after the fact by power negation but can still be negated initially
weaknesses: Don't try sticking stuff on to your self
Its permanent so may not want to use it that much
Short range power(you would need to be within grabbing distance and require two objects

name: Power Shambles
description: An example: suppose someone has two super powers, the ability to shoot heat rays from their eyes and the ability to freeze things via touch. When effected by Power Shambles, the mechanics of these powers would randomize so that they were shooting freeze rays from their eyes and heating things via touch. The more superpowers someone has the more opportunities arise for things to be switched around, and this power leaves no superpower alone when invoked. Every power someone has is changed.
summary: The ability to shuffle the mechanics of someones superpowers.
strengths: Switch up the machanics of peoples superpowers, disorienting them.
Get through an unbreakble defence by randomising what the defence protects that person from.
Shamble yourself to try and get better powers.
weaknesses: The powers are shambled randomly, you have no control over it.
This power is not exempt from its effect. If you shamble yourself you may not be able to go back.

name: Deleted Information Accession.
description: With this power, one could give a phone temporary access to all data it ever stored, allowing access to deleted photos. If one applied the ability to a fellow human, that human would be able to recall any memory they had formed. This works best with touch, but more experienced users are not bound by this limitation.
summary: The ability to restore access to lost information.
strengths: Paired with other powers, such as telepathy, this could be extremely useful.
Once you have access, you can re-record that information.
Store a theoretically infinite amount of information on any device able to record data.
weaknesses: The target must have stored the information in the first place.
You cannot access the information yourself without compliance of the target or additional powers.
Effects are temporary; if not recorded again somewhere, the data will be lost again.

name: Delete This Now Okay
description: poorly worded
summary: The ability to be poorly worded
strengths: Becoming a dating guru
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Breaking The Fourth Wall
description: Comic books are divided into panels; by breaking the fourth wall, you can step over the gaps in these panels and thus move forward effortlessly in space or time. You can also read others' thought bubbles and see narration. Your ability allows you to manipulate the world slightly, for example, using a speech bubble as a physical weapon or trapping another in an inescapable panel. You can also climb columns of words like ladders and write on the fourth wall when lacking paper like on a window.
summary: The ability to take advantage of artistic devices used in fictional media as if they applied in real life.
strengths: Travel without wasting time or money
Have a unique understanding of your world
Use your own story as a tool IN your own sotry
weaknesses: You may go mad from comparing reality with fiction
Requires concentration and good parallel thinking to avoid the above
Cannot change what happens a few panels away on a massive scale, only add in "plot twists"

name: Fatigue Reversal
description: This is a very useful power. If you have this power, you can reverse physical exhaustion. When your body gets too tired, it automatically restores your strength and speed to before you got fatigued. Fighting someone with this power can be challenging, since they will not tire easily. Unfortunately, this isn't unlimited stamina; you have to get very tired for this power to activate.
summary: The ability to reverse fatigue or exhaustion
strengths: You can reverse physical exhaustion
You will be challenging to fight, since you won't tire easily
This power restores your strength and speed as well
weaknesses: You have to be very tired for this power to activate
This does not give unlimited stamina

name: Guidance Gem
description: It has the power to guide you to wherever you want, whatever you seek and/or where you will need to be. Whenever you hold it, the light comes out of the gem and the beam points out to where you'll go.
summary: The ability to use it to guide you to wherever you want.
strengths: You'll be instantly teleported when using it.
weaknesses: None.

name: Arcana: 0 The Fool
description: This ability is passive and automatic. It activates in the split second before you are harmed. It reverses time to a few seconds, and then warps probability to make it impossible for the harm to happen. No matter what actually happens, you won't get hurt. A bullet will miss, a gun might jam, something might get in the way. You could stand in front of a car about to hit you and this power would jerk time and probability to somehow get you out ok.
summary: The ability to prevent harmful events from happening.
strengths: Virtual Invulnerability.
Always safe from physical harm.
weaknesses: Doesn't prevent unstoppable attacks.
Probability manipulators.
Won't stop non-physical harm.

name: Lightless Vision
description: One with this ability does not need visible light, infrared, x-ray, or the like, in order to see; the user isn't blind, he simply doesn't require light of any sort to see, so he can see even when light is bent or entirely absent (meaning he can see the invisible and is immune to intense light and light-based illusions); sight capacity for this superhuman can only be impaired if the mind is somehow injured, because they require only mental power to see
summary: The ability to see without the aid of electromagnetic radiation
strengths: Mental power is all that is required to see (absence/presence/distortion of light doesn't matter)
Immune to invisibility, light-basede illusions and intense light
Sight is normal (not green-tinged like night vision or the like)
weaknesses: Optikinesis can impair this power
Psychic energy manipulation can impair this power
If you're normally blind, and this power is negated, you're screwed

name: Fermiokinesis
description: The user can change the shape of solid objects, but you cannot change their material or overall mass.
summary: The ability to change the shape of a solid object.
strengths: Everything really is a weapon to you
You can really screw with someone's body
It's good for defense, too
weaknesses: It's no good against a Shatterer
It's no good against any Elemental
It's no good against Demons

name: Intangibility Immunity
description: This ability is good when fighting ghost or things that can phase through stuff. The user are able touch intangible beings. They can hit anything that is made up of an element that can't be touch like fire, light, and even darkness. With turning, the user can make his other abilities be able to hit or affect intangible things.
summary: The ability to be able to touch spirit, or intangible beings.
strengths: Be able to touch intangible beings
Be able to hit Intangible beings
Be able to use other abilities to hit or affect intangible beings
weaknesses: None for the time being.

name: Mental Energy Hands
description: A person with Mental Energy Hands can create giant, translucent hands that can manipulate objects. These mental hands are directly controlled by the user's real hands. They can be projected up to 100 yards away and be made to be 100 feet tall.
summary: The ability to form and manipulate giant hands made of psychic energy
strengths: One-man wrecking crew
Nearly limitless ability to use them
A form of super-strength
weaknesses: If real hands are tied, the Mental Hands will be useless
Strength of hands tied to concentration
Can be resisted

name: Shattered Glass Universe
description: With this power you can travel to an alternate reality that is the complete opposite of your home universe (i. E. Villains are heroes and vice versa). Once you're there you do not become the opposite of yourself but you stay the same and keep all the powers you had in your home universe. Once you're done in the alternate universe you can simply travel back to your home universe.
summary: The ability to travel into an alternate reality that is the opposite of your home reality
strengths: You can travel to an alternate reality that is the complete opposite of your home reality
You keep your personality and powers
You can go home when you're done
weaknesses: The alternate version of yourself might try to kill you

name: Empathic Sight
description: Being stabbed in the back took down Caesar, Brutus, and King Lear. People with Empathic Sight don't have to worry about that. At will, they can tell friends from enemies by the color they emanate--blue for friends and red for foes. They can also read messages that friends scratch on the wall. To them, it looks like a glowing neon sign.
summary: The ability to tell friend from foe and to detect hidden messages
strengths: Detect potential foes
Find friendly forces in a dangerous place
Reading life-saving messages from friends
weaknesses: Finding out your best friend hates you
Looking around and seeing all foes
Unable to read foe's messages

name: Underwater Senses
description: When you body is submerged under water you are able to see, hear, smell, taste, and touch anything like you are on land. You wouldn't need to wear goggles because nothing would be blurry. Also the longer you are in the water the more superhuman your senses become, if you are in the water for an hour you would be able to see further than the average human (even after you left the water). This effect only lasts until you are dry.
summary: The ability to use your 5 senses like your on land underwater
strengths: You can use your senses underwater
The longer you are in the water the more superhuman your senses become
You wouldnt need to wear goggles when you swim
weaknesses: You need to be underwater
The superhuman senses only last while your wet
You can't breath under water

name: Mega Light Beam Vision
description: With this power you can shoot a mega light beam out of your eyes. A mega light beam is a yellow beam that burns right through the person/object it is aimed at and blinds all of the people around him/her. The beam cannot burn or blind you.
summary: The ability to shoot a mega light beam from your eyes
strengths: You can burn/blind your enemies
Your beam cannot affect you
weaknesses: You cannot make the beam less painful

name: Energy Conversion
description: When you release the energy of a person from your body or the object you put it in, it takes a form of electricity or explosive power, depending on there nature. You can take energy from an object like computer lamp posts etc. but they can't be use offensively...or in any way at all...so there just a waste of space I guess. If you where to take the enrgy of another person with powers then when you release it, it would take the most offensive form of there power(s), but you can only use it once.
summary: The ability to convert human energy into an object or yourself.
strengths: You can make specialized ammo or weapons by taking energy from another person with powers.
No one can use your speciallized weapons seeing that only you can control how much is released.
weaknesses: Since this power is based of emotion your emotions get more sensitive and easily aggrevated.
After using a person with abilities energy you must recharge yourself.

name: Time Lock
description: This power traps a person or object one second out of sync with the rest of reality so that they do not exist in the present. They will remain continually one second in the future until another time power (or this power) releases them. If the power is successfully used on something, then it will appear that the object disappeared in a flash of light. When returned to sync with reality, there would be a flash of light and matter would be displaced where the object was.
summary: The ability to trap a person one second in the future so that they will be unexistant.
strengths: Trap things out of sync with reality so they temporarily are non-existant.
Can be used on anything you have the power to affect.
Perfect Jail.
weaknesses: People with time powers like, Time Defiance or Anachronism can easily escape (Only imperfection)
The larger the object, the harder it is to time-lock.
The matter displacement of large objects returning could be deadly.

name: Glass Shard Strike
description: With this power you can shoot shards of glass out of your hands. The glass cannot shatter inside of your hand and you cannot be hurt by the glass even after it leaves your hand. You have unlimited shards of glass in your hands and can shoot them out of both hands.
summary: The ability to shoot shards of glass out of the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot shards of glass out of your hands
You cannot be hurt by your shards
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by shards of glass that did not come from your hand

name: Platinum Mantle
description: It is a cape made from nanoplasm, but it can change its appearance and shape to your will. You could transform it into many weapons to swipe at you enemies with blades sticking out of the bottom of the cloak. It could allow you to fly by morphing it into wings. Use it for defence, or even for cutting and dismembering your opponent's limbs.
summary: The ability to use and morph it into various arsenals to attack your foes.
strengths: Can go into stealth mode to hide or ambush your foes.
weaknesses: Molten lava will corrupt and melt the mantle into nothingness.
Low temperatures can cause the cape to freeze.

name: Cronochorokinesis
description: With this ability one could manipulate the space related dimensions on an object or the "Co-ordinants", thus, the object transports to another dimension. This is very similar to Object Displacement the only difference being that objects that you transport to another dimension you can not get them back. The object transports to a random dimension.
summary: The ability to manipulate the space related dimensions of an object.
strengths: Transport foes or any other bothersome object to a random dimension.
If one can develop this power enough one could transport one's self to a different dimension
weaknesses: Once transported an object or person is almost impossible to get back.
One does not have knowledge of these other dimensions

name: Palmer's Chain Link
description: With this ability, By swiping your hand across someone else, or shaking their hand, you're given a piece of their strength, and intelligence. You could achieve great distances depending on how many people you touch. Over time, you'll possess superhuman strength and intellect. Soon, you could be able to lift vehicles with your muscle, and your mind could become strong enough to gain psychic abilities.
summary: The ability to touch someone to increase your mental/physical peak and performance
strengths: It won't hurt anyone you touch - you're simply sharing strength, and intelligence through a link.
You can break the chain at any time if you concentrate on excactly who to break it with.
Build on the natural Human psychic ability.
weaknesses: Psychic energy may begin to easily set off.
Difficult to explain how you lifted that Fire Engine.

name: Thoughtform Projection
description: Artists have been trying for years to transform emotions or music into visual media. A person with Thoughtform Projection has a shortcut. They can produce abstract illusiory projections of things like music, emotions, or even a person's thought process. The projection changes shape and color as the idea changes, and it can be made as big or as small as the person needs it to be.
summary: The ability to create abstract 3-D holograms of ideas, emotions, or thought processes
strengths: Create some beautiful 'laser' shows
Stun opponents with the sudden brightness of a thoughtform
With practice, can tell what someone is thinking
weaknesses: Thoughtforms not physical
Color or pattern is totally out of your control
Not very useful for everyday purposes

name: Instant Biographic Aptitude
description: The power to learn the entire biograpy of a person by making skin contact without the need of long-term relationship building or extensive education. Similar to Telepathic Psychoanalysis (Mind Reading), Psychometry (or Clairsentience) and Intuitive Aptitude, but this ability is as if you have been living next to the subject/victim all your life. One with this ability knows all the secrets and details of the person they touch.
summary: The ability to instantly learn the biography of a people by touching them
strengths: Easy friend making ability
Can discover secrets and info from unwilling individuals
Can easily cope with ailed/sick people
weaknesses: Limited only to touch
The trigger is uncontrollable, so you must wear gloves
Intimacy may turn out awkward

name: Enslaving Wish Granting
description: You can grant almost any wish and get a new slave who you can command to do anything you want, even if it's against their morals. You cannot grant wishes that make others omnipotent, omnipresent, omniscient, reality bending, etc. You also cannot create love between two beings nor force one being to love another. Also all commands given must be specific or the slave might try to do something you don't want them to do or do something you haven't ordered them not to do such as killing you.
summary: The ability to grant the wishes of others and make them one's slaves in exchange
strengths: Can easily assemble an army... Or maybe a harem!
Give someone genius-level intellect and have them research anything you want.
weaknesses: You can't grant your own wishes.
You have restrictions on the wishes you can grant.

name: Electromagnetic Receiver
description: A person with this power does not have telepathy, instead they are able to read the electric signals within people's minds to figure out their thoughts and emotions. This power does not leave any telekinetic trail of any sort and is unaffected by Anti-telepathy or Telepathic Prison. In addition, the user can also "read the minds" of machines. However, they can be fooled if there is electrical interference or if a person wears an insulator helmet. If mastered, the user can also influence others.
summary: The ability to read the electromagnetic waves given off by people or machines to read minds
strengths: Alternate method of telepathy
Works on both humans and machines
If mastered, you can also send your own signals to try to disrupt or alter people's thoughts
weaknesses: If you don't focus, you might accidentally listen to radio instead of people's emotions/thoughts
It's even harder to manipulate people's minds with electricity than regular telepathy
Insulator helmets block out your readings

name: Psychogenesis
description: Ignite superhuman mental abilities and control persons with mental abilities within 92 meters of ignition. Anyone with a psychic ability is your mental puppet. But you only have powers through other individuals. When you control their ability through them, their powers are exponentially stronger. Vicariously you are stronger than any other psychogenic power.
summary: The ability to ignite, dominate and control any mental superpowers
strengths: Ignite, boost and control anyone with mental powers within 100 yards
Their power is exponentially stronger when you are in control of their mind
Your domination and power increase by the number of psionic ones around you
weaknesses: Alone you have no power. Must ignite at least one person a day to keep this ability
Alone you also have headaches and will suffer a massive cerebral aneurysm
Run the risk of igniting someone with Psychogenic potential

name: Brainwave Manipulation
description: Every function of our body is controlled by our brain and the electrical signals it produces. A Brainwave Manipulator can speed up or slow down these signals, and thus the thinking processes, of other people. They can slow a person down so much that they seem to be frozen, or speed them up to computer-like levels. However, they must be careful. Speeding someone up for too long can burn out their neurons, and keeping them slow can slow their breathing and deprive them of air.
summary: The ability to manipulate the speed of thinking processes
strengths: Can affect up to 10 people
Help people during tests or other situations
Slow your foes and easily defeat them
weaknesses: Cannot be used on yourself without painful feedback
People who are slowed see the world as extremely fast (pretty obvious)
People who are speeded still limited by their bodies (no light-speed reflexes)

name: Melee Projection
description: You can point any melee weapon, ranged weapon, or whatever at anyone or anything, and "shoot" them with it, somehow creating an effect as if you had attacked with the item. However, it only has 75% of the normal effect, so it's better to "Double shoot". It also makes a gun-like sound, which is kind of cool.
summary: The ability to hit people with things without actually doing so
strengths: Hit hazardous things from long distance
Use fragile weapons without actually using them
Use melee weapons on enemies with ranged weapons from ranged distance
weaknesses: Only about 3/4 efficiency

name: Gravity Switch
description: With this power you can turn gravity upside down but only for you. You can walk up walls as if it's a flat, normal plane. There must be something above you, for example, a lightbulb.
summary: The ability to this power allows you to see everything and work as if the gravity has changed.
strengths: Fantastic for hiding and stealth.
Easily escape from things.
weaknesses: There must be something above you.
Dizzy-ness :P

name: Meteor Power Creation
description: The ability to create metors which can give people powers. If you are hit with 2, you will gain 2 powers and if you are hit with 1, you will gain 1 power. You can keep giving yourself powers too.
summary: The ability to create meteors that give people super powers
strengths: Give yourself powers that you choose
Pretty cool power
Deliberately giving people bad powers
weaknesses: If you lose control, this power can be fatal
May be stressful giving people powers all the time
Bad super heroname: "meteor man"

name: Ability Reflection
description: This is the ability to reflect anything back to the person who used their ability on you. Ex. If somebody threw fireballs at you, the fireballs would reflect off of you and burn the person who attacked you, If someone tried stopped time around you, time would speed up around them, if somebody tried to read your mind, they would only be able to hear their own thoughts. Even physical abilities such as super strength punches and turned against their owner
summary: The ability to reflect the effects of anyone else's power onto the person who used the power against you
strengths: Reflect anythind back to the original caster and hurt them with their own power
You're not affected by any powers no matter what, and also no limit to reflected power
Good team back up
weaknesses: You can be hurt by people who dont use/have an offensive ability ex. Adaptive breath
Team members cannot use their abilities to aid you ex. Healing touch or Ability boosting
If the person is evil, then they would be every superheroes nightmare

name: Reverse Aging
description: This ability allows you to reverse your age at any time, while still retaining the knowledge and experience you have now.  Although you have to power to never die of old age, you won't necessarily be immortal.  You are still susceptible to physical harm and illness.  However, if your illness is due to natural causes from old age, you can reverse the process.  Any age goes, be it 20, 15, 10, even the age you were born.  But be careful--once you reverse your age, you can't fast-forward.
summary: The ability to reverse your age at will.
strengths: Eternal youth
Never get flabby arms or have a wrinkly ass
Hot 18 year olds
weaknesses: Others get older while you stay young.
You can still die from injury or disease (although younger bodies have better immune systems).
Explaining to people why you look so young when you're 180 years old

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Powers
description: The Powers, also known as the Authorities, are the bearers of conscience and keepers of history. They are also warrior angels who remain loyal to the superior. As a Power, you oversee the distribution of power among mankind, hence the name. Powers appear as beautiful humans clad in gold sapphire-studded armor, they also have incredibly long hair which sparkles and glistens like a river in the summer. The Powers carry two beautifully crafted longswords which are hidden in their red velvet wings.
summary: The ability to become a celestial keeper of history.
strengths: Acquire knowledge of past, present, and limited history of the future.
Clear through armies of enemies with ease.
Ultimate beauty.
weaknesses: Powers have no key weaknesses, although they are not ultimately invulnerable.

name: Moon Angel
description: A moon angel abilities are to fly,hydrokinesis and calmness inducement. In the night they are able heal as well but in the day a moon angel is only capable of using one power which the moon angel can decide on what it is.
summary: The ability to become a moon angel
strengths: Can fly and know how to fly
Control water which can be fun
Can be seen as a normal angel and be worshipped
weaknesses: You might not like being worshipped
When it's day time so you're a lot weaker
Your enemies sun angels could take advantage of the daylight

name: Healer 8: Enzyme Addition
description: With this power, you can generate a field with a radius of 25 kilometers inside which all individuals have all normal enzymes. As a bonus, if any of them have other enzymes in their body which are blocked, this power will restore them too. You can also mimic enzymes found in other species or from any superhuman who enters your field, allowing you to survive a greater range of internal pH and resist changes in temperature. The field expands a meter each year and can be switched off at will.
summary: The ability to restore enzymes and mimic those of other species.
strengths: Many poisons are not as effective or even useless.
Range of 25 kilometers, increasing by one meter each year. Can be turned off at will.
Instant cure for enzyme deficiencies such as phenyketonuria.
weaknesses: Limit to temperature resistance; your DNA still falls apart at 120 degrees Celsius.
Enzyme deficiencies will return shortly after people leave the field.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Battleforce
description: An energy that is driven by a combination of willpower, emotion,and courage and channel this energy into anything the user sees as a potential weapon. Some traits enhanced would be durability, power, range, agility, or mechanical function.
summary: The ability to enhance or upgrade weaponary
strengths: Synergies with a skilled combatant
Makes any last minute weapon a deadly tool
weaknesses: Requires a certain amount of courage and willpower
Useless without some form of weapon

name: Cyclonic Past
description: Through what you might call a cyclone, you go into a chosen part in your past and can contact your earlier self to change the path you walked on.
summary: The ability to travel into your own past and change what you do by contacting yourself
strengths: May avoid death
May choose the better side of life
weaknesses: Can alter the timeline greatly
Can cause death
May become stuck in the past and destroy it

name: Centrifugal Force Manipulation
description: With this power you can make anything spin faster or slower or make things spin. You can make the air spin to create tornadoes. You can make projectiles spin to change its trajectory. You can also create artificial gravity by spinning the air around you. You can also soften dirt by making a select portion of the ground spin if you train enough.
summary: The ability to control centrifugal force
strengths: You can make anything spin
You can become dizzy if you make yourself spin or look at spinning things too long
You can be creative with this power
weaknesses: You can only make things spin you cannot move the objects by itself
If you spin parts of your body that is not supposed to spin they will break

name: Leprechaun Teleport
description: Leprechauns are magical creatures. They have many abilities, and one of them is teleporting. But they can only teleport when no one is watching. You now can do the same. As long as no one is looking when you leave or when you arrive, you can teleport anywhere on the planet.
summary: The ability to teleport, as long as no one's looking.
strengths: Poping up behind someone.
Great magic trick
weaknesses: Very strange power

name: Transferring Injuries
description: If a person was hit with a baseball bat, the person possessing this power could transfer the pain from their friend to a rock, or a mirror, relieving the persons pain and shattering or cracking the rock/mirror.
summary: The ability to move Injuries From One Person/Object To Another
strengths: You can save pain from pain
You can hurt others at the same time
You can heal yourself
weaknesses: If you loose concentration, the isn't transferred
Initially, you can't move the pain very far

name: Singularity Generation
description: You can create bowling ball sized exposed singularities. You can guide up to two towards a single target or hit two targets that are close together. Any armor or forcefield will be destroyed first. Powers that defy the laws of physics or give protection from changes to the laws of physics give someone immunity to this attack. Powers of invulnerability or intangibility also give immunity. Otherwise, this attack destroys any target made of energy or matter.
summary: The ability to create exposed singularities and guide them to targets.
strengths: If you had binoculars or telescopic vision and could fly, you can hit someone from miles away.
Kills foes made of matter or energy.
You can send two singularity balls at once.
weaknesses: If someone has immutability, quantum intangibility, space/time indemnity or physics rejector.
If someone has other powers that work like the ones above.

name: Sensory Organisation
description: Tired of mental confusion from several information-providing powers? Does Super Hearing hurt you ears? Is Ability Detection distracting? With this power, all those powers are managed by your body like normal senses, allowing you to use them all at once, while they adjust their power level and work in tandem. Best of all, this works for your normal senses.
summary: The ability to coordinate your senses.
strengths: No more mental overload.
Information is easier to understand.
This is a passive power.
weaknesses: Some powers still make you fall unconscious.
It's more useful for people with sensory superpowers.
While you would normally stay conscious with this power, some powers will still knock you out

name: Aesthetic Assimilation
description: Imagine a hero whose 'base power' is pyrokinesis. By this I mean what s/he is known for, what their essential, underlying ability or theme (fire) is. If this hero suddenly teleported away, or began to fly, it could appear out of character. This power, allows you to use additional powers in the style of your basic ones. The pyrokinetic could teleport in a blast of flame, or the water manipulator could fly with a trail of mist following them. No strict rules on this one. Use your imagination!
summary: The ability to carry out additional powers in the aesthetic style of your 'base' superpower or theme.
strengths: Helps to sustain a hero's image in their day to day hero-ing actvities.
Not a practical power, but a useful one if you're concerned about the public face you present.
Think of the way the Human Torch's flight is linked in with his Pyric Mimicry. It's awesome.
weaknesses: Has no effect on mental abilities or ones which are purely physical, like super strength or agility.
Would also have no effect if the hero has no discernible base power or theme.
If you are unfortunate enough to be a Jelly-kinetic, it could make everything a bit ridiculous...

name: Heated Touch
description: A person with Heated Touch can make their hands hot. Like 10,000 degrees C hot. Like disintegrating things because they burn so fast hot. Sadly, this ability is not a projectile. Around an inch from your hands and the temperature is normal.
summary: The ability to generate heat from your hands
strengths: Cook bacon on your palm
Escaping confinement
Fights don't happen much
weaknesses: Is not ranged, have to touch
Fueled by concentration
Cannot make any other body part hot

name: Infliction Of Agony
description: Pain Infliction is the ability to inflict a mental illusion of extreme pain onto your opponent. The longer you hold it the more intense the pain becomes, causing your victim to see mental images of their worst most painful nightmares and experiences. However, it is not actual pain, just an illusion.
summary: The ability to inflict an illusion of intense pain
strengths: Dehabilitating and powerful.
Can take down just about anyone.
If used for long enough, can cause the target to go mad.
weaknesses: As soon as you break concentration the illusion is broken.
No phyiscal damage is done.
Only targets one person.

name: Super Shoes
description: With this power you get super shoes. Super shoes are magical shoes that allow the user to jump higher and run fast than the average person but not as fast or high as a person with super speed or super jumping powers. They also make it hurt a lot when you kick someone or step on them. The shoes can also become any style of any kind of shoe you want (they start off as nondescript brown shoes) they also grow when your foot grows so they always fit. As soon as you take them off they disappear.
summary: The ability to have super shoes
strengths: You have super shoes
When you take them off they disappear until you want them again so nobody can steal them
They do all the things described above
weaknesses: When you're not wearing the shoes you don't have the abilities they give you

name: Ominous Presence
description: Ominous Presence is not well understood, and probably never will be. The effects are just too strange. When someone with Ominous Presence walks in a room, the temperature drops, mirrors fog up, lights begin to flicker, animals fall silent and cower, and shadows start to grow on the wall. Naturally, human inhabitants are intimidated by this. This paranormal effect extends roughly 80 feet before slowly deteriorating. It can be deactivated, but only with conscious effort.
summary: The ability to subconsciously influence your environment in paranormal ways
strengths: Creepy effects: fogging mirrors, dropping temperature, flickering lights, etc.
Intimidates a foe
Extends 80 feet, slowly decaying after that
weaknesses: Always on, must focus to turn it off
Definitely feared by everyone
Does not actually attack a foe
tags: a chill wind through this room doth blow

name: Hide In Plain Sight
description: A person with this power produces no trace. A scent dog cannot find them because this power erases the user's scent while it is active. This power also makes the user totally silent. However, the user of this power is not totally invisible. They can be seen but they are translucent. This power can be turned on and off easily and has very little effect on the user physically.
summary: The ability to be undetectable
strengths: Escape from scent dogs
Be a super ninja
Make wolverine and run. Even he won't be able to pick up your scent
weaknesses: Not invisible
Doesn't have any offensive uses
Once you turn the power off, you start producing a scent again

name: Super Cloak
description: If you are standing next to something, you can become an exact replica of it. You are only able to be a replica for 10 min. Then, there's a 1-hour cool down.
summary: The ability to become a replica of something you're standing by
strengths: If you're hiding from someone, you can become a replica
Can keep you out of trouble
You can turn into something useful to you and use it
weaknesses: Short period of usage time
1-hour cool down time

name: Audiopathy
description: A person with this power has the telepathic ability to transmit sound into the minds of others. For example, they can cause anyone in their vicinity and later farther away to hear anything they want. While you make them telepathically hear stuff, their own natural sense of hearing is disabled so they only hear what you send them. The user controls the volume and other audio controls.
summary: The ability to telepathically control people's sense of hearing
strengths: Can be used as offensive weapon to hurt people mentally or distract them
Even if someone broke their eardrums this will still work - since this is sent mentally
Can also be used to listen to a song you like or communicate long distance
weaknesses: They can't hear anything else when you send them the sound

name: Decision Change
description: You can listen to any thoughts in the room you're in and if you don't like them, you can change them. The good part is changing minds and stopping fights. The bad part is that you HAVE to hear every thought in the room. The power is useful for stopping wars, changing laws, keeping yourself from being spotted, and keeping yourself out of trouble.
summary: The ability to take a person's thoughts and change them with your mind
strengths: Changing people's thoughts
Hearing what people think of you
Preventing bad things from happening
weaknesses: Hearing every thought in the room
Making things happen that weren't supposed to happen

name: Summoning: Tsukuyomi
description: Tsukuyomi, god of the Moon, brother of Susanoo and Amaterasu. His power is the strongest at night. He can strike down your opponents with illusions, and drive them to insanity.
summary: The ability to summon Tsukuyomi.
strengths: Summon Tsukuyomi.
Illusions.
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Your Mind Is A Stage
description: Your Mind Is A Stage allows you to be the lead role, playwright and director of any event. Say you want to ask someone on a date, Your Mind Is A Stage allows you to change the world to a mental plane where you can create a fantastic theatrical result. In this situation you could make it so you stop them from getting jumped by thugs, or reveal a long lost twin. You're the lead role, director, and playwright. But you can only have 3 acts in a play, and 3 uses per day.
summary: The ability to change your surrounding into a mental state (represented by a theatre stage) and control the outcome
strengths: You can control any outcome
Closed thoughts (unlike Your Mind Is A Prison)
It's theatrically themed (that's why it's called "Your Mind Is A Stage")
weaknesses: 3 acts in a play, 3 times a day
Can cause delusions.
It's theatrically themed (that's why it's called "Your Mind Is A Stage")

name: Chains Of Wrath
description: They are made of the strongest metal in the universe. You can also wrap your entire body in them to make a chain body armor thing. But the the chains are made of metal that is liquid until it comes out your skin. You must absorb large amounts of metal to use large amounts of chains
summary: The ability to shoot chains at your enemies. They can tie them up or kill them depending on how fire
strengths: Always have chains to shoot
Can make armor that will protect you and make you extremely strong
Can tie up or kill enemies
weaknesses: Must absorb metal
Chain armor is heavy and can slow you down
Extreme heat can melt chains

name: Myth Power: Atlas' Atonement
description: Atlas, in Greek Myth, was the Titan god of stamina, endurance, patience and daring, as well as the Bearer of the Heavens. As such, channeling him allows one to gain Superhuman Strength (especially upper-body strength), Endurance (Durability), Stamina and Sturdiness (Steadiness). In addition, one gains Superhuman Physical and Mental Resilience, and can withstand irrational fear and heightened mental states. One can even psychically project a miniature atmosphere, to use as a forcefield, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Atlas' command over the essence of stamina, patience, endurance and daring
strengths: Superhuman Strength, Endurance (Durability), Stamina and Sturdiness (Steadiness)
Superhuman Physical/Mental Resilience; withstand irrational fear and heightened psychological states
Psychically project a mini-atmosphere to use as a forcefield (similar effects to a real atmosphere)
weaknesses: No Pain Immunity or Invulnerability until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 requires that one personally hold the atmosphere up to keep it active (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Cratos' Workout can disrupt this ability (NCN)

name: Astral Shrapnel
description: This is the ability to generate and release astral energy from one's body in the form of sharp, damaging shards. When they come into contact with inanimate matter, they do great damage, but the true damage is done to electrical and biological systems. When they come into contact with electronics, the machine is damaged and may even shut off, while contact with living systems generates pain that can even be felt by spirits and superhumans with no emotion.
summary: The ability to project sharp, damaging shards of astral, or spiritual energy
strengths: Spritual energy is very powerful
Affects electronics drastically
Affects spirits and people without emotion
weaknesses: Only does damage (no passive uses for it)
Can sometimes by activated subconsciously, if power is undeveloped
If you try to change the size or shape of the shards, you get a shock (but they don't change)

name: Form Reversal
description: Just point at something and think. Glass is now sand. Wine is now grapes. A pillow is now a duck. OK, that last one does break some laws of logic, but it's all good. This can be very useful. If you throw a chair and change it into a tree in mid-flight, the effect can be devastating. Turn tires into tree sap, thwarting any getaway attempts. You can even go back multiple steps. Ex: Plastic into Oil; Oil into Dinosaur.
summary: The ability to revert an object to its previous form
strengths: Nothing is immune
Good for mulligans
Can heal teammates by reversing them to pristine state
weaknesses: Cannot reverse the direction of objects; bullets just become really fast rocks
Cannot move anything forward
Requires some massive leaps of logic

name: Trust Keeper
description: Gain anyone's trust and never lose it no matter what.  You need to touch the person to use this power.
summary: The ability to gain anyone's trust and never lose it, no matter what.
strengths: Gain trust
Never lose it
Easy
weaknesses: Need to touch person your gaining trust from

name: Weapon Nut
description: With this ability you have the power to turn your hand into any weapon: hitting objects, swords, guns, bomb launchers, anything--just by thinking of the weapon you want at that moment.
summary: The ability to know everything about any weapon and turn your hand into a weapon at will.
strengths: Very useful in any kind of combat.
Every gun you want in just a blink away without carrying them.
weaknesses: When unstable or uncontrolled, you might get another weapon than the one you were thinking of
When in the wrong hands it can nuke the world or start a nuclear war.

name: Blood Synthesis
description: You can create any number of creatures out of your blood. They are a hive mind with you at the center, so you can communicate with them in a cell-phone like way, but with better reception, and move their muscles as your own. They have no minds of their own, so they cannot do anything (even in their own defense) without your command, don't need food, and are immune to pain. Also, you can mutate the blood even OUTSIDE of your body.
summary: The ability to make creatures out of your blood
strengths: Completely obedient servants that will never disobey you.
Legions of super-soldiers that will show no mercy.
Fun-sized ones will be truly fun!!
weaknesses: You don't have any super-regen yet, so you could rip a pretty big hole in yourself accidentally.
You also don't have super-concentration either.
The red cross blood drive will be kinda interesting, and a couple people won't get much better
tags: the red cross and how screwed it is if you get this power.

name: Nitro Kinesis
description: A person with this power has the power to control the element of nitrogen. Not only can the user rip out nitrogen from the air which is pretty much 75% nitrogen and nitrogen compounds, the user can also create reactions using nitrogen. For example, the user can create highly unstable compounds that explode and cause nitrogen to react with carbon producing cyanide. They can also produce laughing gas. Nitrogen in its elemental form can be used as liquid nitrogen to freeze your enemies.
summary: The ability to control the element of nitrogen, including shifting its phases and creating chemical reactions
strengths: Liquid nitrogen can be used to freeze people because it is a cryogen
Extremely versatile reactions-too many to list here in the pros
It is abundant in the Earth's atmosphere-it's basically 75%
weaknesses: You still need to breathe. So, a nitrogen armor isn't such a good idea
You need to be extremely skilled and know chemistry to create the correct chemical reactions

name: Random Reality Warp
description: You can fire energy bolts from your hands , which when they impact on an object, can cause random reality warps. You have little control of the unlikeliness of the reality change. It can range from making someone trip over by bad luck, to erasing someone from existence or turning a cloud into a gold bar. If you calculate the theoretical odds of an event occuring, you cause that exact outcome, for example making a coin land heads up, which has a 1 in 2 chance.
summary: The ability to fire energy bolts that cause random reality warps
strengths: You are a very unpredicatable, and potentially very powerful fighter
If you're lucky, you could have just the warp you want
When you wish for something with all your heart, a warp has a greater chance of causing it
weaknesses: This power can be incredibly dangerous, if a warp occurs that you don't want
Due to the random nature of your power, any bad warps are practically impossible to undo
Your bolts may be lethal to a foe, when you wish only to stun them

name: Manticore Summon
description: With this power you can summon a manticore, a mythical beast with the body of a red lion, the head of a human (with three rows of sharp teeth) and the tail of a scorpion which can shoot poison barbs that can injure but not kill an opponent. The Manticore is under your complete control and when you're done with it you can send it back to wherever it came from. Also you can only summon one at a time but if one dies you can summon another one.
summary: The ability to summon a manticore
strengths: You can summon a manticore
It under your complete control
If one dies you can just summon another one
weaknesses: The poison barbs can only injure not kill

name: Osteoblast Mimicry
description: This power gives you four abilities. First, your body can secrete a soft collagen-based substance you can model in any way. When you're done, it solidifies into a brittle bone. Second, you can telekinetically move substances containing calcium or phosphate within a short range and form tiny but extremely strong crystals out of them. Third, you can telepathically communicate with anyone with this power. And finally, you can strengthen or inhibit the bone-destruction ability of Osteoclast Mimics.
summary: The ability to create bones of any shape, manipulate calcium and phosphate within a short range and more.
strengths: You can (or rather, should) use calcium/phosphate manipulation to strengthen your bones.
You can use your own body (except your bones, see con 2) as a source of calcium and phosphate.
You can strengthen your own skeleton, but it's not recommended if you don't have Osteoclast Mimicry.
weaknesses: Without either calcium or phosphate, the bones you create will be easy to break.
You can't manipulate calcium nor phosphate that have already been integrated into bones.
And therefore, you can't telekinetically manipulate bones, including the ones you create.

name: Foe Shift
description: With this power you can turn into anybody or anything that you've ever fought against. You gain all of their powers and skill while retaining your intelligence, knowledge and personality. You can stay in enemy mode for as long as you want. It only applies to people or things you've actually fought not just people who you don't like.
summary: The ability to turn into any of your enemies
strengths: You can turn into anything or anyone you've ever fought
You gain all of their powers and skill while keeping your knowledge and personality
weaknesses: You can only turn into people you've actually fought not just people who you don't like

name: Metal Heat
description: Ever walk into a bank robbery and the theif has a gun? Well you don't have to flip out any more if you have metal heat becase you can instantly melt your foe's gun or metal weapon before they have a chance to pull the trigger!
summary: The ability to melt metal at will, with your mind
strengths: No more people pointing a gun to your head.
No more watching scary movies and then feeling scared at night.
And mostly, no more freddy crugar!
weaknesses: If you have not mastered, you may melt your butter knife during dinner.

name: Face Mimicry
description: This power is basically a shape-shifting power limited to the face area, excluding the hair of course. With this you can copy the face of any person you see. However, you can't copy their body, their hair, or their voice. You won't even change your gender. The skin color of your entire head will change to match the targeted person though. You remember all the faces you've mimicked so you can change into them again later.
summary: The ability to copy someone else's face, and only their face.
strengths: Not being able to copy the voice is not a problem if you keep quiet.
Not being able to copy the hair and body is not a problem if you wear a burqa, a niqab or a chador.
Not being able to change gender is not a problem if you explain you just had realignment surgery.
weaknesses: Nothing as long you can come up with an excuse for why you don't look yourself today.
Nothing if you don't meet someone who knows the person you're copying.
Nothing if you can hide your body and your hair from other people while you're transformed.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Shadowing
description: You can create an almost invisible being that follows a person around (until you tell it not to, in which case it fades away) and feeds you information about that particular person. It can also assess that person's weaknesses, strengths and powers, as well as useful strategies. This being can only be seen in daylight (as a shadow), and if somebody notices it, not only can they not get rid of it, it will also make them paranoid.
summary: The ability to create a being to follow and observe someone
strengths: Can drive a person insane
Learn plans and spy on your enemies
Gives you a full readout on the person
weaknesses: A person with true sight can see it
It can only inform you about the person you sent it after
Takes time to gather the information

name: Shock Grenades
description: The Shock Grenades are non-lethal electroshock explosive weapons, but whenever it lands on the opponent it explodes and delivers an electrical shock to disrupt voluntary control of muscles. They are extremely useful when you are in a flood while battling and easily effective against water type foes.
summary: The ability to throw electrical explosive grenades.
strengths: You won't need tasers or normal non-lethal grenades to use them to defeat your opponents.
weaknesses: None

name: Mechanical Charging
description: Perhaps the perfect power for those who rely heavily on energy-run technology, this allows the user to charge energy-requiring machines with solely the power of his mind. One with this ability generates energy that can be used to charge batteries of anything from batteries of cell phones and TV remotes to cars, airplanes, robots and various other machines.
summary: The ability to use psychic power in order to charge machines
strengths: No need for a cell phone charger
Your car doesn't ever need gas to run (it'll run as long as you're in it)
You're a living battery (charging makes machines run longer than normal)
weaknesses: Only works on machines (not living beings)
Charge lasts a lot longer, but is not permanent
Charge often requires physical contact (and in weaker users, can actually drain the USER's energy)

name: Half Dragon
description: Being half dragon gives you the ability to produce fire from anywhere on your body. You can grown big wings to fly at top speed. Finally you have a very tough skin that reduces the damage you take.
summary: The ability to be half dragon
strengths: You can fly
If you have a sword you can swing it and fire comes out
You can turn full dragon for an hour at most for your ultimate power
weaknesses: You are often being chased by the government to do testing
You are known as a freak and a monster
When you get really angry you lose control of yourself

name: Enchantment
description: Have you ever seen a movie where the wizard has a charm that protects him from harm? That charm was enchanted. With this power you can do the same. You can control magical properties like luck, protection, obedience, bad luck, balance, and many others. You can enchant anything or anyone. And you can control how long it lasts.
summary: The ability to create and control magical properties
strengths: You can control tons of properties
You would have luck,balance,protection and much more.
You can enchant people
weaknesses: If they find out people might want you to make them charms
Not much use with fighting

name: Bodily Propulsion
description: You are able to bodily generate thermo-chemical energy and release it from your skin. It comes with an enhanced boost to your base energy levels and endurance. When energy is stored 'behind' a limb or entire body & released, that limb becomes invulnerable to physical harm during propulsion. This power enables multiple other abilities, eg: a personal force field, making explosive shockwave upon impact (landing, hitting)
summary: The ability to store energy in or behind any given limb and release at will, propelling yourself or the limb.
strengths: Use the energy for jet propulsion (and negating the negative side effects of flight)
Unstoppable and unvulnerable while using the energy to move - creates shockwave upon impact
Personal force field to make you almost invulnerable
weaknesses: Unstoppable during propulsion while using the energy; just like the Juggernaut against the Hulk.
Eventually, energy needs to be replenished

name: Sedation
description:
The power to tranquilize organisms into a somnolent state. The user can induce a feeling of calm and sleepiness within the minds of others. The subjects are vaguely conscious; their upper brain functions are slowed down. 
Does not put subjects to sleep or calm emotions (as does Narcoleptic Pheromones and Empathic Manipulation respectively).
summary: The ability to put organisms into a calm state
strengths: Can calm a crazy or angry person
Peaceful ability
Can calm a depressed person
weaknesses: Subjects can become drowsy, so they can't reveal secrets
Subjects may appear intoxicated, so the police may question you
Excessive use may disrupt a subjects sleeping pattern

name: Mark Of Skoll
description: In Norse mythology, Skoll was one of the wolf brothers (the other being Hati) who chased after the sun and moon god. During the day of Ragnarok, Skoll devoured the Sun God and gain his power. With this power, you have the ability to turn into a werewolf or gaint one with immense strength, speed, healing factor, immoratality. You also have power of a Sun God and can use elements like fire, light, and gravity and can become more powerful with sunlight.
summary: The ability to become a solar lycan
strengths: Super strength and speed of a werewolf
Have the power of the sun god
Can stand up against a god and devour them
weaknesses: Other gods might want hunt you down
Might be hard to control at first
Not as strong at night

name: Move Swipe
description: You will be able to use a move that your enemy used on you. You absorb the aftermath of a move, say laser fragments or a dust cloud, and you can use that move
summary: The ability to use a move that was just used on you.
strengths: You can use a cool move
You can mimic abilities that your enemy holds
weaknesses: It has to hit you first
You can only use it once (If it hit you again, you can use it again)

name: Pagokinesis
description: Unlike Cryokinesis which controls ice, Pagokinesis controls the Cold Air that turns water into ice. It grows stronger with the natural cold air around you. Also, the more you use the ability in a specific area, the colder your environment gets.
summary: The ability to control the Cold Air.
strengths: It's like manipulating water and air
The colder it is, the stronger it is
Can be used for flight and speed as well
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate water, only the ice
Grows weaker in warmer temperatures

name: Nightmare Dimension
description: All of humanity's nightmares go to one place: the nightmare dimension. Your power allows you to transport anyone to and from this place. All the fear and terror possibly dreamed lives here and is made into phyisical forms to inflict horror, terror, fear and harm to any visitors. This dark realm has no escape unless you wish it.
summary: The ability to teleport people to a dimension of all of humanity's darkest nightmares
strengths: Cause victims terror
Be a living Freddy Krueger
weaknesses: ...if sending people to a terrible dimesion and causing insanity is wrong, I don't wanna be right
Can only stay inside dimension for 24 hours, then the target is teleported back to our dimension

name: Psychic Network
description: A person with this ability has the power to grant anyone psychic abilities as long as they consent to listening to an mp3. Once the other person, becomes an esper, you also gain the same abilities as the other person. The more people that are in your network, the stronger everyone in the network will be. Only the moderator/proxy/owner has multiple abilities and they can kick out anyone from the network at will as long as they are in a lower rank. The owner can use the group as a calculator.
summary: The ability to create a network of esper whose power increases due to the network sharing
strengths: Create an army
Get everyone's powers if you are the owner
Have the calculating powers of your entire network
weaknesses: You can still be defeated by someone outside your network
Sometimes kicking out someone does not remove their psychic powers
If someone finds your identity as the owner they can plot to kill you so they become the new owner

name: Blessing Of Poseidon
description: Poseidon is the Greek god of the sea. His gift allows you to channel the power of the sea in different ways. You can manipulate sea water and even breath underwater. You can also speak to sea creatures, gain strengh when in sea water, and know your position when at sea. Another thing, when you come in contact with water it will crawl along your skin and heal any wounds you have. And you only get wet when you want. The power of the sea is in your hands.
summary: The ability to have the gift of the sea god, Poseidon.
strengths: You can control sea water and breath .
You can speak to sea creatures, and know your position at sea.
You can heal and gain strengh from the sea.
weaknesses: You are drawn to the sea
You can only use your powers with sea water

name: Plant Manipulation
description: A person with Plant Manipulation (also called Agrokinesis) has an amazing gift. They can induce plant growth and cause large shrubs, grasses, vines, trees and other vegetation to move with their mind; this requires very little concentration. Even more spectacular, their anatomy is more plant-like than animal. This lets them photosynthesize, produce vegetation, and regenerate at twice normal speed.
summary: The ability to control and produce plant life
strengths: Takes little concentration
Can take on many foes at once
Increased resistance to animal-targeted poisons
weaknesses: Herbicides
Fire
Pollution

name: Homing Propulsion
description: This power enables you to give any object, that you are throwing, the property to aim at any target you want and to move towards it. Unless an external force acts upon the object, the latter remains at the same speed it was thrown at. The target must be in your line of sight when you throw your object, but once the target is locked on, the object will keep homing in on it until either one of them is destroyed, the object is stopped or you decide to cancel your action.
