description: This power allows you to release an ectoplasm wave that freezes any liquid permanently. The liquid turns into an ice that never melts and is as strong as a diamond. The hyper cooled ectoplasm has the same consistency as a ghost (Ghosts are made of ectoplasm, right? ) and passes through any solid thing, but not liquids. Using this power you can kill an enemy by freezing the blood inside him. The Permafrost Ice is really strong, but a well-placed attack can shatter it.
summary: The ability to shoot waves of hyper cooled ectoplasm that can permanently freeze any liquid.
strengths: Can freeze any liquid
Makes you nearly unbeatable against liquid-powered enemies (including beings with blood).
The Permafrost Ice is as strong as a diamond.
weaknesses: Works only on liquids, and your emotions can make your power stronger or weaker
You can freeze liquids, but you can't control ice.
Astrakinesis, Hydrokinesis AND Cryokinesis can control the ectoplasmed water

name: Inconspicuous Trenchcoat
description: Unnoticeable means no one knows you exist, you are pretty much invisible, except people subconsciously avoid you and ignore the floating cup of hot chocolate. You also don't leave footprints (you do but no one notices them) you can also make your presence known to certain people and no one will notice they are talking to an empty space.
summary: The ability to put on a a hat and a trench-coat and become unnoticeable
strengths: Good for playing hide and go seek
Good for committing crimes without getting caught
Good for not getting followed
weaknesses: Can accidentally disappear
Must put on trench-coat and hat
If someone really looks hard at that empty space (you) they can see you

name: Paper Manipulation
description: Paper carried around can be manipulated in size and strength, and if skillful enough, can be manipulated in a telekinetic-like fashion. It's portable and allows a variety of uses.
summary: The ability to manipulate paper
strengths: Portable and unexpected. Who's gonna think you're actually armed when all they find on you is paper?
Transportation. If you're too lazy to walk, resize and ride it like a flying carpet.
Weapon and shield-resilient against blades and various other attacks, can be folded into weapons.
weaknesses: Weakness against water. The paper softens and weakens immensely like regular paper.
Death against fire. Paper burns to a crisp like regular paper.
Energy in energy attacks counteracts the paper magic and rips it like regular paper.

name: Descriptor Addition
description: This is a power to transform things and people (including yourself), while keeping them the same actual person. You just add to its description! For example, have a butler? Make him a ninja butler! Or a ninja demon butler, or a ninja demon robot butler. Even if they don't already fit a category (like your friend is just a person, you could still add a descriptor). The descriptors can be basically anything, but this power keeps the inherent nature of the object.
summary: The ability to add descriptors to people or things
strengths: Transform anyone and anything in a lot of ways
Unlike transmutation/transformation, you don't have to grapple with "Is it the same person? "
Can do it to yourself, and inanimate objects. Can use it to kill, just add 'dead'
weaknesses: Less versatile than just pure transmutation/transformation
Can't just give someone any power directly- need an appropriate descriptor
(like robots may have strength, or demons demonic powers)

name: Animalism
description: This ability lets you create/be like any animal you want. Imagine you are a winged human, flying through the sky as high as you want, being a human with gills, and maybe even half human half wolf like a werewolf. This power is SICK!!!
summary: The ability to create limbs similar to animals on yourself
strengths: Breath under water
Fly
Be animal like
weaknesses: It
Is
Sick

name: Biological Bullet Firing
description:
Anyone with the power of Biological Bullet Firing will never feel unsafe because they are able to fire unbreakable bullets from their arms. Though these bullets do take time to remake themselves, you have a limited supply, you shouldn't need to overuse this power. Especially since the bullets are immune to heat, kevlar, and most metal.

Since the bullets are generated from your bones you also have unbreakable bones.

This power takes practice and thankfully is actively engaged.
summary: The ability to fire unbreakable bullets from your arms
strengths: Can Penatrate Most Blockades.
Fires Silently Even During Machine Gun-esque Firing
Easier To Fire Than A Gun
weaknesses: People Will Get Annoyed With Your Scarface Impressions
Possibly Having To Register Yourself As A Legal Weapon
Takes Practice To Fire. Otherwise They Just Slip Out.

name: Elemental Weapon:Thunder Staff
description: You can call forth to you a staff that can conduct, generate, attract, and repel electricity.  You can manipulate while (wielding the staff) natural and man-made generated electricity. You can create disastrous thunder storms. Also while you are wielding the staff, you are granted immunity to the thunder element.
summary: The ability to wield a staff that can manipulate thunder, lightning and electricity
strengths: Manipulate and control, thunder, lightning, electricity (this includes activating machines)
You are immune to the effects of the thunder element
Can create disastrous thunder storms
weaknesses: Control over the thunder element only works while wiedling the staff
Only immune to thunder when wielding the staff
Your elemental weakness is gravity

name: Blades Of Nature
description: You can make any ordinary blade of grass of leaf, or anything related to leaves and grass, into extremly sharp objects.
summary: The ability to make any ordinary blade of grass or leaf into incredibly sharp objects.
strengths: Make a weapon from nature.
You don't need to waste money to buy weapons.
weaknesses: Useless in areas without grass or plants.

name: Power Monstrocity
description: Once this ability is used, you change into a monstrous, scaly beast which becomes stronger when struck by superpowers. However, unless you are skilled with this ability, you may lose your reasoning skills, and it can become chaotic. Has decent defense and offensive capabilities. Did I mention that while in this form, you can inherit superpowers absorbed? (However they only last while you are in this form. )
summary: The ability to shifts into a state which becomes stronger by being struck by superpowers.
strengths: Your form grows in strength and size as you absorb strikes from superpowers.
This ability does not have a limit.
If you revert, and re-transform, skilled users can recover their former strength from this form.
weaknesses: You can lose skills of reasoning and become chaotic unless somewhat skilled with this ability.
May be seen as a threat to mankind (Not saying that conclusion isn't just. )

name: Mechanical Energy Perception
description: Mechanical Energy Perception, also called Potential-Kinetic Energy Perception, Potential/Kinetic Perception or Potential/Kinetic Energy Sense is the ability to perceive mechanical (potential and kinetic) energy, which appear to the user's vision as contrasting colors (if the user perceives it visually). This can be used to see targets' potential/kinetic energy (sometimes even a target's projected path of motion).
summary: The ability to sense potential and/or kinetic energy
strengths: Perceive potential energy (sense the shape of any immobile thing in your radius)
Perceive kinetic energy (sense the shape of any moving thing in your radius)
Switch between the two perceptions at will (and perception can be either psychic or visual)
weaknesses: If Kinetic Energy Perception is active all the time, it can be disorienting
If Potential Energy Perception is active all the time, it's even more disorienting that Kinetic
If BOTH are active all the time

name: Blood Bending
description: With body movement, you lock onto a target (it has to have blood in it). You can control the blood and make the body move however you want. For example, you can swing your fist when you're attached to someone. The person who you're attached to will swing their fist too. You cannot control for more than 20 min. and you have to wait 30 min. before using it again.
summary: The ability to control someone else's blood for at most 20 min.
strengths: Can get people to do what you want
Have them hijack a car, give it to you and they take the blame
weaknesses: The 30 min. cooldown
tags: other people doing things for you

name: Hybrid
description: Permanently change yourself into an anything/human hybrid. You could be an animal-human, a mythic-human, a computer-human, or any other hybrid you can imagine. This only has one use on yourself, but if you become adept enough at it, you may be able to turn other people into them, but most likely you won't get to pick what they are.
summary: The ability to permanently change yourself into an anything/human hybrid
strengths: Become any kind of hybrid you can imagine and stay that way even if the power is drained!
May gain other powers, plus an extended lifespan and highly detailed control over transformation
Become adept enough and you can use this power on other people
weaknesses: Cannot revert yourself unless you have another power or such
Only one use per person
Cannot control what other people will become

name: Ability Granting
description: Many theorize that everyone has ability potential. A person with Ability Granting can unlock that with a touch. The process grants a totally random ability-anything from Hydrokinesis to Intuitive Aptitude to Flight. It lasts for a week.
summary: The ability to temporarily imbue people with superpowers
strengths: Create a super-powered army
Make friends/debtors fast
Make someone's day
weaknesses: Can unlock a dangerous and uncontrollable ability
Can have your army turn on you
Cannot use it on yourself

name: Property Intensification
description: Property Intensification allows the user to intensify, or make a property of any matter that they come in contact to, except living organisms. They can make a razor blade sharp enough to cut through diamond with the flick of a wrist, or make a piece of wood harder then diamond. They can also intensify other properties, making some thing yield far more or less explosive power then its capable of, or even intensify a weakness, making steal as brittle as a mirror, or making rock flexible.
summary: The ability to the ablility to intensify the properties of matter.
strengths: Instantly sharpen or harden any object, or weaken it (among other things.)
Walls really can't stop you.
Not directly dangerous to living organisms.
weaknesses: Must come in to physical contact with  the matter
The effect wears off after a minute after the user is no longer touching it or activating the power.
Must be used indirectly to be used offensively.

name: Empathic Exoskeleton
description: Bugs are, for their size, the strongest animals on the planet. This is in part due to a durable exoskeleton that helps support the weight. A person with an Empathic Exoskeleton generates a similar structure from their body in times of duress. It is extremely tough, and grants the person the ability to lift 5 times their own weight. The exoskeleton is reabsorbed when the threat has passed.
summary: The ability to generate a tough carapace in times of need
strengths: Gain bug-like strength
Surprise factor
Carapace largely invunerable to harm
weaknesses: Only activates in times of danger
Really obvious
Mostly involuntary

name: Pain Transfer
description: With this ability you can take the pain from one person and send it to your enemy.   To use it you must be touching the source of pain and staring to your objective. You can also transfer your own wounds and pain, healing yourself.   There are limitations on the transfer of wounds, for example, if you transfer a wound in the arm to an enemy, the wound will be transmitted to the same arm.
summary: The ability to transfer pain and wounds from person to person.
strengths: You can heal your allies or friends.
You can damage your enemies.
weaknesses: The pain you transfer passes through your body, so you feel it, too.
Must be staring your foe.
Pain can only be transferred to foes who can feel it.

name: Liquid Extraction
description: To use this power, you simply have to apply pressure to a living or non-living thing and all the liquid it contains will be forced out of it. The more liquid there is, the longer it will take. Just like Dehydration, the object will dry up, but the released liquid can still be reabsorbed by its original "container".
summary: The ability to release all the liquid contained inside an object you press.
strengths: Squeeze an orange, a lemon, or any kind of fruit until all the delicious juice is extracted!
This is an effective way to get 100% of the last drops of ketchup at the bottom of the bottle.
No need to twist and wring a wet fabric, which will crease. Just press the water out.
weaknesses: You can try this on a human or an animal if you want, but it's going to be gross...
Don't accidentally use it while drinking, shampooing or using a pen. You'll spill everything.
The liquid can still be reabsorbed, unless the sudden dehydration caused enough damage.

name: Umbrum (Liquid Semimetal)
description: Umbrum in its purest form is unaffected by radiation, light, and darkness/shadows. It is also a pitch-black in color. As it becomes more of an alloy it loses those properties. High-level users of this power can create and keep Umbrum in its purest form while also being able to put it into any shape they wish. Low-level users can only create it in alloys.
summary: The ability to create and control a semimetal that is unaffected by radiation, light, and darkness
strengths: Umbrum can protect the wielder from lethal radiation levels if they wear it as a suit.
Umbrum is lighter than lead.
Those with powers based on light,radiation or darkness run from someone who has mastered this power.
weaknesses: It's a liquid and has to be in an alloy to be worn which lowers its effectiveness.
Maximum that can be created in a second is 1000 cubic metres. (No Con Negation)
Pro: Can also protect all allies unlike a power that gives radiation immunity to the holder.

name: Black Blood
description: One can control the flow of one's blood (colored black), which one can mentally pour out of one's pores and shape into weapons or armor, hardening shortly after contact with air. If cut, the blood will harden over the wound, eliminating the need for bandages. Secreting large amounts of blood will weaken you as if you had lost that blood. Cannot be reabsorbed.
summary: The ability to secrete your blood out of your pores, where it hardens into armor or claws.
strengths: Can make very hard blades or armor in a variety of shapes.
One can seal up any wound or hold any broken bone together.
One can create blades as thin as a molecule.
weaknesses: Once the blood leaves the body, it cannot be reabsorbed and crumbles after a few hours.
Black colored blood is somewhat conspicuous.
Extensive use can lead to weakness or death from blood loss.

name: Mythical Monster Morphosis
description: The ability to morph into the commonly known monsters of mythology, e.g. dragons, zombies, vampires, chimeras, krakens, medusas, nymphs, sirens, ogres, behemoths, you name it.  Also, as you morph into the mythological creature, you take on their power and nature too. For example, as a vampire, you can morph into a bat and have an unsatiable lust for the consumption of human blood, but you are weak to holy water, a stake in the heart and sunlight.
summary: The ability to morph into the legendary beasts of mythology.
strengths: Morph in and out of any mythological monster.
Take on the power of the monster you morph into too.
weaknesses: Monsters must be commonly recognised, can't just imagine new monsters up.
Take on the weaknesses of the monsters you morph into too.

name: Burning Air
description: You can heat the air in an area. Everything within it will keep getting hotter until stopped. The objects or people in the area will either start to burn or melt. Metal and other meltable materials will melt, while unmeltable objects or organisms will be turned to ashes. The area you can burn things in will increase with practice. Will only affect objects or organisms you want it to affect in that area. If you choose to leave something in that area unaffected they won't even notice the heat.
summary: The ability to heat the air in an area
strengths: No more need for lighters or matches
Can heat a cold room
Burn enemies
weaknesses: Hard to control at first
Must concentrate on what you want to get burned within that area
Can cause damage to the climate of your location within fifty miles

name: Chrono Bullet
description: The ability to shoot bullets from your fingertips. That effect can be activated by saying the time + the keyword. Another way to use the chrono bullets is to shoot them into a solid thing (except a human). That thing will become a portal towards said time.
summary: The ability to shoot bullets and open portals from the present to the past.
strengths: For offense
For time travel
weaknesses: To kill someone

name: Heart Beat
description: Give yourself super strength,speed and agility by speeding your heartbeat up, this makes you veritably invincible... For a short amount of time, the advised amount of time is ten or so seconds,because prolonged exposure to this state creates the risk of a cardiac arrest.
summary: The ability to give yourself super strenght,speed and agility by speeding your heartbeat
strengths: Really tough, I mean really tough
Walls are nothing to you
You also give off intense heat
weaknesses: Cardiac arrest
If you have high blood pressure the amount of time you can use this is 3 seconds
Blurry vision

name: Volume Expansion
description: This power allows the user to increase to any volume the capacity of a container. The container looks unchanged from the outside, but it can actually contain much more than it appears. However, you can only put something in it if it can go through the opening, so you can't put whatever you want inside. If you decide to reverse the effect or decrease the volume you've attributed, the excess contents will pour out if they can. If not, all the contents will be crushed to fit inside the new volume.
summary: The ability to increase the capacity of a container, without changing its appearance.
strengths: You can put much more inside a container than what it appears.
You can hide yourself inside a container as long as you can go through the opening.
weaknesses: You can only put things that can fit through the opening.
You cannot decrease the capacity to less than the original volume of the container.
Be careful if you decide to reverse the effect, or else you could end up destroying the contents.

name: Return Attack Doubling
description: Any time you are attacked you can then double the force of your enemy's attack and hit them with it. They suffer twice what they make you suffer. Plus you become more resistant to each power used against you.
summary: The ability to return double the force of any attack you are hit with.
strengths: Hurt them more than they hurt you.
Become more resistant to repeated power attacks.
weaknesses: You still suffer the injuries and pain of any attack.
If you deflect or prevent an attack it doesnt count and you cant use it against them.
If an attack is strong enough to kill you, You die. Cant turn attacks against an enemy if you dead.

name: Double Photon Fireballs
description: You can project a blast of fiery concussive energy that would damage the opponent; it is also capable of to blast through armor, by kneeling down you can fire the same DPF's at your foe feet, perform it in the air and can fire two larger ones that shocks & burns the opponent completely.
summary: The ability to fire both plasmatic projectiles from the palms of your hands.
strengths: Can fire both DPF's at the same time.
weaknesses: Fire and Electricity manipulators.

name: Surface Morphisis
description: A person with Surface Morphisis can absorb when in physical contact with a substance. E.g when touching iron you become iron. when touching concrete you become concrete. when touching rock you become rock. There is so much potential with this ability you can become any element or compound as long as you are in physical contact with it. You add it to you biology then you can revert back to normal.
summary: The ability to take the form of a surface, by touching it.
strengths: Can become as strong as any material you surface morph into.
Can morph into any solid material you are in conact with.
weaknesses: Must be in physical contact with the material.
The materials must be solid. No liquids like water.

name: Movie Jump
description: A person with the power of Movie Jump can jump right in to any mass-produced film that's ever been created. Time in your own reality continues, like in that one episode of Charmed with the book in Magic School. Only one catch: you can't bring back anything that doesn't exist in the real world. Imaginary devices, tools, weapons, items of clothing, etc. cannot exist when you return to real life. Everything else is fair game
summary: The ability to travel into any film ever created.
strengths: Making tons of money from movies that contain wealth
Having so much fun with your favorite fictional characters
Leading a separate life within your power
weaknesses: No imaginary stuff (I know, sorry)
The power might destroy your real life, if you "jump" too often

name: Cluster Clash
description: Do a giant blast sending a big energy wave around you.
summary: The ability to do a giant blast sending a big energy wave
strengths: You can destroy more than one enemy
You use less time fighting if they can get hit anywere they go
Its really strong
weaknesses: If you're weak you might have to use all your power
Its kind of cheap
You might kill yourself if you're really weak

name: Wikipower
description: This power simply involves the ability to alter reality depending on updates made by the user to any Wikipedia page. Perfect for those occasions when you've lost an argument or find yourself stuck for an answers in an exam, just log onto the nearest computer afterwards and change the basic rules of the Universe according to Wikipedia.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality and alter history by modifying wikipedia articles.
strengths: History and the laws of Physics can easily be changed to suit you, as well as the future controlled.
For articles regarding future events the more unlikely the scenario, the more power you acquire.
weaknesses: The McFly Effect: You may unintentionally prevent your birth and consequently begin to fade away.
An article will retain its power afterwards, meaning reality can unknowingly be changed by others.
The effects of potential paradoxes vary from an slight aching to sudden supernovas.

name: Peaceful Aura
description: A person with a Peaceful Aura has an amazing gift. They can induce feelings of relaxation in people around them. Now, while this can be used to resolve a problem or make friends, it can also be forced on someone. This makes the target go limp into a mellow trance that may not wear off for an hour then go into a dream-like coma. Eventually, it may slow their heart and breathing enough to kill them.
summary: The ability to make people relax and mellow at will
strengths: Making friends
Can relax someone to sleep
Can slow heart + breathing enough to kill
weaknesses: May garner fearful enemies
May use power for personal gain
Fueled by emotion

name: Exoproxykinesis
description:
You can step out of your body into another plane where every force takes the forms of different cubes, and time is slowed down. Sound will have clusters of cubes floating out from the source, other powers have cubes from the user or what the user is effecting, etc. With this, you can see and redirect any force. 
EX: Movement can be taken from a person walking to a rock. The person will lose movement or fall and the rock will move. 
Similar cubes can also be combined to increase the force.
summary: The ability to see and control forces on another plane
strengths: No one can see or touch you while in the other plane so it can also kind of double as a ghost power
You can do lots of funny things. Invisible pantsing!
Don't even have to get up to do it
weaknesses: Your body is defenseless when you are on the other plane
Can't combine unsimilar cubes, like heat and sound. Only heat and heat or sound and sound.
Have to touch cubes in the other plane to move or combine them

name: Nano Gloves
description: This gloves consist of nanites, which makes it possible to turn them into anything - from a sword to a pair of pincers.
summary: The ability to have shapeshifting gloves on your hands.
strengths: You can use them in fights
You can use them to build or to repair something
weaknesses: Your gloves only work on your hands

name: Ice Ball
description: Using a drop of water on the palm as a catalyst, can form and levitate a ball of pure ice between one half inch and nine feet across. Up to several hundred small balls (with running water over the hands) or 1-3 large balls can be formed depending on will.
summary: The ability to form perfect spheres of ice.
strengths: Ball of ice 9' in diameter.
Never run out of ice for the party.
Hundreds of small balls of ice can be used as a shield.
weaknesses: Never turns off.
Too slippery to be used for flight.

name: Berserker Instinct
description: This power of Beserker Instinct enables the user to perform mental and physical feats that are athletic under a high adrenaline and heart rate. This ability could enhance the strength, agility, speed, reflexes and the senses under a trance. The user can read an opponent's intentions, drives, emotions even weakness.
summary: The ability to read the moves of an opponent under stress and perform athletic feats related to senses.
strengths: You can be an experienced combatant.
Allows you to be smarter.
Can mimic any skill or trait of another.
weaknesses: This comes with an urge to hunt.
The user can become antisocial.
Once someone is under that 'instinct' it is harder to control.

name: Broken Invisibility
description: With this power you can turn things or people invisible as long as you're holding part of it in your hands. For instance you can make your car or vehicle invisible just by holding the steering wheel or any other part of it. You can make somebody invisible if you're holding their hand or something. The part that you're holding doesn't even need to be attached to the object as long as it originally came from it. You cannot use this power on yourself but it can be used on you by others.
summary: The ability to make something invisible as long as you're holding a piece of it
strengths: You can turn things invisible just by holding part of them
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: The Other Power +Free Burgers!
description: Assuming you're seeing this in a "would you rather" comparison, this power gives you the exact same abilities as the other power over there, but you also get free hamburgers!
summary: The ability to do whatever the other power says, plus get free hamburgers!
strengths: Same as the other power
Plus free hamburgers!
weaknesses: Same as the other power
You'll get pretty fat
You have to pay for the fries

name: All Fuse
description: Can fuse two objects found in the area and make them into one object. Cannot be an object that is alive or strapped/nailed down (houses, trees).
summary: The ability to fuse any objects into another object.
strengths: Multiple items may be used.
Can choose if it turns into a weapon or something else (i.e. furniture)
Can be returned to original items used for combination.
weaknesses: If using multiple items, must wait longer for end product.

name: The Exion Knight
description: With Exion Knight ability, you can control and summon many swords and shields at once. The swords summoned can be as small or as large as possible. The shields can be as sturdy or as flimsy as needed too. Both swords and shields can be telekinetically moved through the air at will. Controlling multiple swords is generally much easier than controlling multiple shields purely because of their vast size differences.
summary: The ability to control both multiple swords and multiple shields at once.
strengths: Has a powerful defense and offense
Can make many shapes out of swords
Shields can be used as transportation
weaknesses: It is very destructive, even if the user means well
Controlling too many of either can cause a mental breakdown
The strength of the shields comes from the strength of the user

name: Superpower Zone
description: This power allows you to create a zone with special rules inside. In comics and other fictional sources, characters are often able to gain superpowers from odd situations. With this power, everyone has a higher chance of superpowers developing from the situations they are in. Once obtained, the superpower will not disappear just by leaving the zone. If a person stays in the zone long enough, their power may evolve depending on the situations they experience.
summary: The ability to create a zone that increases the probablity of gaining a superpower.
strengths: Create a large zone to give a group superpowers.
Create an isolated zone for yourself to train and gain superpowers.
Predict what situation will give you a power you want and cause it to happen.
weaknesses: Once zone is created, anyone can use it till it is taken down.
The superpowers may get out of hand if a large number of people are within the zone.
May get unwanted powers from being in strange or bad situations.

name: Myth Power: Poseidon's Prestige
description: Poseidon, in Greek myth, was the god of the waters, horses and earthquakes; he was also King of the Oceans and Seas. As such, channeling him allows one to control water; summoning moisture out of thin air to form water, causing tidal waves and the like. In addition, one gains command over all the creatures of the sea (fish, shellfish, whales, dolphins, otters, turtles, etc); furthermore, one can breathe underwater, swim with amazing power, walk on water and to teleport through water.
summary: The ability to channel Poseidon's command over the forces of water, the oceans and the seas
strengths: Gain the ability to manipulate water, bending it to one's will, regardless of its physical state)
All sea creatures are at your command, and so are horses
Breathe underwater, walk on water, teleport through water, swim well and withstand water pressure
weaknesses: Cannot disrupt or negate aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot induce earthquakes until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
Absence of moisture or sea critters/horses (and you can only compel them, not speak with them)

name: Multi  Host
description: You want to have several allies, use your ability and control several people at the same time. All of the people must be within your vicinity, can also control your enemies. The ability comes useful in a surrounded, gonna die situation.
summary: The ability to control several people at the same time
strengths: Can make escape easy.
Can have several allies at once
Can control enemies
weaknesses: Can not control those with the same ability or have mental blocks
Will forget how to make friends
Will probably become a villain

name: World Preserver
description: Galactus is the eater of worlds. He preserves his life and power by consuming worlds. A world preserver is the opposite of this, for they gain power from the preservation of life, not its destruction. Every time something dies, you will sense it and it will weaken you, so you would take care to preserve as much life as possible!
summary: The ability to maintain power from life in the universe.
strengths: Gain power from all life in the universe!
weaknesses: If a planet or a star dies, it will weaken you
Cemetaries are your bane

name: Delete This Sensory
description: Ever wished you could sense where anything or anyone was? With this power you will be able to. Same as Clairvoyance
summary: The ability to sense everything in the whole universe
strengths: Hunting
Counting # of people in one area
Discovering other lifeforms in another planets
weaknesses: Headaches if used to long
A powerful demonish source might stun you for 5 min
You have to meditate daily to increase the performance of your power

name: Unobtainium Shield
description: From the movie "The Core", unobtainium is a material that can withstand the hottest of hot and coldest of cold and also gets stronger the more force or pressure its put under. Applying electrical power, one may spread these atoms apart into a unobtainium Shield. Once spread the atoms race through the electrical field giving it the same ability as the solid material. It will conform to electrical field's shape.
summary: The ability to control the individual atoms of Unobtainium.
strengths: The stronger the force against your shield the more powerful your shield becomes.
Resists time, space and reality warping due to its extemely strong atomic bonds.
No physical strength or energy blast can pass through this shield.
weaknesses: Must have a source of electricity
A superhero that has superior Electical field powers could trap you or collapse the shield.
Metal Manipulation

name: The Devil's Temptation
description: Make anyone do your bidding, no matter what it is. Only able to use it during the night time. The person will stop at nothing to finish the task you have given them.
summary: The ability to make anyone into do what you want them to
strengths: You will be able to control anyone
If you tell them to forget, they will
To get revenge on your enemies! MWUHAHAHA
weaknesses: They will know about what you made them do, unless you tell them to forget
It only works during the night, hence the title "Devil's Temptation"
It won't help you during the day when they are after you for controlling them

name: Lucky Charmer
description: Ever charm a charmer?  Want to approach that cutie at the bar?  How about those late fees you're worried about?  Charm your way though it all!  Make others feel great, and be the best charmer out there.  People will want to be around you, and you'll exude a magnetic personality that can't be resisted.
summary: The ability to be irresistibly charming.
strengths: People love you
Never be nervous about social situations
Get invited to all the parties
weaknesses: Some people may feel threatened by you

name: Persona
description: A persona is a facade that people wear in their everyday lives. It is a side of you that you are afraid to show to others. By controlling your emotions, you can give your inner voice physical form (as a mythological figure. ) Remember that your inner self is beyond your limits, but you are still mortal, so you would take care not to get killed, or your Persona will go wild!
summary: The ability to summon your inner self.
strengths: Summon a mythological god from inside your head
Be your own bodyguard
It's Harry Potter meets Pokemon!
weaknesses: You can still get hurt like a normal person
You have to master your emotions to control it
You have to play Shin Megami Tensei to know what I'm talking about

name: Bullet Catch
description: This ability allows you to catch bullets with your bare hands. Of course, you can catch other fast moving objects as well, as long as it's within reason. No trains or anything. Time will slow down when the bullet comes near you, giving you time to react to it. Other things to catch include large shrapnel, rocks, and flung monkey poop.
summary: The ability to catch any fast-moving object, bullets included.
strengths: Stop bullets from hitting you.
Save people from getting hit.
weaknesses: The military will want to probe your ass with very uncomfortable prods.

name: Faultless
description: Do whatever you want and you will never be guilty. Rob banks, forge checks, steal cars, punch, kick, cheat on a tests, etc. You will never be blamed, never accused, and never caught. If anyone asks about you the response is always favorable. People will always think positive of you even if they have evidence to the contrary.
summary: The ability to never be accused or blamed for any wrongdoing
strengths: You could get away with anything and are incapable of being accused.
Be lazy or rotten at work or school or commit the perfect crime, no matter the severity
Someone will get the blame but it will never be you
weaknesses: The person in nearest proximity immediately gets blamed for whatever dirt you do
Could never confess even if a person's life depends on it, no one will believe you
You are not perfect; everybody just thinks you are

name: Personal Zodiac Signs Creator
description: This power allows you to make a set of twelve animals/people/hybrids/objects into your own zodiac. You will be able to transform or gain appendages from any of the twelve. If you want to, you could create a single power for each of them that you would have as well (bird-invisibilty?) You may also create spiritual embodiments of these creatures to help you in battle.
summary: The ability to create your own 12 animal zodiac and have various powers.
strengths: Shapeshift into any of your zodiac signs.
Make special powers for each of them that you would have as well.
Create up to 12 spirits of any sign that will aid you in battle.
weaknesses: You have only access to one sign/power at a time
Real animals/people/objects/hybrids cannot be controlled.
You can only make twelve.

name: Molecular Dispersion
description: The person with this power is able to disperse the molecules of an object, splitting them and dispersing them over space. For example, if this power is used on an enemies' gun , then the gun will disperse into nothingness. This power can only be used on non-living objects.
summary: The ability to disperse the molecules, splitting it and dispersing over space.
strengths: Can easily disarm an enemy
Can easily break down walls
weaknesses: Only can target non-living things
Cannot be used to fight powerhouses

name: Myth Power: Chione's Kindness
description: Chione (Khione), in Greek myth, was the goddess of cold, ice and snow. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the onset of winter and similarly cold weather, at will. In addition, one may psychically teleport to any cold, icy or snowy environment at will, as well as gain physical power when in said environment. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, generate and manipulate cold, ice and snow at will. One can even withstand cold, and share this immunity, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Chione's command over the essence of the cold, ice and snow
strengths: Psychically perceive the onset of winter, and similarly cold weather, at will
Teleport self and others to any cold environment; gain physical power in cold environments
Psychically perceive and generate/manipulate cold/ice/snow; withstand cold (may be shared by touch)
weaknesses: Cannot assume an ice form (or turn others to ice via touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot induce or manipulate cold weather AT ALL; it's covered by MythPower: Horae (Seasons1) (NCN)
Cold Immunity and MythPower: Way of the Winds provide immunity (NCN)

name: Farwalking
description: Ever hear of 7 League Boots? With Farwalking, you don't need them. Using this power, you can cover miles with a single step. The distance covered is controlled by the size of the step. With your longest stride, you could step halfway around the world. And if you want to walk normally, you can just turn the power off.
summary: The ability to cover long distances with a single step
strengths: No need for cars, planes, etc.
You'd be unbeatable in races
weaknesses: Can only go in a straight line
It's hard to control the distance covered

name: Bone Materials
description: With this ability you will be able to change the material your bones are made of. You could change them to steel and deliver a stone crushing punch or change them to rubber and bounce back from any blow. Your creativity defines the usefulness of this power.
summary: The ability to change what matierial your bones are made of.
strengths: Have tough unbreakable bones
Have elastic rubber-bones
Imagination improves its usefulness
weaknesses: Choosing a bad material may cause damage

name: Memory Repression
description: Is there anything you don't want to remember? Are you tired of being reminded of your failures or a traumatizing event? Then, this power is for you! With it, you can completely block any memories you want so they never surface again. They won't disappear; you'll just be unable to remember them. Blocked memories are immune to any form of memory reading or alteration. Moreover, to prevent any morbid curiosity on your part to check what you repressed, memories of ever using this power are erased.
summary: The ability to block access to parts of your memories from anyone, especially yourself.
strengths: You can protect your mind and brain against painful or traumatizing memories.
Mind readers won't have access to the memories that have been blocked by this power.
To prevent you from checking what memories you repressed, you won't remember using this power.
weaknesses: You may have forgotten, but other people won't forget so easily.
You can only use this on yourself.
Don't use this power on your whole memory unless you know for sure what you're doing!

name: Cash Manipulation
description: A person with this power can be an awesome thief because their power is to control.... Paper money. They can use it to quickly create a storm or create a giant fist of money or other structures out of cold hard cash. Best of all, they can attract a crowd of bystanders that can disrupt any of the heroes. Heroes will be powerless before the might of your cash attack, since destroying money is a federal crime. Imagine beating someone and stealing their wallet at the same time... Brilliant.
summary: The ability to control paper money including summoning them from other places
strengths: Control money
Can make it rain money or create structures out of money, money grenades, money sword... You name it
Can blast people with money
weaknesses: You can't really be a hero with this power unless you happen to use your own money

name: Write New Laws Into Reality
description: A person with this power can write new laws into reality as long as the new laws do not interfere with any old laws. This is very important. If your new law in any shape or form contradict existing laws the object in question which the new law is about will be erased from existence The new law becomes a permanent part of reality after 10 years--if it hasn't been negated. Can only write one law concerning anything-no covering loopholes that way.
summary: The ability to rewrite reality with new laws
strengths: Write a new law in reality
After 10 years the new law becomes established as reality and cannot be negated
weaknesses: Can only write 1 new law for about any given topic
People can find loopholes within your laws
Cannot become omnipotent since it conflicts with existing laws

name: Stardust
description: The ability to project (shoot out of hands) a gold, super cosmic energy dust called stardust. It is an explosive, an energy source, a light and a heat source all at the same time. It can also be used to surround objects and move them. It is linked to the users emotions, so the user must always be in control of their feelings.
summary: The ability to project (shoot out of hands) a gold energy dust called stardust.
strengths: Can help when escaping from a room
Can be used like telekinesis
Can be used to attract the attention of allies
weaknesses: Can attract unwanted attention
Is highly combustable
Requires constant emotional control

name: Polarization Force
description: A polarized photo has the colours changed into "polar opposites", this power lets you do it in real life. With a blast of energy, turn solid ground into liquid, heat into cold, light into darkness, strength into weakness, etc. As long as you can see the opposite of an object, it is transformed that way, so a hot coal could either become hot liquid coal, or frozen solid coal. You can change things back the same way. You can even reverse forces with this, like change gravity's effect on a balloon.
summary: The ability to "polarize" anything with a blast, make it opposite to its original form
strengths: Be untouchable-reverse speeding bullets, bog down enemies in liquid road, etc.
Very funky polarization flashing light effect from your hands as you use it
Alter reality to your design with a little ingenuity and imagination
weaknesses: May accidentally liquefy someone--you can make them solid again but they are still dead
Cannot actively move or manipulate things, more of a reactive force
May be pursued by artsy photographers too poor to afford effects software

name: Clairvoyant Interpretation
description: One with this ability has a useful one at his disposal. Any word that he cannot understand, or does not know the definition of will appear before his eyes. Can't hear? The words appear before your eyes to READ. Somebody says a big word you don't know how to spell? The spelling appears before your eyes. Someone speaking in a different language? The subtitled interpretation appears for your reading pleasure. And if you don't understand a word? A plain and simple definition appears for you to see.
summary: The ability to visualize words one cannot comprehend
strengths: Visualize words instead of having to interpret what you hear
Understand different languages (even bar codes, Braille, sign language or the like)
If you can't understand a dictionary definition, this power can even simplify THOSE
weaknesses: Doesn't allow you to communicate in the language you don't understand (only understand them)
Doesn't allow you to remember anything you see (commit it to memory or study it on your own)

name: Chemical Element Mimicry
description: You can transform at will into any chemical element, such as oxygen, iron, potassium or carbon. You keep your human shape and senses, but if in a liquid or gaseous form you can shape yourself. You can also become differet allotropes of the same element, such as becoming either carbon or diamond. If you lose part of your body, you can replace it by absorbing that element from your surroundings. While in an element form you are difficult to kill, as you possess no organs.
summary: The ability to transform into any of the elements of the periodic table
strengths: You can become far more durable by becoming diamond or platinum
You have 118 elements to choose from, so you are quite versatile in combat
You can take advantage of elements' properties. For example, you can now conduct electricity
weaknesses: You can have undesirable reactions, such as bursting into flame caesium
If a radioactive element you are incredibly harmful to be close to
You cannot mimic any compounds, or more than one element at a time

name: Dollar Bill Shift
description: With this power you can change your dollar bills into other dollar bills (1s to 100s, 5s, to 10s etc. ) or into other forms of currency. When you change a dollar into another form of currency you can't change the value.
summary: The ability to change bills into other bills
strengths: You can change dollar bills into other bills or into other forms of currency
weaknesses: When changing one form of currency into another the value has to be the same

name: Color Shirt Power
description: With this power you have a different power depending on the color of the shirt you're wearing. Red: Heat Vision. Blue: Ice Manipulation. Green: Plant Manipulation. Black: Shadow Manipulation. Orange: Super Speed. Yellow: Heat Resistance. White: Invisibility. Gray: Rise of the Demon. Pink: Force Fields. Tan: Flight. Purple: Super Strength. Brown: Elasticity. The list includes any shade of the color in question. If the shirt you're wearing has more than one color, you get more than one power.
summary: The ability to have a different power depending on the color(s) of your shirt
strengths: You can get some pretty awesome powers
weaknesses: If you're not wearing a shirt you have no powers
The color of your pants have no effect on your powers

name: Water Mimicry
description: A water mimic can become one of the most powerful forces on planet Earth at will. They can flow around objects, through pipelines, and generate crushing water jets from their hands.
summary: The ability to turn your bodily tissues into water
strengths: Awesome spy
Never get trapped
Unnerving to your foes to watch
weaknesses: Freezing temperatures
Boiling temperatures
The desert

name: Modder
description: Modders, or Modifiers, are people who create their own custom modifications for certain games. With this power you can tweak real life, creating things with your power. You can't grant life, or destroy it directly, but you can create entire cities, entire lakes, and even seas. You can kill indirectly however, such as modifying it so a small pocket of air is created inside a man's arteries, or someone might accidentally slip on an unseen object.
summary: The ability to mod in real life.
strengths: Can modify almost anything.
weaknesses: Incredibly, incredibly, hard to use.

name: Temporal Trail Perception
description: You can see a person's future trail and past trail. It's a line that moves forward and backwards from them, showing where they have been and where they will be. You can physically interact with it to alter their future or past (for example, by stabbing their future trail and then leaving, when they reach that point, they will suddenly be wounded). If someone has some idea about how your power works, however, they can attempt to readjust their trail and cause it to attack you.
summary: The ability to see a person's temporal trails and change their past and future
strengths: Tell where people are going to be, and, to a certain extent, what they are going to do
Tell where people have been, and, to a certain extent, what they have done
Can predict attacks, and can attack people without ever having to be near them
weaknesses: Attacking a future trail allows someone to know where you've been
And might leave a trace for them to know where to aim if they retaliate
Attacking a past trail lets people know where you'll go, and leave a trap

name: Ability Master
description: This superpower enables the user to be very proficient and effecient with his/her other superpowers. They master the use of any other superpower, but it doesn't affect the power itself. It doesn't evolve, get better or get rid of its cons.
summary: The ability to master all of your powers
strengths: You master any power
weaknesses: Doesn't evolve the power
The cons are unaffected and still apply (unless they have to do with mastery)

name: Flashback Viewer
description: A person with this power has the power to see the past. They can access information from any time in the past. They also have the ability to show their information to others. The limit to this ability is that it cannot show things that occurred before the user's birth. The user decides a time and places. They and everyone in the room and new people who come in will view a flashback, similar to the movies. People cannot change things in the flashback. No one can attack while flashback is playing
summary: The ability to see the past and show it to others
strengths: CSI: You see what happened
Can get information on people
No one can keep secrets from you
weaknesses: Cannot see the future
Everyone can see the past not just you

name: Unrestricted Power Usage
description: Normally one has restrictions on their powers to keep from using all the power that they have. With this power all restrictions are ignored and all the power can be used. This includes every single bit of the being's life force. Using your power without a regard for safety while you have this power can be fatal if you are not careful.
summary: The ability to ignore all restrictions on one's power
strengths: You have to concentrate to use this power.
Can temporarily boost powers well beyond the normal limits.
weaknesses: This power will cause death if not used wisely.
Due to the fact that even immortals have life force they will burn themselves out if they overdo it.
Burning out means that you erase all of your own existence by using every scrap of power you have.

name: Strength Leeching
description: Absorb the strength of other people by touch. Actually gain the strength of 10 men or women, but it only lasts for a day.
summary: The ability to absorb strength from others through touch
strengths: Become stronger from other people.
weaknesses: Have to touch the person in order for the power to work.
Can only absorb  up to 10 people's strength.
Only lasts a day.

name: Fire Wall
description: This wall is an 8x8x1 wall of fire. Anything can go through the wall, but will more than likely be caught on fire and/or turned into ash, depending on what goes through. The wall will last for as long as the user wishes. The wall cannot be moved in any way, so if the wall is needed in a different place, the user will have to dismiss the wall and re-create it at the desired location. The user cannot create more than one wall at a time.
summary: The ability to create a wall that is made of nothing but fire.
strengths: Catches your enemies on fire if they try to go through.
Lasts forever if the user wishes.
Protected from projectiles.
weaknesses: Can't create more than one Fire Wall.
Water can put it out.
Can't move the wall freely.

name: Rift Induction
description: You create a rift in time and space anywhere you deem necessary or desirable which sucks everything around it inside another plane of existence.
summary: The ability to create a rift in time and space
strengths: Ultimate destruction.
Gets rid of annoying things like walls.
Useful at crime scene clean-ups. Also, leaves no evidence, apart from everything being gone.
weaknesses: Might accidentally suck in something important.
Could destroy the world if used wrongly.
Can get boring.

name: Thief Hunter
description: You have to picture anything that once was yours but has been lost or stolen and express the desire to get it back. If it still exists, a terrifying skinless man-horse hybrid is called forth. The creature knows exactly where to look for and it will hunt it down until it is retrieved. It also has dangerous abilities, like a poisonous breath, dissolving touch, flesh-eating body secretions and to shoot fire from its single eye. Thankfully, its abilities are ineffective on the user's belongings.
summary: The ability to get back anything that once belonged to you.
strengths: The creature is tireless and gets more powerful the longer it takes to retrieve the target.
Even if it's somehow destroyed, you can always summon a new one.
The target can be a living being, an object or even an ability.
weaknesses: You can summon only one creature at a time.
You could cause unimaginable destruction.
The creature's one weakness is its phobia of fresh water.

name: Hivemind
description: By staring into someone's eyes, you can will them to become a willing follower with a telepathic link to you and all other followers. All followers see you as god and are willing to sacrifice anything for you.
summary: The ability to create a mindless telepathic army
strengths: manipulate anyone
get a LOT of stuff for free
could control nations
weaknesses: dose not work thought sunglasses
you are still very vunerable
you might think yourself a god

name: Evisceration
description: With this power, you can be either the best doctor in the world or the most evil assassin ever. When this ability is activated, the other person's organs will appear in your hands. While they are out of the body, the person is still living due to an illusory substitute that works like a real one. You can fix injuries on the organ and return it, or you can stab and destroy the organ, then return it. You can also switch the organs with something else.
summary: The ability to remove people's body parts without killing them(yet)
strengths: Best doctor, no need to cut up people just need to operate on organs or just put in replacements
Cruelest assassin-stab organs then return them, switch organ with a bomb, sell organs
While out of body, the organs you hold do not die due to removal
weaknesses: Creepy, very, creepy
For those with fear of blood

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Sorceror
description: The Path of the Sorceror, or the Path of the Write, is the forth Path of Magic. Sorcerors use the written form of the original magical language magicians used. These symbols, however,were never the base for any language, and were sometimes recorded in ancient books. When used, they cause different changes in their surroundings. For example, when the symbol for fire is written and energized, the air(or whatever else)above it, will ignite. The affects of some symbols won't be what you expect.
summary: The ability to have special talent for sorcery.
strengths: You have special talent for sorcery
The symbols can be written anywhere
weaknesses: The symbols weren't recorded often
Sorcery takes time to prepare, even if it is powerful

name: Armor Body
description: With this power your skin becomes five times harder than a rock and three times more resistant to damage. The skin now somewhat looks like a suit that you might see on a superhero. Every part of the body has its own outline with each muscle also partially outlined. Sexual organs are all hidden under flaps of armor if they would be visible on a normal human. The color scheme is always random at first, but can be changed with other powers.
summary: The ability to have skin harder and more resistant to damage than normal with a distinctly different look
strengths: Your skin is harder to damage and break.
You could fight without clothes on and noone would care since it would look like you're dressed.
Don't have to transform or alter your body for the defensive properties.
weaknesses: Can't take the armor off since it IS permanent seeing as how it is your skin.
You may not like the way the armor looks.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Black Powder Manipulation
description: You can make the black powder move around as you wish, cause it to explode as if it was ignited in a small space, and create up to 5 liters of black powder from the air at will.
summary: The ability to create and control black powder
strengths: Instant weapon.
weaknesses: Black powder isn't as good as modern combustion materials.

name: Medicine Water
description: With this power you can turn any amount of water into any kind of liquid medicine. You also instantly know all of the properties, side effects and proper dosages of the medicine that you the water into. You cannot turn the medicine back into water.
summary: The ability to turn water into any liquid medicine
strengths: You can turn water into medicine
You know the properties, side effects and proper dosages of the medicine
If an enemy is drinking water you can turn the water into medicine and possibly make them overdose
weaknesses: You cannot turn the medicine back into water

name: Fragarach
description: This sword can do four things. 1) No one can tell a lie as long as this sword is at there throat. 2) Command the winds. 3) Cut through any shield and wall. 4) Inflict wounds from which no man could recover.
summary: The ability to summon a sword that can do four things
strengths: Cut through any shield and wall
Possess a legendary sword
People will be afraid of you ( pro & con )
weaknesses: Can only do four things
Can only be destroyed by any immortal
People will try to steal the sword

name: Telepathic Survey
description: Telepathic surveyors have the ability to broadcast one yes/no question to all sentient minds within range. Examples of some of the questions could be - Are you a cop, terrorist, murderer, etc. , or - Do I owe you money? The question goes directly to the subconscious, so they can't perceive it, nor can they lie. When a target responds, their auras change to red (for yes) and blue (for no) and are visible only to the surveyor
summary: The ability to send out a telepathic ping that delivers a question directly to the subconscious of sentient beings
strengths: Can configure the range - 2 mile radius sphere or 5 mile cone (45 degree angle)
Can be creative w/ questions – find out anything you want to know that can be answered w/ yes/no
Can detect hostile intent from literally over a mile away. Plus, no more speed trap worries.
weaknesses: Limited telepathy - cannot read minds or persuade/compel others
Might not like the answers (are there any girls here that would go out with me? )
Possible unwanted attention - a telepath might want to trace the ping back to the source

name: Quinbeam
description: You can even fire a large shiny laser from your palm of your hands, and, when it ricochets off of walls, ceilings and floors, it splits in five different directions and bounces about before disappearing (unless they all hit enemies).
summary: The ability to shoot a beam that can ricochet off anywhere and split into five separate beams.
strengths: Quinbeam is one of the most underused ability in the SPL.
Extra useful when you're outnumbered.
weaknesses: You might put anyone and anything in harms way.

name: Television Synchronization
description: With this ability you can copy the powers and skills of people in TV shows. These shows can be live-action, sitcoms, cartoons, anime, etc. The show you're using must have come on television at some point in time.
summary: The ability to do anything associated with television shows.
strengths: The show "Heroes".
The show "True Blood".
Every anime you have seen.
weaknesses: You MUST know the name of the show.
You can't do anything extreme (like being God).
If a person knows more about a show than you, they might find some weaknesses.

name: Mirror Mirror Beam
description: You can shoot a beam out of your hands to reverse a person's personality, ethics, powers. For example, think of it like this: The average power user and his abilities are Fire and he is really serious all the time and he fights for justice. Now, he is an Ice user and he just relaxes and goes with the flow. Oh yeah, did I mention he just killed a puppy?
summary: The ability to change a person's personality, ethics and powers.
strengths: Mess with you Opponent's psyche
If your opponent's power is super-strength, now his power is Super weakness
Super Villains and Super Heros will change sides
weaknesses: They might become a better fighter
If people have a neutral ability that can't change, you will be given extreme pain
Super Villains and Super Heros will change sides

name: Homunculus
description: It takes only a thought to make a homunculus. A homunculus personifies anything you target with your power. While that element is personified, it ceases to exist as the thing whence it was derived.  There may only be one homunculus at a time, but it can be dispelled with a thought.  Anything done to homunculi affects their true form (killing the homunculus with fire would put out that fire even after the homunculus is gone).  Targeting concepts, planets, etc are all acceptable but dangerous.
summary: The ability to create a personification of any thing.
strengths: Easily defeat enemies using your mind, surroundings, or simply dissecting them (or their character).
Make people un-sad, -angry, -etc. (Just watch out for gloom and rage beasts or something. )
Talk to animals, your toaster, whatever!
weaknesses: Homunculi may not like you (one made from evil, for example).
User must take care; taking out the sun (or classical elements) might have repercussions.
Power of homunculi may be unreliable.

name: Connection Severer
description: With this, you can sever the conections between your enemy's teeth and their gum, separate things from a certain space, and much more. You can sever almost anything that has a connection, so no more mind control. However, this can't sever a person from their powers or magic. If you have Abjuration, you can make wards against this to protect yourself.
summary: The ability to sever connections between things, except powers or magic.
strengths: So many connections to cut.
Instant kill by severing the heart.
weaknesses: Can't sever powers or magic.
Wards can prevent it.
Its cons can't be negated.

name: Instantaneous Karma
description: You do good and Karma's energy is upon you. Give a dollar to the poor, you get all the money you need. Patch a kid's scrape and you have the power to heal.  Nurse an old person to health and you can not get sick.
summary: The ability to absorb Karma's energy
strengths: Save a penny, earn seven million. Everything come back seven fold and then some
Do enough good you get to pick the Karmatic power (did i make up a word? )
Eventually you will have more power than you know what to do with
weaknesses: Do bad and it comes back sevenfold or more
Eventually you will have more power than you know what to do with
The finality of all karma is death

name: Pulse Radiance
description: The person has the power to push radiation from his or her person.  The user has the control over the level of violence it inflicts on the victim. Ranging from an itch or burn all the way up to and including death. The one setback is that if the user is using the power for an extended length of time, it begins to wear the user down which could result in anything from the beginnings of a headache to the breakdown of his or her body.
summary: The ability to cause pain or death through pulse radiation
strengths: Awesome power
Area of affect, not just the front arc
weaknesses: Could result in death
Could unknowingly hurt an innocent

name: Banish
description: If someone is pissing you off or whatever, all you have to do is blink once at them & they will be teleported to somewhere else. The restrictions are that it has to be on earth, you have to know the place you are banishing them to, & they will be placed in a safe place. Not in a dangerous area.
summary: The ability to teleport someone somewhere far away
strengths: Get rid of someone instantly
weaknesses: Has to be teleported on earth
Have to know where the location is you're exiling them to

name: Equillibrium Effects
description: A person with this power can create something as long as the correct opposite was created at the same time. For example, creating a hero will also create a villain. To emit a heat wave you will also create a cold wave. Creating matter will create antimatter. With practice the user can create one effect and hold a charge and later enact the opposite effect. Alternatively the effects can be fired at different directions. The amount of charges you have depends on your willpower.
summary: The ability to do anything as long as the opposite is also done
strengths: You can heal and inflict pain at the same time
You can shoot fire and ice at two different directions
You can fly as long as you dig the same amount of time afterwards
weaknesses: You only have limited amount of charges depending on willpower
Some things have no opposites
Antimatter is very dangerous-so it is not a good idea to actively materialize things

name: Anesthesia Breath
description: A person with this power can knock people out by breathing at someone's face releasing a powerful anesthetic gas that immediately knocks them out painlessly. However if you use it repeatedly on the same person they can slowly build up a resistance.
summary: The ability to knock people out by breathing in their face
strengths: Quick knockout
Non-lethal
The effect is instantaneous---at least the first time you use it
weaknesses: Can only be used to knock people out
Can accidentally knock people out when you yawn
People can build up a resistance over time

name: Dissassociating Particles
description:
The best way to obtain invincibility is to avoid all harm, no? If all your molecules are free floating, whatever comes your way will just pass through you! 
you could even spread out your molecules and hide..In Styrofoam!
summary: The ability to turn from solid form to gas form and change the shape of your body
strengths: avoid attacks
turn your own body into a weapon
weaknesses: get blown away in the wind while in gas form
Fire both makes you rise (gas form) with the hot air and burns you better

name: Wood Manipulation
description: You can have the granted ability to control, generate, or absorb wood, but just for that you can even make sharp weapons out of them, or if you try to absorb any wooden object any you'll have some wooden skin and not even electric like attacks will even affect you.
summary: The ability to create or to control anything that is wood with the mind.
strengths: You can become a wood magnet
Electric bolts won't affect you if you have wooden skin.
weaknesses: They can be easliy will burn in the fire.

name: Plasma Walk
description: You can walk or run straight through all obstacles by plasma burning right through them.
summary: The ability to walk or run in a straight line and burn through everything in your path.
strengths: No obstacles can stop you.
"bump" people in a hall and disintegrate them.
weaknesses: Must deactivate to turn.
Cannot go up stairs.

name: Cochlear Hair Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. When activated, you'll have a much better sense of hearing than the average human being. You can also convert vibrations you perceive, such as soundwaves, into electricity and/or special neuronal signals. By sending those signals to someone's auditory cortex (near the temples in humans), you allow them to hear what you hear as long as you want. You can also hear things more clearly than normal when you're under water because the vibrations are enhanced.
summary: The ability to hear better, convert vibrations into electrical impulses and allow people to hear what you hear.
strengths: You will never suffer from decreased hearing sensitivity due to aging or damages.
You have a much better sense of hearing than normal people.
It could help you acquire absolute pitch through training.
weaknesses: You can be deafened by extremely loud or very high-pitched vibrations.

name: Deltakinesis
description: A chemical reaction is a process which leads to the transformation of one set of chemical substances to another. You can control these things. So let's say you have some eggs. You could crack them on any suface and make them start cooking without any heat. Or you could make water start to boil. You could even cause something to start sizzling as if it was covered in acid.
summary: The ability to control chemical reactions.
strengths: You could simulate and control any chemical reaction.
You could be very powerful.
weaknesses: You should learn more about chemicals before attempting anything big.

name: Cosmic Butterfly
description: If any species of butterfly comes within 1 meter of you, you are imbued with a finite amount of ambient cosmic energy. You can absorb, project & manipulate all ambient cosmic energy. You can alter the density of the your atoms from light phasing form to super-dense heavy and impermeable. Phenomenal cosmic powers on butterfly wings.
summary: The ability to gain the power of the cosmic butterfly effect
strengths: Unimaginable energy control, cosmic force bolts, shields and access hyperspace
Phase through solid matter or become so dense you are invincible
Face becomes irradiant fluttering butterfly wings & you ride a giant glowing peacock butterfly
weaknesses: Presence of any species of moth within 1 meter of you returns you to normal human
Use of your power brings you down a level until you return to normal, find another butterfly
You become so powerful you'll be looking for moths the first few times you gain the ability
tags: despite all my rage still just a rat in a cage

name: Vampirism: Superpower
description: Also called Power Vampirism or Ability Vampirism, this is the ability to absorb the energy that powers the superhuman abilities of others; in the process, the subject gets their ability negated (regardless of ability defenses), and the user may may gain one of two benefits. If the user has other abilities besides this one, those abilities are boosted; if this is their only power, they take on whatever abilities they vampirize; this ability is useful against ANY superhuman
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the superhuman abilities of others
strengths: Drain your foes' abilities, negating the foe's abilities
Draining the abilities of foes also enhances one's own abilites (and/or may bestow new ones)
Superhuman foes
weaknesses: Best if you can also sense powers (but Power Sensing does not ALWAYS accompany this power)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, superhuman friends and family members won't want to be around you

name: Solar Cooling
description: With this power, whenever you are in sunlight, you can eliminate heat. The more sunlight, the more cooling you can manage, thus you can easily survive the temperatures of the sun. As you get more experienced with this power/the stronger it gets, the more efficient the exchange rate of sunlight to cooling.
summary: The ability to cool yourself down when in sunlight.
strengths: Hot days are often sunny, so they are less of a problem now.
Sunlight can't make you too hot.
If you have a spaceflight power, you can survive on the sun.
weaknesses: Limited uses.
Hot days with cloud cover could leave you more vulnerable.
Useless indoors, unless in a greenhouse-like environment.

name: Box Ing
description: The ability to create a world inside a box --limited to a distance of 500m away if created outside and limited to the size of the room if created inside-- where anything can happen, given what you desire to happen inside the box
summary: The ability to create a box where anything can happen within it
strengths: Anything is possible
Able to trap anyone inside
Negotiate all powers within the box
weaknesses: Only occurs within the box
Limited to a distance of 500m outside
Limited to the room when inside

name: Nightmare Manipulator
description: The target would be put into their own worst nightmare (i.e drowning) and, like the matrix, the mind gets so scared that the nightmare becomes a reality and eventually the person will drown. Their death however will be a complete mystery to those around him/her.
summary: The ability to make people's nightmares a reality to them and only them.
strengths: time for you to escape
makes enemy vulnerable
weaknesses: you will most likely kill the target
your appearance is changed so you will have grey skin and pitch black eyes
once a target is in their nightmare it is impossible to get them back out, even for the manipulator

name: Gift: Wind
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling winds and air than other beings. Thus their wind- or air-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of air from them. However, someone with this power can only receive air-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of wind and air
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over air as someone with this power.
Air-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only air-based powers now.

name: Telekinetic Virus
description: This power is a strange one. Instead of normal telekinesis the user gains telekinetic control over anything that a virus they spread infects. The viruses can infect people, objects, even things such as fire and water(however you cannot things that deteriorate like it from doing so). Eventually the viruses will die out and create a "set" that you can manipulate. Each set is the total number of things that have been infected and are under your control.
summary: The ability to create supernatural viruses that give telekinetic control over what they affect.
strengths: Once something is infected you can manipulate it no matter the distance.
You can control as many infected objects as you want at once.
Infect pieces of the terrain to use against enemies.
weaknesses: Is things in a set are destroyed/die then you can no longer manipulate them(except for their corpse)
You cannot control how the virus spreads.
The virus dosen't infect things with telesthetic immunity.

name: Essence Expunge
description: The user has the power remove the very essence of any human, creature, or object. The victim of the power will have a problem. If they don't have their essence, they will fade from the physical state of existence any time. They need to absorb their essence through any means if they hope to survive. The user can even expunge a person's superpower and absorb it. The essence will be transformed into energy that the user can absorb for a variety of reasons.
summary: The ability to spontaneously transform anything's essence into absorbable energy.
strengths: Gain many powers
Weaken opponents
weaknesses: Gained powers will be very weak

name: Money Tree V3
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows five thousand dollars (or the equivalent of five thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in ten dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to create a tree that produces money
strengths: You can create a money tree that produces 5000 dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
weaknesses: You can only have one at a time
You can only have up to 5000 dollars

name: Free Fall
description: With Free Fall, one can slow down at the apex of a jump, even to the point where one "hovers" in mid-air.  One can accelerate your fall while grappling a foe in mid-air to do some serious damage with a suplex.  Increase the lateral distance that can be travelled with a single bound, or twist and maneuver around in mid-air to perform all sorts of stunts before hitting the ground.  A bonus of having this power is having a resistance to low-pressure atmospheres... as long as it's there.
summary: The ability to completely control one's descent to the ground, as long as you eventually get there.
strengths: Just about unmatched aerial maneuverability.
Never worry about a hard landing, even if dropped from a plane.
Let's face it: this'd be bad-ass if you were into X-treme Sports or freerunning.
weaknesses: If you don't really have a means of getting to a good height, the applications are limited.
There's almost no offensive firepower, so it'd only be good for dodging in combat.
There's only so many people that you can "carry" with this power...

name: Witch Fire
description: Witch Fire is magical fire that can be used for different effects. For example, the smoke produced can give (when breathed in) people temporary magical abilities. Also, the ash it creates has magical properties. When sprinkled on someone, that person is able to fly for a day.
