weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Reality Flux
description: After an often random interval of time, reality would simply change to cause some new occurrence (normally in favor of the user of the ability), or until the power is deactivated.
summary: The ability to cause reality to change randomly after only activating the power once
strengths: Gain the upper hand of foe
Get out of a situation
weaknesses: Now telling what would happen, the flux may not even apply to the user.
Useless occurrences

name: Mental Ignition
description: Mental ignition requires one to put their hands on either side of another person's skull and charge their cranium with power. The electricity courses through the brain and effectively "fries" it, killing the victim with enough power. If the attack is not lethal, even a second of forcing electricity to directly enter the brain is enough to cause often-permanent damage.
summary: The ability to channel electricity through another person's brain, causing lethal damage.
strengths: Have the ability to kill anyone at anytime from behind without a weapon. The attack cannot be seen.
Have the ability to impair an enemy mentally with a quick charge
Have the ability to mercilessly torture or threaten anyone with death and intense pain
weaknesses: Very difficult to control the amount of electricity
Very risky to use on a person you do not wish to kill
Unusable if the attacker's hands are damaged or lost

name: Tactile Combustion
description: Your body is covered in a thin, invisible energy field which can spontaneously ignite any combustible material within it. If an object is touched, the field extends along it in a limited way, covering the object if possible, and linking to others to a degree. For example, if touching a person's hand, using the power on them would set their entire body alight, but using this on a table inside a house would only set the table alight. You are fireproof.
summary: The ability to set objects you touch alight
strengths: Easily win any close combat fight
You're invulnerable to all flames
You can ignite the air around your hands, creating flaming auras for them
weaknesses: Limited range
You're at a severe disadvantage against foes with guns, long range powers, etc.
Your tactile field cannot strech particularly far -- it can cover about two people

name: Dark Flare
description: Dark power spheres are shot from the palm of the hand exploding on contact causing an explode radius of 5m.
summary: The ability to cast dark explosions
strengths: Good for breaching
Good for fighting groups of enemies
Good against anything that is elemental
weaknesses: If used in close range it could end up harming yourself or others
Needs precise aim for maximum affect
Light elements are not affected by dark flare

name: Barrier Melting
description: Can melt any type of barrier by touching it. Forcefields,walls, shields, etc. Can be magical, physical, psychic, etc so long as it can be physically touched.
summary: The ability to melt barriers one touches physically
strengths: No barrier can stop one's physical attacks.
Doesn't matter if the barrier is natural or supernatural.
weaknesses: Have to touch the barrier.
Can't melt barries protecting the mind.
Doesn't extend to projectile attacks.

name: Einstein
description: The ability to access Albert Einstein's intellect is a very help full gift, especially during a science pop quiz. You automatically know everything that he knew in life.
summary: The ability to access Albert Einstein's intelligence
strengths: Inventing weapons, armor and gadgets on the go
Quizzes and tests are a breeze
Automatically proficient in German
weaknesses: Sometimes getting flashes of his thoughts
Feeling the need to do some thing great, this can be good or bad
People always bothering you to know what Einstein knew

name: Liquid Teleportation
description: You can teleport nearby bodies of liquid, up to the size of an swimming pool, to other locations that you can see. You have to point an index finger at the liquid to teleport it. The liquid will be teleported out of its container, leaving the container behind empty
summary: The ability to teleport liquids around you
strengths: Teleport drinks out of cups or kegs into your glass
Teleporting the blood out of a foe. Bit messy, but it's quick
Get rid of puddles in your way
weaknesses: Can only teleport liquids

name: Existence Blink
description: The ability to cause a subject's physical being to be removed from this plane of existence, and then relocated back to another dimension of the user's choosing. This can be used to send people back in time, to the future, to alternate dimensions, and the like. However, you can't relocate yourself. And if you can't decide where to send the foe, you have a short time before they return.
summary: The ability to change the dimension that a subject currently occupies
strengths: You can transport anything (oncoming bullets, etc.)
They can be transported anywhere
They can also be brought back
weaknesses: Can only keep them out of existence for a short time before they have to go SOMEWHERE
Can only transport them to existing dimensions (no making up NEW dimensions)
Can't transport yourself

name: Power Of The Chimera
description: With this power you can transform two different animals into a single new one, this new animal specie will be called a Chimera. You can create the most powerful predator to ever existed by transforming great predators into one, like a Rhino and a Lion (weird one). But, if you make something too aggressive or too smart it might turn against you. You can't use this power on humans because they are too smart, and you must be careful while creating a Chimera, its a complicated process.
summary: The ability to transform two different animals into a single new one, a chimera.
strengths: You can create a powerful and unstoppable predator with the right animals.
You can create a powerful virus or bacteria too, since they are simple organisms.
Chimeras created by you will be always under your control, as long as you be careful with them.
weaknesses: This power doesn't work on humans, they are too complex and smart.
You can't create something too aggressive or smart, it would turn against you.
Creating a chimera is a complicated process, if you forget to create a single artery it will die.

name: Total Self Bio Control
description: This ability lets you control anything that was ever a part of your biological body remotely. You can control dust that has been a part of your body and you can automatically summon them from any part of the world or universe. Biological implants that have synchronized with your own body can also be controlled. You cannot control things that have been turned into base elements like oxygen however. Carbon dioxide can also be controlled.
summary: The ability to control every non-element that has ever been part of your body
strengths: Every time you spit saliva or pick booger or scratch yourself you add more particles to control
You can control your own blood and body as well as dust, sweat, filth, and dirt
If you have lived a long time this power is very very strong
weaknesses: You cannot control diatomic particles or particles that have been converted into base elements
Controlled things have a tendency to mix when manipulating more than one object
Your controlled objects are highly combustable

name: Antinomian Persuasion
description: While this may seem more of a curse to some, it requires a bit of thought to see the true gift behind it. This ability is often called "Psychic Reverse Psychology", and for good reason. By telling anyone to do something, you subliminally compel them to do the opposite. So, in order to compel someone with this power, tell them what you don't want them to do.
summary: The ability to persuade people to do the opposite of what you say
strengths: Works just as well as a normal psychic persuasion
Can make a person do anything within their power (even if they would find it morally questionable)
Compulsion is activated at will
weaknesses: If it can't be suppressed
If it actually makes them do the things you reverse-compel them to do
People avoid conversations with you

name: Telepathic Prison
description: With this power, the user has the ability to trap the consciousness of anyone who uses telepathy on them in a prison within their own mind. The user can then either talk to them from outside the prison and let them out or keep them trapped forever. When trapped, the person with telepathy cannot move their actual body. You can choose to ignore the person and go throughout your daily life, and the telepath will still be stuck in you. You can also "borrow" the telepathic abilities of the trapped.
summary: The ability to trap people that use telepathy on you in your mind
strengths: People with mind power have to go through a clearance check in order to enter your mind
You can either decide to let them out or keep them trapped
Within your mind, their telepathy only makes you stronger. So, they can't break out with their power
weaknesses: Not useful, unless someone with telepathy uses it against you
They can still trick you into opening the telepathic door if they are good at being persuasive ...
... without telepathy

name: Thunder Ignitement
description: Because of it, Thunder Ignitement is considered the most undisputed super-ability for anyone to use. It does damage and has a 100.0% chance of electrocuting and burning the target. It's also a long-range attack that fires in a straight line of up to 90 miles, and may cause a burn and shock.
summary: The ability to unleash a long electrical flame in all directions.
strengths: It's totally effective against Pod People.
weaknesses: May cause maximum harm to someone you love most.

name: Full Sleep
description: Ever had to wake up early for a job? For school? Ever get in a bet where, if you fall asleep first, you would lose? Well, you won't lose because you won't sleep for very long!
summary: The ability to get a full night sleep in only 1 minute!
strengths: Only takes one minute to sleep!
Go to sleep faster!
1 minute of sleep equals 12 hours of sleep!
weaknesses: Your last time you'll ever sleep, you'll sleep for about a month and die in your sleep.
Snore horribly loud!

name: Myth Power: Aeon's Essence
description: Aeon (Aion, Chronus, Chronos, Khronos), in Greek myth, was the god of eternal time, eternity or infinity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, and withstand age and temporal manipulation. In addition, by touch, one can psychically induce a trance, in which subjects try to count to infinity. Furthermore, one becomes effectively immortal; if ever fatally wounded, the soul leaves the body and solidifies into a new body, complete with a new soul of its own.
summary: The ability to channel Aeon's command over the essence of eternal time, eternity and infinity
strengths: Perceive the passage of time (Chronopathy); Withstand temporal manipulation (Time Defiance) and age
Psychically induce dazed Aeon Infinity Trance, by touch, in which subject tries to count to infinity
If ever killed, soul is released, and turns into a new body with its own soul (Aeon Immortality)
weaknesses: Can't be used to manipulate/travel through time; still can die when power is NOT in use (NCN)
Pro #2 prevents foe from eating/drinking/sleeping (maybe bad for your conscience...)
Pro #2 is permanent until developed; cannot share Aeon Immortality by touch until developed (NCN)

name: Purifying Blasts
description: The blasts are colored golden-white and anything they touch is purified of evil influence whether it is living or nonliving.
summary: The ability to fire blasts of energy that purify whatever evil they touch
strengths: You can purify anything of evil influence.
weaknesses: Purifying humans might not change their habits or attitudes.
Purifying magical artifacts won't get lose powers but will lose curses.

name: Infinite Teeth Healing
description: With this superpower, your teeth will always heal. They will heal cavities and always be strong healthy and white. If your tooth breaks in half, it will heal itself in a matter of seconds. It heals using seemingly magical particles and the teeth enamel comes from a parallel universe. You will never have to worry about broken teeth or cavities ever again. It might be a highly advanced form of science that seems like magic that allows the teeth to instantly heal.
summary: The ability to have your teeth heal completely even if it's broken in half or chipped.
strengths: Never worry about broken teeth again.
Never worry about cavities again.
Your teeth are always strong, white and healthy.
weaknesses: Your teeth aren't any stronger than metal.
Your teeth can be knocked off whole out of your human gums.
Your teeth aren't perfect.

name: Geometry
description: this allows you to project a 3-D graph of the immediate area. you can then manually change the graph, which reality then reflects. also acts as a map.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality in immediate area
strengths: change reality
weaknesses: takes time

name: Idea Spheres
description: A noun is a person, place, thing or idea. An idea is the only one of those that you can't touch. Until now. This ability allows you to create glass spheres out of ideas. Images of that idea will be floating within the sphere. If the sphere breaks, the idea it contains will enforce itself on its surroundings. Create a Sphere of Freedom when you're in a jail cell. Create a Sphere of Destruction in the middle of a fight. Create a Sphere of Power to power your house.
summary: The ability to hold ideas as a physical thing.
strengths: You can create idea spheres
There are hundreds of different spheres you can create
When the sphere breaks, its idea is enforced on its surroundings
weaknesses: Your house will be covered in shelves of spheres
A sphere's surroundings almost always includes you
Some spheres are dangerous

name: Wish Granting Sword
description: A person wielding the Wish Granting Sword and selected people are given the ability to make their wishes come true. The wish granting sword does not give power right away but makes it possible and highly likely to happen. For example if one wished for power, the sword will turn heavy so the user can train. If the user really needed power the sword can grant superstrength. It all depends on how much the person needs it. Thus a person that is desperate will wield tremendous power with this sword.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that will grant your wishes (eventually depending on need)
strengths: You can get your wishes granted
The sword can self-repair even if only one molecule is left
If you want to live this sword can resurrect you a second before you die
weaknesses: You have to work with gained wishes to make it effective, superstrength needs to be developed, etc.
Cannot be selfish with this power, only desperate needs are granted
Sword can be stolen and used

name: Empathic Weather Manipulation
description: An empathic weather manipulator can neither control or accurately predict the weather. All they can do is manipulate it through expression of their feelings & it has to be genuine feelings. If they are happy, it'll be bright & sunny, sad-cloudy & maybe rain, anger causes a storm & so on. They even manipulate clouds to reveal their expressions & feelings like make a cloud look like a boat or bunny or whatever they feel.
summary: The ability to manipulate the weather via emotions
strengths: Manipulate weather empathically
Make shapes of what they feel out of clouds
weaknesses: Its all controlled by emotion
Has to be genuine emotion, not fake

name: Author's Immunity
description: Having your abilities copied or replicated is an undeniable threat to any superpowered person. It doesn't matter how powerful you are, a copycat hero will only use whatever power you have against you. And most often than not they can beat the crap out of most people because of their diverse selection of powers. However in the presence of a person with this ability any superpower which was originaly 'created' by 'him' cannot be used against in any way possible.
summary: The ability to become immune or to be completely unaffected by the superpowers that you created.
strengths: All of your power cannot be used against you.
This ability grants the user complete immunity against stolen or copied abilities.
This ability grants the user the ability to nullify any copied or stolen superpower.
weaknesses: Originality is a must.
If the ability being used by your opponent is not created by you.
If you are up against the author of this ability.

name: Omnipotent Power Blocking
description: Annoyed with powers like Power Safety and Cellular Regain? This power will allow you to get rid of their powers. The secret is that it doesn't affect the abilities in any way; it severs the person's body from the power, so that they cannot use it. For example, if a person has regeneration, the regeneration will still be intact, but the person's body cannot use the power, rendering the person powerless for all intents and purposes, only powers like cellular regain won't be of any use.
summary: The ability to deny access to a being's abilities.
strengths: Great if you can mimic powers.
Can turn the effect off.
Nothing will restore the powers except you.
weaknesses: Does not undo things they have already done.
Erases all powers; you cannot select one you want to remove.
Has to be mentally maintained until you touch them.

name: Zoom Lens Eyes
description: With this ability, your eyes can zoom in on distant objects.  You have perfect vision no matter what distance you're zoomed in at!
summary: The ability to zoom your vision to any distance with perfect clarity.
strengths: No need for glasses
Zoom in on distant planets and stars
Read tiny writing from miles away
weaknesses: It'll be so much fun you'll probably want to zoom in on things all day

name: Solar Fueled Spaceflight
description: With this power, you can travel through space, provided you have enough sunlight. As you absorb the rays of the sun, you gain the ability to fly, resistance to the low pressure, radiation and temperature extremes and sustenance (including air) from the sun's rays.
summary: The ability to fly through space using solar energy.
strengths: Fly through space!
Fly high in the atmosphere.
Has plenty of everyday uses.
weaknesses: Space agencies will want to study you.
Space is huge -you would have an extremely hard time exploring it all.
You can't extend it to others without conscious effort.

name: Power Negation
description: With this ability, you could stop, reverse and negate the powers of other beings.
summary: The ability to cancel the superpowers of others.
strengths: Others would not be able to use their powers on you.
Your power could not be used offensively.
You could allow specific individuals to use their powers in your presence if you wish.
weaknesses: You may have to be touching the target.
The target must be in close proximity to you.
It may be involuntary and uncontrollable.

name: The Power Of The Moon
description: It allows you control water, air, ice and gravity. You can control the tides, the weather and you can become weightless
summary: The ability to the ability the control the elements it rules
strengths: You can refreeze the melting ice caps
You can fly
You can make water appear because of the tiny particles of water in the air
weaknesses: If your powers get out of control, it could destroy the earth
Messing with nature will create extreme consequences

name: Furnace Hands
description: Furnace Hands give you ability to smelt and reshape metal into any form just by touching it. It can't add mass to anything, so you can't make a piece of metal bigger than it already is, simply reshape it into a different form.
summary: The ability to smelt and reshape metal by touch.
strengths: Reshape any form of metal.
Smelt any form of metal.
No need for a furnace.
weaknesses: Not great for combat, unless someone is swinging a sword or such at you.

name: Mega Minions
description: To be able to make minions that will do anything for out of the four basic elements.
summary: The ability to create minions out of the elements
strengths: They'll do anything for you
Can't make as many minions as you want at a time
4 max.
weaknesses: Cant make more than four minions

name: Arachnid Mimicry
description: You can sprout eight legs from your body, and project a sticky silk to form webs. You can climb up walls and have a venomous bite. You also have two extra appendages which end in pincers, or sprout a scorpion-like venomous tail.
summary: The ability to take on the traits of an arachnid.
strengths: Venomous bite/sting.
Sticky silk.
Eight legs & wallclimbing.
weaknesses: Look kinda freaky.
Might develop a spider-like personality.

name: Guardian Angel
description: You have a Guardian Angel that will fight for you. You can also call him at any time to help in other matters.  Guardian angels have their own personality so you can not control them or ask to do something they do not want to do. They have some great powers such as wings, celestial blades, healing powers, etc.  Angels travel through dimensional rifts so they will find you anywhere. You can ask your angel to protect others; he will until he has to save your life.
summary: The ability to have an Angel watching over you.
strengths: Angel will do anything to save your life.
Angels have great powers and skills.
You will have a friend and reliable partner.
weaknesses: The angel can leave you if you do something he does not aprove.
Will protect you even if you don't want to.
He may not come when you call.

name: Air Drop
description: Your mysterious supplier gives you a phone number. The supplies have to drop from the sky. Any sky of of any planet in this universe. Any phone will work. You can't supply a army, just a group of friends. The supplies only drop after you're outside if you made the call from a hardline (phoneset with a wire). The supplies will always land no more than 10 feet away from you. Some things might not be availiable to you (rare and/or deadly things: Kryptonite, 100 megaton warheads, zombie viruses etc)
summary: The ability to call for a air drop of supplies from a mysterious supplier.
strengths: A source of supplies if you're not underground or in another universe.
Any phone, even the first phone ever used, works.
weaknesses: You need a phone.
Supplies can be moved away from you

name: Life And Death Transcendence
description: For starters a person with this ability can no longer be classified as living, dead, undead or anything in relation to these terms. His very existence is altered in such a way that anything (definitions, limitations, rules, etc) that applies to life or death (or anything in between) no longer applies to him. His ability or inability to act will no longer be governed by these two ever present opposing forces. This is a one way process after which you will exist in a way no one has ever before.
summary: The ability to be liberated and transcend all existential limitations of both life and death.
strengths: Transcend the need to live and the inevitability of death.
This ability also applies to superpowers that works with or against life and death.
Never again will your being alive or dead determine if you can think, act, or exist in your realm
weaknesses: You can't use any superpower that has to do with life or death, including healing and immortality
Permanent and cannot be reversed, even if the ability is nullified. Say goodbye to healing forever.
The process is instant but overwhelmingly painful and you may lose your mind as an effect.

name: Planar Sensory
description: There are multiple planes of reality yet most people can only perceive one. This power allows you to expand your sense to ALL of the planes regardless of their distance from your own(as long as they are in your own dimension). This means that all of your senses(even a sixth if you have it) can be used to detect information from the planes. However the sense area is not limitless, you can sense a wide area but to go farther you have to shift sensory perceptions to another part of the plane.
summary: The ability to expand your senses to the other planes of reality.
strengths: Collect large amounts of information on multiple planes(detecting extra-planar entities,guards,etc)
Can view different areas of different planes all at once.
Some enemies might try to come from another plane for an ambush.
weaknesses: You can get sensory overload if there is too much activity on multiple planes.
The phrase "scared out of your skin" does apply.
Some things could be beyond sensory perception on ALL planes.

name: Heat Vision
description: With this ability, you can shoot beams of super-heated light out of your eyes.  Much like Superman, except you will do it with more style.
summary: The ability to project beams of concentrated radiation from your eyes.
strengths: Blast your way through anything
weaknesses: Blasting through things that shouldn't be blasted through

name: Sleepwalker Control
description: A person with this power has the ability to control people when they are asleep. That means that the user can create an army of sleepwalkers to do their bidding. In addition, if the person who is asleep has superpowers, they may use them as long as it does not involve chanting spells or anything that requires words, since the sleepwalkers can only snore. Also, once you have taken control of someone, they can't wake up until you lose concentration on them.
summary: The ability to control people in their sleep
strengths: Can control people once they fall asleep and the sleeping person can use their superpowers
They will forget everything that happened
They cannot wake up unless you lose concentration
weaknesses: If your concentration is disturbed, they will go berserk or, alternatively, fall on the ground
They can't talk and can only snore-so no powers requiring words may be activated
Cannot control yourself

name: 4 Wings
description: Someone with this power literally has 4 wings of any style. All the wings could be the same style, each wing could be a different style, or any other combination possible. Examples of styles are bat, angel, hawk, demon, dragon, phoenix, etc. The wings will always work perfectly together in terms of flying.
summary: The ability to have 4 wings of the style of one's choice
strengths: You can hide the wings as needed.
You can change the style(s) of the wings as wanted.
weaknesses: Might look weird having wings of 4 different styles.

name: See Through
description: Ability to literally get into someone's shoes and view whatever is happening at the moment in their point of view. Happens randomly, not always by choice.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of others
strengths: Understanding what others are going through
New experience, gain knowledge
Primary source to what really is happening
weaknesses: Might sway your opinion to the person's whether it's right or not
Can experience horrific atrocities
This happens against your will

name: Sthenomaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you become a monstrous flesh-like beast which grows and gains power from physical harm. Everytime you're physically harmed, it makes you stronger, giving you superstrength. As your size and strength increases, your form will become more demented, possibly growing new arms. Despite you invulnerability to physical harm, it becomes harder to think rationally, and you are highly susceptible to mental harm.
summary: The ability to transform into a state which grows and gains power from physical harm.
strengths: Grow and gain strength from being physically harmed.
As you grow, your form becomes more wicked, and you begin to grow extra arms.
weaknesses: When you revert to normal, you lose all the effects that you gained from this form.
Mental harm causes you to revert to normal.

name: The Never Ending Slide
description: You can create space-skipping portals of convenience, two at a time, that are linked to each other. These may appear on, in, or overlapping objects. If you create a third portal, the second is now linked to that one and the first is destroyed, and so on. One fun example of using this would be to put a portal near the top of a large slide and another near the bottm, so the slide appears to go on forever. Or you could just make it easier to grab a pie from the fridge.
summary: The ability to create portals linked to one another
strengths: Convenient travel
The lazy man's dream, no need to get up, just reach into the fridge from where you sit
If someone annoys you, push them into a portal beneath another portal, making them fall forever
weaknesses: Limited to two linked portals
You have to have been somehwere first to place the portals before you can go there through them
Very obvious and hard to fit in with the decor

name: Fear Guardian
description: A person with this power has a guardian made up of their own fear. The guardian evolves based on their fears. It also tells the user where danger is ahead of time. The guardian can only be seen by the user and cannot be damaged, but it will grow smaller the less afraid the user is. It will never go away unless the user is unafraid of anything. The guardian becomes intangible when there is nothing that is threatening the user. The guardian attacks with physical force.
summary: The ability to have an ally made up of your own fear
strengths: It can attack people near you, its strength is relative to your fear
Gives you something close to precognition
You can control the guardian if you master your fears
weaknesses: Guardian will not help you unless you are afraid of something
The guardian will always want to destroy the source of your fears even when you want to run away

name: Welding
description: You can create a jet of fire from your body like a blow torch that welds objects together. It welds objects together by creating a liquid metal over whatever it burns that instantly solidifies when it is cooled down. Objects can be welded together without burning the objects but the fire must still go over the area that you wish to be welded. The metal is strong but not indestructible.
summary: The ability to create flaming daggers that welds objects together.
strengths: Weld objects together.
Can choose to burn objects or not while welding.
Metal created to hold welds together is strong.
weaknesses: Might burn people by accident.
Will have hard time removing welds that you make.
Have to be able to reach what you want to weld. Limited range.

name: Quantum Loop
description: Break all or part of yourself into mini cells instantly when receiving any physical strike and form into any shape when needed. When appears in quantum form, one possesses the ability to control over an amount of gravity and magnetic force.  Able to wrap around your enemy to either suffocate, block their vision, or causes sudden gravity and magnetic power to crush them to the floor.  After transformation, an eye has to be kept to ensure vision or it will all depend on other senses to react.
summary: The ability to decompose our own body into quantum size at will.
strengths: Receive no physical damage.
High speed and wide range of activity.
Flexible and has multi-task purpose.
weaknesses: Complete transformation will leave you touch.
Vulnerable to extreme temperatures.

name: Summon Excalibur
description: Excalibur is known as King Arthur's sword, but it is also one of the four swords of power. Excalibur is the sword of ice and its abilities include freezing anything it cuts and absorbing the purest memories of anyone it kills. It is also indestructible and can create Ley Gates when fused with its twin sword, Clarent. Ley Gates are portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
summary: The ability to summon Excalibur, the stone sword of Ice.
strengths: Freeze enemies
Absorb good memories
Create Ley Gates.
weaknesses: Must be combined with Clarent to create Ley Gates.

name: Apotheosis
description: Apotheosis is the ability to become completely immune to anything. The power manufests itself by bringing you back to life after you die. You are now immune to whatever killed you. You can only adapt to the fatal force after you die. Thus anything that slows you down, traps you, or knocks you out remains a threat.
summary: The ability to adapt after death
strengths: you can't die
weaknesses: you have to die to become immune

name: Purple Haze
description: With a wavy gestures of your hands, you can let out some hallucinogenic mist that makes people act real goofy, nullifying their senses, and make them see crazy illusions.
summary: The ability to cast waves on anyone that cause them to have crazy hallucinations.
strengths: Your enemies won't have a clue and doesn't know what hit them.
weaknesses: It can last for up to 45 hours.
Won't work against robots, or armored-type foes.

name: Dark Path
description: As fun as heck with a path going at 300 MPH (miles per hour). You must have a dark ring on at anytime you use it (ring included).
summary: The ability to move on a path of darkness.
strengths: Quick transportation
Fun glide
Go to almost anywhere
weaknesses: Can not go through solid objects
You must have a dark ring on at anytime you use it (ring included)
You can travel by using other objects' shadows to connect

name: Psionic Wrecking Balls
description: Also known as the "Melchsee's Door", the person with this ability is able to project their psychic power through the creation of "wrecking balls" or orbs that can obliterate all forms of matter except for the user. Wrecking orbs naturally home toward psionic energy and eat psychic energy. When enough psychic energy is eaten the orbs grow uncontrollable tendrils of psychic energy. However, through effort however the user can learn to control this power and limit the path of destruction it causes.
summary: The ability to materialize your psychic energy into wrecking balls that can obliterates anything except the user
strengths: Wrecking balls can obliterate any type of matter
User can control wrecking balls with effort and can create more orbs and also compress into discs
Wrecking balls immediately home toward any psychic or brain activity and can eat psychic energy
weaknesses: You need to have great amount of control
If a wrecking ball absorbs too much outside psionic energy it will go berserk
User must have lots of imagination to use this in non-destructive ways

name: Alternate Temporal Optics
description: This power is the ability to view alternate timelines optically. Doing so the user can see what is happening in many different timelines all at once. In addition the user has the ability to travel backwards in the time line to even see what happened in the past so they can tell what triggers what. The scope of the users vision still applies to other timelines so you have to shift your view to see more, however you can use any other optic viewing abilities to view alternate timelines.
summary: The ability to view other timelines and gain knowledge of them.
strengths: See what triggers what in different timelines.
Becomes very deadly/useful in combination with time travel and timeline skipping.
You can gain information that could lead to building advanced technology.
weaknesses: Viewing too many timelines at once causes sensory overload.
You require a visual protection power to view timelines the same if they have been altered.
It takes time to view timelines that greatly deviate from our own.

name: Induced Phobia
description: To use this power, you have to tell your victim "Does/do (object of fear) scare you?... Now, it does/they do." From now on, the victim will feel a visceral panic and anxiety whenever they think about or are exposed to anything related to the object of fear, and they will usually act irrationally. For instance, a phobic of constipation can constantly go to the bathroom; a phobic of water can stop drinking and go crazy when they are wet; a phobic of germs can wash themselves until bleeding.
summary: The ability to cause someone to be irrationally afraid of anything you want.
strengths: The fear is irrational, so the victim will stay afraid, even if one tries to reason with them.
A phobia can be very disabling. A phobic of doors can hardly have a normal social life.
Things related to their phobia can scare them. Popping sounds or blimps can scare a balloon phobic.
weaknesses: You can only give one phobia per person.
A person can become desensitized to a phobia you gave them.
If a person is already or became desensitized to a phobia, you can't give them that phobia again.

name: Ultimate Cowboy Quick Draw
description: A person with this power will always be the first to fire/use their weapon or activate their skill and abilities. A sure and instant fight or flight reaction is always an advantage. Imagine you're in a situation where you're up against someone with the power to: a. Kill you instantly; b. Nullify, manipulate or dampen all of your powers; c. Escape or instantly run away from you. This power will make sure that before they can even say their magic word you have already completed your desired act.
summary: The ability to always be the first person to fire/use a weapon or activate an ability.
strengths: Use your most powerful ability before it gets nullified, manipulated, or dampened.
This ability even works against passive abilities and their instant effects which are always active.
Everybody else (including their abilities) is ready for second place, even Superman!
weaknesses: Nothing! Even time manipulators are no match for you!

name: X Ray Vision
description: Good old X-Ray Vision, you can see through different matter and be able to control the depth that you can see. So to look at someone (like a female) you don't just look through her, you can just look through her clothes, which could prove interesting.
summary: The ability to see through different matter.
strengths: See through solid objects
See through clothes
See into "the box" and know what the mystery item is.
weaknesses: Seeing through a door thinking it was open and running into it.
Seeing through clothes and seeing things that shouldn't be there.

name: Scout
description: Afraid of what might lye ahead in your path? With Scout, you can scope it out before moving on. However,while you're doing this, your real body becomes immovable and vulnerable to attack and you can only scout ahead 100 feet in any direction.
summary: The ability to send a ghost form of yourself ahead of you.
strengths: Seeing what lies ahead
weaknesses: Vulneable body
Limited distance.

name: Animal Control
description: You can take over and control any animal for as long as you'd like.  Your human self will be "asleep," but your conscious mind will be fully awake within the animal.  You can choose to not feel pain, will know how to use all of the animal's bodily functions, and if the animal you're controlling dies, you'll be transported back into your body again.  This ability excludes controlling other humans.  To make matters better, the sleep you get while controlling the animal is good, quality sleep!
summary: The ability to fully control any animal (excluding humans).
strengths: Hunt on the savannah
If your animal dies, you don't
weaknesses: As an animal, being killed might be pretty terrifying
Your human self goes to sleep when you control other animals

name: Velocity Match
description: Dependent object skips all intermediate speeds and directions, jumping instantly to the target's. As long as this power is sustained, other stimuli on dependent object are ignored, such as gravity, air resistance and obstacles. Power can be used to either increase or decrease something's speed as well as change its direction. If the power is turned off, the dependent object will lose momentum and be affected by everything normally. If the independent object is hurt, so will the dependent.
summary: The ability to make an object (or person) instantly go at the same speed and direction as another.
strengths: Best hitchhiker ever.
Can shoot someone like a bullet or throw them like a penny in a well.
Don't need to worry about falling long distances (just match velocity before you hit the ground).
weaknesses: Matching velocity with something right before it crashes.
Losing concentration at high speeds.
People may insist you sit outside the car when seats are limited.

name: Friar Sand Channelling
description: You can have the granted power of being extremely strong, to breathe underwater, and have various magical abilities (transfom a small goard into a gigantic one, etc). You can also become a powerful alchemist.
summary: The ability to endlessly breathe underwater and possess unlimited magic.
strengths: Very strong fighter in the water
weaknesses: You look like a monster

name: Assassin's Eagle Vision
description: Here's an example of how to use it: You are at a concert, and you want to know how many people have blonde hair. Activate this power and pick a color. Everyone at the concert that has blonde hair will be shining with that color.
summary: The ability to determine what is and what isn't through sight.
strengths: Find out who is an enemy and who isn't.
See through illusions.
Intelligence gathering.
weaknesses: Your vision is a little bit blurry so you might bump into a few things.
You naturally focus on whatever is shining, so you might not pay attention to your surroundings.

name: Beast
description:
You choose which animal to act as in nature, any animal from any time period. Mythological animals are not included, only animals that have really existed, this includes dinosaurs. E.g if you chose a rhino, you act instinctly with a strong running charge.
However an animals weaknesses are also included.
summary: The ability to act as an animal would in nature, any animal from any time period.
strengths: Have a rhino's strength
Have a bird's flight capabilities. (Unless you chose an Emu).
Have a whole range of animals to choose from.
weaknesses: As a snake your vision is clouded.
Do not take the animals form, only instincts and abilities.
Mythological animals are not included

name: Counter
description: Your powered by your instinct to know your enemy's every move & successfully block & counter-attack them. You will even be able to disarm them when they hold weapons. This only works in close combat mostly.
summary: The ability to instinctively block & counter attack a foe's every move
strengths: Successfully block & counter attack an enemy
Disarm weapons easily
weaknesses: Only really works in close combat quarters

name: Stellar Mimicry
description: Stars have some amazing properties. A person with Stellar Mimicry can emulate some of them. They can emit bright light, produce plasma jets, generate a powerful gravity field and fly at will. However, they will always have a minor magnetic field surrounding them, and in the course of their life will swell up, shed their outer layers, and then collapse into a black hole much like a real star.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of a star
strengths: Very powerful
Can be turned on and off
The satisfaction of looking like a deity
weaknesses: Will die as a black hole
Magnetic field will wipe out computers
Cults

name: Acedia
description: With this ability the user is able to make another person very slow and weak. The person affected will become very sluggish or slow and probably won't have the energy to move much. The person affected may not even be able to use any of their powers because they are so sluggish. Even if they manage to use their powers it will be very botched or weak. The ability needs to be used by touching someone or by unleashing it all on the area in the form of an aura. There is a time limit to this power.
summary: The ability to decrease another person's strength and speed to a very weak, slow and sluggish level
strengths: Can make someone strong and fast, slow and weak
Can work on multiple people at once
weaknesses: The effects of this power are temporary
The radius of which the power can affect is also limited by the users own strength

name: Elemental Negate
description: A person with this power has the ability to negate any harmful effects of one element at any moment. The elements include but are not limited to: Heat, Frost, Earth, Metal, Air, Plant, Animal, Light, Dark, Liquid, Energy, Spirit, and Time. The user can switch between any negations at any moment but there is a small delay between switches. While active the user is completely immune to anything negatively related to the element no matter the strength of the element that is affecting the user.
summary: The ability to negate the harmful effects of one element on yourself at any time.
strengths: Many elements to choose from.
Complete immunity to the negative effects of one element.
Still affected by helpful things, such as still being able to breath while immune to Air.
weaknesses: Small delay between switches where you can be hurt.
Can only block one element at a time so you are still vulnerable to other elements.
Have to be able to predict ahead of time what you will need to be immune to.

name: Aroma
description: A person with this power has the ability to emit fragrances from their body at will as well as control the direction of their fragrances. Fragrances can have multiple effects. It can paralyze others, remove mental limits, cause pain, create illusions, control other's motor functions, knock people out, and anything that affects the nervous system or the brain. You can make the aroma smell anyway you want as well as make the aroma any color you want at well. You are immune to your own fragrances.
summary: The ability to emit fragrances with various effects on the nervous system
strengths: Once it reaches the brain you can control a person's nervous system/brain
You can bottle up your fragrances to sell to others with the same effects
You always smell nice-you can create cologne/perfume at will
weaknesses: Looks very girly if you are a guy using this power unless you made it invisible
People can become immune to a specific fragrance but you can make more types
People can blow away fragrances with a fan/ Burn it

name: Omnikill
description: Omnikill causes death onsight. The user can cause an instant or prolonged death with a gaze at a victim. The gaze does have to connect with the eyes of the victim in order to have a full effect. When the user gazes at bare skin of a victim the victim may experience anything from a slight tingle to nuclear radiation on the bare skin being looked at. The ability has no connection with telepathy so it cannot be used by thinking about a person. Wearing strong UV glasses may weaken its effects.
summary: The ability to kill on sight
strengths: Seemingly limitless power
Easy to use
Hard to avoid
weaknesses: Very hard to master control of
Can accidently kill loved ones
Can accidently kill the wrong person

name: Ability Examination
description: With this ability, you can examine superpowers. You can learn every detail about them, such as what they are, how they are used, side effects, and how powerful they are with the user that possesses them. You cannot, however, learn how to possess that power.
summary: The ability to examine one's superpowers, and learn every detail about them.
strengths: Examine superpowers of other super-powered beings.
Learn strengths, weakness, how they are used, how powerful it is with the user, etc.
weaknesses: Cannot learn how to use the superpower you examine (unless it is a technique. )

name: Grenade Punches
description: You are able to create a mini explosion when you punch objects which is equal to that of a grenade. But it uses up your calories so you need to eat a lot- so you don't need to exercise.
summary: The ability to create mini explosions with your fists
strengths: Exploding punches
You don't have to exercise
weaknesses: You need to eat a lot of food

name: Photosynthesis
description: With this ability, one can lay down roots and turn green to harvest energy from the sun. This gives them energy, heals them, eliminates disease and restores youth. The power can be turned off at will. The user cannot move while the power is in use, whether voluntarily or forcefully. They also need to be touching raw earth and water for the power to be activated, with sunlight powering the process.
summary: The ability to perform photosynthesis.
strengths: Heal yourself
Prevent someone from forcing you somewhere (example: Teleportation).
Re-energize yourself.
weaknesses: Can't move while in use.
Need to touch earth and water.
Needs sunlight.

name: Rocket Move
description: When you concentrate and punch or kick, you will be able to increase your power 100 fold. Your punches or kicks could destroy an entire block.
summary: The ability to punch or kick with the power of a rocket.
strengths: Increase your punch or kick power 100 fold.
Wipe out the competition.
weaknesses: Could injure or kill a lot of people.

name: Poetic Prophecy
description: This type of ability is hard to control; it could happen anywhere and anytime. You'll be in a trance as you begin to write poems about future events (yourself, others or the world ) and you will awaken without any memory of it. Though, fortunately, most of the time, you have the capability to interpret the poetry you write, no matter how cryptic.
summary: The ability to tap into the future by writting poems.
strengths: Prevent and take action ahead.
You'll become a great psychic.
weaknesses: Fear.

name: Ultimate Trader
description: Physical or abstract traits. Illnesses,damage or injuries. Super powers or just their pros and/or cons. You can trade any of these with another person. Physical objects can be traded for the above mentioned. Just like Ebay but with super powers,emotions or iq points for trade. Deals must be made with free will. A trade partner doesn't have to know you have this power. Some trades won't work. Power pros and cons only work if trade partners have similar powers.
summary: The ability to trade almost anything for anything with someone.
strengths: Lose what you don't need,trade for what you want.
This power can be used without your trade partner knowing you have it.
weaknesses: If you have any power that limits what you can barter.
You might not have what anyone wants or vice versa.

name: Magnanimous Seeds
description: The subject acquires a specific power by touching or holding in their hands one or more seeds of a particular plant species. From the moment the person acquires the power, the plant grows on their own body and influences the effect of the power. An example: if the subject comes in contact with the seed of an oak tree, they'll be able to move objects with thought. The power depends on the personal meaning that the subject gives to the plant, but also on the chemical composition of the seed.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by touching one or more seeds of a specific tree.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as existing plant species;
weaknesses: If the plant is removed from your skin you will lost the power;
Keeping the plant on your body alive is not the easiest thing.

name: Spinning Blizzard Fury
description: Create a blizzard-like tornado to freeze all in its path. You can create it by just using your mind. And it will not harm who you do not want it to. You can also control it and change its size and speed.
summary: The ability to create a blizzard-like tornado to freeze and destroy all in its path.
strengths: You have complete control.
You can create with your mind.
Doesn't hurt who you don't want it to.
weaknesses: Limited by the amount of concentration you have
Does not instantly freeze everthing

name: Perfect Reception
description: Where ever you are in the world, you always have perfect reception on your mobile phone.   It doesn't matter what mobile device, the moment you take it in your hand those bars indicate 100% signal strength.   Even when you're in an underground lair with lead shielded walls, and located in the middle of nowhere.
summary: The ability to always have perfect reception on your mobile
strengths: Never out of reach with our mobile phone.
weaknesses: If the battery of your mobile is depleted then you still can't call.

name: Magnetic Field Boost
description: You can amplify a magnetic field's force up to the level of a magnetar's force (10 to the 15th power gauss) from as low as that of a refrigerator magnet's force (100 gauss). However, using this power to its maximum level will enact such a strain on your body that you will die in 5 seconds. Also, you can only amplify magnetic fields that you are touching.
summary: The ability to amplify the strength of a magnetic field.
strengths: You can make any magnetic field really strong, possibly stronger than that of a black hole's.
weaknesses: A magnetar is well past the point that you would want to amplify a magnetic field as doing(to con 2)
(from con1) so could possibly kill you as well as everything in a 30-kilometre radius.
You are not immune to the effects of magnetic fields that you create with this power.

name: Myth Power: Crisis' Crackdown
description: Crisis (Krisis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of judgment, choice and decision. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the correct answer to nearly any yes-no or multiple-choice question, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive indecisiveness and uncertainty, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically negate subjects' ability to decide (and thus immobilize them), by touch. One can even psychically communicate with and compel subjects feeling uncertain, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Crisis' command over the essence of the judgment, choice and decision
strengths: Psychically perceive answers to any yes-no/multiple choice question
Psychically perceive uncertainty at will; negate ability to decide (immobilize subjects) by touch
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects feeling uncertain/indecisive, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically adapt body and mind to select numerous choices, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive and travel to alternate realities until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oknos' Activity and MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provides immunity (NCN)

name: Boomerang
description: With this power whenever you throw something you can cause it to return to you whenever you want. You can turn this power on and off whenever you like.
summary: The ability to cause things to come back to you when you throw them
strengths: You can make things come back to you when you throw them
weaknesses: If you forget to turn this power off and you throw a grenade it could have disastrous results
tags: it's all coming back to you

name: Thief Tracker
description: With this power whenever something of yours is stolen, you will instanly be alerted and you will know who the thief is. You can track the thief and view its location (as well as the way to location) of the thief at will until you have retrieved what was taken from you.
summary: The ability to know if something of yours has been stolen and who stole it
strengths: You will automatically know if something of yours was stolen
You will know who stole it
Track the thief and view its location, as well as the way to it.
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Rpg Item Pack
description: Like a character in a RPG, you can carry absurd amounts of stuff in a tiny, half-backpack-sized pack. In fact, you can pull from this pack nearly anything you own. The pack will stretch quite a lot to allow moderately large items to be withdrawn, but you won't be able to pack a fully assembled car. Your pack cannot be stolen, but if you're beat-up pretty good, your attacker will get random stuff of yours. (You can leave your pack in a safe place to avoid this. )
summary: The ability to pull anything you own from a compact RPG-style pack.
strengths: You have instant access to all of your possessions at any time.
The pack works like teleportation and thus has no inherent weight limit.
You don't have to think ahead and pack, all unpackable items you own are always available.
weaknesses: The pack is not ugly, but not really a fashion statement.
Very large items (furniture, cars) cannot be "carried".
Anyone who knows you have this power will insist you always supply the camping equipment.

name: Rightful Rule
description: Also called Regal Bond, this is the ability to gain supernatural royal status in one's homeland (depending on the strength of the ability, this may mean one's city, state, country, planet or beyond). One with this ability automatically gains love and respect from neutral or same-aligned citizens of said homeland. In addition, any decree one makes in that homeland is considered law, as well as any consequence assigned to it. One's presence even psychically affects the environment (weather etc).
summary: The ability to gain supernatural royal status in one's homeland
strengths: Be loved/respected by neutral/same-aligned citizens of one's home street/city/state/country/world
Any decree one makes within one's home land is considered law (as well as accompanying consequences)
One's presence affects environment (weather, plant growth, wildlife behavior, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive layout and citizens of one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bend reality within limits of one's homeland until developed (NCN)

name: Convenient Pre Boss Generosity
description: In a video game how do you know when a boss fight is coming? Because you'll find a healing station, or a shop, or a save point and a mountain of ammo piled right outside a suspicious door. With this power, the real world now works under this logic. Every time you're about to be involved in a particularly dangerous fight the universe will provide you with the means to recuperate and prepare for the coming battle. You'll find something to restore your energy or bullets. Anything convenient.
summary: The ability to have the universe be generouse right before a dificult fight.
strengths: Know when a dangerouse fight is coming because of the generousity of the universe.
Be more prepaired for the coming struggle.
Power is balanced to your power level. If you were ordinary, a mugger would count as a Boss.
weaknesses: If this power activates, it means there's no avoiding the fight. It's inevitable.
It dosen't give you an advantage, just prepares you for what is to come.
This power will not activate for fights that are impossible for you to win.

name: Censorship
description: You can cover any object with a black box that is impossible to see through or replace any word about to be said with a bleep sound. Don't want people to see that hideous mole? They'll see a black box instead with this power.
summary: The ability to censor objects and sounds in real life like on TV.
strengths: Great for censoring out things that shouldn't be seen or sounds that shouldn't be heard.
Be a real troll with this power.
weaknesses: Doesn't censor smell, touch or taste.
Could be considered to be a pretty annoying person with this power.
It's obvious you're hiding something when there's a big black box in the way.

name: Roll Back
description: This power gives you a pair of numbers on your hands. To use this power you must designate a number. This number will be imprinted on your left hand. From that moment on, for every action that you take that causes physical change to something or someone else, that action is counted on your right hand. When the number n the right hand goes over the number on the left every physical change you caused is undone and the number on your right hand resets to zero.
summary: The ability to have everything you've done undone after a certain number of actions.
strengths: Undo every physical change you make.
The undoing does not effect where you are.
weaknesses: You have to keep track of how many actions you have left before the reset.
Once the right hand counter has ticked up once you can not change the left hand number.
The numbers are plainly visible on your hands.

name: Power Pusher
description: If you have an enemy who's powers drain them, mentally or physically, you can push an addiction onto them. They will not be able to stop using their own power and they'll be so exhausted all the time that they'll never be able to fight you ever again.
summary: The ability to make people become addicted to using their power.
strengths: Eliminate enemies without killing them.
Keep dangerous people from hurting any more people
Once drained of all power enemies are no longer a threat.
weaknesses: You cannot use this power against people who immunity powers.
Doesn't work against someone with the ability to throw your back at you.
Some victims of this power may commit suicide if you leave in this state.

name: 10 Million Swords
description: User has the power to summon 10 million different swords into the battlefield anytime the user wants the swords that are summoned by this power are unbreakable
summary: The ability to summon 10 million swords to assist you in battle.
strengths: Swords that you summon can be  of any type of sword, any material and any size
This can be good defense against any incoming enemy
You control the swords so you can do anything with them
weaknesses: May be hard to control for some people
You have to be familiar with any type of swords that how it used in battle
Can blocked by other powers and weapons

name: Weaponised Arms
description:
Having the power weaponised arms will allow you to morph you arms into any weapon you can think of. From swords, to spears, knives, daggers, etc to even projectile weapons from bows, crossbows to guns and heavy weaponry, it is all part of your arsenal.
With projectile weapons you will still need to load them with ammunition, your power does not produce this for you, but will morph a way for you to load the ammo.
summary: The ability to morph your arms into any weapon you can think of.
strengths: Can use any physical weapon you can possible think of, and morph your arms into them.
Can use projectile weapons.
Weapons work more efficiently, and effectively than if they were actual weapons.
weaknesses: When using projectile weapons you need to physically have possession of the ammo (bows you need the arrows etc.)
If you lose your arms, your power becomes useless.
If your weapons are dismembered from your body, then the same result happens to your arms, and you've lost them.

name: Video Game World
description: This power allows you to put yourself into any video game you're playing, at will. You can be any character you want, and if you die, you automatically reset the game from any previous point in the game of which you completed. You can pull any item, or anybody out of the game when you want to come out.
summary: The ability to put yourself into the video, and be any character you want.
strengths: Any item you want out of the game is yours.
Be in any game you want, even 8-bit game.
When you die, you reset from a previous point in the game that you already completed.
weaknesses: If the system gets shut off while you're in the game, you can't leave until it is turned back on.
You can still feel pain, but none of it will kill you for real.

name: Game Master
description: Basically, you can win every game and know every trick of the game. It doesn't mater if the game is a board game, a computer game, or anything else. You also know all cheat codes.
summary: The ability to play and win any game easily
strengths: Can win any game
Can con people into thinking you suck
Can win any game on your first try
weaknesses: People will get angry that they can't beat you
Can con people
Games can get boring

name: Arcana: 3 The Empress
description: With this ability you can create any living thing you can imagine out of your own psionic energy. These beings can look or act like anything, and are as intelligent as you want them to be. They look translucent and are the color of your psionic energy and will usually obey you. Mostly.. They are more or less temporary because they dematerialize once they run out of the psionic energy reserve you gave them upon creation. They can be made semi-permanent by periodically replenishing those reserves.
summary: The ability to create living beings out of psychic energy.
strengths: A zoo, pet store, and an army combined.
Anything from throat-ripping bunnies to dragons. Even intelligent life.
They MOSTLY obey you, but might disobey really stupid orders.
weaknesses: More or less temporary.
Can burn lots of psionic energy very fast.

name: Golems
description: A golem is an animated being created entirely from inanimate matter. This power allows you to create golems out of materials around you. For example, if you have a lot of metal around you, make some metal golems. The golems would be completely under your control, have metallic reshaping powers,and have the properties of the metal you chose. This power can be used with anything so you can have an army of superpowered creatures at anytime. Metal golems, wax golems, water golems, its all yours.
summary: The ability to create golems out of anything around you
strengths: Creating super powered creatures
Creating super powered creatures that obey your every command
weaknesses: Some things are best left unanimated

name: Weight Control
description: You can change the weight of anything you want, like make an apple weigh one million pounds or you can make an enemy so heavy that he/she can't move at all or make them so light that they are bouncy.
summary: The ability to control weight.
strengths: Have you ever struggled to carry the gallon of milk? Now, you can make it easier for yourself.
You can use that to train yourself by using pencils as weights.
weaknesses: It won't go back to the original weight until you change it back.
Requires serious concentration.

name: Living Plasma
description: A person with this ability can keep their humanoid shape, yet at the same time be made of plasma. You can fly, cannot be killed in a normal way, can launch yourself in the form of lightning or a hurling fireball of plasma-like energy. Though being made of plasma, you cannot shoot plasma blasts at people. You are able to zip through lines like electricity or even go through space.
summary: The ability to transform into hot plasma while keeping your human shape, and then back again
strengths: Flying
Different mortality rate (cannot die by lack of air, bullets, stabbing, heat etc. )
Able to burn, or shock things
weaknesses: Different mortality rate (can die by cooling, exposed to large bodies of water etc. )
Can be trapped by electromagnets, and stored by metals.
Burning or shocking whatever you touch by accident.

name: Reversed Electricity
description: This power can only be used on normal electrical currents. Normal electricity travels more easily through paths of least resistance and is stopped by insulating materials if the voltage is not powerful enough. Reversing it causes it to travel more easily through insulators and conductors with high resistivity, but they aren't protected from the ill effects of electrical breakdown and reversed electricity can be stopped by very good conductors. Oh, and you can actually damage the human body.
summary: The ability to make the electricity choose the path of most resistance.
strengths: Body fat, bone marrow and sometimes the skin are very vulnerable against this power.
You can make electricity easily arc through the air, even through vacuum.
You can make electricity travel through and burn/damage glass, rubber, paper,...
weaknesses: Unless you have great electrical knowledge, the effects may be unpredictable and backfire.
It can be difficult to affect unpredictable electrical surges, like those of electrokinetics.
It doesn't work on bioelectricity.

name: Deadly Copies
description: You are able to do just that- create a copy of any living person. The only difference between the copy and the actual person, is that the copy has deathly pale skin and blood red eyes. The copies can see in the dark perfectly, but are weakened by sunlight.
summary: The ability to create a copy of any living person.
strengths: You can create an army.
You can get someone else to do your dirty work.
weaknesses: The copies are weakened by sunlight.

name: Durability Drain
description: With this power, anything you touch will become more easily breakable the more you hold it. User can increases the rate of decrease of endurance but cannot turn his power off.  The durability of anything can be drained and if the durability is low enough, it will shatter due to external (or internal) force. Effects will go away after 5 hours if not in constant contact.
summary: The ability to decrease the durability of anything you touch at an accelerated rate
strengths: Smash any type of armor, even magic armors and barriers
Pseudo Super Strength
weaknesses: Still hurts your hand if you are touching anything sharp or punching something hard
Typing on your computer too long might cause it to break
Cannot deactivate power

name: Lateral Locomotion
description:
With this power you can move anything along a wall. You can move windows, doors, torches, murals, artworks, tapestries, murals, holes, and even people. Nothing attached to a wall is beyond this power. If you throw a spear and it is stuck to the wall you can move the spear too. Also you can rearrange the walls within a maze with this power by shifting the walls to other parts of the maze. 

Walls can be any size and through practice you can make this power work an any surface.
summary: The ability to move the position of objects along a surface
strengths: You can ride outside parts of the wall like an elevator or escalator
Move the location of a door to prevent people from following you
Find or make secret rooms by changing the door location
weaknesses: This power is only limited onto a wall or surface

name: Ultraviolet Light Absorption
description: The user is able to absorb ultraviolet energy given off by the sun. The user is then able to fire bolts or beams of ultraviolet energy from the ultraviolet light that has been absorbed. The ultraviolet light that has been absorbed must be released within 5 minutes or the ultraviolet energy that is stored in his or her body will start to destroy their body
summary: The ability to absorb ultraviolet light and fire bolts or beams of ultraviolet energy
strengths: Ultraviolet light is ever present due to the sun.
weaknesses: No power during the night
Will destroy the user's body if the energy is not released

name: The Alchemyst
description: Alchemy is a blend of science and magic. Alchemists knew secrets of the world hundreds, sometimes thousands of years before modern scienctists "discovered" them. Some secrets such as the atom and dna. Your knowledge of this magical science give you many great powers. You would be able to turn ordinay stones into priceless gems, and use different kinds of magical formulas. The power of alchemy is in your hands.
summary: The ability to have knowledge of alchemy
strengths: Knowing the secrets of magical science.
Hundreds of magical formulas at your disposal
weaknesses: A very strange ability
Just because you have the knowledge doesn't mean you understand it

name: Rapid Myological System
description: You grow more muscle and burn more calories within a week of exercising. Every muscle in your body improves with every kind of exercise you do. You also improve the hardness of your muscles. If any muscle in your body is torn, sliced or bruised,  it will automatically regenerate and heal within minutes or seconds (depending on the severity of the damage).
summary: The ability to generate muscle growth in a short time and repair torn attendance in seconds.
strengths: Your muscles are dramatically bigger from exercises you do within a week.
Your muscles are five times harder and well sculpted within a month.
Any damaged muscle within your body will repair itself as good as new (literally).
weaknesses: If the damage is severe, it will take a little longer to repair itself.
Depending how much protein you eat, you will be quite heavy.
If you fast too much, your muscles will shrink only slightly (not dramatically).

name: Speedwings
description: You will be some bright color on your wrists and ankles, and with them you can go faster than a bullet. You can do ordinary running with them, jump, or fly, and they can slice as short range-weapons. However, unless you can speed up your mindtime then you will have a lot of trouble reacting. Also, if you stop too quickly you might break something.
summary: The ability to fly with brightly colored wings on your wrists and ankles
strengths: You go really fast
You can fly
Wings double as weapons
weaknesses: Until you get used to it, you might have trouble controlling it
Unless you can speed up your mindtime, then it'll be as confusing to you as it is to your opponent
Stopping suddenly will hurt because of backlash

name: Empathy Energy Waves
description: If you are controlled in your emotions, like, say, a buddhist monk, you would probably be very deadly with this... unless you're a BUDDHIST monk! It all depends if you're very moody or not. If you can control your rage or happiness you can probably win the fight.
summary: The ability to create bursts of energy rays which vary on strength depending on your mood
strengths: Not that complicated to figure out
Pretty powerful once you got it done
If you play a song that makes you happy in your head it will help control it
weaknesses: Girl on their period beware!
If you are a  very moody person this will be probably be bad cuz you will kill everyone in the room

name: Vibranium Skeletal Structure
description: The user is able to protract and retract vibranium claws from the user's hand. Vibranium can penetrate any material on Earth, because vibranium is the strongest metal on Earth. It's also lighter than most metals. It can also absorb vibrations and kinetic energy, which strenghtens the metal while not hurting the user.
summary: The ability to protract and retract vibranium claws as well as having a vibranium skeletal structure
strengths: It can penetrate any material and makes the user's movement more silent.
It's not a mutagenic and not more susceptible to being irradiated with energy than other metals
Like Adamantium Beta, it doesn't inhibit the biological processes of bone.
weaknesses: Vibranium is metal, easily defeated by enemies with the power over magnetism
Can be destroyed, but is very hard

name: Brain Knowledge Absorption
description: Everything they could recall is now yours to access. Memories, knowledge, ideas, etc you can access all of it. This power works best on living brains and you must be given permission to absorb the brain.
summary: The ability to gain all of a person's knowledge and memories by absorbing their brain
strengths: You can quickly gain knowledge.
Eating also counts as absorption, so using this power and 'Brain Eater' is a good idea.
weaknesses: If something was erased magically or psychically, you won't gain it.
Must have permission from the person giving the brain (No Con Negation).

name: Complete Lockdown
description: When this power is used, every door, window and closable passages within a defined area will shut themselves. They will even lock themselves if possible. Moreover, they, as well as every wall, floor and ceiling, become indestructible and can't be dismantled. On the other hand, only the user can open and unlock chosen passages. The chosen area will unlock itself if you stop concentrating on it for 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to close and lock every means of passage within a chosen area.
strengths: Your headquarters/home will become an impenetrable fortress
Hold your enemies prisoners in an inescapable area.
Lock the doors behind you when you escape from an enemy.
weaknesses: Don't forget to maintain the lockdown or it will disappear after 5 minutes.
You can't close a passage that doesn't have a means to be shut.

name: Warp
description: Using your mind, you will be able to physically distort & twist objects or people. If using your power on a person, you will cause them agonizing pain when you warp them, but won't kill them. They will revert back to their original form when you're done. Everything will be like clay in your hands to mold.
summary: The ability to twist & distort an object or person
strengths: Be able to distort, shape, twist & mold everything
weaknesses: Cause people pain when warping them

name: Power Concentration
description: This ability implies that one can focus all of their bodily strength into one point (such as, a foot, hand, or head) into one monumental use, such as focusing the peak of one's strength into a single punch, or all of one's stamina into a burst of superhuman speed.
summary: The ability to focus the peak of one's strength into one monumental use.
strengths: Preform a super punch.
A burst of superhuman speed for quick get-a-ways.
Super jump over cities.
weaknesses: Only one monumental use.
Takes sometime before one can use this ability continually.
Using this ability at the wrong moment.

name: Adamantium Projectiles
description: With this power you can throw Adamantium projectiles from your hands. This projectiles have special properties that make them immune to air resistance, which allows them to get close to the Light Speed. One single projectile can cause massive destruction on anything, and they are made of the mythical metal called "Adamantium", which makes them nearly indestructible. The projectiles are really powerful, and you might kill yourself accidentally, so be careful!
summary: The ability to throw projectiles made of a powerful metal, which are immune to air resistance.
strengths: A powerful ability, can cause massive destruction and is nearly unstoppable.
Projectiles can get close to the Light Speed, since they are immune to air resistance.
Even if you attack someone invulnerable with this, this person will be thrown really far away.
weaknesses: People with Magnetic powers will be able to stop your attacks.
You might kill yourself while destroying everything with this.
Don't work really well in a close combat.

name: Iridium Skin
description: Iridium is the strongest, densest, lightest and most resistant metal known to man. By wielding this power the weilder posses superhuman strength, resiliency,muscular frame allowing him to jump to great heights and extreme distances. The wielders blood has also become a metal, mercury making him invulnerable to most human diseases.
summary: The ability to cover the wielder in a skin of iridium
strengths: Absorb most physical and long range attacks with little difficulty
Inhuman strength and muscular frame
Can repair wounds to his skin relatively quickly
weaknesses: The weilder is permanently stuck in the iridium form
Extremely weak at high and low temperatures, the mercury would freeze or evaporate
Terribly weak from mental attacks

name: Maxwell's Demon
description: A person with this power is able to create "heat differences" creating areas of hot and cold at will but slowly. This power also allows them to generate electricty using the thermoelectric effect. This power does not influence items to be hot or cold directly but actually causes barriers where only high energy or low energy atoms can pass through.
