In effect, this power can also theoretically shield you from energy attacks as well.
summary: The ability to separate molecules based on their vibrational energy thus creating areas with different temperatures
strengths: Can make areas of hot or cold
Generate electrictiy
Shield from energy based attacks
weaknesses: Needs to study physics to use this power properly
Can't control electricity directly only generate it
Power takes time to take effect

name: Temporal/ Spatial Strength
description: This ability gives the user strength that will depend on how far away they are from the time and space they were born in. If you are sent to another time or dimension, you will gain strength. In your time and space, there are two things that will give you a little bit more strength. One, a different time zone. And two, different places.
summary: The ability to gain strength through different parts of time and space.
strengths: Gain strength.
Good when you are travelling.
weaknesses: When you are in the place you are born, you are powerless.
You have to be outside city range to gain some strength.

name: One Upmanship
description: The person has the ability to "one-up" anyone. No matter what the ability is the "One-upman" is better. He can be defeated by someone without ego or who is selfless in their action. This ability can work with non meta-humans. Ex: 1)If you were around Einstein you would be more intelligent than him. 2) If you're playing a sport you would be the best on the team.
summary: The ability to one up anyone whom you are around.
strengths: Better than anyone else with superpower abilities or average people.
Able to defteat most forms of evil.
weaknesses: Once a person is defeated then the hero loses his "one-upmanship" ability.
Ability does not work on selfless people.
Comes across as being arrogant and a know it all.

name: Awoken Elements
description: With this rare, almost forgotten power, the user can summon the book that was named when the Earth was first created, Awoken Elements. The elements once were wild upon the Earth, tearing and crushing anything in the elements path. A unknown force ''Grabbed'' and sealed the wild elements into this almost almighty book, letting the Earth return to it's first form, small traces of the elements there. This book is filled with the raw power of the Elements, being able to link with whoever touches it
summary: The ability to summon the forgotten book of elements
strengths: The book is able to take more damage than a shield would be able to take.
The elements inside are able to be released upon the user's command, it appears to float on air.
At a high enough level, the user could totally release all the elements at once, masterful skill.
weaknesses: If one looses control over the book, the damage would be world-wide.
The book has a mind of it's own, being able to turn on those who it find unworthy.
Since the book is linked with the user, you would be easily torn apart if the book isn't controlled.

name: Off Panel Action
description: This power manifests in a mental blackout for the other person who will wonder about what you did. Very cheap if used with adequate prep time, such as sneaking in a tracking device or sneaking out items. This can only work for a maximum of 2 minutes. Any more and other people would be suspicious.
summary: The ability to do things that other people can't see
strengths: Very sneaky and you can pull off many things without anyone noticing
Best thief and spy
weaknesses: If other person figured out what you did, they might go after you
If the other person already knew what you were going to do, then they can stop it

name: Disease Manipulation
description: A person who has this ability can store any pathogen (disease-causing bacteria) inside themselves and release it at will. However, it is very difficult to single out a single disease, and the ability activates during stress.
summary: The ability to absorb, dispel, and manipulate illness
strengths: Extremely effective in fights
Could subdue an army
weaknesses: User usually winds up releasing a single conglomerate, deadly disease
Activates with stress unconsciously

name: Automotaun
description: Automotauns were originally robots made by Hephaestus, but you were chosen by Hephaestus to work in his favor. In order for you to do so, he made you his human creation. Different metals give you different abilities, such as silver letting you reflect heat, but you are so genetically enhanced by the gods the metals increase by twenty percent. Hephaestus made you super smart which makes you able to understand and work for him. Lastly, you don't even have to breath.
summary: The ability to change the human tissue into a metal of choice
strengths: Super smart
Special powers from all metals
Have no electrical impulses so there's no need to breath
weaknesses: Rust easily
If you turn into any red metal, beware of dogs
You serve Hephaestus

name: Philosophic Power
description: Your strict moral code--good,evil or chaotic--lets you control, create or destroy as long you follow it every minute of every day. Time, space, energy and matter are playthings to you. However, should you waver for just one second, willingly or not, you lose all power.
summary: The ability to do anything as long as you follow a strict moral code
strengths: You're the master of the material world (time/space, energy/matter)
weaknesses: It's tough being really good all the time
Chaotic people will have trouble balancing good and evil actions.
Power only recovered after a incredible act of some kind to restore one's sense of morales.

name: Affliction
description: Also called, Injury Inducing is the ability to inflict painful wounds upon foes by pure force of will. The user could only induce injuries that have already happened before to himself or to the subject they wish to affect (even wounds the user may still currently have); they could not induce sickness at all (and could not induce death unless the user has himself suffered death; this would be impossible, unless he is capable of Resurrection).
summary: The ability to induce wounds and injuries on foes
strengths: You can beat the crap out of people without touching them
You can always level the playing field (playin with a broken arm? If you do, so does he)
You don't have to still be injured to inflict the injuries
weaknesses: If you've never had a serious injury in your life, the power won't be strong
If your second ability you develop is Invulnerability, this power is useless
May subconsciously activate on ANYONE you get mad at (even loved ones)

name: Chaos Shift
description: The Chaos Shift is a complex ability that is part of the chaos line of abilities. First, looking at your victim, you stun them, making them unable to move. You then put both hands around their ears and scream loudly for about 12 seconds. As you scream, your victim's eyes bleed; meanwhile, you keep screaming louder and louder until your jaws start to separate. You continue to scream as your body falls to the ground. That body dies as you take control over your victim's body.
summary: The ability to take control of another person's body.
strengths: Takes control of victim's body.
Kills victim's soul.
weaknesses: You lose your body.
Very loud.
Hurts a lot.

name: Sui Generis Manipulation
description: A person who possesses this power has the ability to conjure an energy capable of totally annihilating everything under the definition of energy. Named after the Latin term "Sui Generis", the properties and behaviour of this energy are inexplicably one of a kind and is therefore unique to each person using this ability. The transformation and manipulation of the energy conjured lies only on the will of the conjurer.
summary: The ability to conjure an energy that can annihilate all other forms of energy.
strengths: Eliminate all other forms of energy ranging from sound to soul.
The conjured energy will always be unique from person to person like a finger print.
Only the conjurer has the ability to manipulate, transform, absorb, and utilize the energy.
weaknesses: This power requires a high level of concentration and stamina because the energy easily dissipates.
Requires extreme caution, kill anyone on contact -- includes the user of this ability.
Energy easily dissipates in nanoseconds because of all the energy in the universe.

name: Bow Of Heracles
description: With the Bow of Heracles, you are holding a weapon capable of mass destruction. Considered a divine weapon, it can hurt beings on the god level. Otherwise, it can also be used to rain destruction on enemies when firing multiple arrows. When the user decides to actually channel magic power into the bow, you can fire a single charged arrow (full day charge and only if you have that much power) that has the destructive capacity of a nuclear weapon.
summary: The ability to wield Heracles' bow
strengths: Can hurt gods and decimate an entire city
Can use any type of arrow as long as it can be pulled on it
Can fire multiple arrows
weaknesses: Must have super super strength to use
Must have ammo

name: Job Training
description: You gain powers related to the job you work at. Such as if you are a doctor you would gain healing powers while a engineer would gain powers to construct things mentally. The level of powers that you receive depends on how good your job is. A manager would gain better powers than an assistant. You can gain more than one power depending on your type of job. If you are fired than you lose your powers until you regain a job. You also have access to changing into your jobs uniform at any time.
summary: The ability to gain powers related to your job.
strengths: Makes your job easier to perform.
Can use your powers outside of work as well.
Could use powers to get promotions and then get greater powers.
weaknesses: If you are fired you lose your acquired powers.
You still have to do the work for the job.
If you have a bad job then you will not gain great powers.

name: Intonation Manipulation
description: The overview pretty much says it all. With this superpower you are the master of accents. You can put on any accent you choose and it's 100% authentic. French, Irish, Italian it's a piece of cake for you! However, you can only speak English with your chosen accent. The power doesn't work on other languages.
summary: The ability to master every single accent that exists
strengths: You can disguise yourself pretty well
Great for practical jokes
No one knows what nationality you're from
weaknesses: People might get annoyed if you constantly switch accents

name: Lumen Naturae
description: This power lets the wielder use the lumen naturae. This gives the wielder unrestricted access and use to all forms of nature from atoms and gravity to the classic four elements.
summary: The ability to create,control & use the lumen naturae,the light of nature
strengths: It grants the user the powers of nature
The usages of this power are very varied
It can be extremly usefull for breakthroughs in science
weaknesses: It is a very diverse power and has many responsibilities
The knowledge that comes from having this power may be too much of a burden for the user
The power of lumen naturae may have effects on the body

name: Society Improvement
description: At will, an event will cause the whole of human civilization to advance, such as a new advancement in technology, the slowing down of or end to world hunger, a peaceful and wise alien race visiting and sharing its knowledge for a time, a true uniting of nations and all the people of the world, etc. The person who has this ability is not affected by it, they must learn from other sources, such as people, books, and schools.
summary: The ability to cause the whole of society to advance intellectualy and morally.
strengths: Everyone becomes wiser, smarter, and friendlier to each other.
World peace may eventualy be achieved.
Is the counter to Society Degredation.
weaknesses: You become stupider (and possibly meaner) compared to the rest of the world.
You are not directly affected by it, you must learn to advance which is difficult.
They may advance so far you may never catch up to them, you could become an outcast.

name: Advanced Plagiarism
description: Yeah, once the user uses this ability, the targeted person (or any other living creature) can't use any of their strategies, skills, or techniques that the user has copied and upgraded for 5 min. This ability also gives the user minor psychic powers to read the person's mind to see strategies, skills, or techniques. If one of the victim's techiques has to do with their powers, the user can use that power only for that copied technique.
summary: The ability to use other's strategies, skills or techniques, but upgraded, while the original owner can't use them.
strengths: Copy another's strategies, skills or techniques and upgrade them
A person can't use them for 5 min.
Have minor psychic powers
weaknesses: The copied strategies, skills or techniques only last for 5 min.

name: Seduction
description: You can seduce anybody using this ability.  The cuties at the bar, the hottie next door, your teacher, your friend's mom, or even your friend's grandma (hey, I won't judge), it's all in the bag.
summary: The ability to seduce anybody.
strengths: So much action
weaknesses: So little time

name: Blade Boxing
description: Uses creation magic to make swords appear at user's extremities. Upon punching, a sigil appears in front of your fist, and out of it comes a sword. Said swords are usually stopped from going completely out of the sigil (usually the grip remains inside the sigil), but with expending x3 the usual power, one can launch the blades across medium distances. Attacks can vary, such as stabbing from a punch, or slashing from a round house kick.
summary: The ability to combining hand to hand combat with creation magic
strengths: Great increase in power
Any blades can be used (sword, spear, knife, etc)
Magical blades can be used
weaknesses: Relative short range
Without magical blades, can only be used on people (no destroying buildings)

name: Nerve Stimulation
description: Manipulate ones' own and others nervous system. Can be used to cause pain or pleasure in others while also elimination the feeling of pain from ones' self.
summary: The ability to manipulate one's own and others nervous system.
strengths: The ability to enhance pleasure can be as simple as enhancing the nerve reseptors on the tongue.
One can nullify anothers nerves so they do not transmit, immobilizing the other party.
There is no true defence agains it exept for the issue of range.
weaknesses: In most cases, the power can only effect others through touch. Skin to skin is not required.
Power is not viable against non-organic material.
Drugs that effect the nervous sytem can hamper the user's ability to control their power.

name: One Man Fusion
description: Fusion means to merge with someone, becoming one being. With this ability, you can add someone else's talents to your own. If someone is stronger or faster than you, add their talents to yours, and wipe them out!
summary: The ability to add someone else's talents to yours.
strengths: Add someone else's talents to your own
Wipe out the competition
weaknesses: You must know whose talents you are adding

name: White Hole
description: A white hole that cannot be entered from the outside, but can exude matter and light. One can use this for destructive purposes, creating a wormhole that releases matter and energy. The user is immune to its effects and can even create a warp tunnel to travel instantly to any location he or she wants.
summary: The ability to open up an ivory-colored wormhole.
strengths: Wormholes for destructive purposes
Worm hole to travel instantly to any location you want
Immune to its effects
weaknesses: None.

name: Clothing Manipulator
description: With this power you can change the sizes and designs of any article of clothing. You can make an enemy's shirt to tight so it chokes them or make your cloths be able to fit you forever. You can also change the designs of any article of clothing.
summary: The ability to change the sizes and designs of clothing
strengths: You can change the size and designs of any article of clothing
You can strangle your enemies with their own shirts
weaknesses: You can only control clothing not anything else

name: Card Blade Thrower
description: With this power when you throw cards they turn into blades until they hit the ground. You cannot turn them back into cards until they hit the ground. It can be any kind of card, playing cards, greeting cards, business cards, trading cards etc.
summary: The ability to turn cards into blades when you throw them
strengths: Whenever you throw cards they turn into super sharp blades
weaknesses: It happens whenever you throw a card
The blades can't turn back into cards until they hit the ground

name: Path Maker
description: Just like Moses created a passage through the Red Sea, whenever you want to create a path, anything that obstructs the way will move out of it. Stones will roll away, branches will bend to free the path, people or vehicles will move aside,... Anything that can be moved away will move. With some experience and a lot of energy, you could smash through unmovable objects, such as walls, trees or giant rocks, to clear a way through them. Movable things could even be violently thrown out of the way.
summary: The ability to create a path by having nearly everything move out of the way.
strengths: Create a safe path through which you can venture.
Everything will be prevented from obstructing the way until whoever who had to cross crossed.
With enough energy, you could cause serious damage when you want things out of the way.
weaknesses: Things can only be moved away, so holes which are uncovered won't be covered.

name: Compressure
description: A person with this power can control air pressure. They can affect a whole vicinity with pressurized air and shoot cannons of pressurized air. The normal effects of increased pressure does not affect the user. Other people will get headaches by the changes in pressure.
summary: The ability to control air pressure
strengths: Give enemies headaches by quickly changing the air pressure
Can create pressurized air cannons
Immune to changes in pressure
weaknesses: Tricky to use

name: Illusion Of Light
description: You can create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light. This illusion will cause others to think you are a being of good, and will induce hope into them. With practice, you can cause an illusion of warmth.
summary: The ability to create the illusion that your body is shining light
strengths: Create the illusion that your entire body is shining a bright, white, light
Induce hope into others
Takes practise to create an illusion of warmth
weaknesses: It's just an illusion

name: Sensejack
description: This power lets you tap into the sensory input of another person, allowing you to see, hear, taste, feel, and smell as they do. You can ride around in their head as a spy, receiving information unnoticed, but you can't control their senses or actions - you can only observe. Line of sight is needed to tap into a target, but duration is unlimited. Skilled telepaths can detect and evict a sensejacker from a host mind.
summary: The ability to perceive the world using the senses of others.
strengths: Real-time information flow.
Safe and anonymous observation from a distance.
On higher levels, you hear the person's thought what what they perceive
weaknesses: Might have to jump from person to person until you get the right position and perspective.
You can't use your own senses.
You're subject to the limitations of their senses (poor eyesight, hearing, etc.)

name: Pencil Of Freedom
description: Be free from any restraint! In court? Grab a pencil, use the power, and write down what comes to mind. Simply read it off, and you'll have teary eyes and heads nodding that it was necessary. Ram someone's new Porsche? Start scribbling! The Pencil of Freedom is incredibly powerful, and is used almost universally for evil. Can be resisted by people who can shield their mind with superpowers.
summary: The ability to write the world's best excuse for whatever situation you are in.
strengths: Never let it be your fault again.
Get out without blame.
Be truly free of all morality (unless you have a conscience. )
weaknesses: You're a liar.
There may still be consequences from your actions that can't be controlled.
Have to have a pencil nearby to use it, and you have to get that idea to them.

name: Sociological Aptitude
description: With this ability you understand not only all slang terms, but also sarcasm, tone, body language and context, which you can interpret flawlessly. With this power, you will never accidently offend someone and always know exactly how to speak in a way which will not be taken the wrong way. Also offers advanced insight into the human psyche and other sociolgical processes. Perfect for all with Asperger's Syndrome.
summary: The ability to have an innate understanding of society.
strengths: Perfect for those with Asperger's Syndrome.
Perfect for travelling.
Never accidently offend anyone again.
weaknesses: Not useful in combat.
Less useful with Telepathy, Humanity One! , etc.
Useless if you don't speak to relative strangers much.

name: Zygote Mimicry
description: Zygote Mimics have two abilities. The first one is mitosis, the ability to duplicate oneself. The second one is to change this power into any Cellular Mimicry power you want. Beware as the second ability is irreversible, so make sure you have at least one clone left with Zygote Mimicry. Search the site with the keywords "cellular series" to get the list of available powers you can get.
summary: The ability to be the omnipotent/totipotent, most powerful Cellular Mimic of all Cellular Mimics.
strengths: You can get any power in the Cellular Mimicry series.
You can clone yourself to outnumber a foe.
You can create an entire army of Cellular Mimics with various powers.
weaknesses: If you change this power, you can't have it back.
If you change this power before creating any clone, you've just ruined this power's full potential.
Some Cellular Mimicry powers are arguably more useless than others.

name: Negating Energy Beam
description: This power is really effective if you're a firefighter. It is the type of power to put out suns because it is heat and light together. This power can be used in battles, because what would be the point if you would be killed by some thug. It only has one weakness: you must be close to the source of energy to perform this power.
summary: The ability to shoot a ray of energy that eliminates any source of heat, light, or sound energy.
strengths: Good for battle.
Very powerful.
Effective against heat, light, or sound energy.
weaknesses: Must be close to the source of energy.

name: Get This Power Button
description: With this power, the Get This Power button on the Superpowerlist website is continuously and permanently active 24/7 for you and you alone. After you push the button, you will instantly and physically gain the power that the button appeared next to. It shall be permanently active and you can use this power to gain any powers that you have submitted to the superpowerlist website too.
summary: The ability to have the Get This Power button constantly active for you and you alone.
strengths: Gain any power on the Superpowerlist website you want.
Also works for your own submitted powers
weaknesses: Still have to train to improve your control over the powers
Can still only get one power per day, despite the button being active all day

name: Reflexive Super Strength
description: One with this ability gains superhuman strength from one's own physical pain (getting punched, stabbed, etc). The body of the user of this ability is more sensitive to pain than the average person. When the user's body's pain receptors react, it fuels their adrenaline and physical strength. The more one receives pain, the more strength the user gains.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength through one's own physical pain.
strengths: Gain super strength from an abundant source.
More sensitive to pain, means more strength.
weaknesses: No pain no gain.
You can still feel pain and with this ability one is more sensitive to it which can cause blackouts

name: Chaotikinesis
description: When you use this ability, you send out brainwaves that do two things. One, it causes everyone around to start panicing for no reason. And two, they create chaos around them. It could be anything, from a car crash to animals rampaging on the loose. This could be very powerful, even if you have no control of what sort of chaos it generates. You could even focus the chaos and panic into a certian target.
summary: The ability to mentally create chaos and panic.
strengths: You could create some chaos as a distraction.
You can focus your power on a certian target
weaknesses: You or someone else could get hurt in the chaos

name: Lycanthropy
description: Our word lycanthropy comes from an old story about a king who was turned into a wolf. The ability itself isn't so extreme. The user merely becomes a bipedal humanoid with a muzzle, fur coat, claws, and enhanced physical attributes. They are twice as strong, twice as fast, and their hearing and smell are 10 times as acute. Yeah. Merely.
summary: The ability to shape-shift into a wolf-like form
strengths: Scary
Lots of power
Great combat ability
weaknesses: Can be overwhelmed by intense smells
Activates under extreme duress
Can fall into bezerker rages

name: Reality Breaker
description: Breakers can control reality, though they must pay a price each time they do so (like give up your sight, or your left toenail); but each time you break reality, you have to give up a bigger price than the last one; they also have a certain type of intuition that allows them to sense reality, including the presence of others with superpowers and impending danger.
summary: The ability to break reality
strengths: You can bend and break reality however you want to
You can sense danger in others, even when they are not human
Your mind is the key to breaking reality
weaknesses: You must pay a price for breaking reality
Each time you do so, the price only gets bigger
You must use it wisely or not at all; it could kill you if not careful

name: Celestial Flames
description: The flames will literally burn all evil from a person. All evil thoughts, habits, etc after being burned by these flames a person will have a clean mind and soul if not a clean body. You can only gain this power by mastering Golden Flames and by having a pure heart.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that burn evil
strengths: The flames won't hurt anyone physically.
You can make the world a better place.
weaknesses: Might feel a little mean to force people to become good.

name: Red Sun Rebirth
description: Ah, sunrise. The birth of the new day. But for you, the real beauty of it comes from the power you can harness from it! Upon witnessing sunrise, your body flows with energy that allows you to be virtually indestructible. Effects only last 1-3 hours, and it gives you a good reason to wake up early.
summary: The ability to manifest ultimate power during sunrise.
strengths: Gives you ultimat power and control over the elements.
Sure beats coffee.
weaknesses: You must be exposed to the sunrise's rays to activate it.
You also have to wait 1-3 minutes for it to work.

name: Myth Power: Zeus' Zenith
description: Zeus, in Greek myth, was god of the sky, weather, fate and kings; he himself was King of the Gods. As such, channeling him allows one to alter the very sky itself to pour forth its blessings or its wrath. One can call forth any aerial phenomena, from lovely rainbows and gentle rain to drought, flash floods, blizzards and thunderstorms. The user can even call forth fiery meteors, and wield lightning like a weapon. In addition, one can mentally perceive, communicate with and compel sovereigns.
summary: The ability to channel Zeus' command over the essence of the sky, weather, fate and sovereignty
strengths: Call forth the phenomena of the sky (control the clouds, the air, the atmosphere, etc. )
Perceive, communicate with and compel anyone with an authoritative status
Immunity to probability manipulation or perception (Unpredictability)
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft often dislike you
People with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Hades' Haunt often envy you
At the lower levels, may become afflicted with an overwhelming sex drive

name: Anamnesis Embezzlement
description: Ever had an embarrassing moment in front of your crush? Well, all you have to do is "accidentally" bump into (or just touch) him/her and immediately be able to "pick-and-choose" which memory you want to steal, being your embarrassing moment. Basically, through touch you can see the memories of the person you are touching, and then steal and erase the memory from the person. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to steal the memories of another by touch
strengths: You can view the memories of others without having to experience them yourself.
You can steal and "erase" a certain memory that you don't want the person to have.
It's awesome!
weaknesses: You have to be able to touch the person, or it won't work.
They have to have their mental barriers down in order for you to access their memories.
Once you "steal" the memory, the person will not remember the moment.

name: Reaper's Essence Absorption
description: With this power, you absorb the essence of whatever you kill. It could be anything related to the creature, such as enhanced physical attributes (sight, speed, etc. ), skills, and even superpowers. However, the version of the ability you acquire is only about 5% as strong as that which belonged to the original creature. You can compound it with more killings, but only up to 50%. You also gain any associated weaknesses. You keep the new abilities forever, unless something supernatural interferes.
summary: The ability to gain new abilities, properties, and powers for each creature you kill.
strengths: Can collect many powers
Powers can be used to compliment one another
You'll have an edge against anything you've faced before, which grows greater with each success
weaknesses: Each power will never be as powerful as the original
You must kill to gain powers
May not know what to do with all your powers (if you kill a lot)

name: Bursts Of Invincibility
description: A person with this power has invincibility but only in short burst at a time. For 5 seconds the person is invulnerable, unstoppable, and cannot be moved by anyone else. When invincible, any and all powers that target the user directly are negated. All weapons and bullets bounce off. The user becomes shiny when they are in an invincible state.
summary: The ability to be invincible for short bursts of 5 seconds
strengths: You are invulnerable during 5 seconds
You will be unstoppable and unmovable by anyone else for 5 seconds
Through training, the user can use this power at crucial moments
weaknesses: There is a 10 second period between bursts
You cannot extend invincibility to others but you can shield people
Can still be distracted during the 5 seconds

name: Weakness Mimicry
description: If you're fighting against Superman, you will grow Kryptonite armor and be able to shoot Kryptonite quills. If you're fighting Flash, you will be able to vibrate the ground under your feet to trip him up or at least make him lose traction. Fighting against Aquaman, you emit a drought-like heat that evaporates water quickly. All of these come from this one power, if it's for one specific weakness like Superman/Kryptonite or power-based weakness like Aquaman/No water to use.
summary: The ability to morph your body into your opponent's weakness, according to their abilities
strengths: There is a high chance that you could win every fight.
Multiple opponents means mutiple adaptions
Their weaknesses never hurt you.
weaknesses: If you're not facing that one person, you lose that adaptation.
If they have no weakness, which is highly unlikely, you will not be able to adapt.

name: Utopia
description: Once you activate this reality bending power, anything and everything that is harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired will disappear forever, such as: pollution, war, homicide & suicide, physical & psychological disabilities, inner & outer ugliness, illness & disease.
summary: The ability to rid the entire planet of all things harmful, dangerous, ugly, and undesired
strengths: No more harm, danger, ugliness, or anything undesirable
weaknesses: Too perfect?

name: Supersonic Soundwave
description: One rule to this power is, it can't be your soundwaves, it has to be the voice of someone else to be activated.
summary: The ability to ride soundwaves.
strengths: Travels fast
Even works for whispers
Can go through walls
weaknesses: Loud screech when riding
It can't be your voice you ride
It may get caught in tornadoes

name: Summoning: Elemental
description: You have the power to summon Elementals, beings of immense power. They serve you until you dismiss them back to their own plane. You are able to summon Elementals of Air, Earth, Fire, Water, Darkness, Light, and the minor Elementals such as Sand, Metal, and Lightning.
summary: The ability to summon elementals.
strengths: Beings that defend and attack for you.
weaknesses: Will attack you if you can't control them.

name: Redrum
description: If you say anyone's name, he or she will die. If you say anyone's name backwards, they will come back to life. You can only use this power on people you have already met personally. If more than one person has the name you're saying, it will kill the person you met last.
summary: The ability to kill people by saying their name and raise them from the dead by saying their name backwards.
strengths: Kill your enemies
Resurrect your friends
weaknesses: You can't say anyone's name unless you want to kill them

name: Personality Phrases
description: You can change one's personality. For example, you can give somebody "Heart of an eagle". This is life-changing.
summary: The ability to change one's personality with phrases
strengths: Change personality with phrases
Improve one's life
weaknesses: Saying a phrase into the mirror will backfire it upon yourself. (good or bad? )

Summon massive monsters from sparkling lakes and rivers.
weaknesses: Some reflective surfaces may be too small for travel.
Some locations may not have any reflective surfaces.

name: Powerful Lungs
description: This ability allows you to take in large amounts of air at a time. Once you have filled your lungs, you can use it to either hold your breath for a long period of time, exhale it into a powerful gale of wind, or use it to scream in a high-pitched voice. Your massive lungs, however, also take in smoke or anything dangerous in the air more easily.
summary: The ability to take in large amounts of air at a time
strengths: Destroy basically anything and everything in your pathway if you exhale with maximum force
You can hold your breath for approximately 1 to 2 hours (depending on how expanded your lungs are)
Hold gallons of air at a time inside of your lungs
weaknesses: Take in smoke, pollution, and diseases more easily
Can be extremely dangerous to exhale at full-force
May trigger without noticing from taking deep-breaths

name: Soul Successor
description: A person who has this power will never truly die. When someone kills the user, their essence/soul/being is instantly transfered to a successor. They can't fully control the succesor but will always be behind the person and can talk to him/her. While they are in another body, they can add the other person's physical strength, knowledge and memories to their own and they can manifest themselves for a time if that person agrees to do so. The user can be trapped by abilities that target souls.
summary: The ability to live on in others
strengths: You can never be fully killed but you will never be able to act independently again
You can keep on living to fulfill a grudge then give others guidance
You can give others more strength that was gained through training and your original powers
weaknesses: You cannot keep powers that are specific to your successor-but knowledge like magic is kept
You must choose a successor before you die or you will be placed in a random person
You have to stay forever as a spirit of guidance

name: Killing Intent Manipulation
description: At the lower levels of power, this power can only control whether or not a person strongly or weakly desires another being's death. At the higher levelsof power, this power can affect the physical world using nothing more than the user's killing intent. However they cannot create with this power, they can only destroy. The killing intent can be used to 'punch,' 'kick,' 'slash,' etc. I repeat: The more powerful effects only work with the user's own killing intent.
summary: The ability to manipulate the desire to kill others
strengths: Cause mass havoc by making people want to kill each other (May be con if you abhor people killing).
Can affect the physical world wit nothing more than the desire to kill others.
Can control whether people want to kill. If that's not powerful, I don't know what is.
weaknesses: Takes years to reach highest levels of power.
You must have killing intent to use the higher levels of power.
Con Negation and similar powers do not affect this power.

name: Night Fury
description: You can turn into a 'Night Fury' dragon at will, a species from 'How to Train your Dragon'. You have vastly heightened senses, especially sight and hearing due to large eyes and bat-like ears. You have very powerful healing/regenerative abilities, and can breathe bright blue fire up to 3,000 degrees Celsius, which is hot enough to cause sublimation instead of melting.
summary: The ability to transform at will into a 'Night Fury' dragon
strengths: You are a very rare and powerful type of dragon, with unmatched aerial abilities and reflexes
Your abilities are natural, and so don't require practice to harness
weaknesses: You could change forms unintentionally when stressed, angered, scared, etc.
You only partially retain human thought and reasoning

name: Freeze Vision
description: The opposite of heat vision. Your eyes shoot cold beams of ice that freezes anything in your sight. You can even freeze the air & rapid blinking can shoot icicles. Deep freezing can cause an object to eventually crack & break. Though prolong single use without blinking or resting your eyes causes your vision to become blurry & dry.
summary: The ability to project beams of ice from your eyes
strengths: Freeze everything in your sight
Shoot icicles from your eyes
weaknesses: Keeping eyes open for a long time can cause dry eyes & blurry vision

name: Celtic Invocation: Addanc
description: By using this ability, the invoker may call up waves on any body of water. The waves are primarily used offensively, for mass destruction, but may also be used as a form of transport. The invoker may also cause any water surrounding them to spoil and become poisonous if drunken. Also, the invoker may summon little versions of Addanc from brackish water. These versions may spread poison to other water sources and also be used to spy on those near water.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Addanc, the Welsh god of destructive water.
strengths: Having a fight near a body of water.
Living on the beach, or lake, etc.
You may be able to breathe uder water at higher levels of power.
weaknesses: The invoker cannot use their powers to purify the water-only pollute.
You may be persecuted and blamed for tsunamis, tidal waves, freak rips, etc.
You minions may break out of your control and posion your friends and family.

name: Fear Induced Powers
description: This is pretty basic. If you are afraid of heights, you gain flight. Tight spaces: Shrinking. Fire: Cryokinesis. Etc. The twist is that they only work if you are actively experiencing fear. If you are falling you can't just think, "Oh, well. I'll just wait for my flight to kick in. " You have to think that your powers could give out at any moment. Even the slightest sense of comfort, happiness, or confidence will cause them to short out. Ultimately, this is only good for defense.
summary: The ability to gain helpful powers from fear
strengths: Always have an appropriate power to get you out of a jam
Kicks in automatically
Easy to operate
weaknesses: Fear must be contsant and intense
Only good for defense
You can never have full confidence in your ability

name: Food Generation
description: This gives you the ability to make any food you want. This is not limited to condiments as well. You can produce any kind of food and you can end world hunger.
summary: The ability to create food and generate it from your hands
strengths: You can end world hunger
Never be hungry again
Never have to eat cafeteria food
weaknesses: You need plates and cups
Dirty hands

name: Will Breaking: Corrosive Will
description: Achieved only by those who have mastered the discipline of molding will, this ability enables a person to transmute not only their will but also the will of those around them into a viscous liquid-like phantom substance that corrodes logic and rationality, along with perception. Almost visible to the naked eye, this transparent and extremely poisonous substance is pure intangible will that weakens the victim's body and willpower, leaving them vulnerable to other will-breaking techniques.
summary: The ability to corrode logic, rationality, and perception through will.
strengths: Weakens the willpower of your victims.
Instantly kills organic targets.
Can be materialized around you.
weaknesses: Requires other will-breaking abilities in order to finish off strong-minded victims.

name: Enhancement
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached this power increasee all aspects of a power randomly up to 50%. This power can be turned into other enhancements, but loses any part that they don't have. If stolen, this power permanently affects the abiliyt it's attached to and this one is given to the thief. This can be attached to only one power at a time.
summary: The ability to enhance the all the attributes of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Enhances all attributes.
Can turn this into the other Enhancements.
Still have if stolen (kind of).
weaknesses: Loses any part another Enhancement doesn't have when changed.
Can only be enhanced up to 50%.
Only one power at a time and useless without another power.

name: Movie Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport to any real location that appears in a movie that you are watching. You can stay in the place as long as you want but to get back you'd either have to walk/use a vehicle or watch a movie that takes place where you live. This power does not work with home movies or TV shows.
summary: The ability to teleport to any location that appears in a movie that you are watching
strengths: You can teleport to any real location that appears in a movie that you are watching
weaknesses: It is sometimes hard to get back
You have to be watching a movie for this power to work
The location has to be in the movie

name: Witch Walk
description: Through the use of magical power, this ability allows you to walk on anything (water, air, walls, etc. ).
summary: The ability to use magic to walk on anything.
strengths: Get to places faster.
Escaping from enemies.
weaknesses: Doesn't apply to the hands.
Things (such as cracks in the wall or waves in the water) can make you lose balance and fall.

name: Wings Of The Crow
description: It is the ability to summon black wings on your back so you can fly and do anything exactly like a bird using your wings.
summary: The ability to summon black wings on your back to help you fly
strengths: The ability to fly
Being able to get away from the crowd
You can get to places very quickly
weaknesses: You would have feather on your back and it would need cleaning
People might be afraid of you when they see you
Birds will follow you as their leader

name: Shadow Grip
description: This power requires a certain amount of willpower, focus, and thoughts of inner evil.  Once achieved, you can summon 1-2 hands made of pure shadows to do your bidding and attack your enemies.   One back draw is that if you're not focused enough, these hands will turn on you.   Be warned also, as they can only last a limited time.
summary: The ability to summon a large hand of shadows to crush/pound your enemies.
strengths: Helps you lift heavy objects
Self-attacks enemies of all kind
Immune to fire, electric, or ice damage
weaknesses: If not focused right, they turn on you.
Has trouble defeating light
Can only be used for 20 minutes at a time, with a 10 minute recharge

name: Always Thinking
description: With this power you always have a good idea: it can be a way to defeat a villain or ultimate recipe for sponge cake. It's completely random but it's always good in some way or another.
summary: The ability to always have a good idea
strengths: Might come up with a great way to defeat your enemies
weaknesses: Will always be a good idea but might not be particularly useful at the moment

name: Blade Of The Elements
description: This ability allows you to summon an elemental blade that fuses with one's hand.  The user can summon a blade of fire, ice, wind, and diamond.
summary: The ability to summon an elemental blade that fuses with one's hand.
strengths: A strong weapon
It won't fall off
You can use it to fight anything
weaknesses: It is very dangerous
It's hard to use at first
People will fear you

name: Animal Trainer
description: Never fear animals again! This power works by projecting a 30 foot radius of energy that causes any animal to be loyal and friendly to you. Once within your radius, the effect on the animal is permanent. While you can't speak with your animals, you can communicate at a basic level by pointing and using hand gestures. With time and skill, they'll even serve and protect you. Just think of the possibilities! Eagles, lions, whales, and the ferocious three-toed sloth--you name it.
summary: The ability to cause any animal to be tame and loyal to you.
strengths: Never get mauled by an animal
Build an army of angry chimpanzees
Snakes, spiders, scorpions, rattlesnakes--they're all friendly towards you!
weaknesses: Restricted to animals only (doesn't work on pissed off humans)
You can't speak with the animals--just basic gestures

name: The Strange:Sounds Like Reality
description: Some people can sound like anything. And some people can BE anything. Put them together, stir, bake at 350 for an hour and you get this. Anyone with this power can become whatever they sound like at that moment. So, if you can make yourself sound like a firework, then you will become a living firework. Thankfully, this is a voluntary abiliy, so you don't change when you don't want to. Also, you'll be able to change back to normal at will, even if you become something that cannot speak.
summary: The ability to shapeshift using your voice
strengths: Can become whatever you want
You might be really good at controlling your voice
weaknesses: Must sound like what you want to be
Might suck at controlling your voice

name: Card Summoner
description: The ability to summon the image on any card and control it or gain its ability for a short time.
summary: The ability to the abilty to summon the image on any card
strengths: Having lots of different trading cards
You control near unstoppable creatures
You can use the powers of certain cards
weaknesses: You can only summon 12 card images at one time
You can not become any of the creatures
The creatures can only be out for a limited amount of time

name: K.O. Immunity
description: This ability works well in fights. Your opponents would have a hard time defeating you. You'll keep on coming back up with enough energy to stay up until you are knocked back down. This ability also increases one's stamina and endurance to a level that a cannonball won't normally kill you.
summary: The ability to be unable to be knocked out.
strengths: Good for fights, able to get energy when knocked out.
High stamina and endurance boost.
If you stay alive long enough and only get knocked down/out, it's harder to kill you later.
weaknesses: Works only for knocked down, can still be killed by bullets, etc.

name: Believifery
description: The user can manipulate anything that they believe in with their emotions, but no major religions like Christianity. If a Christian had this power, then we going to need God's blessings. It has to be mundane like science, a concept like Life or Death, or semi-religious like the belief in spirits. Eventually, the ability can evolve in order to allow the user to use use this ability without the need for emotions.
summary: The ability to control anything that you believe in through your emotions.
strengths: Control what you believe
What you believe will dictate your power.
Eventually use this ability without emotions, but it will take certain conditions for user to uphold
weaknesses: Apathy will turn off powers
Negative emotion have negative results
What you believe will dictate your power.

name: Dragon Egg
description: You find an egg that looks nothing like any egg you've ever seen, so you decide to break it open and see what's inside. Sparkles start to surround your body as you absorb the power within. You now have the powers of a dragon, which include but is not limited to shape shifting, elemental breath (fire, ice, lightning, etc. ), flight, super strength, above average speed and reflexes, razor sharp claws, enhanced senses, prehensile forked tongue, and magical scales.
summary: The ability to gain all the abilities of a dragon
strengths: Lots of power found in such a puny egg.
You can breath four different elements of your choice.
Your scales allow you to block, use, or absorb magic from spells.
weaknesses: Your belly is your weakness. If it's hit, it's like getting kicked in the groin.
You can only choose four elements. (not ice, fire, earth, air, shadow, lighning) Only four.
Sickos trying to hunt you down thinking you're a big lizard.

name: Pocket Full Of Kryptonite
description: Everybody has a weakness, right? Even Superman, arguably one of the the most powerful heroes of all time, is vulnerable to Kryptonite. Well, with this power you have the the weakness of whoever you're fighting in your pocket, so you can use it against them
summary: The ability to have whatever your enemy's weakness is in your pocket
strengths: You have your enemy's weakness in your pocket
weaknesses: If you're enemy doesn't have a weakness this power is useless

name: Money Tree V5
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one hundred thousand dollars (or the equivalent of one hundred thousand American dollars depending on where you are) a day in fifty dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the unbreakable branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces even more money than Money Tree V4 allows you to produce
strengths: You can make a tree that produces up to 100,000 dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
Said branches are indestructible
weaknesses: You can only make one at a time
You can only have up to 100,000 dollars

name: Birth Right
description: Have control over your horoscope, horoscope animal, horoscope gems, etc. If you are Scorpio then you have power over scorpions, topaz, anger, you can turn into a giant scorpion, part morph, etc. Have power over your Zodiac symbols as well. If you were born in the year of the rabbit then you have power over rabbits, can morph into or partly into one, have incredible running an jumping powers, etc.
summary: The ability to have powers over your horoscope and Zodiac symbols
strengths: Cool abilities
Control over certain animals and gems
Control over certain feelings or things
weaknesses: Depends on when you were born

name: Emotion Infliction
description: By concentrating on your emotion, you will make the opponent feel the same way, driving them to madness, or other feelings. A great way to stop them from hurting you, or such. But you have to feel that way, and the emotion has to be true.
summary: The ability to make people feel how you feel
strengths: Can hinder your opponent from hurting you
Can help your friends if they're upset
weaknesses: It won't remove the way you feel
May lead to depression, anger or anxiety
Takes time to inflict emotion, because you have to concentrate

name: Seismic Scream
description: Also called a Seismic Voice, with this ability, no sound is produced, but the voice is instead converted back to raw, powerful vibration that cannot be resisted by Sonic Absorption or be canceled by the power Inaudibility (but can still produce the same, or worse, devastating effects).
summary: The ability to produce a "scream" composed of raw vibration
strengths: No loud sound is produced
All the power of a sonic scream (or more)
Can't be avoided by Induced Inaudibility, a soundproof barrier or Sonic Absorption
weaknesses: Still destroys property
May bounce off of echoing surfaces
Can instead be resisted by Kinetic Absorption, Vibration Channeling or the like

name: Chain
description: With this power, you have the ability to summon forth a chain made out of near-indestructible energy. The chain can be as long as you want it to be, and its movements can be mentally controlled. You can use the chain as a whip for offensive purposes and deflect incoming attacks. Or as a lasso, so you can grab stuff. You can make it disappear again by force of will.
summary: The ability to summon a chain from your hands
strengths: Swing from building to building like Spiderman
The chain is really strong
The chain can be used to mimic almost any weapon
weaknesses: The chain reacts a second after your mental commands

name: Black Memory Virus
description: When you read over a person's worst memories, you are able to summon them to the real world and follow and haunt your enemy wherever they are. Once the person becomes fully paranoid, you have the choice to lift it or leave it. If you choose to lift it, the target will still be paranoid, although if you choose to leave it the target will continue to grow worse until the virus wears off. It will take up to three weeks for it to wear off.
summary: The ability to read over a person's worst memories and be able to bring them back to the real world
strengths: It's good for getting revenge.
It is powerful.
It works most of the time.
weaknesses: Sometimes it can wear off a few hours after you summon the virus.
Targets who have amnesia or whose memories are faint are not affected.
Sometimes you can be overwhelmed with power.

name: Kiss Strength
description: With this power you gain superhuman strength and invulnerability for an hour after you kiss somebody. It doesn't matter who it is as long as he/she is a member of your species (if you are a shapeshifter it has to be of the species that you are at the time). You then have superhuman strength and invulnerability for sixty minutes after that time you lose the strength until you kiss somebody or are kissed again. The kiss can be anywhere on the face for it to work.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength and invulnerability after you kiss somebody
strengths: You can gain super strength
weaknesses: They have to be of your species
The kiss has to be somewhere on the face
You only have strength and invulnerability for an hour

name: Halokinesis
description: Halokinesis, also called Salinokinesis or Salt Manipulation is the ability to manipulate salt crystals. This includes moving it, moving substances containing it, forming it into crystalline constructs, changing it into various physical states, altering its presence in bodies (including within animals and plants) and the like. One could even whip it at foes with force enough to flay flesh, if enough is gathered.
summary: The ability to manipulate salt
strengths: Salt, and anything salty can now be used as a weapon
Purify and flavor foods (and fling salt into enemies' wounds)
Extract salt from various sources (including from living organisms, and out of wounds)
weaknesses: Eating too much salt can be unhealthy
Crystallokinesis, when developed, can overpower this ability

name: Reality Drawing:Temporal Blast
description: This ability's formal name is Temporal Blast. This ability will allow the user to have a powerful offense. This offense ability does have the price of taking away the speed of your time depending on how powerful it is. Once the force has disappeared, all time will return back the way it was before. This ability is the sister of the ability Reality Drawing: Spacial Block.
summary: The ability to absorb the reality of one's time to form an energy blast, but before released, it slows down time.
strengths: Will have a powerful defense.
Will be immune to the ability's time-slowing effect.
weaknesses: Absorbs speed in one's time.

name: Dust
description: You're able to turn your body into a living sandstorm, blinding enemies or attacking them with slashing dust, which can get so severe as to flay the flesh off your victims. However, in order to turn back into your normal self, you need to go back into the clothes you came out of.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a living sandstorm powerful enough to flay the flesh off your enemies
strengths: Leave your enemies with scars
Blind your enemies
weaknesses: Must get back into previous clothes

name: Forced Reversion
description: Sick of Perfect Immortality and other powers which change the body of the user? Then this is the perfect power for you - you can undo any change done by superpowers, even if they can't do so themselves. With practice, you can prevent such powers (e.g. Reality Warping) from working when around you. Needless to say, this power is best used as part of a team. If a foe is adaptive, he or she will have all adaptations stripped until they are re-adapted away from you.
summary: The ability to undo changes done by superpowers.
strengths: Excellent defense against Perfect Immortality
Great against a power mimic.
You can free people of changes done by another's powers.
weaknesses: This power can only be used in certain situations
Don't use this on an ally with Immortality who is hundreds of years old.
If you undo something beneficial, this power cannot restore it.

name: Absolute Zero Temperature
description: Bring an object to absolute zero temperature, which is 0 degrees Kelvin. The object isn't damaged by the rapid loss or gain of heat. While at absolute zero, not even the smallest parts of the object will be able to move, such as its electrons. Since the object will have no heat energy while at absolute zero, it will have no energy to move, and will remain unmovable while you keep it at absolute zero. The object won't absorb heat from objects around it because you are keeping it at the same temp.
summary: The ability to bring objects to and from absolute zero without damaging them.
strengths: Freeze foes.
Objects become immovable.
Objects are unbreakable and unchangeable while at absolute zero.
weaknesses: Objects will become stuck in space as the Earth moves away from them.
Do not use on yourself or you will become a statue in space.
Frozen objects will dig straight through a planet if the planet moves across where the object is.

name: Offense Shield
description: This power is kind of like invulnerability, but it works only one way. If you punch a wall, the wall gets damage, but not you. If you body slam someone, they recieve damage, but not you. You are not protected from kinetic damage directed toward you. If a car hits you, you receive damage. If someone punces you or you get hit by bullets, you receive that kinetic damage and get hurt. It only protects from the kinetic damage you attack with, not the kinetic damage coming towards you.
summary: The ability to be protected from the kinetic force you cause to other things. Read Description.
strengths: Be protected from damage your attacks cause.
Protection against any kinetic damage you direct towards other things.
You can finally punch the wall without getting hurt.
weaknesses: Does not protect you from kinetic force directed towards you.
If someone punches you of you get hit by a car, you recieve that kinetic damage.
Only useful if you attack.

name: Circadian Control
description: The user is able to change the flow of the day. The movement of time is still the same, but the Earth is just rotated rapidly. The user can change night into day and day into night.
summary: The ability to change the flow of the day, changing night to day or vice versa
strengths: Good against opponents who rely on the sun
Good against opponents who rely on the moon
weaknesses: A very hard power to master

name: Dark Fire
description: In return for becoming a guardian of the legendary dark fire lord, your blood is infused with the poison of the black phoenix. Control the shadows and create flame. Coat yourself in shadows to create a twenty second unbreakable shield. Mix the flame with the shadow to summon forth the mighty dragon ras'khan.
summary: The ability to control the ancient forces of fiery passion and darkest sin.
strengths: Create things out of shadow.
Ride on a dragon.
Become invincible.
weaknesses: The poison will eventually take over your body and turn you into a monster.
A slave for the dark fire lord until the poison takes over you.
A long scar must be etched into your arm for the poison to be injected by the phoenix.

name: Mathematical Intuition
description: With Mathematical Intuition you can solve anything from 3489x243+21 to a rubiks cube in seconds flat. This can also have amazing accuracy by applying geometry to the situation.
summary: The ability to instantly know the solution to any mathematical problem.
strengths: Can solve the most difficult puzzles quickly.
Be an amazing marksman
weaknesses: This power only applies to mathematics

name: Hermes' Helmet
description: The person who posses Hermes' Helmet will be able to run very fast, approximately the speed of lightning. The helmet will stay on the user as long as he or she wills it. If the user is knocked out, the helmet has a small chance to get dislodged from their head. Another person can't use this helmet unless the current user gives it to the other person for them to use
summary: The ability to run fast whenever the user wears Hermes's Helmet
strengths: Can run really fast
Can deliver a barrage of fast punches
Can be the first on the scene of the crime.
weaknesses: Has a chance to get dislodged from the user's head if they are knocked out
Might phase out of the physical realm if they run to fast

name: Unerring Aim
description: The person with this power has an unerring aim whenever they use a bow or arrow. People with this power do not make any mistakes when they fire an arrow from their bow. Not even a strong wind will veer it off its course
summary: The ability to have an unerring aim when the user has a bow and arrow
strengths: An arrow will always hit its target
You will never hurt a person you don't plan to hurt.
weaknesses: Only can be used on a bow and arrow

name: Wards
description: Energy wards are magical constructs set up by someone as a warning/defensive system. To create a ward you must first mentally visualize the area you place the ward in. Next you must focus your own magical energy into one marble sized energy ball. Then mentally move the ball in the shape of the ward you want. The ball will etch a energy trail behind it until you cease to direct it. How much energy you put into determines the strength of the ward.
summary: The ability to create magical energy wards
strengths: You can create magical energy wards of varying strengths
You can control the power level
The wards become invisible when you stop focusing on them and only you can see them with your mind
weaknesses: Forgetting to take down a high-power ward
Though you can't be affected by wards your friends can

name: Flow Disruption
description: Power naturally gathers in an area of the body, generally the heart. When using a power, some of that power flows from the gathering place to where it is needed. With this power, you can "disrupt" or block the flow. This in turn stops the use of powers on certain parts of the body for a shot period of time. This powers requires the target to be physically touched. This power does not stop energy needed to keep an area alive from getting to the area.
summary: The ability to disrupt the flow of power
strengths: Enemy can't use any power on part of their body for a short while.
Stops the power currently being used from getting more power.
The flow of power will slowly return to the affected area.
weaknesses: Have to touch the target.
The blockage only stops power for a short while.
Con Negation and similar powers do not work on this power, Power Safety etc. do

name: Human Interface
description: You are able to bring up your own interface, with it you can decide how long you want to sleep, exercise etc for example you can set your self to skip till after work entirely, you still hold the memories of work but didn't drag yourself through it. You just bring up the interface and set yourself to work for the whole day and your body takes over, you just skip ahead to when the task you have set is over.
summary: The ability to control what you do, when, where and how long for.
strengths: A days work over in a flash
The tiring hours at the gym over in seconds
Be able to study and remember perfectly, AND be your own alarm clock
weaknesses: Can throw you off as 8 hours can pass in seconds
You are brought out of your "sleep" to make any major decision
You might miss out on experiencing something great

name: Blackstars
description: When the power is used, you can take a stack of black shurikens and throw them at the opponent. Then, it all disappears. It will appear on the first object, enemy, wall, etc. straight in front of where you threw it. It will flash red and then explode. All this happens in one or two seconds, depending on the distance. You can throw a deadly multitude of shurikens at the foe, covering their entire body before throwing the last one into the head, causing the opponent to fall and explode.
summary: The ability to throw black ninja stars that explode on contact.
strengths: Could even make doors explode when in contact.
weaknesses: In water, the entire process slows down the speed, including the period of time.

name: Heart Of Light
description: The Heart of Light is a pendant radiating a mysterious aura, capable of resurrecting just about any/everyone. You can even resurrect yourself, heal someone who's sick or injured, and erase a person's evil curse.
summary: The ability to be instantly resurrected and erase person's evil influence.
strengths: It can also resurrect a hero.
weaknesses: None.

name: Super Followthrough
description: A person with this power can create a super-localized time stop which also removes the touched object from current timeline to increased their follow through without decreasing their force allowing them to make big impacts without Newton's third law being in the way--ie you use a small force but you apply it over a long time making a big impact. Naturally this can be used to send things flying with huge momentum.
summary: The ability to increase the impact of any object you throw
strengths: All you need is to be good at throwing and everything becomes a deadly weapon
Newton's third law does not get in they way--your applied force is small
Effects are only active in real time so no one knows that time was stopped
weaknesses: No superstrength---its all about the time

name: Serpentry
description: With this ability, you can transform into any serpent / snake at will. This includes Pythons, King Cobras, Anacondas, etc. You also gain all of their characteristics, including scales, venom, etcetera etcetera. You also have the ability to control them, and speak to them, giving them orders.
summary: The ability to transform into, and control any type of serpent.
strengths: You can shock people by turning into different types of snakes.
Even when you're not in snake form, you can control snakes.
weaknesses: It might not be a good idea to bring snakes around other people, just a thought.

name: Chirality Reflection
description: A chiral object is an object that is not equal to its mirror image. A person with this power has the ability to turn any object or part of an object into its mirror image. In addition this power can be used selectively to target only a single chirality center or point of difference. This power can work on a molecular level to synthesize compounds or prevent someone's body from working correctly.
summary: The ability to change any object into its mirror image based on a point of chirality
strengths: Give your enemies two left feet--to trip them up
Can make it easy to synthesize hard to make compounds
Can switch which arm someone hits you with or simply just make their body not function properly
weaknesses: Less useful, if the user is not skilled enough to affect molecules
Useless against something that is symmetrical

name: Incandescence
description:
The Incandescence ability has two facets: the ability to increase the body's rate of metabolism, leading to an increased body temperature and surge of physical stamina, and the ability to emit a glowing light through bioluminescent molecules in the skin, triggered by the aforementioned high levels of body heat.

This power is activated by stimulating the brain tissue which causes religious experiences.  This stimulation can be prompted by meditation, prayer, etc. Suits holy men or paladin types.
summary: The ability to increase body temperature and emit a bodily glowing light
strengths: Resistance to cold
Constant access to light, and a counter against darkness-based superpowers
Increased physical stamina and alertness
weaknesses: Increased use of calories, leading to more rapid exhaustion.
Lack of stealth while using ability.
Requires self-confidence and a state of calmness.

name: Money Multiplier
description: You can only use it 10 times a day on cold hard cash, if you want to double your money. Example: If you have 1 dollar, double it once to get $2, double again for $4 and again for $8.   It won't last more than 24 hours, so you need to spend immediately!
summary: The ability to double the amount of cash you have.
strengths: Double your money!
weaknesses: Only works on cash.
You can't save the money. You need to spend it within that day.

name: Trivia Finder
description: Having a hard time finding the words? Possessing the Trivia Finder ability allows you to instinctively tell when someone has something in common with you. Impress the people around you with your knowledge, and never worry about party lines again.
summary: The ability to tell what someone else has in common with you.
strengths: Helps you talk to members of the opposite sex.
Its much easier to find people with the same hobbies as you.
It makes it easier to make friends.
weaknesses: No real combat ability.
It only works if you both know the same thing.

name: Living Nightmares
description: Lets just say your enemy's worst nightmare is being kissed by his grandma in public...ha ha... you could make it happen! To use this power you need lots of concentration, enough to bring it to life.
summary: The ability to bring others nightmares to life.
strengths: It scares the enemy half to death.
weaknesses: It could attack you.

name: Creature Bonding
description: First you think of the animals, plants etc. Then, put your hand in a stop position and point it somewhere. That is the place the thing will go.
summary: The ability to merge two or more creatures together into one
strengths: No matter the distance between the animals you can merge them.
It doesn't matter if they aren't animals; they can be plants, fungi, bacteria, spirits & prehisoric
weaknesses: They always come out different when you merge the same animals
You can't take the animals back out after you join them
You can't bond non-living things.

name: Death Existence
description: A person with this ability has the power to remain in existence as long as there is death (or the absence of life) in the universe. When this ability is active the user's state of mind (meaning its condition, freedom and abilities) is safeguarded by the ever existing death. This ability also safeguards itself and other 'death-powered' abilities like necromancy, death manipulation, and other death dealing abilities ever created from being nullied, manipulated, or dampened.
summary: The ability to unconditionally exist as long as death exists.
strengths: Be the ultimate being of death.
This ability and other's that induce, or manipulate death are totally immune from nullifications etc
You, your mind and your soul will forever be free from destruction & manipulation.
weaknesses: You are not alive and somehow not dead.
Your pain and suffering will eternally haunt you.
In the end you will wish you were dead.

name: Geothermal Energy
description: Using this power you can attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it. Whether it be to power your house or use it in battle such as attracting the actual magma.
summary: The ability to attract geothermal energy within the Earth's core and use it.
strengths: Multiple uses, it can power your house.
You can summon magma from the Earth's core in battle.
The Earth's core does not 'open' just because you are attracting energy.
weaknesses: If you use the magma for more than an hour at a time it will become dangerous.
You have to use magma only twice a day. (though the energy is unlimited)

name: Blessing Of Hekate
description: Hekate is the Greek god of magic. Her blessing gives you the ability to use Greek magic. You can control magical fire amd turn people into animals. Also, you'd be able to use words and symbols from Ancient Greek for various effects. For example, saying the Greek word for "lift" might allow you to levitate things or people. Or if you draw the Greek symbol for "serve" on a rock it might transform into a rock creature bound to your will.
summary: The ability to have the blessing Of Hekate
strengths: You can use Greek magic
You're very powerful
You know Ancient Greek.
weaknesses: Using symbols and words in Greek might be tricky unless you practice.

name: Dream Consumption
description: Simply one with this ability mentally consumes the dreams of others, thus gaining strength and other heightened senses from doing so. Consuming nightmares does not affect one in anyway, one may even gain more strength from these nightmares. One can can also eat day dreams and you can't starve to death from not eating dreams that often.
summary: The ability to mentally consume dreams and gain strength and other heightened senses.
strengths: Gain power from eating dreams.
Certain dreams dont hurt you.
Nightmares or extremely good dreams give you even more power.
weaknesses: Must eat dreams to gain power.
Almost useless for combat, but nevertheless can be used in these situations

name: Monster Creation
description: The rules include: that the monsters do what you want them to do and they have to be inanimate objects to begin with.
summary: The ability to change objects into monsters with a random power
strengths: Getting rid of bullies
Doing things without getting blamed
Get what you want
weaknesses: No one gives you the credit you deserve
The creatures attack you when you are knocked out
Creatures disintegrate once defeated

name: Atom Construction
description: Creates atoms using particals from the atmosphere and the earth. If used correctly, the caster can create items out of it. However, forming and combining atoms takes time unless the ability is mastered.
summary: The ability to create atoms from particals in the earth's soil and in the atmosphere.
strengths: Good for a sheild
Good for an explosive if used correctly
Can be used as a source for items or an offense.
weaknesses: Takes a long time to master.
Can be very unstable.
If used incorrectly, it can kill the caster

name: Mood Stone Jewelry
description: With these "Moon and Star" themed artifacts, you can use almost any power depending on the color. If you're happy, you gain the ability to cause powerful euphoria to the saddest person alive. If you're excited, you get the power of electricity. If you're angry, you gain the power of fire. It all depends on your mood. There are thousands of moods. If you wear all three artifacts at the same time, you will glow the same color as the artifacts's mood stone, and your power multiplies by 900!
summary: The ability to wear a necklace, two bracelets and a ring which change the power they give depending on your mood.
strengths: Use almost any power.
Be all-powerful and well-rounded.
Have all 3 artifacts, and you can GO OVER 9000!!!!
weaknesses: Don't use drugs while you're wearing one of them.

name: Confessions
description: The user puts a person under there control for the rest of there life (no undoes). The user stares into the subjects eyes and readjusts his/her mind to follow and obey. People aren't sure how this is possible but it is sure it is a family trait.
summary: The ability to make any person fall under a hypnosis for the user to do whatever (like a slave)
strengths: This can make peace with people
Perfect lie detector
Makes criminals good
weaknesses: Slaves
People can die easier at a sound of a vocal box
Heroes can turn bad

name: Sleep Benefits
description: The duration of your rest corresponds to your power level; a cat nap is much less beneficial than a full-night's sleep. You could lift a maximum of a couple tons and survive a large explosion. As you spend time awake, your powers decrease until you have been awake longer than you have been asleep.
summary: The ability to gain superhuman strength and durability from sleeping
strengths: Various levels of superstrength and durability
Incentive and excuse to sleep more
weaknesses: Your powers will begin to lessen as you spend time awake
If you cannot obtain sleep you are powerless

name: Drug Touch
description: If you have heard of the name of a drug and its effects, you can cause a person to feel their effects by touching them, only when you have skin to skin contact. The drug will actually manifest in the subject's system. You can replicate recreational and medicinal drugs, and control the dosage created. The subject's body will burn through the drug at the normal rate, and you have to touch them again to remedicate.
summary: The ability to cause someone to feel the effects of any drug by touching them
strengths: You can treat the ill and needy by giving them expensive medicines for free
You could make a lot of money giving people the effects of recreational drugs
If in great danger, you could sedate an attacker, or give them a lethal overdose
weaknesses: Your power doesn't work on yourself
You need to research drugs and medicines to use your power to its full potential
Drugs you create still have their full side-effects

name: Canine Mimicry
