description: Canines are one of the dog family on Earth. A canine mimic has a power that allows the person to take on or duplicate on the natural abilities of canine species, such as superhuman senses, physical attributes of strength, speed and agility. They can also track down preys.
summary: The ability to take on characteristics and abilities of canines, such as wolves, coyotes, foxes and other species
strengths: Keen sense of smell, hearing, and eyesight
Extreme physical strength, speed and agility
Easily provoked and quick to anger
weaknesses: If you cannot smell
You are very sensitive to loud music and vibrations, etc.

name: Blessing Of Helios
description: The user is blessed by the Greek Sun Titan, Helios. After the user is blessed, he or she will be able to shoot bolts or beams of fire and command fire.
summary: The ability to be blessed by the greek God of Sun, Helios
strengths: A good offensive power
Can put out fires with the control over fire
weaknesses: Vulnerable to water

name: Sorcerium (Liquid Metal)
description: This metal is immune to magic and can be fully manipulated into any shape at higher levels. At lower levels it is only resistant to magic and can only be in the rough shape of weapons or armors. Note: the metal is NOT Mercury aka Quicksiler or Hydrargyrum.
summary: The ability to create and control a liquid metal that is immune to magic of any kind
strengths: Protect yourself from magic by covering youself with the metal.
weaknesses: People who can control magentism can take control of this metal.

name: Astral : Mantra Plane.
description: This power allows the user to access the Mantra Plane. If the user meditates in the Mantra Plane one can highten their senses and physical prowess to the zenith of human potential. It also powers up any other powers the user has. It also allows the user to gather mantra energy which powers up. It also allows the user to make contracts and summon the several beings living on the Mantra Plane.
summary: The ability to access the mantra plane
strengths: One can attack with a mantra energy which can be used in different ways out the body.
One can summon beings for help
One can train themself to the zenith of human potential
weaknesses: The beings can choose to break their contract if the user is either weak or evil
The mantra energy varies in power depending on the way it's used so it's not very reliable
The mantra energy could overload if not balanced

name: Half Dragon (Eastern)
description: Someone with this power has higher strength, speed, and magical power than ordinary humans. They can cause the weather to become rain, shapeshift, and fly without wings. They will also have claws and fangs.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-dragon
strengths: You have a more altrustic personality than western half-dragons.
You can always have rain when it is needed while growing food.
You are also far wiser than most beings most of the time.
weaknesses: Beware of using your rain power when the gods want a drought.
The 3rd pro also comes with the con of sometimes being more stupid than most beings.

name: Valuable Excrement
description: Instead of producing waste, you excrete valuables depending on the day of the week. Monday it's gold. Tuesday it's diamonds. Wednesday it's Silver. Thursday it's Emeralds. Friday it's Platinum. Saturday it's Rubies. Sunday it is random.
summary: The ability to you excrete valubles from your rear.
strengths: Eating more the richer you become
Fun suprise Sunday's
weaknesses: Possible damage to intestines or hind quarters.
Accidently flush toilet.
Need special toilet.

name: Robot Clone Army
description: Once every 24 hours you can summon a robot that looks exactly like you. Has skin, and human eyes and hair. But inside is a titanium skeleton and cybernetics. The robots run on solar power, or can be charged through an outlet. They obey all commands with out question. Think Terminator 2 but looks like you.
summary: The ability to summon robot's that look exactly like yourself.
strengths: Build an army of robots who will do as you command.
Nearly indestructable.
So many good looking robots =D
weaknesses: Vulnerable to emp
May get sick of looking at yourself.
You are the obvious culprit behind the army.

name: Transformation Mimicry
description: This ability can allow the user to get as strong as the person that transformed. Example, say the user was fighting Goku until Goku transforms into a Super Saiyan. The user can use this ability to transform into a Super Saiyan too. The user gets all the powers and perks that the transformation gives. This ability's effects wear off as soon as the opponent turns back to normal. If the user stays in a form too long, they will burn themselves out.
summary: The ability to mimic another person or thing's transformation.
strengths: Transform into what your opponent (or ally) transformed into.
Counter their new form
All of the perks, none of the weaknesses
weaknesses: Wears off when turned back to normal
Stay in a form too long, then you will burn yourself out.

name: Life Charges
description: You can use this to get any powers they had which were magical and thus bound to their soul you can also put the soul into another body or trade it to get another soul which you could resurrect but you need a empty body that is not too badly damaged you only keep their powers while you have their soul stored inside you and transmitting a soul into another body may cause a change their personality due the host bodies different brain chemistry and metal aptitude. Ability needs line of sight
summary: The ability to kill people to steal their life energy
strengths: Kill your foes by ripping out their souls
Gain your enemies magical powers
Resurrect your allies
weaknesses: Your friends may change in personality and intelligence
Power corrupts
People may sense a great evil from you

name: Dream Library
description: When you fall asleep, you have the choice of entering the library or not. If you choose not to, you will sleep like usual. If you choose to enter the library, then you will find yourself at the entrance of a huge building. You walk inside and see huge bookcases containing every book you ever read and every moment you ever lived. You have the ability to take down any book, and the library's appearance changes upon many aspects of you, such as your past experiences, dreams, etc.
summary: The ability to enter a library which possesses millions of different books
strengths: You only need to read a book once before it will show up at this library.
You don't need to read the whole book for it to appear, but only the parts you read will show up.
You can write books here, and it won't keep your body from resting.
weaknesses: You can only enter the library when you're asleep.
You must have either read part of the book, or lived the moment already.
Any other superpowers you have aren't effective in the library.

name: Soulstorm
description: An array of powers that allow the user to manipulate their soul into living energy. They may bend this energy to their will whether it be a concussive beam, a force field, energy weaponry,or unleashing a soul storm. Every attack tears at the victim's mental and emotional state, piercing the fabrics of their soul. Though powerful and difficult to receive, the power is extremely taxing on the user's mental focus and strength
summary: The ability to transform your soul into a lethal weapon
strengths: Power increases as focus increases
Limited only by imagination and willpower
Attacks can't be physically blocked
weaknesses: Taxing on the mental and emotional state
Can be corrupted or weakened by telekinetic attacks

name: Combining Robot Physiology
description: This power allows you separate and recombine like a combining robot. Your head, legs, arms, and torso are capable of separating, either all at once or individually, and becoming individual creatures capable of locomotion and under your control. They are organic, and are in all ways like normal living creatures except in that they combine to form you. You are aware of everything the see, hear, smell, feel, or taste.
summary: The ability to separate yourself into individual creatures and reform.
strengths: Send a body part to scout the an area, and seperate to get through places you're too big to.
Seperate to avoid attacks, surround the enemy, or stealthily change position.
Keep from bleeding to death by seperating from your injuerd limb.
weaknesses: The independant pieces of you can get hurt and die on their own, costing you limbs.
Make sure one body part brings your cloths with you.
They're freaky little critters.

name: Being A Clayfighter
description: Clayfighter is a series of video games from the official brand called Interplay is about a special meteorite that made the characters and particular things become versions of dough with super powers and related to what are features. This superpower allows its owner to become a wrestler typical dough about it with super powers related to the typical it. A detail not mentioned is that like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
summary: The ability to fight and being are like the characters in the video game series called ClayFighter
strengths: Like the human body could not be molded or mixed nor typical melted as you represent.
You have super powers real good about yourself
weaknesses: Can die as humans die

description:
If a person asks you to bestow them with wealth beyond measure. You can do so, or you could choose to give them poverty beyond measure. Playing with extreme wealth, or extreme poor. If the latter is given, all their assets are reduced to a net worth of zero, or go into a considerable debt.
This power can only be applied if the person asks you to bestow riches on them. You have the choice of wealth, or poverty, however once asked of you, you must make an immediate decision.
summary: The ability to bestow fortune or ill-fortune on others, only if they ask.
strengths: Decide on whether the person becomes wealthy or poor.
Hopefully this will get me top spot alphabetically on the list.
weaknesses: Power is only active when someone asks it of you.
You must make the decision when asked of you immediately, instinctively you won't become indecisive.
You won't be sure whether this person deserves ultimate riches or to suffer unbearably in complete poverty.

name: Politician's Answer
description: With this power you will always be able to come up with an answer that will satisfy whoever it was that asked the question. Disclaimer: You may be caught contradicting yourself.
summary: The ability to always be able to come up with an answer that will please whoever is asking the question.
strengths: You will always have a satisfactory answer.
weaknesses: There was a disclaimer and everything.

name: Card Stack Abilities: Jester
description: Your very existence creates ripples in existence which allow you to be unaffected by any reality manipulating powers as well as break the laws of physics by manipulating reality. You are the jack of all trades but master of none when concerning the powers of the Card Stack spirits. You can use all of their abilites but not to the same extent. As in a the king can always make himself move faster than you by speeding up his own time. You can also create or destroy rocks that can change reality.
summary: The ability to create ripples in existence.
strengths: Break the laws of physics with your will.
Completely unnafected by changes in the time stream, even if they would undo your birth.
Seer type ability users cannot detect you because of ripples in reality.
weaknesses: Takes a huge amount of power to use to any large extent
Only provides immunity to other Card Stack abilities if you are of an equal or higher level

name: Ability Immunity
description: Someone with this power would be completely normal, only they are immune to all superpower effects. Memory removers, illusionists, suggestionists, pain inflictors, psychics are all rendered useless when confronted with a possessor of this power. However, indirect assaults from powers do inflict damage, such as telekinetic knife attacks or teleporting a heavy weight to above your head.
summary: The ability to not be affected by any super power.
strengths: This, if combined with another power, would be the perfect superhero assassin ability.
Ability stealers can't take this (because of immunity), so the wielder of this ability is unique.
Superpowers don't seem so ominous now.
weaknesses: Positive powers have no effect either (such as telepathic relayal of information. )
Still have regular human weaknesses.
Not immune to indirect power effects.

name: Substitute Kryptonite
description: With this power, you can make any object anybody's kryptonite.   The target person will react the same way Superman reacts when he is exposed to kryptonite-all their powers will be gone and they will cringe in pain, prolonged exposure leads to death.  The effects only work on one person at a time, so if you are fighting a team, then tough luck.   This weakness however works on all clones and alternate reality versions of the same person.
summary: The ability to make any object someone's weakness
strengths: In a one-on-one fight, you always have the advantage
You can turn anything into a person's weakness, even people
weaknesses: Lead suits block weakness effects from afar
You can only target one person's weakness at a time
People will call you cheap

name: Injectiplode
description: This ability gives you the power to inject a portion of your own energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs with it. The force of the explosion is determined by how much energy you injected into the object.
summary: The ability to inject an energy into any object that causes the object to explode when a physical contact occurs
strengths: You can set up traps
You can inject your energy into any object and throw it at your enemies
weaknesses: If you make a physical contact with the object you injected your energy into, it will explode

name: The Promise
description: Allows you to make sure anybody's promise to you come true. Useful if someone promises money or anything valuable, but deadly if the promise is of death or defeat.
summary: The ability to make any promise held against you come true, or not.
strengths: You can instantly gain anything from promises.
You can finally get that promotion your boss promised you.
weaknesses: Sadly, you can't promise to yourself.
Death and injury is always a bad thing, right?

name: Iron Cloth
description: This technique can cut through almost anything depending on how much Ki you infused with it. You can also throw it depending on how much Ki you put in is how long it will last when not in contact.
summary: The ability to enforce the tensile strength and cutting edge of fabrics
strengths: Make cloth material as sword, whip, makeshift flails.
weaknesses: Using Ki tires you

name: Monetary Telekinesis
description: Tired of rummaging through your wallet for the exact amount of change because the cashier doesn't have it? Then your worries are over with Monetary Telekinesis! If you have the money, but can't seem to find it normally, then the money will be attracted to you like a magnet! Works on bills and coins!
summary: The ability to instantly have your money come to you in the exact amount needed
strengths: Makes it easier to buy things
Makes time at the counter less aggravating
Saves time!
weaknesses: If you have a large bill and no coins, all you can do is use that bill
This does not break up your money for you
If you lose the wallet, this power will not bring it back

name: Magic Snap
description: All you need to do to activate this power is snap your fingers. Suddenly, a random, silly event happens within your sight, from a random gong sounding, to jello raining from the sky. However, it is completely random, and if you don't know how to snap your fingers, you can't use this power.
summary: The ability to cause random events to happen by snapping your fingers.
strengths: Make comedic things happen by snapping your fingers.
Make people die laughing at the effects that will happen.
weaknesses: No REAL combat uses.
If you don't know how to snap your fingers.
It is completely random.

name: Spirit Animals
description: A mystical power to be able to change into an animal or conjure up spirit forms of the animals. This gives you many possibilities to change into almost any creature.
summary: The ability to change into different animals from touching them, and be able to summon up spirit animals.
strengths: Can change into different animals.
Can make ghost animals of different colors.
You gain some powers of the animals, like the strength or speed of something.
weaknesses: You get a bloodlust when you're a meat eater.

name: Planar Repulsion
description: This power, also called plane connection elimination, is the power to repulse the different planes of reality. This allows the user to release merged planes as well as force anything on another plane away by repulsing the plane it dwells in. This provides protection against interplanar attack. The users very presence causes a large separation between planes which can disrupt any portal between planes as well as insulate against any action in other planes of reality.
summary: The ability to prevent the planes of reality from connecting.
strengths: Protection against extra-planear entities and inter-planear attack.
Can undo the mergings of the different planes.
Can prevent portals that connect the planes.
weaknesses: Reality bending.
Things that exist on many planes.
If an extra-planar entity is already on your plane.

name: Future Trails
description: Focusing on a person or object will allow you to see a ghostly imprint of where they or it will be further along in their timeline. For example, focus on a dog and you will see not only that dog, but a trail of the dog shades showing where it will be and what it will be doing in the future.
summary: The ability to see where a person or object will go.
strengths: Easy way to keep tabs on people.
Save people who would be hurt in the future from their fate.
Know what someone will be doing in the future.
weaknesses: You must physically follow the trail of shades to see what happens in that person's timeline.
You can only focus on one person or object at a time.
You can only see the shade, with no other context other than what you can infer from their actions.

name: Video Eyes
description: With this power you can record anything you see into a video that you watch later all you have to do to watch it is stand in front of a TV or DVD player and think about the video's name for a while and it will eventually appear on the screen
summary: The ability to record videos with your eyes
strengths: Can take videos without a video camera
This camera's water proof
weaknesses: It might take a while for the video to appear on the TV
You have to remember the name to the video

name: Forced Time Travel
description: On a touch you can force someone into the future or past. The distance of the time travel depends on how skilled you are with the power and obviously it would be a terrible idea to send someone to the past. Cannot send self.
summary: The ability to punch people into next week.
strengths: Get someone out of your hair for a while.
Make someone miss their appointments.
Hide people in the future.
weaknesses: Cannot travel in time personally.

name: Premonitious Touch
description: You can look into the future, past or present. This happens usually at random, but also when you touch something, like if you touched an old gun from a war, you would suddenly see a scene with someone holding it.
summary: The ability to glance into the future, past or present at random, but it also occurs when you touch something.
strengths: See trouble.
Find people.
Unaffected by time freezing.
weaknesses: Hurts.
Don't know what you'll see.
Uncontrollable.

name: Orbital Pull
description: The wielder can force any object with solid matter to orbit around their being creating a near impenetrable armour and shield. They can also release the control of an object and direct into any direction with accuracy and destructive force
summary: The ability to have any object orbit your being
strengths: Can make any object orbit you to create a near impenetrable armour and shield
Can direct objects with accuracy and destructive force
Can attract any object into his orbital pull
weaknesses: Can only attract solid objects with physical matter
Is extremely vulnerable to mental and illusion attacks
After a maximum usage of 4 hours the wielder is drained of energy

name: Ultimate Weapon(Sword)
description: Everything has an origin-a time where it was created. This ultimate weapon made in the shape of a sword cuts anything at its origin. When you attempt to hit anything with the sword, instead of slicing your target into bits it will instead slice it at its origin. That means when you attack someone, they will be killed as a baby and will have never have existed in the first place. A paradox will occur and time shifts back and replays everything without the existence of what you destroyed.
summary: The ability to wield the ulitmate blade that cuts anything from its origin
strengths: It can effectively make anything to have never existed in the first place
When placed inside its sheath, it gives the wielder protection against time alterations
The sword will always exist, so it is possible to find the sword again
weaknesses: Erases everyone's memories and then restarts everything without the existence of what you destroyed
This means you only have one shot at using this power, also makes it pointless to name the blade
If you killed someone's father, then their offspring will also have never existed

name: Umbral Waves
description: 20 foot high shadow waves that absorb all light temporarily and renders all people in area to be "hollow" or soulless. While soulless, they lose all ability to think, move or react (beyond autonomic responses)
summary: The ability to make huge black waves that absorb light and temporarily render people soulless
strengths: Render all in area vulnerable
Massive affection area
Those affected can't think or react beyond autonomic responses
weaknesses: Should be accompanied by Night Vision, but that's not always the case

name: Liquid Shock Absorb
description: If your body senses imminent impact, Liquid Shock Absorb will turn your tissues into a gelatinous substance capable of absorbing or redirecting the force. Depending on what hits you, the vibrations may be enough to crack pavement or break bones. After being struck your cells relax and enter a liquid state which is more susceptible to damage and is more difficult to control. Because of this, successive hits may eventually cause damage, but it also allows for increased flexibility.
summary: The ability to resist impact force by temporarily becoming gelatinous
strengths: Ability activates automatically
Almost invulnerable
Increased flexibility and striking power
weaknesses: Succesive hits may cause damage to internal organs
Losing control of your body in liquid form

name: Reverse Pain Empath
description: One may cause others to expirience the pain they are currently feeling. If one inflicts the pain over more than one person, the intensity is diluted. Using this power does not cause the pain to go away. The pain inflicted will be in the same place on the original recipient. (On amputees will relocate to opposite side of the body)
summary: The ability to inflict the pain one is expiriencing onto another person.
strengths: Can harm and disable ememies.
Is untracable (no one can prove it was you. )
High pain tolerance.
weaknesses: Must be hurt to use power.
May cause one to become emo and/or sadistic.

name: Plagiarizer
description: With this ability, you have the ability to tamper with history and rewrite people's lives in order to incorporate you into them. With this ability, you could become the President of the United States by slowly changing the past. You could convince someone that they were madly in love with you for as long as they could remember. You could erase someone from history by denying their birth from the records.
summary: The ability to change history in any way you want in order to change your life.
strengths: Become whatever you always wanted to be.
Get to extremely high places in government in mere minutes.
Do anything you want without fearing the consequences, because you can rewrite the past.
weaknesses: If you change too much in a short period of time, people notice.
If people found out, they could be mad and go into a frenzy
You are still mortal and, as such, you can die before you can rewrite an event to stop your death.

name: Mind Printer
description: With this power you can print out any image that you see in your mind. All you have to do is blink twice and say "Print. " The image will then be printed out on the nearest printer. You can't change which printer the image prints on it will always be the printer closest to you.
summary: The ability to send images that you see in your mind to the nearest printer
strengths: You can print out any image that you see in your mind
weaknesses: You can't control where it prints

name: Follow Me
description: With this power you can make a person follow you. The person will not be able to deviate from the path you take and will enter any building and follow any vehicle that you enter. They will also not be able to do anything else except for follow you. This could be useful to make your enemies follow you to prison or something. You can make the person stop following you whenever you want.
summary: The ability to cause a person to follow you
strengths: You can cause a person to follow you
weaknesses: This power does not work on robots

name: Gods Of Myths
description: This is where Persona comes from. With this ability, you can summon a god or demon from myths, legends, and religion. You will start off at a low level, allowing you to summon a weak Pixie, but as you become more experienced, you can summon or create Thor!
summary: The ability to summon and create the mythological gods.
strengths: Summon Thor, Norse God of Thunder!!!
Summon Cerberus, hound of the underworld!
Create Izanagi, Shinto God of creation!!!
weaknesses: Beelzebub!!
Lilith!!!
Lucifer!!!

name: The Panontic Arch
description: The Panontic Arch, an indestructible electro-mechanical device of unknown age and origin that, when set to a correct setting, will grant powers if you stand inside it. The two powers are based on what dimension the Arch was set to. Powers last 24 hours and any person can use the Arch three times a day. The Arch comes with an indestructible book made of metal, showing the symbols for each setting and name of the dimension. The language in the book will change so as to be readable by anyone.
summary: The ability to use a techno-mystical machine to gain powers.
strengths: Six selectable powers that last a day.
weaknesses: The Arch can be stolen, teleported or hidden by a foe.

name: Energy Immunity
description: Any power or attack that uses, controls, steals, and/or removes pure energy of any kind will not affect someone with this power.
summary: The ability to immune to any energy-based power or attack
strengths: You're immune to a large number of attacks and powers.
You can still utilize almost all of your energy-based powers.
Con: Powers that affect mass but not energy will still affect you.
weaknesses: Bullets, knives, and fists can still hurt you.
Allies cannot lend you their raw power.
You won't gain energy from your own energy-draining powers.

name: Related Injury Power Mimicry
description: You gain some (3 max) powers related to how you are injured, so if you are hit with a flame, you probably will be able to create and control fire.
summary: The ability to get powers related to a way you are injured.
strengths: Get powers when hurt.
weaknesses: It is related to how you are injured.
If you have invulnerability powers.
Anti Power Mimicry

name: Vicarious Replication
description: A virus reproduces itself by using existing cells. So too does a Vicarious Replicator. By touching and holding another person, they can cause that person to become a perfectly indistinguishable duplicate of the user, down to their memories. However, the change can be resisted by those with a particularily strong will and only the user can replicate himself. Finally, when the user dies or loses the ability, all the duplicate people are restored to the state they were changed from.
summary: The ability to duplicate yourself using other people's bodies
strengths: Nearly limitless source of material
Take over your foes before they can do you harm
Duplicates look like you, think like you, and know what you know
weaknesses: Change can be resisted by a strong will
Only user can replicate themself, not duplicates
When user dies/loses ability, duplicates return to normal

name: Living Blood
description: Someone who holds this power has a lifeforce that is different. Their lifeforce will give their blood its own life, its own emanations of power and bring their blood to life upon leaving their body. The blood will take on the form of a random organism and will generally listen to the requests of the one it came from, because it recieved its life and power from them.
summary: The ability to have blood that can move around on its own
strengths: Possibility of a hard-to-kill servant.
Any blood you spill is your enemy's nightmare.
This and the power Endless Blood.
weaknesses: Make sure your wounds are cleaned.
The blood organisms may not listen to you.
The blood organisms might be living, but they don't have souls (May be pro).

name: Self Cleaning Wounds
description: Many people have died because of wound infection. With this ability, all of your wounds you recieve will clean themselves. No need to reach for that painful rubbing alcohol to clean the wound. If you concentrate a little, small pieces of glass or spinters hurting your skin will escape the wound. If you super concentrate, you can get rid of bullets, pins, and cactus thorns in the wound. Never worry about wound infection again. Does not make you heal any faster.
summary: The ability to have your wounds clean itself. Read description.
strengths: Have wounds clean themselves. No more painful rubbing alcohol!
Get rid of splinters and small pieces of glass or splinters in your skin.
Get rid of pins, cactus thorns, and bullets from your skin.
weaknesses: Does not make you heal any faster.
Takes some concentration to get rid of glass pieces and spinters from your wounds.
Takes an extreme amount of concentration to get rid of pins, cactus thorns, and bullets from wounds.

name: Substance: Trait Negation
description: With this power, you can permanently negate the properties or traits of a chemical element, combination or substance in the near vicinity. For example: Lead is a very dense element. If you have a strip of it in your vicinity, you could negate that trait to make it as dense as a sponge. Chlorine trifluoride is a highly flammable compound, but with this power you could make it incombustible, so it's not flammable anymore. The effects are permanent, so you only need to concentrate for a few seconds
summary: The ability to negate the traits or properties of a particular substance, chemical, etc.
strengths: Negate the properties of a substace until they no longer have the trait at all.
Change is permanent, no need to concentrate.
You can directly target chemical in the area, or a large burst within the vicintiy of 100 metres.
weaknesses: Change is permanent, that might not be so good.
You can only negate the porperties that the substance already has.
With large bursts, you could make technology important to everyone useless

name: Body Switching
description: Using this power, you have to look into the eyes of a person, then your mind will switch with their's. You will have their body & vice versa. You will gain all of their super abilities if they have any, but not their skills & knwoledge that they learned. This only lasts for a day till the spell wears off.
summary: The ability to swap your mind & personality into another person's body
strengths: Swap bodies with another person
Gain their super powers
weaknesses: Have to look into their eyes for the power to work
You don't get any of their learned skills or personal knowledge
Only lasts for a day

name: Mirror Cracking Ugly
description: Mirrors will just break whenever you smile at your reflection. It works no matter how ugly you really are. However, you need to see your own reflection and it only works on mirrors you can see yourself reflected in.
summary: The ability to fracture mirrors when you smile at them.
strengths: You must see yourself in the mirror, but others don't have to see you in the mirror.
Make people believe THEY made the mirror crack by being careful with angles.
weaknesses: You will be given 7 years of bad luck for each mirror you crack.
You will only be able to see how you look when you smile for a split second.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Memory Chip
description: With this power you can download anything to your memory. Everything goes: movies, video games, TV shows or enemy plans that someone stupidly put on the internet. But you must be able to access it on a regular computer (so no DoD memos) and the speed is the same as the highest download speed you've ever achieved on your OWN computer. Can also transfer the chip's contents back onto a computer.
summary: The ability to download things onto your memory
strengths: Can download anything from the Internet onto your memory chip
weaknesses: Sometime your memory can get cluttered
Using this power too much can cause your memory & memory chip to crash, leaving both blank
Limited to regular stuff and (possibly) limited bandwith

name: Metazoa Forming
description: You can create any animal-based life form. You can create wildlife based on present day animals, animals from the past, and animals from fiction stories.
summary: The ability to create animal life
strengths: Can create any type of animal-based ecosystem
weaknesses: Can cause catastrophic effects if the past, present, and fiction meet.

name: Cryo Webs
description: You have the granted ability to produce your own silk webbing from glands within your forearms, which will instantly freeze your opponents solid. It can be formed into any object of your choosing, but apparently you can simply direct the waves of coldness that you project in certain ways so as to create ice in the shape you may desire.
summary: The ability to fire webs that instantly freezes the opponent.
strengths: You could even protect yourself by being encased in a Organic-Ice web armor.
weaknesses: It can last for up to 102 hours.
The icewebs can be dissolved by acid, fire, or salt.

name: Dhampirism
description: A dhampir is normally a half-human half vampire crossbreed. With this power you have the powers of a vampire, but due to having half human blood, you don't have their traditional weaknesses. In other words, you have a really, really long lifespan, faster healing,  hypnotism, etc. Anything a vampire can do, you can do. Crosses, garlic, holy water, etc all affect you as much as they do a normal human being.
summary: The ability to the powers of vampires without the usual weaknesses
strengths: Powers of a vampire.
No vampiric weaknesses.
weaknesses: Can still be killed or die of old age.
Will often be mistaken for a vampire.

name: N(Sqrt) 1
description: With this ability, you can turn anything that is real imaginary. You can turn people imaginary, but they never die in this form. Nothing in the physical world or the spiritual world can affect the imaginary world. Nothing imaginary affects the real world. You can't see your foes if they become imaginary. Besdies reversing the effects, you can also turn something that's imaginary from the start, real.
summary: The ability to make anything real turn imaginary and vice versa
strengths: You can turn real things imaginary.
You can turn foes imaginary.
You can turn yourself imaginary.
weaknesses: This power can not turn imaginary things real.

name: Animal Attraction
description: Someone with this power is treated as a friend by all nonhuman animals and will never be harmed by them. You cannot have both this and Animal Intimidation at the same time (this part cannot be removed by any power).
summary: The ability to have animals be so attracted to one that they treat one with reverence
strengths: Always have friends no matter where you go.
Someone chasing you? Not anymore! Run into a bear's den and the bear will guard you with its life.
If you're an animal lover.
weaknesses: Animals might decide to snuggle up to you when you don't want them to.
If you hate animals.

name: Hunger And Rest
description: A person with this power can summon two guardian spirits, one with the aspect of Hunger and the other of Rest. One is Male and the other Female, but this is different for each user. Each spirit takes on either an Angelic or Demonic form, that also changes their personalities, depending on how you command the spirits. Hunger has command over the physical body, starving it or feeding it, while Rest has command over the mental body, giving a sound mind, or driving it to insanity.
summary: The ability to summon the spirits of Hunger and Rest.
strengths: Have two spirits that can protect you.
Angelic forms serve to make you and your allies stronger.
Demonic forms serve to make your foes weaker.
weaknesses: Their personalities change to mirror how you command them.
You don't control their powers directly, have to give them orders.
If the spirits become at odds with each other (one Angelic, other Demonic)

name: Pain Powered
description: With this power you become a sadist. You feed off of others pain and agony, just to gain strength. But with that strength you become more durable, faster reflexes, smarter, super strong, and super fast. With enough torment surrounding you, might even be able to use other powers of anyone who stands in your way. Involuntary
summary: The ability to gain strength from other's suffering
strengths: Smarter, better, faster, stronger. (Eat your heart out Kanye)
Gain strength from anyone's pain, that includes your enemies
Involuntary; no matter who suffers you will gain power
weaknesses: Sadistic
Might be seen as evil
Enough pain and suffering could kill a victim

name: Tv Dimensional Travel
description: This ability allows you to go into a TV and be in a TV show. When you go into the TV world, you can do what ever you want in there... anything. You can bring things into that world, and take things out, from small things to people. You can even put things from other shows and put them into other shows, but make sure you bring them back otherwise you can't get out. You can't go in reality shows because you would screw up time itself. You can't travel into games, computers, or ipods. Just TV's.
summary: The ability to travel through TV universes
strengths: Be like a god in any TV show
Control the things you bring from TV
Get out of jailby through a TV
weaknesses: You can only travel through TVs
You can't go into reality TV shows
You will take up time when in TV worlds

name: Photograph Resurrection
description: It was once believed that, when you take a picture of someone, the camera takes that person's soul. Photograph Resurrection allows you to bring old loved ones back to life in a non-corpsy form. All you need is a picture of them and their dead body. Simply wave the photo over their heart (which must be INSIDE the body) and snap. They will be back to life at the age the picture was taken. They can still die again and they will dissappear from the photo, so have lots of photos of them XD
summary: The ability to bring a person back to life in their (non-corpsy) body by using a photograph of them
strengths: Bring people back to life
They won't be corpsy
They come back the age they were in the picture
weaknesses: They can die again
You need a picture of them as well as their body WITH a heart inside
The photo can only be used once, since they will disappear from the photo

name: Author's Power Channeling
description: Do you possess a lot of powers you made, only to get them negated, stolen, etc? If so this will be very useful to you. In such a situation, you can channel the power from someone who possesses that particular power. They cannot stop this with any power, although they are not harmed in any way. However, it does not work on those mimicking the power. Unfortunately, powers such as Con Negation do not affect this power. If you lose this power, you lose all protections.
summary: The ability to channel the powers you made.
strengths: Keep the powers you made.
The more popular the power, the harder it is to permanently negate it.
No limit to range, no defense and the target is not harmed.
weaknesses: Only works with powers you made.
Mimics do not help in any way -the target must have acquired the power in the normal way.
Does not provide immunity to counters (e. G. Telepathy vs Anti Telepathy)

name: Soul Marker
description: A person with this power has the ability to place part of their soul into a restore point. If the user dies he is instantly transported to his restore point-alive but dazed. The user can also teleport freely from restore points. If all restore points have been destroyed the user dies. Restore points are set by throwing a materialized knife at a location. Restore points can be moved by taking out the knife-doing so will cause the part of your soul to return.
summary: The ability to mark restore points where you can revive/teleport to
strengths: Teleportating to protect your restore points
Revival at restore points
You can also use the marker knives as weapons
weaknesses: Cannot prevent old age
If you split your soul too much(not a good thing)
If people destroy your soul markers

name: Oxygen Morphing
description: Oxygen can be turned into anything that is equal to or less than your own mass. The object will be taken from the oxygen in a ten-mile radius around you. Ex: superpowered gun, army of you. You can move objects through the air. Ex: you can create a platform that you can move to any location in the atmosphere where you can still breathe. Objects last one hundred days.
summary: The ability to turn oxygen into anything less than or equal to your own mass
strengths: Can create an army.
Make yourself unique objects
weaknesses: May use enough oxygen to damage the environment.
Limited object time.

name: Napalm Stomp
description: You can slam your foot into the floor, causing a huge catastrophic eruption and damaging all foes. This might be great thing for clearing out whoever gets in your way.
summary: The ability to slam your foot to the ground that causes to the ground to erupt.
strengths: Could cause some explosions just by stomping your foot.
weaknesses: If you stomp on a floor full of oil can accidentally blaze yourself to ashes along anyone with it.

name: Lunar Granting Powers
description: Every time the moon shines at night, you will receive superhuman powers.  Each night, you'll become stronger & faster all cultimating to the full moon phase where you'll become a being of pure unknown energy. You'll be powerful at night, but will have to turn back to normal in the day. The only time you'll receive power in the day is when there is an eclipse. You will become a being of cosmic solar energy.
summary: The ability to gain power during phases of the moon
strengths: Gain power each night when the moon is lit
Become energy when the moon is full
Become cosmic solar energy during an eclipse
weaknesses: Turn back to normal when day approaches
Daylight savings makes your nights of power shorter

name: Death Wish
description: With this power, you are reborn when you are struck by a killing blow (as a passive defense mechanism). After you are reborn, your strength and speed is enhanced. However, your subconscious will take over and exact revenge on your killer to your body's full extent, using all known skills. During this phase you will feel no pain nor any emotion. If you die in this state, no ability can resurrect you. This "reborn" form cannot be switched off at will, and will switch off only when your goal is met
summary: The ability to be reborn when you die, giving you extra strength and speed.
strengths: Allows you to swiftly exact revenge upon enemies.
Your body will fully utilize all abilities it knows.
No distractions or wasteful movements; every action is intended on killing the enemy.
weaknesses: Lack of thinking before you leap.
You cannot return to the living once killed.
Incredibly exhausting.

name: Refresh Upon Timeout
description: When you die, this power allows you to be reincarnated back into your mother's womb, and live out your life again. Wish everything had gone differently? This power's for you.   Any superpowers acquired in life are also inherited, so each cycle allows you to become that bit more powerful. Studying in one life will also have a knock on effect on intelligence in the next etc.   Generally the past lives cannot be remembered (except through deja vu), but 'Unforgettable' or something could solve that.
summary: The ability to be reincarnated as yourself when you die, and live your life again.
strengths: Build upon the experience and abilities of past lives
Put right any wrongs you may have committed in your life
If able to remember past lives, this is a form of precognition
weaknesses: Trapped in an infinite loop (like a 'Groundhog Life')
Cannot always remember past incarnations
Must live through all stages of your development again (birth to adulthood)

name: Concentration
description: To divert blood flow and muscle tension to a single body part. Said body part also develops extreme elasticity and durability, enabling it to withstand heavy blows and recoil. Muscle mass increases also, and the extremity develops a dark red tint due to the extreme blood pressure. Concentration in the arm enables extreme strength, in the legs extreme running/jumping abilities, etc.
summary: The ability to focus strength and endurance into a specific extremity or body part--e.g. piledriver fist, etc.
strengths: Heavy hitter when the time comes!
Maneuverability! Nobody can catch someone with super-legs.
Huge, dark red arm looks AWESOME.
weaknesses: Extended numbness results from the huge blood pressure afterwards. Sorry!
If you overuse it, you might just lose a limb. Be careful!
If you can't "concentrate" fast enough, it's over...

name: Primal Fear
description: Everyone still has that old 'fear instinct'--the nameless horror that makes us want to run and hide. A person with Primal Fear can subdue conscious thought while bringing up this old instinct. Meaning? Everyone in 50 yards will leave the area, no matter the cost. The user can flip this on and off, like a switch. However, it is difficult to target specific people. The user's eyes also glow yellow.
summary: The ability to induce an irresistible fear in the people around you
strengths: People will want to leave the area, no matter the cost
Good distraction
Cornering someone while using this power
weaknesses: 50 yard range
Difficult to target specific people
When using, eyes glow yellow

name: Sensory Deprivation
description: The user creates a mist or fog which upon contact with someone paralyzes them and cuts off all, or some of their senses as you desire. This ability does not reach full effect instantly, but creeps up on the victim. The ability manifests as a mist, nearly invisible, that moves slowly away from you toward your target, blanketing all the space in between. You are able to project this mist several hundred meters and you can also control who is affected by this ability.
summary: The ability to selectively block any sense.
strengths: Powerful ability.
Selective sense blocking.
weaknesses: Takes time to work, several seconds.
Targets can run away.

name: Synchronization
description: The power to fuse yourself with anything within 2 feet. Can create a single being working in unison.
summary: The ability to fuse with objects and people
strengths: Gain characteristics of object in range
Is not permanent
You have a majority of the mental control
weaknesses: Only lasts an hour.
Think before you fuse
Some results may make you appear repulsive

name: Shadow Kinetic Slash
description: The user can absorb potiential energy around them in order to turn it into a grayish air slash that can cut almost anything especially anything that can't move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to redirect it as a air slash.
strengths: Powerful energy air slash
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Alien Database
description: With this power you will know absolutely everything about every alien planet and alien species that exists in your universe. This power applies to every planet that has life on it except for your home planet.
summary: The ability to have extensive knowledge on every alien planet and alien species that exists in your universe
strengths: You will know everything about every alien planet and species
weaknesses: If their are no aliens in your universe this power is useless

name: Vibration Sense
description: Also called Vibration Perception, Vibration Energy Perception or the Vibrissa Effect, this power allows the perception of the force produced by the oscillation of waves (vibrations that range anywhere from force produced by echoing/reverberating sound, underground seismic activity, vibration in the water, through solid surfaces and in the air); the user can even perceive psychic vibrations (presence of life, ghosts, psychics, etc), and can analyze them to discern presences (and species), etc.
summary: The ability to psychically detect vibrations of any kind
strengths: Pick up on vibrational energy easily (discern when people are approaching, leaving, etc. )
Predict impending heart attacks, impending earthquakes, and oncoming attacks
Sense and analyze psychic vibrations to discern the species of approaching subjects
weaknesses: Not superhuman sense of touch (can't sense temperature/pressure changes, feel minute indents, etc. )
Detecting earthquakes and heart attacks and the like requires the user be in the immediate area
Psychic attacks do especial damage to the user's mind

name: Reactive Density
description: Human tissue is easily torn. But a person with Reactive Density automatically increases their density with external pressure. This makes them generally impervious to harm: knives shatter on their skin, bullets flatten on impact, and even a speeding car cannot hurt them. However, there are some downsides. The user can still get sick and there is no super-strength that comes with it. Even more dangerous, massive pressure (1000 tons+) causes the user to over-dense. This results in a heart attack.
summary: The ability to increase your density in response to pressure
strengths: General invunerability
Not having to worry about safety concerns
Presence
weaknesses: No super-strength
Can be burned (though less badly than normal)
1000+ tons pressure causes heart attack

name: Instant Appraisal
description: This is a very useful ability. It allows the user to detect and appraise objects of value. Whenever an object of value comes within 15ft of the user, they'll get a feeling of warmth and well-being. When they actually see the object, they'll instantly know how valuable the object is.
summary: The ability to detect and appraise things of value.
strengths: You could find some really great deals.
With good negotiation skills, you could make a lot of money
weaknesses: You have to find the object yourself, the detection won't give you the location.

name: Clothing Power
description: A person with this power gets more abilities relative to the amount of clothing they wear and the type of clothing worn. For example, wearing sunglasses gives you laser vision and wearing a scarf gives you cryokinesis. Different brands affect the type of power. You can develop a varied set of powers by mixing and matching articles of clothing. However, you lose abilities as your clothing is destroyed. Earrings, rings, and other decorative items are also considered as clothing.
summary: The ability to gain abilities depending on the type of clothing you wear
strengths: By switching clothes, you can access a lot of powers
You can get multiple powers by wearing different combinations of clothing
Wearing multiple shirts on top of each other gives you multiple powers
weaknesses: Sometimes, to get the ability you need, you must wear embarrassing outfits or cross-dress
If your clothes are destroyed, you can't use the ability until you get the same clothes again
You need to have a large wardrobe

name: Yin Yang Touch
description: By making physical contact with matter (living or inanimate), you can use the forces of Yin and Yang on it. You can protect something from damage with yin power, and if it's a living thing you can heal it. If you use yang, you can make things take damage based on their composition (crumble, erode, rust, etc.), and if it's a living thing you can make it get sick. This is not the same as Yin and Yang Manipulation.
summary: The ability to harm or help anything by touching it.
strengths: Yin can protect things from harm temporarily, and if used on living things can even heal them
Yin can destroy things worse the longer you touch it; if used on living things, they get sick
Can be used on living and inanimate things
weaknesses: Not the same as Yin and Yang Manipulation (no blasts, behavior manipulation, etc.)
Requires touch
Sometimes you can't turn it off (one hand always produces yin, one always produces yang)

name: Myth Power: Way Of The Winds
description: The Winds, in Greek myth, had numerous gods. As such, channeling Aeolus (Aiolos- Keeper of Winds), one can generate and manipulate wind, at will. Channeling the Anemoi (Winds), Boreas (North), Notos (Notus- South), Euros (Eurus- East), Zephyros (Zephyrus, Zephyr- West), Caicias (Kaikas- Northeast), Sciron (Skiron- Northwest), Apeliotes (Southeast) and Lips (Southwest), one can perceive wind's power, direction and flow. Channeling the Anemoi Thuellai (Storm Winds) one can become a living wind.
summary: The ability to channel Aeolus, the Anemoi and the Anemoi Thuellai and their command over the essence of the winds
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate air/wind (including breathing in any gaseous medium), at will
Detect wind's direction/pressure/temperature; even heighten senses of smell/hearing
Become a spiraling, formless, shapeless, nearly-invisible breeze
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with or command horses, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically raise one's home into the air as a floating island, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith allows negation (NCN)

name: Attention Detection
description: This power enables you to sense when you are being paid attention to by anyone and wherever they are. If it's from people you are acquainted with, you'll know their identity. You won't know their true intentions but you can feel how much attention you are being given and how (thought, scrutinizing, conversation, overhearing, active listening,...).
summary: The ability to sense when someone is looking at, thinking about or even talking about you
strengths: Discover if someone keeps thinking about you, gossips on you or spies on you.
Knowing there are people thinking or talking about you is motivating.
Not knowing their intentions doesn't mean you cannot guess them right!
weaknesses: Passive power - you'll need active training to shut it off at will.
Can become overwhelming if you are (in)famous.
Can be depressing if you realise noone is paying attention to you.

name: Myth Power: Caerus' Cunning
description: Caerus (Cairus, Cairos, Kairos), in Greek myth, was the god of recognizing and seizing opportunity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive when an opportunity of any kind has presented itself (a person leaves himself open in a fight, one is about to receive a call offering a great job, etc). In addition, this perception doubles one's speed, reflexes, agility and dexterity to help seize the opportunity at hand. One can psychically perceive how long the opportunity will last.
summary: The ability to channel Caerus' command over the essence of chance and opportunity
strengths: Perceive when opportunities present themselves (when developed, share perception by touch)
Speed/reflexes/agility/dexterity all increase to help seize opportunities
Perceive how long one has to take an opportunity (and when it has passed)
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not last when opportunity passes (during power use) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel opportunists until developed (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: Angel Power: Angelic Might
description: This ability allows the user to harness at least part of the capabilities of an angel. Your strength, durability and stamina grow exponentially, and you will be able to grow mighty feathered wings at will for superhumanly-fast flight. You will also be able to perceive lies, different languages, people in need, evil spirits and demons. Not to mention, angels transcend the realm of humanity, so they're immune to a lot, including age, disease/illness, magic, psionics, electricity, fire and acid.
summary: The ability to channel the features and capabilities of an angel
strengths: Supernaturally-high stats, regenerative capability, winged flight and an intimidating aura of good
Heal others and perceive lies, spirits, people in need and demons (and understand all language)
Immunity to diesase, magic, psionics, sonic attacks, electricity, fire, acid and age
weaknesses: Useless if your intentions are impure (use it for evil deeds, you lose it for good)
Does not affect actual angels and divine beings (only demons, demoniacs and evil folks)
Demons are more prone to attack you in your human form (angel form doesn't last forever)

name: Razor Wind
description: With this ability you can summon a blast of wind which can cut, slice, slash or dice anything or anyone in your way. Can be used to create piercing blasts to puncture holes or large gusts that slice most things in half.
summary: The ability to summon up a piercing blast of wind that slices through anything
strengths: Cut throught swathes of enemies
Cut through nearly any matierial
weaknesses: Difficult to aim
A liability when fighting in populated areas or with teamates

name: Razor Wire
description: This ability allows you to fling lengths of razor sharp wire from any point on your body. The wire can attach to nearby static objects and is very strong/durable. You could even use it in a spider-man fasion for travel. Wire can be retracted back into your body.
summary: The ability to shoot lengths of razor sharp wire any point on your body
strengths: Wire is razor sharp to cut enemies
Can use the wire for travel
Wire can be fired from any point on your body
weaknesses: May harm innocent bystanders
Difficult to use as a form of travel

name: Music Of The Spheres
description: One with this ability is greatly gifted. With it, you can tune into the Music of the Spheres (the Music of the Heavens or Musica Universalis), which is the normally-inaudible musical and rhythmic working of the universe. Tuning into it brings about a state of true mental and spiritual harmony. In addition, you can allow others to hear the music as well. However, because their minds are not adapted to such frequencies, they enter a euphoric stupor that lasts until they can no longer hear it.
summary: The ability to tune into the transcendent rhythmic, musical workings of the universe
strengths: Mental/spiritual harmony by tuning into the transcendent essence from which all music/rhythm derives
Tuning into said essence will also make you an excellent poet, singer, songwriter, dancer, etc.
Tuning others into it renders them stupefied by the sheer beauty of the music
weaknesses: Some weaker users cannot tune into the music without themselves being stupefied
If you ARE stupefied by your own music, it's permanent, unless undone by another with this power
Some weaker users can't allow others to hear the music

name: Living Portal
description: As living portal you can't move and you lose all senses. The only powers you have that keep working are passive non-physical ones. Omniscience on demand still works. Size manipulation and shapechanging powers will let you be a smaller,bigger or non-human shaped portal. 100% of your body exist in Limbo(the space between dimensions) when you're a living portal.
summary: The ability to turn into a human-shaped portal between two locations,times or dimensions.
strengths: A form of invulnerability.
If foes can't travel to Limbo to attack you physically.
weaknesses: A foe who can travel to Limbo.
Powers that negate or control time travel,teleportation or dimension travel.
Unless you have omniscience on demand you can't perceive anything.

name: Poison Flames
description: The fire is as hot as an ordinary fire. The smoke is as poisonous as a rattlesnake's poison. The user of this power is immune to the poisonous smoke.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that always give off a poisonous smoke
strengths: Allies with Poison Immunity and Fire Immunity.
weaknesses: Enemies with Poison Immunity and Fire Immunity.
Your allies can still be affected by the fire and smoke, you can still burn yourself with the fire.

name: The Pendant
description: Alone, this power will create a barrier that blocks all physical attacks up to 5000 Newtons. If you also have The Throne, The Crown, and The Ring then this power will also protect the mind so long as the physical barrier is still standing.
summary: The ability to create a barrier that can protect one against harm
strengths: Protection to the mind and the body in one power.
Like the other powers in this ggroup you don't need an object or artifact to use this power.
weaknesses: 5,000 Newtons isn't that much force (only 500 kilograms or 1100 pounds).

name: Hand Blades
description: With this power you can turn your entire hand into a super sharp blade. You can use this power with both of your hands and the blades are so sharp they can even cut through rock and metal.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into blades
strengths: You can turn your hands into blades
You can use the power with both of your hands
You can even cut through rock and metal
weaknesses: You cannot make the blades less sharp

name: The Power Of Chaos
description: Conjure the Chaos Emeralds and use them to their full capabilities. Use Chaos Control to teleport. Use all seven to become invincible and super fast. However, the power only lasts in accordance to your emotion, and the type of power also mimics your emotion, both negative and positive.
summary: The ability to conjure and utilize the Chaos Emeralds
strengths: Teleport with Chaos Control.
Become invincible and super fast with all seven.
weaknesses: Power lasts as long as your emotion is strong.
Power changes depending on positive and negative emotion.

name: Forced Liquid Shift
description: With this power you can turn other people into a puddle of liquid. Once in puddle form the person is no longer sentient and you can trap them in a bottle or put them under a bright light and cause them to evaporate or something. When you're done messing with the person you can return them to their normal form (or not).
summary: The ability to other people into liquids
strengths: You can turn your enemies into liquid and then put them in a bottle or something
weaknesses: If you do decide to turn them back into human form they will probably try to hurt you

name: Sk: Phantom Creation
description: This ability allows the user to steal potiential energy in order to create phantoms in which the user can control them. The phantoms take the form of the things the potiential energy came from or the user can combine them in order to create a super phantom. The user can use his own potiental energy to create a phantom, but the user won't be able to move.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to materialize shadowy kinetic-energy phantoms.
strengths: Create phantom to serve you
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: Lucescere Veneficus
description: This is a spell that when cast it shoots a beam of pure good magic (aka light) at the enemy. It can be channeled with your hand but it works better if you use a staff or sword.
summary: The ability to shoot a beam of pure light (good magic) at an enemy
strengths: Utterly destroys your enemy
It only harms your enemy, so innocent bystanders will not get hurt
weaknesses: If you use your hands it might blow you back and kill you

name: Bullet Rain
description: With this power you can cause armoro piercing bullets to rain from the sky. The bullets can pierce through the even the strongest armor but they cannot hurt you or anybody else with this power.
summary: The ability to cause armor piercing bullets to rain from the sky
strengths: You can cause bullets to rain from the sky
You cannot be hurt by the bullets
weaknesses: You can't hurt other people who have this power

name: Rose Possession
description: This power channels your inner power to launch a rose at the target. The rose will envelope the target in thorny vines that have a special toxin that invades all bodily functions. Another rose will automatically appear in your hand, acting as a remote control for the target, thus making them your slave. Think of what you want the target to do with the second rose in hand, and it will happen.
summary: The ability to control living things with roses.
strengths: Can control your enemies.
Comes in any color you can imagine.
If you choose, the rose and the vines can grow internally so they are not seen.
weaknesses: Kills the target if not taken out.
The second rose is a rose none the less so if you want the target to live, take care of it.

name: Myth Power: Basileia's Best
description: Basileia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of royalty, sovereignty and monarchy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically summon a crown, which allows one to compel others to do one's will, as well as withstand compulsion. In addition, one can psychically summon a scepter that forces subjects to bow/kneel, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon a throne to heal/empower self and allies, at will. One even gains royal status in one's homeland, whether or not one wears the crown.
summary: The ability to channel Basileia's command over the essence of royalty, sovereignty and monarchy
strengths: Psychically summon a psionic crown that allows compulsion of others, and immunity to compulsion
Psychically summon a scepter to make subjects bow/kneel, and a throne to heal/empower self/allies
Gain royalty status in one's homeland (decrees become law, defended by citizens of that land, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon (user-controlled) psionic crowns for others until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to one's homeland at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bend reality within limits of one's homeland until developed (NCN)

name: Superpower Shifting
description: You can manipulate from which part of any individual's body any of their powers manifest, are channelled, etc. You could transfer Heat Vision from the eyes to the index fingers to shoot heat beams out of them. You could compress Invulnerability to, let's say, a foot, so only the foot is invincible. You could expand Bone Claws so the claws come out of anywhere on the body. You cannot completely suppress a power though, and the shifts can sometimes have unforeseen consequences.
summary: The ability to change the location of a superpower in an individual's body.
strengths: You could mess with anyone's powers, so they have a hard time figuring out how to activate them.
You can use this power on yourself in case you're prevented from using another one of your powers.
You can change the way you use this power, from contact to sight or even with your voice.
weaknesses: This power touches the true nature of superpowers, beyond a simple description of what can be done.
Putting a power somewhere you think will make it useless can have unexpected results.
For example, X-Ray Vision in a hand could give the power to make objects see-through on contact.

name: Aquatic Time Travel
description: If you are completely submerged in any body of water (lake, river, pool, bathtub) you can slow down, speed up, or go backwards in time. This ability also lets you be able to hold your breath underwater for longer periods of time. The area around you that you time travel in would also be protected from the effects of time.
summary: The ability to travel forward and backward in time while in any body of water.
strengths: Time travel
Area around you is protected
weaknesses: Risking paradox

name: Merging
description: You may get the chance of combing two or three persons, places, things, and/or even universes.
summary: The ability to temporarily merge two beings into which results in a completely new and stronger being.
strengths: A great way of having two things into one
You may even surprise you friends and family members about this ability
weaknesses: Having this merging ability may have devastating  consequences

name: Sp: Empowering Presence
description: 'SP' stands for 'Sharing Presence'. This ability allows you to empower others around you more and more the longer that they stay nearby. This also grants you a bonus: You gain as much power as all the empowered people around you. Increases your natural abilities, and supernatural abilities. Basically, try to get as many people around you, for as long as possible to maximize effect. Can be 'turned-off'.
summary: The ability to empower others in your presence, and gain strength for each person empowered.
strengths: Increase power of those around you, and yourself at the same time.
This ability can be 'turned-off' if wanted.
weaknesses: Although you benefit, you may not want to use this around multiple enemies.

name: Author Power Manipulation
description: With this power, you can control the powers you made. Unfortunately, a loss of focus with some of the finer movements can be disastrous; your victim may attack and destroy you.
summary: The ability to manipulate the powers you created.
strengths: Manipulate the powers you made.
While you cannot block powers you made, you could stop them from doing anything productive.
The more you make, the more useful this is.
weaknesses: Useless if you do not make any superpowers.
Lack of focus/concentration can be dangerous.
Useless against powers you didn't create.

name: Mind Overthrow
description: Using the Mind Overthrow, you can force the victim's mind to break and destroy it completely, turning them into what is referred to as 'a vegetable'. However, using this also allows you, if you succeed, to place your consciousness into the victim's body. Using this, as long as you can break someone's mind, you can live indefinitely.
summary: The ability to overthrow minds.
strengths: Control someone else's body completely.
Live forever.
weaknesses: You lose your old body.
Risky at times.

name: Chronopathy
description: Tick. Tock. A Chronopath has a powerful psychic link to the timeline. This gives them a powerful internal clock, down to the millisecond of the day (it's 3:09:36:58 PM), a sense of how long events will last, and a sense of when events will occur. They can also detect temporal anomalies, and sense temporal manipulation, and the age of matter (how time has affected things). However, it only gives you a sense of when events will occur, not how to stop them, and it does not bestow precognition.
summary: The ability to possess an intimate link with the timeline
strengths: Grants a powerful internal clock
Gives a sense of how long events will last, or how long till an event occurs
Perceive age, temporal manipulation and temporal anomalies (like time travel)
weaknesses: Not Precognition or Postcognition
Does not let you know how to stop events, only when they will happen
Cannot manipulate time

name: Titanium Battle Armor
description: The user is able to equip his body with a near indestructible Titanium Battle Armor. The power source is a compact quantum power cell. The power cell is able to give a charge lasting for a month. After the cell has worn out , it must be charged for 24hours. The suit will have power using the solar cells installed at strategic spots on the armor, but only limited abilities
summary: The ability to equip your body with a Titanium Battle Armor
strengths: Near invulnarability
Has the ability to have supersonic speed
Has the ability to fire laser beams
weaknesses: Recharging the battery is tedious
Cannot achieve independent space flight

name: Money Tree V4
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows ten thousand dollars (or the equivalent of ten thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in twenty dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else. Also if you're attacked you can use the branches as weapons to defend yourself.
summary: The ability to produce a tree that creates even more money than the third version of Money Tree
strengths: You can create a tree that produces money
You can get up to ten thousand dollars a day
You can use the branches as weapons
weaknesses: You can only get up to ten thousand dollars a day
You can only create one at a time

name: Induced Paralysis
description: With induced paralysis you can stop anyone from moving or talking. This power only applies to movement and in no way effects organs or the blood stream. Though it usually wears off in an hour, with extreme concentration, you can leave someone permanetly paralyzed.
summary: The ability to hinder all the muscular functions of the body.
strengths: Shut up anyone
Win any fight
Keep annoying people still
weaknesses: Lasts for a very short time
Takes a good ammount of concentration

name: Spatial Gunfire
description: This ability gives the user limited manipulation of space. When the bullets are constructed they can be directed for arcs, curves, high speed ricochet, zig zag, and aerial attacks. This ability also allows the user to stand upside down in midair. Other objects and debris which are energized by touch can also be directed. Spatial fields can also be created to trap targets in 'rooms' of bullets and shrapnel.
summary: The ability to direct energized bullets in your vicinity.
strengths: Thrash enemies in tight spaces.
Selected targets have no means of escape. Only entry but no exit.
Your personal spatial field will repel your own bullets and debris.
weaknesses: May trap teamates if not careful.

name: Kinesis One
description: Persons with superhuman abilities are drawn to you. If within 60ft of you they trigger your "kinesis" which snatches their abilities from their body & grants you the power. Their power is yours while the person is near & they in turn are powerless, weakened & slowly dying. The process completely & permanently changes their power, enhancing certain portions, twisting others, or cancels the power. If they manage to get away from you their power is forever deformed, distorted & twisted.
summary: The ability to use the 1st form of kinesis to absorb special abilities and alter them
strengths: Subconsciously pilfer the superpowers of others within 60 feet of you.
Permanent distortion of abilities (when the victim gains them back)
You cause other ability replicators, dampeners, thieves & reflectors to implode
weaknesses: Alone your telekinetic ability will allow you only to lift, move minor objects.
Superhumans are slowly dying in your presence, you are no team player
You will never truly copy anothers abilities, effects are random,the power will forever be perverted

name: Rise Of The 3 Headed Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a three headed dragon. You can fly, are super strong and have sharp teeth in all three of your heads. One of your heads can shoot lightning bolts, the second one shoots poison that kills on contact and the third one shoots a green goo that melts through anything.
summary: The ability to turn into a 3 headed dragon
strengths: You can turn into the three headed dragon
You can shoot lightning, poison and green acid slime
weaknesses: You can be killed
You can't speak any human languages unless you have the power "Dragon Language"

name: Voodoo Doll
description: You can instantly create dolls that you can imbue with the power of voodoo. Ultimate control!!!!!
summary: The ability to create voodoo dolls of any living thing.
strengths: Take revenge, and control every human and animal
Control yourself, to save yourself from danger (throw the doll in the direction you want to dodge)
Can do anything to the doll, and it happens to the person (give it to your dog ... )
weaknesses: Must know what the person or animal looks like
If you aren't good at coming up with torture ideas ...

name: Energy Fist
description: When you run out of choices and want to defeat the enemy quickly and effectively you use the energy fist. You clench your hand into a fist and energy slowly circles your hand. Next, you punch the ground and you send a very powerful wave of energy to your enemy. You can also direct where the energy wave will hit.
summary: The ability to punch the ground with your fist and send energy waves to a particular direction
strengths: Defeat the enemy quickly and effectly.
Very powerful attack.
Strength increases.
weaknesses: Could hurt your hand from the force you are hitting the ground with.
If you don't direct your energy wave, you could hurt your allies/friends.
Need lots of energy and could drain you from power which will cause you to faint after the attack.

name: Power Dealing
description: You can steal others' superpowers, containing the powers in your body, and then grant the powers to others. You can chose to remove individual powers, or remove all of the subjects' powers. You cannot use the powers stored in your body.
summary: The ability to steal powers, store them in your body, then give them to others.
strengths: You could sell superpowers for a lot of money, becoming very rich
When attacked by a superhuman you could take away their powers
Some people would probably pay large amounts to depower a superhero/villain
weaknesses: You have to take powers from someone before you can empower others
You'll probably have to buy powers off others before you can sell them for large amounts
You could be violently forced by someone to give them powers

name: Sword Attributes
description: This superpower gives you the ability to have the attributes of a sword. You can turn any part of your body into a sword, but your whole body cannot turn into a sword just parts of your body. The attributes of a sword can be metal, wood, sharp heavy etc.
summary: The ability to have the attributes of a sword
strengths: The user can create swords at will
