weaknesses: You cannot turn into any other weapons other than a sword
You have to see the material to make one of your body parts to become a sword

name: Myth Power: Psamathe's Smarts
description: Psamathe (Psammathe, Psammatheia, Amatheia, Amathea, Amathyia, Amathia) is the goddess of sand, especially that of the beach and the sea. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate sand at will. Furthermore, one can take on the consistency of sand, at will, allowing one to assume the form of nearly any subject one desires. One can even teleport to anywhere with sand, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Psamathe's command over the essence of sand
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and manipulate sand at will; teleport to anywhere with sand, at will
Gain Arenaceous Shapeshifting (turn into sand, and reform as nearly any living subject at will)
weaknesses: Cannot gain normal Sand Mimicry, or turn subjects into sand, until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 is limited to subjects of similar size/weight/mass until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, mimic, manipulate or turn subjects into glass until developed (NCN)

name: Aerodynamic
description: You can fly up high in the air toward the skies, completely surround yourself with a sphere of electric exploding energy damaging the enemy if he or she is in range of the explosion. While electricity surrounds you, you can launch yourself towards the foe. That'll shock all enemies in one direction, then the other, bouncing against the edges of the floors and walls a couple of times.
summary: The ability to surround yourself with exploding electricity, damaging anyone that gets nearby.
strengths: Works great against water-type adversaries.
weaknesses: Won't work while indoors.

name: Heavy Thunder
description: This ability allows you to doubles the weight of everything you hit with Heavy Thunder (green lightning bolts). Using this power you can knock down someone easily, turning him so heavy that he can't stand his own weight. If you shoot something that is 70 pounds, it will become 140 pounds, then 280, etc. You can focus the Heavy Thunder energy into a green electrical knife, and every time you cut someone with that knife he will bleed twice faster.
summary: The ability to shoot green lightning bolts that doubles the weight of things.
strengths: A powerful ability, can knock down someone easily.
The Knife Mode can make someone bleed to death in seconds.
weaknesses: Works slower on people with Super Strength.
When you stop using the Knife Mode you get unable to use the Heavy Thunder for 3 hours.

name: Sun Blade
description: By utilizing the heat around you, you are able to form the Blade of the Sun. This blade is not as hot as the Sun but something very close. When hit with it, then your hit will burn anything to ashes at that very moment.
summary: The ability to utilize the heat around you to form the Sun Blade.
strengths: No one else can hold it.
If someone shot at you, the sword's heat will burn away every bullet they try to hit you with.
The Sun Blade can also create waves of fire.
weaknesses: No one else can hold it.
Your body has to be accustomed to that type of heat. If not, then you are dead.

name: You "Matter"
description: Any piece of item (like trash), body part, or really any type of matter can be "switched" with another form of matter. But you cannot create new matter or destroy it. (kind of like alchemy but you can switch back faster and without barely thinking about it.) Its like transforming matter but if you had lets say a ball and then make it into a sword, you can still get the ball back. your just taking an item from one location (inter-dementions work) and bringing it to you
summary: The ability to "switch" matter
strengths: You can get any item
you can change its size & composition
you can change things like sounds
weaknesses: The items/parts-its-made-of have to exist elsewhere
cannot trade in anything for more than 99x its size
not indestructable

name: Map Eyes
description: To know every map there is. So each time you close them, you see a map to anywhere, even a map through the body. You could use it to escape enemies or figure out where you are when lost.
summary: The ability to see maps in your eyes
strengths: See maps
Never get lost
Escape enemys
weaknesses: Could lose in battle

name: Superpower Equalization
description: With this superpower you have the ability to make your opponent's superpower cut in half, and add a half of that superpower to your own superpower repertoire. So you and him would have equally measured superpowers of the same type.
summary: The ability to halve your foe's superpowers and gain half their superpowers for yourself
strengths: No matter how powerful your opponent is (he can be God himself), their superpower(s) are cut in half
You become equally matched as far as superpowers go
This ability activates with your opponent's arrival on the chosen battle location
weaknesses: You are equally matched, so unless you have a bit more brains than your enemy, none of you will win
You both have the same superpowers, so it's going to be hard to win the fight

name: Heat Eater
description: A person with this power does not need to eat normally instead their body takes in energy by absorbing heat. When next to another object you can also absorb their heat thus freezing them. Also you can absorb the heat from flames. When far away, you can activate this ability like a heat magnet attracting heat from objects remotely. People affected experience a pseudo burning effect(close to boiling water) from the heat escaping the person's skin and eventually frostbite before being frozen.
summary: The ability to absorb heat for food
strengths: You don't need to eat you just need to absorb heat from other things
Freeze things by touch
Remote absorption of heat
weaknesses: Extreme cold weakens you and makes you hungry
Can't absorb the environment past freezing point of water without equipment
Cannot absorb heat when you are full-you will throw up fire-fire can still burn your esophogus

name: Fifth Amendment
description: No matter what you do, blow up a building, kill dozens of children, you will not be held responsible for ANY OF IT by ANYONE.
summary: The ability to not be responsible for any crime you may commit
strengths: No time in jail. Ever
Great if you're a villain.
weaknesses: If you want to go to jail
People with strong willpower will still hold you responsible

name: Mimic Absorber
description: Faced with someone who mimicked this power, from you or not, you'll steal their copy from them and make it disappear. It affects any power which was acquired by creating a copy of this power as a reference, while giving them or not changes. It doesn't work on someone who obtained this power legitimately. It works on stolen ones only if they were mimicries to begin with. The best is noone can even copy this power from you as copies will be absorbed before they can even reach the duplicator.
summary: The ability to absorb any mimicries of this power.
strengths: This power is impossible to copy from you! As copies will be absorbed before they go anywhere.
You'll absorb any instances of mimicry of this power, whether it was mimicked from you or not.
Two mimicked Mimic Absorber powers will absorb each other and disappear.
weaknesses: It's unmimickable. Big deal! It doesn't even do anything! Besides, good luck finding mimicries!
It can be stolen from you and it cannot be backed up, as a backup is a copy.
If you absorb a copy with alterations, like enhancement or reversal, you can't keep the alterations.

name: Temporal Memory
description: When an event of the past is changed, no one remembers it, because it never happened, right? With this power, you will remember the events that took place before the change, even though no one else does.  So, let's say Bob Doorstop goes back in time and stops himself from being born, so he never existed. Thing is, you'll somehow remember him, and you'll have the motivation to go back in time and stop him.  You'll remember people, events, wars, etc even when they've been erased from time! Cool!!!
summary: The ability to remember the previous time stream after it's alteration.
strengths: Remember things that never happened.
With a time machine, you could bring events and people 'back'.
Super memory, and your friends will never be erased from existence.
weaknesses: In order to right the wrongs, you need a time machine; otherwise, you'd just remember.
Your friends would think you're crazy, remembering non-existent things.
Your brain could be a mess, provided you have a tendacy to go insane.

name: Self Proclaimed Friction
description: With this ability, you can walk on any surface as if it has friction. That means you don't slip on ice rinks or wet floors or any surface you walk on. You can walk on the most slippery surface possible without slipping. This ability only works when you're wearing shoes, sneakers, boots, or some kind of footwear. Socks do not count.
summary: The ability to walk on any surface (no matter how slippery) as if it had friction.
strengths: Walk on any surface without slipping.
Walk on ice and wet floors without slipping.
Whatever you walk on seems to have friction.
weaknesses: Must wear shoes, sneakers, boots, or other footwear to work.
Socks don't count.

name: Item Possession
description: The ability to take over anything that's not already alive. The only real limit is that it has to be one unit.  You can't get a whole train, but one car. The different parts of the objects are opposable, and when what you're in breaks, you pop out. You still feel some pain, but it is lessened.
summary: The ability to possess inanimate objects
strengths: Be a beast at hide and go seek
Easy way to turn a getaway car into a trap
weaknesses: Useless in areas without obects

name: Picture Perfect
description: You can move into pictures, movies, a television, the internet and so on. You can also throw people into and trap them in the 2D dimension. You can do the opposite too, by pulling 2D characters, items, creatures and such out of the 2D world into your 3D world.
summary: The ability to move between 2D en 3D worlds.
strengths: You can move between 2D world en 3D world.
You can throw things/people in 2D world or you can pull them out.
The changes made by people/things you throw into movies for example alters reality,even when you die
weaknesses: If you die everything resets, everyone and -thing returns to their own dimension.
You cant control the things you pull out of 2D worlds, if you pull out a villain, it stays a villain
The changes made by people/things you throw into movies for example alters reality,even when you die

name: Explosive Sight
description: This ability allows you, with a glance, to force something to explode or shatter. This works for anything solid, as it doesn't affect liquid or gas. This is unable to be controlled, so it has to be contained using a special mask, which allows control over the power, and you don't have to look like a freak, as it is a plastic sheet which can be simply placed over your face.
summary: The ability to explode things just by looking at them
strengths: Able to explode anything with a glance
You waste no effort using this power
The mask doesn't look awful, unless you are horrifically ugly
weaknesses: Uncontrollable without mask
Could accidentally kill others

name: Corrosion
description: Corrosion. It's why stuff doesn't last for millions of years. A person with Corrosion can speed up the process 10,000 times with a touch, making iron rust and collapse, wood rot in an instant, and plastic bags dissolve before your eyes.
summary: The ability to induce the breaking down of a material
strengths: Very useful
No real limits on the size of what can be affected
Destroy resources rapidly
weaknesses: No affect on already corroded materials
No affect on incorrodables, i.e gold, solid plastics, etc.
Limited affect on objects covered by patinas

name: Televandalism
description: All you need to do is concentrate on any object you can see, and it will break under your mental influence. The larger and more complex the object is, the harder it is to break, and it may even require several minutes. The way it breaks is up to the user and their mind, as however they envision it is how it will happen. With enough time and focus, you could fold a 747 in half. However, you are limited to non-organic objects only, so no breaking people's bodies. Now go break stuff.
summary: The ability to break objects from afar
strengths: Break anything you want.
Control over how the object breaks.
Who's going to know you broke it? Nobody can prove you did it.
weaknesses: It's not telekinesis, as you can only break things.
Can only break non-living things, like guns or cardboard boxes.
It may take a long time to break a large object, and you may pass out from the strain.

name: Twin View
description: Imagine yourself going to school,and you know two good paths. You can't decide which path is the less dangerous path. So, you use Double View, and you see yourselve in one view, taking the path within the quiet neighborhood. You see that you are okay, but in the other view you see yourself being beaten in the path that is near the pizza shop. OUCH!! Better take the first path.
summary: The ability to see your  future consequences in two different sights.
strengths: You can see the future.
You can see your mistakes.
You can use your powers to become a swami. (but,I don't recommend it)
weaknesses: You'll get headaches.
Might see a nasty future.
You might be stuck in the future.

name: Emerald Light
description: The rays of emerald light will heal and regenerate any living thing within the range of the power. The user will become nigh invulnerable while the power is being used. Once the power runs dry it will take a few hours to recharge.
summary: The ability to shine bright miraculous rays of emerald light
strengths: Super healing for user and surrounding allies
User becomes nigh invulnerable for a short time
Full regeneration of lost limbs and various body parts
weaknesses: After use it takes a few hours to recharge
Any cybernetic being may become full human again against their will
If the target of the power is dead they can't be brought back.

name: Pokemon Shifting
description: If you want to be big and strong, shift into a Snorlax. If you want to be a fighting master, shift into a Machoke. If you want to be cute, shift into a Jigglypuff... You get the idea!
summary: The ability to shift into any pokemon that you want
strengths: You can be strong, fast, cute, big, and you can scare people!
No need to buy a costume for halloween
weaknesses: You can only shift into one pokemon at a time

name: Plasma Bomb
description: You are able to use the most powerful plasma, with which you will take down any foe.
summary: The ability to shoot orbs of hot and radioactive plasma
strengths: Make a powerful weapon
Take down even the hardest enemy
weaknesses: Dangerous
Hard to conrol

name: Edible Energy Emitter
description: This ability allows you to generate an energy ray, beam or wave that transforms anything it touches into a substance that looks similar as the original but is edible. For instance, wood may be turned into chocolate swirled to look like wood.
summary: The ability to generate an energy ray that transforms any matter into a similar-looking edible substance
strengths: Never starve (and/or end world hunger)
Eat your way out of any prison
Eat enemies
weaknesses: Once changed matierials cannot be reverted, unless your power develops
Can't decide what KIND of food it turns into (color, texture and shape determine this)
People always begging you to make stuff into food for them

name: Myth Power: Apollo's Appeal
description: Apollo (Apollon), in Greek myth, was the god of prophecy, oracles, healing, the arts (philosophy, etc), sports and sunlight. As such, channeling him gifts one with skill in sports (especially archery), music (singing, songwriting, playing instruments), art, poetry and divination. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of sunlight). Furthermore, one can absorb sunlight to gain physical power. One can even psychically heal others with sunlight, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Apollo's command over the essence of prophecy, healing, the arts, sports and sunlight
strengths: Gain skill in sports, music, art, poetry and divination
Psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of sunlight)
Absorb sunlight to gain physical power; psychically heal others with sunlight, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically control sun's course (rising/setting) or manipulate solar energy (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon indestructible bow (infinite plague-tipped arrows), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow powers of Prophecy (or Paradox Prophecy),  by touch, until developed (NCN)

name: Hush Ruckus
description: Your skin absorbs sound making complete silence until you redirect through your voice as an ultra ruckus or a concentrated super scream.
summary: The ability to absorb sound and redirect it as a loud, extremely annoying noise or super scream.
strengths: Awesome sound manipulation.
Speak in an altered voice or to more than one person at once with different words.
Create complete silence.
weaknesses: Can annoy you too much.
Will shatter glass upon activation.

name: Black Hole Generation
description: With this power, a person can cause an atom to turn into a small black hole, which grows and has greater then normal gravity. It only affects things you allow it to, but it does more than just pulling things in and spaghettifying them -- time slows down and all powers are distorted beyond use. It stores Hawking Radiation, which becomes heat, light, concussive force, radiation, etc. Once you stop maintaining it or walk out of range, it explodes in a blast of Hawking Radiation.
summary: The ability to create black holes.
strengths: Very destructive.
Powers are messed up -teleporters can't get away and you can't be mimicked.
It only affects things you allow it to.
weaknesses: Lack of control.
Like real black holes, things have to be close until they gain mass.
Apart from destruction, it's almost useless.

name: I.Q.
description: You will be able to either increase the intelligence of a person to make them a genius or lower it to the point where they become brain-dead. You must touch their head for it to work though.
summary: The ability to raise or lower someone's intelligence.
strengths: Grant a person increased intelligence or lower it.
Does not work on yourself.
weaknesses: Must touch their head for the power to work.
Might make them too intelligent or too dumb or even kill them if they're brain-dead.

name: Dragon Force!
description: The Dragon Force, similar to the Phoenix Force as it is an immortal entity born between states of being, is the physical embodiment of matter in all realities of the omniverse (whereas the PF is the epitome of psionic energy). The user can tap into the Dragon Force to harness complete shape-changing qualities, matter and anti-matter manipulation, incalculable levels of superhuman strength, invulnerability, flight and speed, as well as create and destroy life.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Dragon Force.
strengths: The user is encased by solid matter that takes the form of a giant green dragon.
The Dragon Force is based on matter that had once existed, is existing, or will one day exist.
The user can call upon any number of powers the Dragon Force employs.
weaknesses: The user may lose to stronger entities.
The user may grow insane do the power of the Dragon Force.

name: Exploding Weapons
description: With this power you can make weapons that create explosions when they hit things out of nowhere. You can only create melee weapons such as swords, clubs, flails, maces, battle axes, spears etc. The explosions cannot hurt the person that uses the weapons only the person that the weapon hits.
summary: The ability to create exploding weapons out of nowhere
strengths: You can create explosion causing weapons out of nowhere
The explosions only hurt the person you hit with the weapon not the user
weaknesses: You can only create melee weapons no guns or bombs or stuff like that

name: Strange Visitor
description: Each day you can say the words Strange Visitor X, & you become any fictional extraterrestial. A Kryptonian, Silver Surfer, a skrull, a Predator, a Necronom Alien, Riddick, a Covenant Elite, Lion-O, Saiyan, Jeeves (MIB), Autobot, Decepticon etc. You will look like a hybrid of you & the extraterrestrial, have all there powers & the intelligence to create whatever technology or paraphernalia they use.
summary: The ability to transform into any fictional alien ever created
strengths: Any known extraterrestial being from books, tv, movies, video games, legend etc
Sangheili, Kherubim, Oans, Daxamite, Klingon, Q (Trek), Viltrumite, Klendathu Bugs
Power lasts for 24 hours, or until you take enough damage to force you into normal form
weaknesses: The power is random and shaking off the alien's fictional agenda takes 10min.
Alf, ET, gleek, grunt, jackal, MIB worms, Ferengi, Ewok, Hutts, vulcans, Marvin the Martian
Becoming Galactus will make you want to gnaw on our pretty blue planet

name: Chemical Warfare
description: Okay the name basically says it, you can create substances that are chemical weapons out of thin air or turn a different matter into the chemical you want. You could create different types of tear gasses or nerve agents,also a psychological agent which could cause hallucinations/delirium. And of course you could just kill them with sarin, cyanide, or botulism.
summary: The ability to use the toxic properties of substances to kill/injure/incapacitate people
strengths: Just stun them with tear gas or with hallucinations
Easily kill them if you want
weaknesses: Kill people TOO easily
If a villain gets a hold of this, there's gonna be trouble

name: Limit Transcendence
description: Simple. If you have a power that specifically disallows something (for example, if you have a magnetism power that specifically says in its description "you can't lift non-magnetic metals), then at will you can gain a power to do just that.
summary: The ability to gain a power from what you can't do
strengths: Get a lot of new powers from old ones
Get to do things even your powers say you are unable to do
weaknesses: You only get new powers based on the wording of your old ones
Your old powers have to be off this site or somewhere where they have a worded description
Immortality- you can't die, so you can at will get the ability to die. Kind of pointless.

name: Emotion Manipulation
description: A person with this ability can amplify a subject's current emotions (e.g. happy to ecstatic, sad to suicidal), even to the point of overloading them so they can't think (e.g. sexual pleasure so powerful they are immobilized); they can change one emotion into another (e.g. happy to sad, sad to angry, sad to fear, etc.), or once it is developed, suppress emotions completely. You can also induce or negate Empathy and other powers based on sensing, manipulating or using emotions.
summary: The ability to change  a person's emotions
strengths: Can change a person's emotion to your advantage
Turn your enemies against each other
Make your enemies suicidal, or extremely scared
weaknesses: Cannot change your own emotions
May cause you to change someone's emotion unwillingly at first
If you don't practice, emotion changes can be permanent

name: Finger Tracker
description: With this power, when you really want to find something. All you have to do is use this power and your finger will automatically point to you where to find what you need. This is helpful for finding lost objects as well as tracking people or information. The tracker cannot be fooled by any external force however illusions can hide the true answer. Also this does not tell you the distance of people and will only display the fastest route or the route that you specificate
summary: The ability to have your finger point you in the right direction of what you want or need
strengths: You will never get lost
You can always find out where your belongings are
You can find other people or information
weaknesses: If what you are looking for does not exist
Sometimes the power is deceptive if something happens to be in front of your finger for example

name: Pain Charge
description: This power allows the user to enhance his abilities/strength/speed/skills and other powers (if he/she has others) by 50% for every injury such as wounds,contusions and even internal body damage suffered by the one gifted with this superpower. Amputations or loss of body parts,except the head, will instead give a 500% increase in efficiency of all the user's skills and capabilities. Sickness or ailments,on the other hand,will yield a 1000% efficiency in your powers.
summary: The ability to increase the efficiency of one's abilities and skills with every injury suffered
strengths: Wounds and other injuries will no longer hinder you from your tasks
Amputations and other fatal injuries will turn you into a superhuman
Your enemies will become hesitant to attack you
weaknesses: You can still die from suffering too much injuries and bodily damage
You will be restored back to normal once your injuries are healed
You must still possess enough strength to move or do stuff upon suffering injury

name: Truth Serum
description: This power makes a person tell the honest truth. You touch the person & a psychoactive drug is injected into their blood stream that makes them lose some inhibitions, mostly the part of lying & being silent. So they start rambling on about everything they know & believe is true. It's a fast acting chemical that wears off after a day. Plus, it makes them dehydrated from non-stop talking & hyperactive & restless, so they'll crash after the drug is out of their system.
summary: The ability to induce a truth telling chemical into a person
strengths: You'll hear the truth, the whole, truth & nothing but the truth
weaknesses: They endlessly babble on
What they believe is true could be false information
Wears off after a day & they become dehydrated & lethargic

name: Alternate Synchronization
description:
With this power you have an ability very close to omniscience but only in the present. You get to know all the knowledge in all the alternate universes and apply them to another universe. 

For example, if a vaccine was developed in one continuity, you can reproduce the vaccine in another continuity.
summary: The ability to have the knowledge of every alternate reality version of yourself on demand
strengths: You know a lot of people before they meet you as well as their weaknesses
You can take over the world with your knowledge
Access to a lot of technology
weaknesses: If the main one is destroyed all the other ones will disapear too
You have to collectively thwart all the enemies within each universe
Does not see the future or the past (weak against time travelling)

name: Beast Boy
description: You can turn into any animal, even mythical creatures, but only for at most 30 minutes at a time. If you are an animal for 14 minutes, then there is a 14 min. wait. So, if you're an animal for the whole 30 minutes, you would have to wait the whole 30 min. You can switch animals on the move.
summary: The ability to turn into any animal for at most 30 minutes
strengths: You can turn into any animal
Helpful in combat
You are able to switch animals on the move
weaknesses: There can be a long wait
Max time is 30 min.

name: Speech Empowerment
description: When someone with this power hears a speech or debate, he/she will be able to do what is said in that speech. You have to listen to the whole speech, understand it and the received powers vanish after a day. You can get multiple powers.
summary: The ability to gain powers from someone's speech
strengths: Get powers from speeches and debates
Can get multiple powers
weaknesses: Need to hear the speech/debate from beginning to end
Need to understand the speech/debate
Powers will last for a day

name: Aversion Change
description: Aversion are the things that, in the superpower world, makes someone weaker. A normal person would usually have one or two, but this ability can allow the user to change his aversion. This makes him able change their weakness to something that no one could find out.
summary: The ability to change one's aversion at will.
strengths: Change your aversion
Remain strong
weaknesses: Can only have one aversion at a time.

name: Sense Eliminator
description: With this power you can eliminate any four of a person's five senses (taste, sight, smell, touch, hearing). You can change which four you want to delete every time you use the power and you can restore the person's senses whenever you want.
summary: The ability to eliminate four of a person's five senses
strengths: You can delete any four of a person's five senses
You can restore the person's senses whenever you want
weaknesses: You cannot delete all five of a person's senses

name: Time Replacement
description: You can replace any event that has happened with a new one of your choosing. An example of this could be changing what you had for breakfast this morning. Rule of what you cannot do: you cannot remove someone from existence. You cannot undo your own death, but you can change non-fatal things. You cannot tamper with peoples lives directly. The new events that you used to replace the old ones will not change the past or the future in a significant way. THIS POWER DOES NOT LET YOU TRAVEL IN TIME.
summary: The ability to replace events that have happened with different ones.
strengths: You can do whatever you want to, then go back and change what you did.
You can relive certain events.
You can look forward or back in time.
weaknesses: You can only use this power on something that happened recently.
You cannot bring things into existence, merely suggest that it comes into existence.
You cannot travel in time, you can only change certain events

name: Criminal Mastermind
description: With this power you are a natural master criminal, you know what to steal, how to get it, who to sell it to, and how to launder the money, it's in your nature. Whether it is being a con artist, a drug dealer or a master thief you'll know how to work your operation, best of all you cannot be caught by any law enforcement at all, even if you admit to your crimes they won't believe you, however this does not stop other criminals from trying to take you down.
summary: The ability to be the ultimate criminal mastermind
strengths: Make a lot of money and retire early
You'll always know how to operate or pull of a job
You can never be caught by any law enforment
weaknesses: You could hurt innocent people, depending upon what you do
Other criminals might try to take you out to take your place, but it is easy to stay hidden
One way or another you might be hurting someone

name: Book Of Cards
description: This power allows one to summon a book with 300 card slots inside of it. The slots are divided into categories, 100 each for Living, Non-living, and Events. So long as you have the book in your hand you can point to something and recite "Gain," whereupon the thing you pointed at becomes a card and is added to the book. To use a card, take it out of the book and say "Gain" with it in your hand. Whatever was in the card will be summoned out of it at any point you can see, destroying the card.
summary: The ability to create a book to fill with useable cards.
strengths: Store things as cards for easy transport.
Change your enemies or life threatening events into cards.
Anything can be "Gained" if you focus on what you want to Gain from something.
weaknesses: You have a limited number of slots, and can not place a card in an inappropriate slot
The power does not make something summoned from a card loyal to you.
Once something has been summoned from a card it can not be made into a card again.

name: Final Fantasy Weaponry
description: You can summon any weapon from Final Fantasy series to your aid and you can have only four weapons at time, but you can change the weapons any time. And you can also lend the weapons with your friends or teammates.
summary: The ability to summon any weapon from any Final Fantasy Series.
strengths: Weapons variables are great.
You can lend the weapons.
You can dual-wield weapons.
weaknesses: It has to be from Final Fantasy Series (Kingdom Hearts are included! )
It has to be different weapon (no duplicates! )
Dual-wielding makes you bit slow

name: Self Hypnosis
description: A person with this power can command their body to act in anyway physically possible. They can access 100% body strength and all their composite skills. They are immune to mind control since they command themselves. They can also give themselves special skills, such as hypnotizing themselves to be expert gunmen or hypnotizing themselves to play the piano extemely well. The user must first will himself in order to activate his power; if they are not motivated it will not work.
summary: The ability to give commands to yourself in order to perform feats to your full potential
strengths: You can access your full potential at will
You can access skills that you normally wouldn't have
weaknesses: You will be very tired after using this ability for a long time
Cannot transcend own physical limits without consequences
You must be motivated in order to activate your power

name: Flight
description:
The classic ability to fly.  No running start required.  You DO need to flap your arms to stay aloft, though.  You can travel at up to 60 MPH (or 100 KPH for you metric people), and you have heightened reflexes when traveling fast (or else you'd run into a lot of things).  

You CAN get hurt if you crash into something.
summary: The ability to fly.  Arm flapping is required.
strengths: Travel anywhere pretty quickly - no car needed
Fame and probably fortune
Get out of dangerous situations easily
weaknesses: Getting sucked into a plane turbine
Running into power lines
You might become famous, which would mean you get a lot of attention

name: Super Power List Leech
description: When you gain this ability you choose any member of the Superpowerlist and gain access to any power that person has gained. The problem though is that if you gain a power and the person you leech of gains the same power, your version of that power is cancelled and you can not use the power anymore. Once you choose a person to leech off of you can not change your decision.
summary: The ability to use almost any power obtained by another member of your choosing.
strengths: Use any power the person you choose has that you do not have.
Can use on a person with a lot of powers to quickly gain many powers.
Has no effect on the person you are leeching off of.
weaknesses: Can not change which member you leech off of once you pick.
If the member you leech off of stops using site you stop gaining powers.
If they gain the same powers you gain then that power cancells out for you.

name: Holy Power: Avenging Thunder
description: With this power you can shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or shield. This laser has the same amount of energy as a small star and destroys everything on its path. You can shoot this laser many times in great speed, but it attacks only forward, making you vulnerable.
summary: The ability to shoot a powerful laser from your fist, or Avenger Shield, with the same energy of a small star.
strengths: You can shoot a powerful laser in great speed from both hands.
This power has an accurate targeting, and a great field of range.
weaknesses: Attacks only forward, making you vulnerable from other directions.
Energy Absorption or Suppression powers
The destruction left behind has to be cleaned up by SOMEONE

name: Night Vision
description: No more fumbling for that light switch.  You can see perfectly in any level of darkness.  Even in the darkest of caves, seeing clearly is no problem.
summary: The ability to see clearly in the dark.
strengths: At night, you can still see everything
If you're afraid of the dark, you're cured.
If you live in the country, you can see deer.
weaknesses: Haunted houses might bore you
If you like to sleep in the dark, you'll still see everything

name: Curse Of Epic Failing
description: You can cause your enemies to constantly epic fail but it must be funny and the the length and the intensity of the curse increases with practice.
summary: The ability to have your enemies fail
strengths: It's awsome
weaknesses: It's magic so magic negation works but if the subject tries to negate it after it
Is already in effect he/she fails at negating the curse in a epic fail maner

name: Dark Charizard
description: You can become an alternate form of the Pokemon Charizard, with dark roan red skin, an orange chest, silver-black claws, glowing amber eyes, and a tail-flame of black fire. You can sense anyone both psychically and physically. You also have extremely powerful 'black fire' pyrokinesis, telepathy, and regeneration. You can read the minds as well as memories of any person or animal within a twenty-mile-radius.
summary: The ability to transform at will into a 'dark' form of Charizard
strengths: You are a very rare and powerful type of dragon, with unmatched aerial abilities and reflexes
Despite being a 'dark' dragon, you are not evil!!
You can use the powers in human form if you choose
weaknesses: Your power starts off fairly weak, and so practice is required to harness your abilities
At first, you could be stuck in your Dark Charizard form for longer than you desire
An extremely dangerous ability in the wrong hands!

name: Chromakinesis
description: The ability to change any color to any other color, not having to know names or computer values for the colors.
summary: The ability to manipulate colors.
strengths: Change your shirt design or your hair/eye color
Change the lens of a camera (or the enemy's eyes) to black to avoid detection.
Have lots of fun with this power
weaknesses: Not inteded for battle
Your friends will want you to do stuff for them

name: Iron Arms
description: Lining your arms with metal can be really helpful. One can mold the iron into a weapon of choice and the weapon would be of the strongest material. Use them to touch some of the hottest objects, the most powerful of acid, and the toughest walls. The power can be activated on and off whenever you choose for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to line your arms in metal.
strengths: Shape into any tools, keys, weapons,etc.
Touch just about anything
Powerful and tough
weaknesses: Can be a bit stiff
No feeling, so you don't feel texture

name: Lavapit
description: With this power you can cause lavapits to appear on any flat surface and then make it disappear later. You can make the lavapit any size you want and keep it in existence for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to make a pit full of lava to appear on any flat surface
strengths: You can create lavapits
You can make them any size you want
You can keep them in existence for as long as you want
weaknesses: If you fall into the lavapit you will probably burn or die

name: Serpent Staff
description: This staff was made by aztec gods. It looks like a golden wing serpent with a ruby eyes and a sapphire gem in its mouth. When thorwned on the ground it turns into a 60 ft flying serpent which can be used to travel on and when hold the sapphire gem it turns the staff into a a rainbow blade.
summary: The ability to transform in to a 6o ft winged serpent or a sword made of refracted light
strengths: Fly around on the gaint snake
Turn the staff into a combat light sword
weaknesses: Sapphire isthe source of power
Staff can be stolen

name: Delete This Selfless
description: First, you do your victory pose. Then, you start multiplying quickly. Moments later, your multiple duplicates rise right beside you and they begin to pummel the enemy from side to side in a blur as the opponent is beaten before a splat and a scream is heard.
summary: The ability to utterly multiply and pummel your opponent.
strengths: Could be a good thing when you are outnumbered.
weaknesses: Nothing bad here.

name: Emotional Bomb
description: If someone is calm, the shock wave will be as if you are half way in the water at the ocean and the waves hit you. The strongest shock wave is like someone dropped an atomic bomb.
summary: The ability to create a shock wave with the strength of one's anger.
strengths: You can defend yourself
People will not mess with you
You have a lot of power
weaknesses: People will fear you
You will be alone all the time
People will never want to be around you

name: Ability Information Library
description: Are your information powers causing mental overload? With this power, you problem will be solved. You can set your other powers to send their information into a mental bank, instead of your mind. You can then review your information in your own time, already sorted into the categories you need. Alternately, the information can simply appear as knowledge as it is needed (i. E. When speaking about world history, information from Psychometry may spontaneously surface.
summary: The ability to store information from powers in a special format.
strengths: No more mental overload.
Presorted information.
Can look through stored information in your own time.
weaknesses: Still limited to your own memory; you just access it as needed/wanted.
If you don't review your stored information, you may lose track of what you know.
Still takes up space in your memory, so you may need a memory-enhancing power.

name: Psychic Distraction
description: Focus in anything is key. A person with Psychic Distraction can consciously infulence another person's brain so that it loses some ability to sort information. The result? Small noises, motion, an itch that would normally be ignored suddenly merit full and automatic attention. This ability takes little energy to activate and can be left on for a radius-effect of squirrely people.
summary: The ability to dramatically decrease a person's attention span
strengths: Target loses ability to maintain focus
Can be used to sneak past unfocused people
Devastating in hand-to-hand combat
weaknesses: Weakens with range
Must be careful to not be noticed yourself
Can be accidentally left on, crippling allies

name: Precognitive Dreamer
description: With this power, you will have precognitive dreams about things that will happen in the near future (a few days). Most of the time, it will be an event that concerns you or your friends directly, but it can also be a very important world event, like the 9/11 attacks.
summary: The ability to have precognitive dreams.
strengths: See your future mistakes, and prevent them from happening.
Become the best medium ever.
Prevent disasters.
weaknesses: You don't always remember your dreams
It's random: you might end up not having precognitive dreams for more than a month.

name: Sentient Superpower
description: More noticeable if you have multiple superpowers. Each and every one of your powers acquires a personality. They are capable of acting on their own and taking over your body. Unlike DID, you are conscious of your condition and can discuss with your abilities. You have still access to all your powers, but using one may cause the power you're using to take over your body. Moreover, a certain power doesn't mean a defined personality. There are a lot of possible personalities that could fit.
summary: The ability to have each of your abilities have a personality of their own, including this one.
strengths: Your superpowers can perceive the world through you. So, they may notice something you don't.
If you can't stand up to someone, maybe one of your abilities will.
Each personality has access to the superpower they represent.
weaknesses: The more abilities you have, the more personalities you have to deal with.
There may be conflicts between your personalities.
You could lose your body to your abilities, though it's usually temporary.

name: Animated Arms
description: With this ability, you can create a pair of animated 3D hands and control them. You can use them to long-distance slap someone and never get caught. Can make them disappear too
summary: The ability to create a pair 3D animated arms and move them.
strengths: Have an extra arm under your control
weaknesses: If people see you creating them

name: Weapon Capture
description: This power will allow you to take there ability and store it in the sword. But sadly only one ability will be stored inside the sword. Once more the ability has a cost each blade must take at least a finger but it would be weak. If you cut off say the arm t will be fully stored and fully at its full potential. Going with any weapon. You can use bladed cards basically anything can be turn into a weapon:D. Others wont be able to use the weapon.
summary: The ability to take anyone's power by a single strike.
strengths: Have the ability of others.
Can work with any weapon.
Limitless
weaknesses: Say if you have a bow and arrow only the arrow will absorb it
Cant work with any explosive and or gun.
Only one weapon can hold in one power.

name: Sonar
description: Like bats or dolphins, you too can use the power of sonar to know your surroundings.  Never stuble in the dark again!  You only need to listen to the ambient noise around you and you will instantly have a 3D image in your mind of what your environment looks like.
summary: The ability to know your surroundings by hearing reflected sound waves.
strengths: Knowing what's behind you
See in the dark--save on energy bills
weaknesses: You might freak people out if you leave your house lights off all the time

name: Necroplasmic Summoning
description: Allows you to manipulate necroplasmic energy into solid, ghost-like apparitions to do your will
summary: The ability to summon ghost-like apparitions to do your bidding
strengths: Always have personal servants when you want them
Take the "goth" stereotype to a whole new level
Creep out your enemies
weaknesses: Too many summons will exhaust you rapidly
Some summons may take on a mind of their own

name: Human Damper
description: When you activate this power, it progressively converts your kinetic energy into heat, effectively dampening your movement. It only applies to the kinetic energy stored in your motion, so bodily functions aren't affected. Your body also becomes highly resistant to heat, but if the heat is too high, you will burn. You can only transform your own energy. If you want to affect someone or something else's energy, you need to be solidly connected to them so their kinetic energy is shared with you.
summary: The ability to dissipate the kinetic energy stored in your body as heat.
strengths: You can slow down more easily.
You can even decrease your terminal velocity if you are falling.
You have some form of heat resistance.
weaknesses: If the heat you produce is extremely high, you will burn. Also, you are not fire resistant.
If you want to dampen something else's speed, you need to be attached to them.

name: Plasma Vision
description: Plasma is a state of matter where the molecules have extremely high levels of energy. Good examples of plasma are fire and lightning. This power allows the user to fire bolts of plasma from their eyes to hurt enemies, burn down doors, etc.
summary: The ability to fire bolts of plasma from one's eyes
strengths: Can utilize something highly dangerous with your eyes.
Can turn this power off to minimze accidents.
weaknesses: Will still hurt you if you fire it at yourself.
Destroying a nice pair of sunglasses.

name: Flow Reversal
description: The reversal of Energy, as in Heat, Kinetic, and so on. This also means mild manipulation of movement in objects and so on.
summary: The ability to redirect energy
strengths: Ability to redirect several types of energy.
Stem the flow of small rivers.
Negate effect of mild radiation.
weaknesses: Cannot redirect Lightning or stop objects more than twice own mass.
Requires a degree of knowledge of Energy Types.

name: Atomic Filtering
description: When you touch something, you have tiny, atomic-sized pores on your skin that have vacuum-like properties. This vacuum pulls substances into it, and with a bioelectric charge, separates it into groups of like atoms. When the substances exit your pores, regroup and rebuild, you are left with basic elements. You can also reverse the process.
summary: The ability to separate substances on an atomic level.
strengths: You could separate deadly chemicals from the air to kill victims.
You could separate pollution from oxygen and breathe better air.
You could reverse the vacuum and launch out a glob of iron. Heh, face-breakin time!
weaknesses: You have to be in contact with the substance.
You have to know what you could use offensively and defensively.
You have to be pretty smooth, and quick-witted.

name: Euphoric Aura
description: You can really cheer someone up when your aura of complete blissful happiness spreads to them. They will become entranced & feel complete enlightened aligned centered zen. A nirvana state of euphoria. Without worry, fear, sad gloominess. Just happy thoughts. Though the down side to this happy power is it doesn't affect you, you have normal feelings & the people could become addicted to your heavenly aura & want you around forever.
summary: The ability to make a person become entranced with joy
strengths: You bring happiness to everyone around you
weaknesses: You can't use your happy power on yourself
The euphoria could become addictive for the people
People might withdraw & become depressed when you're not there

name: You're A Fictional Character
description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a fictional character by saying their full name, the name of the character and then say "Poof! ". EX: "John Doe, Bugs Bunny, Poof! " To turn them back you say the name of the character, the persons name and then poof. EX: "Bugs Bunny, John Doe, Poof! "
summary: The ability to change people into fictional characters
strengths: You can turn people into fictional character
You don't even have to snap (snap didn't fit in the title so oh well)
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Hallucinization
description: With this power, you can leave to physical plane and become an illusion in someone else's mind. You then become intangible to everyone but them. You know everything they know and can disappear and reappear at any time. However, while you are in their mind, you are extremely susceptible to chizophrenia medication and their thoughts. Exiting this mode takes a little effort, and you might not get out in time. Still, this power offers a multitude of uses.
summary: The ability to turn yourself into a hallucination
strengths: Easy transportation
Mind Reading
Drive people crazy
weaknesses: Can only affect the victim
If they stop believing that you exist, then you stop existing
The gun is in your hand... The gun is in my hand

name: Singularity Shapeshifter
description: You can turn into a vaguely humanoid exposed core of a black hole. You don't affect gravity, but gravity control has no effect on you. Any matter touching you will have its atoms ripped apart. Any energy beam striking you will be harmlessly scattered. You are a walking somewhat man-shaped breakdown of reality, so reality bending powers can't affect you directly. A probability controlling power could affect the world around you, hindering you, but not you.
summary: The ability to become a singularity, that is the core of a black hole.
strengths: Immune to direct attack.
Villains will leave their best gear at home if they're facing you.
Or just retire from villainy.
weaknesses: You can't save people or important objects using physical contact. No hostage rescue.
You have the potential to be worse than a bull in a china shop.
Destruction is your first, middle and last name.

name: Blessing Of Zeus
description: Zeus is the greek god of the skies. His blessing allows you to gain powers over his realm. You can create bolts of lightning strong enough to destroy a car or topple a small building. You can even call down lightning from the sky to charge you or your weapon. Also, Zeus's symbol is the eagle, so controlling eagles is now a simple extension of your will. You power is driven mainly by emotion, so watch out for lightning when you get upset.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Zeus
strengths: You have powers over the skies
Eagles are your servants
Lightning is incredibly powerful
weaknesses: You can't fly
Your emotions have more control over your powers than you do

name: Anger Control
description: Also called Four Humors: Yellow Bile. With this ability you are able to raise or lower the anger inside of people. You can strike the anger of a completely calm person and make them go into an unstoppable rage or make a completely angry person relax or sleep. Your anger levels can not be affected by Agitator Pulse, etc. At higher levels, Berserker Rage and Hatred could possibly be more powerful.
summary: The ability to completely control the anger in people.
strengths: You can make people not hate you.
Make people kill themselves by raising their rage level past limits, but that could make you evil.
Make Berserkers relaxed or fall asleep.
weaknesses: People can still kill you.
Only at the higher levels will anger-based powers be more powerful.
People with Emotionless, Omninscience, etc. Are not affected by this ability.

name: Zone Mirror
description: Any reflection is able to open the gateway.  You have to touch the reflection for it to open.  In the mirror zone, one can not be harmed or touched. But be warned he who enters has no guarantee that he will be able to leave the zone again.  You can only leave the zone if you know an exit and posses the power to open these portals.  Those who lack the power are stuck in this zone forever. Unless you know how to teleport.
summary: The ability to open a gateway into the Mirror dimension.
strengths: You can hide in a place where almost nobody is able to get.
Send enemies into an nigh-unescapeable prison.
Reflections are everywhere so there are many place in wich you can hide.
weaknesses: Blurry reflections might corrupt you as you travel from your current realm into the mirror zone.
If you forget how to leave the zone you risk getting stuck forever.
In this zone pain is joy, when you bleed you won't feel pain but you're still approaching death.

name: Lock Pick Fingers
description: With this power you can turn all ten of your fingers into lock picks, which can open any lock ever made, except for those that are sealed by magic. When you've finished all your lock picking antics, you can turn your lock picks back into fingers.
summary: The ability to turn your fingers into lock picks
strengths: You can turn your fingers into lock picks and then back into normal fingers
You can open any lock except for those sealed with magic
weaknesses: You can't open locks that are sealed by magic

name: Detective's Clairsentience
description: You just have to touch the cadaver of a man or an animal to have a vision of the murderer, and to have a vague idea of who he is and where you can find him.
summary: The ability to know the murderer of a man or an animal by touching its cadaver.
strengths: Best. Detective. Ever.
Exhume the body of JFK, and finally have the answer.
weaknesses: If you don't want to solve crimes, the this power is of no use to you.
You only have a vague idea to where the murderer is.

name: Spec Swap
description: A person with spec swap can change the specialty of any other power they posses. An power can be changed to an Offensive Spec or a Defensive spec or to any number of different specialties. Heal Spec or Damage Spec could make a power heal or hurt rather than what it was normally intended to do. Specs could include ranged, accuracy, area of effect, or speed. A poison spec would not work unless poison was a part of the power originally.
summary: The ability to change the specialty of a power.
strengths: Swap specs to what is needed currently.
Make a power heal or damage instead of what it normally does.
Have multiple specs to switch between.
weaknesses: Using a spec, such as Offensive, would make the Defensive side of the power weaker.
Takes time to change specs, but training can reduce the time.
Can't add on to a power, such as specializing in poison, without it already existing in the power.

name: Emf Manipulation
description: EMF or Electromotive force is what tends to cause current (actual electrons and ions) to flow. Manipulating EMF will make a change in voltaic cells, thermoelectric devices, solar cells, electrical generators, transformers, and even Van de Graaff generators, ceasing them or overloading them. Electromotive Force is smiliar to a magnetic field. In other words, one can use this to manipulate batteries, making them dead or to overloading them.
summary: The ability to manipulate Electromotive Force
strengths: Manipulate batteries. Hey, at least you won't have to go buy new ones.
A very unique power.
weaknesses: You do not have control over the Magnetic Field, just a certain kind.

name: Hyper Move
description: This ability will make you tired, but it will be worth it to release a catastrophic ability. This power will charge your body to perform one (or more if you're strong enough) move or technique in a destructive way. You can do it again within 5-10 min.
summary: The ability to launch a full on strike within one move.
strengths: Very powerful
Can perform any move with catastrophic force.
weaknesses: It will make you tired and weak.
You can do it again within 5-10 min.

name: Auto Negate
description: A person with this power has the ability to negate everything that directly affects them. This means that they cannot be the direct targets of any superpower. This obviously means no instant kill powers work on them. They also cannot be lifted up by telekinesis. Indirect attacks still work. For example the telekinetic can still throw boxes at said person. This power also negates the positive effects of your own powers that affect you directly.
summary: The ability to automatically negate the effects of any power that directly affects you
strengths: No instant death or erasure from existence
No type of power theft at all
Another Con or Pro: You cannot be teleported
weaknesses: Can still be hurt by indirect attacks
Also negates any positive effects of any power that directly affects you
Can still be trapped in a time loop if time is targetted not you

name: Ultimate Pyrokinesis
description: A person with this power can create a flame of any size and the flame has the the property of being able to burn anything even abstract concepts like souls and time. The flame is unextinguishable and cannot be moved from the place where it was made. The flames can spread if it catches onto another burnable fuel(which can be anything). It does not require oxygen to burn but it can be spread through sparks catching on to other objects. Flames also burn any incoming controller force.
summary: The ability to create a flame down to the very concept that is also unextinguishable
strengths: Your flames are unstoppable
Once someone gets burned they will stay on fire until burned completely or until eternity
If you time it right you can stop your own flames by burning it with another flame-very hard to do
weaknesses: Your flames are permanent and stay stuck so you will have to prevent it from spreading
You cannot control your own flames except control where they start
Since it burns time anything around the flame will be distorted so you cannot even see your flames

name: Black  Out
description: Whenever this power is activated you release a cloud of black smoke around you that is like a dark fog. Your eyes eventually evolve to see through this giving you an added bonus of night vision, but only after being exposed to it for a while. However that being the case your eyes will become extremely sensitive to light in general.
summary: The ability to emit a cloud of darkness around you like a smoke bomb
strengths: Ninja vanish
Can see in the dark
weaknesses: Light
Equals
Bad

name: Paradise Planner
description: God saw how you're dissapointed with the world he's made, so he gave you a chance at creating a universe to see if you can do better. You must plan this universe precisely, from every event(assuming you want time to exist), to the nature of life in that world, to the location of every object(assuming this universe is physical). Every soul that has ever lived in the old universe must be included in your new universe somehow, and after it has ended they will judge it and compare it to the old one.
summary: The ability to plan, create, and live in your idea of a perfect world.
strengths: You are given a room with a computer for notes and every form of comfort that you could ever want
You will live forever in any form you choose, and you will never forget anything.
You can try as many times as you want, and, if you give up, you can return back to the old world.
weaknesses: People might not like any of your ideas of paradise.
Highly likely that, unless you're extremely determined, you may eventually give up after some time.
Highly unlikely that you will ever create something better than someone who is already omnipotent.

name: Desert Control
description: Deserts are harsh environments that very few can survive in. This power allows you to control the sand and heat that make up deserts. Summon scorching sandstorms to blind and burn opponents, use blasts of sand to wear down and cut things, or create sand constructs. You can even create a small desert to fight in, ideal for you but horrible for opponents. You can also use heat for many things. Just be careful not to let your power get out of control and end up creating a new Sahara.
summary: The ability to create and control sand and heat
strengths: Create harsh desert conditions that only you can really fight it
Lots of uses for heat and sand
weaknesses: Creating deserts you can't get rid of

name: Good Intent Resistance
description: This ability allows you to resist any physical attack, illness, superpower, spell, reality change or any other action that would have an effect on you. You have complete control over what you have resistance to. This power will only work if your intentions in life are pure and good. Your power of resistance will increase depending on how pure your intentions are.
summary: The ability to resist anything if your intentions are pure.
strengths: You can resist ageing to prolong life.
You will have a huge advantage in fights if your intentions are good.
weaknesses: If your intentions are bad, the power works against you, making you weaker.
Useless if you use it only to fight, for no particular reason.

name: Hobby Powers
description: With this ability, you'll have powers related to your hobbies and will make them more productive, easier, and more fun. If your into pottery, you can dry your items without the need of a kiln. If your an author for fun, you can write on a surface without a pen or pencil or type with your mind, etc.
summary: The ability to have powers related to your hobby or hobbies
strengths: Hobby is a lot more fun
Can impress your friends with stuff you can make
weaknesses: Not really useful in combat

name: Green Guardsmen Power Ring
description: The user is able to form constructs made up of pure energy from a green power ring using the power of justice. These rings choose people on their ability to have great virtue , is just and have no mood for injustice. The ring's only weakness is the negative energy used by the grey power rings which is injustice and evil. The symbol of the ring is a shield. The battery source is stored in a giant scale of justice placed in the Green Guardsmen Corps homeworld
summary: The ability to use the mysterious green  power of justice
strengths: Can make constructs made out of pure of energy fueled by justice
Can shoot bolts and beams of pure energy
weaknesses: Weak against negative power of injustice
Must recharge the ring using a power source from a miniature golden scale.

name: Flying Cars
description: With this power you can give any vehicle the ability to fly and you will instantly know how to fly it. You can make cars, boats, submarines, bikes, scooters, wingless planes, rotorless helicopters etc. The ability to soar through the skies at whatever speed they were able to go one the ground/water/space.
summary: The ability to give any vehicle the ability to fly
strengths: You can give vehicles the ability to fly
You will know how to fly them
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You only know how to fly vehicles you've already used this power on

name: Just In Time
description: With this power whenever you have to be at an event or a show or anything you'll always be exactly on time not a second before not a second later. You can turn this power off so you can be early to things or fashionably late for things if you want.
summary: The ability to be just on time
strengths: You will always be on time
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force3
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Orthanes (Orthannes, Orthages, Orthagenes- sexual arousal), one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects who are attracted to oneself, and/or to whom one is attracted, at will. In addition, one psychically withstand being knocked off of one's feet (ie remain standing 'erect'), at will. One can even gain physical power in the presence of large phallic objects (skyscrapers etc).
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
strengths: Psychically perceive and compel attractive/attracted subjects, at will
Withstand being knocked off of one's feet, at will (if you choose, lay down to sleep, etc)
Gain physical power in the presence of large phallic objects (the bigger, the better)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically immobilize people standing upright, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate phallic objects (baseball bats, pipes, etc), until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Power Fusion
description: This gives the user the ability to fuse someone elses power with another and make it one. In order for this to work, the two subjects must be in physical contact with each other at all times for the user to fuse their powers. For example, if the user combines the powers of invisibility and super strength, both targets will be invisible and super strong as long as they remain physically contacted with each other. Once contact is seperated, the fusion is canceled. Some powers may not be fusible.
summary: The ability to fuse any power with another
strengths: Fuse two powers together to create something better
No time limit
weaknesses: Targets have to have phyical contact with each other until the fusion is canceled
Some powers may not be fusible

name: Attack Replicating Ground
description: You need to direct one of your attacks toward the ground which will absorb it. Then, the same attack will be released from the ground in one of three ways. First, the attack can be released all around you, save for a tight spot where you stand. Second, it can be released out of a remote area. Third, it can progressively be released toward a target, following them if they move. The attack released is the same as the one dealt to the ground, but replicated to cover a bigger surface.
summary: The ability to let the ground below you absorb your attack and release it over a big surface.
strengths: You can greatly increase the power of an attack and its range.
Just stick a sword in the ground and create hundreds of blades.
Shoot fire toward the ground and create fields of fire.
weaknesses: It only works on the ground and you could attack yourself in the process if you're not careful.
It only lasts as long as you keep attacking the ground with your attack.
The attacks can only be released from the ground in your vicinity and your visual field.

name: Curse Of Life
description: The Curse of Life, a powerful curse that affects the user instead of someone else. Once used, the person who uses it can't die, from disease, old age, or any form of attacks. The head can be severed from the body, and it will still live. Injuries will heal at a supernatural pace also. However, it is a curse because it allows the user to never die.
summary: The ability to be constantly affected by the Curse of Life.
strengths: Can't die ever.
weaknesses: You have to live forever.
The people you love will continue to die around you.
Can still feel pain.

name: Combustion Projection
description: This is one of the most dangerous abilities. A Combustion Projector can generate a powerful ray that super-heats the air around the first object it contacts. The oxygen explodes, destroying the target. This ability is very powerful, but it has its drawbacks. The ray can only be projected by the forehead, and a direct blow to its middle will block the ability for a while. It is also hard to control at first; the beginner must be careful to not maim or kill himself.
summary: The ability to generate an explosive beam from the forehead
strengths: Extremely dangerous
Good for combat
Nigh-unstoppable
weaknesses: Can only be projected from the forehead
Direct blow to the forehead's middle temporarily paralyzes the ability
Hard to control at first

name: Star Sight
description: The ability to predict future events on earth by watching the stars and planets.
summary: The ability to predict future events by watching the stars
strengths: Being able to predict natural disasters
weaknesses: Some times you will feel separated from reality.
You have to see the stars.

name: The Write Stuff
description: When you forge a signature, you actually channel the person, perfectly replicating their writing style.
summary: The ability to perfectly forge anyone's handwriting.
strengths: Never have to bring home a permission slip again.
Get all the prescription drugs you want.
Get bills passed.
weaknesses: Prepare for possible incarceration for fraud.
People will be asking you for celebrity autographs.

name: Insomnia
description: Have you ever been in a heated battle with an arch foe and you grow overwhelmingly tired? With Insomnia, you're able to put yourself into a trance and stay awake as your senses and strength heighten. But if you stay in the trance too long, you'll turn into a brainless zombie for eternity. Or until a slayer kills you.
summary: The ability to go with out sleep and heighten your senses.
strengths: Able to stay awake to fight.
Grow stronger.
Senses heighten.
weaknesses: Stay in trance too long & you'll turn into a zombie.
A slayer may kill you.

name: Timeline Protector
description: The timeline from the moment you acquired this ability to the moment you lose it cannot be altered or prevented from flowing. In other words, any power that manipulate time won't work. There may be moments when your ability is cancelled, but, once it's reactivated, the timeline will snap back to what it should be, voiding any modification. Also, if someone travels through time during a period when your ability is cancelled, they can't go outside this period, as your ability acts as a time wall.
summary: The ability to protect the integrity and existence of your timeline.
strengths: Always active. As long as you have this power, time can't be slowed down, sped up or stopped.
Any power that affects reality or allows time travel won't work.
The periods when this power is active can neither be changed nor travelled through with time travel.
weaknesses: Can be cancelled. Though any modification is voided when your ability is reactivated.
If you're discovered, time manipulators may try to kill you to use their abilities.
You can't alter time either.

name: Grey Matter
description: You might get a strange feeling if you try to walk past and touch an unknown person who turns out to be a criminal. You are then able to witness, listen, and know what the evildoer is up to.
summary: The ability to see, hear and realize what a villain knows just by touching them.
strengths: You might inform the Police, the FBI or the CIA to let them know what the villain is planning next.
weaknesses: You'll have bad dreams.
The criminals might know you too.

name: Sleep Absorption
description: This allows you to suck the energy anyone gained from their sleep through touch. You can take as much energy as you want but no more than what they gained during their lifetime. If you take too much, the victim will get symptoms of sleep deprivation, but you will be able to stay awake, heal faster, enhance your memory and have an energy boost among other things. Symptoms include dizziness, hallucinations, increased blood pressure, immunity deficiency, loss of memory, dementia and even death.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy anyone gained during their sleep.
strengths: Gain all the benefits of sleeping without losing your time.
You will never feel the need to sleep again. You could do so much more and gain so much time.
You have control over the activation of this ability.
weaknesses: You could severely incapacitate or even kill someone with this ability.
You will never have dreams or nightmares. Daydreams will never beat that feeling of unconsciousness.
It will take a lot of sleep before that person recovers what they lost.

name: Crystal Growth
description: The crystal can be any kind of crystal. It will grow from any size to however large and any shape you want it to be at a rate of 27 cubic centimetres per second.
summary: The ability to cause crystals to grow by touching the crystals
strengths: Can always have weapons with you.
Crystals won't set off metal detectors.
weaknesses: It will take some time to get weapons and items of the needed size.
Always need to have some kind of cryystal around for this power to be effective.
Can't change the properties of the crystals except for size and shape with this power.

name: Target Eye
description: Also known as Eyehole Effect. This power causes objects to be attracted toward what the person see similar to a blackhole. Also the user can distort light in front of their eye so that they can see things that are farther away up to 2500 meters. Eye gets stronger the more it is used-the retina gets bigger and the eye veins grow. When at its peak, the user can create a black hole where they are seeing thus being extremely strong but the user becomes effectively blind. Best used for sniping.
summary: The ability to cause projectiles to home in at what you are seeing and if mastered a black hole
strengths: As long as you are looking at it, nearby projectiles will be attacted to it like a blackhole
Target Eye also give the user vision up to 2500 meters-the range for this ability
Can deactivate the power at will in early stages or by closing your eyes
weaknesses: Another Pro: You can just train one eye to have the black hole
Dangerous to user when up close(Blast Radius-and sucked into own hole)
Continued use causes lack of control and leads to Blackhole Vision

name: Persistent Revival
description: A person with this power refuses to give up. When they are knocked out or if their heart stops, the body sends an electrical signal that either restarts the heart or wakes up the person, regardless of their physical condition. Also, the body will be able to perform CPR on itself to resuscitate the user. However, this does not fully revive the person's strength.
summary: The ability to revive oneself when put out of commission
strengths: The toughest wrestler-Who can pin you down unconscious?
Can't be knocked out by sucker punches. Will get back up.
You can be revived indefinitely as long as you have the will to fight
weaknesses: You can still die
People will think that you are a glutton for punishment
You can still feel pain

name: Anesthetize
description: You could stop feeling pain. Blind, deafen, numb people.  You may make someone not sense anything but pain. Like a numbing medicine, only all-around. Cut off a hindering sense, too.
summary: The ability to remove senses.
strengths: Can fight without the trouble of pain.
Make your enemies senseless and kill them with ease.
Make people know only pain.
weaknesses: When you anesthetize yourself, you won't know if a vital part has been hit.

name: Torrental Darkness Rain
description: The user first presses his or her palms together which will collect all the darkness in the vincity of the user. It is compressed into the form of a sphere and, depending on how long the users palms remain together, the more darkness will be collected and, in effect, the more powerful the attack is. The user can then release the darkness by unlocking his or her palms in a forcefull motion. The darkness cannot be redirected back to the users palms once released.
summary: The ability to release a torent of destructive darkness at the target.
strengths: The darkness will pursue the target until it is either dead or destroyed.
The darkness cannot be dodged, blocked, redirected or stopped in any way.
The dark force can be adjusted according to the forcefullness of the movement needed to release it.
weaknesses: The darkness is extremely destructive and can branch out in all directions if not controlled.
The darkness will permanently destroy all life from organisms that it comes into contact with.
The darkness cannot be redirected once it has been released.

name: Distance Locker
description: When you activate this power, your current distance with your target will be locked. So, if one of you tries to get near or away, it would push away or drag the other to keep the distance between you constant. And if the latter tries to resist, the former will feel the resistance. Used effectively, you could prevent anyone from getting close or away, keep a safe distance from something or someone, or avoid being flown or teleported far away by locking your distance with the ground.
summary: The ability to lock your distance with something/someone, so neither of you can get near or away from the other.
strengths: You can severely impede someone else's movements.
Coupled with Superhuman Speed, you can drag someone to death.
Coupled with Superstrength, you can push/drag anything or anyone without touching them.
weaknesses: You can severely impede your own movements.
If your opponent has Superhuman Speed, they can drag you to death.
If your opponent has Superstrength, they can push/drag you without touching you.

name: Illusory Wishes
description: A person with this power can grant anyone's wishes through illusions. For example, if someone wished for a hamburger, they would instantly see a hamburger and start to eat it despite it being a tree branch or etc. If someone wishes for someone back from the dead, then you can create an illusory duplicate of the same person, but they cannot be grabbed, etc. or if you are evil, you can replace it with a sword, so the person hugs the sword and dies by bleeding.
summary: The ability to grant anyone's wishes with an illusion
strengths: You can grant any wish (except it is an illusion)
You can grant your own wishes (but you know it isn't real)
