Can be used as pranks or kill people deceptively
weaknesses: It's not real
Someone has to actively wish for something for you to grant it

name: Warp Spasm
description: Warp Spasmers are dangerous to see, mainly because that means the Spasmer can see you. A person with Warp Spasm involuntarily goes into one when they have become enraged to the point of no return. Their bones and flesh twist in their skin, their features distort like wax, and they go mad. In this state, they cannot feel pain and have enhanced speed, strength, and endurance. They are very difficult to stop and will kill anyone on sight, usually starting with the source of their anger.
summary: The ability to distort your body in a spasm of rage
strengths: Happens whenever you are absolutely furious
Unable to feel pain
Enhanced strength, speed, and endurance
weaknesses: Involuntary
Hard to keep yourself from spasming
May kill friends, family, etc.

name: Photoshop Reality
description: This applies to Photoshop and all similar programs. You will be able to alter reality by using the program on an image or photograph. The only limits are your imagination and skill with the program. Once you become very skilled with this, you will be able to create objects or even living things.
summary: The ability to alter reality by using Photoshop
strengths: Alter anything that you have an image of
Skilled users will be able to create objects and living things
weaknesses: You need a computer and the program to use it
Can take some time to do it right

name: The Four Swords Of Power
description: The four swords of power are four stone swords that have been influential throughout history. They are Excalibur the sword of Ice, Clarent the sword of Fire, Durendal the sword of Air and Joyeuse the sword of Earth. With this power you can summon all four at the same time and fuse them into one weapon. Together they give you each of their individual powers along with the power to summon Coatlicue, The Mother of All Gods, who will devour your enemies.
summary: The ability to summon and wield all four ancient swords of power at the same time.
strengths: Use all four sword's power at once.
Summon Coatlicue
weaknesses: You get all the negative effects of weilding all four swords
Coatlicue will eat you if you summon her and there is no other food.

name: Fisticuff
description: With this power, the user breaks both speed and stamina barriers allowing them to punch their enemy for hours or even days without the enemy being able to escape the blows or dodge them. Fisticuff can even "speed match" to keep superspeed or teleporting opponents from escaping. Unfortunately, the move is strictly punches and so the chain can be broken by an accidental alternative blow such as a kick, throw, headbutt, or even open hand blow. This would allow an escape for the enemy.
summary: The ability to deliver an endless amount of high speed punches to an enemy
strengths: You can never get tired of punching and so can deliver blows for hours or even days
"Speed match" keeps even quick-moving enemies unable to escape.
weaknesses: All blows have to be punches in order to work
The chain can be broken if a blow is delivered that is not a punch, such as a kick or a throw

name: Vanishing Act
description: You can vanish for up to a millenium and you can choose when and where to reappear. However, it has too be on the same continent you vanished from. You would essentially be non-existant during that time, so you have no information of what happens during your absence. To you, your absence seems like a second. The only way it can be undone is by yourself or by time travel.
summary: The ability to vanish off the face of the planet.
strengths: Vanish for any amount of time up to a millenium.
Excellent evasion and mystery.
Great teleportation: you can reappear anywhere on the continent you vanished from.
weaknesses: Irreversible (except for time travel).

name: Technological Clock
description: It basically means that you could go to a tiny tribe, jump the technology forward and make them superior to modern US. Basically, make any technology more or less advanced. It can be very useful.
summary: The ability to control the level of technology
strengths: Mess with people you don't like
Jump humanity forward (cool!)
Make your stuff better than anyone else's
weaknesses: It only works as long as you're thinking it

name: Willpower: Will Of Corruption
description: A person with this ability has the power to corrupt the freewill of other people by forcing his willpower upon them. The willpower of the user dwells within the mind of his victim; it acts like a poison that merges with the victim's mind and freewill in order to 'rewrite' them. In effect those who were corrupted no longer possess the ability to choose for themselves; instead they act or think in submission to the willpower that took hold of their very existence.
summary: The ability to corrupt the freewill of other people.
strengths: Concentration is not necessary. You just need to poison them with your willpower.
Victims think and act just like you. The need to control them is no longer needed
No conscious being that possess freewill is immune to this ability.
weaknesses: The act of projecting your willpower to corrupt others require absolute mastery.
Corruption may take time depending on the willpower utilized.
Victims eventually die.

name: Under Mass
description: Anything with less mass than you is now a simple extension of your will. I'm fond of example, so let's say you have an apple. You can move the apple, teleport it, send it through time, change it into an orange, disintegrate it, clone it, change its DNA structure, or do anything else with it you can imagine. But there are rules. You can't convert something into something living unless it was alive to begin with. And you can't control anything that has more mass than yourself.
summary: The ability to control anything with less mass than yourself
strengths: Very powerful
The more you can imagine, the more you can do.
weaknesses: No creating life
You can only control things that have less mass than you

name: Godparent Intuition
description: With this power, you can bestow superpowers on any infant. The power/s will slowly develop as the child grows up and they will become aware of their abilities when they are ready to handle them. You are free to choose who gets what superpower and you can put limitations on any of them. However, this is the only power you can possess and it doesn't work on yourself. You can bestow a superpower on an infant only before they reach the age of 1. They can have multiple powers as well.
summary: The ability to bestow any superpower on any infant
strengths: Help kids out by giving them superpowers
Be a sort of fairy-godmother/father
You are extremely powerful in your own way
weaknesses: You don't know if the child will grow up to use the power for evil
Might ruin a kid's life
You might give them the wrong power for their personality

name: Jelly Stingers
description: A person with this power has developed cnidocyte cells. In other words they can sting people like jellyfish. They can decide the lethality of their sting from simply stunning to putting people into a coma or straight up killing.
summary: The ability to have cnidocyte cells(stinging cells)
strengths: Can sting people
It can be volunary but being surprised causes you to accidentally use it
Can decide the lethality from stun to coma to kill
weaknesses: Being surprised causes you to use it-----(though nonlethally)
No aqautic adaptation (no breathing underwater, or otherwise mimicking a jellyfish)

name: Danger Cloaking
description: This ability really uses the term "Hidden Dangers" to a new extreme. This ability affects anything that the user conceives as a threat or danger like a volcano about to erupt, lion ready to pounce, or even a new disease. Then they will place it into a pocket dimension. The user can use this pocket dim. In 2 ways. It could store the threat until the user escapes or use that threat as a trap for others. The second option shows that these dim. Have time stopping effects on things inside them.
summary: The ability to hide threats and dangers in a pocket dimension (dim.).
strengths: Put anything you think is a threat in a pocket dim.
Use that chance to escape the threat or use the threat as a trap for others
The trap activates as soon as the victim steps in to the area where the threat was sealed.
weaknesses: When not used as a trap, the threat will come out within an hour or so.

name: Abomination Materialization
description: This ability allows the user create animals and beast that beyond the laws of nature. They are freaks, but they are powerful. The user doesn't get full control at first, but eventually they will.
summary: The ability to create horrific creature that do not fit in the natural order.
strengths: Make abominations
Eventually Control them
weaknesses: They will kill if you cannot control them.

name: Phobomaniacal Form
description: With this ability, you can transform into a state which grows and gains power from the fears of others. You become a dark, horrifying beast. Not only do you also become larger and more powerful, but as you grow, you become increasingly terrifying, and you may strike people with claws which put them into a state of shock and fear. You can also let off a horrendous roar, which causes emotional trauma, and can potentially kill people, depending on how strong you have become.
summary: The ability to transform into a state which grows and gains power from fear.
strengths: Strike people with claws, or let off a horrendous roar which can cause emotional trauma or kill.
You become more invulnerable to physical, emotional, and mental damage the larger you become.
Growing larger will probably strike additional fear into people.
weaknesses: Resistance to fear will cause you to lose power, and revert if you become weak enough.
People with less fear towards you can cause more damage.
Once you revert, you lose the effects gained while in this form.
tags: Paul McCartney's wife (Vespert: lol How dare you!)

name: Condensation
description: With this power, you can condense anything you can see into any size smaller than it was originally. For example, you can condense a cloud to flood the area below it. You can condense your enemy into a pile of flesh and bone. Even make a black hole out of the Earth by condensing it. You just need to be able to see the object. You cannot expand an object though.
summary: The ability to condense material with your mind.
strengths: Flood an area with a cloud.
Kill that guy with a gun.
weaknesses: Diabolical people will destroy the Earth.
You cannot put something back to the way it was.
What will you do with that pile of flesh?

name: Nightfall
description: This is the ability to generate an aura of psionic darkness around oneself. This aura of darkness makes the area around it look like it would at night (hence the name), and psionically blinds everybody in the field, along with making anyone within the aura/field appear invisible to anyone outside of the aura/field. Not to mention, this aura also protects the user and anyone else within the field from intense light, as the field absorbs all ambient light within a certain radius.
summary: The ability to produce an aura that produces various night/dark related effects
strengths: You can see within the aura
Foes can't see within the aura
If you have another power like lycanthropy or invisibility in darkness, it's activated
weaknesses: If you suck and can't see in your own aura
If your loved ones can't see in the aura
People can see you coming (a big radius of darkness surrounds you)

name: Bone Breaker
description: With this power you can break any person's bones with a snap of your fingers. You need to have that person in front of you. Concentrate on the bone to break, and then snap your fingers. Also, you can fix bones with the same procedure. It is better if you have an extensive knowledge of human anatomy.
summary: The ability to break bones with a snap of your fingers
strengths: Break the bones of your enemies in any dangerous situation.
Repair bone in any accident
You will never have a broken bone
weaknesses: Needs full concentration in the beginning
If you aren't careful, can cause serious damage to yourself or others.
People will suffer in pain if you don't use it wisely

name: Holy Power: Prismatic Volley
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you absorb a small amount of the universe tissue, focusing and comprising it inside the Pistols, and then releasing it against your enemy, attacking him with every element of the universe and destroying your target completely. This power wastes a regular amount of energy, and its range is safe and precise.
summary: The ability to shoot a volley of shots from all existing elements in the universe, destroying the target completely
strengths: Powerful, Safe and Precise, this ability is the perfect elemental power.
Doesn't wastes too much energy.
With all elements in the universe, its nearly impossible to survive this power.
weaknesses: Takes a few seconds to get all the elemental energy.
Using this power too much can cause damages to the universe tissue and cause weird things to happen.

name: Heavy Rain Glasses
description: These glasses are wirelessly connected to the internet, satellites, and various other things that can be used to find out what you need to know. Here's how it works: A person leaves their wallet on the ground. Activate the scanner on the glasses and it can identify it's owner using any DNA and fingerprints left on it. It can then find their address, phone number, etc.
summary: The ability to use a pair of glasses that can gather enormous amounts of information.
strengths: Find all sorts of information about friends and enemies
Can be used for blackmail
weaknesses: They can break
No real combat purposes

name: Scarecrow (Scare Crow)
description: This ability is really good if you prefer to scare than attack. This causes any humanoid likeness (ventriloquist's dummies, mannequins, dolls and, of course, scarecrows) to become more and more creepy until it's creepy enough to bring to life. When they've reached their "peak creepiness", and enough fear has been imparted into the desired effigies, they can be animated; they will be able to exert greater strength and speed than any being that fears them.
summary: The ability to make inanimate humanoid likenesses become very creepy, and use their creepiness to animate them
strengths: Creep enemies out
The creeping discomfort that they generate allows them to come to life temporarily
They can exert greater strength or speed than (and track) any being that finds them scary
weaknesses: Only works on inanimate humanoid likenesses (dummies, dolls, mannequins, etc.)
If they creep YOU out, too, then they can overpower YOU, as well
Animation is only temporary

name: Hades
description: Hades the god of the underworld, also referred to as Hades the god of riches and the dead. This power not only gives you the power to manifest vast amounts of riches to your disposal whenever you wish, but it also allows you to control the dead. You also have Cerberus as your partner, but all dogs big or small have needs. It's very unwise to ignore the needs of this 30 story puppy. You'll reek of corpses most of the time and have pale skin.
summary: The ability to gain the powers of the god of the underworld.
strengths: Untold riches
Control of the dead. (souls and zombies)
Giant three headed dog at your disposal
weaknesses: Giant dog droppings. (grab the pooper scooper)
Reek of corpses
Pale skin

name: Lucky Last Shot
description: Whenever you fire a gun, your accuracy is increased in proportion with the amount of bullets left. This way your last few shots will almost always hit where you want them to and be incredibly deadly.
summary: The ability to good for last ditch efforts
strengths: You will always succeed at something the first time you try it
Accuracy doesn't decrease proportionally, just increase
weaknesses: No accuracy increase with machine guns
Only works for firearms (no longbows or bazookas).

name: Werepire
description: It can only work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire, and you'll become a werepire (often referred to some as werevamp and vampwolf). Your strength and speed increase significantly, allowing you to move several meters and down a story in less than a second, as well as the ability to change partially, such as your eyes and teeth and even turn your fingers into claws.
summary: The ability to become and posses the powers of both Werewolves and Vampires.
strengths: Can't be affected by sunlight.
Could turn others into Werepires.
weaknesses: It'll work when you are bitten by a werewolf and a vampire.

name: Positive Power Charge
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling positive.
E.g Happy, cheerful, joyous, excited.
However you are weakened by people with negative feeling. Ths power opposes Negative Power Charge.
summary: The ability to gain strength based on positive feelings and emotions.
strengths: You feeling positve, doubles the extent of your power.
weaknesses: Must rely on people having positive feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Luxuria
description: This ability allows the user to cast an illusion(s) to another person based on their most intimate desires. For example the person may see the one they love confessing to them, or perhaps see a harem of women(or men) relinquishing themselves. The illusion is very powerful and cannot be broken easily. Even if the person realizes that its an illusion that alone will not break it.
summary: The ability to cast an Illusion to another based on their most intimate desires
strengths: Can work on just about everybody
Can't be broken by mere recognization of the illusion
weaknesses: Though powerful and realistic it's a mere illusion
The length of the illusion is affected by the users own energy and power

name: Photon Repressed Superstrength
description: Photon-Repressed Superstrength is generated by specialized cells all over the body. However, light causes these cells to become inoperative. So, at 12 midnight under a cloudy sky, you could bench 100 tons. At noon under the sun, you could bench 100 pounds.
summary: The ability to have superhuman strength determined by how dark it is
strengths: Become an awesome night watchman
Impress people at night concerts
Beat people up in the night and leave
weaknesses: Little to no superhuman endurance
Little to no superhuman durability
Light, day, night in New York, floodlights, etc.

name: Animal Empathic Communication
description: Like Wild Thornberries, you will be able to talk to animals & have them understand you. Animals will also be able to talk to you & you will understand them. Even though you understand each other, it doesn't mean that dangerous, hungry animals won't attack you.
summary: The ability to speak to & understand all animals & vice versa
strengths: Talk with animals & have an understanding of each other
Animals will help you if you need assistance
weaknesses: Dangerous animals might still attack you
Some animals might not shut up

name: Arcana: 8 Strength
description: You are strong, fast, invulnerable to harm! As long as you stay calm and centered. As opposed to getting stronger from fury, this power makes you grow in strength from calmness. The angrier and more emotional you get, the weaker you get. Showing extreme rage or sorrow will make you weaker than a normal person. A totally centered and calm person with this power would be able to tip over skyscrapers, run faster than the wind, and survive being hit by a bullet train.
summary: The ability to get stronger, faster, and more durable the calmer and more serene you are.
strengths: Strong, Fast, and Hard to hurt.
Harder to mentally dominate.
weaknesses: Showing emotions makes you weak. Literally.

name: Nine Dragons
description: You could conjure up to nine blazing dragon spirits which fly towards, elevates & coils around your foes and then whips and damages them. Your foe is left burned in yellow-orange flames.
summary: The ability to fire 9 flaming dragons that'll swirl & engulf your opponent.
strengths: It is super effective against plant type foes.
Melts off Ice type objects and opponents.
weaknesses: None

name: Obsession Generation
description: The length of the message and the number of times it will be repeated depend on the energy you will spend to create it. Your target can also reduce the number of repetitions if they perform certain actions related to the message. For example, for "dirty", they can wash themselves or clean their house; for "the door's not locked", they can go all the way to their house and check their door; for "red is death", they can avoid touching red things or saying words with the sound "red".
summary: The ability to make a message of your choosing repeat itself over and over again in someone's mind.
strengths: You can easily drive someone to madness, paranoia, suicide or murder.
It can be an effective way to brainwash someone.
A little energy is needed to use this power, so a message can be repeated for hours.
weaknesses: The victim reduce the number of repetitions. But, they need to perform certain actions to do so.

name: Mercury Mimicry
description: A person with this power can turn into a mercury based form that can alter its phase and body physiology at will. In the mercury form, they have all the properties of mercury in the given form, as well as resistance to heat and a sort of heat detection capability. However, all the properties of mercury are copied, including toxicity and diamagnetism. I.e. can not touch people without poisoning them and is repelled by strong magnets. You can regenerate or grow larger by consuming mercury.
summary: The ability to turn into a mercury based form which can change its phase or shape at will
strengths: Gives you heat detection capability----think thermometers
Alterable form--Liquid, solid, and gas and alterable body physiology
You are dangerous to touch and bulletproof and heatproof and can regenerate by absorbing mercury
weaknesses: Too dangerous in mercury form ie can't grab someone to safety because of mercury poisoning
Can be called thermometer man as an insult
Affected by magnets

name: Harry Potter Magic
description: With this ability the owner of it can use spells to accomplish a variety of things, lighting fires, instant killing, torture, mind control, teleporting. You need to know the incantation, or atleast the spell name, you also do not require a wand.
summary: The ability to use spells, techniques from the Harry Potter Brand.
strengths: Occlumency (Prevents mind control).
Legilimency (Mind Reading).
Instant killing.
weaknesses: You may need to be a Harry Potter fan boy/girl.
Anti Magic Abilities.

name: Half Wyvern
description: Someone who has this power has wings proportional to their body, fangs, and a long tail with an arrow-shaped barb. Anyone who they bite with their fangs will contract a deadly but noncontagious disease. Also, someone with this power will have boosted strength.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-wyvern
strengths: If you bite your enemies, they will die in pain.
weaknesses: Long-range fighters prevent the use of the bite.

name: King's Cross
description: You can send a glowing turquoise cross from your chest in front of you directly towards the opponent or float in mid-air having several crosses kinetically imbued within spinning, swirling & surrounding around you, these follow as you fly damaging or killing every villain on sight. As it hits the enemy he/she will be quickly disintegrated.
summary: The ability to fire a huge light blue cross from your chest.
strengths: It protects you from the Dark Arts.
weaknesses: They will fade as it lasts for eight turns.

name: Perceptible Magnetism
description: Magnetic fields are all around us, whether in the earth's magnetic field, around electrical objects, even very small ones in the brain. This power allows you to see those fields visually as colours, and so be able to tell things like the strength and direction. Always know exactly where North is. Be able to sense electrical equipment. Know in advance if an enemy is going to use a magnetic manipulation attack. The possibilities are endless!
summary: The ability to see the magnetic field lines around you as colour gradients.
strengths: Always navigate perfectly with no need for a compass. Could be helpful with Flight.
Sense where and how powerful electrical equipment is.
Preempt magnetic superpowers by sensing disturbances in local magnetic fields.
weaknesses: No control over magnetic fields, just perception.
Could be distracting, but focus is needed to use it so you probably wouldn't notice it normally.

name: Song Of Healing
description: With this power, you have the ability to heal tormented souls with a song. Upon being healed and departing from this world, the soul leaves behind a mask. These masks allow you to transform into the mask's owner as they were just before death, granting you access to all of their abilities. People will recognize you as that person, but you will not have their memories or personality, so be careful. The masks can be taken off at any time and can be worn by anyone.
summary: The ability to heal tormented souls and turn them into masks.
strengths: Potentially unlimited mask transformations.
Perfect disguises.
Masks can be removed at any time or even given to other people.
weaknesses: You do not have memory of the mask owner's life.
People will believe that owner of the mask is dead, so be careful.
This power does not allow you to see, locate, or communicate with tortured souls.

name: Library Of Dreams
description: A person can access this library when they fall asleep. This will be akin to a lucid dream where they enter a library. In the library are all the books erased from history ie burned destroyed etc and books that were thought up but never published. Unfortunately you can only access these books for the duration of your sleeping time. You get kicked out when you wake up in real life. Also you cannot recall enough to write the books down when you wake up, although you remember the details perfectly.
summary: The ability to have access to all books that were erased from history or never published when dreaming
strengths: Can have access to all the books that you wanted to read
Can dream up furniture in the library to sit on while reading
These books cannot be accessed by anyone else
weaknesses: Some books should never be opened or read
No access to books when awake and you are able to recall details but cannot write it out
Will be tired when you wake up unless you sleep inside the library

name: Match Speed
description: With this power you can add the speed any object you are pursuing is moving at to your maximum speed while chasing it. In other words if you are chasing a car that is moving at 25 miles per hour and your top speed is ten miles per hour, you are able to move at thirty five miles per hour as long as you are chasing that car. Once you catch up whatever you are pursuing your extra speed goes away.
summary: The ability to match the speed of anything you are chasing
strengths: You can match the speed of anything you are chasing
weaknesses: The extra speed goes away once you catch the object

name: Literally Literally
description: When someone says "literally" and they meant figuratively you are able to activate this power and make their statement actually literal. The power is activated by saying "Literally?" when a figurative statement is said with the word literally. Example: statement said "I'm so hungry I could literally eat a horse." "Literally?" effect - the person who said the statement begins to devour a horse.
summary: The ability to make a statement literal when "literally" is said but figuratively was meant.
strengths: People will learn real quick to use the word literally properly.
Power can be used on self to make something true. ex: I'm literally dating "celebrity name here".
weaknesses: There is no way to undo the effect once this power is activated.

name: Spark Manipulation
description: Spark manipulation is similar to lumokinesis, but is not that at all. It is when you can stun your enemies using the sparks, making them blind or unconscious. You can also make yourself into a beam of sparks, and can shift your size and shape at will. You can also sting opponents when your sparks hit them
summary: The ability to create an aura of extremely bright light around yourself.
strengths: You cannot be harmed while in spark form
Your enemies will not be able to see you after your attack
The stings can cause extreme pain to opponents
weaknesses: Spark form only lasts for about 5 minutes
When in spark form, you cannot fly
Enimies can still defeat you if not fompletely blinded

name: Human Mood Ring
description: When you read someone's emotions you know what they're feeling and your body turns into the color of their emotion. For example, If you sense that someone is feeling very happy your body turns into a dark blue color. It's all based off the mood ring colors.
summary: The ability to read people's emotions.
strengths: You can help someone out if they don't know what they're feeling
Use it on your BF or GF if you are not sure that they love you
Use it on your boss if you think he or she is mad at you
weaknesses: Others can tell that you are reading their mood by your change in color
Does not help with reading your own moods

name: Human Gun
description:
From bazooka to pistol. From sniper rifle to double barrel shotgun. You can shoot any kind of gun from anywhere on your body. But there are 3 rules that follows it. 
1. For every gunshot there is a price of energy so shoot wisely. 
2. You can not make up a gun, the gun must exist. 
3. You can not shoot for nothing, there must be a reason for every shot you make.
summary: The ability to shoot any type of bullets from your body
strengths: As long as you have a reason, even the most stupidest one, you can shoot
You can make your own gun and it counts as existing
You can regain energy by any means
weaknesses: If you lose all your energy you fall alseep untill you gained all you energy back
If there is no such thing you can't shoot it
You can't shoot because you feel like it, you need a better reason

name: Whitelighting
description: You can heal a cut, a bruise, a rash, anything except broken bones and if the person you're healing isn't already dead. This of course applies to yourself also. You're not immortal, you can just heal slowly.
summary: The ability to slowly heal anyone or anything that isn't dead. This does not apply to broken bones.
strengths: Heal fallen friends
Heal yourself.
Regain strength quicker when hurt.
weaknesses: It's slow.
Doesn't work on the dead.
Doesn't work on broken bones.

name: Blessing Of Hephaestus
description: Hephaestus is the Greek god of fire and blacksmiths. His blessing gives you skills and powers unlike any other. You can craft magical weapons, armors, or items of any kind. Also, you can create anything OUT of anything else. A sword of fire. A chariot of lightning. A house of leaves. Another thing, you can control fire.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Hephaestus
strengths: You can create wonders
You can control fire
weaknesses: Some of your creations might go haywire

name: Swarm Transformation
description: At will, you can transform yourself into a swarm of flying, sting insects. You now control them all completely as a hive mind. You can reform only when the majority of the swarm is gathered together and shapes a humanoid form. If any insects are killed, then upon reforming the corresponding mass will be missing from your body, such as nails and hair, though you will quickly regenerate. If too many bugs are killed, you are killed too. A few bugs can be released at will to spy.
summary: The ability to fragment into a swarm of insects
strengths: You can easily spy on others
It is pretty difficult to kill a massive swarm of flying insects
In a dense humanoid form of flies, you can lift and move objects
weaknesses: Your insects are vulnerable to insect poison, fire, being eaten, etc.
You leave behind any clothes you were wearing, so you reform nude
Experiencing dying as a bug could traumatise you

name: External Power Evolution
description: With this power, you can touch a person and evolve it. This works by making the power one step better and then removing the old copy. This also refreshes it from any side effects not related to the power itself and restores it to it's normal condition, including cleansing it of the Condition Change powers. For example, if you used this on Regeneration, the subject may experience a faster healing factor and removal of pain. Unfortunately, this only works for normally acquired powers.
summary: The ability to improve another's power by stealing them.
strengths: Improve the powers of allies.
Gain as many powers as you want.
Help an ally who is struggling under the effects of a Condition Change power.
weaknesses: Requires touch.
Each user can only use this once on each of a target's powers.
Con Negation does not work for this.

name: Origamimancy
description: An artistic ability transforms paper origami to life. It can provide entertainment, attack your enemies and uch more. You control the former origami figures and they will do your bidding without question.
summary: The ability to transforms origami objects into life.
strengths: Spy agents.
Artistry
weaknesses: Short paper supplies.

name: 2 Door Destiny
description: You are able to make two doors pop out of nowhere and show you which destiny you should follow if you do this thing. If you are deciding over a girl or to kill somebody, it shows you what to do.
summary: The ability to have two doors show you your destinies.
strengths: Able to make decisions easily
Know what you should do and shouldn't do
weaknesses: Can't always control your own destiny
Sometimes you have to let go of some things

name: Vampirism Immunity
description: That is, any power that takes or drains energy, blood, etc will have no effect on one.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that take from one directly
strengths: Shadowulf1's Vampirism series will not affect you (not even Vampirism: Superpowers).
weaknesses: This power makes you immune to even allies draining power from you.
You can't even use a power to drain yourself to boost an ally.

name: Cerebropathy
description: This ability amplifies the brainwaves of the user. It is not clear whether it finds mutants by the power signature they send out when they use their powers or by the presence of the of the X-gene in their body; both methods have been used throughout the comics.
summary: The ability to detect and communicate with super-powered mutants with X-genes or Genetic Engineering
strengths: Detect mutants worldwide
Find mutated aliens outside of the planet
weaknesses: How your power works is mysterious to you, but at least it works.

name: Resurrection (Half Demon)
description: When you die, you come back from the dead with one or more powers from the demon who sent you back to the world of the living. You may end up looking like the demon but your actions are your own. It's possible to be a hero with demonic powers, just not easy to convince anyone of it.
summary: The ability to come back to life after you die, gain demonic powers
strengths: Coming back from the dead.
Gain really strong powers.
You have free will while in the living world.
weaknesses: You may look like the demon who granted you another life, as a reminder of who you're endebted to.
You might constantly be trying to prove that you are not evil.
Coming back is more painful each time you die.

name: Electrifying Fire
description: You can create a yellow flame that electrifies what it touches instead of burning things.
summary: The ability to create and control a flame that shocks instead of burns
strengths: The fire makes it easier to stun an enemy with all their limbs instead of incinerate them.
weaknesses: The flame is a bright yellow which makes it easier to see.

name: Electroreception, Passive
description: All living beings generate a weak bioelectric field. In a method similar to how some sharks, fish, and even the platypus hunts for food, the possessor of this ability can sense the weak bioelectic field generated by the muscles, nerves, and in some cases, the gills, of other living beings. This sense is generally tuned to low frequency signals. A close-range ability, usually good within a few feet unless the it puts out a powerful bioelectric field. Also may be used to sense non-living things.
summary: The ability to sense the weak bioelectic fields generated by other beings and locate them
strengths: Know the location of nearby beings, despite being hidden or in dark
This can be used to supplement or replace your other senses
May even be able to find your lost cell phone
weaknesses: Devices that put out electomagnetic fields may disrupt this ability or hide the target

name: Miniature Army
description: If you've seen the movie Small Soldiers, then you will immediately recognize this power. However, the user materializes soldiers instead of making them. You are the general and you give them missions. Your army is made up of soldiers, navy, air force, and special ops. The army has tanks, copters and other military vehicles. Soldiers are armed with all modern weapons the user can think of and each have radios to communicate their findings to you. The army's numbers regenerate over time.
summary: The ability to materialize a miniature army that can fire modern weapons and obeys your orders
strengths: You can command an entire army of soldiers/marines/air force whose numbers also regenerate over time
Find where your missing socks are
You can have your army surround your enemies and fire at will
weaknesses: You only have a finite number of soldiers (but the numbers always regenerate) also unlimited ammo
Your army can be stepped on by anyone
The size of weapons does make a difference. However, the sheer number of attacks more than makes up

name: Enlargement
description: This ability allows you to enlarge any part of your body.  The user can even turn them self into a giant.  When punching or kicking the person when their body is enlarged, the user feels no pain at all.  When the user punches somebody while their fist is enlarged, it can send the victim across a football pitch.
summary: The ability to enlarge any part of your body
strengths: Can become a gaint
Gives superstrenght
Feel no pain
weaknesses: Can over enlarge
May squash a love one

name: Quadarmy
description: With this power you can summon four bodyguard/soldiers. They are all under your control and they are trained in all kind of fighting and know how to use any type of weapons. If one of them dies you can only summon tree and so on and so forth once all four die you lose this power.
summary: The ability to summon four soldiers
strengths: You can summon four soldier bodyguards
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Symbiosis
description: Symbiosis is the ablility to call forth a symbiote that enhances your strengths and weakness. Your abilities will be enhanced depending on the type of sybiote you have. You can change your form as well in sybiote form.
summary: The ability to withdraw a symbiote from your body
strengths: Enhances your ablilities
Makes you look cool
Can change form
weaknesses: Can get too attached to you
Enhances your weakness
Fire and super sound are your weaknesses

name: Alternate Reality:Heroes Vault
description: With this power, you can access any weapon that was used by any hero or antihero in any timeline, by creating a downgraded copy from an alternate reality that gives you the same skills to wield it as the original user.  Also, you can transport people to your alternate reality to fight until someone dies. Weapons have all the effects given in myths and legends and also gives you access to the original user's memories.   Even modern heroes' weapons and tools can be copied.
summary: The ability to use any weapon or tool that was used by a hero or antihero with 90% the efficiency of the original
strengths: You can use a lot of weapons and tools (think Link, except you don't have to go through a dungeon)
You can create an alternate reality where you can use all your items with no time limit
weaknesses: Does not grant superstrength or speed, only the ability to wield the weapon
10 percent decrease inefficiency
Created weapons have a maximum staying time of 5 minutes outside the alternate reality

name: Myth Power: Nike's Knowledge
description: Nike (Nice), in Greek myth, was the goddess of victory (in combat and competition). As such, channeling her allows one to naturally possess every skill one will ever need in one's lifetime. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and gain enhanced physical stats in the presence of subjects that wish for his success. One can even adapt their body, gaining superhuman abilities/features, to enter a competition wherever it is being held (in space, at the bottom of the sea, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Nike's command over the essence of victory
strengths: Become an expert strategist; Win nearly any competition (board games, sports, obstacle courses, etc)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain power around subjects who wish for your success
Gain a type of Reactive Adaptation, so location doesn't hinder your ability to compete
weaknesses: Must practice to improve skills to peak; Wing Generation comes only at the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 only works in competitons (not combat or the like) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity (NCN)

name: Strength Multiplier
description: The person with this power will become more powerful than the currently most powerful person within the room or within a 500ft radius. For example, if Superman is in the same room as you are, you become 2 times stronger than Superman. Note this power only works for physical strength, you will not gain any superpowers
summary: The ability to become more powerful than the most powerful person currently in the room ir within a 500ft radius
strengths: If a powerhouse is within the room or 500ft radius you will become stronger than that he or she
You are the strongest person in the room or 500ft radius
weaknesses: When there's nobody around, this power is, useless
If the strongest person leaves the room or 500ft, somebody else is targeted. Ergo, you lose strength

name: Cloth Manipulation
description: You can telekinetically manipulate any cloth or fabric, shaping it in any way. These can be clothes someone is wearing, curtains or a nearby roll of silk.
summary: The ability to manipulate organic and synthetic fabric
strengths: Can control someone's movements by moving their clothes
Could choke an enemy with their tie/shirt
Could use a roll of strong cloth as a grappling line
weaknesses: Very limited power
Little to control in a rural or unpopulated area
Cannot control too much cloth or fabric far away

name: Get This Power
description: With this power, you can add the "Get This Power" button on any power on the superpowerlist.com. You can easily get any power and help other get their favorite power. However, you have to be on the page you want to add a "Get This Power" to and you can only add the button to ten powers per hour. Although the button only stays for the remainder of the hour you put there, it will also be active 12 hours later if it's still on the same day. Can still only get one power per day.
summary: The ability to add the "Get This Power" button on superpowers.
strengths: Add the "Get This Power" button to superpowers.
Get some of your favorite superpowers.
Help others get their favorite powers
weaknesses: Max of ten active powers per hour, button is only active for the hour you put it there
You have to be on a page to make it active.
Can still only get one power per day

name: Thorn Man
description: With this power you can generate thorns all over your body. You can remove the thorns with your hand or you can shoot them out of your body at high speeds.
summary: The ability to be covered in thorns
strengths: You can generate thorns from your body
You can shoot them out of your body at high speeds
If you dye your hair pink or something you can be like a human rose
weaknesses: Once they are removed from your body the thorns can hurt you

name: Chronopathism
description: Anything that gets within 4 millimeters of you gets aged by hundreds of years in mere seconds. You're forced to wear a thick suit that can withstand old age.
summary: The ability to age anything (or anyone) you get near by hundreds of years in a matter of seconds.
strengths: Every type of weapon, bullets, laser, nuclear bombs or toxins, become too old to effect you in range
Anyone you feel must be "taken out" will be easily dealt with at the mercy of time.
After training and loyalty are developed, a child can be quickly aged to the middle of their prime.
weaknesses: Full blown relationships are pretty much impossible.
Could only be considered a good bad guy power.
Everyone who's heard of you probably hates you

name: Anomaly Core
description: You can create rocks that each grant one wish by creating an anomaly in existence around themselves. The rock needs to be around the target of the wish. The rocks can only be created by Jesters and any Jester can destroy the rock
summary: The ability to create a rock that grants wishes
strengths: Grant any person any wish.
You can give yourself or another person any ability as long as they are near the rock.
Alter reality in a set area.
weaknesses: Wishes often go awry, creating unimaginable chaos.
Rocks can only be created by Jesters
Rocks can easily be destroyed by other Jesters, thus disabling the wish.

name: I Phone Mimicry
description: You are able to call, text, send emails and go on the Internet like any iPhone, but in your head. You also are constantly recording whatever you see, as well as being able to have an internal clock with the time. You are able to download apps and music and play them whenever you want. You can also read other people's texts and emails, as well as listen to their calls. If you are in a place without coverage or wifi signals, your powers won't work properly.
summary: The ability to mimic the functions of an iPhone from your head.
strengths: You have an iPhone in your head.
You can listen or read other people's calls or texts.
weaknesses: You powers won't work properly without coverage or wi-fi signals.

name: Ruthless Pursuit
description: This power forms a psychic link between a target being pursued, and the user's feelings for the target (his hatred for the target, or his desire to find him for any other reason); this connection allows the user to track the target wherever he goes (or to at least have an idea of what direction the subject lies in, and a psychic vibration that fluctuates with the growing/diminishing proximity of the subject)
summary: The ability to pursue a target, by forming a link between the target and your desire to find them
strengths: Two words: Bounty Hunter
Four Words: Reality Show "The Locator"
Even more words: track down any desired object, subject or location
weaknesses: Must have seen the target before
Your power is only as strong as your desire to find the target
This is kind of a villain power (think "Michael Myers")

name: Scruffgor
description: Scruffgor is a dragon/tiger/shark and he can fly, run fast and breathe underwater. He can defend you or take you anywhere you want to go, but only for a 10 minute limit, then you must wait two days before you can summon him again.
summary: The ability to call down Scruffgor and control him for 10 minutes.
strengths: Can defend you
Take you anywhere
Very powerful, and you have control over him
weaknesses: Only 10 minute limit
2 day waiting time
Is very big so might cause people to panic and run all over

name: Nanite Swarm
description: You release millions of nanites out of your body through your skin. They automatically target and destroy the enemy or object you make them attack. They are fully controlled by the brain.
summary: The ability to summon a swarm of nanites that destroy anything in their way.
strengths: Very few defenses against it
Very precise in targeting
weaknesses: No defensive positions
Might gross some people out

name: Millusionance
description: You can create illusions to match up with the music currently playing.
summary: The ability to create an illusionary show to go with whatever music is playing
strengths: Put on a great show
Have a blast
Can make you rich and famous
weaknesses: Not practical in everyday life
Not obviously useful in combat
When the music stops so fades your illusion

name: Reverse Agitator Pulse
description: A person with this power has a more advanced form of agitator pulse. Instead of making people fight to the death, he can make everyone desire the death of the specific target. This is caused by a feedback pulse forcibly caused by the initial pulse from the target so that everyone else near him that can get the pulse will also try to kill him/her. However this pulse only lasts 2 minutes afterwards affected parties except initial target will have amnesia and forget the whole incident.
summary: The ability to shoot a pulse at a biological target causing everything else biological to attack said target
strengths: Your enemies now have to fight everyone that is not immune to this power
Pretty much that's it--your target becomes the target of everybody's enmity for 2 hours
weaknesses: This power runs out in 2 hours
Enemies can avoid spreading the pulse by staying away from moist areas and metal/touching people

name: Reverence Of Time
description: This power grants the user the respect and high held reverence of time and temporal beings. You gain the trust of temporal entities automatically and they act favorably to you. You gain access to temporal artifacts and locations normally inaccessible to people but only if you are capable of doing so. As a bonus you are also held in a higher regard than other non temporal beings meaning that you can both converse more easily with them and they treat you better than they would treat others.
summary: The ability to hold the respect and reverence of time and it's direct associations
strengths: Ally yourself with high power elementals of TIME.
Gain temporal entities favor and hospitality.
You gain access to temporal artifacts and locations.
weaknesses: You only get PERMISSION to access temporal items/places not any necessary temporal power to do it.
You have no form of time control from this power.
You only gain the favor of temporal ENTITIES not just people with time manipulation.

name: Word Defuser
description: A person with this power can split an object into its composite words and create objects from those words. For example, you can split a firefly into fire and a fly. You can also create more people by splitting apart people's name. Ricky Bobby becomes Ricky and Bobby and Catwoman becomes a cat and a woman.
summary: The ability to an object's words in order to create multiple objects
strengths: Fake diamonds become diamonds and fake, just throw away the fake
Create more people
You can use synonyms--firefly is the same as lightning bug
weaknesses: If an object only has one word in its name
Spilt people are unpredictable--you don't know what they are like

name: Double Voice
description: When you desire, you can speak in two distinct voices simultaneously. The second voice is opposite of your gender. You may not speak in the second voice alone. This ability has little application outside of intimidation.
summary: The ability to speak in two voices at once.
strengths: Effective intimidation tool.
Users have full control over when they use this ability and can speak normally.
weaknesses: People are likely to fear you if you do this, possibly believing you are a demon.

name: Soul Tangibility
description: A person with this power can turn parts of their body into soul form which allows them to touch ghosts and other things that otherwise are intangible to mortal beings. This gives the user the potential to be an excellent exorcist and ghostbuster. This power recognizes a personality as a soul and can also be used to force personalities from a person's body so you can remove a murderous personality from someone's body.
summary: The ability to turn parts of your body into half soul form to touch souls
strengths: If someone is possessed you can push the soul out with your hands
Can be used to attack ghosts and evil spirits without the need to use long incantations etc.
Also renders you immune to possession
weaknesses: This power also attracts supernatural forces to your location
If evil can also use this power to kill living people by ejecting their souls from their bodies
You will be sought for your ability to cure bipolar disorder-even if its not scientifically explaine

name: Myth Power: Tyche's Hand
description: Tyche, in Greek myth, was the goddess of chance, fortune and luck. As such, channeling her effectively makes the user a friend of fate, almost always positively affected by it. In addition, one can influence stochastic fields to produce good and/or bad luck for others. One can also psychically discern all the possible outcomes of a move (or the ultimate conclusion of a decision). The user can even perceive an object or subject's luck factor, impending events of good/bad fortune, and the like.
summary: The ability to channel Tyche's command over the essence of luck, probability and chance
strengths: Almost always positively affected by the forces of fate; immunity to probability manipulation
Distribute good/bad luck at will (and charge objects with bad/good luck by touch)
Perceive stochastic fields (the chances of an event happening, impending fortune/misfortune, etc. )
weaknesses: People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Zeus Power are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Oceans/Tethys Power are immune to this ability

name: Power Imbued Jewellery
description: This power allows you to create jewellery that has random power inside of it. That piece of jewelery will only respond and uses its power for you unless the jewelery is given by you to someone else.
summary: The ability to make jewellery with powers inside them
strengths: Many different powers to have
Only works for you
Very small and inconspicuous
weaknesses: It takes great concentration to create a piece of power imbedded jewelery
You don't know what power you're going to get
If you get a cursed power or a negation power you're screwed

name: Dimensional Rule Immunity
description: This power has two parts. The first is that you are able to resist a foe forcing you into another dimension that was created or was already there. The second part is that you are unaffected by said rules of a dimension if they tricked you into it. For example, if it only let you use your powers a certain way you could defy that rule and use them anyway. This also provides immunity to rules of Personal Realm.
summary: The ability to be immune to the rules of other dimensions
strengths: Be immune to the rules of artificial or natural dimensions.
Can't be forced into a pocket dimension.
weaknesses: There are other methods of harming you.

name: Wing Appendages
description: You will have bat-like wings attached to you. Your body structure will be different so you can fly. The wings will be attached to your shoulder blades. Your bone structure will be hollow so you'll be light. If in high places, you'll use the wind current to glide, but in low places it'll be difficult to lift off the ground. Plus you might get exhausted from flapping your wings a lot and if you're carrying something, that's more weight on you.
summary: The ability to fly/glide with wings
strengths: Fly/glide via wings
weaknesses: If on low ground, it'll be difficult to take off
Might get exhausted from flapping your wings

name: Fixed Form
description: A person with this power has both a curse and a blessing. Their body's form can never change. They can't grow taller or shorter, or perform shapeshifting. The person can talk but they can't change their facial expressions. They also seem to never age. The user is immune to cuts and bruises since their skin cannot be changed, so the person won't bleed. However, they will still feel pain. Also, the person is immune to injuries, like bone fractures. The person can get sick but with no indications.
summary: The ability to have a body whose physical features can never change
strengths: You never seem to age-good if you are not still a kid or are already an old man
You are immune to cutting and piercing damages and cannot be injured ever
You can walk on spikes but still feel pain
weaknesses: You will look the way you did from the moment you have received this power
People will think that you are a witch since it doesn't look like you age
You do not know when you are sick

name: Corruption
description: We all have a darkness in us. A Corruptor can set it free. They can secrete a fluid that, on contact, supresses the inhibition center of the brain. This includes the inhibition to disobey orders, the inhibition against violence, and the inhibition against hurting ourselves. If the target is not given direction, they will go on a mad rampage. The effects wear off in 4 hours.
summary: The ability to release someone's inhibitions by touch
strengths: Send a crowd on a mad rampage
Great as a distraction
Crazy army at your disposal
weaknesses: Don't get in their way
Must touch target
Wears off in 4 hours

name: Tidal Beam
description: You have the granted ability to fire a glowing beam of high-powered water blasts which can easily knock over a person, but only if you are in your water form.
summary: The ability to fire a geyserous beam of water-like substance.
strengths: You can use this power to put out the flames.
weaknesses: Never use this while you're around electrical currents.

name: Name Based Powers
description: This ability grants the user with a superhuman capability, power or feature based on one's name. Not to be confused with the power Yclepsis, the power to control a person by calling their name, this power would let a person named Billy gain the proportional powers of a goat, a person named Randy would gain seductive powers, a person named Jasmine would gain the powers of a flower (Pheromones, hypnotic beauty, photosynthesis, maybe plant control, etc), as long as it pertains to one's name
summary: The ability to gain a power based on your name
strengths: If you have a unique name (like Prince or Serenity or Micah) you gain powers pertaining to that name
You can base the ability on your first, middle, last name or alias (and you can change it up)
Your power can't be negated (and one with Yclepsis can "change" your name to give you new powers)
weaknesses: If you have a weird name (like Monroe or Jeremy) it would be hard to tell what power you'd get
If someone has the power of Yclepsis and makes you forget your name, your power is negated
If you don't like your name, your power is less than max potential

name: Aspect Clones
description: You create the following clones these clones act independent and cant be reabsorbed they have the same powers as you(unless otherwise stated clone is C) They are as follows:A C just like you, a C that is like you only 7, a evil master mind C, a C of the opposite gender, a C that is dumb and savage but with powers enhanced times 2 if that would be good for it, a nice C, a wussy C, a C with opposite powers, a C that is old and, a C that is dumb and mean,and a C that is better than you in every way
summary: The ability to create clones of you that reprisent different aspects of you
strengths: They are good clones
weaknesses: When you gain this power or lose it it activates
All the C's exept the one like you, the opposite gender one and the one that's better than you.
It creates any clone it likes, create clones like themselves.

name: Palindrones
description: A palindrome is a word, phrase or number pattern that reads the same way when read forwards and backwards. A Palindrone is a robot that hovers on one single leg, has two arms with knife like fingers and a sigle red eye that can shoot lasers of various strengths ranging from slight burn to "hey remember when there used to be a person where that pile of ashes is". They also have several turrets that shoot tiny cannon balls from them all over their body. These features also appear on the bots' back
summary: The ability to summon an army of drones that look the same in the front as they do in the back
strengths: You can summon an army of the above described Palindrones that are under your complete control
The Palindrone's can never be subject to a surprise attack due to their weapons and eyes on their ba
Cks.
weaknesses: The drones can be subject to robot controlling powers

name: Hyalokinesis
description: A person with Hyalokinesis can manipulate glass in any shape, color, or density. They can repair, reshape, or recolor it without heating it up. Naturally, it can also be used as an offensive weapon (slicing or stabbing) or as a defensive tool (super-dense body armor or a levitating shield). However, they cannot create glass. In addition, they are not immune to the damaging effects of glass--i.e. cuts and blood loss.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate glass
strengths: Glass is everywhere
Effective offensive weapon (stabbing + slicing)
Good defensive tool (shields or dense body armor)
weaknesses: Cannot create or destroy glass
Not immune to its damaging effects (i.e. blood loss)
Takes concentration

name: Celestial Deity: Sun
description: You have powers over: Fire, gravity, life and are the strongest Celestial deity in general. You are the only one who can use celestial summon skills. You can also teleport to the sun, suffer no damage from being there and when returning you either return to the point where you left or to another preset point (like your house).
summary: The ability to have dominion over the power of the sun.
strengths: You are super powerful.
weaknesses: Careful not to squish the earth with that gravity power.

name: Chemical Redirect
description: A person with this power has the ability to redirect effects placed on one object to another object. For example, they can boil water then switch the effect to a nearby iron door to boil the iron. If the other object is destroyed, the original receives the same effects again. However, if an effect was cancelled through other means, then the effect will stay cancelled. It cannot remove physical change so no switching wounds.
summary: The ability to redirect chemical reactions of one object to another
strengths: Can switch any reaction to another object
Can steal regeneration (if it is caused by chemical processes)
Reverse poison effects then reverse the antidote effects
weaknesses: Can't reverse physical changes
Must know chemistry

name: Top Hat
description: The ability to pull anything out of a top hat. The object must be able to fit through the bottom in the top hat. The item must already exist, no imaginary things, but can be from different times and dimensions. You must reach inside the hat with your hand to retrieve something.
summary: The ability to pull anything out of a top hat
strengths: Can pull anything out of any top hat
Top hat can be any size
The thing can exist in alternate dimesnions and throughout time and space
weaknesses: Must be able to fit through the bottom of the top hat
Must already exist
Have to reach inside the hat with one of your hands

name: Eclipse Angel
description: Eclipse angels are extremely rare like moon and sun angels they possess extraordinary powers. In day they possess powers of a sun angel and in night the powers of a moon angel and during a eclipse the eclipse angels are capable of granting wishes but this ability only lasts until the eclipse ends.
summary: The ability to becone a eclipse angel
strengths: Powers of a moon and sun angel
Powerful all the time
Grant wishes
weaknesses: Wishes can only be granted on a eclipse
Eclipse angels are extremely rare
Eclipse angels can't grant their own wishes

name: Cyborg Creator
description: With this power you can create cyborgs by fusing people with machines. You can do it with any person and any machine. You can fuse a person with a television set and be able to watch TV on their chest or merge a person with a telephone and cause them to be able to receive calls from their mind. Or to create a more conventional cyborg you could merge a person with a robot. You cannot control the cyborgs that you create but you can reverse the merge whenever you want.
summary: The ability to fuse people with machines
strengths: You can create cyborgs
You can undo the merge whenever you want
weaknesses: You cannot control the cyborgs you create
The cyborgs you create might get angry at you for horribly fusing them with machines

name: Marble Charge
description: You can only create the explosive marble from your palm, so if something happened to them, your power would be useless. You also can only create them in ten second intervals. The explosion from them is equal to a grenade. The marble can either be detonated when your enemy steps on it, on your command, or if something hits it. There is no expiration date for the marble and there is no limit of marbles you can make and detonate at once.
summary: The ability to create marble sized balls from your palm and leave them to explode when you want.
strengths: The marbles will never run out.
Can act like a mine, grenade, or impact bomb.
You can potentially explode a million of these marbles at once anywhere in the world.
weaknesses: If you accidentally step on one on them you are as good as dead.
You need at least one hand to create the bomb.
They will not detonate when wet.

name: Landscape Mimicry
description: This ability lets the user turn, partially or fully, into any piece of landscape found naturally. This would include mountains, waterfalls, a giant tree, etc. The user can only mimic landscape they have seen firsthand themselves. The user can turn completely into the landscape they saw, or only take on certain traits. Able to manipulate their landscape form to a certain extent. Can only mimic one type of landscape at a time.
summary: The ability to have the traits or become a form of terrestrial landscape.
strengths: A very good disguise in a natural setting.
Manipulate your full or semi- landscape form.
Gain the traits of any type of landscape.
weaknesses: Bad disguise in cities.
Can only take on the attributes of one type of landscape at a time.

name: Dictionary
description: You can pick any word from a modern dictionary and bring that word to life. If it is a noun, such as a "car" or "gun", you can summon it. If it is a verb, such as "fly" or "jump", you can do it or have someone nearby do it. You can link nouns with adjectives to enhance or weaken them. Example; you can say "massive" and "sword" to summon a huge sword to use. You can also link adverbs with verbs to enhance them as well. Example; you can say "run" and "quickly" to run at supersonic speeds.
summary: The ability to affect reality by picking out words from a dictionary
strengths: You can create practically anything out of nothing
You can kill enemies simply by saying "die" or revive loved ones with "resurrect"
weaknesses: You can only use each word once in your life
Certain actions are impossible due to the user only being able to use one or two words at a time

name: Unity Gem
description: When you use the gem, you can turn your imagination into reality. It's sorta like the Green Lantern's power, except the gem requires imagination instead of willpower.  Your imagination (constructs) can only be reality for 1 hour before dissipating.
summary: The ability to summon forth an unique gem.
strengths: Green Lantern's power without willpower
weaknesses: Your imagined reality (constructs) last for 1 hour

name: Technomorph
description: A person with this power can turn into any type of appliance in existence as well as some fictional appliances. For example you can turn into a refrigerator that can shoot freeze rays when the door is opened or if you wanted to surprise people it can shoot out fire instead. However there is a price for having such a great power you must always charge yourself for 4 hours everyday or else you will be stuck in your current form.
summary: The ability to turn into any type of technology
strengths: Able to turn into appliances or toys or even a phone to hide.
Can move in any technological form-though speed may be an issue
Can morph to access various superpowers by creating the necessary parts to simulate them
weaknesses: You can only turn into pieces of technology that you somewhat understand so no black hole generators
You need to charge yourself for 4 hours per day

name: Womanizer
description: With this ability you can think or imagine any woman you want and make a 100% perfect clone of her appear in front of you as your own. You completely own her. You can also change her any way you want. You can make her disappear when you're finished. They will always do whatever you want and or say. It is perfect.
summary: The ability to think or imagine any woman you want and make a copy appear in front of you as your own mind slave
strengths: You can have any woman you want, wherever and whenever you want
You can do whatever you want to the clone or make it do whatever you want
You will be better than Playboy
weaknesses: It's demeaning to women
Real women will hate you
Other than that, it is flawless

name: Delete This Duplicates
description: duplicate
summary: The ability to be a duplicate
strengths: duplicate
weaknesses: same

name: Mask
description: With this power you call for a mask to hide your appearance. The mask is not like a normal mask. This mask dos not come off unless you take it off. The mask will hide your appearance from your enemies & they will not be able to take it off or force you to take off. You must want to take it off and be safe to take it off.
summary: The ability to call for a mask that can hide your appearance.
strengths: Mask will hide your appearance
Mask dos not come off unless you take it off
The mask will hide your appearance from your enemies
weaknesses: You have to want to take it off
You don't have any offensive power
You can be killed

name: Jinx
description: You shoot a psionic energy wave to a certain person or object. This causes a minute alternate reality to happen in which you manipulated a probability field, meaning you caused "bad luck" to someone.
summary: The ability to manipulate probability & cause misfortune
strengths: Cause bad luck
weaknesses: Still can have bad luck yourself

name: Worl Zuper
description: WorlZuper gives you the power to create your own secret world in your mind. You can even transport your friends there. You can make your own fictional characters. You can create and do ANYTHING!!!
summary: The ability to create your own world inside your head
strengths: The world can be anything that you want it to be
You will never age
You will never get sick
weaknesses: You can only have up to one world
If you visit your world for more than 8 hours you will get a small headache
You will disappear off of the face of the earth while visiting your world

name: Heisenberg Uncertainty
description: A person with this power has the ability to display the Heisenberg uncertainty principle at will. When activated, the user can either be described as moving really fast or rapidly teleporting. They become virtually unhittable and undetectable. The user can use this to dodge attacks within a room as well as have unpredictable attacks. The user can also "teleport" with this ability by stopping where they want. The user must control the distance of being uncertain or else they can be anywhere.
summary: The ability to display the Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle at will
strengths: No one can figure out where you are or how much momentum you have except you
You can hit really hard if you time it right
You can teleport with this power
weaknesses: Must have an understanding of quantum physics in order to use to full extent
You must actively control this power
Your strength fluctuates, so you have to know when to hit-see con number 1

name: Animal Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn humans into any kind of animal. You can turn the person you turned into an animal into other animals as well and then back into a human when you're done. This power only works on humans not animals that were always animals.
summary: The ability to turn humans into any kind of animal
strengths: You can turn humans into any kind of animal
weaknesses: This power only works on humans not animals or aliens

name: Ability Supercharging
description:
Ability Supercharging allows you to supercharge other people's abilities, thus making them even more powerful.
It can also be used to generate and fire a concussive energy blast.
Supercharged abilities also sometimes have a secondary effect(EG. Supercharged Superspeed charged enough to the speed of light theoretically allows time travel).
summary: The ability to supercharge other people's abilities. Has a secondary use.
strengths: Supercharge your ally's ability to make them more powerful.
Fire a concussive energy blast.
weaknesses: Sometimes activates on it's own.

name: Cabletation
description: With this ability you can travel through any cables that travel over some distance. Whether it's to the other side of the house or on the other side of the state.
summary: The ability to teleport through power cords, cables, and LAN lines.
strengths: Free travel
Near instant travel
weaknesses: If power in cable is shut off you would die
If cable is cut you will die
You can only go to that place where the cable ends

name: Individual Confrontation
description: With this ability, you have a +50% chance of defeating someone while confronting them individually (no one can step in and interfere), which means it improves your odds against them no matter what you're doing (chess, racing, battling, etc. )
summary: The ability to have a +50% chance of defeating someone while confronting them individually.
strengths: Increases your odds against anyone while confronting them one on one.
Takes effect in any subject (racing, playing chess, battling, etc. )
weaknesses: It still doesn't guarantee your success.
Can make competitions too easy.

name: Pet Vehicle
description: Never be stranded again! This power grants you a telepathic link with your vehicle. It comes to you when called AND it can transform into any other vehicle you can possibly think of (restrained to the boundaries of reality, of course), from a unicycle to a space shuttle. You will still need fuel for all gas consuming forms, and rocket fuel for rockets, naturally. If you are driving in car form and fuel is low, it will give you a five minute warning before turning into a bike.
summary: The ability to command a transforming vehicle
strengths: Comes to your call
Can order it to run people over with no danger to you
Could even turn into Da Vinci's self-powered flying machine
weaknesses: Still need fuel
Must be realistic: no magic buses that run on dreams and songs and pony puke
No other cons

name: Addiction Storage
description: With this power you can store the need to do something your body is dependent on such as eating, drinking, sleeping, breathing or anything else your body is addicted too. While the addiction is being stored you will not feel negative effects of ignoring the addiction. The stored addiction can then be passed onto someone else if you wish, such as making somebody else feel your collected hunger. You would then have to recollect your hunger to use again.
summary: The ability to store the need to do something your body is dependent on for later.
strengths: Not feel the effects of hunger or anything your body is dependent on.
Can force your body's needs onto other people.
Do not have to worry about becoming addicted to new things.
weaknesses: Will have to wait for your own hunger to build up before you can force it onto another person.
If to much of an addiction is stored and forced on someone it could kill them.
Using drugs to often because you are not worried about becoming addicted.

name: Reverse Power Change
description: With this power you can activate it to make anything that attempts to reduce your powers strengthen them instead but it also makes anything that attempts to strengthen you while it is active weaken you instead. You can still be harmed but things that affect how strong, smart, fast, etc you are get reversed. If you get affected by a power removing power you will gain Power Safety.
summary: The ability to make things that make you weaker make you stronger and vice versa.
strengths: Gain strenght equal to how much people try to weaken you.
If powers are attempted to be stolen then it can be reversed to give Power Safety.
Can be turned off and on at will.
weaknesses: If turned on and something strengthens you, you will become weaker instead.
Intelligent foes may catch on and strengthen you while you have it on.
Does not reverse harm to the body, only things that sap or give a form of strength.

name: Treant
description: Treants are mythological humanoid trees. With this power you can control any foreign Treants that you may find and have them serve you. You can also create Treants from the trees around you. You can also turn yourself into a Treant, causing your skin to turn into wood and you to grow larger (and allowing you to communicate with plants).
summary: The ability to have control over and manipulate Treants.
strengths: Control any Treants that are around you.
Create your own Treants from the trees around you.
Become a Treant yourself and gain their enhanced attributes.
weaknesses: Weakens when away from nature.
Foreign Treants are harder to control.
You are subject to the weaknesses that come with being part tree.

name: Golden Needles
description: You can throw needles at your foe, which cause hallucinations when they penetrate the skin. It also induces temporary paralysis, a slight swelling in the tongue (resulting in slurred speech) and leaving them momentarily with a bad headache.
summary: The ability to toss out needles to your opponent that causes them to have hallucinations.
strengths: A good way to screw up an enemy's mind.
weaknesses: Those won't work when they have armor on.

name: Blades Of The Fae
description: You can create up to 10 blades composed of light that act like pure acid to whatever they touch. You can control the blades with a thought. In order to gain this power, you must eat a live fairy.
summary: The ability to create and control blades of light that act like acid to what they touch
strengths: The blades can't be controlled by acid manipulators because it only acts like acid.
weaknesses: You can lose control of the blades to photokinetics and blade manipulators.

name: Elemental Army
