description: You will be able to create minions to fight for you. 10 will be made out of water, 10 will be made out of earth, 10 will be made out of fire, 10 will be made of air.
summary: The ability to create an army made of elements
strengths: Despite their elemants, each of them fight with equal stregth.
Each of them have special moves incorperated with their elemant
weaknesses: Not Really.

name: Vine Manipulation
description: Users can create, shape and manipulate vines. The vines are created only under the attendance of trees(i mean big trees like Banyan Tree). For offense, the user can strangle the enemy and for defense they can move from one place to another using good number of vines.
summary: The ability to create vines in trees and control them
strengths: The power has both offensive and defensive powers
You will be in great advantage if u are surrounded by trees
User can create vines on trees and manipulate them
weaknesses: The number of vines the user can create is limited
Users are powerless in areas without trees
Great disadvantage against fire and ice users.

name: Enmity  Memory Deletion
description: This power allows you to erase all of the negative memories someone has of another person. Bad memories containing only the two of them are completely exorcized, while the person is deleted from any bad memory that contains more people. The good memories your victim has of this person are left completely intact.
summary: The ability to delete all the bad memories someone associates with a specific person.
strengths: Alter someones perception of someone else.
Improve someones reputation.
Help improve a negative relationhip.
weaknesses: The person you erace dosen't change, and has a chance to make a new bad impression.
If you want to compleatly repair someones reputation, you have to get to most of their detracters.
You could set someone to liking a compleat monster.

name: Arceusforce: Splash
description: The user of this ability can channel the control over the seas of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Water-type. The user's skin turns blue and their irises turn light blue. Under their aquatic guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Water-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Water attacks such as Water Gun, Bubblebeam, Hydro Pump, Water Spout and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Water form.
strengths: The user is resistant to fire, ice, metal and other water-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of water for water attacks.
The user can breathe underwater and swim fast.
weaknesses: The user is weak to electrical and plant-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user and may even require to be unlocked from default form.

name: Fluid Containment
description: With this power, one can create specialized forcefields which will allow solid objects and energy to pass through, but fluids will not. However, fluids can pass through if sealed within a container.
summary: The ability to create a barrier blocking the passage of fluids, but not solids.
strengths: Perfect for an airlock; there will be no loss of atmosphere, with no interruption to function.
With experience, fields can be moved and made into any size or shape.
Has a huge number of uses.
weaknesses: Not as useful as a defensive or containment field.
Only works for fluids.
Fields suffer the same limitations as normal forcefields.

name: Suicidal Strength
description: With this power you can kill yourself and benefit from it. You gain twice your original strength, however you feel the pain until your heart has stopped, or is cut into tiny little pieces. After you kill yourself, your body will regenerate, but with more muscle tissue.
summary: The ability to commit suicide and come back with twice the physical strength.
strengths: No more bodybuilding (hee hee)
Good for if you're extremely suicidal
weaknesses: Bad if you're not extremely suicidal.
You will freak everyone out in the proximity with your emo abilities.

name: Induced Paper Effects
description: A person with this ability has the power induce 'paper like' changes to everything around him. This enables him to tear, cut out, crumple, shred, throw away, write on, and fold the universe along with everything in it. Facing Invulnerable opponents? Stop them from doing anything by crumpling both space and time or even reality itself around them! After that, why not throw them away? Far, Farrr away. And that's only the beginning, the possibilities are ultimately endless! The only downside is...
summary: The ability to affect everything around you as if it was paper.
strengths: Having trouble being hit by projectiles? Why not fold the space around you? Say adios to direct hits
Up against telekinetics? Stop them dead by cutting them off from the rest of reality!
The act of someone tearing his foes into two pieces then throwing them away is a sight to behold.
weaknesses: Ohhh nothing really, except that you can't acquire or use other abilities!
This ability aside, you are still basically human with basic human weaknesses and basic human needs.
Cannot be used by 'shadowy' egotistic maniacs who think they're god or something.

name: Opinion Shift
description: This ability enables a person to shift/change other people's opinions about anything. However, there is one restriction. A person can only change the opinions of 5 people every day.
summary: The ability to change people's opinion(s).
strengths: Change the opinions of people who dislike you.
Get a girlfriend/boyfriend more easily.
Lots of fun.
weaknesses: Only 5 people per day.
Possibly serious consequences.

name: Mark And Track
description: You need to touch the object or the person you want to mark and track. Frow now on and until you release the mark, you will sense exactly where they are at any time. You can mark as many things as you want and you will still be able to remember what they are and distinguish them, though too many marks may overwhelm you. Also, the closer the marked things are to you, the stronger they will attract your attention. As such, if they are in your visual field, you can clearly pinpoint their location.
summary: The ability to mark anyone or anything and keep track of their position.
strengths: You can easily tail anyone. You just need to mark them or one of their possessions.
There's no limit to how many persons or objects you want to keep track.
If one of them gets too close to you, you will know it immediately.
weaknesses: You need to touch the person or the object you want to mark.
If you marked someone's possession, they can still leave it, lose it or give it to someone else.
If you mark too many things, you may be overwhelmed by the huge quantity of marks.

name: Thanatoform
description: Thanatoform lets you turn into a Grim Reaper version of yourself, allowing you to access any location, not die of natural causes, and carry a cool weapon that doesn't have to be a scythe. One thing to keep in mind is you are not Death. Death is Death, and Death can still kill you, so don't make him mad and do what he tells you. Also, this power would make the coolest halloween costume and it's just plain cool. I mean you can turn into a Grim Reaper version of you... once every 55 days, sorry.
summary: The ability to turn into a Death/Grim Reaper version of yourself
strengths: People, and natural causes (like animals, poison, drowning, or germs) cannot kill you.
You look cool
You have the power of death
weaknesses: Death itself can still kill you (so don't make Death angry)
You can only use Thanatoform once every 55 days
Death may hire you to "do work" meaning you may have to kill someone you love or is important to you

name: Transforming Dragon Master #1
description: As Master of all known Martial Arts, styles & ways you are gifted with the ability to transform into literal forms of fighting styles. For example, if fighting in tiger-style within a few moves you transform your hands into the form of a tiger paw. More moves in the same style grants your more bodily changes. If you fight long enough you morph into a human-hybrid of the form able to use heightened senses & strength. Eventually able to reach dragon level, your ultimate form.
summary: The ability to transform into the many forms of various martial arts styles
strengths: The easiest transformations are made within animalistic styles: leopard, monkey, tiger, mantis
Drunken master techniques allow you to enibriate anyone watching you
T'ai Chi transforms you into different form of energy (fire, lightning, etc. ) emotion dependant
weaknesses: Each level requires focus on your kata, lapses in focus revert you to a normal fighter
You cannot force the animal form, each situation dictates what style you will use
You will destroy your dojo a few times before you perfect your abilities

name: Fire Eyes
description: With this power you can set people's eyes on fire meaning they will have flames coming from their eyes and unless they have some sort of flame resistant power will be in immense pain
summary: The ability to set people's eyes on fire
strengths: You can set your enemies eyes on fire
weaknesses: This may kill the person you use the power on

name: Fearless Gas
description: You have the power to release an anti-fear mist. This gas removes a person's fears, leaving them unable to discern harmful from harmless or even good from bad.
summary: The ability to take away people's fears rather than manipulating them.
strengths: You can strip anyone of their phobias
Make an opponent run fearlessly off a cliff, into a hail of bullets, etc.
weaknesses: They could go recklessly out of control after you take away their fears
Fearlessness disappears as the gas is metabolized

name: Human Dictionary
description: Basically the ability to know every meaning and definition for every word in any language.
summary: The ability to know the definition to any word in any language.
strengths: Easily pass English and L.O.T.E
Know the meaning to EVERY word.
Can swear at people in other languages.
weaknesses: Can make you feel like a nerd

name: Myth Power: Epione's Epiphany
description: Epione (Epiona, Epigone), in Greek myth, was the goddess of soothing pain. As such, channeling her allows one to soothe pain (physical and mental) by touch, a word or a thought. In addition, one can smooth out cramps, kinks and cricks, by touch. Furthermore, one can psychically access knowledge and skill in massage and other recuperative physical therapies (like yoga, tai chi, etc). One can even totally withstand pain (natural or caused by abilities); this pain immunity may be shared, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Epione's command over the essence of comfort and soothing pain
strengths: Soothe physical/mental pain; touch eases cramps (used on healthy subjects, increases flexibility)
Psychically access knowledge and skill in massage and other physical therapies
Withstand all manner of physical and mental pain (may be shared by touch)
weaknesses: Cannot soothe pain by transferring it to another party, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot negate pain-based powers until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Johnny Storm
description: You can do just what Johnny Storm from Fantastic 4 can do! You light on fire, fly around, chuck fire balls at bad guys...unless, you want to BE the bad guy.
summary: The ability to light on fire and fly.
strengths: fly while on fire
chuck fire balls
go to supernova heat
weaknesses: your clothes burn off
noticeable
stealth is not an option

name: Iron Skin
description: You can transform your skin into a hard protective iron coating/shell. It will still flex and bend with your body movements.
summary: The ability to morph your skin into an iron coating.
strengths: Great protection from bullets.
Good protection from alpha particles.
weaknesses: Affected by moisture, you can rust.
Your weight increases by 10 times
You attract magnets.

name: Rapacity Rebound
description: Imagine you get an awesome new power and then it's stolen. Of course you want revenge - with this ability, the stolen at power triggers itself to harm the robber. I. E: Your power to shoot bullets out your hand gets stolen. Now whenever the thief tries to use the power, he shoots bullets at himself. This only works on powers, not states/forms of being. E.g. it works on eye lasers, but not on form/summoning a dragon. They can still use the power, only it does half damage
summary: The ability to automatically trigger a power that's been stolen to work against the thief
strengths: REVENGE!
The power does double damage to the thief
weaknesses: You don't actually get your power back.
Only works on stolen powers, not states or forms of being.
They still get to use the power

name: Impersonal Effects
description: This ability allows the user to make a connection of sorts between two things or people. This means that if something happens to one thing to will happen to the other. For example: if you use your power on a ball and a boulder, whatever you do to the ball will happen to the boulder. But if something happens to the boulder nothing will happen to the ball. That's because the ball is the control object. The user can choose which is the control. So it's kind of a universal voodoo.
summary: The ability to cause something to share the state of something else
strengths: You can control things and people
It looks really cool (set a candle on fire set your enemies on fire)
It takes only about 3 seconds to create or destroy a connection
weaknesses: You must touch at least one of the objects for it to work
All affects are shared so if you move the control the connected thing moves with it

name: Retrocognition
description: Many great mysteries in history are unsolved. A Retrocognitive can see visions of the past---anywhere from 900 million years ago to 1 minute ago. This may seem worthless. However, the user usually has amazing control over this, letting them see what other people have done, what happened in specific rooms, or even embarassing events from a person's life.
summary: The ability to induce visions of the past
strengths: Can see what other people have done
Can see what happened in military rooms
Seeing what she was really doing that one time
weaknesses: Cannot see what they're doing
Must have a good idea of what you're looking for
Not liking what you see

name: Zeo Crystals
description: The user is able to harness as well as use the powers that are embedded within the five mystical zeo crystals. There are in total five zeo crystals, each crystal with a different color has its own unique power. The Red Zeo crystal has the ability of flight, the green zeo crystal has the ability of superstrength, the blue crystal is super speed, the yellow crystal is invulnerability and finally the pink crystal is healing.
summary: The ability to use the abilities embedded in each different zeo crystal
strengths: Different sets of power to combat different situations
Only gives power to the person that is good in nature
Cannot be stolen
weaknesses: Cannot combine two crystals together to get two powers

name: Black Hole Immunity
description: The summary says it all. With this ability, you can never get sucked into black holes. It also has the added bonus of letting you actually go through white holes, so you can see what's on the other side. So it also means you can escape black holes. However, you can still be sucked in if you touch the black hole (but who would actually do that? )
summary: The ability to be immune to the attraction of black holes.
strengths: Be immune to the gravity of black holes without being immune to any other gravity.
Escape black holes with ease.
Go through white holes and find out the truth of black holes.
weaknesses: Where are you going to find a black hole?
You can still get sucked in by touching it.

name: Myth Power: Aegle's Aesthetic

name: Dinosaur Summon

name: Importance Aura
description: With this power you will be able to see an aura around every object that tells you how important an object is to your current situation, or how important it will be to future situations. This thought is then implanted or psychically communicated to a foe; the foe starts to contemplate on the thought so hard, that as they try to make sense of it, all motor functions cease, and the subject has no other desire except to contemplate the meaning of the thought that has been implanted in their mind.

description: Each power actually possessed,stolen,mimicked,duplicated or copied with power backup ability adds together and multiples the person's density by that number. Author power mimicry adds all the powers created by that person. Shadowulf1 tamer add all powers created by Shadowulf1. It takes 50 copies(the power backup ability) to equal one power. Top 10 power mimicry adds up to 10 powers,depending on how many of them the person actually possesses. Omni power mimicry counts as one power.
summary: The ability to give someone's powers weight and increase that person's density.
strengths: Make a power duplicator to heavy to move his own body.
Slow or stop power thieves.
Another way to stop someone using author power mimicry.
weaknesses: Someone with super strength.
You give someone invulnerability with this power.

name: Childish Wishes
description: With this power, you may grant the wishes of anyone under the age of thirteen. All the child must do is say "I Wish... " and you are able to grant the request that follows. Be the kind Fairy Godparent who makes all their dreams come true or the cruel Jinn who twists the words of their wish to harm them and everyone around them.
summary: The ability to grant the wish of a child
strengths: Grant children's wishes.
Sell wishes and make oodles of money.
weaknesses: You may only grant the wishes of children,
The wish must begin with "I Wish... "
People may think you're a creep for hanging around children.

name: Exact Condition
description:
When using this power the person always does things exact no more no less and reality warps subconsciously to make a person "exact"

Slight reality manipulation always have the exact amount in your wallet, when in the lab all measurements are exact and reactions perform exactly as calculated with very precise equipment
summary: The ability to always be exact
strengths: Always take exact measurement
You are always "exact"ly right in calculations
You will always have "exact"ly what you need
weaknesses: You can never be better than "exact"
If someone asks you for the exact value of pi and you try to explain, same with meaning of life

name: Cyperiokinesis
description: Through the hand of the caster, a sensation of intense burning and zero-degree freezing is felt within the target, giving both a mental and physical disability.
summary: The ability to give the sensation of being burned and frozen simultaneously.
strengths: Heavy wounding if inflicted properly
Can leave the enemy mentally defeated if nothing else
weaknesses: Depending on the strength of the opponent, it may not be as effective as on a weaker one
Through total mental control, it can be overcome

name: Which Blade
description: Every time you take out this weapon, it is different. From the lameness of a pencil to the power of Excalibur, this weapon is totally unpredictable. You can get any weapon with a blade or point, so no spoons or guns, unless they have a machete on them. If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword, one that hasn't been broken. If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that changes each time you unsheathe it.
strengths: Any sharp weapon
Chance of mythical/legendary swords
If your sword breaks, you can put the handle in the sheath and it will come out as a new sword.
weaknesses: No way to predict or control what sword you get
Chance of pencils, pens, arrowheads or other useless ones
If your sheath breaks, then it is stuck as is. If you make a new one, it won't change the blade.

name: Instant Replay
description: Perhaps you get yourself in a debate and you'd like to repeat certain points that the opposition pointed out earlier. Instant Replay is just the thing for the job!  Forgot where you put the keys? Don't know what you ate for breakfast? Instantly Replay it in real space that you can project anywhere, anytime! What better way than to say "I told you so!" when you can just show it?
summary: The ability to instantly replay a scene, moment, or a recurring image in public
strengths: Can repeat important information required during missions
No need for electricity or gadgets
Can replace TV
weaknesses: Will only replay whatever you have seen and heard
Must have surface to project onto
Will only play reruns (hence replays) of shows (if used as replacement for TV)

name: Daily Powers
description: Your powers change every day. There's no limit to the powers that you'll have!
summary: The ability to powers change daily
strengths: There's not limit to your powers.
New powers everyday.
weaknesses: Once you used that power for a day, it will never come back.

name: Chainokinesis
description: With this ability, you can control chains with your hands as well as release them from your hands. It is a lot more draining to release chains. If you are more adept, you can even release chains from walls and the ground.
summary: The ability to control and manipulate chains.
strengths: Never run out of chains.
Lock people down.
Beat people with it.
weaknesses: Very draining
Useless if you have Intangiblity
Can be melted with fire

name: Haha! Burn, Baby, Burn!
description: You can actually control the elements. Good thing is you can create your own minions from your element, such as, let's say, you can control fire, you can create minions who are your element (fire) and they follow your commands. Bad thing is, you CAN be defeated by your opposite element, such as water beats fire, earth beats wind, energy beats ice and so on. The examples below are the characters created from my own imagination.
summary: The ability to control and create minions out of fire, water, air, etc.
strengths: Kyanos (ice)
Tremblor (earth)
Groglurk (fire)
weaknesses: Drakonnan (fire)
Haeos (energy)
Heatblast (fire)

name: Delete This Life Crusher
description: You can grab your opponent by the neck, filling your fists with dark energy, and start consuming their life force. Then, you even punch your enemy in the stomach and allow the charged dark indigo firey energy to burst through them before throwing their body to the ground, and then stomp on their back that breaks their spine.
summary: The ability to completely drain the very life of your foe to death, then stomp on their back.
strengths: Could steal a person's life to gain a new one.
weaknesses: Can't give back a life that you stole from a person.

name: Costume Power
description: You are able to change into the things you wear. For example, you are able to have the powers of a sorcerer if you dress like one, or you are able to have the powers of a superhero if you dress like one. If you need to learn about people from the past, you can put on those types of clothes and see what it was like. That also includes if you want to learn about a famous person, you could dress like them and then know what they know. But you can always go back to just being you if you want.
summary: The ability to gain powers depending on what costume you wear.
strengths: Can be different persons
Can totally freak people out during Halloween
Fun
weaknesses: You might not have the costume you want
People might think you're weird if you always wear a costume
Can't merge two costumes, e.g. you can't add angel wings to an alien costume

name: Power Reverse
description: With this strange power you can cause a Pyrokinetic to become a Hydrokinetic, a Flyer to become a Tunneler, a Mind Reader to a Mind Controller. With one touch you could cause anyone's power to completely reverse. All powers have an opposite and this power also tells you what the reversed power will be. Some powers on the other hand might have more than one reversed form. For example, an Ability Amplifier might become either an Ability Thief or an Ability Dampener. With practice you could choose.
summary: The ability to cause anyone's power to become its polar opposite.
strengths: You can reverse people's powers (and change them back).
If someone you know hates their power.
You know what the reversed power will be.
weaknesses: Most won't know how to control their new ability.
You must touch them to reverse them.
Reversing your own power could be bad.

name: Aphrodite
description: This power enables the user to be as beautiful as Aphrodite herself. But Aphrodite has a temper. So the user can also make sure that any victim can never be loved.
summary: The ability to have hypnotizing beauty
strengths: Beauty
More than just looks
weaknesses: Kinda boring

name: Saboteur
description: The Saboteur is capable of disturbing the peace among individuals, small cliques, communities, and with enough willpower, towns or countries. The Saboteur's greatest tool is chaos and utilizing this element augments your strength drastically. The Saboteur also draws power from civil disputes, anger, shouting, and other forms of rage. When the Saboteur is fueled by chaos, he or she will emanate a burgundy aura. The aura can discharge in several forms of offense and defense.
summary: The ability to become a superpowered expert in the art of sabotaging.
strengths: Riots will transform you into a virtually invincible being of unmeasurable power.
Blast targets with beams of raw chaos.
Expanded knowledge of sabotage; possibly unlimited solutions.
weaknesses: Pacifists and monks are your worst enemies.
May be portrayed as a sociopath.

name: Negative Power Charge
description:
This ability your strength, speed, accuracy, hand-eye coordination, logic and strategy skills increase greatly when in a vicinity of people feeling negative.
E.g Angry, upset, frustrated, moody.
However you are weakened by people with positive feeling. Ths power opposes Positve Power Charge.
summary: The ability to gain strength based on negative feelings and emotions.
strengths: You feeling negative, doubles the extent of your power.
weaknesses: Must rely on people having negative feelings.
Negative feelings weaken you.

name: Vision Drain
description: This power lets you steal a persons very memories, any they have from now to the day they were born, simply by touching their head. This move can be useful if you need to learn a secret your friend is keeping from you, find out where they hid the diamonds, or discover any other information the target could possibly know.
summary: The ability to drain a person of their memories and add them to yours.
strengths: Find out any bit of information you need.
Good for police investigations.
Find out the answers for that big important test you have on Friday.
weaknesses: You could see some disturbing things.
Mind learn some hurtful things if the target knows you.
Could get cought by someone else if you don't use this power in private.

name: Polymerkinesis
description: You can be capable of manipulating and channelling various kinds of plastic. You can even manipulate polyesters and silicone-based nylons to your whim. This newly developed technique allows you to form organic bioplastics with the earth, water, and air.
summary: The ability to control and reshape plastic objects
strengths: You can be a Plastic Magnet
Plastic is a relatively common substance
weaknesses: Fire will melt anything you can control
Rural areas typically do not have many plastics

name: Demolition Zone
description: This power creates a zone that changes things that are inside. Things inside the zone lose their invulnerability and immortality for as long as they are inside the zone. Objects become more brittle the longer they are inside the zone. People also begin to develop the power the create controlled explosions on inanimate objects to demolish them. The effects of the zone fade though when the zone is left.
summary: The ability to create a zone that allows the destruction of anything.
strengths: Enemies lose their invulnerability and immortality.
Objects become weaker.
Ability to cause controlled explosions on inanimate objects.
weaknesses: You lose invulnerability and immortality too.
May start breaking things you do not want.
Foes can cause explosions as well.

name: Point Defense
description: Basically, point defense is the practice of defending a single object or small area using things that are normally offensive. Ex: Using Surface-to-Air missiles to destroy Intercontinental Ballistic missiles, however realistic that may seem. This power just applies the practice of point defense to offensive superpowers. For example, this power will use Pyrokinesis, but not PB: Ignition. You could do point defense without this power, but it is harder to do without this power.
summary: The ability to defend oneself with offensive powers
strengths: If all your other powers are offensive, then this power will really help.
You can still use your powers normally even if they're being used by Point Defense.
This power calcutes out all the mathematics involved for the user.
weaknesses: Has no effect on normally defensive powers.
Will not affect friends' powers.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Magic Effect Transfer
description: Curses and enchantments are long-lasting magics that affect objects and people and are sometimes permanent. Someone with this power can change the one who is affected by those types of spells. Each spell whose target is changed will drain energy from the user of this power and require a large amount of concentration. The stronger the spell, the higher the energy drain.
summary: The ability to transfer the effects of magic from one being to another
strengths: Take curses off allies and put them on enemies.
Concentration needed remains the same regardless of spell strength.
weaknesses: Some high-level curses and enchantments (especially divine ones) cannot be affected by this power.
Pretty much impossible to use while fighting.

name: Golden Flames
description: These flames have the color of gold and can hurt beings like ordinary fire but deal more damage to anything that is evil and less to anything that is on the side of good. Those who are extremely virtuous will most likely not be harmed by these flames.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that are anti-evil
strengths: Cool golden flames that have the purpose of taking down demons.
weaknesses: Not meant to be used against the virtuous.

name: Perfect Power Detection
description: This power will look at everything about a person- from their passions, dislikes, and personality to what other people think about them, and will tell you what the perfect power for them would be. You can also limit what it's based off (for example, just based off of their desires and nothing else, or just what power would make them happiest), and limit what powers there are to choose from (for example, "of the powers off of the super power list... ").
summary: The ability to detect what power would be perfect for someone
strengths: A must have for power-granters! You also get to know *why* it's perfect.
Also does the reverse, you can look at some of the powers that they'd hate the most
Will manage your own powers too if you have Josh's Power Switchboard (see very first comment).
weaknesses: Without power-gifting powers, completely useless
No more asking people "what power(s) would you want, if you could have superpowers"
(since you'll already know the answer)

name: Emotional Submission Chamber
description: With a gesture you can encase your opponent in a grey barrier from head to toe concentrating based on your emotions, he or she get a panicked look on their faces and the barrier closes in an orb around them and lifts them above the ground. Massive color balls of willpower, fear, rage, love, hope, compassion, justice, sorrow, peace, joy, greed & wisdom forming orbiting and spiraling inwards towards the barrier and it powerfully explodes with the foe that's in it dealing a huge amount of damage.
summary: The ability to create a barrier that traps your opponent for free hits.
strengths: You could out-trap your foe with this move.
weaknesses: None

name: Aura Attune: Air
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Air. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to air or wind are greatly empowered, but all earth related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to air powers, but weaker to earth related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Air Elemental, causing Air-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Earth-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to attune your aura with the element of Air.
strengths: Empower your spiritual or magical air powers.
Have air-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful air powers.
weaknesses: Weakens magical and spiritual earth powers.
Earth-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful earth powers.

name: The Guardian Of Eden
description: The power to protect and use the Garden of Eden. The Garden can give you powers or let you see into the future, each gift is different for each individual, however, the Garden can make it's own choices and if you prove unworthy, it will kill you or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
summary: The ability to protect and use the Garden of Eden
strengths: The Garden gives you a gift it see's you need. (weaponry/powers)
You have the ability to protect Eden and use the wisdom and powers of the Tree.
You are viewed as a high ranking Angel which can move in an out of Eden at whim
weaknesses: If proven unworthy to the Garden it will either kill or banish you to the darkest regions of Hell.
You cannot change the future.
You cannot use the Garden for revenge or murder.

name: Vampiric Matter Manipulation
description: This ability allows the user to generate a sinister material that is design to feed on the energy that other matter to move. This makes the other matter inert and maybe even worse. The vampiric matter can absorb the matter's basic properties.
summary: The ability to create and control a form of matter that feeds on other matter's motion energy.
strengths: Create a dangerous matter that feeds on other matter to be more powerful.
Make all matter useless
Affects living creatures as well.
weaknesses: Does not possess special properties of other matter just how the matter moves.

name: Lord Of Shadow: Shadow State
description: With this power you can steal a person's shadow by touching it. You gain the person's powers, but you can only use them in the Shadow State. When you enter the Shadow State, your eyes turn black and you are surrounded by a dark aura. You can use the powers of all the people whose shadows you have stolen. But using the Shadow State has a cost. The darkness fills you with rage, and the shadows carry the memories of their original owners. Without practice, the rage and memories could consume you.
summary: The ability to steal people's shadows, allowing you to gain their powers by entering the Shadow State
strengths: In the Shadow State you have complete mastery over the powers you have gained
You can enter the Shadow State at will
Can be used with Shadow Traitor: you can steal a shadow for your army and gain its powers too
weaknesses: The rage and memories make it hard to control youself (think Avatar State)
Even with experience, prolonged time in the Shadow State can drive you insane

name: Meteoric Metamorphosis
description: This power allows you to turn yourself into a stone-like material and launch you in the air like a real meteor. You can fly in that form and, in addition, your body will be unbreakable, destroying every terrestrial stuff in your way.
summary: The ability to convert your body into stone and propel yourself like a meteor
strengths: You can fly really fast both on earth and in the space
If you land in somewhere with enough force, you'll make a real disaster
In your Meteoric form, you're completely invincible, even if you don't have oxygen
weaknesses: It's really hard to control the flight distances
Your force will be very difficult to tame if you aren't very careful
Your power can be a danger to others in a very enclosed places

name: Correlation Inducement
description: With this ability, you can make any one factor influence another, with a positive or negative correlation. You can make any one factor influence any other, such as making the amount of toast consumed positively correlate with longevity; the more toast a person eats, the longer they live.
summary: The ability to make any one factor influence any other.
strengths: Achieve a huge variety of effects.
Universal.
Fits several specialized purposes.
weaknesses: Universal.
It lasts until death or intentional reversal, so you could forget it is in action.
Be careful not to make one factor influence another when the opposite is already in play.

name: Transformutation
description: Basically, this power lets you give life and transforming ability to any mechanical or electrical device. You are essentially a selective "All Spark". The transformers you create are at your command, becoming your trained pets. Like pets, however, they must be cared for and taught how to behave, otherwise they revert to their natural "good" or "evil" base.
summary: The ability to turn any mechanical or electrical device into a Transformer.
strengths: You can have your own personal robotic bodyguard anytime you want.
Turn your car into battle-ready warrior - who can then turn into a better car!
You can have many smaller pets that will do your mischievious bidding.
weaknesses: Bigger transformers tend to be accidentally destructive. Your car might sit on your house!
Un-cared for transformers could turn against you.
Too many transformers might be hard to manage.

name: Alti Power
description: I didn't make this. It's a power that someone named Alti has on Xena: Warrior Princess. When she touches people she can make them go through something in their past or future in the present. Once she touched Xena and made her experience being crucified from the future, and Xena's hands and feet got nail holes in them. She also made her legs feel broken another time, but didn't actually break them because she wasn't touching her.
summary: The ability to make people experience something from their past or future.
strengths: Its a friggin awesome power
You can see a person's future or past with it
It makes super PWNage
weaknesses: You have to touch a person to do it fully.

name: Death's Scythe
description: The ability to summon death's scythe which can slice and dice anything no matter how strong. The scythe can also grab people and send them for judgement which will either send them for eternal punishment in hell or eternal happiness in heaven.
summary: The ability to summon Death's Scythe
strengths: Can cut through anything.
Send enemies to hell.
Can summon it wherever you are.
weaknesses: Anyone can use it while you're unconcious if you had it in you're hand.
Enemies may go to heaven or choose to to come back to life.
Can be used on you.

name: Book Of......
description: Say you wanted to know to bake a cake. All you would have to do would be think or say "Book of Baking" and it would appear wherever you want. It would contain all the information known on baking but still be normal size. To make it vanish say or think "Book of Baking" and it would vanish. You could do the same thing for any topic. Book of Magic, Book of History, or even Book of Books. Can have as many books as you want at one time. But you may want to always have the Book of Books as a guide.
summary: The ability to summon a book on any topic
strengths: Have the ultimate source of information on anything at anytime
The books are normal sized and can be vanished whenever
Could get more power from books like Book of Magic
weaknesses: May not know what book you might need.
May lose track of some books

name: Existential Frequency Shifting
description: This power allows you to tune into someone's existential frequency. By doing so, that person becomes the only one who can see, hear, or touch you, or more generally interact with you -- anybody else who doesn't match that frequency will just phase through you, won't even notice you and won't have any effect on you. That person is also the only one you can interact with. So, from your point of view, you are in a copy of the real world but devoid of population, except for you and that person.
summary: The ability to target someone so that person is the only one who can interact with you.
strengths: Your frequency can be changed randomly. It'll have a slight chance to match someone's in the world.
Anyone who doesn't match your frequency can't do anything to you, since you don't "exist" to them.
They can't even detect you or cancel your power.
weaknesses: You can only interact with the person (or people, in rare cases) who matches your new frequency.
You can feel very lonely, seeing the world as an empty place.
To cancel it, you must match the universal frequency. If you don't realize it, it can mean trouble.

name: Adventure Time!
description: Your life is boring? Problem solved! When you say the magical words "Adventure Time", you will be treated to an awesome, dangerous and funny adventure. This way you will never get bored, and you can go on all crazy adventures that you always wanted. The adventure usually starts when something weird happens exactly after you say "Adventure Time", so have fun!
summary: The ability to make crazy, funny and cool things happen by saying out loud "Adventure Time"
strengths: You will never get bored (saying Adventure Time causes SOMETHING randomly cool to happen)
Adventures are dangerous, but you will never die in them, and they are always awesome.
weaknesses: Has no battle purposes, except maybe escape

name: Weight Shift
description: Your center of gravity is the point in your body through which you find it easiest to balance. With this power you can shift your weight to move it about your body at will with no visible effects. This concept was briefly explored in Futurama where it grants Hermes mad limbo skills. However, there are many other uses. If you place it in your head it can make you very difficult to knock down. Placed in your feet it makes it easier to get up. A variety of ninja-like skills are at your disposal.
summary: The ability to shift your center of gravity to anywhere in your body
strengths: Very Versatile
Ninjaesque
No visible changes
weaknesses: Difficult to get the hang of
Feels slightly uncomfortable
Placing weight in your head only works if you are hit in the head

name: The Giving Tree
description: When you use this power, a seed or seeds will appear in your hands. The seeds will have a small image of what it will make. When you plant the seeds they will grow unnaturaly fast, fully grown in less the five minutes. You can even control what its full size is. You can choose what they bear. It can be anything from oranges to money to machine guns.
summary: The ability to create seeds for any sort of tree
strengths: Can create almost anything
Trees are cool
weaknesses: Trees can be chopped down
Can create ALMOST anything

name: Rotating Shield
description: The forcefield created has a maximum radius of 100 metres. The shield is constantly and automatically rotating. The effect of the rotation is to decrease the damage inflicted to the shield itself. This allows the shield to last against more attacks in the long-run but takes up more power than your average force field.
summary: The ability to create a shield that rotates and spins areas of itself
strengths: Can take more hits in a longer battle.
75% less concentration needed to have the field spin than with a normal forcefield.
weaknesses: Takes up more power in the long run that could be used for other powers during the fight.
Normal nonspinning shield takes 20% less concentration to keep going than this shield.

name: Calcium Manipulation
description: With this power you are able to control not only calcium, but objects that have a large amount of calcium in them. This means that the user is able to create and control things such as milk, bones, and shells. It is even possible to change an object with calcium into a different object with a large amount of Calcium, such as turning Milk into Bones. Calcium is the most abundant metal by mass in many animals.
summary: The ability to control and create calcium, and objects made out of Calcium.
strengths: Control and create Calcium and objects with large amounts of Calcium.
Control objects such as Milk, Bones, and Shells.
Animals have a large amount of Calcium in them, making this power useful against them.
weaknesses: Objects need a large amount of Calcium in them to be controlled.
Creating objects that have Calcium in them is harder than creating pure Calcium.
People with stronger metal manipulating powers.

name: Psychopompism
description: This ability is not one to be toyed with. It allows the user to lure a person's soul out of its body by imitating the experience of near-death. This may mean causing the subject to see "The Light", or causing their life to flash before their eyes. Either supernatural method makes the soul feel like it's time to leave and go on to the afterlife, effectively killing the person in whom the soul resided.
summary: The ability to lure souls out of their bodies, resulting in death
strengths: Kill foes with no trace
Their spirit won't even haunt you
If used on discarnate spirits, it sends them to the afterlife as well
weaknesses: Can't be undone
Once the process starts, it can't be stopped
Immortals, time-defiers, astral projectors, animals and plants are all immune to this power

name: Weight Mimicry
description: With this power, you just touch an object, concentrate on it, and Boom. You now weigh as much as that object. This process does not change your mass or density, and you do not require extra muscle to support extra weight. You can imitate the weight of anything, from the air around you to the whole earth, though doing the latter will likely cause you to fall to the center of said earth and die. There are really only two applications for this power: flight and demolition.
summary: The ability to become the same weight as anything you touch
strengths: Float and/or Fly if you have some helium with you
Tackle with the weight of a house
No need for extra muscle
weaknesses: If you can think of more than two effin' uses then you're effin' brilliant
Falling through the earth might hurt a bit
Must touch another human to return to a reasonable weight

name: The Paths Of Magic:The Warlock
description: The Path of Warlock, or the Path of Thought, is the second Path of Magic. Warlocks use nothing but their minds and visualization to do magic. Because humans have very powerful minds, they are extremely good at following this path. It is also said that warlocks and witches are the best at controlling mana in it's rawest form, or in other words, mana weaving. This gives you a special talent for the Path of Thought.
summary: The ability to have special talent as a warlock.
strengths: As a human, you're already gifted at this path.
weaknesses: Takes great concentration

name: Drain Vision
description: With this power, you can fire pink-colored rays from your eyes at the opponent. These rays drain their life entirely to replenish your health with frightening results – the enemy will spend the rest of their life living as a shriveld up old coot.
summary: The ability to fire rays from your eyes that will drain someone's life force.
strengths: Could look young and healthy again.
weaknesses: Draining your opponent can take up to 20 minutes

name: Anger Vision
description: With this power, your anger turns into radiation that your body stores. You can project it from your eyes at will. The angrier you get, the stronger it is. And if it reaches the maximum zone--or "M-Zone"--it will be uncontrollable, shooting a huge beam out of your eyes. The only thing that blocks it is titanium. The only way to know people have this power is a red glint in their eye (which turns bluish when they're happy).
summary: The ability to shoot anger from your eyes
strengths: Shoot anger out of your eyes.
Give bullies a run for their money.
Finally get the treatment you deserve.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable powers.
People with titanium armor.
People can tell you have this power from a red/blue glint in their eyes.

name: Enhanced Senses
description: With this power, you would see, hear, smell, taste, and touch with more clarity, accuracy, and detail than usual.
summary: The ability to have better senses
strengths: Better senses
weaknesses: Bad smells and tastes, bright lights, loud noises

name: Goldworks:The Box Of Power
description: The Box of Power has been known by many names over time. The Diabolical box, Pandora's box, The Box of Fate, and others. Within this golden box, an incredible, unimaginable power dwells, the power to grant near godhood. All who open this box are granted god-like powers and a realm. They will know what their realm is, because they will find a scroll stating what it is within the box. The box will endow you with godly energy, with which you can do as you wish.
summary: The ability to wield the Box of Power
strengths: Near god-hood(because you were once mortal, you can still be killed but it's very hard to do)
Powers over your realm
Other godly powers
weaknesses: Can still be killed
Not a true god
Too much power is bad for everyone

name: Altered Ego Cloning
description: Everyone has an alter ego. They could be superheroes, villains, even a successful businessman, I don't know. Those are the people we dream of being, just like you and me but only better. They could also have powers but it is a one-time chance to create your altered ego. For me, I would have my altered ego be like me, but only stronger, faster, and more impervious to physical damage.
summary: The ability to create different version of yourself.
strengths: Your altered ego can be anything you want.
There are no limits on how many abilities or skills it would gain.
You can make it disappear or reappear whenever you want.
weaknesses: You can only make one.
Once you create your altered ego, you can't change it.

name: Musical Master
description: Take any instrument, such as a piano. Think out the music as you go along and it will seem like you are playing the piano along to your mental composition. No musical training necessary. This will work for any instrument but will only make music from that instrument, i.e. you can't take a flute and make it sound like a trumpet, etc. Have a rock song stuck in your head and want to play it masterfully for the next school talent show? You can, without any experience. Just play!
summary: The ability to create any music you want with a certain instrument just by thinking it.
strengths: Play any song or piece on any instrument just by thinking it out
No experience required; you can be a master at any musical instrument
Make money by landing gigs as a musical genius
weaknesses: The sound must be playable by the actual instrument
Only play one instrument at a time (unless you can play two at a time in real life)
Be cautious when playing out your thoughts: volume, quality, etc.

name: Voodoo Power
description: With this power if wanted to make a building get destroyed you could make a Lego structure then nock it down, or use at chess board to control a real war. When your done you can gust undo the voodoo spell.
summary: The ability to make anything a Voodoo doll of any thing
strengths: You are the controller
weaknesses: Don't make an mistake

name: Akasha Mastery
description: Also called Akasha Manipulation, one with this ability has an immensely powerful one at his disposal. The user is capable of psychically tapping into and altering the collective unconscious (which the mystics call the Akashic Records); this can be used to alter what people remember (including restoring memories, or changing what they know to be history), what people perceive to be true, and even change what psychics pick up on from the astral realms. This can't be telepathically resisted.
summary: The ability to alter the collective unconscious to suit one's desires
strengths: Change what people remember and perceive as truth (distort/hide memories, fool lie detectors)
Change what psychics perceive (make a precog see the wrong future, or the like)
Perceive the true Akashic Records, and undo any changes to it at will
weaknesses: Some people don't have the "PERCEIVE the Akasha" part, and they forget what they changed
Might be tempted to use this for evil
Divine beings, ghosts, extradimensional entities and those with True Sight, etc. Sense the truth

name: Inconvenience Destroyer
description: Whether it's comfort or the situation where you owe a friend $1 and you only have 99 cents, this power will eliminate inconveniences, generating that extra cent. This power works on minor inconveniences, not major.
summary: The ability to eliminate minor inconveniences.
strengths: None really, it's not that useful.
weaknesses: Only minor. Not major.
Not really useful, as it's only minor inconveniences.

name: Water Absorption
description: Absorb water and ice with out harm. You can either release the water when you absorb it or save it in your body. Can only hold the water in for an hour.
summary: The ability to absorb any water or ice without being harmed
strengths: Water or ice will never hurt you
If your a firefighter you will never need a hose again
Good for in the summer and the pool is crowded
weaknesses: If held in for to long you will blow up
Does not work at all in dry areas
If you go into a desert all the water will immediatly evaporate

name: Chaos Incarnate
description:
The essence of Chaos flows through you. 
Schrodinger's cat is every outcome between death and life until it is observed, right? This power is something along those lines. 
Essentially, your body exists in a never-ending state of flux. All of your qualities are constantly subject to change. 
Experience extreme mood swings; levels of intelligence, strength, reaction speed, etc. Unexpectedly change; shapeshift (although retaining a basically human form); use magic, see things, die, be water.
summary: The ability to defy expectations. Or fulfill them. Or something...
strengths: Possibilities are endless.
Dying occurs, but not permanently.
Make your enemies tremble in fear.
weaknesses: Uncontrollable state of being.
Probably not rational more than half the time.
Make your friends flee in terror.

name: Office Assassin
description: You know a multitude of ways to use any everyday objects to kill someone. Anything you can hold in your hand you know over 50 ways to kill someone with it. You know just where to staple someone in the neck to paralyze them; you can make a bomb out of a microwave, a radio clock, a water jug, and rubbing alcohol; you can make poison out of coffee, hand sanitizer, and a bag of jellybeans; you can crawl through air ducks, jump from roof to roof, and climb from window to window with ease; etc.
summary: The ability to kill someone with everyday objects
strengths: You know over 100 ways to kill someone instantly with just a paper clip
You can hide any evidence and never get caught, they'll never know it was you or how you did it
You know every form of self defence and martial arts there is.
weaknesses: You may have random impulses to kill the nearest person.
Does not affect your skills at normal weapons, e.g. guns, knifes, etc.
If someone taps your shoulder, or does anything to startle you, you go into killing mode.

name: Jadeite
description: Jadeite is a form of jade and is currently the most expensive gemstone in the world. With this power, you have full control over jadeite having the power to create it, shape it, alter it's weight and density, perceive it and turn into a form composed of it. Even large amounts of Jadeite can be levitated and reshaped with little effort. However, you can only control the solid form of jadeite.
summary: The ability to generate, manipulate and mimic the mineral jadeite
strengths: Jadeite is the most expensive gemstone in the world.
Can turn yourself into a jadeite golem.
Can have full control over jadeite, creating and reshaping it.
weaknesses: If you create to much jadeite the price will go down.
If jadeite is changed chemically you lose control over it.
Geokinetic powers may override this power (and can manipulate YOU in Jadeite form)

name: Power Programming
description: With this ability, you can rig your abilities to perform a set task just before they are negated or when you are about to die. For instance, if you used this power on Teleportation, if somebody tried to negate it, it would predict the danger of power negation and work in the set way (in this case, send you to a preselected area) by itself in the instant before the negation occurred.
summary: The ability to rig a power to work automatically if it's in danger of changing, deletion or negation.
strengths: Affected powers will activate moment before the are negated.
Works with most powers.
Time manipulating abilities do not affect it.
weaknesses: Must be set up beforehand.
Only activates the power a moment beforehand.
Could take effect in the wrong situation (E. G. Killing an ally with power negation).

name: Biohazard Immunity
description: With this superpower, you are immune to all illness based attacks. If you have this power, you can also duplicate it and give the power to as many living organisms as you like. Any living organism with this superpower are immune to illness based attacks.
summary: The ability to any and all illness based attacks.
strengths: Be completely immune to illness based attacks.
Can duplicate and grant the superpower to others.
weaknesses: You can still catch the common cold.
If someone attacks you with the common cold, you might catch it.
Everyone gets the common cold sometimes.

name: Genuine Intuition
description: Everyone has had a "gut feeling" about something at one point or another. Intuition is defined as "the power or faculty of attaining to direct knowledge or cognition without evident rational thought and inference." With Heightened Intuition, you will be able to trust those gut feelings 100% of the time. If you have a bad feeling about something, you will be accurate in thinking so, just as if you have a good feeling about something. You DO still have the power of changing how things turn out.
summary: The ability to trust your intuition 100% of the time.
strengths: Prevent you and your loved ones from getting into bad situations
Getting a bad feeling about your flight and cancelling it
Getting a good feeling about the lottery numbers you picked!
weaknesses: You don't always get gut feelings about things--it comes and goes.
Getting a bad feeling about a presentation you're about to make
Risk is everywhere.  You might start act on your intuition too much.

name: Myth Power: Ares' Arrogance
description: Ares, in Greek myth, was the god of war, battle, bloodshed, violence and manly courage. As such, channeling him allows one to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition. In addition, one gains superhuman strength, speed, durability, stamina, reflexes, agility and dexterity. Furthermore, when one is angry or afraid, one can psychically enter a battle rage, which negates one's irrational fear and boosts allies' morale. One can even psychically produce a powerful sonic scream, when injured.
summary: The ability to channel Ares' command over the essence of war, battle, bloodshed, violence and manly courage
strengths: Snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Gain superhuman physical stats; when angered, enter a psychic battle rage, similar to berserker rage
Gain Sonic Scream, when injured
weaknesses: Cannot harness one's rage to induce Rapid Regeneration until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand damage from (and gain physical power from) weapon attacks until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia provides especially strong influence over one with this ability (NCN)

name: Rumors
description: A person with this power can spread rumors extremely quickly by spreading them telepathically. Only people that know about your power realize that it was you that spread the rumor. Everyone else thinks that it was their own idea and everyone that hears the rumor will have it stuck in their head so that they find it easier to believe or more curious about it. The more people affected by this power the more quickly the rumor will be established as true---in terms of belief.
summary: The ability to spread rumors secretly by telepathy
strengths: Spread fear into an entire populace and humiliate enemies
Can also be used to broadcast messages to allies
Can be used to start up conversation with strangers
weaknesses: Once someone knows about your powers they become immune to it
You are responsible for the consequences of the rumors
Can tempt you to troll people and lie

name: Carnage Blade
description: The blade has great power and can cut through the most toughest materials and metals and it can be activated at will.
summary: The ability to create a blade from your strongest arm
strengths: Can cut through the toughest materials and metals
Has great power
Can be activated at will
weaknesses: Can hurt many people

name: Geoformation Mimicry
description: Geoformation or Geoform is short for Geometric Transformation. Basically, you can mimic anything that is based on translation, reflection, rotation, or dilation and the way it does it. I will give you an example: You can mimic the dilation of your shadow to big or small and can do it continuously.
summary: The ability to mimic anything that translates, reflects, rotates, or dilates.
strengths: Multiple variety of transformations.
weaknesses: The effects only lasts for 15-20 min.

name: Ability Detection
description: Ability Detection is like a metal detector mixed with an X-ray machine and wrapped in radar. It allows the user to detect superhumans, know their ability, and even how powerful they are. It is difficult to jam or redirect, and can even be used to track down a specific ability. However, it does have a limited effective range of 100 miles.
summary: The ability to sense the whereabouts of superpowered individuals
strengths: Be aware of the approach of potential threats
Know if someone has an ability and what it is
Can be used to track down a specific power
weaknesses: Does not work on normal humans, no matter how dangerous they are
Limited effective range of 100 miles
No offensive capabilities

name: Heartless
description: If you have this ability, you can withdraw your heart from your body in the form of a glowing golden light. When your heart is outside your body, you can experience no emotion, but your body and clothes will be entirely in black and white. When this power is first gained, it can be used to heal someone at the cost of your own stamina in the area of pain. Once trained to full power, it can be used as a weapon and without losing any of your own strength.
summary: The ability to use your heart as a weapon
strengths: Heal people and bring back the dead
Use as a light in dark places
Experience no emotion when in use (no sadness or loss of temper)
weaknesses: Experience no emotion when in use (obvious that it's being used)
Lose all color on your clothes and body (obvious that it's being used)
Needs to be trained a lot before it can be used as a weapon or without losing any of your own health

name: Living Rock
description: With this power, you can make rocks into stone warriors to defend/serve you. Basically, you find some rocks and fire the life wave at them, and they form themselves into a human shape. This power will only work if there are enough rocks to make a person out of.
summary: The ability to bring rocks to life.
strengths: Rock armies
Rock slaves
Crowd surfing with enough rockmen
weaknesses: High 5s really hurt
Not exactly the brightest pets
Heavy

name: Web Willpower
description: The primary function of the it is to provide a weapon capable of transforming your thoughts into physical constructs through the your strength of willpower. You can create any particular items or construct that they can imagine as long as you have the willpower necessary to will it into existence. The constructs are made out of Web Fluids, which is an expression of pure willpower. You can also create web based missiles or bullets.
summary: The ability to construct anything that you can imagine made from webs
strengths: It can used in offence or defense.
weaknesses: Those webs can wear off and dissolve into a powder.
Willpower-based; a lack of focus will result in a failed construct

name: Disasters
description: Nuclear Explosions, Tornadoes, Hail, Plane Crashes, Earthquakes, and everything in between. Cause any form of disaster or calamity to occur.
summary: The ability to make any form of disaster happen
strengths: Can be as harmless as rain or deadly as a comet strike
weaknesses: Cannot stop disasters from happening

name: Virtuevice Wings
description: This may sound extremely bizzare, but you may have this strange feeling of having both bird and bat-like wings from your behind your back, you can have white feathered wings from your left side and Brownish black leathery wings from your right side, but you also be able to fly ultrafast with having both feathers and leather wings from your back.
summary: The ability to sprout both bird and bat-like wings from you back.
strengths: They are inhumanly strong, easily capable of breaking a man's bones.
weaknesses: People think that you're half-angel and half-devil like the movie Little Nicky

name: Super Hindsight
description: With this ability, in any disaster you will know what could have been done to prevent it.
summary: The ability to know what should have been done
strengths: You'll help people learn what they should have done
If you personally make a mistake, you'll know what you should have done
weaknesses: You'll never actually be able to prevent disasters

name: Energy Wrist Watch
description: With this power you have an irremovable watch that shoots energy beams on your wrist. The beams can be set to different power levels by turning the watch face with the lowest being burning and the highest being instant death. The watch is irremovable so an enemy can never steal it but you can't take if off either unless of course you lose this power.
summary: The ability to have a watch on your wrist that shoots energy beams
strengths: You can shoot powerful energy beams from your wrist watch
You can adjust the power levels of the beams
weaknesses: You can't take off the watch

name: Resin Excretions
description: With this power the user can excrete different types of resin from their skin. Sticky resin, which when hardened is stronger than stone. Elastic Resin which acts like rubber. Flammable resin. Resins with healing and toxic qualities. Slick resin that reduces friction. But to use them, the area you excrete it from must be bare.
summary: The ability to excrete a number of differant types of resin from your skin
strengths: Healing and poisons.
Weapons and armor.
Quick ways to get around.
weaknesses: The resin comes out of your skin, so don't dress to heavly.
You cannot controll the resin, only excrete and fire it.
Water will wash it away in its unhardened state.

name: Death Manipulation
description: This superpower allows a person to communicate with anybody who is dead. They are able to see them and speak to them as well as have the deceased to talk back. However, this ability would be really terrible for a battle or a fight. This power, when in use, renders the person invisible to anything around them. Unfortunately, if used for too long of a period of time, the person using it will eventually want to join them and kill themself.
summary: The ability to communicate with those who have died
strengths: You get to communicate with the dead
You get to become invisible except to those who are deceased
weaknesses: Not very good for fights
Does not actually bring the deceased back to life
You could die from wanting to join them if communicating with them for too long

name: Direct Sunlight Absorption
description: When your skin is exposed to natural sunlight, the energy is instantly diffused to every cell in your body and instantly consumed for your superpowers: super strength, invulnerability, healing, super speed and flight. You cannot store this energy, and when in darkness, you lose your abilities instantly. If the sun's light is blocked or dimmed, your powers instantly diminish. Having just a fingertip exposed to sunlight will raise your power levels to slightly above human level.
summary: The ability to have superpowers only in sunlight
strengths: On a sunny day or above the clouds, your power is great
Can heal injuries just by standing in the sun
weaknesses: You'll probably have to fly/fight half-nude to absorb more energy
At night or in the dark you could be killed easily.
If you try to fly down into a heavy cloud cover, you'll fall and die

name: Aura Of Masculinity
description: The user becomes a master at anything men find appealing, including, but not limited to: rugged good looks, fighting (with or without weapons), wooing women, intelligence, and access to the best cars and clothes. He is also granted a powerful voice that girls find irresistible and enemies find horrifying. This lets him negotiate with anyone and anything. He can perform unbelieveable feats due to this manliness. In short, he becomes the ideal man, a living action hero, a man's man.
summary: The ability to become the manliest man on the planet.
strengths: Able to master anything that men find appealing, like fighting, picking up girls, and drinking beer.
The user is able to perform impossible feats because his manliness defies space, time, and physics.
Any living thing will fight for the user because of his looks, talents, and manliness.
weaknesses: If the user leaves his planet, his power becomes useless.
Might cause an arrogant nature in the user.
If the user abuses his power, it could be devastating to both him and those around him.

name: Flames Of Possession
description: A person with this power has a very selfish power indeed. They gain the ability to create a fiery construct of anything that they have ever burned as long as that object had been burned to ashes. Once an object has been burned, they can immediately summon a fiery construct of that object with the same properties. In addition, even burned people can be summoned by the user, so the user can easily assemble an army of flamies. Fiery constructs can become solid or pure flame.
summary: The ability to summon fiery constructs of anything you have ever burned to ashes that will obey you
strengths: Can easily get lots of fiery objects
Can have a flame army
Constructs can become solid or flame at will and you can touch the fire without damage
weaknesses: Some things are hard to burn to ashes-such as metal
The durability of the solid construct remains the same
Need to have a lighter or some other object to start your fire collection

name: Time Defiance
description: Also called Atemporality/Extemporality, Atemporal/Extemporal Existence, this implies total immunity to any and all time-based attacks, abilities and effects. A chronokinetic could speed up, slow down, reverse or even stop time, and the user would be aware of it all, because it wouldn't affect them in the slightest. The user couldn't even travel through time, or be affected by time in any way shape or form besides normal aging.
summary: The ability to resist unnatural temporal effects
strengths: Immunity to Chronokinesis/chronokinetic effects (Temporal Spike, MythPower: Kronos' Craft, etc. )
Cannot be aged/de-aged, sped up, slowed down, reversed, stop or the like (no Obliteration, etc. )
This power is often accompanied by Chronopathy, so the user can also detect temporal anomalies, etc.
weaknesses: Can't travel in time (no undoing mistakes)
Can't receive good temporal effects (superspeed, etc. ) unless you have other chronokinetic powers
Still age

name: Kirby's Inhale
description: With this ability, you can inhale things and other people's attacks and gain powers from them like the famous pink puff, Kirby. Ex. Inhale ice and you can have ice breath. Ex. Inhale gunpowder and you can produce bombs out of thin air. Etc. People might think you're a cannibal though.
summary: The ability to inhale people and items and gain powers from them
strengths: You can inhale anything and gain a power from it.
It's easy to eat cause you could eat anything.
weaknesses: Eating at a restaurant is not a good idea.
Be careful when kissing.

name: Bird Control
description: With this power, you can control all types of birds, which means you can make birds poop on people you don't like or you can make them peck people's eyes out.
summary: The ability to control birds.
strengths: Can make birds poop on people you don't like.
Can make birds peck people's eyes out.
weaknesses: Not useful when fighting cat-themed villains.

name: Imbue Genetic Trait
description: You can put genetic traits into things, but you need DNA from a creature with those traits. You can also take out traits if you know their genetic sequences. You can see someone's DNA by tasting it and know what every thing does.
summary: The ability to put genetic traits into things.
strengths: Can give yourself powers from allies.
You will make an uber-vampire.
Give your enemies bad traits or take away their powers.
weaknesses: Must taste their blood.
Might get like AIDS or something.
Will probably need some paper to write the looong sequences on.

name: Shadow To Clay Figures
description: The user is able to summon up clay figures from their own shadow or shadows from non-sentient life. These clay figures are under the direct control of the person who summoned them. The number of clay figures that the user can can summons is highly dependent on the user's control over this power. If the clay gets burned by pyrokinetic users and turns into stone, the user can still control the new stone figures.
summary: The ability to summon up clay figures from the user's shadow
strengths: Shadows are ever present
Clay is strong against electricity
weaknesses: Weak against water
Shadows are scarce during the night

name: Equal Power
description: With this power whenever you're fighting a person/creature/people/creatures with the same super powers as you your superpower automatically becomes the same power level as theres. So if they have more practice with the power and there's is stronger your power automatically becomes stronger as well.
summary: The ability to have the same power levels as the person or people you're fighting
strengths: If you're fighting someone with the same powers as you your powers become as strong as their's
weaknesses: Your power reverts back to its normal level after the fight is over
This power is useless if your opponent doesn't have any of the same powers

name: Schwann Cell Mimicry
description: Your skin is made of an electrically-insulating material. Whenever you are grasping something, you can command your skin to stretch and roll round it, locking, consolidating and tightening your grip. Additionally, you can allow Neuron Mimics who can create special signals to direct them toward desired Neuron Mimics within a medium range, though you cannot make one who can't generate these signals create one. You can also undergo mitosis.
summary: The ability to have an electrically-insulating skin, stretch it and roll it round things you want to grasp.
strengths: You are needed if a Neuron Mimic wants to send their signals to another Neuron Mimic.
You are immune to the effects of electricity.
You can wrap things with your skin to protect them from electricity.
weaknesses: The Neuron Mimics still require Astrocyte Mimics to receive signals sent by other Neuron Mimics.
Unlike Oligodendrocyte Mimics, you can't detach yourself from things you've wrapped.
You are useless to a Neuron Mimic who can't even send signals.

name: Ability Source Link
description: A user of this power can link one power's source to another, charging it up. For instance, if they had Telekinesis, this power and Direct Sunlight Absorption, they could make their telekinesis gain strength when they stood in sunlight without reducing the power of Direct Sunlight Absorption.
summary: The ability to link the sources of your powers together.
strengths: Boost any power.
Take full advantage of your situation.
Benefits a variety of power choices.
weaknesses: Can weaken linked abilities too.
Must have an ability with a factor as a source to boost another power.
If one power is rendered nonfunctional, the link is broken.

name: Substance: Trait Enhancement
description: With this power, you can permanently enhance the properties or traits of a chemical element, combination or substance in the near vicinity. For example: Copper is a good conductor of electricity and heat. If you have a strip of it in your vicinity, you could enhance that trait to turn it into a super conductor. Titanium is a tough, heavy metal, but with this power you could make it almost indestructable.  The effects are permanent, so you only need to concentrate for a few seconds.
summary: The ability to enhance the traits or properties of a particular substance, chemical, etc.
strengths: Enhance substance properties to their maximum potential.
Change is permanent, no need to concentrate.
You can directly target chemical in the area, or a large burst within the vicintiy of 100 metres.
weaknesses: Change is permanent, that might not be so good.
You can only enhance the porperties that the substance already has.

name: Power Bearing
description: With this power the user can only be affected by a superpower or ability once. Say if the user gets hit by a energy blast, he can't be affected by the same blast again. The user can only negate three powers at once.
summary: The ability to only be affected by a ability/power once
strengths: The foe can't spam you with the same attack
weaknesses: This power only works if the user were hit by the power/ability
This power only allows you to negate three powers at once

name: Induced Shapeshifting
description: Shapeshifting is a great power, but it has the limitation of only affecting you. With this power, you are able to make others shapeshift by touching them. If you die or lose this power, they will revert. You may choose whether they can change between their forms at will or not.
summary: The ability to make other people shapeshift.
strengths: Make others more attractive to you.
Heal others, including reversing age.
Help your friends/allies in acts of infiltration.
weaknesses: Cannot use it on yourself.
Requires touch.
Consciousness and power are always retained.

name: Ten Incarnations
description: The user of this power has the ability to wield the power of the god of Victory which is "Ten Incarnations" and they are Gale(Wind), Bull, White Stallion, Camel, Boar, Youth, Bird (Raptor), Ram, Goat,and Warrior.
