However, some Incarnations work only under certain conditions, and all of them can only be used once a day.  Conditions are like the white stallion can only be used against those who have committed great sins against the people and likewise.
summary: The ability to posses the abilities of "Verethragna", the god of Victory
strengths: Ability of Verethragna(God of Victory)
With proper training Incarnations could be activated and used at the same time
weaknesses: Some incarnations only works under certain conditions
All of the incarnations can be used only once a day

name: Neural Pyrokinesis
description: This superpower allows people to trick the body into thinking it's burning while causing no actual harm. This makes it perfect for torturing people.
summary: The ability to make a person think they're burning to death.
strengths: This is great for torture.
This doesn't take any focus--just eye contact.
This power is non-lethal.
weaknesses: This cannot kill someone.
Must make eye contact.
Strong-willed people can break the effects.

name: Fairy Magic
description: Fairies aren't the only ones who can use their type of magic. Humans can use it too, if well trained in the fairy arts. Such abilities include glamouring, instilling sleep in others, foresight, transmutation, telekinesis, elemental control, you might even grow your own wings that you can retract at will. Just be careful you don't offend fairies or use the knowledge of their sacred arts for evil or they might just take your powers away.
summary: The ability to use the magic of the fairies
strengths: Flight via fairy wings that you can grow/retract at will.
Do near infinite kind of magical tricks, such as spells & potions.
Having the magic of fairies will undoubtedly prolong your lifespan by milleniums.
weaknesses: If you offend fairies, they make take away the knowledge of how you use their magic.
Trust me, you DO NOT want to make fairies mad! They're more powerful than you think.
Use this magic for good, not evil. Fairies are not evil creatures.

name: Death
description: This power enables you to kill anything in the world, from people to animals to plants to even molecules. This power is deadly and is a great offensive power. Anyone who has this power could be unstoppable. The affects of this power vary on what you use it on, but everything will die in its own way. This power is the most deadly of all and the only way that you can stop it is to kill the user, and that won't be as easy as it sounds.
summary: The ability to kill anyone or anything with the wave of a hand, the blink of an eye or a tilt of the head.
strengths: Can kill anything.
Great offensive use.
You are pretty much unstoppable.
weaknesses: May be too powerful for some.

name: Anti Matter
description: The ability to create anti-matter, or dark matter, at will. Anti-matter is the opposite of matter - yes, it exist in real life - and creates massive explosions if it comes in contact with ordinary matter, such as rocks, water, even air. Simply put, the power enables you to create massive explosions, and in the worse-case scenario, black holes.
summary: The ability to create anti-matter at will.
strengths: Nobody will have the guts to come near you, risking to explode.
Blast the crap out of things.
Create a black hole, and let it suck up everything in nearby places.
weaknesses: Watch out so that you won't blow yourself to smithereens!
Don't get sucked up by one of your own black holes!

name: Magician's Sight
description: The Magician's Sight is a tool used by many magicians. Basically, it lets you see the unseen. This includes auras, wards, invisible things, and you can see through any sort of disguise spell. You can also see force lines, streams of magical energy that run through the ground and sky.
summary: The ability to use the Magician's Sight
strengths: You can see things most people can't
Disguises won't fool you
You can see force lines
weaknesses: You can't do magic

name: Dream Dance
description: Dream Dance is the most vaguely-defined extradimensional energy force for you to draw your power. Dream Dance is also seen as a physical space to which you can astrally travel inside someone else's head while they are knocked out or asleep and you'll be able to detect actions and events in their dreams.
summary: The ability to simply force yourself in and out of time when you're inside someone else's dream.
strengths: You'll be able to warn someone if they are in danger.
You might tell someone if something's wrong in real life.
weaknesses: Never travel in someone else's nightmares.

name: Metaschizophrenia
description: In the occurrence of a metahuman, or superhero/supervillain, is diagnosed with Schizophrenia a rare abnormality may happen in which each personality that is developed may have a separate power. These powers do not have to be similar and could possibly be polar opposites.
summary: The ability to become a schizophrenic human with multiple personalities, each having a different power
strengths: More than one power
weaknesses: Not all personalities can be good

name: Battle Pro Generation
description: Generate the perfect solution for battle, so that everbody involved wins.
summary: The ability to generate perfect soulutions to a battle so that everyone wins
strengths: It's so good the opponent has to give in!
All around good.
weaknesses: Not good if your taking revenge.

name: Umbrium (Deadly Metal)
description: Umbrium can harm shadows and the effect of harming a shadow is that the effect rebounds back onto the shadow's owner. Ex. Cut the arm off the shadow and the arm will fall off the person. High-level users of this power can manipulate umbrium into any shape they choose while low-level users can only make rough shapes.
summary: The ability to create and control a jet-black metal that can harm shadows and darkness
strengths: Umbrium can be dangerous to your enemy if you can get to their shadow.
weaknesses: Do not accidentally harm your own shadow with Umbrium. EVER.
Umbrium can still be blocked with ordinary objects.
Umbrium can only harm things by cutting shadows.

name: Dinosaur Physiology
description: As a result of incorporating a serum containing all DNA of every dinosaur that has ever lived, you now have all their abilities at your disposal. You have the following abilities: superhuman strength, speed, endurance, acute olfactory receptors, durability, and sight. You can produce claws or extra limbs with ease and quick recovery.
summary: The ability to acquire dinosaur limbs and extensions along with their characteristics.
strengths: Your thick hide renders firearms useless.
Clear through dozens of enemies with an ankylosaurus tail.
Become the ultimate predator.
weaknesses: Weak to roving blackouts.
The intensities of cold temperatures will pose a threat to you when this ability is active.

name: Instant Degree
description: You will instantly be granted a legitimate Ph.D. (just about the highest degree one can earn) in any field of study of your choosing.  You will be given all the knowledge and experience that goes along with it, including a decent set of friends and connections.
summary: The ability to instantly have a Ph.D. and all the knowledge that comes with it for one field of study.
strengths: Truly be a master at one subject
Earn a lot more cash
Be the man
weaknesses: Choosing which field of study
If you skip college, you'll miss out on all the good times
The process of learning can be fun

name: Spark Flux
description: The user can focus their aura into a defensive electricity field with a 100m radius. It electrocutes all in that range. The user can share it's senses with the Spark Flux and when the user is surrounded by the Spark Flux, he/she is protected from most types of sensing.
summary: The ability to creat a web of aura generated electricity around the user
strengths: It is good for stealth missions, recon since it protects from most types of sensing including sound
It is good if the user is outnumbered by enemies in close range.
It only needs a small amount of aura to sustain.
weaknesses: While Spark Flux is at use the user is greatly vulnerable if it is surpassed.
It has a very short range.
The more injured the user gets the more energy the Spark Flux will take from the user.

name: Remote Battle Armor
description: You posses a highly advanced battle armor that can be controlled from any distance.  The remote controller is a helmet. That helmet reads your mind to give you perfect control over it's movement and the weapons build into the armor.  It also makes you see/hear/sense everything that the armor experiences. When the connection is lost a limited AI will activate.  This AI will act based on pre-programmed instructions. For example: flee from danger, self-destruct, return to base, ...
summary: The ability to remotely control an advanced battle armor
strengths: The battle armor can be rebuild and upgraded to prepare for any challenge.
Damage to the armor doesn't hurt you.
The armor isn't bound to human limitations. (massive G-force, visual spectrum,... )
weaknesses: While in control of the armor you still need to protect your own body.
Disruption of the signal between the armor and the controller could be a problem.
Martial artists might see you as a coward because you don't face danger directly.

name: Sanity Sucking Illusions
description: The illusions you create with this power can only be seen through by insane people, as they can't perceive reality correctly. As such, in order to see through them, one must lose their sanity. Just realizing it's an illusion isn't enough, they must try to see through or perceive what is hidden by it, but they can only succeed by losing their grasp over reality. Sometimes it's not clear if it's the illusion that directly sucks their sanity or if it's just part of the process.
summary: The ability to create illusions that cause insanity to those who manage to see through them.
strengths: Even if they manage to see through the illusions, who would believe them? They're insane!
Very effective against powers that allow one to see through illusions.
weaknesses: Those who are already insane are unaffected.
It's ineffective against powers that repel illusions.

name: Reptile Control
description: With this power you have complete control over all reptiles (snakes, lizards, chameleons etc. ). You can make the reptiles fight for you or you can put on cool animal shows at zoos and make some extra cash.
summary: The ability to control reptiles
strengths: You have complete control over all reptiles
You can make them fight your enemies for you
You can put on cool animal shows at zoos
weaknesses: Your reptiles can be killed
If there are no reptiles near you you have a problem

name: Myth Power: Nod To Nereus
description: Nereus (Nereos), in Greek myth, was the god of the quiet sea and the sea's bounty of fish, as well as the Old Man of the Sea. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can psychically teleport to any calm, quiet body of water at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, and command fish and other aquatic species at will. One may even communicate with the sea itself, to receive psychic insight about past, present and future.
summary: The ability to channel Nereus' command over the essence of the quiet sea and the sea's bounty of fish
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch); teleport to any quiet body of water
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command fish and other aquatic species
Speak with the sea to receive insight on past/present/future; automatic favor with sea creatures
weaknesses: No Aquatic Shapeshifting until the higher levels (NCN)
Only summon fish, turn one species into another, or turn foes into fish at higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Iron Stomach
description: With this power you can consume anything without it having an adverse affect on you. You can eat anything you were allergic to without having an allergic reaction, you can eat anything that has been poisoned or is spoiled and you will not die or even feel sick. You can even eat fire or explosives and you will be fine even if the explosive is set off in your stomach you will not feel a thing and you will not die.
summary: The ability to have an invincible stomach
strengths: You can consume anything without having an adverse reaction to it
You can eat anything poisonous or explosives
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you eat the person you're fighting or something

name: Myth Power: Heed Hysmine
description: Hysmine and the Hysminae (Hysminai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fighting (fist-fights, street fights, etc). As such, channeling them allows one to perceive and induce fighting in any two or more subjects. In addition, one gains superhuman fighting prowess, and the ability to perceive a foe's moves in combat (or to predict the moves of ANYONE in radius with hostile intent). Furthermore, weapons and other potentially harmful objects in radius will turn intangible to the user AND the foe.
summary: The ability to channel Hysmine and the Hysminae's command over the essence of fighting and non-martial combat
strengths: Gain superhuman prowess in unarmed and non-martial (non-war) combat; perceive/induce fights at will
Predict the moves of any foe, in combat or in everyday life (Combat Precognition)
Exude a radius that turns all potentially harmful objects intangible (forcing PHYSICAL combat)
weaknesses: Cannot amplify physical damage from hits of self/allies in combat until the higher levels (NCN)
Only negate mental and energy abilities (forcing hand-to-hand combat) at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Separate Bodies
description: At the decision of all the personalitities you have, you can separate out all of your personalities into two or more bodies. Each personality gets to choose how its body looks except for the personality in the original body and the personalities can communicate with each other using an unbreakable mental link.
summary: The ability to separate into two or more bodies for one's personalities
strengths: Gang up on an enemy with all your personalities in different bodies.
Me, Myself, And I; Sentient Superpower; and Triple Being all go well with this power.
weaknesses: Not many beings have more than one personality.

name: Resculpt
description: With this power the human body has the properties of clay to the user. In other words you can reshape the human body, make a person shorter or taller, resculpt them into an animal or another human including members of the opposite sex, you can also combine two people into one, like conjoined twins. When the power is activated the person you are resculpting freezes then you litterally sculpt the persons body like they are clay. The changes are real, if you turn someone into a dog they are a dog.
summary: The ability to resculpt anyone as if they were clay
strengths: Great for pranks
After some training it becomes reverseable
Shrink bad guys
weaknesses: The power mainly relies on the users artistic skill if you can't sculpt it wont look good.
Initially you can't reverse what you are doing.
Changes are real

name: Limited Summon
description: With this ability you will be able to instantly summon anything or anyone that currently exsists on earth to you. There is a catch however, you can only summon each object once. Once you have summoned a particular item, you can never summon it again.
summary: The ability to summon anything that already exsists on earth one time for each item.
strengths: Summon anything or anyone
Have access to any item that could help you
weaknesses: Can only summon an item once
The more items you summon the less you will be able to summon later

name: Raiami
description: The Raiami or Lightning Net Technique, is an ability useful in the capture of enemies without having to kill them. After focusing your inner energy it is released from your hands in the form of a yellow lightning net that catches your opponent electrifying them into unconsciousness. Where most lightning moves fade after being used, the Lightning Net remains intact until the user releases it. This net will shock everything except the one who created it.
summary: The ability to create a net made of lightning that will bind and electrocute your emenies.
strengths: You can defeat enemies without having to kill them.
Enemies that are being electrified will not be able to use their powers.
Water based escape techniques will be innefectual against lightning.
weaknesses: It can only be used close up.
You can't stray too far from the net or it will dissapear.
A steady amount of your inner energy is constantly being used up to keep net in its form.

name: Power Non Interference
description: Your powers will not interfere with you or your other powers. For example, if you obtained all of your powers at once, along with this, then any that might horribly mutilate you or guarantee you'd die would be automatically disabled until you willed otherwise. In short, you'll always be able to live a normal life if you choose. Secondly, they can't interfere with each other. Your powers can't say "Having this means you can never be immortal" or "This can be your ONLY power. "
summary: The ability to prevent your powers from interfering with you or each other
strengths: Picked up some bad powers? Now you don't have to be afraid of getting the downsides
Careless wording like "Can't be immortal" where they meant "Doesn't make you immortal"
Automatic & knows what you want (Hate immortality? It's off. Want it? It's on. )
weaknesses: Does nothing to the downsides that powers apply to themselves.
If this power can't just negate the downside, it disables the powers until they're needed instead.
As with all meta-powers, useless on its own.

name: Laser Manipulation
description: With Laser Manipulation, one can amplify the characteristics of lasers. Examples include making a heat ray by changing the intensity of the laser or blinding foes by changing the brightness of a laser. One could change the coherency of a laser, making it change from a beam to making it spread out like normal light. A person with this power can be deadly with just a laser pointer or a CD player.
summary: The ability to manipulate the characteristics of lasers
strengths: Turn a CD player into a heat ray.
Change the coherency of a laser and make a flash, blinding foes.
weaknesses: You can blind yourself
You cannot emit lasers

name: Mmo Grab
description: Wow,Wizard101,and Rumble fighter Wouldn't you wish to have those exocores,or powerful pets or spells,or that awesome sword you got on a raid in real life? Now you can with Mmo grab. You just find the weapon in your game. Put your hand on the computer screen,and it will phase through to let you grab the weapon,and the weapon transforms into what the weapon would actually be like no 5 inch sword a 5 ft sword
summary: The ability to grab any item or weapon from mmorpg's
strengths: Have any mmorpg weapon
Never get mocked again cause your mockers will fear your mighty sword
You will be the champ in mmo conventions
weaknesses: Theres no bad things have fun

name: Skin Reforming
description: With this power, you can make calluses to endure an attack, make your hands soft (I don't know what good that is), or fashion weapons attached to your skin. You could make your fist into a huge club or make your whole arm into a shield. This does not require your hands, you just need to will your skin to do it.
summary: The ability to control the thickness and shape of your skin.
strengths: Your elbow is now a spear.
Make calluses on your feet to endure a fall.
Never need Lotion Mimicry?
weaknesses: It is not passive. You need to make it happen. The sniper wins again.
You are not invulnerable, just pretty close.
It might be hard to transform that jumbled mess of a club back into your hand

name: Starfire
description: Starfire's powers are superhuman strength, stamina and durability, flight, energy projection (called starbolts), and linguistic assimilation. The color of your starbolts varies from person to person. Linguistic assimilation allows you to know the language of another person by physically touching that person.
summary: The ability to have the powers of Starfire (Teen Titans)
strengths: Superhuman strength, stamina and durability
Flight, energy projection (called starbolts), and linguistic assimilation
Color of your starbolts varies from person to person
weaknesses: Must physically touch a person to know the language(s) that they know

name: Holy Water
description: The subject's body reacts with the molecular composition of water that they drink, and depending on the source and origin of the water, they acquire a specific superpower. An example: drinking water from a spring situated in Germany, he/she will be able to control plants and vegetation; drinking water that comes from the Antarctic, he/she could manipulate ice, and so on. The effect of the power lasts until the water flows in the organism.
summary: The ability to gain a superpower by drinking water that comes from a specific place.
strengths: This method of gaining powers is not invasive, no collateral effects are expected;
A single drop of water is sufficient to give a power.
weaknesses: Water is not so different in the world, so the range of obtainable powers is limited;
The duration of every power is limited;
Providing fresh water from some places in the world is not so easy.

name: Lifestyle Effect Persistence
description: Ever had one day when you did god things, like eat healthily? With this ability, you can record such a day and continue experiencing the effects after resuming your old lifestyle.
summary: The ability to experience the effects of continually living the lifestyle of one day.
strengths: Studying is easier; while you may not acquire new knowledge, you do remember it.
Living healthily is easy; just record on a day of healthy living.
The things that are bad for you can now be enjoyed.
weaknesses: Can only live the benefits of one day's lifestyle at a time.
You experience the bad as well.
You must record while living that day.

name: Love/Hate Spell
description: This ability allows you to play around with people's feelings for one and other. You can make people love other people or hate them. You can even make that super hot model you like so much fall in love with you.
summary: The ability to cause a person to love or hate another person.
strengths: Make all the ladies fall in love with you
Can make people of same gender fall in love with each other.
Make a profitable business
weaknesses: Everybody will be searching for you.

name: Command Discs
description: A person with this ability has the ability to transfer their will to another object through the use of discs. The discs can be thrown or inserted and they will enter anything thrown, unless it does not have enough surface area to absorb the disc. The discs are the size of standard cd-roms. You can only create commands that physically fit on the disc(written). You can also throw multiple discs. Cannot take control of any person unless the disc is inserted into their head.
summary: The ability to creat disc that contain your will and cause the written command to be executed by whatever it hits
strengths: Even if people dodge, whatever is behind them will carry out the command
You can materialize an infinite amount of discs
You can make commands which are impossible, such as "walk away and explode"
weaknesses: You need to write on the discs beforehand and the discs take time to be materialized
You need to have a good throwing arm or secretly insert discs at close range
Needs to hit someone's head to make his whole body fulfill the command

name: Trick Magic
description: This ability is very similar to the power Magic Tricks, but the difference is that the user never does any real magic. Here's the process. First, you must imagine what you want to do. Then, you will have a vision of how to do it using stage magic. Let's say you want to shoot endless fireworks from your fingers. Then, you will have a vision of how to build a small, concealable firework-shooting device that goes around your wrist or something like that.
summary: The ability to do anything through sleight of hand.
strengths: One of the BEST performers of all time
Can be very useful
weaknesses: May be harder to do some tricks than others.

name: Enhancement: Shielded
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the other power generates a shield around you based on its original purpose. Ex. Telepathy-mind scrambling shield, a fire power-a firey shield, etc. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to have a power generate a shield around one when this power is attached to it
strengths: Shielded when using an offensive power by that power.
Best offense is a good defense.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Someone with Barrier Defiance or Melting

name: Warrior Insect
description: Many insects have the ability to defend themself or a colony with amazing abilities. Become an ever adapting insect-human hybrid. Your skin hardens to a bulletproof exoskeleton. You can grow transparent wings. Large retractable stingers can grow out of hands and feet. Insect abilities at human size will give you an advantage that is nearly unbeatable.
summary: The ability to mimic insect physiology
strengths: You could look normal but have every insect power imaginable or scare enemies by changing features
In an instant you could grow wings, stingers, mandibles, claw-like hairs to climb walls and more
Super-senses: Enhanced vision, hearing, smell
weaknesses: Revert to normal human agility and reflexes in cold weather
You will be addicted to sugar
With this power men will be instinctive followers, women will be natural leaders

name: Future Vision
description: You can fire electric bolts from your eyes whether is far or close and put it into theirs and see what their future is like, but you may able to stop their new crimes from happening and save the innocent.
summary: The ability to stare far away or up close and fire bolts into your opponent's eyes to see what events may occur.
strengths: You can stop new crimes from happening.
Villains will be afraid of you.
weaknesses: Must stare at an enemy to work.

name: Your Mind Is A Prison
description: Your Mind Is A Prison allows you to take your enemy or enemies and trap them inside your mind; from here you can do what you want to them from making them wear a pink tutu to having them chased by the monster in your closet. While in your mind, your enemy also can't escape until you free them; unfortunately during this time your thoughts are exposed and if they figured out how they could kill you. Another effect is waking nightmares/hallucinations.
summary: The ability to change anyone from a physical state to a mental state and trap them inside your mind.
strengths: Unavoidable and inescapable to your enemies
You can do anything to them
Has unlimited uses and can last as long as you see fit.
weaknesses: Thoughts exposed to enemy
Could cause insanity, death, shift in personality, mental impairment.
Occasional waking nightmares (hallucinations).

name: La Force De Fourmi
description: When your enemy is much stronger than you, your aura flips around the difference and you become the stronger opponent
summary: The ability to become stronger than your enemy when he has more power than you
strengths: Be able to defeat who's normally stronger than you.
Good for an underdog, especially in betting
You temporally have awesome power
weaknesses: Lasts as long as you're fighting that enemy
The enemy needs to be stronger than you, someone equal or lesser in power can defeat you
You have to constantly weaken yourself in order to use this power

name: Transformers Summon And Cntrl
description: With this power you can summon and have complete control over any Transformer. It doesn't matter if they're Autobot, Decepticon, Mini-Con, Vehicon, Maximal, Predacon etc. You can summon as many as you want and when you're done you can send them all back.
summary: The ability to summon and control any Transformer
strengths: You can summon and control all Transformers
You can summon as many as you want
You can send them back when you're done
weaknesses: You might lose them when they're in their alternate mode

name: Esc Key
description: You'll become a super escape artist. Master of Escapology. If you are tied up, handcuffed, restrained, or locked in something. Using your power, the locks or rope or whatever is holding you will instantly unlock or un-tie. Nothing can hold you.
summary: The ability to know how to escape from any restraint or trap with ease
strengths: Become a super Houdini
weaknesses: Only works if in a restrained item or situation

name: Ice Shard
description: Like the explanation says, you can shoot ice shards out of your hands.
summary: The ability to shoot ice shards from your hands.
strengths: Shoot ice shards.
Could kill because they are sharp.
weaknesses: If your opponent has a fire power, he/she could melt it.

name: Wind Breeze
description: Wind breeze can be used to travel quickly or to not be seen or to fit through tight spaces. It can even be used to create certain natural disasters (large and small). Also, the user won't get mixed with other winds/breezes. Plus, if you want, the user could scare someone by pretending to be a ghost.
summary: The ability to become a wind breeze.
strengths: Eco-friendly and efficient transportation
Become an invisible breeze
Be a "ghost"
weaknesses: Natural disasters may get out of hand
"ghost prank" might go too far

name: Geo Mimicry
description: You'll be like the Thing except your not orange & you can change back into human form. Your body will take on the property of rocks. You'll have an increase in size, superhuman strength, endurance, a super tough & thick hide that makes you almost invulnerable. Bad thing is your speed & agility will be slow, you'll sink to the bottom in bodies of water & strong winds will cause erosion.
summary: The ability to turn into a humanoid rock creature
strengths: Become a living golem
Become taller & larger, super strength, endurance & rock skin
weaknesses: Movement is slow
Can't swim, just sink
High winds will turn you into dust over time

name: Split
description: When you use this power you create a dimensional rift that splits you into light and darkness forms. While in light form you are glowing white and can create solid light projections and light energy laser beams. In shadow form you have pale, blue skin and one black eye with an orange pupil. You can create shadow mist that poisons others; also you have sharp claws, can melt into liquid shadow, feed off the energy of the core of planets, and you can change form.
summary: The ability to spit into light and darkness forms
strengths: While in light form you can be a human flashlight
You spit into two bodys and control each seperately
In shadow form you can get stronger by feeding off the core of planets
weaknesses: Feeding will eventualy cause the planet to explode
Shadow form may scare people

name: Reaper's Contract
description: When you are present when a person is about to die, you enter into a separate dimension with the person where you can offer them the chance to become your slave in exchange for them being completely healed. You do not have to be honest while making the deal. You can have as many slaves as possible, but each person can only make the deal once.
summary: The ability to keep somebody from dying in exchange for them becoming your slave.
strengths: Save people from death.
Have slaves to do your work.
Have all the knowledge and skills of the slaves at your disposal.
weaknesses: You will appear evil for having slaves.
May not have many slaves due to lack of deaths.
Person must willingly agree.

name: Rain Of Terror
description: Now you'll even lethally rain on someone else's parade by dropping a billion nails from above and/or sending many long spikes all around flying across the area onto the enemies. Shoot up a bunch of endless shards in several different directions.
summary: The ability to summon a million spikes from the sky
strengths: Bust up a thousand of ballons.
You can take out an entire army.
Take this power in a different direction.
weaknesses: Not a good idea to use indoors.

name: Ability Switching
description: You can switch your ability with another person's. You can also just switch other people's abilities, and even switch abilities into normal people.
summary: The ability to switch a person's ability with your or another person's ability.
strengths: Try another power.
Mess with people.
weaknesses: Useless powers.

name: Hour Skip
description: When tired or bored, watch as up to an hour of time speeds by in seconds as your subconscious mind does everything you would be doing/was planning on doing.
summary: The ability to "skip" up to one hour by seemingly speeding by while your subcouncious does everything you do.
strengths: The ultimate boredom solution
Still get everything done
weaknesses: Only works for up to an hour
Requires 10 minute recharge

name: Infamous Electric Karma
description: The way you use your lightning powers and the color it is, depends on your "karma". If you do good things, it is perceived as good karma and your lightning will be blue-colored. If you do bad things, your lightning will be red-colored. You can create electric shockwaves, grenades, lightning bolts, and other things.
summary: The ability to control lightning and electricity according to your karma.
strengths: Can heal people or kill them by sucking their energy out of them.
Can heal yourself and recharge your powers by absorbing electricity from electronics.
Can cling to objects which allows you to climb buildings easily.
weaknesses: Standing in bodies of water (pool, ocean, sea) will short circuit your powers and kill you.
Powers can activate accidently sometimes.
Setting things on fire.

name: Ability Division
description: An Ability Divider makes superhumans share. By touching a superhuman and another person-usually non-powered-they can divide the superpower evenly amongst them. This leaves the superhuman half as strong, half as fast, etc. However, as the other person uses their half of the power, the superhuman begins to regain their full power, until the other person has none. The other person also does not have as much control over it as the original superhuman. This can be used on yourself with great focus.
summary: The ability to temporarily divide one superpower amongst two people
strengths: Weaken a foe
Strengthen a non-powered ally
Can be used on any power
weaknesses: More effective on a power+non-power than a power+power
When recipient uses split power, the donor regains power
Recipient does not have as much control as donor

name: Word Fusion
description: A person with this power has the ability to alter reality by making something new by taking two objects and mashing their names together. For example, combining an orange with a sports car to make an orange sports car, or sports car with a drink to make a sports drink or gas (car drink). You can combine two people together as well, for example you can take a Mr. Moore and a Mr. Butts to create Moore Butts. Fusions separate out after 24 hours.
summary: The ability to create a new object/person by taking the words of two objects.
strengths: You can be creative in your fusions.
You can use synonyms, i.e. you can make firefly into lightning bug to make your fusions easier.
Make valuable usable items such as rocket fuel.
weaknesses: People fusions can be totally random -- you don't know the result.
Fusions only work for 24 hours and you cannot unfuse them before then.
If things are usable items, using them will make the two composite items gone forever.

name: Blessing Of Loki
description: Loki is the Norse god of mischief and trickery. His blessing comes with many gifts. As he was the only god capable of shapeshifting, some with his blessing can do this as well. Loki was also known for his manipulative nature and persuasive voice. The voices of most with his blessing will take on a near hypnotic quality. Yet the one gift given to all is the ability to devote their energy to general mischief.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Loki.
strengths: Some can shapeshift
Most have an almost hypnotic voice
All can devote their energy to making mischief. This includes minor illusions, teleportation, etc.
weaknesses: There is no guarantee that the blessing will include the hypnotic voice, or shapeshifting

name: Mamodo
description: A mamodo is a friendly monster that will help you out with its book of spells. Well, with this power, you can summon a mamodo anytime you want. And you don't need a spell book! Just tell it what to do and it does it. And you can summon a different one depending on the occasion.
summary: The ability to summon a magical partner.
strengths: Summon a different mamodo for each occasion
They are strong and fast
Have magic spells to help you
weaknesses: Can only summon one at a time
You can't use their attacks
They have to be there to attack so don't think you can ask for them to attack

name: Chess Summoner
description: You can summon chess pieces to turn those pieces into real versions of the chess pieces. Pawns are normal soldiers. Rooks can be turned into different buildings. Knights can be turned into knights or just the horses. Bishops can use magic, white heals while black has telekinesis. Kings are for defensive powers while Queens have offensive powers. The chess pieces are completely under the control of the summoner. If destroyed, the chess piece can be resummoned after a (short) recharge period.
summary: The ability to summon chess pieces and make the chess pieces into real things.
strengths: They do not have rules like in a chess game.
White is made of stone while black is made of metal.
Personal Army.
weaknesses: Can not have more pieces summoned than there are pieces on a chess board.
Chess pieces can be destroyed and turned back into chess pieces.
May be hard to control all the pieces at the same time.

name: Sound Storage
description: You can store the energy from sound waves in your body and fire that off as plasma blasts as needed. You can fire off the blasts with however much of the energy you've stored up as you want. The maximum amount of energy you can store is enough to destroy two two-story buildings that are consecutively placed. This power can only be gained by singing a full requiem while simultaneously playing a piano piece that lasts an hour. Both of them have to be done correctly and without any breaks.
summary: The ability to absorb the energy of sound waves in one's body and fire off the energy as plasma blasts
strengths: Enemies who are 100% sound-based.
The energy limit is only without other powers (good idea to have Infinite Energy Storage).
The piano piece will most likely be classical music (may be con if you hate classical music).
weaknesses: Some users are unable to stop absorbing sound and are effectively deaf.
Users cannot absorb sound that they emit.
How many easy hour-long piano pieces are there out there?

name: Selective Omniarch
description: This allows you to rule over few things, about 1 or 2 things, 3 at most. Although you do have to prove yourself worthy to rule these things. EX: To rule over time you must prove yourself to be a strong time warper. If this test is failed you do have the opportunity to do this test again.
summary: The ability to rule over few things as long as you are worthy to rule over them.
strengths: Rule over some things.
weaknesses: You could only rule over 3 things at most.
These challenges are extremely difficult.
If the thing already has a ruler, than you can not rule it as a second ruler.

name: Remote Control Control
description: With this ability you can: make a TV remote control time, or a remote-control-car control your cat, or the dash board on your car control probability by just touching it! The problem is that you have to squeeze it for 2 minuets to get it back to normal.
summary: The ability to make some thing that controls something control something else
strengths: You can control everything
there is a loop hole to this power see if you can find it
weaknesses: You have to squeeze it for 2 minuets to get the control back to normal

name: Offspring Of Darkness
description: This is what happens when a Children of the Moon(credit to Avoontap)and the Child of the Night (more credit to Avoontap) have a child. It grants the abilities; Razor tongue, Transform into a beast or incredible strength at will, Fast and strong at night and razor claws and teeth. Have purple eyes which can be easily identified. These offspring are taught to fight at the age of 2 so watch out for some vicious beasts.
summary: The ability to become a powerful beast at night
strengths: Super Fast and Strong at night, slightly weaker then average humans in day
So many things to try out!!!
Parents are AMAZINGLY POWERFUL!!!
weaknesses: Pale skin and purple eyes are easily identified.
Just a weak human during day

name: Arceusforce: Earth
description: The user of this ability can channel the power over the planets of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Ground-type. The user's skin turns light brown, their irises turn gray. Under their earthen guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Ground-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Ground attacks such as Earthquake, Mud Bomb, Earth Power, Fissure and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Ground form.
strengths: The user can resist mineral and poison-based attacks and is immune to electric-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of earth and seismic power used for Ground attacks.
weaknesses: The user is weak to water, plant and ice-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form

name: Helmet Of Night
description: With this power, you call forth a helmet to manipulate and control the element of Shadow and Darkness. While wearing it, you can phase through objects, blind anyone you want, become invisible in the presence of darkness, manipulate shadows and darkness into solid objects or force fields, see clearly in the shadow and darkness, and see what shadows see. The Helmet cannot be lost as it will come all the way back to you. You are immune to the effects of Shadow and Darkness.
summary: The ability to call forth a helmet that can manipulate and control the element of Shadow and Darkness
strengths: With the Helmet, you are immune to the effects of Shadow and Darkness.
The Helmet cannot be lost as it will come back
The shadows will protect you
weaknesses: Light will weaken you
You must have the Helmet on for it to work.
People may fear you

name: Cloud Mimicry
description: You can 'rain' your form up into the shape and substance of a cloud (same mass as yourself, but less density, which is that of a cloud), and can do anything that a cloud would be able to do, including raining on people, shooting lightning, making tornadoes, hail, etc. This power turns you into a cloud, so anything that affects a cloud affects you, and everything that doesn't affect a cloud doesn't affect you. After 'raining' yourself back down, the cloud disappears and you become human again.
summary: The ability to turn into a cloud at will
strengths: Float around at any height at will without fear of falling (you fall as rain)
Shoot lightning!!!!!
Spy on people
weaknesses: A cloud floating around will be suspicious
Pollution
You can be caught with a vacuum cleaner...

name: Spirit Shield
description: Do you hate getting attacked by poltergeists? Getting possessed by some random spirit? Fear no more! This power allows you to create a shield that keeps out bodiless spirits. The shield's radius is from your skin to 100 metres away.
summary: The ability to create a shield that keeps out bodiless spirits
strengths: No chance of being possessed!!!!
Poltergeists can't close enough to you too attack!
weaknesses: Can still be physically attacked by a spirit possessing someone else.

name: Reincarnation 8: Power
description: With this power, your soul is attached to your powers, so if it is absorbed, stolen, copied, etc, your soul is anchored to that person. You can control those who acquire powers from you and even use them as a new body if needed. As a side effect, your control over the power is enhanced. If you lose a power, you can channel a weakened version of one power acquired by someone else (with experience and only if this power is working).
summary: The ability to link your soul to your powers.
strengths: Friendly Power Gifting becomes more useful.
If you die, you have plenty of potential bodies.
If you lose this power, it's effects continue.
weaknesses: If people lose the powers they acquired from you, you lose your connection to them.
Once others discover you have this power, they won't steal or copy it.
Control and possession of others can be stopped by powers such as Anti Telepathy.

name: Death Rewind
description: Upon death, time rewinds by 1 minute. This allows you to prevent your death as well as whatever else you want to happen. The problem comes in when you die and can't prevent putting you in a permanent loop. Example: organ failure, nuclear explosion, etc. Also, the power is involuntary requiring your death to be activated.
summary: The ability to rewind time whenever you die
strengths: Sometimes know the future
Virtual limited immortality
weaknesses: Eventaully die and can't prevent it
Requires you to die

name: Birdblast
description: 1. It can destroy anything near at full blast.  2. Its very powerful.  3. It can burst your eardrums. 4. At any pitch it can still destroy.
summary: The ability to let out an extremly powerful ultrasonic scream.
strengths: Very powerful
It can burst eardrums
weaknesses: Can destroy anything near at full blast
At any pitch it can still destroy

name: Superhero 3: Captain America
description: Captain America obtained his powers from the Super-Soldier serum, which gave him enhanced strength, speed, endurance, and agility. Which will happen to you when you get this power. You also have a metal shield that rebounds on walls when thrown and protects from you bullets.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the shieldwielding supersoldier, Captain America.
strengths: You're stronger, faster, agile than you ever were.
You can beat people at gym and the Olympics.
You also have a cool shield that comes with this power.
weaknesses: You're not entirely superhuman.
You could accidentally kill somebody in a fight.
Bullets will most likely harm you.

name: Detective
description: This ability will undoubtedly assist you in the law enforcement career. You've got a knack for solving crimes, using your detective skills. You're like a modern day Sherlock Holmes. You also get the criminal.
summary: The ability to solve the unsolveable crimes, using your keen detective skills.
strengths: Reduce the crime rate.
Take down the worlds most notorious criminal masterminds.
weaknesses: Criminals might seek revenge.
Don't possess any power, to defend against attacks from the criminals.

name: Bio Cure
description: This power can absorb all pollution there is, but it can hurt the user depending who the user is. If they have used it most of there lives, absorbing hazardous wastes is a piece of cake. If the user is a minor or someone new to it, they could kill themselves. Also, shooting a massive beam of what was absorbed is the only thing a new user can do at first, but later they can do so much more, like giving that pure energy to other lifeforms.
summary: The ability to intake all kinds of pollution and release it in any kind of way.
strengths: Clear any pollution
Give life back to other beings
Save any life from dangerous pollution
weaknesses: The user can be killed by the pollution they intake
The amount of pollution and power they absorb can overwhelm and destroy the user
Eventually the body will be overwhelmed

name: Mech Summoning
description: You summon a mech (a large robot that you get in and pilot) or power armor (a mechanical suit enhancing the abilities of the wearer). You also gain all the skills necessary to pilot it (others can use them, but they don't get the skills). You can summon as many mechas in general as you want, but if there are a specific number of them in the fictional universe, then you can only summon that many of it at a time. If you need any special abilities to pilot it, you gain those, and can pass them on.
summary: The ability to summon a fictional mech
strengths: GIANT. ROBOTS. Or, if tearing up a city doesn't suit you, you can always do power armor.
If some work allows customization and has the rules for it (like a game), you can make your own.
If you give a mech to someone willingly, you can shut it down, destroy it, or unsummon it at will.
weaknesses: Only published series get free reign. Fiction published on the Internet only allows balanced mechs.
Mechs can get stolen. You'll have to touch them (skin-to-metal) or destroy them to unsummon.
If you can't get into them. Also, if your powers are weakened, most mechs will probably collapse.

name: Perfect Teeth
description: Your teeth will always be in the right position in your mouth for whatever they need to do at the moment whether it is smiling, eating or something else. Also, your teeth will never get cavities and if any of your teeth are taken out of your mouth it will be replaced by a new tooth within a couple of minutes.
summary: The ability to always have a set of perfect teeth
strengths: You will never need a dentist ever again.
weaknesses: The tooth that comes in after losing a tooth isn't any stronger or durable.

name: Parasite
description: Here's how it works: When you bite someone, you can give them stuff (for example, your pain/damage), and you can take stuff, like their talent, intelligence, strength, and power. You then form a parasitic link that allows you to transfer these attributes at will. You can have many parasitic links, but you can't get rid them, although you can stop using them or give back stuff.
summary: The ability to when you bite some one you form a parasitic link
strengths: You can have many parasitic links
weaknesses: You can't get rid of links but you can stop using them or give back stuff
You must bite the person

name: Santa Claus
description: A person with this power has all the powers of Santa Claus. Naturally, you also have to deliver presents on Christmas, but you can also use your powers on other days of the year as well. You have an army of elves that can make any toy in the world -- even copyrighted ones. This also allows you to have any material possession. You also have superstrength and a bag that can hold anything inside. You can also fly with the aid of a reindeer.
summary: The ability to be Santa Claus and have all the powers of Santa Claus, both fictional and theoretical.
strengths: Can travel the whole world in a day -- can decide if this is super speed or time stop or both.
Has an army of elves that can instantly make whatever toy you need -- i.e. any material possession.
Can make a reindeer fly and have superstrength to carry whatever is in your bag.
weaknesses: Unparalleled clairvoyance -- literally see people at all times, which is disturbing.
Immortal and contractually required to work one day a year for the rest of immortality.
You are invisible to people who do not believe in you.

name: Secret World Organization
description: You are the supreme boss of a secret organization that's spread all over your world.  As such you have control over it's vast resources and actions.  The organization possesses hidden research facilities, sleeper cells of trained operatives, shadow politicians, training facilities,...
summary: The ability to have complete control over a secret organization in your world
strengths: You can give missions to trained teams
You can have the research departments invent new weapons and tools
You can use the orginazation to influence politics while staying in obscurity
weaknesses: Keeping control over the organization can consume a lot of time and resources
Superheroes finding out and taking you down

name: Myth Power: Dos' Donation
description: Dos, in Greek myth, was the goddess of giving. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive what things subjects would enjoy as gifts. In addition, one can psychically access a pocket dimension containing 'perfect gifts', at will. Furthermore, one can psychically summon divine ribbons/gift wrap to bind foes, at will. One can also psychically trap subjects in divine gift boxes, at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any gift-giving occasion, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dos' command over the essence of giving, donation and generosity
strengths: Psychically perceive what subjects want as gifts, access pocket dimension with perfect gifts, at will
Psychically summon divine ribbons and gift wrap to bind foes, divine gift boxed to trap foes, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any gift-giving occasion, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically bestow knowledge, skills or (random) superpowers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow injuries, beauty, breath or life-force, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Harpax's Haul and sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Momentum
description: When you build up momentum, you can keep it at a steady pace with this power. The build up requires energy, but once you keep it at the same level, you won't have to expend energy. This means you can go on forever. It doesn't mean you're invulnerable, though.
summary: The ability to keep your momentum at a steady pace.
strengths: Keep going forever.
Conserve energy once you have momentum
weaknesses: Not invulnerable.
Build-up requires energy

name: Matriculation
description: You can turn the real world into a programmable virtual reality and turn any virtual reality into the real world.
summary: The ability to replace the real world with a virtual reality and vice versa.
strengths: You can put the world and all the people in a computer.
You can make any virtual reality as real as the world around you.
weaknesses: Virtual realities are not very developed today, so you have to wait...

name: Anti Telepathy
description: I was thinking, "Sure you might have physical strength, but what about the Psychics? They can hurt us in a way we can never stop, in our minds. So, I took the pleasure into making this 'mentalist-proof armor.'"
summary: The ability to be immune to any attack or contact of mind.
strengths: You won't be affected by any mental ability, even telekinesis.
With enough concentration, you can bounce back the mental ability.
You won't be affected by hypnotism.
weaknesses: I can't think of anything, I made this ability for protection.

name: Jibberish Comprehension
description: On the one hand, this power allows you to understand the meaning of any foreign language. On the other hand, it also allows you to understand any hidden messages contained within coded, cryptic, vague or badly worded messages, in-jokes, double entendres and even visual messages. This power is always active, so you automatically read or understand messages as what they are intended to mean or hide.
summary: The ability to automatically get the intended message behind what you would not normally understand.
strengths: You can understand what animals, babies, drunk guys, insane people and girls want.
You can understand the meaning of any hidden messages and codes.
You can understand the sense of any language, be it a computer, an alien or a sign language.
weaknesses: You just understand the meaning. You don't get the knowledge of how to code or speak the language.
You could get in trouble if you understand something that's supposed to be confidential.

name: Multicomplexion Effect
description: A Multicomplexion is a person who has two or more abilities of different origins, but can only use one depending on how strong they are. So basically, this is more of a condition than ability. People who are Multicomplexions and have two or more abilities of different origins, their bodies can't accept the new power so they repress the new ability and take the stronger ability. If the stronger ability has been weakened or taken away, the other ability kicks in and cannot be weakened or stolen.
summary: The ability to have two or more abilities of different origin, but can only use one depend on how strong you feel
strengths: Won't overload the body if filled with abilities.
Will supply you with other abilities if the first one is gone.
Won't let the weakest ability be weakened or stolen.
weaknesses: Won't be able to use all your abilities all the time.

name: Power Combo Controller
description: The ability to combine powers or separate powers in yourself or others. Powers that are combined are more powerful but are harder to use as well. Powers that come from a power being separated into more powers are only slightly weaker but are easier to control and take less energy to use. Not all powers can be separated into more than one power. This power can return powers that were affected by this power to normal. You must have all the parts of the previous power if the power was separated.
summary: The ability to combine or separate powers into new powers.
strengths: Combine powers into stronger versions.
Separate powers into multiple easier-to-use powers.
Can be used on anyone.
weaknesses: Combined powers are harder to control.
Separated powers are weaker the more the original power was separated.
New powers have both pros and cons.

name: Energy Projection Trail
description: With this ability, you are able to fly swiftly, leaving a trail of energy in your wake. Color is determined by whatever outfit you are wearing at the time. If something comes into contact with this energy, it will be severely burned.
summary: The ability to fly very fast, leaving a trail of colored energy behind you
strengths: Hippie clothes!!!
Can be used to burn things
Can be seen in the dark
weaknesses: Can be seen in the dark
Not exactly stealthy

name: Iamscience
description: Iam- (now) -science(knowledge) is the ability to know everything that is happening at the very moment. It doesn't mean that you know the future or the past beyond your normal ability. But you do know everything NOW. Where everything is, what everything is, and what anyone is doing or thinking... Now.
summary: The ability to know everything in the present, but not the past or future.
strengths: Useful for finding... Anything
Could be used to read minds, but not alter them.
See "Laplace's Demon", a mathematical theory.
weaknesses: Not very useful for combat
You don't know what is going to happen.

name: Masochism
description: While the name does arouse a connotation that's more kinky than capable, this ability is a very useful, helpful one to have. It allows the user to perceive pain as pleasurable (as implied by the name), and to gain power from anything people would normally consider painful. Any attack short of instantaneous lethal damage will only EMPOWER the user, bouncing off of him like he has Superhuman Durability/Invulnerability, instead of doing harm.
summary: The ability to take pain as a positive effect instead of a negative one
strengths: Normally-painful stimuli are now pleasurable
Empowered by normally painful things
Any damage short of instantaneous lethal damage (beheading, Death Touch, etc. ) only HELPS you
weaknesses: Death Touch, Lifeforce Drain, Necrokinesis, Necromantic effects still can kill user
Suicide attempts can still kill the user
People think you're weird when they ask about your powers

name: Intelligence Shield
description: You are not hurt by the attacks of those less intelligent than yourself. This applies to any attack they might make, including nuclear strikes.
summary: The ability to use your comparative intelligence as a shield
strengths: Invincible if you are the smartest in a fight.
You can increase your defence by learning more.
Passive: requires no effort.
weaknesses: Smarter people can still hurt you.
May need a lot time to study
You can still hurt yourself (falling off a cliff, running into stuff, etc).

name: Liquid Quartz
description: With this ability you can generate and control a crystal clear liquid. You can manipulate the liquid with your mind. This liquid will harden into quartz crystal when it is no linger in cotact with you. It will stay liquid as long as you keep a connection to it.
summary: The ability to generate and control a liquid that can harden into quartz
strengths: Unlimited supply of quartz
Can control the liquid
weaknesses: Cannot control the hardened quartz
Must stay in contact with the liquid to control it

name: Transformation To Summoning
description: You will be able to turn a power in which you transform into something, into a power where you summon it. Like if you are able to shapeshift into a vehicle, you would be able to summon a vehicle. This effect can be reversed.
summary: The ability to change a transforming power into a summoning one.
strengths: If you are able to transform into many things.
weaknesses: They may not listen.
You may want to transform into them.

name: Vita Visum
description: With this power, you can activate a 'mode' of vision that enables you to see a human being's current life span. You can increase or decrease this number, as if setting a clock. You cannot drop the number precisely to zero. You are able to detect any alterations to the number. The countdown falls by its own unit of time, and can vary from person to person. The number of changes you can make is limited for a period of time due to potential strain.
summary: The ability to see and control the life span of others.
strengths: Control over how long a person has to live
Easier personal time management with those who matter.
weaknesses: Cannot determine the exact method by which someone is destined to die.
No control over the lifespan if simply looking at a photograph - the image must be fresh.
Not immune to effects; still vulnerable to attack and eye strain/damage when activated.

name: Twilight
description: The ability allows you to change from your normal state into a twilight state, giving you the powers to step in ultra speed to shoot pure light out of your hands and eyes if you are in the light.  If you are in the dark, you become it, having the powers of the darkness. You will be able to move throughout shadows, open doors into the void and emit beams and shockwaves of darkness from your hands and body. Plus, you can control the enemies' fear.
summary: The ability to become the embodiment of fear and hope
strengths: Able to surprise the enemy
The look of you can scare the enemies
Plus the look of you can give hope when in the light
weaknesses: You have a weakness: the time it takes for the sun to rise and set, you have no powers
The state you are in in the dark can be terrifying to the people you are protecting
This power is so cool that noone will want the other powers

name: Myth Power: Hades' Haunt
description: Hades (Haides, Aides), in Greek myth, was the god of funerals, the dead, the Underworld and subterranean treasures (oil, precious stones/metals, etc). As such, channeling him allows one to perceive, communicate with and compel undead (ghosts, zombies, liches, vampires, etc) at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate earth (including oil, metals--precious or not-- minerals and precious stones). One can even withstand and negate death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Hades' command over the essence of the dead, the underworld and underground treasures
strengths: Summon, perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command undead (ghosts, zombies, etc)
Control earth and its subterranean treasures (precious metals, precious stones, oil, etc)
Withstand and negate death/necromantic/underworld-based or infernal effects (Death Inducing, etc)
weaknesses: Ghosts and other undead like, no, LOVE you
Cannot open up the earth to banish foes to the Underworld until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot release infernal creatures/monsters/demons from the Underworld until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Pheromone Production
description: A pheromone is a chemical that produces a physiological response when smelled. A person with Pheromone Production can pump out huge amounts of state-influencing pheromones, making anyone who sniffs them miserable, delirious with happiness, enraged, alert, drowsy, or any other powerful emotion or state. This ability's strength depends on the user's nutrition and the recipient's sense of smell.
summary: The ability to produce state-changing pheromones
strengths: Can be used on a massive scale
Make an entire room fall asleep and then leave
Make anyone feel sad, happy, sleepy, in love etc.
weaknesses: Can run out of pheromone
Strong winds can blow the pheromone away
People with colds

name: Schrodinger's Cat Infliction
description: The person affected by this ability is forced to replay a certain time frame between 5 minutes-1 week that may have different consequences each time depending on the person's actions. The affected person will repeat the scenario a set number of years(max 10) at the user's discretion. The scenario will restart if the person affected dies. All changes will be reversed when the scenario replays. Once the effect has worn off the person affected will regain all memories of the scenarios.
summary: The ability to freeze a frame of time for a sentient being
strengths: You can inflict on your enemies a fate worse than death(until the time limit)
You can freeze yourself in a frame of time to predict the consequences of your actions
weaknesses: There is a time limit of 10 years that you can freeze a sentient being in
The results can be unintended, for example: personality change

name: Magic Consumption
description: With this power a person can undo powerful enchantments with a touch and then absorb all the energy of the spell, further fueling their magic eating rampage. The user is immune to all forms of magic, any spell aimed at them is absorbed upon contact. This person functions as a sort of "Magic Vampire" absorbing a mage's magic and leaving them drained shells.
summary: The ability to destroy and absorb magic, magical constructs, and magic-users.
strengths: Immune to magic.
If you eat enough magic, it suspends all biological requirements and functions.
Some magic is tasty.
weaknesses: Rather destructive.
Can't be turned off.
You often kill mages accidentally.

name: Bubble Manipulation
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate bubbles. Not just soap bubbles they can manipulate any bubble. Of course there are many applications for this power, this includes but is not limited to parties, office work, combat, and medical work. The only limit is your imagination and your willpower.
summary: The ability to manipulate any bubble including shape, velocity ,and durability
strengths: Make different shaped bubbles ie bubble structures-----just because you can
Can increase the durability making it useful as a concussive weapon--they'll never expect it
Can also make bubbles violenty explode releasing air pressure as a weapon
weaknesses: Need to have a source of bubbles---can't create bubbles
Manipulation relies on mental power and concentration
Need to understand the physics behind bubbles to make them explode

name: Induced Digression
description: The flow of ideas being expressed is like a flow of water. And just as you can divert water to make it go wherever you want, you can divert a speech/conversation to make it go to whatever subject you want. Since the direction is taken naturally, it can be difficult for the speaker(s) to notice they are digressing, but, if they do, they can change the subject or come back to the original one.
summary: The ability to control the direction of a speech/conversation.
strengths: You do not have to be one of the speakers to use this power.
You can bring anyone into a delicate, embarrassing or confidential topic.
You can get information out of anyone.
weaknesses: If they realize they are digressing, they can break your control.
The further the distance toward the topic you want, the longer it may take to get there.

name: Triple Being
description: Some'one' with this power is really three different beings who are all living in the same body. 1 of the beings is the opposite gender of the other 2 beings. Their body changes to reflect who is in control of the body at the time and only one can control the body at a time while the other two advise. Each of the beings have their own random power that can be used only when they are in control of the body.
summary: The ability to be three beings in one body
strengths: Can utilize three different, albeit, random powers.
Three cooperative minds can think faster than one.
weaknesses: The three beings may not agree with each other at times.
Multiple sets of clothing for each being need to be bought and will drain their collective wallet.
Fights over who gets to control the body.

name: Runescape Magic
description: With this ability the user can use ANY spell that exists in the existing spellbooks, without having to pray at special alters or use elemental Rune stones. They can also conjure copies of any known staffs, they do not require levels, with this ability the user is treated as a Master Of Magic.
summary: The ability to use Runescape spells.
strengths: Magic
Awesome powers.
Self defence for Runescape fans.
weaknesses: You'll scare people.
Certain people will hate you for doing magic.
You may try to attain god-hood.

name: Quartz Graveyard
description: This abilty give you the ability to preform The Quartz Graveyard move. By slamming your hand on the ground you can cause hundreds of Quartz spikes to erupt from the ground around you. The spikes rise in a wave eminating from you and devastate the area around you.
summary: The ability to cause large spikes of quartz to erupt from the ground in a large area
strengths: Cause lots of damage
Large area of effect
weaknesses: Does not discriminate victims (You can harm allies by accident)
Requires nearly all your energy to use.

name: Acausality Curse
description: This power turns the causal timeline of someone's life into an acausal one, meaning A to B to C... Y to Z can become Z to L to G to A... This power has limits. When your victim is unrecognizable at some point in the past, your power cuts off. Shape shifters are unaffected. Time travelers can just travel to the past before you affected them. Reality changers can ignore this power. However, those who can be affected by this power will be continually confused and helpless.
summary: The ability to scramble and rearrange the moments of a person's life
strengths: Immortals who can't time travel, shape shift or change reality. Good Luck to them.
Make an immortal wish he were dead.
weaknesses: Any power that can restore causal existence to your victim.
May drive a victim crazy.
You don't know how many years back in the past you can affect a mortal victim.

name: Admiral Awesome
description: Rob a bank and don't get caught when you dazzle everyone in the room by doing anything. Chewing gum, yawning, even breathing. This power is also refereed to as Fonz-ekenisis. Look at a mirror and you're trapped, staring at yourself until someone breaks the mirror.
summary: The ability to dazzle anyone into forgetting what you were doing.
strengths: Do anything and not get in trouble
Never wait in line for rides
Get rich quick for doing nothing.
weaknesses: Look out for mirrors.

name: Vibrate
description: You will be able to make powerful vibrations like a jack hammer. Either make soft vibrations till you wear an object down or make it soft or powerful ones that turn an object to dust or even explode it.
summary: The ability to make powerful vibrations
strengths: Go into roadside construction or demolish a building
weaknesses: You'll be considered an earthquake

name: Chemical Factory
description:
With this ability you can create any chemical in your body as long as you know the formula and have the base elements within your body. 

Your body's digestive system is replace with a chemical plant in a dimensional pocket where chemicals can be stored

This makes you immune to the effects of any chemical swallowed. 

Nutrients are made from the chemical factory to be place within your body

Your body's pores are also immune to chemicals
summary: The ability to produce chemicals within your own body and spray them from your pores
strengths: Produce acids, adhesives, slicks and other stuff if you know the formula
You can give yourself a diet by selectively choosing what type of nutrients go to your body
You are immune to chemical damage
weaknesses: Must know chemistry
Must eat several chemicals to use power effectively

name: The Death Flower
description: The power of The Death Flower is basically flowers that can turn into any weapon you can think out of your imagination. It may be weak when beginners use it but once you have mastered it, the stronger it will be.
summary: The ability to use any kind of flowers and turn them into weapons.
strengths: It can cut through anything once you have mastered it.
The flowers is your medium and you are the master.
It becomes handy when the user is fighting an enemy. It doesn't matter if he/she is weak or strong
weaknesses: For beginners, it's harder to control and it would take up most of your energy.
And that's mostly all of the bad things that could affect the user of this power.

name: Shadow Of The Wolf
description: Shadowulf's name inspired this, so give him some credit. Using this you can use the Shadow of the Wolf. Doing so gives you a wolf's speed, strength and ferocity. Some side effects include your hair growing at a faster rate, eating raw meat, and wanting people to scratch your stomach.
summary: The ability to use the Shadow of the Wolf.
strengths: Boost of speed.
Ferocious strength.
weaknesses: Craving for raw meat.
Hair grows at a faster rate.

name: Metal Detection
description: One with this power can sense metals with ease; not always is the metal apparent to one's perception, though; you must consciously try to tune into the location of the metal; although, if you are standing directly above it (or in close enough distance to it), you'll receive a painless, but shocking jolt that automatically alerts you of its presence; in addition, your power allows you to automatically tell what KIND of metal you've come across.
summary: The ability to perceive metals
strengths: Find any source of metal with ease
Your detection of metal doesn't overwhelm your senses
Detect what type of metal it is
weaknesses: People will bother you all the time to find gold or silver, etc.
SOME have too great a sensitivity to metals (it overwhelms their senses)
Sometimes the detection of the metals is accompanied by a bleeping sound

name: Quadruped
description: Tired of walking on two feet? Of course you are. With this ability, you can get on all fours and sprint at high speeds like a cheetah.
summary: The ability to get on all fours and run at high speeds.
strengths: Faster than running.
weaknesses: May be somewhat shocking to most people seeing you run on all-fours.

name: Preferential Politeness
description: Our ability to be civil with one another is the backbone of our society, but this power can take it much farther. As long as you are polite to someone they will cheerfully follow most requests. They will only realize something was fishy if it is pointed out to them later that maybe they shouldn't have given that nice man the secret plans, or stopped to have a chat with the polite young lady when they were supposed to be cleaning out the vault. But if you are ever rude, the spell is broken.
summary: The ability to have people be accommodating to you as long as you are polite
strengths: Everyone will always treat you with respect if you do the same.
You can talk your way into any building and talk down any criminal.
People will comply with most "favors" that you ask for.
weaknesses: If you are impolite to the person your spell is broken and they will probably be angry.
Asking someone straight out for something is incredibly impolite.
What counts as polite can vary from person to person.

name: Magic Absorption
description: Someone with this power will temporarily boost their strength, speed, and endurance every time magic is used directly on them. The boosts are equal to half the power of the spells themselves. This power cannot turn off but magical artifacts can be used so long as they do not affect the wielder.
summary: The ability to absorb magic that has been used on one and use the power from that magic to boost physical abilities
strengths: No enemy spells can harm or weaken you.
weaknesses: Your allies cannot strengthen or boost your powers with their spells.
You can still be affected indirectly by spells.

name: Myth Power: Phorcys' Ferocity
description: Phorcys (or Phorkys), in Greek myth, was the god of the dangers of the sea. As such, channeling him allows one to manipulate water at will, as well as surviving underwater and swimming well. In addition, one can perceive dangerous waterways (rocky waters, rough or stormy waters, toxic waters, flooding rivers, waters infested with sea monsters, rapids, whirlpools or water spouts, at a waterfall's edge, etc) at will. One may even teleport subjects to locations laden with said dangerous by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Phorcys command over the essence of the dangers of the sea
strengths: Gain the ability to manipulate water, bending it to one's will (regardless of its physical state)
Perceive dangerous waterways at will (rocky/stormy/toxic/monster-infested, waterfall's edge, etc)
Teleport subjects to dangerous waterways by touch; sea monsters will NEVER attack you
weaknesses: People with Teleportation Immunity or the like are immune to Pro #3
People with aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers are immune to this ability
At higher levels, people with MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige can disrupt/negate this ability (NCN)

name: Panontic Bracelet
description: The panontic bracelets are made of the same material as the archs. The bracelets only give one power and only work for three dimensions. Ergi-lets you radiate the heat of that dimension from your body. Ithuri-lets you travel to Ithuri. Nameless-you can temporarily summon a minion of one of the inmates trapped there. The heat of Ergi only has a range of five inches. You can't control what minion you get and the minion only stays thirty minutes. Bracelets and arches work together.
summary: The ability to gain powers by using a panontic bracelet.
strengths: Summon a horrible creature to help you.
Travel to a dimension where you can go to any other dimension.
Radiate ultra hot heat from your body
weaknesses: The creature only stays thirty minutes.
The ultra hot heat only goes five inches from your body.
