name: Constellation Rearrangement
description: A person with this power can change the position of stars in the night sky by diffracting the light from the stars to change the position of stars when viewed.
summary: The ability to change the "position" of stars in the sky
strengths: Can rearrange constellations at will
Can use for advertising and message relaying
Since its actually diffracted light no damage to the cosmos occurs(directly at least)
weaknesses: Not useful in combat(or at least I can't come up with anything)
Could cause mass panic

name: Runic Wall
description: The user of this ability is capable of creating an invisible wall, which is integrated with certain rules to pass through it. Only when the rules are met, the wall will let you through
summary: The ability to create a invisible wall which blocks everything unless the specified condition is met
strengths: You can make up your won rules inside the rune wall
Can be used to play some games
You can be a trap master
weaknesses: Takes time to create the wall
Consumes a fair amount of energy

name: Elemental Weapon:Water Trident
description: You can call forth a trident that can control and manipulate the properties of water. Not only water, but steam and ice, and everything that is primarily H2O. You can thrust the trident at foes and strike them down, or you can flush them away with a tsunam or tidal wave.  You are immune to the effects of water, while wielding the trident, and can breathe underwater.
summary: The ability to wield a trident that can control and manipulate water
strengths: Control and manipulate all forms of water (steam, ice, and water)
Can strike enemies down, by thrust a powerful trident at them
Not only control water, but can generate it too
weaknesses: Can only control water when wielding the trident.
Are only immune to the effects of water, when wielding the trident
Your elemental weakness is fire

name: Anachronism
description: One with this ability is actually born into the wrong timeline, and thus being from a time before or after their current timeline, they gain certain powers. You may be faster than normal, and age slower than normal (though this is not always the case); you may even have random or intuitive knowledge about your own timeline.
summary: The ability to exist outside of one's natural timeline as though one belonged there
strengths: If you're from the future, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the future
If you're from the past, you may psychically get information (or visions) about the past
The fact that your temporal presence is distorted may result in you being faster than normal
weaknesses: If you're born in the past, and you're from the future, people MIGHT think you're a witch.
Being a temporal anomaly sometimes results in you moving slower, or aging faster than normal
Coming into contact with anything from your true timeline, while still in the wrong one, kills you

name: Luck Reversal
description: This ability is not to be taken lightly. It does not allow direct manipulation of luck and probability, but rather reverses whatever stochastic effect is currently at work. In other words, if the user sees a subject is experiencing bad luck, he can reverse this, so that subject will instead experience good luck. In the same way, he can reverse a foe's good luck to bad luck. The user, if his power is strong enough, can even affect himself.
summary: The ability to reverse stochastic effects
strengths: Change allies' bad luck to good luck
Change enemies' good luck to bad luck
Influence situations (without directly affecting PEOPLE)
weaknesses: If you can't control this power, you can also change your own good luck to bad luck
If you can't control this power, you can also change a foe's bad luck to good luck
If you are really lucky in your life, people may get suspicious

name: Empathic Storm Cloud
description: An Empathic Storm Cloud has many uses, in both combat and defense. It hovers over head at all times, only dissipating when the user consciously wills it to; its effect varies based on the user's emotions (thunder and/or lightning when angry, furiously blowing winds when afraid/nervous, rain when sad or a combination of these and orher effects at will). The user can often also make the cloud FOLLOW the foe with its effects, or even coalesce the cloud's molecules so one can stand on and ride it.
summary: The ability to produce a storm cloud above your head that interacts with your surroundings based on your emotion
strengths: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions
Make the cloud follow the foe around, raining/hailing on him, striking him with lightning, etc.
Can even be used to ride/fly on
weaknesses: Cloud produces effects based on one's emotions (emotional stress may even harm loved ones)
If you have no control over this power, it may even hurt you
Cloud is almost ALWAYS overhead, even if you develop this power

name: Subliminal Sexuality
description: Also called Subliminal Seduction, Psychic Seduction or just Seduction, one with this ability can project sexual thoughts to the minds of others, can speak with subliminal seductive power behind each word, and stimulate the brain's pleasure centers by touch, voice or thought. This can be used to attract and seduce any subject one desires, because the subject receiving the thoughts would believe THEY were the ones thinking them.
summary: The ability to psychically project sexual thoughts into the minds of others, and otherwise seduce subjects
strengths: Seduce anyone you find attractive (regardless of gender, as long as they are at least humanoid)
Your touch and voice are sexually pleasing
May be accompanied by the ability to psychically perceive how to sexually please others
weaknesses: If it only works on the gender you're not attracted to (rare, but it happens)
If it's permanently active (EVERYBODY falling in love with you would suck)
If your every touch stimulates pleasure (you could never have a normal conversation again)

name: Vortex Punch
description: Make a fist and directly in front of the fist all surrounding matter (except user) is sucked violently toward that specific point till user stops or till 250,000 lbs. Is reached within the ball that is compressed to a quarter's size. This can be kept for as long as the user has his hand in a fist, once released the matter violently returned to it's former density in an explosion (that is directed away from user by controled release. All living things contained within are reduced to meat soup.
summary: The ability to make quarter sized balls of up to 250,000 lbs.
strengths: Can take many opponents at once
Can use with both hands
Can be used as defence against bullets, missiles,... Etc.
weaknesses: Can only use as many as user has hands at a given time
Hands become basically useless except for punching since already In a fist.
May be harmful to other members in party

name: Paper Falsification
description: To use this power, you just have to write down on a sheet of paper, a card, a badge or any writable support the heading of the forgery, such as "Passport", "Police" or "Contract". Anyone who reads it will believe it to be genuine. Additional contents, such as the object of a "contract" or the identity of a person on a "passport", are optional but adds to the realism of the forgery. Furthermore, the effect is carried on if the inscription is scanned, photographed, filmed or photocopied.
summary: The ability to make anyone believe some written material is genuine.
strengths: You can easily falsify any official paper.
You can make people believe someone else is the writer or the owner of a paper.
You can make anyone believe false facts about you, such as your identity, your job, your side,...
weaknesses: People have to at least read the heading of a paper for your power to affect them.

name: Blessing Of Hercules
description: The user of this power is blessed by the divine Greek hero Hercules. This blessing is only given to males. When the user is blessed by this divine Greek hero, he would be given Hercules' strength as well as armor, sword and shield. His greatest weakness is powerful magic or sorcery.
summary: The ability to be blessed by the divine hero Hercules
strengths: Has the strength of Hercules
Has the equipments of the divine hero
weaknesses: Weak against sorcery and strong magic

name: Flinching Invulnerability
description: In old platformers, you sometimes turn invincible when you get hit. A person with this power basically has this power in real life. When they flinch, they become invulnerable for a few seconds and attacks will go through them. While not as useful as true invulnerability, this power is nevertheless useful in increasing its users survivability. In addition, this power works the instant you flinch, and you can move while invulnerable allowing you to learn how to flinch at specific triggers.
summary: The ability to be invulnerable and semi-intangible for a few seconds after you flinch
strengths: Two for flinching--fails to affect you
Immune to multiple hits--since you would flinch then get out of the way while invincible
Can be bulletproof if you flinch the moment you hear the gunshot
weaknesses: Invulnerability only happens for a few seconds and you blink at those times
Simple to use but hard to master---who can teach you how to flinch correctly?

name: Transferable Eyesight
description: Your normal sight and any other vision modes can see through another set of eyes. These eyes can be a doodle of disembodied eyes to the eyes of a living creature. The highest levels of this power let use vision-based powers(i. E. Laser eye beams) through a set of other eyes. If the other eyes you're looking through are damaged in any way you instantly see through your own eyes again.
summary: The ability to transfer all your modes of vision to another set of eyes.
strengths: See through anything that is or has a set of eyes. Paintings,toys,photos,etc.
The highest level of this power works other powers like heat vision.
weaknesses: Total mastery of this power is needed make it work with powers like laser eye beams.

name: Healer 3: Strength Restoration
description: When this power affects someone with muscular deterioration, their strength is restored to it's former level instantly and permanently. This does not recover muscle lost to lack of activity. As a benefit for you, you gain the same amount of strength.
summary: The ability to restore the lost strength of others and gain strength for yourself.
strengths: Range of 25 kilometers, increasing a meter each year of possession. Can be turned of at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain the strength too.
weaknesses: You cannot restore muscle lost to lack of physical activity, unless extreme.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: T Vportation
description: With this power you can pull any object or person out of a TV program at will!  Great tools and experts are available with a click of your remote and your TVportation power!  Once you have the object, it's yours to do with what you want.  The person or character is at your service and must do as you wish.  You're limited only by your imagination and channel selection.  The objects and characters go back when your show is over.....
summary: The ability to pull anything or anyone out of a TV show
strengths: Just about anything is available - even fantasy objects and characters
Unique power!
Recorded shows work, too!
weaknesses: Limited only by the length of the show:  30 min or 60 mins, etc.
People might not understand your choices

name: Total Bs
description: You can tell exactly what individuals want to hear in order to get what you want. It's not telepathy so much as it is an empathetic connection and the careful observation of your target's actions.
summary: The ability to bS your way into or out of any situation
strengths: You see that girl over there, want her number? You got it.
Your boss gave you that raise and promotion, what was it your company does again? Aww who cares!
"Thanks again for not giving me that ticket, officer! I will tell my sick grandmother you said 'hi'"
weaknesses: Just because you fool everyone into thinking you know what you are doing, odds are you have no clue.
Extreme ego boost, you might con yourself into believing the things you tell people.
God forbid you don't get a chance to talk to that mugger before he knifes you

name: Artistic Replication
description: You can draw, paint, sculpt, whittle, etc. anything you see or have seen. Includes signatures and such.
summary: The ability to recreate what you see / have seen through artistic medium
strengths: If you get mugged, you can draw an accurate picture of him.
Become a famous artist.
Forge anything from the Mona Lisa to your boss' signature.
weaknesses: Won't help in a fight.
Can't recreate original fantasy art since it applies only to things you've seen.
If you don't remember what it looked like well enough, you can't recreate it.

name: Blindsight (Blind Sight)
description: Also called Blind Sight, Blind Sense or Sightless Sight, this is the power to see without truly seeing. One can do this one of three ways. 1) the user can see the shapes of objects and subjects as a psionic outline rather than the true shape; 2)the user's eyes simply acts as a mode of awareness and points subconsciously in the direction of obstacles, so the user looks like he can see; 3) the user's sight capacity is inverted (when his eyes are closed he can see, but when they're open he's blind)
summary: The ability to use numerous methods to see without truly seeing
strengths: Weird ways of being able to see catch people off guard
Still see perfectly
May be accompanied by some other visual aspect (telescopic, infrared, lightless, ultraviolet, etc. )
weaknesses: Immature people might mess with you, cause they think you're blind (which you technically are)
The second variation requires some getting used to
The third variation may get confusing IF you can't turn it off (sleeping would be hard)

name: Ultimate Vaccination
description: With this power you can gain immunity to anything if you inject some of it into you. So if you inject yourself with alcohol you will never be able to get drunk again. If you inject yourself with a virus you will immune to that virus. If you inject yourself with coffee, it will never be able to keep you awake and active again.
summary: The ability to be immune to the effects of something if you inject yourself with it
strengths: You can be immune to anything
weaknesses: Once you inject yourself you will always be immune to that thing

name: Border Patrol
description: This does not just include physical borders, but also conceptual barriers, like those between Truth and Lies, Criminal and Citizen, Death and Life, Past and Present, Present and Future, etc. You can manipulate them in any way you want once the power is fully developed. For example, conceptually blur citizen and criminal to destroy a city (citizens get arrested, criminals everywhere), or open a physical portal between the Truth- a place, and the Lie- an image of that place, to travel instantly.
summary: The ability to have perfect control over borders and boundaries
strengths: Extremely powerful reality manipulation
Can also manipulate any physical boundaries or borders, or things trying to block you
weaknesses: Some boundaries will take time to fully control the energy of (example: Reality and Imagination)
You must be able to figure out what boundaries to manipulate in order to actually do something

name: Duo Tacto Mimicry
description: This ability allows you to replicate the abilities of any two superhumans! However, keep in mind that when you attempt to copy the abilities of a third meta human, you lose the first ability that you copied, with your second at risk should you copy a fourth mutant's power! You also keep whatever side effects their powers may come with (i.e. the super human's power -- effect on appearance, angel wings, blue fur etc. ) until you copy "over" the power and push it out of its "slot"
summary: The ability to copy the powers of two metahumans by touch
strengths: The abilities of any two meta humans
weaknesses: You have to make contact with them
You gain any features their powers gave them
When you copy a third person's abilties, you lose the first person's abilities

name: Encouraging Voice
description: Have your voice be the most inspiring and encouraging yet with this power. Perhaps your mother is depressed over her divorce; with this power the user can encourage her and she will be filled with joy. If you use this power used wrongly, she may be depressed even more.
summary: The ability to encourage any whom needs it.
strengths: Be like Martin Luther King Jr. , inspire anyone!
weaknesses: If used wrongly, the power will backfire, discouraging anyone.

name: Cargo Cult Deity
description: 'Cargo cult' is the term for a primitive group worshiping outsiders with more advanced technology, believing the technology to be magic. With this power, any technology you have/are using (note that even clothes count) is increased to the point that most of the people around you would consider it 'god-like. ' The technology retains, for the most part, its original function, just greatly extended in capability (a flashlight might turn night to day, but it won't shoot lightning or make bread).
summary: The ability to have technology that makes you seem like a god
strengths: Have advanced technology- powerful enough to look like a god (or at least a powerful magic user)
The more advanced the people around you, the more advanced you get
Most city-dwellers have fairly high standards, and everything in a city is technology.
weaknesses: You have to be in contact with whatever you're upgrading
Your power is entirely dependant on other people to make it, and their standards of what a 'god' is
The new technology won't be able to do random/new things, it has to be an extension of its old self

name: Social Engineering
description: With this power you can manipulate large number of people through verbal persuasion and deception without a failure.
summary: The ability to influence social behaviors and attitudes
strengths: Can make people believe in the unbelievable
Can establish relationships with an ease
Can rule the world and beyond
weaknesses: Can't use when your mouth is shut
Is immoral!

name: Face Reality
description: A hero that just knows he's the greatest. The guy who directed The Happening. This ability is to make individuals like them become non-delusional and realize they're not a good as they think they are. A short period of depression may happen to someone after you use this power on him. After this his behavior will become normal and tolerable. The effect of this power is permanent. Sadly anti-telepathy or similar powers will block it.
summary: The ability to help those with delusions of grandeur realize how the world perceives them.
strengths: No more movies like The Happening.
No egotistical heroes.
This power may make some villains realize they'll never win and give up villainy.
weaknesses: The guy who directed The Happening has anti-telepathy.

name: Unimaginable Existence
description: An existential state wherein the affected person cannot be brought up in other people's mind to be pictured, thought of, or even imagined. Meaning anyone with this ability suddenly becomes an absolute enigma completely alien & unthinkable to anyone who tries to imagine or picture them in mind. In effect, a person with this ability (& with practice even their surrounding) is rendered unaffected by anyone or anything that has something to do with Telepathy, Mind Reading, & Power of Imagination.
summary: The ability to exist as an unimaginable being relative to the existence of people who thinks of them.
strengths: Nobody, not even telepaths, can think of you.
Renders your existence and at a certain extent your surrounding unaffected by power of imagination.
Also makes you a hard target. How can you attack someone you can't even think of?
weaknesses: You can still be attacked if you can be seen
No one thinks of you. Not even your love one's. (yup, no more birthday parties and the like).
Not suitable for team work.

name: Drizzle
description: You can now make it rain from the sky anywhere at any time, indoors and out. You control how long and how hard it rains as well as the temperature of the rain that falls, from boiling heat to as cold as the arctic sea. Since the rain is supernatural it vanishes at the point when it would normally evaporate and contains none of the nutrients needed from water to survive.
summary: The ability to make it rain.
strengths: Make it rain anytime. By extention you can also make it cloudy.
Rain out your opponent with a boiling or icy shower.
Flood whole areas.
weaknesses: Nothing can make use of the rain water.

name: Weakness Inducing
description: With this power, you can give your target a weakness. It works on everything: humans, animals, plants, objects etc. They can be as complex or simple as you want, but one at a time. You can change the weakness and give multiple things/persons the same weakness. The effects will wear off when they leave your range (10 miles).
summary: The ability to give the target a weakness.
strengths: Give anything a weakness
you can change the weakness
You can give multiple things/persons the same weakness
weaknesses: Can only give someone/something one weakness
Weakness will fade when you're out of range

name: Zzzzzzz Point
description: With this power whenever you point at someone they will instantly fall asleep (and probably fall to the ground) and start snoring extremely loudly. This is useful to disrupt class or get people in trouble in class by making them fall asleep and start snoring in class or you can make your enemies or criminals fall asleep long enough for you to defeat them or for the cops to come and arrest them. The person wakes up and stops snoring as soon as you stop pointing at them.
summary: The ability to make people fall asleep and start snoring by pointing at them
strengths: You can make people fall asleep and start snoring loudly
You can disrupt class
You can cause enemies to fall asleep
weaknesses: You have to be pointing at them or they'll wake up
You can't make them fall asleep without snoring

name: Bullets Of Un Adaptability
description: The power of defensive adaptation is an effective way of protecting oneself from defeat. For some, it is a cheap and annoying ability that doesn't require mastery, skill, or any tactical method to overcome a difficult situation. With this ability however, a person can now materialize a bullet (wired to defeat the target) that can counter-adapt any immunity or protection gained from adaptation. It will continously evolve and transform itself whenever the target has adapted from a previous attack.
summary: The ability to materialize meta-existential bullets that counter-adapt to anything the target is adapted to.
strengths: Infinitely creates new ways to harm, torture, counter abilities to defeat your target.
All Meta-bullets fired transcend all existential limitations and stay within the target.
The Meta-bullet will continously adapt to cause harm, even if it is inside the target.
weaknesses: The bullet is perfectly unique and no two bullets are the same so you don't know what they do.
Can 'only' I repeat ONLY be used against annoying super beings capable of adaptation.
Has no effect whatsoever on non-adaptative targets.

name: Emotional Imprint (Non Living)
description:
While touching any non-living object you can imprint it with any single emotion you have personally experienced, and also multiply that emotion to extreme levels. 
Ex. While holding a public phone you can imprint anger onto it, and then multiply the emotion. Whoever touches that phone will be overcome with the emotion regardless of logic.
summary: The ability to embed imprint emotions onto non-living objects which "infect" those who touch it.
strengths: Can use it for personal gain ex. wearing a ring that emits love so those who shake your hand...
Very powerful "behind the scenes" ability. Lust, Fear, Gulit, etc.
Can create projectile manipulation weapons ex. Airsoft guns...pellets embedded.
weaknesses: Cannot use directly on yourself.
Cannot use emotions you've never experinced.
Effects wear off of person after 12 hrs, and off of object after 3 days.

name: Spell Burn Aura
description: A person with this ability has the power to burn up the power of existence of anything which is mystical or magical in nature; this involves (but is not limited to) any paranormal phenomena like magic, sorcery, divination, necromancy, curses, and blessings which endow characteristics that are clearly mystical. Indirectly, this ability also burns away mana and soul together with its vessel. This ability is passive and is only activated in the presence of such mystical energies.
summary: The ability to burn away the existence of divine magic, sorcery, necromancy, curses, hexes, blessings, etc.
strengths: Be the ultimate mage hunter!
No mortal, immortal, unholy or divine power can touch you!
Even mystical weapon and armors will burn into crispy black or molten substance.
weaknesses: Healing power or the like will not work on you.
All unholy or divine forces will ultimately want to destroy you.
This is not magic and it is not an ideal substitute.

name: Myth Power: Bia's Benefit
description: Bia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of force, might, power and compulsion. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate the force behind a projectile (such as giving a paper ball the force of a wrecking ball, giving a Mack truck the force of a tricycle, etc) at will. In addition, one can speak nearly irresistible compulsions, as well as psychically manipulate the power behind others' compulsions, at will. One can even psychically manipulate the power of superhuman abilities.
summary: The ability to channel Bia's command over the essence of force, might, power and compulsion
strengths: Psychically manipulate the force a projectile exerts, at will
Psychically compel others, and manipulate and withstand others' compulsions, at will
Heighten or lessen the force behind any superhuman ability
weaknesses: MythPower: Ananke's Answer provides immunity to direct effects of Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPowers based on Styx and Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) provide immunity (NCN)
Power/strength/toughness-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Humanity Separation
description: This ability was actually made to prevent near-death situations, but now, with the proper training, it can be used in more ways than one. When you separate, your body will be in atomized pieces, your spirit will travel as a ball of light, and your mind will travel in brain-waves. Eventually, you'll have to come back together, so before you split up, think of a location. Then, all your pieces will return at that spot. You can do this to anyone else as well.
summary: The ability to split oneself or others into their mind, body, and spirit.
strengths: Good escape plan.
Different form of transportation.
weaknesses: I don't know if this ability is good for fighting yet.

name: Evil Eye
description: To know what true intentions of your enemies your eyes glow Dark Red, this ability allows you to see if a person's a cheater, swindler, rapist, or some other vile fiend.
summary: The ability to see what sinful person has done in the past, present, and/or future.
strengths: Criminals might fear you.
weaknesses: Never try to use your power on National TV.

name: Mental Communication
description: Tired of phone credit running out? Well, then this is a great power to have. It enables any two users in the universe to communicate mentally. It can be turned off at will and you can choose if you want to be able to communicate with others. If you think a stray thought, don't worry, you can choose whether to send it or not.
summary: The ability to communicate with anyone else with this power.
strengths: No need for credit.
Message is always perfectly clear.
Can communicate over any distance.
weaknesses: If you are the only one with this power.
Same problems with language barriers.
No other uses common to telepathy.

name: Power Encryption
description: With this power, you can think of any power you have (including this one) and a series of letters and/or numbers. Once this "encryption" is done to a power, it can't be copied or altered. Powers can be stolen, but unless the power thief knows the access code, they can't use it. Encrypted powers can't be shared willingly even if you wanted to no matter what power sharing powers you have.
summary: The ability to encrypt your powers so they can't be copied or altered.
strengths: Keep the best powers to yourself.
weaknesses: You have to choose between sharing powers with your friends or encrypting your powers
Mind readers.
Remembering access codes if you have too many powers.

name: Super Smoke
description: This is a power any ninja would want. Super Smoke allows you to change your entire body (clothes and objects included) into smoke. Of course you would control this form like you would control your human body but with more freedom. You could "fly" at the speed of wind (approximatively), you could become untouchable and get inside or outside places trough small gaps. The only problem is if you get struck by a strong wind you will be forced back into your human form.
summary: The ability to change your body into smoke
strengths: Become the ultimate ninja
Untouchable
Can get to places faster
weaknesses: Strong winds force you back in your human form
No offensive abilities

name: Gift: Minds
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling minds than other beings. Thus their mind-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of minds from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve mind-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of minds
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over minds as someone with this power.
Mind-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only mind-based powers now.

name: Loading Is Overrated
description: You have two pistols with magic cartridges that contain an infinite number of bullets. You just shoot and shoot and never have to load.
summary: The ability to have two guns with infinite bullets.
strengths: Ultimate pistol hero
Bang-bang, with both of your hands
You can always protect yourself
weaknesses: It's just two pistols, not a weapon of mass destruction
Your bullets are easily identifiable, so beware of detectives
Not so badass if you get so trigger happy that you accidentally kill someone innocent

name: Hibernation (Enemy's Hand)
description: Simply put, if an enemy attacks you, your power reflects their force back on them and it forces them into a hibernation state. They go to sleep and their systems are reduced to a slower pace. Depending on the power they use, they will be in hibernation for as little as minutes or as much as a year.
summary: The ability to force any enemy into a hybornation state.
strengths: You can use this ability to gain time to carry out complicated plans.
This power is often used instinctively so you're never ambushed from behind.
You won't kill anyone so this power makes capturing really easy
weaknesses: You must be attacked before this power can work.
Immortals, Demons, and Time changers are immune to this power. If you use this power on someone,,,,,
With the same power you could get caught in a recoil effect and trap eachother in hibernation 4 ever

name: Spl Mimicry 1: Ability Chain
description: Once you gain this power, you gain all of the powers in your profile. If you lose this power, you retain your acquired powers. Your powers are not mimicked from another source, but now legitimate. Unfortunately, you must gain this power legitimately or through others in this series for it to work. Luckily, once you gain one in the series, you gain all of them. No power can eliminate this power's cons.
summary: The ability to gain your profile powers.
strengths: Gain all of your powers in real life.
Gain all other powers in this series, whether you possess them or not.
The powers are legitimate and not dependent on this one.
weaknesses: Must be legitimate or acquired through possession of other powers in this series.
You must get an opportunity to gain a power of your choice for this to be useful.
Serves no use on it's own; you must have a profile on the Superpower List.

name: Shock An Awe
description: When you use this ability, you can slam your fist into the ground causing a shockwave, that stuns any person, group or any piece of technology, in a 1-mile radius for 10 seconds. You cannot stack the time and you must wait for the full 10 seconds before using the power again.
summary: The ability to make a shockwave stunning a person, group or technology for 10 seconds
strengths: Stuns people for 10 seconds
Disables technology for 10 seconds
Stuns up to a 1-mile radius
weaknesses: Cannot stack the time
Must wait for a full 10 seconds before using again
Only works in a 1-mile radius

name: Bs
description: Ever wanted to BS your way on an essay to a test and get a 100? Well, now you can! This useful ability lets anything you put on paper--or on the computer screen, or even any lies you make, sound perfectly true even if they are BS!
summary: The ability to bs your way out of anything
strengths: Anyone will believe what BS you tell them
You can BS really well
You get better with practice
weaknesses: Not really useful if you're a superhero

name: Hydro Breath
description: You can easily breathe out burst streams of water from your mouth to extinguish fire and reduce your opponents to wetness (especially fire-based enemies).
summary: The ability to spew a jet stream of water from your mouth.
strengths: You'll become a human firehose.
weaknesses: Never use it on electrical objects.
If you use it on electric based opponents, you can get shocked.

name: Molecular Repulsion
description: This ability will allow you to make stuff, including you, unable to be touched or combined by any molecule or what they form into like earth or water. This was made for defense, but with the right amount of imagination, it can be used for offense.
summary: The ability to make anything unable to be touched by any molecule, the effects only last for 10 min, if left alone.
strengths: Can be protected by any form of molecule.
Make anything else protected by any form of molecule.
weaknesses: The effects, if left alone, can last for 10 min.
Can't be protected from light, sound, or heat energy.

name: Master Evolver
description: You can use your ability to accelerate the genetic evolution of living organisms, could foribly evolve or devolve life froms at an aceelerated rate. For my example - you could fire mental waves to evolve any ape species into a human, any kind of fish into a reptile/amphibian and/or you can use it on a human to make their craniums grow in size.
summary: The ability to turn any ape/primate into a human & turn any fish species into a reptile/amphibian.
strengths: You could even turn a Shark into a T-Rex.
Can enhance other hero or villain's powers & abilities.
weaknesses: It can cause them to die.

name: Myth Power: Plutos' Bounty
description: Plutos (Ploutos, Ploutus, Plutus), in Greek myth, was the god of wealth. As such, channeling him allows one to answer any question related to money (how much an item costs, stock investments, etc. ); however, they, themselves, have no need for it. All of society will treat them as though all the money in the world is at their disposal (anything with a price on it will be given to them, free of charge, no questions asked); in addition, their presence makes "food plants" produce more plentifully.
summary: The ability to channel Plutos' command over the essence of wealth, riches and bounty
strengths: Provide for yourself for life
Provide for your loved ones for life (and maybe feel a greater sense of charity)
Fame (knowledge of the workings of the economy ANYWHERE in the world)
weaknesses: Fame (knowledge of the workings of the economy ANYWHERE in the world)
People with MythPower: Demeter's Touch can sense your powers (hope they aren't villains)
People with MythPower: Tyche's Hand can sense your powers (hope they aren't villains)

name: Backseat Driving
description: With this power you can control any vehicle you are in contact with like it was part of you body as long as you are touching it or touching something (other than the ground) that is touching it. You could surf behind your boat and be the driver at the same time but if you let go of the rope you'd have to swim back to the boat yourself
summary: The ability to control any vehicle you are in contact with without touching the controls
strengths: Con take control if driver is unconcious, drunk or unfit to drive
Can show off on your way to work "surfing" on top of your car
If kidnapped can drive from trunk or cargo area
weaknesses: People can't stop you if you are drunk
It's dificult to see where you are going from the trunk
Car has all the limits it would if you were at the wheel

name: Number Knowledge
description: You can know ANY number.  Think about it.  Lottery numbers.  The number of times you've been checked out today.  The number of people who think you're sexy.  You can know ANY NUMBER!
summary: The ability to know any answer, as long as the answer is a number.
strengths: Find out things you'd never know
Win the lottery by knowing the winning numbers
weaknesses: You might change the future if you act on certain things

name: T Vkinesis
description: With this power, you can go into the television shows you love and be a part of the show, completly changing the plot as you know it.
summary: The ability to go into television shows or movies.
strengths: Everyone thinks the show was originally made the way it was while you were in it.
You will look like the characters in the show. E.g. If it's a cartoon, you will be animated.
You can take stuff from the show with you back into the real world.
weaknesses: You could get killed in the show and no one will know you.

name: Literal Genie
description: The person with the literal genie has both a blessing and a curse depending on what they wish for. For example, wishing for a ton of money could result in a ton of cash dropping on them. Also, asking to cure cancer can lead to every cancer patient dying or some other messed up reality warping. That is because the genie is literal and will grant the wishes literally without knowing the true intentions of the wisher.
summary: The ability to have a literal genie in your command
strengths: You have infinite wishes, except you only get 3 a day -- and wishes must be reversed the same day
The genie is nigh-omnipotent
weaknesses: The genie is literal -- that means that it is very hard to wish for exactly what you want
You cannot wish to know the exact phrasing -- one of the rules
Again, the genie is literal -- this is so bad that it takes up two cons

name: Tactile Electric Charge
description: I originally thought of this ability as "Supercharger", but it can be for fighting as well. You can grab an enemy and throw him while your ability shocks him. You don't have to use your hand to use it, because you can use any part of your body that can hold or grip.
summary: The ability to release a powerful charge of energy just by holding on tightly
strengths: Recharger
Can damage or overload anything
weaknesses: Must be physically holding something
No range

name: Ultima X Power: Transport
description: The Ultima-X Powers are a series of forces that form the bond between reality and Japanese animated, and/or drawn fiction. They can be found in anyone that has a supreme, yet healthy love for anime and anime characters. This particular Ultima-X energy allows you to pull a character through to our dimension freely, and vice versa(send the character back. ) The Ultima-X energies themselves however are not meant to be controlled, but to keep the balance between reality and fiction. Use carefully!
summary: The ability to summon modern japanese anime, manga, music, and game characters to your side.
strengths: The character you summon remains in his/her animated state, and does not change.
Having that favorite anime character beside you in times of need has never been easier!
Characters can be summoned as long as they are modern anime-styled, or drawn as such.
weaknesses: Keeping a character for too long outside of his/her reality will disrupt the fabric of reality.
Remember, the character has no knowledge outside of what he/she already believes.
Only one character can be summoned at a time every 3 months, during a new moon.

name: Fractal Matter Conversion
description: Use this power on anything solid-say a vase, smash it into a 100 pieces, and you get the original back plus 99 duplicates. Smash those hundred vases and you a get 10,000 vases. Now imagine any weapon or armor self-replicating/regenerating. This power will work on the simplest thing(a rock) to the most complex-a super computer. This power will work on a painting or a book. It will work on objects made of frozen liquids. It will work with batteries. Scale is no object-the Earth could be affected.
summary: The ability to make any non-fractal non-living object into a fractal one.
strengths: Make anything you own self-replicating and self-regenerating.
Your clothes will always be like new.
Think of what objects you like to make indestructible.
weaknesses: Powers that totally destroy an object.
Matter control powers.
Powers that stop or freeze an object without damaging it.

name: Salient Perception
description: A person with salient perception would look at a group of objects, and be able to find/choose the object they need for their situation. This manifests as an intuition-type feeling. For example, a person looking for a paper clip on a messy desk would almost instantly know where to find it. The user, however, must know why they need the object. The more specific the purpose, the more situationally-appropriate the most noticeable object will be.
summary: The ability to distinguish situationally-important objects from the objects around them.
strengths: Answers on multiple question tests would be easily known.
Fighting an attacker in an unknown location? A quick look around, and you can find an improv weapon.
Can also be used for finding people in crowds (as long as you've seen the person's face before).
weaknesses: Requires a reasonable degree of focus.
If you want to find an object, you must have seen one of the object before.
If you're looking for a person, the further you are from them, the weaker your intuition will be.

name: Mood Ring
description: If you're depressed, your eyes turn blue. If you're angry, your eyes turn red. If you're happy, your eyes turn hazel. If you're in love, they turn violet-pink.
summary: The ability to change your eye color based on your mood
strengths: Possible to gain a new power whenever your eyes change color
If you are uncertain if you're in love or not, look in the mirror
weaknesses: Obvious when you're using it

name: Surface Phasing
description: The ability to become 2 dimensional on a flat surface (similar to a shadow) and to move fluently throughout the room.
summary: The ability to move inside flat surfaces.
strengths: Chances of confusing the opponent are endless
Able to reach high and low places
weaknesses: If wall is damage, results could target you

name: Tele Atomic Disintegration
description: By telepathically causing atomic decay in bodies of matter (e.g. tables), this power allows its wielder to cause explosions on the scale of atomic bombs. This means that when provoked, one could destroy an entire city in minutes. The perfect villain superpower.
summary: The ability to cause objects to explode like an atomic bomb.
strengths: Perfect villain power.
Cause mass destruction and murder.
Genocide made easy.
weaknesses: Will probably end up killing oneself in the explosion.
Cause mass destruction and murder.
May not be able to control it.

name: Isolation
description: With this power, you can isolate a single element when it is combined with others. For example, you could make water disappear and float upwards by isolating the oxygen and hydrogen. It requires little focus and can only be used when in physical contact with the object you want to break up. You could basically kill anyone by isolating all of the elements they are made of. You do not need to isolate them completely though. You could breathe underwater by just isolating some O2, not just oxygen.
summary: The ability to isolate elements in compounds, minerals, ect.
strengths: Isolate precious metals from ordinary rock.
Breathe underwater.
Instant kill.
weaknesses: Needs physical contact.
Might become power-mad.
Might need to research your periodic table to use this effectively.

name: Faith Induced Abilities
description: Conditional awesomeness! This power gives you all the powers people believe you to have. If they believe that you have super strength then you do--on the other hand if they believe that you are extremely weak then you will be
summary: The ability to have all the powers people believe you to have
strengths: You can be a god if others believe you are
You can be an invincible hero as long as people believe you are
You can be anything if people believe you are
weaknesses: If people don't believe in you, you lose your powers and turn into a loser
If people believe you can shoot rainbows from your armpits or the like
If someone says that they don't believe you, you will be paralyzed when they are saying it

name: Spark
description: An electrical spark is created by snapping one's fingers
summary: The ability to create a spark by snapping your fingers
strengths: Can light certain objects on fire
Waterproof
Can come in handy in survival situation or recreation
weaknesses: Not good for offensive
Nor defensive

name: Camera Power: Alteration
description: A person with this power has the ability to alter reality by taking a photograph. When taken, things inside the picture cannot exit the photographed area in the real world-invisible barrier. You can also jump into photographs and pick up items to use-they will levitate in the real world. People can only see you if they find the photograph-which must be within the photographed area. Also, you can attack the photographic image and have it be reflected in the real world when inside the photograph.
summary: The ability to alter the world by altering photographs
strengths: You can trap people inside a room by taking a picture of the room with the people inside
You can enter photographs and grab objects inside the photograph to use, even those hidden
You can hide within a picture to attack-the real world is affected by your actions
weaknesses: If the people find the picture you are hiding in, they can burn it

name: Vampirism: Energy
description: This is the ability to absorb a type of energy into the body with no harm to oneself and convert it into sustenance and/or physical power; the energy may be any type (electricity, radiation, magical, psionic, etc. ) but it is almost NEVER all types. This ability is similar to normal Energy Absorption, but is distinguished by the fact that it absolutely MUST be accomplished by a bit to the source (though fortunately, due to this power, that does not threaten to harm the user)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the energy of others
strengths: Drain enemies' electronics, electrical appliances, generators, energy attacks, etc
Drain your foe's resources and get full and revitalized at the same time!
Though voluntary vampirism is by mouth, the body can also absorb energy attacks through the skin
weaknesses: Doesn't absorb enemy's life-force until the very HIGHEST levels
Requires an actual bite like a true vampire
May want to stick to energy producing superhumans (you'll look ridiculous biting a TV)

name: Loki's Staff
description: Used by Loki the Norse god of trickery, mischief, and evil, it allows you to create illusions. The only way you can obtain this is by going through a difficult maze full of riddles. Good with Thor's Hammer.
summary: The ability to wield Loki's staff
strengths: Let's you create illusions
Good weapon
Good with Thor's Hammer.
weaknesses: You can trick yourself at times
It's not able to trick those who have really strong minds(like superhumanly smart)

name: Sun Palms
description: You are able to create stars in your hands. You are also able to mentally be able to explode it.  These suns are loaded with an insane amount of thermal energy, so if they touch you, you will be burned.  BADLY.
summary: The ability to create sun in the palm of your hands.
strengths: Create Stars.
weaknesses: You will be burned badly.

name: Neatness
description: In your presence, things are put away,cleaned, dusted, you name it, in your presence.  But just because everything is cleaned doesn't mean you are organized (can't find a folder,etc.)
summary: The ability to have things cleaned in your presence.
strengths: Everything is neat.
weaknesses: You may not be organized.

name: Rainbow Forcefields
description: You can create rainbow that act like something telekinetic. You can move stuffwith it, use them as shileds etc.
summary: The ability to moves things with your hands or mind and create force shields that look like rainbows
strengths: You can block hits
You can move people around
You can use your powers to clean up
weaknesses: The shield don't last that long
Powers become out of control when you are angry
You can lose your powers if you don't use by the time you turn 18

name: Myth Power: Chrysos' Crusade
description: Chrysos (Chrysus, Khrysos), in Greek myth, was the god of gold and golden riches. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will. Furthermore, one can turn anything that glitters into gold (the metal), by touch. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are wearing gold (and gold-colored non-metals), at will.
summary: The ability to channel Chrysos' command over the essence of gold and golden riches
strengths: Psychically perceive and manipulate the gold metal (and gold-colored non-metals) at will
Psychically turn anything that sparkles/glitters into gold, by touch
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those holding/wearing gold
weaknesses: Cannot turn non-sparkly matter into gold (or manipulate gold-turned matter) until developed (NCN)
Cannot assume a form of gold (or reverse Midas Touch) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Hepheastus' Forge provide immunity (NCN)

name: Electric Halo
description: With this ability, you generate a ring of bioelectrical energy around your head. This energy will shock any who touch it. The strength of the electrical energy, and the resulting glow of the halo, would depend upon your concentration. This will offer some protection from cranial assaults. It would also greatly increase the effect of any headbutts you give someone.
summary: The ability to generate a ring of bioelectrical energy around your head
strengths: Generates light to aid in seeing in darkness
Protects your head
Electric head butt
weaknesses: The glow oif the halo may increase detection on stealth or night missions
May attract the attention of a lot of religious nuts

name: Skill Reversal
description: Reverse another super human's power
summary: The ability to reverse other's powers
strengths: May increase team mate's power
May weakens enemy's power
weaknesses: May weaken team mate's powers
May strengthen enemy's powers
Lasts fifteen minutes

name: Great Impersonator
description: You can disguise yourself perfectly to look like someone else, but they have to be human. You even sound & act like that person. You can look like a celebrity to world leaders to whomever else. Downside is you only know the known facts about that person, not their personal knowledge.
summary: The ability to become a perfect look-alike
strengths: Become famous
Win look-alike contests
weaknesses: Crazed fans will follow you if you disguise yourself as a celebrity
You only know the facts about the person, not there personal knowledge

name: Clairaudience
description: A person who can psychically hear, hears things from either the past or near future or voices of spirits. Its like if you were blind & your hearing was tuned up psychically, you could picture the surroundings of the past or future by the sounds that were psychically echoed. You can also listen to the deceased & technically become a medium. You can't hear things from ancient past or distant future, just events close to the present.
summary: The ability to psychically hear & listen
strengths: Hear things from the past or near future
Listen to ghosts
weaknesses: Can't hear things that happened long ago or distant future

name: Angel Blade
description: When used, you will grow wings that can be removed and used as razor-sharp blades. The wings will grow back if removed, but the wings can be broken and will hurt when removed. FYI: You can fly!
summary: The ability to grow wing blades
strengths: Razor-sharp wings
Wings will grow back if removed
Can fly
weaknesses: Wings can be broken
Will hurt if removed

name: Attractive Pheromone Release
description: What can I say not only are you a babe magnet but you're bettering the babes that are attracted to you and the effects are maintained until the user wants it to stop. When this occurs, the women returns to its normal self. And this is used with extreme ease and no time at all.
summary: The ability to make selected women be greatly attracted to you and enlarging the women "features"
strengths: Hotter women
Hotter women love you
Stays until the user decides to stop pheromones
weaknesses: None

name: Common Sense
description: This ability allows you to not be an idiot and to think clearly in a situation.
summary: The ability to not jump to conclusions and to think rationally
strengths: Looking smart
Not being an idiot
weaknesses: People may think you're an ass.
So rare it's a goddamn super power

name: Turbo Superhuman Fighter
description: You'll be fighting like Goku or a Street Fighter. Deliver a 1000 lightning kicks at once or a bullet time punch that has the effect of a shotgun or rocket jump in the air & crash down creating a devastating earthquake with your fist. Even creating a powerful blast of air with a punch. You defy fighting physics.
summary: The ability to be a superhuman fighter
strengths: Kick ass turbo style
weaknesses: You have to control your strentgh or you'll accidentally injury someone

name: Endeavor
description: With this ability, you can make someone feel your pain. They feel excactly the same pain as you do. However, you still also feel the pain, and you must be concentrating on that person to activate this ability. They must also be within eyesight.
summary: The ability to make someone feel your pain.
strengths: Show someone how you feel about your pain.
Also works with forms of stress, or mental conflict.
weaknesses: Cannot show them why you feel that way, if it is stress / mental pain.
It can really hurt someone to give them your pain.

name: Power Clothes
description: The powers put into the clothes can be any power that the user of this power currently has. The user of this power cannot put anything too powerful into the clothing such as Self-Existence Manipulation, Power of Imagination, Con Negation, Death Touch, etc. Anyone who can wear the article of clothing can use the power it has. 1 power per article of clothing.
summary: The ability to put powers into clothes
strengths: The user keeps the power they put in the clothing because a copy is put in the article of clothing.
Can be any power the user has except thos mentioned in description and con 2.
weaknesses: Power can be used by anyone who can wear the article of clothing.
Omnipotence, omniscience, etc. Nothing too powerful. Ask if you aren't sure.
Con Negation and similar alteration powers do not work on this power.

name: Pain Suck
description: Pretty simple. You can take out pain and injuries from someone, store them inside you (you don't feel anything) and when you are attacked, you can inflict the pain and injuries on your foe.
summary: The ability to take people's pain and inflict it on others
strengths: Can heal others
weaknesses: Cannot heal self

name: Third Eye: Telekinesis
description: This power is gained by using the Third Eye power. The third Eye power slowly turns into this power the more you stare at objects from far away. You can move anything you can see with your third eye. You can stil use the Third Eye powers.
summary: The ability to telekinetically move any object one's third eye can see
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can move objects mentally.
Can still use the Third Eye powers.
weaknesses: Must use Third Eye and look at objects a long way away.
Must see the object with your third eye.
Can't get the other formerly possible power.

name: Rinnegan: Samsara Eye
description: If you are born with this special ripple like eye, than you are able to control all jutsu and master them easily. Although this is inherited, one must at least look at one technique to know how it functions
summary: The ability to control all kinds of jutsu with this special eye
strengths: Almost all jutsu is yours to master and make your own
You will be able to graduate from the ninja academy with ease
You can use a jutsu for every situation
weaknesses: You have to see the jutsu, being blinded negates the learning ability
You can't learn about abilities that are faster than you can see them
Invisible jutsu because you can't see them

name: Open Dark Voids
description: You can open up voids that will suck your enemies into a dark and unknown dimension that they can't escape from until they die. You can also control the suction force.
summary: The ability to open voids that suck people into them
strengths: Sucks in huge swarms of enemies at once
Your enemies can never escape
weaknesses: You can get sucked in too
May suck in innocent people too

name: Blessing Of Hades
description: Hades is the Greek god of the dead, and of wealth. His blessing allows you to summon the dead and shadows to do your bidding. Skeletons and corpses will be your army.  Shadows will be your armory, your pets, and you highway. You will be able to travel through shadows. The other side of his blessing is wealth. Precious metals will be your play-things, able to be controlled, heated and reshaped to your will.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Hades.
strengths: You can control the dead and shadows
Shadow traveling is almost like teleporting
You'll be rich beyond your wildest dreams.
weaknesses: Shadow travel makes you very tired. You can only do it twice every few hours.
Forging shadow creatures and precious metals is very hard to do. It will take practice.
While you're very powerful, your powers drain you a lot

name: Elemental Weapon: Earth Hammer
description: You can call forth a hammer/mallet, that when pounded on the ground can cause massive quakes, tremors, avalanches, and terraform the land.  You can pound away at foes or manipulate and control the earth to do damage.  This power you can manipulate the majority of minerals found on the earth, including trees and plants. While wielding the hammer, you are immune to the effects of the earth element.
summary: The ability to wield a giant hammer/mallet that can manipulate the earth
strengths: Control and manipulate the earth (this incorporates the basic natural minerals too)
Can pound away at enemies, with your giant hammer/mallet
A giant hammer that you can wield with ease and minimal effort
weaknesses: Can only control the earth element when wielding the hammer/mallet
You are only immune to the effects of the earth element when wielding the hammer
Your elemental weakness is wind

name: Cryptic Helper
description: With this power, a mysterious, disturbing and shadowy human(? ) figure with glowing red eyes that only you can see appears occasionnally before you and then quickly disappears. It will give you a hint about your future by performing a relevant action that may or may not make sense at first by either gesturing, miming, pointing at something or presenting an object inside its hands. That figure tends to appear more often when you're in real need or in danger or when destiny needs your hand.
summary: The ability to receive hints about the future from a mysterious figure.
strengths: Although frightening, that figure will always try to help you out in its own way.
Be warned about impending danger on you or people around you.
Whether you turn good or bad, the figure will always follow your alignment.
weaknesses: You will most likely think you're crazy when you first experience this power.
So will people around you.
Passive power. You can't stop the mysterious figure from appearing.

name: Pb: Mind Excercised
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power Boost'. With this ability, all of your mental superpowers are doubled in effectiveness. (Includes powers, need concentration, etc. )
summary: The ability to have all of your mental superpowers doubled in effectiveness.
strengths: Doubles the effectiveness of your mind abilities.
If you have a lot of mind abilities.
weaknesses: If you don't have mind abilities.
Or any superpower whatsoever.

name: The Dealer
description: The cards are "stored" in the hero's mind. Hero wants to use this card upon the person, for example, he wants the person to be hungry, and he visualises the card in front of him, there's special decorations to each card, for example, "be hungry" would be a picture of a plate of food on the card, so he deals the card to the person, putting it on the palm of the person's hand, making sure it's parallel to the life line on the person's palm, and then, the person becomes hungry!
summary: The ability to make things happen based on the card dealt to the person.
strengths: Easy to control others
Can easily visualise any card you want
Works fast.
weaknesses: Must be very very specific.
Quite high chance that you might do someone harm instead of helping them.
Not easy to master.

name: 4 Kings
description: The Four Kings are the opposite of the Four Horsemen; you can summon them to bring light & hope all over the universe. For example: Blessing (Health) is the opposite of Pestilence: can cure anyone of diseases, Peace the opposite of War: become blessed & stop ongoing conflicts, Bounty is the opposite of Famine - can have the power to create crops & stop anyone from starving, and Life the opposite of Death: allows you become merciful and to bring back the innocent from the dead.
summary: The ability to bring about the bringers of absolute harmony.
strengths: Can bring about the goodness everywhere.
weaknesses: None actually.

name: Muscle Programming
description: Normally, we control our muscles using our subconscious mind. This ability forges a sort of connection between the conscious and subconscious mind. By using visualization, programmers can set a series of action for their muscles to do. After doing this, and then activating their ability, the user's body will go into a sort of auto-pilot,like trance. They will carry out whatever actions they programmed in before.
summary: The ability to program your muscle to perform certain actions.
strengths: During auto-pilot, you will move with more balance and agility than moving normaly.
You'd have more control over your body than others
weaknesses: At first, breaking out of your trance before it's finished will be nearly impossible.
But with practice, you will be able to do this easily.

name: Zero Tact
description: Remove all heat from anything with a touch. The side effect being you will also cause someone or something of equal size and weight to be consumed by flame. Shatter walls, people, buildings etc.
summary: The ability to reduce any object to absolute zero with a touch
strengths: You can activate this power at will
Irreversible. Works on any size, shape or person as long as you make skin contact
Side effect could eliminate two problems
weaknesses: No choice. Absolute zero, you get three seconds to break contact or you freeze too
Side effect is someone or something will be instantly be consumed by intense heat
Losing precious items while learning how to use your ability

name: Rock Cycle
description: With this power in one hand you have the power to control heat and in the other hand you have the power to control pressure. You can only control the heat and pressure on rocks and minerals though. Pressure can be used to compact or expand the minerals or be applied in a certain direction to levitate minerals. Heat can create magma or freeze the minerals so that they become harder. By using heat and pressure you can turn one type of rock into another metamorphic rock.
summary: The ability to use heat and pressure to change rocks and minerals.
strengths: Can heat up or cool down rocks and minerals by extreme temperatures.
Can apply pressure on rocks in a single direction to move the rocks.
If you understand Earth science you could change rocks into new rocks.
weaknesses: Only works on rocks and minerals.
Might be annoying for some for the power to be seperated into each hand.
If you have less than two hands then you lose parts of this power.

name: Acid Rays
description: With this power you can shoot a beam that can corrode anything from the palms of your hands. You can melt through skin, stone, metal, wood and other strong materials.
summary: The ability to shoot beams that corrode anything from your hands
strengths: You can shoot beams that can melt through anything from the palms of your hands
The beams can melt through even the toughest materials
You can shoot the beams out of both of your hands
weaknesses: You might melt your own skin

name: Soul Hacker
description:
You can bind another's soul to your own by a certain mean determined by yourself. Once they are bound to you, they cannot be unbound unless they die. 
You are also dead when you recieve this power and can do many supernatural things.
summary: The ability to bind another's soul to yours.
strengths: You cannot die if you have marked someone.
You can teleport and read minds.
You can easily escape in times of emergency.
weaknesses: If you haven't marked anyone, you are able to die for the second time. You will not come back.
You have yellow eyes which mark you as a soul hacker to the world.
You tend to be on everyone's hate list as you are considered an evil being.

name: Hgc Correlation
description: Imagine if you control and manipulate what's happening right now. You could control your friends and it would be like a some sort of video game (kind of like the movie Surf Ninjas). You might even look into the past, presant, and future on your Gameboy Advance.
summary: The ability to control events looking through your handheld game console.
strengths: It could even be like a real life Beat 'em up and Platform game.
weaknesses: You don't want to get caught.

name: Electrical Perception
description: With this power, you will know the exact location of any electrical current from up to 50 meters away. Power lines, cars, lightbulbs, etc, anything that has an active electrical current.
summary: The ability to perceive any electrical current from up to 50 meters away
strengths: You can know where people are since the brain runs on electricity as does the neural system.
Always know where your cellphone is or where a phone booth can be found.
weaknesses: Only helps if the electrical item is on otherwise there are no electrons moving and thus no current.

name: 1st Key Of Life
description: With this power the first key of life is yours to summon. Mankind has two kinds of Death resulting in two keys. This one is for the Underworld. By dropping/throwing this key on the ground, an earthquake occurs, and within the cracks, the people you wanted to release come up within the cracks, releasing them from the underworld.
summary: The ability to summon the first key of life.
strengths: Release loved ones from the Underworld.
weaknesses: You may have a loved one that went to Heaven.
If they ate down there, they can't come back.
It is a small key you may lose.

name: Myth Power: Asteria's Esteem
description: Asteria, in Greek myth, was the goddess of nighttime oracles (necromancy, astrology, prophetic dreams, etc) and falling stars. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically receive visions of past, present of future nights, at will (or induce them, by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes, at will. Furthermore, one can ask spirits of the dead anything, and they must answer. One can even gain physical power in the presence of his zodiac sign.
summary: The ability to channel Asteria's command over the essence of nighttime oracles and falling stars
strengths: Psychically receive, at will (or induce, by touch), visions of past, present or future nights
Perceive subjects' astrological signs and horoscopes; compel the dead to answer questions (at night)
Gain physical power in the presence of your astrological sign (on clothes, in the sky, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot Time Travel to past/future nights until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon falling stars to gain/grant wishes (stronger means more wishes), until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity to direct effects (NCN)

name: Eternal Existence
description: The concept of non-existence, as opposed to existence, is fully and utterly removed from you. This guarantees that the true 'you' can never be destroyed. Your consciousness or soul (whichever you prefer) will go on forever. As a side effect, you are also immune from unnatural permanent changes (such as mind control) to your mind/personality. The range for 'temporary' changes is infinite, though, as long as there is an eventual revert.
summary: The ability to be incapable of not existing
strengths: Guarantees that you have some sort of afterlife, rather than the whole nothingness after death.
It also forces mind controllers/personality changers to continuously use power to keep your mind.
While your memories are a bit more malleable, they're also difficult to alter.
weaknesses: This is not immortality- you can be killed all the same. It just guarantees there's something after.
You might go to hell, or die and be trapped as a intangible spirit for eternity.
You can go insane, or be trapped in any body that allows you to retain consciousness (maybe stone).

name: Defenders Call
description: Reinforcements appears as soon as you say: Calling all defenders, Cover me! A lightning bolt will crash from the skies and reveal a hero that is perfectly suited to take down whatever danger is about to harm you.  An evil scientist trying to kill you with a freeze ray? The reinforcements power will summon a fire manipulating hero.  A hero for every situation.
summary: The ability to summon a random being that will defend you.
strengths: Nothing will ever get close enough to kill you if you summon a defender.
You are prepared for every situation.
You get to order beings around that are possibly more powerful then you.
weaknesses: Each defender can only be summoned once, someone else that could save you is summoned instead.
This power only works if you get attacked, NOT if you attack.
Power not available on a holiday, everyone deserves to be with their family on a holiday.

name: Samson's Strength
description: Samson was a sort of biblical superhero who could basically call down the powers of the Lord to turn himself into a hurricane of ass kicking. At one time, he used the jawbone of an ass to kill 1,000 Philistines who had been sent to capture him. The weakness of his ability, however, was that it came from his hair. The longer it was, the more strength he gained. Samson was eventually betrayed and made powerless when his hair was cut off in his sleep.
summary: The ability to draw incredible strength and power from your hair.
strengths: Gain awesome strength
Become nigh-invincible in combat
weaknesses: You have a prominent weakness

name: Crystal Brain
description: The crystal brain is a gem containing massive intellectual power. Anyone in possession of the crystal brain can put it inside a golem, a robot, or any inorganic person to make it smart. It can also turn a dumb person intelligent by simply letting them hold it.
summary: The ability to place an intelligent crystal into a golem or suit of armor in order to animate it
strengths: It can erase a person's dumbness
Can put it inside a Golem's head to turn it intelligent.
weaknesses: It might be smarter than you

name: Induced Agony
description: This ability works by stimulating the pain receptors in the body. It affects everything within a 12-foot radius. This power can be turned on and off. With great concentration, focus and mastery over this ability, the user will be able to induce agony in a target over great distances.If used too much the ability will backfire and cause you pain or turn on and off without control.
summary: The ability to cause those around you to feel extreme pain.
strengths: Opponents won't know what hit them.
Good for close combat and crowd control.
Cause pain over distances.
weaknesses: The ability backfiring on you.
The power turning on in non-combative situations

name: Lycanokinesis
description:
Lycanothropy Lycanthropic Psychokinesis. "Shift" the characteristic of transformation into a different animal. Accelerate to start (ex. Werewolf before a full moon) or speed up a shift. Cancel cancel or stop a shift. Reversal reverse or temporarily undo a shift
Transfer steal a shift from one person and give it to someone else including yourself; you can only hold one shift at a time (no werecat ear with werewolf nose)and must transfer back 100% or else you get perma-shifted (non-manipulatabe
summary: The ability to manipulate "shifts" (lycanthropy) by acceleration, canceling, reversal, or even transferring
strengths: You can shapeshift or cause others to shapeshift
You can transfer entire shifts or just parts like eyes or claws of the shift
Keep a werewolf from transforming at full moon or accelerate it so they transform earlier
weaknesses: You need someone that can change into something else to manipulate a shift
You can only hold onto one shift transformation if you transfer one to yourself
If transfering a shift from yourself back to the source you need to make sure to transfer it 100% ,q

name: Cellphone Creatures
description: You will start off with one mystic symbol on your cellphone that you can use to summon one specific species of normal animal on Earth. As you develop this power you will gain more images with which to summon creatures. The creatures that can be summoned range from lice and mice to chimera and dragons. Each image can only summon one creature at a time and you cannot summon more than 5 creatures at a time. Summon by pressing "call" while looking at the image, "end call" to unsummon.
summary: The ability to summon creatures using images on one's cellphone then control the creatures
strengths: All summoned creatures are under your command.
After developing the power you can have extremely powerful creatures.
Noone else can use your summons.
weaknesses: You need a cellphone that can process images. One cellphone can be used at a time for this power.
Summonable creatures unlock in order from weakest to strongest. Lost cellphone means a restart.
The number of images you can have is limited by your cellphone's memory.

name: Synchronous Event Inducement
description: The user will have the ability to make anything happen at the same time and location. An example would be if the user saw one man about to fall and saw crate of poisonous scorpions about to be opened in a different location. The user can make it that both these events happen all together in the same spot in a perfect, synchronized fashion. Now the man falls in an opened crate of scorpions. A cruel scenario, but an example none the less.
summary: The ability to cause two or more things to happen at the same place and time.
strengths: Create instant chaos
Make things happen faster
With training, bring events from different realities and timelines to one place.
weaknesses: Events that are brought from different realities and timeline will disappear.

name: Ghostly Haunting
description: Ghostly Haunting is the ability to enter someone else's mind and change what they see into their worst fears. An example is projecting visions of spiders everywhere for a person who is scared of spiders.
summary: The ability to haunt a person with their worst fear.
strengths: You can easily distract someone.
People may be crippled by the fear.
weaknesses: People probably won't like you.

name: Undead Shapeshifting
description: One with this ability has much potential to discover. They can assume the form of a zombie (with powers like a life sense and anatomical automatism), or a mummy (with powers like sand control, prehensile bandages), a vampire (with enhanced strength, speed, etc. And thirst for blood), a lich (with the power to summon other undead) or even a ghost (with the powers included in imperceptibility, as well as the ability to levitate, possess foes and manifest your presence in spooky ways).
summary: The ability to assume the form and abilities of any type of undead at all
strengths: All undead have reduced needs (no need to eat, sleep or breathe, except zombies and vampires)
Immunity to psionics, radiation, poison, disease, sonic attacks and sleep inducing
Shapeshift into the zombie version of various animals as well
weaknesses: Necromantic effects
Holy symbols, garlic and holy water when in vampire form (and vulnerability to sunlight until fed)
Tends to scare folks (think torches and pitchforks)

name: Siren Song
description: When you make a sound, e. g. Yell or scream, you will be able to turn it into a destructive blast of energy which would render people unconscious from it. You also can play any instrument to channel this power.
summary: The ability to turn sound into destructive energy
strengths: Able to make a destuctive blast of energy from a small sound
You will be able to play any instrument
weaknesses: You need to make your own sound

name: Sharpener
description: A person with this power can make anything as sharp as a blade and have extremely sharp edges. When used on a plastic knife, it becomes sharp enough to count as a real knife, and sharpening your own body lets you defend against steel weapons. You can even sharpen objects not on your body through concentration. You can sharpen the handles of a person's gun or sword to make them drop their weapon, or, if desired, sharpen their clothes to create lacerations.
summary: The ability to make anything have edges as sharp as a blade until deactivated
strengths: Make people drop weapons
Strengthen bladed weapons easy
No need to buy scissors or knives when your body is sharp enough
weaknesses: When people touch you when you are sharp-when they are not your enemies
Accidentally cutting yourself

name: Soul Survivor
