description: If you die, your soul will travel to the closest living person of appropriate gender & age. The soul whose body you inhabit will enter your dead body & die with it. You will see yourself, but everyone else sees the body you possess. At least you'll have near immortality.
summary: The ability to switch bodies with a living person upon death
strengths: Near immortality
A new body
New identity
weaknesses: Have to die in order for the power to work
Someone else will also have to die
N one will recognize the real you

name: Unsee
description: With this handy psychic ability, the user can concentrate for a moment and neatly delete a single unwanted image from his or her mind. With slightly more effort, he or she can remove an unwanted image from the consciousness of another person. Unfortunately, the target of the ability must describe the unwanted image as completely as possible to the user of the power in order for him or her to focus upon it. Therefore, the unwanted image ends up in the consciousness of the user of the power. Yuck!
summary: The ability to erase unwanted mental images from your mind or somebody else's.
strengths: Completely undoes the adage, "What has been seen cannot be unseen. "
Removes images you have actually seen and ones that you have inadvertently imagined.
Great for healing sanity losses from encountering Great Old Ones and other sanity-blasting sights.
weaknesses: Only effects unwanted mental images. You can't erase things you wish your friends can't see mentally
It does not erase the memory that you once had the mental image, so you may imagine it again.
It does not erase any other memories, so it won't save all of one's sanity from such encounters.

name: Speed Drawing
description: You might need several sheets of paper, because if you draw too fast you'll cause the paper to spontaneously combust from friction burn.
summary: The ability to draw anything you want at the speed of light.
strengths: Draw anything fast
Easy way to make a quick buck as an artist.
weaknesses: Only works with drawing, not writing nor reading.

name: Induced Mutation
description: Evolution's march would grind to a screeching halt if not for mutations--but most are harmful. A person with Induced Mutation can create mutations in people that they can see: blindness, skin disease, mental damage, or even cancer. However, it could equally be stuff like better blood pressure, increased endurance, extra muscles, or even (1 in a million) the activation of abilities. The user can usually discriminate between good and bad mutations--sometimes. They have to see the person to Induce.
summary: The ability to induce mutations, good or bad, in others
strengths: Can induce any negative mutation
Can induce any positive mutation
Can affect anyone you can see
weaknesses: Sometimes cannot single out good or bad mutations
Cannot make a specific mutation
Must see the person first

name: Face Carver
description: By carving eyes on an object, you can give that object the gift of sight. By carving a nose or nostrils on an object, you can give that object the gift of smell. By carving a mouth on an object, you can give that object the gift of speech. By carving ears on an object, you can give that object the gift of hearing. It only works on objects, not on plants, animals or human beings, dead or alive, unless they are processed into objects.
summary: The ability to make objects see, hear, smell or talk by carving eyes, ears, a nose or a mouth, respectively.
strengths: You can create sentient pumpkins.
You can discuss with everyday objects.
You can make objects spy on people undetected.
weaknesses: It's not a guarantee that objects will be loyal to you.
Despite having a mouth, they can't eat, because they don't have a butthole to defecate.
You can only carve the main organs present on a human face.
tags: was edited as it was just a unimaginative combination of two unrelated powers

name: Hemokinesis
description: The user can detect and manipulate anything in his/her circulatory system. One also have a very active bloodstream that destroys any blood-travelling pathogen, cardiotoxin or blood-attacking nanites entering its area. It's also possible to alter/stop the flow of blood, clotting, heartbeat, and white count; both their own blood as well as other people's. Blood manipulators can also use theirs and others' blood to form weapons, such as whips, needles, blades and the like.
summary: The ability to control blood and have an active bloodstream
strengths: Bleeding is not a problem
Can create clots to cripple or kill with a touch
Blood weapons.
weaknesses: Difficult to master

name: Even The Odds
description: With this power, you can even the odds in any unmatched fight, through disadvantages to the stronger side and/or advantages to the weaker side. Maybe a freak accident will injure your opponent, or maybe you'll find yourself with new powers. The possibilities are endless, but it's impossible to control which will happen. And if you start to lose you can't even the odds again, so don't get overconfident. An evenly matched fight can still be rough, but it's better than a hopeless one.
summary: The ability to make a fight evenly matched
strengths: You'll never be outmatched
If someone/something comes to help your opponent, you'll get extra help too
No one will know what to expect when they fight you
weaknesses: Doesn't put the odds in your favor, it just evens them
Can't even the odds again if you start to lose
Might accidentally even a fight that's in your favor

name: Evil Detector
description: With this power you can detect if somebody is evil just by looking at them. If you detect that the person is evil, you can confront him and possibly send him to jail or if you're a villain try to forge an alliance with him.
summary: The ability to detect if somebody is evil
strengths: You can tell if somebody's evil
weaknesses: If you don't have any actual evidence that the person is evil you cannot have him sent to jail
If you are blind this power does not work

name: Ability Skill: Limit Pass
description: This ability skill will break your limits to the full extent. This ability can be used once a day for an hour.
summary: The ability to use the full force of one's powers for 1 hr if they have a limit or are at a low level.
strengths: No limits on your powers.
weaknesses: Lasts for an hour, once a day.

name: Soulless Immortality
description: If you have this power you are immortal but you somehow lost your soul and are still alive. One side effect is that you are unaffected by soul-based powers but you can't use soul-based powers either.
summary: The ability to be immortal but at the cost of one's soul
strengths: Any power that affects souls no longer has any effect on you.
You can't die.
weaknesses: You lost your soul.
You can't use soul-based powers.

name: Energy Blend: Shockwave
description: When you activate this power, pointing at any target releases a blue beam of electro-sonic energy from your finger. Electro-sonic energy is a mix of electricity and sound, so it negatively charges the target. The beam doesn't directly hurt the target, but anything the target touches will discharge the energy into the ground. The target will not only be charged with electrons, but their molecules will vibrate even faster than usual. Producing sound fuels the target's energy field. It's temporary.
summary: The ability to produce a beam of electro-sonic energy.
strengths: Make a beam out of your finger that turns the target into a capacitor.
The electronic field is increased when the target produces noise.
The effects are only temporary.
weaknesses: Will not hurt them directly, but they will shock everything that they touch.
Unless you have advanced control over the power, you will regret pointing at anything.
The effects are only temporary.

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message9
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Urania (Ourania- Astronomy) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all astronomical works, at will. In addition, one can psychically project one's vision to telescopic distances, at will. One can also fly, as well as psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically mimic alien species, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of astronomical works, at will
Psychically project one's sight to telescopic distance, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions; mimic alien species (language, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Flying Carpet Companion
description: With this power, all you need do is call your carpet, and wherever you are, your Carpet Companion will fly to you within seconds. Your Carpet Companion is completely indestructible, and will respond to your verbal commands. Top speed of the carpet is Mach 2, but you may have trouble traveling at such speed while clinging to a carpet. You must be specific with your commands, otherwise your Carpet Companion (which is rather stupid) may misunderstand you and do something you may not like.
summary: The ability to summon a magical flying carpet.
strengths: You have a magical Carpet Companion that can fly
Your Carpet Companion can be used as a shield, as it is indestructible
Anytime you need it, it will be there for you
weaknesses: It has no seats or handles, only tassles on two ends
If you cannot speak, your Carpet Companion won't do anything at all
Your Carpet Companion is rather stupid, as it is a carpet

name: Disaster
description: Natural disasters have always played a major role in the world's history. A person with Disaster can bring forth various natural disasters: floods, fires, hail, tornadoes, earthquakes, meteor showers, etc. However, the ability is extremely volatile: strong negative emotion usually makes it very uncontrollable. The user has little directive control over the disaster. With training, though, they can send disasters 6 miles away and create very minor disasters.
summary: The ability to summon various natural disasters
strengths: Great destructive power
Very versatile: tornadoes, earthquakes, meteor showers
Becomes very powerful with training
weaknesses: Very volatile w/ emotion
Have very little directive control over the disaster
Only natural, not smog or acid rain

name: Zodiac: Sagittarius
description: You can call upon the power of Sagittarius by drawing his symbol in the air. This allows you to fire off psionic projectiles at a rate of 100 per second for two seconds before you have to draw the symbol again. The projectiles can be fire, water, earth, sand, mud, wood, etc.
summary: The ability to call upon the power of Sagittarius the Archer
strengths: Can fire projectiles rapidly.
Projectiles can be made from virtually anything.
Projectiles are tough to destroy.
weaknesses: Can only fire for 2 sec before drawing symbol again.
Have to draw symbol to use.

name: Razorphoon
description: With this ability, you can create a giant whirlpool in mid air filled with razor blades, swords, knives, mirror shards, glass shards, and much more. You can use it to douse fire enemies and slice your foes deep at the same time. If you are electrocuted while using the power, an army of razor blades made of water will fly out of the whirlpool and attack the enemy.
summary: The ability to create a whirlpool in the air filled with sharp objects.
strengths: Puts out fire enemies
Cuts your enemies, so they lose large amounts of blood
Send an army of razor blades to do your bidding
weaknesses: Betray the razor blades, and they will destroy you

name: Vocal Mimicry
description: Sound effects men have nothing on a Vocal Mimic. Using their voice, they can reproduce sounds with eerie accuracy, from a gunshot to another person's voice to a flock of birds taking off. The user must have at least heard the sound once, and their vocal cords have the same limits as anyone else's.
summary: The ability to mimic sounds with extreme mimicry
strengths: Can mimic voices
Anything from a gunshot to flock of birds taking off
Mimicking public officals on the phone
weaknesses: Must have heard it at least once
Accuracy depends on how well you remember it
Vocal cords have same physical limits

name: Coincidence
description: With this ability, you receive natural, coincidence-like signs of the right decisions to make. With this power you could play the stock market and know 95% what is the best one and make millions. You could figure out the best ways to pick up a hottie.
summary: The ability to cause and interpret natural signs of what decions to make
strengths: Could become very powerful
weaknesses: You could interpret the sign wrong
You have to catch it when it happens

name: Communication Intrusion Sensor
description: Whenever you're having an exchange of information through any form and method (speech, written paper, thought transfer, sign language, braille,... ), you can sense when an unwanted party is trying to intercept or understand it. It works whether you're the sender of a message or a receiver. However, as a receiver, you can only detect intrusions if a communication with you is already taking place and if you are aware of it, but you won't sense it if the message is blocked before arriving to you.
summary: The ability to detect when a third-party is listening in on your communication.
strengths: It's a good way to know if someone is can listen in on your conversation.
You can detect intruders regardless of the methods thay are using to intrude.
It even works with delayed means of communication, like leaving a note intended for someone.
weaknesses: You will even detect people who are intruding unintentionally or without ill intentions.
Someone can still get the message before you have the idea to stop the communication.
You can't detect it when someone intends to communicate with you or if a message has been received.

name: Lightning Blood
description: This power only works when the blood is outside of your body and is at the user's will. The blood will electrocute what it touches with around 5000 volts of electricity. You are immune to the electrical power created with this power.
summary: The ability to have what one's blood touches be electrocuted
strengths: If you're bleeding it is bad for your enemies.
weaknesses: You need to lose blood to use this power.

name: Powers Of The Hydroquan Hero
description: You will be able to control liquid, but you cannot control frozen liquid. You can also turn into water and become very flexible. But beware! You may be frozen by your enemy when you are in liquid-form!
summary: The ability to control liquids and liquefied substances, and turn into liquid.
strengths: Aqualad
Aquaman
Hydrolad
weaknesses: H2Ogla
Bin Fei
Mercurus

name: Cosmic Dice
description: A few rules. No repeated results on the list. Any sized die works. The written list doesn't matter once you empower a die. One result on the list must be 'nothing happens'. The dice you make can be destroyed or stolen but are immune to probability powers. You can affect a force of the universe or a single person. Your dice only work for you. The effect of a dice roll is undone when that die is rerolled.
summary: The ability to write a result list for a die that really happens when you roll that die.
strengths: There's a die with 120 sides if you have the creativity.
Lack creativity; the 2 sided die
Will only work for you and you are unaffected by probability powers.
weaknesses: Dice can be destroyed and stolen.
Accidental die rolls that affect the forces of the universe.
A die roll that backfires against you.

name: Forced Shared Healing
description: Whenever a living being is healing from an injury or an illness, you can steal a portion of their regeneration capacity to heal yourself. You are not copying their healing mechanism; you are just taking some of the energy involved. In essence, you are slowing down their progress in repairing a wound or curing an illness. It works whether the healing process is natural or supernatural. It also works if the targeted organism is fighting against an illness but isn't getting better anyway.
summary: The ability to heal by channeling a portion of someone else's healing process.
strengths: You can heal extremely fast if you use this on someone with a regeneration or a resurrection power.
You can delay instantaneous healing abilities or cause them to only heal gradually.
With experience, you can channel as much as 78% of someone's healing capacity.
weaknesses: Doesn't work on invulnerable beings since they can't be injured and, therefore, don't need to heal.
It works in cases of immunity to a disease, but you won't heal much as they aren't really ill.
It doesn't work on a healthy and sane person, nor on someone who can't fight against their disease.

name: Mini Capsule Grenade
description: The person with this power is able to summon mini capsule grenades for him or her to use. The grenades range from smoke grenades, electrical grenades, a normal sized grenade that is used to capture a person or even a freeze grenade.
summary: The ability to summon mini capsule grenade, each with its own use and specialty
strengths: Never run out of grenades
Different grenades have different uses
No cooldown time between summons
weaknesses: Only can summon one type of grenade at a time
Maximum of five mini capsules per summon of one type

name: Dark Angel Summon
description: With this power you can summon an angel of darkness. The angel is not under your control and is completely evil. It will probably try to take over your mind and use you for its own agenda so you should probably get some kind of anti mind control powers before using this. The angel is extremely powerful with flight, super strength, immense knowledge of black magic and shapeshifting abilities. You can unsummon it later.
summary: The ability to summon an angel of darkness
strengths: You can summon an extremely powerful dark angel
It can be mind controlled
You can send it back whenever you want
weaknesses: It might try to mind control you or kill you

name: Cone Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. It gives you a better perception of movements. It also allows you to convert darkness into electricity. The darker it is, the more voltage you produce, but you can still shoot a fair amount of electricity in dim light. Alternatively, you can convert darkness into signals. By sending them to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you'll make them see what you see. When this power is activated, you will only see in one of three colors: red, blue or green.
summary: The ability to better see movements, convert darkness into electricity and allow people to see what you see.
strengths: You can perceive movements better than a normal human being.
You can electrocute someone if the light is dim enough.
By touching the back of the head of a human person, you can show them what you see.
weaknesses: You will only see in one color, and that color remains the same and can't be changed.
To see in all three colors while using this power, you need to acquire it multiple times.
You can't shoot electricity at all in very bright light.

name: Identity Assumption
description: By touching a person or a recently deceased corpse, you assume their appearance, knowledge, and identity. In this state, your mind operates on two levels: one duplicates the thoughts and mannerisms of the person whose identity you have assumed, the other is your rational mind which retains ultimate control. You can cancel this power at any time, however you cannot assume that identity again without again having physical contact with the person. Any powers that read minds only see the first mind.
summary: The ability to copy the appearance and memories of a person
strengths: Perfect for disguise and infiltration
Knowledge gained remains permanently
Can duplicate minor power
weaknesses: Unless the subject is dead or restrained, there will be trouble
Cannot duplicate major supernatural abilities

name: Action Inalterable
description: Every action you complete can only be undone by you or someone else with this power. In other words, if you break something, only you can fix it. If you make something, no damage can be done to it other than damage inflicted by you. In addition, this ability also allows you to reverse your actions and re do them up to thirty seconds after said action. Time for reversal doubles itself after each use.
summary: The ability to insure anything you do remains done.
strengths: No one can break anything that you make.
No one can duplicate an object you've broken within a certain limit.
Nothing you break can ever be fixed by anyone else.
weaknesses: If you accidentally break something, without realizing it.
If you destroy something needed to society.
Cons cannot be negated.

name: Tactic Swap
description: This is the brother of my previous ability, Mode Swap, but this is a different version. Instead of switching any ability from physical to mental, it switches something different. A good example is if an army were to attack you; just switch them into a defensive phase and escape. Another good one: if you have the ability to release an energy blast, you can switch it into an energy barrier.
summary: The ability to switch any ability or personality from offensive to defensive or the other way.
strengths: Changes your or your opponent's abilities from offensive to defensive or the other way.
If you have a lot of abilities, you'll be able to open a whole new world of abilities.
weaknesses: You'll never know what will come out when switch the nature of your abilites.

name: King (Or Queen) Of Balance
description: Ever had the feeling where you lose your balance for no reason? Well, this power allows you to cause that exact feeling on others. With a flick of your hand, enemies will topple like dominoes and have no clue why they suddenly lost their balance. At the beginning, it is difficult to control.
summary: The ability to alter people's sense of balance
strengths: If an enemy has a gun or something else, they need to concentrate to use. You can cause them to miss
It's good fun to use on friends
weaknesses: You are still human and can still get hurt if things don't work out.
It is difficult to control to begin with and you may find it happens more to you than others

name: Swiss Army Gun
description: The Swiss Army Gun is a multi-function pocket Gun-handle; it has an amount of various projectile weapons such as a pistle, normal/ sniper rifle,grenade/missile launcher, water/ray gun, and Gatling gun. Each weapon comes with a full clip of ammo when it is summoned but you must switch weapons when it runs out of ammo to get ammo back. Based on Amalgamer's Swiss Army Saber.
summary: The ability to use it to switch to different guns within it.
strengths: Can switch between weapons instantly and store as just the handle when not in use.
Has large variety of projectile weapons including fictional ones.
Useful for changing strategies and confusing opponents.
weaknesses: Has limited ammo but ammo can be reloaded when weapon is switched.
Need good aim and practice with each weapon.
Projectile weapons for this power does not include things such as bow and arrows.

name: Queen Of Hearts Impossibilty
description: The Queen of Hearts told Alice that she believed "as many as six impossible things before breakfast. " This power allows you to to turn belief into power! Starting at 6am in whatever time zone you are in at that time, you can alter up to six laws of physics and/or logic for up to three hours. You can determine upside-down gravity, 2 and 2 are 5, on and on. Power can only be used whilst on Earth. Laws return to normal at 9am. You cannot alter the speed or flow of time of that three-hour interval.
summary: The ability to alter up to six laws of physics and logic between 6am and 9am
strengths: You can fulfill your wildest fantasies once a day, every day
You can continually experiment with the universe
You can make things so you don't have to go to work/school before 9am
weaknesses: You have to be awake during those three hours
No matter how you alter reality, it will return to normal, and quickly
You can develop a God complex

name: Vorpal Strike
description: With this power, you are able to cleanly decapitate someone with one blow from your hand. The would resembles a cut from a blade. While a basic punch to the head or face would work, a karate-like chop to the neck is the most efficient means of using this ability. The power is activated by focusing your chi, or life energy, into your hand, creating a cutting field around it. Advanced practitioners of this technique are able to perform this feat with thier feet or even other parts of their body.
summary: The ability to take a person's head clean off with one blow
strengths: You knocked his block off
Devastating attack
weaknesses: You are required to concentrate and keep focus to use this ability.
Distractions disrupt power

name: Third Eye: Truth Seeing
description: This power is gained by never using the Third Eye powers, but having the third eye open. The Third Eye power slowly turns into this power. The third eye can see through illusions, the true form of a shapeshifter, the general truth, and what happened in the past. The eye can still be decieved with past events. The further back in time the harder it is to see what happened.
summary: The ability to see the truth and past with your third eye
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can see the the truth and past.
Can still use Third Eye powers.
weaknesses: Must have Third Eye power and never use it but have the third eye open.
Only the third eye can see anything and it is still decievable.
Cannot get other formerly possible Third Eye evolutions.

name: 100x Big Bang Kamehameha!
description: Literally meaning "Hundredfold Big Bang Turtle Destructive Wave;" it is an energy wave technique used by Super Saiyan 4 Gogeta against Omega Shenron. It is a fully-powered, synchronized combination of two ultimate attacks simultaneously harnessed by a separated Goku and Vegeta. The user does not genuinely provide the attack with their own energy, in fact, they gather it from their environment - broadening its force to any extent. Hence, nothing can survive it.
summary: The ability to expel the most powerful attack in the Dragonball Franchise.
strengths: Destroy anyone and anything.
weaknesses: None known.

name: Egyptian Shazam
description: The person with this power has been chosen by the Egyptian Gods Shu, Heru, Amon, Zehuti, Aton and Mehen. Different Gods give their champion different powers Shu (super endurance) , Heru ( superhuman speed and flight), Amon ( super strength) , Zehuti ( superhuman knowledge), Aton ( Magic ) , Mehen ( invulnerability ). When the person shouts SHAZAM!!! They will gain the powers of all the Egyptian Gods and become their champion.
summary: The ability to blessed by the Egyptian Gods, thus becoming their champion.
strengths: Can take down power houses
Can combat crime no matter how big or small
Magic has little or no effect to the person in champion form
weaknesses: Cannot remain in champion form forever,or risk accelerated aging when you tuen back to human form
Some powerhouses can take you down

name: Chameleon Mimicry
description: This includes (a more gecko-like trait) climbing up walls or sticking to ceilings, having eyes that rotate independently of one another, being able to alter your skin tone so that you blend in with your natural surroundings, (frog-like) natural hopping ability, and having a sticky, prehensile, extensible tongue used for snatching objects from across the room.
summary: The ability to take on the traits of a chameleon.
strengths: Climb up walls and stick to ceilings.
Automatic camouflage; partial invisibility.
Sticky snatching tongue.
weaknesses: You're born with a greenish skin tone, but you may be able to alter it using your powers.
Your tongue is sorta gross.

name: Central Air Conditioning/Heat
description: With this power you will always be cool or warm; you will never become too hot or too cold, but you'll always be somewhere in the middle. If it is very cold in your location you automatically become warm, if it is very hot in your location you will automatically become cool. This power basically makes you comfortable, temperature-wise. It is automatic and it cannot be turned off.
summary: The ability to be constantly cool/warm
strengths: You will never be too hot or too cold
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
It cannot be turned off

name: Missile Launcher Arms
description: With this power you can turn both of your arms into small missile launchers. You can launch an unlimited amount of missiles from both of your arms.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into small missile launchers
strengths: You can turn your arms into missile launchers
You have an unlimited amount of missiles
weaknesses: Any damage sustained in missile launcher mode is transferred over to arm mode

name: Golden Apples
description: In Norse mythology, Idun was the goddess who safeguarded the Golden Apples.  One bite from this fruit and the gods would maintain their immortality and power.  If a mere mortal ate this, they would become a god.  The trade-off is that it must be eaten once a year, otherwise you will grow old and die!
summary: The ability to generate the enchanted food of the Norse Gods.
strengths: Generate the ultimate elixir
Become superstrong, invulnerable, and eternally young!
Can give this power to others
weaknesses: Must eat once a year
The wrong person may eat the apple
Can start Armageddon or make people fear you (or both)

name: Power Uneffectiveness
description: The ability to take away others' superpowers with your mind.
summary: The ability to take away others' powers
strengths: No Superpowers can hurt you.
You can decide which power to take away
You can kill someone by taking away his/her power (sometimes)
weaknesses: You're actually not that powerful
You can take away your own power if you're not carefull!
You need to have a weapon with you to hurt someone

name: Vitrification
description: Similar to the superhuman power Glaciation, this is the power to psychically transmute matter into glass. One with this ability may do it by touch, look or just mental power (depending on the user's genetics). It affects the subject in the same way one is affected by the power Petrifaction, but, instead of stone, the subject turns into glass. In addition, if a subject is turned into glass, they can *sometimes* be returned to normal at will, as long as the glass isn't shattered.
summary: The ability to turn matter into glass
strengths: Glass is very fragile
May be accompanied by the ability to assume a form composed of glass (or to control glass)
User is often able to affect living and inanimate matter
weaknesses: You can't return a person to normal if they get shattered
Sometimes only affects living matter (or only non-living matter)
It can also be triggered subconsciously (accidental vitrification)

name: Pacifism
description: This ability acts as a "physical" force that prevents any violence between any two parties. This ability cannot change a person or party's beliefs however.
summary: The ability to stop violence anywhere, anytime
strengths: World peace
Galactic peace
Universal peace
weaknesses: Peace dependent on you
Once you're gone, all hell will probably be let loose
People may want to kill you

name: Ultimate Pwn!!!!!!!
description: With this power you can completly destroy your enemy with one punch.
summary: The ability to destroy any opponent with one punch
strengths: Awesomeness
Auto victory
Coolness
weaknesses: Nothing bad about this power

name: Creator Of Worlds
description: This power allows you to create planets. Of course they are not created from scratch, but using the cosmic material already present in sorrounding space. The person who creates the planet can give it any desired characteristic (making it habitable, giving it a breathable atmosphere, etc. ), "hearing" at a distance every change he affixes.
summary: The ability to create planets.
strengths: The planet is perfectly autonomous (if you want so);
You can "feel" anything is going on your planet in a detailed way.
weaknesses: It could be affected cosmic balance;
You have no way to go to your creation, if not in classical ways (space travelling).
You only can create good life conditions, NOT life itself.

name: Broken Explosion
description: With this power you can cause things to explode as long as you're holding a piece of it in your hand. The explosion can hurt you so be careful not to stand too close to the object you are blowing up. You can steal a tire of an enemy's car then cause it to explode sometime later or cut of somebody's hair and then cause them to explode once you get far enough away from them.
summary: The ability to cause things to explode if you're holding a piece of it in your hand
strengths: You can cause things to explode as long as you are holding a piece of it in your hand
You can do it as many times as you want
weaknesses: The explosions can hurt you
You have to be holding something for this power to work

name: Moisture To Ice
description: The user of this power is able to turn the moisture in the air into ice. The ability to turn the moisture in the air into ice, is dependent on how humid the air is. If the air has a high humidity then this power is very effective, in a low humidity environment, this power is almost useless
summary: The ability to turn the moisture in the air into ice
strengths: Air is pretty much humid in most parts of the world
Good at stopping bad guys
weaknesses: Low humidity or no humid air will render this power useless

name: Fireflies
description: With this power you can summon up to ten million fireflies and have them under your complete control. You use a bunch of them to lift you up and fly you around, or have a giant flashlight that follows you around, or you can make them attack your enemies. You can unsummon them whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon ten million fireflies and have them under your complete control
strengths: You can have up to ten million fireflies
Never need a flashlight again
They can fly you around
weaknesses: They're not very strong so making them fight off bad guys might not be so effective

name: Green Arrow's Quiver
description: With this power you can summon Green Arrow's quiver. You have every trick arrow he's ever used and once you fire them they automatically teleport back into the quiver after an hour. You're also an expert archer but only when you're using Green Arrow's quiver.
summary: The ability to have Green Arrow's quiver
strengths: You have all of Green Arrow's trick arrows
The arrows automatically teleport back to you after an hour
weaknesses: You're only an expert archer when you have the quiver
If you use all of your arrows in under an hour you're screwed for a bit

name: Delete This Bone Clawduplicate
description: With this power you can have retractible claws in your knuckles. Your claws come out without hurting yourself. Is the same as Bone Claws, which is older.
summary: The ability to make claws retract out of your knuckles
strengths: It doesn't hurt
More stronger than a punch
weaknesses: May ruin your gloves

name: Gold Manipulation
description: Gold is one of the most valuable substances in the world. This ability allows you to manipulate it in quite a few ways. You can move it, of course, but its more than that. You can reshape it on the molecular level. Also, with practice, you would be able to convert matter into gold. This ability also grants a "gold sense". Whenever gold is near you, you will know its location, amount, and density.
summary: The ability to manipulate gold
strengths: Manipulating gold
Gold is very valuable
Having a gold sense
weaknesses: Too much gold will decrease it's value.
Gold is also a very soft material

name: Cutting Remarks
description: With this power as long as you can speak and your foe can hear and understand you any insults you give him will affect him as if you had cut him with a sword. If you have telepathy you can affect a deaf foe or one who couldn't fully understand your spoken language. This damage is neither invisible matter or a form of energy,unless you have telepathy then it is psionic damage. Invulnerabilities and damage resistance are no protection against verbal insults. Insults can't be repeated.
summary: The ability to insult to opponents and affect them as if you had cut them open.
strengths: Ignore invulnerability or damage resistance of any foe.
This power+Invisibility+Telepathy
Every foe doesn't have resistance to psionic damage.
weaknesses: You need new insults for every fight.
A deaf foe with psionic resistance.
Losing your voice.

name: Bone Launcher
description: Bone fragments from the skeleton are launched at high speed through fingers or any other part of the body, the bone tissue lost needs to be regrown to launch more. The bone can not go through materials that a regular bullet from a gun can go through. This is the perfect gun, because no one would no when you shoot.
summary: The ability to fire bullet-like bones shards from the body
strengths: Never need to buy a gun
Easier to go through metal detector at airport with weapon
Makes almost no sound
weaknesses: Would need to have accelerated healing for better use
Loss of bone the more you use it, unless you can regenerate
Could misfire anytime if you don't have control over it

name: Injury Illusion
description: This power allows you to fake or create a fake scenario of you, someone else or something else getting injured in anyway. When you perform this power on yourself, you'll never feel the actual pain of the injury but it'll look 100% real. When using this on others you can choose to make them feel the actual pain or not. Say your driving, you can simulate a random car crash or explosion and it'll be a hologram illusion to everyone. Touch it & it becomes real (it has life-like properties)
summary: The ability to fake any type of injury or accident to yourself, someone, or something else
strengths: You're immune to your own simulation, though you can choose to feel a bit of pain for realism.
You can get out of an situation you want by faking the right injury, and you always come out alive.
You can guilt people into feeling sorry for you and doing whatever you want
weaknesses: People will hate you for making sick jokes
You can't really kill anybody or yourself
Can't protect yourself while your asleep

name: Dense Air
description: This power allows you to make air thinner or denser. You can make it so thin that people find it freakishly hard to breathe, or so dense and heavy that people can barely walk through it.
summary: The ability to mess with air molecule concentration in an area
strengths: Lower your enemies' oxygen supply, thus reducing their brains' capabilities.
You are immune to the effects, so you'll be running around while others are gasping for air.
weaknesses: I'm pretty sure there is none. I could be wrong, but I don't think so.

name: Spirit Mastery
description: The ability to call upon spirits through the use of summoning them. They are bound to their summoner and will do their bidding . They can be used as both an offensive and defensive power.
summary: The ability to call upon spirits and control them
strengths: Awesome defensive powers since they cannot be dispelled
Their loyalty to the summoner is unwavering
They can be summoned from anywhere
weaknesses: It takes great concentration to summon them
If concentration is broken during summoning, they disappear
They are not as strong in daylight.

name: Spider Silk Skin
description: With this ability, you can have smooth skin that's stronger than nylon. The skin is harder to break apart or get injured. The smoothness of the skin helps you give the perfect massage.
summary: The ability to have soft, flexible skin that's stronger than nylon
strengths: Have skin that's stronger than nylon.
Bruise less easily.
The skin is soft, so you can give the perfect massage.
weaknesses: Flesh and internal organs can still be damaged.
Might not know how to give a massage.
You are seemingly normal.

name: Godly Hand
description: To acquire this hand you must have lost a hand, then a god(dess) "donates" their hand to you. Granting you, a godly hand. All hands have the ability of superhuman strength, and durability.
summary: The ability to have a godly right/left hand.
strengths: Have a godly hand!
weaknesses: The god(dess) is chosen randomly.
You have to lose a hand.
Only having superhuman strength in one hand kinda stinks

name: Demonic Weaponry: Scar
description: Scar is one of the more destructive Demonic Weapons. It resembles a butchers knife, but with no hilt. It is pure metal, with silk wrapped around where the hilt should be. It is said anything it touches will stop growing, and die. If you were to cut a man's wrist with it, even just a shallow cut, where it cut would become nothing but dead cells. There are few who meet this blade and live to spread the tales of it.
summary: The ability to use the demonic weapon Scar.
strengths: Powerful knife.
Works on plants, animals, and humans: anything that lives.
Appears like a normal butcher's knife
weaknesses: Useless on nonliving things, such as puppets or powers.
Corrupts the soul; need a power to become aware of this.

name: Singularity
description: This ability makes you absolutely one of a kind. It prevents you from being forcibly replicated/cloned, having powers mimicked, and being mimicked by Shapeshifters or Illusionists. In addition, no one can ever mimic your voice, your hand writing or your skills/movements. You possess a physical, psychic, and empathic trait marks you as special, so even if someone tried to disguise themselves as you, people who know you would notice the ruse. There aren't even other you's in alternate realities.
summary: The ability to resist being mimicked, copied or replicated
strengths: Being truly one of a kind
Cannot ever be mimicked successfully; anyone who tries to will go back to normal in seconds
Does not prevent you from mimicking others (or replicating yourself if you have the power to)
weaknesses: People who know you will also know when YOU are in disguise (may not always be bad)
Can't help friends if they need to mimic your powers
No other you's in alternate realities... (sad face, only one of me to go around... )

name: Cat's Grace
description: To have to reflexes of a cat. You'll land safely on your feet from high buildings, but not to high. This power doesn't come with 9 lives.
summary: The ability to land safely on your feet like a cat
strengths: The reflexes of a cat
Can land safely from tall buildings
weaknesses: Can't be to tall of a building
Don't get 9 lives

name: Magnetic Resonance Vision
description: Simply what the description says, it doesn't get any simpler than that. You can get an MRI of anything instantly. That's it, just a slight modification of an age old superpower.
summary: The ability to be able to see things as if they were in an MRI scan
strengths: Similar to X-Ray vision
Has most of X-Rays Pros
weaknesses: To see the bad just contrast it with x-rays

name: Ira
description: A transformation-like ability that allows the user to go into a state of rage. Under this state the user has increased speed, strength and even endurance. The senses are all heightened greatly as well. For example the user can perceive bullets as going really slow thus giving him the ability to dodge them effectively.
summary: The ability to increase strength and speed to monumental levels
strengths: Can go beyond the limits of the body
The longer the user remains in the form the more power is obtained.
weaknesses: The body is severely weakened once said state is over
The longer the user remains in said state the more detrimental the aftereffects will be.

name: Body Link
description: This ability does damage to your enemies body as they deal damage to you. This only effects the one who caused you damage so you cannot self inflict injuries to your enemy. The damage does not have to be from a physical attack to be dealt back to your enemy; it just has to do physical damage. Also cannot be used on attacks to the mind. The transfer does not heal you in the process. All damage is dealt at the exact same time so if you are killed the enemy dies with you. This is always active.
summary: The ability to deal damage that was dealt to you to the one who did it
strengths: Enemy won't want to hurt you usually unless they have issues
If your enemy cuts your arm off, theirs gets cut off also
Works even if you're unconscious
weaknesses: Does not give you any resistance to attacks or prevent death and does not heal you
Must be physical damage to your body to work
Cannot be turned off, so if you are hit by an ally, they would still be hurt

name: Superhero 1: Spider Man
description: He's red, he's blue, and his webs are just like glue! Who is he? Spider-Man! With this, you can shoot spider webs from your wrists and swing from place to place. That's not all, you can stick to walls and sense danger with Spidey's "Spider-Sense". You also have superhuman strength (10 tons), incredible speed, and you can do amazing front flips, back flips, somersaults, and more acrobatic feats.
summary: The ability to have the powers of your friendly neighbourhood web-slinger, Spider-Man.
strengths: Shoot webs, swing from place to place, slingshot yourself, and make various weapons out of them.
Stick to any surface and use your Spider-Sense to sense danger or track down anyone and anything.
Lift a car with your bare hands, run and jump from building to building, fight like a Karate master.
weaknesses: Your Spider-Sense can't detect any symbiotes (e. g. Venom or Carnage)
Someone who has superhuman strength can pull you out of a wall.
If you're web swinging, you might accidently hit a building.

name: Villain Verbosity
description: This power is aura. When at a distance of at most 40 feet and in your line of sight, opponents will feel compelled to describe as proudly as possible every action they are going to do before they carry it out, no matter how trivial ("scratching an itch") or not trivial as an opponent telling you the combination to a secret vault you didn't know they had, or a nasty superpower you didn't know they had. The "spell" of your power is broken if you are no longer visible or if you act aggressively.
summary: The ability to make opponents say what they are going to do before they do it.
strengths: No sneak attacks on you.
Opponents will reveal any tactics they are going to use against you.
Opponents may reveal they are bluffing.
weaknesses: You might be forced to dodge attacks without fighting back.
It is better not to know that an opponent has five different powers to kill you with.

name: Mutation: Claws
description: This mutation causes your fingernails to turn into ultra-strong claws capable of rending flesh and bones.
summary: The ability to mutate your fingernails into razor-sharp claws
strengths: The claws can easily kill any lifeforms you encounter
Additional mutations increase claw strength
weaknesses: Does not increase muscle power, you must be strong to compensate
Mutation time increases with the number of mutations

name: Greatest American Hero
description: "Believe it or not, I'm walking on air. I never thought I would feel so free eee eee. Flying away on a wing and a prayer. Who could it be? Believe it or not, it's just me. " Yes, with this power, you will have the red alien suit of Ralph Hinkley. The suit comes with an instruction manual to show you how to use it, so hero up!
summary: The ability to possess a red alien suit with various powers.
strengths: Invulnerability, super strength, psychometry, invisibility
Walk on air
Cool 80's theme song
weaknesses: Losing the instruction manual
Learning how to use the suit (and sucking at it) if you lose the manual
Flying and falling (make sure you fly low)

name: Self Insertion
description: With this power, you can look into the memories of others and insert yourself therein. It will seem to them as if they had known you forever and, assuming that you insert yourself into happy and good memories, they will trust you implicitly. Be careful, however, for if a true friend points out that you were not really there, then the spell is broken. So be sure to get everyone connected to that person as well.
summary: The ability to insert yourself into anyone's memories.
strengths: Make people love you by inserting yourself into the happy memories of their life.
Make people fear you by putting yourself in their bad ones.
Become old friends with the rich and powerful.
weaknesses: If you insert yourself into many people's lives you must make sure that the memories are consistent.
If you try with someone who has a big social circle, expect a lot of work.
You cannot change the memories, only put yourself in them.

name: Electricity Immunity
description: Electrical components, wires, cables, and anything else that holds or contains electricity will never shock a holder of this power.
summary: The ability to be immune to harm from electricity
strengths: Can repair damaged wiring without worry of death by electrocution.
Lightning is a form of electricity.
Electrokinetics might fear you, if you have other powers.
weaknesses: I can't think of anything that's bad about this power, but there might be.

name: Camera Power: Freeze Frame
description: A person with this power can turn anything they see immobile at will. There are two limits on this power. The first limit is that you have to close one of your eyes every time you use this power. Opening it will release the immobility effect. The second limit is that it can only immobilize what you see. If someone is hiding behind a rock or is invisible, they won't be immobilized. Otherwise, this is a very versatile power, even allowing you to make water solid or even freeze fire or explosions.
summary: The ability to render anything you see that would be visible in a standard camera immobile
strengths: Can immobilize enemies
Non-lethal in normal situations -- air still moves and people's internal organs are hidden from view
Can even freeze explosions so you can pose in front of it
weaknesses: People can hide behind objects or within objects to avoid power
Must close an eye to keep things immobilized
Con 2 ruins the picture of yourself in front of the explosion

name: Fire Walk
description: The flames created by this power will only last for 10 minutes before they disappear. Your speed is also boosted while using this power.
summary: The ability to cause the areas one's feet touch to burst into flames
strengths: Surround enemies with a ring of flames.
You can choose when to use this power so that there are as few accidents as possible.
weaknesses: Can accidentally hurt friends if you're not careful.

name: Fear Sight
description: With this superpower, you can shift into a persons biggest fear. You don't get any abilities of the person's biggest fear, and you can only look like the persons fear for an hour. If you look into multiple people's eyes, they will each see you as there own greatest fear.
summary: The ability to change into a person's biggest fear by looking into their eyes.
strengths: The person you use this on could become scared and flee.
You can use this on multiple people.
weaknesses: You can only look like a person's fear for an hour at a time.
You do not gain any abilities of that person's fear.
If the person has no fear, there will be no affect.

name: Murphy's Law
description:
When a person is using this power, they can make anything go wrong by thinking about it as long as they can determine a fatal flaw in something's design. 

This can work on any design from robots to someone's plan
summary: The ability to make anything that can go wrong go wrong
strengths: You can make things malfunction by analyzation-pointing out flaws make things malfunction
Very few designs can be without flaws or possible mistakes.
weaknesses: If this power is accidentally used on yourself making things worse for yourself
If someone was able to cover all the flaws you can think of
If you can't find a visible flaw in a person's plan or design

name: Talent Of Killing
description: This is a fearsome ability. One who has this can kill a person with one blow at age six. Later on they can fight many strong opponents at once. Their speed and strength become greater and they become slim. This person can kill upfront or sneakily and is proficent in accuracy and weapons. They can also attack without an enemy having time to react. They are skilled enough to catch arrows out of midair.
summary: The ability to have natural talent of killing.
strengths: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Taking out villans.
weaknesses: Power sacrifice works on this.
People wont like you.
Taking out villans,

name: Appearance Switcher
description: You may change the piece(s) of clothing you have on at the time to anything you have seen or heard about.
summary: The ability to change the article of clothing you have on.
strengths: Never have to buy clothes.
FREE CLOTHES!
weaknesses: You can only change the clothes you are wearing.
Have to have seen or heard about them.

name: Atomic Fission
description:
Ability to control the molecules of living things by using heat transfer from the source to the destination in an extremely high-level radiation emission stream. It will penetrate any substance at a molecular level and transform the object into any other object through the power of suggestion from the source. 

The negative side-effect is the energy level must be replenished with the heat of the sun over a period of 15 minutes to full strength.
summary: The ability to split biological molecules apart through heat displacement
strengths: Molecular transformation
Heat transfer from object to object
Super strength with the power of the sun
weaknesses: Depletion of energy when used over an extensive amount of time
Unable to use to full strength in temperatures below freezing
Can produce unstable amounts of radiation harmful to others

name: Mind Control Through Hugs
description: You are able to control a persons mind when you hug them, however this can only be achieved via hugging them, and you can only control them if you will it. If a persons mind or will is strong enough, they can break from your hold on them, however if they are controlled via your hugging ability, they can do anything you ask, except killing themselves. So basically you have little minions that follow you.
summary: The ability to control a persons mind through hugs
strengths: You can control a specific person of your choice
The person you hug is under your command
You do not have to keep hugging the person, to have control of the mind
weaknesses: They can break free of your control
You cannot command them to kill themselves
You have to hug them to control them

name: Pain Transferring
description: Pain transferring allows the user to get rid of their pain or discomfort by giving it to someone else or any other sentient being. This does not allow them to transfer their actual injuries, just the pain and discomfort side effects from it. More advanced users of this power would be able to transfer only a portion of their pain, still allowing themselves to feel some of it.
summary: The ability to transfer pain or discomfort from yourself to another sentient lifeform
strengths: Get rid of your pain and discomfort
Potentialy never feel pain or be uncomfortable again
weaknesses: If you can't feel pain you dont know when you have been seriously injured (so be careful)
You must inflict pain upon another being in order to use this power

name: Autotune
description: With this power you can Autotune your own voice and other people's voices to make them sound good when they sing. You can use the power on anybody and it makes them sound good, even when they're singing live.
summary: The ability to autotune your own voice or other people's voices
strengths: You can make people sound good when they sing.
It works even when they're singing live.
weaknesses: No use in combat.

name: Book Lover
description: Whenever you look at the cover of a book you instantly are done reading this book no matter how long it actually is!!!!!
summary: The ability to look at the cover of a book and be done reading it already.
strengths: Could be the fastest reader in the world
If you read non-fiction books you will get smarter
weaknesses: You could be done reading all of the books in your school's library in 1 day or less
You would have read a lot of books!

name: Absorption On Death
description: With a touch the user of this ability absorbs DNA, knowledge/skills and powers of the recently deceased, ranging from years to days depending on the freshness of the corpse. Death up to a day old allows the user to gain information/skills about things/procedures as if they've done/known it for years. A corpse from a day to a week old deteriorates this from years of knowledge to about a week. A month's old corpse (and older) yields you info/skills up to about 24 hours before death (and sooner).
summary: The ability to absorb the memories and abilities of the deceased.
strengths: Gains knowledge of how to perform advanced complicated tasks
Can obtain multiple powers
The DNA absorption allows you to shapeshift in the other's appearance
weaknesses: This ability is never deactivated
Cannot absorb from the living
You absorb the good with the bad: ability weaknesses, emotional traumas etc.

name: Time Spaced
description: You can invert someone's 3 spacial dimensions and 1 time dimension so he lives in 1 spacial dimension and 3 time dimensions. The effect is, if a victim moves or is moved forward, they will age, and if they move or are moved backwards, they will get younger. A victim will age either way one day for every foot they move. Time traveling victims will teleport. Teleporters will time travel in the spot they stand. This power will affect someone who can live in more then three spacial dimensions.
summary: The ability to invert someone's space-time dimensions.
strengths: Cripple super fast opponents and teleporters.
Mess with someone's existence.
Move a foe into old age or turn him into a baby.
weaknesses: Immortals.
Once time travelers learn how to teleport, they could come after you.

name: Buffication
description: When your heart rate increases rapidly your body undergoes rapid muscle hypertrophy and ossification. In this process you will grow 10 feet tall and pack on 900 pounds of pure super strong musclemass.
summary: The ability to pack on hundreds of pounds of musclemass instantly
strengths: No one will be able to beat you up
You will be by far the strongest man in the world
You could make lots of money in strongman and bodybuilding competitions
weaknesses: Your clothes will be ripped apart
You will be scary looking

name: Eyes Of Perception
description: The Eyes Of Perception is an odd ability, but incredibly useful for tacticians and such. People are born with this, and it's easy to tell at times. More than a hundred eyes are hidden on the user's body, covered by skin. When all of these eyes are opened, the user gains amazing powers of perception, allowing him to see the weaknesses of opponents, and even what attacks they'll use seconds before they use them.
summary: The ability to use the Eyes of Perception.
strengths: Perception.
Can see the moves of enemies.
weaknesses: Hard to control.
Hard to master.

name: Reactive Copies
description: With this ability, you make superpowered copies of yourself when outnumbered. The copies are almost as durable as steel and although seemingly normal, can lift 250 lbs. This is a passive ability which only works when you're outnumbered. For example, if 20 enemies face you. You'll make 19 copies. The copies can't copy your superpowers. If it's one on one, you don't make copies, period. Their main goal is to protect you. It's too perfect. You can't control your copies minds.
summary: The ability to make an equal amount of superpowered copies of yourself that protect you when outnumbered.
strengths: Make superpowered copies when outnumbered.
Never be outnumbered again.
The copies are there mostly to protect you.
weaknesses: It's too perfect.
You can't control your copies minds.
If it's one on one, you might die.

name: Evt Teleportation
description: Based on sight, thought, and knowledge, this teleportation transfers the volume of yourself to your target location and sends the target volume to where you stood.
summary: The ability to equal volume transfer teleportation
strengths: Effective weapon
Silent teleportation
Inconspicuos
weaknesses: Exhausting overuse

name: Detrital Affinity
description:
You have moderate kinetic control over decaying leaves, animals, wood, feces, rusted metals, and the like, and dust; more indistinguishable from original form for more precise control. Dust from asphalt, concrete, or other inviolable materials is out of the scope of control. Although, you can advance deterioration visibly in any non-living or dead objects with concentration and time. 
You also have a form of touch-initiated claircognizance with waste. (eg Dried blood is good for tracking. )
summary: The ability to advance and command decayed or decaying materials and dust.
strengths: Drive away unwanted people with waves of trash, corpses, and whatnots.
Be a forensic expert.
Clean your house instantly in all those hard-to-reach places!
weaknesses: It's hard to avoid becoming terribly filthy.
Dust can't hurt your enemies.
Groping gross things might be too much to get what you want to know.

name: Absorbing Matter At Will
description: Whoever has this power can absorb almost any type of matter. Though it'll make you stronger, it'll also make you slower.
summary: The ability to absorb almost anything
strengths: Can't be hit by liquids, light rays, metals or rocks
Gain Super Strength
Really durable against bullets
weaknesses: You get really heavy
You can't always control it
Very slow
tags: you can absorb what threat comes your way
and can also be the very mighty

name: Altdimension Creature Summon
description: With this power you can create a portal and summon a creature from a different dimension that may or may not help you fight enemies
summary: The ability to summon creatures from alternate dimensions
strengths: You might summon an extremely powerful creature that will help you
weaknesses: You might summon a weak creature
You might summon a powerful creature that wants to attack you

name: Psionic Restraints
description: Someone using this power can prevent a psychic from using their full power by limiting how much power the psychic can access. The psychic can only be restricted down to 50%. The user of this power can decide how many people to use it on at the same time. WARNING: The more people this power is used on the easier it is for them to shed their restraints and use their full power.
summary: The ability to keep a psychic from using their full power
strengths: Don't have to fight psychics at their full power.
Don't have to concentrate once target(s) are determined.
weaknesses: Only affects psychics.
Con Negation and similar powers do not affect this power.

name: Seventh Amendment
description: No matter how trivial it is, you can sue anyone for over $20 no matter what it is and WIN.
summary: The ability to sue anyone for anything for over $20 and win
strengths: Get rich quickly
weaknesses: If you sue for under $20, you always lose

name: Induced Excitement
description: With this superpower, you can make anything (or any subject) sound exciting to you and others. You can make history sound exciting to you. You can get someone excited about watching paint dry. Only you can see the exclamation points. This is also useful in combat. You can make your enemies excited about the good side. It's these invisible exclamation points you summon that makes things exciting. Effects last 24 hours or less. Exclamation points become more and more visible after the first hour.
summary: The ability to make anything sound exciting to you and others!
strengths: Make anything sound exciting to you and others!
Make your enemies excited about joining the good side!
Make people excited about making a better future!
weaknesses: Making people excited about bad things.
Exclamation points start to become visible after the first hour.
Effects wear off in 24 hours or less.

name: Metabolism Control
description: With this power, you can increase or decrease the metabolism of anyone you choose. If you decrease their metabolism... then they will get fatter. If you increase it... then they will be skinnier. Warning: If you decrease or increase their metabolism too much, they will die.
summary: The ability to control metabolism.
strengths: You can control metabolism
You can make people skinnier or fatter
weaknesses: You may accidentally kill someone....

name: Blunt/Slashing Conversion
description: With this power, you can change the damaging effect of any thing. Things that normally deal blunt damages, such as punches, kicks, hammers or falling on the ground, will slash. Things that normally deal slashing damages, such as knives, swords, axes or shards of glass, will deal a blow.
summary: The ability to convert slashing force into blunt force and vice versa.
strengths: When dealing with slashing weapons, it's better to get bruises rather than lose an arm.
Deal serious damages with a single punch or the edge of your hand.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect you from harm.

name: Twilight Power: Illusion Of Pain
description: The user projects the illusion of being in extremely intense physical pain into others  minds, thus incapacitating them. Can cause people to experience excruciating pain that  instantly incapacitates them. Can inflict this pain on only one target at a time, must be able to see your target to use this ability on him or her.
summary: The ability to creates the illusion of intense pain.
strengths: Creates the illusion of intense pain.
Useful for torture.
Instant.
weaknesses: Only effects one person.

name: Cartoon Power: Dr. Vicktor
description: With this power you can make purple lightning come from the sky and strike buildings, people or anything else.
summary: The ability to create purple lightning
strengths: Can electrocute enemies or enemy hide outs
You don't need to be near the things you strike with purple lightning
Purple lightning is so cool
weaknesses: Ben Ten fanatics might think you're some kind of monster villain because of the purple lightning

name: Soul Reaper
description: This power allows you to see a person's soul aura & to rip it out of them. Doing this extends your lifespan while the become a zombie & eventually turn to dust. You also become stronger, heal faster & soon nigh invincible. But there are conditions: a person at peak & ripe age is the best soul to take, very young or old grants little power & it depends on if the person was good or bad. Good souls are well good, but a bad evil soul causes pain, madness & rage.
summary: The ability to take & absorb someone's soul & gain power
strengths: Take souls from human bodies: living or dead
Gain great power
Near immortality
weaknesses: Best to take a person's soul in there peak
An evil soul will cause pain, madness & rage

name: Angry Earth
description: Pick anyone of your choosing. Then by your command, the earth will open under the person, swallow them, then close back up.
summary: The ability to have the earth swallow anybody
strengths: Powerful
Little concentration
weaknesses: Dangerous
Creepy

name: Radioactive Shellfish
description: As a result of a small radioactive horseshoe crab being painfully grafted to your spinal column, you have aquired superhuman abilites. You and the horseshoe crab have formed a symbiotic bond allowing you to produce bone-like weapons. Your bone structure is also extremely dense giving you durability similar to an exoskeleton. You can also survive in water for long hours and swim with ease. Your physiology allows you to store water in your bones and discharge water in jets of aqueous blasts.
summary: The ability to aquire a dense bone structure and produce bone-like biological weapons.
strengths: Dense bones allow you to take a lot of punishment.
Extinguish fires with ease.
Produce "bone pincers" to easily snap and crush your enemies.
weaknesses: Must drink plenty of milk to keep your calcium level high.
Can't stay in water forever.

name: Reality Shift Comic Style
description: Every wanted to be like super man on a comic page? Well now you can! This power lets to user turn the world around them into a comic 2D platform. First person and third person views make it look like a real comic and people talk using word bubbles like in the comics. This means to user will have to go into third person view to read what people are saying.
summary: The ability to make the world around you look like a comic strip
strengths: Finally live in a comic
The user can make the story and change it around if they want
weaknesses: Have to read others words
May take some time gettin guse to seeing yourself from a distance

name: Ghost Of The Bloody Harvest
description: Strength in numbers. You can become the strongest person in the universe. By ripping muscle, skin and bone from as many mammals as you can, you can become immeasurably and increasingly stronger. The process adds to your density, durability and lifespan. If someone is stronger than you, just find a few more victims and return to the fight tougher and stronger.
summary: The ability to gain perpetual superhuman strength and immortality by harvesting mammals
strengths: Incredible strength, pack it in add muscle tissue, the stronger the mammal you steal from the better
Almost immortal. If injured heal by stealing parts. The lives you take add to your life.
Dense and Durable. You are immune to electricity, it just solidifies the transplant
weaknesses: Bloody and messy. You must harvest parts from living mammals.
Must electrify yourself to make the transplant permanent or your body will reject new parts
Theoretically you will reach a point of ultimate strength. 2000 years from now.

name: Myth Power: Helios' Help
description: Helios (Helius), in Greek myth, was the god of the sun, sunlight, sight and oaths. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate sunlight, at will. In addition, one can absorb natural sunlight to gain physical power (and sustenance) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically turn into an entity of sunlight, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Helios' command over the essence of the Sun and sunlight
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate sunlight; gain physical power, sustenance from sunlight
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Transform into an entity of pure sunlight, at will; psychically perceive lies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot cast illusions of sun's course (rising, setting, solar eclipse, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish foes to the Sun, by touch, or open portals to the Sun, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically project vision anywhere the sun shines or cure blindness, until developed (NCN)

name: Essence Release
description: This ability puts stored essence gained through Hollowing Essence to use by allowing you to release it in an explosive manner. The properties of the stored essence determines the effect of the blast. For instance a creative essence might repair everything and essence of fear may cause all living beings in the area to become fearful.
summary: The ability to release stored essence in an explosive manner.
strengths: Unleash a blast if stored essence
Multitude if possible effects
weaknesses: Not always a predictable power
Must have stored up essence to use.

name: Unlimited Supply Of Grenades
description: With this power you have an unlimited supply of grenades in your pocket. These grenades work like regular grenades except for the fact that your are immune to the power of the grenades.
summary: The ability to have an unlimited supply of grenades in your pocket
strengths: You have an unlimited supply of grenades
You can't be hurt by your own grenades
weaknesses: You can still be hurt by other grenades

name: Sand Mimicry
description: Sand is defined as 'a naturally occurring granular material composed of finely divided rock and mineral particles'. A Sand Mimic can become this at will. This means they can create blasting jets of sand from their own body mass, fly by directing their sandy form, allow objects to go through them, and even take on extra sand to become larger. However, they are subject to parts of themselves being seperated (like in a jar), being transformed into glass, or even being washed away.
summary: The ability to turn your body into sand
strengths: Can allow objects to pass through your sand
Can drift on wind currents as sand
Can take on extra sand to become larger
weaknesses: Parts of you can be seperated from the whole
Can be turned into glass or washed away
Never totally flesh-and-blood

name: Necrokinesis
description: Necrokinesis is a torture power that allows you to cause people, plants or animal flesh to rot even though they are alive. This power however cannot kill anyone. It is only used for torture and takes what would seem like forever to completely rot someone's body and, if they can't die from this, then why bother trying to go that far in the torment; you have other things to do.
summary: The ability to cause people, plants, or animals to decay while they are STILL alive.
strengths: You can cause another person's flesh to rot right off their bones
It's one of the most gruesome of torture
The rotten-flesh cannot heal (exception of superhealing)
weaknesses: It's a torture power, so it cannot ever kill someone (even if 80% of their body has decomposed)
At first, the decaying is fast, but as time passes, it slows down more and more and more
Putrification stinks (carry nose plugs at all times)

name: The Architect
description: Ever felt that your room needed more space, lighting, color, etc.? This is the power for you! Use the materials of your house or building to change it at will, even making them move.
summary: The ability to manipulate buildings
strengths: Mobile home takes a new meaning
If there are weapons in the structure, you may relocate them
Change home every day
weaknesses: You need materials in order to make changes that involve size
You can accidentally break rules in the apartment or dorm
You need some type of building

name: Earth Siphon
description: When you use this power. You can pull out the earths life energy, And use it as you wish. But be careful use it too much, and it could cause unnatural disasters.
summary: The ability to suck energy out of the earth
strengths: Suck out the earth's energy
Use it as you wish
weaknesses: Cant overuse it (see description)

name: Note Creation
description: You can create music anywhere you go and anyway you want. It can be people tripping simultaneously, or causing people to sip drinks, all in song. It can be any song (Ode To Joy, Happy Birthday,... ) Wherever you make the music, everything within a 50-meter radius becomes silent, so you can appreciate the music. You can do it anytime, but can only have one song before halting it. To make the music, you have to think about the song and scale (B flat) and then snap your fingers. Snap again to halt.
summary: The ability to create music anywhere, anyhow.
strengths: Be a music master.
Entertain your school and friends.
Make everyone applaud you.
weaknesses: People may think you're a freak.
May be a bad form of music (farting, burping).
Cannot merge songs.

name: Burrower Dart Thrower
description: This attack does impaling damage initially, then cutting damage. When they hit flesh, the darts will start wiggling their way through flesh or bone. The darts have 4 razor-sharp edges. You can shoot one dart at a time or up to five every second. If armor is penetrated but not flesh, the darts can sense flesh and start digging into flesh. If a dart misses a target and someone picks it up barehanded, the dart will start digging into flesh. Your own darts know not to hurt you. The range is 300 ft.
summary: The ability to shoot metal darts from your hand that will burrow into a foe.
strengths: Selective rate of fire.
Decent range.
An attack that may cause pain to someone who regenerates.
weaknesses: Darts of someone else with this power will hurt you.

name: Bottomless Pit
description: Disclaimer. Bottomless pit is actually a dimension and it's only 1 billion miles deep. You can open a pit under someone who up to 200 feet away from you. The pit opening can be 20 feet wide. Inside the pit it's five miles in diameter. The pit will collapse on itself if a victim dies,lands on bottom or escapes. You can collapse your own pits but not pits of others.
summary: The ability to open a bottomless pit at will under someone.
strengths: You can hide in one in you need to.
As long as a foe lacks certain powers he's gone.
weaknesses: This power is useless against teleportation,dimension jumping and those who fly.
Any other powers that would counter the effect of this power.
A foe with this power.

name: Normalization Immunity
description: Normalization fluids and anything else that would permanently get rid of all your powers will not work on you anymore. It does not matter if the fluid, power, or chemical would normally be ignored by or bypass the normal defensive powers and/or immune system, this power will turn those normalization fluids and chemicals into useful nutrients and negate the powers.
summary: The ability to be immune to any attempt to turn one into an ordinary being of one's species
strengths: Normalization fluids are history!!!
This is not powered by mitochondria, but by directly ripping apart glucose molecules.
weaknesses: This power can still be individually removed.

name: Egyptian Gods: Meskhenet
description: The Egyptian goddess Meskhenet was said to be the creator of life. She was able to breathe "Ka" (life spirit) into a human's soul as they are born. Users will be able to ccreate life and spirits, breathe life spirit into nonliving objects, and resurrect dead organisms for a short period of time. As Meskhenet was also associated with fate, users will be able to manipulate and sometimes foretell the future.
summary: The ability to create life and spirits.
strengths: Give life to nonliving or dead things.
Manipulate and see the future.
weaknesses: This power is extremely costly in energy.
Resurrected things are short-lived.

name: Singer + Song Writer
description: This power bestows you with an extremely beautiful, perfect, and powerful singing voice, that never ever tires and never needs to be maintained whatsoever. It also gives you the power to easily create and compose any song, which shall always be beautiful and a smash hit.
summary: The ability to sing beautifully, and to write any beautiful smash hit song.
