strengths: Complete and utter constant success!!
Always produce a smash hit song.
An infinite amount of wealth from the music that you create.
weaknesses: Nothing bad whatsoever.

name: Plot The Plot
description: With this ability you will be able to create the top notch schemes simply by blacking out for a few seconds(you must figure out how to black out on your own)And when you figure it out you will wake up. Mastermind any scheme, theft, Or master plan as easily as you would put on a pair of socks, don,t take that literally if you have broken legs.
summary: The ability to mastermind a scheme.
strengths: Perfect plots
No flaws
Look smart
weaknesses: Knock yourself out
Unexpected events can foil plots
Can only create plots with information you already know.

name: Animal Humanoid Evolution
description: All you do is touch a non human animal like a dog or ape & they will start to instantly evolve into a humanoid. They will have the characteristics of man increased intelligence, speech, bipedal for some etc. Depends on what animal it is. Their whole structure will change to resemble a human's except their genetics will stay the same. Though they might try to take over, fight & enslave man for domination & their primitive instincts could surface like killing to eat.
summary: The ability to make animals anthropomorphic
strengths: Make a man-like walking talking animal
Who knows what secrets we could learn from the animal kingdom
weaknesses: Might rise up & try to claim for domination of the better species: man vs man-imals
Their animal instincts could surface & take over them. Making them deadlier.

name: Catalysis
description: If you paid any attention in Chemistry class, you might remember that a catalyst is a substance that speeds up the chemical reactions of other substances.  With the power of catalysis, you can speed up any chemical process. This is actually a warping of space/time, but targeted to specific chemical processes only. For instance, you can make someone's car rust instantly, or age the cheddar in your fridge. Or, disable your enemies by speeding up their cell division rate, causing them to age!
summary: The ability to speed up chemical processes using your mind
strengths: Speed up decay processes to render almost anything unusable
Cause wounds to heal quickly
Always have perfectly aged cheddar cheese on hand!
weaknesses: Once you've used your powers, there's no reversing the process

name: Nudality
description: By doing a simple gesture, your foe is surrounded in a puff of smoke. Your opponent loses their clothes and starts to shiver covering their most private parts.
summary: The ability to make all of your opponent's clothes vanish completely.
strengths: A greater thing for embarrassment.
weaknesses: None.

name: Dungeon Summon
description: A person with this power can summon a portal that leads to a video game style dungeon. The dungeon has monsters, bosses, and treasures, and has different floors that act as levels. If a person can make it to the harder levels of the dungeon they can find rarer and more powerful artifacts, but they have to be able to beat stronger bosses to obtain them. The dungeon is infinite and maze-like. A person with this power can create a portal to leave at any time. Only artifacts can leave the dungeon.
summary: The ability to summon a portal that leads to a dungeon.
strengths: Obtain rare and powerful treasures within the dungeon.
Open up portals to go on adventures or train with friends.
Can be used as a prison, by trapping people inside the portal.
weaknesses: The monsters inside will attach whoever enters.
There are random traps hidden in the walls.
Have to defeate stronger and stronger bosses to obtain treasures.

name: What If?
description: A user of this ability can see what would have happened if they made a different choice in life.
summary: The ability to see what could have happened
strengths: Answer what if questions
Feel better about your life
weaknesses: Feel worse about your life
No other use

name: Magnetic Field Perception
description: The given radius will differ for each holder of this power as well as how strong or weak the magnetic field must be for them to percieve it.
summary: The ability to percieve any magnetic field within a given radius
strengths: Always know if someone is going to attack you with steel or iron as both have a magnetic field.
The brain gives off a magnetic field of its own and thus can be sensed.
weaknesses: Someone who attacks from beyond your range of perception with only non-magnetic weapons.

name: Spawn
description: In order for this power to work, you must shed at least one drop of blood. From that blood, an exact copy of you is made. Same age, intelligence etc. You can multiply infinitely. No one is for for sure who is the original. You can drain yourself of blood & from that can spawn who knows how many of yourself. The negative is you can't re-absorb your copies, meaning whatever skills they learned you won't have.
summary: The ability to create & multiply yourself
strengths: Multiply yourself infinitely
weaknesses: Must shed blood to make a copy
Can't absorb your copies

name: Old One Power: Necronomicon
description: Old Ones: things of science and magic from other realities merged in hyperdimensional forms that bring insanity to all who merely think about them. Malevolent or uncaring, the human race is beneath the notice of their infinite might. You get an encyclopedic knowledge of these beings: the names, histories, abilities, politics, philosophical insight into their existence, the ways to summon them, and call upon their power for your own use. You are forced to write as much of it as you can in a book.
summary: The ability to have the forbidden knowledge of the mythos
strengths: Not even the Old Ones have all this knowledge. If you're noticed, they might find it useful.
Of course, you can also use it to avoid them, staying alive as long as possible.
You know how to call upon their magic for nearly any purpose, and their cults will love you.
weaknesses: Being around even the friendliest of the Old Ones will corrupt you or slowly kill you.
So does using their magic. Also, their cults are NOT good people. Heroes will assume you're evil.
You must complete that book. When it is, you must either accept the corruption, or die by your hand.

name: Bullet Catching
description: With this power, you can't get hurt when someone shoots you, as long as you catch the bullet in your hand before it hits any part of your body.
summary: The ability to catch bullets
strengths: Can't get hurt by bullets easily
weaknesses: You have to catch the bullet with your hand. Otherwise, it will hurt... a lot!

name: Combined Defenses
description: This power makes it easier to combine defenses together between multiple beings. Forcefields become melded together and stronger, point defenses more coordinated together, etc. If the one with this power is knocked out or killed, the whole net of defenses falls apart and reverts to normal separate defenses. Note: 'Net of Defenses' refers to the combined defenses.
summary: The ability to more easily combine defenses with other beings
strengths: Defenses for the group are linked together and coordinated.
The point of this power is to prevent any damage whatsoever to any member of the group.
weaknesses: The holder of this power must be awake, conscious, and alive for this power to work.
The net of defenses is linked to the holder of this power.

name: Calcium Increase
description: Calcium strengthens bones, right? So, add more calcium to your bones, and your body will be more durable.  As this power advances you are able to go to higher levels of endurance, but with this ability will not give invulnerability.
summary: The ability to put more calcium in your bones.
strengths: More bone.
weaknesses: You may seem heavier.

name: Enhanced Character
description: You gain all of the following: Great & tremendous willpower far beyond anyone or anything imaginable. Complete & utter immunity to the influences of all evil, temptation, & corruption. A strong unwavering sense of justice, morality, & righteousness that never fails nor falters. A strict moral code often attributed to midwestern values which you feel strongly compelled to adhere to. And strong feelings of wanting to protect life, people other, & to never give up, even when things look bad.
summary: The ability to have a series of greatly enhanced positive character traits.
strengths: Your basically the ultimate good guy and hero.
Your fully capable of inspiring and uplifting people to be better, act better, and do better.
Provides you the capacity to stay calm, cool, & collected in any situation you find yourself in.
weaknesses: Finding yourself at odds with people who don't share your point of view.
Most corrupt or evil individuals definitely hating your because of this superpower.
Doesn't provide you any other superhuman powers or abilities.

name: Myth Weapon: Grimpage Eclair
description: The user gains the power to summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon formed into the shape of a rod. The small rod doesn't seem like much, but it does pack quite a punch, able to break holes in solid stone, but when the user is in danger, it transforms, this weapon grows another four feet, the tip becoming jagged before a blade rips from the sides of the top, a double bladed dark pink Scythe, truly a wicked weapon to demolish one's foes with. It has a ''sister'' weapon, but that's another story.
summary: The ability to summon the Grimpage Eclair, a weapon said to cut the very bonds of life.
strengths: Despite the small, two feet size of it in the weapon's first form, it still packs a wallop.
In it's transformed state, it is more than capable of cleaving though foes like butter.
With it's bloody and almost magical roots, it is able to cut the flesh, with the soul.
weaknesses: With it's two foot range, unless the user moves in close, it's not going to be able to hit.
The second form only comes out when the user is in real danger, the user can't fake it.
In it's second form, the blades are extremely sharp, the user must be careful not to harm themself.

name: Coreation
description: The power to drain heat from the center of the Earth and use it for superstrength. The power also makes you immune to fire.
summary: The ability to suck the heat from the center of  the Earth and use it for superstrength.
strengths: You get unbelievable superstrength.
You get superhuman durability.
weaknesses: You can get too much heat in your body and die.

name: Vampiric Aura
description: You have an aura that steals life-force from other living beings. You can then use that stuff to reverse age, heal, stop aging, etc. Anything that has to do with life can be done. Restoring life to others takes tremendous amounts of stolen life however even with a body to put the life into.
summary: The ability to have an aura that steals life
strengths: You can live as long as there are other life forms.
You can be whatever age you want.
You can restore life to others
weaknesses: You must have other life forms near you.
No one will want to approach you (but Immortals don't mind; they have infinite life-force to give)
If you can't turn this power off for some reason when you need to.

name: Leidenfrost Effect
description: With this superpower, you are protected from hot liquids and solids that are 122 degrees fahrenheit or hotter for a short time. There's an invisible layer of insulation. The layer works for five minutes at 122 F. The hotter it gets, the longer the insulation last. Every degree hotter it gets, that is the number of additional minutes it last. Can only work against heat 122 F of hotter. 222 F will have this power work for 105 minutes. Anything colder than 122F can still burn you.
summary: The ability to temporarily be protected from extreme heat
strengths: Be insulated from temperatures 122 degrees fahrenheit and above.
The hotter it is, the longer this power stays activated.
No more third degree burns.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect you from heat colder than 122 degrees fahrenheit.
Can still get a mild first degree burn sometimes.
Insulating layer is visible underwater.

name: Entropic Immunity
description: Also called entropic resilience this power grants the user the power to completely resist the adverse effects of entropy. The user of this power cannot have their energy chaotically spread out beyond use on a microscopic,macroscopic or any other scale. This means that the user can attack without having their blows reduced in power by entropy or suffer any disadvantage by an entropic attack. This power even eliminates NATURAL entropy's negative effects upon the user.
summary: The ability to resist the negative effects of entropy
strengths: Resist entropic influence inflicted upon you.
Don't fear the dampenning of your attacks or harm to your body through entropy.
You are still free to use your own entropic based powers.
weaknesses: You can still be INDIRECTELY affected by entropy.
Not all that useful in most situations.
The enemy can still INCREASE the energy in their attacks.

name: Unforgettable
description: Once you turn 16 you'll enter a 16 hour coma and when you wake up you'll remember all your past lives.
summary: The ability to remember all your past lifes.
strengths: You'll get knowledge that most people can't even dream of.
The things you were good at in your previous lives will bond once again with your body.
weaknesses: Every single bad thing that has ever happened to you or that you have done will return to hunt you.

name: Space Hero
description: When you are in space, you can survive the cold (even the absolute zero), the radiation, you don't need to breathe and you are able to float or fly in space. But you need to be in a vacuum: in the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.
summary: The ability to have various superpowers while being in space.
strengths: You survive extreme cold and radiation in space.
You don't need to breathe in space.
You're able to float and fly in space.
weaknesses: In the atmosphere, you are just a normal human being.

name: Secret
description: The attributes of secrets can be very useful indeed. You can hide in plain sight or in shadows and other thiings with the effectivness of invisibility. You can be well protected from danger by barriers and other things. You can also be exempt from people scanning you to find things out about you and this includes intuitive aptitude. You can also gain a secret's trait of being important to be an automatic V. I. P.
summary: The ability to manipulate the attributes of secrets in yourself.
strengths: This power cannot be shortened to its breif description at the top.
This is good for being evasive.
A wide plethora of uses and pros cant be negated.
weaknesses: Can be blocked by power sacrifice.

name: Haberdashery Mimicry
description: With this power, you gain all the typical abilities associated with any hat you wear. A hard hat will turn you into an peerless construction worker, a coonskin hat purveys the firearm skills of Davey Crockett, and a Deerstalker will give you unparallelled powers of deduction.
summary: The ability to gain powers from hats.
strengths: Hats give you the abilities of the most famous person to wear them (Such as Mario's cap)
In cases where the hat isn't associated with someone, they give the most appropriate skills for it.
weaknesses: If the hat is knocked off your head, you lose all your power.

name: Suspended Division
description: When you knock over a glass, it hits the ground and shatters, right? Not any more! With this power, you can postpone when an object will break. You may knock over a glass, but when it lands it will be intact. You can then decide when it will shatter. When you stab or injure someone, it leave no initial mark or wound, but when you decide the wound will appear, the breaking action will occur. This happens to anything that breaks, tears, evaporates, breaks up etc, any action that divides an object
summary: The ability to postpone the breaking up of an object
strengths: Postpone accidental and deliberate breakages caused by you.
Stab someone, then use your power as blackmail.
Object remains intact until you so desire.
weaknesses: It only works with things you break, not anyone else.
Some get suspicious when water won't evaporate, cheese is uncuttable and food is indigestible.
You don't need to say anything, so just thinking about an object breaking might be enough.

name: Superpower Charge
description: With this ability, by being struck by any superpower, you gain power and energy, depending on how strong the power that struck you was. You can store this energy for as long as you want, and release it in a powerful blast of energy, or choose to save it, which will increase your mental and physical strength.
summary: The ability to charge your power by being struck by superpowers.
strengths: Every superpower used against you will benefit you
Save the energy of the powers you are struck by, or release them in a powerful, energetic blast
Being struck by powers makes you feel great, and has a nice taste
weaknesses: No additional benefit if someone is healing you, or shielding you, etc.
If you're never struck by a super-powered being
This is a passive ability (it's always active)

name: Farsight
description: Did you ever want to see what your best friend is doing? With this power you can!
summary: The ability to see things from far away
strengths: See what other people are doing
Spy on your crush
See where your foes are
weaknesses: None

name: Creature Attractor
description: Unless it is controlled, you always give off a signal that indiscriminately tell any living creature in a large vicinity to come to you, except those from the same species as you. When sufficiently mastered, you can choose to attract only the species you want or only one specific creature, control the radius of your power, and even turn this power off. This power only draws the creatures' attention to you. They won't find you attractive; their feelings towards you are left to their nature.
summary: The ability to attract creatures from species other than yours.
strengths: You are the perfect bait! Just attract any creature into a trap.
Works on any creature. Plants and fungi (though they will rarely move), lost animals, cryptids,...
You could have a Snow White moment with forest animals.
weaknesses: You are the perfect bait! You can draw the attention of any creature away from your allies.
Works on any creature. Kystians, bacterias, ferocious animals,...
If you haven't mastered it, this power will always be on.

name: Color Change
description: With this power you can change the color of anything you want. The change is permanent if what the change is done on is wanted by the person or the item's owner.
summary: The ability to change the color of any item or person to any other color
strengths: You can be any color you want.
You can make others any color they want to be.
weaknesses: No true combative use.
Only affects colors, nothing else.
Color changes are only superfluous at worst.

name: Coin Flip Of Truth
description: With this power you can ask any true or false, yes or no question and flip a coin to know the answer. Heads is true or yes and tails is no or false.
summary: The ability to know the answer to any yes or no question by fliipping a coin.
strengths: Pass test with little to no studying
Know if someone is lying to you
Always win the coin toss by asking an easy question
weaknesses: Need a coin
Only yes or no questions

name: Moon Fire
description: Gives the wielder control of moon fire. Moon fire is the essence of the night, so it lets you control darkness, shadows, moonshine, the evil inside people, the public conciousness and protection at night. Each use of the moon fire will make the wielder more attune to the darkness. If the moon fire is left uncontrolled, the wielder will eventuall turn into a mooncalf, a creature of the moon.
summary: The ability to wield the moon fire
strengths: Gives you control over the evil in others
Shadows can be used to hide from enemies
Gives you protection when it's night
weaknesses: If left unattended, it will take over the wielder
It will make the wielder a magnet for creatures of the night
It is very addictive

name: Waterisation
description: You can use this power to make anything within a 5 mile radius into water but you won't be turned into water , although if you learn to control it you can turn youself into water. When you lose concentration everything will go back to its origional form unless its water.
summary: The ability to turn everything around you into water
strengths: Water!
Never be thirsty
Really win a fight with this
weaknesses: Its just water
As soon as you lose concentration everything turns back
If you can't swim then learn. Now!

name: Immortal Slayer
description: Basically you can kill anything that has eternal life, or general invincibility, simply by touching it, and it stays dead.
summary: The ability to kill immortals
strengths: Defeat any super powerfull characters that try to play the "invincibility" card. "
Kill vampires, werewolves, zombies, ghosts, etc. Simply by touching them
weaknesses: Does not work on anything mortal.
You have to come into physical contact with the immortal.

name: Four Eyes: Torture
description: This power is gained by using the long distance part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. When someone stares into all of your eyes simultaneously, they suddenly see and feel the worst torture they can think of for themselves.
summary: The ability to make people see and feel elaborate illusions by staring into your eyes
strengths: Do torture without any hard work.
Can still use Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have the Four Eyes power and use the long distance power.
Target must stare into all your eyes at the same time.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Myth Power: Nectar And Ambrosia
description: Nectar (Nektar) and Ambrosia, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the respective Food and Drink of the Gods, of the same names. As such, channeling them allows one to turn normal food into delicious Ambrosia (which heals, cleans wounds and has all vital nutrients needed for any species--mortal or immortal--to survive), by touch. In addition, one can turn normal drink into succulent Nectar (which preserves age and enhances physical beauty), by touch. One can even negate said effects at will.
summary: The ability to channel Nectar and Ambrosia's command over the essence of the food and drink of the gods
strengths: Eat the divine delicacies of the Olympians, which taste heavenly (and have rejuvenating properties)
Eaten together, they can bestow temporary immortality (preventing aging, permanent injury and death)
One can turn off the immortalizing effects at will (if a foe gets his hands on it)
weaknesses: Nectar and Ambrosia must BOTH be ingested to achieve the effect of immortality (NCN)
Nectar-and-Ambrosia-Bestowed Immortality only lasts for as long as the power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Blessing and MythPower: Ganymede's Gain allow negation of this ability (NCN)

name: Triforce Of Wisdom
description: You have the triforce of wisdom and this gives you several powers. First, you know everything that is happening around you. Second, you have vast magical powers including healing, magic or even mind control. Third, you mostly make good choices.
summary: The ability to use the triforce of wisdom
strengths: Magic, healing and mind control
Vast wisdom
Make good choices
weaknesses: when you heal you give up your own life
People with the triforce of power may try to take the triforce of wisdom from you

name: Myth Power: Mnemosyne's Memory
description: Mnemosyne, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of memory, remembrance, recollection and language. As such, channeling her allows one to manipulate memory (implanting memories, enhancing memory, distorting memories, erasing them, etc) at will. In addition, the user has total memory of every experience or bit of knowledge he encounters (except anything he WANTS to forget). One can even understand and communicate in all languages (even those of animals, insects, aliens, spirits, machines, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Mnemosyne's command over the essence of memory, remembrance, recollection and language
strengths: Psychically manipulate memories of self and others (implant, enhance, distort, erase, etc) at will
Panmnesia (total recall of every experience one encounters); repress traumatic memories at will
Omnilingualism (ability to understand and communicate in any and all languages)
weaknesses: Cannot survive death as a Living Memory until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Cellular Regain
description: If there is one thing I learned about superpowered heroes (and villains) is that, without their powers, they are almost nothing. So, that is why I made this ability so that, if that actually happens, Cellular Regain would kick in and will return that person's ability to fight once again.
summary: The ability to not lose your other abilities if someone or something drains it.
strengths: You'll never lose your powers.
If the opponent who is draining you holds on, they will either explode or burn out.
This ability works  with inner energy, blood,and genes as well.
weaknesses: You'll never lose all your dangerous powers.
Your opponent could be more powerful if they hold on.
Your opponent could mutate into the form of your powers forever by 20% chance.

name: State Of Zero
description: Attacks, willpower, strength, ability, thoughts, anything can be reset to a point of zero with this power. Enough said.
summary: The ability to reset anything to a point of zero
strengths: No one can take action against you since all their actions return to a point of zero
If you kill someone, their death state is also turned to zero, causing an infinite death loop
This power is very broken
weaknesses: You cannot prevent aging since it will reset your age to zero(You die)

name: Ultimate Tk (Acceleration)
description: A person with this power does not have Time Skip. Instead of erasing time frames, the user merely has the power to make time go faster. The user is unaffected by their own power, they go as fast as time is accelerated. This means that they can move normally while everyone else's reaction time is slow, so people can get run over by cars that are a distance away. Also, the user only ages normally while everyone else ages faster. Also, if the user wanted, they could speed up time till doomsday.
summary: The ability to make time go faster and be unaffected by this power
strengths: People don't notice that time has gone faster-their reaction is the same as when time is normal
You can be unaffected by this power-you move as fast as the time you speed up
Extremely powerful if placed in the right hands
weaknesses: People don't notice that time sped up until you tell them
Mess with the world time and annoy physicists
A person who wants to destroy the world can simply speed everything up to doomsday

name: Artistic Precognition
description: People have always needed to know what will happen next. A Precognitive can induce visions of the future, which they will experience as if they were watching it themselves. However, many users find it difficult to remember all or part of these visions. So once they enter the trance, they will usually pick up their most familiar art tool available and will begin recording the vision while still in the state. This might be a painting, a sketch, a literary work, a whittling or even a musical piece.
summary: The ability to predict the future through artistic media
strengths: Get hired as a consultant for almost any company
Totally voluntary
The phrase "I whittles the future" never gets old
weaknesses: Might see a very unpleasant future
May become a bit of a control freak
If you predict the future on a musical instrument

name: Bone Claws
description: The bone claws are unbreakable and they can cut through anything. So if you are a good guy you can tear someone's face up. If you are a bad guy you can cut into a bank vault. But there is a catch. if you don't have a healing ability you will have a lot of scars. Also, it will hurt really really badly (you'll get used to it).
summary: The ability to make unbreakable bone claws come out of your saces between your knuckles
strengths: Looks wicked cool
They are unbreakable
Can cut through anything
weaknesses: It hurts
Takes a while for skin to heal

name: Perspectivation
description: You can make people see the cause for revenge against someone, or make the reason clear why you like something, or someone. Basically people would know how you feel about a situation.
summary: The ability to make people understand things the way you see it.
strengths: Could gain allies from people who understand.
Assure someone of something you're gonna do.
Make someone know a decision's reason, but not when you change your mind.
weaknesses: People will know exactly what you feel, so you can't lie.
May make people hate you for the way you see something.
Hard to control and may allow people to predict your decisions.

name: Love Nerd
description: This ability know what turns on anyone. This ability will make you never fail with the ladies or men. You just think of someone in an affectionate way and you'll know exactly what attracts them. Although that's all it does, it only makes people attracted to you when your doing the things they like.
summary: The ability to know what attracts anyone
strengths: Never fail with a lover.
Always know what people like in other people.
weaknesses: Doesn't really help you with bad guys
There not really attracted with the real you.

name: Spirit Helper
description: With this power you get a spirit helper. A spirit helper is a ghost like thing that can go inside of you and sort of possess you though you both can control your body. While the spirit is in you, you are stronger, fast and can fly. You are also immune to mind control, telepathic and psychic based attacks and powers due to you having multiple personalities in your body. You also cannot be possessed by an evil spirt even if your spirit is not inside of you. Your spirit can also only possess you.
summary: The ability to have a spirit helper/sidekick
strengths: You have a spirit helper
You are stronger, faster, can fly and are immune to psychic, telepathic and mind control attacks
You cannot be possess by another spirit even if your spirit helper is not inside of you
weaknesses: Your spirit helper can take full control of your body but only in extreme cases
If you die your spirit helper can take control of your body (not necessarily a bad thing)

name: Allpower Time
description: Ever wanted a particular power, but could never find it? You knew there was a time when all were available, but it was just as elusive. Well, with this power, you will sense when the time is active.
summary: The ability to sense when all powers are available on the superpower list.
strengths: Always gain a power you want.
Help your friends on the site too.
Harmless, so nobody will fear you.
weaknesses: You may not have site access at the time.
You need to acquire this power first, which puts you in a Catch-22 position.
People may nag you for the time.

name: On A Dimensional Scale
description: This ability changes a power so it is on a dimensional scale. Ex. Telepathy on a dimensional scale.
summary: The ability to alter a power so it is on a dimensional scale.
strengths: Larger area to use a power.
weaknesses: Only one power.
Can only be used once (Cannot be reversed)

name: Gravity Perception
description: Also called Gravitational Energy Perception, Gravity Sense, Gravity Perception, Gravimetry, Baroception or Barognosis, this is the ability to perceive the flux, intensity and flow of gravity, and alterations to such. This perception lets the user sense disturbances in gravitational fields made by movement, as well as sensing the size, shape, weight and density of objects without having to see them; the user can even sense how to maneuver to effectively DEFY gravity, to mimic Superhuman Agility.
summary: The ability to perceive the effects of gravity in one's immediate area
strengths: Sense movements by perceiving disturbances in gravitational fields
Sense the presence, shape, weight and density of objects around you without having to see them
Sense how to effectively maneuver to appear to have Superhuman Agility
weaknesses: Doesn't work in low/no-gravity situations
Especially sensitive to when people alter gravity (may be disorienting)
Maneuvering to defy gravity only comes at the higher bands of ability development

name: Wolf Hybrid
description: If you are a wolf hybrid you would be part human, part wolf. You would have mostly the bone structure of a human, but your skull might be shaped more after a wolf's. You would have most (or all) of a wolfs abilities.
summary: The ability to be part wolf and gain part (or all) of a wolf's abilities
strengths: You would have a much farther developed sense of smell
You could jump far and run at great speeds
You would have the nails (and the teeth if your face is like a wolfs) of a wolf.
weaknesses: Your ability can't 'turn off' it would be a perminent part of your chemical make-up
You would be furry and have a tail. (though in some cases considered adorable)
You would have a much higher temper, it would be easy to anger you

name: Card Stack Abilities: Ace
description: Access the powers of the elemental spirit of consciousness and control the spiritual realm. You can turn your physical body into an astral one and possess creatures. Break through the toughest mental bariers and rewrite the memories and personalities of your enemies. If your feeling particularly nasty, rip out the spirit of a creature and decide whether or not you want to give it back its body. Summon spirits of the dead back into their former bodies and control them.
summary: The ability to have complete control over the spiritual realm
strengths: Saying hello to your great great great grandfather whenever you want.
Possess people and make them do whatever you want
Avoid physical injury by switching into an astral form.
weaknesses: A spirit binder or ghost hunters
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Collective Noun Creation
description: A herd of elephants,a troop of gorillas or a howling of werewolves. If you can find the collective noun for a creature somewhere(the internet,a book)you can bring a average-sized group of that creature into existence. The group of creatures obeys you. You can only have one group at a time. What you create still has any traditional weaknesses. Your coven of vampires is still affected by sunlight and also affected by undead control powers.
summary: The ability to bring the collective noun for a creature into existence.
strengths: There are many useful animals that have collective nouns.
There are collective nouns for mythical creatures... A dignity of dragons.
Yes,you can create a crowd of people.
weaknesses: There's more collective nouns for natural animals than mythical ones.

name: Animal Merging
description: You can merge your biology with any one animal & become an animal/humanoid hybrid. You will take on the animal's characteristics. It only lasts for an hour & your animal side might start to take over.
summary: The ability to merge with any animal
strengths: Merge with any animal
Take on their characteristics
weaknesses: Only lasts for a hour
Animal side might take over

name: The Maze
description: Creates a magical maze that traps anyone you want to trap. Cheating is impossible because the maze's walls can detect any thoughts of cheating. The only way to get out is to find the exit, which is almost too impossible to find. The maze is not visible in the naked eyes of people outside the maze.
summary: The ability to create a magical maze to trap anyone you want to trap
strengths: Can save you from killing the people you hate the most.
weaknesses: You cannot disperse the maze.

name: Decision Redirection
description: One with this ability can change the current decision(s) of others to the opposite. For example, a foe is deciding if he should stay and face one in combat, one simply changes his mind to run away from the user. The major flaw of this ability is that one cannot know what decisons another object is going over or cannot change "spur of the moment" decisons.
summary: The ability to change whatever a subject's current decison to the opposite
strengths: Can stop someone from fighting you.
Stop others from thinking the wrong thing.
weaknesses: Can stop possibly good decisons
Cannot read minds
"Spur of the Moment" decisions, decision without thinking.

name: Time To Die
description: With this ability you can look at any living organism and see it's life span. You will be able to see exactly when, where, and how someone or something will die.
summary: The ability to see exactly when and how someone or something will die.
strengths: You will know when anything will die
You will know how long you have to prevent the death, if you want too
You will know what you should do to prevent the death, if you want too
weaknesses: You cannot know learn your own fate
You might upset the natural balance sooner or later
If you did look at your own timeline somehow, you'd die right after you're done looking

name: Pencil Based Powers.
description: This power allows you to turn your entire body into a mixture of metal and wood for defense and still have the same freedom of movement you had before. For creation you can produce diamond-hard lead spikes and projectiles out of your body and you can create black shapes of objects as if they had been drawn. For deletion you can create a pink rubber material that absorbs forces or energy (which you can reshape) or create a pink energy that breaks apart atoms.
summary: The ability to have a metal/wood body and have powers based on creation and deletion.
strengths: Have a metal / wood body.
Can produce lead weapons and black drawings that act like the real thing.
Can make rubber barriers and pink energy that deletes objects.
weaknesses: Takes more power and control to use black drawings and pink energy.
The black drawings are not as strong as the real things.
The pink energy works slowly unless you concentrate a lot of power in one area.

name: Lydian Tunic
description: When activated, the Lydian Tunic can glow light green & illuminated, can use it to put a force field around yourself which causes projectiles to be redirectly move back at your opponent, can block all kinds of attacks, but it can be extremely light and/or very heavy for someone else to use. Pretty effective against weapons of any kind.
summary: The ability to use it to have defensive invulnerable protection.
strengths: It could grant you extreme durability & enhanced strength.
weaknesses: It can be harmed by dark magic or even psychic attacks.

name: Frieza Forms
description: With this power, as your power grows, you are able to turn into different forms, created by your imagination.
summary: The ability to be able to become a different form as your power grows.
strengths: Create different forms.
weaknesses: Other than a different look, it is nothing different.
No real combat use.......

name: Dimension Destination Control
description: Within 100 feet of you someone dimension traveling will go to a dimension of your choice. You can mentally preset this dimension or change it at will. This power also effects those traveling to other planes or alternate universes. Anyone who possesses the power PA:Ithuari is immune to this power. A few dimensions are off limits for this power (No con negation).
summary: The ability to control where someone goes when they dimension travel.
strengths: Decide where (universe, plane, dimension) dimension traveler goes.
Ergi, the dimension where it's 11 billion degrees.
weaknesses: You can't send anyone to Nameless(i.e. the power PA:Nameless).

name: Soul Animorphic Hidden Power
description: This ability unlocks the seal that keeps your soul from unleashing those unknown abilities you have been holding onto and have been unable to use. These abilities are limited and based off of your personality and feelings.
summary: The ability to unleash your inner soul's animal abilities
strengths: Have the enhanced abilities of the animal you resemble the most
Ability to heal over time
Allows your stamina to be so enhanced you can fight for a week
weaknesses: Activates only when in a desperate situation
May have unknown side effects such as memory loss
May become uncontrollable and those around that you care for may get hurt

name: Angel Power: Angel's Sword
description: This power allows you to channel the mighty sword that every angel wields. At will, you can call to your possession a mighty, three-and-a-half-foot-long sword. This sword can not only cut through anything, but it can change into any type of bladed weapon: two-handed broadsword, longsword, shortsword, dagger, throwing knife, hunting knife, shuriken, butter knife, whatever. In fact, if you need it to, it can even turn into a shield of the desired size, to protect as well as attack.
summary: The ability to channel the sword of an angel
strengths: Sword can cut through nearly anything (and can be recalled to your possession at will)
Can change to a sword or bladed weapon of any size (to fit one's personal strength, or preference)
Can also change into a shield of any size, and (when developed) even armor
weaknesses: Can't cut through divine materials (can't pierce the robe of an angel, or similar materials)
If you try to use it to harm an innocent, it'll phase through them (then teleport away from you)
If you try to use it against an angel, the sword will teleport from your possession to the angel's

name: Animal Splicer
description: This ability takes two or more animals and combine their DNA to make a new organism. Anything is possible, just be creative. Once this creature is created, it listens to any command you say.
summary: The ability to take two or more animals and combine them into one organism, giving you control over it.
strengths: Transportation is easy
It requires no tools in doing this, just your hands
You have an army of creatures to do your bidding
weaknesses: If no animal is in sight then this power is not activated

name: Gaze Of The Mischief
description: The toughest warriors, the coldest women, none are left behind by the gaze. All and truly all within the gaze commence to misbehave as soon as you activate your gaze. Thieving, fighting, childish behaviour and naughty actions will be unavoidable. Be warned the effects are temporary and if you use it to much on someone, they will become devious forever.
summary: The ability to make anyone within your sight misbehave and be naughty.
strengths: No need to fight, just look at some people and flee while your enemy is destracted.
All are effected so don't be surprised if one who is normally far to serious becomes a grown child.
The gaze is only temporary, when used in moderation the subjects are returned to their normal state.
weaknesses: People might want to kill you while under the gaze.
People who are recovered could hold you responsible for their deeds.
People who are hit by the gaze multiple times a day will experience side effects.

name: Holy Power: God Of Speed
description: With this power you can become faster than light for 3 seconds, making you fast enough to kill entire armies before your time runs out. When you are faster than the light, 3 seconds is enough to do a lot of things, like killing an entire army, then take a shower, eat some cake and write a book with 500 pages before the 3 seconds time end.
summary: The ability to become faster than the light for 3 seconds.
strengths: You become really, really, really fast.
With this power, you have enough time for putting your superhero clothes on before saving the day.
weaknesses: This power makes you tired, and you can only use it 2 times a day.
Only Tormentors can use this power.

name: Gaze Of Contempt
description: A sort of reality warping that allows you to project your willing suspension of disbelief onto the world. While it will not depower anyone, it will prevent powers you find to be ludicrous or logically incoherent from affecting you directly. You may still be harmed by secondary affects (e. G. A building falling over, etc)
summary: The ability to ignore any superpower you personally deem to be stupid.
strengths: Humiliating defeats will be a thing of the past.
Power through annoying novelty midbosses like a hot knife through butter.
weaknesses: Silver age superheroes will think you're a jerk.

name: Exemptedness
description: This power causes you to be exempted from a plethora of things. You could be exempted from laws and be a villain or be exempted from movement and literaly be unmovable. You can also make yourself exempted from fire or other elements. A bad feature is that you can make yourself exempted from types of damage, but not from damage itself, and powers like regeneration block can still get to you if you are not careful. You can declare yourself exempted from the laws of physics.
summary: The ability to be exempted from many things.
strengths: Be exempted from space to travel quickly.
If you turn evil and become exempted from perception, specific powers can still find you.
Youre levelheaded friends with anti telepathy or such still know when you do bad.
weaknesses: Not exempted from most superpowers, mostly just from what they can do.
Not exempted from natural stupidity, also takes practice to master.
These three cons can't be fixed by con negator or flaw removal.

name: Tactile Career Match
description: With this superpower, you instantly know what the perfect job is for any person you meet just by shaking their hand. You don't need to know anything about them, not even their name. Just by shaking their hand you instatly match their skills to the perfect occupation or career. However, it doesn't work on yourself.
summary: The ability to instantly match any person to their perfect career
strengths: You'd make a great career advisor
You're always 100% correct
You could make a lot of money with this power
weaknesses: It doesn't work on yourself
You can't switch it off
Some people might not be happy to hear they're in the wrong job

name: Displaced Existence In Time
description: Ever been on something like a long car trip and wish you could skip straight to the destination? With this power, you can! Activating this power will displace your soul from your present body and into your future body. You can choose the time your soul re-inhabits your body, and the time passes in the blink of an eye. And whenever you go to sleep next, your soul will travel back to the time of activation and relive the lost time as a dream. No one will notice a thing!
summary: The ability to 'skip' certain periods of time, and relive them later.
strengths: Skip long, boring events
While reliving the events as a dream, you act exactly as you would've normally
No one notices, and the time passes instantly for you
weaknesses: The length of your time-skip will reflect exactly how long you sleep.
You will not be able to wake up until you have completed your lost hours of time.

name: Tag
description: There are some people who are so charismatic that they are universally loved. And then there's that one guy who everone hates. Tag excites these general feelings around a person you designate, amping them up to the point where they either beat him mercessily or they deify him.
summary: The ability to make a person loved or despised by touching them
strengths: Help someone out who deserves it
Beat someone down who deserves it
Cause a distraction
weaknesses: Temporary
Cannot be used on yourself
Person who is touched feels a small shock

name: Icicle Control
description: You can create and control icicles out of the water floating in the air(humidity). The icicles will last as long as you want them too and will melt when you don't care about whether they are there or not. The icicles will be as hard as normal icicles are.
summary: The ability to create and control icicles
strengths: Untraceable kills because the icicle melts.
Last as long as you need them.
weaknesses: Only icicles.

name: Elemental Weapon: Fire Sword
description: With this ability, you can call to you a sword engulfed in flame. With it you can slash away foes and increase heat. It can also manipulate and control fire; you can shoot fire blasts and beams with the sword. Also you are immune to the effects of fire while wielding the sword.
summary: The ability to wield a sword that controls the fire element
strengths: Control and manipulate all fire (ones you generate, and already lit fires)
Can slash away at enemies with an awesome sword engulfed in flames
weaknesses: The sword controls fire, not you
Only immune to effects of fire, while wielding the sword
Your elemental weakness is water

name: Intimidation
description: Rodney Dangerfield once said, 'I don't get no respect.' A person with Intimidation never has that problem. No matter their age, weight, or gender, they can consciously intimidate the people around them. The user can only affect people who see them, and it is more powerful the fewer people there are.
summary: The ability to cause feelings of fear and discomfort
strengths: Get some respect
Work your way to the top more easily
Completely voluntary, can 'flip the switch'
weaknesses: Cannot affect a crowd efficiently
Can be resisted
Can be blocked by closing your eyes

name: Numbing Point
description: With this power you can cause a person's entire body to become numb just by pointing at them. You can not limit the numbing effect to certain parts of the body and the victim only stays numb while you're pointing at them.
summary: The ability to cause a person's entire body to become numb as long as you're pointing at them
strengths: You can make people numb by pointing at them
weaknesses: You can not limit the effect to certain parts of the victim's body
They only remain numb while you're pointing at them
It happens whenever you point at someone

name: Meteorbolt
description: The enemy doesn't stand a chance when you summon a meteor that is covered in thunderbolts. It comes down on him/her really fast and hard, and will fry them.
summary: The ability to summon a huge lightning covered meteorite.
strengths: Brutal power to have.
Massive damage
weaknesses: Strange and brutal power to have.
Difficult to control & Collateral damge
Enemy might push you in its path

name: Abacomancy
description: Abacomancy is a method of divination using small particles (Sand, Dust, Ash, Etc.) An Abacomancer merely waves a hand over some dust/sand and it rearranges itself into a pattern that tells the future. More sand/dust means "seeing" further into the future. This power is very unspecific in what information it gives you; you may get anything from useless to bizarre. The better you are at Abacomancy, the more useful the information you get. For obvious reasons, this power works well in deserts.
summary: The ability to divine the future through sand, dust, and ash.
strengths: Can get information about the future.
Can work on dusty things, sand, or even the remains of campfires.
The patterns are unique to each person, like a fingerprint.
weaknesses: May give you really weird things like, "There are 3 millon grasshoppers on the continent".
Can't be used without small particles.
Takes time and effort to decipher the patterns.

name: Think Wings
description: With this power you can give people or animals wings with your mind all you have to do is think of the desired person or animal with wings
summary: The ability to give people or animals wings with your mind
strengths: You can give your friends the ability to fly
weaknesses: You can't take away their wings once you give it to them
Does not work on birds
You can't give yourself wings

name: Synesthetic Inundation
description: One with this ability should use it carefully. Also called Synesthetic Overload, it allows the listener to hear the sound the user produces, but also makes them perceive it as visible light. In effect, when the user screams, he not only produces loud (not sonic, but loud) sound, he also produces blindingly-bright light in the foe's sight range. This effect can often be turned off at will.
summary: The ability to induce a synesthetic overload of the senses
strengths: Your scream can be a weapon without it being sonic in capacity
Induce synesthesia in others, ONLY for the purpose of them being blinded by your voice
Can be turned off at will
weaknesses: If the power CAN'T be turned off at will, makes conversation VERY awkward
Only affects beings that can hear
Covering the ears protects one from this ability, but also blinds them until power is turned off

name: Catharsis
description: Also called Purgation or Purging, this is the ability to purge the body of all ills at will. All the user needs to do is inhale deeply, and when he breathes out, any bodily impurities are sublimated (changed into a gas) and released from the body. One with this ability can breathe out viruses, bacteria, stresses (stress-inducing hormones) or the like. This improves the speed of recovery from sickness, or even inflict said impurity on others.
summary: The ability to breathe out impurities
strengths: Breathe out all your stresses, diseases and viruses at will
Helps speed up healing process
Inflict the exhaled impurities on others
weaknesses: Cannot breathe out stresses until they build up immensely
Aniothability can allow user to resist being afflicted with exhaled stresses
Immunity can allow user to resist being allficted with exhaled diseases/viruses

name: Temporal Transformation
description: When the user transforms time will either stop or will be slowed down. It's basically like how the characters from Sailor Moon or Winx Club do transformations and the enemy seems not to move at all until their finished transforming.
summary: The ability to freeze or slow down time during a transformation
strengths: Time slows or stops during transformation
weaknesses: Time Defiance or other time powers can interfere with this

name: Antithesis Mimic
description: With this power, you can become the antithesis of anyone you meet. For example, if you meet a super lazy person, you can use this power and become a super smart and organized version of the same person and vice-versa. If you copied someone while they were weak but they later became strong, you can access both versions of the same person. You have limited control over the copied person's personality. Copying a hero will turn you into an anti-hero, and if not careful, a villain.
summary: The ability to become the antithesis of any person or being you know
strengths: This power can show people their possibilities
Limited disguise since you look the same (most of the time) but have different strength/control
weaknesses: You also have the good attributes reversed too-if you copy a good person you will become evil/darker
The antithesis can only copy powers that a person had at the time that you met them

name: Myth Power: Oreithyia's Order
description: Oreithyia (Orithyia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sharp, cold mountain winds. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate cold winds at will. In addition, one may induce the feeling of frostbite in living things by a touch. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport self and others to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
summary: The ability to channel Oreithyia's command over the essence of mountain winds
strengths: Generate and manipulate cold winds at will; induce frostbite in living creatures by a touch
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
weaknesses: Cannot teleport foes to mountaintops and immobilize them there until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Way of the Winds and MythPower: Horae (Seasons) provide immunity
Cold Immunity provides immunity

name: The Strength Of Goodwill
description: The more goodwill people feel towards you, the stronger, tougher and faster you become. Distance is not a factor. There is no limit to how many people or to whether or not they are human. Billions of intelligent beings in the universe means a billion times amplification for your powers.
summary: The ability to be more powerful through the goodwill of those who believe in you.
strengths: Near infinite speed, toughness and strength.
weaknesses: Mr. Lonely. No time off. Billions of people who want help.
Must maintain a perfect public image at all times.

name: Punch Invulnerability
description: Whenever you get punched, it leaves no damage or pain.
summary: The ability to be invulnerability to punches
strengths: Great in fight
weaknesses: Doesn't help if you get kicked
Bad wrestler
Mostly useless

name: Focus Attraction
description: Focus Attraction is the ability to select someone and centre their focus on yourself or an object, causing them to be obsessed with the object as long as you hold concentration.
summary: The ability to attract all focus on to something.
strengths: Can stop someone from attacking by changing their focus.
Cause someone to be obsessed with you or someone else.
While they're focused you can attack them and they will not respond as long as you hold it.
weaknesses: Not offensive.
Only affects one person at a time.

name: Solitary Sphere
description: Sphere is formed by hands and is made up of dark energy. A person hit by the sphere enters a deep coma and catatonic state. Once in coma the person is trapped in darkness and while a hour passes it wouls seem like one year.
summary: The ability to trap a person in his consinse
strengths: Perfect defense
Sphere absorbs other powers
Also used as explosive
weaknesses: Uses lots of energy
Effects are not permanent
Does not work on people that also use darness as a power ect. Cloak

name: Myth Power: Galene's Grace
description: Galene, in Greek myth, was the goddess of calm seas, and calm weather at sea. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically still any body of water (keep water from being manipulated by hydrokinesis, etc) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically calm storms at sea (and on other bodies of water), at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere where the sea is calm, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Galene's command over the essence of calm seas
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically still any body of water at will; psychically calm storms on any body of water, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport self/others to anywhere the water is calm
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and command sea creatures, until developed (NCN)
Cannot calm the 'sea' of 'stormy' emotions, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige provides immunity and allows disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Warning Label Maker
description: Think of a object within visual range. Image a warning label on it. A warning appears on it and affects the object according to what you imagined on the label. Ex. You could put on a enemy's city-destroying laser that was just finished "must be on without firing for 3 months or laser will explode. " This power can make harmless things harmful(i. E. A cylinder of nitrogen gas with the right warning into something like nerve gas). Any label is made out of normal material.
summary: The ability to create a warning label on an inanimate object, affecting it by what's written on the label.
strengths: With the right warning label you could change something.
Sabotage.
Superpowers could make a warning label unremovable and nearly indestructible.
weaknesses: Only affects inanimate objects.
Without superpower protection a warning label is easily removed or destroyed.

name: Transformation: Sticky Thing
description: The user is able to transform his or her form into a translucent , liquid sticky substance that can stop any projectile, like bullets or medium velocity projectiles that are thrown by enemies.
summary: The ability to change his or her whole body into a sticky substance
strengths: A good defensive power
The sticky substance can be used to ensnare enemies
weaknesses: Might get ridiculed by the public

name: Pandoran Nightmare
description: Every night when you sleep, you have a vivid, detailed nightmare depicting the worst even that will occur in the world the following day. This will continue to happen every night until the day you die. The dream will be detailed enough to accurately figure out what exactly will happen, where it will happen and when.
summary: The ability to have a prophetic dream every night of the most terrible thing that will happen the following day.
strengths: You can prevent major loss of life through early warnings.
You could change the course of history for the better.
weaknesses: Sleep will become an inescapable hell.
The establishment might just write you off as some kind of loony street preacher.
No matter how hard you work to prevent the distaster it will only have been one out of many.

name: Gorgon's Touch
description: This power allows you to turn anything you touch into a brittle stone that can break if hit. It is possible to turn something you turned to stone back to its previous form, but it causes immense drain on your own energy.   You can also control how fast the thing transforms, allowing for instant transformation or incredibly slow.
summary: The ability to turn anything into stone that you physically touch.
strengths: Can break through anything.
Can turn even living things to stone
Can control what is turned to stone (so you don't accidentally turn your friend to a statue)
weaknesses: Can't undo power if the item that was transformed was broken.

name: Zodiac: Scorpio
description: By drawing the sign of Scorpio in the air, you can fire off telepathic blasts that poison your enemy's mind with doubts as to why they are fighting. They will question what it is they fight for and whether or not your side would be better. This can lead to a massive loss in morale for ordinary troops. This effect lasts for two minutes and blasts are fired in sets of one per second.
summary: The ability to poison your enemy's mind(s) with doubts
strengths: Get rid of enemies fast.
Can gain alies from enemy side.
weaknesses: Can accidentally reinforce an enemy's resolve.
Are required to draw the sign of Scorpio.
Con Negation and similar powers don't work on this power.

name: Wind Perception
description: Wind Energy Perception or Wind Perception is the ability to perceive the flow and flux of the wind, and its direction; it also allows one to perceive things being carried by the wind, or that affect the flow of wind; it may even allow one to eavesdrop on conversations by listening to voices being carried by the wind (and otherwise mimic Superhuman Hearing), or allow one to mimic Superhuman Smell by honing in on scents carried by wind
summary: The ability to perceive the flow and intensity of the wind
strengths: Sense the flow, direction and intensity of the wind
Sense things being carried by the wind (including the approach of storm clouds)
Mimic Superhuman Smell and Superhuman Hearing by honing in on the wind
weaknesses: Sometimes you see only see the wind as color (and can't hone in on scents or sounds)
Sometimes your power to smell the wind is really strong (honing in on scents is disorienting)
Sometimes your power to hear the wind is really strong (honing in on sounds is disorienting)

name: Children Of The Virus
description: You are Child of the Virus. You have a razor sharp tongue. You also have sharp claws that are coated with the virus. You don't get nutrition from regular food, but you feed off people. Every person you infect you feed off of their life force psychically until it runs out. There is no limit to people you can infect. The more people you infect the stronger you get. Also those that are infected have to do whatever you say. If you get hurt you can heal by eating your infected's life force.
summary: The ability to infect people by scratching them or cutting them with a whip-like tongue, and control the infected
strengths: Be invincible by infecting many
Slice enemies in half with your long toungue
Heal yourself by eating a large amount of your infected's life force
weaknesses: Basically you have to slowly kill people to live and become strong
You have to come into contact with someone to infect them

name: Animal Shift
description: With this power you can turn one animals into another one, you can turn cows into zebras, dogs into cats etc. You can change the species of a single animal as many times as you want. You cannot use this power on humans - super or not - or aliens.
summary: The ability to turn animals into other animals
strengths: You can change the species of animals
weaknesses: This power has no effect on humans, aliens or superhumans

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Dragon
description: With this power you can turn into a dragon with two heads. One of your dragon heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. In addition to that you are super strong, can fly and have sharp teeth in both of your mouths. You cannot speak English in this form only the language of the dragons.
summary: The ability to turn into a two headed dragon
strengths: You can turn into a two headed dragon.
You can fly.
You can breathe fire and ice.
weaknesses: You can only speak the language of the dragons in this form.

name: Living Toys
description: With this power, you can bring any of your toys to life (including ones that don't have faces or human/animal characteristics, such as Slinkys, toy cars, stuffed animal hot dogs etc. ) Once alive, however, the toys are not under your control but you can turn them back to normal toys when you're done with them. This power only affects toys that are owned by you, not just any toy you see.
summary: The ability to bring your toys to life
strengths: You can bring your toys to life.
weaknesses: They are not under your control.
The toy has to be owned by you.

name: Absolute Perspective
description: You've had the worst day ever. You feel like you're starving. You're the luckiest man alive. Are you though? When faced with situations where you feel like this, this power allows you to gain a global perspective, flashing up thoughts, images and emotions of people who are *really* happy, *really* lucky, or *really* hurting. Allows for completely realistic rationality, but will likely leave you emotionally shell shocked.
summary: The ability to perfectly put situations into a global perspective.
strengths: Be completely realistic and rational in your thinking.
Rejoice with those people who are *truly* happy.
Could spur you on to help people who are actually starving etc.
weaknesses: Would drain you to keep seeing *really* bad situations.
Anything you achieve would be put into perspective, likely showing how meaningless it is.
Could find it hard to empathise with people complaining about how bad their lives are.

name: Aqua Cage
description: This ability allows you to create a water sphere to entrap your enemy. Once the opponent is trapped, the water sphere will solidify and shatter into millions of shards along with the trapped opponent. The Water Sphere originates from your hands as a small sphere at first. You have to throw the sphere at your opponent and it will turn big.
summary: The ability to create a sphere of water to trap your opponent
strengths: Can trap multiple opponents at once
weaknesses: Can be dodged
Requires your hands in order to form

name: Fighting Words
description: Any combat-related word that you use (like punch, kick, jump, etc.) will affect your foe in the way that you speak ('kicked' people will feel as though they were kicked, etc.); this is awesome, but can also be a downer; you can't control it, or turn it off or on; so you are stuck with it for life. ANY combat word you say will affect people (unless you direct it at a certain person, it'll affect everyone in radius).
summary: The ability to use your words to fight
strengths: Doesnt take a lot of energy
Only have to say words
Good to have big mouth
weaknesses: If you go hoarse it doesnt work
Cant turn it off
Doesn't work if you cant pronounce the word

name: Hacker's Touch
description: Hackers are people who are extremely curious, sneaking into people's lives and learning everything they can, but they never use this information to their advantage. You have the Hacker's Touch. Whenever you touch someone with your bare hands (only works with your hands), you can learn everything about them besides their future. The limitation is, if you use this to your advantage, you will lose the ability and the information. However, you can use this ability to help the person you learn about.
summary: The ability to have the Hacker's Touch.
strengths: Learn things easily.
Satisfy curiosity.
Can help others.
weaknesses: Can't take advantage of the information.
Have to wear gloves to avoid accidental contact.

name: Sacrificial Superiority
description: At will the user's speed, strength, and dexterity multiply. It can be done only a little (x2) or a lot (x10). However much the user powers up, though, is the level of strain on their bodies. Unless they are very seasoned in this ability then the higher levels, such as x10 or higher, can kill them if they use it for too long. The most famous user of this ability was none other than King Arthur, who, according to legend, once successfully used x20 in combat.
summary: The ability to enhance your speed, strength, and dexterity at the cost of physical strain
strengths: The user's overall performance can multiply well beyond normal measures.
weaknesses: A strain on the body; lower levels barely wind the user, though higher levels may cause injury.

name: Non Fractal Invulnerability
description: Kinetic damage from non-fractal matter has no effect on you.
summary: The ability to be immune to any non-fractal kinetic damage.
strengths: Nigh invulnerability to most kinetic attacks.
weaknesses: Fractal damage could still cut you to ribbons.

name: Human Hurricane
description: This power requires a great deal of focus and energy to be used. When activated, a gravitation field surrounds the user, the radius of which is adjustable. Any objects pulled into the field will begin to spin around the user while remaining a set distance away. It takes more focus to rotate the objects faster, and even the best of users would only be able to maintain the field for about a minute before collapsing. Once the field is down, all objects will keep their speed, and are sent flying.
summary: The ability to create a potent orbital field of varying size and rotational speed around the user
strengths: Can easily destroy just about any interior locations.
With very precise focus, different objects can be rotated at different speeds within the field.
While in use, the user is protected by a kinetic barrier a few inches from their body.
weaknesses: Takes a lot of energy to use.
User becomes very drained for a time after use (about ten times the total time the power is active).
Limited functionality.

name: Double Helix
description: The elements can be from the periodic table (oxygen, helium, hydrogen, plutonium, etc) and/or the traditional elements (fire, water, wind, ice, etc). The elements can be changed as needed. Either way, they will rotate around like a double helix. Radius for the helix is half a metre.
summary: The ability to take one or two elements and create a a rotating double helix with them
strengths: The two elements can also be used to augment other powers.
Ex: Oxygen can make fires larger.
weaknesses: Some might think it looks weird.

name: Blade Edge Rotating
description: The result of rotating the edge of the blade is that it can cut through objects more easily than a normal blade. A side effect is that the rotating edge also gains molecular teeth like what is on a saw. The rotation goes around the sharp edge then before it reaches the hilt at the handguard it completes the circuit so that no molecules or atoms are lost from the blade.
summary: The ability to cause the edge of a blade to spin like a chainsaw
strengths: Makes it several times easier to cut through things.
weaknesses: Noone can see or hear anything different so it appears as if nothing is happening until you cut.

name: Delta Darts
description: You can throw darts that are charged with powder blue energy at your opponent that'll leave them temporarily paralyzed.
summary: The ability to fire darts at a speed of light to your foes.
strengths: Can even humiliate and/or beat your foe while they are stunned.
weaknesses: Won't work when they have their force fields or armor on.

name: Continue
description: This power requires something to happen first, but once it has it can be continued. Submisiveness or ignorance broadcasted over video can be continued. Other "Continues" are damage, healing, change, replication. You can continue a state of something, emotions, thoughts, actions, and forces such as change, damage and traumas
summary: The ability to cause things to continue through this power.
strengths: Prolong an existing effect.
Creative people love this.
Continue pumpkin pie for years or damage for hours.
weaknesses: Self protection & reality changing powers (Unbendable will, Power of Imagination) break Continues.
Cons can't be negated
The harder Continues are, the shorter it can be continued

name: Syringe Manifestation
description: With this ability, you can materialize a syringe filled with a virus. The virus responds to your will and can be easily programmed to cause any effect simply by thinking it. Once injected into a person, the effect begins to take place in the time designated by how you imagined it. Any physical effect can be caused by the virus, including but not limited to illness/curing cancer/transformation/brain washing. The effects do not wear off and are not affected by immune systems.
summary: The ability to create syringes filled with magical reality-bending viruses.
strengths: Control people's bodies entirely through injections.
Cure cancer.
Use it on yourself to give yourself physical-based superpowers like super strength.
weaknesses: Once the virus manifests itself for one use, the needle can be used against you.
Once injected, you will have to administer another dose if you wish to change the transformation.
Some transformations may turn out wrong and you may be overcome with guilt.

name: Emotional Ego Trip
description: With the power of each personality, you could control different powers with vast emotions. However, due to your multiple personalities and potential, you can possess different powers and some of your abilites and personalities are as follows: fiery rage - zorn, cold cruelty - gene fezirk, waterly joy - acre, electric awe - tonnerre, god mode - victory, psychic lust - adan, optimismistic terrakinesis - manearth, envious toxics - eve, and enthrallment of light and dark - libra.
summary: The ability to possess different powers and personalities inspired by your emotions.
strengths: Your enemies will get confused.
weaknesses: It can only last up to 144 hours.
Your condition will grow bad to worse when you grow older.

name: Alphabetical Name Based Powers
description: If you had this power, and went to the superpowerlist.com, and clicked the "explore" button, and clicked "A-Z", and found the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name, then you would have thet power. For example, my name is "Niko", so I would get "Nightmare Manipulator" because that's the closest superpower to my name alphabetically.
summary: The ability to get the superpower that's alphabetically closest to your name on the superpowerlist.com
strengths: Might get an awesome power
weaknesses: Might get a stupid power

name: Measure Control
description: If you were to hold a clock then you can control time. Holding a thermometer gives you control of hot and cold and a ruler the ability to control size.
summary: The ability to when you hold a measuring tool, control what it measures
strengths: You can control many types of measurements
weaknesses: You must hold measuring tools

name: Soulerite (Diamond Metal)
description: Pure Soulerite is as hard as diamond and also boosts the power of soul-based powers. Alloys that are at least 50% Soulerite have the hardness and the effectiveness of the boost is at least one-fourth that of pure Soulerite. In an alloy with less than 50% Soulerite, the alloy will retain the hardness but lose the boost to soul-based powers. If the percentage of Soulerite becomes less than 40% though the alloy's toughness will start to drop fast.
summary: The ability to create and control a metal that has the hardness of diamond
strengths: Soulerite is really hard to break and can be turned into weapons.
weaknesses: Making alloys of Soulerite can be ineffective.
10% Soulerite in an alloy is not much better than steel.

name: Alien Language Translator
description: With this power you can translate any alien language. This is useful is you're trying to talk to aliens in order to make peace or just to make conversation.
summary: The ability to translate any alien language
strengths: You can talk to any aliens
weaknesses: Only works with aliens you don't necessarily know all the languages of your planet
Doesn't work with animals

name: Lateral Line System
description: Similar to the lateral organs possessed by most fish and some amphibians, this adaptation is a must for all aquatic beings.  Being able to detect the movement and vibrations of the water around you allows you to orientate yourself in relation to water currents, avoid collisions, detect predators and prey (or the positions of friend or foes), and, if applicable, assist in schooling behavior.
summary: The ability to detect movement and vibrations in the water
strengths: Detect approaching foes (or prankish friends) trying to surprise you in the water
Avoid bumping into things while swimming. Especially helpful in the dark.
Orient and position yourself in a group in the water
weaknesses: Only effective in the water (or other liquid environments). Useless in the air.

name: Life Unmaking
description: This power lets turn a man into a puddle of mostly water. Victims can be solid,liquid,gas or energy. Turn a man of living rock into a lifeless statue. Use this power on someone made of fire and he'll become a blazing camp fire. An air elemental will disperse into the atmosphere. Any solid (un)dead will crumble to dust. Ghosts will break apart into ectoplasm. The only ways to undo this power are through time reversal or reality alteration. You only need to think to use this power.
summary: The ability to turn the living or once living into inert matter.
strengths: Deal with living,dead or undead foes.
All you do is think to this power.
