Only reversed with time or reality powers.
weaknesses: This power won't on anything that was never fully alive.
Someone with immutability or fixed form.

name: Plant Speak
description: You can communicate with plants with this powers. That includes bushes, trees etc. You can find out what happened somewhere of which only the plants were witness.
summary: The ability to communicate with plants.
strengths: Talk to plants.
weaknesses: They might talk too much and affect your sanity

name: The Perfect Werewolf
description:
You transform into a werewolf at night but you can use some of your abilities as a human. 

- As a human: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Sensing Danger
- As a werewolf: Strength, Speed, Senses, Agility, Faster Healing, Claws, Fangs, Sensing Danger, Resistance to Injury

Since you have the body of an animal, pretty much anything can kill you, but it takes a while for someone to do so because of your resistance to injury
summary: The ability to be the perfect version of a werewolf.
strengths: Can turn into a werewolf on any night (not just a full moon).
weaknesses: Anything can kill you (swords, guns, etc. ).

name: Breakdown
description: When touching organic material with skin-to-skin contact, the area being touched will start to break down on the cellular level, eventually turning the object or area into a puddle of ooze. Contact must be maintained the entire time. It only affects the area being touched extending out at all angles within a six-inch radius. The ability is always on, and the user is not immune to their own abilities. If applied to a normal human at the shoulder, the arm would break down and drop off in 2 min.
summary: The ability to break down organic material
strengths: Breakdown starts on contact
Most wounds are fatal if contact is maintained
Can cause aggravated damage
weaknesses: Must maintain skin-to-skin contact to work
Can damage yourself
Hands must always have some kind of synthetic covering on them

name: Mediumism (Mediumship)
description: Also called Spirit Channeling, one with this ability (called a medium) has a fine tuned connection to the spirit world. They can see and sense the spirits of the deceased, understand their speech, communicate with them (regardless of language barriers) and even channel them into one's body; channeling spirits allows them to express themselves through the user, including speaking/writing, as well as using any superhuman powers they may have had in life (this is called Mediumistic Automatism)
summary: The ability to perceive, communicate with and channel spirits of the dead
strengths: Perceive, and communicate with the spirits of the deceased (and perhaps other spirits over time)
Channel spirits of the dead (give them a chance to communicate with loved ones)
Allow them to work through you, to use any superpowers they may have had in life
weaknesses: Does not prevent the possibility of being possessed
Does not ensure a spirit you channel is a good one (once they take control, they leave on their own)
Does not let you compel spirits (only perceive, communicate with and channel them)

name: Stupify
description: With this power, you hold the ultimate trump card in any social situation. With the blink of an eye, you can reduce any person to a bumbling, mumbling, stuttering fool for any duration. You must be within a 1 mile radius and either see or hear your target. Great applications of this power include: speeding tickets, classrooms, arguments, courtrooms, presidential speeches, karaoke night, first dates, job interviews, and of course, reading a nuclear bomb deactivation code.
summary: The ability to make people babble, mutter or stumble over their own words, on command and for any duration.
strengths: Trump card in any social situation
Stop arguments in their tracks
You're the ultimate smooth operator when everyone around you is stuttering and mumbling
weaknesses: Can't exactly use this to defend yourself in a physical altercation
Your stuttering, mumbling targets will be pretty annoying
Sometimes it's better to just give them a good old fashioned biotch slap

name: Ability Linking
description: The powers are not fused together. They are just "tied" together, so if one is copied, stolen, cancelled, removed or deleted, the other will be as well. You can only link your own powers together, including those which didn't originally belong to you. Curses can also be linked with another curse or ability. Objects with abilities cannot be, except if they are part of an ability the user has, like the ability to own or summon the object. If a power is immune to an effect, the other will be too.
summary: The ability to link together two or more of one's own superpowers.
strengths: Link a curse to one of your superpowers and tempt someone else into stealing or copying it.
Link Ability Cancellation or Superpower Dispersal to a superpower someone wants to steal from you.
Positive effects are shared too, such as power augmentation.
weaknesses: You need to come up with a good strategy if you want to make this power useful.
The superpowers are not fused together and can still be used separately.

name: Calorie Burn
description: This ability allows the hero to convert his fat and immediate energy into energy. This can be used to warm object, it can be fired, it can be thrown, it can form a force field, or it can explode from ones body. The power makes you body convert energy and nutrients more efficient so you can go without food for days if you don't fire the energy to much.
summary: The ability to turn fat and calories into manipulatable energy.
strengths: Maintain excellent body shape.
Improved overall body function.
Energy attacks.
weaknesses: You have to eat pretty constantly if you plan on a lot of energy discharge.
Keep candy with you on missions.
If you use too much energy you risk losing conciousness.

name: Gasoline Alchemy
description: Change water, beverages and any other liquid into gasoline.
summary: The ability to change a liquid into gasoline.
strengths: Never go to the gas station.
weaknesses: You need to put some kind of liquid in your car and change that into gas.

name: Artifact Mastery
description: The person with this power is able to use majority if not all the artifacts in Warehouse 13. The only exception are the artifacts in the Dark Vault. Besides that, the person with this power is able to transport the artifact he or she want to their position. The person who has this power also has a psychic link to the warehouse, making them know exactly what is it in the warehouse
summary: The ability to use the ancient mystical artifacts that are stored in Warehouse 13
strengths: Huge assortment of artifacts for different situation
Easily defeat enemies due to huge array of artifacts
weaknesses: Great concentration is needed to summon the artifacts from long distances
Concentration is needed if the user wants to summon multiple artifacts at one go
If the user is knocked unconscious, the artifacts can be stolen

name: Pharmacy!
description: Have you ever had a problem where the insurance doesn't cover medication cost? Worry no more! With this power, you can make any medicine appear instantly! Limited to three types of medication at a time. Side effects may include hypervigillance and paranoia. These side effects are only temporary. Talk to see if pharmacy is right for you.
summary: The ability to make any medication appear in your hands.
strengths: Make medicine appear in your hands.
Side effects are temporary.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.
weaknesses: You will be hypervigillant.
You'll have paranoia.
Can't summon medicine that makes you high.

name: Amber Breath
description: With this ability you will be able to exhale a cloud of gas that activates with the air to form an amber like substance to trap your enemies in. Anyone trapped in the amber remain in a state of suspended animation until they are freed. The gas has a delayed activation so you don't have amber form in your esophagus.
summary: The ability to breath out a gas that quickly coalesces into amber
strengths: Trap enemies
Victims remain alive (good if you're a hero)
Gas has delayed activation to prevent suffacation
weaknesses: Gas does not travel very far
Victims remain alive (bad if you're evil)
Hard to control

name: Nth Metal
description: Nth metal is one of the magical metals. Nth metal appears very similar to gold but is infinitely more valuable. That means it can be manipulated through thought-waves. So after creating it you can will it into armor, weapons, cloths with enth thread,or almost anything else you can imagine. You can fly with Nth metal boots. Also it can absorb magical energy. The metal will only respond to its owner so unless you give or sell it the metal will only serve you.
summary: The ability to create Nth metal
strengths: You can create one of the magical metals
The metal is nearly indestructable and extremely valuable
You can move and reshape it with your will
weaknesses: Creating Nth metal is very hard and tiring
It can only absorb magical energy not expel it
You can't create the other magical metals

name: Power Backup Ability
description: If you have this power, every 24 hours this power will make a backup of itself and any other powers you have. These backups will remain dormant until you permanently lose a power through some sort of power negation or some sort of power theft. As soon as that happens, a dormant backup will awaken and your lost power will be restored. Dormant backups are undetectable and can't be stolen or negated or altered due to an active version working.
summary: The ability to make copies of your own powers so you can't lose them.
strengths: No fear of power thieves or power nullifying if you plan things right.
It works with any number of powers.
weaknesses: It takes time to build up a good number of backups.
This power can be altered or controlled without triggering a backup to awaken.
Power thieves and power nullifiers will join together to get you.

name: Quick Bridge
description: With this power whenever there is a gap that you can't cross (or you can cross it doesn't really make a difference) you can make a bridge appear that is the exact length of the bridge and that is strong enough to hold any amount of people/vehicles/animals/other stuff. After you and your party cross the bridge you can make it disappear again.
summary: The ability to make a bridge appear over any gap
strengths: You can make bridges appear
The bridges can hold an infinite amount
You can make the bridges disappear when you're done
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Pyrokenesis Limited
description: Instantly lighting candles can be done with the snap of your fingers, but you cannot control fires larger than a radius of 26 feet.
summary: The ability to create small amounts of fire
strengths: Ability to start fires instantly
Control small fire sources
weaknesses: Cannot control large amounts of fire such as a forest fire

name: Biome
description: With this power you can create a sphere of any size that changes the ecosystem within to match a Biome of your choosing. You can change the area to that of a tundra, desert, rain forest, etc. The change is instant and all Earth plants and animals except humans get changed to match the Biome you create. Masters of this power could create a sphere in space that creates a planet with Earth plants and animals inside of it based on a Biome.
summary: The ability to create a Biome sphere that changes the ecosystem within.
strengths: Change your area to the Biome of your choosing.
Make your enemies live in artic or desert areas.
Create planets at master level.
weaknesses: Permanent unless you create a different Biome to replace to existing Biome.
Limited to the size of sphere you are able to create.
Does not give any sort of weather control after sphere is made.

name: Magic Immunity
description: One with this ability has a natural capability to resist and shake off all magical effects; this means that no magic can affect you at all. Magic energy directed at you will bounce off of you; magic items will malfunction; magic bindings and magic traps will be treated as intangible around the user, and he can simply walk through them. Magic cannot be directly used on the user in any way, shape, form or fashion
summary: The ability to not be affected by magic, in any manifestation
strengths: No magical attacks, entrapment, banishment or curses/hexes/jinxes
No being altered magically
Makes the battle an even playing field when up against mages
weaknesses: Mages REALLY don't like you
Can't be magically ENHANCED either
Can't be magically HELPED OUT either

name: Social Theft
description: Stealing all information about someone just by touching them. All of their thoughts will forever are locked inside your mind. You can take away emotions too
summary: The ability to steal emotions, thoughts, memories and dreams
strengths: Learn what people think about you
Know when someone lies
Learn all about someone just by touching them
weaknesses: If you store to many memories, you might forget things
Other people are aware when their thoughts are being stolen
Stealing to many emotions or whatever can cause brain damage.

name: Zone Zero
description:
Do you have enemies who are just a pain in the behind? 
Immortal, overpowered or just really annoying? 
Well we, the employees of Diviousness. Inc have developed the Zone Zero Power. 
As soon as the threat is in your sight just clap your hands and wamm bamm they have been relocated into Zone Zero, a soothing place filled with nothing but air.
summary: The ability to send someone to another dimension.
strengths: Nobody is safe from your almighty hands.
You don't kill someone so your karma isn't harmed.
It never fails, as long as you clap your hands.
weaknesses: Useless for people who lack hands.
Enemies who are able to teleport are still able to return.
If someone glues your hands to a rock or something else you are left defenceless.

name: Odd Evening
description: Not only does this ability allow you to compute probability to a certain degree, it gives you some power over it. If you fall from a great height and there is a chance that you will live, no matter how small, you can even the chances between life and death, making it 50/50. Further probabilities, such as breaking bones vs. not breaking bones, require further concentration. You can seriously improve your chances in any situation, but it will always come down to a toss-up.
summary: The ability to make all outcomes of an event equally likely to occur
strengths: Can even all possible outcomes instantly
Can even influence people's thoughts by evening their likelihood to make a certain decision
Make bullets more likely to misfire
weaknesses: No guarantees that it will work in your favor
Some outcomes must be broken down further

name: Thunder Clapper
description: With this power you can make deafening thunder whenever you clap your hands. You cannot turn this power off so it happens every time you clap your hands. The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius.
summary: The ability to make thunder by clapping
strengths: You can cause deafening thunder to sound whenever you clap your hands
The thunder can be heard by everybody in a hundred mile radius
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off
If you don't have hands this power is useless

name: Fingerprint Database
description: With this power, you are a human fingerprint database. Whenever you see a fingerprint, you will instantly know who it belongs to, and you can even sketch a copy of any person's fingerprint.
summary: The ability to know the owner of a fingerprint when you see one
strengths: You are a walking, talking fingerprint database.
You can sketch exact copies of human fingerprints.
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat.

name: Goldworks: Army Of Gold
description: Long ago, there was a ancient civilization whose name was lost to time. They had knowledge & technology far beyond other empires. After 700 years of peace, that civilization was torn apart by a civil war that killed hundreds of thousands of citizens. In the end, the emperor used what was left of their technology to create a golden crown. This crown had the incredible power to control the skeletons of the falling citizens, which had also turned to gold. The skeletons are under the wielder's power
summary: The ability to wield the Crown of the Golden Dead
strengths: Controlling an army of golden undying skeletons with a golden crown.
When you need them, the skeletons will rise from the ground to help and serve you
The skeletons can repair themselves when needed
weaknesses: The crown can be lost and used by others.
The skeletons are no stronger or faster than other beings

name: Siren's Signal
description: This ability allows you to emit a sound that can only be heard by a person of your choosing. This sound sounds like a siren song and calls the person to your location. No matter where in the world the person is, they will be inexplicably drawn to you.
summary: The ability to call any person to your location by emmiting a sound only they can hear
strengths: Find anyone world-wide
weaknesses: Might take awhile for the person to reach you
Might take a dangerous route to reach you
Doesn't hypnotize people, just attracts them

name: Past Revival.
description: With this power you will reincarnate in the past anytime that you die. You will reincarnate a certain number of days in the past that is equal to the number of days that you lived. You would be born to a random family that is having a baby at that time. You keep your same appearance even if the family you are born too has a different appearance. Upon turning five all your memories come back from your future lives. You could meet yourself if you lived longer than previous life.
summary: The ability to reincarnate in the past.
strengths: Can live major moments in history.
Could change the future since you know future events.
Wont die until you get back to the time of the first humans.
weaknesses: Everyone you know would eventually not be born yet.
Most modern day things would not be invented yet if you go back far enough.
You wont have your memories first five years of life, if thats a problem.

name: Crown Of Ice
description: With this power you can summon a crown made out of ice and it will apear on your head. Though it is made out of ice your head will not become cold from it. Embedded in the crown is a large blue jewel that can either shoot beams of ice that can freeze people or objects or shoot super sharp icicles that can impale people. The crown also allows you to control snow animals such as yetis, polar bears, snow owls etc. When you're done with it you can just unsummon by taking it off your head.
summary: The ability to have an ice crown that allows you to shoot ice beams out of your head and control snow animals
strengths: You have an ice crown that shoot ice beams/icicles and controls snow animals
If anybody ever tries to steal it by removing it from your head it disappears
It doesn't cause your head to become cold
weaknesses: It's not very fashionable

name: Stimuli Inducement
description: Heat, Gravity, smells, etc. The user can induce the feelings of any stimulus towards anyone or anything. If a stimulus that is external like a reaction to fire is induced to a victim, the victim will be engulf by that stimulus spontaneously.
summary: The ability to inflict different stimuli towards anything.
strengths: Make feel any kind of stimulus: external or internal.
External stimuli will result in exposure to actual stimuli.
weaknesses: Can be very dangerous.

name: Peace Manipulation
description: With this power, you can be the ultimate peace keeper or peace breaker. You can alter how one person or group of people feels about another person or group of people with no restrictions on group size. If you strive for world peace, you can have it. If you're a psycho and strive for world destruction, well, go for it you crazy bastard. One restriction--you can only use this power once every 24 hours, so choose your sides wisely. Works great when you need a good cat fight to cheer you up!
summary: The ability to manipulate the level of peace between one or more people.
strengths: Pit the world against your greatest enemies
You can implant motivations for being on your side
The ultimate war: Bitches vs. hoes
weaknesses: One use per day
A world of peace might be boring and predictable
If the hoes lose the war, all you have left are bitches  :(

name: Rebirth
description: With this ability you can start life over anytime in a new body & family. On 2 conditions: you can't use the power before the age of 13 & your body turns to ash as your soul remains in the state he is until a new baby body is available. Also, you keep memories of your ancient life and that you have the power. On your 13th birthday, you will receive a notebook reminding you fully of your old life and the reason you used the power.
summary: The ability to be reborn into a new body any time after the age of 13.
strengths: Can start life over
Practically immortal
weaknesses: You can possibly wait a long time before your rebirth
Can't use your power before the age of 13
Sudden memory of past life can cause trauma and nightmares

name: Super Mario
description: With this power you will be able to fly,become invisible,become pure steel,phase through objects,run on water,become faster,be abnormally strong for size,jump incredibly high for size,intense acrobatic skills,be smarter than you would normally be,be good at sports,and have a chick with tons of money :D
summary: The ability to have all the abilities that mario and bros. Would have
strengths: Amazing range of different powers
Be incredibly good at almost anything
weaknesses: You have to save your girl like alot

name: Eternal Nourishment
description: With this ability you will never be hungry or thirsty again.  You will always feel satisfied (not full).  If you want to feel full, you still have the option of eating something. Also, you will always have the perfect level of nutrients, fats, carbs, etc. in your diet.  So, if you start working out, your protein levels will automatically increase. As a result, your health will probably be top notch. Eating foods that are unhealthy, like the glorious twinkie, is still bad.
summary: The ability to never go hungry or thirsty.
strengths: Never have to pay for food again
Have a perfect food intake as long as you don't eat junk food
Never feel hungry
weaknesses: Never have the satisfaction of quenching thirst of relieving hunger
You might not enjoy food as much
You might start eating more junk food

name: Magma Current
description: With this power you are capable of sending waves of magma across the ground at your opponents. Regardless of how strong you are the waves only go as far as you raise them.
summary: The ability to send a wave of lava along the ground.
strengths: Very easy to clear away your opponents.
weaknesses: Doesn't mix well with water because lava and water mix into stone.

name: Dance Of The Dead Marionette
description: Ability to control the actions of others. Can force others to use their superpower. Can control the whole body. The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute. Complete death of a live target in 5 min.
summary: The ability to control the actions of others.
strengths: Works incredibly well on undead/dead.
Allows for full control.
Can control just body parts if you want (ex. Only an arm)
weaknesses: The body (part) of a live target will start to die if spell left on for longer then 1 minute.
Complete death of a live target in 5 min.

name: Soul Exchange
description: This is a slighty dark power, but ultimatly not an evil one. It allows the user to give someone almost anything they want, in exchange for their soul. After they die, they will become your servant for as long as you have their soul. So, if they died a year after you made the deal, then they must serve you for a year after they die. You will have total power over them, even controlling their shape. After their service is paid, they will go on to the afterlife.
summary: The ability to make soul-exchanges
strengths: Granting the wishes of many people, for a fair price.
This power won't affect the target's judgement in the afterlife.
weaknesses: It seems like an unholy power
Contact is necessary to make the deal

name: Organic Deconstruction
description: One can reduce living cells into nothing, and when developed can, in theory, destroy a person, people or any living things. Eventually, and with the will, one can develop the ability to raze entire areas of everything living. If the individual had an emotional bond with someone, had touched them or had a good look at them, then he/she could break them down if they were, for example in a mile range depending on that persons strength. Emotions can effect the strength and range of this ability too.
summary: The ability to break down living things
strengths: Can potentially destroy numerous dangerous people or animals in an instant
Useful in war and law enforcement
Practically invulnerable
weaknesses: Vulnerable while sleeping or unconscious
Would have committed a sin and a crime, and would become an enemy of your country
Will and state of mind affects range and power, could be taken down with long range gunshot

name: Magic Tricks
description: Stage magic and true magic are two different things. This is the bridge between the two. After creating a magic trick, and performing  it successfully, the user will be able to do it for real. Let's say you figure out how to make objects vanish and reappear. After you perform it, you will be able to make objects vanish and appear at will. You must create the trick yourself for this power to kick in.
summary: The ability to gain powers through magic tricks
strengths: Gain great powers of deception
Become one of the greatest performers of all time
weaknesses: Must create the trick for this to work.
Must perform the trick successfully (without anyone seeing how you did it)

name: Vampirism: Neuronal
description: Also called Neuronal Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the nerve impulses of others and convert it into sustenance and physical power; this may be used to facilitate an increase in speed, reflexes, agility, dexterity and cognition (anything requiring neuron activity). This absorption of neuron impulses leaves the foe temporarily paralyzed.
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the nerve impulses of others
strengths: Take away the neuron impulses of foes, leaving them paralyzed in the process
Taking their nerve impulses also heightens your own nerve firing (speed, reflexes, agility, etc. )
Foes with Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Reflexes, Superhuman Agility, etc,
weaknesses: The paralysis is sometimes permanent
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, family and friends won't want to be around you

name: Stackable Abilities
description: Let's say that you have 2 powers that both give you the side-effect of superstrength. Now you may think that will be useless but with this power it will not be. Now any power that you gain that is similar to an existing power will increase the power and efficiency of both powers and any power related. This power can not be negated or tampered with.
summary: The ability to increase power and control of any existing ability when you gain a similar ability
strengths: Stack all your speed and strength and durability powers to have better power and control
This power can not be negated or tampered with---but your other powers can
Any ability that overlaps with another will increase the overall effectiveness of all connected
weaknesses: Need to have similar abilities first

name: Collective Noun Morph
description: You can become a warfare of hydra,a culture of bacteria,a swarm of nanites,a skynet of cyborgs or a nucleus of physicists. Any collective noun form that exist in a book or on website. When reduced to your last body,you revert to normal,and can't use that lost form for a day. Your collective noun form is average size. Any skills given by it are good but not the best. Some forms aren't allowed. Con negation won't let you use those forms.
summary: The ability to literally become a collective noun for anything alive or that can move itself.
strengths: There are collective nouns to give you mythic,undead,jedi,angelic or other kinds of powers.
You can add your own collective nouns to a website or self-publish a book.
Collective forms can give you new skills
weaknesses: You revert to normal if reduced to one body,and can't use that particular form for a day.

name: Empathy: Emotional Resonance
description: Words and even actions are an inadequate ways to express oneself.  Now, you simply can have your thoughts, feelings, emotions, motivations, and values conveyed perfectly by simply willing it.  You also will automatically understand other's thought and emotions perfectly. There will be no doubts about intentions, good or bad.
summary: The ability to completely understand others and be understood by them.
strengths: You will likely grow to be a very emotionally mature person.
Most relationships may become stronger than ever!
Less worry over what was said or done.
weaknesses: No matter how hard, you will simply have to grow up.
Some relationships you enjoyed may reveal themselves to be a facade.
You may know what should be done or said even when you can't actually do or say it.

name: Living Insect Repellant
description: With this ability, you can repel all insects (even if they're supersized). You repel blood sucking insects especially well. Insects hate the way you smell, but no human or animal can perceive the smell. You can repel fleas. You can not repel arachnids or leeches unless you practice a lot. Mosquitos will stay away from you.
summary: The ability to repel all insects (even supersized ones).
strengths: You can repel all insects, even supersized ones.
You don't smell any different to people or animals.
You will never have an insect bite again.
weaknesses: Might take decades of practice before you repel arachnids and/or leeches.

name: Mental Destitution
description: This power(also called mental destruction or mental degrading)is the ability to damage or cancel the higher thought processes of others. Simply put it allows the user to render an opponent incapable of any higher thought causing unconsciousness or worse. As a side effect the user can also stop mental abilities(telepathy, telekinesis,etc) from affecting them due to their usual requirement of high mental power. The user can project this effect in fields or by their sheer presence.
summary: The ability to cancel out thought or higher thought and some of it's products.
strengths: Can easily incapacitate foes AND stop their offensive telepathy or telekinesis.
You can do this in varying degrees(disorientation,delusion,incompetence,death).
You are immune to the effects of this power.
weaknesses: Enemies such as golems or robots.
The effects are never permanent.
Foes who possess backlash powers.

name: Quartz Portal
description: This ability allows you to use any piece of quartz as a portal to any other piece of quartz. You can travel through these portals or use them to spy on an area. The size of the quartz does not matter.
summary: The ability to use quartz crystal as a portal linked to any other piece of quartz
strengths: Size of quartz doesn't matter
Teleport to any other piece of quartz
weaknesses: Quartz must be in the location you want to travel to.

name: Touch & Go
description: The user once he or she has touched a vehicle of his or her choice is able to travel at the maximum speed that vehicle can travel at. However, this power is only applicable to be used on land vehicles such like cars, motorcycles, trucks and trains. The user is able to start out at the vehicles' maximum speed, after time the speed will start to decrease depending on use.
summary: The ability to obtain the maximum speed that a vehicle can travel at by touching that said vehicle.
strengths: Cars are ever present in cities
Can move really fast
Cant be hit easily and can easily hit people
weaknesses: No cars in jungles or desserts if power wears out and need to acquire new speed
Cant fly

name: Singing Perfection
description: An individual with this ability has a perfect, beautiful, & unbelievable singing voice.
summary: The ability to have a perfect singing voice
strengths: Fame
Fortune
Admiration
weaknesses: Fans Constantly Chasing you
Paparazzi

name: Tattoo Power Seal
description: A person with this power can seal another superhuman's power upon touch by absorbing it into their body. This process creates a tattoo on their body that represents the sealed power. The touching part means either touching the person using the power or having the power come in contact with your skin. Once one of these conditions is satisfied, the user can then take away that power and turn it into a tattoo on their body. The user can also give back the power thus causing the tattoo to disappear.
summary: The ability to seal a person's powers within your own body upon touch by turning it into a tattoo
strengths: Combined with Tattoo Power, this means power stealing
As a bonus, this comes with power negation--if the power is directly used on the user
Can also give back powers to original owners
weaknesses: Will be heavily tattooed if you use this too much
If the other person's power is so powerful that the tatoo can't fit on your body

name: Ninja Spawn
description: With this power you can spawn an infinite amount of ninjas and they're all completely under your control
summary: The ability to spawn ninjas
strengths: You have an army of ninjas under your control
weaknesses: Ninjas aren't the strongest people in the world and can be killed by powerful enemies

name: Delete This A Infinity Turbine
description: You can use it to escape situations by charging your fists connected with cosmic power, surrounding yourself with an aura, while flying spinning towards your opponents to send them flying. You can also spin in place and suck in nearby enemies and/or projectiles. Opponents are thrown to the opposite side of the M. I. T. , while projectiles are neutralized.
summary: The ability to charge your fists with cosmic energy while flying spinning towards your opponent.
strengths: Can do a great deal of damage.
Fly through projectiles.
weaknesses: None.

name: Remnant Affliction
description: Also called Residual Affliction or Recurring Affliction is the responsiveness of an injury to the presence of the inflictor of said injury. Simply put, whenever one goes near a foe, whatever injury the user has caused to that particular foe (physical or psychological) will either resurface entirely, re-bruising and re-scratching up foes, or the area where the subject was wounded will begin hurting again; psychological damage will arise again.
summary: The ability to cause previous injuries to resurface in one's presence
strengths: The more you hurt them one time, the more they hurt next time
You will never leave your enemies' memories
You always get the advantage in a fight (wounds heal at a normal rate, even with a healing factor)
weaknesses: May also work on loved ones
Injuries (sometimes) must have been induced by the user
Makes befriending a former enemy very hard

name: Epic Absorbsion
description: "Eparticals" or epic particals are the substance that makes things epic. You will have the ability to absorb these particals from people or things. The more eparticals you have the more epic your actions become. Turn a punch in to a "EPIC PAWNCH". Or a kick into a "EPIC KICKUH". Bewarned if you absorb eparticals from people they will become less epic. Or if you absorb too many eparticals you will turn into Chuck norris (wait i dont think thats bad).
summary: The ability to absorb "Eparticals"
strengths: Become more epic
Make a epic PAWNCH
Become chuck norris
weaknesses: If you dont like becoming chuck norris

name: Nuclear Reaction
description: With this ability you can create nuclear explosions and reactions, by having the mental capacity to split any atom with your mind. Once an atom is split a nuclear explosion happens. Also atoms are everywhere in all matter.
summary: The ability to create nuclear explosion, by splitting the atom with your mind,
strengths: Create nuclear explosions anywhere.
Your nuclear explosions won't harm you in any way.
weaknesses: Effect of nuclear explosion is devastating long-term.

name: Money Tree V2
description: With this power you can create a money tree that produces money instead of leaves. You can only produce one at a time and it grows one thousand dollars (or the equivalent of one thousand US dollars depending on where you are) a day in five dollar bills (or the equivalent). If the money tree gets destroyed or you destroy it, you can create a new one somewhere else.
summary: The ability to make a tree that produces more money
strengths: You can cause a money tree to sprout out of the ground
You can get up to one thousand dollars a day
weaknesses: You only get up to one thousand dollars a day
You can only have one tree at a time
People will always be trying to steal it from you

name: Ghost Force
description: This power let's you see ghosts and attack them. Instead of going through the ghost it is like a solid to you.  When in use the body glows a faint greenish-blue. Also allows you to turn a spectre or poltergeist back to visible form.
summary: The ability to be able to attack a ghost as though it were solid and return them to normal form
strengths: You can attack ghosts as though normal solid creature
Allows you to turn poltergeists visible
Blocks most ghost powers that are sent as an attack at you
weaknesses: Only applicable to ghosts

name: Unpredictable Time  Boost
description: This ability, if you know the time when the boost will hit you, can be useful in almost any situation. The way this work is that it works for different people. When the ability boosts your body it will give you energy, and a boost of speed, strength, and agility. This ability boosts your mind's percentage by 50% and gives a basic telekinetic ability when the time comes. When the ability boosts your spiritual side, you'll be more at peace with yourself and able to dodge most hits.
summary: The ability to power up your body, mind, or spirit in different sets of time.
strengths: Very powerful.
Multiple ways to attack or defend yourself.
weaknesses: You might get a different boost than the one you need.
Your boosts will come at different and unpredictable times.

name: Blessing Of Pan
description: Pan is the God of Wild Places. His blessing allows you to be one with the Wild, meaning you can control everything natural in nature. Rivers, trees, rocks, wind, if it's naturally there, you can control it. You cannot control animals; however, you can speak to them and they always love you. You can also use nature magic. It involves playing a certain tune on a wooden instrument for a certain effect. It could be almost anything, from finding a path to putting someone to sleep.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Pan
strengths: Controlling nature
Speaking to animals, who always love you
Nature magic
weaknesses: Losing your instrument
If you hurt nature, nature will hurt you back
Nature magic has its limits

name: Human Maraca
description: It won't activate if you move your body in a normal way, unless it is natural for you to rapidly shake your body of parts of your body. So, just like a maraca, you will make similar shifting and shuffling sounds when you shake any part of your body. It can also activate when you halt fast movements of your body, because your body vibrates shortly before coming to a stop. Running also activates this power because your body is actually shaken up and down.
summary: The ability to make a sound similar to maracas when you shake your body.
strengths: If you forgot to bring your maracas.
It only activates if you shake your body, which you don't usually do if you need to be quiet.
weaknesses: The sound just ruins the mood of oriental booty shakes. Seriously.
You need to analyze in which situations your body shakes. For example, shivering is a body shake.

name: Power Vampire
description: With this power you become a power vampire. You can absorb the life force and energy of any living being gaining vampire like powers including superhuman strength, speed, staminia, durability, healing and senses, immortality, minor shapeshifting, flight, and any traditional vampire powers, abilities, and knowledge. The more life force you absorb the more you crave and eventual with constant absorbtion you will be unable to go without draining someone and go gradualy insane.
summary: The ability to become a power vampire.
strengths: Gain Vampire Powers
Gain minor control over the people you drain
Gain any powers, abilities, or knowledge the person had.
weaknesses: The power weakens the victem(s) and can kill with repeated absorbtion(Bad for a hero)
May be hunted by vampire hunters
Draining the life force from sentiant beings(anything but plants) causing gradual insanity

name: Myth Power: Siren's Song
description: The Sirens were known in Greek Myth as beautiful sea nymphs whose song lured many sailors to their death, crashing on the rocks of their island home. Channeling them gifts you with the same seductive power. You can entrance others of the opposite sex with your voice, and it has more than one effect. If you are up close, the subject will follow any command given. If you are far away, the subject will try to reach you at all costs to follow your orders. You can also communicate with/command birds.
summary: The ability to channel the deadly seductive powers of the Sirens
strengths: Entrance subjects of the opposite sex with an otherworldly singing voice
If they hear your voice close-up, they follow any command issued (whether you sing it or not)
If far away, your voice lures them to you (by safest or most dangerous route possible; you choose)
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Aphrodisia or MythPower: Arrows of Eros are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Muse Influence are immune to this ability
You can also communicate with, control and share the senses of birds (may make you seem wimpy)

name: Souls
description: "Souls" is the ability to make dolls come to life and obey your every command (stage 1). Once the power advances, you are able to transfer your soul into any doll (stage 2). The next stage is that you are able to transfer your soul into someone else's body and when you get killed your soul will be set free so you can take control of a new body as your own (stage 3). You can have other people's souls go into other bodies (stage 4).
summary: The ability to control souls.
strengths: Control dolls
Transfer your soul into dolls
Controlling someone
weaknesses: Your energy is drained
You get tired when your doll is destroyed
You see all the dead souls

name: Thriller Dance
description: Everyone knows the iconic Thriller from Michael Jackson. With this power, you can compel zombies within a 60 feet radius and/or within your line of sight to do the Thriller dance. They automatically know the dance and so do you. They recognize you as the main dancer, if you opt to join in. Even works on zombies that are under somebosdy else's control, but does not workon superhumans that used a power to become a zombie.
summary: The ability to compel zombies to do the Thriller dance
strengths: Thriller.
Dancing zombies.
Prevent from being eaten till help arrives
weaknesses: When the dance has ended, you have to 5 minutes to use this power again.

name: Electrical Tentacles
description: The tentacles will reach from the user's head to their ankles and can generate electrical energy. The amount of energy differs for each user differs. The tentacles are black and the user can control the movement at will. The user of this power is the only one immune to the electricity.
summary: The ability to have tentacles that can electrocute what they touch
strengths: The tentacles are part of your body.
weaknesses: Entering water is not a good idea.

name: Precognitive Extrapolations
description: Everyone extrapolates, They all think about what might happen. People with this power take it out to the far end. They can accurately predict what will happen minutes, hours, or even days into the future. However, this power requires vast amounts of information in order for you to make accurate predictions, its also burns alot of energy limiting the number of predictions you can make. The farther the prediction is into the future the less accurate it gets, and the more energy it burns.
summary: The ability to non-psychically predict the future
strengths: Lets you "see" the future
Is not a psychic talent, and is unaffected by powers that mess with psychics
You can choose what to extrapolate about.
weaknesses: Requires TONS of information
Burns alot of energy
Less accurate the farther it goes into the future

name: Living Powers
description: With this power you cause all of your other powers to come alive and gain a spirit body and personality. The personalities will always have your same goals. The living powers can even teach you how to use the powers better. You can even let a living power take over your body so that it can use the power to its fullest. If the power is negated it will appear as if the spirit is repelled from your body. When the spirit returns so does your power. Affected by all power affecting powers.
summary: The ability to have your other powers come alive.
strengths: The Spirits can aid you to use your powers more effectively.
Mimicry mimics the spirits also but the spirit remains loyal to you.
The spirits can be suppressed when not needed.
weaknesses: Does not work on this power.
You may not like the personality of your power.
Having many powers will cause them all to come alive.

name: Touch Of Pain
description: This sounds lame at first, but you can poke the exact place in the brain that kills.  You can temporarily stop people's hearts.  You can cause headaches, or pains anywhere.
summary: The ability to poke/touch/push/etc someone anywhere - even internally.
strengths: You can cause pain anywhere in your oponent.
You can kill your oponent instantly.
You can neutralise your oponent.
weaknesses: One poke per person per day.
More than one poke and the energy drain is too much.

name: Sp: Defensive Presence
description: SP stands for 'Sharing Presence'. With this ability, people in your area are given extra defense against all forms of harm. (Physical, mental, etc. ) In return, you gain the amount of defense given to people by this bonus. For example, if 5 people are in you're area, they gain defense, and you gain their totalled defense. Can be turned off.
summary: The ability to give people around you more defense, and in return you gain the amount of defense given.
strengths: Extremely helpful in fights of all sorts.
Can be turned off.
weaknesses: You may occasionally forget to turn this ability off.

name: Ability Skill: Mimicry Wisdom
description: Let's say the user, a Fire Mimic, has this Ability Skill. Once they mimic the fire, they will gain the wisdom of this element. They will know how to use it, to actually think like it. That goes to all different types of mimicry-based powers--electricity, sound, etc.
summary: The ability to gain innate intelligence, to those with mimicry powers, of the thing being mimicked.
strengths: Know how to use the thing you mimicked.
No need to practice.
weaknesses: Must be a mimicry-based powers.

name: Stockpile
description: With this ability, you gain more and more strength over time. By simply not exerting your physical strength, it can stockpile to become dozens of times stronger than usual. This also applies to not using your superpowers. For example, if you don't exert Telekinesis for long enough, you'll be able to move larger things, such as tall buildings.
summary: The ability to become more powerful by not using your strength / abilities.
strengths: Patience is the key.
Doesn't have any negative effect on your strengths.
weaknesses: Patience is the key.

name: Blood Weaponry
description:
By creating a small cut on your body, you can control your blood to create weapons like shuriken and swords to fight with. Depending on the attack used, and whether it is held or not, very little or a lot of blood is used.

However, there is a catch. You can possibly kill yourself by expending too much blood too fast. Draining more then 75% of your blood in an hour will likely pass out unconscious, and your injury will continue to bleed, possibly leading to death by blood loss.
summary: The ability to create weapons made of your own blood.
strengths: Always have a readily available weapon on hand
Weapons are sharp as titanium
Blood can be reabsorbed into body if still in contact with skin
weaknesses: Can lead to death due to too much blood loss
Requires some focus to retain control over blood
Uneffective against vampires and other creatures that feed on blood

name: Psychic Vampire
description: You can enter someone's mind and drain their life energy straight from their body.
summary: The ability to drain a human's life energy.
strengths: You can have a stable telepathic link if you have five people in it.
You can talk to people if you dont want to anyone else to hear.
People will not want to mess with you.
weaknesses: If you have less than five people in the link, it kills the other person.
Once five people are in the link, there's no reversing it.
Once you start a stable telepathic link, your power is useless with anyone not in the link.

name: Napalm Dominance
description: This power allows the user to create and freely control high-grade napalm, a gelatin substance that not only persistently adheres to surfaces it comes in contact with, but that burns with such an intense heat that being anywhere within several hundred feet of a source of napalm can cause third degree burns. Larger quantities of napalm can cause the air temperature to dramatically spike, causing water to boil rapidly and burning skin and muscle with 2,200 degree Fahrenheit winds and flames.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate military-grade napalm.
strengths: It's great for mass combat; the intense heat drives away most low to mid level baddies.
It's absolutely wonderful to be paired up with any wind-oriented powers (except for vacuum control).
The intensity of heat makes it useful even in small quantities and vs. Water/ice powers.
weaknesses: You're human, too, so you better be wearing some anti-thermal gear or something.
It's an indiscriminate power; watch out for civilians and allies.
Be careful of potential collateral damage, like buildings catching fire.

name: Blue Ray
description: Heal any blind person by emitting blue rays from your eyes. This blue rays restores one's sight without any complications or side effects.
summary: The ability to give recovery sight for the blind.
strengths: Heal the blind and be the greatest eye doctor.
Your eyesight are immune to any known radiations!
weaknesses: None.

name: Divine Dimensional Travel
description: This does not include the ability to Astral Project, but to create a portal as what it looks like a Dreamcatcher, if you travel to Heaven, you might be able to see your greatest grandparents, & see what's going on in the afterlife, but if you travel to Hell you'll see Extremely what's going on when dead evildoers have suffered.
summary: The ability to create amazing portals to the Afterlife (Heaven), and/or the underworld (Hell).
strengths: You might be able to ask someone in the afterlife who the perpetrator is that caused a hero's death.
weaknesses: Better be careful of not let any demons from the underworld follow you back home.

name: Equal Speed
description: The user just has to throw an object, e.g. a marble, pencil, table , etc. The object will move in a straight line not slowing down, allowing the object to move through walls, vehicles, or even people. The object will travel in the same direction at the same speed until it is destroyed or commanded to stop by the user.
summary: The ability to stop resistance on a moving object.
strengths: Sturdy objects will last in this state for a while.
The user can often use this on more than one object at once.
Not affected by gravity.
weaknesses: Foes can avoid slower objects.
Object can be worn down or destroyed if it is not sturdy enough.
Objects lose this effect if the person is unconscious or dead.

name: Jeweled Tears
description: Your tears will literally turn into jewels when you cry. They can be sapphires, rubies, diamonds, emeralds, etc. The size of the jewels are the same as the tears.
summary: The ability to create rare jewels by crying
strengths: You can get lots of money by crying a lot.
weaknesses: Tears are generally really small.

name: Frost Shell
description: A frozen shell is created two inches above and around any object of your choosing. The shell is light blue and can allow a small amount of light to pass through or none at all as well as air to breathe. The shell keeps strong amounts of energy from passing through so that it keeps power out or power trapped inside. It is near impossible to break the shell through non-physical means but can be shattered from a strong physical hit. Only lasts while caster is around. Shell is not fixed to one spot.
summary: The ability to create a frozen area around a object that prevents energy exchange.
strengths: Can be used as a defensive barrier.
Or as a prison for energy.
Takes little effort to make.
weaknesses: Can be broken physically.
Manipulated by cold-related powers.
May not put shell up until after the energy hits you and then you trap the energy inside with you.

name: Ultimate Comeback
description: This power is perfect when you're getting burned constantly and can't figure out a good comeback in time. Now you can! Someone hurting your feelings, then absolutely destroy them mentally with the ultimate comeback when they feebly try to tell you off. However, this only works on after burns, it doesn't help with physical bulllying. And the ultimate comeback works automatically.
summary: The ability to create the ultimate comeback to any burn instantly
strengths: Ultimate comeback to any burn
Possibly blow someone's mind out of their head
weaknesses: Only works on burns
Happens automatically

name: Sleeper Agent
description: A sleeper agent is someone who has a predetermined program written inside of them. With this ability, you can reprogram someone without them knowing about it. Once you activate the program, they will follow your commands. If you want, you can turn them into super-soldiers.
summary: The ability to plant a modifying program in the minds of others
strengths: Amass an army
Tell people what to do
Reprogram their minds and make them soldiers of fortune
weaknesses: Every program has a kill code
A person of strong will might resist the program

name: Death Hallucination
description: Basically, you trap someone in a hallucination that ends with their death. The time spent in the hallucination can't be longer than a day, which means their death is guaranteed. The hallucination is instantaneous in real time, so no matter how long they spend in the hallucination, no time will pass outside. The hallucination can be anything from the world exploding, to a zombie apocalypse, to just getting hit by a car.
summary: The ability to trap people in a hallucination that ends with their death.
strengths: Pretty fun.
Can be used on yourself
Experience the world blowing up, if you're bored
weaknesses: May drive people insane if you aren't careful.

name: Aut   Phone
description: The AUT - phone is a handheld device that resembles an iPhone, the time on the phone is unlimited. A whitish silver portal is opened by pressing a button on the phone that sets it to open a wormhole to a new dimension, and with this phone, it can instantly gain knowledge from any universe you travelled in.
summary: The ability to travel to any paralell universe with the use of an alternate iPhone.
strengths: You might find interesting cultures in many alternate universes.
weaknesses: If you don't like this universe, you'll leave.

name: Forced Superpower Activation
description: A lot of powers require you to do something or fulfil certain conditions in order to activate them and use them. It may be concentration, certain emotions, saying something, drawing something, being exposed to sunlight, certain gestures or actions, etc. If someone with this ability does exactly what's needed to activate someone else's power, they will activate it without that person's consent. They're NOT copying that ability, nor do they channel it; they just force that person to use it.
summary: The ability to activate someone else's power by fulfilling all the conditions needed to use it.
strengths: Some powers can be used as you please, as if you copied them, like Telekinesis or Geokinesis.
If an ally is put in a position where they can't activate their power, you can activate it for them.
You can use it on a power which is already activated but isn't used to its full capacity.
weaknesses: Unless there's a specific conditions to fulfil, you can't deactivate a power if they are using it.
In most cases, activating a power doesn't mean you can use it on yourself, like Teleportation.
They can be immune to their own power, but not you. So, be careful when you activate a power.

name: Kryptopain
description: With this power, you can send pain by thought to another person. The rules: Be careful--even if it's a little bit of pain, it could be tons of pain to that person. Don't imagine it too much.
summary: The ability to send pain by thought to another person.
strengths: Can torture siblings and bullies
Can send pain through your body to get out of class
Can save people while the bad guy is in pain and can't concentrate
weaknesses: Killing people
Killing family members by accident
Not controlling it

name: Omni Vampire
description: Are you getting sick and tired of people with omnipotence? Worried about being spied on with omnipresence? Can't catch someone with omniscience? Well, if you get this power you will continuously drain the life out of them. Their powers are blocked. This power can affect the whole universe.
summary: The ability to drain life from omni-powered beings.
strengths: Get many powers.
Omnipotence is no longer invincibility!
No more omni powers!
weaknesses: Warning: Ownership of omni powers in conjunction with this is suicide.
Whatever you do, don't choose omnipotence.
Can't use this power against someone else with this power.

name: When You're Hot, You're Hot.
description: One can control molecules and generate a coating of heat. The user can coat their body in thermal energies and create an aura of heat around themeselves, from extremely hot to mild. It can also be controlled on just certain body parts or around them. Blasts can be shot from the body, but the farther the distance the weaker the effect.
summary: The ability to munipulate the molecules of the users own body in order to create intense heat.
strengths: A shield of heat for protection.
Creates a light when needed.
Cook anthying with your hands.
weaknesses: Can only be generated off their body.
Blasts weaken with distance.
Lack of control can melt your surrondings.

name: Under Pressure
description: This power is both a blessing and a curse. Whilst it allows you to send pressure shockwaves and implode/explode enemies, it comes with a price. You will forever have the song "Under Pressure" by David Bowie and Queen blaring at you and all those in your vicinity at 80db. A small price to pay? Perhaps. But remember.  "It's the terror of knowing What this world is about Watching some good friends Screaming 'Let me out' Pray tomorrow - gets me higher Pressure on people - people on streets"
summary: The ability to manipulate pressures, and send pressure waves at people.
strengths: Awesomely powerful ability with the power to kill.
weaknesses: You have to listen to "Under Pressure" forever.

name: Dagger Strike
description: With this power you can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands. You have an unlimited amount of dagger and the daggers are sharper than normal daggers, even being able to cut through metal.
summary: The ability to shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot daggers out of the palms of your hands
You have an unlimited supply of daggers
The daggers are sharper than normal daggers they can even cut through metal
weaknesses: You might accidentally stab yourself

name: Mjollnir
description: Use Mjollnir to break mountains or crack some skulls. You have the ultimate weapon. No godling, alien, man or beast can withstand a blow from it. If you throw it Mjollnir will always hit its mark and always return to you. You can make enemies think you are weaponless by hiding it in your tighty whiteys. Then whip it out (the hammer) and beat the snot out of them. You are almost immortal while Mjollnir is yours.
summary: The ability to carry the mighty hammer of a thunder god
strengths: Sword in the stone rule: only you can lift Mjollnir
Eventually control lightning, fly, teleport thru an astral realm and ride giant goats, yeah goats
You'll be 7 ft tall with long curly red hair, massive muscles, superstrength and a love of violence
weaknesses: Dragons, cross-dressing murderous trickster half-brother/sister, frost-giants, and dark elves
You'll have to die a warrior's death or no burning boat funeral or Valhalla for you
Ragnarok will happen on Earth as long as you possess the hammer and you will not survive

name: Positive Reincarnation
description: Project positive energy with one's mind in it. The positive being is a bright white color. When the positive being is out, one is protected by an impenetrable force-field and one's eyes turn the same color as the positive being. Since it is energy, it can fly and phase through objects. The positive being can't stay out of one's body too long or it'll dissolve into nano-particles and be reincarnated by a negative being. However, if the two merge together, they become unstable and will explode.
summary: The ability to project one's positive energy into a human like-being.
strengths: Can fly
Can phase through objects
weaknesses: Can't stay in positive being for a long time
Merging with negative equals explosion.

name: Dagger Wrist
description: When used it will make a slit in your wrist (it wont hurt). And a dagger chain will come out. It can hurt you but it is indestructible,And can support any weight so you can swing on it.
summary: The ability to summon a dagger chain out of your wrist
strengths: Have a weapon in any situation
Swing off the dagger-tail
Completly concealable
weaknesses: The slit wont hurt but the dagger will
If you bring it to a gun fight
You have to practice

name: Magma Mimicry
description: This power combines rock & fire mimicry. The Thing & Human Torch fused together. Your body will convert itself into burning lava creating obsidian body armor. You'll have increased strength & durability. You can secrete & spew lava & make volcanic blasts. The negative side to this power is your speed is slow & water can harden you till your frozen solid.
summary: The ability to become living molten rock
strengths: Increased Strength
Molten lava powers
weaknesses: Hindered speed
Water equals enemy
Burn everything you touch

name: Twisted Liquid Reflection
description: This power gives you full control over what is reflected on the surface of any liquid. You can even make moving objects, or as if there was not even any liquid at all. To use it, you must touch the liquid while imagining an image or a scene and it will appear on the surface as if it was a movie or a picture.
summary: The ability to change what someone sees on the surface of a liquid to whatever you imagine.
strengths: You can hide people/items beneath the surface of lakes or pools.
Or you can make sure no one takes water from your secret oasis.
This ability works on any liquid. Just to be clear, pudding is not a liquid.
weaknesses: You can only change the parts of the liquid you can see.

name: Myth Power: Hebe's Hedge
description: Hebe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of youth, youthful vigor and the young, as well as Cupbearer of the Gods. As such, channeling her allows one to only age to one's physical prime, thus gaining eternal youth. In addition, one can psychically de-age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone younger than middle age (young adults, teens, kids, etc). One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the young.
summary: The ability to channel Hebe's command over the essence of youth, the young and youthful vigor
strengths: Gain Eternal Youth (remain in the physical prime of youth)
Psychically de-age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the young, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the young, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's youth into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Geras' Guard and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Wanted
description: You can strip someone of all their powers & replace them with the least wanted power on This List. Depending on how many powers they have is the factor of how many most wanted powers you gain.
summary: The ability to make someone have the least wanted powers while you gain most wanted
strengths: Give someone the crappiest powers created
Gain the MVPs (Most Valuable Powers)
weaknesses: Can only gain has many most wanted powers as the # of powers the other person has
Least wanted could become more popular each day

name: The Dorian Gray Complex.
description: Not to be confused with the Dorian Gray Syndrome, the user of -this- ability can place their soul into an object and therefore become immortal, so long as that object is not harmed and/or destroyed. The user thus retains their prime appearance and is enhanced to peak human conditioning. The user can also separate their soul into multiple objects, making their destruction incredibly difficult -- the user is still unaffected even when many portions of their soul has been dissipated.
summary: The ability to cast one's own soul into objects.
strengths: The user is immortal.
The user is enhanced.
weaknesses: If the object is damaged or destroyed, the user suffers the same fate.

name: Clothing Kinesis
description: With this ability, you can control any piece of clothing you wear. You can even fly with this power by making your clothes fly. You can use your clothing to boost your own power and you can use a cape/scarf as an extra limb(s) You can throw your hat and have it come back at you. This power works on any clothing that you wear regardless of the material. Touch other people's clothes directly also give you control over them. Your power overrides other forms of cloth control since it is specialized.
summary: The ability to control all the clothes you wear
strengths: If you made clothes with titanium/kevlar or some durable material
You can change very fast.
You can simulate strength/flight with a full body suit or a cape and gloves
weaknesses: If people destroy your clothes
If you are captured they will throw you in a cell naked
If you wear a cape you can get sucked into a turbine

name: Witch Time
description: This power is more like a magic spell. Whenever you dodge an attack (or anything that's going to hurt you) at the last second, time automatically slows down.
summary: The ability to slow down time after dodging at the last second.
strengths: Enemies would be moving in slow motion to you.
Enemies would think you have super speed.
weaknesses: You can't control it. The time slow-down happens automatically as soon as you dodge.
Dodging at the exact last second isn't easy.

name: Call Of The Wild
description: When the chips are down, you can use this power to call every single animal in a 10-mile radius to aid you in combat, as long as the animal wouldn't die leaving its habitat, for example a fish, it would come to you as quickly as possible. You would also be able to give them commands and they will understand you.
summary: The ability to call for help to every single animal in the surrounding area
strengths: Get help from a lot of animals
Animals are strong
weaknesses: Maybe there isn't a lot of animals nearby
Maybe they're all weak

name: Myth Power: Ocean/Tethys Power
description: Ocean (Oceanos, Oceanus, Ogenos) in Greek myth, was the Titan god of ocean's expanses; his wife Tethys was the Titan goddess of freshwater, as a source of nourishment. As such, channeling Ocean, one can perceive and manipulate water, turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to anywhere submerged in water. Channeling Tethys, one can perceive, communicate with and share the senses of any being submerged in water (not just aquatic species), and generate drinkable water at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ocean and Tethys' command over the essence of freshwater and the ocean
strengths: Perceive, manipulate, and mimic water at will (in water form, breathe underwater
Project your sight to anywhere submerged in water; generate potable water at will
Perceive, communicate with and share senses with any creature submerged in water (even non-aquatics)
weaknesses: Cannot become physically stronger underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot become invisible underwater until the higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: New Emotional Spectrums
description: It can grant you the ability to create solid-light constructs, wild animals, and weapons; whatever only you imagine. Here are the new inversions. Pink - Kindness, Magenta - Temperance, Brown - Sloth (Laziness), Teal - Wisdom, Tan/Beige - Humility, White - Life, Grey - Immortality, Scarlet - Chaos, Crimson - Vampirism, Bistre - Obedience, Gold - Pride/Vanity, Silver - Diligence Bronze - Cruelty.
summary: The ability to have new different wavelengths of light based on thoughts and feelings.
strengths: Might be use for a greater good.
weaknesses: Might be use for Extraordinary Evil.

name: Myth Power: Phobos' Fear
description: Phobos (Phobus), in Greek myth, was the god of fear and phobia. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive fear (the feeling itself, and what fear in particular), induce fear, amplify fear (even to the point of overwhelming, paralyzing phobia) and negate fear by touch, word or thought. In addition, one gains physical power in the presence of (non-induced) fear. One can even totally withstand the effects of fear (whether natural or induced) and share this immunity by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Phobos command over the essence of fear and phobia
strengths: Perceive, identify, induce, amplify and reduce fear in others at will (really easy to scare others)
Gain physical power from the (natural, non-induced) fear and phobia of others
Immunity to irrational fear (natural or induced); share Fear Immunity (Fearlessness) by touch
weaknesses: Cannot cast phobic illusions (illusions of what scares a foe) until the higher levels
Cannot be used to induce or manipulate nightmares (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath, MythPower: Enyo's Laugh, Fearlessness, etc provide immunity

name: Auto Desk
description: When you are having trouble you can pull up this smart computer and ask for a resolution. This power really helps with problem solving and you can even ask it to create an acual object of your design.
summary: The ability to make a levatating touchscreen smart computer pop up
strengths: Have infinite info at your fingertips
Can cheat on any test
Can show up on your eyes instead of in front of you
weaknesses: Can attract viruses
Can crash
Can't use without special fingertips (need to do ritual)

name: Mechanical Imperceptibility
description: A person with Mechanical Imperceptibility has a strange gift. No machine can register their presence--radar, infra-red detectors, even household cameras. They simply do not show up on film. This aura can be extended to up to twice your body mass. However, it cannot be turned off and secondary effects still show up (doors opening, footprints, etc.).
summary: The ability to be undetectable to machines
strengths: Unable to show up on cameras
Unable to be heard on recordings
Can be extended to twice your body mass
weaknesses: Secondary effects still show up (doors opening or closing)
Not invisible to people
Cannot be turned off

name: Existence Nullification
description: Saying someone does not exist causes them to disappear and it's as if they never began existence. When this happens, everyone's memories of that person are erased (including yours) and anything they ever did will be gone as well, such as children, bank accounts, jobs, records, if they murdered, those people return with a present life. The time between them dead and coming back alive, false memories are implanted in people's minds, as if they were still alive, even to the reanimated.
summary: The ability to cause someone to never have existed just by saying so.
strengths: Very effective.
Practically unbeatable.
Can null more than one at a time. ("You all don't exist")
weaknesses: Dire consequences.
Can still be attacked by surprise. Therefore, do not have time to nullify the existence.
If you null yourself or someone else with this power nulls you, the same effect happens. See desc.

name: Bio Metallic Parasite
description: You can manipulate the (beneficial)parasite's size to make an near-indestructible metal shield or create a slide to prevent a hazardous fall. The parasite will react instinctly when your in harm. Example, someone is about to punch you from behind and the parasite will coil around your enemies arm preventing the punch. The parasite responds to your mental commands so if you think it, you get it.
summary: The ability to manipulate a small piece of metal that lives on  your body
strengths: You will rarely get hurt
Traveling isn't much of a problem
You can make it small enough to prevent you from feeling it
weaknesses: It will tire you easily if you don't  build your endurance
A reflex time may not be quick enough to prevent some attacks
Sometimes the parasite will have a mind of its owns

name: Transparency Curse
description: This power allows you to put a particular curse on anyone you want. The curse is that their thoughts are no longer confined in their own mind and can therefore be perceived by anyone in their vicinity. How big that vicinity is depends on the emotional state of the accursed, ranging from tens of meters to tens of kilometers. The victim usually won't realize they've been cursed until they've been told so or they notice people's reaction. Only the person who put that curse can lift it.
summary: The ability to curse anyone into being a "thought transparent".
strengths: You can make the most intimate secrets of anyone public.
In a combat situation, you AND your allies can anticipate your opponent's moves.
You can drive anyone to suicide, isolation or craziness, as it is unbearable to have that curse.
weaknesses: The curse can also be lifted if you die. If your victims realize this, you're in big trouble.

name: Movie Madness   Hero Syndrome!
description: This what enables an Action Star to overcome any boundaries within a movie, and most often than not succeed at whatever situation calls for his expertise. Expertise can be anything from complete control and accuracy of any weapon, leaping from high places and landing without suffering harm, to being a formidable hand-to-hand combatant, surviving on sheer force of impulse, and disarming an atomic warhead with only a few seconds to spare. Among other possibilities imaginative!
summary: The ability to become a hero as if the protagonist of an action movie!
strengths: Basically, the talents are seemingly in the Hero's favor.
Limited only to the Hero's personal existence.
Is also a probable answer to wearing the same clothing one had worn the other day.
weaknesses: Nothing bad previously known.
Nothing bad currently known.
Nothing bad futurely known.

name: Magi (Magus)
description: When you are a magi you gain the ability to call forth a mystical sword that represents your essence. You also gain acrobatic skills, stronger endurance, and the ability to discharge energy from your body. The "magi blade" is indestructible and can either slice through any object or deflect it. Your sword is easy to call forth although if separated from it you must concentrate to call it back. A magi can also sense the presence of other magi.
summary: The ability to call forth a sword and become a superhuman.
strengths: You may have abilities that other Magi don't have.
Your endurance is extremely high so you can take a lot of punishment.
An energy discharge is much more lethal than a firearm.
weaknesses: You are not the only Magi so there will be rivalry.
Must concentrate to call back sword.
Other Magi can sense when you are near.

name: Spiritual Purification
description: We all know that there are some real creeps out there: rapists, pedophiles, criminals, devil worshippers, etc. This power enables the user to purify a person's spirit. Turn some child molester into a dedicated catholic or something. Or even something small, like turning a bully into a "sweetie." But maybe, if someone was pure evil, this power would either purify them--or destroy them.
summary: The ability to purify anyone's spirit
strengths: Lower population of creeps, criminals, and bullies
If anyone tries to do anything bad to you, just purify them and they'll stop
weaknesses: Can't attack, just defend

name: Kigen Arts
description: This ability allows one to borrow and reshape the spirit of nature. The spirit can take any form, offensive and/or defensive means, under your command. Using this ability may corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your ability.
summary: The ability to borrow and reshape the spirit of nature
strengths: Can resurrect the dead by transferring the borrowed spirit from nature.
You can create a barrier or pure blast of spiritual energy.
weaknesses: May corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your powers
Overuse of this ability may anger nature, resulting in violent weather

name: Awakened Power
description: A person who has the Awakened Power has the ability to max out all of one's abilities to the maximum level the dimension can handle. Such as strength, speed or other super powers to their most powerful, making the person more powerful than even most gods for a short period of time. To use the Awakened Power, one must know the name of their soul, not the name given to them by their parents at birth.
summary: The ability to max out all of one's stats and powers for a cost.
strengths: You can become stronger than anyone to the point the Hulk looks as weak as a kitten
Your senses will also be maxed out, such as sight and sound and even touch.
All other powers will also be maxed out such as semi fire control into universal fire control
weaknesses: Must know the name of your soul.
Best used by immortals as it can shorten a mortal's life span by 10 years each time they use it.
Maxed out senses mean maxed out sensitivity

name: Ultimate Physical Strength
