description: The person that wants this power is either very powerful or a fool. This power grants the user unmatched physical strength but does not grant any of the necessary powers to make it useful. The user is not able to even move without causing a disaster, except by blowing through their mouth. The user remains as brittle as ever, thus their arms can break if not actively repelling anything. Please do not choose this power if you don't have the required secondary powers or it will be your own undoing.
summary: The ability to have unmatched physical strength without the required secondary powers
strengths: No one can beat you in a head-on fight (except yourself)
Your very movements can cause natural disasters
weaknesses: Super Strength does not give you super speed or endurance
You cannot move or else the ground you walk on will become a crater and your foot will be stuck
You cannot even use this power without the required secondary powers

name: Instinct Negation
description: Also called Instinct Termination, Instinct Suppression or Instinct Blocking. This is the ability to psychically cancel out the subjects' instincts and innate behaviors. One with this ability could cause a person to not get off the train tracks, even though they see the train coming, or cause a person not to move their hand off the stove, even though the temperature is very high and everything in their mind tells them that harm is coming to them.
summary: The ability to cancel out the innate behaviors and responses of living things
strengths: Even pwn people with Superhuman Reflexes (they react faster, but that's if they react AT ALL)
Hurt enemies, and then negate their innate instinct to retaliate or get help
Foes won't move when the train is coming, or get out of the crossfire in a gunfight, etc.
weaknesses: The number of people that can be affected depends on how developed your power is
Effects may be permanent
If powerful, also cancels autonomic body responses (now you're going to superhuman jail for murder)

name: The Perfect Vampire
description: A perfect vampire is basically a vampire without all of the stupid weaknesses. Powers: Strength, Speed, Agility, Senses, Healing, and Hypnotism. You have fangs that can be used to pierce the skin of humans to suck blood. The only things that can kill you are getting your head cut off and being set on fire and burning to death.
summary: The ability to be the perfect version of a vampire.
strengths: You can actually walk in the sun.
Crosses, holy water, wooden stakes, and silver DON'T hurt or kill you.
weaknesses: Decapitation (getting your head cut off) kills you.
Incineration (being set on fire and burned) kills you.
Lack of blood will make you tired and dizzy.

name: Polymer Reformation
description: A person with this power has a power similar to Polymerkinesis, but can only break up polymers (and selectively reform them), not control them like a magnet. A person with polymer manipulation can break up any type of polymer within a 7 ft. range and can also selectively reform polymers within a 1 ft. range. Besides manipulating plastics and nylon, the user can also break up the proteins in muscles and reform them, giving them either tougher or more elastic muscles.
summary: The ability to break up synthetic and natural polymers (and reform them)
strengths: You can instantly "recycle" any plastic and change its properties to a certain extent
You can control your own muscles to make it either more elastic or tougher
You can break up muscles or plant tissues at will
weaknesses: Can only reform polymers when less than 1 ft. away
Accidental Clothing Damage if not mastered, also this does not work on metals

name: Transforming Dragon Master #2
description: As Master of Martial Arts, styles & ways you are gifted with the ability to transform into forms of base elements through fighting styles. Earth, wind, fire & water. Continuous movement in a style grants more bodily changes. Fight long enough & you morph into a full form of an element, able to use incredible durability, endurance & strength. You could even lend your powers to others if you are fighting in tandem. You innately know each fight style when you begin practice or battle.
summary: The ability to transform yourself into many forms of elements through martial arts
strengths: Transform into any form of fire for burning offense
Transform into any form of earth or water for defense
Mix elements to form fighting clay, lava, dust storm, geysers, hail etc.
weaknesses: Complete devotion to movements & absolute focus is needed to maintain element fighting forms
You cannot force your element form, each style dictates what form you must take
You can lend your powers only to people who can mimic the fighting style (preferably another master)

name: Weather Fusion
description: This ability allows the user to fuse with any weather condition. When the person is fused, they are the weather and can control it. For example, being rainy lets them control all the rain drops like bullets and attacking the rain does nothing, being sunny lets them control the heat, etc. However, the limit is the time the weather condition is active. If the user does not unfuse before the weather condition ends, they will forever be stuck as that weather condition.
summary: The ability to fuse with the weather
strengths: You are invincible as long as it is the same type of weather
You can control the weather to attack
You can create a pattern that looks like you, similar to a mirage to speak
weaknesses: You must unfuse before the weather ends every time you use this or you will be stuck as the weather
If you are stuck, you will be "immortal" but you can only appear if the same weather occurs again
You cannot activate any other powers when you are the weather

name: Human Imprintation
description: You can take the soul of any human and put it in something or someone else. If you put the soul in an inanimate object they will feel the thing as their body and be able to comuniicate through limited telepathy. If you put the soul in someone else, the person will either develop split personality disorder and the other personality will be the souls, or the soul will just be a voice in their head, depending on the willpower of the person
summary: The ability to take the soul of a person and put it in an inanimate object
strengths: Mess with people.
Put bad guys literally, and permanently in jail
You could rule the world
weaknesses: It's permanant and you could regret doing it
It takes time
VERY hard to control

name: Blessing Of Erebus
description: Erebus, the Greek god of shadows and darkness, is one of the minor and less known gods. His blessing gives you powers over the dark. For one, you can control shadows as living things. They are your faithful servants. You can make them do whatever you want. They can reshape themselves and store things within themselves. However, you cannot become a shadow or shadow travel.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Erebus
strengths: Control shadows
The shadows can reshape and store things within themselves.
Shadows can spy on things for you and can "communicate" with you
weaknesses: Can only summon so many shadows to help you at once
No shadow mimicry or travel

name: Lightning Familiar
description: When you use this ability you can create a lightning bolt that you throw into the ground it'll summon any creature in lightning form to protect you. However, you can't touch them or you'll get shocked and they only last 5 minutes only allowed 3 at a time.
summary: The ability to throw a lightning bolt to summon a familiar
strengths: Summon a familiar to protect you
Shock and destroy your enemies
You can trick people into believing that your lighting bolt is a weapon
weaknesses: Can't touch your pets
Only lasts 5 minutes
Three at a time

name: Blackened Bone Manipulation
description: If parts of the bone grows outside of the body, the outer area in contact with the air becomes black and near indestructible. The bone feeds of the blood of its enemies, and will become stronger the more blood it absorbs. Another point is that the bone that has been grown outside of the body can be snapped off without pain and used as a weapon. However, this bone becomes weaker than it would normally be. Small shards of bone can be fired from the under side of the wrist.
summary: The ability to grow bones in any area of your body, the bone hardens on contact with the air.
strengths: Any normal broken bone can be replaced by this untill the original has repaired itself.
Almost no limit to the amount of bone than can be grown.
If developed properly, the bone can also be used as a form of armour.
weaknesses: Because of the thirst of blood that the bones have, the owner can become driven crazy by the thirst.
The uncontrollable thirst can sometimes leave the owner open to attacks.
They need blood to survive. If they do not get enough, then they will feed upon the owner's blood.

name: Composing
description: Once this ability is first gained, the user can memorize a song completely the first time the song is heard all the way through. Once this ability has been trained halfway to full strength, hearing the name of a song causes them to memorize every word and note of the song. Once the ability has hit full power (or once the user turns 21, whichever comes first), they've memorized every song in the world and gain a new ability every time a new song is sung all the way through.
summary: The ability to hear the name of a song and immediately know every word and note
strengths: Be a great singer
Never forget words to any song
Become stronger based on other people's songwriting talent
weaknesses: Cannot gain new abilities based on your own songs
Takes years to master this power, even if you are born with it
Really hard power to gain (like one in a million)

name: Curse Eater
description: A demon, human, or other entity with the Curse Eater power would be able to absorb any harmful magic that is fixed to a location, phrase, event, or otherwise tied down to a condition. The entity would then be able to use the power they gained from their meal for magic.
summary: The ability to devour curses for their magical power and use it as a spell.
strengths: Most people avoid curses, so you live without that hanging over your head.
Magic not specifically directed can be devoured to fuel your own spells.
Even a normal person with the Curse Eater power could be an extraordinary sorcerer.
weaknesses: You would gain enemies - enemies that are probably sorcerers or divine beings.
A sorcerer with Curse Eater would find that it stunt their magic growth.
People might think you're weird if you stalk around asking for rumors about the local haunted house.

name: Literally Literal
description: You are able to pick out an idiomatic expression from someone and force them to reenact it, e.g. if someone were to say "pinch me, I'm dreaming", you could pinch them and they would disappear from this world and wake up in another world; if someone said "this bites", an animal will appear out of nowhere and bite them; if someone said "when pigs fly", a random pig with wings/jetpacks will appear in the sky; etc.
summary: The ability to force someone to enact their idiomatic expression.
strengths: Great for a good prank, or getting rid of enemies, e.g. if an enemy said "I'd rather die"
You can control how an idiom is enacted, from funny to deadly (if that idiom is possibly lethal)
weaknesses: Cannot use it on yourself. Is also permanent
Can only use it once a day per person
Can only use it on one idiomatic sentence per person

name: Ebony Whip
description: It may look like a regular whip, except for the tones of nanoliquid. Whenever you use it, it assumes features which seem to be revolving around both shadow and phantom. With the phantom powers, you are able to remove and control an opponent's powers using a ghastly force by wrapping them around it, and in shadow form, you are able to change her size and shape at will, forming tentacles, and hardening it to punish foes and break through anything.
summary: The ability to morph it and use it to punish your foes from upclose or afar.
strengths: Can fire medium-sized black spikes from the whip.
Could wrap your enemy around your whip, then spin until the victim's bones fly out of their body.
weaknesses: It will not work against water/ice-type opponents.

name: Walls Of Jericho
description: It is designed to block and trap foes that are in contact with the barriers. They can be stunned, or even zapped if they run into it. It is also intended to stop the spread of zombies, werewolves and vampires, and instantly absorb projectiles.
summary: The ability to create barriers that can absorb projectiles and can hurt and trap opponents that run into it.
strengths: Nothing can stop it, except magic.
weaknesses: Only those with light or dark magic can destroy the walls.

name: Brush Of Truepaint
description: The Brush Of Truepaint is a brush that allows you to create a portal on a canvas that lets you go inside. Once inside, you can imagine something and the brush will auto-paint it for you. This also works on creatures. Everything in the painting is real and real time...The trees will move, wind will blow, creatures will move... When you paint the portal back out, the canvas will contain the things you painted.
summary: The ability to make portals into paintings and paint
strengths: A safe haven for easy hidden escape that no one would think to look
Painting appears normal from the outside, nobody can see the brush
Can create things in the canvas world, like toys and animals to play with
weaknesses: If someone destroys the painting, then you are stuck till you paint the scene on another canvas
Could get cluttered if you don't realize how much your painting
Painted items could turn against you.

name: Evolution Of Pokemon
description: With this power you can pick a combination of two Pokemon types and evolve up to two times to gain powers based on which combination you choose and how you use your powers while you are evolving. As you evolve you become more Pokemon like. Which types you pick as your primary and secondary types changes how you will become. You will learn four skills as you evolve based on how you train power. You can change out of Pokemon form at will. Can change types but will have to retrain powers.
summary: The ability to evolve in a similar way to the way a Pokemon does.
strengths: Become any combination of Pokemon types.
Learn up to four special skills to use while in Pokemon form.
Can change type choices and can change out of Pokemon form to normal at will.
weaknesses: Can not use learned skills if not in Pokemon form.
Have to retrain if you want to add the ability to change into a different type combo.
Watch out for MasterBalls.

name: Parody Power
description: This power requires a good imagination and a good sense of humor. You have to observe what someone's power does. You have to be a 100 feet or closer. You have to think of a parody of the power you're observing. The parody effect last for a hour. Joke powers and cartoon-based powers are immune to this power as is this power itself.
summary: The ability to temporarily change someone's power into a parody version of itself.
strengths: Alter a foe's power and have a laugh at the same time.
A good power if your funny and imaginative.
weaknesses: You are dull-witted.
You choose to read a quantum physics book rather than watch a funny movie.

name: Zodiac: Gemini
description: With this power you can do what Al Bester in Babylon 5 did, just on someone else. You can make someone else's psychic signature appear to be yours for 2 hours by drawing the sign of Gemini above their head.
summary: The ability to create a psionic clone of yourself
strengths: Make enemies confused as to who is truly you.
weaknesses: If the person decides to commit a crime.
Only lasts for 2 hours.
Unaffected by Con Negation.

name: Apocalypse
description: Nuclear War, pandemic, alien invasion, robot uprising, economic collapse, environmental collapse, EMP strikes. These are among threats that could end civilization as we know it. You can select and shift details of any sort of apocalypse you choose, and travel to alternate timelines where it has occurred or where it will occur. Your power will eventually choose a time in the main timeline-and slowly torture you if you refuse to end the world. This is open to modification by other powers, however.
summary: The ability to control the end of the world as we know it
strengths: Have private access to alternate timelines of your choosing/control, along with privacy in them
If the time isn't 'right,' you can reverse the damage of other potential apocalypses
You can also start the apocalypse at will, but then reverse it or dampen its effects
weaknesses: Unless you are VERY careful with the real time-line effects, people will try to kill you
If you choose to enter one of the timelines and be able to take things out of it, you can die in it
The glorious post-apocalyptic genre of fiction might get to be pretty boring for you

name: 3rd Person Vision
description: With this ability you can view yourself as if from a third person perspective. You will still be able to move normally, but see everything from a different perspective. You will see yourself as if from a bystanders point of view and can change where you are looking from (i. E. Height, angle, zoom).
summary: The ability to view yourself from a 3rd person point of view
strengths: Be able to see everything around you
Can still move normally
weaknesses: Coordination is slightly impaired, until your vision return's to normal

name: Myth Exchange
description: With this power you have the ability to change the attributes or aspects of any mythological or fictional creature with that of another mythological or fictional creature. Such as making zombies only be hurt by silver while werewolfs will hunger for brains. Also Zeus could be made master of the seas while Hades could be made to suck blood like a vampire. You can change one creature without having to affect any similar creature or creature you got the attribute from.
summary: The ability to switch the attributes and aspects of mythological and fictional creatures.
strengths: Swap attributes of mythological creatures to ones that you can more easily handle.
Create new mythological creatures by mixing attributes.
If you become a mythological creature (zombie, etc. ) you can use this on yourself.
weaknesses: Can only swap the attributes of two species (e.g. werewolf), or Gods etc. at a time.
Angering an Olympian by changing its power.
The attribute or aspect you switch to may not be any better for you than the one you switched from.

name: Madness Into Matter
description: By touching a psychotic person's head, you can turn his delusions into reality. If he believed he was Napoleon, he really becomes an awesome strategist who speaks French. If the person believes he's monitored by aliens, little green man really show up. WARNING: a psychotic delusion is rarely stable, so this power can become extremely uncontrollable.
summary: The ability to turn any psychotic person's delusion into reality
strengths: Can recreate Napoleon, John Lennon, etc.
Can summon aliens and whatsoever.
weaknesses: Can become uncontrollable.
Manipulating another person's mind is not so ethical.
Only works on one psychotic person's delusion at a time

name: Feeding
description: When you spot your victim you can weaken them by using tentacles hidden in your chest to capture your prey. When your prey is cuaght the tentacles and the victim is dragged into your chest and the longer your victim is in their the more energy is drained.
summary: The ability to feed off of people's energy
strengths: Always have an unlimited energy supply as long as living beings exist
Can feed as much as you want.
Grow stronger after every feeding.
weaknesses: Can't give back energy
When low on energy you will automatically start feeding
You must always feed as long as you live.

name: Credit
description: With this power you can sacrifice money in order to achieve anything instantly that you could of obtained with that money. This includes sacrificing objects for their respective monetary value. For example, you could sacrifice a certain quantity of money to teleport as if you had paid that money to hire a taxi. However, you can not use money to make money with this power, by saying you invest it or something else, but there are ways around this.
summary: The ability to achieve instantly anything you could achieve with money over time.
strengths: Makes money easier to use.
Instantly achieve what would normally take a large amount of time.
If you are rich, then you have many possibilites with this power.
weaknesses: Only can do what you could realitically achieve with the money you have.
Running out of money and not being able to use this power.
The money is lost from the economy.

name: Full Metal Alchemists: Truth
description: One with this power is able to summon the gate of truth and go through it, going through the gate of truth allows one to do alchemy without use of transmutation circles, one who practices this ability could also be able to perform alchemy without even movement. Just thought.
summary: The ability to be able to summon the gate of truth.
strengths: Perform alchemy without circles.
weaknesses: The truth isn't always good.
You see terrible memories once you walk through the gate.

name: Drill Hands
description: With this power you can turn you hands into drills whenever you want. The drills are super powerful and can drill holes through almost anything. You can also change the size of the drills to increase power and to make bigger holes.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into drills
strengths: You can turn your hands into drills
They can drill through almost anything
You can make the drills bigger or smaller for more power or to make bigger holes
weaknesses: Drilling large holes can be tiring

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes1
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Anteros (Anterus- Mutual, Returned, Requited Love, Avenger of Unrequited Love), one can perceive a subject's love interest, and whether that love interest (including one's own) returns the same affections. In addition, if they DON'T, one may afflict them with ONE curse. One may even afflict a curse on (and do enhanced damage against) those who have hardened, unfeeling, unloving hearts.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive a subject's love interest, and if the love interest returns the same affections
Inflict a curse on one's love interest if they don't return one's affections
Inflict a curse on (and do enhanced damage against) heartless, unloving foes
weaknesses: Only generate wings to fly, summon (and use proficiently) a bow and arrow at will at higher levels
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Superpower List A Day
description: This ability lets you have any power on this list in order for 12 hours when you start to use it
summary: The ability to have a power from the superpower list everyday
strengths: Any power on the list
Cool powers
weaknesses: Only last one day
Only for 12 hours of that day
In alphabetical order

name: Spell Cutter
description: Someone with this power can cut spells into pieces (thus preventing the spell from being cast) with any bladed item. Spell strength does not matter as the spell is negated. A holder of this power can tell that a spell is being cast because they'll see a design appear near the spellcaster. Cutting the design prevents the spell from being cast. The design is what represents the spell and size and elegance differ dependent on the magnitude and complexity of the spell.
summary: The ability to prevent spells from being cast with ordinary bladed items
strengths: Works with any blade.
Works on any spell.
weaknesses: Requires a blade.
Only eliminates spells, magic that isn't formed into a spell isn't affected by this power.
Power only works before the spell is cast not after.

name: Dive Breath
description: This power allows you to give others the power to breathe underwater. Although the effect is temporary and fades after a while. The user must first breathe into the desired person's mouth for effective use.
summary: The ability to give others the ability to breathe underwater
strengths: You and others can breathe underwater
You can endow multiple people because it's temporary
Good for scuba diving trips
weaknesses: Power is temporary and will wear off after 4 hours
Must breathe deeply into the target's mouth
Only works by breathing directly into the target's mouth

name: Plant Immunity
description: Any harm caused by plants has no effect on the holder of this power. Poisons, leaves, tree trunks, vines, etc. Nothing originating from plants will have any harmful effect.
summary: The ability to be immune to harm caused by plants
strengths: Can run through poison oak with no worries!
Don't have to worry about plant food while in the wilderness.
weaknesses: Animals can still hurt you.
Part-animal part-plants are borderline for immunity.

name: Myth Power: Apheleia's Affinity
description: Apheleia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of simplicity and plainness. As such, channeling her allows one to force subjects to speak bluntly and straightforwardly, with a touch; they will be unable to speak beyond the understanding capability of the least intelligent subject in the room. In addition, when one touches a subject/object, they can instantly learn all of its parts, functions and rules needed to operate. One can even touch a text and psionically reduce it to its simplest terms at will.
summary: The ability to channel Apheleia's command over the essence of simplicity and plainness
strengths: Force subjects to speak plainly and bluntly (make conversation easy to understand)
Psychically learn object/subject's anatomy/parts/functions/operation (Intuitive Aptitude), by touch
Touch a text (written, typed, etc) and psionically reduce it to its simplest/easiest terms
weaknesses: Cannot psionically translate languages (written, spoken, typed, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically reduce/simplify a foe's understanding, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: E Mail Powers
description: With this ability, your e-mails are divided into categories like clothing stores, Junk, and of course superpowerlist. Clothing store mails would give you clothing powers, Junk mail gives you trash control, superpowerlist e-mails give you the power if accepted, rejected ones are corrected to be less overpowered,more orginal (etc.), then given to you.
summary: The ability to gain powers based on e-mails.
strengths: You could get many powers.
weaknesses: No email.
Don't believe in sending or receiving e-mails

name: Compass Corpse
description: You need to have a corpse. Other forms, such as bones or ashes, can be affected once you master this power. By touching the body, you can cause it to signal in which direction their murderer(s) is(are) if there are any. If the deceased was a strong-willed person or at least would have shown some determination to help capture the culprit(s), the body could even move on its own toward their killer(s). This power doesn't discriminate between intentional and accidental killings.
summary: The ability to make a corpse look/point toward their murderer(s).
strengths: Help families get closure by identifying the murderer of their loved one.
Discover on whom you should take revenge for the murder of your loved ones.
Traumatize the culprits by making the corpses move.
weaknesses: The deceased won't be able to perform actions other than indicating who killed them.
You have to touch a dead body.
If you're the culprit and you didn't know it.

name: Artistic Influence
summary: The ability to get any power depending from the meaning of an artwork.
strengths: A very wide range of acquirable powers, as various as the artistic production;
The possibility to choose some favorite artworks which effect is more appreciable;
The power is mantained for all the time the subject needs.
weaknesses: The subject must have a representation of the artwork with him, and in front of him;
Every power is limitated;
The subject's feeling must be properly "inspired".

name: Movie Projector
description: With this power you can produce any movie that ever appeared in a movie theater onto any flat surface from your eyes. You don't have to have seen the movie but you have to know the name of it and the year it was released in theaters.
summary: The ability to project any movie onto any flat surface from your eyes
strengths: You can project any movie onto any flat surface
weaknesses: It has to have been in theaters
You have to know the name of the film and the year it was released in theaters

name: Power Purge
description: Caution: Since otherwise it would be a real bother, especially if you have too many powers, you can't decide which powers to get rid of. When activated, this power automatically chooses which powers to delete based on how often they were used, how proficient you were in using them, how beneficial they were to you and how long you had them. It only works on powers you own. Depending on the situation, the discarded powers may still get back though. Also, this power is NOT immune to its effect.
summary: The ability to get rid of powers that are of no use to you
strengths: No more dumb powers you only got because you didn't have more time to look and grabbed those!
It automatically cleanses your superpower list for you, saving you the bother of looking though it.
It uses a very careful process based on your past uses of your powers.
weaknesses: It doesn't take into account the future possibilities of your powers.
What if you come across an unlikely situation where a dumb power you had would have been useful?
Remember to use this power often, otherwise it can commit 'superpower suicide'.

name: Dead Eye
description: With this power your irises become gun-barrels and you eye-lids become a trigger. All you must do is look at someone and blink and they will appear to be shot. Your eyes fire no bullet and makes no sound, but the victims wound will be that of a high caliber handgun such as a magnum.
summary: The ability to shoot people by blinking at them.
strengths: Carry a weapon with you everywhere.
Shoot anyone stealthyly.
weaknesses: May cause the act of blinking to become very uncomfortabe.
Looking at things doubly so.

name: Fire Sight
description: The user of this power can use fires as their 'eyes'. They can see what is happening around the fire as if they were in the spot they are looking from. The limit is that the fire must be less than 1 kilometre from their body in order to see out of the fire.
summary: The ability to see out of fires
strengths: Hunting a fireuser? This power is perfect!
weaknesses: 1 kilometre isn't that large of an area. 3 to 10 minutes to run that distance.

name: Blood To Water
description: With this power you can turn any amount of blood into pure drinking water. You can use this power while the blood is still in the person which would kill them due to all of their blood becoming water. Or you can use it when the blood is already outside of the person in order to drink.
summary: The ability to turn blood into water
strengths: You can kill people by turning all of their blood into water
You can cut yourself or somebody else and turn the blood into drinking water for you too drink
weaknesses: People might think you're a vampire

name: Invulnerable Eyes
description: With this power you can make your eyes invincible. Your eyes cannot be poked out or become blind. Your eyes also won't hurt if you look at the sun or other bright lights. You also will never get a black eye again. It works on both of your eyes (or all of your eyes if you have more than two) and you can't turn this power off.
summary: The ability to make your eyes invulnerable
strengths: Your eyes are invulnerable
weaknesses: Not an offensive power

name: Toy Model To Living Being
description: Whether it is a doll or a plastic model it will still turn into the living being it is modeled after. It also does not matter whether it is modeled after a human, animal, plant or mythical creature. The new living being will have no memories and no skills other than walking, talking, and thinking unless it was affected by a power that caused it to be sentient then it will keep any skills and memories it had.
summary: The ability to turn models of living beings into actual living beings
strengths: Works on toys affected by Living Toys. Also affects dolls created by Living Doll Creation.
weaknesses: New humans will not have IDs in national databases.
This power cannot reverse itself.
Will need to feed new living beings.

name: Theme Generation
description: Unlike Theme Manager, this power lets you create themed items with out changing other objects. This power lets you create new matter by thinking of a certain theme, and an object you want that follows that theme. At first this power is only capable of creating hand held items, but more complex things can be made as skill grows. All items created must follow the same theme, so if you want to switch themes, all previous items must be changed or deleted first.
summary: The ability to create items that follow a certain theme.
strengths: Create new items that follow a useful theme.
Skill can be developed to create larger more complex objects.
Large variety of themes to use.
weaknesses: All current items created must follow a single theme.
Only small personal items can be created at beginner level.
Needs user to be creative to achieve full potential.

name: Shadow Caller
description: This superpower allows you to call upon someone else's shadow. After the shadow has been called upon, it morphs into a demonic-looking plasma-covered dog and it will stand by your side awaiting orders (it can also morph into a darker version of its original body). The side effect of stealing someone else's shadow is that they slowly suffocate and are unable to speak. This power also allows you to become a shadow as well.
summary: The ability to call upon other people's shadows
strengths: Quick and easy to create an army.
Able to hide from foes easily.
weaknesses: You can get stuck as a shadow and eventually die.
If someone's will is strong enough, they can call back their shadow.

name: Immunity Detection
description: Anything immune to your powers is immediately detected. Even if they would normally be immune to such detection, you can still detect them by sensing the absence of information. It is like dark is the absence of light; you cannot see the dark itself, but you can see the lack of light.
summary: The ability to detect people with immunity to your powers.
strengths: You can finally detect those with Beneath Notice.
Find those immune to which powers before you start a fight.
With other powers, you can identify the nature of the immunity.
weaknesses: May pick up normal items (e. G. Will detect normal humans if you have Ability Detection).
Less useful without other powers.
Very limited uses; if something is immune to a power of yours.

name: Rainbow Slide
description: With this ability, you generate a rainbow-like projection that you can travel on, much like the Marvel Comics character Iceman's ice slides. You slide along it as you generate it. It is fast travel. Some particularly powerful individuals use this ability to transverse intergalactic distances (Up to hyperspatial speeds), although most users just move around the city or country side (100+ mph).
summary: The ability to generate a rainbow that you can travel on
strengths: Fast travel
weaknesses: Brightly colored, it is not a stealthy means of tranportation

name: Myth Power: Agon's Aggression
description: Agon, in Greek myth, was the god of contest and competition. As such, channeling him allows one to to be instantly snapped into peak physical condition. In addition, one can psychically perceive an opponent's game plan or strategy, play by play (as well as any flaws in said plan) at will. Furthermore, one can psychically inflict one misfortune (per power use) on each of one's opponents in a competition, at will. One can even withstand perception and manipulation of probability and skills.
summary: The ability to channel Agon's command over the essence of competition and contest
strengths: Snapped into peak physical condition, even when power's use is up
Psychically perceive an opponent's game plan/strategy (and any flaws in it) at will
Psychically jinx opponents, at will; withstand perception/manipulation of probability and skills
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not amplify stats to superhuman levels until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 and #3 do not apply to combat until developed (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity to Pro #3 (NCN)

name: Horse Control (Horse Mastery)
description: WIth this power you can summon any kind of horse and adjust their size or take control over any horse you see. You can summon giant horse or tiny horses or even medium sized horses. With enough training you will be able to make the horses even bigger and be able to change the sizes of horses that you haven't summoned. You will also be able to control zebras, donkeys, mules and other horse related animals but not summon or size shift them.

strengths: You can control horses
You can summon horses
You can change the size of horses
weaknesses: Its bad if you're allergic to horses or horse related animals
If you never meet anybody with Karate Zebra you will never be able to use the karate zebra control
Part of this power

name: X It
description: With this power you can make people leave a room or building whenever you want. Want someone to leave you alone just make them leave the room. Want a free period just make the teacher leave the school. Want to stage a jailbreak just make all of the cops/guards leave. Once you make the person leave they cannot return until you use this power on a different person in a different building.
summary: The ability to make people leave a room or building
strengths: You can make a person leave a room or building
weaknesses: The person can return to the building/room once you use this power on a person in a different buildi

name: D&D Transformation
description: You must have actually played as a PC with the character and it must not be overpowered (although it can be overpowered if you were using content from a d&d book published by wizards of the coast) also you don't get that character's gear you're still are wearing your own clothes. (sorry no uber sword)
summary: The ability to transform into your d&d character(s)
strengths: Most normal people have 1 to 9 hp you can have hundreds
You are uber
weaknesses: You only get your characters physical stats so no change to int and wis
You must follow the same rules as the character you turn into (Ex: Spells per Day).

name: Induced Insomnia
description: With this power you can cause people to never be able to fall asleep causing them to become weaker, slower and eventually go mad due to lack of sleep. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to cause people to never be able to fall asleep
strengths: You can cause people to never be able to fall asleep
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Blood Monsters
description: With this ability, a red fog appears on you, getting darker as you get angrier. About 3oz of blood work their way out of your body, creating a monster based on your anger, up to 10. These monsters are either Offensive-Scouting, Defensive-Scouting, or in rare cases Offensive-Defensive.
summary: The ability to create monsters from your own blood.
strengths: They are at your command.
weaknesses: If you have no blood to give.
If you are peaceful and calm.
They can be dissapear if you want them to, but can never be unsummoned until mastered.

name: Duplicate Inhabiter
description: With this power you can transfer your consciousness into any clone, robot, statue/wax figure version of yourself and move around in that body. This is useful if your enemy makes an evil clone version of you and takes it back to his base, you can transfer then inhabit the clone and be able to see where the enemy's base is or even fight the enemy as your clone. Or you can build a robot version of yourself and give it powerful weapons and abilities and then transfer your consciousness into it.
summary: The ability to inhabit the bodies of clone/robot/statue versions of yourself
strengths: You can transfer your consciousness into any duplicate of yourself
You don't have to be near the duplicate to inhabit it
weaknesses: If you're real body is destroyed while you're inhabiting a different one you are stuck in that form

name: Spacial Scroll
description: The spacial scroll is a giant red scroll with black star which. By touching an object and saying seal the object will then be teleported into the scrolls hammer space. to get an object out of the scroll just think of the object and say release and it will teleport out of the scroll.
summary: The ability to ustore unlimited items with in it
strengths: Store unlimited amount items
Make packing easy
weaknesses: teleporting large obejects out may hit you
scroll can only teleport objects inside and outside

name: The Seer Of Horizons.
description: This power is a ability that only manifests in those who are neither good nor evil, hanging onto the threads between both forces. The Seer is able to see far over the hypothetical horizons, thus into the future. An outfit also comes with this, but it changes to fit the user, but the colors will always be faded light blue, grayish white, and dark purple. The user can see just seconds, minutes, hours, even years into the future and even split-seconds. The Seer also obtains a gold crystal ball.
summary: The ability to become the Seer.
strengths: Is almost impossible to sneak up on, if that wasn't already clear.
One can even see over the horizons of other people.
The crystal ball enhances the ability of the Seer.
weaknesses: Sometimes seeing the future isn't always pleasant, you won't always be able to change it.
The user of this power is able to lose it by being influenced by external forces.

name: Dwarf Planet Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain powers by shouting the name of the dwarf planets in our solar system. For example, if you shout out Ceres you get to control plants and communicate with them, Pluto (control over ice), Orcus( phasing), Haumea (geokinesis), Quaoar ( energy construct), Makemake (lava-kinesis), Eris ( illusion), Sedna (hydrokinesis).
summary: The ability to be empowered by the dwarf planets in our solar system
strengths: Different powers to counter different situations
Good arsenal to take down enemies
weaknesses: Powers are not that strong compared to planet empowerment

name: The Master Musician
description: With this power you can play any musical instrument perfectly and you can play any song on it. You can play as many instruments at a time as you want provided that it is humanly possible (if you have one of those one man band things you could play that perfectly)
summary: The ability to play any musical instrument perfectly
strengths: You can play any musical instrument perfectly
You can play as many musical instruments at a time as you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Builder's
description: These builders are super tiny (i inch) but can do amazing things, they are able to build anything. Literally.
summary: The ability to summon very tiny beings that are the greatest builders.
strengths: Build anything.
weaknesses: They are easily stepped on.
Since they are tiny, they don't get things done fast.
You are able to temporarily able to make them disappear, but not fully until mastered.

name: Laughing Point
description: With this power you can make people laugh just by pointing at them. You can make your enemies laugh uncontrollably during battle distracting them from doing whatever evil thing they were doing.
summary: The ability to make people laugh when you point at them
strengths: You can make people laugh just by pointing at them
You can make sure people always laugh at your jokes
You can distract your enemies

As you stop pointing at them they stop laughing

name: Sertoli Cell Mimicry
description: This power can only be activated if you are a male. As a Sertoli Cell Mimic, you can absorb dead cells from your species, whether they're yours or not, and convert them into nutrients inside your body. Additionally, you can feed other people by injecting them with nutrients stored inside your body. All you need to do is touch them.
summary: The ability to convert dead cells into nutrients and inject your own nutrients inside someone's body through touch.
strengths: You can feed those who can't feed themselves.
You can feed on your own dead cells if you're hungry.
weaknesses: You need to find a large amount of dead cells to produce a decent amount of nutrients.
You have to be a male or be able to become one to use this power.
You can only feed on cells of the same species as yours.

name: The Beauty Of Death
description: If one were to look you in the eyes (which are ever-changing) they would die painfully, after a long period of 1 whole day. Wearing sunglasses will cancel the effect, and only your deepest love can look without dying.
summary: The ability to kill someone by having them look into your beautiful eyes
strengths: Being beautiful
Torturing enemies
weaknesses: Killing accidentally
Always having to wear sunglasses

name: Cyrolance
description: With this lance you have the power to freeze all most anything apon striking contact,split it into small forms of ice spears and reform it back,and with enough training create snow storms.
summary: The ability to use it to manipulate ice
strengths: Freeze your enemies with a single strike
Control small ice spears
Create snow storms

Takes a lot of training to make snow storms

name: Population Density Control
description: A person with this power can control population density. Causing more people to come and go away from any area at will. The effect is not instantaneous but happens really quickly after the user uses the power. This power is a sort of signaling power combined with reality manipulation and probability manipulation that causes more people to appear where you are. Also this power does not only work on humans, you can increase the population of rats or other animals as well.
summary: The ability to control population density
strengths: Can increase turnout at any event
Can decrease the amount of people surrounding you
Can work to increase the population density of any type of living creature that exists
weaknesses: Cannot control who is in the population that arrives or goes away
Cannot control the people or animals in the population that you bring to your location
Not instantaneous

name: Ally Shift
description: WIth this power you can turn into anybody who has ever helped you in a fight. You get all of their powers and skill while keeping your intelligence level and knowledge. This power only lets you turn into people who have helped you in a fight not any of your friends. You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want and when you're done you can turn back to your normal form.
summary: The ability to turn into any of your allies
strengths: You can turn into anybody who has ever helped you in a fight and you get all of their powers
You retain your intelligence level

name: Avatar Summon
description: (If you like the avatar the last air bender series than this power is for you) with this power you can  Summon forty-six characters from the series. You can only summon one character at a time saw choose wisely. Know your history

strengths: You have forty sixe characters to choose from
Some of the girls might like you
They will help you and protect you

Teams and armies are very hard to summon
Can only summon one character at a time saw choose wisely

name: Arthropod Armour
description: Chitin is a tough, resilient material; the main component in the exoskeletons of arthropods (invertebrates, like centipedes and lobsters). When this power is activated by triggering a chemical reaction in the skin, a thick layer of segmented chitin grows to encase the user's body. The armour is extremely durable almost to the point of being impenetrable, able to deflect knives and bullets. Repeated attacks will eventually damage the armour, which then must be shed to be removed.
summary: The ability to generate a resilient chitinous substance that envelops the body like armour
strengths: It is almost impossible to be physically harmed when armour is formed
Armour is dense enough to protect the user from explosions and impact damage
weaknesses: Your speed and manoeuvrability is greatly hindered when ability is active
Armour is vulnerable at the joints, much like in crustaceans
Armour does not protect against non-physical damage, such as extreme heat or toxic gasses

name: Jla Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League of America. The hero doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon members of the Justice League of America
strengths: You can summon members of the Justice League
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the League
weaknesses: You can only use the mind control function if you summon only one hero

name: Snap You're Dead V2
description: With this power you can cause a specific person to die by saying their first and last name and then snapping. If their are multiple people with the same first and last name they will all die unless you add a middle name when you use the power.
summary: The ability to cause people to die by snapping your fingers
strengths: You can kill people by snapping
weaknesses: If multiple people have the same name they will all die

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message7
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Terpsichore (Terpsikhore- Choral Song, Dance) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all music, songs and dances, at will. In addition, one can psychically attune to music, to gain genre, title and/or lyric-based abilities, at will. One can even psychically produce music, which compels subjects to perform a perfectly-coordinated dance routine, at will.

name: Summon Blood Golem
description: The ability to summon a blood golem. Any where blood has touched the ground, from a battlefield to a grave yard will be the perfect places to summon blood golems. However you do require blood. But if out of luck your own blood will be enough.

Controlling a blood golem that does your biddings

name: Hoola Hoop Teleportation
description: WIth this power whenever you jump through a hoola hoop you can teleport to any location on the planet that you're on. It doesn't matter if you've been there before you just have to think about the place while jumping through the hoop and you'll instantly go there.

name: Reverse Nature
description: You can reverse the way any part of the human body works. Example: The more someone swallows, the more their mouth fills with spit until they drown. The more someone eats, the emptier their stomach becomes until it devours itself. The more someone urinates, the more their bladder fills until it ruptures.

strengths: You can kill people

It might look gross

name: Overflow
description: A person with this ability can control the flow of fluids in their own body. They can make blood flow faster so that they can get more energy. They can release adrenaline at will into their bloodstream and skilled users can release a fluid called overflow into their own body, increasing energy output by 100-fold but destroying body cells in the process. Other people without this ability are not benefited by overflow in their bodies but will still have their body cells destroyed.

strengths: Can make yourself stronger and faster anytime you want.

name: Kickmaster
description: With this power you have a super strong kick. You can break anything with your feet or send enemies flying. Your foot is not invulnerable though unless you're kicking something though.

strengths: You have a super strong kick
You can kick through anything
weaknesses: Your foot is only super strong/invulnerable when you're kicking things

name: "Speak Animals!" V2
description: With this power you can give animal's the ability to speak any human language. It doesn't have to be a language you know all you have to do it point at an animal and say "Speak Animal! " and the animal will instantly learn every human language.

name: Volume Manipulation
description: With this ability, you are able to multiply the volume of an object by the number of powers you posses/created. If you acquired a power you made, you get twice the bonus. Unfortunately, this only works for powers acquired directly from the site, not through other powers.

name: Myth Power: Thesis' Theorem
description: Thesis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of creation and creativity in nature. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the atomic, molecular and chemical structure of matter, by touch. In addition, one can psychically manipulate and alter the atomic, molecular and chemical structure of matter, by touch. Furthermore, one gains an ingenious superhuman creativity. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with inventors and other creative people at will.

strengths: Psychically perceive matter's atomic/molecular/chemical structure (Material Perception) by touch

name: Rock Portation
description: A person with this power does not have control over rocks but they do have the ability to control the position of any rock within a certain range. This includes being able to teleport concrete. The user can even create constructs by displacing rocks in a certain shape. In addition if skilled you can even teleport rocks into the same position repeatedly at fast speeds to suspend it in air.
summary: The ability to apport or teleport any type of rock or concrete within your vicinity
strengths: Obvious uses include raining rocks or creating instant holes or breaking building supports

name: Inheritance Manipulation
description: The user can use this ability to inherit anything that he/she could inherit; the ones that give the user the inheritance do not have to be dead. One can inherit anything from your family or other kinds of relationships. It can be powers, wealth, possessions, skills, etc. Of course, that means you are actually taking their things before their time. The only people that are not affected by this ability, other than people you don't have a close relationship with, are your descendants.

strengths: Get your inheritance early
Manipulate them

name: Rise Of The Ursagryph
description: With this power you are able to transform yourself into the mythical ursagryph, a creature that is a combination of a bear and a falcon. In ursagryph mode you can fly, have enhanced strength and agility and you can injure people with your talons or beak.
summary: The ability to turn into an ursagryph
strengths: You can turn into an ursagryph

weaknesses: People might attack you thinking you're some kind of evil monster from hell or something

name: Supernetics
description: All of your powers become written into your genetics, unless they are items or armor powers. When you have children, they inherit all powers genetically, but only one becomes active. The only way these offspring can pass on powers however, is if they inherit this power, allowing them to pass their powers on.

strengths: More superheroes.
Items can be passed down through family lines.
A clan of super heroes will fight by your side.
weaknesses: Your offspring might turn against you.

name: Radiation Consumption
description: Like certain species of fungi, a user of this ability is able to feed on normally harmful radiation. This comes with a high level of resistance to said radiation and the user can change which types of radiation their power will affect.

name: Gelatin
description: You can secrete a clear gelatin from specialized glands in your skin and control it telepathically. You can alter its form and properties. summary: The ability to secrete and telepathically control a gelatin like substance
strengths: Amazing potential to do anything
You can give it healing properties
no concentration required

if this got in the hands of a villain

name: Segmented Aura
description: This ability gives the user an aura that is separated into segments. Each of these segments are different for they will have different functions and powers. This segments would be base on a certain theme or something like that. The user can use their aura in 2 forms, complete segmented form or tagmosis form. Complete segmented form is the segmented aura becomes layers to create a barrier and tagmosis form is when the aura's segments are fused together amplifying physical strength and durability.

weaknesses: It will be difficult to control your aura with its segments.

name: Ghiorso Extempore
description: A unrestricted power that allows the wielder to create a superpowered soldier out of nothing but the surrounding materials, with very little effort. The superhumans are unique and have personality identical to an average human being. The wielder has no control over their state of health, and cannot instantly kill them or revive them. Powers of instant death, resurrection, and omni-anything cannot be used.
summary: The ability to spawn superhuman slaves at will.
strengths: Instant Army
Personal Superhuman Bodyguards
weaknesses: Sentience of Creations- probability they can turn against the weilder

name: Stooge Division
description: With this power the user can, with a touch, cause someone to divide into two identical copies of themselves. However, each copy will only have half the intelligence of the original. If you then divide one of these copies that copies intelligence will be split two ways. You can keep dividing clones as long as you want, until you have turned one clever person into a large group of barely functional imbeciles.
summary: The ability to divide a persons intelligence across clone bodies.
strengths: Divide one smart person into twenty dumb ones.
It turns one person into a group.
weaknesses: It turns one enemy into a group.

name: Viper Trap
description: With this power all you have to do is choose a place in your vicinity that isn't being observed (under a table, behind a couch, the inside of a box) and a poisonous snake will materialize there, coiled and ready to strike.   The viper will attack the first living thing that disturbs its hiding place.

strengths: Place an angry viper near someone you want dead.
Multiple snakes may be materilized at once.
weaknesses: The snake does not obey you, and does not just go away once it's bitten someone.
It strikes the first living thing to disturb it's hiding place, not who you want it to bite.
The place you materilize the snake must be currently unobserved.

name: Totems & Crafts
description: By the use of thoughts/magic, you create physical objects, who carry vary in shapes, forms and sizes, as well as purposes too. They contain the shapes, symbols, patterns or motifs on their surfaces that further invoke other powers for you to use, further advancing your current power status. They are physical, and as any physical object, they can be destroyed.
summary: The ability to craft or design totems by the use of thoughts, who further grant you other supernatural powers
strengths: Create items that can elevate your power levels or your magic or any other superpower you have
You can do this continually, as long as you have superpowers, and as long as you have this ability

weaknesses: You are limited to how much of these you can carry. In battle? Not too many sadly.
These are physical objects that can be destroyed, and easily too. Just a swing of a sword is enough.
They are not immune to magic effects. Inverted & Mirror-effects can screw up your use of them.

name: Wind Up Key
description: This power allows you to place a wind up key, like those used on clockwork toys, onto anything and anyone. You can then turn the key to "wind up" whatever you placed it on. Anything wound up by the key takes some action of springs into motion. For example, a person will continue the same sequence of actions they were when you first started turning the key, a car would roll forward, a door would swing open and shut. You can even keep someones heart beating by sticking the key in their chest.
summary: The ability to place a clockwork wind up key on anything.
strengths: You can mke anything move, but only in the way it is suposed to.
Any living thing become paralyzed from the moment you start turning the key.
In addition, they will keep performing their "sequence" until they run out of "power"
weaknesses: How long the effects of the key last depends on how long you "wound" what you put the key in.

name: White Assassin 2
description: The White Assassin Absorber(WAA), has the ability to absorb things with his hands and shoot them out of his hands or they can stay in his hands and he can use them like a hidden knife etc. The (WAA) cannot absorb energy only objects that are not to big. He can absorb little bits of an object if it's too big.

strengths: You can assassinate in plain sight
It's cool to absorb things
weaknesses: The user can only abosrb objects that are the size of the body or smaller
The user needs to touch the item
The user cannot absorb elements

name: Psychic Cushioning
description: With this power, you can create cushions of psychic power with a thought. They protect you from tough blows and can be used as objects like pillows, shields, crash pads, air bags and even road blocks to protect vehicles from accidents. These psychic cushions are tough to penetrate as they are powered by the user's willpower.

strengths: Amazing defensive power.
Never worry about falling to your death.
You'll always have a soft bed.
weaknesses: You can't really harm anyone with this power as the cushions are soft.

name: Age Capability Mimicry
description: At different points in an organisms' life cycle, they may have capabilities lacked in another. With this power, one can manifest such abilities at will. Examples include the regenerative capabilities of a fetus, the enhanced intelligence and learning capabilities of an infant or a teenager's resistance to weight gain. A capability is simply any biological trait specific to one or a few age/s.

strengths: Manifest capabilities you had when younger or will have when older.

weaknesses: You must possess the trait at some point in life, past, present or future, in order to use it.

name: Quartzling Spies
description: This power allows you to create small creatures from quartz with the purpose of discrete espionage. These creatures will function independently following your orders. They are able to project what they see back to you, giving you dozens of moving eyes that are difficult to destroy given how hard quartz is.

For just being evil.
weaknesses: Might hurt someone you didn't want to.

name: Era Adaptation
description: Confused with the latest trends? This ability adapts you to the styles, mannerisms and even languages of a given time. This is even more useful if immortal, since you will not have to adjust and still better for a time traveler, since they wouldn't seem out of place. This also works if you move to another area.
summary: The ability to adapt to current styles, gestures, mannerisms, etc of an era.
strengths: Keep up with the newest styles and trends.
Won't seem like an outsider in another country; you even speak the language fluently.
Even more useful if immortal or a time traveller.
weaknesses: No offensive use.
No combat use.
Does not help you to get where it may be needed (i. E. Does not allow time travel).

name: Primal Impact
description: Primal Impact deals a heavy amount of damage; it can really mess up certain enemies. Unless this attack misses, you might know who's friend or foe.
summary: The ability to go into an infinite rage, unleashing your inner animal.
strengths: When you try to become an rabid animal and not transform into one.
Might even scare off some bullies.
weaknesses: You might wind up losing control of this ability and living off in the jungle forever.

name: Simon Says
description: You can possess a unique power of warping reality by yelling out "Simon Says". For example - You could rearrange the molecules of your body at will into any form you choose, psionically levitate yourself in any of your forms, reproduce by dividing yourself into two identical beings, deflect projectiles, cause enemies to stumble or otherwise suffer the effects of misfortunes, teleportation, and/or you can do everything at once by saying the title name.
summary: The ability to manipulate reality and the laws of the universe by saying the title name.
strengths: The Title says it all.
weaknesses: You can only say it if your name is Simon or Simone (Female name for Simon).

name: X Plosion
description: This ability allows you to accelerate the particles on a specific place with your mind and create an explosion in the form of an "X". The explosion can have any size, it can be small enough to crush an enemies brain or big enough to destroy a whole building. Reducing or increasing the explosion size too much would consume too much energy and kill the user.
summary: The ability to create a powerfull explosion in the form of an "X" with your mind.
strengths: Can destroy nearly anything without damaging anything else
The attack has cirurgical precision and can be used to neutralize without killing an enemy
Explosions can be created anywhere in the entire world, if you know where are you aiming
weaknesses: If the explosion is too big or too small, it'll kill you
If you can't see or don't know exactly the place you are aiming you can hurt innocents
Exploding something too far away can make you really tired or even kill you

name: Retreating Healer
description: When you leave a battle you are 1/3% healed, this includes burns,poisons, etc.
summary: The ability to be partially healed when you leave the battle.
strengths: Become healed.
weaknesses: You are partially healed.
You are healed by about 1/3 or less.

name: Headshot
description: If you shoot a person in the foot, the bullet will automatically go for a headshot.
summary: The ability to get a headshot no matter where you hit the person
strengths: You can kill any enemy
You wont waste bullets
Its fun
weaknesses: Spatial Manipulation

name: Indirect Total Immunity
description: This power renders you immune to powers a person uses against you that they have not directly gained. This means that no mimicked, shared, gifted, or other indirectly gained power a person tries to use against you will work. This applies to the users of power sharing or gifting who give others powers in excess to make powerful teams. The exception is that if a person uses a power to figure out how to use other powers can and you are still affected by powers replicated from reality warping.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that a person themselves have not directly gained.
strengths: A good defense against teams of people who share powers to become extremley powerful.
You can still use all powers that you have mimicked and can be affected beneficially.
You can still use power sharing or gifting yourself.
weaknesses: If a person has a lot of directley acquired powers to start with.
If people dont share powers but work together.
Still affected by weapons created by shared powers.

name: Judge, Jury & Executioner
description:
Using this power you can immediately conclude whether or not someone has committed a crime. Next you determine an appropriate punishment fitting for the crime that has been committed. Then you can carry out the decided punishment on the guilty person.
Your ruling is always final! And you never make a mistake.
summary: The ability to know of a crime committed, determine a punishment and carry it out.
strengths: Never make a mistake about who the guilty person is.
Be the one who carries out the punishment on the guilty person.
weaknesses: Some people may want to seek revenge.

name: Half Giant
description: Someone with this power will be taller, stronger, and have a higher endurance than most humans. Also, they will tend to have a higher resistance to magic.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-giant
strengths: It takes stronger magic to hurt you to the same degree as an ordinary human.
Some rare versions of this power allow for control of fire and/or ice. (Norse Mythology)
weaknesses: Basketball players might still be taller than you.

name: 1st Key Of Death
description: This key is able to kill half of mankind - since man kind is so large it has two keys - or summon half of the dead,. The appearance of the ded is as if they lack muscle, but they are slightly stronger than normal human beings. If you kill anyone, you summon dark hands out of the ground to to take them to the underworld.
summary: The ability to be able to bring humans back to life or kill them.
strengths: Good if you are a murderer.
weaknesses: It is a very small key, that you can lose.
Might have the wrong key for the killing someone.

name: Survival Board Game
description: This power allows you to create a survival board game like Jumanji except you can create any theme you want, such as a zombie board game. Each player takes turns rolling a dice to see how far to move their character on the board, when they do they will get a card. Whatever is written on the card will come true in real life, such as "Zombies attach your school, move back two spaces" which is where the survival part comes in. Reality resets once the game is completed.
summary: The ability to create a survival board game like Jumanji.
strengths: Create multiple types of board games.
Fun for the whole family.
Reality resets to the point when the game began once the game is completed.
weaknesses: Requires at least two people to use.
The effects of the game won't end until the game is finished.
It is called a survival board game for a reason.

name: Relational Empathy
description: Relational empathy allows the user to sense the relationships, or connections, between people. With it the user can sense romantic relationships, but also ties of family and friends, loyalty and devotion. They can sense the strength of the bonds, seeing who would turn traitor, or die for one another. This can be used to find leaders, or how to beat the resistance by picking off a few key people.
summary: The ability to sense relationships
strengths: Relationship Sensing
Useful in government
weaknesses: You may have unwanted loyalty
Ruin groups, governments, families

name: Soon
description: With this power, you will always know the exact time down to the second, someone is referring to when they say "soon". The person doesn't even have to know when they're referring to, but you will know when the payoff will happen. For example, if you ask a teacher when you're going to get your test grades back, and they say soon, but actually have no idea when they'll gave them back, you will know exactly when you'll get it back.
summary: The ability to know exactly when somebody is talking about when they tell you 'Soon'
strengths: You will always know when someone will do something when they say soon
weaknesses: This power is very confusing to explain to people
Not much use in physical combat

name: Bindless Determination
description: Imagine this. You are chained up to a wall in a cold dark cell, you hear footsteps as the excutioner enters to end your life. You have been waiting for this moment. As he unshackles you from the wall and pulls on the chains to lead you to death you spin yourself around throwing him against the wall, steal his weapon and proceed out of the prison. You become a better fighter when bound or captured.
summary: The ability to become a better fighter when bound, chained, trapped, or imprisoned.
strengths: You are more of a threat captured than when free.
You can even fight if you are being hanged.
Escape your capturers (your fighting abilities will decrease after you free yourself)
weaknesses: With this said you can escape a noose or guillotine until the lever is pulled and the trapdoor opens
or the blade falls down.

name: Enhancement: Exponential
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it boosts the other power exponentially. Ex: If the power level of a power is 1 it is boosted to 1, 2 it is boosted to 4, 6 it is boosted to 46656, etc. If attached to powers that are already too powerful this power acts like Enhancement: Uncontrollable, without the benefits. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to boost a power exponentially
strengths: Attaching this power to a shielding power.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Beware of backlash from attaching it to powers that are already too powerful.
Con Negation and similar powers have no effect on this power.

name: Body Part Duplication
description: You have some means of duplicating, but you can only duplicate one body part at a time. You can also duplicate the body parts of others.
summary: The ability to duplicate individual parts of the body.
strengths: Copy your body parts
Copy others' body parts
weaknesses: Only one at a time
Can't copy the entire body

name: Sonic Howl
description: This is the remarkable, but strange power to possess a metagene that gives out a prolonged potent howling sonic attack, it can last from 0. 50 to 60 minutes, absorbing the sound waves around you and sending them back with concussive force by howling, and can cause an incredible amount of damage to non-living targets, and a remarkable amount of damage to living targets, stuns people in an entire area.
summary: The ability to utter a loud, protracted, concussive sound or cry to damage and stun foes or objects.
strengths: Can even induce sleep.
weaknesses: Only if you are a werewolf or a hybrid you can use it.

name: Dark Energy Enhancement
description: When you're in a tough situation, your dark powers enhance by 10 fold, giving you an extreme power when it comes to Darkness.
summary: The ability to empower your Dark Energies.
strengths: Helps with your Shadow Bolt's damage
Enhances power 10x
Increases your adrenaline
weaknesses: You lose your focus every once in a while
Isn't predictable
Disables all Holy abilities

name: Ability Swap
description: You ever see a guy walking down the street, and saying, "I wish I could trade him places." Well, people with Ability Swap can do something along those lines. They can exchange the ability for another's by touch. However, this means that you are stuck with their powers while they have Ability Swap. Still totally worth it though.
summary: The ability to change out your power for someone else's
strengths: Can get one awesome power
Can get what you need and leave
See what it's like to be a Water Mimic, Speedster, etc.
weaknesses: Person tagging you back
Ability might suck
Person you gave Ability Swap might give it to someone else

name: Transformation: Jade Warrior
description: The user with this power is able to transform into the Jade Warrior, a warrior from ancient China. A mystical jade necklace transforms the wearer into the Jade Warrior and gets all the knowledge and experience of all the previous Jade Warriors
summary: The ability to transform into a mystical Jade Warrior
strengths: The Jade Armor is impervious to magic
The armor enhances your strength
Limited invulnerability
weaknesses: Rather slow at times, but not a major problem

name: Delete This Energy
description: Chi energy,
summary: The ability to control
strengths: The
weaknesses: Corruption happens easily.

name: Under Space (Sub Space) Access
description: Under-Space (Sub-Space) is a dimension that lies between the 3rd and 4th dimensions. This dimension is the storehouse of cosmic information. The universal harddrive. The user of this ability would be in a sense, WI-FI connected to this dimension at all times.
summary: The ability to mentally access the dimension of Under-space (Sub-Space).
strengths: All information desired would be known.
Infinite knowledge.
Read 1 and 2.
weaknesses: Infinite knowledge sounds great, but do you really want to know everything?
Until one really learns to control this power, one will know things they don't want to know.
Can drive one mad. MAD FOR ABSOLUTE POWER!

name: Empathic Backlash
description: Empathic Backlash, also called Emotional Backlash is the ability to cause emotional intrusion to backfire on foes. That means that if the user feels negative emotions, if someone feels negative emotions toward him or if they try to read or manipulate his emotions, the foe will get a backlash which temporarily knocks them out.
summary: The ability to generate a backlash based on emotional contact
strengths: If you dislike someone and they're in close enough proximity, they'll feel the backlash
If someone who dislikes you gets too close, they feel the backlash
Emotion readers and manipulators who try to use their powers on you feel the backlash as well
weaknesses: If friends are mad at you, they also feel the backlash
Animals almost always feel the backlash because of their empathic capabilities
The backlash can rarely be turned off

name: Unwaiting
description: This power gives you the ability to skip lines, travel instantaneously, etc. Note that you cannot use this power to complete tasks more quickly, nor can you use it to forge interpersonal relationships without waiting. Essentially, this power applies only to you -- when it affects how others would perceive time/space, it does not apply.
summary: The ability to never have to wait for anything. Ever.
strengths: Chinese food like whoa. Right away.
Skip women's bathroom lines. Men's bathroom lines if they ever happen.
Travel between opposite time zones and actually time travel.
weaknesses: Loss of patience, over time.
Increased likelihood of obesity.
Super jet lag.

name: Tri   Blast
description: You can even Clang your wrists together so you would strike with a simultaneous triangle-like projectile. You even have the ability to shoot or emanate plasma in the form of a blast or discharge, with a tell-tale concentric Triangle pattern. These waves will emanate from his body in all directions.
summary: The ability to send out triangle-like fireballs that would hit the opponent.
strengths: May even stun.
Can be used on objects which may cause them to shatter, explode, or seemingly disintegrate.
