The body of a person that has this ability produces more blood than the average person.
Even the tiniest scratch can give a user a huge advantage.
weaknesses: Losing to much blood.
Limited blood of course.
If in the situation, distance of the oppenent if they aren't bleeding.

name: Real Gaming
description: This ability lets you and only you use a special controller to take control of others' movements. You can control people, animals, vehicles,etc. This doesn't let you control minds however, only their movements. Also you can only control one person or thing at once. You can play them over long distances & can watch the action on a screen on the controller. Like many games you can type in cheats that give the person special powers. Just select a power and whatever you're controlling has the power.
summary: The ability to use a special game controller to control things
strengths: Play real life gta
Have access to several other powers with cheats
Have someone else rob a bank for you
weaknesses: Only control one thing at a time
Limited cheat codes

name: Myth Power: Peitho's Persuasion
description: Peitho (Pitho), in Greek myth, was the goddess of persuasion, temptation, seduction and charm. As such, channeling her gifts one with mesmerizing charm; most neutrals will find one's mannerisms incredibly engaging, so one is hard to dislike, or to resist. In addition, one becomes highly skilled in convincing others to do one's bidding; one communicates in one's own language, which subliminally translates to a language the subject can understand. One can even resist the charm effects of others.
summary: The ability to channel Peitho's command over the essence of persuasion and temptation
strengths: Hypnotic charm (people like you a LOT, and try very hard to please you and gain your approval)
Powers of persuasion work on a subliminal level (no one can tell the power is even being used)
Persuasive capability transcends language barriers; immune to charm/persuasion abilities of others
weaknesses: Cannot verbally compel others to do one's bidding until the higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with love, attraction and sexuality based MythPowers can sense (and withstand) this ability
People with MythPowers based on law, order and justice are immune to this ability

name: Anime Entering
description: You can enter any image - as long as it's done in anime style. You'll be a character in the story/picture and be part of that story/world (won't show on the outside). You can return in the exact time and state that you left in
summary: The ability to enter any anything that's drawn in anime style
strengths: Can be from anywhere- including fanart
You'll look like an anime character
You can bring other people with you
weaknesses: It must be done in anime style
If you die, you'll return to the real world and can't head back for a year

name: Myth Power: Artemis' Art
description: Artemis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, the maiden's chastity (purity), childbirth, healing and moonlight. As such, channeling her allows one to skill in archery, hunting, cooking natural remedies, midwifery and caring for animals. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of moonlight). Furthermore, one can absorb moonlight to gain physical power. One can even psychically heal others with moonlight, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Artemis' command over the essence of hunting, wilderness, wild animals, and the moon
strengths: Gain skill in archery, hunting, natural remedies, midwifery and caring for animals
Psychically perceive the future (at will, in the presence of moonlight)
Absorb moonlight to gain physical power; psychically heal others with moonlight, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically control moon's course (rising/setting, phases) or manipulate lunar energy (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon indestructible bow (infinite plague-tipped arrows), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel animals, at will, until developed (NCN)

name: Raiametsuchi
description: When you turn this ability on, anything around you is hit by a constant stream of lightning without the users will to control it. This technique is quite powerful in fighting someone who uses close range attacks, as they won't be able to get close without being hit by a bolt of lightning, blast away or electrified on the spot.
summary: The ability to become conductable and electrify anything in range without need of a conscious thought.
strengths: If enemies sneak up behind you, they'll still get electrocuted because this power works on its own.
Good at keeping melee fighters at bay.
Powerful against water users.
weaknesses: You can not control the power, you can only activate it and deactivate it.
The lightning that comes off of you, will hit anything, friend or foe, in a certain radius.
Your energy is consistantly being used up, transforming into the lightning.

name: Green Blast
description: Blasts the foe with a 1' wide, neon-green, beam of energy from the eyes and it is unavoidable (follows foe until it makes contact) & penetrates ANY type of defense system. Scrambles the foe's DNA, thus turning said foe into a blob of flesh & squishy bones, thus killing the enemy.
summary: The ability to shoot a green beam of energy from the eyes.
strengths: Eliminates foe
Tracks foe until successfully making contact with the enemy
Penetrates ANY type of known defense(s), force field, wall, etc etc....
weaknesses: Can only be used three times
May cause temporary blackout lasting about 5 seconds from being shot from the eyes
Kills foe (superheroes do not typically kill the supervillains)

name: Telephoneportation
description: This power allows you to transport through phones. Any kind of phone will work, just stick your head in and climb on through. It works on objects too, meaning you can put stuff through the phone as well as yourself. This method of transportation is one way, so only things on your side can transport. If signal is completely lost while you have a body part extended into the phone, that body part will be cut off.
summary: The ability to transport through telephones
strengths: Punch people through the phone.
Talk face-to-face with anyone who has a phone.
Give people things through the phone.
weaknesses: Lose signal, lose body parts. Keep your head on!
You can only send, never recieve.

name: Subconscious Manifestation
description: This is a very dangerous ability to have if you don't have enough control over it. Your subconscious is where your mind hides your repressed memories, the things you don't want to say out loud nor think about, and your deepest desires, fears and emotions. When this power is activated, they can burst into the real world, taking symbolic shapes, transforming reality and interacting with it according to the meaning attached to it. This power is usually activated subconsciously.
summary: The ability to let your subconscious spill into the real world.
strengths: You can sort of exorcise your own fears and satisfy your own impulses.
You can discover more about yourself, things you forgot or kept denying.
The manifestations can take the form of creatures, humans, or alter reality to fit its meaning.
weaknesses: You don't want to have your traumatic memories and your fears manifest into reality.
It's very difficult to control and it's even more difficult to control the manifestations.
Your own manifestations can kill you, in which case they will disappear so it's not all that bad.

name: I Can Hear You
description: With this power whenever someone is talking about you no matter where they are in the universe you will know what they're saying. This includes hearing plans against you, if people are going to throw you a surprise party, if people like/don't like you etc. It only works if they say your full name (first and last not middle) and you can't turn it off
summary: The ability to know what people are saying about you
strengths: You can hear what people are saying about you whenever they talk about you
weaknesses: You can't turn it off
If they don't say your first and last name you can't hear it

name: Phasewalk
description: You temporarily transport to another dimension making you invisible, and gives you increased speed (only goes half as fast as super speed). Upon entering and exiting phasewalk you emit a "phaseblast" which damages everything around you. You may exit phasewalk at anytime. You may only use phasewalk for 30 seconds and after every use you must wait 5 seconds before you may use it again
summary: The ability to use Liltih's Phasewalk
strengths: Very versatile power
Phaseblast makes up for lack offensive choices in phasewalk
Great for sneaking into or outof hostile groups or just getting around
weaknesses: Cool down on use may be annoying
Your phaseblast may damage allies or items wanted undamaged

name: Gokai Change
description: When you were young did you want to be a Power Ranger? Well, with this power you can transform into any member of the groups that are considered by their fans to be the inspiration for Power Rangers! The name of this power is the transformation phrase for the 35th of these groups, Kaizoku Sentai Gokaiger, and you need to say the name of this power in order to use it. Also don't be surprised if you end up fighting a giant space empire, or if the "Monster of the Week" explodes on defeat.
summary: The ability to transform into any member of the first 35 Super Sentai.
strengths: So. Many. OPTIONS!!!
You get a giant robot too!
weaknesses: You may end up being forced to defend the Earth from a giant space empire.
You need to know what the various groups are.

name: Cold Point
description: Unlikely you can create a spear of ice out of thin air, but only when it's below zero or in cold areas you might be able to throw an an ice spear to damage and freeze your enemies even if it kills them.
summary: The ability to shoot out a icy harpoon to damage, impale and freeze your opponent.
strengths: You might be able to break through concrete blocks with this power.
weaknesses: You can only use this ability when it's zero below.

name: Imagination Screening
description: A picture is worth a thousand words. By projecting your thoughts or imagination onto a screen, people would better understand you.
summary: The ability to project your imagination onto a screen
strengths: No need to make powerpoint presentations anymore.
Quick way to communicate.
No grammar, semantic or orthograph needed.
weaknesses: You can't afford a lack of concentration and compromise yourself with a random thought.
Screen not included.

name: Soil Nourishing
description: With this power, you absorb nutrients from the ground which are used to enhance your strength, stamina, endurance/durability etc. So it becomes good if you are out in the wild. Only once it's completely mastered, you'll no longer have to touch the ground with bare flesh (but you still need to touch the ground).
summary: The ability to absorb nutrients and minerals from the ground for strength.
strengths: You'll get enhanced strength, stamina, endurance/durability.
Will be able to fight for a long time if you stay on the ground.
weaknesses: Most times, you'll have to touch the ground with your bare flesh.

name: Weakness Pool Manifestation
description: When activated, every being or object will appear to you with a swirling pool of energy near them. This pool is a representation of all their weaknesses, even the unsuspected and less obvious ones, like a need for food or air, an attachment to a loved one, or a past trauma. Only you can see it and only your attacks can affect it. Any damage dealt to the pool will be reflected on their owner and any type of attack will work. Basically, that pool now becomes their most obvious weakness to target.
summary: The ability to create a manifestation of all your enemy's weaknesses which you can attack to deal damage.
strengths: Even attacks which shouldn't affect them will work. You can strike the pool of an intangible being.
Even those who claim to be invincible can have a weakness, not just a magical or a physical one.
Only you can see the pool. So, it will be difficult for your enemy to defend it without seeing it.
weaknesses: The weakness pool can be difficult to target.
One with very few weaknesses will have a very small pool. One without weakness won't even have one.
One who is changing or shifting their weakness will either have a fast moving pool or a fading one.

name: Piece Of Eden: The Sword
description: The sword can cut just about anything as long as it's solid (so it can't cut air or water or anything like that). It also gives the user knowledge of battle skills and strategies.
summary: The ability to use a sword that can cut anything solid.
strengths: Can cut anything (bullets, rock, metal).
Knowledge of battle.
weaknesses: Can be destroyed and causes a HUGE explosion if it is.
Enemies can use it.

name: 4 D Field Generation
description: Mentally create an inverted forcefield around you that traps matter and hides yourself as a shadow on the ground.
summary: The ability to create a 4D area of space around you
strengths: Impervious to most attacks
Perfect camouflage
Excellent for trapping criminals
weaknesses: Matter is expelled after the field evaporates
Could take in far too much matter and create a black hole

name: Gravity Thief
description: With this power, you can "steal" the gravity from different places of the world. You do this by importing gravitons and controlling the direction that they "carry" gravity. For example, if you steal the gravity from the other side of the world, you will fall upwards! If you steal the gravity from the place 90 degrees to your left (in the middle of the opposite side and you), you will fall left! With mastery, you can fall multiple directions in mere seconds.
summary: The ability to "steal" the gravity from different parts of the world.
strengths: You can fly in any direction you want! (Although it's more falling with direction).
You can use this power to walk on ceilings, walls, the undersides of staircases.
Not all objects are affected by the gravitons; only whoever or whatever you want, and yourself.
weaknesses: Takes practice to learn how to manoeuvre through the air.
You move through the air at the same speed as falling. There is no slowing down, or speeding up.
Falling to your left (or right), but not stopping and falling out of the atmosphere.

name: Astral Trapping
description: Trapping foes in an astral-projective state implies the following. You can keep ghosts from manifesting on the physical plane. You can immobilize ghosts in one place on the astral plane. You can keep people from turning intangible, keep the intangible from becoming tangible again, and keep the invisible from becoming visible. Prevent Astral Projection, and travel to the Astral Plane. Prevent a spirit from leaving a person's body (they don't die)-- you can even do the same for YOURSELF.
summary: The ability to trap foes in an astral-projective state
strengths: Spirits can be trapped on astral plane, kept from manifesting on physical plane
People who can turn imperceptible (invisible or intangible) are trapped in that state
Prevent Astral Projection (and spirit departure upon death), Astral Travel and Ominous Presence
weaknesses: People who are stuck being invisible can still affect you
Doesn't have too much combat use
Ghosts get really pissed at you (so when you let down your guard, they will let you have it)

name: Crimson Tornado
description: The person with this power use to be a person but due to a freak accident , he or she is now disembodied crimson tornado that floats around. However, a robot body was created to house the now disembodied tornado. Through this robot body , they are able to generate tornado using their new forms. The power of the tornados can be boosted by using certain equipments attached on the robot's body. The person with this power, cannot control any other winds but his or her own tornado
summary: The ability to create crimson colored tornados
strengths: Tornado can be used for transport
Tornado can be used to attack enemies
Good against other aerokinesis user
weaknesses: Robot body can destroyed if it has taken a lot of damage
Can only control your own tornados
Can be deactivated if hit with a strong enough electrokinesis user

name: Cryptid Mimicry
description: Cryptids are mystical animals that the general populace are not aware of and only a certain group of people acknowledge or know they exist. With this power, the user ( who must believe in the existence cryptids and have knowledge about them ) can take on the characteristic of a cryptid of their choice. This power only allows the user to mimic on cryptid at a time.
summary: The ability to take on the characteristic of a cryptid
strengths: Can become unstoppable
Different cryptid transformation bring different powers in to play
weaknesses: Need to have a wide knowledge about cryptids
Cannot combine characteristics of two cryptids together

name: Contract Fulfiller
description: With this ability, you can be the best bounty hunter, treasure seeker, or bodyguard in the world. As long as you have established a contract with someone, you will gain the abilities needed to fulfill your contract and also the knowledge of how to fulfill the contract. However, the user is bound by the rules of the contract. The user can interpret the contract in the way they see fit, but they cannot go against the contract or the contractor, unless allowed by the contract.
summary: The ability to gain abilities to fulfill any contract
strengths: You can fulfill any contract and you can choose which contracts to accept
If two parts of a contract are in contradiction, you can choose which part to follow
You can choose your own interpretation; unless the contractee is very specific
weaknesses: You are bound by the conditions of a contract and you don't know what abilities you get
If the contractee dies, the contract is null and void, unless stated otherwise in the contract
Contract Nullification stops your powers

name: Gift Of Ubiquity
description: When you really want to do something, but think you can't do it, a doppelganger appears and does what you wanted to do, while acting the same way you would. The tasks must be possible for you, and the doppelganger disappears when they are done. However, you won't realize they are, except for material traces and witness testimonies. Because of the very nature of this power, it becomes tricky to use once you know about it, as it's only activated when you really think you can't do something.
summary: The ability to have a doppelganger do what you deeply want to do, unbeknownst to you.
strengths: Have things done, in spite of the fact that you think you can't do them.
Works no matter how far the distance between you and the doppelganger.
If you have other superpowers, the doppelganger can use them.
weaknesses: No transfer of knowledge. Anything the doppelganger experiences while it exists, you don't.
When you realize you have this power, it becomes tricky to activate.
Only one doppelganger can exist at a time and it won't know what previous ones learnt by themselves.

name: Nova Outburst
description: One can create mini or massive supernovas with their hands. The massive supernova starts from one's heart. Then, one begins to glow bright, exposing heat and radiation. Afterwards, one explodes, causing an extremely luminous bright light to be seen thoughout the galaxy. Anything in a hundred mile radius will be eliminated, except the core. Sometime after, the massive supernova, a neutron star or a black hole is created.
summary: The ability to create a supernova from inside oneself
strengths: Create luminous light
Can create a neutron star
weaknesses: Can eliminate things close to you
Creates harmful radiation
Can create a black hole

name: Eat This
description: Whatever you eat will make you stronger and invulnerable for a limited time. Don't hold back. You can eat anything. Eat stones and for and hour you have all the density and ability to lift whatever they weigh. You will not get fat. Eat brick walls, eat the sidewalk, eat normal food in truckloads.
summary: The ability to eat everything, making you stronger and more durable
strengths: Your body can metabolize anything to make you a physiological powerhouse.
Keep adding to your mass and density and you could go toe to toe with the man of steel and Thor
Your teeth are always the most dense and durable substance known to man
weaknesses: Your bowel movements destroy any and every toilet and or bathroom
You breath smells like a rotting corpse slowly decomposing in toxic waste
You wake up each day as normal person. Don't be an idiot and tell some sweet thing your secret

name: Time Travelling Blast
description: The Time-travelling Blast is a unidirectional force sent from either the past or the future. It is impossible to use it in the present. The force and time difference of the blast may vary according to the the wielder's strength and control. The blast may also "miss" and continue forward/backward in time for a brief period. Once it has successfully been sent, it also takes some time for the blast to travel to the intended target, requiring some planning of specific targets at specific times.
summary: The ability to project blasts into or from the future
strengths: Nobody would ever know it was you, as you (probably) wasn't there.
It could confuse enemies, unless they already knew it was you
weaknesses: Inaccurate - you have to know when and where
Hard to learn
Messing with the timeline can be dangerous

name: Goldworks:  The Golden Fleece
description: The Golden Fleece is the wool of a golden ram in Greek mythology. It has many powers, including healing and nature refertilization. It will heal any living thing it touches and wherever it goes, nature will become fertile and strong. Also, whoever wears the Fleece gains great strength and durability. It basically boosts the life force of everything around it. It can also disguise itself as another piece of clothing such as a golden coat or cloak, but only for limited periods of time.
summary: The ability to wield the Golden Fleece
strengths: Great strength and durability
Healing and life force boosting
Fleece can appear as another piece of clothing
weaknesses: When the Fleece leaves, nature returns to its normal state
All of the Fleece's diguises are golden and temporary

name: Curiosity Inducer
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anyone curious about something or more curious than usual. For example, if you make an outrageous offer, other people will wonder how you will do it rather than think you are crazy. You can also use this to make people more interested in what you say. You can also use this power remotely, prompting people to look out of their hiding place so that you may find them. This power does not override free will.
summary: The ability to induce people's curiosity about things
strengths: Can help people become more interested in things
Can use it to convince people to do things
Make people listen to what you have to say
weaknesses: Cannot force people to do anything
Does not look like an amazing power
Must have prep to make this effective

name: Thirteen Treasures: Crockery
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. These items will bear any food that the user may wish for upon command.
summary: The ability to use the crock and dish of Rhygenydd the Cleric
strengths: Any food you might wish for!
weaknesses: Can only summon a plateful at a time.

name: Monetary Penalty
description: This power allows you to "curse" someone so that, whenever they perform an act of selfishness, greed, or ill will the "price" of the damage caused by their actions vanishes their assets. If they do not have the money to cover the damage, then assets such as vehicles and property will vanish. If they do not even have those things their organs will be vanish based on their current value on the black market to cover the "dept. " If even that does not suffice they will vanish entirely.
summary: The ability to have money and assets vanish in response to ill deeds done.
strengths: Give someone an incentive to do good.
Punish anyone who makes their money by mistreating others.
weaknesses: The assets vanish, they don't go to the wronged party.
Could destabiliz economies.

name: Rise Of The Kryptonian
description: With this power you can turn into a Kryptonian with all of the powers and weaknesses of Superman.
summary: The ability to turn into a Kryptonian at will
strengths: You have C.Ks powers
weaknesses: Red sun radiation makes you human
Kryptonite is very bad for you and can kill you

name: Morphine
description: A person with this ability can take away the pain of anyone who is hurt physically. Although it is rather useful in emergency situations, the wounded person would still have to seek medical attention for their injuries.
summary: The ability to take away a person's physical pain
strengths: If the person is in a lot of pain, it'll stop them from screaming all the time
The injured can be more cooperative
weaknesses: If its bad enough, the healer can feel the pain
If the healer does not know basic first aid, the person can still die from the wounds

name: Steampunk Hero
description: You can easily construct steam-operated weapons. You also have a vast knowledge about mechanics and engineering. When activated, your arm will transmute into a larger steam-operated saw, firearm, etc. Your arms and legs can also function as pistons for infinite swinging or running power. If your selected weapon breaks, you can produce another; your weapons never overheat. You can synthesize other metals with your weapons for better durability and performance.
summary: The ability to produce machinery that operates on steam.
strengths: A giant power saw that can easily topple trees; timber!
Your "piston fist" leaves craters in skulls and other worthless pieces of junk.
Releasing steam is optional.
weaknesses: There's no use to being a Steampunk Hero without an imagination.
Some metals are completely useless to synthesize.
Watch your aim with your "revolver knuckle"

name: Shadow Kinetic Reversal
description: This ability will force the kinetic energy of anything around them into the energy they need to absorb from them. This will definitely immobilizes moving things. Gives users extra energy.
summary: The ability to change kinetic energy to potential in order to vampirize the energy.
strengths: Extra energy
Immobilizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving

name: 3 Headed Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a three headed dragon. The dragon can fly, is super strong and under your complete control. All three of its heads have super sharp teeth but that's where the similarities end. One of the heads shoots lightning out of its mouth, the second one shoots poison that kills people on contact and the third head shoots out a green goo that is highly acidic and burs through anything it makes contact with.
summary: The ability to summon a three headed dragon
strengths: You can summon and control a three headed dragon that shoots lightning, poison and acid goo
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: It might accidentally kill you

name: Infrared Vision
description: Though one can see perfectly in the dark and figure out the temperature of things, a lot of time will be needed to learn how to figure out the exact temperature of things. No more will the military need goggles and bulky equipment to see in the dark!
summary: The ability to see the temperature of objects /see in complete darkness.
strengths: With experience, you can (usually) tell if someone's lying or not by how how warm they get.
As long as you're quiet, you can score perfect points in nighttime water gun fights.
You can tell if someone's dead or not without 'touching the evidence'.
weaknesses: You can never see things like regular people can (in true color).
Little or no depth perception!
Objects with similar colors and temperatures won't be seen well or at all.

name: Dream Transmission
description: When you dream, you'll recieve future events that will happen way later. This will make you able to warn people of what is to come.
summary: The ability to receive future events (like 5000 years later future) through dreams
strengths: See what's in the future
Warn people
weaknesses: Not everyone will believe you
Hard to tell apart future info and just your dream

name: Artifact: Sceptrum Virtuale
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a staff appears that can be used to control and hack anything on the Internet. You can also use it to enter the Internet as a spirit. While in "cyberspace", you have seven mice minions that can help you hack and control the Internet. It can also be used on other electronic devices.
summary: The ability to summon a staff that can be used for electronic purposes.
strengths: The staff can also be used for magic.
Can hack data, passwords, and do whatever you want with the Internet.
weaknesses: When in cyberspace, your actual body is in the real world and unconscious.

name: Wood Control
description: you can control different sizes of wood - trees, paper etc to use as shields, battering rams, whatever you can think to use wood for. the wood your controling can be shattered with enough blunt force, frozen, set on fire
summary: The ability to control wood with your mind
strengths: theres a lot of wood around
can use it to help the rainforest
paper airplane army
weaknesses: control can be broken
possible to get cut off from wood

name: Spell Singer
description: The SpellSinger ability is an odd one. All you have to do is sing. However things might not always be like you want them to be: if you sing about about a boat to take you across the ocean, you can risk to summon a water dragon, or a whale. You will always get help, just dont expect that if you sing about knives that its a knife you are gonna get, it might as well be flint that is as sharp as a knife.
summary: The ability to summon any kind of help by singing.
strengths: You can use the power everywhere.
You don't need to prepare to use the power.
You will always be amazed or amused with what the power brings you.
weaknesses: Hard to use power if one has a soar througt,
Crappy power if you are a mute.
As you never know what you might get, there is really no way of preparing yourself.

name: Holy Power: Reality Distortion
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you can absorb dark matter and then concentrate it into your pistols, using it as bullets. When your shots hit the foe, you distort the reality around them and create small "Crushes", completely destroying them. This attack is precise and deadly, but absorbing enough Dark Matter to use it, takes time and wastes too much energy.
summary: The ability to shoot a powerful attack, that distorts the universe around your target and destroys him.
strengths: You can destroy nearly anything.
It is very hard to block this power.
weaknesses: This power is slow and wastes energy.

name: Neuron Activity Catalyst
description: This power speeds up the firing of neurons of anyone within a few yards, as well as their ability to handle the faster thought processes. The effects of the catalyst include increased efficiency of skill, such as a doctor suddenly becoming better at his job, or sudden epiphanies and memory recall as new synapses are formed. However, the power doesn't work on its user, and is involuntary, so Anyone that is nearby will gain the effects, regardless of alliance.
summary: The ability to boost the frequency and the efficiency of brain activity in the people around you.
strengths: Improve the skills and sensibilities of the people around you, for better results in battle or work
Help your friends work through their problems or remember important things... just by staying nearby
You'll always be an invaluable member of any team or group
weaknesses: The power itself isn't choosy - it'll work on both friend and foe alike with equal efficiency
You might feel left behind as all your friends/allies improve by leaps and bounds around you
The power doesn't really work on cyborgs or aliens or other more-or-less inhuman brain chemistries

name: Causality Reversal
description: The causality of anything you do is reversed. If you did A to get to B, then you have got to B and just have to do A, which means you are now at B again. Only an extremely strong will or great luck can negate your power.
summary: The ability to reverse causality
strengths: Everything has 99.9% chance of success
Anything you do is permanent
weaknesses: You cannot undo what you have done, even by time travel
You must explicity say what your intended consequences are before doing the action
Other people can manipulate you into doing their will

name: Judgement
description: If you touch someone you can see their soul, including every sin they committed. If the soul you see is suffering from one of the seven deadly sins, you can force the corrupted soul out of the body and send it to Hell.
summary: The ability to judge souls
strengths: Get rid of evil.
See people's sins.
weaknesses: See people's sins.
You can see your own soul.

name: Camera Power: Capture
description: A person with this power has the ability to capture people on film-not in the usual way. The user can transfer people, objects and scenery in the real world into their camera film. The people caught on film cannot get out unless the film is developed. If it is a Polaroid (tm) camera, nothing can get out unless the user lets them out. However the person can still talk while in the polaroid picture. Any type of camera works, even miniature. Cannot capture translucent or transparent objects.
summary: The ability to capture and store people or objects in film
strengths: Everything in the screen is captured
You can capture parts of objects
You can release objects that you have captured on film by developing it
weaknesses: You need to have film
Destroying the film or picture causes the objects to be destroyed(could be pro or con)
Anyone can develop the film unless you use a Polaroid or similar type camera

name: Quantum Rod
description: The quantum rod is a powerful weapon that grants you the ability to transform it into 2 modes of plasma energy. The modes of the rod is: the jiskra bow - the string of the bow is made of mass electric energy, and the galaxy double sword - which is similar to the double-bladed lightsaber.
summary: The ability to use it to transform it into 2 weaponary modes of plasma energy.
strengths: Can really use it for an extreme advantage on your foes.
'Jiskra' is a czech word for 'spark'.
weaknesses: None.

name: Cloud Generation
description: A person with this power has the ability to convert water in the atmosphere into clouds. They can even create clouds at street level as long as there is water in the air. The clouds are controllable through practice and it is possible to create air gaps within the clouds. A master would know how to create any type of cloud, be it a peaceful white cloud to a dark stormy raincloud. However, the user is limited by the fact that they don't have full control of the clouds once released.
summary: The ability to create clouds out of water from the atmosphere
strengths: Clouds can become an excellent smokescreen at street level
Can learn how to make different types of clouds
Can make structures using clouds
weaknesses: If you are evil you can block out the sun by creating endless supplies of clouds
Can't control clouds after creating them
White puffy clouds don't look threatening

name: Artifact Of Light: Aero Dagger
description: Aero dagger is designed for tricking people. It is impossible to kill someone with it, because as it touches someone, it teleports them to a pre-set location, replacing them with an identical clone created by the dagger. This allows you to publicly kill someone, while actually teleporting them to safety.
summary: The ability to summon a magical dagger with black blade.
strengths: Good for tricking people
The dagger can't actually kill anyone
weaknesses: Careful not to use it on someone you dont want to die, if the location is set to be inside a volcano

name: Pain
description: You can use any and all powers you've ever heard of for 12 hours a day. No matter what the power. You can be the most powerful being on the block. Do what ever you want. Have fun with it, impress everyone around. Women will love you and even your enemies will be impressed with you. You will pay a heavy heavy price for it all. What you do will come with pure pain. How ever powerful you are in your 12 hrs, That's how much pain you'll be subject to in your 12 hour payment time.
summary: The ability to use any power you've ever heard of, for the price of feeling pure pain.
strengths: Do what ever you want. Be as powerful as you want. You have all day use multifuple powers at once.
You can use any power you've ever heard of. Be a perfect undefeated hero.
If you love pain, then you'll love this power. Used in Moderation you can do good things with it.
weaknesses: Pay for it in pain, what you use is reflected on you in equal doses.
You can never kill anyone, if you do you'll suffer an eternity in pain and you'll live unable to die
You quite possible will kill yourself before you ever kill anyone else anyway.

name: Explosive Cutter
description: Someone with this power can disarm any explosive by cutting it. The location that is cut does not matter as the explosive will lose whatever it is that causes it to explode.
summary: The ability to disarm any explosive by cutting it
strengths: Anti-bomb squads will love to have you if you have this power.
weaknesses: Only really helps if there are multiple explosives around that need to be disarmed quickly.

name: Shuriken Strike
description: With this power you can shoot super sharp shuriken (ninja stars) from your palms at your enemies
summary: The ability to shoot ninja stars from the palms of your hands
strengths: The stars are super sharp and can pierce through metal, rock and just about anything else
weaknesses: You might accidentally cut yourself

name: Myth Power: Teumessian Fox Trot
description: The Teumessian Fox, in Greek myth, was a magical fox who was fated never to be caught by any pursuer, regardless of their speed. As such, channeling him allows one to move with speed that adapts to outdo any any subject that pursues him; likewise, one's reflexes, friction/wind resistance, etc adapt to handle changes in speed. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command foxes at will. One can even turn into any breed of fox, or mimic the abilities of a fox at will.
summary: The ability to channel the superhuman evasion prowess of the mythical Teumessian Fox
strengths: Adapt speed, reflexes and wind/friction resistance to avoid any pursuer
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command foxes
Turn into any breed of fox, or mimic the abilities of a fox at will
weaknesses: Every hear of the tale of Laelaps and the Teumessian Fox? Look it up.
Speed/athletics/competition-based MythPowers provide immunity
MythPower: Artemis' Gift and other animal-based MythPowers (may provide immunity and/or control)

name: Legendary Tailoring
description: With this power you are the greatest tailor to have ever lived, able to create the most stylish and well made clothing of all time. This power also allows you to weave impossibilities into the cloths you make. Pockets that are bigger on the inside, a living scarf that obeys your every command,and a jacket that shrug of a LAW rocket are just a few of the fantastic items you can sew yourself.
summary: The ability to create impossible and fashionable clothing.
strengths: Weave superpowers into the very fabrics of your creations.
Make money selling your clothes.
Always look good.
weaknesses: You have no power without your super clothing.
You must make each piece personally for the power to work. No mass production.
Likely be sought after by people of ill repute, who wish to put your power to work for themselvs.

name: Inferno Hurricane
description: A huge hurricane of fire 1 mile in diameter. The rain is lava. The wind is 1,140 degrees farenheit.
summary: The ability to create a huge hurricane made of fire
strengths: You are totally invulnerable during hurricane.
With this superpower, you are imunne to fire and heat.
weaknesses: Hurricane lasts five minutes.
You become physically drained and exhausted afterwards

name: Blessing Of Athena
description: Athena is the Greek Goddess justice, warfare, strategy, and courage. The characteristics all needed for a superhero or heroine. Once Athena gives the blessed one her blessings, they will be granted an indestructable suit of armor to carry out justice and defend the weak
summary: The ability to be blessed by the Greek Goddess Athena
strengths: You have an indestructible armor
You are the symbol of justice
weaknesses: You can't fly

name: Dagger Strike V2
description: With this power you can shoot super sharp daggers from your hands. The daggers can cut through anything but if you accidentally stab yourself with your own daggers you don't feel a thing.
summary: The ability to shoot daggers from the palms of your hands
strengths: You can shoot daggers from your hands
The daggers can cut through anything
They can't hurt you
weaknesses: You still have to aim

name: Haute
description: Hautes are a type of magic users. Once they have gained control over an ability, they can both recognize and manipulate that power of themselves and others. Manipulation includes keeping the other person from using they're power, amplifying another persons power, or unlocking another person's innate ability if it has not "awakened".
summary: The ability to recognize and manipulate powers of others, as long as you have them.
strengths: Any power you have can recognized and manipulation, even in others
You can "awaken" dormant powers in others if you recognize the power they have
weaknesses: Requires strong will to use, as you need to override another's willpower

name: Forgotten Luck
description: This is strange, but useful gift. Anyone with this ability can induce 12 hour long luck in themselves and others. Everything that happens to them will be good for them. But, at the end of the 12 hours, they will totally forget everything in the last 12 hours. So the end result will be them waking up(the memory loss will knock them out)in a strange place, and finding that their life is a lot better. For example, they could wake up in a library with a ton of money in their pockets.
summary: The ability to induce incredible luck and then forget it.
strengths: Inducing great luck in you and others.
It has cool name.
weaknesses: You forget everything after the hour of luck are over.

name: The Throne
description: With this power alone you can create one ordinary human soldier an hour to fight for you. Each soldier has a shortsword, chainmail armor, and a round shield. If you have the powers, 'The Crown' and 'The Scepter' as well then you can create 5 soldiers per hour instead of 1.
summary: The ability to create soldiers to fight for one's cause
strengths: 120 soldiers per day if you can stay up all 24 hours each day and have all three powers.
It can take up to one month to get an army of 480 soldiers. 16 soldiers per day, 8 hours of sleep.
weaknesses: Most modern armies have guns and probably well over 1 million soldiers.
The weaponry is somewhat obsolete.

name: Patriotic Empowerment
description: The person with this power is able to gain super powers based on how patriotic they are. The more patriotic they are , the more powerful they become. They also have the ability to draw power upon the patriotisme of the crowd as well. Superpowers include super strength, flight, and limited invulnerability and the ability to project force fields
summary: The ability to have superpowers based on how patriotic you are.
strengths: You get superpowers depending on your patriotisme
Fight enemies that want to harm the innocent people within your country
You are patriotic to your country not the government
weaknesses: You can be patriotic, but can be an enemy to the government
If you lose your love for the people in your country, you lose your powers
If the people within the country lose faith in you or the country, you alsol lose your powers

name: King Of The Hill
description: With this power you can cause a giant palace full of jewels and expensive items to appear on any hill by pointing at it and saying "I'm the king of the hill! " You can use this power up to ten times. The palaces also have an armory full of state of the art weapons and military vehicles and the palace is indestructible so it make for a good fortress as well. This also means that you can't make the palace disappear so once you use this power ten times you lose it.
summary: The ability to cause giant palaces to appear on hills
strengths: You can make palaces appear on hills
They are full of money
They are indestructible and have an armory full of state of the art weapons
weaknesses: You can't make them disappear
You can only use this power ten times

name: Blood Bath
description: Blood of other living beings' heal you. Foreign blood upon contact with your body immediately begins to heal you of broken bones, damaged tissue, even mental attacks. If you are not injured it acts as a stimulant igniting your adrenaline, charging you to peak strength, mental capacity & beyond.
summary: The ability to heal yourself by the blood of others
strengths: You can fully heal from any injury even death
Blood Bathing will take you to adrenaline enhance levels of physical prowess
Letting the blood dry on your skin gives you slightly enhanced durability
weaknesses: I don't suppose people will just let you cut them
Finding enough blood for each injury will pose a bit of a problem
You will need to be submerged in blood to be brought back from death

name: Lord Of The Dance Floor
description: If anyone is dancing, you will immediately be able to dance twice as well as that person. If a group of people is dancing, you will be able to dance better than all of them combined. This superpower applies to all forms of dance. The presence of another person/being dancing and music in the background is required for this superpower to activate. Its effects will then last until you stop dancing.
summary: The ability to always one-up anyone who's dancing
strengths: Become an instant hit.
Impress your audience.
Take on the world!
weaknesses: Superpower doesn't work if you dance alone
Superpower doesn't work if there's no music
Superpower doesn't grant any basic ability to dance on your own

name: Undying Love
description: By admitting your undying love for a certain person, place, object, or an ideal and attempting to protect it, you are able to pull a flaming sword from your chest and fight with it. Not only does it increase your drive to protect the thing you love most, but also increase your ability to do so.
summary: The ability to use your undying love for a person, place, thing, or ideal and create a sword from that drive.
strengths: You get a sweet, flaming sword to fight with.
Fear doesn't affect you as much with your increased drive, causing you to not stop fighting.
You become a better combatant with improved reflexes and fighting prowess.
weaknesses: You can't have any doubts about whether or not you love said thing, person, place, etc.
It might be a bit shocking the first time a flaming sword erupts from your chest.
Fear doesn't affect you as much, which might cause you to make mistakes.

name: Myth Power: Hermes' Hustle
description: Hermes, in Greek myth, was the god of travel, messengers, trade, thievery, cunning wiles, language, writing, diplomacy, athletics, and animal husbandry, as well as Messenger to the Gods, and Guide to the Underworld. As such, channeling him allows one to have superhuman speed; one can even run over water, on air, and up walls. In addition, one becomes adept at using deceptive, sneaky language to trick people, as well as pickpocketing, stealth, athletics and numerous chthonic, underworld pursuits.
summary: The ability to channel Hermes' command over the essence of commerce, cunning, athletics, theft and travel
strengths: Superhuman lickety-quickness (even running over water, on air, and up walls; super reflexes as well)
Expert at lying, stealth (sneaking around/hiding), pickpocketing, and athletics (sports)
Immune to necromantic/death effects; perceive, communicate with and banish/ward off/exorcise spirits
weaknesses: Cannot evade Lie Detection or speak all languages (animal, etc) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot peer into, and travel to/from the Astral Realms at will until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPowers based on the 12/13 Olympian gods can be used to summon you, when they are developed (NCN)

name: Human Lightning Rod
description: Your body provides the electricity with a path of least resistance to the ground. So, if electricity is travelling through the air in your vicinity, your body will 'attract' it and disperse it into the ground. If you touch a conductor with electricity flowing through it, it will discharge into your body and into the ground. It works as long as you are in contact with the ground or a body of water.
summary: The ability to harmlessly channel electricity to the ground through your body.
strengths: You can divert the flow of electricity and neutralize it.
You can protect yourself and others from electrocution, lightning and electricity-based abilities.
You can safely stick your fingers or a fork inside an electrical outlet.
weaknesses: Lightning will take the most direct path to strike you, possibly damaging things along the way.
You will be hit by lightning a lot! There goes your hairdo.
You need to be touching the ground or a body of water to use this power.

name: Episode Inducing
description: This power allows the user to cause the resurfacing of any condition that the subject has ever previously experienced. This resurfacing can range from hiccups to laughter to crying to coughing or sneezing (withouit even BEING sick) to burping to farting and the like, as long as the subject has experienced it before. The user can even cause certain illnesses to resurface (such as viruses/ailments--HIV, eczema, ringworms, herpes, etc-- and mental illness).
summary: The ability to reproduce any condition the user has ever previously experienced
strengths: Common experiences (consume them with uncontrollable laughter, itching, sneezing, coughing, etc. )
Condition can be revoked at will (and controlled in intensity)
If you don't know WHAT previous conditions a foe has, use the power; the most RECENT thing emerges
weaknesses: If you can't control intensity of the episode
If you can't stop the episode at will
If your foe has never been sick or cannot get sick

name: Super Squad: Bird's Eye View
description: You can see through your normal eyes and then you have a bird's eye view. Owned by mythical superhero "Bald Eagle".
summary: The ability to see from two angles, your normal eye view and from straight above.
strengths: Bird's eye view.
Good to see if there is anything above you.
Can even see above buildings when inside
weaknesses: If a plane or something hits your bird's eyes, you feel a lot of pain.

name: Day/Night Control
description: You decide when day comes! You decide when night plagues the city! Its all in your control! You can also control sunsets and sunrises and what colours they will contain and you'll be able to control how much of the moon everyone in your city see's. this is basically controlling the rotation of the earth.
summary: The ability to control both day and night
strengths: Create amazing sunsets to stun your friends!
Dont want to go to bed yet? Just extend day time!
Drag the morning on if you want to sleep in!
weaknesses: If you make it night time all the time, vampires will love you but all the plants will die.

name: Pulse Stave
description: A 6'6 pulse stave which has a blue-green orb on one end, powered by technology, able to fire plasma electric balls which stun the foe, and you can switch it to rapid-fire mode. You could use this to start with an energy-ball explosion and hit the enemy in the stomach while charging energy, which you discharge and trespass through the stave, which then passes through the enemy and creates a more powerful spherical energy-ball.
summary: The ability to use it to produce blasts of energy-ball attacks.
strengths: It's powerful enough to destroy plastic, steel, and wood.
weaknesses: None.

name: Better Life
description: This power can only be used once. When the user decides to activate the power, their current family will give the user up for adoption, and almost instantly, a very rich, loving, and beautiful (inside and outside) family will adopt you. The previous family will never re-adopt you and the better family will never un-adopt you (nor want to). The new family lives in a mansion with cooks, maids, butlers, servants, and gardeners (maybe more). The family can pay for you to get a huge makeover.
summary: The ability to get adopted by a very rich and loving family
strengths: Rich, loving family
Mansion with cooks, maids, butlers, servants, and gardeners (maybe more)
Better life
weaknesses: Some people may like their current family

name: Myth Power: Oistros' Attraction
description: Oistros (Oestros, Oestrus, Estros, Estrus), in Greek myth, was the god of maddening excitement and rage, especially in matters of love. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with attracted/attractive subjects. In addition, one can absorb sexual energy from one's surroundings, converting it into physical power; the longer it is held in, the stronger (and more maddening) it gets. One can even amplify others' sexual energy, by touch, sending them into a frenzy.
summary: The ability to channel Oistros' command over the essence of romantic frenzy or sexual rage
strengths: Psychically perceive and communicate with people who attract you, or are attracted to you
Absorb sexual energy and convert it into physical power (or, when developed, Berserker Rage)
Amplify subjects' sexual energy to a fever pitch, by touch, sending them into a frenzy
weaknesses: If sexual energy is held in too long before use, it may cause temporary symptoms of psychosis
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities (or not being sentient) provide immunity

name: Vortex
description:
This ability allows you to create a vortex.
The vortex sucks all nearby objects inside it turning it all into nothing.

A vortex is like a miniature black hole that is more directed.
summary: The ability to call a vortex whenever you desire.
strengths: Can summon a vortex, whenever you choose.
This power is not accidentally misused.
With enough patience, practice and focus you can conjure miniature vortexes further from you.
weaknesses: If you are nearby the vortex, there's a chance you could be sucked in.
All Vortexes summoned work with the same pulling and gravitational forces, that you cannot variably alter.

name: Enhancement: Double
description: This power is a support and useless on its own. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it doubles the effects of the power. E.g. double fireball - fire two fireballs simultaneously or fire a fireball twice the size or intensity as normal. If someone tries to steal this power it doubles the effect to the attached power and gives this power to the ability thief.
summary: The ability to double the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Double the effect of a power!!
Could if used enough double the number of uses or triple instead.
You still have this power if it is 'stolen'.
weaknesses: Useful only if you have another power.
Can only be used for one power at a time - takes time to switch
The power might be useless doubled or more trouble.

name: Reflection Switching
description: This power is difficult to describe. You don't actually have a reflection, but you can trade places to where your reflection would be, effectively disappearing in the real world. When in "mirror world" you are still vulnerable to reflections of things, but anything that isn't reflected doesn't exist, and is replaced by a white void that you can move through at will. Through this realm, you have access to all mirrors and reflective surfaces, but searching for the portal you want may take time.
summary: The ability to trade places with your reflection
strengths: Get into any facility with a mirror
Awesome hiding place
weaknesses: Must have a mirror
Still vulnerable to reflections
Switching through non-uniform surfaces (puddles or broken mirrors) could seriously mess you up

name: Lateral Magnetizer
description: The user can make anything stick to the surface of an object similar to a magnet. The strength of the attraction depends on the user. Employed the user can effectively walk on walls or ceilings except gravity still works. When close by your opponent they cannot move their legs to dodge although they can still move the upper body. It is not real magnetism so heat will not affect it, but brute strength can rip a hole off the surface to move.
summary: The ability to make objects along a surface that your are touching attract objects similar to a magnet
strengths: Stop people from dodging your attacks by magnetizing the ground
Walk on walls if you use a lower magnetic setting
Prevent people from fumbling you by making your hand magnetize
weaknesses: You would be stuck to the surface too
Brute strength may be used to escape or breaking the surface or limbs

name: Aural Immersion
description: By being inside an aura with your whole body, you can gain a power based on the aura you are in. The aura can give a power that the aura's owner has, a power based on their personality, or a power based on their spirit. Each individual aura can only be used to gain a power once. Auras of those with omni-power will give slightly different powers than the omni-powers. Ex. Omnipotence will give Infinite Energy Storage.
summary: The ability to gain a power by fully immersing oneself in an aura
strengths: After a while you can end up with a large variety of powers.
weaknesses: Most people don't have auras you can immerse yourself in.
You may end up with only horrible powers.

name: Glowing Eyes
description: Your eyes can glow light in a colour that fits with your aura, mood or preference.
summary: The ability to have glowing eyes
strengths: Makes you easier to find in the dark
Makes you look cool in the dark
weaknesses: Makes you easier to find in the dark
Can also make you look spooky in the dark

name: Kinesis Bandit
description: An individual with this ability has no ability on their own. However if they are in the presence of someone with psychokinetic abilities, they can harness that energy and use that power if it is actively being used. For example being around a pyrokinetic lets you use pyrokinesis but only when the holder of the power uses it.
summary: The ability to mimic the psychic energies used by someone else.
strengths: Can potentially have any psychokinetic power
weaknesses: Can only copy one power at a time
Power must be active to tap into it

name: Poisoned
description: When you opponent lands a hit on you, they then become poisoned, but 30% of the time it will not poison them. If they hit you again and they are poisoned, then the poison worsens.
summary: The ability to have a 70% chance to poison a foe when they land a hit on you.
strengths: This poison can only be healed naturally.
weaknesses: People with Poison Immunity.
30% of the time it doesn't work.
Only works with physical attacks.

name: Sk: Jet Propulsion
description: The user takes the potiential away from any stationary thing. Then the user will charge at anything with extreme speed. It is a very dangerous Shadow Kinetic ability.
summary: The ability to indirectly vampirize the potiential energy to allow the user to rocket themselves at high speed.
strengths: Powerful ramming attack
Immoblizes opponents or any object.
weaknesses: Works only when the solid isn't moving
Hard to control at first.

name: Myth Power: Mania's Madness
description: Mania and the Maniae (Maniai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of madness and insanity. As such, channeling them allows one to think with a superhuman form of sanity that, in normal humans, would come across as insanity or dementia. In addition, one can psychically induce, amplify, reduce and negate mental instability by touch, as well as completely withstanding it. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are eccentric, demented, insane or mad at will.
summary: The ability to channel Mania and the Maniae's command over the essence of madness, insanity and mental instability
strengths: Gain a superhuman genius form of sanity that resembles insanity (immunity to mental penetration)
Induce, amplify, reduce and negate madness/dementia/insanity by a touch; withstand TRUE insanity
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are crazy/insane/mad
weaknesses: Cannot project 'Madness Bolts' (matter-distorting psychic energy) until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Lyssa's Lunacy, Berserker Rage, etc provide benefits to Pro #2
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Es Excalibur
description: This power is similar to the ones that turn humans into weapons, but this allows for greater power and control of the weapons created. When the person with this power applies him/her self to another being as an ES (Equip Soul) the persons body turns to 4 Excalibur sword replicas, a full body armor, and provides full regeneration. The 4 swords can be dual wielded by the soul of the ES and by the being ES is equipped to, or can be combined together into a full version of Excalibur for more power.
summary: The ability to use Equip Souls
strengths: Heals the one being equipped.
Privides increased speed, power and knowledge to use the weapon properly.
The equipped being retains all it's original powers.
weaknesses: ES can not fight on its own.
The ES has to rely on the equipped person to fight.

name: Three Laws Of Robotics Aura
description: In classic science fiction these laws applied to robots. Your power changes them and makes them apply to everyone around in a 500 foot radius. Affected beings can't injure you or through inaction allow a unaffected being to injure you. Any affected being must obey any command you give,except where it conflicts with the first law. Any affected being will protect its/his/her existence as long as the first two laws aren't in conflict with such protection.
summary: The ability to affect everyone in a 500 radius around with the three laws of robotics.
strengths: A mobile effect that turns anyone into your helpers or bodyguards.
Bank personal will just give you all the money you want.
A great power against a hero without the means to stop it affecting him.
weaknesses: Anti-telepathy,mind control immunity powers. Anything similar.
Anyone who has ranged attack of more than 500 feet.
Your former 'robots' will want revenge on you.

name: 3 Forms Of Body
description: When you activate this ability, you will separate into the 3 forms of body. The Skin Form, The Muscle Form, and The Bone Form. Each Form has its own strengths and weaknesses. The Skin form is constantly regenerating and healing. It is susceptible to poison and radiation. Muscle Form is incredibly strong but is susceptible to psionic attacks. The Bone form is immune to all poisons, radiations and psychic attacks and has increased defense, but is less intelligent and prone to error.
summary: The ability to separate yourself into the three forms of body.
strengths: Three bodies are better than one.
Have three different powers at once.
weaknesses: Splitting up is unpleasant.
Have three distinct weaknesses.

name: Shelter Summon
description: With this power, you can summon a shelter in your presence. It can be unsommend when your done with it...or you can just let it exist
summary: The ability to summon a shelter your presence.
strengths: Always have a place to stay.
weaknesses: It's only a cabin with little to no furniture.
Basic amenities, such as a toilet, sink and tiny fridge

name: Shut Up
description: Do your siblings ever bother you by just talking and talking and talking and talking? Not anymore! With Shut-up, you can make anybody be silent until you decide to make them talk again. But it can backfire by leaving everybody quiet for the rest of their lives, so you could go insane.
summary: The ability to make anybody (I repeat, anybody) shut up!
strengths: No more annoyances
Peace and quiet
weaknesses: If you use it too much at one time, it could backfire
You might go insane.

name: Doom
description:
This ability permits the user to cast a time-limit on a person for how long left they have to live.
The minimum time is 60 seconds and time-limits can not exceed 12 months. Can not do instant death or cast an infinite time-limit. The time-limit you cast can not be changed afterwards.
summary: The ability to cast a time-limit on people till they are dead
strengths: Cause people to die in exactly 1 minute.
People who deserve to die can die as soon as a minute is up thanks to this ability.
weaknesses: Can not cause instant death.
Can not reverse or stop time-limit. (Be careful who you use it on)

name: Orbs
description: The orb ability is when you shoot out blue orbs with bright lights in the middle. it is super powerful against almost anything.
summary: The ability to cast out orbs at your opponents
strengths: you can orb your self to any place in the universe
you can orb anything to anywhere in the universe
you can fly
weaknesses: It has no affect on electricity
you can not rearrange yours or anybodys body parts
It takes a while for your powers to be at their full extent

name: Forget Me
description: With this power you can make anybody forget who you are and that they had anything to do with you. This is useful if you get caught doing something you're not supposed to be doing (stealing, trespassing, cheating etc. ) Unfortunately you cannot make them forget only one thing about you when you use this power on a person they forget that they even knew you or met you and everything else about you.
summary: The ability to make people forget who you are
strengths: The pros are listed above
weaknesses: The cons are listed above

name: Zeus: Nuke Fist
description: With this power you are able to charge your fists with destructive energy, capable of completely, literally, destroying objects.
summary: The ability to charge your fists with destructive energy able of destroying objects.
strengths: Destroy objects.
weaknesses: Some objects it cannot destroy, such as vibranium.
This hurts your fists A LOT.
If your object(s) move and your fists hit each other, you are in for a world 'O pain......

name: Power Reincarnation
description: This power only aplies if you want to come back to life with all your memories and/or use of all but 1 of your powers. If you do then you get to choose whether you want to be male or female, but you can't choose anything else before being reborn. The power you lose due to this power is completely random.
summary: The ability to come back to life at the sacrifice of one power
strengths: You keep all your memories and all but one of your powers when reincarnated.
You could lose your most useless power.
weaknesses: Only thing you can decide about your next body is your sex.
You could lose your most useful power.
The power lost is random.

name: Hydra Summon
description: With this power you can summon the multiheaded hydra. The hydra is under your complete control and you can make it do whatever you want. If the hydra dies, you lose this power forever. Unless you are somehow able to bring the hydra back to life with some sort of resurrection power/machine/spell/other. When you're done with the hydra, you can send it back to where it came from.
summary: The ability to summon the hydra
strengths: You can summon a hydra
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: If it dies you lose this power

name: Angered Spontaneous Combustion
description: This is not exactly the best power to have when in a small room full of people. This ability is completely painless to its user; he/she will survive the full blast of the combustion because the user regenerates after the blast. The angrier the user is, the bigger the explosion and flare.
summary: The ability to suddenly catch on fire and explode if the user's angry enough.
strengths: Awesome party trick.
If it's cold, just get mad.
weaknesses: Live alone so you don't get angry around people.
Cannot be held back or controlled.

name: Charonian
description: If you possess the charonian you can keep people from dying but to do it you have to suck youth from others to keep them alive.
summary: The ability to keep the doors of death closed for some people to die
strengths: You can make people immortal if you suck a lot of youth.
You can live VERY long!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
You can suck away youth from enemies.
weaknesses: You hav to suck a way youth to do it.
It is soooooo hard!!!!!!!
It is really stressful

name: Exploding Swarm
description: The user appearance is a cross between a white zetsu and clay face. The user can create up to three duplicates/ clones at any given time, the clones will try to latch onto the enemies. When attacked and pieces of the clone are separated from the clone's main body(example: an arm)that piece will transform into another full clone. The clone also has the ability to explode(similarly to a possessed abomination in Mass Effect 3)
summary: The ability to create duplicate/ clones that can be deonated
strengths: Overwhelm enemies
Normal phyiscal attacks are useless
Feel no pain when exploding
weaknesses: A tiny piece of the user needs to remain intact or willl die.
After a clone explodes the user must wait two minutes before creating more.

name: Pocket Change Summoning
description: With this power you can summon anything of equal or lesser value to the amount of money you have on your person. You don't lose the money when you use this power and you can easily summon multiple things that are worth the amount of cash you have on you but you cannot summon anything that would cost more than the money you have on you.
summary: The ability to summon anything that you could afford with the money in your pocket
strengths: You can summon anything that would be able to afford with the money you have in your pocket
weaknesses: You can't summon anything that is worth more than the amount of money you have on you

name: Myth Power: Pandia's Pander
description: Pandia (Pandeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the full moon's light and youth. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate moonlight, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb ambient moonlight to recover and gain physical power, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically restore health and youth, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Pandia's command over the essence of the light of the full moon and youth
strengths: Psychically generate full-moon moonlight, absorb moonlight to gain physical power and heal, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Psychically restore subjects' health and youth, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically induce/negate madness, or lycanthropy, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn subjects into stupid, deformed mooncalves, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Giggly Palm
description: To emit nitrous oxide, you must first catch the enemy then cover their mouth with your palm- but don't worry, they won't struggle for long. The gas will enter their body and take over their being, causing them to laugh uncontrollably and eventually wear their lungs out when they will suffocate and die.  This is normally a power for a super villain due to the hilarity of the event (it's just plain fun to watch).
summary: The ability to release laughing gas from your palms
strengths: Stun your enemy
Wears the enemy's lungs out
Almost always kills (if not killed, they will be severely scarred)
weaknesses: Must cover their mouth with your hand to emit the gas
Comes only from your palms

name: Optic Delay
description: When used, it can prevent the subject from seeing things up to few seconds after it has happened, and so one can easily evade the subjects vision for a few seconds. This ability can affect more than one person at a time and lasts as long as one chooses to. This power can backfire
summary: The ability to disrupt a subject's optic vision temporarily and "rewind" it to a few moments in the past.
strengths: Evade a foe's attacks.
Get a chance to flee.
Affects mutiple subjects and can last as long as one chooses.
weaknesses: Can backfire.
Can take some time to learn how to use this ability on mutiple subjects.
Can take some time to learn how to turn on and off.

name: Headache
description: Cause mental pain with your mind to either severely hurt somebody or leave them unconscious. Or, just by merely touching the brow of a victim, you can leave them in a small coma. However, without control you can cause mental pain to people all around you.
summary: The ability to cause mental pain with or without touching a person, leaving them unconscious
strengths: Hurt your enemies easily
weaknesses: You must have control of the power

name: Bloodlines (Special Type)
description: You can pass along a power with this power and it is permanently decided which power when you use this power the first time. That one power and this power are unstealable and unmimicable as well as the knowledge of one technique being transferred. You still keep the powers and knowledge of the technique after transfer. Transfer requires 1mL of blood consumed and must require your approval. This power is not negatable, unalterable and can be used multiple times.
summary: The ability to pass along one power and one technique through the blood
strengths: Can use multiple times.
This power is passed along attached to the other power.
The technique is your coice.
weaknesses: Other power is still alterable.
The recipient could be unhappy about which technique you give and attack you.

name: Wushu Finger Hold
description: The ultimate Kung Fu move. You grab the forefinger of your enemy with all of the fingers in your hand except the pinkie. When you flex your pinkie you deliver a massive amount of chi energy directly to the body resulting in a mass explosion of chi force. No one knows exactly what happens to the opponent, but they disappear after the move is completed.
summary: The ability to completely obliterate your opponent
strengths: I think the good parts are obvious
weaknesses: Cleaning up the mess afterword

name: Air Car
description: With this power, you can drive a car like you normally would, except the car isn't there. You can "drive" (float/hover/levitate) anywhere a car could fit. This is done by a combination of Mimesis and Telekinesis. It'll make the same sounds, but doesn't require fuel.
summary: The ability to drive an imperceptible car.
strengths: Free car
No expenses
weaknesses: Safety is an issue, as nothing protects you
Can't go too fast without protection

name: Bread Crumbs
description: With this power you will never lose your way. As you walk, you can leave trails or spots of light which only you can see. You could also use this power to mark an object.
summary: The ability to leave a trail or spots of light which only you can see
strengths: Never be lost
Tag objects to identify them
weaknesses: Only you can see the trails

name: Knight Owls
description: With this power you can summon up to 57 knight owls. Knight owls are more or less just owls with armor, their armor is impenetrable and they can be summoned during the day or night. They are under your complete control and you can unsummon them when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon a flock of knight owls
strengths: You can summon a flock of knight owls
They are under your complete control
Their beaks and talons are sharper than those of normal owls
weaknesses: They might eat your mice friends
They can die
You can only summon 57 of them

name: Naga Morphing
description: This power allows you to transform into a Naga and back. Nagas are half-humanoid, half-serpentine creatures with humanoid features from the waist up and a snake's body from the waist down. This power gives you the traits of both a human and a snake. You also gain Naga Magic so you can hypnotize people.
summary: The ability to transform into a Naga
strengths: You can scare off criminals by turning into a fearsome naga.
Climb up walls and constrict foes.
Some nagas have camouflage and/or venom!
weaknesses: Controlling your new lower extremities.
It takes time to shift between forms.

name: Monster Converter
description: The power to turn people into Monsters. The power makes other people into Monsters that only you can control. The Monsters look a lot like Hollows (from the manga cartoon Bleach).
summary: The ability to turn people to Monsters that only obey the one who used the power
strengths: You can make an extremely big army of Monsters
You never need to take orders from anyone, just turn them into monsters ;P
You can reach world leadership pretty easily
weaknesses: You need to touch the person you want to turn to a Monster
You cannot use it on yourself
You always have to fear that the Monsters turn against you

name: Energy Draw
description: You can make a beam of energy on your fingertip to draw on wood, tile, and even air. Any surface is possible.
summary: The ability to create an energy to draw on any surface
strengths: Draw plans anywhere
Draw anything
weaknesses: Not good in a fight though

name: Sculptor's Touch
description: A person with this power has the ability to make anything they touch be extremely malleable enough to be bent easily. When effected object is not in contact with your hands the touched object returns to its usual malleability. Some real applications of this ability include the uses of it in the arts and possibly in several sports like archery or pole vaulting. In battle this can be used to tie people up in knots or hitting people through their bendy armor.
summary: The ability to make things that are in contact with your hands be malleable
strengths: You can make sculptures very easily and are good at making art
Make things malleable or non-malleable at will
Very useful auxilary power in combat
weaknesses: Bending things is not the same as destroying things
Its very hard to return things to the exact way they are after bending them

name: Myth Power: Hypnos' Lullaby
description: Hypnos (Hypnus) in Greek myth, was the god of sleep. As such, channeling him allows one to induce sleep (or insomnia) at will, as well as manipulating the length and depth of sleep (from a light catnap to a total coma); even putting machines to "sleep".
