In addition, one can compel the sleeping, causing them to sleepwalk to carry out commands. Furthermore, one maintains his awareness as he sleeps, and awakes fully rested from any amount of sleep he has; one can even go without sleep if desired.
summary: The ability to channel Hypnos' command over the essence of sleep
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand sleep at will; even put machines to "sleep"
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the sleeping (and sleepwalkers)
Sleep is entirely voluntary, and totally recharges energy and restores your health
weaknesses: Cannot use this ability to manipulate dreams (NCN)
Cannot enter a sleepwalking trance with Precognitive Reflexes until the higher levels (NCN)
Sleeplessness, Dreamlessness, Perspicuity, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Background Music
description: You can choose if this can be heard by others or not. You don't choose the music, your mood and the current event determine the soundtrack. However, it can be switched off, dimmed, or amplified.
summary: The ability to have background music play to different events in your life.
strengths: Become an instant song master!
A skip and a dance to a merry tune!
You can be James Bond, Jackie Chan, or the Pink Panther!
weaknesses: You might end up bobbing your head to a catchy tune and be sent to a mental hospital.
You might end up wallowing in self-pity.

name: Swords Of De Aging
description: The swords cause what they touch to de-age by 1,000,000,000 seconds and are composed of light. They only cause things within a close proximity of what they touch to de-age. Ex: Your hand is touched and only it will de-age. The swords can be controlled mentally by the user and only five swords can be used created/controlled at a time.
summary: The ability to create and control swords that cause what they touch to become younger
strengths: Things younger than 1 billion seconds will find themselves turned into base atoms.
Help the elderly relive their teenage days.
weaknesses: Enemies immune to having their age supernaturally changed.
User is not immune to the effects of their swords.

name: "Speak Humans!"
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak any human language. They will know how to speak the language with perfect grammar and even know how to use slang words.
summary: The ability to give any person the ability to speak any language (bestow Omnilingualism)
strengths: You can give people to the ability to speak any human language
They can speak with perfect grammar, no matter what language
They will even know slang words, colloquialisms and figurative expressions
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: I Am Batman
description: With this power you can turn into any version of Batman from any of the comics, TV shows, movies, radio dramas etc. You have all of his memories combined with yours and you have all of his skills, abilities and equipment however you retain your personality.
summary: The ability to turn into Batman
strengths: You can become Batman
weaknesses: Having the memories of two people might be hard to handle

name: Wild Cat
description: With this power you can change domestic house cats into jungle cats. You change your little tabby cat into a ferocious tiger or your siamese into a lion and so on and so forth. The cats that you change become under your control however you cannot turn them back into house cats.
summary: The ability to change domestic house cats into jungle cats
strengths: You can turn house cats into jungle cats
They are under your control
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Healer 6: Hearing Aid
description: With this ability, anyone within 25 kilometers has their hearing restored to expected levels, regardless of cause. This ability repairs the normal auditory organs to normal working order and repairs relevant brain damage. In all cases, you are able to hear what is heard by those healed at will. In addition, you may enhance your own sense of hearing by the same amount, but naturally this will degrade over time. Range increase by 1 meter each year of possession and may be switched off at will.
summary: The ability to restore hearing and gain clairaudience as well as enhanced hearing.
strengths: Restore hearing to the deaf.
Enhance your own hearing and hear through the ears of those healed if needed.
Has a base range of 25 kilometers which increases by 1 meter for each year of possession.
weaknesses: Will only help the deaf or hearing impaired.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Serpent Fingers
description: The supers fingers, toes, and any other desired digits, extend out to twice the standard length while morphing into snakes or a snake like form. Each can act independent of the super, or act in accordance to the supers will. Snakes can be; venomous (causes necrosis of flesh), constricting (3x users strength), Paralytic Neuro Toxin, or has an Ultra Strong Biting (x3 users bite, and diamond hard teeth). Snakes can extend out to 3 meters per tier and regenerate in minutes when cut.
summary: The ability to transforms finger (and toes if desired) into vicious snakes under the supers control.
strengths: Snakes can be used as mid ranged independent attackers, or directed. They will actively defend.
Adds additional attack methods. Can support the users weight, allowing brachiating between points.
Digits recover 1% of length every 15 seconds. At higher levels head hair and full limbs also change.
weaknesses: There is a 1% chance per tier of gaining an insanity Due to the serpents ability to be independent.
This power is disturbing to many people/beings, especially the ophidiopho minded. May scare allies.
There is a very real potential for shock from loosing a snake. A 5% chance of causing a freakout.

name: Myth Power: Anchiale's Anchor
description: Anchiale (Ankhiale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the warming heat of fire. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate heat, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb ambient heat, to gain physical power (and sustenance), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport through any body of fire, or fire-starting heat, at will. One can also withstand intense heat/cold. One can withstand even psychically turn into an entity of thermal energy, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Anchiale's command over the essence of the warming heat of fire
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate heat; gain physical power, sustenance from external heat
Psychically teleport through fire (or fire-starting heat), at will; withstand temperature extremes
Psychically turn into an entity of thermal energy (heat), at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically absorb 'heat' from passionate emotions (anger, love, etc) until developed (NCN)
Heat Immunity, Heat Absorption, Fireproof Body, Empathic Immunity, etc, provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Iapetos' Impetus provides negation (NCN)

name: Wind Up Punch (Electro Magnet)
description: A person with this power can generate electricity by spinning their arms around. Due to magnetic forces within their arms, spinning their hand rapidly generates electricity. The more they spin, the more magnetic their hands get and the more electricity they can generate per spin. The user is also able to store their electricity in their arms. When charged to a certain point, metal objects stick to the user's arm like a metal hand and the user can blast the charge metal at targets.
summary: The ability to charge up electrical energy in your fist by winding up your arms
strengths: You become immune to your own electrical shock and can charge up with no damage to your own life
When winding up, you can also hit people with stray sparks of electricity
Electric punch can be deadly and can also hit long range with charged metal if charged enough
weaknesses: Can accidentally hit other people with electricity whilst charging
The user's hands are permanently magnetic-however, it is really weak when not spinning

name: Offensive Bubble Breath
description: A person with this power can blow out bubbles of many different colors, each with a different effect. They can blow out all of one color or various colors at a time. The effects are listed in the Pros and Cons.
summary: The ability to blow out bubbles with various effects depending on their color
strengths: Red Bubbles-explode on contact,
Green Bubbles-sticks on skin, is lightly acidic, and becomes a bubble prison
Blue Bubbles-expands and pushes things away
weaknesses: Black Bubbles-releases poison gas when popped
Orange Bubbles-ignition on contact
Yellow Bubbles-electric shock on contact

name: Random Cannon
description: With this power, you have the ability to launch randomly created objects from your hands at speeds of up to 500 MPH (800 KPH). Simply hold your palm up as if to say "stop", invoke your power and BOOM! Since your "cannonball" is a randomly created object, it can be ANYTHING, from a piano, to a fluffy sheep, to a boulder, to a suitcase full of money. You have total control over the speed that your cannon launches objects at. It could be ANYTHING though, so use with caution!
summary: The ability to blast randomly created items from your hands
strengths: Your cannon has endless ammunition.
Power and fun. Imagine the joy of taking someone down with a sheep.
Your power can easily be made into a drinking game!
weaknesses: The objects your cannon launches are randomly generated - you have no control over them.
Though it's unlikely, you could blast something that backfires, like a swarm of bees

name: Gauntlet
description: To change the size, shape, and density of your arm.
summary: The ability to change your arm into an unbreakable claw
strengths: looks cool
crush things
shield
weaknesses: heavy
rips shirts
slow

name: Blunt/Piercing Conversion
description: With this power, you can change the damaging effect of any thing. Things that normally deal blunt damages, such as punches, kicks, hammers or falling on the ground, will open holes. Things that normally deal piercing damages, such as nails, stakes, arrows or bullets, will deal a blow.
summary: The ability to convert piercing force into blunt force and vice versa.
strengths: If you are shot, you will get knocked by the projectile rather than bleed to death.
Deal serious damages with a single punch or the edge of your hand.
weaknesses: Doesn't protect you from harm.

name: Elemental Move: Futo
description: The literal translation is wind knife. This is a wind element manpiulation techique which can create any kind of kinfe out air within the palms of your hands witch can be used for hand combat or a throwing object and is strong enugh to cut through rock.
summary: The ability to create any kind of knife out of air
strengths: Very useful in battle
Make any kind of knife with any kind of gas
weaknesses: Need the wind element
Hard to use under water and space

name: Werewolf Control
description: With this power you have complete control of any person who is a werewolf, even if they're not in their werewolf form
summary: The ability to control werewolves
strengths: Werewolves are very strong
Werewolves usually travel in packs so you can have a lot of werewolves under your control
Goes well with werewolf tracker and wolves to werewolves
weaknesses: It only works on werewolves not regular wolves

name: Delete This Take No Prisoners
description: You do your usual victory pose. Then your eyes will turn red-orange and you rushingly glide towards your opponents. Next, when everything goes dark, you perform multiple blows to everyone at the same time, ending with your opponents on the ground and you'll utterly whisper "Serer Tong" which is an anagram for No Regrets.
summary: The ability to rush towards, and inflict multiple blows on multiple enemies at one time.
strengths: Comes in extra handy when you are outnumbered.
Can say Take no Prisoners in a different language.
weaknesses: None.

name: Arcana: 5 The Hierophant
description: This ability deals with information and knowledge. It allows you to move knowledge from anywhere and anything into your mind and then into a medium of your choice. You can take information from anything, books, computers, radio waves, even people's memories. 'Take' means you completely remove it from the source. The same rules apply for putting the information in new places. This power has a very large range, it covers several miles.
summary: The ability to transfer any kind of information from and to any medium.
strengths: You can have vast libraries (both literal and otherwise) of information.
You can make people forget things, teach them things they never knew..
You can take songs straight from the Internet into your mind.
weaknesses: You can't decide what information to take, unless you know exactly where it is.
Your mind is not infinite, so you can't hold all the information in your head at once.

name: Armor Of Light
description: So long as the wearer is true of heart, noble in cause and just in intent then The Armor of Light may be bestowed upon the Hero. It is a nigh indestructible full body armor composed of brilliant, glowing holy magic and energy that cannot be destroyed by conventional means. Can only be summoned when the situation is at its darkest, despair is imminent and defeat is possible. The hero must be strong willed and a believer in such things. It is however weak to corruption of wearer and dark magic.
summary: The ability to summon a magical suit of armor of holy energy
strengths: About gaurentees that the Hero will never loose
Is immeterial (thus need not be carried nor can be destroyed)
Its holy signature and radiant glow is inspiring and can rally allies
weaknesses: It doesn't mean the Hero can win either
Should the hero grow currupt, loose any requisits or stop believing, the armor is lost
It can not be used at all times, only when it is truely needed

name: Sacred Water
description: The power to find safe havens in pools of water. You can stand in water or just have water between you and a foe, and be safe. No one can cross the water you use to stay safe.
summary: The ability to stand in water and keep anyone away from you.
strengths: Awesome way of staying safe
Easy to activate
Easy to hide
weaknesses: Won't work without water
Won't work on water spirits
Won't keep you dry

name: Man Boido Dangan
description: Some may call this overpowered, but the art of Man Boido Dangan (Ten-thousand void bullets) is quite complicated. The user brings out many bullets from the void, and can control them with his/her mind. One bullet is quite weak, but many can be powerful. The user has a limited amount of bullets though, but can stop shooting at any time.
summary: The ability to cause a vast amount of bullets to come out of a void, and be able to control them..
strengths: Powerful when used in a large amount.
weaknesses: Has a limited amount
Weak on their own

name: X Treasure Chests V2
description: With this power you can cause a chest full of treasure to appear whenever you write or draw the letter x. It can be in any color and the larger the x the larger the treasure chest. You can draw the x on any flat surface and a treasure chest will appear. You cannot get rid of the treasure chests.
summary: The ability to make treasure chests appear whenever you write or draw the letter X
strengths: You can make treasure chests appear just by writing or drawing the letter x
It can be in any color
The bigger the x the bigger chest
weaknesses: You cannot get rid of the chests
You have to draw an x

name: Particle Copy
description: With the power to copy particle properties, you can make your car act like a tachyon and travel faster than light or make your homework into a neutrino. Whatever a particle can do, or should do, you can make stuff do it!
summary: The ability to make objects act like particles.
strengths: You can do almost anything!
Very powerful.
weaknesses: Must know the particle to copy its properties.
Very dangerous if used wrongly.

name: Moon Blade 4th: Emerald Green
description: A Sword that is completely green. Able to heal a target by stabbing it, and in the process, dissipating into the body. Once the target is healed, you remove the blade, which detaches from the body and returns into the sword form.
summary: The ability to create a healing sword.
strengths: Heals the target in seconds.
Can be used with any of the moon blades.
Can be swiped through a target while just running past them.
weaknesses: Has no offensive or defensive abilities.
First time patients may be skeptical to be stabbed.

name: Computer Entity
description: When this ability is activated/obtained, the user is transformed into a 'living' computer. Their body is just a 3D metal (it's colored and it doesn't look metal) rendering. It starts as themselves, but it can be tweaked/recreated to be different. They know all commands, and have a unanimous operating system that can run mac, windows, or linux files. Somewhere on their body they will have a metal plate for hardware replacements. They start out with very high quality hardware, though.
summary: The ability to be a computer. Please read description.
strengths: Be the best hacker/pirate/digital artist/computer user/gamer ever and watch/do it in your head!
Never need a phone, computer, gaming system, etc. again! You can use all types of files/data!
Morph your metal body to whatever you want it to look like and can implant upgrades!
weaknesses: Could get a virus or an error.
You'll need to morph your body slightly to go swimming.
Could get hacked/VNCd

name: Children Of The Spirit
description: You are a ghost basically, you can't die but you can reincarnate at will. When you reincarnate the next time you die you turn ghost again and remember everything from your past lives. When you curse a human, they can see you. You can turn human for 7 hours at a time and eat, sleep, etc. If you are killed while in human form you just turn back into a ghost. You can possess people and make them do whatever you want. You can teleport wherever you want to go and you can fly or float.
summary: The ability to be a ghost and turn into a human for 7hours at a time and curse 7 humans at a time
strengths: Phasing; Imperceptibility (except to those you curse)
Possess people to make them do whatever you want them to do (or curse them with bad luck)
You can choose to reincarnate as a human for seven hours at a time (Never die)
weaknesses: Can only become a human again for 7 hours at a time before you become a ghost again
Being a ghost can and will eventually get boring (MAYBE)
Only 7 people at a time can see you

name: Hitchhiker's Aptitude
description: Whenever someone or something is moving very fast, they leave behind a trail which the user can see and can instantly travel along, but only in the direction the object or person took. The trail can remain from a few seconds to minutes before disappearing. The user can catch a ride from anywhere the trail is available to wherever they want along the trail. In the case of teleportation or time travel, the user can only catch a ride from the spot where the teleporter or time traveller disappeared.
summary: The ability to hitch a ride with any fast-moving object or person, even through time and space.
strengths: Pursue anyone who tries to flee by running away, by car or any other vehicle.
Follow anyone who is superspeeding, superjumping, flying, teleporting or even time travelling.
You can ride the trail from anywhere it's accessible and leave anywhere along the way.
weaknesses: The trail disappears after a few seconds to minutes.
Against teleporters or time travellers, the trail is only accessible where the person disappeared.
Though you travel instantly along the trail, you can only move in the same direction that was took.

name: Bringer Of Magic
description: Whenever someone with this ability is around anyone doing magic or using a magical power, they would find that they have up to 10 times the power they did before. This is a voluntary ability, so if someone is using a magical power against you, you can turn it off. Also, you choose who you use your power on. So if there are two magically powered people--one friend, one foe--you can choose to only power up your friend. Can also be used to overpower someone to the point where they pass out.
summary: The ability to amplify any sort of magic
strengths: Voluntary ability, so no powering up an attacker
Can choose who you amplify
Can be used on yourself if you have another magic power
weaknesses: If you don't know about someone, you might power them up by mistake
Might knock yourself out

name: Physigy
description: There are many physical attributes, but I will give you only one example. Strength is one. You can change strength into energy and then you can crush anything. Just don't overuse it or you will suffer pain depending on that attribute.
summary: The ability to turn one's strongest physical attribute into energy that is used the same way and amplified.
strengths: You will be stronger depending on your strongest physical attribute.
weaknesses: You will suffer pain if you overdo it.

name: Assess Abilities
description: Just by looking at someone you can see any special Abilities or special powers that person has.I don't mean things like being able to count backwards really fast I mean Superhuman Powers or Extraordinary Abilities
summary: The ability to know what superpowers or abilities anyone possesses.
strengths: You can Prepare Yourself for any Possible Situation Involving that Person.
You will Know What Their Value to you Would Be.
It Will Help You to Understand a Persons Quirks or Odd Behavior.
weaknesses: You May Try to Exploit People for their Abilities.
You may Need an Ability and you Waste Time Looking for That Person.
You May become Superficial in Dealing with People and their Powers

name: Myth Power: Oath Of Ouranos
description: Ouranos (Uranos), in Greek myth, was the god of the sky's expanses and the dome of the sky (the atmosphere). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive any location open to the sky (including weather and subjects' activity), at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate clouds (lower them to generate fog, etc), at will. One can also psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can even psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions).
summary: The ability to channel Ouranos' command over the essence of the sky's expanses and the dome of the sky
strengths: Psychically perceive any location open to the sky (weather, subjects' activity, etc), at will
Psychically manipulate clouds (move them around, obscure the sun, generate fog, etc) at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
weaknesses: Cannot psychically teleport foes to the sky or the atmosphere, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive life and events on alien planets/worlds, until developed (NCN)
No perception underground or in densely shrouded areas (NCN)

name: Agony Vision
description: Your power works by stimulating the pain center of virtually any humanoid, a synaptic scan calibrates it for each species. Traditional forms of punishment can overwhelm the nervous system, after a time the brain ceases to feel anything. However, agony vision possesses sensors that continually shift the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony, hence its name.
summary: The ability to fire intense beams from your eyes to cause enemies extreme pain.
strengths: You can use this ability to interrogate, submit and torture your enemies.
weaknesses: If this power reflects on a mirror you too can go into a constant state of pain.

name: Spontaneous Human Combustion
description: Bored? No problem. Set your neighbours on fire telepathically! With this power, just by thinking about it, you can make anyone suddenly burst into flames. They will continue burning-unless you choose to release them from your power- until there is no longer anything to burn. Because the victim becomes self-oxidizing, water cannot stop the fire. Planning a suicide? Make it one to remember! (My humour has turned quite macabre... )
summary: The ability to cause any human to burst into flames.
strengths: Awesome assassin.
Never go bored again.
Win any fight with non-superpowered people.
weaknesses: May end up killing a lot of people.

name: Third Eye: Control
description: This power is gained by using the long-distance and slow-motion aspects of the Third Eye power equally. The Third Eye power slowly changes into this power. You can fire rainbow blasts from your third eye that you to control every aspect of a person it hits for an hour. This means mental, physical, and superpower aspects. Control can be shaken off by those with strong will. After the hour they are released from your control but changes stay. You can still use the Third Eye powers.
summary: The ability to fire a blast from one's third eye that allows control of a person
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye.
Can control other beings.
Can still use Third Eye powers
weaknesses: Must have Third Eye power and look at far-off objects and fast-moving ones equally.
Must hit the target and blast is really visible.
Cannot get the other formerly possible powers.

name: Sacrificial Augmentation
description: This ability, as the title suggests, allows you to sacrifice any form of living entity to gain physical strength. If you have any, this also enhances any 'superpowers' that you may possess. Note that the strength gained by the sacrifice is determined by the size and strength of that which is sacrificed.
summary: The ability to sacrifice living entities to enhance your strength.
strengths: Strength!
Sacrificial Powers!
Now everyone has a purpose :)
weaknesses: Not beneficial to anyone but yourself
Cannot be used on invincible entities
Not everyone may want this to be their purpose :/

name: Delete This Omega Blaster
description: You can fully charge your arms full of energy, then unleash it into a lethal but powerful blue-purplish projectile at your enemies that devastates them nearby.
summary: The ability to let out a charged projectile aimed at your foe.
strengths: Extremely Powerful.
weaknesses: None

name: Flower Petal Wind
description: The wind will only last for 2 seconds and brings along several flower petals. You can choose what type of flower the petals come from and can control the movement of the petals as much as you want. However, it is exponentially easier to control all the flowers as a group than individually and this power can be used only once every 24 hours. The petals disappear after 1 hour by the way.
summary: The ability to create a gust of wind that brings along razor-sharp flower petals
strengths: Can use for dramatic effect and as an effective attack.
weaknesses: It's much harder to control an individual petal than 1000 petals in a single group.
The number of petals is random each time you use this power.

name: Dictukinesis
description: The ability to manipulate and control alcohol. Some can only turn things into alcohol. Some users are able to increase the amount of alcohol inside a person when they've only inhaled literally a drop of it, making them drunk. And can lower to alchol limit in a certain beverage meaning that you drink more without getting drunk or liver poisoned. If mixed with Pyrokinesis it could be very dangerous against an opponent(s)
summary: The ability to manipulate alcohol with your mind.
strengths: Fun at parties!
Always win drinking contests.
Along with Pyrokinesis, it could be very powerful.
weaknesses: Along with Pyrokinesis, it could be very destructive.
You might be sent to rehabilitation for all that alcohol.
Alcohol doesn't nourish you at all.

name: Paneth Cell Mimicry
description: Despite having an offensive and defensive role, this power is not a type of Leukocyte Mimicry. This power allows you to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. When you recognize a foe, you can trigger a second ability, the one to release a volatile substance which can create holes through their skin, and this only attacks a foe's skin. Also, you can secrete a liquid substance with antibacterial properties.
summary: The ability to detect foes and release a substance which pierces only their skin, as well as secrete antibiotics.
strengths: You can secrete antibiotics.
You can detect foes, especially those you can shapeshift to evade detection.
You can release a deadly airborne substance that only targets foes.
weaknesses: You do not have any of the other abilities of Leukocyte Mimics.
So, you can't clone yourself, nor distort your body.
Once you've released your deadly product, you need time to replenish your supply.

name: Graphic Novel
description: With this power you can turn regular old boring novels into fun and exciting graphic novels. If the book already has a graphic novel version it will become that, but if there is no graphic novel version of the book in existence this power will create one for you drawn by your favorite artist/in your favorite style. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn books into graphic novels
strengths: You can turn books into graphic novels
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Epitome Of Beauty
description: The user can appear to whomever they choose as their personal epitome of beauty/attractiveness/sexiness. The user can use this power in three ways. 1) They can appear as ONE persons personal epitome of beauty, and appear that way to everybody. 2) The user can appear to EVERYBODY as their personal epitome of beauty all at once, appearing differently to each individual. 3) The user can become their OWN personal epitome of beauty, making them the most beautiful person ever by their own standards.
summary: The ability to appear to others as their personal epitome of beauty
strengths: Appear to others as their personal epitome of beauty
weaknesses: 3 different ways of using this power, but only 1 of those ways can be used at a time

name: Dual Appendages
description: Can split your arm(s) into two arms, effectively doubling your record of arm wrestle wins and punching someone twice with one swing. From any joint or attachment, one can sprout second limb from. Turn yourself into a quadrapede by growing two new legs, grow to bodies attached to one head, two tongues, ten fingers on one hand, four ears, etc. Best of all... Two heads!
summary: The ability to grow two working pairs of any appendage(s) or limb(s), at will.
strengths: Can easily climb with a second set of forearms or multitask with two heads!
Endless and undiscernable source of flesh and bone!
Become the ultimate gamer and speed up your typing!
weaknesses: Gets slightly uninteresting after a while, and gross.
Can only make two of each appendage.
Will not regenerate lost limbs only duplicate them.

name: Special Event Embodiment
description: This ability allows one to become a physical representation of an event that they hold most dear. It could be a good moment, a tragedy, or even an embarrassing moment. They will represent it. They will have certain abilities depending from that event like producing items or living things that where from that event especially if it was relevant to that event, create the same event again, and even produce effects that have to be based on that event.
summary: The ability to the embodiment of a special event or moment in one's life.
strengths: Be the a living embodiment of an event or moment
Become stronger if other people remember
Gain certain abilities based on that event
weaknesses: Only one event or moment
You will never forget

name: Panthera Cantus
description: By touching your chest with two fingers, and saying the name of the ability, your upper body's clothes disintegrate, and black lines (tattoos) cover most of your body. You gain claws on both feet and hands, and become advanced at martial arts.
summary: The ability to become a panther/human hybrid.
strengths: Great hand to hand power.
High speed
weaknesses: Due to clawed hands, you are unable to use weapons.
Can speak, but unable to use spells that require an incantation.

name: Personality Implantation
description: With personality implant, you can temporarily place your mind into anyone else. They'll think like you, act like you, and so forth. You can use it to make your own sports team, make everyone agree with you, or just mess with someone. Only problems would be that if the person you were using it on is unable to physically do things that you can. Also, your mind stays in your body; it's like copy-paste. However, the person you're using it on will eventually turn back into themselves.
summary: The ability to place your peronality into others.
strengths: Get your own group.
Make enemies have your mind, so they'll be good.
Group projects should be easy because your group thinks like you!
weaknesses: Wears off with time.
The people you use it on don't remember anything.
Since it's not a hive mind, the yous don't have to listen to you.

name: 1000 Exploding Fireballs
description: You can create fireballs that explode upon impact in groups of 1000. You can adjust the power of the explosion by changing the density of the fireball. The denser the fireball is the more powerful the explosion, thus a fireball that has its molecules spread out is a lot weaker than a normal one. The heat of the flames cannot be changed.
summary: The ability to create 1000 exploding fireballs
strengths: Can create more even if previous groups aren't fully used.
No concentration required for fireballs to stay after creation.
Can set extremely dangerous traps for intruders or enemies.
weaknesses: Must create them in sets of 1000.
Harder to create denser fireballs for more damaging explosions.
No immunity to fire or explosions without another power.

name: Breakdown Voltage Manipulation
description: It's well known that electricity cannot (easily) flow through an insulator. That's true as long as the applied electrical voltage remains below a voltage level called the breakdown voltage of the insulator. If not, the insulator becomes electrically conductive. With this power, you can control that level. By lowering it, you can weaken an insulator, making it less effective to protect against electricity. By increasing it, you can make it more resistant to electrical breakdown.
summary: The ability to change the breakdown voltage of insulators.
strengths: Great if you have an electricity-based superpower since insulators won't be a problem anymore.
Increase the breakdown voltage of the air around you to protect yourself against lightning strikes.
Increase the breakdown voltage of your shoes to ground yourself.
weaknesses: It only works on insulators and partially on semiconductors, but not on conductors.
It can take a long time to change the level if the difference with the intrinsic level is too high.
You cannot increase a breakdown voltage to infinity, so high-voltage electricity may still flow.

name: Pixmension
description: One must hold a photograph, drawing, picture, etc, and then blink. When they reopen their eyes they are in the pixel dimension. Once in the dimension one can only explore the region of the picture and can only get out through the picture they came in--unless there is a picture in the picture; then they can get out from there. Back in the real world in the picture/whatever one entered, the user will be in it. If the picture/whatever one entered is destroyed then the person is trapped forever.
summary: The ability to enter the pixel dimension
strengths: Go to the past
Travel the world
Visit make believe worlds
weaknesses: Only can stand for 15-20 hours
Can only re-enter after 5-10 hours
Destroy the Picture means lost forever

name: Gas Mimicry
description: Gas is something we all need--but if we breathe the wrong kind, it can kill us. A Gas Mimic can take on the properties of a gas at will, letting them float, become invisible, untouchable, and hide in small spaces. Their ability also allows them to take on the properties of specific gases, like chlorine gas, tear gas, or even nerve gas. However, they can be contained in airtight chambers, cannot pass through nonporous matter, and will be blown away in a stiff breeze.
summary: The ability to turn your body into various gases
strengths: Silent killer
Cannot be struck in gas form
Can choose which gas you want to be
weaknesses: Being blown away
Vacuum cleaners
Your flight is very slow

name: Pro And Con
description: When you mentally activate this power, you have a fifty per cent chance to permanently remove either the positive or negative aspects of a super power of your choosing.
summary: The ability to either remove all negative aspects of a power or all positive aspects by chance.
strengths: No more limitations on powers.
You may become exceptionally powerful, or foes exceptionally weak.
Can be used on other people.
weaknesses: Stuck with the outcome. (Powers may become liabilities or foes may lose weaknesses)
Power is unaffected by luck-altering powers.
No, you can't remove the cons from this power.

name: Soul Inspection
description: You can see another's soul.  By being able to inspect their soul you are able to see all the kindness they have done in the past, or all the sins they have done.  This ability allows you to know every aspect of them, their birthday, age, all of their abilities.  This power allows you to some of their next movements.  If you train this power you will be able to take their soul out of their body.
summary: The ability to inspect another's soul.
strengths: Inspect their soul.
Know their powers.
If you train enough then you can see the graces and sins they will do.
weaknesses: Taking souls out of body means that for a short second their life will flash before your eyes.
Their is a 30% they will know they are spying on you (Permanently)
You can only focus on 10 souls at a time.

name: Pistol Master
description: A Pistol Master is a person that can pick up a pistol and be a master of it without even having to see before. You can curve bullets, have pin point accuracy, and perfectly modify your weapon better than anyone else would be able to.
summary: The ability to be a master of any pistol known to man
strengths: No more hiding behind walls for enemies
You can have the greatest pistols ever and not have to train
weaknesses: Pistols don't have that long of a range
Drop your pistol you're dead

name: Kill Yourself And Be A Ghost
description: With this ability, you can kill yourself by force of will. You will fall on the floor and your spirit will leave your body BUT you won't go into the light. From this point, you are an earth-bound ghost, and you're existing on another plane. Now you're made out of energy, and you can put yourself into anything, objects, animals and even humans. When you possess them, you can control them, though you have to practice. You can communicate with other spirits too.
summary: The ability to kill yourself and become a ghost and return later to your body to live again
strengths: Communicate with other dead people, interact with other energies and expand your knowledge.
Haunt places, scare your enemies and friends!
Possess objects and control them
weaknesses: Be sure to hide your body before activating the power, otherwise you might wake up in a coffin!
You have 24 hours, after that, your body starts decomposing, and you'll be taken to the afterlife
Avoid mediums if you don't want to be seen

name: Triforce Of Power
description: With the triforce of power you have vast power, immortality, you can transform into a dark beast and you are almost undefeatable. But on the other hand, you are corrupted and led to evil.
summary: The ability to use the triforce of power
strengths: Vast power
Transform
Undefeatable and immortal
weaknesses: Evil
Corrupted

name: Debt Collection
description: A person with this power has the ability to collect any debt, and the debtor cannot attack you or they will owe you more. Killing you lets you take their life. This can also work on other, non-monetary types of debts. For example, if someone agreed to give you their soul to pay for the debt it's fair game. All the things you collect from debts can be loaned to others. Debts must be agreed on ahead of time and there is no joking. If someone is unable to pay on time, you can change the conditions.
summary: The ability to collect any debt no matter how ridiculous and be totally invincible against a debtor
strengths: You always get back what you are owed
You can collect people's souls--and sell them to others
You can write the contract for the debt yourself
weaknesses: If you aren't a loan shark you probably will become one
If someone decides to kill themselves to end the debt--can't collect
If you owe someone a debt this power will work against you too

name: Eject
description: With this power you can eject yourself or others from any vehicle. When this power is activated a hole will instantly appear in the roof above the person's head. The person will then shoot out of the car and receive parachute. This works for any and all vehicles and can be used on any person.
summary: The ability to eject yourself or others from a vehicle
strengths: You can eject yourself or other from any vehicle
Free parachute
You can use this power on any person and any vehicle
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you're fighting in a vehicle

name: Pixelization
description: Real Life is in an amazing resolution. So amazing that it sometimes gets annoying. The user of this power can change anything touched into a pixel form, even himself. The resolution (the amount of pixels) can be chosen, and a pixelyzed entity can be reshaped, although it needs time and talent to make great changes. A pixelyzed living being doesn't feel pain, but if their pixels are separated, it will need to find them before turning back to normal - or live without a part of its body.
summary: The ability to change any solid or liquid matter into pixels and shaping them.
strengths: Retro-style version of life.
Reshape things easily.
Immune while in pixel form.
weaknesses: Need physical contact to work.
Problems if disgregated while in pixel form.
Only lasts for 24 hours.

name: Jumping Jack
description: With this ability, you can jump into the air as high as you want without getting hurt on the way down.
summary: The ability to jump as high as you want.
strengths: No apple is too high for you.
Show off your trampoline skills.
weaknesses: There's less oxygen at high altitude.
Ceilings.

name: Rise Of The Behemoth
description: With this power you can turn into a behemoth; a giant eight foot tall monster with jet black fur. You have razor sharp claws and teeth, plus a long powerful tail. You also have extremely powerful legs that allow you to jump over twenty feet.
summary: The ability to turn into the mythical behemoth
strengths: You are super strong
You have razor sharp claws and teeth
weaknesses: You might be attacked because people might think you're a monster

name: Pan Dimensional League Of You
description: Have the PD existence power and you can create a pan-dimensional league of yourself. You pull every other you to this dimension. All of you will get along by varying degrees. The demon you will apologize to the angel you and that will be that. The kystian you will be insanely hateful as normal but will take it out on anyone who isn't a version of you. Bad guys watch out. You will likely need your own planet, a transdimensional building or a private dimension as a base of operations.
summary: The ability to create a mixed villain/hero/antihero league of yourself.
strengths: Create the Power League of (insert name here).
Better than a team.
weaknesses: You need vast space to house every version of yourself.
You'll have to hire a PR firm to deal with the carnage caused by the kystian you.

name: Negative Transformation
description: Negative Tranformation is the ability to get rid of parts of yourself. With it, you can get rid of your physical form and phase to pass through objects, or get rid of your visible form to be invisible. You can also get rid of your need for something like air, food, or water. It can also get rid of sicknesses in yourself.
summary: The ability to negate parts of yourself.
strengths: It isn't really a specific power, so you can do a whole bunch of things with it
It isn't permanent. I guess that is a good thing
It is pretty much only limited by your imagination
weaknesses: You can only use it on yourself
It isn't permanent. In case you wanted it to be
You cannot add anything to yourself

name: Rainbow Manipulation
description: This power can be used to generate rainbows and manipulate existing rainbows for your own use. This means you can change light different colors, and control colored light to form it into blasts, bolts, barriers, rays and lasers, and even constructs. You can also solidify rainbows and lower them down like a staircase so you can walk on them, form them into colorful fireworks, etc.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate colored light for various purposes
strengths: Generate little rainbows to cross over puddles, rivers, and other things that hinder your movement
Hit foes with colored light, or use it to defend yourself
Stand on rainbows if you want (but only if you can fly)
weaknesses: Less powerful in dimly lit areas; useless in complete darkness; powerless against Light Absorption
Cannot be used to change the color of things
Cannot be used to manipulate white light (only colored light)

name: Myth Power: Asclepius' Effect
description: Asclepius (Asklepios), in Greek myth, was the god of medicine and doctors. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill with every medical and therapeutic procedure, tool and piece of equipment in existence. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel doctors/physicians, other medical professionals, as well as subjects with healing, regenerative and restorative powers. One can even restore the dead to life, fully healed of injury, illness and ailment, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Asclepius' command over the essence of medicine, doctors and healing
strengths: Gain skill in every field of medicine, surgery and therapy
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel medical professionals and healers
Restore the dead to life, fully healed of injury, illness and ailment (physical and mental)
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate the healing process of self/others until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 can only restore the dead (has no effect on the living) until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restoration-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Underworld Assault2
description: The Underworld, in Greek myth, was composed of three levels. The second was Hades. As such, channeling the realm of Hades, one may summon the large three-headed dog Cerberus at will; he is super-strong, with a flaming bite that can harm even spirits. In addition, one can banish foes to any of the infernal rivers: Lethe (Oblivion) erases memory; Cocytus (Lamentation) dredges up painful memories; Acheron induces sourceless pain; Phlegethon (Flame) burns like fire; Styx is home to hateful harpies.
summary: The ability to channel the hellacious power of the Greek Myth Underworld's second level, Hades
strengths: Summon/command huge three-headed dog Cerberus (superhuman stats; flaming bite harms even spirits)
Banish foes to any of the five underworld rivers to be tortured
Immune to death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers
weaknesses: Cannot free spirits of the dead from Hades (no Con Negation)
People with death/underworld/necromantic based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with law, order and justice based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Weather Empathy
description: We devote most of our morning time to the news, and they devote their time to the weather. A person with Weather Empathy is a extremely accurate weather forecaster. The ability lets them detect major weather systems from miles away, lets them accurately tell and predict temperature, and lets them know how much time there is before the system reaches their location. However, they cannot control the weather. In addition, their predictions get less accurate the farther away in time the event is.
summary: The ability to detect and accurately predict weather phenomena
strengths: Extremely accurate weather forecaster
Able to know how long a system will take to reach them
Able to detect major systems from miles away
weaknesses: Cannot control weather
Accuracy of predictions decrease the farther away in time they are
People bugging you about what the weather will be

name: Insanitation
description: With this power, you will be able to control the amount of sanity a person has with a thought. It's only a temporary change but a useful one. Most insane people feel very little pain.
summary: The ability to temporarily drive anyone around you insane.
strengths: Cops will be temporarily unable to realize they were supposed to catch you.
An army of painless insane people is usually a good one.
By causing the insanity of a great political leader, they will be overthrown.
weaknesses: Insane people might still attack you.
Mental hold is broken while in extreme pain.
This is not mind control.

name: Inner Beauty Painting
description: A person with this power has the ability to paint someone's inner beauty. For example they can paint even the most ugly person into a beautiful rendition if they have a good heart. However if a person is evil or has a bad heart the user cannot paint them beautifully no matter how beautiful they are in outer appearance. The user becomes automatically proficient in artistic skills when they activate this power.
summary: The ability to paint a person's inner beauty
strengths: Can immediately know if a person is good or not
Goes beyond disguises
Make money selling portraits
weaknesses: People will hunt you down for the chance to be painted
Many people will be upset if you paint them badly
Prevents you from painting an evil person in a good way

name: Enhancement  Sharing
description: With this power you can share almost any enhancement power you have with others. There are 3 rules. 1. You can only attach an enhancement once to a power. No getting multiples of the same enhancement and attaching them to the same power. 2. You can have an enhancement attached to only one power at a time. 3. Enhancement: Untouchable and Enhancement: Reflecting cannot be shared with others. This power cannot be altered for more or less rules.
summary: The ability to share almost any enhancement power
strengths: Help allies with the enhancements you have.
Rules can't be added by enemies (or allies).
weaknesses: Useless without enhancements.
This power cannot be affected by Con Negation or similar powers.
Cannot share some enhancements.

name: Flaying Focus
description: Skin enemies live and core apples in seconds! Enemy armor stopping your bullets? Not a problem! Give them a glare and the armor will tear, leaving you with a soft, squishy human target! Works every time you focus. The longer you focus, the more you tear away.
summary: The ability to rip layers from targets with a glare
strengths: Remove layers of anything
weaknesses: Fail all vision exams
Can no longer have staring contests.

name: Summon Chuck Norris
description: Ability to Summon Chuck Norris once a day to your aid in battle.
summary: The ability to summon Chuck Norris to fight for you.
strengths: He will fight and win every battle for you, defeat every foe for you.
He will protect you from harm.
You will be in the presense of greatness.
weaknesses: Can only be summoned to battle your foes.
Can only be summoned once a day.
Power will not work if you are a ninja.

name: Dor Mii
description: You will become a a demon in the form of your spirit animal; for example if your spirit animal is a fox you gain a demon form of a fox. You also gain powers that correspond with said demon as well as increased speed/strength/agility and heightened senses. While this power is normally voluntary, a transformation can be caused by extreme emotions such as rage/fear and love. An involuntary transformation will also occur is your life is in danger.
summary: The ability to become a demonic representation of your spirit animal
strengths: You will be stronger than you were in every way
The only people on your level would be strong demons and other Dor Mii
Depending on what your spirit animal is you could become unstoppable
weaknesses: A transformation caused by rage could send you into a killing frenzy
You will be able to hear and smell everything and that could get annoying
Rare though it may be you could develop a demonic influence that could corrupt your soul

name: Animal Form
description: With this power you become permanently half of an animal of your choosing. The animal must be an non-mutated animal of your home planet. Once an animal has been picked it can not be changed without losing and regaining this power. If this power is lost, a ghost of the animal you picked will attempt to find you and return this to you. This power works if you become a robot, zombie, ghost, energy being, another animal, statue, Et cetera
summary: The ability to remain half animal even when changed into another form.
strengths: Always become half animal of your choosing.
Works even if you are transformed into something else.
If power is lost a ghost animal will make its way to you to return the power.
weaknesses: Can not change animal until the power is lost and regained.
Will never be fully human again.
If you pick a lame animal you may be stuck with it for a while.

name: Mesmeric Fear
description: This is a very nasty curse. Whenever the accursed should feel fear or know they should avoid something or doing something as it might cause them troubles, injuries or even death, they will actually feel a very strong attraction, curiosity and pleasure, prompting them to jump into the lion's den. However, this curse can only be inflicted to someone who frightened or injured the user.
summary: The ability to make anyone attracted to what they fear and what they know might hurt or kill them.
strengths: The accursed is now willing to get hurt and to kill themselves
People should avoid using fear-inducing powers against you.
weaknesses: You have to be injured or frightened in the first place.
The accursed cannot be attracted to something they didn't notice, consider or realize is dangerous.

name: House Maker
description: If you draw a house (including furniture), it turns real and goes where you want it. Use your wildest imagination.  If you can't draw, you can also write out a description of your house.
summary: The ability to make a house for free.
strengths: Free stuff.
Famous inventor.
Free money.
weaknesses: It comes out exactly how you write it, so spelling could be a problem.

name: Time Loop
description: This ability allows the user to travel back to any specific point in time where they existed. They will inhibit the body of their past-self. The user has control over how long that length of time is, so it can be a day, weeks, months, or even years. After the designated period has ended, time resets, and the person is transported back to the beginning of they length of time they chose. Once the power is used, the user is trapped in the chosen time period forever.
summary: The ability to travel back to a certain point in time repeatedly
strengths: The ability to relive the glory days over and over again.
The ability to change moments in time to make them better.
Technical immortality.
weaknesses: Might have to relive bad moments over and over again, and it could get boring after awhile.
Changes made to the timeline are never permanent.
Forever trapped in a specific moment in time.

name: Lucky Boomerang Effect
description: All you need to do is throw the object and it will always come back, unless it gets stuck in something or someone catches it in midflight. The power is automatically activated, so be extremely careful with what you throw.
summary: The ability to throw any object and have it come back to you, like a boomerang would.
strengths: You can throw something and have it come back to you.
Easily strike anyone out in baseball as long as you're the pitcher.
weaknesses: If the object gets stuck or caught, then it won't come back

name: Sound Absorption
description: A person with Sound Absorption can absorb all sound in a 50-foot radius whenever they please. No sound can leave or enter the area, and no sound in the area is audible.
summary: The ability to absorb all sound in the area
strengths: Sneak up undetected
Become an amazing secret agent
Never hear an annoying sound when you don't want to
weaknesses: Effectively deaf when using ability
Still not invisible
Sudden loss of sound very noticeable

name: The Pied Piper Effect
description: When one plays a musical instrument, they can attract rats in a 100 mile radius to the area and control them. The control of the rats will wear off once the user stops playing an instrument. The rats follow you wherever you go playing an instrument. This works with any musical instrument, not just a flute.
summary: The ability to play a musical instrument to summon and control rats.
strengths: Rats have strength in numbers and diseases.
Call upon rats to attack your enemies.
Call upon rats to assist you in times of need.
weaknesses: You have to have musical talent to use this power. (Vocals don't count)
You can't keep playing an instrument forever.
If there are no rats in a 100 mile radius, the power is useless.

name: Mini Plane Drone
description: You will be able to summon a mini plane that can fight using laser guns, rocket launchers, and extenting arms.
summary: The ability to summon a miniature plane that can fight for you.
strengths: Able to slip through radar.
weaknesses: All of the weapons are miniature to, so it has a little less than average damage rate.

name: Melting
description: When using this ability, you'll need some conscious effort to melt objects.  A novice at this might cause the object to "partially" melt objects, but a more skilled person could melt an object in an instant.  Also, this ability just doesn't work by touch.  You would be able to melt any object with in the your sight. The greater the size, the more the concentration.  This ability doesn't cause the temperature of the object to rise and is not effected by the type or density of material.
summary: The ability to turn solid materials into liquids
strengths: Instant water from ice
gets rid of obstacles in you way
weaknesses: Can't turn melted objects back to solids
creates messy puddles

name: Doppler Effect
description: One with this ability uses himself as a reference point for the fluctuation of light. He concentrates on a subject he wants to effect, and then a psionic link is established. This link allows the user's proximity to determine a foe's perception of light. As he moves closer to the user, RED light becomes more and more visible, so he is blinded by red light. The FURTHER he moves away from the user, BLUE becomes more and more visible, so he is blinded by blue light.
summary: The ability to cause foes to see fluxes in light based on one's proximity to them
strengths: Overwhelm a foe without even touching them
Your body is a reference point (very close makes blinding red, very distant makes blinding blue)
Blinded by a particular color, they can't see (you can get away, attack them, etc)
weaknesses: Only affects foes that require light to see (no Lightless Vision, blind people, etc. )
If the subject has Protected Sight, he wont be blinded
If the subject can manipulate light, he can stabilize his vision

name: Effect Persistence
description: Knock an illusionist unconscious and their illusions will fade away. Kill a telekinesist and the things they were manipulating will drop. Well, with this power, whatever powers you were using when you fell unconscious or died will remain active and even have their effects reinforced. So, illusions will remain and seem even more real, things moved with telekinesis could speed up or gain a life of their own, fires born from pyrokinesis will grow fiercer, forcefields will become more impenetrable.
summary: The ability to maintain and reinforce the effects of your powers when you're unconscious or dead.
strengths: Killing or knocking someone unconscious will no longer be a solution to stop a power or a curse.
When you die or fall unconscious, all or most of your life energy will reinforce your powers.
The effects will be maintained as long as the energy you had will allow it. It could take years.
weaknesses: Be careful what power you're using. With Imperceptibility, no one will be able to find you.
Once you come back to life or regain consciousness, the effects will be back to normal or even stop.
It doesn't change the fact that you're vulnerable or even dead when it happens.

name: Ancient Beast: Cerberus
description: With this power, you not only gain the power of pyrokinesis and geokinesis, but you also gain untold strength and durability, the ability to morph into Cerberus, and the ability to split yourself into three, in either human form or Cerberus mode. Souls of the dead fear you because you can feed on them to strengthen yourself, but that strength is only temporary.
summary: The ability to have the powers of Cerberus
strengths: Strength and durability
Pyrokinesis and geokinesis
Split into three
weaknesses: Power is only temporary when you eat souls
Changing into Cerberus tires you out quicker
Souls don't taste very good. (Bleh! )

name: Even Weaponry
description: When faced with an armed opponent, using this ability will create copies of their weapons for you. However, if you are also armed, duplicates of your weapons will be created for them. The duplicates are exact copies of the original ones, even in terms of supernatural abilities. If the original weapon has some sort of supernatural allegiance with its owner, the duplicates will also have one with its new owner. If an original weapon is lost or abandoned by its owner, its copy will disappear.
summary: The ability to possess exact duplicates of one person's weapons, while allowing them to have duplicates of yours.
strengths: Against supernatural weapons or some Ability-Imbued objects used as weapons.
You can only target one person, but that person doesn't have to be your opponent.
If your opponent is gaining the upper hand with your weapon, you can always cancel this power.
weaknesses: Giving an opponent supernatural weapons or some Ability-Imbued objects used as weapons.
Sometimes, it's not the weapon itself that's important, it's how you use it.
Copies will vanish if the original ones are lost or abandoned. Even copies of ammunitions.

name: Doom Bringing
description: Cause the doom of ANYTHING! A person, a planet, an object, a virus, world hunger. ANYTHING that can be destroyed/ended. Obivously the bigger/stronger it is, the harder it is to destroy it. Also negates immortality/endless youth
summary: The ability to cause doom unto anything
strengths: Doom to all who oppose you
Can simply do it by thought.
Make immortals into mortals
weaknesses: One a day
Can't "undo" anything you used it on

name: Shifting Jewels
description: To be exact, the holder of this power creates jewels that are surrounded by a thin setting of gold, silver, brass, or another metal. The metal is what transforms at its owner's will into a specific object chosen at the creation of the jewel. The jewel holds the data on what the metal transforms into and each jewel can only hold one form's worth of data. The form can be anything the same size as or smaller than a suit of armor with wings.
summary: The ability to create jewels that transform into other objects
strengths: Can create deceptively noncombative jewellry that transforms into weapons, armor, or shields.
Only transforms at the OWNER's will, not even the maker's will (good selling point though).
Con: Con Negation and alteration powers will NOT get rid of the cons in this power.
weaknesses: Only one chosen object per jewel. Chosen object cannot be changed once decided on.
The item that the jewel's setting transforms into cannot be bigger than a suit of armor with wings.
Have to use a jewel that already exists when using this power.

name: Gift: Liquids
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling liquids than other beings. Thus their liquid-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of liquid from them. However, someone with this power can only receive liquid-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of liquids
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over liquid as someone with this power.
Liquid-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only air-based powers now.

name: Starships V2
description: With this power you can turn any air vehicle into a starship. The starship is tricked out with tons of alien technology such as teleporters, lasers, turbo thrusters etc. You can turn the starship back when you're done.
summary: The ability to turn air based vehicles into starships
strengths: You can turn any air vehicle into a starship
You know how to operate the starship
weaknesses: You do not know how to operate the air vehicle unless it is a starship

name: Double Metabolism
description: With this power, all your powers are boosted passively to double their strength. However, this comes with a side effect; you will require twice the metabolic energy to sustain yourself. However, you simply need to eat more and move less to provide this energy.
summary: The ability to boost your powers to twice their strength, but require twice the energy.
strengths: Double power strength!
Passive and applies to all powers at once, stacking with others.
Harder to gain/not lose weight.
weaknesses: Food requirements may be daunting at times, especially without sustenance powers (e.g. Heat Eater).
Need to have other powers to be useful.
Cons cannot be removed by powers like Con Negation.

name: Divine Form: Osiris
description: A priest of Osiris can temporarily allow the Egyptian lord of the dead Osiris to posses their body. This grants all the powers of the god for a short period of time (undead army, resurrection, etc).
summary: The ability to temporarily channel the spirit of Osiris into your body
strengths: Temporary invicibility
Near indestructibility
Incredible powers
weaknesses: Leaves you completely drained, physically and mentally
Cannot hold on to the spirit for long; your body cannot hold divinity for too long
Have to be in peak human condition or may be fatal

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta1
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Stilbon (Stilbos, Hermaon- Planet Mercury) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mercury. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Mercurian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Mercury's patron, Hermes, to resist and benefit from his domains (cunning, theft, speed, language, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mercury (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Mercurian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Mercury's patron god, Hermes; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Mercury at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Mercury-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Shattering Mirror Duplication
description: This ability will make you appreciate mirrors. You'll be able to fool enemies with a clone with a very special ability. You see, if the clone gets hurt it begins to crack, then shatters into millions of energy shards that will give enemies not years of bad luck, but pain.
summary: The ability to create a clone made of energy that acts like a glass.
strengths: You won't need a full body mirror.
You won't be affected by the clone if it shatters.
Fools enemies.
weaknesses: You can only make one clone.

name: Power Puppet Telemetry
description: This power only works with the consent of someone else (who can have powers of their own). When you use this power, your body goes comatose and now have the fives senses of the consenting person. You can only use your powers. However, any powers that steal, copy, alter or negate other powers will only affect the powers of your telemetric volunteer. Mind-effecting powers only affect you. If your volunteer is killed, the affect will be if you had a stroke. You can release your volunteer at will.
summary: The ability to transmit your powers through another person you control.
strengths: Be an overweight lazy couch potato and fight crime.
Any powers you have can't be directly affected. They're in your body and you're at home.
The best secret identity possible-it's not you actually fighting crime.
weaknesses: You can feel the pain of your volunteer.
Let a villain go to keep the volunteer alive or have a virtual stroke?
In a coma. Alone. In your house. How's your home security? What if there's a fire?

name: Fractal Shrapnel Grenadier
description: You can create shrapnel grenades of a fractal nature. If an opponent gets hit with even one single piece of shrapnel, that single piece will grow into a disc. This disc will grow inward causing internal injuries. Amputation of a limb or beheading is possible also. The shrapnel of a grenade is crystalline. The blade can grow in any opponent that can be hurt by the shrapnel regardless of what your opponent is made of. Your grenade can hurt you if you're too close to it.
summary: The ability to create and throw shrapnel grenades of a fractal nature.
strengths: A grenade that becomes multiple deadly discs.
A disc will grow inside anyone who got struck by the shrapnel.
If you have another power to protect yourself from a grenade, you can just drop one at your feet.
weaknesses: Anyone with the power to absorb or block the shrapnel.
Someone made of a hard substance.
Someone to whom internal injuries or beheading wouldn't matter.

name: Expandito
description: You may expand any part of your body in any way you choose.  You may increase the length of your legs, stretch or neck, make huge fists, and the like.  Strength to operate such enlarged body parts is included.
summary: The ability to expand any part of your body.
strengths: May became gigantic
Super fighting skills
Hit with the ladies (if you know what I mean).
weaknesses: You cannot shrink, expansion fades within the hour.
Takes concentration to expand

name: Future  Damages
description: This power lets you choose a future date for when the damage of any attack is going to affect you. You have to know when you're going to be hurt or the power won't work. You can delay death with this power if someone disintegrated you. You can't choose any time more than two years into the future from the time you would have actually been injured or killed. You can't choose the same future time for every injury or a possible death. This a extremely limited time travel power.
summary: The ability to push any injuries done to you to a future time.
strengths: You can call a hospital and let them know when to be ready.
It's actually good that this power isn't activated your instinct or subconscious.
weaknesses: Deciding what injuries to hurt you now or later in a fight could be tough.
Foes with a time control power.

name: Summon Maids
description: A person with this power can summon maids. The maids are skilled at almost everything and are very good at cleaning. In addition they know martial arts. They also have emotions, so if you get one angry they will beat you up even if you were the one that summoned them. There are a possible of 300 different kinds of maids you can summon and you can also summon unlimited clones of one maid.
summary: The ability to summon maids
strengths: They are very skilled
They will clean things if you ask them nicely
They can also fight
weaknesses: They will only follow reasonable orders and will take offense at your remarks
They have emotions so you can make them angry/sad and they will attack you
Only 300 different maids with different names and you need to address them by name

name: Holy Power: Star Extinction
description: Using the Gunslinger Pistols, you can absorb the energy from the stars, from the galaxy, from the planets and the universe itself, concentrating this energy into the Gunslinger Pistols, and then shooting it in the shape of light. When this light reaches your enemy, its energy create a small Big Bang, destroying the target. Surviving this attack is nearly impossible and it wastes a lot of energy.
summary: The ability to shoot a volley of light over your enemy, creating a small Big Bang over him, destroying him.
strengths: Nearly impossible to escape.
This power can destroy most of the things in the universe.
Immortality is probably the only power that would save your enemy's life from this ability.
weaknesses: Wastes a lot of energy.
You can hurt a lot of people if you use this on the wrong place.
Gunslinger only.

name: Baysplosion
description: WIth this power you can make fake explosions happen whenever you want. The explosion look and sound convincing but nothing and nobody gets damaged when you make them. They are good for scaring your enemies or friends and also for making movies.
summary: The ability to cause fake explosions to happen whenever you want
strengths: You can make fake convincing explosions
You can make cool action movie scenes
You can scare people
weaknesses: They aren't real explosions

name: Robot Transformation
description: This power allows the user to become a robot, turning his/her skin into titanium and armed with wrist mounted machineguns, eye and finger lasers, shoulder mounted missile launchers, and a powerful chest mounted energy cannon. Also, in robot form, the user has flight capabilities courtesy of a jet pack installed in his/her back. The user can only revert back to human form if he/she runs out of power or ammunition.
summary: The ability to become a heavily armed and armored robot
strengths: Destroying all your opponents with just one barrage of all your weapons
Become the ultimate hybrid of human and machine
No one will beat you in "robot dancing" because you are a robot
weaknesses: EMP waves and other machine stopping devices can disable you in robot form
When in robot form, you have no emotions or any kind of feelings at all
Running out of energy or ammunition

name: Induce Insanity
description: Insane in the membrane. This is a mental attack, with it you can cause madness in a person or group of people that have no mental illness. If you stare at them using your power, they'll become completely schizo. They'll lose total grip of reality becoming delusional, lose control over themselves, paranoid, catatonic, & even hostile. So be careful not to get to close to them. You can also make them sane again. This power doesn't work on people already mentally ill though
summary: The ability to cause someone to go mad
strengths: Cause madness in a person or crowd
Create total anarchy when unleashing craziness to the world
Can make them sane again
weaknesses: The victim may become hostile & dangerous to you
People already with mental illness cannot be affected

name: Ultimated Dragon Bringer
description: You let out a yell so loud that it is heard all over earth (only by dragons)then every dragon comes to help you. Also there are many types of dragons poison, lightning, fire to help you out in any situtation of dire need. The thing is though you can only let out the yell when it's truly needed.
summary: The ability to summon all dragons on earth
strengths: Many types to help
Can take out large armies
Can deffinetly scare the crud out of enemy
weaknesses: You can't control the dragons
Some dragons still want to fight after battle
Makes your very tired

name: Half Lich
description: A being with this power has higher magical power and a better-looking body than an ordinary human. They can fully regenerate their body from a single cell or take control of a human's body so long as even a cubed centimetre of their phylactery exists. The phylactery is less vulnerable than an ordinary lich's as it is in the half-lich's body, looks like what they want it to look like (maximum size is 3 centimetres cubed) and can withstand much more damage than a lich's can.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-lich
strengths: Don't need to do a ritual to become a half-lich, unlike a lich does.
Hard-to-destroy phylactery.
Don't need to hide a deformed or ugly body like a lich would.
weaknesses: The magic boost differs between beings and can be from 2 times better to 1000 times better.
Phylactery will not change location if the half-lich takes control of a new body.
Cannot change the look or size of the phylactery once it is outside of the original body.

name: Mist
description: You create a mist-like vapour that is thick and heavy. It cannot be seen through, and it is almost sound proof. The mist could range from a small cloud cover, to an entire state, maybe country in range that it reaches, depending on persons personal skill with it. However, it will slowly drain the energy out of you.
summary: The ability to control or produce a mist that cannot be seen through.
strengths: Good for a quick escape
Comes in handy in fights or ambushes
weaknesses: You cannot hear if your enemy is several feet from you, of just inches away

name: As The Crow Flies
description:
With this power you can find all the shortcuts from one place to another

This includes finding gaps in space time. 

This also makes you competent in parkour
summary: The ability to have the knowledge of the shortest path and the capacity to make it there
strengths: Parkour Master
Be the fastest in a race most of the time
Find hidden passages
weaknesses: Can only move from point A to B
Does not make you invincible or immortal

name: Hydro Bomb
description: This is the most explosive and wettest ability to master. It allows you create and utilize an endless supply of bubbled water balloons for massive damage. Because of the rapid throwing rate, it can overwhelm fire based enemies. You can make a hydro bomb. You can do a lot with the bomb--though note that if you hold a bomb in your hands for too long, it will blow up and splash on you, along with anything else that gets in the way (including your allies).
summary: The ability to throw a ball of water that explodes and splashes the enemy on contact.
strengths: It's extremely effective against fire based enemies.
weaknesses: Never use it on electronics.

name: Dust Click
description:
May be considered a dangerous or useless power.
Turning any solid object to dust all yo have to do is focus on the object you want converted into dust, and click your fingers. Then that object turns into dust.
