This works like this: you ask the other person if they want to know what your power is; then, you ask if they really want to know; if they say yes, then you exclaim your power is the power to control their fate since they wanted to know. By fate, it means you now control the person's past, present, and future - pretty much the other guy's entire life is in your hands.
summary: The ability to gain control over the fate of anyone who tries to find out what your power is by asking you
strengths: If a person is curious, then this will be too easy to use and a lot of people are naturally curious
This power is very broken
No one who knows what your power is can act against you
weaknesses: If a person knows what your power is from far away
If someone says that they dont want to know

name: Odontoblast Mimicry
description: Dentin is a type of bone only Odontoblast Mimics can secrete. While regular bones are vulnerable to acid, you have the option to make your dentin more resistant to acids when you secrete it. You can also telekinetically move substances containing calcium or phosphate within a short range and form tiny but extremely strong crystals out of them. Use these crystals to make your dentin harder. (Harder doesn't mean even more resistant to acid though)
summary: The ability to secrete dentin of any shape and manipulate calcium and phosphate within a short range.
strengths: Create bone structures that are more resistant to acids to those of Osteoblast Mimics.
You can use your own body (except your bones, see con 2) as a source of calcium and phosphate.
You can be a short-ranged lactokinetic.
weaknesses: The bones you create are more resistant to acid, but they are not immune to acids.
You can't manipulate calcium nor phosphate that have already been integrated into bones.
And therefore, you can't telekinetically manipulate bones, including the ones you create.

name: Eternal Dreaming
description: If you're like me, than you may find that reality just isn't good enough. With this power, you can escape reality permanently. Whenever you decide to activate this power, you will fall asleep and never wake up. In your sleep, you will forever be dreaming. Whatever happens to your physical body will not effect your dreaming. In your dreams, you will realize that you're dreaming, and from that point on, manipulate your dreams however you choose to. It will feel very much real, as if you're awake.
summary: The ability to fall asleep and dream forever
strengths: Manipulate your dreams and forever exist in your very own paradise
Dreams will feel just as real as reality, as if you're awake
You can find an escape from reality if you're unhappy with life
weaknesses: Everyone in reality will think you're in an unexplained coma
You will never see your REAL friends and family ever again
If you choose to activate this power, you can never wake up again, even if you want to

name: Reincarnation 4: Daily Back Up
description: This power is similar to Power Backup Ability; instead of making copies of your powers, every 24 hours it makes a backup of you and your live. When you die, your body heals itself to perfection from a backup. You will revive at the age of the back-up or when you acquired this ability. A new health problem will not be saved, but if you overcome one, it is. You revive instantly, but you are left powerless for 1 hour, leaving you vulnerable. Meaning you can't revive for an hour.
summary: The ability to make backups of your physical condition.
strengths: With a good enough strategy, you could be very hard to kill.
If your body overcomes a health issue, it will be copied.
Revive completely - age and all.
weaknesses: Takes a lot of time to build up a good number of backups.
You will be without powers for a short time - including this one.
If a killer waits for revival, they could kill you.

name: Reincarnesis
description: With this power you can connect to all your past lives and recall any important events or combinations to any event during those times. You can see all of your past selves as well as see anyone of the past selves of your family and friends. With this ability you can also revert back to your own childhood memories and see events unfolding as if you were there.
summary: The ability to recall or be all your previous selves.
strengths: You can learn all about why you were given your current life.
You can find out where all your fears originate from.
You will know what to do in this life to avoid repeating mistakes.
weaknesses: You will experience all of your deaths and see your own coming.
You cannot alter the events in any way only what you learn from them.
Knowing too much will give you migraines and paranoia.

name: Moon Blade 2nd Form: Sky Blue
description: A blade with a white hilt, and a blue blade and wings sprouting from the hilt. Allows for wind manipulation, flight.
summary: The ability to create a blade allowing for advanced wind manipulation
strengths: Ability to fly.
Ability to produce blades of compressed wind that are wired off as the sword is swung.
weaknesses: Almoust no power underwater, and no power in places with no air (space)
Medium range weapon which has limited effectiveness in close quarters combat.

name: X Men Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the X-Men. The X-Man doesn't have to be currently an active member of the team they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon when of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon any member of the X-Men
strengths: You can summon any member of the X-Men
You can control up to one of them
weaknesses: If you want to summon more than one you lose the mind control function

name: Instant Messaging
description: Send and receive texts and instant messages with your mind.
summary: The ability to send and receive texts and instant messages with your mind.
strengths: You'll never get in trouble for texting when you aren't supposed to (they won't know)
No need to try and push all those little buttons
No need to constantly check or charge up your phone
weaknesses: You can't instantly make calls. You still need a phone of some sort for that.

name: One True Protection
description: When you obtain this, it is sort of 'offline. ' It doesn't do anything until you arm it on one of your powers. You can change which power it's there for, until you actually need this power. At that point, it becomes locked in, utterly permanent. The power this is assigned to can never ever be denied to you. It can't be stolen, removed, negated, erased, altered, whatever. If you are targeted for your power or altered to prevent your use, you will still wake up when you would want to use the power
summary: The ability to be unable to be denied the use of one single power
strengths: An absolute and undeniable guarantee to a power
You don't have to choose anything, but you can choose when you want to
Doesn't follow the wording of this, but rather the concept
weaknesses: You can get this power multiple times (idea-wise, not site-wise), but each instance is one power
This power is utterly useless on its own, it needs another power to work with
Choosing a stupid power for this, having it locked in, then getting and losing a better one

name: Angel Power: Angel's Halo
description: This power allows you to channel the glow that envelops every angel. A warm light that comforts the innocent, but that frightens and agonizes the wicked, and allows you to see clearly through any illusion. Enveloped in this light, your vision is also enhanced; not only can you see in better detail and with better range, but you can see and sense innocents, angels, demons, the spirits of the dead and others with this power; you simply can't communicate with angels, demons or spirits.
summary: The ability to channel the halo of an angel
strengths: Your light is comforting to innocents, and your touch calms them
Your light is frightening to the wicked, and your touch agonizes them
Improved sight; see/sense innocents, angels, demons, spirits of the dead and others with this power
weaknesses: Your sight is improved, but doesn't bestow Clairvoyance, Precognition, Postcognition or the like
If you want to help people who struggle morally, but you scare them
You can't communicate with angels, demons or spirits, just perceive them

name: Holy Power: Terra Burst
description: Using the destructive energy of the Reaper, you can crush part of the tectonic plaques underneath you and your target, creating an enormous explosion of fire and magma, destroying everything at great distance. This ability is really powerful, but dangerous and hard to control. You can destroy a whole army of enemies if you can control this power, but you might kill a lot of innocent people if you don't be careful.
summary: The ability to crush part of the tectonic plaques underneath you, creating an enormous explosion of fire and magma.
strengths: Can destroy a whole army of enemies if used wisely.
Can destroy nearly anything.
Hard to defend, because its attack is indirect.
weaknesses: Dangerous and hard to control.
Only Reapers can use this power.

name: Myth Power: Aphrodisia
description: Aphrodite, in Greek myth, was the goddess of love, beauty, romance and sexual attraction. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically change one's appearance and voice, at will to match nearly ANYONE'S idea of beauty (including one's own). In addition, one can psychically induce sexual attraction or arousal in anyone of one's sexual preference, by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive how to please any sexual partner they take, and charm nearly anyone, to get one's way.
summary: The ability to channel Aphrodite's command over the essence of love, beauty, romance and sexual attraction
strengths: Psychically change one's voice and appearance to match nearly anyone's idea of physical beauty
Psychically induce sexual attraction and/or sexual arousal by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive how to please any sexual partner, or charm nearly any subject to get one's way
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate/withstand love/romance/sex-based abilities until developed (NCN)
Cannot blow a kiss to psychically stun foes, and seduce them over a distance, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Oath of Ouranos, MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Falcon Pawnch
description: The ability to make a flaming bird come from your fist. It is the strongest punch on the planet. You must yell "FALCON PAWNCH!" It has a five second charge before using it and after using this power, it completely drains you for 10 minutes.
summary: The ability to make a flaming bird come from your fist and destroy someone with a punch.
strengths: Destroy walls, vehicles, ect.
Extreme fire damage
Send superman through walls
weaknesses: Has a five second charge before using it
Must yell "FALCON PAWNCH!"
Completly drains you for 10 minutes

name: Four Eyes: Supernatural Sight
description: This power is gained by not using the Four Eyes power but having all the eyes open. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever all of your eyes are open you can see anything supernatural. It does not matter if the being or item is invisible or see-through, in your vision it will be opaque.
summary: The ability to see anything supernatural with one's eyes
strengths: You can see the supernatural.
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and not use it's powers and have all eyes open.
Just because you can see them doesn't mean you can do anything about them.
You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: Toy Fusion
description: When you pick up a toy eg. Buzz Lightyear, you become a life size version Buzz Lightyear with all the abilities of that toy and all
summary: The ability to become a life size version of any toy you want
strengths: You can become a real superhero
You can entertain children at parties
weaknesses: Becoming vechicles, stuffed animals and baby dolls would be usless

name: Myth Power: Aether's Experience
description: Aether (Aither, Ether), in Greek myth, was the god of the bright, glowing upper air of heaven; divine essence, which the gods themselves were said to breathe (Ether or Quintessence, the pure essence of energy). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate ether at will. In addition, one can psychically harness ether to enhance the physical stats of oneself and others with divine powers. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with MythPower users at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aether's command over the essence of the bright, glowing upper air of heaven
strengths: Generate and manipulate ether/quintessence/divine essence at will (may be used to harm or heal)
Harness either to enhance physical stats of self and others with divine abilities, etc
Gain power to fly, defy gravity, rapidly regenerate and psychically perceive MythPower users
weaknesses: Cannot turn into a form composed of ether (able to survive in space, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot impart ether (bestow others resistance to divine attacks) until developed  (NCN)
Cannot use ether/quintessence/divine essence to disrupt divine powers until developed (NCN)

name: Neverending Sharpness
description: Any blade made of metal can be become permanently sharp with this power. It will never become duller but it can be made sharper than its current state.
summary: The ability to remove the possibility of dullness from a blade
strengths: Never need to sharpen or whet your blades ever again.
weaknesses: Just because it will never become duller doesn't mean it's as sharp as it can be.

name: Finger Daggers
description: You can turn your fingers into dagger blades that are still attached to your hands and back into regular fingers. Also, you can choose how many of your fingers turn into daggers at any given time.
summary: The ability to turn one's individual fingers into dagger blades
strengths: Your fingers are hidden weapons in plain sight.
You can never drop the daggers since they are attached to your hands.
weaknesses: Some rare versions of this power cannot turn the daggers back into ordinary fingers.

name: Summon Atlanteans V2
description: With this power you can summon an army of soldiers from Atlantis. The Atlanteans are under your complete control. They have immensely long life spans, have super strength, can breathe underwater and are adept at magic. You can summon as many as you want and unsummon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Atlanteans
strengths: You can summon an army of Atlanteans
You have complete control over them
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: The Ring
description: Alone, this power will cause an enemy mental harm by gesturing at them. The mental harm will make them feel like they have the worst hangover ever and 100 people are yelling at them simultaneously. If you also have The Crown, The Scepter, and The Mantle, then you can use this power's effect without gesturing just thinking about it.
summary: The ability to cause enemies mental harm by gesturing
strengths: Really cruel method of torture.
Like the rest of this series no need for any objects or artifacts to use this power.
weaknesses: Easy to get caught if you don't have The Crown and The Scepter.

name: Half Elf
description: Someone with this power has higher dexterity and magical power than other beings. Also, they can move so silently that even those with enhanced hearing might not be able to hear them walk by. In addition, someone with this power has pointed ears and will always have a thin, lithe body.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-elf
strengths: You can cast spells more easily than most beings.
You can move around without people noticing you until you want to be noticed.
weaknesses: Dragons, full-elves, gods, demons, angels, and more can be far better spellcasters.

name: Pro Negation
description: Is there a superpower you dislike, because of all its great uses (against YOU)? With this ability, you get rid of all those pros. Anything good about a superhuman ability will be cut out of it, and the foe will be left with all the bad. The subject will still register as having that power (by power sensors, aura readers, etc. ) they just won't be able to use it for any benefit, while suffering all the consequences.
summary: The ability to negate the pros of a power
strengths: A far more devastating version of Power Negation (lose the good, keep the bad)
Subconsciously works to prevent itself from being negated (and doesn't affect one's other powers)
When developed, can be focused into a wave or omni-directional blast
weaknesses: Con Negation can remove a power's negative consequences
Sometimes, the power manifests as a constantly active aura, affecting one's superpowered allies

name: Four Riders: 1 War
description: You have the power of war. Which means you ride a red horse and cause everyone you ride by to be so full of hatred and indignity that they instantly try to start a war. You also wear full battle armer and carry a huge sword.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the first rider of the apocolypse
strengths: You are extremely powerful and one if the bad guys
You have an awesome out fit.
You ride a bright red warhorse
weaknesses: You are extremely powerful and one of the bad guys
You help bring on the apocolypse
You can only create war. Not peace

name: Power Shuffle
description: This power seeks out anyone that has superpowers in a area you designate, then reshuffles what everyone has. Every power is added to a single pool, which then randomly dolls out those powers to everyone that contributed to it. Receiving multiple powers is possible, but everyone who had their power added to the pool will receive at least one superpower back. This effect is permanent, with all powers being left with their new owners regardless of what you do after.
summary: The ability to randomly switch who has what super power in a given area.
strengths: Randomize the capabilities of every super human in an area.
If you arn't satisfied with your own powers, gamble on getting ones you like.
weaknesses: You have no control over who has what power after the shuffle.
This power is not exempt, and will be shuffled away as any power would.

name: Essence Spell Casting
description: This ability allows the user to sacrifice parts of his own body in order to use a spell. The amount used dictates what kind of spells are optional. The user doesn't even need to give up his own magical energy. Of course, the user will slowly disappear. The user can regenerate, but it will take awhile.
summary: The ability to use spells and enchantments by using one's own physical essence.
strengths: Use spells
Do not need to give up your energy
Parts will come back
weaknesses: Lose parts of your body
Be structurally weaken.

name: Mirakuru Power
description: In Arrow, the Mirakuru Drug is sort of an evil version of the Super Soldier Serum. It makes you super strong, over Peak Human Levels, and almost invincible, even giving you a healing factor, but it also comes with the risk of driving you insane.  Explosives can still hurt you.
summary: The ability to have the power of the Mirakuru Drug from Arrow
strengths: Super Strong
Bulletproof
Healing Factor
weaknesses: Roid Rage
Hallucinations
Vulnerable To Explosions

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours04)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Gymnastica (Gymnastika, Gymnasia- Exercise Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one exercises. One can also psychically access peak condition. One can even psychically learn any physically possible feat, by observing it done once, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one works out, or practices athletics/sports
Psychically access peak physical condition; perform any physically possible feat, by observing once
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access Multi-Jump (Double Jump, Triple, etc), until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically access Body Supremacy and Precognitive Reflexes, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon projections of famous athletes, for psychic insight, until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Course Of Chronoi 1
description: The Chronoi (Khronoi, Times), in Greek myth, were the gods of past, present and future. As such, channeling Parochemenos (Parokhemenos- Past), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the past, at will. One can also psychically become imperceptible (except to those who can sense the past), at will. One can also psychically launch subjects into the past, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Chronoi and their command over the essence of past, present and future
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically perceive the past (and become imperceptible, except in past-tense) at will
Psychically project subjects into the past, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Postcognitive Imperceptibility is useless against those who can perceive the past (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to the past, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon a past version of oneself to the present, until developed (NCN)

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Makes your adrenaline get so high which causes your energy to increase dramatically. Increases speed and agility, and also strenghth. But it is temporary and needs an recharge.
summary: The ability to have very high adrenaline rushes
strengths: Increases athleticism
weaknesses: You might not control yourself at times
Temporary boosts
Needs an recharge

name: The Handyman
description: You can unscrew screws, fasten nuts & bolts, and hammer away. Anything that you can find in a garage that fits in your hand, you can just do WITH your hands (within reason). Life would be oh so much easier.  As a bonus, your hand can also be used as a power drill.  Now that's pimped.
summary: The ability to use your hands as any kind of tool, including a power drill!
strengths: Never have to purchase tools
Fix your car almost entirely with your hands
Could be useful skills for other areas of your life
weaknesses: You can still hit your thumb

name: Youth Drain
description: This ability you can drain the youth from anyone, making yourself young, and your victim will increase in age. The amount of youth energy drained is dependant for how long you stay in physical contact with your victim. This ability can easily kill old people and if not careful may revert you to state of prebirth; which will kill you.
summary: The ability to drain the youth from others, keeping yourself young.
strengths: Can stay young forever.
With this ability, you may be able to live forever.
weaknesses: All your victims will increase in age.
Can not give back the youth you have drained.
If not careful, might die from prebirth.

name: Parisitic Energy Transmutate
description: When you are injured you can bond your body with any other person. You pretty much turn into an exo suit over tham. While you are taking in energy from them they can use all your other powers if you have any more. While you are bonded with this person you are aware of everything they do but you cannot do anything at all. If you bond with anyone with powers of their own Your combined strength is doubled while bonded. The bonding lasts for much shorter time periods with powered hosts.
summary: The ability to bond with any person in trade for their energy, they use all other powers you have.
strengths: Bond with anyone to heal your body.
You strength doubles when you bond with anyone with powers of their own.
You lend your other powers to the host body. This helps keep them from rejecting you.
weaknesses: You cannot control whats going on while you're bonded. Be careful who you connect with.
It takes time to heal, you could be stuck with each person you bond for days or even weeks.
It takes full skin to skin contact in order for this power to work, Could get weird amongst friends

name: Spirit Item Manifestation
description: With this ability you can manifest and demanifest an item which is based off your soul and spirit. The item itself has the ability to focus all of your powers through it, giving them a major boost while increasing your aptitude with them. If you become more powerful your item upgrades itself to a more powerfull form to fit your new found abilities. Unfortunately these items, mostly the weapons, tend to have a mind of their own and may try to kill you if you start to have inner conflict.
summary: The ability to summon a weapon capable of mass destruction out of your spirit
strengths: Summon a weapon, or item capable of mass destruction that can not be stolen
This weapon can guard against energy attacks and effect spirits
You can summon it at will so you don't have to lug it around everywhere
weaknesses: Using the weapon correctly requires training
It may try to kill you
This weapon is only as powerfull as your will, and can be temporarily broken by a stronger one.

name: Cleansing Flame
description: With this ability you will be able to fire wave of flame. The unique thing about the fire you create is that it does not affect helthy organic matter.
summary: The ability to fire waves of fire that do not affect healthy organic matter
strengths: Leave healthy organic matter unaffected
Burn out impurities
weaknesses: Cannot harm healthy people

name: The World Within The Mind
description: There is a world within the mind of a host. The beings vary from living sentients to mindless monsters depending on the host. Much like the existence of the beings existing on the host, the powers of the host depend on the abilities of the beings. Unfortunately, just thinking of an all-powerful being doesn't make the host all-powerful. The beings are manifestations of the characteristics of the host.
summary: The ability to host an entire civilization within one's mind
strengths: It's the equivalent to being a God
You are the world in a sense
You are connected to the people of your mind
weaknesses: It's much like schizophrenia: Whose thoughts are whose?
When a being dies, the host can feel it; When the host dies, so does the civilization
Unfortunately, you have no powers if the people in your mind do not

name: Chains Of Typhon
description: Gain the ability to become the greatest monster in all of Greek mythology! You will be able to become a miniature version of the monster and be able to create earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, and all other manner of natural disasters. What you look like will depend on how much control you have over your ability, ranging from your normal uper body with a giant snake's lower body to being 100 feet tall with firey eyes and hundreds of serpent legs.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the monster Typhon
strengths: Can cause destruction on a very large scale
When fully mastered, you are close to invincible
Become the scourge of weathermen everywhere
weaknesses: You have very little control of your own power at first
You can only start disasters, you cant stop them, not even your own
Not a very good power if your not into destroying stuff

name: Controlled Adrenaline
description: this power will allow you to activate your adrenal glands for as long as you want.Powers include increased strength,speed,quicker reflexes and thinking,and withstand pain more.
summary: The ability to activate your adrenal glands
strengths: turn power off and on
are stronger
are faster
weaknesses: using adrenaline for a long period of time increases the risks of  palpitations, tach
you are only as strong and fast as you normally would be in a ''fight or flight'' situation.
adrenaline won't really help you if you're falling from a great height

name: Night Mare Summon
description: The NightMare is a creature that can bring living creatures nightmares (bad dreams). The nightmares given by a NightMare summoned by this power will be random. The NightMare looks like a ghostly horse with ghostly flames around its ankles and as its mane.
summary: The ability to summon and control a ghostly horse that can bring nightmares to people
strengths: The NightMare can fight for you.
The NightMare can give your enemies nightmares.
weaknesses: The NightMare can really only harm spirits and undead.
Note: Sorry for the (somewhat) puns in this power.
Can't ride the NightMare unless you can touch spirits.

name: Sonic Breath
description: You can emit a stream of wind from your mouth that is equal to a hurricane. It is very directional and the stream can be wide or focused.
summary: The ability to emit a jet stream of wind from your mouth.
strengths: Blow down buildings.
Launch sailing ships.
weaknesses: Can cause a lot of property damage.
Sneezing may be a problem.

name: Yokai: Kitsune
description: In Japanese mythology, kitsune were recognized as shapeshifting foxes with up to nine tails. With this ability you are able to become one of these vulpine tricksters. You will be capable of generating mystical flames or fireballs better known as "fox fire". The more tails you have the more powerful and wiser you are. Kitsune can also access temporary flight for long distances.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
strengths: Shapeshifting is useful.
Use "fox fire" to fend off enemies without breaking a sweat.
weaknesses: You can't fly forever.
You can grow have up to nine tails.

name: Temporal Duplication
description: This ability allows you to summon yourself from the past 30 mins. to the present without causing any paradox. This past version of you will automatically be psychicly intuned with you in the present. Meaning the will know all the info you know now. Also if your past version dies, they will have already summoned you/themself from 30 mins ago 100% healthy so the present you won't disappear. You can't have more than you & your past self can be present. No future you for the futures always changes.
summary: The ability to summon your past self from 30 mins. ago
strengths: Have the past you from 30 mins come to the present paradox free
Past slef will be intuned with you
If past you dies, another one from 30 mins ago will appear
weaknesses: Can only have one past version of yourself present at a time
Can't summon future version of yourself for future is always in flux

name: Scotoma Creation
description: Whenever you are in someone's visual field, you just need to gesture the action of removing or moving away something in the air if you want to use this power on them. From their point of view, they will see you "removing" portions of their field of vision, creating blind spots in their vision. These blind spots will remain as long as you stay in their visual field. If not, they will slowly close themselves and disappear.
summary: The ability to create blind spots in someone's visual field.
strengths: Partially or totally obstruct anyone's visual field. Try removing the center - it's very hindering.
It affects all of their eyes (two in most cases), as long as the eyes were opened.
The blind spots follow their eye movements.
weaknesses: You can't hide something in a blind spot. They just need to look away a little and they will see it.
If an eye is closed, that one won't be affected.
The further you are, the smaller the blind spots will be.

name: Hand Manipulation
description: Hands can expand, elongate, compress, sharpen and change shape. Increasing size also increases the sizes of muscles without increasing the mass thus granting pseudosuperstrength but only in the fingers. If you wear gloves they will also have the same properties.
summary: The ability to change the size and shape of your hands
strengths: You can create hammers, wings, lances, swords, and other creative things
You can punch with big hands and pick up small things with a small hand
weaknesses: Only your hands can be manipulated
If your hand had an injury making it big will only increase the size of the injury

name: Gift: Lights
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling light than other beings. Thus their light-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of light from them. However, someone with this power can only receive light-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of light
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over light as someone with this power.
Light-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only light-based powers now.

name: Enhancement: Healing (M)
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. While attached, it changes the effect of the power to cause it to heal minds instead of the original effect. Can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to change the effect of a power to healing minds
strengths: Easy to do mass healings with Omni-Directional Blast.
Destructive powers can now have a second use.
A cure for insanity!!!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
A fireball that heals might be a little odd.

name: Trick Arrows
description: This power allows the user to spawn any arrows used in any media (television,comics, and movies).  These can also be arrows that you can think up, but they have to be logical.
summary: The ability to spawn trick arrows used in any media.
strengths: Spawn trick arrows!
weaknesses: You have no bow, or quiver.
Must be logical if you create your own.

name: Swords Of Aging
description: The swords cause whatever they touch to age 1,000,000,000 times faster than normal for one second. However, they only age whatever is in a close range to what they touch. Ex. If your hand is touched, only that will age rapidly. The user of this power can only have five swords out at a time. Aging the mind or brain however does not bestow increased intelligence by the way.
summary: The ability to create swords made of light that rapidly age whatever they touch
strengths: Age your enemies so that it's harder for them to move.
1,000,000,000 secs is approximately equal to 31 years, 8 months, 15 days 14 hours and 24 minutes.
Each cut makes it harder to dodge the next cut.
weaknesses: Those with powers that prevent aging can fully negate this power's effects on those they can affect.

name: The Infinite Dollhouses Prison
description: A study of the power infinitely regressed led to this power. It creates a universe that is a house missing one wall with a dollhouse in it that is the house with the dollhouse in it. The house the victim finds himself in is a dollhouse in a house ad infinitum in either direction. A victim will always have food and water. There is just enough light. The victim won't suffocate despite an infinite of them existing. This power can only be used once a day due to stresses on reality and yourself.
summary: The ability to trap forever someone in an infinite series of dollhouses.
strengths: Eternal imprisonment is always good.
weaknesses: Only once a day.
Dimensional travelers or those who resist reality changes.
You can't be there to hear the infinite scream of your infinite victim.

name: Shattering Person
description: This is an interesting power. If a truck were to hit you, intead you would shatter as soon it touched you. While shattered, you can reshape yourself. It sorta looks like liquid moving when you see it. You can also control your shatterability from china to plate glass. Also for some unkown reason, you will pass through glass. Your pieces can also teleport if they are somewhere else. You can also shatter certain parts of your body.
summary: The ability to shatter like glass.
strengths: You won't get hurt by blunt things
Broken bottle hand
Pass through glass
weaknesses: Nothing

name: Stun Beam Vision
description: The people with this power is able to stun people with this power. Unlike the other visions which can potentially hurt people or kill people, this power will only stun the enemy. This power works, by stunning the enemies' neural synapses. This power has an effective range of 500 feet.
summary: The ability to stun enemies with your vision beam
strengths: Stun enemies instead of killing them (Stun now, ask questions later)
Will not accidentally kill your enemies
Easy to take down enemies with little or no superpowers
weaknesses: More powerful enemies might not be affected
The stun effect will wear off after time
Cannot hurt a person

name: Name Strength
description: With this power you can have super strength whenever anybody on the same planet as you says your full name (i. E. Jonathan Robert Doe). After they say your name you have super strength for the next ten minutes. This power does not work if you say your own name of if you tell somebody to say your name.
summary: The ability to gain super strength whenever somebody says your full name
strengths: You can have super strength
weaknesses: They have to say your whole name
You can't say it yourself or tell other people to say it for you
It's only ten minutes

name: Summon Sharke
description: Sharke are 20 ft. long, fly, look like a snake/shark hybrid and have an average IQ. Sharke can eat whole or take a bite from any matter that won't last forever. In the extreme far future, all normal matter won't exist. The Hulk or adamantium could be eaten. Sharke can only be hurt, stopped or contained with psionic, temporal or magical powers. A sharke stays until you unsummon it. You can summon a new one every day, but after a day, any sharke will eat when you're not around.
summary: The ability to summon a temporal energy monster.
strengths: Invulnerability is useless against a sharke.
Have your sharke chew its way into an adamantium vault.
weaknesses: If one sharke might be too much trouble to keep around more than a day.
Anyone with time control powers.
Any foes who could live forever.

name: Delete This Mastery
description: the same
summary: The ability to combo
strengths: None.
weaknesses: None.

name: Untamed
description: This power (also called Untameability or Untamer) allows the user to create a barrier between them and those who possess a Tamer power of them so as to prevent the "Taming" that allows others to have all the powers created by the user. In addition the user gains an automatic immunity to all powers mimicked through tamers, though this is ineffectual if the person possesses a hard copy of the power being used. At advanced levels the user can even put up barriers for others who have tamers of them.
summary: The ability to be immune to and cancel the effects of tamer powers.
strengths: These barriers cannot be breached by Barrier Defiance.
Don't worry about Tamer powers gaining all abilities you made.
Acquired Total Immunity will not protect against this power even through having a hard copy.
weaknesses: The barriers will not defend against anything else other than protection of powers you have made.
Not much use if there is not a "Tamer" of you.
Only at advanced levels can barriers be spread.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth1)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Hegemone (Soil, Healthy Plant Growth) allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate soil, at will. In addition, one can psychically teleport to anywhere with soil, at will, as well as gain physical power by standing in soil. Furthermore, one can psychically prevent plant growth or manipulation, at will. One can even psychically summon plants through space-time, to help self/allies, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically perceive, manipulate and teleport to any location with soil, at will
Gain physical power by standing in soil; Psychically prevent plant growth/manipulation
Psychically summon plants through space-time to help self/allies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically manipulate plants (Agrokinesis), other than summoning them for help (NCN)
Pro #3 does not allow one to perceive and communicate with plants until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Trip Wire
description: With this ability, you can trip anyone at any time. Someone walking just a little TOO gracefully? Is there a arrogant bastard at the party that just needs to go down? What about that cop that just pulled you over? Trip them all, with or without them knowing it was you. Just think about it, and you can make it happen.
summary: The ability to trip anyone you want just by thinking about it.
strengths: People watching
Tripping someone you really don't like
Getting pulled over and asking the cop to demonstrate the sobriety test for you
weaknesses: Tripping tight rope performers

name: Eye Projector
description: This power only works with absolute concentration. It can be used as an illusion to fool enemys and it helps when having flashbacks that are a little blurry. You have to let this power recharge itself for 5 minutes after use.
summary: The ability to project thougths through eyes like a movie
strengths: You can project maps and globes from your eyes
Using it as a decoy to trick enemys is a good strategy
Can be used like a flashlight
weaknesses: This power can cause short term memory loss
Using this power takes away your field of vision while in use
This power doesn't work in direct sunlight

name: Constellation Animator
description: With this power you can bring any constellation of stars to life it doesn't have to be a known constellation just any shape or figure you happen to see in the stars
summary: The ability to bring constellations to life
strengths: You can have some really cool things
weaknesses: You could have some really lame things (like dippers in assorted sizes)

name: Snap You're Dead
description: With this power, every time you snap your fingers, anybody who hears it will drop dead. All their body systems immediately shut down, and their soul automatically leaves their body. Sometimes the person's death is irreversible, but if you develop this power, the reversibility of the person's death can be decided. You might even be able to decide who can hear it. Either way, though, you should be careful when you snap your fingers with this ability.
summary: The ability to kill people every time you snap your fingers
strengths: Useful if surrounded by enemies
Immune to the effects yourself
Can sometimes be reversed by means like Resurrection, Revivification, Necromancy, etc.
weaknesses: It happens whenever you snap (can also affect friends, too, if they're caught off guard)
Deafness and the powers Sound Absorption and Inaudibility negate this power
This power cannot be reversed by the user

name: Play Dead
description: Stop all body functions and start them later, giving you the genuine appearance of a dead person. Can move while doing this.
summary: The ability to stop all body functions and restart them later.
strengths: Play dead to avoid bears.
Play dead to avoid villains.
Play dead to copy your dog.
weaknesses: You might be tossed in an incinerator.

name: Panontic Arch: Baroth
description: The Baroth dimension of false heroes. You gain two powers. First, the power to deceive anyone using empathy, mind reading, prediction, past detection, lie detection, body language reading or an alignment detection power on you. Second, you gain the power to not suffer any super powered consequences if you break an oath, promise, deal or pledge. Someone with a prediction power or body reading ability has to see you for you to give him a false impression.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Baroth dimension.
strengths: Be evil as you want and be sensed as the nicest guy on the planet.
Be good as you want and fool a good-detecting super villain.
weaknesses: Your 'goodness' or 'evilness' in some situations will be difficult to explain.
You still suffer non-superpowered consequences by breaking a promise.

name: Oath Of Light
description: This power allows you to have a mind at peace with itself, without stress or worry. It also allows you to know subconsiously how to fix a bad, tense, or awkward situation. You can also bestow a mind at peace upon others. However, there is a price. You cannot kill a living creature, or act self-servingly in any way. This means that doing things like walking over grass very awkward, as you would not physically be able to step on a bug.
summary: The ability to have true happiness and bestow it upon others, at a price.
strengths: You will be truly happy.
People will automatically like you.
You will be safe from depression.
weaknesses: You cannot act even remotely self-servingly.
You cannot kill, so there are many jobs you will be unable to do.
You won't be much good in a fight, unless you have extremely strong willpower.

name: Life Soundtrack
description: Your life now have a soundtrack it goes wherever you go and it always fits the situation you're in, you can make also other people hear the soundtrack. However, you cannot stop hearing the soundtrack yourself.
summary: The ability to have a soundtrack in your life that always fits.
strengths: Soundtrack always fits.
It can help you focus on something.
It can raise your awesome level in eyes of your friends.
weaknesses: You cannot turn it off, you don't hear it only when you sleep.
It can distract you sometimes.

name: Empathetic Olfaction
description: Ever go into a room after a fight & you can sense strong emotions you can almost cut it with a knife. Well, you can't with this power, but you CAN smell it. Emotions take on an indescribable smell & they surround the person much like an aura. Different emotions emit different smells from pleasant like happy to foul odors like sad or angry. So strong you can almost taste it & if strong enough you could decipher & read a thought possibly.
summary: The ability to psychically smell a person's emotions & thoughts
strengths: Smell emotions & maybe be able to read some thoughts
weaknesses: Has to be a very strong emotion smell to read thoughts but may not always work
Psychopaths are hard to smell

name: Induce Apathy
description: Makes anyone in your sightlines (as in you can see them or could see them if you turned around) and range (defined here as the range at which you can make out their facial features) feel apathetic to everything. For example, you could murder someone in front of a loved one and they wouldn't care. In fact, you could murder anyone around you and they would not fight back.
summary: The ability to make those around you cease to care about anything.
strengths: Free to live your life as you like (criminally if you wish) unobstructed.
Avoid arguments and tricky social situations.
Undefeatable at any short-mid range form of combat.
weaknesses: Impossible to have face-to-face social contact with people.
Any instance of you having sex is debatably rape.
Any long range weapons such as Sniper Rifles are just as effective on you as normal people.

name: Sensational Sound Burst
description: This ability is great for all those music lovers out there. This power is enough to destroy 2 buildings if let loose for the first time. The "side effects" of the beams on your victims depend on what the sound, word, or music is and there also could be multiple side effects. It must genuinely be your favorite sound. No recordings.
summary: The ability to let out a powerful concussion beam, or blast everytime you hear your favorite sound, word, or music.
strengths: Use your favorite sound for power
weaknesses: Must hear the sound to release it

name: Vampire's Kiss
description: Your saliva is a potent drug that gives humans or humanoids extreme euphoria, intoxication, and lowered inhibitions. Absorption is near-instantaneous and can be delivered through skin contact or ingestion, but the lips provide the strongest path. Effects last roughly between thirty minutes to an hour, and a single drop dissolved in a glass of water is enough to induce effects. Those exposed to this drug develop a strong unconscious mental dependence which is attributed to you if you are present.
summary: The ability to secrete an immensely druglike saliva
strengths: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Your saliva is a two-pronged attack - it functions both chemically and magically.
The effect is the same on all humans and susceptible humanoids. There are no physical side effects.
weaknesses: You are immune to the effects of your own saliva.
Delivery must be physically administered, which may already be challenging outside of combat.
Spiritual humanoids receive the narcotic only magically, which means halved strength.

name: Myth Power: Acheilos' Action
description: Acheilos (Akheilos, Acheilus, Achilos, Achilleus, Achilles), in Greek myth, was the god of sharks. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command sharks at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a shark at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will (others by touch). One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location that is home to sharks at will.
summary: The ability to channel Acheilos' command over the essence of sharks
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic sharks at will
Transform oneself into any species of shark (or wereshark) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with sharks at will
weaknesses: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent shark-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth3)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Thallo (Buds, Shoots, Blooming) allows one to psychically perceive reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, at will. In addition, one can cause plants to produce weaponized buds/shoots/blooms (explosive, poison, acid etc) at will. Furthermore, one can grow buds/shoots/blooms from one's body, at will. One can even psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to 'bloom', by touch.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically reduce plants to harmless green buds/shoots/blooms, and at will
Psychically weaponize plants' buds/shoots/blooms, and produce buds from one's own body, at will
Psychically loosen inhibitions, causing emotions to heighten to 'full bloom', by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically communicate and eavesdrop through flower blooms, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically cause buds to bloom into magical flowers (lotus, moly, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Sonic Screwdriver Creation
description: The amazingly useful sonic screwdriver of the who-verse. You can create one a day. Open a electronic door,cut locks,control a elevator,charge a battery,unlock handcuffs,cut rope,crack ice,a makeshift flashlight and a 100+ more uses. Anyone can use them.
summary: The ability to create a sonic screwdriver.
strengths: One hundred plus uses including as a screwdriver.
Small and can be hidden.
One function is to store the consciousness of a person.
weaknesses: Some uses are only useful in the who-verse.

name: Summerlands
description: Above
summary: The ability to concentrate hard enough on something and make it appear, also to VISIT the Summerlands
strengths: You always have everything you need
You are able to get away from danger quickly
You are fearless
weaknesses: Anyone can come with you
You can be easily discovered
You're too secretive

name: Thumbtack Grenade
description: You have the ability to summon a grenade in your hand. You can either throw it, use it as a close-combat weapon, or strike the ground with it. However, when it comes in contact with any solid surface besides your own body or clothing, it will explode. But instead of causing a normal explosion, it will shoot thumbtacks in every direction, in all kinds of colors. You cannot control the colors of thumbtacks you have.
summary: The ability to summon a grenade that sends out thumbtacks when exploding.
strengths: Have a weapon anytime you need one.
Can use it to cause pain to your enemies.
There are roughly one million thumbtacks released during each explosion.
weaknesses: They're only thumbtacks.
You could get hit by one.
You can't control what color thumbtacks fly out.

name: Quicklove
description: Make any girl instantly fall in love with you without a problem. All you have to do is concentrate and make eye contact.
summary: The ability to make any girl you want fall for you without problem
strengths: Easily get a girl
Have no problem getting any girl you want instantly
Get the girl of your dreams without question
weaknesses: It could end up hitting a girl you don't like

name: Infinitely Regressed
description: You have the ability to do the most difficult reality manipulation possible. You can temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression universe. You put the person in a white room holding a white box. Your victim opens the box. Inside is a tiny version of themself looking inside an open white box-it's the room they are standing in. If they shake the box they are holding, their room will move the same way.  The 'white box' universe can be escaped with reality altering or dimension travel powers.
summary: The ability to temporarily trap someone in an infinite regression.
strengths: Imagine if your victim turns the box upside down.
Your power will freak out enemies.
weaknesses: You break laws of the universe-you don't know what could happen when using your power.
Reality changers or universe jumpers.
It's only temporary. Just enough time to get out of sight of any pursuers.

name: Cyborg Transformation
description: This power counts robots covered in flesh(The Terminator),a mechanical shell giving life support and/or mobility(i. E. A dalek,a cyberman or Darth Vader) or someone partly organic,partly mechanical(DC Cyborg, a borg or Darth Vader-again). If a borg you could assimilate others but be confused as you have no collective. Being Darth Vader gives you force powers. Technology powers will be your bane.
summary: The ability to become any cyborg from any source(comics,tv,books,etc).
strengths: You will assimilate others.
You will use the force.
A single dalek is very tough to defeat.
weaknesses: Any cyborg will have aspecific weaknesses or at least a one weakness.
Technology powers will stop or control you.
Electromagnetic pulse powers.

name: Pyramidal Neuron Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. You can understand electrical signals (only if they are meant to carry information) or special signals used by Neuron Mimics. After analysing them, and if you decide to give an order or send some other information, you can encode it and send it by generating electricity or the signals Neuron Mimics use. The greatest strength of Neuron Mimics is the formation of communication networks between them. They can put their intelligence together and act like a giant brain.
summary: The ability to perceive information out of electricity and shoot electricity to send messages.
strengths: It is not required to have received a message to send one. You can spontaneously shoot electricity.
You can understand electrical signals, though it's not guaranted you'll understand the message.
By networking with Neuron Mimics, you can discuss at light speed without speaking or writing.
weaknesses: You need help from Oligodendrocyte or Schwann Cell Mimics to send messages to other Neuron Mimics.
You need help from Astrocyte Mimics to receive messages from other Neuron Mimics.
If you're all alone, you won't be able to use this power's full strength.

name: Missile Stop
description: With this power whenever you see a missile falling towards you or the area you're in you can freeze it in midair and keep it in the air until you want it to fall. Only you can cause the missiles you freeze to fall but you cannot cause missiles stopped by others with this power to fall. This power is useful if the world ever goes into nuclear apocalypse mode.
summary: The ability to prevent missiles from falling
strengths: You can stop missiles from falling
weaknesses: You cannot unfreeze missiles stopped by other people with this power

name: Myth Power: Epimetheus' Idea
description: Epimetheus (Epimetheos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of afterthought, or retrospect reflection. As such, channeling him allows one to reduce and distract meticulous thought and concentration in others (making subjects less capable of formulating a coherent plan, and more likely to make terrible decisions). In addition, one may perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are naturally flighty thinkers.
summary: The ability to channel Epimetheus' command over the essence of afterthought
strengths: Reduce and scatter otherwise meticulous thought (foes become unable to function effectively)
Psychically perceive a subject's past regrets by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally flighty thinkers
weaknesses: People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Iapetos' Scorn are immune to this ability
At the lower levels, this ability may affect one's personality

name: Snap You're A Monster
description: With this power you can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or monster just by snapping saying their name and the desired creature eg. "John Doe, Dragon". Once in creature form they are not under your control and might even attack you but you can change them back by snapping and reversing what you said earlier eg. "Dragon, John Doe". All damage sustained in creature mode transfers over to human mode.
summary: The ability to turn people into mythical creatures, cryptids or other monsters
strengths: You can turn anybody into a mythical creature, cryptid or other monster by snapping
You can change them back
All damage sustained in creature mode transfers to human mode
weaknesses: They are not under your control

name: Party Powers
description: Lets you mark people so that whenever they turn their power on non-lethal fireworks, lights, sounds, and confetti will periodically be released from their body until the power is turned off. Useful for annoying people and finding the location of people when they turn their power on. Confetti disappears after 30 seconds and fireworks after they explode. This power lasts on target until it is magically removed by user or some other power. Effects grow stronger if power is left on longer. Parties!!
summary: The ability to make confetti, lights, sounds, and even fireworks appear when a person uses their superpowers.
strengths: Amusing to watch.
Drive superpowered foes insane.
Easily find invisible or hiding foes.
weaknesses: Expect to be hated by the people you use this power on.
Only works on powers that can be turned on/off.
No offensive / defensive capabilities.

name: Pampered
description: Whenever this power is "activated", the user is automatically pampered by anyone and everyone they encounter. That's all there is to it. And because of the effect this power has on people, the user is immune to making enemies. And don't worry about getting tired of being pampered because that only happens in movies, how does someone get tired of being pampered, nobody does in real life!
summary: The ability to be pampered by everybody
strengths: Everyone pampers you
Immune to making enemies
Most-likely won't get tired of being pampered
weaknesses: Some people might get tired of being constantly pampered (if they're weird! )

name: Realistic Air Guitar
description: With this power you can make it sound like your actually playing the guitar (with skill) whenever you air guitar. It doesn't even have look convincing the guitar sound will just come out of nowhere and automatically sound really good.
summary: The ability to make it sound like you're actually playing the guitar when you air guitar
strengths: Make all your friends thing you can play the guitar
Win any air band competition
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Nanite Biomechanicality
description: The overview says it all. With this power you have Generator Rex's(Rex)powers. Every time a new power is discovered by Rex, you get it. You can discover new machines. Sometimes you turn into Rex's EVO form. But you still keep your memory.
summary: The ability to have all of Generator Rex's powers
strengths: Rex makes extremely powerful machines
You can discover machines.
Sometimes a control nanite activates and con 1 is inactive
weaknesses: Rex's powers sometimes don't work when you get angry
In EVO form you lose control.

name: Beserker Rage
description: Vikings did it. Indonesians called it 'running amok'. But it's really an ability called Beserker Rage, where a person can induce a state of enhanced strength, speed, agility, endurance, and ingenuity. However, this ability comes with a price: while in this state, the user's mind is in primal mode. They are only influenced by pain and rage, cannot remember anything, and are an equal threat to friend and foe.
summary: The ability to go into a beserk state with enhanced attributes
strengths: Escape is simple
You against 100 people
Multiple enhanced attributes
weaknesses: Equal threat to friend + foe
Cannot remember what happens in beserk state
Rage wearing off in middle of fight

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Cherubim
description: Cherubim have been described as the most fearsom and intimidating angels in the hierarchy. The Cherub is said to have four faces: one of each a man, an ox, a lion, and an eagle. The ox is considered as the "true face". The Cherub also has four conjoined wings covered with eyes and the feet of an ox. Cherubim usually reign in strength and lightning-fast speed; buzzing about like lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to become an angel of protection.
strengths: Strike fear into your enemies as they cower before your presence.
Your strength and power is second to none.
weaknesses: May frighten loved ones.

name: Super Enhanced Pack
description: Like the Enhanced Pack Invulnerability power but the number of the group boosts any power or powers of any group member. The exception is strength powers.  Ex: 5 people in an enhanced pack. One has a running speed of 90 mph and one can fly 300 mph. The runner now runs 450 mph (unless friction is a problem) and the flier goes 1500 mph. Some powers might not benefit due to the fact they're as good as they get, boosting the power wouldn't make any sense or a power can't be modified.
summary: The ability to have all the members of an enhanced pack get a power boost equal to the number of the group.
strengths: An enhanced pack with enhanced powers.
weaknesses: Certain powers may not get the power boost.

name: Will Breaking: Deadlock
description: This ability may prove to be useful when you are up against extremely powerful opponents who seem to resist all types of manipulative abilities. By projecting your will directly on your target grants you of some sort of limited control on them. This limited control stems from your willpower that dwells inside your target's mind which now coexists with their freewill. In effect you can cancel out their actions by thinking of something opposite that action. Thus your opponent is rendered inactive.
summary: The ability to induce inaction resulting from the opposition of two uncompromising wills.
strengths: Can also target manipulated objects making it extremely useful against telekinetic targets.
Can be used on yourself to eliminate the effects of spirit, mental, physical, psychic manipulations.
Can be used around you to disrupt psychic and precognitive abilities.
weaknesses: Requires quick thinking and concentration.
You dont actually possess the control of your targets action; you only induce inaction.
No one completely wins in battles between two opposing free wills; it always ends with a draw.

name: Motivator
description: With this power you can incite a strong, burning passion in those around you. The feeling can only be described as a strong desire to accomplish something together. Whether it be a class project, construction work, or a presentation, the people surrounding you will have an insatiable hunger for achievement. With concentration, you can use this power on yourself. This power is always "on" and cannot be turned off, but with time and mastery, you can suppress it almost completely.
summary: The ability to motivate people to achieve common goals.
strengths: Everywhere you go, people make things happen
You'll be paid a ton of money just to show up
Waiting in line at the DMV
weaknesses: At parties, "accomplish" may be a loose term
You might just want to kick back with friends

name: Soul Bullet
description: The bullet increases its power, speed, and will go through any obstacle as of it was a ghost until it reaches the target.
summary: The ability to infuse a bullet with a piece of your soul.
strengths: More power.
Hiding behind a wall wont save the target.
weaknesses: Soul skills take time to recharge. (about 30 min)
If you are shooting through the wall you can still miss.

name: Myth Killer
description: This ability emanates from the firm but unconscious disbelief of a person to mythological beings. By his mere presence anything that is mythical in nature ceases to exist.
summary: The ability to kill mythological beings and anything associated to them.
strengths: Obliterates the existence of myth whatever its form.
Disbelief is your ultimate weapon.
weaknesses: Only works against Mythical creatures and powers.
You are unaware of this ability and those who are affected by it.
Fate, Belief, or Fascination towards anything mythological destroys this ability.

name: Hair Blades
description: With this power, one can turn their hair into blades attached to their head and back into hair. The blades' movement can be controlled so long as the blades are attached by hair to the head. One can have any number of blades so long as there is enough hair and can lengthen hair to extend the blades' range or to make bigger blade(s). Maximum range of blades while attached to hair is 100 m. Minimum length of blade is 1 cm. Blades will stay together for 3 hours after being detached from head.
summary: The ability to turn one's hair into blades and control the blades
strengths: Always have a weapon as long as one has hair.
Can make the hair longer to extend the range of the blades.
weaknesses: Blades can be used by others if detached.
Hair must still be attached to head.
Can only send hair a maximum of 100 m away.

name: Mirror Control
description: You can control the visual appearance, physical and chemical composition, and the location/movement of any mirror within 50 metres of your position.
summary: The ability to control mirrors that are near one
strengths: You can have the mirrors act as shields against light-based attacks.
weaknesses: If there are no mirrors around.

name: Myth Power: Ioke's Onslaught
description: Ioke, in Greek myth, was the goddess of onslaught, when one side of battle is overwhelmed by another. As such, channeling her, one gains superhuman fighting and weapon prowess, and the ability to perceive a foe's moves in combat (or to predict the moves of ANYONE in radius with hostile intent). In addition, one can convert an enemy's allies into his own allies, who link minds with one for as long as the power lasts. Furthermore, one can replicate self and allies (natural or converted) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ioke's command over the essence of onslaught, and overwhemling combat power
strengths: Gain superhuman fighting and weapon prowess (and gain a Combat Sense)
Convert an enemy's allies into one's own allies, who link minds to be perfectly in sync in combat
Replicate self and/or allies (natural or converted) at will
weaknesses: Number of replicates grows over time; only fuse self/replicates into a giant when developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Nike's Knowledge provides immunity (NCN)

name: Ignorance Manipulation
description: You can control what people are ignorant about and make them want to know more or less about whatever you want.
summary: The ability to manipulate what people are ignorant about
strengths: Ambassadors, diplomats, and important etiquettes.
Diplomacy is based on not being ignorant.
Make assassins not want to know anything about you.
weaknesses: Pro: Knowledge is half the battle.

name: Appraiser
description: The user is able to appraise the worth of an object or the power and abilities of a person just by looking at the person. The user of this power can only appraise one person or item at a time, How accurate the appraisal is dependent on the user's mastery of his or her control of this power.
summary: The ability to appraise the worth of an object or the power and abilities of a person by just looking at them
strengths: Can appraise a worth of an object
Good to determine alien objects
Good at finding new recruits to join their team
weaknesses: Has no combat power what so ever
Appraisal might be off the mark if the user's control of this power is low

name: Spychic
description: You have psychic abilities to move objects with your mind and read others minds. BUT only if you're spying on someone. The powers are strong but can only be activated if you're doing spywork for yourself or others.
summary: The ability to have psychic abilities as long as your spying
strengths: Be able to read minds
Be able to move objects with your mind
You could have a very fun and successful spy career!
weaknesses: This power only works if you're spying
If you don't want to be a spy, then you're out of luck

name: Myth Power: Dolos' Deal
description: Dolos (Dolus), in Greek mythology, was the god of cleverness, cunning, guile and trickery. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in how to speak and act to trick and con others. In addition, one becomes highly agile and dexterous, gaining skill in stealth, sleight of hand, pickpocketing, picking locks, cracking safes and other sneaky pursuits. Furthermore, one's voice can be used to cast illusions so subjects believe anything one says. One can even literally turn insults back on foes.
summary: The ability to channel Dolos' command over the essence of cleverness, craftiness, cunning and guile
strengths: Gain superhuman skill in tricking and conning others
Become highly agile and dexterous, gain skill in stealth, sleight of hand, pickpocketing, etc
Cast illusions by voice (subjects believe anything one says); turn foes' insults back on them
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel tricksters/thieves/con artists when developed
Only gain the power of Crocodile Tears and (eventually) Mirage Inducing at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute and MythPower: Prometheus' Plan provide immunity (NCN)

name: Super Stickiness
description: Things stick to you like glue when you have an adhesive body! You can also stick onto surfaces! Talk about stickers!
summary: The ability to stick onto things, or stick things onto you
strengths: Stick your property onto you for easy carriage.
Stick onto surfaces & climb them. You can even walk on ceilings like an insect!
Enemies will stick onto you, too, slowing down their attacks!
weaknesses: There are some things that you don't want to stick onto you, like the sharp edges of knives!
Other sticky surfaces will be more difficult to get off of, since you're sticky, too.
Stickers, tape, & glue will be more difficult to peel off of you if you want to peel them off.

name: Myth Power: Furies' Fury
description: The Erinyes (Furies), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of divine punishment for crimes against the natural order. As such, channeling Tisiphone (Murder Retribution), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on killers, at will. Channeling Megaera (Megaira, Megara- Grudge), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on the jealous/envious and unfaithful, at will. Channeling Alecto (Alekto- Unceasing), one can psychically perceive and inflict curses on the wrongfully hateful, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erinyes' command over the essence of divine punishment  and vengeance
strengths: Psychically perceive and inflict curses on murderers/killers, at will
Psychically perceive and inflict curses on the jealous, the envious and unfaithful lovers, at will
Perceive and inflict curses on the wrongfully hateful/wrathful/mean-spirited/spiteful, at will
weaknesses: Cannot summon a divine snake whip, or gain the power of winged flight, until developed (NCN)
Cannot attone criminals' crimes (so others forgive/forget them), until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Virus Scanner
description: Who knows what people are carrying nowadays. Well, now you will! This ability allows you to know the full virus/disease history of anyone you meet, including yourself. You'll know their current afflictions, and past ones as well.  And of course your chances of contracting STDs will plummet. You also know how to cure, though you might not be able to (two different things)
summary: The ability to know what viruses or diseases people have.
strengths: Avoid all STDs
Be one badass doctor
Dr. House will have nothing on you
weaknesses: Packed elevator rides
Shaking hands
Knowing the histories of co-workers

name: M.S.C.P.
description: M.S.C.P. stands for Multi Spiritual Combination Possession. You can summon two, three or more spirits that are good and/or evil at your command to possess you to gain new powers and personalities, also to become one being.
summary: The ability to have 2, 3, or more spirits to possess you to gain new powers and personalities.
strengths: Can use the combined powers of the multiple spirits of the heroes and villains to merge with you.
weaknesses: Those spirits you possessed will try to take control of you.

name: Final Fantasy Mimicry
description:
Ever played final fantasy? I have. 
This ability allows you to mimic any character or a job class from any final fantasy. This also includes summons like Ifrit, Shiva, Bahamut, etc. And only incorporates usable characters. This also includes one-time characters, like Sephiroth. 
(I'd mimic him first. )
summary: The ability to mimic any character or job class from the final fantasies.
strengths: Mimic any final fantasy character or job class.
Are able to mimic the summons, espers, gf's, aeons or eidolons.
Mimic Gogo from ff6 or the mimic job class, gives you the ultimate mimicry ability.
weaknesses: You can only mimic the characters' from the final fantasies you own.
You mimic the attributes of the current stats of the character you mimic.

name: Mirror
description: Anything you feel they will feel.
summary: The ability to make others feel what you feel
strengths: Dish out a whole lot of Karma
You die they die
weaknesses: You have to hurt yourself to do any damage
You cant say that didnt hurt

name: Camera Mind
description: Having a camera mind would be great for all those moments when you wish you could have gotten a picture, such as a deer in the woods. To zoom, you have to get closer to whatever you're taking a picture of, and to get a sideways picture you'd have to tilt your head. Once you hit the capacity of 100 pictures, you have to transfer them to an actual camera (meaning no cell phone cameras) before they can go on the computer.
summary: The ability to take pictures with your mind
strengths: Can capture those perfect moments instantly
Doesn't matter if you forgot a camera
weaknesses: Can only store 100 pictures at a time
Need to transfer pictures to a camera and upload the pictures from there

name: Four Eyes: Elemental Control
description: This power is gained by having the Four Eyes power and having only the two normal eyes and upper/right eyes open. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power.
summary: The ability to utilize one element per eye
strengths: Can control four elements.
Can still use other Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have had Four Eyes and had only the normal and upper/right eyes open.
Cannot choose which element each eye allows control of when open.
Cannot get other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Ambush Detector
description: Picture this somebody you know has been kidnapped. You receive a note telling you to meet the kidnappers somewhere. You think to yourself: maybe this is some sort of a trap. Well, with this power you can detect an ambush from thirty yards away and replan your rescue accordingly.
summary: The ability to detect an ambush from thirty yard away
strengths: You can detect if you're walking right into an ambush from thirty yards away
weaknesses: You have to be at most thirty yards away

name: Twilight Power: Anti Shield
description: This power works via physical contact with a target. With this ability the user can destroy or penetrate any Mental Shield, no matter the degree to which the shield holder has evolved it. The user can also break Physical shields after one thousand uses.
summary: The ability to penetrate or destroy shield abilities.
strengths: Shield Breaker
Works well with Tactile Thought Projection.
weaknesses: Physical shield breaking takes time.
Physical contact required.

name: Long Kiss Goodnight
description: With this power you can give any living thing the long kiss goodnight. Projected at the speed of thought, the long kiss goodnight has a range of about 8 kilometers and mentally locking target that cannot escape your deadly affections.
summary: The ability to use a blown kiss as a high caliber kinetic killshot
strengths: Direct pure linear kinetic force at the speed of thought
No misses. Victim is mentally tagged, kiss will go through anything to hit target
Headshots with the entering effect of a high caliber AP shell and the exit of a grenade
weaknesses: Must mentally tag a living being, then blow the kiss
Purely an offensive & no chance of shooting to wound, damage anything 3 meters behind target
No silencer. The effects are loud and reverberate. Just walk away no one will ever know.

name: Follower
