description: With this power, the end receiver will be placed in a trance, where they must follow another person (that you choose) no matter where they go. They will always know where your designated "leader" is, and will follow them at all costs wherever they go. When the follower reaches the leader, they will stand as close to the leader as possible without touching them. This can get pretty damn annoying, especially when you make multiple people follow someone. Snapping your fingers releases all followers
summary: The ability to cause anyone to follow another person (physically) at all costs
strengths: Use as self defense
Mess with your buddies
weaknesses: Snapping your fingers releases ALL followers, not just ones you choose

name: Time To Eat
description: This superpower lets you think of an object you want eat without having to leave the house. Say, a small restaraunt in Korea has the best dumplings ever! All you have to do is think about em.
summary: The ability to make anything you want to eat appear in front of you, no charge.
strengths: You'll never be hungry again.
You want have to settle for mom's meatloaf.
You'll save money on food.
weaknesses: You'll probably never learn to cook.
Sometimes you don't really want the food to appear, especially not in class.
I don't know what else but maybe you'll think of something.

name: Chest Beams
description: A person with this power can shoot concussive beams originating from their upper chest. In addition, the user can control when to fire their chest beam and it will not fire at the wrong times. However, when used it will break the chest region of their clothes. Luckily this power also gives the user's chest some sort of invulnerability so that you don't need armor to protect it.
summary: The ability to shoot concussive beams from your chest
strengths: Surprise Factor
Can do it at close range via a hug
Can be fired repeatedly
weaknesses: Will expose your chest for the world to see
Con number 1 can be worse if you are female or worse for male as well

name: Myth Power: Hephaestus' Forge
description: Hephaestus (Hephaistos), in Greek myth, was the god of fire, metal, volcanic activity, the forge and craftsmanship. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in all of the numerous handicrafts. In addition, one can psychically manipulate fire and metal at will. Furthermore, one can psychically manipulate molten rock/metal (magma/lava) at will. One can also totally withstand the effects of fire and heat. One can even absorb heat and fire at will, to gain physical power and sustenance.
summary: The ability to channel Hephaestus' command over the forces of fire, metal, volcanic activity, and the forge
strengths: Gain skill in artisanry, metalworking, stonemasonry, sculpting, jewelry making, blacksmithing, etc
Psychically perceive and manipulate fire, metal and volcanic lava/magma (MOLTEN rock/metal)
Totally withstand the effects of heat (shared by touch); absorb heat to gain power and sustenance
weaknesses: Cannot generate and manipulate smoke and ash until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot assume a form of fire, metal or molten rock/metal (lava/magma) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot teleport foes into volcanoes or volcanic faults by touch until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Saikazane Ryu
description: The demonic dragon Saikazane is capable of perceiving all knowledge of the universe, from insects to questions of faith. He can also fire destructive beams from his eyes which disintegrate anything it makes contact with. The kanji tattoos on your forearms allow you to invoke this mysterious being to do your bidding. Saikazane can also transfer a small portion of his powers to the summoner, such as energy projection, flight, immense strength, lightning quick speed, and superior durability.
summary: The ability to summon a demonic dragon.
strengths: Defeat feeble enemies with ease.
Disintegrate your desired targets.
Gain knowledge of the universe.
weaknesses: You are still vulnerable.
A dangerous ability to utilize around civilians.

name: Aggregated Cells
description: The ability to make cells seem to be on drugs, they move around at intense speed in whatever place I want when I want, causing that place to be rendered chemically mixed. The buildings water, the ocean concrete.
summary: The ability to change all chemical cells.
strengths: The Ability to Alter Reality is Very Strong.
You make your friends into poop, litterally.
weaknesses: The chemical reaction onto certain objects may effect Earth itself.

name: Dark Eyes
description: Rules: Must have skin-to-skin contact. You must be conscious to use it. You can use it only until you run out of energy
summary: The ability to blind people
strengths: People tend to leave you alone
Helps in sticky situations
weaknesses: Black eyes that are ridiclously sensitive to light
Very hard to control; this power is linked strongly to your emotions
People fear you

name: Planeswalking
description: You can use real game cards of Magic: the Gathering and make their effects real. Summon creatures, cast spells, cover area with a certain type of land.
summary: The ability to use Magic: The Gathering cards to actully cast spells and summon cretures
strengths: You get to see what how the effects work out in real life
You won't have to worry about bullies
You won't need to buy a guard dog
weaknesses: You have to own the card (they have to be bought, be given to you or won fairly)
They might not let you enter tournaments anymore
It would turn a fun game into a life or death scenario

name: Pain Drain
description: An ability best in the hands of someone selfless, you take the physical pain away from someone, making you feel that pain, so they don't have to. The damage will still be inflicted on the individual, but you take the pain away, easing their suffering.
summary: The ability to take the pain, when someone is inflicted with physical pain.
strengths: Drain the pain from those damaged, so they don't have to.
Ease the suffering of a terminally ill patient.
Not absorbing the damage.
weaknesses: Stating this boldly, a painful ability to use.
Damage is still inflicted.

name: Flowering Burning Anger
description: You use this power to thrash your enemies by tossing burning sharp blossoms at them, and then seperates to fry them. It can go right thourgh your opponent leaving behind charred holes anywhere in their body.
summary: The ability to fire off burning petals and scatter them at your opponent.
strengths: You can have the ability to control both Grass and Fire-type powers.
weaknesses: None.

name: Utopic Vision
description: Know who is stopping the creation of Utopia and who could aid it. Potentionary vision, (i.e. seeing what could be rather than what will be). See visions of acts that will lead to the birth of an idealistic world.
summary: The ability to know how to bring about Utopia
strengths: Create world peace
End all Suffering
weaknesses: May involve many crimes
Could harm your sanity

name: Soul Twister
description: When you clench your fist, it will start to glow a foggy white color. When you open your hand in front of someone, a ghostly white hand engulfs the opponent, and sends their soul out of their mouth, and freezes the opponent in silver ice. Their soul starts to spin and expand, until it'a transforms into a full blown tornado and moves away. If the soul twister picks up the frozen host body, the tornado returns to the host by forcing itself through a crack, breaking the ice as well.
summary: The ability to eject the souls of yourself and others out of their body in the form of a large tornado
strengths: Highly destructive.
Tornado blows wind at 0 degrees Kelvin.
If ice is touched, the person who touched it is also frozen and their soul is ejected as well.
weaknesses: When broken ice melts, several little ghost hand silhouette seek out hosts to freeze.

name: Crusader's Faith
description: Crusader's Faith provides not only immunity to, but also the general nullification of any faith based, god or god-like powers that are used on, around, or in the general vicinity of you, unless they are the faith based or god powers of your god.
summary: The ability to nullify and otherwise be immune to all faith based and god powers other than those of your god
strengths: Immunity to the faith based and god powers of other faiths.
Nullification of fath based and god powers of other faiths.
weaknesses: Religious bloodlust.
May become extremely judgemental and hypocritical.

name: Firewall Bypass
description: The person who has this power can go on any website on any device that they chose to, even if that website they is being blocked by parental controls or a firewall at school, without using any sort of proxy.
summary: The ability to get on any website regardless of whether it is blocked or not
strengths: Be able to go on any website they want.
Works on any electronic device.
weaknesses: You can suffer consequences if you get caught.
You might get a virus on your computer if you go on a bad website.

name: Summon Leviathan
description: With this power you can summon the Leviathan a sea serpent that can breathe fire and has super sharp teeth and almost impenetrable skin. The Leviathan is under your complete control but it can't walk on land so this power is useless unless you're fighting in or at least near a body of water. When you're done with it you can just send it back to wherever it came from.
summary: The ability to summon the Leviathan
strengths: You can summon a sharp toothed, fire breathing sea serpent to help you
The Leviathan is under your complete control
weaknesses: It can't walk on land so you need to be in or at least near water for this power to be effective

name: Gentrification
description: This quasi-magical ability temporarily transforms up to six people with little to no class (with respect to dress and behavior, not income) into well-mannered, refined, eloquent, and stylishly dressed individuals. It will not change their basic ethical makeup, i. E. A gentlemanly cad is still a cad, but it will make them classier. The duration of this transformation is roughly 24 hours divided by the number of people affected.
summary: The ability to temporarily transform people with little or no class into well-mannered and respectable persons.
strengths: Great for dressing up henchmen and hirelings to blend in to polite society.
Good for cleaning up rogues and thugs to avoid soiling one's gloves while at fisticuffs.
Good for polishing up wenches and doxies into semi-respectable ladies when tavern hopping.
weaknesses: Changes the appearance but not the substance of a person. Evil with nice manners is still evil.
All of the changes are temporary. The clothes and shoes change back when the effect ends.
This ability does not affect the person's health, but it may mask the symptoms. (Beware STDs! )

name: Interdimensional M Gun Monster
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves a machine gun. When you activate this ability, a machine gun will materialise in your hands. You start by shooting many rounds of nothing. You will in fact be shooting many small yellow monsters in quick succession. Each monster will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
summary: The ability to fire many small monsters in quick succession using a special machine gun
strengths: Fire many small monsters quickly at a target.
No precision required; Just aim at the general direction, you're bound to hit something.
Not lethal.
weaknesses: Bounces off walls.
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Scares people.

name: Math
description: You would be able to subtract,add,mutiply,or divide anything with different results. For ADD-you can add any thing to anything else. Power,size,strength,speed and any other characteristic. For SUBTRACT-you can subtract any characteristic. For MUTIPLY-you can mutiply anythings characteristics. For DIVIDE- you can divide anythings charactistics.
summary: The ability to control reality with math
strengths: Educational power!
Mutiply uses
weaknesses: Educational power
Must be good at math
You might hate math

name: Sticky Fingers
description: Sticky Fingers allows anyone to get what they want, as long as it's on a physical plane, like money, jewelery, new videogames, even people. It can't get you things like respect, or something like that, more of the opposite for this one. The power automatically works by reading your mind and making whatever (physical) you want fly and stick to your hands. The problem is you steal things without purposely meaning to, and sleep stealing is an issue. So people will think you are a no good klepto.
summary: The ability to have what ever physical thing you want fly to your hands and stick to them.
strengths: You can always get what you want (as long as it's a physical thing)
It's automatic
weaknesses: People will accuse you of being a thief
It reads your subconcious(sleep stealing, getting things you want but don't want to get by stealing)

name: Musical Leech
description: Ever wanted to sing/play a musical composition, but either didn't have the time or just plain sucked at it? This power allows you to absorb the musical talent of those around you through physical contact. The longer you remain in contact, the more talent you absorb.
summary: The ability to steal musical talent from people through physical contact
strengths: Learn how to play instruments/sing quick
People you touch lose their musical talent (embarrass enemies)
Sometimes, retain musical talent permanently
weaknesses: You only gain knowledge on how to play instruments that the people you touch know how to play
People you touch lose their musical talent (angry, tone-deaf people)
Sometimes, musical talent is retained only temporarily

name: Myth Power: Said By Pseudologoi
description: The Pseudologoi (Pseudea), in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of falsehood, lying and deception. As such, channeling them allows one to tell lies so convincing that subjects automatically believe them, unless they see otherwise. In addition, one can psychically perceive lies. Furthermore, one may manipulate the brain of subjects with a touch, so that they are unable to tell lies at all, or able to ONLY tell lies. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel liars.
summary: The ability to channel the Pseudologoi and their command over the essence of lying and deception
strengths: People automatically believe any lie you tell (unless they find out otherwise)
Psychically perceive lies; make foes incapable of lying, or able to ONLY tell lies, at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel people who are normally deceptive
weaknesses: People with MythPower: Aletheia's Absolute can perceive, withstand and disrupt this ability
At the lower levels, one may become a compulsive liar
At the lower levels, sensing lies may induce headaches or disorientation

name: Rainbows
description: With this power you can cause rainbows to appear whenever and wherever you want. The rainbows can be used to distract people with their beautiful colors, blind people with their brightness or to create realistic nature scenes for movies, tv shows and youtube videos.
summary: The ability to cause rainbows to appear whenever and wherever you want
strengths: You can create rainbows wherever and whenever you want.
You can use them to distract people, blind people or to create realistic nature scenes
You can make the rainbows disappear when you're done with them
weaknesses: Some people think rainbows are a bad omen

name: Free Association Prediction
description: A person with this power can know anything through free association. They can tell the future or even figure out the answer to questions on a test. Free association is stringing related words together. Unfortunately, this power is hard to control since the user could go off in wild tangents before getting the information that they are looking for.
summary: The ability to figure out any sort of truth via free association
strengths: Tell the future
Get rich
weaknesses: No one will believe you (at first)
You are right for the wrong reasons
Hard to control where your predictions end at

name: Super Charge
description: With a mental "ON-OFF" switch, you can throw others' powers into hyper drive, causing them to lose all control and subconsciously destroy themselves with their own abilities. This lack of control grows more severe with a closer proximity to you.
summary: The ability to make other powers uncontrollable
strengths: Near-immunity to other powers
Targets would kill themselves, so you don't get your hands dirty
weaknesses: Targets would become time-bombs, potentially destroying everything around them
Inability to predict how this "super charge" will affect the target

name: Demon Power Set
description: You will be able to have an incredible demon power set. These powers include: Teleportation, Demon Push, Demon Pull, Black Fire Blast, Super Speed and Wings.
summary: The ability to have a demon power set
strengths: Great Defence
Great Stregth
Great Stamina
weaknesses: Sensitive to Light
Weak against vampires

name: Manmade Element Manipulation
description: The four evil elements--deforestation, radiation, smog and toxicity--are the corrupt opposites of earth, fire, water, and wind.  Deforestation is the ability to obliterate all tree life, radiation is the power to release electromagnetic energy from your hands, smog is the ability to launch a deadly ball of gas to your enemies, and toxicity is the power to unleash a poisoned green acidic spray.
summary: The ability to wield the four dark powers of pollution.
strengths: Gain four very effective abilities
weaknesses: You'll be forever corrupted

name: Acid Tide
description: You could swamp the entire battlefield with a giant wave, filled with powerful sulphuric acid. This acid can burn right through everything, but this power can also be used to cross pools of toxic (create your own layer of acid over the pool of acid).
summary: The ability to create a wave of acid that will burn through everything.
strengths: You are immune to your own acid.
Surfing on acid (even possible with a surfboard, as long as you touch it)
weaknesses: Falling of your surfboard means bye bye surfboard.

name: Demonic Song
description: It's simple all you have to do is sing it effects all that can hear it so the louder the song is the more people you can control.
summary: The ability to control people who hear your song
strengths: Loud voice equals big army
it doesn't matter if you sing good or bad
karaoke is awesome
weaknesses: quiet voice equals ineffective
you could effect sombody you didn't want to effect
you may not like to sing

name: Tardigration
description: Nature has equipped the animal species known as tardigrades with a whole arsenal of survival skills and abilities that allow them to, for example, survive being cooked at over 100 degrees celsius or being radiated by thousands of gamma rays. Also, they can survive without water for years and can stay alive in the vacuum of space. This superpower allows you to adapt this biological protection and to use it to become "as tough as a tardigrade".
summary: The ability to use a tardigrade's unique survival skills.
strengths: You will survive pretty much anything.
You won't need to eat or drink for years.
weaknesses: You will also adapt other features of a tardigrade. For example, you look like a tardi-human-hybrid.

name: Paradox Bestowal
description: This power makes it so that you can bestow a paradox upon someone. With just the flick of your finger, you can bestow an unsolvable paradox that tears through the fabric of space-time so your opponent will be shoved into a state of nonexistence. When in this state, they will still be alive, but the universe will not remember them, and they will not be able to communicate with anything or anyone in any way. Unfortunately, this power is irreversible and cannot be undone.
summary: The ability to bestow an unsolvable paradox onto someone.
strengths: Bestow a paradox upon your enemy.
The enemy will be shoved into a state of nonexistence.
weaknesses: This power is irreversible.
The paradox may destroy the planet...... Just kidding.

name: Drunk Control
description: With this power you can make any drunk person your mind slave. All you have to do is make contact with a drunk person and you will be able to take control of him until he becomes sober.
summary: The ability to control people when they are drunk
strengths: You can take over the minds of drunk people
weaknesses: If you never see a drunk person in your life this power is useless
You loose control once they become sober

name: Punisphere
description: You can lift up the opponent and trap them in a micro-electromagnetic dimension of your creation. Watch as your foe gets electrocuted several times inside; then you close your fist, crushing the dimensional orb which causes raw energy to give your foe the final large shock and dealing huge damage, probably killing them.
summary: The ability to trap & shock your enemy in a tiny orb.
strengths: Could give your enemy a squeezing shock.
weaknesses: Some people are protected against trapping through their powers

name: Myth Power: Maidens' Maximum
description: The Hyperborean Maidens, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of archery. As such, channeling Opsis (Opis, Oupis, Upis- Aim), one can aim with superhuman accuracy, and can psychically disrupt aim, by touch. Channeling Loxo (Trajectory), one can psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory. Channeling Hekaerge (Hecaerge, Arge- Distancing), one can psychically perceive space (objects' presence, distance, speed, velocity, momentum, etc), and psychically disrupt others' spatial sense, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Hyperborean Maidens and their command over the essence of archery
strengths: Aim with Superhuman Accuracy, and psychically disrupt aim, by touch, at will
Psychically manipulate airborne objects' trajectory (Flight Manipulation) at will
Psychically perceive space, at will, and disrupt others' spatial sense, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot summon indestructible bow and quiver of infinite arrows, until developed (NCN)
Cannot withstand the effects of the cold (Cold Immunity), until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Blade Ankle Wings V2
description: With this power you can sprout two wings from both of your ankles. The wings allow you to fly and also give you enhanced speed. The wings can also shoot our small silver blades that can pierce anything. The blades cannot be used against you.
summary: The ability to sprout wings that shoot sharp blades from your ankles
strengths: You can sprout wings from your feet
You have enhanced speed
You can shoot blades from the wings on your feet
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Delete This Cannon Punch
description: Your left hand will turn red. You'll then get the chance to lunge toward your opponent by driving your fist through them. After it's done, your left fist will let out some steam.
summary: The ability to glowingly fly forward with your fist and push them against the wall.
strengths: This is just a regular flying power!
weaknesses: None.

name: Primal Scream
description: Imagine the worst migraine you've ever had. Then multiply it by 70. A person with Primal Scream can induce this head-splitting pain in others with a raw, high-pitched cry. This is not particularily loud--100 decibels--but it causes mental anguish far greater than its volume. Experienced users can push the volume up to 150 decibels, which causes physical damage as well. However, it is totally fueled by emotion and drains its user of energy.
summary: The ability to produce a scream that attacks the minds of the listeners
strengths: 70 times worse than a migrane
Gets stronger the more you use it
Effective crowd control
weaknesses: Not particularily loud (100 dB)
Totally fueled by emotion
Drains user of energy

name: Arrow Creation
description: The arrows are created out of the air. The shafts are of any chosen wood (yew, hornbeam, etc), the arrowhead is made of any chosen stone or metal (iron, obsidian, etc), and the fletching can come from any kind of bird (geese, duck, etc).
summary: The ability to create arrows at will
strengths: You can have arrows that are of a high quality whenever you want.
weaknesses: You need to have a bow for this to be fully useful.

name: Power Ring Symbiosis
description: Power Ring Symbiosis turns you into a ring that retains all of your powers and force of will. The wielder must, and is compelled to give thier powers to the ring in order to use it. The wielder cannot, nor wants to remove the ring and can use all of the power within it at will. The wielder belives that they are in control, but in actuality, they are acting out your thoughts, desires and will. When the wielder dies, the ring comes off and retains the powers of itself and all previous wielders.
summary: The ability to permanently become an indestructable ring with all of your powers and force of will
strengths: Live through another and gain power each time a new host emerges.
Never truly die.
Gain the knowledge of each wielder.
weaknesses: You are a ring.
Nobody might put you on for quit a while.
Defenseless when not on a finger.

name: Rise Of The Legendary Pokemon
description: With this power you can turn into any of the legendary Pokemon even ones that have not be officially released or discovered. In Pokemon mode you retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak. You can stay in Pokemon form for as long as you want. Also if you turn into Manaphy, find a Ditto and give birth to a Phione it will be under your control.
summary: The ability to turn into any legendary pokemon
strengths: You have over 40 powerful forms
You retain your intelligence level, personality and ability to speak
If you give birth to a Phione by turning into Manaphy and breeding it will be under your control
weaknesses: You might be hunted by pokemon trainers
You might be hunted by pokemon collectors
The real legends might come after you

name: Induce Necrosis
description: You're able to induce the disease through touch, saliva, blood and breath. You can infect someone's lungs through breath, pass it into water supplies by using blood or saliva and kill someone in a matter of seconds (as the cells multiply and infect other cells quickly) by touching them. You're also able to reverse the process in your body and others' and can target specific cells in a body (e.g. fat cells).
summary: The ability to induce the disease necrosis (the death of living cells).
strengths: Ultimate assassin.
Able to affect someone from a distance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to mundane ways of killing.
Cells die in air after a few minutes.

name: Black Cat's Dance
description: This insidious power allows the user to alter probability, absorbing the good luck of another person and passing on any bad luck he or she possesses to that person as well. This means that the user will not only drain them of their good luck and leave them with their own bad luck, he or she will leave them with his or her bad luck as well. The possessor of this ability can use it consciously 12 times a week, but once a week it will be triggered unconsciously as well.
summary: The ability to cause another person bad luck by crossing his or her path.
strengths: Great way to boost your luck before hitting the casinos!
Good way of getting revenge, especially if your foe is lucky.
Good for a career in sports, medicine, or politics.
weaknesses: You quickly get a reputation as a jinx or a "Jonah. "
The ability may affect friends and loved ones when it goes off unconsciously.
On Friday the 13th, the effect of this ability is reversed!

name: Arcana: 2 The High Priestess
description: This power gives Procedural Knowledge, or "How-To" knowledge. It gives you expert knowledge and muscle memory without you ever even so much as seeing something done. You could learn how to throw a curve ball or how to operate a machine gun. This ability will often give information that is useful, but not always for the current situation. The only real limits to this power are that you can't learn how to do the physically impossible or do something without the things required to do it.
summary: The ability to gain random knowledge.
strengths: Can gain any kind of how-to knowledge.
Might gain the how-to knowledge of a martial art expert.
Can activate at will.
weaknesses: Never gives you what you want to know.
Can't do something impossible, or directly gain superpowers.

name: Streaker
description: Those with this power can cause people to streak, without anyone (except the user, people who can resist telepathy/mindcontrol/change to willpower) noticing anything wrong, with varying levels of control. Weak control can cause everyone around you to streak uncontrollably. Those with strong control can make only specific people streak, or make them only remove certain things, such as weapons, without them noticing. It is possible also to make people notice the streaker.
summary: The ability to cause people to streak.
strengths: Cause people to streak without anyone thinking its unnormal.
With strong control can make people not wear certain things, such as weapons.
Can streak yourself without worrying about breaking the law.
weaknesses: With weak control you might see people streak that you did not wish to see.
May take a lot of will power to keep people from noticing the streaking.
If you lose control and people notice the streaking you may get into trouble.

name: Ultimate Sidekick
description: A person with this power has all the abilities and strengths of every sidekick in existence and can use multiple abilities simultaneously. However, they can only access these powers if they are the sidekick of a hero. In addition as a sidekick, they are not allowed to outperform the hero in popularity, doing so will make them lose their powers since they are no longer a sidekick.
summary: The ability to emulate the power of any sidekick to any hero or villain from any published source
strengths: You have a lot of power, speed, and other capabilities
You are actually stronger than the hero/villain most of the time
weaknesses: No matter how strong you are, you are still treated as the sidekick
If you try to be better than the hero in public view, you will lose your powers.
You need to find a hero/villain to be a sidekick of.

name: Son Of Re
description: Summon the Son of Re at any time. He is an ancient, fiery warrior that is superstrong & absorbs heat. He is technically dead on our plane giving him zombie like attributes, very hard to kill. He carries a variety of weapons of which he can pull from the dimension he resides in. Flaming oversized swords, bow and arrows, axes, spears, and shields. All of which only you and he can utilize. He is always angry and hard to control. He is not your sidekick. You are his. Once summoned you belong to him.
summary: The ability to summon the Son of Re, a fiery, ancient, near-unstoppable warrior.
strengths: He becomes invincible after he absorbs a sufficient amount of heat & burns like a walking inferno
He lends you his weaponry (fireproof while holding them) & teaches you his warrior fighting skills
Immortal? If he dies, u rise from the ashes as a fiery phoenix for one hour or until he reintegrates
weaknesses: When he absorbs 2 much heat forced to release by exploding fireball kills himself and u each time
Don't call him by his many names (Horus, Osiris, Amun, Atum, Apollo, Helios) or he will pimp-slap u
He is not ur friend, he will kill u, ur friends or family if u lie, cheat or steal in his presence

name: Magic Negation
description: With this ability, you become the very antithesis of magic; any magical effect is automatically negated in your presence; magic spells will fail, curses falter and fade away; magical traps vanish into thin air, and magical illusions are suppressed, to reveal the truth behind them. What's best, not only do you negate the magical enhancements of others, but magic that touches your body cannot affect you AT ALL.
summary: The ability to negate the magical abilities of others
strengths: Negate magical spells and effects that have already been produced
Prevent magic from being used in the first place
Magic touches your body, it's negated (naturally immune to magic)
weaknesses: Mages HATE you...
No magical enhancements
No magical assistance AT ALL...

name: Moon Blade 9th Lighting Yellow
description: Blade for controlling light and lightning. Looks like a golden blade with blue marks on the hild and bottom bart of the blade.
summary: The ability to summon the 9th Moon Blade
strengths: Can summon lightning bolts.
Can control light in any variation such as making someone invisible by bending the light around them
Or by blinding someone with light or absence of it.
weaknesses: Light manipulation has no effect on blind people and light illusions are cancelled by true-sight.

name: Spinekinesis
description: The ability to grow spines and have control over all spines. You can grow spines as weaponry or break opponents' spines with a thought. You can cause paralysis by blocking signals coming from the brain, or cure it if caused by the spine. If you have this power, your body can't be taken over by mind-controlling powers because you can replace the signals going to your muscles. In the same way, you can control how other people's bodies move, unless they have direct muscle control outside the spine.
summary: The ability to create and have complete control over spines.
strengths: Spine-based offense / defense
Cause or cure paralysis
Can control signals going through the spine to control or prevent bodies from being controlled.
weaknesses: May be painful if you decide to grow spines from your body.
Ineffective if people can control their body with other means besides signals through the spine.
Takes focus to grow spines that are not grown from your own body

name: Half Raiju
description: Someone with this power has claws and fangs as well as furry wolf,cat,monkey or weasel ears and a wolf-,cat-,monkey- or weasel-like tail. They will have higher strength,speed,and magical power especially for lightning magic. They can also transform into lightning at will and transform back into their normal forms. Use of the lightning form comes at a cost of extreme pain all over the body though. Also, as a Raiju is a servant of the gods a Half-Raiju only needs to bow down to gods and demi-gods
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-raiju
strengths: You are far more powerful than most beings.
For the most part you don't have to do what others want you to do unless you want to.
Note: Raiju translates as 'Lightning Beast' but is often depicted as a wolf, weasel, cat or monkey.
weaknesses: You have to do what gods and demigods order you to do.
The lightning form is a definite last resort.

name: Gargoylenesis
description: This ability allows you to transform oneself into a powerful gargoyle with skin of stone. You can fly (with wings), perform incredible feats of maneuverability in midair, change your skin shade to blend in with different types of stone, and rip boulders from the ground to hurl. However, you must be very focused and concentrated to become a gargoyle, and it does tax your energy quite a bit, although no extra energy is used once one has transformed.
summary: The ability to transform oneself into a gargoyle made of stone
strengths: You can become a gargoyle with the powers of flight
You become very strong, fast and agile
Chameleon-like abilities
weaknesses: Takes enormous amount of focus to become, cannot be rushed.
You are terrifying and may cause innocent civilians to run to their doom off the edges of buildings
Takes a fair amount of energy to activate

name: Human Bouncing Ball
description: Whenever you or a part of your body is hit by a blunt impact, you or your body part will bounce without suffering any internal damage. The same goes if you hit something. You will still be able to cause damages, but the recoil of your hits will make you spring away. You can't be hurt if you hit yourself. This power is always active, so you can't turn it off and you are forever immune to blunt impacts.
summary: The ability to bounce upon impact.
strengths: You are immune to blunt damage.
If you fall to the ground, you will bounce in the air.
If you are punched, you can bounce against a wall and hit them back.
weaknesses: Always active. So, be careful if you accidently or impulsively hit something.
You have little control over your bounces.

name: Freezing Skulls
description: You can grant youself by creating ice sculptured skulls and throw it at your enemies and you can throw up to nine, but. The worst thing you can do to them is those iced skulls actually bite and freeze them stiff that can give out to a new meaning of Bone Chilling.
summary: The ability to send icy skulls at your opponent, then freeze them solid.
strengths: You'll be having fun with this ability when you give your opponents the chills.
weaknesses: None.

name: Interbody Transfer
description: Ever had to empty your bladder, but you can't get to the bathroom, but you see someone else going in? You can teleport your urine into their bladder instead. Teleport your kidneys to a child in need. Teleport the spoiled food you just ate into someone else's stomach. Teleport that bullet you just took into your attacker's brain. But, you cannot take things from others, only send them. Just be careful what you send. The only limit is what's inside of you at the moment. Got cancer? Not anymore.
summary: The ability to teleport anything inside your body to someone else's body.
strengths: Remove any offending objects from your own body
Never worry about diseases, viruses, or anything else invading your body
Can send away objects that are even partially in your body, but only the part that is inside of you
weaknesses: The objects must go into someone else's body.
You must know about the object to purge it
To teleport dangerous things into people, they first have to be inside of your own body

name: Pokemon Maker
description: You can make your own pokemon with ease.
summary: The ability to create your own pokemon
strengths: You have cool pokemon you can make
Be the envy of your peers
weaknesses: Pokemon may suck
You might not be creative

name: Cursed Regeneration
description: A person with this power has been cursed to become a servant of some other being eventually. However in the mean time, they have the access to regenerative abilities that regrow their bodies to the ones desired by the one who granted the curse. The regrown body parts are indestructible and can give the user of this curse superstrength. However this curse can only be given by someone that dislikes you and they might send hoardes of soldiers to injure you more.
summary: The ability to regenerate except the cells destroyed are replaced with indestructable cursed cells
strengths: Can regenerate from fatal injuries
The new cells are indestructable
Cursed muscle cells give you some degree of superstrength
weaknesses: The person that cursed you must be someone that dislikes you.
Once your whole body becomes cursed you will become the eternal servant to whoever cursed you
The cursed cells prevent you from killing the person that cursed you

name: Sawtooth Fingerprint
description: With this ability you are a covert killer. You can push small sawtooth blades from beneath the skin in your fingers. These blades pop up from between the grooves of your fingerprint and are incredibly sharp. Slice, dice, cut, rip, and shred with your ten deadly digits.
summary: The ability to push small sawtooth blades from between the grooves of your fingers
strengths: A weapon at your fingertips (litterally)
A covert and concealed power
Blades stay sharp
weaknesses: Forgetting to retract the blades
Accidentally cutting yourself

name: Red Sun Beams
description: With this power you can shoot red sun radiation from your hands. Red Sun Radiation can turn Kryptonians into normal humans. Depending on how much red sun radiation you shoot them with the longer they lose their powers for. The red sun radiation also burns non Kryptonians but doesn't make them lose their powers.
summary: The ability to shoot red sun radiation from your hands
strengths: You can turn Kryptonians into normal humans
You can burn non Kryptonians
weaknesses: As long as they're near a yellow sun you cannot make the Kryptonians lose their powers permanently
It only burns non Kryptonians

name: Babushkian Cloning
description: This power sort of lets you be like a russian nesting doll. You make one slightly smaller clone of yourself. That clone can make one clone slightly smaller than himself and so on and so on. The smallest clone of a clone can be no smaller than a nanomachine. If one clone in the clone chain is killed all the clones vanish. If a growth power is used on any of the clones,all the clones vanish. Using other copying powers on any of these clones also causes the chain of clones to vanish.
summary: The ability to make smaller and smaller copies of yourself.
strengths: A microscopic or smaller version of yourself could be useful.
A half-sized version of you could be helpful.
weaknesses: It takes time to get the smallest version of yourself.
One clone dies,all the clones die.
You can't make these clones any bigger in size.

name: Masculinization
description: Someone affected by this power will become more masculine in both mind and body. They will start to act like how they think a proper guy acts. Their body will also bulk up and they will gain a fully masculine body (legs, abdomen, arms, etc). Females affected by this will still act feminine, but more tomboy-ish.
summary: The ability to cause someone to become more masculine
strengths: They will be unaware that they are changing until pointed out.
weaknesses: Can be reversed, but only by other powers.

name: Tournament Field
description: You can choose an area of 4 square kilometers in which people are allowed to enter with a group of no less than 3 beings. While in the area only one person can fight at a time. If someone tries to attack an enemy while a member of their group is fighting someone else, the whole group immediately gets a cruel and unusual punishment game. The game chosen is random every single time. Don't bother trying to avoid the punishment game, because that results in death for anyone who tries.
summary: The ability to create a battlefield area where only one person in a group of three can fight at a time
strengths: Great to lure enemies into and hire mercenaries.
Telling allies the restrictions but not enemies or people who wander into the area.
Setting up cameras to watch the punishment games.
weaknesses: Punishments affect friends as well as enemies.
Have to manually alter the terrain yourself, this power only designates the zone.
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Enhancement: Mending
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it causes the power to repair objects and buildings when used. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power repair damaged objects when used
strengths: Repair your fortifications with Omni-Directional Blast.
Used in combination with either Enhancement: Healing and people will love you.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.

name: Aura Of Purification
description: Anyone who stands in the aura of someone with this power will be purified of evil and become more inclined to do acts of good.
summary: The ability to purify others of evil by keeping them in one's aura
strengths: Artifacts and places can also be purified by keeping them in your aura.
weaknesses: Anything that leaves your aura can still become (more) evil.

name: Teleport To Master
description: With this power you can teleport straight to wherever your master is whether it is 100 yards away or on the other side of the universe. Doesn't matter whether what kind of a master they are or whether or not you want them to be your master. Also works if you acknowledge them as your master but they don't acknowledge themself as your master.
summary: The ability to teleport to where one's master is located at
strengths: You can help your master whenever they need help.
You can make it to classes on time (teacher).
weaknesses: You are unable to teleport back home.
You cannot teleport to other dimensions until the higher levels.

name: Percussive Awakening
description: With this ability the user can awaken anyone, from any degree, or type of sleep by hitting them. This includes naps, to comas, to even eternal sleep, this counters superpowers and magic, that induce sleep. This power also creates thirty minutes of immunity to sleep related powers.
summary: The ability to wake anyone by hitting them.
strengths: Wake up a comatose friend.
Thirty minute immunity to sleep powers.
weaknesses: Friends who make you hit yourself in your sleep.
You could accidently hit yourself.

name: Super Forget
description: With this power whenever you point at somebody they forget what they were doing when you pointed at them. So if your enemy is building a weapon of destruction or aiming a gun at your head or something you can just point at them and they will forget about it. You can do this as many times as you want to the same person or you can use it against a bunch of people by pointing at several different people.
summary: The ability to point at someone and make them forget what they were doing
strengths: You can make people forget what they were doing by pointing at them
weaknesses: Just because they forgot they were doing it doesn't mean they won't think of doing it again

name: Death Memory Sight
description: By making physical contact with the corpse, he or she will be able to tap into the memories and thoughts of the deceased's life, but only while in contact with the corpse.
summary: The ability to see into the past of the dead
strengths: It will be easy was to find who murdered the deceased
An easy way to discover the secrets of the long dead
weaknesses: Morbid thoughts and seeing the death of the body
Can cause slight insanity if you accept the dead's memories and personality too well.

name: Myth Power: Methe's Mirth
description: Methe (Methyse, Methyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of drunkenness. As such, channeling her allows one to withstand, as well as psychically manipulate drunkenness, at will. In addition, one can psychically elect to give in to the effects of drunkenness, at will, which improves both fighting and weapon skill. One can also psychically perceive subjects' drunken hallucinations, at will. One can even psychically realize said hallucinations, at will, so they affect foes as though they were real.

name: 2 For The Show
description: With this power you can have as many tickets as you need or any show. You can get the tickets for any row or seat you want. This power works for any play, movie, concert, sporting event, opera, ice show etc. Unless it's already sold out.

name: Waifu Control
description: Some people become obsessed with fictional worlds, or even fall in love with fictional characters. You can control that. You can make someone fall in/out of love with a character, change their soulmate to a character, make them desire a fictional world more than the real one (or solve that problem). You can even make characters and worlds respond in kind, 'desiring' a person, though you have less control. At maximum level, you can bridge between fiction and reality, if it's in the name of love.

name: Tattoo Artist
description: With this power you can cause yourself or others to suddenly have tattoos anywhere on their body. You can send people messages by causing words to appear on their body or frighten people by causing scary images to appear on them. name: The Colt
description: (This gun is very wear ) this looks like the colt M1892. This gun can kill all most anything. This gun has Latin inscriptions on it, it says I fear no evil. This gun can't kill Lucifer or god. This gun is deadly in the wrong hands. Know your history.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours06)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Mesembria (Noon Hour, Midday), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when noon hits. One can also psychically project one's vision to anywhere beneath the midday sun, at will. One can even psychically generate noonday heat/light, 12x stronger, at will.

name: Chew Bubblegum And Kick Ass

High accuracy

name: Guardian Helmet
description: Once a user wears the Guardian helmet, the source of power and recognition for the intergalactic peace force known as the Guardian Corps,he or she will be granted its power which includes the ability to fly, survive in space, limited invulnerability, scanning abilities, database access to the Guardian's database and the ability to create hardlight constructs via the Guardian star that serves as the helmet's power souce

Meet different peaple

name: Quartz Tag
description: This ability allows the user to tag an object or organism, through direct contact, with small quartz particles. The particles are psychically linked to the user and can be tracked anywhere in the world. If the quartz particles make it into the blood of a living organism they can override the effects of personal psychic canceling abilities.

name: Dream Database
description: With this power whenever you touch a person you can be able to see every single dream they've had (while sleeping) throughout their entire life. Even dreams they themselves can't recall having.

name: Tornado Spin
description: Just like the Tasmanian Devil (Taz) from Looney Tunes, you can spin extremely fast, until you become like a miniature tornado. The speed and strength of the spin depends, and can get stronger with practice, but usually is strong enough to tear through obstacles, and deflect projectiles (even to tunnel into the ground). name: The Whisperer
description: This power allows you to send your whispers to any location that you can think of. If you begin to speak louder than a whisper while using this power, this power will automatically reduce the loudness of your words. The resulting words are ten to twenty decibels. name: Ghost Writing
description: To harness this power, you have to choose a keyword; for example, "super". Every time you write the word "super" you turn into a ghost temporarily. In this state, you have the standard ghost powers (flying, intangibility, invisibility, etc. ) After thirty minutes, the power will wear off, and you will not be able to use this power for the rest of the day (unless you develop it). name: De Zombinizer
description: If anyone or everybody is bitten and/or infected, the De-Zombinizer allows you to turn people back to their normal state just by releasing a lime mist with a gesture of your hand.

strengths: Can cure any or everyone who's totally zombified.

name: Bioacoustic Disruption
description: Bioacoustic Disruption is the psionic ability to disrupt mechanisms of communication within species. One with this ability could psionically disable a foe's ability to speak or to hear, making communication extremely difficult. This ability could be used to render a person deaf (so that he can't hear warnings or understand people who try to talk to him) or mute (so that they can still hear, but they cannot respond back to what they are being asked or told).

name: Pokemon Taker

Townsaver then augments its strength and speed to the point that it could slay entire armies. While Townsaver is drawn, its user cannot die by any means regardless of injuries. After the fighting has stopped, all the strength and speed disappear, and if the person is badly wounded they will die.

strengths: Super-strength, Speed, and Limited Invulnerability

They are not protected on the outside.

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Envy
description: By gaining the abilities of Envy one gains numerous benefits. The first is a great shapeshifting ability, you are able to shape shift into a real or fictional person as long as they way less. You also gain incredible speed and strength, no matter what form you are in.
summary: The ability to gain the abilities of Envy.
strengths: Transformation.
Speed and strength.
weaknesses: If others become better than you, your envy shall get to the better of you.
Your eyes are your greatest weak spots.

name: Predator Creator
description: Your hands fire invisible beams that when they strike an object, makes them instantly evil and out to kill. This works for living things (like turning a giraffe into a superpredator by making grow sharp teeth), technology (like making a car suddenly drive itself, run people over), and even everyday objects (like pens would chase you bouncing with their springs, stab your vein, contract their ink reservoir, and inject you with toxic ink). You cannot mentally control them, they just want to kill.
summary: The ability to make any living or nonliving object instantly become murderous
strengths: You can make multiple things predatory at once, and it doesn't wear off, unless you take their power
The most harmless looking objects can jump in peoples tracheas, choking them
Living things and machines can change themselves to become killers (grow teeth, horns, etc. )
weaknesses: Non-living objects (besides machines) cannot change themselves, only stretch and contract to move
Because you don't have control of them, they can attack and harm you as well
Most things will be to easy to destroy (like predatory porcelain) and some things simply can't move.

name: Mime Control
description: Worried of mimic power users? Transform yourself into a mime and fully control them by your body actions and gestures.
summary: The ability to control mimic power users.
strengths: You can use your other abilities while this is activated.
This cannot be copied or absorbed.
Make fun of others.
weaknesses: Works only for mimic ability users.
Control only one person at a time.
Kick your victim, you'll be kick as well(unless you teleport,etc. To avoid)

name: Myth Power: Algos' Affliction
description: Algos (Algus) and the Algea, in Greek myth, were the gods of pain, suffering, sorrow and distress. As such, channeling Achos (Physical Pain), one can psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will. Channeling Lupe (Mental Pain) one can psychically induce and manipulate mental pain at will. Channeling Ania (Distress, Trouble), one can psychically perceive factors that annoy, bother, trouble or distress the foe, and psychically manipulate probability to bring about said factors at will.
summary: The ability to channel Algos and the Algea's command over the essence of sadness, pain, misery, grief and suffering
strengths: Psychically induce and manipulate physical pain at will
Psychically induce and manipulate mental pain (sadness, worry, regret, trauma, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, and bring about factors which distress and trouble the foe at will
weaknesses: Cannot transfer pain or psychological trauma to/from self or others until developed (NCN)
Aniothability, Mental Immunity, etc provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Hecate's Hex
description: Hecate (Hekate), in Greek myth, was the goddess of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads. As such, channeling her endows powerful magic; one can brew magic potions and charms (such as love charms, transmutation potions and magic remedies), hex foes, etc. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits and witches, as well as withstand magic/necromantic effects. Furthermore, one gains physical and magic power during the new moon, and at crossroads.
summary: The ability to channel Hekate's command over the essence of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads
strengths: Powerful magic at your disposal (hex/jinx/curse foes, assist allies, shapeshift, cast illusion, etc)
Psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits/undead and witches/necromancers/mages
Become more physically and magically powerful during the New Moon and/or at crossroads
weaknesses: Cannot compel ghosts/spirits/undead, witches/mages or black dogs until the higher levels (NCN)
Until the higher levels, even immune to direct magical BENEFITS (NCN)
Disrespecting spirits (desecrate graves, etc), directly harming spirits or mages disrupts power use

name: Burning Blood
description: This power only works when the blood is outside of your body and is at the user's will. The blood will burn at the temperature of regular flames. You are immune to flames created with this power.
summary: The ability to have one's blood ignite in flames.
strengths: If you're bleeding, it is bad for your enemies.
weaknesses: You need to lose blood to use this power.

name: Scar Empowerment
description: The larger the number of scars you have the higher your physical strength, endurance, and speed are, as well as all other powers you have being boosted by 1% for each scar you have. In order to gain this power one person has to punch OR kick you 10,000 times at full force.
summary: The ability to be empowered by the number of scars one has
strengths: Having this power, 'Blades of Pain', and 'Scarred'.
weaknesses: An enemy with 'Scarred' can make this power useless.
Getting lots of scars will hurt and take time.

name: Glucokinesis
description: Glucokinesis, also called Sucrokinesis, Saccharokinesis or Sugar Manipulation is the ability to manipulate sugar crystals. This includes moving it, moving substances containing it, forming it into crystalline constructs, changing it into various physical states, altering its presence in bodies (including within humans and plants) and the like. One could even whip it at foes with force enough to flay flesh, if enough is gathered.
summary: The ability to manipulate sugar
strengths: Sugar and anything sugary/sweet can now be used as a weapon
Flavor (sweeten) foods or remove excess sugar from foods (don't betray your diet)
Extract sugar from various sources (including from living organisms, and out of foods)
weaknesses: Eating too much sugar can be unhealthy
Crystallokinesis, when developed, can overpower this ability
People with Sugar Rush are immune to this ability

name: Tripler Du Canon De Venin
description: Manifest a cannon, two for each arm and one for the back, charge energy and then fire a huge amount of power to cause huge damage
summary: The ability to produce triple cannons that release powerful energy
strengths: Destroy any enemy in its path
Extremely fast power blasts
Can reduce a mountain to rubble
weaknesses: Can't be used more than once a day
Huge consumption for amount of power used
Has to sleep for 24 hours after eating huge consumption

name: Neutrophil Granulocyte Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. You can detect hurt friends and enter combat mode as soon as you find them. In combat mode, you can stick to and absorb foes, killing them. You can absorb up to 25 foes, before you die. You can also produce a poisonous gas which only affects foes, paralysing them and slowly killing them.
summary: The ability to be attracted to harmed friends, stick to/absorb foes and produce a foe-specific poisonous gas.
strengths: You can sense if a friend is hurt and locate them. It even works if you are already in combat mode.
When you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level until you absorb them.
You enter combat mode as soon as you find your hurt friend in order to defend them.
weaknesses: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.
If you absorb too many foes, you'll die.

name: Spiritual Converse
description: The gifted person can see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits (living and dead) from ALL forms of life. Spirits of deceased (both human, animal and plant), Spirits from nature, Spirits from the Elements, Angels, Demons, Gods, small spirits from All forms of energy, Spirits residing in flowers, trees, and anything living. The user can communicate both verbally and telepathically.
summary: The ability to see, hear and communicate with ALL spirits.
strengths: The user is gifted to be the diplomat between the natural and the supernatural.
The user can negotiate with troublesome ghosts and malevolent spirits of natural disasters.
The person is never alone and can use the spirits as intuitive messengers, and protectors.
weaknesses: Negotiations are not always 100%
The person has this uncontrollable ability to attract ALL spirits (good and bad).
Everything is making sounds. There is NO privacy or quiet time.

name: Snack Time!
description: With this ability, you can have a snack anytime. You can summon as many snacks as you want. Snacks disappear after 48 hours. You can't summon meals or drinks with this power. No exceptions.
summary: The ability to have a snack anytime!
strengths: Have a snack whenever you want!
No limit to the amount of snacks!
Have a midnight snack!
weaknesses: You can't summon meals.
You can't summon drinks.
No exceptions.

name: Acid Immunity
description: No acid will ever hurt someone with this power.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by acids of any kind and strength
strengths: You can still digest food since the acid isn't hurting you.
Enemies with only powers having to do with acid.
weaknesses: Bases can still hurt you.

name: Osmosis Manipulation
description: Osmosis is essential to the human body; we use it when we breathe, cells get nutrients with it, and we couldn't live without it. This process is now in your power! With this ability, you can take in substances through your skin like oxygen, water, etc. You can also mess around with other people's osmosis so their cells don't get enough oxygen.
summary: The ability to control your osmosis and that of people around you
strengths: Take in more oxygen than your lungs normally do, drastically reducing the need to breathe.
Stop your enemies' cells from getting any nutrients, thereby destroying their major organs.
Change anything else in the world that requires osmosis.
weaknesses: You are more susceptible to poison.
Your chances of getting sick increases when you use your power: skin is part of the immune system.
Swimming in salt water causes your blood pressure to skyrocket.

name: Ability Devolution
description: This ability lowers the abilities of others down to their first state of development. This could make other abilities nearly worthless. A good example would be if someone could raise a tidal wave, then with this ability, it will reduce it into raising a small amount of water. Most of the time during this ability's effect, it could turn against the user of the other ability if not mastered.
summary: The ability to turn other abilities to their low-level form.
strengths: Weakens enemies ways of attacks.
Turns ability users' abilities against them.
weaknesses: Might affect your other abilities.
Short- time effect.

name: Talent Granting
description: A talent is a group of aptitudes useful for some activity, or qualities that make someone who has them espically good at a certain thing. A talent granter can imbue someone with these qualities. They cannot, however, imbue anyone with qualities beyond normal human capabilities, such as intangibility or flight.
summary: The ability to imbue others with talents or special skills.
strengths: Can grant anyone with a talent of your choice.
It is possible to grant yourself a talent, at the expense of losing this ability
weaknesses: Contact is required
Can't grant super-human qualities
Can't grant more than one talent per person, but you can take a talent back.

name: Body Fat Manipulation
description: With this power, the user can use their own weight for multiple purposes. For example, one could make the fat on the front of their body become bulletproof or even use fat to enhance their strength. One of the many other applications of this power is to burn it rapidly, granting a massive energy boost (such as for powers) but it makes you lose your fat--a precious resource. The holder can store a limited amount of fat extra-dimensionally. With training, you can control your metabolism.
summary: The ability to manipulate body fat.
strengths: To prepare for a fight, simply become obese.
You can steal fat from others.
Can give regenerative stem cells.
weaknesses: If you can't gain weight easily, this is pointless.
There are some powers that prevent weight gain.
There are plenty of medical conditions which can cause weight loss.

name: Gift Of Ezechiel
description:
It is said in the Bible that the prophet Ezechiel ate a scroll containing some divine prophecies: the scroll tasted like honey and after eating it he was able to report word by word everything was written there. 
Everyone who possess this power can eat every text (written on papery or another digestible support): in this way, the subject can learn by heart the text and repeat it word by word. Useful for students (XD).
summary: The ability to memorize every written text by eating it.
strengths: The subject is able to learn a big quantity of texts;
He also learns all the information contained in these texts;
He can bring back to memory every page or paragraph learned during his life by association of ideas.
weaknesses: Not every support is digestible, and also eating too much paper is not so healthy.
The text must be totally readable;
The risk of "information indigestion" is high; if taken too much information at once you risk coma.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth4)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Carpo (Karpo, Damia- Ripening, Ripe Fruit) allows one to psychically summon ripe fruit, at will, as well as ripening unripened fruit, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location with ripe fruit, at will. Furthermore, one can gain physical power by eating ripe fruit. One can even produce the aroma of ripe fruit, to attract and/or intoxicate subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically summon ripe fruit, and ripen unripe fruit, by touch, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere with ripe fruit, at will
Gain physical power from eating ripe fruit; produce the aroma of ripe fruit to attract/intoxicate
weaknesses: Cannot turn into an immovable, indestructible divine fruit tree, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically turn normal fruit into magical fruit (Golden Apples, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Beautification Vision
description: With this ability, one merely has to look at an individual and they will immediately express the standard of beauty in that time and place for a person of their race and gender. For instance, all will become young and females will enjoy low body fat while males will experience enhanced muscle tone. Once transformed, they will revert back over time, but the effect can be reapplied. There will be no consequences before, during or after the transformation, nor after reverting.
summary: The ability to induce the current standard on any individual through sight.
strengths: Can be applied to yourself by simply looking at any part of yourself.
Change others to boost self esteem or even financial reward.
If applied continuously, targets can enjoy eternal youth and immunity to any disfiguring illnesses.
weaknesses: Restricted to the general standard of beauty, not your own.
Cannot bring back then dead (cannot restore someone to the beauty inherent in life).
Cannot cure diseases, only remove the visible signs of them.

name: Cat Tastrophe
description: This power will allow you to have extend-able claws, jump incredibly accurately and "fft!" at your enemy.
summary: The ability to have all the powers of a feline.
strengths: Conceal your claws easily.
weaknesses: You are easily frightened by Dogs.

name: Resurrection Sacrifice
description: If you bring back to life one person, you will offer one year of your lifespan. Two persons, two years, etc.
summary: The ability to bring someone who died to life again by offering certain years of your lifespan
strengths: You can bring your lovers to life
weaknesses: Your lifespan will be reduced
You can bring back one person each year
You will feel weak after using this power

name: Reverse Possession
description: Instead of allowing a ghost to possess YOU, YOU can possess a ghost. This ability allows you to climb into a ghost's form and gain control of its mind. You then have all the powers of a ghost and partial invulnerability. Note: This power is only to be used on friendly spirits. Evil spirits can override your control and destroy you. Friendly spirits tend to forgive and forget.
summary: The ability to be able to possess ghosts.
strengths: You can possess a ghost.
You gain all of the ghost's powers.
In this state, you are partially invulnerable.
weaknesses: If you do this on evil spirits... They'll destroy you.

name: Melanopsin Cell Mimicry
description: A type of Neuron Mimic. While exposed to light, especially a blue light, you can convert it into electricity, as well as special signals, and your body clock will remain stuck to wakefulness, keeping you alert and active no matter how much sleep you need. By sending the signals to someone's visual cortex (the back of the head in humans), you may make them see what you see, though it will be unconsciously, as well as keep them awake. Also, this power responds slowly to changes of lighting.
summary: The ability to stay awake when exposed to light, convert light into electricity and make people see what you see.
strengths: You can electrocute someone when you're exposed to light.
The brighter and bluer the light, the more effective this power will be.
Feeling sleepy? Take a light therapy.
weaknesses: When you go from darkness to light, this power needs time to activate.
When you go from light to darkness, this power needs time to deactivate.
You can make people see what you see, but they may not notice as it affects unconscious sight.

name: Emotional Body Color Change
description: With this power you can change your skin color depending on your emotion. You can turn this power on and off whenever you want. When you're angry you turn red, happy yellow, sad blue, lovestruck pink, confused purple, determined orange, excited green, scared white, brave gray. This is good if you want to be able to camouflage with something all you have to do is feel a certain emotion and you change colors. The stronger you feel the emotion the darker the color is. You can use this on others too
summary: The ability to change your skin color depending on your emotion
strengths: You can change your color by feeling emotions
You can turn the power on and off
You can use it on others to see what they're feeling
weaknesses: Not much use in combat

name: Instant Friends
description: You want to be friends with someone right, but they hate you, use this power, and presto! You got a new friend. It also works on celebrities too.
summary: The ability to make anyone your friend.
strengths: Get friends quick.
Be able to go to more parties.
Meet celebrities.
weaknesses: There is such as thing as too many friends
Friends may fight for your attention

name: Endless Passageway
description: This power can affect any delimited area used for passage, such as corridors, roads, bridges, stairs, ladders, walkways or tunnels. You can make one end of any passageway unreachable. So, anyone who enters from the unaffected end will have the impression of advancing, but the other end will never get closer to them. Their only way out is to go back the way they came, unless you decide to switch your power to the other end.
summary: The ability to make the end of a passageway unreachable.
strengths: You can protect your secret hideout by affecting the passageways leading to it.
You can make a maze unexitable by affecting the very last corridor.
With practice, you can discriminate who should be stuck in the passageway and who may pass.
weaknesses: They can still reach the other end if they step out of the boundaries of the passageway.

name: Like Spell
description: This ability allows you to cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else. You can also use the spell to make anyone like you. The duration of the spell depends on how much someone liked someone else before the spell. If someone hated someone else (or you), the spell only lasts 3 hours. If someone already liked someone, the spell lasts 3 months. The spell duration varies. Someone might like someone else (or you) even if the spell wears off. The effects wear off if you tell them about the spell.
summary: The ability to cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else.
strengths: Make people like (not love) others.
Make friends more easily.
Even works on people who dislike others or you.
weaknesses: Spell must remain a secret. Telling them about the spell breaks it.
Spell doesn't last as long on those who dislike the other person.
Someone might like you even if the spell wears off. Bad if you don't like them.

name: Bubbles Blast
description: This power gives one the power to summon a large ammount of bubbles that have two effects when they burst. One they form an impenetrable fog around in the room the user is in, or the direct area of affect. Two, when the bubbles burst they cause the temperature in the direct area of affect to drop drastically.   This power is naturally weak against wind and fire attacks, and is purely deffensive in nature.
summary: The ability to summon a large ammount of bubbles that burst into a impenetrable fog.
strengths: Clouds your foe's line of sight.
Causes temp to drop drastically.
weaknesses: Weak against Fire and Wind type attacks.
Purely a deffensive power.

name: Human Jack Hammer
description: When you jab or punch an object it will be slowly smashed or worn down because your fist is super hard and it moves very fast.
summary: The ability to smash an object by rapidly jabbing or punching it
strengths: Can easily destroy an obstacle in your way.
weaknesses: Bad if you jab a human.

name: Foe Cloning
description: When you defeat someone in battle you gain their shadow (a perfect likeness of him/her with all their powers). A few problems are: though you can collect any shadow, you can use only one at a time and you can't move while using it. If an enemy beats you you don't get their shadow, and magical people seem to be immune to it.
summary: The ability to contol any a clone of anyone you defeat
strengths: Control anyone you ever fought
You will be in two places at once
Instant shadow switches
weaknesses: If they beat you you'll NEVER get their shadow
Totally frozen in place while using
Most magic users are immune to having shadows stolen

name: Gift: Emotions
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling emotions than other beings. Thus their emotion-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of emotions from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve emotion-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of emotions
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over emotions as someone with this power.
Emotion-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only emotion-based powers now.

name: Unison Raid
description: This last a relatively short amount of time, but allowes to increase overall power as well as utility of skills. 1st Person gains all the powers of the 2nd person, and the 2nd person, losing their body, follows the 1st as a ghost, untill Unison Raid is cancelled.
summary: The ability to combine two individuals and their powers into one body.
strengths: Increases overall power.
Allows for the 1st person to use powers without having to worry about co-ordinating with a teammate.
Gives full understanding and mastery of powers for the duration.
weaknesses: Having one fighter instead of two.
Takes up extra energy to maintain, versus fighting as two separate individuals.
Can't be used too often for fear of losing personality.

name: Sunstone
description: The sunstone looks like a multicolored jewel necklace with beads and magatama with limitles solar power. It can be combine with any weapon like the moon blade to enhance  its abilities,repair it if they both get damaged or destoryed, and can combine the weapon with your body.
summary: The ability to use this jewel to enhance weapons
strengths: Enhances the moon blade abilities
Repair if damaged or destoryed
combine your weapon to your body
weaknesses: stay combined too long with your weapon and you will remain like that
going super nova will over heat you and your weapon

name: Shadow Fire
description: This power is a force to be reckoned with. By using this ability you induce damage upon your foe by attacking their shadow. This does not cause heat damage nor does it cause direct physical damage. It causes transferred damage. This power can only be wielded by people who have access to the shadow realm or who have absorbed it with power absorption. The stronger the level the more the damage.
summary: The ability to burn shadows
strengths: Indirect attack
If used in shadow realm it 2x the damage
Not actually fire
weaknesses: To shadows its fire
Can affect user
Sucks if being used against you

name: Baton Of Absorption
description: This magic baton acts as a shield and weapon. When spun, it stores energy for a powerful blow. When the baton is hit by any form of energy while spinning, it absorbs the energy and transforms based on the energy. For example, if the baton absorbs fire energy, it turns red and the two crystal balls on both ends fill with fire and leaves a scorching mark when used on somebody.
summary: The ability to wield an attack-absorbing baton
strengths: Excellent shield
Uses stored energy to attack enemies
Absorbs all kinds of energy
weaknesses: Whatever you do, do NOT break the crystal balls storing the energy

name: Unicity
description: This ability allows you to resist being added on to or increased. This means that you cannot be increased in size, possessed, mind controlled, forcibly psychically linked, given powers forcibly , or other things which add on to the body, mind, powers, or spirit of the person. It also prevents foreign agents from growing in or on you and can allow you to prevent any transformation that causes you to increase in some way whether physical or not. As a side affect you cannot get cancer.
summary: The ability to resist being added on to or increased.
strengths: Resist being given least wanted powers.
Cannot be possessed or mind controlled as it adds to the spirit or mind.
