If you have powers to add on to yourself you are capable of doing so.
weaknesses: Does not protect against other types of damage.
Still affected by powers that reduce you.
Does not protect you from being totally destroyed.

name: Fish Control
description: With this poer you have complete control over any species of fish, including sharks. If you're fighting underwater, you can have a shark or swordfish come and attack your enemy. You could also use this power to cheat in fishing competitions.
summary: The ability to control any species of fish
strengths: You can control any species of fish
You can make sharks and swordfish attack your enemies
You can cheat in fishing competitions
weaknesses: Has no use if you're not fighting in or at least near the water
Has no affect on sea mammals

name: Dissolvilcation
description: Your fingers are glowing with a bright greenish aura and you shoot a beam at your opponent's head that causes it to explode into bloody pieces while their body will dissolve into a puddle of dark yellow or lime-ish goo.
summary: The ability to shoot beams from your fingertips that cause your foe's head to explode and their bodies to melt.
strengths: A kind of a weird fatality.
weaknesses: Totally gross.

name: Hypno Dance (Entrancing Dance)
description: Simply by dancing you can induce a trance in any person that is watching you. Clearly the person must be able to see, and must be looking at you when you begin your dance. Any interruptions before the full effect of your dance takes place will free the target unless he is foolish enough to stare at you again. That being said the skill makes excellent crowd control and through the use of video, like Youtube the possibilities are limitless. Once you stop dancing the effect fades in 20 minutes.
summary: The ability to dance in such a manner that any person watching is mesmerized.
strengths: You can compel men to do what you want.
Excellent crowd control
Get back at your ex
weaknesses: Only works for fthe opposite sex
Victims must be able to see
Physically taxing

name: Vocal Powered Strength
description: A person with this power has superstrength but only when they are talking. The good thing is that their strength increase the louder that they speak. However the limitation of talking can be very troublesome especially if people know about this weakness. For example, if you are gagged you cannot use your superstrength. Also is someone uses gas or other corrosive it can hurt your lungs.
summary: The ability to have superstrength when you are talking
strengths: Your voice gives you superstrength
The louder you speak the more powerful you get--there is no limit
weaknesses: If you cannot speak then this power is useless ie sickness, gagged, etc.
Swallowing flies, getting hit with tear gas, having objects crammed down to shut you up
Can't use this to do a surprise attack

name: Gift: Plants
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling plants than other beings. Thus their plant-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of plants from them. However, someone with this power can only receive plant-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of plants
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over plants as someone with this power.
Plant-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only plant-based powers now.

name: Mole Detector
description: With this power you will know if their is a traitor or mole within your team or group. If a person is secretly revealing information or fighting for your enemies you will instantly know who it is and how they are interacting with the enemy. With practise, you can sense betrayal in other groups too.
summary: The ability to sense if there is a mole within your team or group
strengths: You will know if their is a mole or traitor within your team or group
With practise, you can sense betrayal in other groups too
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
No use if their is no traitor or mole

name: Half Tanuki
description: You will have racoon-like ears and a racoon-like tail. Your physical strength and speed will be higher than that of a normal humans. Your magical power will be boosted especially for shapeshifting and healing magic.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-tanuki
strengths: People will continuously want your help for healing.
weaknesses: People will hate the tricks you play on them.
Very obvious that you're not normal.

name: Unsnappable
description: Powers that need a snap to activate can't have any effect on you.
summary: The ability to be immune to powers that are activated by snapping
strengths: Snap power immunity
weaknesses: None

name: Object Splitting
description: You can split any object in two by running your finger around it in a complete loop. It will split along the line you draw. If you have a hollow object, the two halves will act as if still connected. For instance, if you split a straw, you can put one half in a drink and drink remotely through the other half. In this way, you can remove your limbs and operate them from a distance. However, once the object is split, it cannot be rejoined. You could put some tape around it but it wouldn't be same.
summary: The ability to split objects and form portals between the two halves
strengths: Split any object in two easily
Operate limbs remotely
Perpetual motion now possible
weaknesses: Must be able to draw a complete, non-stop line around the object
Object can never be truly rejoined
Portals only available with hollow objects

name: King Of The Super Gators
description: With this power you can summon and control super powered alligators. The alligators can fly, breathe fire, have super strength, enhanced agility, sharp teeth and bulletproof skin. You can summon up to 20 super gators at a time and can unsummon them when you're done with them. The gators can stand on their two hind legs but cannot speak or write only communicating through growls and other animalistic sounds. The gators also have all of the abilities of a normal gator like breathing underwater.
summary: The ability to summon and control super powered alligators
strengths: You can summon and control up to twenty super gators
If one dies you can just summon another one
You can unsummon them when you're done with them
weaknesses: They cannot talk to you
You can't summon regular alligators or any kind of crocodile

name: Death Eater's Hunger
description: Death Eaters being what they are, mock & sneer upon the very existence of life in this realm. For them, only death & decay, which are most often than not inevitable, are the only absolute truth that nature must eventually obey & submit to. Through this ability they are able to ultimately cast insult to life & to anyone who futilely attempt to keep it by inexplicably transforming that ability to live or its energy into the absolute existence of death in the form of dark viscous blob-orb of death.
summary: The ability to transmute life energy into bite sized orbs of death.
strengths: You do not simply end life; you distort, corrupt, & reverse its existence and function.
These death orbs can be consumed by a death eater or manipulated into other useful forms.
Very pleasing for anyone who thrives on the death of other's.
weaknesses: The meaning, essence, and existence of life is ultimately altered.
Immortality

name: Frictionless
description: If you are being hold onto, you will easily be able to slide right out of their arms. You can also slide on the ground without stopping until you de-activate your power & produce friction again.
summary: The ability to become frictionless
strengths: Become slippery
Slide for miles without stopping
weaknesses: Have to becareful when sliding or you might run into something

name: Gigantization
description: The opposite spectrum of shrinking. You can make things behemoth size--be it a person, building, animal, plant. They will grow to a max of 25,000 feet in height. Weight & mass all depends on what is growing. You use this power by touching whatever you want enlarged and it will increase size every second you touch. Living things might find it hard to breathe with increasing altitude & there's the whole "giant rampage" issue that could occur. The object retains its huge size for 12 hours.
summary: The ability to make objects or people larger in size
strengths: Make objects huge with physical contact
The max height is 25,000 ft (almost the size of Everest)
Clothes on people will grow too
weaknesses: Must keep touching for whatever to grow; can't grow yourself
Living things will find it difficult to breathe when growing too tall
People & animals might crush things

name: Beads/ Marbles To Bombs
description: The user is able to change beads/marbles into bombs that can be used to fight against their enemies. Only 5 beads/ marbles can be changed into bombs at a time.
summary: The ability to change beads/marbles into explosive beads/marbles
strengths: Beads/ marbles are compact an easy to carry
Explosive power is equivalent to a quarter pound of C4
weaknesses: Might run out of marble or beads

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Stone
description: A Philosopher's Stone ignores the law of equivalent exchange for Alchemy, "Mass for Mass". As well as, giving the ability to perform human transmutation and to create homunculus for normal alchemists.
summary: The ability to have your body act like a Philosopher's Stone.
strengths: Could create something out of nothing.
Amplifies ability.
weaknesses: You have to have some kind of Alchemy skill.
Only works on certain skills. If you do soul alchemy, you create weapons.

name: Blessing Of Qing Long
description: Qing-Long is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts and is alternatively known as the Azure Dragon of the East. When facing the direction east, you will be imbued with all the strength of a dragon, as well as control over the element of wood.
summary: The ability to become as strong as a dragon as long as you are facing east.
strengths: Become as powerful as a dragon.
Control plants and the wind.
Always know which direction east is.
weaknesses: You must be facing east for powers to activate.

name: Slifer The Sky Dragon
description: (This powers is scary and should not be used unless you have no choice) you have all of his powers and memories but at the risk of binding your soul to the god.
summary: The ability to turn into Slifer the Sky Dragon from Yu-Gi-Oh
strengths: Your power level increases one thousand times for each other power you have
You are master of the sky and the weather in this form
weaknesses: You look like a two jawed dragon
Slifer the Sky Dragons strength is its weakness
tags: master of the sky and weather

name: Myth Power: Panope's Panoply
description: Panope (Panopeia, Panopea) is the goddess of the vast view of the sea's horizon from a height, by which sailors spot land and oncoming storms. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any location one can see the sea/ocean on the horizon, at will. One can even psychically transport a subject's soul, by touch, out to a random spot on the sea, where it remains until retrieved.
summary: The ability to channel Panope's command over the essence of the sea's broad panorama
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically teleport to anywhere one can see the sea/ocean on the horizon, at will
Psychically transport a subject's soul, by touch, to a random spot on the sea/ocean
weaknesses: Cannot psychically project sight anywhere over the ocean/sea until developed (NCN)
If a soul is not retrieved, by touch, before too long, the subject could starve to death
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Leaf Form
description: With this power you can transform any part of your body into leaves, which you can then control freely. You can change your entire body into a pile of leaves and then move about freely as though sailing on the wind, reforming by bring the leaves back together. You can control what type of leaves you become, reform the parts of your body that the laves make up independent of your whole body, and heal yourself by applying real leaves to any wound to replace the part you lost.
summary: The ability to turn your body into leaves.
strengths: Heal yourself with leaves.
Change yourself into poison oak and fly around.
Midigate damage by transformin into leaves when struck.
weaknesses: Any leaves caught or lost will not be able to reform.

name: Arceusforce: Insect
description: The user of this ability can channel the power over the insect armies under the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Bug-type. The user's skin turns olive green, their irises turn pink and pupils turn green. Under their insectoid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Bug-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Bug attacks such as Bug Bite, Spider Web, Pin Missile, Megahorn and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Bug form.
strengths: The user can resist supernatural combat, plant and earth-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of silk and insectoid aura to perform Bug attacks.
The user can climb walls like a fly.
weaknesses: The user is weak to fire, wind and mineral-based attacks,
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form

name: Tunneling
description: Imagine a mole on steroids. On Java coffee. That is the effect that a Tunneler can achieve. By mentally displacing soil, they can burrow at speeds of up to 75 miles an hour and at depths of up to 2 miles below the surface. The user has a reduced need to breathe while under the surface and a heightened sense of touch (allowing them to "see" what is in their path). However, these bonuses only apply while Tunnelling.
summary: The ability to move quickly underground by displacing soil
strengths: Speeds of up to 75 mph
Depths of up to 2 miles
Reduced need to breathe + radar sense
weaknesses: Running into bedrock
Superhero name would suck
Enhancements only apply while tunnelling

name: Piece Of Eden: The Shroud
description: The Shroud can be used to perform miracles such as walking on water, turning water into wine, etc.
summary: The ability to use a shroud that can perform supernatural miracles.
strengths: Can be used to bring people back to life.
Can also be used to bring you back to life.
weaknesses: Enemies can use it.
Can be destroyed and if it is, it will cause a HUGE explosion.

name: Superpower Trap
description: You have to be holding or touching an empty closeable container to activate this power. You can only capture superpowered beings and they must be in the vicinity. Once you have decided on your victim, every nearby superpowered being will hear the tune to 'Pop Goes the Weasel' in their head. At a random moment, the tune will stop and a clown will quickly emerge from the container, grab the victim and pull them inside. It works even with small containers and they can't escape until it is opened.
summary: The ability to capture superpowered beings.
strengths: Fun and suspenseful way to capture a superpowered opponent, regardless of the origin of their power.
The clown has depowering effects on the victim. So, it can even capture intangible beings.
The tune can hint at who may have a superpower as only they can hear it.
weaknesses: Only works if the designated victim has a superpower.
You don't know when the clown will emerge. So, the victim may have the time to flee.
Don't accidently designate yourself.

name: Queen/King Of The Bees
description: With this power you are the king or queen of the bees meaning they do whatever you say; not to mention, you can see what they see, hear what they think, and understand bee dancing and buzzing
summary: The ability to have control of all types of bees
strengths: You can make the bees sting people  you don't like, and command them in other ways
You'll never get stung by bees again (and they'll defend you...even QUEEN bees obey you)
You get free honey (they let you reach into their hive without reacting)
weaknesses: Does not work on hornets, wasps or yellow jackets
Might make them like you too much (follow you everywhere, etc.)

name: Myth Power: Aletheia's Absolute
description: Aletheia (Alatheia, Alethea, Alathea, Alethea, Alethia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of truth, honesty and sincerity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive lies, deception, dishonesty, untruth and insincerity at will. In addition, one can answer nearly any question they encounter with absolute truth. Furthermore, one can psychically force subjects to speak only truth, at will. One can even see through/negate illusions and shapeshifting, and restore lost memories, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Aletheia's command over the essence of truth, honesty and sincerity
strengths: Psychically perceive lies, deception (illusion, shapeshifting, etc), untruth and insincerity at will
Answer nearly any question with absolute truth; psychically force subjects to speak only truth
Psychically see past/prevent/negate illusion and shapeshifting and restore lost memories at will
weaknesses: Kinda turns you into a stickler for the truth
If you tell a lie while using this power, it short-circuits temporarily (honesty is the best policy)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: V.I.P. Access
description: VIP Stands for "very important person". With this ability, the magic gate opens up for you at any event or place with restricted access. This includes waiting in line! Be it a bar, club, concert, or even a government facility, you will be treated as a special VIP guest and will be allowed in (including whoever you are with), free of charge or hassle. You and your friends will roll right in like a rockstar!
summary: The ability to access to all events and venues, free of charge.
strengths: Free access to concerts, bars, and clubs
People will see you as high status by the way you are being treated
Never wait in line at theme parks, movie theaters etc.
weaknesses: You might be allowed in, but having spending money is another issue
You're treated like a VIP, but you're still held accountable for your actions (ie crimes)
You're on your own when it comes to workin the ladies in the VIP lounge

name: Earth Diving
description: Just dive toward the ground and you will break through the earth's crust, eventually coming out the other side. WTF, you say? Excellent question. This power gives you invulnerability, unstoppability, and increased lung capacity only to be used for this purpose. You're gonna need that last one, as this trip will take at least three hours at top speed. You come out on the opposite side, but can redirect to about 15 latitude points with concentration. This can also be used through water.
summary: The ability to dive through the entire earth
strengths: Excellent escape technique
Easy Transportation
Become a one man oil pipline driller
weaknesses: Takes FOREVER
Crazy Scary
May run out of breath

name: Induced Radioactivity
description:
A person with Induced Radioactivity can generate dangerous radiation in massive amounts for a variety of effects including:
*Radiation poisoning
*Radiation burns
*An EMP (Electromagnetic Pulse)
*Heating objects
*And finally, a dangerous atomic blast similar to an Atomic Bomb
summary: The ability to generate harmful radiation
strengths: Extremely powerful
Can stop an army
Only limited by imagination and will
weaknesses: Always emitting some radiation
No peaceful uses
Easy to fatally injure or kill

name: The Terrorizer
description: Imagine if you had the invisibility of Hawley Griffin, the vile methods of Mr. Edward Hyde, the vampirism of Count Dracula, and the immortality of Dorian Gray. With all of that, you can become a monster that'll strike fear into the hearts of good and evil alike. You can drain your opponent's blood, can spy on your enemies, could have brute intense strengh, and never die for a long time.
summary: The ability to transform into a horrifying being with dark various powers.
strengths: Nothing good can come from this ability.
weaknesses: Can accidently kill your family and friends.
Can forever become a vile lunatic.

name: Monkey King (Sun Wukong)
description: With this ability, you become the monkey king, Sun Wukong himself. In the story, Journey to the West the Monkey King was a master shapeshifter knowing over 72 different transformations. He was also a master martial artist with superb strength. His staff, known as Ruyi Jingu Bang was capable of reaching incredible lenghts. Sun can also fly upon a cloud for traveling. With this ability you are nearly invincible and immortal.
summary: The ability to become a legendary figure from Chinese mythology.
strengths: The spells are quite powerful.
Use your cloud for short trips.
It is good to be immortal.
weaknesses: The transformations are imperfect, your tail is still noticeable.
You are still prone to damage and can feel pain.
A habit to play pranks on others.

name: Objection!
description: You can object to anything you want at any time. Things that bother you, tick you off, make you sad, anything at all. But if you do, you won't be able to bring back the thing or person you objected to. So watch what you object to.
summary: The ability to object to anything that annoys you.
strengths: You can object to anything you don't want to listen to.
If there is anything you don't like, you can object to it.
You can get rid of anything you want to.
weaknesses: Certain things shouldn't be objected to.
Once you object you can't go back.
If you don't think about what you object, you may object the wrong thing so think before you object.

name: Mr.Sunshine
description: This power assures that the user will always be bright and sunshiny, even if their mood and their actions reflect just the opposite. One with this ability is constantly surrounded by a warm glow that is reminiscent of sunlight, and can be used as such. In the user's presence, plants get nutrients and grow slightly faster (but never out of control); you cast a glow in the dark, can withstand being sunburned, can withstand intense cold, and (perhaps the best part) you can turn it on/off anytime.
summary: The ability to be constantly surrounded by a warm glow of sunlight
strengths: You constantly radiate warm and comforting sunshine (never too hot or too bright)
All the properties of sunlight (help plants grow, give off heat/light, resist temperature extremes)
When developed, can turn it off and on at will
weaknesses: This power was changed from its original idea (hope the author doesn't mind)
Those who can absorb or manipulate solar energy tend to be a pain
Somtimes the heat, light and radiation you give off depends on your emotions (burn stuff by mistake)

name: Medusa Glare
description: Like the Greek mythical monster Medusa, you will be able to look at someone in the eyes & make them paralyze for a day. It only works if its eye to eye contact though.
summary: The ability to look at someone in the eye & paralyze them
strengths: Paralyze people
weaknesses: Only last for a day
Have to make eye contact

name: Avaritia
description: This is a power that allows the user to create a powerful vacuum that can suck up anything. It's basically similar to a black hole. It's activated by using one's hands to create the vacuum(hole). Anything that is sucked into the hole can be used later on by the user, for example weapons or even people(as shields).
summary: The ability to create a vacuum that can suck up anything
strengths: Can suck up just about anything
Very powerful and hard to avoid
weaknesses: Hard to control and may inadvertently suck up something not intended
Has a time limit, doesn't last forever
Its power and size depend on the overall strength and ability of the user

name: Mind Freak
description: Ever wondered how Criss Angel performs all his insane stunts? With this power, you can, too! This ability lets the user levitate, walk on water, make things disappear and reappear, and escape from impossible situations. You are still human, though, and can die.
summary: The ability to possess all the powers of master illusionist Criss Angel
strengths: Levitate, disappear, and other cool powers
Escape from practically anything
Be awesome in general
weaknesses: People will constantly be asking how you do it
You scare little kids

name: Space Vehicles
description: With this ability you can turn your body into any type of space vehicle real or fictional such as a Space Shuttle, Star Ship, UFO etc.
summary: The ability to transform into any kind of space vehicle
strengths: You can travel through space
weaknesses: You can only travel through space while in vehicle mode

name: Mind Eraser
description: The power to erase stuff in your mind--intense traumas, irrational fears, etc.
summary: The ability to erase your own memories
strengths: Perfect for if you're watching a scary movie
Can erase your memories of clandestine activities
weaknesses: Cannot restore lost memories on your own

name: Myth Power: Soter/Soteria Says
description: Soter and Soteria, in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of safety, preservation and deliverance from harm. As such, males channel Soter; females channel Soteria. Doing so allows one to perceive impending danger for oneself and others. In addition, if one is in a dangerous situation, one may produce an aura about oneself and one's allies which prevents foes from thinking to do them harm. Similarly, dangers from inanimate objects are deflected off of this aura.
summary: The ability to channel Soter and Soteria's command over the essence of security, safety and deliverance from harm
strengths: Perceive impending danger
Produce an 'Aura of Safety' that keeps enemies from wanting to hurt you (and/or allies)
That same aura deflects harm from inanimate objects as well
weaknesses: The 'Aura of Safety' often doesn't draw people to come rescue you until the higher levels
Cannot stop or reverse time to prevent or undo harm until the higher levels
Cannot perceive the actual CAUSE of impending danger until the higher levels

name: God Phone V4
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods or Goddesses from Norse Mythology. The deities are not under your control but they might want to help you if you have a good reason for summoning them. If you don't have a good enough reason however they will most likely destroy you. You cannot send them back unless they want to go back.
summary: The ability to summon any of Gods and Goddesses from Norse Mythology
strengths: You can summon any of the Norse Gods and Goddesses
You can summon as many of them as you want
They might help you
weaknesses: They might kill you

name: Star Arranger
description: With this power you can arrange the stars into whatever shapes or patterns you want. You can write people's names in the stars, write messages, or make funny shapes in the stars. This is also a good way to distract your enemy while fighting at night.
summary: The ability to arrange the stars in certain patterns
strengths: You can arrange the stars into any patterns you want
You can distract your enemies in fights
weaknesses: If it's a cloudy night this power is useless

name: Tint V2
description: With this power you can cause other people to see the entire world as just one color. You can make one guy see the entire world as being blue and another person seeing it as red and so and so forth. You can undo the effects of this power whenever you want.
summary: The ability to make other people see the whole world in just one color
strengths: You can cause anyone to see the entire world as one color
You can reverse the effects of this power
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Human Battering Ram
description: With this power you can cause any door no matter how many locks it has on it to open just by touching your head to it. It only works with doors that swing inward (push doors) and not pull doors, revolving doors, sliding doors etc.
summary: The ability to cause doors to open when you touch them with your head
strengths: You can open doors just by touching your head to them
weaknesses: They have to be push doors

name: Jli Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. The hero doesn't have to currently be an active member of the team, they don't even have to be living in the current comic book timeline. Also when you summon one of them they under your complete control. Unfortunately if you want to use the mind control function you can only summon one of them. If you summon two or more you lose control over them.
summary: The ability to summon any member of Justice League International
strengths: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can mind control up to one of them at a time
They don't have be an active or living member of the League
weaknesses: You can only use the mind control function if you summon only one hero

name: Human Magnet
description: This power allows you to become magnetized. You can attract or repel metal objects. This will become very useful if people are trying to shoot you. Although in it's early stages, this power is uncontrollable, but with time, you'll be able to master it.
summary: The ability to be magnetized
strengths: Repell bullets
Never have to reach for a fork or other utensil
Be able to pick up change
weaknesses: Bad when in cutlery store
Bad in video cassete store
In early stages, uncontrollable

name: Human E.O.
description: Ever wanted a portable electric plug? Well, now you have one. With this power, you can generate an electrical outlet from any part of your body to supply energy to your many devices. Electricity is infinite and comes from a special dimension. You can change the shape of the electrical outlet to fit any plug.
summary: The ability to create electrical outlets from any part of your body
strengths: Very convenient
No electricity bill
weaknesses: Can only make an outlet as big as your body
Someone can kidnap you to use you as their infinite power source
If someone pours water on you then you will get shocked but only if you have an outlet on

name: Effect Latency
description: With this power, you can add a delay to a superpower. So, it will take a moment to take effect after it has been activated. In the case of a power that is already in use or always active, variations that may occur during its usage will be delayed. It will even take some time to deactivate if its user wants to switch it off. If the power already has a delay, you can add more time to it, but you can't shorten it. You can assign a different time lag to different superpowers.
summary: The ability to add a delay to a superpower so it takes time to take effect.
strengths: You can affect anyone's abilities, even yours.
Delay a lethal superpower's activation so you can escape!
It's really annoying and frustrating when there's a lag all of a sudden.
weaknesses: The delays are maintained even when you're not around, but at the cost of YOUR energy.
The longer the delay, the more energy it will suck from you to maintain itself.
Can delay the negation of a power, but only if this power's effect is not negated in the process.

name: Sleep Vampirism
description: With a touch, you can drain as many hours of rest from a person that you want to use yourself. You can 'store up' sleep, ensuring you are well rested for many long days if you have drained a great deal, eliminating the need for naps or rest. Can be subtle, taking just an hour or so from many targets, or take an entire day of sleep from someone. Limited to taking 24 hours per person between rest cycles.
summary: The ability to drain the benefits of sleep from another to use yourself.
strengths: No need for caffeine
Always feel rested and at your best
Knock people out with a single touch
weaknesses: Possibly get very bored with all your extra hours of productivity
Many people around you tired
Ineffective against anything that doesn't sleep

name: Single Man Army Corp (Smac)
description: The person who has the special transformation belt, designed by the military, can transform into SMAC, the prime example of soldier and warrior. The belt gives the wearer super strength and invulnerability  The belt also has an uplink with an army satellite in orbit that can upgrade the transformation or divert power to other powers. For example, diverting power from super strength to invulnerability, making them more invulnerable but lest powerful in strength and flight.
summary: The ability to be as strong as an army corp via transformation from a special belt.
strengths: You are the ultimate soldier
You can take down most enemies
Can divert power to other sections to make you more suited to combat a certain situation.
weaknesses: Once the power source runs out it, needs to recharge
Satelite link can be hampered by bad weather

name: Bat Suit
description: The person with this power, has the ability to put on this bat themed battle suit. The suit includes a kevlar utility harness and a gas powered magnetic grappling gun. The suit is made up of a hybrid kevlar material and has reinforced padding at the joins. This made the suit bulletproof as well as invulnerable to knife stabbings. And a cape that is made up of a light weight fabric called memory cloth. The memory cloth becomes rigid when a current is applied to it
summary: The ability to put on a battle suit that has a bat theme
strengths: Good for fighting crime
Can survive in an urban hostile environment.
weaknesses: No super powers whatsoever

name: The Dark Side Of The Force
description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things, that surrounds and penetrates living beings and binds the galaxy together. Sith can harness its Dark Side to do nearly anything from telekinesis to shooting lightning to conquering the galaxy. The ability to connect with the Force is based upon the concentration of Midi-chlorians in your cells.
summary: The ability to harness emotions such as anger, jealousy, fear, and hate for nearly infinite uses.
strengths: You can choke people with your mind
Your eyes turn yellow
You rule over a vast army of clones and planet-destroying superweapons
weaknesses: You don't get to choose what color lightsaber you have, because red is the only one ominous enough
Multiple of these will occur to you: mutilation, betrayal, defeat by a kid, and painful death
There's only 2 of you against the entire Jedi Order, and at one of you has to die in this movie

name: Body Part Substitution
description: This power allows you to replace any body part from libs, to eyes, even your internal organs. You can install multiple parts such as having two heats, four lungs, two sets of kidneys, etc. Any powers, or actions that were performed with that part, is also transferred to you. This can give you any number of powers, although restricted to that one part(if you take the finger from a fire manipulator, you can only use the power with that finger). You can also take the body parts of animals.
summary: The ability to replace any part of your body with other organic parts.
strengths: Have more than one power
Not worry about if you lose an arm
weaknesses: The parts all age at a faster rate
You can subcome to memories gained from said parts
Once damaged, that part can not be healed.

name: Surgical
description: With this power the user can channel pure energy into the form of any surgical tool. The energy can be drawn from the surroundings or from the user. The energy can be reshaped into any surgical tool and will act as the tool does. More than one tool can be formed at a time. The energies can be used to create chemicals to be used in surgeries but the user can not control the chemicals once they are created.
summary: The ability to create surgical tools out of pure energy.
strengths: Create surgical tools and chemicals anywhere.
Save people's lives.
Use surgical tools to "operate" on your enemies.
weaknesses: Need knowledge of how to perform surgery.
Can not control chemicals after they are produced.
Operations may not go as you wish.

name: Air Sight
description: If you face a opponent who is invisible, you will be able to use this power to see the air traveling around him. Sense any fast moving objects he throws at you and can be used to find people watching you.
summary: The ability to see air physically and sense objects in the air
strengths: See the air as colors
Storms and hurricanes look cooler
weaknesses: Useful only for defense not attack

name: Animal Enhancement
description: With this ability, you can increase the natural abilities of any animal. This includes strength, speed, reflexes, and intelligence. The amount you can increase their abilities by depends on the mastery of the user. The average user can increase the abilities by x50. Their bodies will adapt accordingly to this change. (Ex: makes the brain larger if you boost intelligence, or the muscles larger if you boost strength. ) However, you can't reverse this ability, so grant this power carefully.
summary: The ability to enhance the abilities of animals.
strengths: Give an animal super-powered abilities.
The average user can multiply their natural abilities (strength, reflexes, intelligence, etc) by x50
Use this on your pets to give them a boost to their abilities.
weaknesses: It's not a good idea to use this on untamed animals.
You may make an animal too reckless by enhancing their abilities.
Cannot use this on humans.

name: On Deadly Ground
description: You have the ability to make rocks, soil and sand nerve-gas-deadly to the touch. The area can't be more than 100 feet by 100 feet. You can reverse the effect any time. You're immune to this power but not other poison and venom powers. The nerve gas effect works with a single grain of sand. You can use this power if you become a elemental or create them. This power doesn't work with processed earth materials.
summary: The ability to make the earth around you poisonous to the touch.
strengths: Your'e at the beach, in the woods or at the mountains.
A good power for a villain with an earth power .
A single poisonous grain of sand. That's all it takes.
weaknesses: Someone who is immune to earth and/or poison powers
You're not near rocks, soil or sand.

name: Shear Thickening Cartilage
description: Cartilage is the soft, flexible material that connects bone and allows you to move. With this ability, your cartilage will increase in viscosity(resistance) as stress and strain increases. The greater the stress, the more the resistance becomes. You can turn this power off at any time. The setback of this is that if you put too much stress on your body, it will become much harder for you to move. It only makes cartilage nearly indestructable, not your bones. It's a non newtonian fluid!
summary: The ability to have cartilage which increases in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress.
strengths: Have your cartilage increase in viscosity(resistance) with increased stress and strain.
Cartilage resist impact and pulling more.
It's a non newtonian fluid!
weaknesses: Harder to move when power is on.
Must move slower or lift less when power is on.
Only useful in certain situations.

name: Awesome Masseur
description: With this power you give the best massages in the world. You can relax anybody and heal all back pains. In the middle of the fight you can give your enemy a massage (this might be tricky) and calm him down and then capture him.
summary: The ability to give the best massages in the world
strengths: You are the best masseur in the world
You can relax almost anybody
You can heal all back pains
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Brass Fists
description: With this ability you can turn your forearms into metal brass causing massive dammge to whoever you punch. It's like brass knuckles except now it's your whole fists.
summary: The ability to turn your forearm to your fingter tips into brass
strengths: Powerful punch
Unbreakable fists
Doesn't make your fists heavy
weaknesses: Heavy at first
Can be worn down by amonia attacks

name: Empathy Switching
description: Like in The Crow or Powder, you will be able to touch someone & absorb their empathic memories like feelings of pain & tragedy & inject it into someone else. So you have a person that is in pain & dying, you take their empathy & go put it into the one who caused it. Or if someone has depressed feelings, you take a cheerful person's emotional thoughts & give it to the sad one. You do feel a little bit of the empathy you absorb & can only absorb one at a time.
summary: The ability to absorb a person's empathic memory & project it to another person
strengths: Trade emotions between people
weaknesses: You feel just some of the empathy you absorb but not as much as what you project
Can only take one empathy at a time

name: Ability Jump Start
description: This power is not cancellable as it would obviously defeat its purpose. It allows you to use any of your powers when they should be cancelled. It doesn't restore your lost abilities though. You can choose more than one power to jump-start. Once you are done with a power, you can release it, in which case it becomes cancellable again.
summary: The ability to jump-start your abilities that have been cancelled.
strengths: You can use your powers against power negators.
This power cannot be cancelled.
weaknesses: Useless if your powers aren't cancelled in the first place.
This power can still be removed/stolen.

name: This Will Hurt You More Than Me
description: If someone/something harms you, you will do more damage and harm to them. Also enhances your damage for things like punches and other powers.
summary: The ability to do more damage to the thing that hurts you
strengths: Do more harm
Do more damage
People won't want to harm you.
weaknesses: You can still be hurt
You can still die.
Do more harm.

name: Bubble Trapper
description: With this power you can take anyone as your prisoner. Know someone you don't like, trap them in a bubble. Want to ground your kids, trap them in a bubble. Or if you're just bored, trap someone is a bubble.
summary: The ability to trap people in indestructable bubbles.
strengths: It is unbreakable, so not even other superpowers can break through it.
Great for prison cells.
Unlimited air.
weaknesses: You have to give your prisoners food and such, it is only a bubble.
You can't change its size.

name: Humor Field
description: With this power you release a aura that makes everyone laugh uncontrollably. However, it is only limited to 200 yards. It's strongest on april fools day.
summary: The ability to emit an aura that cause people to laugh uncontrollably
strengths: Finally funny
Causes foes to laugh as well
Strongest on April Fools Day
weaknesses: Limited to 200 yards
Doesn't work on comedians
Doesn't defend your title

name: Dead Shed
description: If get cut, burnt, stabbed, shot etc. You would be able to peel that part of the flesh off yourself revealing perfectly healthy skin underneath. Like it never happened. Even if you die from your wounds, it takes awhile till you revive yourself & shed your dead body. This is not immortality or accelerated healing. You still feel pain & not immune to diseases & will die from them. Then you'll come back with healthy organs & bones. Its a healthy you inside a dead you.
summary: The ability to shed injuried or dead skin on yourself
strengths: Shed dead tissue to reveal healthy ones
Your insides will eventually heal after death then you'll revive
weaknesses: Not true immortality or accelerated healing
Still susceptible to illness
Still have to die in order to come back

name: Sword Of Damocles
description:
A person with this power can create the sword of damocles that hangs above people's heads and drops when ordered by the user. 

Only the target and the user can see the sword. 
The sword grows bigger the more fear is exerted but not vice-versa. 

This power can be spammed.
summary: The ability to materialize a sword above the heads of enemies
strengths: Sword(s) always follows target and swords change direction to always hit the enemy
Can be spammed-tons of swords over a person or tons of swords over an army
With training, the Damocles sword can fall on other parts of the body or form a cage of swords
weaknesses: Sword(s) is only as big as a person's fear
If the sword becomes too big it will fall regardless of the user's commands

name: Stampede
description: You can summon any animal you want in great numbers. A worm hole opens up and releases the animals you are thinking of at the time. The worm hole opens behind you, giving you time to strike an epic pose. Also, a thought is subconsciously put in the animals' heads to run as fast as they can, avoiding you and aiming for your desired target. When they've done their job, they get taken back to their point of origin, not knowing it even happened.
summary: The ability to summon a group of any animal to trample your enemies
strengths: Can take out large groups of people
Makes for a good distraction
Useful for breaking out of cages, cells, and the like
weaknesses: The animal must exist somewere in the world at the moment (No dinosaurs)
Not usable in small rooms, for obvious reasons
Can only summon one kind of animal at a time

name: Bullet Shrimp Mimicry
description: Bullet shrimps, when they snap their claws can create cavitation bubbles that create huge sound effects where struck and can be hotter than the sun as well as generate sonoluminescence.With this power your snaps create the same effect only larger because you are bigger and you have the secondary powers needed to not get affected by your own effects. Bullets can be used underwater and in air.
summary: The ability to have snaps with the power of the Bullet Shrimp
strengths: Snap bullets
Even if you miss the shockwave is more than enough to knock out or kill your prey
weaknesses: Too lethal to use all the time
If you don't know how to snap your fingers or are unable to do so

name: Selective Unfreezing
description: This power is completley useless if time isn't frozen. If somebody (you or another person) froze time, you would be unharmed and you could also make certain things work, like a car.
summary: The ability to selectivley unfeeze things when time is frozen
strengths: Use items that couldn't function otherwise while frozen.
If you get this you will probably be able to freeze and unfreeze time by yourself.
Use this again if someone freezes your targeted item.
weaknesses: Things can be re-frozen
Useless if time is not frozen
You might wanna be able to freeze time yourself

name: Song Of The Family
description: With this power, you will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family (father, mother, sister, brother, wife, son, daughter) is in a hundred-foot radius of you. Also, when you sing while this power is in effect, only good things will happen to you, so if you sing while fighting an enemy and one of your immediate family members is near you, you will win the fight. Or, if you use this power while buying a lottery ticket, you will win the lottery.
summary: The ability to have a beautiful singing voice when near members of your immediate family.
strengths: You will have a beautiful singing voice when a member of your immediate family is near you.
Only good things can happen to you when you use this power.
weaknesses: Your family members have to be near you.

name: Eight Virtues
description: The ability to possess all Eight Virtues. Charity, Temperance, Chastity, Patience, Kindness, Diligence, Humility and Justice. This power lets you purify a soul and they will see the light to know what evil things they done. E.g Chastity - The person will embrace moral wholesomeness. Diligence - The Person will have a careful nature and total work ethics.
summary: The ability to possess all Eight Virtues.
strengths: Can cast all Eight Virtues onto anybody at once.
weaknesses: Nothing bad about this power at all.

name: Exploding Limb Technique
description: Ability to make objects explode when stricken by your limbs. When striking objects with your hands, feet, legs, knees, elbow, fingers and even your head it sends large amount of kinetic energy through the object in which causes rapid and violent explosion; all depending on how hard you can strike an object. The harder you hit the bigger the explosion. The technique can be used for defensive or offensive use, which takes training.
summary: The ability to make objects explode when stricken by your limbs.
strengths: Able to make objects explode and the ability heightens when in adrenaline rush.
Used as/or for self defense.
Can control the kinetic force either through thought or power of the mind.
weaknesses: When in a emotional state of conflict it can be an unwanted accident waiting to happen.
Debris from explosion can harm you, well depending on what the debris consist of.
Needing extensive training/knowledge on knowing how to focus the energy and use it.

name: Last Man Alive
description: You can freely enter or exit a parallel dimension where you are the only person(s) on the planet. Anything you do in this other dimension has no effect on the real world. You can bring things to and from this dimension, including bringing people into the dimension. People automatically return if you exit the dimension or die inside it. Wild animals still exist, but pets and anything sentient will not exist in the dimension. You will come back to the original world in the nearest safe spot.
summary: The ability to temporarily become the last person/people on the planet.
strengths: Alone in time.
Can explore areas you could not before.
Can bring things back from the dimension.
weaknesses: Cars, planes, nuclear reactors, etc. will end up crashing without people.
Wild animals may attack.
Cannot trap people inside the dimension

name: Summon Mega Sharke
description: If you want this power, you first need to have the Summon Sharke power. Stop reading now and see what that power is and come back to this power. This power summons a sharke with the same abilities and weaknesses as a normal sharke, but it is 60 feet long and able to gulp down an object the size of a tank or take trash dumpster-sized bites out of a bigger object. A mega-sharke, if left unsupervised, will eat the same as 6 normal sharke.
summary: The ability to summon a giant temporal energy monster.
strengths: Bigger is better!
They eat tanks in one gulp.
No one will mess with you-if you're crazy enough to keep a few mega-sharke with you.
weaknesses: A 20-foot-long temporal monster is bad enough to have around-you want a 60-foot-long one?

name: Super Acute Hearing
description: Your hearing, at will, becomes so acute that you can hear specific conversations across a sports stadium. You can hear a cats footfalls from a block away.You can hear an owl flap his wings from 1/4 mile away. With mastery, allows you to pick up other frequencies too.
summary: The ability to hear a pin drop from 1/2 mile away
strengths: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You can hear the tumblers on a safe drop into place.
You will hear people arrive at your door long before they ring the bell.
weaknesses: You can hear what people are saying about you after you leave the room.
You might not like everything tht you hear.
Loud noises can become deafening!

name: Encore
description: You could compel the foe to keep using only the same move by clapping your hands. You can even use it to call for a brief extra repetition done after the main performance is complete until your opponent gets tired.
summary: The ability to make anyone repeat the same thing over again by clapping your hands.
strengths: A great, but strange use for humiliation.
weaknesses: It'll get much more annoying after a while.

name: Myth Power: Pallas' Passion
description: Pallas, in Greek myth, was the Titan god of warcraft; planning and executing combat and military campaigns. As such, channeling him allows one to become a master strategist, by thinking of problems in terms of military conflict. In addition, one can psychically perceive the plans and schemes of others in proximity. Furthermore, one gains skill in every weapon and fighting style in his physical and mental capability. One can even augment or disrupt stats (strength, etc) and physical superpowers.
summary: The ability to channel Pallas command over the essence of warcraft and military campaigns
strengths: Become an expert strategist; psychically perceive plots/plans/schemes/strategies of those in radius
Gain skill in every weapon style and martial art (fighting style) in your physical/mental capacity
Augment/disrupt physical stats (strength, speed, reflexes, etc) and physical superpowers, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot augment/disrupt combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers until developed
People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with Unpredictability and MythPower: Ares' Wrath are immune to this ability (no Con Negation)

name: Spam Frame
description: This ability allows you to have anything repeat itself for as much time as you want. The time that is surrounding anything you touch including you is being continuously copied until you cancel it. Since time is still passing outside you own touch your actions will still add up.
summary: The ability to repeat any action continuously through continous recycling of time frames
strengths: Never run out of bullets, you can keep shooting as long as you are doing the same thing
Can have near infinite wealth or food. Eating 1 grain of rice repeatedly or continuous money deposit
weaknesses: You can only repeat 1 specific action
Others can change their actions but you cannot until you stop

name: Super Squad: X Ray Heat Vision
description: See through things (again not clothes) and see heat. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
summary: The ability to see through things (not clothes) and see heat.
strengths: See through walls.
See heat in complete darkness.
Can see through skin to see diseases.
weaknesses: Can't see through clothes. (To some, it's bad. )
Can't see through mirrors.
The heat you see will be the heat your eyes are.

name: Space Suit
description: The user can create and control a space suit that could be of various designs as long as it matches real world designs of space suits. The wearer of the space suit has access to outer space related powers. The wearer can survive in space indefinitely and can create mini planets, black holes, stars, meteors, and other objects found in outer space. The wearer can also control how gravity affects himself such as the strength and direction of the gravity on himself. Can be remade if original is lost
summary: The ability to create a space suit that gives the wearer space related powers.
strengths: Have personal space suit that lets you survive in space.
Can create mini versions of objects existing in outer space.
Wearer can control his personal gravity, controlling strenght and direction of gravity on himself.
weaknesses: Have to be wearing the space suit.
If the suit is destroyed or lost then you lose access to the powers.
The objects created will be about the size of a human.

name: Dance!
description: With this power you can make anybody dance just by thinking of the person and saying "Dance! " after that the selected person will start dancing uncontrollably until you say "Stop! "
summary: The ability to make people dance uncontrollably
strengths: You can make anybody dance
You can cause your enemies to start dancing during a fight
You can make them stop by saying "Stop"
weaknesses: They can still attack you while dancing

name: Eagle Shifting/Attributes
description: The Haast Eagle was the most powerful Eagle ever in the world. This eagle standing was 6ft tall and its wingspan was the size of a small air plane(2. 7m). It had a powerful beak and talons and it was very fast even though it was big like all birds it had amazing vision.  These are the attributes of the Haast Eagle
summary: The ability to shift into an Eagle and have the attributes
strengths: The user can shift into the actual versions of the Eagle or smaller ones
The user can have the attributes of a haast Eagle
weaknesses: Opponents can see the user clearly in the air even if its the smaller version
The smaller version of the Eagle is 6ft wingspan 3ft height (yikes)

name: Myth Power: Eris' Enmity
description: Eris, in Greek myth, was the goddesses of strife and discord; her dual good and bad forms were called the Erites. As such, channeling her allows one to summon Golden Apples of Discord, at will, for subjects to argue and/or fight over. In addition, one may gain physical power in the presence of natural strife. One may even split in two; one copy boosts allies' morale (getting them to feel motivated and competitive, which speeds their healing process); the other causes foes to turn on one another.
summary: The ability to channel Eris and the Erites' command over the essence of strife, discord, enmity and social chaos
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce and negate strife at will; gain physical power from natural strife/discord
Summon Golden Apples of Discord (one at a time) to wreak havoc on foes (or to feed self/others)
Split into two copies; one heals and motivates allies; the other causes foes to turn on each other
weaknesses: Subjects only follow compulsions inscribed on Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Subjects only become instigators by eating Golden Apples of Discord at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Thought Bubble Pop
description: Ever heard the saying "an idea blowing up in their face"? That's the idea behind this power. You see people's thought bubbles which you can pop; the bigger the bubble, the bigger the explosion. It might splat into some primordial thought goop all over their faces or unleash the horrors contained within a random thought (such as a giant chicken); if the thought survives the popping of course.
summary: The ability to see the thought bubbles of others and pop them.
strengths: People who think a lot make HUGE explosions
The explosions do damage if great enough
Random thoughts are sometimes awesome if they survive the pop
weaknesses: Bubbles are very very small for people who don't think much at all (obviously)
The "thought-goop" is just messy/nasty. Nothing else than that.
If a thought does survive the popping, some of them suck (giant chicken is arguably one of them)

name: Deathtrap Making
description: It's self explanatory. When you touch any non-living object, it will flash a silver light, indicating it's been rigged. When another person uses it, it will kill them in some sort of way. For example, a laptop and a door. When a laptop is used, it will violently elecrocute the user to death. When a door is touched, it will powerfully swing open, crushing the user to the wall. Just don't use it on anything you use daily, like your toilet, or a comb.
summary: The ability to touch any object and turn it into a fatal trap
strengths: Create your own house of death
Strategically kill your enemies
Have fun creating creative ways to kill someone
weaknesses: Touching yourself is a bad idea if you're in a relationship.

name: United We Stand
description: With this power you have super human strength parallel to that of the Incredible Hulk but only when you have at least one of your friends near you
summary: The ability to gain super strength when you have friends near you
strengths: You have incredible strength
weaknesses: You may be putting your friend in danger if you're fighting crime and need your super strength

name: Lich Transformation
description: If you have this power you can turn yourself into a lich when you die. A lich (pronounced lik) is someone with power who didn't want to die. Because of this they do some ritual to prevent themselves from dying. They also retain intelligence and have increased magical power. This power takes out the ritual part that most lichs did, but your body has to die for this power to work and it has to be in one piece. You do retain your physical looks but your body will be slowly decaying.
summary: The ability to turn oneself into a lich when one dies
strengths: Your magical power increases.
You have intelligence unlike most zombies.
You don't have to do a long magical ritual.
weaknesses: You're undead and you will generally be thought of as evil regardless of whether or not you are.
You have to die.
Your body has to be in one piece.

name: Swiss Army Saber
description: The swiss army saber is a multi-function pocket sword-hilt; it has an amount of various blades such as broadsword, kriss, katana, scimitar, machete, drakesword, and kirehashi. It is approximately 96 mm (4.6) long.
summary: The ability to use it to switch to different blades within it.
strengths: Can definitely confuse your foes in combat.
weaknesses: None.

name: Origami Manipulation
description: This strange ability has more uses than most would think. Origami is the anicent art of folding paper into different shapes. With this you can create and control all sorts of origami. So if you create a giant origami dragon, it will follow your mental orders. This ability also grants the power to become origami. When you do this, you will become a life size origami human. You then can become any number of origami shapes and creatures.
summary: The ability to manipulate origami
strengths: Become origami.
Your can create origami weapons and creatures.
All of your creations are under your control
weaknesses: A very strange ability

name: Aaimuzki
description: Based on a yokai, it gives you a cactus like appearance with needles you can throw and enlarge and retract, plus you can greatly increase and decrease your muscles, giving you heightened strength and size.
summary: The ability to gain cactus-like skin and the abilty to rapidly increase and decrease you muscle mass.
strengths: Heightened strength.
Enlargement and projectile needles.
Rapid regeneration and cactus-like physiology.
weaknesses: Huge appearance changes.
You lose your senses of smell and taste when activated.
Muscles arent high on the superhuman strength scale.

name: Disaster Glove
description: When you think of the glove it will be placed on your hand. You will have control over all disasters, e.g. earthquakes, birdflu and other epidemics, meteor strikes etc. You will also know when actual disasters (not caused by you) will happen. The only side effect is that you're not immune to any of the disasters (even if caused by you).
summary: The ability to summon the glove of disaster
strengths: Control the element of Disaster
Cause destruction to your enemies
Make people fear you
weaknesses: You could hurt yourself (not immune to effects)

name: Currency Switch
description: Euros, yen, dollars, dinars, pesos, seashells, gold-plated latinum, etc. You can change your money into any type of currency that you want whether it is a real currency or a fictional currency, even historical currency from ancient Hawaii or Sumeria. Exchange rate is based on value of the target currency in the original currency. Ex: An ancient coin that is worth say 100 dollars will be exchanged by this power at that rate. Ex: 1 yen is aproximately 1 US cent so that would be the exchange rate.
summary: The ability to change money from one currency to another currency
strengths: Time travelers will always have the currency they need.
No fees and no banks required.
weaknesses: No combat value.

name: Cryptobiosis Gold
description: Cryptobiosis is what some animals go into to survive tough conditions. All their internal mechanisms and organs stop working, leaving the animal 'dead' until the conditions are right for it to wake up. With this power, it is similar: When the conditions aren't right for normal life, your body stops working and becomes a gold statue. Your golden body is indestructible, and you will wake up when your body can survive. But the statue is stiff; you can't move. You are put in "suspended animation".
summary: The ability to survive almost anything
strengths: Survive vacuum,pressure, lack of oxygen, too much/little heat and anything the environment has.
Cryptobiosis Gold form is indestructible.
Wake up when conditions are right, and you don't age.
weaknesses: Can't breathe, think, talk or move when in this form.
When you wake up, your friends/relatives might be dead.
You only survive conditions, not things like poisons, bullets, falling etc.

name: Brain Scramble
description: When this power is activated, an aura begins to begins to grow around you. When you choose to release it, everyone within this space, excluding you, will have their brain randomly switched to another body in the area. Basically, lots and lots of chaos. This is useful if a large group is after you. Even better if there are supers within the ranks, being that they will have to get used to new powers before they pursue you. It will have no effect if used on only one person.
summary: The ability to randomly switch the brains of people in an area
strengths: Can be used for escape or relaxation
Cannot be undone except by you
With practice, can be extended to cover the entire earth
weaknesses: No control over where the brains go
Trading the brain of a supervillain into the body of a superhero
You are excluded: no switching into a better body

name: Blessing Of Iris
description: Iris is the greek goddess of Rainbows. Her blessing allows you to gain many powers over rainbows and color. You can create and manipulate rainbows as a tangible force, and can use them to communicate. You can also use the essences of the colors. For example, the essence of red is fire. You will be able to camoflage, and manipulate color.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing Of Iris
strengths: Controling color and rainbows
Using the essences of color
Camoflage
weaknesses: You can't always use rainbows to communicate

name: Hexting
description: You are able to create and cast an incredible variety of spells by one simple strange thing, texting. However, Hexting is quite necessary for you to cast spells, but which extends to an ability to control the elements including fire, air, earth, liquid, ice, and also create strong invincible force field, transmutation, massive teleportation portals, and among other feats.
summary: The ability to cast dark chaotic spells just by texting.
strengths: Text "fired" to do some fire damage.
You can become a text wizard or witch.
weaknesses: You will get caught.

name: Myth Power: Pontus/Thalassa Pov
description: Pontus (Pontos), in Greek myth, was the god of the sea's depths; his wife, Thalassa, was the goddess of the sea's surface. As such, channeling Pontus allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one may mimic crushing deep-sea pressure with one's hands at will. Channeling Thalassa, one may stand/move on the surface of any body of water like solid ground. Channeling either allows one turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to any body of water at will.
summary: The ability to channel Pontus and Thalassa's command over the essence of the deep sea and the sea's surface
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater; mimic crushing deep-sea water pressure with one's hands at will
Stand/move on the surface of water like solid ground; immunity to effects of (any) dehydration
Turn into a form composed of water, and project one's sight to/within any body of water at will
weaknesses: Only share Aquatic Adaptation, Deepwater Perception or Water Mimiby touch at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot teleport self/others to sea bottom/surface or manipulate water by touch until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Morati Spell
description: Cast the spell by saying "Morati" (pronounced more-awe-tee"). This will destroy darkness, evil, banish demons, and destroy evil spells.
summary: The ability to destroy evil matter
strengths: Hasn't failed me yet
Banish demons
Destroy an opponent's darkness spell
weaknesses: None

name: Dinosaur Control
description: You can fully control any dinosaur you want. But you have to find them first
summary: The ability to control dinosaurs.
strengths: You can control dinosaurs
Paleontologists would seek you out if they can revive dinosaurs
weaknesses: Dinosaurs don't exist anymore
Need other powers to get/summon/revive dinosaurs

name: Stupipathy.Telepathic Stupidity
description: It is the ability to make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence. Once used by a psychic con-man to make a lot of money and earn a living.
summary: The ability to make anyone stupid or defenseless through telepathic influence
strengths: More than normal convincing power to average intelligence people
Near mind control ability through repeated practice
Can be used to oneself as an effective disguise
weaknesses: Cannot be used in battle or life and death situations
Takes a lot of practice and creativity to be useful
Will not make you famous, only affects people at subliminal level

name: Expandable Mind
description: This power enables a person to extend their mind into the psychic realm that is the Astral Plane. This allows them to handle and store much more information than normal. It can be used in unison with other powers, like telepathy, to flash memorize vast amounts of data. Also it could allow a clairvoyant to use multiple view points with less disorientation by reducing the mental load on the brain. The downside to this is that your extended mind is open to attacks on the astral plane.
summary: The ability to expand one's mind into the astral plane.
strengths: Allows for increased intelligence, memory and mental agility.
Can be used to temporarily store information to complex to normally process.
Works well with other psychic powers.
weaknesses: Leaves one vulnerable to psychic attack on the astral plane.
Makes a very visible "Cloud" of psychic energy on the astral plane.

name: Myth Power: Phales' Philander
description: Phales, in Greek myth, was the god of the phallus (male sex organ), adultery, rape, pederasty and other male sexual indecency (like exposing genitalia). As such, channeling him allows one to assume the form of any male humanoid at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with males of any species (and compel females) at will. One may even psychically absorb power (including sexual virility) from males by a touch; this same touch induces sexual pleasure in females.
summary: The ability to channel Phales' command over the essence of the phallus, adultery, rape and pederasty
strengths: Assume the form of anymale humanoid at will (regardless of one's true gender)
Psychically perceive and communicate with males (and compel females)
Touch males to absorb power (and enhance male attributes); touch females to induce sexual pleasure
weaknesses: Cannot assume the form of male animals (besides humanoids) until developed (NCN)
Cannot use phallus as divining rod (locating/navigation, detecting lies, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Baubo's Burlesque provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tetris Shift
description: With this power you can turn people into pieces from tetris. You can turn them into any of the pieces but to play the game you're gonna have to throw the people in the air and hope they fall in the right place.
summary: The ability to turn people into tetris pieces
strengths: You can turn people into tetris pieces
weaknesses: You cannot play the actual game Tetris with them

name: Normalization Fluid
description: With this power you can inject a serum that "cures" any and all superpowers. In minimum dose this acts like a tranquilizer by causing your body to tense up and combat its own power. In maximum dose this eliminates any and all superpowers of a person. This power is treated as a cure and will never be perceived as a threat by any superpower sense or barrier. The body will not reject this fluid and powers that come in contact directly with the fluid when in the body are negated.
summary: The ability to "cure" superpowers
strengths: The effects are permanent and powers cannot be regained
This power is never perceived as a threat by superpowers
You can help people who don't want their powers or take power away from supervillains
weaknesses: You have to get within range to inject the fluid
It takes times to circulate within the body and it can be sucked out or slowed down from the heart
Does not take away inherent powers such as natural intelligence or natural training

name: Willpower: State Of Permanence
description: You may not be aware of it but your freewill is the most important force that resides in you. Anything you choose to do or not to do is governed by your freewill. The excercise of freewill for a powerful ability user is important. If he plans to make use of his powers in this physical world his freewill must be free from any constraint. But freewill like any other forces that resides in us can be changed by other enities that dwell outside us. This ability blocks such changes enabling freewill.
summary: The ability to render one's freewill unaffected by unnatural change.
strengths: Let your freewill remain unchanged even if reality itself yields to such changes.
weaknesses: No offensive use

name: Selective Recall
description: A person with this power has the power to hide knowledge or memories from himself until a certain time period or until he says a certain code word. This power also allows someone to have more memory than an average person to cope with stored memories. When activated, this power has a sort of pseudoamnesia effect where the person has absolutely no idea what they are doing. However, they can still remember new bits of information while they are in the amnesiac state.
summary: The ability to have memories that are only available when the user decides to access it
strengths: You can hide the truth and lie without any repercussions
You make a great spy-I dont know anything and you would be half right
Forget painful memories unless you needed to recall it
weaknesses: Sudden rush of old information can shock you, you may have switched sides previously, etc.
This only affects your memory so you will still look the same
If the code word is lost or you are killed before the time to recall is possible

name: Bullet Catching V2
description: With this power whenever you're shot at the bullet will instantly fly into your hand and since this power makes your hands impervious to bullets you'll be perfectly fine. However if you're holding something when someone takes a shot at you the bullet will probably destroy whatever you were holding.
summary: The ability to cause bullets to fly into your hand and be perfectly ok
strengths: Your hands are impervious to bullets
Bullets instantly fly towards your hand when you're shot at
weaknesses: If you're holding something when you're shot at the thing will probably be destroyed

name: Myth Power: Thanatos' Threat
description: Thanatos (Thanatus), in Greek myth, was the god of peaceful, non-violent, painless death. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive painless death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died painlessly. Furthermore, by a paralyzing touch, one may induce simultaneous shutdown in all of a subject's organ systems. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Thanatos' command over the essence of peaceful, painless, non-violent death
strengths: Psychically perceive past, present and future non-violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died non-violent deaths
Induce instantaneous (painless) death, by touch; withstand necromantic effects
weaknesses: Cannot generate wings to fly until the higher levels
Cannot summon an indestructible scythe (similar to Thanatos' Scythe) until the higher levels (NCN)
Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: False Cognition
description: Also called Psychic Sleepwalking, Hypnagogic/Sleepwalker Automatism or (Psychic) Somnambulance, this ability allows you to undergo a hypnagogic trance, like a psychic autopilot command. This allows the conscious mind to rest, so your body can heal and recover, without having to stop for rest. In this trance, one can respond to one's environment as though still awake (though, whether the eyes are open or not depends on the user).
summary: The ability to act under a hypnagogic trance in which no true cognition takes place
strengths: Get sleep without having to stop (subconscious knows your needs/desires/routines and can direct you)
Immune to mental tampering in the trance state (no true cognition, just impulse and instinct)
If your eyes aren't open in the trance state, your power is often accompanied by a Spatial Sense
weaknesses: If subconscious desires are harmful and take you somewhere you didn't want or need to go
If your eyes aren't open in this state, and you have no Spatial Sense
No dreaming in this state (though this can also be good as it protects you from dream manipulation)

name: Doomsday Energy
description: A person with this power has a doomsday device planted in their body. However, their body has adapted to slow down the activation of the device and harness energy contained within the device for superhuman feats. The doomsday device is like a parasite that attaches to a person's heart and nerves. The user is given the ability to either slow down the timer for the device or hasten it and gain power. If the user dies before the device activation, the device recalibrates and looks for another host.
summary: The ability to harness the power of a doomsday device planted in your body
strengths: You can instantly vaporize anything you want-and I mean anything
You also gain enhanced strength and speed and the ability to travel and survive in a vaccuum
The timer is actually very long-about a zettayear and it recalibrates to a zettayear each time
weaknesses: If you overuse this ability, you will blow up the universe(no joke)
Stopping the doomsday device will kill you-heart stops and doomsday device will recalibrate anyway
The allure of power-hastening the device gives the user access to more power and abilities

name: Holy Power: The Tormentor
description: With this power you can "activate" the Tormentor mode. You gain a powerful energy kimono and the powers of the Tormentor. While using the tormentor you get Hallucinization, Superhuman Senses and Super Speed Class Omega. You also become able to use all the other Tormentor ability's. To acquire the Tormentor you must send a killer that repented from his crimes to hell, even if he is good now.
summary: The ability to use the powers of The Tormentor, the third Path of Light.
strengths: Allows you to use all the next Godlike powers of The Tormentor.
Makes you so fast that you become able to reach the light speed.
