Allows you to use the Torment Claws, who brings punishment to all the ones who should suffer.
weaknesses: Hard to get, Tormentors are considered black sheep's by the other enlightened.
Need Six Paths of Light.
Another Enlightened can kill you.

name: Amber Eyes
description: Amber is a fossilized tree resin; some pieces of amber have prehistoric insect trapped inside the sticky sap. With this power, if you stare at someone for a long period of time, their body will be trapped inside your eyes like an insect in amber. They can be trapped there for as long as a month, and during that time, they cannot escape. You can trap a maximum of two people (one for each eye). This comes with a price; it will become slightly harder for you to see clearly.
summary: The ability to trap people inside your eyes
strengths: You can trap your enemies just by staring at them
You can keep them there for a maximum time of one month
They cannot escape their prison
weaknesses: They may try uselessly to escape, causing minor eyestrain
You can ONLY keep them trapped for a month
While someone's trapped, your vision gets slightly less clear

name: Myth Power: Ctesios' Title
description: Ctesios (Ctesius, Ktesios), in Greek myth, was the god of the house/home and property. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with members of one's household, as well as psychically compel visitors to one's home, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically fortify one's home as an invulnerable fortress, at will. One can even psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ctesios' command over the essence of the house, the home and property
strengths: Psychically perceive and teleport to one's home at will
Psychically perceive and communicate with household members, and compel visitors, at will
Psychically fortify one's home, at will; Psychically summon and manipulate one's property, at will
weaknesses: Cannot apply Pro #1 and Pro #3 to allies and foes, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate one's home (or bend reality within it) at will, until developed (NCN)
Home/family/domestic-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Vocal Sfx
description: A lot of sound effects can be reproduced with only the mouth and voice, sometimes the body. This power allows you to cause real effects when you produce them. For example, imitating an explosion SFX will cause one; a motorcycle SFX allows you to travel as if you were on a real one; a gunshot or machine gun SFX allows you to fire TK bullets; a ripping SFX can tear fabric. Keep in mind that you don't materialize things, you just make it seems like they are there and can act on their surrounding.
summary: The ability to create real effects based on the sounds you make with your mouth and voice.
strengths: This power is very flexible. You don't have to produce a perfect imitation of a SFX.
One SFX can be used for various effects. A metal impact can pound nails, deflect swords and more.
Since your power isn't "substantial", its effects can't be blocked by conventional means.
weaknesses: You have to learn how to produce sound effects. Just saying "BOOM" or "SCRATCH" won't work.
Only sounds produced with your own body works. For example, recordings don't work.

name: Induced Temporal Pull
description: First, you can perceive the "chronon" particles that people and objects pile up in them during time travels. Second, you can "read" them to know when they come from or from which timeline they originate. Third, you can create a time pull, causing the particles and their host to be attracted to their origin, so, eventually, they will be tossed into their correct time. However, if they somehow manage to resist, their period or timeline will be pulled toward the current one, merging with it.
summary: The ability to perceive things that are not from this time and cause them to be pulled toward the time they left.
strengths: Send time travellers back to when they come from.
Restore the timeline by sending misplaced objects and people to their correct time.
weaknesses: It probably won't prevent the time travellers from coming back.
If they have the power to resist the time pull, their time will come to them. Very dangerous.

name: Quiescence
description: The user of this ability has a valuable power at his disposal. This ability allows the user to literally phase outside of the realms of time. During this time, the user doesn't have to eat, breathe or sleep, and he is incapable of physical contact with the physical world; he also becomes intangible. However, until the danger passes, the user is also rendered immobile.
summary: The ability to internally produce a temporal silence and stillness
strengths: Cannot be touched by anything that is bound to the realms of space-time
Don't need to eat, sleep or breathe, and doesn't age (state of "temporal dormancy")
Total quiet for assistance in contemplation (remain aware of environment)
weaknesses: Cannot move (stuck in whatever pose you take before ability activates)
Can still be touched by time-defiers, chronokinetics, and "nonexistents"
The user can use this ability at will, but it is SUBCONSCIOUSLY activated upon sensing danger

name: Arcana: 7 The Chariot
description: This power is difficult to control. It automatically attempts to destroy anything you view as an "obstacle". It'll smash walls, send people flying, and flatten cars. Anything that gets in your way is going to be at least damaged, if not destroyed outright. This power only works if you have a particular goal in mind, and something is getting in the way of it. Non-physical things that get in your way will make this power demolish things in the general area. The key to this power is control.
summary: The ability to passively telekinetically demolish any and all obstacles.
strengths: At times, you can be about as easy to stop as the Juggernaut.
You can go from point A to point B and heaven help what gets in your way.
Gains power with emotions.
weaknesses: Without control you'll LITERALLY leave a trail of destruction behind you.
A non-physical obstacle will make this power go berserk and destroy everything in the general area.

name: Hair Arrows
description: The hair that is fired off will be stiff and straight. It will be fired off in a straight line from where it was on your head.
summary: The ability to fire one's hair off like arrows
strengths: Always have a way to defend yourself.
weaknesses: Hair is only stiff when fired. May be a pro.
It will hurt to fire off your hair. Equivalent to getting the hair plucked from your head.

name: Reversed Fire
description: To start a fire, you need an oxidizing agent (mainly oxygen), a combustible and an activation energy (usually heat). Remove any of these three components and the fire will weaken and die out. However, a reversed fire becomes more intense when it doesn't have enough of these, reaching its strongest peak when one is completely removed before suddenly dying out. While the fire will still disappear, it has the potential to start another one due to the intense flmaes and heat it produces.
summary: The ability to make a fire grow fiercer when it should weaken.
strengths: Extinction methods based solely on cooling down the heat won't work as the fire is self-sustained.
Other extinction methods may work, but they will usually make the fire stronger or start new ones.
Good if you have pyrokinetic powers AND a fireproof body.
weaknesses: The reversed fire still needs fuel and oxygen, or it will die out.
As it grows stronger, the fire consumes fuel and oxygen more quickly.
Most of the time, a reversed fire grows uncontrollable, even more than normal fire.

name: Purple Flames
description: These purple-colored flames can burn like normal flames, but will be more harmful to those who lead a virtuous life. Those who are pure evil most likely will not be harmed by these flames.
summary: The ability to create and control purple flames that are more harmful to those who are virtuous
strengths: The flames will probably creep your enemies out.
weaknesses: The flames hurt those who are good more.
Users of this power will most likely be evil.

name: Radioactive Burn: Outbreak
description: You must read "Radioactive Burn" to understand this ability. When active, you can pass the radioactive burn as a disease, therefore resulting in an epidemic. Those with the virus will gain the same abilities as the carrier, but less in power, strength, endurance, and intelligence. When the "burn" is passed on, the victim's flesh will bubble like tar and metamorphose into a monstrosity. The victim is incapable of reverting back to their original form and however obeys your commands.
summary: The ability to pass on the radioactive burn as a virus.
strengths: Create an army of superpowered monsters.
You are capable of acting as a vaccine for victims of the virus.
This ability works on any living organism, including plants and insects.
weaknesses: None really.

name: Demon Summon
description: This gives you the power to summon evil, twisted demons that will do anything no matter how big the sin because they're from hell. The more demons you summon and the worse the sins get the more evil, insane and twisted you become.
summary: The ability to summon demons from hell
strengths: Have demon slaves.
Will do anything you say.
Never turn on you.
weaknesses: You become evil and twisted.
Could become insane.
5% of damage demons take, you absorb.

name: Equator
description: With this power, any time that you compare two or more things, everyone around you will agree, even if it makes no sense at all. For example, you could say, "Sedimentary rocks are just like my lungs when I breathe in," and everyone would just nod in agreement. Or, say, your friend tells you their father just died, and you say, "I know how you feel, I dropped a nickel the other day," and they think you understand their plight perfectly.
summary: The ability to equate anything to anything else, and everyone will simply assume it makes sense
strengths: Everyone will believe you so long as you make a comparison.
No more arguments about your stupid metaphors or ridiculous allegories.
Imagine haggling with somebody about the value of things...
weaknesses: Only works when comparing two or more things, no flat out lies.
Not all that useful against any opponents.
Anybody who can negate this power may inform people that you don't actually make sense.

name: Evil Impulse
description: When the user places their hand against the victim's chest, they can suck out all the evil and release that in the form of an energy beam. Once mastered, you can amplify their evil until it becomes too much to handle. This will cause the victim to explode.
summary: The ability to gather energy from evil and use it in an attack.
strengths: You can easily defeat super villains.
Every living being has even a little bit of evil in them.
weaknesses: This power recoils every time it is used.
You can accidentally use this power against yourself.

name: Blessing Of Hestia
description: Hestia is the Greek goddess of home and family. A being with her blessing has many gifts. For one, they always have a home, temporary or permenant. Meaning they always will have someplace to stay, rest and eat. Also whenevery they're at home, any injuries they have will heal rapidly and they will start to regain their energy. And when at home, they can conjure food for themselves and visitors. The user can also induce loving family like feelings in anyone they have eye-contact with.
summary: The ability to have the Blessing of Hestia
strengths: Always having a home.
Healing and food conjuring
Good family-like feelings
weaknesses: Can only conjure so much food.
Can't control where your homes will be(they will always be nearby, though)

name: Skill: Ultimate Feint Strike
description: You will perform a feint strike with any weapon that your opponent will always go to block, making it easier to win fights
summary: The ability to perform an ultimate feint attack
strengths: You can always feint your opponent in a fight
It will make you a great fighter/soldier
weaknesses: There really isn't one

name: Side Effect
description: ever wanted to give some one a side effect you see on cans of stuff and that sort? now you can and you make up your own like explosive diarrhea!
summary: The ability to give anyone a side effect!
strengths: enemy:come on!..."ploop" yes!..."BOOM!"
you'll have a lot of fun
weaknesses: can't make death a side effect  but still can make stuff like explosive diarrhea

name: Container Fill
description: With this power, any time you open a container, it is instantly filled with what it was meant to contain, no matter how many times it was previously emptied.  So, Gun Cabinets will always be filled with firearms, and picnic baskets always filled with food.
summary: The ability to have any container you open be filled with what it was meant to hold.
strengths: Never go hungry or thirsty with lunch pails and water bottles.
Never run out of ammo
Always have everything you need
weaknesses: Container must be closable and sealable (no cups or plates).
Might not get what you like (Gun cabinets might be filled with Muskets...)
Only works if you open the container

name: Shrinking
description: The power to shrink someone to tiny sizes, making them easy to fight or unseeable.
summary: The ability to shrink someone to centimeter sizes.
strengths: You can shrink your enemies so they cannot keep up with you.
They are weaker in a fight.
weaknesses: You can't see them.
Their powers still work to their limits so they can do anything they could before.

name: Tornado Fingers
description: Your fingers can become mini tornadoes when you start to twirl them. The tornadoes will be twirling in the direction that your fingers are pointed. The power can only be activated when you twirl that finger that you want to use to become a tornado.
summary: The ability to turn your fingers into mini tornados
strengths: You can pick people up and spin them around when you point at them.
You can pull people or objects toward you when you want something.
You can float in the air when you point your fingers at the ground.
weaknesses: You could get finger cramps if you use the power for a very long time.

name: Myth Power: Themis' Decree
description: Themis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of divine law and order; traditions of good conduct, and other divine decrees, as passed down by the gods. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the laws, customs and traditions of any land at will; in addition, one can sense defiance of said law (true crimes and immoral acts). Furthermore, one can compel subjects to do anything in their physical/mental capacity, as long as it is legal. One can even receive and bestow divine oracular insight.
summary: The ability to channel Themis' command over the essence of divine law and order
strengths: Perceive the essence of law and order (laws/customs/traditions) and defiances of law
Psychically compel people to do anything in mental/physical capacity, as long as it isn't illegal
Receive (at will) and bestow (by touch, word or thought) divine oracular revelations
weaknesses: Cannot enhance or disrupt/negate law/order/justice based MythPowers until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot erase illegal/unlawful thoughts from others' minds by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Tychon's Hand
description: Tychon (Tykhon), in Greek myth, was the god of opportunity, chance and accident. As such, channeling him gifts one with the ability to perceive, manipulate and benefit from the same. This means one becomes a genius at calculating and understanding probability; one can tell when the "right time" is to make any move; one can tell when a decision is a good or bad idea; and if they allow their intuition to lead them, they will find fortune constantly.
summary: The ability to channel Tychon's power over the forces opportunity, chance and accident
strengths: Your feelings can lead you to the right decisions making you seem almost psychic
Become a genius at stochastic sabotage (tossing a rock out a window leads to your foe's murder)
Tell if an idea is a good one or not
weaknesses: Cannot apply powers from Pro #3 to oneself until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability
People with Luck Reversal can disrupt this ability, until it is developed

name: Human Bomb
description: You can seep out of your body chemical compounds that make plastic explosives. Your body is can revert from normal to C4 by holding your breath. You regrow any plastic you cut off to make your explosion but only in C4 mode. So if you use a your whole arm, you have to hold your breath for that long till it grows back which could take a few minutes. Have to supply own firing pins & timer. If you are shot or contact with fire while as C4, huge explosion & unlikely you survive.
summary: The ability to produce plastic explosives from your body
strengths: Create bombs from your body
Can regrow limbs but only as C4 body
weaknesses: Have to supply your own detonating devices
Have to hold breath in order to become plastic explosive & regrow parts of body used
If damaged while in C4 mode, you'll die as you make a huge explosion

name: Think Outside The Box
description: A person with this ability has the power of materializing a box that is impervious to physical damage and has a strange effect of making anyone inside it only think and perceive things which are not inside the box.
summary: The ability to materialize an invulnerable box that makes anyone inside it think of what's outside.
strengths: The user is exempted from the effects of the box.
Telekinesis, Mind reading, Precognition, Perception Power and other Mind powers are also affected.
It comes in many different colors and sizes!
weaknesses: When everybody else is outside the box.
If you are outside the box.
It is just a box.

name: Sleeper Moths
description: The oddest way to put people to sleep is by releasing a bunch of small magical moths. They even have unusual features that have sleeping power inside of them.
summary: The ability to release tiny moths that instantly put your opponents to sleep.
strengths: A total good chance of sneaking around enemy headquaters while they are sleeping.
weaknesses: None.

name: Instant Counting
description: Also known as Number Sense, a person with this power can instantly tell the number of objects there are with just a short glance. In non-combat, you can win contests and impress people -- however this can be used to keep track of how many people there are facing you (so you don't let one get away). It's also useful in scouting missions.
summary: The ability to instantly know the number of jelly beans or other things you see
strengths: Always win Jelly Bean counting contests
Excellent recon
weaknesses: None

name: Figure Inhabitation
description: When you wish to get away from someone, or appear someone you're not, you may enter a statue of a person. For example, say you are in a waxworks, you could enter one of the waxwork models and move around as that person. But, your own body will be left behind as a statue.
summary: The ability to enter a statue or other representation of a person
strengths: Become a famous person, like Daniel Craig, and lap up the praise.
Hide from anyone, almost anywhere.
Works even with paintings
weaknesses: Your body will be left behind as a staue, and could be taken away or broken
Must look human to work, no animals
Trying to enter half a waxwork or statue will result in death

name: Demonic Transformation
description: You can transform yourself and others into demons. The form's power and looks are based on how much damage to other people's life they have done directlly or indirectly. The demonic forms are different for each person and their nature will change to fit their form. Gender change is not possible.
summary: The ability to transform into a demon
strengths: Can transform people into demons.
It's not karma-based so works on that healer who healed a killer on accident (might be con).
Demonic forms are all different.
weaknesses: Transformation can be 'undone' by temporarily transforming back into their original form.
Doesn't work on demons or part demons since they are already demons.
Transformation is basically permanent.

name: Flaming Serpent
description: You can let out a 19-inch fiery flying snake from the palm of your hands that will burn and stun your opponent.
summary: The ability to fire a flaming projectile in a shape of a flying snake.
strengths: Fire
weaknesses: Water

name: Vampirism: Adrenal
description: Also called Adrenal Absorption or Stamina Absorption, this is the ability to absorb the literal stamina (vigor or energy) of a subject, and convert it into sustenance and energy for one's own personal use; temporarily gain a boost of strength, temporarily gain a boost of speed, or go longer at your normal pace; even resist the urge to eat or sleep for a while (as such, this power is especially helpful on a hyper foe, or a foe with an adrenaline rush)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the adrenaline of others
strengths: Take away the stamina of your foe, making them temporarily VERY tired
Taking their stamina also delays having to eat or rest
Foes with Superhuman Stamina, Superhuman Speed, Superhuman Strength, Berserker Rage, etc.
weaknesses: Doesn't absorb foes' life-force (only tires them, doesn't age them)
Sometimes it requires an actual bite like a true vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: You're Fireproof
description: With this power you can turn people fireproof. They won't be able to become burned or feel hot from fire and they can even walk through it. Their clothes and other items however can still be burned. You cannot however make yourself fireproof.
summary: The ability to turn people fireproof
strengths: You can make people fireproof
weaknesses: You cannot make yourself fireproof
You cannot make items fireproof

name: Vampire Control
description: With this power you can control vampires. You can make them fight battles for you or bite people and turn them into vampires to increase your army of mind controlled vampires.
summary: The ability to control vampires
strengths: You can control vampires.
You can make them bite other people turning them into vampires to increase your vampire army.
weaknesses: They can only fight at night or in dark places.
They can be defeated by garlic.

name: Shadow Immunity
description: Powers that would directly affect your shadow will no longer affect it. EG. Shadow Obliteration or Shadow Manipulation if it is used on your shadow.
summary: The ability to be immune to shadow-based powers affecting one directly
strengths: You can't be erased from existence by Shadow Obliteration anymore.
weaknesses: They can still affect shadows in the environment to indirectly affect you.

name: Myth Power: Panacea's Patience
description: Panacea (Panaceia, Panakea, Panakeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive how to mix cures, remedies, antidotes and antivenin at will (ingredients, where to find them and how to prepare them). Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with the ill and injured. One can even psychically transfer healing abilities, by touch, to and from oneself and others, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Panacea's command over the essence of cures, remedies, antidotes and panaceas
strengths: Psychically access knowledge and skill in finding and preparing any cure/remedy/antidote/antivenin
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those in need of healing
Psychically transfer regeneration/healing abilities to/from oneself/others, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot cure harm (illness and injury) of  self at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn medicines to/from poisons and other dangerous substances, at will, until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ent Summon
description: With this power you can summon up to ten Ents. The Ents under your complete control and they are super smart, super strong and if they get angry enough even the sound of their voices will cause great destruction. You can have the Ents for as long as you want and then send them back when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Ents
strengths: You can summon up to ten Ents
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Myth Power: Hesychia's Hush
description: Hesychia (Hesykhia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of quiet, rest and tranquility. As such, channeling her allows one to calm subjects with a touch, a word or a thought; this even works on Berserker Rage, and similar angered/frenzied mental states. In addition, with prolonged contact, one can even lull a subject into peaceful sleep. The user may even manipulate probability to prevent any events that disrupt the user (or subjects) from restful ease, quiet relaxation and peaceful harmony.
summary: The ability to channel Hesychia's command over the essence of quiet, rest, silence and stillness
strengths: Induce calm and tranquility in any subject (including oneself); quell Berserker Rage, and the like
If contact is prolonged, subjects can even be lulled into peaceful slumber
Manipulate probability to prevent disruption of peace, tranquility and rest
weaknesses: Cannot PREVENT Berserker Rage or other angry mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Only psychically induce temporal/molecular stasis (stillness) in matter at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Dike's Decision provides immunity (NCN)

name: Avenger Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character that has been or currently is apart of the Avengers. This includes the comic books, the TV shows and the Avengers movie. The Avengers are not under your control but they may decide to help you depending on what you want them to help you with.
summary: The ability to summon any character who's ever been a part of the Avengers
strengths: You can summon any Avenger
They don't have to currently be an Avenger for you to summon them
weaknesses: They have to be alive when you use this power
They are not under your control

name: Pearl Effect
description: Calcium carbonate is secreted from the skin and is fashioned to any form desired ex. (sword, shield, mimicry of other objects, etc). Can create layers of calcium carbonate to make you skin tougher.
summary: The ability to generate a pearl like substance from the skin.
strengths: Denser than normal pearls.
Can be useful in different kinds of situations ex. (duplication of keys, etc.
If the user is creative, he/she can use this power to it's maximum potential.
weaknesses: It breaks if to mush pressure is applied.
Secretion of calcium carbonate is not as fast as most abilities.
Gets heavy if to much layers are created.

name: Boulder Rain
description: With this power you can make giant boulders fall from the sky wherever or whenever you want. The boulders are roughly the size of a minivan and completely round in shape so once they hit the ground they start to roll causing more damage.
summary: The ability to make giant boulders fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause giant boulders to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want
The boulders are round so they will role once they hit the ground
weaknesses: You might damage innocent people or things

name: Messy Minions
description: You can create a number of useful organisms in any shape or form to do your bidding. They are fully aware and need no controlling but do require orders.
summary: The ability to create helpful sentient minions from ash, dirt, dust or soot.
strengths: You can have small tasks done without worrying about it.
You can spy on people without them realizing.
You can basically make your minions anywhere.
weaknesses: They are made of dust or dirt, they don't stand well in a fight.
They can't speak, so keep questions to yes or no.
They are dirty.

name: Reincarnation Detection
description: When a parent-to-be has this power, they will sense the being to inhabit their child's body when developed. It starts even before conception. If they know of the soul to be born as their child, they are able to eject it and allow another to take its place. They share these senses with the other parent.
summary: The ability to sense and repel reincarnation applying to your offspring.
strengths: Prevent someone with Reincarnation Determination inheriting your powers against you will.
Know the personality your child will have,
Your knowledge will be shared with your partner, whether they have powers or not.
weaknesses: If you aren't familiar with the new being, they may take you by surprise.
Only works on biological children.
No use if you aren't interested in having children.

name: Car Chase
description: With this power you will be able to go at the same exact speed of the car or truck that you are pursuing (providing that you yourself are in a car or a truck). You will only be able to match the speed the vehicle is currently moving at when you use the power not its potential speed. You don't even need gasoline in your car for this power to work.
summary: The ability to match the speed of any car/truck that your are pursuing
strengths: You will be able to match the speed of any car or truck that you chasing
You can come in second place in any competitive car race
No gasoline required
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot use this power on bikes, planes, tanks, boats, helicopters, motorcycles, skates, scooters
You need to be in a car or truck for this power to work

name: Transformers: Omega Supreme
description: With this power you can cause a high powered tank gun to sprout from your head. When you use this power your entire head becomes metal as well. The gun can shoot any type of ammo you want and can move to any spot on your head. A side effect of this power causes you talk like Omega Supreme (Speech patterns: Omega Supreme).
summary: The ability to cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
strengths: You can cause a tank gun to sprout from your head
Your entire head becomes metal (this does not hamper your breathing, sight, smelling or anything els
weaknesses: You talk like Omega Supreme when you use this power

name: Thirteen Treasures: Mantle
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This mantle grants the bearer invisibility from all eyes, while still allowing the wearer to view all others.
summary: The ability to wear the Mantle of King Arthur
strengths: If you so wish, you can pretend to be Harry Potter.
weaknesses: The books in the restricted section of Hogwarts will still scream when you open them.

name: Healer 5: Genetic Purification
description: With this power, you project a field with a diameter of 25 kilometers around yourself. When an unborn child is within this range, all genetic disorders or at least the negative aspects are removed. As a side effect, you establish genetic-based telepathic link with them you can use for things like communication, spirit transference/reincarnation (with powers) and sharing senses. This power can be switched off at will and the range of the ability increases at one meter each year.
summary: The ability to remove genetic disorders from unborn children and establish a link.
strengths: Range of 25 kilometers, increase by one meter each year of possession. Can be turned off at will.
Instant and permanent.
You gain a telepathic link which can be used by other powers for even more purposes.
weaknesses: You will need another power to cure genetic disorders in anyone else.
Limited range.
Unlike other healing powers, this cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Ace In The Hole
description: This allows for the user to deliver a perfect strike against any opponent. The strike will bypass all of the enemies defenses and is essentially a one hit knockout.
summary: The ability to deliver one decisive blow.
strengths: Thrown objects can count as the strike.
weaknesses: Activates randomly 5 minutes into any fight
Can only be used in a fight.
Decisive blow can only be through the hands.

name: Attack Trailer
description: This power causes you to leave behind a glowing "trail" every time you attack, which follows the path of your attack perfectly and hangs in the air until dismissed by the user. Anything that touches the line will suffer the effect of the attack on whatever part of it touched the trail. For example, if you were to shoot a gun the bullets would leave behind grey trails following the path of the bullet. Were someone to touch one of these trails with their hand, they would be "shot" in the hand.
summary: The ability to leave behind a trail after you attack that hurts anything that comes into contact with it.
strengths: Pin your enemies in.
Leaves traps hanging in the air.
Trails are all different colors so you can identify them.
weaknesses: Someone with armor could pass through the trails unharmed depending on how you attacked.
You are not immune, touching the trails will hurt you as well.

name: "Delete This" Mimicry
description: A person with this power has all the powers that say delete this in their title. Wait a minute if you have this power doesn't this power make it so you have this power? Infinite loop!!!
summary: The ability to have all the "delete this" powers from the Superpower list
strengths: Have a lot of powers
Can use multiple powers at once and can choose to not use the powers you don't like
weaknesses: If the powers are actually deleted you lose them forever
Crazy ass drivers

name: Witch Species: Fair Folk
description: The fair folk could do many things including teleportation, creating illusions, and thousands of other magical abilities. Originally called faeries these beings are some or the most powerful, albeit odd looking witch species around
summary: The ability to have all of the powers of the fair folk
strengths: You are probably the most powerful thing out there
You are the king (or queen) of practical jokes
You get to travel between this world and the true world of magic
weaknesses: Your, oh about anywhere from three inches to about 3 feet tall

name: Glass Shard Golem
description: This ability allows you to become a human sized golem made entirely of quick moving glass shards. Because the glass that composes your body is in constant motion you cut and slice everything that touches you. You become a walking storm of destruction.
summary: The ability to become a golem made of fast moving, sharp glass shards
strengths: Great for defense from most melee weapons
Great for hand to hand combat
You can change back to human at any time
weaknesses: Cuts everything that touches you

name: Attachable Abilities
description: The user has the power attach items to the very essence of their abilities to change how they work. Example: If a person has the ability to shoot fire bullets, then the user attaches a cup to his ability's essence. The ability goes through the cup like a medium. The ability is alter to match the medium. Since a bullet is smaller than the hole of the cup, the ability changes. Thus, the fire bullet gets bigger to match the cups hole. Through the cup, the ability is converted into a fire cannon.
summary: The ability to equip items to your abilities in order to change their effects.
strengths: Modify abilities
Make them have new effects
weaknesses: Items may be attached for longer periods of time than needed
Items can make new effects unpredictable

name: Induce Migraine
description: The user is able to cause an extremely painful migraine in an enemy. Low level users can only induce the migraine to one enemy, but a high level user can induce extremely painful migraines to a room full of people. A powerful enough user can incapacitate an enemy with this power
summary: The ability to cause extremely painful migraines in an enemy.
strengths: Good to stop either criminals or law enforcement
Can incapacitate an enemy
weaknesses: Might not be able to effect someone that has strong mental blocking powers

name: Nightmare Fuel
description: This ability allows the user to, in essence, place a mine in a person that will bring their nightmare to life the next time they have one. Individuals observing the subject with spy based powers are also affected.
summary: The ability to bring people's nightmares into reality
strengths: No contact necessary.
Can be used through spy based powers.
Lucid dreamers with this power can create their own monsters consciously.
weaknesses: Only works once before having to be reapplied.
The user ALWAYS has the "mine" in them.
You have to wait and hope the afflicted has a nightmare.

name: Xl
description: With this power you can turn anything into a version of itself that is ten times larger than the original object. Anything, food, clothing, animals, even people (although this is probably not healthy). You cannot however reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to make anything into an extra large version of itself
strengths: Make things ten times larger
weaknesses: Can't reverse the effects of this power

name: Summoning To Shapeshifting
description: With this power you can change any summoning power that you have in your arsenal into an ability to shape shift into whatever it was that you were able to summon.
summary: The ability to change a summoning power into a shapeshifting power.
strengths: You can change your summoning powers into shape shifting powers.
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power.

name: Pantheon
description: With this power you can split yourself into several different people each representing one aspect of your personality. You can create as many extra people as you want but as you go on the personality aspects that they represent will become more obscure (oh the one that constantly picks his nose, the one known for having red hair, the one that watches Sherlock twenty four hours a day every day).
summary: The ability to split yourself into several different beings each representing one aspect of your personality
strengths: You can split yourself into several different beings
You can reabsorb them whenever you want
weaknesses: They're not under your control
The more you make the less obscure they get

name: Point Zero
description: Zero point is the lowest possible energy, sometimes referred to as vacuum energy. Once this is activated, an area surrounding your body, its size depending on the user, creates a void. Any energy or powers entering this field are nullified, and absorbed into the user's body. This field sucks the energy and life of even humans that pass into it. This is a last resort ability, and usually results in the user's death.
summary: The ability to activate Point Zero.
strengths: Ultimate defense and offense.
Nothing can pass the field without dying.
weaknesses: Causes the user to die.
Can't move while using it.

name: Fusion Dance!
description: A more universal fusion dance, of the sorts. Where two beings, of any race, shape and size, can align their energy signatures and combine them by performing a mode of body movements. The result of the dance is that of one individual, standing in an aura of electricity and force, whose level of power has been heightened several-fold, and who possesses mixed physical and mental traits of both fusees. Life across the multiverse would never see this coming.
summary: The ability to merge two bodies together into a single, superior entity.
strengths: Create an awesome, super-cool name for the fusees; like, Matalex (Matt + Alex).
Become the most powerful being in existence with knowledge of martial arts.
Destroy anyone who threatens to destroy you or the Earth, or take over the Galaxy!
weaknesses: Users must know how to and perform the dance without flaw.
The new body may be difficult to handle, and might harbor intolerable mannerisms.
The fusion lasts just about 30 minutes -- sucks!

name: Word Cracker
description: This power gives you strong knowledge of supernatural linguistics that you can apply to understand how a language-based supernatural effect works. You can then dismantle and rearrange it to produce a different effect, or destroy it. It works with any language. Written, oral or even sign. Human or non-human.
summary: The ability to understand, disrupt and cancel language-based superpowers and magic.
strengths: You can counter any magical spell, word-based power, name-based power, number-based power,...
You can change the intended effect of these powers, though the results may be unexpected.
weaknesses: Though you can understand how language-based powers work, you cannot use this power to copy one.
It may take time to fully decrypt and analyze a language-based effect, depending on its complexity.

name: Quartz Form
description:
By activating this ability you transform into a golem made of quartz. This form gives you superstrength, increased endurance, and increased defense. Being made of quartz also gives you the added ability of being immune to any energy, beam or light based attack with the quartz deflecting and dissapating it. 

Even after being destroyed while in quartz form you can regenerate by all your pieces reforming.
summary: The ability to turn into a mobile golem made of Quartz
strengths: Increased Strength, Endurance and Defense
Immune to light based attacks
weaknesses: Quartz is more brittle than you think
Being made of quartz doesn't exactly make you very threatening

name: Bane To The Piggy's Existence
description: Have you ever wondered what something was made of? Well be glad you found this power! Bane to the Piggy's Existence is the ability to inhale anything (doesn't matter how big or small) and spit out everything it is comprised of in its original state. For example, if you inhale a table you will spit out a full grown tree and some metal! Now doesn't that make you want to huff and puff!
summary: The ability to inhale objects and spit out the elements those objects are made of.
strengths: Really helpful if you are in need of a specific material.
Since the objects shrink going in and coming out it doesn't matter how big your mouth is.
Also really useful for combat purposes. Inhale something on fire and you'll be spitting fireballs.
weaknesses: Obviously, it doesn't work if your mouth is covered.

name: Quoth The Raven, Nevermore
description: With this ability, you can summon to your side the Raven himself. A shadowy, spectral bird, he goes by Nevermore, and will only answer to that name. He can speak, and will happily carry out any task that you ask of him (in the bird's capability), including spying and revealing cryptic knowledge. He is immortal, and can return from being banished or "killed" at will, so once you summon him, he's there to stay (although, he doesn't eat, sleep or breathe, so he doesn't require much care).
summary: The ability to summon the otherworldly raven to your side
strengths: It can speak, and will gladly follow orders, including spying and giving cryptic knowledge
It can speak with other birds (AND read their minds and emotions) and rally them to fight
It is immortal (can regenerate, and return from death or banishment at will)
weaknesses: He's a smart-alec, so sometimes he may choose not to answer, or answer sarcastically
He doesn't eat, or breathe, but he also doesn't sleep (and he won't leave unless HE wants to)
His knowledge is often cryptic (yes or no questions get you a croaking "NEVERMORE" as a response)

name: Enhancement: Flaming
description: This is a support and does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the physical part of the power surrounded with flames. The fire will go out if it is separated from the power's physical part AND it has no fuel. If stolen, this power permanently effects the other power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power's physical part surrounded with flames by attaching this power to it
strengths: Flaming powers. Flaming Hair Blades! Don't ask how that works.
You can change the heat of the flames with training.
This plus fire immunity equals RAMPAGE!!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Enemy with fire immunity.
Might be useless flaming or might not want the power to be flaming.

name: Usurpation: Angel
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp all powers of a single angelic entity, leaving it completely powerless in the process. Your appearance will change to reflect the angel whose powers you have usurped (i. E. : white wings, clothing or other symbolic changes). 
You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original angel. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random angel who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single angelic entity.
strengths: Become an angel and use their divine abilities
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your" powers
Angels won't mind you borrowing their powers to fight evil
weaknesses: If you use the usurped powers for evil, angels might want to destroy you
Demons will see you as enemy, or try to recruit you as weapon against angels

name: Metallic Hair Alloy
description: The user is able to create a heavy duty sturdy titanium metal from their hair. This is telekinetic, so no words or spells needed. Think it and you can do it. When used as a weapon, the hair forms to the place you want it the most, i.e. if you wanted a sword, the hair would curl around your arms and form a sword. Same thing with a gun that shoots metal bullets. Limitation: You cannot create massive things, such as buildings or houses. If you have any questions, contact me for better explanation.
summary: The ability to create a titanium metal from your hair
strengths: Guns have unlimited ammo since you have thousands of hairs per square inch on your head
The metal that is created is virtually indestructible
Can create a one-manned machine of any sort. Color depends on hair color
weaknesses: If the hair gets wet, the titanium alloy rusts and becomes weak
If, for any reason, your hair breaks off or the metal is breaking, you lose your regular hair

name: Shadow Lugia
description: At will, you can become the 'Shadow' form of the Pokemon Lugia. You can communicate with telepathy and also control other's perceptions of reality, implant/erase thoughts, and also read and control minds, all exactly like Matt Parkman. You also have extremely powerful regenerative capabilities, and can heal others regardless of injury or ailment severity. You also have hydrokinesis like Percy Jackson from 'The Lightning Thief', and vector telekinesis like Sylar from 'Heroes'.
summary: The ability to transform at will into the 'shadow' form of Lugia with near-limitless power
strengths: This is a very versatile, and cool, power to have!
Both your hydrokinesis, and the Lugia's song, can heal and strengthen both yourself and others
Your greatest weapon is your mind and despite being a Shadow Lugia, you are not evil!!
weaknesses: Harnessing your powers will take time
Psychic static from your telepathy can give you headaches when learning to control the power

name: Sacrifice Adaption
description: With this power you can adapt to most (not all) things. Like if you were hit with a flame, you would become fireproof, but that fireproof power would come at a cost. You could lose things ranging vaulable items to loved ones.
summary: The ability to adapt to most things at the expense of a sacrifice
strengths: Adapt.
You can choose to use this power, so if you can choose if the sacrifice is worth it.
You know the sacrifice beforehand.
weaknesses: You are not able to adapt to everything (if you are at the HIGHEST LEVELS it may be possible)
Some adaptions may be useful, but require a very important sacrifice.

name: Drill Teeth
description: With this power, you can turn your teeth into miniature drills. The drills can drill through almost anything, except for teeth and other drills. You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills and turn them back whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn your teeth into miniature drills
strengths: You can turn your teeth into drills that can drill through almost anything.
You can turn any amount of your teeth into drills.
You can turn them back to normal teeth whenever you want.
weaknesses: You can't drill through teeth or other drills.

name: Enhancement: Unblockable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power ignore all barriers. This power can only be attached to powers that do no harm to the target. Ex: works on "Mind Reading" but not "Mind Control". This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced so long as the power does no harm to any being.
summary: The ability to make a non-damaging power unblockable
strengths: Harmless powers unblockable.
Scanning powers don't have to worry about walls or barriers that are in the way
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only usable on harmless powers.
Con negation and similar powers have no effect. No altering in RPs or discussions to get rid of cons

name: Quivering Palm
description: When making a successful strike against a target, the user of this power can send vibrations into the targets body. Once the vibrations are in the targets body, the user can simply will the target to die at any point within a period of a few days. The target can resist the attack, but it is very unlikely. After a few days, or if the target resists your attempt to kill him, all current vibrations in the body would be gone. Can be used on multiple targets.
summary: The ability to send potentially fatal vibrations into another one's body.
strengths: If attack is succesful, you can instantly kill harder foes.
Threaten people to do what you want during the period the vibrations are in their body.
Can be used repeatedly to refresh the vibrations in the target's body.
weaknesses: Requires landing a succesful blow on opponent.
Vibrations only last a certain period of time.
Target can resist the killing attack if they are exceptionally skilled.

name: Evil Manipulation
description: By manipulating evil you could force someone to do an evil deed,make him steal or kill for you,but once you turned him evil,you cant turn him back to normal.
summary: The ability to manipulate evil.
strengths: Make the president steal a nuclear bomb for you.
Make a serial killer strike again.
weaknesses: You cant turn back the chosen person back to normal.
A strong willed person can resist.

name: Erythrocyte Mimicry
description: This power is always active. It changes the chemical composition of your body so it automatically absorbs dioxygen and carbon dioxide. Your body can absorb up to 40 times its volume and can use the absorbed oxygen to breathe. Your skin also becomes red in the process. To release the absorbed gas from a part of your body, you must flex or press that area. However, your body can also absorb other substances more easily, such as carbon monoxide, nitric oxide, or cyanide to the detriment of oxygen.
summary: The ability to absorb and release various gases, mainly oxygen (O2) and carbon dioxide.
strengths: Your body can contain much more oxygen and carbon dioxide at the same time.
The absorbed oxygen acts as a personal oxygen tank.
You can contain a lot of gases!
weaknesses: This power is always active. You can only turn it off through the use of other powers.
You could kill many people and animals by anoxia the first time this power is activated.
Carbon monoxide is nearly impossible to release and they take the place of oxygen.

name: Calcium Fist Breaker
description: If someone's skeletal system is made out of normal bone, they better not punch you. If they punch you, they're fist instantly becomes hollow and possibly break. If they are wearing brass knuckles, this power doesn't work. If they have a different skeletal structure or are using superpowers, it doesn't work.
summary: The ability to have someone's fist turn hollow and break when it's made out of normal bone.
strengths: People's fist break/become hollow if they punch you.
They'll think twice about punching you.
weaknesses: If a supersayan/superhuman punches you.
If someone does something else to hurt you.
If the person is wearing brass knuckles.

name: Ghost Of The Future
description: The future spirit or the ghost of yet to come is a dark non-speaking grim reaper like being, it can teleport you in a form of a mist to the depressing horrible future to view somebody their darkest destiny.
summary: The ability to summon a spirit to warn a person what dark and deadly fate awaits them.
strengths: You'll be transported back to the present time & able to change your own life for the better
weaknesses: Can see your own grave.
You might not like the future

name: Penance
description: This power is used by Ghost Rider (Penance Stare) and Akuma (Raging Demon). With this ability, you can force criminals to feel the pain and anguish they have caused others. We all have sins to atone for, but if you have too many, then this ability will drag your soul down to hell!
summary: The ability to force others to relive their sins.
strengths: Help reform people if it's not too late for them
Takes the wrong that someone has done... And turns it against them!
weaknesses: If a person empties their mind and soul, it won't work

name: Zonk Out
description: With this ability, you can control the quality and the amount of time you sleep. You control the sleep stages. Sleep as much as you want. Induce your own sleepiness. You can't induce lack of sleep or a poor sleep quality with this power.
summary: The ability to sleep as much and as well as you want.
strengths: Sleep as much and as well as you want.
Get well rested.
Induce your own sleepiness.
weaknesses: Sleeping more and/or better than usual. Get yelled at for sleeping a lot!
The more well rested you are, the more energy you have while awake.
Get too well rested, and you'll stay awake for 24+ hours with strong clean energy if power is off.

name: Inverse Shapeshifting
description: With normal shapeshifting, you can turn into other creatures or objects. With Inverse Shapeshifting, you can turn other people into your look-alikes. They will have their own memories and personality, but they will look exactly like you.
summary: The ability to turn anyone into your identical twin.
strengths: You can confuse your enemies.
No quantitative limits: you can turn the entire mankind into your twins.
You can turn a more powerful enemy into your twin and make the chances equal.
weaknesses: They will get back to their original shape after 24 hours.
They will have your biological structure, so they can have some of your superpowers.
Your face will be well-known, if you use this power a lot.

name: Charging Rhino
description: This ability can also proves to be handy while playing football
summary: The ability to have the Strength and Speed of a Rhino, and its invincibility
strengths: You will be as invincible as a Rhino
You will be as fast as a rhino
You will be strong as a rhino
weaknesses: You will occasionally be dumb as a log
You will be short tempered
You will be more agressive

name: Fate Switch
description: A person with this power has the ability to switch fates with someone else. For example if they are destined to die at a young age they can switch this fate to someone else. If your defeat is certain then you can switch this with someone else, then reality will warp to give you the advantage. Everytime you switch fate, the results of your last fate switch will start to crumble. If you made an empire then switched fates with a peasant your empire will start to crumble.
summary: The ability to switch fates with someone else
strengths: Switch your death with someone else
If you're erased from existence then you can still switch with someone in existence before erasure
Can switch with an immortal to "defeat" the immortal
weaknesses: If someone you switch with has a worser fate than you
You can still die of old age since that is a universal fate

name: Special Memory Manipulation
description: With this superpower, you can instantly erase any embarrassing situation from your memory. For example, suppose you made a fool of yourself at a party and your mates keep reminding you about it. Well, now you won't have any idea what they're talking about. Ah, blissful ignorance.
summary: The ability to forget any embarrassing situations you might have experienced.
strengths: Forget all embarrassing moments.
Remain blissfully ignorant of your embarrassing mistakes.
Feel better about yourself.
weaknesses: Once you erase a memory, you can't get it back.
You might not learn from your mistakes if you keep erasing them.
You might start to think you're perfect.

name: Coatl, The Ever Flowing River
description: This power allows you to be very successful in what you're doing. You'll be more productive and the quality of your work will increase, as well as any profit you can get from it. To reflect your success, your skin will shed, revealing a more appealing appearance. Your inner self will also "shed" to reveal a more attractive personality. The best thing is people won't notice the change, they only feel something's different but won't know what, unless they are very observant.
summary: The ability to increase your productivity, the quality and profitability of your work, and enhance your appearance.
strengths: Hard work and determination is undoubtedly the road to success with the help of this power.
Your family, friends and acquaintances will still recognize you after you change your appearance.
Any project you undertake can become successful if you put your heart into it.
weaknesses: Beware as it only works if you actually put effort into it: It doesn't reward laziness at all!
You can't control what appearance you will get after you shed your skin.
Using your other superpowers to help with your projects can be seen as laziness.

name: Excalibur And Avalon
description: Excalibur is the strongest sword given by the Lady of the Lake; with it you can cut through almost anything. Avalon, the sheath, lets you become invulnerable by healing all existing wounds through cellular regeneration and protecting against dimensional, magical, and physical attacks.  If the user acts unchivalrous then the effects will be negated  Both of these can be stolen, and cannot be used against each other(strongest spear/shield paradox)
summary: The ability to wield Excalibur and its sheath Avalon
strengths: You have the best weapon combination short of divine weapons
You can lead armies and create your own kingdom
weaknesses: You will die young betrayed by your most trusted knight
You must be chivalrous
Can be defeated by divine weapons

name: Bloodless
description: Normally when at least 50% of the blood is drained from a body, the body dies. However, with this power you can live even if all the blood in your body is drained away. You'll survive with nutrients getting to each cell similar to how an Arctic fish gets nutrients to each cell or a fungus alternatively.
summary: The ability to live with a body that has no blood
strengths: Can survive with no blood in your body.
Used in conjunction with Blood Manipulation.
weaknesses: When all the blood disappears from the body it will stop regenerating blood for the rest of life.

name: Sea Mammal Control
description: With this power, any type of sea mammal is at your control. This includes dolphins, whales, porpoises, manatees, walruses, seals, sea lions etc.
summary: The ability to control sea mammals
strengths: You can control all sea mammals
weaknesses: Most sea mammals are confined to the water so this power is only useful if fighting in the water
No applicable to other sea animals that are not mammals

name: Anti Magic Bullets
description: This power allows the creation of psionic bullets that destroy any magic they come in contact with and physically harm magical beings. Magical artifacts are 'depowered' as are cursed beings. 10 bullets can be fired in a second for 10 sec with 1 min rest between each burst. If you try to extend the 10 sec limit, you cannot use this power for 1 week. The bullets can pierce through magical things, but dissipate a sec after firing. Bullet per second rate can be increased with hard training.
summary: The ability to create psionic bullets that destroy magic on impact and physically damage only magical creatures
strengths: Can take down the strongest magical opponent.
Can increase rate of fire.
Bullets can pierce to hit multiple targets.
weaknesses: Only works on magic.
Bullets dissipate really quickly.
Hard to get targets to line up for the piercing effect.

name: Anvil, Safe And Piano Drop
description: With this power you can cause anvils, safes and pianos to fall from the sky and onto your enemies, enemies' houses/bases, enemies' car or anything else that you want to drop an anvil, safe or piano on
summary: The ability to make anvils, safes and pianos fall from the sky
strengths: You can crush people/things
weaknesses: What are you going to do with the anvils/safes/pianos after they crush things

name: Mini Me
description: You can create a 2-inch chibi version of yourself that follows your orders but also has a slightly different personality than its creator. Ex. The Mini-Me could be more spunky, flirtatious, etc. The Mini-Me will be three heads tall, in other words its head is 1/3 of its total height and also looks cuter than its creator. You can communicate with the Mini-Me telepathically and also verbally. This power can only be gained by using Telepathy at the same time you use Astral Projection.
summary: The ability to create a 2-inch chibi version of oneself
strengths: Carry him/her around in your pocket as a companion.
Instant servant!
The Mini-Me likes anyone you like and hates anyone you hate.
weaknesses: Only one way to gain this power.
The Mini-Me's strength is in proportion to how small it is in comparison to its creator.
You will know when you gain this power because you will faint.

name: Pleasantly Warm
description: Is it raining? Not anymore! With this power, all you have to do is say the words "Pleasantly Warm" and it will become as warm as day. You can only make the weather warm and sunny. Nothing more.
summary: The ability to make a sunny weather
strengths: Rain,rain go away.
It's raining sunshine :)
Have a wonderul weather.
weaknesses: You can only make the weather warm and sunny. Nothing more.
Might hate sunlight.
This can even be activated at night time. So vampires, you're screwed.

name: Energy Mimicry
description: One with the ability of Energy Mimicry is capable of mimicking the energy in one's surroundings. They can also mimic other empowered humans' abilities by successfully replicating their energy. However, when one mimics the energy of an empowered human or a normal human they take their ability strength as well. So they are just as experienced as the user they mimic from.
summary: The ability to mimic the energy that is in one vicinity, whether being heat-related, magnetic, solar, or kinetic.
strengths: The advantage that one has in battle is immense since they can take their enemies' power
With training, one can wield all forms of energy.
One can also learn to master the natural elements
weaknesses: Can only mimic nearby energies.
Can't master mimicked abilities from others past their proficiency.

name: Eye Beam Holes
description: Ever wanted to make someone's head disappear? Just stare at them and concentrate. Turn 'em into swiss cheese. This can be done to any substance. You can control the hole's size, but its maximum diameter can only be as big as the distance you are from the object, and its maximum depth is half that distance. You can unmake a hole by staring at it again, so you can pass through walls and stop followers. This can be used for spying, though it is not as discreet as X-Ray Vision.
summary: The ability to stare holes through objects
strengths: Very Dangerous
Holes don't have to be permanent
Works on any substance
weaknesses: Limit to size of holes
Only works if you can see the target
Not the best way to spy

name: Weapon Form
description: The power to turn people into weapons. They will only be changed into a weapon for 15 minutes. Pretty cool, huh?
summary: The ability to turn people into weapons for 15 minutes
strengths: Super strong to counter bad guys in battle
Destroy disasters
weaknesses: Lasts 15 minutes
Weapon type will fit character's personality

name: Friend Summon
description: Basically, you can summon anyone whom you consider to be a friend to your location.
summary: The ability to summon one's friends.
strengths: Always have help when you need it.
weaknesses: Might tick off your friends by constantly summoning them or summon them at the wrong time.
If you're the strongest and you're losing a fight, your friends won't make much of a difference.

name: Sleep Sight
description: With this super power, looking into a person's eyes will make them fall asleep for up to twelve hours. The effect can vary from two hours to twelve hours. When they wake up, they will not remember falling asleep. Also, the person will not be able to be waken up until your power wears off.
summary: The ability to make people fall asleep by looking into a person's eyes.
strengths: You can cause people to fall asleep to get out of tight situations.
weaknesses: You can't control exacly how long a person will fall asleep.

name: Myth Power: Leto's Grace
description: Leto, in Greek myth, was the goddess of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment. As such, channeling her allows one to turn imperceptible (invisible, intangible, inaudible, inodorous, etc) at will; one does not even leave behind traces of one's presence, such as fingerprints, footprints or the like. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will, as well as withstand any abilities she has. One even gains favor with subjects who have MythPowers.
summary: The ability to channel Leto's command over the essence of motherhood, womanly demure, modesty and concealment
strengths: Turn imperceptible (invisible, etc) at will (may be shared by touch); impossible to track
Psychically perceive and communicate with one's mother at will; immune to her abilities
Favor with people who have MythPowers
weaknesses: Cannot mimic/absorb mother's abilities until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift and MythPower: Artemis' Gift provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and other Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Death Perception
description: A person with this power has the ability to predict how someone will possibly die within the next 24 hours. For an assassin this is an useful ability since you know how to kill someone. For law enforcement or a bodyguard you can prevent people from dying by predicting how they can possibly die and preventing it. This ability is only activated when the user wills it and all scenarios seen can be avoided--can avoid fate but not death--in the end.
summary: The ability to see how someone will die within the next 24 hours
strengths: You know how to kill someone, possibly even an immortal--gives you info how to kill
You know how to prevent someone from dying early
You can use this in direct combat to figure out people's weaknesses and attack them
weaknesses: You will often have to save people if you want to check the power often
You cannot predict your own death
Trying to help may sometimes be the reason someone will die but not always

name: Demon Type Absorption
description: This power is demonic and will corrupt the soul. You can absorb livin beings into your body and then use their matter to create new beings that are under your control by ejecting some living mass from your body. You can also enhance the unseen parts of your body with the matter and transform parts of your body to be more demonic. You can also change height, weight, gender, anything except being less demonic.
summary: The ability to absorb any living being for various uses
strengths: Can still absorb beings that died (this includes plants).
Can become really strong.
Can create living beings under your control.
weaknesses: Cannot absorb matter that never lived.
Must become more demonic (may be pro for some people).
Soul corrupts.

name: Airborne Rage
description: The possessor of this ability automatically secretes an odorless chemical that induces a homicidal rage in the people around him/her. The chemical also makes them identify the possessor of the ability as a friend, meaning they will never attack him/her. This ability also can be reversed, and will make everyone romantically love each other, no matter their orientation. The anger can be directed at a certain person or group, giving you a homicidal army that will also want to kill each other.
summary: The ability to induce a state of destructive rage in the people around you
strengths: Can create an army of crazy, murderous people
Can create of group of peace loving people in even the craziest of people.
Won't get attacked by the people around you.
weaknesses: Won't be included in the lovefest
Hard to control/turn off

name: Mass Consumption
description: With this ability, your body grows by the amount of mass consumed. You can also use this ability to steal mass from other forms of life. You can compress your body to a normal size, however the more mass you take in, the more difficult it becomes. The amount of mass your body can take is limitless, so you can become three times your normal size, or even hundreds of times your normal size.
summary: The ability to increase size based on mass consumed
strengths: You can make yourself look taller
weaknesses: Becomes harder and harder to compress to a normal size as you gain mass

name: Potent Blood
description: Your blood is potent and can enhance what it is put into. Example: A potion that enhances your strength by a factor of 10 suddenly enhances by a factor of 20. It can be any type of liquid or solid that can be ingested for some kind of effect. You cannot enhance how much your blood enhances stuff nor can the potency be reduced.
summary: The ability to have blood that enhances the effects of what it is put into
strengths: Your blood enhances potions that can make you stronger.
weaknesses: Your blood can enhance poisoned potions.
Your blood will NOT mix with gases.

name: Myth Power: Techne's Teachings
description: Techne (Tekhne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of art, technology and craft. As such, channeling her allows one to access knowledge of any technical skill, at will (as well as withstand skill-based effects). In addition, one can enter a trance state, to relay psychic insights, artistically. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command machines (engine-run machines, electronic devices, etc). One can also psychically mimic electronic devices' thought processes, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Techne's command over the essence of art, technology, technical skill and craftsmenship
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of any technical skill (and withstand negative skill-based effects)
Enter a trance state, to receive psychic insights, and relay them via artistic expression
Psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic thought processes of machines
weaknesses: Cannot psychically gain/bestow/enhance/disrupt/negate magic powers until developed (NCN)
Cannot travel into technology (Cybernetic Projection) or art (Artistic Travel) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hephaestus' Forge provides negation (NCN)

name: User Rank Power Boost
description: Basically what the overview says. The power boosting number affects any power with a measurable trait. If you're not one of the 10 most powerful users then this power  works as if you were 11th most powerful user. This power allows for multiple 11th most powerful users.
summary: The ability to boost the effectiveness of any of your powers by a number equal user rank squared
strengths: Not one of 10 most powerful users? You get the best power boost.
There can be more than one 11th most powerful user.
A way to balance your powers against those of the top 10 users.
weaknesses: None or not enough of your powers have measurable traits.

name: Mind Fi
description: You now have the ability to emit a WiFi signal from your head. Any computer within a range of thirty feet can log on to the Internet via your brain waves. The signal is always good, and pretty fast. The only downside is the headaches that form after an hour or so.
summary: The ability to use Mind Server.
strengths: Create a WiFi signal.
Always have Internet connectability.
weaknesses: Causes headaches.

name: Mantis Hookswords
description: Also known as the crescent blades, they are extremely durable and when you slash with them, they can fire off waves of fire & ice. They are very sharp so you can eviscerate your foes with great ease.
summary: The ability to use the swords to fire off waves of energy.
strengths: One Ice blade
One Fire blade
Sharp and durable
weaknesses: Can be stolen
You are not immune to your own blades

name: Myth Power: Jaws Of Charybdis
description: Charybdis (Kharybdis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of whirlpools and the tides. As such, channeling her allows one to survive underwater and swim well. In addition, one can stir any source of water into a whirlpool (which may be used for Teleportation and the like) at will. Furthermore, one may inhale with the power of a whirlpool, and exhale with the force of a tornado (with the added option of unhinging one's jaws) at will. One can even spin rapidly like a miniature tornado at will.
summary: The ability to channel Charybdis' command over the essence of whirlpools, maelstroms and the tides
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater; stir water into whirlpools (may be used for Teleportation)
Vortex Inhalation (immense water/air intake); Gale Exhalation (even shoot pressurized water/air)
Spin rapidly, like a minature tornado, at will; Unhinge one's jaws at will
weaknesses: Cannot stir ambient moisture into buzzsaw-like blades until th higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use whirlpools for Dimensional Travel or Time Travel until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot perceive (and gain physical power from) the flux of the tides until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Long Distance Sex
description: The ability to have sex with another person or partner in a different location, and yet it feels like real sex. They can feel, see, hear, taste, and smell you as if you were actually present in their location.
summary: The ability to make someone feel like they are physically having real sex with you at a distance
strengths: You can have sex with anyone
No possible way to get pregnant
Could greatly improve the success of your long distance relationship
weaknesses: Can't get pregnant from doing it
Person isn't actually there with you

name: Enhancement: Counter Attack
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power automatically counter an attack to you when you're attacked. This power cannot be attached to overly powerful powers such as Power of Imagination, Self-Existence Manipulation (don't know what it would do for one thing), unavoidable attacks, etc. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power automatically counter-attack when the holder is attacked
strengths: Putting this on a negation power might be a little overkill on superhumans.
Great for a surprise attack when enemies think you're guard is down.
Don't have to worry about countering anymore because any attack is automatically countered.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
The attack on you might be a joke set up by friends.
Can only have one of this power at a time.

name: The  Less Power
description: You have the ability to less-in yourself in some way. Ex. Shadowless or ageless; also death, time, fear, sound, emotion, color, life, power, change or sin; any trait that make sense with a -less added to it. You can't choose boundless or limitless and be omni-powerful. You can only reduce yourself in one trait but can change it at will. Becoming mindless, lifeless or powerless for example would require secondary powers to restore yourself.
summary: The ability to reduce yourself in some way.
strengths: Become translucent and hard to see.
Live longer.
Protect yourself from shadow control powers.
weaknesses: Secondary powers are required to recover certain traits.

name: Negative Neutral Blasts
description: There are these machines/powers that take away superpowers called "neutralizers." Villains just love using these to make the hero "a normal person". Ironically this power only works if you have been neutralized; now you can create powerful blasts of energy to project at your enemy, fly or create a shield to protect yourself and others. All powers are neutralized, except this one; if this is your only power, nothing is neutralized.
summary: The ability to create powerful blasts of energy from your body when your powers are neutralized.
strengths: This power is made to activate if you have been neutralized
Send the blasts from your feet to fly
Stop the blasts a few feet from you to create a shield
weaknesses: Only works if you have been neutralized
Sucks if this is your only power

name: Wind Up Punch (Kinetic)
description: A person with this power has the ability to charge up kinetic energy in their fists by "winding up" their arms-spinning. Also, the user can store this energy for any time they want until they punch something. When they punch something, they transfer all the charged kinetic energy into the attack. The target will either get blasted away or have a gaping hole. The energy is transferred without Newton's Third Law, so there is no recoil and the user's arms do not break due to the opposing force.
summary: The ability to charge up your fists with kinetic energy by winding up
strengths: You can store unlimited amount of energy by winding up
Your arm does not break from the recoil or Newton's Third Law
You can combine this with superspeed to wind up faster or with multiple arms to get more hits
weaknesses: It takes time to store energy
If you spin too fast, you might dislocate something
You only get one shot since it will most likely blast your target away or kill in one shot

name: Lock Shot
description: The LockShot is the opposite of the KeyBlade. It is a fusion of a pistol and a pad lock. Like the KeyBlade it can take on many styles and can be used to cast a variety of magics. Unique to the LockShot is its ability to lock people's hearts turning them into Heartless controlled by the wielder. If destroyed the Heartless return to being normal people. The LockShot can not be wielded by anyone but its owner and will teleport back to its owner.
summary: The ability to summon and wield the LockShot.
