strengths: Have the LockShot as a weapon with infinite ammo.
Allows magic use such as holy, cura, and firaga.
Has the option to turn those it shoots into Heartless.
weaknesses: Will be seen as a villian if you turn people into Heartless.
The KeyBlade can undo the effects of the LockShot.
Those with strong will can become immune to becoming Heartless.

name: Taste No Evil
description: You can enjoy eating the oddest foods and drinking things that aren't beverages, but you could sense spoiled snacks and spiked drinks by using your red-glowing taste buds and if it detects them you can devour them.
summary: The ability to be immune to tainted & poisonous foods while eating them.
strengths: You can't get poisoned and sick while trying to eat and drink anything else.
weaknesses: Some people might try to see you as disgusting and weird.

name: Self Submersion Limits
description: With this ability, you choose how deep the water is to you. You can choose to make the water 6 feet deep or 6 inches deep to you. This works because of a psionic invisible platform that is tangible only to you. You can turn the power off. If the power is on, you can't choose the psionic platform to be deeper than 6 feet or less than 1 inch deep.
summary: The ability to choose how deep the water is to you.
strengths: Choose how deep the water is to you.
The invisible psionic platform protects you from deeper water.
You can turn the power off.
weaknesses: The psionic platform is only tangible to you.
You can't set the psionic invisible platform deeper than 6 feet or less than 1 inch deep.
You might not know if you have this superpower.

name: Myth Power: Nomos' Nomination
description: Nomos (Nomus), in Greek myth, was the god of rules, law, ordinances and statutes. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically inscribe rules on subjects; subjects will follow their inscribed rule without question, and act with hostility toward those who don't. In addition, one can psychically summon (and recall every word of) a book with every rule and/or law in existence, at will. Furthermore, one may point to a rule in the Rule Book, and perceive/teleport to any place said rule applies.
summary: The ability to channel Nomos' command over the essence of rules, law, ordinance and statutes
strengths: Psychically inscribe rules on subjects that serve as psychic compulsions
Psychically summon a Rule Book with every rule/law in existence; check for rule/law loopholes, etc.
Point to a rule in the Rule Book and teleport self/others to anywhere said rule applies
weaknesses: Rule-compulsions must not contradict one another, or both are negated (NCN)
Only inscribe subjects with one rule at a time until developed; no direct inscription of death (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Epiphron's Appeal
description: Epiphron, in Greek myth, was the god of prudence, carefulness, shrewdness, thoughtfulness and caution. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive nearly any significant events in subjects' lives, so they can prepare for them. In addition, one's luck increases when one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead carefully. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with careful, meticulous people at will. One may even psychically compel rash and reckless people.
summary: The ability to channel Epiphron's command over the essence of prudence, carefulness and caution
strengths: Psychically perceive especially significant events in the lives of others at will (by touch)
Gain better and better luck the longer one takes time to practice, prepare and plan ahead
Psychically perceive and communicate with cautious, prudent people; compel reckless people
weaknesses: Cannot perceive especially significant events in one's own life until the higher levels (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck based-MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: 3 Headed Dragon Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon a three headed dragon. The dragon can fly, is invulnerable, has sharp teeth in all of its mouths and is super strong. One of the dragon's heads shoots fire, the second one shoot ice and the third one shoots out webbing. The dragon is under your complete control and you can unsummon it when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon a three headed dragon
strengths: You can summon a three headed dragon
It's under your complete control
weaknesses: It can be killed
It might be attacked by the government for being a monster

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message4
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Euterpe (Lyric Poetry) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all lyrical works, at will. In addition, one can psychically generate and manipulate rhythm and tempo, by touch and/or proximity, at will. One can also psychically convert objects into other objects with rhyming names, at will. One can even psychically compel subjects, by rhyming, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of lyrical works, at will
Psychically generate and manipulate rhythm/tempo, by touch or proximity, at will
Psychically convert objects into rhyming objects; compel subject, by rhyming, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Cd Consciousness.
description: Don't have many defensive powers? Have a major weakness? Afraid of death? Just want some extra protection? If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, this is the power for you. If the CD is put in an electronic device, you can enter and control that device. You can even burn yourself to make more CD's. Each CD also has a copy of your DNA from your touch. Uses the same process as Power Backup.
summary: The ability to put a copy of your consciousness on CD
strengths: Avoid death, unless all your CD's are destroyed.
This power automatically protects the CD from scratches.
Control electronics with the capacity to use CD's.
weaknesses: If you can't get blank CD's.
If alive, you can only access electronics through a deep trance or sleep.
CD's can be destroyed.

name: Bacterial Communication
description: Bacteria produce chemicals they use to communicate. With this power you can generate these chemicals to employ a variety of effects. You can program the bacteria with your powers to empower you or give you back your lost powers. You can make them join together and infect something, glow, aid bodily functions or attack. You can use this to create new strains and you can also make the bacteria form a cluster the size of a small dog to use as a weapon.
summary: The ability to control how bacteria and some cells communicate.
strengths: Versatile.
Heal yourself and others.
Make poisonous bacteria or ones that corrode things.
weaknesses: Healing is limited.
Try telling your friends that your job is bossing around germs.
Creepy.

name: Quartz Bolts
description: This ability allows you to fire bolts of white energy that turns anything they strike into quartz crystal. Objects retain thier shape.
summary: The ability to fire bolts of energy that turn anything into quartz.
strengths: Turn anything to quartz crystal
Objects retain shape
weaknesses: Does not discriminate. If you hit it, it's quartz.
Hard to be percise

name: Blue Needles
description: You are able to rapidly throw a bunch of acupuncture needles at your opponent, and one more at their head. They then start to go a little further than skin-deep, your foe turns red and starts to feel intense pain. They'll be inflated and float on way up high. An explosion is heard as their blood, bones and organs rain down.
summary: The ability to throw them at your opponents, causing their bodies to swell and explode.
strengths: May be able to throw one or two which stops your foe from moving.
Can use it for rapid firing,
weaknesses: Kind of gross.

name: Enhancement: Unfindable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes it nearly impossible to scan for or find the attached power. It also makes itself 'invisible' to an outside searcher to help hide the other power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power nigh impossible to scan for or find
strengths: Now you have a backup the enemy knows nothing about... Hee hee hee hee...
If this power is somehow stolen its last effect is really nice, highly unlikely though
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Mind readers don't have to bother searching, your memories will tell them.

name: Walk On Water
description: The ability stand on bodies of water without sinking .
summary: The ability to walk on Water
strengths: Cross ponds and lakes without detouring for a bridge.
Keep your feet dry when you step on a puddle.
Chase Ducks and Geese.
weaknesses: Unable to swim
Can't take a bath

name: The Walking Plague
description: Those with this power can infect any living thing with any disease simply by touching them. However, the power is always active and the user has little or no control over what diseases are used with each touch (though you can learn to gain some control).
summary: The ability to infect any living thing with any disease through physical contact.
strengths: You can weaken enemies easily.
You can make enemies die painfully and slowly (if you enjoy watching others suffer).
You could discover new diseases (any disease meaning discovered and undiscovered).
weaknesses: You can kill someone by accident (say you bump them by mistake and give them cancer).
You cannot turn off your power so you risk killing any creature you touch.
The diseases are chosen at random so you could try to kill someone and end up giving them a cold.

name: Medicated
description: With this power a drug's claim is taken literally. Pain relievers allow you to control your pain and the pain of others. Sleeping pills allow you to induce sleep. Allergy medicine allow you to make anyone allergic to whatever you choose, etc. Recreational drugs are mostly dangerous but have varying effects. All abilities last until the drug runs its course.
summary: The ability to gain abilities from pills
strengths: The range of your powers is dependant on dosage
Multivitamins will enhance abilities gained from medications
Steroids, HGH and muscle builders will take you beyond any top athlete
weaknesses: Medications must be in pill form and you still have to come up with the co-pay
Herbal medications have a 50 percent chance of being a placebo
You are at risk of every drug's side effect and you could always overmedicate.

Not affected by mood
weaknesses: No snow days
Hurricanes if two halcyon's fields come into contact

name: Wood Hardening
description: Your very presence can reinforce any wooden object or the wooden part of anything so they become extremely hard while still keeping their wooden appearance. They also become impossible to burn. With this, you can easily deceive people into thinking they are just dealing with plain simple wood, but they won't be able to scratch, cut or smash it.
summary: The ability to make wood as hard as diamond
strengths: Lumberjacks won't be able to fell trees, lovers won't be able to carve silly hearts into their bark.
No one will be able to smash through the wooden door you built
Hylian Shield or Master Sword are now less than Wooden Shield and Sword
weaknesses: Fighting against a wood manipulator.
You also reinforce your enemy's wood.

name: Delete This Armageddon Torpedo
description: You can disappear and come off from nowhere. Your entire body is completely covered with light-filled energy. You then fly straight towards your enemies, knocking them way into the air and doing a maximum amount of damage
summary: The ability to emit aura from your body, fly at an opponent and push them against a wall, dealing a lot of damage.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Nevermore
description: You could possess the power to bestow bad luck among villains. By a combination of simple empathic gestures and mental concentration, you can create a raven (which is a sign of sorrow) that'll cause extreme misfortunes and eternal death to your foes from your own dark energy, can manipulate reality, and essentially can have any abilities needed to accomplish your goal of vengeance.
summary: The ability to cause worst things happen to evildoers.
strengths: It'll be fun to watch your enemies to suffer in agony or misery.
weaknesses: However, once those goals are met, you'll lose this powers and your existence in the real world.

name: Prehensile Feet
description: This power gives you the ability to have feet that anatomically resemble hands. You are then able to grasp things with your feet, type with your feet, or give the bird with your feet.
summary: The ability to have hand-like feet.
strengths: You can hang yourself upside down by holding onto to tree branches with your feet.
You are an expert tree and rock climber as your feet are very agile.
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off.
Hand-like feet are hardly made for running or bipedalism.
tags: was edited as it was too overpowered and unbeatable

name: Sensory Focus
description: With this ability, one can look in one direction, and focus on it to allow himself to hear everything in that specific location. Other sounds are faded out while the user is tuning. This takes minimal effort, however becomes difficult to do if the location is over 5,000 ft away. This also allows the user to see more vividly in that specific area, and he can zoom in closer to observe what he is looking at more easily.
summary: The ability to tune into sound and focus into a certain direction.
strengths: Tune in your ears and eyes to a specific location/direction.
Listen to faraway conversations.
Allows you to see objects more clearly.
weaknesses: May be triggered without much effort, causing it to switch on randomly.
Everything farther than 5,000 ft is much more difficult to tune in.

name: Location Swap
description: With this power, you just think of a person, then you and that person will swap locations, and you will appear at the location where he used to be. Same thing happens with the other person.
summary: The ability to swap locations with other people.
strengths: Be the greatest spy in the world.
Swap locations in self-defense.
Always keep up with your friends.
weaknesses: You might not know where the other person is headed.
You might accidentally use this power.
If you swap your location with an evil being, that being might do evil deeds.

name: Lava Spit
description: You can spit lava from your mouth!
summary: The ability to spit lava
strengths: Can melt stuf
Works with loogies
Doesn't hurt the inside of your mouth
weaknesses: The lava can only go as far as you can spit
Can't kill someone with your spit
Spit doesn't taste good

name: Myth Power: Hearken To Hybris
description: Hybris (Hubris), in Greek myth, was the goddess of insolence, excessive pride, outrage, outrageous behavior and violence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically impose admiration on neutrals in one's vicinity, so they think highly of the user. In addition, the angrier one gets, the easier objects become to break in his vicinity; one's insults inflict literal physical pain. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the proud, the violent and the eccentric.
summary: The ability to channel Hybris' command over the essence of insolence, arrogance, outrage and violence
strengths: Psychically cause neutrals in radius to think highly of you; insults inflict literal physical pain
When angered, objects in one's vicinity become easier to break
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel pompous/conceited, eccentric and violent people
weaknesses: Cannot use injury to inflict injury, or reduce a subject in size until the higher levels (NCN)
Effect of insults depends on how much an insult hurts the subject (NCN)
MythPowers based on Nyx or her children provide immunity (NCN)

name: Snap You're Gone V3
description: With this power you can send anybody to an alternate dimension by snapping your fingers and saying the person's name. They will then be transported to a random alternate dimension. It is possible to bring the person back but only by snapping, saying their name and getting lucky by having the random dimension be the person's home dimension otherwise they keep on going to random dimensions whenever you snap and say their name.
summary: The ability to teleport people to other dimensions by snapping
strengths: You can send people to other dimensions
weaknesses: It is almost impossible to get them back

name: Myth Power: Plane's Plight
description: Plane, in Greek myth, was the goddess of errors, flaws and mistakes. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive flaws in truth, logic, strategy, structure, etc. In addition, one can psychically reveal said flaws to others (reveal physical flaws by touch; reveal immaterial flaws by word/thought). When immaterial flaws are exposed, they can be exaggerated to deal MENTAL pain/injury/damage. When physical flaws are exposed, they can be exaggerated to deal PHYSICAL pain/injury/damage.
summary: The ability to channel Plane's command over the essence of error, wrongness and failure
strengths: Perceive errors of all kinds (structure, grammar, logic, strategy, procedure, etc) at will
Exaggerate physical errors/flaws (cracks, scrapes, scars, etc) to deal physical pain/injury/damage
Exaggerate immaterial errors/flaws (grammar, lies, logic, etc) to deal mental damage
weaknesses: Cannot induce erroneous choices or erroneous behavior/clumsiness until the higher levels (NCN)
Flaw Exaggeration must develop with time; NEVER exaggerate error/mistakes YOU cause (NCN)
People with MythPower: Momos' Mockery are immune to this ability (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Growth2)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of plant growth. As such, channeling Auxo (Auxesia- Increase) allows one to psychically grow plants, and prevent or reverse plant growth, at will. In addition, one can psychically grow and replicate plants and plant matter (wood, paper, cotton, etc), at will. Furthermore, one can can grow roots, to ground oneself or absorb nutrients, at will. One can even psychically tap into trees, by touch, to grow in size, strength and durability.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of plant growth and production
strengths: Psychically grow plants, as well as prevent or reverse plant growth, at will
Psychically grow and replicate plants and plant matter, at will
Grow roots (ground oneself, absorb nutrients), and tap into trees' power to grow in size/power
weaknesses: Cannot psychically manipulate plants (Agrokinesis), other than manipulating growth (NCN)
Part 2 of Pro #3 cannot be shared with others, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demeter's Touch and MythPower: Gaia's Gift provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Mirror Generation
description: You have the ability to temporarily transform flat surfaces into mirrors. The surface will return to normal if you go too far away from it, but you also have the ability to turn it back to normal yourself. This power can be used in conjunction with other mirror-based superpowers for powerful results.
summary: The ability to turn any flat surface into a mirror.
strengths: Any flat surface can be transformed into a mirror.
You can return to surface to normal at any time.
Greatly enhances the use of mirror-based superpowers.
weaknesses: Surfaces return to normal if you go too far away from them.
Few uses without other mirror-based superpowers.

name: Witch Species: Benandanti
description: In ancient Italy there was a type of witch called the benandanti, they had many abilities including. Sensing the good and evil in others, manipulating Karma, astral projection, super reflexes and super-healing
summary: The ability to have all of the powers of a benandanti.
strengths: An ancient and powerful race.
You can tell the kind of person someone is.
weaknesses: You don't have control over what happens to someone when you use karma manipulation.

name: Pen Creation
description: This power grants you the ability to create pens whenever you want. With this power, you can create pens at any time like when you are in need of a pen to write a paper just think of it and boom! It is there.
summary: The ability to create pens whenever you want to.
strengths: You never have to worry about not having a pen again.
You will never run out of pens.
You can easily create a weapon out of nowhere if you get in a fight.
weaknesses: When, your pen runs out of ink you will have a useless pen.
You could eventually fill the world with useless pens.
People could think you're a witch and burn you to the stake.

name: Reptile Mimicry
description: Reptiles as a group are highly successful animals, having been around for millenia. A Reptile Mimic can manifest some of their adaptations at will, including scales, gecko-like climbing power, enhanced strength, a crocodile's bite, and a powerful tail. However, when they are in this form, they have slightly reduced intelligence and emotional capacity. They also are cold-blooded.
summary: The ability to manifest aspects of reptiles at will
strengths: Strength
Shock factor
People not wanting to start fights
weaknesses: All or nothing- all the aspects or none of them
Reduced humanity
May become estranged from loved ones

name: Summon Charon
description: By calling his name and offering 2 coins, the ground opens up and Charon the boatman appears riding a wave of lava. He then grabs your enemies and drags them to hell.
summary: The ability to summon the infamous boatman, Charon.
strengths: Great way of getting rid of your enemies.
Good way to send people to hell.
weaknesses: The boatman doesn't work for free. You must pay 2 coins of any kind.
Damages the ground around you.
You must be in eyesight of your target.

name: Fictional Vehicle
description: With this power you can turn into any fictional vehicle such as the Bat Mobile, the Goblin Glider, the Halberd, the Arwing, snow speeder etc.
summary: The ability to turn into any fictional vehicle
strengths: Can turn into any fictional vehicle
weaknesses: You can't turn into any real vehicles even if it has appeared in a movie, T. V. Show or comic book

name: Mimesis (Mime Power)
description: Also called Miming, Mime, Pantomime, Pantomimicry or Imitation, this is the ability to mime objects, structures and occurrences into existence by pretending they are happening. By pretending they see something falling out of the sky, a large object of the user's choice (anvil, boulder, a fat lady, etc.) is pulled out of the collective subconscious to pummel the foe. The user can also lean on "nothing", do the infamous "box trick" and the like, but he must conform to the mime "silence rule".
summary: The ability to mime actions, objects and occurrences into existence
strengths: Mime objects (walls, baseball bats) OR occurrences (strong winds, oncoming flood) only you can see
Famous mime abilities (leaning on nothing, the box trick, lassoing) and immunity to sonic attacks
Mimed objects are invisible to everyone except user and people of his choosing (and animals)
weaknesses: Nobody likes mimes
Real mimes get jealous and then you get into miming battles all the time
Speaking, while using this ability, cancels the ability's use temporarily

name: Viral Telekinesis Regular
description: This power allows you to create a supernatural virus that infects people to create "bases". You can draw power from these bases to use telekinesis(the power depending on the base size). Eventually the virus will die out and set the size for a base. When people in a base die your power wanes and only one virus can infect a person at a time. However you can create multiple bases and cast out several viruses at once but you are only capable of drawing power from ONE base at a time.
summary: The ability to create supernatural viruses that give you an infected populace to draw telekinesis from.
strengths: Several bases can be created at once.
If you have a large base, you have extremely powerful telekinesis.
You can switch which base you channel from rapidly.
weaknesses: You have no way to determine the lifespan of the viruses.
You can only channel less power from a base that has had many people die.
It can be hard to build up a large base.

name: Standing Ovation
description: Know what one of the all time fears is in America, even worse than death itself? Public speaking! With this ability, you'll never stutter and stumble over your words again. Never again will you feel the nervousness that comes from standing in front of a group of people and speaking. It'll be smooth music to their ears. Perfect placement of humor while always getting the message across. Even if you're completely BS'ing, your speech will be spectacular. So bring on those damn oral presentations!
summary: The ability to be phenomenal at public speaking 100% of the time.
strengths: Deliver amazing speeches with 100% confidence
Woo the ladies in the audience with your eloquence
No accidental sharting due to nervousness
weaknesses: Your fear has been conquered for you, which may not be as rewarding
After you've woo'ed the ladies with your speaking, you're on your own buddy ;)

name: Demon Dash
description: You could even perform a shoulder ram, but with a dark blue-ish energy representation of a magical beast that rushes at enemies, and/or you can run forward at a very fast speed past your opponent, spinning them in a dizzying state. It can be used to destroy walls and buildings, but because direct contact with the enemy is required, you can still take damage while using it.
summary: The ability to transform into a demon, and rush forward with a full burst of speed at your foes.
strengths: Can destroy walls and even buildings.
weaknesses: Could take major or minor damage while using it.

name: Death Energy Sponge
description: All dying things have a one last spark of life in them. In a 1000 mile radius you can absorb this energy and 'squeeze' it out as an energy attack or to generate a force field. The strength of an attack or forcefield will be in flux. Living things die, but not all at the same time. You will always be able to use this power. The attack will be electrical in nature. The force field won't stop kinetic attacks like bullets but will affect someone punching you as if you used a stun gun on him.
summary: The ability to absorb the last spark of life from a dying creature.
strengths: Withstand energy damage.
All living things die.
An electrical attack.
weaknesses: This power is in flux.

name: Night Of Plenty
description: Going of the grid is a lot easier if you don't have to buy  most of your food.
summary: The ability to harvest a garden or field instantly on a full moon.
strengths: Harvesting food is relativity easy.
weaknesses: You can only use it on a full moon.

name: Space Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any kind of space vehicle. You can summon rocket ships, satellites, lunar rovers, space pods, UFOs etc. You also know how to operate any vehicle that you summon. When you're done you can unsummon the vehicle.
summary: The ability to summon any type of space vehicle
strengths: You can summon any kind of space vehicle
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: Just because you know how to operate a space vehicle doesn't mean you're ready to go into space

name: Rube Goldberg Machine Creation
description: There are three requirements: you need to trigger the first action, there must be enough elements available and the reactions must be possible. If all these are met, you just need to think about a task and a chain of events will accomplish it. Living beings' reaction can be involved, such as someone opening a door to see what's happening, someone putting down an object in a convenient place when they stand up, or even a rat chewing on a rope that just so happens to connect a car to the ceiling.
summary: The ability to trigger Rube Goldberg-esque reactions to perform the tasks you want.
strengths: With experience, this power could even guide you to perform the first action perfectly.
Cause an incredible chain of reactions to perform even the simplest task without the need to set it.
Humans's, even animal's and plant's, reaction to what's happening can be elements of the chain.
weaknesses: If some reactions are impossible, the chain will break.
Complex tasks are very difficult to realize, especially if there aren't enough elements.
Unless you have precise aim and calculated move, you may fail to trigger the chain.

name: 3rd Time's The Charm
description: You will literally win at anything you do the third time you do it, unless there is more of a prize than just making you feel good about winning.
summary: The ability to win at anything that doesn't have any prize except making one feel better
strengths: You always win the third time you do something!
weaknesses: You had to fail the first two times.
Doesn't guarantee future wins.

name: One Power Unrequirement
description: With this ability, you can use it to complete the requirements of one superpower instead of doing what the superpower requires. It only works with one superpower. No more sacrifices to use the one power you always wanted to use. Now you can freely use that one superpower. Cons of those powers may still apply. Be careful how you use this power. This power has no requirements.
summary: The ability to use this superpower to eliminate the requirements of one superpower.
strengths: Eliminate the requirements of one superpower.
No more deadly sacrifices that may kill you.
You can now use that superpower.
weaknesses: Cons of the other power may still apply.
If your superpowers do not require anything for you to use them.
Use responsibly.

name: Air Lock
description: With this ability you are immune to weather changes caused unnaturally. So if it is a natural change if the sun is shining and it a beautiful day, you would be unaffected by that. But if another made the weather rainy, you would be immune to the rain and cold.
summary: The ability to be immune to unnatural weather changes.
strengths: Unaffected by weather changes.
weaknesses: If someone makes it ran down money, you would be unaffected by that.
Weather usually isn't that much of a problem.......

name: Spirit Eater
description: Whenever there is a spirit in a one hundred yard radius, your mouth will automatically open and the spirit will be sucked into it. The spirit will not be able to posses your body and you will gain all of the powers that the spirit had; but only when it was alive for twenty four hours. If the spirit did not have any powers when it was alive, you simply gain super strength and invulnerability for twenty four hours.
summary: The ability to eat spirits and grow stronger
strengths: You can gain the powers of spirits
You can gain super strength and invulnerability
You can never be possessed by spirits ever
weaknesses: You only have the powers for 24 hours

name: The Balance
description: If you spot someone who is ill, injured and/or near death, you can miraculously heal them through touch and all their illnesses and injuries will disappear. However, there is a dire part to this power. As someone gets another chance at life, someone else in the vicinity will inexplicably die of something. You can heal that person too, bring them back to life, but again, someone else will die. You have a gift and a curse. It's a tease power of playing God. Order and balance must be set.
summary: The ability to heal anyone, but with a consequence
strengths: Can instantly heal or bring someone back to life
weaknesses: When you save someone, someone else will die

name: Superderm
description: With this ability, you will become immune to all injuries caused by friction. No more scrapes or friction burn. No more skateboard injuries. No more knee pads or elbow pads.
summary: The ability to be immune to injuries caused by friction
strengths: Be immune to all friction induced injuries.
No more skateboard injuries.
No more knee pads or elbow pads.
weaknesses: You are not indestructable.
Can still get hurt by physical attacks not involving friction.

name: Demon Lords
description: Call upon the seven demon lords for thier powers such as Leviathan-Sea Monster form, Beelzebub-Deadly Flies, Belphegor-Seducing Hypnotism, Mammon-Matter Magnetism, Asmodeus-Wind Gusting, Amon-Army of Souls Command and Lucifer-Great Demonic Strength.
summary: The ability to have powers from each of the seven demon lords of Hell.
strengths: Having awesome POWERS!
weaknesses: You will be EVIL!

name: Bioluminescence
description: The ability to make the skin grow, also when cut the blood of a person with this power glows.
summary: The ability to make the skin (and your blood) glow
strengths: Great night vision
Skin doesn't break out
Able to create a visible path for others in the dark
weaknesses: If person doesn't know how to control it they glow all the time in the dark
Powers don't work well in light

name: Holy Power: Field Of Fear
description: With this power you induce an hallucination on your enemy, making him think that he spent 100 years in hell, which is enough to drive anyone crazy, no matter how strong your enemy is. This power causes no physical damage and you can use it only on a maximum of three enemies per time. This power wastes almost no energy at all. People with Level Omega mind powers might be able to get protected from this power.
summary: The ability to create an hallucination, making your enemy think that he spent 100 years in hell, driving him crazy.
strengths: Can drive your enemies crazy without even getting tired.
Can use it on three enemies at the same time.
Hard to defend.
weaknesses: Causes no physical damage.
People with Level Omega mind powers are able to protected themselves from this power.
Only a Tormentor can use this power.

name: Mon Moves
description: A person with this power can access a variety of abilities by imitating Pokemon attacks. If the user does not have the adequate body part, their body will shapeshift temporarily to use the attack. Temporarily transformed parts have the same type advantages, disadvantages and strength of the chosen pokemon. You have to declare the attack before it can be used. All of the attack's effects can do the same damage as seen in the video game or the TV show.
summary: The ability to use any move used by a Pokemon in real life
strengths: You gain a lot of powers like telekinesis or energy balls or spewing fire.
Type advantages apply, but only when attacking
weaknesses: If someone throws a pokeball at you, your power will subconsciously make it real
Type disadvantages apply when attacking as well

name: I Am Here!!!!!!!!!!!
description: A magical presence is where a certain thing happens in your presence. For example,you could give someone a presence of Misfunction. Then whenever they are around things would go haywire. When you give someone a presence you can control how long it lasts but one month max. When you give a presence to yourself you can suppress it but its hard to do for a long time. Some common presences are the Presences of fortune,misfortune,peace,anger,fear & others. Once you give a presence you cannot take it.
summary: The ability to give anyone a magical presence
strengths: You can be specific (presence of exploding hot dogs)
Helpful in most situations
Gain multiple powers. Sorta.
weaknesses: You cannot take a presence back once you give it
More specific presence take longer and are harder to do
If it is discovered people will abuse (if you dont already) your power.

name: N+
description: You don't look like him, but you can jump up to 10 feet in the air, run up walls, run faster than a missile, and you can't get hurt unless you would die from the injury.
summary: The ability to have the powers of the ninja in N and N+
strengths: Agility
Immunity to injuries that would not cause death
Wall run
weaknesses: When you die, you explode
Your lifespan is limited to 17 years after you get the power but can be raised by getting gold cubes

name: The Centipede's Dilemma
description: Ask an opponent to tell you how a power they have works. If they try and fail, they power is gone. This power always works on other powers that control or manipulate complex things like matter, time, space, life, energy, etc. It won't work on something simple like super strength. How it works on anything in between depends on the IQ of your foe and the complexity of the power you want to negate. If your foe can or can't explain their power, your power will never work on them again either way.
summary: The ability to permanently negate an opponent's power if they can't explain it to you.
strengths: Can the Hulk explain why he can't be hurt?
"I can..." isn't an answer to how you control time and space.
weaknesses: Geniuses.
You only get one shot with this power.
The simplest powers can often be the best ones-you can't negate those powers.

name: Triforce Of Courage
description: With this power you have the triforce of courage and with this you can summon the master sword and gain courage and if you lose your soul it goes back to you body but until you find the person or thing that almost took your soul you will stay in wolf-form.
summary: The ability to use the triforce of courage
strengths: Fear nothing
Use the master sword
Never get your soul taken away
weaknesses: Untill you find the thing that almost took your soul you stay a wolf

name: Power Level Progress Blocker
description: Having a superpower isn't enough, you have to learn how to use it, train it, develop techniques, etc. This power allows its user to block anyone in their vicinity from making any further progress with their superpower. In other words, their level of proficiency with their power can't rise and their power can't evolve in any way. This power affects all the powers of a user, and blocks any means to level up a power.
summary: The ability to prevent the level of a power from rising.
strengths: It's frustrating for them to realize the efforts they just made to train a power were a waste.
Great against Ultimate Upgrader and, to a degree, Technique-based Power Creator.
weaknesses: You need to stay in their vicinity to keep blocking their power level.
The time and effort they'll lose is ridiculous in comparison with the time needed to master a power.

name: Personal Power Deactivation
description: This power is very rare and very heard to find. Imagine having powers that you don't want and you want to torn them  of permanently. You choose any power you have and it is deactivated.  This power is not immune to ability cancellation or any ability that is similar to it. This power does not protect or defend you in any way.
summary: The ability to turn off any power you have at will
strengths: Make your self feel better
You can cheat very easily (pro & con)
You can use this power as much as you want
weaknesses: This power is nether offensive or defensive ( no con negation)
only the auther of the power can torn it back on (no con negation)
Only works on yourself

name: Prerecorded Precogition
description: When you record a video for someone to see or hear in the future, you're only saying your message. You don't know how the person would respond or what they would say. But that would change if you have this power. When you start recording, your vision moves to when the recording will be played. You will speak and act out your message, but you will see and hear only the future. You will know the future guy's responses, and so you could change your message accordingly, conversation-style.
summary: The ability to anticipate the responses to a recorded message
strengths: Have a conversation with your great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren.
Doesn't even have to be far into the future, it just has to be in the future.
You could look through the recording's eyes and see what the future is like.
weaknesses: People might think it's not a recording.
Others wanting to know about their great-great-great-great-great-great (GASP! ) -great grandchildren
Effectively useless in combat - More useful in a time capsule or something.

name: Twin Devils
description: The twin devils are a pair of sais that are forged from mercury & scandium. They can manipulate and conjure darkness, as well as disperse mystical scarlet flaming energy in a form of a barrier. Further, they can send forth blasts of necrobolts which can only destroy any opponent that is evil. They will be sent  all the way to the underworld.
summary: The ability to use them to stab & strike with a brutal & mystical force.
strengths: Awesome sais
Darkness manipulation
weaknesses: Only works on evil beings

name: Myth Power: Phoebe's Phenomenon
description: Phoebe (Phoibe), in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of bright intellect and prophecy. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the past, present and future. In addition, one can psychically manipulate subjects' extrasensory powers, by touch, at will. One can also psychically absorb ambient light to increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will. One can even psychically project the feeling of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Phoebe's command over the essence of bright intellect and prophecy
strengths: Psychically perceive past/present/future; manipulate subjects' extrasensory power, by touch, at will
Psychically absorb light to temporarily increase one's intelligence and extrasensory powers, at will
Psychically project sensation of being blinded/burned by intense light into subjects' minds, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically project light to extend range for Part 2 of Pro #1, until developed (NCN)
Effects of Pro #2 and Part 2 of pro #1 only last while power is active (NCN)
MythPower: Leto's Grace, Apollo's Appeal and Artemis' Art provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hell Bent
description: Have you ever heard the term Hell Bent on something? Well this power can motivate people to do things in you want them to do, and when you do it they won't stop until they die or succeed. This is what it means by being Hell Bent.
summary: The ability to make people Hell Bent.
strengths: Make people do your will.
They won't stop ever.
weaknesses: They might die.

name: Gale Breath
description: With this power you become filled with an unending supply of air. The air causes your body to expand so that it becomes bloated, almost like a hot air balloon. Having this air means you will never need to breathe because you are filled with the supply of air. You can also blow out the air with considerable force. The air you blow out could be either hot or frosty.
summary: The ability to be full of a considerable amount of air.
strengths: Have an unending supply of air.
Breathe gale winds.
Your body will not be hurt from containing the air.
weaknesses: Your body becomes bloated containing the air.
You could be popped.
Accidentally releasing the air.

name: Vampire Immunity
description: Vampires' fangs can't pierce your skin nor can they control your mind. They also can't use guns or swords to kill you because they're the ones using them. Nothing they do directly to you by themselves will have any effect on you.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by the direct actions of vampires towards one
strengths: Vampires can't steal your blood or turn you into one of them.
'Vampirism: Superpower' won't neutralize this power, but it will negate your other powers.
weaknesses: Werewolves and zombies can still bite you and turn you into one of them.
Shadowulf1's Vampirism powers can still affect you.
Vampires can still hire mercenaries to kill you.

name: Surf's Up!
description: Snap your finger and manipulate tidal waves, causing them to increase in size, decrease in size or otherwise change (including what direction they move in).
summary: The ability to create and control large tidal waves or Tsunami
strengths: Ride the waves with glory.
Make waves larger or smaller at will.
Even cause tsunamis.
weaknesses: Creates tsunami when pissed off (unintentionally).
Must have presence of massive body of water.

name: Aura Of Corruption
description: Anyone who stands in the aura of someone with this power will be corrupted and become more inclined to do acts of evil. Cannot have both this power and 'Aura of Purification'.
summary: The ability to cause others to become (more) evil by keeping them in one's aura
strengths: Artifacts and places can also be corrupted by keeping them in your aura.
weaknesses: Anything that leaves your aura can still be purified.

name: Relationship Breakup
description: Parents, friends, a girlfriend/boyfriend, a husband/wife, exes, a boss, colleagues, the doctor, the baker, the guy they bumped into on the street, the girl they met in the lift, a rival, a kidnapper or a bully. Whenever two people interact with each other, a bond is created. Someone with this power can see these bonds and cut them. When it happens, both of them will forget everything about each other after experiencing a short sentiment of grief or relief depending on their former relationship.
summary: The ability to sever the bonds between individuals.
strengths: Get rid of a rival in love or a family member by making them forget their love or their family ties.
Help someone forget their past as a victim or a former prison convict and move on.
Dissolve groups of people, such as allies, sport teams or gangs.
weaknesses: Material traces, such as photographs, videos, phone numbers, or even common friends, still remain.
It doesn't prevent the two people from creating new bonds.
Doesn't work with animals and objects.

name: Death Touch
description: This power is based on flesh to flesh contact. It begins to kill cells in the target rapidly. Depending on how long contact is held, the victim can be brought to a fatal state or be killed. It may be affected by the abilities of the opponent on how it may effect them and also may not work. Ex. Hand to sleeve of opponent has no effect. It will also not have any effect on something mechanical like a robot or machine.
summary: The ability to bring upon near or full death upon a living entity through flesh contact.
strengths: May lead to quick victory.
Can cripple an opponent temporarily or permanently.
Intimidating presence.
weaknesses: Close range.
Interferes with social activities greatly.
Easy to misuse.

name: Submission Collar
description: With this power, you can create a collar around anyone's neck and assign a task to them. If they refuse to carry on that task, the collar will strangle them until they either resume or die. Once it's been completed, the collar disappears. You can create as many collars as you want but only one task can be associated with one collar and only one collar can be given to one person. For this power to work, you also need to explain the basics of your ability if they don't know about it.
summary: The ability to create a collar that strangles people if they don't obey you.
strengths: Force anyone to do your bid, even your enemies.
If they already know about your power, you don't have to explain it and can activate it immediatly.
weaknesses: If someone doesn't understand your power, it won't work on them.

name: Legends: Byakko.
description: With this power, the user conjures the mythical forces of the legendary Byakko (literally meaning; White Tiger). As such, they become engulfed with the creature's magnificent might; able to take the form of a tiger who harnesses superhuman strength, speed, senses, invulnerability, and control over the elements of wind and metal. The virtue of righteousness lives within, and the world is seen through clairvoyance. The user's abilities are doubled during the autumn season.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Tiger God.
strengths: The power can be activated at any given moment.
The user is the epitome of a tiger's (mythological) evolution.
weaknesses: The user's power is dependent on the number of tigers still existing.
The user's power is multiplied by the statistical value (prowess) of lasting tigers.

name: Power Of The Fainting Goat
description: Fainting goats are domestic goats that contract their muscles for roughly ten seconds when startled. With this power, you can invoke this response in any living creature by contracting all muscles related to movement, resulting in a total stiffening of the body. You can make duration from 1 second to 10 minutes. It's painless and doesn't inhibit breathing or cause any other negative effects to the body, and the victim stays conscious. The target will simply stiffen up and be totally immobile!
summary: The ability to cause living creatures to stiffen their muscles
strengths: Great for self defense or a good laugh
Fainting cats, dogs, people, cows, you name it
People won't want to mess with you
weaknesses: Doesn't cause any damage if that's what you're going for
The victim is still totally conscious

name: Wayfinder
description: Also called the sword of wisdom, Wayfinder possess the ability to lead you to wherever, or whatever, you want or need. Wayfinder will lead you intelligently, taking you through steps to get what you want. The main problem is that wayfinder does not lead you down the safest or quickest path, in fact it leads you down the longest and most dangerous path possible. Another lesser use of Wayfinder is to answer a question and to point to the answer. But beware, multiple paths will confuse it.
summary: The ability to wield the sword of wisdom.
strengths: Leads you where you want to go
Has a great sense of direction
Well balanced, super sharp sword, resistant to most damage
weaknesses: Has a nasty sense of humor
Extremely dangerous paths to your goal
It can't multitask.

name: Myth Power: Hemera's Daybreak
description: Hemera, in Greek myth, was the primeval goddess of daytime; daybreak and the daytime sky. As such, channeling her gifts one with Ultraviolet Vision to see better at day. In addition, one can perceive any location in the world where it is daytime, and the activities of any creatures in said locations. Furthermore, one can travel to and from any location where it is daytime, at will. One can even withstand light-based attacks and psychically disrupt shadow/darkness-based attacks at will.
summary: The ability to channel Hemera's command over the essence of daylight and the daytime sky
strengths: Gain Ultraviolet Vision to see better during the day
Psychically perceive any location where it is day (and creatures' activities in said locations)
Teleport self and others to any daytime location; withstand light powers, disrupt dark powers
weaknesses: Only generate 'daylight' or Time Travel to future/past daytimes at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel diurnal creatures until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hellhounds
description: A hellhound is a dog from hell that can withstand far higher temperatures than most creatures. They also can harm any kind of bodiless spirit with nothing more than their bare paws and fangs.
summary: The ability to summon hounds from Hell
strengths: Powerful pets.
weaknesses: The hellhounds you summon might decide to kill you.
You have to try to control the hellhounds by normal or supernatural methods.

name: Wolf Pack Eclipse
description: This power can only be obtain if have the mark of Skoll and Hati. When combing the two marks you can become even more stronger werewolf than before with the power of the sun and moon your power can grow during the day or night.
summary: The ability to become a twilight lycan
strengths: Become the ulimate werewolf
Power over the sun and moon
Never lose power during the day or night
weaknesses: Need the mark of Skoll
Need the mark of Hati
Gods will hunt you down

name: Myth Power: Mystis' Mission
description: Mystis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiates into mystery rites, like cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically convert normal language into language only the user and chosen subjects can understand, at will. In addition, one can psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic bond between the user and/or chosen subjects, at will. One can even psychically project a forcefield nearly impenetrable by anyone except the user and chosen subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Mystis' command over the essence of members initiated into mysteries
strengths: Convert normal spoken/written language into a language only the user/chosen subjects can understand
Psychically establish a telepathic and/or empathic link between user/chosen subjects
Psychically project a force field, nearly impenetrable by anyone except user/chosen subjects
weaknesses: Pro #2 requires touch (and cannot develop into user-dominated hive-mind), until developed (NCN)
Cannot access arcane/occult knowledge to cast magic spells until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia and MythPower: Telete's Test provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tenocyte Mimicry
description: You can produce biological fibers compressed into very tough bands. These bands have some elastic properties but are still very resistant to traction forces. Also, you can easily stick either end to any kind of solid surfaces. Additionally, you can undergo mitosis, creating identical copies of yourself.
summary: The ability to create tough collagen bands.
strengths: You can create very resistant ropes.
You won't waste any time tying your rope or finding something to tie it to, you can just stick it.
You can duplicate yourself to outnumber an opponent.
weaknesses: Your "ropes" can still be slashed.
Your "ropes" can conduct electrical current.
You can't reabsorb your clones.

name: Sarcasm Detection
description: With this ability, the user can detect sarcasm, whether spoken, telepathic, written or otherwise. It manifests as knowledge, not a sense, when sarcasm is used.
summary: The ability to detect sarcasm in any form.
strengths: Detect sarcasm flawlessly.
Good for autistic people.
Very useful when on the internet.
weaknesses: If you are good at picking up on sarcasm, this is next to useless.
Nearly useless if you do not understand the means of communication.
Very limited number of possible uses.

name: The Mixed Beast
description: This beast has the mouth of a lion the feet of a bear and the body is leopards body it has wings of an eagle and the tail of a scorpion. This beast came out of the worst parts of hell "the abyss".
summary: The ability to summon the mixed beast
strengths: This beast is very powerful
The user can ride this beast
weaknesses: The mixed beast is vulnerable towards light and abilities with light
The user can only ride the beast when it knows how to control it
You can only summon 3 at a time and this beast is very hard to use

name: Gamerverse: Reality Glitch
description: With this power, you perceive the laws of nature as merely sophisticated programming for the universe. With this power, you can create glitches in the fabric of reality. When activating this power, you can voluntarily dump excess 'coding' into any physical space you can see immediately. It will form a random law for that place that might shove you forward or back, teleport you, increase impetus, move people, etc. But it is random, so they may actually hinder you. The possibilities are limitless!
summary: The ability to create and utilise glitches in reality
strengths: Create a glitch in a part of reality that you can see.
Only YOU can be affected by these glitches.
Glitches stay in that part of space for only a couple of hours.
weaknesses: Can only create a glitch in the part of reality that you can actually see with your eyes.
Glitches are random, so they might hinder your efforts.
Glitches might also be completely useless at that current time.

name: Restaurant Transformation
description: With this power, when you open a buildings door to enter, you can choose to transform it into a restaurant. Everyone inside is changed to reflect this, becoming waiters, chefs, entertainers, and other diners as the building's interior changes to reflect the fact that it is now a restaurant.   The theme, menu, and quality of the restaurant is determined by the type of building you've transformed, and the building returns to normal when you leave so there's no need to pay.
summary: The ability to turn any occupied building into a restaurant.
strengths: Feed mostly everyone in a large building.
Always have acess to a restaurant, eat at a different place every night.
Dine and dash all you want, everyone forgets the restaurant the instant you're out the door.
weaknesses: People who enter after you are not effected by the restaurant transformation.
All the time spent being a restaurant is just wasted time for the inhabitants of the building.

name: Lambs Cross
description: This ability allows the user to control the iron in their blood or limited capabilities, allowing them to create cuts, gashes and slashes at any place which their blood has come into contact with. The user may also be able to sharpen their blood into blades an other tools however this blood must remain connected to a flowing source therefore the blades can only be made on ones body however the incisions can be made at any distance as long as there is a sample of the users blood.
summary: The ability to slash at places where the users blood has touched
strengths: Blades and other tools can be fashioned out of the iron content within the blood
Cuts, gashes, slashes and incisions can be made at any distance as long as their is blood about
User can control flow of their blood and can therefore not be affected by any form of drug or toxin
weaknesses: Slashes, cuts, gashes and incisions can only be used when blood is around
If the user loses too much blood they will die
Blades and tools must be kept connected to a flowing blood source

name: Universal Reset
description: With this power, one can reset the universe with all events still occurring in the same way. The only changes are to reality itself; certain people are no longer required to maintain reality, while people who imbued the entire universe with their consciousness are now once again vulnerable to destruction and everybody is capable of nonexistence.
summary: The ability to reset the universe to a near-perfect replica of its current state.
strengths: Repair damage to reality.
Neutralize certain individuals without danger.
Reality is not damaged in the process.
weaknesses: Certain powers such as Reality Anchoring interfere with the normal action of this power.
Only works in your current universe.
Does not protect against anything such as destruction of reality.

name: Taper
description: A person with this power has the ability to materialize any type of tape they have seen and can manipulate it. For example, you can use the tape as a chain when coming out of the air or change it into a lifeline before falling into a hole. You can also materialize it in front of a person's mouth to stop them from talking. You can only materialize about 2 inches per second but through practice you can materialize up to 100 ft per second. Also, you can later materialize constructs of tape.
summary: The ability to have an unlimited amount of tape that comes out of nowhere
strengths: You have unlimited amounts of tape
Duct tape is very durable and electrical tape is electric proof
Needs practice before becoming useful
weaknesses: No tape armor--how would you get it off?
Has all the weaknesses of the respective tape that you are using

name: Turbo Sense
description: When you're driving a vehicle, you will feel it as a part of your body. You will feel its size, its speed, its power. You will be able to react faster and to drive expertly. Your power is compatible with all sorts of vehicles: cars, planes, submarines, spaseships, etc.
summary: The ability to feel any vehicle you're driving as a part of yourself
strengths: Brand new sense, unique experiences!
You can drive more skillfully
weaknesses: Crashes will be painful, even if your human body doesn't get injured.
You may feel some kind of absence when you stop driving.

name: 300 Reapers
description: You would have the ability to summon up 300 reapers to your will and make them do what ever you want....Anything!And you can call them back at anytime.
summary: The ability to command 300 reapers to your will
strengths: Army of reapers to back up your buds
Make them do yardwork
You can take X number out of 300
weaknesses: The maximum is 300
They might turn on you if you are not nice to them

name: Superfly Sabre
description: The Superfly Sabre is made of an amalgamation of crystal and steel empowered by a golden glow with internal power that can slice through anything and slash your enemies with it. The Sabre so powerful it can slay 20,000 super villains in a single slash.
summary: The ability to use it to slash through any material and slice your foes.
strengths: It is a very cool sword to have.
Can't be used by evil beings. It instantly vaporizes any crook who try to posess it.
weaknesses: None.

name: Entomokinesis
description: The power to manipulate various forms of insects, such as bees or ants.  This allows you to control the  actions from individual insects to entire swarms.
summary: The ability to manipulate certain kinds of insects.
strengths: Excellent for defense if you have a swarm of hornets or wasps with you.
Seldom will need to worry about solving infestation problems.
Won't need to worry about being attacked by insects you can control.
weaknesses: Cannot control all forms small life, such as arachnids.
May sometimes unknowingly control the actions of insects.
Cannot actually summon insects to defend you.

name: Archivist
description: Archivists are masters over archives and libraries. They have control over book, scrolls, and paper in which they can manipulate them with spells to form attacks. Archivists can also archive things by trapping an object inside of a book or scroll. Archives and Libraries can be summoned by the Archivist as well allowing access to knowledge, protection, and resources for the Archivists powers. Archivists can also hush others to prevent them from passing on the knowledge archived in their brain.
summary: The ability to have all the powers of the legendary Archivists.
strengths: Have access to the wide range of Archivist spells.
Can archive objects, people, places, etc inside of your books and scrolls.
Mental access to the knowledge in your own archives.
weaknesses: Archivists tend to be physically weak.
Your weapons of choice are a quill and inkpot.
If you are unable to gain access to paper you are considerably weaker.

name: Dinosaur Revival
description: Just by touching the fossil or bone (it doesn't matter how many you have), you can bring the whole dinosuar back to life!
summary: The ability to revive fossils dinosuars.
strengths: You can bring fossils to life.
weaknesses: The dino may accidentally eat you if it gets hungry.

name: Looks To Kill
description: If you stare at someone for longer than 5 seconds they will drop dead, peacefully.
summary: The ability to look at someone and kill them
strengths: If you hate someone, it's easy to eliminate them
People will never be mean to you.
You can kill ANYTHING!
weaknesses: You can't have staring comps
People will only like you so you won't kill them
You can't stare at someone you like.

name: Idea Nulllifying
description: With this ability one can cancel the ideas of others and possibly one's own ideas. One can cancel out a foe's idea to attack, an idea to escape, etc. If this power is developed, one can cancel out his/her own ideas such as, should one flee from opposition. This ability cannot be turned off.
summary: The ability to the cancel out the ideas of others and possibly one's own self.
strengths: Stop your oppenents from attacking.
Cancel ideas for foes to escape.
Gain automatic confidence.
weaknesses: To cancel one's own ideas takes years to develop.
If a foe is extremely strong willed, this ability will not work
Cancelled out good ideas of others

name: Hereditary Memory
description: With this ability your children will know what you know. Your memories will be passed down to your children , the youngest knowing the most.
summary: The ability to pass your memories to your offspring.
strengths: This skill is hereditary.
Your children will be the smartest.
Save time on education.
weaknesses: Only effects males.
Share the same personality.
Sibling rivalry.

name: Liquid Rain
description: With this power you can cause rain to turn into any liquid. You can only use this power on actual rain not just any water. This power works even if the rain is already on the ground as a puddle. You cannot turn the liquid back into rain water.
summary: The ability to turn rain into any liquid
strengths: You can turn rain into any liquid
weaknesses: It only works on rain

name: Theme Music
description: With this power, you can turn context-specific theme music on and off whenever you want. Everyone around you can hear it, but you can control the volume. However, it all depends on what you're doing at the moment, and changes dynamically with you. Fighting your arch-nemesis? Just turn on your theme music and you'll get an epic, dramatic score that would make John Williams jealous! It responds to everything that happens. ex: gain the upper hand in a fight, and it builds to a crescendo.
summary: The ability to create music based on what you're doing.
strengths: Adds drama, comedy, suspense, etc. to any situation you find yourself in.
Music responds to exactly what you do.
All music is original, and therefore not subject to copyright law.
weaknesses: Can annoy others if you abuse the power.
Not smart to use it while sneaking up on somebody.
Can possibly distract the user.

name: Yellow Dog
description: Fear, anger, hate, violence. Let it out. Yellow Dog finds you at your most disturbed focusing your bad feelings into your body. Guiding you, while leeching your base emotions, inciting you to frenzied violence against foes, granting you enhanced strength, speed, agility & reflexes. Your senses are that of 10 dogs. You are immortal while the Yellow Dog is with you. Injuries are transferred to the dog, because the Yellow Dog likes the pain. Fear, anger, hate, violence. Let it out.
summary: The ability to become fueled by your own negative emotions.
strengths: Negative emotions feed your abilities allowing you to let out a burst of emotion on a target before,
You beat the target senseless. The more mean, rude or cruel you are to a foe the more power you get
10x the speed, strength, reflexes, agility of a normal human. 10x a dog's senses.
weaknesses: The Yellow Dog is metaphysical, psionic powers can effect it and it's weakened by magic
You will probably have to be around someone you hate to ignite your powers
Hard to be a hero with this power. Yellow Dog makes you do bad things to people

name: Rise Of The Cerberus
description: With this power you can turn into Cerberus, the giant three headed hellhound that guarded the underworld, in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to with this power you can turn into the giant three headed hell hound Cerberus
strengths: Three heads are better than two which are better than one
You have strong teeth and a loud bark (and you're superstrong and superdurable)
You are pretty darn scary
weaknesses: You can't fit into small places (about the size of an elephant)
You might be mistaken for the real hell hound and attacked

name: Bloodline Extreme
description: Can pass along one's power, knowledge, body form(shapeshift for this), etc through way of having another being consume one's blood. The only thing not passed along is your personality. The biggest possible cost is that the person has to drink an amount of blood equal to 52% of the blood in their body. The blood can be up to one week old.
summary: The ability to pass along almost everything about oneself to another by way of blood
strengths: All your power and knowledge get passed along.
Recipient can masquerade as you at boring meetings.
Blood doesn't have to be fresh.
weaknesses: You're most likely going to die unless it's a baby (50% of blood gone from body means death).
Vampires will love this.

name: Aftermath
description: When your foe lands a hit on you, a small bit of damage is given to your opponent.
summary: The ability to damage your foe when they land a hit on you.
strengths: You don't have to hit your opponent to damage them.
weaknesses: The damage given is so small, it isn't even useful.
Only damages opponent when hit with a physical attack.

name: Drug Mimicry
description: This ability can make the user become a liquid or gaseous drug. He be able to help heal people or give them the user's own brand of steriods. The user can give or take away side effects of the drugs that he gives out. He can heal himself and pump himself with steriods without feeling any side effects.
summary: The ability to mimic the properties of illegal or medicinal drug.
strengths: Have a liquid or gaseous form
Heal yourself and others of illness, pump them with steriod, or other drug uses.
Can give or take away side effects
weaknesses: Since you are chemicals, you are effected by temperature.
Just for a joke, People might do commercials about not taking you.

name: Ehecatl, The Sky Cycle
description: When activated, you change into Ehecatl's priest outfit with its noticeable red face and giant mouth. In this form, you can blow extremely powerful winds and tornadoes. Your winds are so strong that, if you direct them towards the sky, you can affect the paths of the sun, the moon and the clouds. However, the stronger the wind you blow, the more energy is needed. You can also blow a symbolic wind, being able to stir up people's emotion and magnifying their affection for their loved ones.
summary: The ability to embody Ehecatl, the wind God, who can create winds so powerful, they'll move the sky and hearts.
strengths: You can magnify love and affection in people's hearts.
You can create powerful winds and tornadoes you can use to fly and travel.
Your winds are so powerful, they can move the sky.
weaknesses: You look ridiculous whenever you activate this power.
Creating powerful winds is very tiring for your body.

name: Cartoon Power: Mario
description: With this power, you have the amount of lives Mario generally starts off with: five. Meaning that when you die, you instantly come back to life right where you died.
summary: The ability to have five lives
strengths: You have five lives
weaknesses: If you get shot by a criminal and you come back to life where you died you will just get shot again

name: Mystic Honey
description: You create mystic honey at any moment and move it with your mind. The mystic honey has special properties that can cause people who eat it to feel healthier and stronger. The mystic honey can also speed up the healing process of wounds that it touches. The mystic honey is capable of acting as a shield by stopping objects from passing through it. The mystic honey is also always great tasting no matter what you put it on.
summary: The ability to create and control honey with special properties.
strengths: The honey can heal wounds and improve health.
Can be used offensively by creating weapons or honey-bolts.
Can be used defensively by creating barriers.
weaknesses: While you can stop the honey from healing foes, they can still get stronger by eating it.
Objects created out of honey are not the strongest.
The healing properties of the honey take time.

name: Double Vision
description: Have your opponent look you directly in the eye and he will see a complete double of whatever he is looking at. Like Naruto's Shadow Clone, with double vision, you can create a living clone that can hurt you even if it isn't the real one. But if the person decides to attack the wrong one, then it doesn't affect you.
summary: The ability to make your opponent see doubles
strengths: Can really confuse your enamy
Good if you are dealing in hand-to-hand combat
weaknesses: There is always a fifty-fifty chance of your opponant hitting you

name: Jobber Aura
description: A person with this power can make anyone purposely lose to them in any activity once. When used the other person somehow wants to lose to you for some given reason and they will forget the reason after they lose. This will always work--however this can only work against someone in a given activity only once.
summary: The ability to make people want to lose to you
strengths: Beat people way stronger than you
Impress your friends
weaknesses: Can only work against anyone or anything once for a given activity

name: Artifact Of Light: Valkyria
description: The bow is a very strong weapon on its own, and it further magnifies its power by allowing the user to shoot part of his/her soul along with the light arrow. Upon agreement, even a whole person can be turned into a arrow and shot out of Valkyria, for increased power or for any other reasons. A soul fragment returns to the user after being shot out as well as anyone turned into an arrow can revert back to human form at will.
summary: The ability to summon a bow named Valkyria.
strengths: Can fire arrows at an insane speed.
Has great power, and is the strongest light alligned bow.
Good against anyone, great against demons and other light fearing beings.
weaknesses: You could, but is nearly impossible to use if you are a dark being such as a demon.
Firing speed and power will be greatly reduced for dark ebing users.

name: Delete This Comet Kick
description: Using this power, you can charge up your left leg and foot with a fiery glow. Your kicks can now target your enemie's torso and break through glass and bricks unharmed.
summary: The ability to fly across anywhere while glowing and connect on your opponent with a kick.
strengths: This is just a regular flying power!
weaknesses: None.

name: Instant Trip Wire
description: From the tips of your fingers, you can cast thin, nearly invisible wires that can be stuck to any surface and linked to any trap you can think of. For example, you could string one across a hallway and mentally place a cluster of shurikens on the adjacent wall (these will be invisible until triggered). When your target trips the wire, the shurikens will be launched at high speed into them. Wires are unlimited, one trap per wire, and traps can be literally anything you can think of.
summary: The ability to create trip-wires and link them to any trap you can think of.
strengths: Wires are nearly invisible, like spider's web, while traps are completely invisible until triggered.
You can place any trap you can think of.
Wires are indestructible, but disappear after being triggered.
weaknesses: You can trigger your own traps.
in the right light, wires can be seen.
If your target reacts quickly enough, they can potentially escape the traps.

name: Myth Power: Power Of Perses
description: Perses, in Greek myth, was the god of savagery, pillaging, destruction and laying of waste. As such, channeling him allows one to exaggerate the weak points within a structure, to the point it will tear, break, crumble, collapse or otherwise come apart. In addition, the user becomes physically empowered by destruction NOT caused by him. The user can even psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally vicious, ferocious, fierce, savage or destructive.
summary: The ability to channel Perses' command over the forces of destruction, pillaging and savagery
strengths: Destroy inorganic matter with a touch, a word or a thought (causing it to come apart, or the like)
Gain physical power from destruction that is not cause by you
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel vicious/ferocious/savage people
weaknesses: Cannot disintegrate or vaporize matter with a touch until the HIGHEST levels (no Con Negation)
Cannot REVERSE or UNDO damage (Mending) until the higher levels
People with combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction based MythPowers are empowered by this ability

name: Hellish Banishment
description: A person with this power does not have the ability to send someone to hell but they have something very similar. Everyone likely has been to a place that was very hellish and would not ever want to go there again. Well now you can send them to that exact time/place courtesy of this power. If the place does not exist anymore or has changed instead their mind gets tricked into replaying that scene until the user decides not to. If people get used to the hell, they will be sent to the next hell.
summary: The ability to send someone's mind or body to his/her hell on earth
strengths: You can send someone's mind to relive his hell on earth
You can send a person to their least favorite place in the world
You can talk to the person while they are in their hell
weaknesses: If someone's life is already living hell then you can't send them anywhere
People can get used to hell over time, but then they will be sent to their next hellish place
If someone does not have the concept of hell

name: Splitting Shield
description: In essence, this power makes a physical attack split in two so that the original target of the attack is standing in between both halves of the attack which then proceed on to hit up to two objects that are behind the original target.
summary: The ability to make a long range attack split in two and hit the areas to the sides of one
strengths: You won't get hurt by long-range attacks.
Normal shields needed only for close range attacks now in battles.
weaknesses: Two people might get hurt because of you.
You have to concentrate on using this power, so snipers will still get you if you don't expect them.

name: Planar Compaction
description: Also called Plane Merging, this ability grants the user the power to compact the planes of reality together. When any action is performed in a compacted area it affects ALL of the compacted planes. Beings that are in a compacted area also appear on all merged planes so extraplanar entities can come through. In addition due to the different nature of the planes when they merge reality can warp randomly. If uncontrolled, the users very presence will create areas of merged planes.
summary: The ability to compact several planes of reality onto each other.
strengths: Catch enemies on a different plane.
There is a possibility to cause extra planar entities to come to a different plane.
Cause the different planes to warp the reality of one another.
weaknesses: Reality warps are random and uncontrollable.
There is no telling what kind of extra planar entity will come through if ANY.
If someone is just plain in another dimension.

name: Myth Power: Elpis' Elevation
description: Elpis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hope.
