As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, their likelihood and how to achieve them, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of hopeful subjects. One can also psychically cast illusions of subjects' hopes, wishes and dreams, at will. One can even psychically induce a powerful physical and/or mental backlash in subjects hoping for one's misfortune, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Elpis' command over the essence of hope and expectation
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' hopes/wishes/dreams (likelihood, how to achieve them, etc), at will
Gain physical power and sustenance in the presence of optimists, at will
Psychically cast illusions of hopes, backlash foes' negative hopes as physical/mental pain, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically backlash foes' negative hopes as matching misfortune, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel optimists, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Pandora's Box provides power from this ability (NCN)

name: Summoning Specialty
description: With this power whenever you use a power that doesn't normally summon something, you can instead choose to summon something based on the power's normal effect. Ex: 'Pyrokinesis' could summon a salamander, a phoenix, etc. 'Wolves to Werewolves' could summon wolves or werewolves.
summary: The ability to summon something with a power that normally does something else
strengths: You now have another choice on how to use each individual power.
You can control what you summon if you want to.
weaknesses: What you summon with a normally nonsummoning power is random.
Exception con 1: : "Rise of..." powers will summon what you would have transformed into.
Exception con 1: MythPowers: the channelled god.

name: I Can Hear You V2
description: With this power you will automatically be able to listen to any conversation that is about or in reference to you. The people talking do not even have to mention your full name for you to be able to listen in. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to be able to hear any conversation that is about you
strengths: You will be able to listen in on any conversation that is about you
The speakers do not even have to mention your name
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Xianyang Theory
description: With this power you can know where any of your enemies are at all times. All you have to is say their name out loud and instantly you will know where they are. This power works for anybody you don't like anybody you've ever fought against or anybody who is competing against you.
summary: The ability to know where your enemies are at all times
strengths: You can know where any of your enemies are at all times
weaknesses: You have to speak their name out loud for it to work

name: Myth Power: Lethe's Legacy
description: Lethe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of oblivion (forgetfulness and forgottenness) and Lethe, the Underworld River of Oblivion. As such, channeling her allows one to wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought. In addition, one can withstand the same effects, unless one DESIRES to forget unwanted/unneeded experiences. Furthermore, one has access to an extradimensional Lethe Space; it contains the user's forgotten memories, as well as lost memories of his allies, and anyone else he touches.
summary: The ability to channel Lethe's command over the essence of forgetfulness, oblivion and the Underworld River Lethe
strengths: Psychically wipe memories with a touch, a word or a thought
Withstand mermory wiping and memory loss (natural or otherwise) unless one DESIRES to forget
Psychically access (and/or travel to) a Lethe Space, which contains lost/forgotten/wiped memories
weaknesses: Only banish foes to the Underworld River Lethe by touch/word/thought when developed (NCN)
Once banished to the River Lethe, foes' memories are completely forgotten (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Flutter Jump
description: With this power you can flutter jump. Meaning that when you jump you can stay in the air longer and propel yourself farther if you start flapping your arms around.
summary: The ability to flutter jump
strengths: You can flutter jump
weaknesses: You look like an idiot when you flutter jump

name: App Power: Temple Run
description: This ability gives you the powers of the popular game Temple Run. With the power of the runner, you have unlimited stamina and enhanced agility. A convenient path will appear to take you wherever you need to go, even space. You can also summon temporary boosts such as shields or speed. Finally, you can summon Cuchanck, the guardian of the temple. This monster will pursue your enemies, forcing them to run or face the beast's wrath. If Cuchanck catches his quarry he will bring them to you.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the endless chase in Temple Run
strengths: No need to eat or drink or sleep
You can run anywhere, be faster than a jet, protect yourself from any attack, or summon money
Cuchanck is virtually impossible to escape or defeat, so your target can only run
weaknesses: Some super powers may allow people to escape Cuchanck
You can only sustain Cuchanck for a limited time, up to 12 hours. Boosts are even shorter
Can't run underwater or in space until higher levels

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Seraphim
description: The Seraphim, also known as "the burning ones", have six wings in total; two covering their faces, two covering their bodies (feet), and two with which they fly. As a Seraph, the light emanating from you is so bright that not even angelic beings or anything else can look upon you. Your primary abilities consist of utilizing pure light as your weapon.
summary: The ability to become the highest ranking angel in heaven.
strengths: Ward off demonic armies and other forces of darkness.
Vanquish and repel foes with the power of light.
Strike down enemies with blinding light.
weaknesses: You are still susceptible to harm and damage from higher demonic beings.

name: Ivory Axe
description: The ivory axe is a mystical materialistic weapon to be used for blunt damage and is nearly indestructible. Can Swirl it about 440 degrees around you, converting into a blunt force melee weapon or as a throwing weapon. It can also fire an energy blast of fire or ice. It could also manipulate magnetic fields, allowing the user to deflect incoming gunfire back at attackers.
summary: The ability to use it to unleash a powerful swing & slice your enemies.
strengths: It is immune to evil acts if that means it can't crave blood.
It can cut through any substance.
weaknesses: None.

name: Heat Mouth
description: Everyone has heard about Supermans ice breath, but what about heat breath? Heat breath is different from fire because it is super heated air rather than flame. The temperature of the heat can range from average human temperatures to metal melting heats but does not harm the user because the heat only triggers once the breath leaves the user's mouth and is surrounded by oxygen. This power doesn't increase the user's lung capacity.
summary: The ability to blow super hot air from your mouth
strengths: Able to melt most metals known to man
Powerful and useful - can heat up water etc
You can fly by being your own hot air ballon
weaknesses: Using on humans can cause them to smell horrible
Running out of breath high in the air being a hot air ballon

name: Old One Power: Cthulhu
description: Cthulhu, the mightiest of the Old Gods slumbering on Earth. The green, squid-headed, dragon-winged reality-distorting sanity-shattering abomination grants you a portion of his power. With it, you have perfect control over dreams and tentacled sea creatures (squids and octopi). You can also sort of control people, by sending them dreams giving them an order, and then showing them the twisted geometry of Cthulhu's sunken city, horrifying them into obedience.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Great Old One Cthulhu
strengths: Dream control powers for communication and control. And squids, whatever that's worth.
You will reincarnate as the first Star Spawn born after his awakening.
If the most horrifying possible armageddon comes to pass (Old Ones returning), you will be safe.
weaknesses: If Cthulhu himself didn't grant this power, he gets angry. Dreams and afterlife are unending pain.
Overtime, you start to dislike the laws of reality more and more, and become extremely malevolent.
Any attempts at finding your alignment via unnatural means always turns up "Ultimate Evil. "

name: Myth Power: Honor Of The Ourea
description: The Ourea, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of mountains. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions on any mountain throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to psychically perceive the layout of any mountain at will (including caves, tunnels, volcanic faults, etc within that mountain). In addition, one may teleport to any mountain at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on (or inside of) a mountain.
summary: The ability to channel the Ourea and their command over the essence of mountains and mountain life
strengths: Knowledge of any mountain in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any mountain at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc) are enhanced for as long as you are on a mountain
weaknesses: Cannot alter a mountain's weather until the higher levels (NCN)
Not every mountain is habitable
Pro #3 gets weaker the further you are from the mountain peak (NCN)

name: Board Game Battle
description: With this power, the user may bring any object from any board game, eg. The tokens from Monopoly, or some Hungry Hungry Hippos.
summary: The ability to bring objects from board games.
strengths: Can bring objects from board games
weaknesses: Can only bring things from board games
Can't bring things from board games that the user hasn't played

name: Artifact Of Light: Angel's Eye
description: Angel's Eye looks like a crystal ball on a chain, with wings around it. Worn on the neck, it allows the user to use any skills that manifest in one's eyes, such as future sight or laser vision.
summary: The ability to summon Angel's Eye.
strengths: Many different skills.
Protects the user's eyes from any harm such as blinding.
weaknesses: Can only be summoned for so long, before disappearing for a recharge.

name: Myth Power: Graces' Grandeur
description: These Charites (Kharites, Graces), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of fame, fortune and glory. As such, channeling Eupheme (Praise), one gains physical power from every compliment or word of praise/encouragement that one receives. Channeling Eucleia (Eukleia- Good Repute), one can psychically spread (or wipe subjects' minds of) rumor/scandal about self/others at will. Channeling Euthenia (Wealth, Prosperity), one can psychically transform property into their proper monetary value with a touch.
summary: The ability to channel the Charites' command over the essence of glory and reputation
strengths: Become physically more powerful (stronger, etc) with every compliment (even if they only think it)
Psychically spread (or wipe subjects' memories of) embarrassing rumors and scandals at will
Psychically exchange property for its monetary value (ie touch a car, instantly get thousands back)
weaknesses: Cannot "trade reputations" with others by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Pheme's Feat provides immunity to Pro #2 (NCN)
MythPower: Plutos' Bounty and MythPower: Tryphe's Trifle make Pro #3 useless (NCN)

name: Paper Sharpening
description: This power enables you to sharpen and harden the edges of any sheet of paper, rendering it able to cut through any material. The paper remains sharp as long as you keep concentrating on it.
summary: The ability to slice with a simple sheet of paper
strengths: Because it's been hardened, the paper can be used as a throwable weapon.
Anything made of paper becomes deadly in your hands.
weaknesses: Beware of paper cuts!

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours01)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Auge (Daybreak), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, wake up feeling rejuvenated and gain physical power at daybreak. One can psychically generate light from the eyes to see in the dark, at will. One can psychically teleport through darkness, as an entity of light, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate, wake up refreshed and gain physical power at daybreak
Psychically generate light from eyes to see in the dark, teleport through shadows as entity of light
weaknesses: Cannot psychically induce wakefulness (allies) or drowsiness (foes), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is daybreak, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future daybreaks, until developed (NCN)

name: Steampunk Battle Armor
description: The user is able to equip his or her body with a steampunk battle armor. This battle armor runs purely on highly compressed steam generated from a special type of coal that can generate heat for a good week. The armor is made up of an element that is a combination of brass and an unknown like element. However, the armor is not invulnerable.
summary: The ability to equip your body with a Steampunk Battle Armor
strengths: Has two shoulder mounted gatling gun when brought out of slot
Can fire hot compressed steam
Can fly due top steam power
weaknesses: No match for powerhouses
Weaponry is a tad obsolete

name: Hellfire
description: This flame has an orange-reddish color and burns the victim's soul while it is burning the body as well. This power can only be gained by way of full mastery of 'Ghostly Pyrokinesis'.
summary: The ability to create and control a fire that burns the soul as well as the body
strengths: Anyone killed by this power cannot be reincarnated because their soul has been destroyed.
weaknesses: Do not burn yourself with this flame. EVER.

name: Swan Song
description: In legends, a swan is thought to be mute for its entire life, except right when it is about to die, when it emits a lovely song called the Swan Song. One with this ability imitates this effect on a foe. The user closes the subject's mouth and programs vital organs with a psionic "kill-switch" function linked to the voice. So the next time the subject speaks, the vital organs automatically shut down at the same time, causing the subject to die a fairly quick, but painful, and irreversible, death.
summary: The ability to use a subject's voice as a kill-switch
strengths: Force a foe to be silent for the rest of his life, or DIE
Works on nearly any species (even non-divine immortals)
The effect can be undone at will
weaknesses: Can only be undone by the actual one who uses it, and cannot be undone if the subject dies
Does not affect undead, extradimensional entities or divinities
Mimesis (Mime Power) or natural muteness renders the ability moot

name: Satisfaction Manipulation
description: You can emit an invisible beam that changes how much hunger or thirst the affected beings feel.  The effect fades away after some time.  Unless you reapply or remove it.
summary: The ability to change the feeling of hunger or thirst in another being
strengths: Increase the thirst or hunger of the clients. More profit for the bar or restaurant.
Remove the hunger of predators that want you as a meal.
Make your guests appreciate your food even more.
weaknesses: Your targets could overconsume when eating/drinking doesn't satisfy.

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Horn
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin, the demon-wizard. The horn will fill, on command with any drink desired.
summary: The ability to wield the horn of Bran Galed
strengths: Rehydration station!
Get drunk with all your friends for free!
weaknesses: If somebody takes control of your body, they could make you summon poison.

name: Iron Tiger Armor
description: The person with this suit of armor will be able to fly, shoot focused laser beams, missiles as well as use the armor's advance H. U. D. Interface to hack into security systems, scan for life signs, give tactical suggestions as well as give a status report on armor's statuts and prevent the suit's system from being hacked into. The suit is colored black and yellow.
summary: The ability to wear an near indestructible tiger themed armor
strengths: Able to combat most threats
Cannot be hacked
weaknesses: Susceptible to EMP blast
Replacement parts might be hard to come by

name: Toy Gun Affect
description: Simply point and fire (well not quite). Toy-gun Affect allows you to change an object, such as a gun like an AK-47 into the toy version of that same object, such as a squirt gun that resembles an AK-47, from a distance without having to actually touch the object (of course it has to be within vision). If used on a vehicle such as a car the passengers will be teleported automatically out of the vehicle before "toyification" of said vehicle. The toy state of the object only lasts one hour however.
summary: The ability to turn anything into a harmless toy.
strengths: Make any weapon useless
Fun for the whole family XD
Can be used from a distance (that's why it's the Toy-GUN Affect) and not just if touched.
weaknesses: Ineffective on people or animals
Only stays a toy for 1 hour before changing back
Not reversible (turning a toy such as a toy sword into a katana)

name: Card Wielder
description: A Card Wielder has the ability to use cards as a weapon. He/she can levitate cards and shoot them at another enemy. There isn't a certain amount, pertaining to you shooting them out of your fist. They are used also to help you move around, if necessary. The cards also have a mind of their own, doing task that the Card Wielder has told them to do.
summary: The ability to control cards
strengths: Uses as a weapon
Doing task so the master has less work
Moving around advantages
weaknesses: Not always loyal
Makes you weak after using too long
Not too strong

name: Reaper   Sickles
description: The reaper sickles are totally razor sharp with chains linking between them, you can throw it at your foe and it will home in onto your opponent and it will spin around you, charge it and fire energy waves & dispense electric stun shocks from the blades. Can even grab the opponent and hit them onto the sickles which pull through them.
summary: The ability to use it to fire slashing projectiles.
strengths: Those have incredible range and last a longer time.
weaknesses: None.

name: 32 Gb Memory
description: The user has a 32 GB memory chip in their head that can only be used to absorb knowledge that has to do with human history, scientific breakthroughs, government files, top secret government files, scientific files as well as military strategies. The user can't absorb knowledge that is deemed unnecessary to the survival of the human knowledge. The download is done with a special neural link headset that is linked to a computer, using the bluetooth or USB port.
summary: The ability to have a 32 GB memory storage in the user's brain.
strengths: A living repository of human knowledge
A source of wisdom and information for other people
weaknesses: Can't fight with this power
Ambiguous which cultural info is "necessary"

name: Bravery
description: Bravery is not the absence of fear, but the acknowledgment and conquering of it. One with this power, after facing their fear and mentally conquering it, will truly conquer it. Say your worst fear is fire. You must first face it, then conquer it(saving someone from a fire, remaining calm alone in the middle of a fire, etc. Only then will you be able to control fire and be totally immune to its effects.
summary: The ability to be truly brave
strengths: Mastering fear
Finding true bravery
weaknesses: Must first face your fear, and conquer it (which isn't always a bad thing, but is always difficult)

name: Parasol Knight
description: A parasol is given to the recipient of this ability. It is virtually indestructible and doesn't flip inside out with strong winds. It grants the recipient the ability to manipulate the direction and strength of wind, and their own density to move with the parasol. The parasol is able to shoot energy beams from the tip. The power is dependent on the happiness level of the user.
summary: The ability to use a selected parasol and wind manipulation to perform various actions.
strengths: Control the wind to be able to move and dodge seemlessly with the wind, and even fly.
The parasol is virtually indestructible, and can also be used as a shield or a blunt weapon.
It's pretty sneaky, no one would think of a parasol as a weapon.
weaknesses: The control of the wind is limited to a small perimeter around the user, typically not offensive.
The strength of the energy beams are completely dependent on happiness. No joy, no power.
The user and the parasol are connected. However, if it's lost, the powers are lost.

name: Craft Greater Semivif
description: You get craft material with this power by painlessly removing pieces of yourself by hand. Any lost pieces grow back in an hour. After this regrowth, you can start again. The semivif you make look like mannequins made of your guts and organs. They have your intelligence and are only affected by damage or powers if you are affected by damage or powers. You can have the invulnerability power and use this power. Any regeneration power will make the regrowth time for this power a second, not an hour.
summary: The ability to craft greater semivif servants.
strengths: These semivif can't be affected by anything unless you are first.
This power works with invulnerability.
weaknesses: If you're psionically stunned, all your semivif will be too.

name: Meteor Call
description:
Its name says it all 'Meteor Call'
Summon a meteor from outer space like the asteroid belt and cause it to come hurdling towards the earth.
Also you can call as many meteors as you want.
summary: The ability to call a meteor from space to come hurdling towards the earth.
strengths: Can call as many meteors as you want.
Can cause the meteor to land on whoever you want.
weaknesses: Might get crushed under the meteors weight.

name: Minus Splicer
description: You have the ability to separate one person you touched, causing them to be separated into two different beings (one's male and one's female).
summary: The ability to split anyone into male and female halves
strengths: You might find a male or female counterpart attractive.
weaknesses: You could find a male or female counterpart unattractive.

name: Ban Hammer
description: When activated, the Ban-hammer will appear in your hand. It is able to perma-ban everyone it touches. You can perma-ban them from everything, even from using the bathroom.
summary: The ability to summon the almighty BAN-HAMMER
strengths: Ban anyone
Ban them from everything
weaknesses: Might accidentally touch a loved one

name: Insect Symbiosis
description: These insects are stored in the user's body and have a symbiotic relationship with the user. The user , houses the insects in exchange for the insects obeying the user's commands
summary: The ability to use insects that is stored inside the user's body
strengths: Can use insects for offense and defense
weaknesses: The symbiosis relationship might become a parasitic one if the user becomes to weak
Insects are easily defeated by fire

name: Acidbase Conversion
description: You can convert any object into an acid or a base on contact.
summary: The ability to convert any object to either an acid or a base.
strengths: Can make explosions
Can turn air into acid and target into base
Unlimited salt
weaknesses: Useless at long range combat
Accidents could be fatal
Useless against guns

name: Astral Law: Gungnir's Point
description: The user is allowed to take out Gungnir, Odin's supreme spear. The spear generates a gauntlet of the hand on which it's held. It has the ability to fire gravitational beams that have the effect the user wants (e. G. The user can fire a gravotational beam that crushes the opponent to the ground using gravity or sends them up into the atmosphere where they die of lack of oxygen. The user can also fire small pods that have the same effects. Gungnir can also act as a compass for places or for energy
summary: The ability to take out Odin's mythical spear Gungnir from the MantraPlane
strengths: One has probably the best compass in the world.
One can transfer the effects of hieghtened or lessens gravity onto the opponent
One can have a portable powerful weapon
weaknesses: The gravitational effects wear of after some time
Since all of the user's mantra is on controlling Gungnir, the user is quite weak to physical attacks
Gungnir is a long range weapon and is not nearly as good in close range

name: Beauty's Scythe
description: Ever heard of how death is beautiful well this scythe lives to the name it grants the wielder incredible beauty and power. Though this scythe kills someone in a very beautiful way like the person will explode into flowers.
summary: The ability to wield the scythe of beautiful death
strengths: Can great beauty
Death is immortal
Do become death itself
weaknesses: Can only kill people who are meant to die
When all life dies so do you
Only the scythe's wielder get this power

name: Card Master
description: This is good for a gambler, you just think about what you want, then you get it, and a bonus is that you can master the art of cards, which includes card throwing, sleight of hand and other card tricks you know!
summary: The ability to choose what cards you get on card games
strengths: You dont need a poker face
Good money-making ability
Works on cards you personally have made
weaknesses: Doesnt work on fake cards other people have made
You can be blamed for cheating if you get the same card everytime

name: Blast From The Past
description: With this ability, you can relive 20 minutes from your past once each day. You can't change the future with this ability--you can only experience 20 minutes of something you did. Whatever changes you make during your trip back will not become a reality after the 20 minutes is over.
summary: The ability to relive 20 minutes of your past once each day.
strengths: Experience something really enjoyable over and over.
Find out the truth about something that once happened.
You can do whatever you want for 20 minutes; they will be reverted after that!
weaknesses: Don't use this to relive the worst 20 minutes of your life, unless you're masochistic.
You can't change the past with this power alone.
You can't travel to the future.

name: Eye Of Balor
description: Balor was a giant in Celtic mythology with an eye that could kill anyone he looked at. When you receive this power, one of your eyes becomes infused with this mighty ability. Once gained, the eye of Balor becomes permanent and is always active. The eye gives you the strength, endurance and stamina of a 50-foot tall giant and the ability to turn any organism to ash by focusing your eye on it.
summary: The ability to use the powerful eye of Balor
strengths: Turn your enemies to ash
Superhuman strength, endurance and stamina
Works on any living person or animal big enough for you to see
weaknesses: You will have to wear an eye patch or something to keep from accidentally killing things
The victim must be in your direct line of sight (you can't use it through opaque solids)
The farther away the organism is, the more concentration it takes

name: Lizard Tail Effect
description: If you have this power and someone with TK tries to grab you, the only thing they're grabbing is a single hair on your head. If you're immortal and someone with Iapetos' Scorn tries to take away your immortality, all they'll affect in you is a single cell in your body. The same thing with powers that would erase you from reality or total destruction powers that directly target your body. You regrow any lost parts. Yes, a foe grabbing your arm and not letting go would cause you to lose your arm.
summary: The ability to only have a part of your body affected by certain powers.
strengths: Some powers only target a part of you which you can afford to lose.
Powers that use stickiness will trigger this power.
There are many powers that work like the ones mentioned in the description.
weaknesses: You will need a power like teleportation if you're reduced to a human torso.

name: Leap Of Faith
description: With this power you can use anyone's power(s) for an hour. The catch is that they have to say "I trust you."  Also, that person can't use their power in that hour.
summary: The ability to use others' powers if they trust you
strengths: No limit to the number of powers you can have
Can have any power
Takes the person's power for an hour (good for use on bad guys)
weaknesses: Person with power must say "I trust you" (tricky for use on bad guys).
Leaves person powerless.
Very corny to say. (:

name: Myth Power: Eleos' Empathy
description: Eleos (Eleus), in Greek myth, was the goddess of mercy, pity, compassion, empathy, sympathy and forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive others' emotions, or show others one's own emotions (as the case calls for it) in order to show, or be shown, pity, compassion or mercy. In addition, one may perceive those who are naturally unmerciful, and harm them by a touch. One can even shapeshift into a cute and cuddly form that subjects find so cute that it is impossible to do harm to.
summary: The ability to channel Eleos' command over the essence of mercy, pity and compassion
strengths: Perceive the emotions of others, and show others one's own emotions (to gain, or better show, mercy)
Perceive the merciless/insensitive/unforgiving and harm them by a touch
Shapeshift into a form (of one's choosing) so cute/cuddly, people will defend/refuse to harm it
weaknesses: Only perceive emotion to better show mercy; only project emotion to receive mercy (NCN)
Only heal subjects (or kill them painlessly as an act of mercy) by touch at the higher levels
MythPower: Anaideia's Anger provides immunity

name: Power Burning
description: Be careful with this as it can burn only powers and does not differentiate between an ally's power and an enemy's power. Also do not let it touch you if you have Superhuman Strength or another power like that as it will burn the power and hurt as though 100 spikes have pierced your skin. To gain this power you must have had your powers negated 1000 times within one week.
summary: The ability to create a flame that can only burn other powers
strengths: Burn a curse to get permanently get rid of it.
It still will hurt if you touch the flame despite the fact that it won't burn the skin.
weaknesses: Warning: Do NOT use on a magical item that you want to use.
Gaining this power is somewhat comical for your enemies until you gain it.
When destroying a magical weapon's power, the weapon itself will also be destroyed.

name: Quintesson Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Quintesson and have them be under your complete control. You can summon Quintesson scientists to create things for you or Quintesson Executioners to kill people for you etc. When you're done with them you can send them back.
summary: The ability to summon any Quintesson
strengths: You can summon any Quintesson
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Hepatocyte Mimicry
description: Hepatocytes Mimics really have a huge number of abilities. The main ones are the abilities to store sugar inside their body, to neutralize various toxic subtances, such as alcohol or drugs, to produce bile (a fat solvent), to create duplicates at a extremely rapid rate, to manipulate cholesterol and to regulate cholesterol levels in other people. They can also gain or give new abilities in the vicinity of other Cellular Mimics. For example, Thrombocyte Mimics will produce sticky ropes.
summary: The ability to have all the equivalent abilities of liver cells, known as hepatocytes.
strengths: You have a wide panel of abilities. Check other Cellular Mimic pages for more.
Your duplication ability is extremely fast, near instantaneous.
You can heal people and may give them new powers if they are Cellular Mimics.
weaknesses: You can heal other people very effectively, but you can heal yourself only at a much slower rate.
A less cool ability is to convert ammonia into urea.

name: 2 For The Show V2
description: With this power you can project any episode from any TV show from your eyes onto any flat surface. All you have to do is say the name of the episode and the name of the TV show.
summary: The ability to project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
strengths: You can project any episode from any TV show onto any flat surface
weaknesses: Only works for TV show for movies please see Movie Projector

name: Minotaur Summon
description: With this power you can summon the mighty minotaur from Greek Mythology. When you summon it the Minotaur is under your complete control and you can make it do whatever you want. The minotaur has super strength and has sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies.
summary: The ability to summon the minotaur
strengths: You can summon the minotaur
It is under your complete control
It is super strong and has long sharp horns which can be used to impale enemies
weaknesses: The minotaur eats humans so feeding it could be a problem
There is only one so if it dies this power is useless

name: Cybear Summon
description: With this power you can summon as many Cybears as you want. The bears are under your complete control and have super strength and durability and they can shoot lasers from their eyes. You can unsumon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon Cybears
strengths: You can summon an army of Cybears
They are under your complete control
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: They can be destroyed

name: Anti Space Generation
description: Anti-Space, although similar to anti-matter, has different properties. Anti-Space atoms teleport any of it's atoms that contact any other types of atoms to a random point in space light-years away from itself.
summary: The ability to generate and propel Anti-Space parrticle spheres
strengths: Powerful and deadly
Effective shield
weaknesses: Can't make spheres to large for possibility of contact with yourself
Takes time to generate spheres

name: Math: Evil Negative Squared
description: When you negatively square a negative integer, the result is positive. So, -4 by -4 equals positive 16. With this power, the same rule applies, except negative is evil and positive is good. When facing an evil person, activating this power will bring forth an exact replica of this person. They will both look the same, act the same, and will both be the same amount of evil. Then they will merge in a blinding flash of light, and their alignment will change from evil to good. They are now positive.
summary: The ability to change a person from evil
strengths: Change the alignment of an evil person to good.
They will feel happier, without feeling the urge to slaughter innocents
Maths is AWESOME!
weaknesses: This is more a hero power. Sorry to disappoint the villains
It is largely irreversible.

name: Artifact: Tengu No Kakuremino
description: When you say "Adeat", a cloak appears. This cloak allows you (and others) to travel to a different plane of reality. In this plane, is a house complete with a kitchen.
summary: The ability to summon a cloak that can let you travel to a different dimension.
strengths: Has camouflage so enemies don't notice it.
More than one person can enter.
You control who gets in and out.
weaknesses: No combat purposes.

name: Outfit Conjuring
description: Did you ever want an outfit from the mall that was just to expensive.Well, with this power, you can create with with only the power of your mind. Not only can you conjure it on your body, but your friends body too.
summary: The ability to create any outift you can think of
strengths: Create any outfit you want
Always a perfect fit
Make even the most exotic things
weaknesses: You'll miss shopping at the mall

name: Opposite Personality
description:
This ability you can change the personality of a person to be the exact and direct opposite.
E.g a shy and quiet person becomes talkative and loud.
However you can not change what they are feeling or emotion only their personality. You can't make an upset person happy.
summary: The ability to change the personality of a person to the exact opposite.
strengths: Give shy people a confidence boost.
Effect of ability can be reversed. (Just use it a second time. duh!)
weaknesses: Behavioural changes in opposing personality can cause person to take devasting actions.

name: Memory Limit
description: When this ability is activated, the person's memories of last week are wiped and the person is now only able to remember 3 new things at a time besides subconscious acts like breathing.   When the target wants to remember something new they will have to forget about the first thing they learned.   This power can be used on yourself and can be deactivated only by you.
summary: The ability to make a person only able to remember 3 things at a time
strengths: Your opponents will be severely limited in capacity
If you fill their head with irrelevant information you can mess with them
weaknesses: Trying to explain something to a person you accidentally used this on
Notebooks or writing in hand

name: Mental Photo Editing
description: With this power you can take a picture every time you blink and then edit the photo in your mind. You can end captions, change the colors of things, photoshop things into the image, add speech bubbles, crop it, erase the redeye etc. You can then transfer the image to any computer you want. You can turn this power on and off so you don't take a picture every time you blink.
summary: The ability to take and edit photos with your brain
strengths: You can take and edit photos with your brain
You can send the pictures to any computer in the world
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
If you don't send the pictures to a computer eventually your brain will become cluttered

name: Trees To Ents And Vice Versa
description: With this power you can turn trees into mythical tree monsters called Ents. The Ents are not under your control but may help you after much debilitating with the council. You can use this power on as many trees as you want and you can even turn Ents other than the ones you created into normal non monstrous trees.
summary: The ability to turn trees into Ents and Ents into trees
strengths: You can turn trees into Ents
You can turn Ents into trees
weaknesses: The Ents are not under your control

name: Omnidroid Summon
description: With this power you can summon the Omnidroid from The Incredibles. The Omnidroid is under your complete control and can shoot lasers, crush things, cut things in half, turn into a ball and run over things and more.
summary: The ability to summon the Omnidroid
strengths: You can summon the Omnidroid
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: It can be destroyed (it's hard but it can be done)

name: Owl Mimicry
description: With this power you can mimic the skills of an owl. You have excellent night vision, you can fly, you can grow a sharp beak, you can turn your hands into talons and mice have automatically have a fear of you.
summary: The ability to mimic the skills of an owl
strengths: You can mimic the skills of an owl
You can fly
Mice won't come near you
weaknesses: You prefer to be up at night and sleep all day

name: Voice Swap
description: With this power you can trade voices with any other person. Once you steal their voice you will sound exactly like them and they will sound exactly like you. You do not have to be near the person for this power to work. You will not gain their speaking mannerisms and if they know how to speak other languages you will not learn them by using this power. You will however gain their accent with their voice.
summary: The ability to trade voices with anyone else
strengths: You can trade voices with any other person
weaknesses: You do not gain their speaking mannerisms or knowledge of other languages
You cannot switch other people's voices you can only switch your own with someone else's

name: Power Boomerang
description: This power is great against power stealers. If they steal it from you, it returns to you and... That's pretty much it. It does nothing else... No, really. It only gives you the power to have this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away. It can still be mimicked though... Or destroyed... Or willingly discarded if you want to get rid of it. Otherwise, there's nothing much you can do with it... B-but it cannot be stolen or tak-, oh wait, I already wrote that, didn't I?
summary: The ability to automatically have this ability come back to you if it is stolen or taken away.
strengths: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
If someone mimics this power, they will end up with an unstealable power that does nothing!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
weaknesses: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you and that's it.
It does nothing else.
It can still be mimicked, deleted, discarded, etc.

name: Super Squad: Extra Vision
description: See cosmic powers, like that of the Silver Surfer, and magic, like that of Doctor Strange. Owned by fictional superhero "Vision".
summary: The ability to see cosmic and magic powers around you.
strengths: Can see cosmic and magic powers.
Can see if the cosmic or magic power is good or evil.
Can absorb it if it's a weak enough magic.
weaknesses: It feels as if your eyes are in chlorine.
Blind to all other things.
You go blind for ten seconds after using it.

name: You're Heat Resistant
description: With this power you can make people heat resistant (no snapping required). They will not get sun burns or be able to be hot even if they want to. They can still be burned by fire or lava however. You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power.
summary: The ability to make people heat resistant
strengths: You can make others heat resistant
weaknesses: You cannot make yourself heat resistant with this power
You cannot make them fireproof or lavaproof

name: Myth Power: Astrape's Assault
description: Astrape, in Greek myth, was the goddess of lightning. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, generate and manipulate electricity at will. In addition, one can conduct electricity, as well as absorb electricity to gain physical power. Furthermore, one can look at lightning strikes to psychically divine past, present or future, at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear lightning, as well as teleport to the site of lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to channel Astrape's command over the essence of lightning
strengths: Psychically perceive, generate, manipulate, conduct and absorb electricity
Watch lightning strikes to psychically divine the past, present and future
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who fear lightning
weaknesses: Cannot assume a form of living electricity (Electrical Mimicry) until developed (NCN)
Cannot call lightning down from the sky until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: Life Force Sacrifice
description: With this power you are able to amplify your powers, but in order for them to experience greater power some of your life-force must be sacrificed, power is measured in 6 months (1/2 years), so this amount of time is subtracted from years to live.
summary: The ability to donate some of your life force in order to amplify powers and talents.
strengths: Powers are greatly amplified.
weaknesses: If Immortal, you can not use this (No con negation)
You will die sooner.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes5
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Himeros (Himerus- Sexual Desire, Longing and Yearning), one can perceive and manipulate sexual desire (for reasons other than producing offspring) within others. In addition, one can direct the focus of a subject's sexual desire to anyone --or anyTHING-- one wants. One can even psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects when they naturally experience the sexual urge.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive and manipulate a subject's desire to pleasure themselves sexually
Psychically direct a subject's affections to anyone --or anything-- one desires
Psychically compel (and do enhanced damage against) subjects naturally experiencing a sexual urge
weaknesses: Cannot psychically gravitate or repulse attractive/attracted subjects until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Apolausis' Applause
description: Apolausis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of pleasure, enjoyment and delight (in an entertainment/fun sense). As such, channeling her allows one to gain numerous entertainment skills. In addition, one can psychically entrance subjects, immobilizing them in awe of one's performances, at will. Furthermore,one can psychically induce pleasant, happy sensations, by touch. One can even psychically rewind time and memory, at will, by clapping, making subjects relive previous actions and experiences.
summary: The ability to channel Apolausis' command over the essence of enjoyment, pleasure and delight
strengths: Gain numerous entertainment skills (acrobatics, juggling, dancing, singing, stage magic, etc)
Psychically entrance subjects with one's performances; induce pleasant, happy sensations by touch
Induce a 'psychic encore' (reversal of time/memory) of a subject's experiences, by applauding them
weaknesses: Cannot cast an illusion of (or gain physical power from) cheering/applause until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain power from others' natural smiles, laughs and happiness until developed (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Eater
description: There must be balance. As the Myth-Eater, you devour anything that relates to Myth, mythic gods, beasts, weapons even mythic cities. Eat titans, eat days of the week, months. You could eat time. Every myth, every pantheon, every legend. Each myth you eat gives you the strength, lifespan and power to eat the next mythic figure. Of course, a group of gods will team-up against you and you'll smile as you are surrounded knowing you will not hunger for a few millennia.
summary: The ability to devour every person, weapon, place or thing related to Myth, Legends
strengths: Instinctively gain more power to transcend mythic foes.
None of the so-called gods can escape your hunger. When you arrive, it is their end
Your hunger is precognitive ensuring each thing you devour makes you stronger than the next
weaknesses: You'll eat Cerberus, Fenrir, Laelaps, Teumessian Fox (all may be considered to be Ghostdogs)
In a mythic melee do not go against your instincts or it could be your undoing
Elder gods like Zeus & Odin have a propensity to whine quite a bit before they are devoured.

name: Strong Right Hand
description: Your right hand and arm are indestructible and possess enough superhuman strength to shatter a concrete pillar with a good punch. Your strength will increase if you work out. This power extends only to your right shoulder, and the rest of you is completely mortal.
summary: The ability to possess a super strong right hand
strengths: Can win any fight if you start it with a good right hook
Can block attacks with your right arm
Your right-handed throw or swing will be great in sports
weaknesses: The rest of you is as weak and vulnerable as anyone else is
Using your right arm extensively will leave you looking lop-sided, like swordsmen
If you use your full strength in a fight, you would kill a man

name: Jerk Healing
description: You can heal injuries, but to do so, you must tell them to stop whining. Somebody has a papercut?--"Somebody call whine-one-one! "--and it's healed! Friend on the ground, nearly dead?--"Stop being a big wuss and get up"--kick 'em in the ribs a few times, and everything's good! Actually dead? "Just get up you lazy fat sonuvagun!" You can heal yourself by downplaying injuries ("It's merely a flesh wound!").
summary: The ability to heal people by being mean
strengths: Get to make fun of people and have them thank you
You and your loved ones can live forever
weaknesses: Those who don't know what you're doing will think you're a pretty big jerk

name: Quantum Re Animation
description: You can make re-animates that are sort of like the weeping angels of doctor who. As long as these re-animates aren't being watched they are fully alive and healed. They become strong enough to rip thru steel or rip someone from limb to limb. These re-animates move so fast as to appear to teleport. When 'dead' these re-animates must be reduced to less than a finger or when not being observed these re-animates will be intact and alive again.
summary: The ability to have a dead person be alive only if that person isn't being observed.
strengths: Who's going to suspect a dead body is a threat?
Quantum re-animates reconstitute from a little as a pinkie finger.
These re-animates are only alive when not being observed(pro/con).
weaknesses: 360 degree vision, surveillance cameras or anything similar.
These re-animates are only dead when being observed(con/pro).
They can be destroyed in their stone form (but it's hard)

name: Resurrection In Killer
description: If someone kills you their soul is forced out of their body and yours is put into their body. You will keep all of your own powers but get none of theirs.
summary: The ability to come back to life in the body of the one who killed you
strengths: You can never truly be killed.
weaknesses: You can still die of old age.

name: Half Sea Serpent
description: Someone with this power has higher strength and speed than normal humans. That boost is doubled when they are in the water. They can 'breathe' water like a fish and are extremely good at swimming. They will also have finlike flaps of skin on their hands and feet, scaly skin, gills, and a scaly tail.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-sea serpent
strengths: The tail can be used as a weapon.
Hard for others to catch you in a race in the water.
weaknesses: You're not as good on land as you are in the water.

name: Dendritic Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). In normal mode, you can stick to and absorb a foe into your body, killing them. Once you've absorbed one, you'll then enter combat mode in which you grow several arms and legs, gaining enhanced mobility, and assimilate the foe's cells into your skin. When you encounter a Leukocyte Mimic who recognizes the cells as a foe's, you can make them enter combat mode too, if they haven't yet.
summary: The ability to stick to/absorb a foe, assimilate their cells and make other Leukocyte Mimics go into combat mode.
strengths: You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
Enhanced mobility skills include enhanced running, climbing, jumping, swimming skills.
In normal mode, when you touch a foe, your body will stick to theirs on a molecular level.
weaknesses: Once in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode, in which you can't absorb or stick to foes anymore.
As soon as you touch a foe's body, you'll get stuck to them until you manage to absorb them.
You'll automatically enter combat as soon as you absorb at least one foe.

name: Lonely God
description: Once the user activates this power, two things will happen. 1) you will recieve godlike power (nearly unlimited). 2) everyone else on earth (mankind/animals and insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone.
summary: The ability to have godlike power along with complete loneliness
strengths: Godlike power
Loopholes are still fair game
Some people like being alone
weaknesses: Everyone else on earth (mankind, animals, insects) will instantly disappear and you'll be all alone

name: Myth Power: Pan's Prowess
description: Pan, in Greek myth, was the god of shepherds, flocks, pastures, wilderness, hunting and rustic music. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and compel plants and animals. In addition, one can gain a supernatural awareness of events in the immediate environment. Furthermore, one can produce the "Call of the Wild" by voice, or by the entrancing music of summoned panpipes. One's presence even evokes a fear in foes, similar to being lost in the woods.
summary: The ability to channel Pan's command over the essence of shepherds, flocks, wilderness, hunting and rustic music
strengths: Commune with nature psychically (awareness of weather conditions, one's immediate environment)
Communicate with and control animals (and unleash animal nature in people)
Your presence can invoke fear reminiscent of being lost in the woods (they become panicked/nervous)
weaknesses: Aniothability, Mental Immunity and the like provide immunity to Pro #2 and Pro #3
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace provide immunity to the direct effects of Pro #2
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Living Music
description: Your cells elongate and vibrate as classical music that you control. But you still liv and can go back.
summary: The ability to turn your cells into sound waves of classical music that makes you living music.
strengths: Amplify yourself to deafen and shatter glass.
Intangible.
Escape through incredibly tight spaces.
weaknesses: You can be absorbed.
Limited to classical music.

name: Idiots To Geniuses
description: With this power you can turn anybody you want into a genius, but it works best if the person has a low IQ (diminished by mental retardation, old age, infancy, etc.) to start.
summary: The ability to turn stupid people into geniuses
strengths: Help friends out
Help out the "mentally challenged"
Help out the elderly and little kids
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself
Some say ignorance is bliss

name: A Swarm Of You
description: You start as a swarm of ant-sized versions of yourself. With time and practice you can become a swarm of femto-sized versions of yourself. Femto-sized versions of yourself are small enough to affect matter and energy processes on a sub-atomic level. This power doesn't give you a hive mind. Losing one part of your swarm reverts you to normal form.
summary: The ability to become a swarm of tiny or smaller versions of yourself.
strengths: Affect matter or energy processes on a sub-atomic level(with time and practice).
At a small enough your swarm-self will be unaffected by some attacks.
weaknesses: You're not a hive mind. You have to coordinate all yourselves somehow.
Lose one part of your swarm and revert to normal.

name: Blue/Purple Grenade
description: This power came from the dream of my brother.  Blue Grenade: You can throw it at somebody (including yourself) and anybody in the radius of the grenade will have blue metal skin and will be indestructible (similar to the Silver Surfer). When you jump and stomp you will have a flying board. Also you will be super fast. This super power is temporary.  Purple Grenade: Basically a magic grenade. (Its radius just hurts.)
summary: The ability to throw a magic grenade with various effects
strengths: You can fly
You can go super fast
You are indestructable
weaknesses: This can cause alot of destruction
If you use this on another person, they will not know how to use it (unless you use it on them alot)
If a villian is in the radius he will have both his and your powers

name: Mosquitos
description: Fun fact: It would take about 1,000,000 mosquito bites to completely drain an average adult human of all of their blood. With this power you can summon up to 1,000,000 bloodthirsty mosquitoes that are under your complete control. You can use them to attack you enemies or just summon a couple to be a mild annoyance to your friends. The mosquitos will never bite you no matter what. If some of your mosquitos die they are replaced with new ones so that you can have up to 1,000,000 at all times.
summary: The ability to summon 1,000,000 mosquitos
strengths: You can summon up to 1,000,000 mosquitos
They are under your complete control
They will never bite you
weaknesses: Their buzzing can get annoting
They can't penetrate armor

name: Swimming Out Of Water
description: In a way it's like flying, except no wings. You have the same, light feeling that you do when underwater. You wont float off either because just like in water you can control where you go.
summary: The ability to float through the air as if in water
strengths: Traveling is made easy
You are more flexable
Makes it harder for opponents to attack when up in the air
weaknesses: You move slower
Dodging is harder

name: Jade Emerald Shades
description: With these you can look through any disguise, to see who is a demon or an alien, you could also get a glimpse into the future just by wearing the shades, if you see everything light purple: the future could be better, if you see everything orange: the future can be far worse.
summary: The ability to use the Jade Emerald Shades to see through disguises and look into the future.
strengths: The future is so bright you gotta wear shades.
Weird looking sunglasses.
You can wear them at night.
weaknesses: The future been bright for so long, it could look dark.
The enemy can see you.

name: The Trial
description: If the person succeeds at the trial they will have full use of all of their powers to the power's highest level, but if they fail the trial, then their powers will be locked at the current levels and never be able to become stronger. The trial for each person is based on who and what they are and thus is different for each person. Also, they cannot be disturbed while taking the trial (temporary invulnerability,) which takes place completely in the mind and thus they will not be physically harmed
summary: The ability to have anyone take a trial of which the result affects their power levels
strengths: Allies could become much stronger.
Enemies could be locked at their current power levels.
Any given person can only take the trial once. May be a con if they fail.
weaknesses: Enemies could become much stronger.
Allies could be locked at their current power levels.
Using this power on yourself is a risk.

name: Myth Power: Tryphe's Trifle
description: Tryphe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of luxury, extravagance, and lavish living. As such, channeling her allows one to receive services, products or deals offered by any upscale establishment (country club, luxury hotel, etc) for free. In addition, one can psychically manipulate (and receive insight from) designer items. Furthermore, one can turn luxury items into similarly shaped weapons, tools and armor. One can even psychically perceive, locate and manipulate precious metals and stones.
summary: The ability to channel Tryphe's command over the essence of luxury, extravagance and lavish lifestyle
strengths: Full free access to luxury/upscale places and services; turn luxury items into weapons/tools/armor
Psychically manipulate (levitate, move, etc) and receive psychic insight from luxury items
Psychically perceive and manipulate precious metals/stones
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the rich/spoiled/greedy when developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically upgrade normal items into luxury items, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Money/economy/wealth-based MythPowers provide immunity/disruption/negation (NCN)

name: Completely Ungifted
description: This power makes you 100% unaffected by any power. Inversely, you can't have or use any power or object with power. This power transfers to the nearest person when you die, so there is always someone with this ability. If the person the power transfers to has a power, it is lost forever.
summary: The ability to not be affected by any power.
strengths: Never affected by any power.
Ability transfers from person to person after death, so it's never lost.
Power is always active, and undectable.
weaknesses: Can't use any power or object with power.
People might think you're useless.
You might not know you have the power until someone attempts to use a power on you.

name: 7 League Jump
description: In one jump you can go 7 leagues from your original position. It takes around a minute from initial push from the ground to landing on your feet. While landing your feet and legs become immune to all harm. There is no need for any item to use this power and you can choose whether or not to use this power. It is not automatic.
summary: The ability to jump 7 leagues in one movement without much effort
strengths: You can escape quickly.
Calculate it correctly and you can kick someone in the face when landing and take no harm.
weaknesses: The jump is always 7 leagues, no more, no less.
This con and the previous con are immune to alteration by other powers.
Can tire out quickly from the jumping.

name: Vampric Vendetta
description: By concentrating intensely on a person you despise, you drain their vitality bit by bit until they waste away and die. However, as you drain life, you begin to take on their characteristics more and more, and if you drain them completely, these characteristics are ingrained into your personality.
summary: The ability to drain the life out of people you hate.
strengths: Destroy those who stand in your way.
Hold power over life and death literally at your whim.
weaknesses: You will become everything you hate.
In doing so you will grow to hate yourself.
The compounded self-loathing will cause you to collapse into a godlike demon of all consuming hatred

name: I Can Hear You V3
description: With this power you will automatically know if someone is typing or writing something about you. You will know who the person is and what they are writing or typing. You cannot turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to know when a someone is typing or writing something about you
strengths: You will know when someone is typing or writing something about you
You will know what the person typed/wrote and who the person is
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power on and off
You will not know who the person was writing or typing to

name: Collared
description: Anyone on which the weilder of this power puts a collar, is their slave and the collar can only be taken off by the master or someone they completely and fully trust. This power can only be gained after making 1000 collars from raw materials (e.g. cow hide) by hand.
summary: The ability to make those that you put a collar onto become one's slaves.
strengths: Works on anyone who doesn't have Slavery Immunity or Mimic Slave.
You start off with 1000 collars when you gain this power.
weaknesses: It will take a large amount of time to create 1000 collars.
How in the world are you going to get the raw materials for all those collars?

name: Shadow Life
description: You have the ability to tie your life to a shadow. When the other person dies or object, so do you.
summary: The ability to string your life to another person's shadow.
strengths: Easier to live a long life.
weaknesses: Harder to live a long life.

name: Enhancement: Electrifying
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it electrifies the power's physical part. This power requires no source of power to keep going. If stolen, it will permanently electrify the power it is attached to. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make the physical part of a power surrounded by electricity by attaching this power to it
strengths: Shock your enemies. Electrifying Hair Blades!
No source of power required for the electricity.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Power might be useless electrified or might not want power to be electrified.
One power at a time

name: Nasa Warehouse
description: With this power you can summon anything that NASA has created, invented, or designed. You can control the size of the object that you summon so it does not have to be the same size as the one NASA made. You also gain knowledge of how the object was made and how to use it for as long as it is summoned. The knowledge is lost when the object is unsummoned. NASA does not lose the objects it makes when you summon, you summon a copy. You also have a mental catalog of everything you can summon.
summary: The ability to summon anything that NASA has created.
strengths: Summon anything NASA has created, invented, or designed.
Have knowledge of how the object is made, and how to use it.
Can control the size of the copy you are summoning as well.
weaknesses: NASA will not like you stealing their ideas.
If NASA goes out of business.
Can only use what NASA has made.

name: Ape Shift
description: Any change in your emotions or the emotions of anyone you care about will cause you to go Ape-Shift, transforming into a giant Silverback. You will be larger than any other ape and about 100 times stronger, optimally. Your sight, smell, taste and hearing will be off the charts. You will keep your intelligence. Well, as much IQ as any bipolar 8000 lbs gorilla can have.
summary: The ability to go Ape-Shift and transform into a super-strong 10-foot, 4 ton gorilla
strengths: When really frenzied, your already amazing strength doubles
All other non-human primates will look to you as their master & you can control them.
Leap and swing around any city like it is a concrete jungle.
weaknesses: Highly emotional in Ape-Shift. Any sudden change in emotions make you lose your mind
In a fight, you will not know when to stop & nothing but you can calm your beserker rage
The urge to throw your own feces is irresistible, even when you are human

name: Demon Transf. #2 Black Dragon
description: You transform into a big, black dragon. You have all the strength and powers of a dragon (fire breath etc. ). As an additional trait you have a fear aura (everyone looks at you and becomes VERY scared)
summary: The ability to transform into a big dragon.
strengths: Dragons are cool
Fear is cool
weaknesses: You are just a scary dragon, not much to see

name: Monster Control
description: With this power you can control any monster as long as it exists
summary: The ability to control monsters
strengths: You might be able to have an army of monsters
Can control their behaviors, and they like you (act like pets or guardians around you)
They won't want to scare you
weaknesses: If you exist in a universe where no monsters exist, this power is useless
If you're a scaredy-cat, this power won't do you much good...

name: 300 Spartans
description: You can materialize 300 spartans from your back yard, your bathroom. You can be their leader and its fun.
summary: The ability to appears 300 spartans instantly.
strengths: You are the leader.
They are your friends.
You can make them disappear or reappear.
weaknesses: You have to feed them.
Take good care of them.

name: Tirer La Couverture
description: Supernatural influences, such as spells, curses or effects of a superpower, can appear to you as either strings of words or symbols, a representation of the one who cast them or that of an artifact, or any other clues that indicate what the user is dealing with. Without any knowledge of the supernatural, this ability is pretty much useless to identify or counter spells, curses or the like. However, it can hint you that something supernatural is at work.
summary: The ability to see spells, curses or any other supernatural influences.
strengths: Allows you to see if something supernatural is at work, for example in cases of unexplained illness.
What you see are clues about what spell, curse or superpower is at work
weaknesses: You can't really do anything if you don't know much about superpowers, curses or spells.

name: Haymaker
description: Haymaker is much similar to the fisticuff ability, but rather than delivering an endless combo of punches, haymaker delivers one superblow that can knock out any enemy with enough force to punch a wall and knock out the enemy standing on the other side. Overuse, however, can tear your own muscles or break your bones.
summary: The ability to deliver a highly powerful knockout punch
strengths: Knocks out any opponent, even if they are made of metal or standing behind a wall.
weaknesses: Can be avoided by a fast-moving enemy
Overuse can eventually tear your muscles and break your bones

name: Rise Of The Hydra
description: With this power you can fight crime as the legendary super strong five headed hydra in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into the legendary five headed hydra
strengths: Whenever someone cuts off one of your heads two more grow in it's place
Really big, strong reptile (superstrength, superendurance, strong tail, claws, fangs, etc)
weaknesses: You'll be attacked as you look pretty dangerous

name: Cytotoxic T Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. In combat mode, you will cause a foe's cells to die by touching them, but only if the foe is of the same species as you. Note that, with this power alone, you cannot enter into combat mode by yourself.
summary: The ability to kill cells through touch (only cells of the same species as yours and only in combat mode).
strengths: You can tell friends from foes on a molecular level, meaning you can't be fooled by shapeshifters.
You can kill or severely hurt a foe by touching their body.
Your elastic body makes you impervious to blows.
weaknesses: You can only kill the cells you're touching and only those of the same species as yours.
You cannot enter combat mode by yourself with this power alone.
You can't return yourself to normal mode and your killing ability is always active in combat mode.

name: The Flaming Cage
description: Create small red orbs that will quickly surround someone and shot fire at each other and connect together to form and cage. This can work on groups of people and can be used as a good torturing method, mainly because fire can be shot from the orbs at the captive. If used underwater in stead of fire the orbs will release heat at very high temps(around 1000 degrease at times) and connect. The orbs can also trap moving targets on the run. The space in between the fire is 8 inches by 7 inches.
summary: The ability to trap an enemy in a cage of fire.
strengths: The orbs may also burst into flames and chase down enemies.
If water is sprayed onto the flames the heat will take its place until the water is gone.
Orbs will burn almost anything that touches them.
weaknesses: The larger the target the more orbs are needed and take about 3 seconds to create 5.
The space between the fire is small, but can still be passed through if one is quick enough
The orbs can be brooken by smashing them with about 3 tons of pressure.

name: Clean Oceans
description: With this ability, you can instantly clean sections of any body of water (depends on size). You can keep the world oceans clean, counter pollution and overfishing, protect/restore coral reefs etc.
summary: The ability to fight threats made to bodies of water
strengths: Clean oceans
Healthy fisheries
Healthy reefs
weaknesses: The bigger the body, the more you need to concentrate
Oceans are to big to do instantly, need a chopper to do it entirely

name: Hollow Mask
description: This ability lets you grow a hollow mask on your face at any time by storing energy and moving your hand in front of your face. Your mask will appear however you want it to look. When you release your mask you get the ability of one of the arrancar from Bleach which is a permanent effect for the mask. So for example your mask would be called Hollow Mask- Luppi or Hollow Mask- Ulquiorra
summary: The ability to grow a hollow mask on your face
strengths: Become a half hollow
Increased strength, edurance, and speed
Can release your mask for increased stats and abilities
weaknesses: Does not come with zanpakuto
Takes alot of energy to keep up
Must store energy before using

name: Usurpation: Magic
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp the magical powers of a single magic user, leaving them completely powerless in the process. Clothing will change to reflect the person whose powers have been stripped for the moment. 

You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original owner. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random mage who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single magic user.
strengths: Fighting magic users will become easy as you turn them powerless for the a while
Instant knowledge of what you can and can't do with "your " powers
weaknesses: The more powerful the magic user, the shorter you keep their powers
Magic could also just mean that powers are magical in nature but do not allow to do "real magic"

name: 3rd Key Of Death
description: This key is able to raise dead animals. They are at command, and since they remain undead, they can't be killed. The key turns into a door that releases selected animals - like if you wanted to bring back a lion, but not an elephant. They can be unsummoned, as if they were in quicksand they slowly sink into the earth.
summary: The ability to summon a key that is able to raise dead animals.
strengths: An undying army of animals.
weaknesses: It is a small key, that can get lost or get destroyed.
Only animals.
No Con Negation or Inconvience Destroyer.

name: Wudang Totem
description: The person with this totem is able to call upon the martial art skills of the animals that are inscribed on the totem, which is the tiger, the bat, the shark, the eagle and the fox. The ultimate form of this version is that the user will be able to change to the humanoid animal form of the animal that they are currently using. When you change to the humanoid animal form, you also gain that animal's natural ability.
summary: The ability to instantaneously learn the ways of the Wudang Warrior.
strengths: You know the ancient wudang martial arts.
You can transform into a humanoid animal form to give yourself more power to fight enemies.
weaknesses: Can only use one martial art at a time.
The humanoid animal transformation can last only for an hour.

name: Imperious Interruptus
description: You can hijack the conversations of subordinates.  You can speak to one of the subordinates while you turn your back to the others.  Those others are not allowed to leave, nor to chime in.  Their only choice is to stand awkwardly waiting while forced to listen.
summary: The ability to hijack the conversation of subordinates
strengths: You can spread your wisdom to your subordinates without delay
weaknesses: You boss can use this power against you.

name: Condition Change: Water
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user's skin is visibly wet. It doesn't matter where the skin is wet. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user has visible water on their skin
strengths: Just keep them from getting wet.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.
A hydrokinetic

name: Myth Power: Pledge Peitharchia
description: Peitharchia, in Greek myth, was goddess of obedience to command, subservience and submission. As such, channeling her allows one to compel nearly any subject to do one's bidding. In addition, one can cause the requests and commands of others to effect a subject like psychic compulsions. Furthermore, the user is immune to compulsion of any kind, compulsions directed to do him harm are instantly negated, and the user may psychically perceive and communicate with those who are naturally obedient.
summary: The ability to channel Peitharchia's command over the essence of obedience, subservience and submission
strengths: Make foes subject to one's own will, and/or the will of others (and immune to compulsions of others)
Compulsions directed to do you harm automatically fail
Psychically perceive and communicate with those who are obedient by nature (servants, etc)
weaknesses: Abilities which bestow Compulsion Immunity
Cannot pass on the Compulsion Immunity until the higher levels
Cannot induce pain in disobedient people (who disobey orders OR compulsions) until the higher levels

name: Brown Adipocyte Mimicry
description: This power is always active. Your entire body is covered in a huge amount of tiny brown spots. As soon as you touch/consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb between twice and three times your body mass. However, it won't affect your build at all. In addition to storing a lot of fat, you also have an extremely high metabolic rate and can convert fat into a huge amount of heat. The conversion aspect of this power is amplified by cold external temperatures.
summary: The ability to absorb fat and convert it into heat.
strengths: The fat you absorb also acts as a thermal insulator, protecting you from extreme cold or heat.
You look tanned (well, from a distance).
You'll never worry about becoming fat.
weaknesses: You can only generate heat as long your body contains fat.
Once you burn all the fat in your body, you'll be very vulnerable to external temperatures.
You'll become very heavy despite looking normal.

name: Myth Power: Ire Of The Arae
description: The Arae (Arai), in Greek myth, were the fierce sister goddesses of curses, imprecations and misfortune. As such, channeling them allows one to grant up to nine wishes a day, for oneself and/or others. These wishes may be for anything, so long as they do not directly help or benefit anyone. In addition, one may receive knowledge of foes' innermost fears and weaknesses at will. One even gains favor by evil-aligned gods of the Greek pantheon and immunity to MythPowers based on good-aligned gods.
summary: The ability to channel the Arae and their command over the essence of curses and misfortune
strengths: Grant nine malevolent wishes a day, for self and/or others
Receive knowledge on the fears and weaknesses of foes
Favor with evil-aligned gods of the Greek Pantheon; immunity to MythPowers of good-aligned gods
