description: With this power, you can kiss someone and make them feel certain ways. For instance, if someone is feeling sad, you can kiss them and make them feel happy. Not only can you make them experience emotions, you can also control their physical feelings. For instance, if someone is tired, you can kiss them to give them energy.
summary: The ability to kiss someone and make them experience different feelings and emotions.
strengths: You can kiss someone anywhere on their body (hand, cheek, lips, etc. )
If the person wanted the kiss, accepted it, or was happy to get it, the power works even better.
weaknesses: If you're unable to kiss someone, the power won't work.
If the person didn't want the kiss or didn't accept it, the effect wears off faster or can be broken

name: External Superpower Activation
description: This is the counterpart of Forced Superpower Activation. Instead of activating someone else's power by fulfilling the conditions to use it, you can activate one of your own powers while someone else fulfils the required conditions. This can be tricky to use if there's a very short time frame when the conditions are reunited. For example, if the condition is saying "Adeat", you must already be using this power on them before they say it, not while they say it, not after.
summary: The ability to activate your own power by having someone else fulfil all the conditions needed to use it.
strengths: If you are put in a position where you can't activate your power, someone can activate it for you.
If you'll never be able to fulfil the conditions yourself, like being pregnant as a man.
If the effects normally manifest on your body, they will still manifest on your body, not theirs.
weaknesses: In some cases, this person can use your power as they want, possibly against you, like telekinesis.
If the conditions must be maintained to keep your power active, you will be depending on them.
Tricky if there's a very short period of time when all the conditions are reunited.

name: Songspeak
description: One with this ability can communicate psychically with others through song. They need only sing or hum a note, and the musical sound conveys the message without need for lyrics (similarly, music from others conveys a message to the user). In addition, the user may use this ability to mimic (and resist) Hypnotic Song, Psychic Song, Dread Song, Siren Song, or the like, based on what is needed. Furthermore, the ability results in a beautiful, tireless singing voice.
summary: The ability to communicate psychically with others through song
strengths: Communicate in a way that's even more discreet than telepathy or empathy
Mimic (and resist) any song-based ability
Awesome singing voice
weaknesses: Doesn't allow you to otherwise manipulate sound
No sonic attacks unless they sound song-like (no just outright compulsions)
Deaf people

name: Blessing Of Heimdallr
description: The user, once blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr, is granted a golden suit of armor, a golden great sword , a mystical horn and limited powers of the God Heimdall
summary: The ability to be blessed by the Norse God Heimdallr
strengths: Limited Precognition
Enhanced Eyesight and Hearing ( Not super )
Can summon allies with mystical horn
weaknesses: Can't fly
Armor and great sword reduces speed

name: Thunder Skulls
description: You can fire a skull of light yellow electrical energy at your opponent; it zaps and knocks them farther back, as well as having increased damage.
summary: The ability to fire skull like projectiles which will shock the opponent.
strengths: It maybe one of the oddest projectiles ever to be on the SPL.
Works well against water-type foes.
weaknesses: Will not have an effect on wood, plastic and rock type opponents.

name: 1 For The Money V2
description: With this power you can turn one object into the exact amount of money you or the person who most recently bought it for. You can only use this power once a day.
summary: The ability to turn one thing into its monetary value a day
strengths: You can turn objects into their monetary value
weaknesses: You can only use this power once a day

name: Summoning: Symbiotic Parasite
description: Symbiotic Parasite, a cruel uncaring demonic creature that latches onto people. Once summoned, it will latch onto the user, using the user's body to survive. The person whom it attaches to gains incredible powers for the cost of hosting the parasitic demon.
summary: The ability to summon a Symbiotic Parasite.
strengths: Incredible power.
weaknesses: Saps your energy at times.

name: Demon Doppleganger
description: Everyone has a demon doppleganger, most are sealed away. Some are good, some are bad.
summary: The ability to trade places with your Demon Doppleganger
strengths: Gain demonic powers
More resilient
weaknesses: Demons are both good and bad
Might be stuck in demon form depending on the demon

name: Concretakinesis
description: The power to mentally move concrete with your mind, allowing you to destroy concrete, use it as a shield, and make concrete mud slides.
summary: The ability to mentally move concrete with your mind.
strengths: Destroy concrete.
Make shields out of concrete.
Good protection.
weaknesses: Slower than most -kinesis.

name: Business Tycoon
description: This ability you do exceedingly well, at managing business and companies. Always shooting straight to the top of the corporate ladder. Whatever your business is about. You get all the clients and become extraordinarily wealthy.
summary: The ability to do extraordinary well at business management.
strengths: Always excell in business 100% of the time.
Choices you make end up making you more money.
weaknesses: Business management may not be one of your interests.

name: Information Inaccessibility
description: The user has the power to unconditionally withhold information by writing that information on paper, and then burning that paper afterwards. The information has to be something personal (like your name or a current position) or something that 'affects' you personally (like the name of your friend). After the informaton is burned away, any attempt to access/recover/distribute/comprehend/store it will ultimately be futile. The effects cannot be undone, even if this ability is nullified.
summary: The ability to unconditionally withhold information by burning the paper it was written on.
strengths: Your opponent will never know where you are, even if you two are face to face.
Even if you say every information out loud, no one will receive nor comprehend that information.
The effects of this ability is irreversible; thus, it cannot be nullified.
weaknesses: Only the user of this ability is unaffected. Everyone else (your family, friends, allies) is not
Irreversible

name: Rollout
description: Also called Rolling or Tumbling, is the ability to curl into a ball and roll at high speeds. This can be used to tumble into foes and bowl them over, to smash through subjects like a living wrecking ball, deflect projectiles hurled at the user, or just for very quick, efficient travel. It can even be used to ricochet off walls or bounce around an area at will. Rolling is almost always at a very high speed, just like Sonic the Hedgehog.
summary: The ability to curl into a ball, and roll/tumble at high speeds
strengths: Very efficient travel (at high speed, and the back is very flexible so rolling doesn't hurt)
Good to bowl foes over with the same power as Unstoppability, but only while rolling
Superhumans try to throw you? You're very bouncy, you'll just ricochet off the walls
weaknesses: Doesn't increase strength unless you are rolling
Doesn't increase speed unless you are rolling
Increases durability, but still hurts if you roll over surfaces like concrete roads with rocks

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes7
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Pothos (Pothus- Passionate Longing, Desire and Yearning for the Unattainable), one can perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover, and summon a copy of that being to life. It can be altered completely to suit the user/subject's whims and falls instantly in love with the user/subject. One can even travel to and from a fictional universe where a fictional dream lover lives, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive the identity of a subject's dream lover
Psychically summon a copy of a subject's dream lover to life (create, edit and delete them) at will
Teleport self/others to and from a fictional universe where a dream lover lives, at will
weaknesses: Knowledge/Skills/Powers/Abilities bestowed on a dream lover must grow in power over time (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Blob Transform
description: Similar to blob mimicry, but different (and better). You can transform into a blob with something of a "cell membrane" (you can change and hold shape). You are blue and indestructible, and have a single eye. (your brain is combined with your cells that make up you). You can switch between your normal self and blob at any time.
summary: The ability to transform into a blob
strengths: Indestructible
Can eat things (anything)
You can see and hold shape
weaknesses: People can go through you
You have no muscle mass

name: Set Fire To The Rain.
description: If you say "Set fire to the rain," the rain will turn to fire, it will be massively destructive but no worries, you are immune to the fire.
summary: The ability to turn rain into fireballs.
strengths: Easily wipe out a village.
Immune.
You can turn the fire back to normal.
weaknesses: Very destructive.
Cannot work without rain.

name: Floor Removal
description: This ability allows you to grab the floor and to pull it out. Once released, the floor will quickly come back into place. If there's a room under the floor, you can also open a passage to it. If your enemy or a bystander is standing on the floor, you can literally pull the floor out from under them to make them fall.
summary: The ability to pull the floor out like a rug
strengths: Make your enemies trip.
Easily open an access to the room beneath the floor.
weaknesses: Useless against flying enemies.
Works only on the floor

name: Laser Fingers
description: Each finger may emit a highly accurate laser beam that can reach approximately 7 meters away to any target. The lasers can go through gloves and pockets, but are not lethal in anyway shape or form.
summary: The ability to shoot lasers from fingertips for pointing purposes only
strengths: Point extremly accurately
Blind enemies by suprise
Lasers can change colors (may cause seizures)
weaknesses: Lasers don't burn, pierce, or harm enemies
Does no damage to the eyes
Fingers may overheat

name: Daydream Recovery
description: You can remember past daydreams. You can daydream again. You can also make it much harder for people to interrupt your daydreams (unless you want them to). Your brain puts together what it learns during daydreaming as a side effect. Your brain exercises it's complex problem solving skills during the daydream. You might become more emphathetic. A daydream might be a stronger form of imagination.
summary: The ability to recover your ability to daydream that has been crushed by certain people.
strengths: Recover your ability to daydream.
Remember past daydreams
Daydreaming has similar benefits to sleeping.
weaknesses: Might not recover imagination.
If you daydream excessively, it becomes disruptive to your life.

name: Babel
description: What if you could confuse everyone you speak with to the point that they could no longer speak or understand coherent words? With this power, you could drive people nuts. Say one indistinguishable word to a person and you will cause that person to never be understood when they speak, write or communicate in any way. Each person they speak to will fall prey to your power. The only cure to your confusing bedlam is getting the victim near an open flame. What if you could confuse the entire world?
summary: The ability to cause a contagious linguistic nightmare.
strengths: You only need to speak one garbled word to begin confusing people
You could ruin an opponent's ability to think clearly and his team's communication
You are the only one who can understand the confused message your victims are trying to speak
weaknesses: Being near any open flame ruins your effect and returns your victim's thoughts and speech to normal
No one will ever be able to accurately recount anything you say again
Your confusing babble could ruin communications across the globe

name: Summon Fractal Crystalloid
description: A fractal crystalloid is fractal in nature, that is should one be damaged any pieces that come off will grow into new crystalloids. This cycle will keep repeating itself unless certain powers are used. Powers of total destruction, reality erasing, entrapping powers, powers that somehow freeze objects, matter control, matter manipulation, powers that control earth or crystals. Crystalloids have no minds of their own, are 6 feet tall, strong as an olympic weightlifter and look like icy skeletons.
summary: The ability to once a day summon a self-replicating crystalline being.
strengths: Servant-warriors that opponents will avoid damaging.
Crystalloids have no minds-mind control powers are useless.
You want an army? All you do is smash one into a thousand pieces.
weaknesses: If some takes control of this power and turns your crystalloids against you.
Any powers that exploit a crystalloid's weaknesses.
Crystalloids can't act on their own.

name: Anti Virtual  Reality
description: All powers based on virtual reality have no effect on the area 100 metres around you whenever this power is activated. This power considers any fake world on an internet server to be virtual reality as well as any power that inputs digital information into the real world.
summary: The ability to make virtual reality-based powers ineffective 100 metres around oneself
strengths: Completely counters Digitalization, Matriculation, etc.
weaknesses: Only helps against virtual reality-based powers.

name: Author's Genius
description: This power grants the user a fully functioning yet inherently loyal mind inside your own. While it cannot use your superpowers directly, it will serve it's master in any way. It begins with the same level of intelligence, memory and creativity as its masters', but increase exponentially when a power the user added to the superpower list is acquired.
summary: The ability to have a secondary mind whose capabilities increase exponentially.
strengths: If you create a lot of popular powers, this mind will be extremely intelligent and creative.
Completely loyal and obedient; in spite of intelligence, it will do whatever you want it to.
Memory increases as well.
weaknesses: Cannot effect the outside world.
Cannot stop you if you fall under the influence of another.
Cannot use your powers, although it will be telepathically shielded if you are.

name: Myth Power: Dione's Dynamic
description: Dione, in Greek myth, was the goddess of moisture, moist soil and oak trees. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate moisture in the air (humidity, steam, mist, fog) at will. In addition, one can imbue moisture into, or absorb moisture from matter, by touch. Furthermore, one can psychically absorb nutrients from soil (especially if moist), to heal and gain physical power, at will. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere with oak trees, at will
summary: The ability to channel Dione's command over the essence of moisture, moist soil and the oak tree
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate moisture in the air; imbue (or absorb) moisture at will
Absorb nutrients from soil to heal and gain physical power, at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to any location with oak trees, at will
weaknesses: Cannot trap subjects' souls within oak trees (immobilizing foes), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into an immovable, indestructible divine oak tree, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a divine mist, a dove or a flock of doves, at will, until developed (NCN)

name: Life Drain Backlash
description: Should the user of this power ever run a marathon, have his life-force absorbed, or otherwise exert too much energy, the consequences can be dire. When the user feels exhausted, even mentally, his body gives off a psychic version of an EMP that basically causes a foe's nerves to fire off at once. This temporarily disables their foe so they can recuperate and catch their breath.
summary: The ability to produce a backlash effect whenever you suffer a severe loss of stamina
strengths: Life-force absorbers are no match for you
Vampires are hurting themselves by trying to drink your blood (and dehydration harms dehydrators)
If you get too tired, your power goes off to give you a headstart or a leg-up
weaknesses: If you get really tired during sex
If you feel mental strain during a test
Never run a marathon, if you don't plan on being discovered

name: Coinspinner
description: Also called the sword of chance, Coinspinner is one of the 12 swords of power. As its name implies, it is lucky, if a bit of a gamble. Even without being drawn Coinspinner endows its user with superhuman good luck, it seems as if it is impossible for them to go wrong. But Coinspinner is the most intelligent of the swords. And the most unpredictable. Coinspinner will often leave its owner without warning vanishing, and leaving a storm of bad luck in its place.
summary: The ability to wield the sword of chance.
strengths: Superhuman Good Luck
Somewhat intelligent
Well balanced, super sharp sword resistant to most damage
weaknesses: Unpredictable
Has a nasty habit of disappearing at the moment you need it most.
Leaves bad luck behind.

name: Super Alloy Shapeshifting
description: Just like colossus, but a lot cooler and more durable. You can withstand temperature extremes and you have immunity to most physical attacks. You can change in any alloy you want, even adamantium and vibranium.
summary: The ability to turn your body into a super-alloy while retaining organic properties
strengths: Withstand temperature extremes and most physical attacks
Can withstand almost anything like acids, bullets, TNT, etc.
Super-strength, superhuman endurance
weaknesses: Physical protection only
Can be hurt by super super strength

name: Flight Of The Bumblebee
description: This ability can pack quite a sting (pun intended). It allows the user to mimic all the abilities of any given bee species. The user may turn into a bee or a SWARM of bees at will. He can size-shift to a small size at will (without turning into a bee), sprout bee wings without size-shifting, turn into a HUMAN-sized bee, and the droning of his wings can produce four effects: 1) normal flight, 2) disorientation, 3)pacification (inducing drowsiness), 4)sonic blasts.
summary: The ability to access abilities pertaining to bee species
strengths: Mimic bee abilities (venom, itch-inducing touch, flight, communicate with/command bees)
Bee wings produce 4 different effects the user can control
Mix bee effects (Human-sized bee, Human with bee wings, Human with stinger, etc. )
weaknesses: While size-shifted, you can be smushed
You can turn into a hive of bees, but you can't replicate yourself in NORMAL form, or at NORMAL size
May form a hive-mind with others who have this ability (if they get in range)

name: Chaos Dice
description: You can conjure 6 sided dice that you can roll. If the roll is one, the person you have picked will not die but will be painfully hurt. If you roll a six, your victim's inner organs and body explode in chaos as your victim feels the worst feeling of pain possible to feel by a human.
summary: The ability to roll dice to randomly kill someone.
strengths: Can be painful and deadly
weaknesses: You could roll a one

name: Dodge
description: This power will allow to move out of the way of some sort of attack. However, you must be aware of the attack in order to dodge it. For example, if someone hits you from behind or catches you off guard, they will most likely succeed.
summary: The ability to dodge any attack or action towards you.
strengths: Great in combat situations.
Applies to mental and physical attacks.
Can lead to good counter moves.
weaknesses: Have to be aware of the attack.
Has to be realistically dodged (tight corners can be a problem)

name: Old One Power: Yog Sothoth
description: Yog-Sothoth is immensely powerful, as he is the master of time and space (and some magic). He can open gates from and to any place (including other realms) and any time. The opening of the gates is so great a task that he keeps an eye on your use, refusing to open gates for reasons he disagrees with. He also uses you to further his goals often, usually allowing him direct access to the universe so he can feast. As you are useful, you gain eternal youth and immortality, at least to aging.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Yog-Sothoth
strengths: Mastery of time, space, and dimension! The benefits of these powers can't begin to be listed here!
As he needs people on the inside to gain access to this universe, he is much more willing to talk.
If he sees fit, he might teach you some of the powerful mythos magic. You're immortal, too.
weaknesses: Unless it's necessary for survival, gathering power, or useful for him, no time travel for you.
The Mythos magic he might teach you drains the stability of the mind of the user and local reality.
His goals are usually "curry favor with the other Old Ones" and "enter reality to cause horror. "

name: Epidermal Chroma Control
description: With this power, you can completely control the color of your skin. You can be white, black, purple, or whatever. Options are only limited to the visible light spectrum. However, you cannot alter the texture of your skin, but your skin doesn't have to be a solid color, and you could even create patterns of color on your skin. Your internal colors (including eyeballs) will not change, nor will your hair color.
summary: The ability to control the color of your own skin at will.
strengths: Can provide some degree of camouflage
Never have to put on coloring makeup again
Can have new tattoos everyday
weaknesses: Not that useful for hiding unless naked and bald
Strong emotions may trigger unintentional changes
People may want to touch and poke your skin whenever it is a non-normal color

name: Sneaky Superpower Snatcher
description: An upgraded version of Power Boomerang. Not only will this power return to you if it is stolen or taken away, but it will also steal some of the thief's powers. Otherwise, it still does nothing and it still is vulnerable to mimicry, destruction, cancellation, etc. But, it still is much better than Power Boomerang, right?
summary: The ability to have this power come back if it is stolen right after it steals some power from the thief.
strengths: This power cannot be stolen or taken away from you! Yeah!
It also steals powers from the thief if they steal this power!
If it's cancelled to prevent its return, it will return to you the second the cancellation stops.
weaknesses: What if the thief also has this power and what if you accidentally steal it from them?
It does nothing if it's not stolen or taken away.
It can still be mimicked, deleted or discarded.

name: Yes Man
description: Every time you say the word yes you get good luck.  Talking to your boss,in a important event,just keep saying yes and you will surely have good luck.
summary: The ability to have good luck when saying yes.
strengths: Always have good luck.
weaknesses: Saying another word will give you bad-luck.
Passive ability.

name: Title Theme Tune
description: The tune will be only about you! Let's say WHD has this power. He just heard a person in distress. As he runs to rescue them, his theme tune plays: "Double-you!... Aitch!... Dee!... WHD!!!..." Let's say Vespert has it and really needs to go to the toilet but they are all occupied, so he has to wait: "*drum rolls* Ves-PERT! *drum rolls* Ves-PERT!". Let's say Shadowulf1 has it and is standing on a building top: "Here he iiiiis... The AAAAlll-miiighty Shadowuuuulf!... Hero ooof the CENturyyy!..."
summary: The ability to have a catchy tune about you play whenever you have to do something tense or just awesome.
strengths: Noone around you will hear the song. So your position won't be given away.
The subject of the song is you! Or your secret identity depending on the circumstances.
It emphasizes the awesome or difficulty of actions you perform.
weaknesses: Cameras can capture the song so anyone seeing you on TV will hear it.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: X Men Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character who has ever been a member of the X-Men even if they're no longer a member anymore
summary: The ability to summon any member of the X-Men
strengths: You can summon powerful heroes to help you
weaknesses: They don't have to help you

name: Extraterrestrial Psychic Link
description: When this power manifests, a psychic link between you and a random alien will be established. From then on, you will be able to exchange telepathically (thoughts), empathically (emotions), sensorily (senses) and mnemonically (memories) with that alien. Unless special conditions arise, you will never be able to change to another alien 'correspondent'. The reason why that specific alien was chosen is because he/she/it(?) has this power as well.
summary: The ability to psychically communicate with one specific alien in the whole universe.
strengths: You or the alien can turn this power off, but you won't change correspondent when you turn it on.
You can obtain valuable information about alien technology, culture and knowledge.
You will psychically understand each other and can become friends or more.
weaknesses: You most likely will never meet your new friend in person. And you cannot change your correspondent.
People can think you're crazy if you tell them you're in communication with an alien.
You may be psychically invaded by the alien, meaning it may take over your body.

name: Skeleton Key
description: Your fingers are the exact size, shape, and thinness to unlock anything you come across. The only thing you have to do is put your finger in the lock and turn.
summary: The ability to unlock anything with your bare hands
strengths: Never worry about locking your keys in a room.
Help the attractive damsel in distress who locked her keys in her car.
Pretty much unlock anything.
weaknesses: Horrifyingly mangled and hideous hands.
Hands so useless they can't do anything (pick things up, turn door knobs, hitchhike, etc.)
Combination locks baffle you.

name: Bard
description: Bards are musical warriors that can enchant others with their songs. A bard can play any instrument expertly and the songs they play can have the effect of buffing themselves and their friends or hindering their enemies. A bard's melodies can unite a group so that their strengths act in harmony. Advanced Bards can even use their melodies to mesmerize their foes and alter their minds.
summary: The ability to have the musical powers of a Bard.
strengths: Use songs to strengthen and bolster allies.
Use songs to weaken or dishearten foes.
Advanced Bards can mesmerize others.
weaknesses: Requires an instrument.
Have to play songs to effect others.
If the song is stopped or isn't heard, the effect wears off.

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Freezer
description: Have the abilities of Freezer, which includes using alchemy to control the boiling and freezing of water, and causing the molecules to form in a specific shape. "Boiling and Freezing are both elements of water. "-Freezer.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of Freezer.
strengths: The abilities of Freezer.
weaknesses: In some places water is not usable.
You have to watch Full Metal Alchemist to understand the full effect.

name: Invincible Ears
description: With this power your ears are invincible meaning they cannot be cut off, you cannot go deaf, you cannot get an ear infection, your hearing is always perfect, you can't be affected by the bang part of flashbang grenades, nothing can hurt your ears, your ears cannot feel cold or heat unless you want them to.
summary: The ability to have invincible ears
strengths: Your ears are invincible
weaknesses: Only your ears are invincible

name: Interdimensional Arrow Monster
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves the sport archery. When you activate this ability, a bow will materialise in your hands. You start by pulling the string back and aiming as if you were launching an arrow. You will be shooting nothing, but when you release, a red spherical monster slips into our dimension. It will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
summary: The ability to fire a small monster using a special bow
strengths: Fire a small monster at a target by firing nothing.
The monster will pull the target into the dimesion it came from.
Get awesome archery skills. "How are you so good with archery? ", and you say "Ah, it's nothing! "
weaknesses: Unlike an arrow, this monster will bounce if it hits a wall. What if it bounces back at you?
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Bad if you dislike the colour (color) red

name: Gravitational Stabilization
description: When you are able to create and or destroy matter or energy, you have to be wary of disrupting the gravitational constant and thus killing the universe. This power bestows upon you a form of telekinesis as strong as the universe is large. Unfortunately, you cannot use it in any way other than subconsciously making the universe behave normally, as if nothing had changed. This power cannot be modified by other powers.
summary: The ability to make your current universe act normally despite creation/destruction of matter or energy.
strengths: Create or destroy matter or energy without destroying the universe.
Takes no effort; it even does the adjustments automatically. You may even forget about the power.
You also compensate for those who do not have this power.
weaknesses: Cannot use this telekinesis for anything else. You cannot even modify it with other powers.
Does not help if you change the gravitational pull of the body you stand on.
If you die or lose this power without reversing your work, the universe will suffer.

name: Claymore : The Storm
description: This gives you a set of claymores; this claymore looks like the Scottish broad sword and is made of iron. It can create storms, but beware, for it attracts lightning
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can only create storms
strengths: Create a storm of your making
Looks like the Scottish broad sword
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore (no con negation )
You are not immune to the storm
What ever you do, do not lose the claymore

name: Helmet Hair
description: With this power you can turn your hair (only the stuff on your head) into a helmet. The helmet is completely indestructible and you can turn it back into hair whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn your hair into a helmet
strengths: You can turn your hair into a helmet
The more hair you have the larger your helmet
weaknesses: You can really only protect the top of your head

name: Surface Compulsion
description: With this power you can let out a mental pulse that will compel anything in an area of water to rise to the surface of it. How large the area is is left to the users discretion. Creatures will remain at the surface of the water for as long as the user wills.
summary: The ability to compel any living creature in an area of water to rise to the surface.
strengths: Find people trying to hide underwater.
Scoop up sea life with a net when they surface.
Send anything attacking you underwater to the surface.
weaknesses: You'll probably end up killing deepwater life that can't hendel the change in pressure.
You have no control over them once they reach the surface, you can only tell them to come up.

name: Nail Bullets
description: With this power you can fire off your fingernails from your hand with the force and speed of a bullet. The nails grow back as soon as as you've fired every nail on one hand, quickly and painlessly.
summary: The ability to fire your fingernails like bullets.
strengths: A concealed weapon with unlimited ammo is on hand at all times.
Your nails will always grow back healthy.
weaknesses: They're fingernails, so don't expect deep penetration.

name: The Shyamalan Effect
description: Oh what a beautiful day..... Why is my house on the moon?! What a twist! This power allows you to manipulate one's own or someone else's probability so that whatever they do next will turn out to be a "twist" like in a movie. When the killer is going after them, it might turn out that he just wants to kill that awful nail biting habit of theirs. What a twist! You can't control what kind of twist happens though. It can be good, bad or just plain weird.
summary: The ability to affect probability to force a huge random twist in a situation.
strengths: Make your enemies really confused.
Maybe you like M. Night Shyamalan movies so much that you can make your life like one.
weaknesses: You can't control what kind of twist it will be. It can be for the best or for the worst.
Maybe you hate M. Night Shyamalan movies and stupid, unexplainable twists.

name: H&V Control
description: There are 3 rules: 1. You can only control one target at a time; 2. While controling, your body will be left unconscious; 3. You can only control your target for 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to control heroes and villains
strengths: Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
Able to have different powers
weaknesses: Your original body goes into an unconscious state
You only have a limited amount of time in a body
After you leave the target's body, the target becomes conscious

name: Firework Vision
description: You are able to generate a blast of fireworks from your eyes. The blast can be any colour and you can control how strong it is. You are unable to control when the blast explodes.
summary: The ability to shoot fireworks from your eyes
strengths: You are an immediate party hit
It can be very useful
You can control the colour and how strong it is
weaknesses: You cannot control when the blast explodes

name: Contained Blood
description: This power prevents your blood from leaving your body or, more precisely, your blood vessels. You could have a very bad cut or lose a limb, but at least you won't bleed. You can't even get bumps or hematomas. Since your blood doesn't leak from the blood vessels, it also coagulates more easily. However, it doesn't prevent things like poison or dirt from entering your body through your wounds.
summary: The ability to not have your blood leave your blood vessels.
strengths: Never lose any blood.
Great against mosquitoes, vampires and other blood suckers.
Never get internal bleedings, bumps, hematomas or black eyes.
weaknesses: You can't donate your blood.
You can't take blood tests.
Doesn't prevent your blood from being contaminated.

name: Flip A Destiny
description: With this power, you can decide your destiny by tossing a coin. In order to use it, you must first ask something to the coin, then flip it. If it is heads you will get what you desired, if not, you will get the opposite. This is also useful during combat. If you are outnumbered or cannot beat an enemy, just flip the coin. You will not only win but also defeat your enemies once and for all. But you may also fail at flipping the coin. Then you will not only die, but also burn in hell forever.
summary: The ability to decide your destiny by flipping a coin.
strengths: You can get all you want.
Can win any battle.
Is a matter of luck
weaknesses: You can lose all you have.
Can lose any battle.
Is a matter of luck.

name: Deaf Ray
description:
With this power you can shoot a "deaf ray" from you finger tips that switches a person's normal hearing with sounds that do not make them suspicious. 

They will not know that they have been hit unless someone starts to talk to them.
summary: The ability to shoot an invisible beam that makes someone deaf for 1-2 minutes
strengths: Can use it on others so you can talk freely without them knowing what you said
Can use it on yourself to study better
weaknesses: Deafness only lasts 2 minutes
Reading Lips
Using it at the wrong time

name: Reincarnation 1: Genetic
description: With this power, you have a genetic anomaly compos, which is passed on to your descendants. These genes have this power. This trait is autorecessive (look it up) Children born with two of these genes turn into "backup" bodies upon death -complete with your exact DNA, including powers. Children born with one copy will be carriers, able to produce backups and more carriers, but not otherwise affected. If they inherit neither, they are normal humans.
summary: The ability to reincarnate as your descendants.
strengths: Be very hard to kill with enough backups.
Easy to use.
If negated, the genes are passed on until the suppression is over, when they regain their powers.
weaknesses: Someone can kill all your backups and carriers.
May be hard to keep all the backups and carriers safe.
Certain causes of death will not cause the backups to revive.

name: Anatomical Automatism
description: A katana is the best thing that could happen to an Anotomical Automator. When a part of their body gets seperated from them, they control it as if it was still attached. This means that severed hands and arms can still scurry around, severed legs can still kick, and even spilled blood will crawl around. This also comes with the ability to reattach the limbs easily. However, it still hurts and the body cannot automatically detach body parts.
summary: The ability to control the parts of your body after they have been severed
strengths: Having limbs severed not such a big deal
Can reattach the parts easily
Can even control spilled blood
weaknesses: Still hurts
Cannot automatically detach body parts
Do not have a psychic link to parts

name: Glowing Items
description: With this power you can easily find things by just thinking of the item, then it will instantly start glowing. It also helps if you're trying to find the enemy's secret weapon, by just thinking "The Enemy's secret weapon," it will instantly start to glow wherever it is
summary: The ability to make things glow
strengths: You can easily find things
It's fun to watch things light up when you think about them
weaknesses: You can't turn it off which means whenever you think of something it will automatically glow
It can't help you at all in physical combat

name: Shootingism
description: Basically, if you are in a room and some one has a gun you are able to control it even if it's not in your hand. You can also pick up any weapon and instantly know how to use it. Even if you have never seen it before.
summary: The ability to shoot from any rifle or weapon
strengths: Able to shoot people with 'no hands'
Shoot from any weapon
Instant knowledge of that rifle will stay with you.
weaknesses: Harmful to your brain
You can end up shooting yourself or friends
If not developed it can be deadly

name: Youtube Hypnosis
description: With this ability you can hypnotize or brainwash any one through youtube videos. It doesn't matter what the video itself is about as long as you have encoded your command, general idea or opinion etc. And whoever watches the video will be instantly hypnotized and/or brainwashed.
summary: The ability to hypnotise or brainwash people through youtube videos
strengths: Hypnotize millions of people to do or think what you want
Using this power on really popular videos insures you will get a wide affect
Can change or remove the command from videos
weaknesses: Can only use on 10 videos at a time
Videos can be deleted along with the command
Person has to watch the entire video for the power to work

name: Aura Changer
description: Whoever possesses this power can change someone's aura color by thinking, touching, or staring at the person they want to affect. With this, you can change people's moods, and better yet, change what aura-readers see (and what message they get from a person).
summary: The ability to change someone's aura color
strengths: Can change someone's mood (good).
Pretty.
Fool Aura-Readers.
weaknesses: Can sometimes change someone's mood (bad).
Can't be used to otherwise change the aura.

name: Myth Power: Pheme's Feat
description: Pheme (Ossa), in Greek myth, was the goddess of rumor, gossip and fame. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive any rumors that are circulating, as well as the truth behind them. In addition, any gossip one speaks will be taken as truth, and those who hear it will feel compelled to spread it to others, before also forgetting who first told them. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel gossipmongers (those who love to hear and tell gossip).
summary: The ability to channel Pheme's command over the forces of rumor, gossip, fame and reputation
strengths: Perceive any circulating rumors, and the truth behind them
Spread (or stop) any rumor by a word, a touch or a thought
Perceive, communicate with and compel those who love to gossip
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel celebrities until the higher levels
Cannot psychically heighten or reduce popularity (one's own or others') until the higher levels
At the lower levels, powers may work at either too SMALL a range, or too WIDE a range

name: Paradox Knower
description: Ever wonder what would happen if you prevented your grandparents from marrying? Or commit suicide by murdering your past self? With this power, you can know all these paradoxes and more, including things that don't have to do with time but are just paradoxes. With this power, you also get a bonus of knowing the effects of time travel that don't contain paradoxes, i.e. preventing someone from killing your friend may make it so your friend turns evil and takes over the world someday.
summary: The ability to know the effect of paradoxes
strengths: Know the answers to every paradox.
Allows you to think before you act.
Combine this with time travel.
weaknesses: You don't get time travel with this power; you must get it separately.
People may not believe what you're saying and do it anyway.
Leave any other cons in the comment section below!

name: Jump 1: The Superpower List
description: With this power, you can enter a reality where every power on The Superpower List exists in reality. At first, this is useless, as you start off in that reality anyway. However, if you are forced into another reality, you can return at will, as long as this power works.
summary: The ability to enter The Superpower List reality.
strengths: Powers can be acquired if found.
You can return if forced into another universe.
You can bring whatever/whoever you want with you.
weaknesses: Useless unless moved to another reality.
Trapping people there would just empower them over time.
You are not the only superhuman in existence.

name: Dark Powers: Depression
description: You can summon the Depressions, small humanoid monsters that are able to slowly steal the energy of everyone around them and transfer it to you. They are very fast, but cannot walk like a normal person: they walk crouching, like monkeys. They are mindless but follow all your orders without question. Very useful as soldiers, since they are always many and they have claws that are more dangerous than any sword. This power turns you evil.
summary: The ability to summon humanoid creatures that absorb the energy of everyone around them and redirect it to you.
strengths: You have an army of loyal minions that follow all your orders.
The Depressions will slowly restore your energy, if there is at least one person nearby them.
weaknesses: The Depressions are ALWAYS absorbing the energy of people around them, so you might hurt your allies
Just like all abilities from the DarkPower kind, this power turns you evil and addicted to using it

name: Rise Of The Robot Scorpion
description: With this power, you can turn into a giant robot scorpion. In scorpion form, you have a massive arsenal consisting of lasers, plasma cannons which can be used through your tail and giant claws that can be used to grab things. You can also fly and burrow under the ground.
summary: The ability to turn into a giant robotic scorpion.
strengths: You can turn into a giant scorpion.
You have lots of weapons.
You can fly and burrow under ground.
weaknesses: You are not very fast.

name: Black Beetle Scarab
description: The user with the black beetle scarab is able to form a black beetle armor around his or her body. The black beetle armor is symbiotic in nature, and it will help the user in times of need. The black beetle armor host a huge array of defenses and weapons. Besides that, the black beetle armor is totally invulnerable to every form of fire. The armor has only limited invulnerability to physical attacks
summary: The ability to have a black beetle armor form around the user with the use of the scarab
strengths: The symbiotic nature of the armor helps the user in times of need
Invulnerable to all types of fire
Has a huge arsenal of weapons as well as defenses
weaknesses: When they symbiote takes over, the user forgets what he or she does during that time.
Not invulnerable to physical strikes, only limited

name: Wing Arms
description: When you think of winged people, you naturally assume the wings are attached to their backs, right? People with this genetic alteration have wings attached to their arms instead. They do retract, with one extra section folding down into a groove in the forearm.
summary: The ability to have wings that are attached to your arms
strengths: You can fly.
The wings are retractable.
weaknesses: X-rays (people freaking out about the extra bone in your arm).
You can't carry stuff with your arms while you're flying.

name: For Ages Three And Up
description: Recreate any object from a child show or comedy.
summary: The ability to recreate objects from shows rated Kids and/or a comedy.
strengths: Some are helpful.
weaknesses: No Violence, Teen shows objects can be recreated with this power.

name: Innocence Weapons
description: With this ability you can summon any of the innocence weapons from the show D. Grayman. Upon summoning you will have all the knowledge and skill required to use the weapon. The weapons can only be used for good purposes and will not work for those who are evil. Demons defeated by the weapons will be purified. Can only use one of the Innocence Weapons at a time.
summary: The ability to summon and use exorcist weapons from D. Grayman
strengths: Many different exorcist weapons.
Very strong for those who are good and going against evil.
You automatically know how to use the Innocence weapon upon summoning.
weaknesses: Can only use one at a time
Does not work for those that are evil
Can only use ones from the show.

name: Balls Of Fire
description: Imagine balls.  Now, imagine balls of fire.  That's what you bring to the table.  Kick ass at any sport, as long as there's some kind of ball involved.  Make Tiger Woods look like a kitten.  Make Michael Jordan feel like a midget.  With that dirty mind of yours, you may even be thinking of less-than-PG uses for this ability.  Hey, anything goes as long as it's a sport and it involves balls, you dirty minded bastard.  Great balls of fire!
summary: The ability to be amazing at any sport involving a ball (or balls).
strengths: Kick ass any most sports
Eventually, you'll find a way to turn the horizontal tango into a sport
Never warm the benches
weaknesses: Your main weakness is badminton

name: Destino
description: Destino is a spanish translation for destiny. You can use the trident to shoot black shells with the right tine, light-filled javelins with the left and an energy blast of devastating force with the middle one.
summary: The ability to summon a trident that shoots mystical force.
strengths: Destino is capable of destroying anything that is sinful.
weaknesses: Can be stolen
You're not immune to the damage (collateral, recoil, damage of a reflected attack
Middle tine is not useful against someone/thing that isn't sinful

name: Myth Power: Olympus Invocation
description: Mount Olympus, in Greek myth, was the abode of the Olympian Pantheon (the assembly of twelve of the most powerful and influential gods). As such, channeling it allows one to perceive whenever a meeting is being held (or going to be held) among the Olympian Council. In addition, one can psychically attune his consciousness to the meetings, and listen in on them, at will. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive and communicate with those with MythPowers based on the Twelve Olympians, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the splendor of Mount Olympus, the abode of the twelve Olympians
strengths: Perceive when a meeting of the Olympian Council will be held (or is being held)
Be an oracle, able to foretell disasters, heroic feats, daring adventures and the fate of the world
Recognize (and psychically communicate with) those who have MythPowers based on the Twelve Olympians
weaknesses: Doesn't make Olympian MythPower users automatically respect or like you
Cannot be used to travel TO the peak of Mount Olympus (NCN)
Cannot be used to perceive the thoughts of the ACTUAL Olympians (NCN)

name: Zero's Scroll: Dark Light
description: Dark Light is considered light, but it is pure black. Using this you can create a light made of darkness. Because this combines to conflicting elements, light and dark, it is extremely volatile. Instead of exploding, it implodes. When use on someone it will be absorbed into the targets body, and the said body will implode on itself.
summary: The ability to use Dark Light.
strengths: Create black light.
Great for offense.
weaknesses: Hard to control.
Very... Very volatile and unstable.

name: Opposite Stimuli Effect
description: There are many types of stimuli in the world, like the most common stimulus, gravity. With this ability, instead of being grounded by gravity, you'll float, and with training, you'll fly. Now let's say the stimulus was aimed directly at you, like a heat ray. Well, you'll feel cold and, if it keeps up, the effects will neutralize each other.
summary: The ability to react to a stimulus in an opposite way.
strengths: Able to fly.
Able to neutralize stimuli if it is directed at you.
weaknesses: If not trained, things that you want to feel will feel different to you.

name: Enhancement: Speed
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power work at a rate 3. 5 times faster than normal. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to use a power faster than it's normal limits
strengths: Using a power when your opponent thought you were still in the recharge or cooldown phase.
Great for a surprise attack with powers that have longer recharge or cooldown rates.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Will not affect powers that are unaffected by alterations or that cannot have their speed changed.
Trying to calculate out the speed rate for recharge or cooldown rates.

name: Serpent Supreme
description: With this power you can turn into a giant man eating snake whenever you want. In giant man eating snake form you are the size of an elephant and have green, nearly impenetrable skin. You have a long red forked tongue and two rows of sharp teeth. The only thing you can eat in this form is other humans; if you eat anything else, you die.
summary: The ability to turn into a giant man eating snake
strengths: You can turn into a powerful giant man eating snake
You have nearly impenetrable skin and two rows of super sharp teeth
weaknesses: All you can eat in snake mode is other humans
You have not arms or legs

name: Whistle Point
description: With this power, you can make people start whistling uncontrollably whenever you point at them. They don't even have to know how to whistle, though, after you use this power on them, they will remember how to do it later. This is useful if people are saying bad things about you, you can simply point at them and they will start to whistle instead.
summary: The ability to make people whistle when you point at them
strengths: You can make people start whistling when you point at them.
Once you use it on somebody they know how to whistle permanently.
weaknesses: You have to keep pointing at them or they'll stop whistling.

name: Eosinophil Granulocyte Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). When you encounter a large foe (who can't be absorbed by Leukocyte Mimics), you enter combat mode. In this mode, you can release a corrosive gas. It can be used to dissolve foes to break them down and make them easier to absorb. You can also use it to crack walls to allow Leukocyte Mimics to come. Once you've released too much gas, you die. You also have protection against parasites.
summary: The ability to release a corrosive gas when faced with a large foe, one who can't be absorbed.
strengths: You can break down large foes to be absorbed by Leukocyte Mimics with eating powers.
You can form cracks on walls to create passages for Leukocyte Mimics (they have an elastic body).
This power gives you immunity against parasites
weaknesses: When you've released a lot of gas, you die.
The corrosive gas does not distinguish between friends and foes, so your friends can be affected.

name: Death By Future
description: Also known as Undead Doppelganger, the person with this ability can summon the dead souls of anybody in order to kill the person that they are the dead form of. So, for example, if I summoned the dead soul of Superman, then a ghastly figure with all the powers of Superman will appear to kill him. Also, the doppelganger is already dead, so it can't be killed normally. It requires knowledge of magic in order to kill it/restrain it. The dead form also knows everything the person knows constantly.
summary: The ability to summon dead souls from the future to kill their present forms
strengths: The dead souls know all of the present form's strengths and weaknesses
Make people technically kill themselves
The dead souls will definitely not switch sides and their only purpose is to kill themselves
weaknesses: It's cruel to make people kill themselves and this power takes time to cast
If the person is immortal (still they have an immortal enemy though)
Can be countered using magic

name: Cannon Arm
description:
Instead of two arms, how about a cannon and an arm.
You can shoot deadly energy blasts from the cannon without needing to reload. It is similar to a technological and biological fusion. However like all technology you need to make sure your cannon is charged.
summary: The ability to have a cannon on one arm and shoot deadly blasts from the cannon.
strengths: No need for reloading your cannon
Cannon won't fire instantaneously.
weaknesses: Have to make sure the cannon is charged. (Like charging your phone).

name: Last Obtained
description: This power increases the power of the last power you obtained allowing you to do things that you could not normally do. The increase in power only lasts 24 hours at which point you need to obtain a new power. If this is your last power or your last power is lost or stolen then the last power that is usable to you is amplified for the remaining time.
summary: The ability to increase the power of the last power you obtained.
strengths: Have increased power with new abilities.
Will not have to worry about training as much when first obtaining powers.
If you lose your last power then the last usable power is amplified.
weaknesses: If this is only power you have.
Will only last 24 hours per power

name: Holy Power: Bloody Spirit
description: Using the Reaper Scythe, you can summon a Bloody Spirit, a powerful Spirit made of many condemned souls and forged with rage in the deeps of hell. This Spirit will follow all your orders because he has no main mind, and the more souls he is made of, the more powerful he is. The Bloody Spirit has the power of Telekinesis, Intangibility, Super Strength, Flight and a little Darkness Control. Using this power might cause damage to your own soul. Bloody Spirit can be exorcised.
summary: The ability to summon a powerful spirit, made of many condemned souls and forged with rage with the Reaper Scythe.
strengths: Really powerful, one of the strongest of the HolyPowers.
The Bloody Spirit is nearly invincible.
Bloody Spirit follow all your orders.
weaknesses: Wastes so much energy that your soul is damaged.
Although its really hard to do this, the Bloody Spirit can be defeated.

name: Think Room Temperature
description: With this power you can make things that are either too hot or too cold, room temperature
summary: The ability to make things room temperature
strengths: Make weather nice and mild
Make enemies have to eat room-temperature food
People ever throw boiling water at you 'cause you can't sing? Now it's only lukewarm
weaknesses: Devastating Environmental Effects
KILL PEOPLE by making their body room temperature (about 70 degrees Fahrenheit)

name: Pokemon Trainer
description: Tired of playing pokemon for hours while constantly watching the girls next door, yelling at the t.v saying ''WHY CANT I BE HUGH!?'' Well, with this power you can have an army of pokemon at your disposal
summary: The ability to actually have any pokemon ever created in one pokeball
strengths: You dont have to fight
If one pokemon fails try another
Be the envy of all pokenerds
weaknesses: Can only have one pokemon at one time

name: Bodily Malfunctions
description: This power makes a person lose their bodily functions, meaning they crap & piss themselves til you leave. You secrete & release an aerial chemical pheromone that attacks anyone else's neural inhibitor that controls their bodily functions, making them urinate & defecate uncontrollably.
summary: The ability to induce loss of bodily functions in a person
strengths: Can be used as a distraction/escape power, making people go #1 & 2
weaknesses: It's a toilet joke superpower
The mess

name: Flower Walk
description: With every step you take flowers or plants grow in your footsteps. You can control which plant or flower grows if you concentrate but if you don't concentrate the flower will just depend on you mood or thoughts.
summary: The ability to create flowers or plants wherever you walk.
strengths: You hungry? Just concentrate on a fruit or vegetable and walk.
Plants and flowers grow instantly.
The plants and flowers survive and grow in any weather or condition.
weaknesses: Can't make up plants; they have to be real.
Looks kind of strange when flowers grow out of the sidewalk.

name: Arcana: 9 The Hermit
description: This ability allows you to form imperceptible (Invisible, Intangible, etc) thought-forms from your own mental energies. These thought-forms have the exact same senses as you do and can float speedily through the air to wherever you send them. However, these thought-forms can only obey simple orders and will dissipate once they use up all of the energy you gave them. They are unable to physically affect anything around them and can only relay information to you by merging with your mind again.
summary: The ability to send out thought-forms to collect information.
strengths: Allows you to keep track of important people, items, or places.
Offers some of the benefits of astral projection without many of the risks.
With efficient use of energy, you can have a virtual army of invisible spys.
weaknesses: Thought-forms have no intelligence to speak of and blindly follow only simple orders.
They can be detected and destroyed by psychic means.
Unless they return to you, you gain no information.

name: Sibling Power
description: You and your siblings possess super strength, super speed, invulnerability, healing and flight, as well as an invisible aura. When you are in a sibling's aura's range, your power's increase in ratio to your proximity. When standing next to your sibling you can withstand a nuclear blast and lift mountains, but if you are a mile away you are barely superhuman. At all times you have a telepathic connection with siblings, which either of you can block at will.
summary: The ability to have strengthened shared powers when near a sibling
strengths: When nearby you and your siblings have phenomenal power
Could be a great crimefighting duo
Playing ball games while flying would be cool
weaknesses: Have to be near your sibling to use your powers
If you hate your sibling, then superpowers will only worsen the situation
If a sibling dies, you must be near their body or ashes to use your powers

name: The Power Of Flowers
description: You can generate flowers (types of flowers may vary) that have a calming, pacifying effect on others. Some affected individuals may also become more affectionate and tolerant of others. The effects generally last an hour on average. The power may manifest in two ways: 1) a spray of flowers from the hands or 2) rapidly growing a bed of flowers under the target.
summary: The ability to generate flowers that calm and pacify others
strengths: A non-lethal, non-violent ability
Good for calming rioting individuals or crowds
weaknesses: Allergies
You may be called a hippie

name: Battle Leather
description: You can grow a durable hide, as hard as steel, as light as silk, and it can be shed at will. The leather doesn't disappear once shed, either--it can be crafted into other armor or objects.
summary: The ability to grow a durable hide
strengths: Light, easy to use defence
Items can be crafted from the shed hide
You can grow it on other people if you are touching them
weaknesses: Hide takes up nutrients fron your body
Enemies finding and using the hide against you

name: Shapeshift: Kitten
description: Who hasn't wanted to change into a fuzzy little thing at some point in their lives? Well, now you can.
summary: The ability to transform into an adorable little kitten
strengths: If you're a guy, you know what girls do with little kittens, right? Right? =]
You still think like yourself when in kitten form.
Legally get high on catnip.
weaknesses: You can't really fight. At all.
You can't speak with your kitten mouth either.
Heaven help you if the animal pound catches you.

name: War Zone
description: Creates a zone that causes war and fighting to be more likely to happen and intensifies them. People in the zone become more agitated to the point where they go insane with rage if inside the zone to long. People become stronger the longer the field is in place and aspects of the environment become more dangerous. Healing affects also weaken over time. Effects are quickly removed if the zone is left.
summary: The ability to create a zone that intensifies fighting.
strengths: Cause a fight when you need one.
Put on an enemy camp and destroy them from within.
Good to use against opponents that rely on their brains.
weaknesses: May go into a rage yourself.
If you start a war and are on losing side.
Has no use except to start fights.

name: Holy Power: Redemption
description: With this ability, when you defeat someone, you can chose if your defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell. If this person is "forgiven", she will be sent to Heaven. If this person is "punished", she will be sent to Hell. This ability also allows you to use other Holy Powers. This power is Hero only.
summary: The ability to chose if a defeated enemy deserves heaven or hell, and allows you to use other Holy Powers.
strengths: You can chose if our enemy deserves forgiveness or punishment.
Makes you able to learn all Holy Powers.
weaknesses: You need to be a good person to be able to use this power.

name: Orbis Sensualium Pictus
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a book appears that can give you detailed information about anything supernatural (magic, demons, angels, etc. ).
summary: The ability to look up any information about the supernatural.
strengths: Comes with a broom that can be used for magic and flying.
weaknesses: Information is constantly being updated so something might get deleted.
Searching for the exact information you want may take a while.

name: Keep Moving Or Else
description: This power allows you to put a curse on anybody which causes them to die if they stop moving. You cannot remove the curse from the person and you can curse as many people as you want.
summary: The ability to cause people to die if they stop moving
strengths: You can cause people to die if they stop moving
You can curse as many people as you want
weaknesses: You cannot remove the curse

name: Soul Re Creator
description: You can turn a soul into a body, equal or less than the souls old body's weight, their body/soul slowly grows back, for someone small, less than 2 months, for a heavier person, a little longer than 4 years.
summary: The ability to turn souls into bodies while their soul slowly grows back.
strengths: For giving them back their bodies they are loyal to you.
weaknesses: How likely is it you will find a wandering soul?
It takes a while to grow back their body from their soul.

name: Bottleneck Effect
description: With this ability, you can decrease the dimension of an opening or a conduit which is made to allow passage for a fluid or through which a fluid is currently flowing. This includes biological openings and conduits, like the veins, the trachea, the mouth, and such. You cannot decrease it completely as fluid must still be allowed to flow if it's possible. So, you cannot close it. This power requires active concentration to maintain the effect.
summary: The ability to limit the flow of fluids through an opening or a conduit.
strengths: Limit container leaks.
Strangle your enemies from a distance.
Fluids include liquids and gas.
weaknesses: Cannot close the opening or conduit completely.
Requires active concentration.

name: Panontic Arch:Thend
description: Thend, the home of the sharke. You have no 24-hour limit on the use of panontic arch powers. Anything you can touch you can choose to age 100 billion years in a second -- just like sharke do when one bites something or someone.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Thend dimension.
strengths: A deadly time power.
No time limit on panontic arch powers.
weaknesses: Some things literally last forever.

name: Superhuman Insanity
description: Joker, Hannibal Lector, and all mad scientists all have this trademark ability. They cannot be convinced  or dissuaded by ordinary means and can always come up with a convoluted scheme.This power also renders the user immune to fear based power-they are so insane that nothing scares them.
summary: The ability to be so insane that it serves as an advantage
strengths: You are not afraid of anything
You can come up with things that no rational person would have considered
You are immune to mind control
weaknesses: Sanity has its advantages--social interaction, etc.
You will be placed in the mental ward or isolate yourself from society

name: Pull/Push
description: With this power you cause the commands for pull and push to be reversed in a person's mind. When they want to pull something they will push it and when they want to push something they will pull it. This can be useful if someone is trying to take something away from you you can cause them to actually push it towards you. Or if someone is trying to push something hazardous towards you can make them pull it towards them. It works on telekinesis and robots as well.
summary: The ability to make people pull things when they want to push them and vice versa
strengths: You can make people push things when they try to pull them and vice versa
You can really screw with someone when they try to open a door
weaknesses: Your enemy can figure out what you're trying to do and simply do the opposite action

description: With this ability, you get to become James Bond. Packaged with this ability, you get a license to kill and cool gadgets, like a laser pen or jet-propelled pants. You talk with a very cool British (or Scottish) accent and get all the fine honeys who hear your voice. Anything James Bond has done in movies or books, you are able to do it as well.
summary: The ability to become the greatest MI6 agent ever
strengths: British or Scottish accent!
Wicked gadgets to help out with fights or escapes
You see a girl you want to bed? Well, now you can have her!
weaknesses: Too arrogant at times.
Always get captured the first time going against a master villian
Can sometimes depend on gadgets too much

name: Beatlemania
description: Women and girls will flock to you as if you were the most attractive, talented person on Earth. They will scream and follow you everywhere you go. If you happen to have a British accent or a musical talent, the power becomes even more effective.
summary: The ability to make women and girls do whatever you wish (if you don't mind screaming).
strengths: These women would die for you. They'll do almost anything you ask of them.
It's a great confidence booster!
weaknesses: Females can get very hostile. Really, be forewarned.
You have virtually no privacy. Even while at home, they'll be outside waiting for you.
Your hand may cramp from the amount of autographs you'll have to sign.

name: Omnizord
description: The Omnizord is the combination of the ten mythical zords: salamander, serpent, mandragora, golem, chickidemon, manticore, griffin, thunderbird, unicorn, and a black dog. This combination would be the first to demonstrate a rare ability, that of transformation within its combined state. The first stage of combination of the Omnizord was a tank-like vehicle, then after forming the tank mode, you and nine others could initiate transformation into the Omnizord's battle mode.
summary: The ability to summon ten mythical creatures to combine them into the complete ultimate weapon.
strengths: Can use it to fight very large evildoers.
weaknesses: It can only work when you have 9 friends with you while summoning them.

name: Hollywoodoo
description: You always have the superpowers of the hero who is starred in the latest Hollywood blockbuster. If they release another Spiderman-sequel, you get Spiderman's abilities, if they release Wolverine 2, you will be immortal and unbreakable, and so on.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of the hero starred in the latest American superhero-movie.
strengths: New combination of powers about every month!
weaknesses: Pray that they won't release Hancock 2.

name: Power Separator
description: With this power, you can separate your own powers. For example, a power to create and manipulate water could be separated into a power to create water and a power to manipulate water.
summary: The ability to separate powers.
strengths: Nothing, it gives you the same power except as smaller powers.
weaknesses: Doesn't help you.

name: Critter Instinct
description: Your body is sort of like the animal you most resemble and you have all the same mannerisms. You don't turn into the animal, but you have the same instincts.
summary: The ability to be like an animal
strengths: If you're like a wolf, your vocal chords allow you to do a pretty wicked creepy howl.
Cat people can have night vision
weaknesses: It's uncontrollable: you never know which instinctive behavior is going to pop up next.
Froglike people inherit the amphibian's preferred diet...

name: Exploder
description: No one will ever want to hit you. You will explode with any concussive trauma & subsequently reintegrate anywhere you want within the blast zone. Ram into structures, vehicles, whatever. Here's a personal favorite: jump off a building and see what kind of crater you'll make.
summary: The ability to explode when you are hit
strengths: Hits, punches will cause a small reactive explosion roughly 5 times the force of the hit
Large hits, hit by moving vehicles or hit by the superstrong causes exponentially massive explosions
Explode and reintegrate wherever you want within the blast zone
weaknesses: No more pats on the back, high-fives or the like. Slicing and energy weapons pose a threat
Accidentally bumping into things, tripping and walking through crowds are precarious adventures
When you reintegrate you are buck-naked to the world & slightly disoriented
tags: blowing up like you thought i would

name: Carbonylkinesis
description: Carbon monoxide is a colourless, odourless, and tasteless gas that can be lethal when inhaled. The gas can affect the user, but being able to control it they can keep it away from themselves.
summary: The ability to manipulate carbon monoxide.
strengths: Can speed up the process, force the gas into the victims blood.
It can't be detected by the victim, but the user can see it in a different colour.
The death can appear to be accidental.
weaknesses: The user must be very careful not to use it in a confined space, or inhale it.
It is harder to control, the more people the user is effecting.
It cannot be created nor destroyed, so it has to be gathered from the environment.

name: Perfect Zombie
description: A person with this power can revive as a zombie. But not just any type of zombie. You get to retain your intelligence and sentience as a human and you do not need to eat brains or do any sort of ritual. You just revive with increased strength lack of pain receptors and unlimited stamina with no need to sleep. Also you don't rot either. You can move as fast at I am Legend Zombies. However you can still be "killed" by a headshot or be burned to death.
summary: The ability to revive as a zombie with your sanity intact and you do not need to eat brains
strengths: All the normal zombie powers like unlimited stamina, can't get killed by normal wounds
Don't have to eat brains and you don't rot over time and you don't smell either
Retains brain power---as in you can still think like a normal person
weaknesses: You are already dead and your skin is pale
Can still be burned or shot in the head
No regenerative factor---your cells are dead--so you need to sew up your body the hard way

name: Axe Of Pine
description: When the holidays are coming near you want to fight your enemies in a fitting theme. With this ability anything wooden in your hands can be turned into a 7-foot long Christmas-tree-shaped axe capable of chopping enemies to bits. Also, you don't need super strength to use this weapon, but anyone else trying to use your axe WILL (it'll be extremely heavy to them). Note: Around Christmas your tree-axe is decorated.  (delete the following: This is not meant as a joke. )
summary: The ability to summon a huge pine tree shaped like a rasor sharp axe.
strengths: This axe is just as strong as any other axe.
No need to drag heavy objects with you.
It's flammable, so you can wield a flaming axe
weaknesses: Avoid using it on a necessary item (can't be reversed)
When lighting the tree-axe on fire, might burn your hands

description: Also called the Cypher Effect, or the Nonentity Effect, one with this power can reduce nearly anything in all of existence to zero. When matter is reduced to 0, it is shifted into a metaphysical plane of existence in which matter is only imagination. It can have no effect on the real world, other than being seen by those with this ability, and those with ESP. Matter affected by this power cannot be otherwise affected at all (even by the user) until shifted back into existence.
summary: The ability to reduce nearly anything to 0
strengths: Makes all physical and energy attacks ineffective
Protect fragile objects and valuables; release affected things at will or keep them cyphered forever
Living things don't to eat, drink, sleep, breathe, etc while cyphered
weaknesses: Can't cypher intangible concepts (emotions, imagination, thought, etc. ); psychic attacks still work
Injury, age, hunger, thirst and other bodily process only cyphered when the SUBJECT is cyphered
Cannot cypher self (to escape age, harm or bodily needs) until the higer levels (no Con Negation)

name: Myth Power: Priapus' Pride
description: Priapus (Priapos), in Greek myth, was the god of vegetable gardens and the fertility of animals associated with agriculture. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate vegetables, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats and bees at will. Furthermore, one gains physical power from eating vegetables and other garden-grown produce. Power use may cause involuntary erections.
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' command over the essence of vegetable gardens and fertility
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate plants that yield vegetables
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command sheep, goats, bees and other garden animals
Enhanced stats from eating vegetables; immune to MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia
weaknesses: Cannot root subjects to the ground (sprouting various vegetables) by touch until the higher levels
People with MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability
People with plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Delete This Rapid Eruption
description: You will strike and break the bones of your opponents several times then end it with lifting them up with a powerful uppercut kick that'll send them flying far upwards.
summary: The ability to do multiple powerful kicks to the opponent that sends him/her flying.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: None.

name: Holy Power: Seismic Wave
description: With this power you can divide the land with your Reaper Scythe and shoot the seismic energy of a level 9 earthquake against your target, shattering his bones and destroying everything around him. This attack is very powerful, but slow and dangerous.
summary: The ability to divide the land with the Reaper Scythe, shooting the energy of a level 9 earthquake on your enemy.
strengths: Cause massive destruction.
This power has a great field of range.
Even if you miss, the attack will probably destroy the ground under your enemy and overwhelm him.
weaknesses: This power is slow and dangerous.
Only Reapers can use this power.

name: Thematic Power Boosting
description: The rules. You must actually have acquired the powers. You can only one thematic power boost at a time. A multi-theme power only gives one theme but of your choice. As long as you have one power in a group that can be boosted it doesn't matter if the others can't be. 1 out of 10 powers becomes 10 times more effective. A theme can subject(time,fire,telekinesis,etc) or the name of a power series(i. E. Mythpowers). It can't be both.
summary: The ability to boost the effectiveness of a group of powers related by theme.
strengths: If all your powers are the same theme or mostly the same theme.
If all or most of your powers can be boosted.
weaknesses: None of your powers are theme related.
