All your powers are from mimicry or theft.

name: Organization
description: To be organized you can find a folder,find pencils,etc.  While you are organized, it doesn't exactly mean you are neat.
summary: The ability to be organized.
strengths: Organized.
weaknesses: Doesn't exactly mean you are neat.

name: Bladed Whip Tail
description: The tail is 1 metre long and 2-5 centimetres thick dependant on where it is measured. The tail can be controlled at will as it is a part of your body. The bladed end is as sharp as a 4-body katana and if it is cut off will take 3(blade only)-4(whole tail) days to grow back. The look and composition of the tail and blade vary for each being with this power.
summary: The ability to have a tail that can act like a whip with a blade on its end
strengths: Weapon that can protect you whenever you need it.
weaknesses: Really hard to hide.
Can't lengthen the tail so that it can hit long-ranged enemies.

name: Synoviocyte Mimicry
description: By consuming sugar, you can produce and secrete a substance which, when mixed with water, gives it various properties depending on pressure. Under normal pressure, the affected water acts like a lubricant. Under high pressure, it becomes very viscous, being able to absorb shock. Under negative pressure, gases which were dissolved are released as bubbles, which produce high-frequency cracking sounds by collapsing when the pressure returns to normal. Otherwise, you can also undergo mitosis.
summary: The ability to give water the property to become more viscous when subjected to pressure, among other properties.
strengths: Duplicate yourself to outnumber your enemies.
Make puddles of water very slippery.
Affected bodies of water become harder to swim in the more you move.
weaknesses: Bellyflopping into a suddenly viscous liquid is very harmful, sometimes deadly.
It takes time for a big body of water to be entirely affected by your power.

name: Planet Hopper
description: Might suffocate into a unstable planet, stars, blackholes, you never know
summary: The ability to look at any picture of planets and teleport there with a thought
strengths: If Earth is destroyed, Mars is within 1 second away
Can take multiple people at once
Too fun
weaknesses: Teleport into a blackhole
Burn by a planet that's too close to a Star
Teleport onto a inhabitable planet, not having. Oxygen etc..
tags: basically but your not a planet devour

name: Weapon Control:Armored Assault
description: This weapon control grants the ability to create an armored detachment out of nothing. The type and ammount depends on knowledge of what you are doing(someone with expeirience or military knowledge as opposed to a total noob) and training.
summary: The ability to summon an Armored group to aid in combat
strengths: Can create armored onslaughts
Good combo with other WC powers
weaknesses: You must have seen what you are making
May not always work
Crew comes seperately

name: Miracle: Cross Bear
description:
With this power people that hit you will lose their willpower to hurt you the more that they hit you. 

The more willpower/hatred a person puts into a punch the more drained of willpower the other person will be.
summary: The ability to take away someone's willpower when they hit you
strengths: No one wants to ever finish you off, unless they do so in one hit
You can hit back when the other person has no more willpower
If you are a masochist then you will get over the main con of this power
weaknesses: You still get hit and it will hurt
Will only work on the thing inflicting the pain-does not target the puppetmaster

name: Blades Of Pain
description: Basically, anytime one gets a wound it turns into a scar from which one can create a shadowy blade. The size of the blade depends on the size of the scar. However, one can still die from a losing their heart or being beheaded. This power can only be gained in one way: by being cut 10000 times in one day and surviving throughout all of the cuts.
summary: The ability to create dark blades from one's scars
strengths: Really powerful if used correctly.
Not truly immortality, but close enough.
weaknesses: Extremely dangerous to try to gain.
People will be scared of the one with this power.
You'll end up with lots of scars with this power.

name: Zigzagging Projectile
description: Whenever you throw something while having this power activated, the projectile will adopt a totally random and ever-changing zigzagging trajectory, effectively convering more space than a normal trajectory, while still moving at the same speed and in the direction it was thrown. Since it's unpredictable, it's very difficult to dodge -- it's very difficult to aim precisely too!
summary: The ability to cause things you throw to have a random zigzagging trajectory.
strengths: Covers more space than a normal trajectory and therefore has a higher chance of hitting the target.
Very difficult to predict and to dodge.
You're a nightmare if you have a machine-gun
weaknesses: The smaller the target, the more difficult it is to aim precisely and hit with this power.

name: Myth Power: Laelaps' Pursuit
description: Laelaps (Lailaps), in Greek myth, was a magical dog who was fated always catch any pursued target, regardless of their speed. As such, channeling him allows one to move with speed that adapts to outdo any any subject that one pursues; likewise, one's reflexes, friction/wind resistance, etc adapt to handle changes in speed. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs at will. One can even turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will.
summary: The ability to channel the superhuman chasing prowess of the mythical dog Laelaps
strengths: Adapt speed, reflexes and wind/friction resistance to catch any target
Psychically perceive, communicate with and command dogs
Turn into any breed of dog, or mimic the abilities of a dog at will
weaknesses: Every hear of the tale of Laelaps and the Teumessian Fox? Look it up.
Speed/athletics/competition-based MythPowers provide immunity
MythPower: Artemis' Gift and other animal-based MythPowers (may provide immunity and/or control)

name: Myo Virus
description: With this ability, you can infect people, plants, and animals with the Myo Virus. This causes them to grow, and become stronger until the user de-activates the Virus at will. Life forms with this Virus become increasingly aggressive the longer this virus festers. A life form can grow to a height of 1,000 feet before its heart stops, or dies. Once deactivated, they return to normal size and strength.
summary: The ability to infect life forms with a virus that makes them grow and become stronger the longer it festers.
strengths: Infect people, plants, animals, or yourself with this virus.
As the subject becomes larger, they will become stronger.
Can increase or decrease the speed of the Virus' effect.
weaknesses: Once the target exceeds 1000 feet, their heart fails, or they die.
Targets become increasingly aggressive as the Virus festers.
You can't deactivate the Virus unless you can see the infected target.

name: Snap You're An Animal
description: With this power, you can turn anybody into any animal by snapping, saying their name and the desired animal. For instance, "John Doe, Elephant". The person will then turn into the desired animal but is not under your control. You can turn the person back by snapping and reversing the phrase you said earlier. From the previous example, "Elephant, John Doe". All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
summary: The ability to turn people into animals
strengths: You can turn anybody into an animal.
All damages sustained in animal mode transfer over to human mode.
weaknesses: The animal is not under your control
If you do not know how to snap or are mute, this power is useless

name: Enhancement: Multi Planar
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows the power to spread out its effects over multiple planes of existence. This in turn also decreases the level of power on any one plane of power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to allow a power to spread out its effects over multiple planes of existence
strengths: Now you can hit those pesky enemies who are on a different plane of existence.
Affects all planes of existence at the same time.
weaknesses: Usseless without another power.
Effects are spread out evenly in all the planes.

name: Relative Alteration
description: This is the power to change or replace negative or positive energies. With it, you could control gravity by increasing or decreasing it. You can also replace positive space with negative space (AKA teleporting). You can also switch something's attributes with its opposite, like switching fire and water to make fire wet and water burn. You can only change what you touch though, or the area around you with things like gravity.
summary: The ability to alter or replace negative and positive energy.
strengths: Not a very specific power so you can do a bunch of things with it
Can do almost whatever you can imagine.
Changing something can be permanent
weaknesses: You need contact with whatever you are altering/replacing
Changing something can be permanent

name: Variables
description: This ability allows you to view and modify the variables - the invisible properties that define how an object exists in the universe - of anything. The possibilities are endless. Modify the AGE variable to change the age of an object or the COLOUR variable to change its colour. You can also change your own variables. If you are ill, increase your HEALTH variable, or if you need some extra strength, increase your STRENGTH variable.
summary: The ability to modify the variables of objects.
strengths: You can be immortal by manipulating your AGE variable.
You can increase your SKILL variable to increase your skill in other activities.
You can increase your intelligence, strength, speed - anything really.
weaknesses: Overuse of this power will tire you without the proper training.
Changing variables you do not understand can have terrible consequences.
Changing the wrong variable could kill you.

name: Mind Blower
description: Tired of people not listening to you? Is your voice lost in the sea of opinions and ramblings of your friends and acquaintences? Do people not take you seriously? A Mind Blower has all of these issues handled with ease. Everything you say will be seen as deeply profound and insightful. You will capture the attention of anyone and everyone within earshot, and they will be eager to listen to you. Even casually saying "let's blow this popsicle stand" will arouse deep fascination and interest.
summary: The ability to cause others to think everything you say is profound
strengths: Never be ignored or seen as boring
Captivate audiences, friends, family
Gain respect and admiration
weaknesses: You cannot shut this power off. It's active at all times.
Goofing around will still be seen as profound

name: Beauty Stealing
description: With this power you can become attractive by simply touching the person that you envy because of their beauty. By doing this you will replace your appearance with theirs and their appearance with yours.
summary: The ability to steal the beauty of another human
strengths: Improving your appearance
Feeling good about yourself
Making the person you envy suffer from your appearance
weaknesses: It is not your true beauty
People will know about the switch in appearances
More of a villian's power rather than a hero's power

name: Terrain Moving Man
description: Focus on a terrain feature, at the same time it will shrink and be pulled in into your closed fist. You can put it back where it was or you have an hour to release it somewhere else. You can't move a terrain feature that goes length-wise beyond the horizon of the Earth. You could move a small enough town with this power and anything in it. You take air and climate with the feature you're moving. If someone with immutability was on a mountain you wanted to move, their power would stop this power.
summary: The ability to shrink a terrain feature and relocate it.
strengths: Move small mountains, seas, lakes and good-sized chucks of rainforest.
Less focus and quicker to use than terrain manipulation.
You can hold a shrunk town in your hand. How many powers let you do that?
weaknesses: Can't affect oceans or mountain ranges.
Someone with immutability or a power like immutability.
Radical environmentalists may try and kill you.

name: A Life For A Life
description: If you have this ability, then you can use it to bring a dead person back to life or save the life of someone who's inches away from death ... if you allow someone else to die to replace them.
summary: The ability to give life to a dead or dying person in exchange for someone else's death
strengths: Save people's lives
Bring back the dead
weaknesses: Be responsible for a murder
Can only heal fatally wounded or diseased people

name: Music Of  Sound Soul
description: Play the concerto of your soul on an instrumental manifestation of your powers in order to purge yourself of all ailments and access the perfect form of your abilities while you play it. The instrument does not manifest itself in the physical realm but instead exists only in your mental realm.
summary: The ability to reset yourself to your perfect state.
strengths: Instantly rid yourself of injuries or mind control by resetting yourself.
You do not have to lug the instrument around since it exists inside of your mind.
The song coordinates muscle movements in a fight and ups your reaction time.
weaknesses: If a spirit enters your mind and hijacks the instrument it can take control of and alter your body.
If you play the wrong song or make to many mistakes it could damage your spirit permanently.
Playing the first few notes requires intense concentration and zero movement for a small time.

name: Enhancement: Sealing
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it allows a power to seal things away based on what the power does originally. Ex. Telepathy seals minds, Aerokinesis seals away air, etc. This power can only be attached to one power at a time and can only seal the things away while attached to the power. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to and seals are still working.
summary: The ability to allow a power to seal things away by attaching this power to it
strengths: Seal your enemy's mind into the back of their mind.
Power seals based on original use.
Last sentence is the theft rule (for con 3).
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Power might be useless with sealing or more trouble.
Seals disappear when attached power changes unless this is stolen, then theft rule applies.

name: Hobbit Feet
description: Have feet like a hobbit! You can walk without shoes. Stubbing your toe won't hurt, you can walk around in the snow without getting frostbite or pain, and walk on that hot beach sand. Ever wanted to do that cool coal walk thing? Now you can!
summary: The ability to have feet that aren't affected by anything
strengths: No need to buy shoes. Ever.
Walk in snow without the pain
Walk in hot sand without the burn
weaknesses: You're feet get really hairy
No use in a fight unless the enemy is a bully and breaks your shoes

name: Freeze Blink Forgetter
description: You can freeze someone with only 3 blinks and they forget everything for that day.
summary: The ability to freeze someone with 3 blinks of an eye.
strengths: Keeps you safe
Keeps villains frozen
Can let your enemies forget what you did to them
weaknesses: May freeze someone on accident
May cause your eyes to be cold
Brainfreezes afterwards

name: Moonshine Slash
description: You can launch a wave of sonic energy at your opponent by swinging your leg in mid-air.
summary: The ability to launch an energy wave attack with your leg.
strengths: Never before seen special move.
weaknesses: You could miss.

name: Brownian Motion Manipulation
description: A person with this power has the ability to manipulate small particles suspended in a liquid or gas. In effect the user can manipulate any particle by controlling the kinetic heat around the particles. This can be used for various effects.
summary: The ability to control the movements of small particles suspended in a liquid or gas
strengths: Move dust across water for fun including spelling out words etc.
Redirect particles in the air for various effects including changing air currents etc.
Particle power users beware this power
weaknesses: Is not impressive unless mastered
Physicists and scientists roll in their graves---This is a joke
This does not work in a vacuum

name: Soul Eating
description: The power gained is equal to the power of the soul eaten. This power allows you to physically grab souls.
summary: The ability to gain power by eating souls
strengths: It doesn't matter whether the souls are good or evil.
weaknesses: If you can only find weak souls.

name: Condition Change: Ownership
description: A power affected by this power will only affect that which its user owns. The power can now only affect their pets, their books, their toys, etc. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only on that which its user owns
strengths: Technopaths can't mess with your computer anymore if you touch them.
Mind readers can't read your mind if they don't own you.
weaknesses: Must touch the person you want to affect with this power.

name: Spawn: Greek Armory
description: You are able to spawn fully stocked Greek Armories.  They will be stocked with Greek weapons, used in their wars and only those weapons, so newer weapons or weapons from a different culture will not be stocked in the armory.  Since the greeks believed in magic and magical items there is a possibility that you may spawn a magical item armory.
summary: The ability to spawn an unlimited amounts of Greek armories.
strengths: A fully stocked armory with weapons, and possibly magical items.
If you train enough you will be able to summon an armory with the gods weapons.
weaknesses: Some items might be cursed...
Since you spawn already created armory's you must do a lot of research of which is the best

name: Magic Talismans
description: Magical items created over the centuries contain numerous powers. Also boosting the magical abilities of the user. Not a power in itself but a better way to strengthen magic abilities.
summary: The ability to use powers implanted into magical artifacts.
strengths: Boost magic attacks.
Increase power with simple possession of the object.
Specialize in a school a magic by having certain items.
weaknesses: Objects are not unbreakable.
If you lose them your power will drop.
Too many can cause someone to "overload".

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Wrath
description: By gaining the abilities of Wrath, you would gain almost perfect swordsmanship, rarely making a mistake. You gain increased strength, speed, and agility. You also gain an ultimate eye, able to read, predict and counter any and all situations. The only weakness of the eye is that if there is an obstacle in between the eye and a situation the situation and the eye will read, and predict the situation incorrectly.
summary: The ability to use the abilities of Wrath.
strengths: The ultimate eye
Perfect swordsmanship.

description: The skin of the holder of this power is developed so that it can accommodate from 30 to 40 butterflies inside it. These butterflies are bigger than normal, they have a strength and a high regenerative factor, and can depart for several kilometers from their "nest". When butterflies rest, the skin of the subject seems simply decorated with their wings; when they are active the skin appears normal. The subject can control these butterflies and perceive what's happening around them.
summary: The ability to hold about 40 mutated butterflies in your skin and to have a mental link with them.
strengths: The butterflies are more longevous, more resistant to cold and hunger and more strong than normal;
The subject has a mental link with them and he/she can keep in contact with them at long distances.
weaknesses: The metabolism of butterflies depends on the host organism's one;
No offensive skills.

name: Dark Powers: Schizofrenia
description: With this power you can summon Schizofrenia, a pack of terrible monster wolves. These creatures look like really creepy wolves with stitched mouths. But when they start to show their true form, it's revealed that they are truly demons. When fully transformed, the creatures are able to talk like a really mean person, making their target unable to think, without the wolves hearing them. When the enemy is unable to resist, they kill him slowly. This power naturally turns you evil.
summary: The ability to summon wolf like creatures that drive your enemies crazy before killing them.
strengths: You can kill someone in a terrible way.
You can fully control The Pack, and only you and your target can see the Schizofrenia.
The wolves can read the target's mind, and they know how to hurt him/her.
weaknesses: The wolves are not hallucinations, your target can kill them if he is realizes this.
You can summon another wolf if one dies, but killing you would make them all disappear.
This power slowly turns you evil, and you become addicted to using it.

name: Children Of The Moon
description: You are transformed into a werewolf every time the moon is up. You gain your power from the moon and the fuller the moon is, the more wolf you become ... the darker the moon is, the more human you become. Every full moon you turn full wolf, every new moon you don't morph. Your fangs and teeth are sharp and lethal, you are also fast and posses incredible strength.
summary: The ability to transform into a werewolf every time the moon is up
strengths: Transform into a beast or incredible strength each night
Own the forest while hunting for prey
weaknesses: Your screwed if your in the middle of a battle and the moon go's down
There is only one night in a lunar cycle that you get to stay human

name: Myth Power: Prophasis' Plea
description: Prophasis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excuses, apology and pleading forgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to make up nearly any excuse, and those who hear it will believe it. In addition, one can perceive the truth behind the excuses of others and make false excuses (which often pertain to personal misfortune) come true, until the subject apologizes. One with this ability may even withstand compulsions and probability/reality manipulation as long as one has a good excuse.
summary: The ability to channel Prophasis' command over the essence of excuse, apology and asking forgiveness
strengths: Make up any excuse, and subjects will believe it (unless they can see otherwise)
Perceive the truth behind the excuses of others (untrue excuses can be made true)
With a good excuse, withstand compulsions, magic and reality/probability/chance/luck manipulation
weaknesses: ESPECIALLY vulnerable to MythPower: Epimetheus' Idea
People with MythPower: Prometheus' Plan are immune to this ability
People with probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability are immune to this ability

name: Rise Of The Alternate Legends
description: With this power you can turn into alternate or different versions of Legendary Pokemon. You can turn into Primal Dialga, Shadow Lugia, Baby Lugia (aka Silver), Shiny versions of legendaries, the Golden Ho-oh from the first episode of the anime, Green Gem Deoxys and the monster Groudon from Jirachi: Wish Maker. In Pokemon form you retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak.
summary: The ability to turn into alternate forms of Legendary Pokemon
strengths: You can turn into powerful forms
You retain your personality, intelligence and ability to speak
weaknesses: You cannot turn into the normal forms of the Legendaries

name: Groundhog's Day
description: You must live the same day for one week. You have no control over this power. Example: "1" July 1st equals "7" July 1st's You do not age more than the typical day. You cannot die until the 7th day. The 7th day carries over to the next actual day (Example: July 1st 7th day carries over to July 2nd 1st day)
summary: The ability to relive the same day for one week.
strengths: 7 times longer life
Correct mistakes
Avoid death
weaknesses: Miserable day is multiplied by 7
May lose track of days
Possible frustration

name: Myth Power: Effect Of Eos
description: Eos, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the dawn. As such, channeling her allows one to rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day (the current day or any other one desires). One can also psychically perceive and communicate with anyone who is awake at that time, as well as project his sight to anywhere the light of dawn touches. Furthermore, one is gifted with the ability to generate wings for flight, stand on clouds, withstand atmospheric conditions and generate/glide on wind at will.
summary: The ability to channel Eos' command over the essence of the dawn
strengths: Rewind or fast-forward time to the dawn of any day of one's choice
Project sight to anywhere dawn's light touches; perceive and communicate with anyone awake at dawn
Generate/manipulate/glide on winds, stand on clouds, winged flight
weaknesses: Cannot disrupt or repel effects of MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Help from Helios and MythPower: Salute to Selene provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Hyperion's Watch and MythPower: Theia's Light provide immunity (NCN)

name: Time Merge
description: It might sound extremely strange. You can have the ability to combine different decades, like if you want to merge the 1970's, 1980's and 1990's, it'll be a difficult culture clash, but mixing in between the 1960's and the 2000s, it'll be total Heck.
summary: The ability to combine two or three decades.
strengths: Everything and everyone around you might become new.
You can also create an "amalgamation" of two or three timelines you've seen from each decades.
weaknesses: Everything and everyone might become twisted
No one from each timeline will understand each other.

name: Crazy Legs
description: You can dance any dance you want to dance, perfectly as soon as you want to dance it, without breaking a sweat.
summary: The ability to do any dance perfectly.
strengths: Win dance contests.
Show off.
Look awesome at dance parties.
weaknesses: Can't exactly attack anyone with it.
Can't exactly defend yourself with it.

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Tiger
description: You draw upon the power of the Tiger. You can transform into a tiger, talk with tigers, and move around jungles, forests, and the like wihout making a sound in order to kill your target. This does not help with sneak attacks unless they are to kill.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Tiger
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Can move around any normally noisy environment without making a sound in order to kill.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the tiger. 1926, 1938, 1950, 1962, 1974, 1986, 1998, 2010, etc.
More of an assassination power.

name: Vampirism: Empathic
description: Also called Empathic Absorption or Emotion Absorption, this is the ability to absorb energy from emotions (which sometimes relieves people of their emotions), or to simply become stronger in the presence of intense emotion; sometimes, the user become stronger only in the presence of a certain emotion, such as love or doubt, or anger, or bravery, or the like (as such, this power is especially effective on empaths and others who give off powerful empathic emanations)
summary: The ability to gain sustenance and power from the emotions of others
strengths: Drain your foes' emotions, making your foe temporarily emotionally numb
Draining their emotions also builds your physical stats and your resistance to empathic powers
Foes with empathic (emotion-related) abilities have nearly no effect
weaknesses: Can still have emotions READ when this power is in use (though it also drains empathic perception)
Sometimes it requires and actual bite like a vampire
If you can't control it, friends and family won't want to be around you

name: Psionic Fruit Ripening
description: Ripen unripe fruits and vegetables to make them ripe, or take already ripe fruits and vegetables and ripen them until they ferment.
summary: The ability to ripen fruit and vegetables with your mind.
strengths: If the store only has green banannas, no worries.
If you want an orange off the tree, but it hasn't fully ripened, no worries.
If you want to ferment something, no worries.
weaknesses: Accidentally overripening fruit or vegetables.
If you hate fruits and vegetables, I guess it wouldn't do you much good.
Friends and family will always be wanting you to ripen things for them.

name: Tattoo Imprisonment
description: You can use this power on someone by touching them. The people who you turn into tattoos can interact with each other and any other tattoos you have. They can also affect your body with their powers but if you die, they will be trapped forever on your skin.
summary: The ability to turn people into tattoos on one's skin
strengths: This power can reverse itself.
weaknesses: You can now be harmed by your own tattoos.

name: Batman Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any vehicle that Batman has used. You can summon any kind of Batmobile, Batwing, Bat Boat, Batcycle, Bat Pod, etc. This power also gives you the knowledge of how to operate the vehicles.
summary: The ability to summon any vehicle from Batman
strengths: You can summon any Batman vehicle.
You know how to operate the vehicle.
You can unsummon them when you're done.
weaknesses: The vehicles can be destroyed.

name: Myth Power: Iris' Illumination
description: Iris, in Greek myth, was the goddess of color and the rainbow, as well as the Messenger of the Gods. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will. In addition, one can absorb color from matter, by touch, and re-release it at will (to re-color matter or as bolts/blasts of light). Furthermore, one can use rainbows to walk on or teleport, as well as fly. One even gains immunity to effects based on colors from the rainbow.
summary: The ability to channel Iris' command over the essence of color and the rainbow
strengths: Psychically perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will
Absorb color from matter, by touch, at will (recolor matter, Camouflage, release colorful blasts)
Use rainbows to walk on, or for teleportation; fly (wings optional); gain Rainbow Immunity
weaknesses: Only change color of matter without a touch (or manipulate colored light) at the higher levels (NC
Cannot manipulate matter of same color as one's clothes until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Hera's Habit and MythPower: Thaumas' Theme provide immunity (NCN)

name: Go Back Home
description: The power to go go back too your home sweet home.
summary: The ability to go back to your home sweet home!
strengths: If you are bored in a car its perfect!
weaknesses: Use it wisely!

name: Good/Evil Seperation
description:
This ability causes other people to divide into two people that look exactly like them. However, one person has all the good traits, while the other person has all the evil and bad traits. It divides the good and evil qualities of that person.
On top of the separation. The good and evil traits are defined by the original (whole person's) moral perception of good and evil, what they think of being essentially the "worst" and "best" attributes of themselves.
summary: The ability to divide a person in two, separating their good and evil sides.
strengths: You create a purely good person.
weaknesses: You create a purely evil person.
The morality of good and evil is based on your subject's perception of morality, and not your own.

name: Ability Sponsors
description: This is a superpower-based ability. If you know someone with a superpower (the sponsor), then they can decide to let you use it. Their power is then passed onto you for as long as the sponsor lets you. If the sponsor can only use their power so often because it drains their energy or something, when their power is passed on, it will still drain the sponsor's energy and not the receiver's. This ability could be extremely powerful if the wielder has lots of superpowered allies.
summary: The ability to allow others to use their ability through you.
strengths: Can be extremely powerful.
Does not require proximity.
Does not require energy from the receiver.
weaknesses: Relies on sponsors.
Drains sponsors' energy.

name: Power Hobbling
description: Tired of seeing power with no cost? With this ability you can apply a thematically appropriate weakness to any power. Invulnerability? They lose their sense of touch. Fire powers? Now they must constantly eat or "go out". Animal form? They lose themselves in it. However, any flaw you inflict will also be placed on you for exactly one week. So be careful about who you curse.
summary: The ability to give any power a crippling drawback
strengths: Make people regret they ever had power in the first place.
weaknesses: Any flaw you place is put back on you for one week.
You will likely become hated among those with powers.
The flaw you place might not keep the recipient from hurting you

name: Trousers Of Doom
description: He who has this power can store anything in his pockets forevermore, regardless of size or shape. First, he must chant, "Picky picky pockets," and then name the object he wishes to store. There is only one catch: absolutely NOTHING that enters the pockets can ever come back out.
summary: The ability to store anything in your pockets
strengths: Put people in a permanent time-out.
Who needs jail when nothing can escape your pockets?
weaknesses: You can't take anything back out.
Never, EVER say "Picky picky pockets, the universe," because you'll be trapped in the void.

name: Enchantress
description: This ability allows any female to enchant and entice their victims into falling in love with them.  Someone poor at using this ability might not even know they have it, but anyone whom they feel they love would love them back.  Anyone whom is decent at weilding this ability would have anyone whom they come in contact with fall for them, and lastly, a master would be able to pick and chose.  This ability works on contact for anyone competent; a touch of the hand could do it.
summary: The ability to make anyone fall in love with you.
strengths: Anyone you love would love you back.
So deep into love that they will do anything you ask of them.
weaknesses: Never know if they love you for you.
They could get hurt; if you love them you do not want that.

name: Holy Power: Hands Of Energy
description: With this power, you can use the Torment Claws to create a huge quantity of energy. You can use it for different purposes: you can use it with your Omega level superspeed, running and destroying everything behind you with the energy; or create a huge explosion by concentrating the energy and releasing it. You can also use the energy to make the Torment Claws more powerful, destroying everything you touch with them, or give it the power to create waves of destructive energy.
summary: The ability to create a huge amount of energy in the Torment Claws and use it for different battle purposes.
strengths: You can create pure energy from the Torment Claws, and use it for many purposes.
You can create an infinite amount of energy with your claws.
You can use it to restore the energy of your allies.
weaknesses: If the energy creation get out of control, you are going to kill yourself.
Only Tormentors can use this power.

name: Hall Of Fear
description: The Hall of Fear is an illusion power. It forces the victim's mind into a dark hall illuminated by torches. There they are confronted by their worst fears. If they lose to them, they fall into insanity. If they beat their fears, you are forced into the Hall and have to face your fears.
summary: The ability to use the Hall of Fear.
strengths: Forces people to fight worst fears.
Drives people insane.
weaknesses: You might be driven to insanity.

name: Piece Of Eden: The Apple
description: The Apple can give you the ability to create illusions and control people's minds. As long as it is in your possession, you can use this power.
summary: The ability to use an apple that can control people and create illusions.
strengths: You can carry it in your pocket or bag and still use its power.
weaknesses: It must be in YOUR possession.
Enemies can use it if they take it from you.
Can be destroyed. And if it is, it will cause a HUGE explosion.

name: Reality's A Musical
description: Are you a talented musician that just can't seem to get your career started? Well, now you don't need to! With this power, you can call a keyboard to you that will form with a strap around your neck. You determine what each chord, cadence, and note does to a specific amount of space, determined by you power level. Once you determine this, you may not change it.
summary: The ability to summon a piano that can bend a space of reality to your will.
strengths: You can control reality by playing the piano.
It may work on a smaller scale if you can't play actually.
You can add theme music to a space of reality to determine what happens.
weaknesses: It's somewhat heavy.
You can't change the settings you put on it.
It takes a few minutes to fully summon it.

name: Sparta Kick
description: With this superpower you can spawn a infinite hole into the ground and kick something down it.
summary: The ability to make a giant hole and kick someone/something down it.
strengths: Effective killing.
A cool rubbish bin
weaknesses: You have to say 'THIS IS SPARTA!!! "
You would say it by accident.

name: Get Cooking
description: You can cook anything in the world! Like, you just throw anything in the oven and set the time, and it's really good!
summary: The ability to cook anything in the world and make it good.
strengths: Never throw away anything ever again
Never hungry!
Costs less paying for food
weaknesses: Sometimes it won't cook
Can't cook stuff older than a month

name: Hive Mind
description: Hive Mind is very easy to overlook, but do so at your peril. People in a Hive Mind share a mind--they are one mind with several bodies. Therefore, anything one person in a Hive Mind knows, the whole Hive Mind knows. It also knows where each of its members is. Finally, the Mind can flood all of itself into a single member, giving them telepathy and hypnosis.  This leaves the other members comatose. There is no individuality in a Hive Mind, and when one member dies, it almost kills the others.
summary: The ability to share a mind with several others
strengths: Can be as many as 20 people
Know what your Hivemates know
Can flood all of it into one member, giving them psychic powers
weaknesses: No individuality in a Hive Mind
When one dies, the others almost die too
"Flooding" leaves the others comatose

name: Poison Dart Strike V3 Monsters
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they only effect monsters (werewolves, vampires, Bigfoot, zombies, dragons etc. ) the darts paralyze the victim for up to twenty minutes
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: While the monster is paralyzed you can easily slay it or save somebody from it
weaknesses: After the twenty minutes the monster will probably kill you

name: Narcotic Emission
description: A person with Narcotic Emission is a walking drug factory. At will, they can release a powerful heroin-like narcotic liquid from their skin. Upon contact with another person, this liquid is quickly assimilated. Its effects are euphoria, a reducing of physical pain, and apathy. The subject must touch the drug in order to feel its effects, and some may experience mental addiction. Narcotic Emitters are immune to their own drug.
summary: The ability to generate a powerful drug from your skin
strengths: Help the terminally ill feel better
Make some money
Aids in fights (distract foes with how good they are feeling)
weaknesses: Subject may experience mental addiction
Subject must touch drug to feel effects
Immune to your own drug

name: Rotating Wrists
description: You can make your wrists turn all the way around the axis defined by the length of your arms. It won't hurt at all and you can make them turn either clockwise or counterclockwise.
summary: The ability to have wrists that can rotate around the axis of your arm.
strengths: You can now open or close screw caps without stopping and grabbing the cap at a different point.
You can now turn keys in their lock in a single continuous movement.
You can now do the helicopter spin with a bo staff or any stick without releasing it.
weaknesses: If you don't stop the wrist rotation in the normal position, your hand will look funny.
Sadly, you can't rotate your pinky fingers with this power alone... (Quick! Use Con Negation!)
You can sort of slap someone by rotating your wrist.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Disaster Zone
description: Wherever they go, people with this ability cause mayhem. Cars wreck, weapons misfire, things blow up, and people trip. This power is completely passive and requires no concentration. It also is unfortunately always active and can not be turned off. It does not affect you but it does affect everyone else within a 300 ft (91.44 meters) radius. Any "good luck" powers will provide protection from this ability. With practice you can learn to focus on one person, but you will still cause bad luck.
summary: The ability to passively cause bad luck to everyone else
strengths: Doesn't affect you
Gives you "virtual" good luck by making everyone else's worse
Can work on many people
weaknesses: Can't be turned off
Can cause bad luck to friends
Not many people will want to be near you

name: Alien Detector
description: With this power, you will automatically know if a person is an alien just by looking at them. If the person is an alien their skin will look bright red to you. You cannot turn this power off, so let's say one of your friends is an alien, their skin will always look bright red to you, which can get annoying.
summary: The ability to know if somebody is an alien
strengths: You will know if there is an alien near you.
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off.
If you're color blind, this power might not work for you.
If you're blind, this power will not work for you at all.

name: White Adipocyte Mimicry
description: This power is always active. As soon as you consume fat, you'll absorb it in your body. You can absorb up to four times your original body mass, becoming more obese. When you consume at least twice your body mass, you can undergo mitosis, duplicating yourself into two identical individuals and cutting your fat supply in half between your two selves. Also, as you slim, the skin will readjust so you won't have any excess. Additionally, you have the power to inhibit your or other people's appetite.
summary: The ability to absorb fat, duplicate yourself when you're fat enough and make people feel sated.
strengths: The fatter you are, the more resistant to extreme temperatures and damages you become.
You have a great control over your fat intake as you can order your own body to feel full.
You can divide yourself into two, slimming in the process without any excess skin.
weaknesses: If being thin is important to you, you'll never use the full potential of this ability.
People can be very cruel and discriminating with obese people.
You cannot easily lose the weight you gained.

name: Family
description: With this power, you automatically know when a member of your immediate family (father, mother, sister, brother, wife, son, daughter) is in trouble. This power also gives you the exact location and nature of the danger, so you get over there and try to help them. Unfortunately, this power can never be turned off and you're alerted whenever your little brother trips over a rock or your daughter was stung by a bee and other minor forms of danger.
summary: The ability to know when a member of your immediate family is in trouble.
strengths: You know whenever a member of your immediate family is in any kind of danger.
weaknesses: You're alerted for even the smallest things.

name: Legendary Weapon: Gungnir
description: This allows the user to summon and wield the legendary weapon Gungnir. This weapon belongs to the King of the Norse Gods, Odin. It's incredibly powerful and can pierce through just about anything. Also, its special ability is that it's a spear that never misses its target. It can't be stopped once in midair. Truly a fearsome weapon.
summary: The ability to summon and wield the legendary weapon of the Norse God Odin
strengths: Very powerful weapon that can pierce through just about anything
Never misses its target
Can't be stopped in midair, except by the user
weaknesses: Hard to control such a powerful weapon (takes a lot of energy to wield and control)
Getting the weapon is very difficult and chances are Odin won't just give it up

name: Odd Change
description: You see, these changes can only be stop if you are physically alone. It is not bad because this ability is made for one thing, combat. You'll need to fight different opponents with different form. Each form has a different face and each form is based on one of the three characteristics of a fighter: speed, strength, or agility.
summary: The ability to unwillingly change your form depending on who you meet.
strengths: Able to protect your identity.
Gain different fighting styles.
weaknesses: You have to be physically alone to stop it.
No one will see your true form.

name: Enhancement: Spinning
description: This is a support. It is useless without another power. When attached to another power it makes the projectiles spin which in turn gives the projectiles a piercing effect. This means that they are not slowed down when going through an object. If stolen, this power permanently affects the power it is attached to. It can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power's projectiles spin by attaching this power to it
strengths: Spinning projectiles. Spinning Fireballs!
Hit an enemy when they think they are safe.
Having this and an aiming power.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Still have a bad sense of aim if your's wasn't good in the first place.
Still need to know where to fire.

name: Flight Of The Lemmings
description: Ever heard the story of how a group of lemmings will run off a cliff to their deaths without hesiatation, while following the group? This is the same concept. If you force a member of a group does something, all of the others do it as well, even with inanimate objects. One enemy get's scared, all of them get scared. you pickpocket one person, you pickpocket them all. You always decide when the effect takes place.
summary: The ability to force a group of objects to copy the actions of one member of said group.
strengths: Seduce/mesmerise/enlist/control large groups of people at once.
You can decide if when the effect takes place
You are not affected by this power yourself.
weaknesses: Be careful of who's included in a group when you initiate a response for obvious reasons.

name: Alpha Cell Mimicry
description: This Mimicry belongs to the islets of Langerhans. You can produce glucagon, a hormone which raises the level of blood sugar in the body. You can inject a dose in anyone through touch, forcing their body to produce more sugar. You can also use it on other Cell Mimics from a distance. Hepatocyte Mimics will be forced to release their stored sugar but will be able to create more from various substances, like milk, fat, muscles,... Adipocyte Mimics will convert and release their fat as fatty acid.
summary: The ability to produce and inject glucagon, as well as trigger new abilities in Hepatocyte and Adipocyte Mimics.
strengths: You can help people suffering from hypoglycemia.
When you're in need of sugar, you can use the glucagon on yourself.
You can give Hepatocyte and Adipocyte Mimics (both white and brown) new powers.
weaknesses: It only works on humans and other species with a genome similar to human's, such as mice.
After a while, the body of those injected with glucagon can counteract its effects.
You can only undergo mitosis when united with all the other Mimics of the islets of Langerhans.

name: Spawn: Greek Pavilion
description: This power spawns a delicious greek eatery, it is very spacious able to seat up to 400 quests.  You are served by satyrs, the food always replinishes. You are also given goblets that can create any kind of drink, like bright red lemonade, or hot chocolate with marshmallows,etc.
summary: The ability to spawn a greek pavilion.
strengths: Spawn a pavilion that makes great foods.
If your lost and need food.
Your own personal restaurant!
weaknesses: The satyrs are somewhat slow and tend to eat some food you get until power develops.
People might think it is an actual restaurant and walk in.

name: Fancy Nail
description: You can lengthen and shorten your nails at will. These nails can cut anything - fire, water, air, flesh, diamonds, etc. - anything.
summary: The ability to cut anything with your nails.
strengths: Can cut fire and thus escape burning buildings
Instant self-defense
weaknesses: If you don't control it, you could slice yourself in half
Cutting cheese causes many unfortunate puns

name: Empathic Linking
description: This power links two people together empathically, meaning they feel what the other is feeling in terms of emotions. You can choose to connect their lives as well; if one person is hurt or dies, the other one is hurt or dies as well.
summary: The ability to connect two persons together empathically
strengths: Make people understand each other by placing them in their shoes
You can tell is someone is lying
You can use it on anyone you like
weaknesses: You may not like what you find out.
Both targets could die

name: Dragon Wand
description: The Dragon Wand is an unnatural and mystical artifact. It is a two and a half-foot long steel wand with an Emerald Dragon's head on top with dark red eyes. it can grant you great powers, primarily used for casting spells--enhancing, multiplying, gathering, focusing and redirecting mystical energies, etc. It only works when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.
summary: The ability to gain supernatural powers & abilities from a Chinese sceptre
strengths: The Dragon Wand has been shown to only to destroy dark magical creatures or objects.
Vast potential
weaknesses: You may only cast spells when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.

name: Benevorous
description: You get a boost to stamina,strength and speed depending on the level of goodness in a foe. It starts with 50%(someone almost a anti-hero,but not quite) to a perfect angel of a person who gives you a 100 times boost to your physical traits. This power a has a 300 foot radius. The power automatically scans for the best goodness to feed off of when facing multiple foes. Foes need not have actual powers,the perfect cop could give you a boost to your physical traits.
summary: The ability to feed off the goodness of a foe and become better physically.
strengths: Turn a foe's goodness to your gain.
A almost anti-hero can still give you a slight boost to your physical traits.
The goodness you feed off of can come from a superpowerless but goodhearted person.
weaknesses: A amoral person is fighting you.
Someone evil like yourself is fighting you.
A good guy is attacking you beyond the 300 radius.

name: Gustance Deduction
description: A person with this power is able to figure out vast amounts of information by tasting something. They analyze the exact tastes of the components that went into the tasted object. This lets one figure out the composition of their food as well as give them the ability to simulate the flavor of any food in their mind by combining the tastes of said ingredients in their mind. However, there are cons - you have to have tasted something before in your life to determine what ingredient it is.
summary: The ability to determine details of something by taste
strengths: Figure out the composition of your food - what type of meat etc
Become a very good food critiquer
Become an excellent experimental chef
weaknesses: Figuring out there was poison in something
You might not want to taste everything
You need to have a reference to figure out the exact taste

name: Food Control
description: With this power you can summon a food army. They will fight for you and do whatever you tell them to do. Plus if your hungry you can it.
summary: The ability to control food and make them fight for you
strengths: Having an army that will fight 4 you
If you are hungry you can eat the army
weaknesses: If you eat to much you might throw up
They can plan a revolt

name: Con Generation
description: Some people think highly about their ability, but the worst thing that could happen to them is coming across someone with this power. The user can cause a bad plausible situation to happen to a superpowered being, related to the use of their superpowers. Even though someone claims there are no cons to their superpower, either because they don't want/know/believe them to have one, there usually is a worst-case scenario that might happen to them that could make them regret they used their power.
summary: The ability to cause a very bad situation to happen to a superpowered being when they use their superpowers.
strengths: You're immune to this power. Sort of. (See con 1. )
Don't believe it when the description of an ability says there are no cons.
Cause them to regret having powers or even hurt/kill them by backfiring their powers on them.
weaknesses: It's rare but it can happen that the generated situation could affect the user in some ways.
The situation must be plausible -- well, in a world where superpowers exist, anything is possible.
A fully-mastered Con Negation power.

name: Naruto
description: This power allows you to either have the abilities of, transform into, or partially transform into, Naruto, from the series,"Naruto".
summary: The ability to turn into or have the powers of Naruto from the anime "Naruto".
strengths: Can have all of his amazing powers.
Can do all of his jutsus.
Can do all of his jumping and running and fighting skills.
weaknesses: Opponents can still beat you if they are more skilled.
Can only do what Naruto can do plus your own skills.
Can only transform yourself.

name: Temporary Speed Boost
description: You can multiply your speed by a constant of 5 for 1 minute, but all your leg muscles are damaged beyond what short term rest will cure. You signal your muscles for the speed increase by tapping one foot against the other foot.
summary: The ability to boost one's movement speed at a cost
strengths: Chances are an enemy won't be able to stop your speed during that one minute.
Your bones' conditions are unchanged by this power.
weaknesses: Healing and regeneration powers will not speed up the time needed to recuperate.
You heal the damage caused by this power at the average rate for someone your age and fitness would.
Average time to recuperate from this power is one month.

name: Enhancement: Potent
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the potency or power of the power. Maximum increase in power is 200%. If this power is stolen, then the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power can be attached to only one power at a time.
summary: The ability to increase the potency of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Power is stronger.
The power can do more damage.
Works for physical, mental, magical, etc.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Might not want a power to be stronger in a hostage situation if you are a good guy.
Maximum increase in power is 200%.

name: Uncanny Faith
description: The ability to move a mountain or do anything else that seems impossible to man, but possible to God. You pray for whatever you want to happen and if your faith is strong enough, it will happen.
summary: The ability to do things through prayer.
strengths: You can do anything.
You go to heaven.
You have a close relationship to god.
weaknesses: People will hate you.
People will try to kill you.
People will think you're the messiah.

name: Protective Ability Acquisition
description: Temporarily gains all abilities necessary to eradicate a person or thing that is putting the user in danger. The amount of abilities gained to protect the user are limitless. The user has full control and understanding of the abilities gained; however, once the danger has been eradicated, the user becomes completely powerless. This ability becomes triggered if the user becomes naturally ill, if the user is being attacked etc.
summary: The ability to be protected by abilities
strengths: You are virtually invincible.
weaknesses: If you aren't in danger you are completely powerless.

name: Template: Glory Angel.
description: A demented, immortal seraphim, stolen from grace. The user is able to take the form of man, but also that of an angel, whose six large wings spread feathers of glistening white. But, beneath that facade, there is deceiving; the user is composed of worms, through and through. A fever of mysterious power capable of independent movement, communication, and complete biological manipulation. The user is accompanied by unlimited strength, speed, invulnerability, and an immense regenerative factor.
summary: The ability to channel the power of a special seraphim.
strengths: A unique physiology allows total command over themselves.
The user can "absorb" other invertebrates inside/within themselves.
There is no limit to how big, small, or wide the user can be.
weaknesses: The user may lose to a stronger being.
The user is susceptible to magic and psionic influence.
The user may draw unwanted attention.

name: Blob Mimicry
description: Like the old monster movie, you can turn into a liquid/plasma form that grows bigger every time you consume something. Almost nothing can stop you, from electricity to explosions to freezing to fire to nukes. You adapt quickly & continue to grow, but you can't form any shapes like a fist or hammer. You just look like a giant amoeba. You consume matter by breaking it down with strong acid chemical enzymes. You can return to normal after everything you ate is dissolved.
summary: The ability to turn into an evergrowing/consuming gelatinous blob
strengths: Be a giant consuming blob & continue to grow
Nearly invulnerable, adapting quickly
Can return to human again
weaknesses: Can't take complex shapes
Can't return back to normal till everything you ate is dissolved
May be hunted by the military & angry mobs

name: Yokai: Tengu
description: The tengu, translated as "heavenly dogs". They appear as avian humanoids with red or blue skin with either a long nose or beak. The tengu are usually depicted as carrying hauchiwa (fans made of feathers) which stir up great winds. Tengu are also portrayed as expert samurai and yamabushi.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
strengths: Master swordsman.
Stir up deadly tornadoes.
weaknesses: Still susceptible to damage.

name: Know Demons
description: With this power you will know when a demon is nearby. The location of the demon must be within 10 kilometres. You will know how powerful the demon is, what type of demon it is, what powers it has, what it looks/sounds/smells like, and what it eats. This information pops into your head and disappears when the demon is out of range.
summary: The ability to know when a demon is near
strengths: You know when a demon is nearby.
Knowing where a succubus/incubus is to avoid her/him.
If you can counter the demon's powers and fight it on even terms(do this only if strong enough).
weaknesses: This power doesn't help with combat.
You have to research how to get rid of or keep the demon away on your own.
This power isn't really useful except for demon hunters.

name: Black Power
description: With this power you can utilize the powers of any African American superhuman. The powers of Storm (Marvel), Black Panther (Marvel), Bishop (Marvel), Sync (Marvel), Monet St. Croix (Marvel), Photon (Marvel), Firestorm (DC), Blue Marvel (Marvel) Static (Marvel), Bumblebee (DC), Spiderman (Miles Morales- Marvel), Green Lantern (John Stewart- DC), Black Lightning (DC), Cyborg (DC), the new Aqualad (DC), Frozone (Incredibles), Mr. Terrific (DC), Black Vulcan (DC) and others are at your disposal.
summary: The ability to use the powers of any African American superhumans
strengths: Can use some great powers
Can psychically access a mental database of all African-American superhumans (hero/villain) at will
Power Negation (by any means, short of Omnipotence) only affects one ability at a time
weaknesses: Doesn't allow you to access knowledge or skills of Black superhumans (only superpowers)
Does not allow you to shapeshift to look like the Black superhumans you mimic
Power Mimicry allows the foe to access ANY power this one bestows (not just the one you're using)

name: Olive Branch
description: With this power whenever you're holding an olive branch you can make peace with anybody. You have to find your own olive branch though but any peaces made when you held the olive branch become permanent even when you let go of the branch.
summary: The ability to make peace with anybody when you hold an olive branch
strengths: You can make peace with anybody as long as you're holding an olive branch
All peace treaties made using this power become permanent
weaknesses: You have to be holding an olive branch

name: Quota Setting
description: Basically this is forcing someone to do or make a certain number of things within a set amount of time. The ratio has to be reasonable for the person in question. If the person forced to fill the quota can't finish by the time the timer runs out they have to do a punishment based on how much they failed. Ex. Missing 50% means a worse punishment than missing 49%. If they finish before the time limit, the one who set the quota has to take the punishment.
summary: The ability to force a person to fulfill a quota or else they have to take a punishment
strengths: Running after using this power on an opponent.
If they don't finish in time.
Their friends unwittingly delaying them.
weaknesses: If they finish in time.
You can't delay them nor can you get anyone else to delay them.
Con Negation and alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Angelic Resonance
description: The resonance wil only work if the person has love in their heart. The more love they have the more powerful of an angel they will become. Appearances change dependant on the person becoming an angel.
summary: The ability to resonate with a person in such a way that they turn into an angel
strengths: Better against villains than heroes, usually.
weaknesses: Never ever use this against a hero.
Can't use this on yourself.
Can make a villain loved and revered by the superstitious.

name: Myth Power: Dysnomia's Deed
description: Dysnomia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of defiance, disobedience, insubordination and lawlessness. As such, channeling her allows one to withstand and negate any compulsion, short of command by an omnipotent being. One can share this immunity by a touch. Furthermore, one's touch can also make subjects lose all respect for law, invoking a havoc-wreaking frenzy until the power's use is spent. One can even psychically perceive and communicate with those who are naturally disobedient and defiant.
summary: The ability to channel Dysnomia's command over the essence of disobedience, insubordination and lawlessness
strengths: Immunity to ANY compulsion, short of direct omnipotent influence; Compulsion Immunity can be shared
One's touch can negate respect for the law/rules, so subjects go into a frenzy of anarchy
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with the naturally disobedient and defiant
weaknesses: Cannot compel the naturally obedient, defiant, disobedient or insubordinant (no Con Negation)
People with law and order based MythPowers are immune to this ability (higher level can negate it)
People with MythPower: Eris' Enmity are immune to (and empowered by) this ability

name: A Z Powers V2
description: With this power you can get a new power every day. The first day you have this power you will get a random power from this website that starts with the letter "A" the next day you'll get one that starts with "B" and so on so forth on the 27th day the cycle wil restart. You cannot change the power you get and you can't get powers that star with numbers or symbols.
summary: The ability to get a new power everyday corresponding to a different letter of the alphabet
strengths: You can get a new power everyday
weaknesses: You can't change the power you get
You can't get a power that starts with a number or symbol

name: Flute Of The Spirits
description: When you play this native American flute, you summon a bunch of vengeful Apache warriors, who are good at guerilla warfare. They are mortal and their strength comes from their anger. It's an honor to have this flute.
summary: The ability to use a native American flute to summon Apache warriors
strengths: They are good at guerilla warfare
The flute is made from elk horn
It's a honor to have this flute
weaknesses: The Apache warriors hate the government and its people
They do not trust the American army
They speak Apache (no con negation)

name: Chessboard Pattern
description: This power allows you to project a black and white chess pattern from your feet, up to any size you want, before locking it down. Anyone caught on the pattern when it is locked down is trapped on it, and is moved to the closest open starting position. They will then have to play a game of chess, acting and moving only as the pieces they represent can, until either "king" is taken. The pattern then vanishes, setting them free to move however they please.
summary: The ability to make people move as though they were pieces on a chessboard.
strengths: Tie up pursuers and villains in long games.
weaknesses: Only works as a delay tactic,

name: Shape Journal
description: With this ability, any form you take is recorded, allowing you to assume it once more. This applies not only to shapeshifting, but also things like Reincarnation Determination and even transfiguration curses; you can change back at will and assume the cursed form as you choose. Partial shifts are also possible, but they may require more practice.
summary: The ability to record all forms you have taken in the past and shift into them at will.
strengths: Perfectly replicate any form you have ever taken.
This power will allow you to return to your old form if you lose other shapeshifting powers.
Makes your default form easy to remember.
weaknesses: You'll need experience before you can do partial shifts between forms with this power.
You need to have been altered in the past, by yourself or an external force.
Does not apply to mundane changes, such as aging.

name: Quartz Gravity Center
description: This ability allows you to select any nearby mass of quartz and make it the new local center of gravity. This means that all gravity will pull towards it. The size of the quartz mass determines the strength of gravity. This effect is local and affects objects within a mile radius.
summary: The ability to cause any nearby quartz to become a local center of gravity
strengths: Alter a battlefield to your benefit
weaknesses: Chaotic and difficult to anticipate

name: Evolution Vision
description: The power to see a animal's future form just by looking at it. You can see any next evolution, as well as any next change in the environment; the reason an animal evolves. It makes a picture in your mind of the animal's or the environment's next evolution.
summary: The ability to see a animal's future form
strengths: See all kind of cool animals
weaknesses: May not like what you see

name: Surgical Stitching
description: This power lets you create stitches out of energy from your body that have the power to bind things together. The stitches can be used to make it so that two objects can not be easily separated from each other. Stitches can be placed on wounds to make it so that the area can heal better. The stitches can also be used to hold a broken body together so that the person can still use it. The stitches can also be used to bind a spirit to an object or body. Stitches can be removed by this power.
summary: The ability to create stitches made out of energy.
strengths: Stitch objects together so that they become stuck.
Stitch wounds and a body back together so that the person does not die while healing.
Stitch the intangible and spirits as well.
weaknesses: Stitches can be broken by force.
Stitches can be manipulated or blocked by those with energy powers.
If used on self to much the stitches may become the only thing holding your body together.

name: Long Distance Bitch Slap
description: This ability allows you bitch slap anyone from a distance just by thinking about it.  They won't know it was you (unless you somehow make it obvious).  You can bitch slap them pretty hard, but you won't do any permanent damage.  This ranges from people in the room with you to even people you're watching on live TV.
summary: The ability to bitch slap someone from a distance.
strengths: Road rage
Shutting someone up
weaknesses: Road rage

name: Swordsman Power V1
description: With this power you can summon two swordsmen, who know everything there is to know about swordfighting. These swordsmen are very proficient/skilled in it, but not invincible.  They have normal swords and when one is destroyed, you can always summon another one.
summary: The ability to summon two master swordsmen
strengths: You have two expert swordsmen for body guards
You can summon another one when one dies
They might teach you how to be an expert swordsman yourself
weaknesses: You can only summon two at a time
They can die
They only have normal swords

name: Myth Power: Eirene's Elegance
description: Eirene (Irene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of peace. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically quell conflicts at will (by causing any two or more conflicting subjects to lose the ability to speak and/or forget what they were going to say/do). In addition, one can produce a molecular and temporal stasis around any weapon to prevent that weapon from going forth and doing subjects harm. One can even psychically calm any kind of rage and ease troubled minds by touch, word or thought.
summary: The ability to channel Eirene's command over the essence of peace and pacifism
strengths: Prevent and end arguments by erasing hostile memories, or rendering subjects mute
Induce a temporal AND molecular stasis around weapons (rendering them TOTALLY useless)
Calm any rage (even by rage/madness/frenzy-based MythPowers) and soothe troubled minds
weaknesses: Only perceive, communicate with and compel pacifists/peacemakers at the higher levels (NCN)
Only quell earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, stormy skies or violent seas at the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity until the higher levels

name: Summon: Metal Men
description: The metal men are sentient robots that the user has created to help him or her defend peace and justice. There are a total of six metal men, consisting of gold, mercury, lead, iron, platinum , lead and tin. All of them have the ability to morph their shape, forming new weapons, they also posses super human strength and enhanced invulnerability due to their robot body. They also can combine themselves to form other objects and too form their ultimate robot form: Alloy
summary: The ability to summon the metal men that you have built
strengths: Used to fight crime
Adaptable to any situation
Cannot be reprogrammed unless initiated by the creator
weaknesses: Certain metals weak against air ( if they are exposed to extremely high concentration ie an attack )
Certain metals will melt under very high temperatures

name: Enhancement: Multi Dimensional
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows the power to affect targets in other dimensions without the user being in the dimension. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to allow a power to affect targets in other dimensions without the user being there
strengths: Trapped in a different dimension? Heal your allies from afar with this power.
Attack an extra-dimensional enemy outside of their dimension.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Will NOT work on any 'Ultimate' powers.
Will not allow the user to go beyond their limits in the dimension they are in.

name: Iron Ball
description: The subject creates around him/herself an eight-feet-diameter hollow ball of organic metal, in which he levitates and whose movement and trajectory he/she can control. With this sphere, the subject can crush his/her enemies. The ball is translucent only from the inside, so that the subject can see the surrounding area, but it provides just a little autonomy in air.
summary: The ability to create a big metal ball around yourself to use as a steamroller.
strengths: The sphere is really resistant, it can crush a lot of enemies;
You can see others, but nobody can see you into the ball;
The trajectory is perfectly controllable and adjustable.
weaknesses: The air contained in the sphere is limitated and grants only half an hour of autonomy.;
You cannot have external contacts (you can't take any objects, can't talk to anyone etc. )

name: Aura Attune: Earth
description: With this power, you may attune your aura with Earth. While active, all mystical and spiritual abilities related to earth or stone are greatly empowered, but all air related ones are weakened. You also become more resistant to Earth powers, but weaker to Air related powers. This power also makes your aura like that of a powerful Earth Elemental, causing earth-aligned beings to treat you with respect. Air-aligned beings, however, fear or hate you. Luckily, this power can be turned on and off.
summary: The ability to attune your aura with the element of Earth.
strengths: Empower your spiritual or magical earth powers.
Have earth-aligned creatures treat you with respect or friendliness.
Become more resistant to harmful earth powers.
weaknesses: Weakens magical and spiritual air powers.
Air-aligned creatures hate or fear you.
Weaker to harmful air powers.

name: Cartoon Looks
description: Kinda like shape-shifting. You can look like any cartoon character. The complex part is that it's a real life version of the character.
summary: The ability to look like the real life version of a cartoon character
strengths: Good-looking cartoons characters
Don't have to worry that your disguise is a person that already exists
weaknesses: Ugly cartoon characters

name: Star Eater
description: With this power whenever you eat a star you gain a new power similar to Planet Eater. You would have to be a giant and be able to breathe in space though this power does make your mouth heat resistant so you can eat stars without burning you mouth.
summary: The ability to eat stars and gain powers
strengths: You get a new power whenever you consume stars
Your mouth is heat resistant so you can never burn it
weaknesses: You'd have to be giant and able to breath in space in order to use this power
If you eat too many stars planets will start to die out

name: Great Hammer Of Justice
description: The Great Hammer of Justice only can be used by people who are just in their heart. The hammer is also somewhat semi sentient, as it will not hurt a person if the user is wielding it for purpose of revenge, even though the target has done wrong. The hammer can also judge whether the target is really guilty of a crime. The hammer grants its wielder a steel battle armor that offers enhanced strength, flight and limited invulnerability. The hammer itself is indestructible
summary: The ability to use the Great Hammer of Justice
strengths: Can combat crime ranging from small to large crimes
You cannot use it for bad.
Can go head to head with powerhouses
weaknesses: You cannot use it for vengeance
The suit the hammer gives can be destroyed or badly damaged, injuring the user

name: Myth Power: Harpax's Haul
description: Harpax, in Greek myth, was the god of taking. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically bypass the legal/social consequences of stealing. In addition, one can psychically access a pocket dimension as infinite storage for loot, at will. Furthermore, one can deal enhanced damage against foes they have stolen from. One can also deal enhanced damage against foes who have stolen from them. One can even psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any theft or robbery in progress, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Harpax's command over the essence of taking, theft and robbery
strengths: Psychically bypass legal/social consequences of stealing, access pocket dimension for infinite storage, at will
Deal enhanced damage against foes who have stolen from them, or who they have stolen from
Psychically perceive and teleport to the site of any theft/robbery in progress, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically steal knowledge, skills or (random) superpowers, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically steal injuries, beauty, breath or life-force, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Dos' Donation and law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Phrase Replacement Service
description: There are many powers that require you to say, write, sign or hear certain words or phrases to activate or cause an effect. This power allows you to assign a new word or phrase to those kinds of powers, entirely replacing what you needed to say before. For example, with Object Summoning, you could assign the phrase "my wife" to replace the word "anvil", so you'll summon an anvil whenever you say "my wife". However, you won't summon anvils by saying "anvil", nor your wife when you say "my wife".
summary: The ability to assign new words or phrases to powers involving the use of words or phrases.
strengths: Assigning a new word to a power will only affect that power, not the other ones you may have.
Trick your enemies by causing effects entirely unrelated to the contents of the word or phrase.
You can replace a single word with a phrase and vice versa.
weaknesses: Assigning a new phrase means the old phrase lost its use and the new phrase lost its old use.
You may complicate the activation of those powers, as they had a certain logic to which word to say.
You can only change the word or phrase, not the way it must be used (spoken, signed, heard,... )

name: Exploding Sneeze
description: With this power you can cause huge explosions whenever you sneeze. You are unaffected by the explosions and you can turn this power on and off.
