summary: The ability to cause huge explosions when you sneeze
strengths: You can explosions when you sneeze
You are unaffected by the explosion
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: It happens whenever you sneeze unless you turn it off

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta5
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phaenon (Phainon, Cronion, Kronion- Planet Saturn) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Saturn. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Saturnine weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Saturn's patron, Kronos, to resist and benefit from his domains (time and its destructive effects, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Saturn (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Saturnine gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Saturn's patron god, Kronos; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Saturn at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Saturn-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto foes) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Kronos' Craft and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Damage Resistant
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes anything that the enhanced power creates harder to damage. For physical items, the atoms become more tightly bonded together. For mental powers, it feels to enemies as though more willpower is holding the thoughts together. If this power is stolen, the enhanced power is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power's creations harder to damage
strengths: Your creations are harder to damage.
Works on mentally- and physically- based powers.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Doesn't work with shapeshifting powers.

name: Virus Fixer
description: Don't you hate it when your computer gets hit with a virus and crashes? With this power that is a thing of the past! You can fix any problem that was caused by a computer virus by writing a program yourself to destroy a specific virus. The virus itself is destroyed and the problems are completely cured.
summary: The ability to fix problems caused by virtual viruses
strengths: Problems with computer viruses are gone.
weaknesses: If you're slow at typing, your computer will probably crash before you're done with the program.
Only helps with computer viruses.
Hackers

name: Screamer
description: Every note on the scale you scream induces a different effect upon those who hear it. Low C-low level anxiety and shortness of breath, D-high level anxiety and panic attacks, E-dizziness and vertigo, F-nausea and stomach cramping, G-severe headaches and fatigue, A-blindness, B-euphoria and eventual stupor, high C-the listener to visually hallucinate. By rapid oscillation between two notes one can combine effect.
summary: The ability to cause varying physiological effects by screaming musical notes
strengths: What do you think?
weaknesses: What do you think?

name: Superhuman Dent
description: Superhuman Dent or Super Dent, also called Super Strong Teeth is the ability for a person to exert force from the jaw muscles beyond that of a normal human. This can be accomplished by either fortifying the jaw muscles with psychic force, or simply having denser muscle mass in the jaw beyond that of a normal human. This ability is usually accompanied by extra strong dentine, the stuff that teeth are made of.
summary: The ability to apply force to the jaw muscles beyond that of a normal human.
strengths: Making chewing a lot easier
You can bite into almost anything, including solid substances such wood, metal, plastic etc.
Your jaw muscles will never ache from hard chewing
weaknesses: You may accidentally bite off your tongue or the side of your cheek

name: Myth Power: Krios' Creed
description: Krios (Kreios, Crios, Creios, Crius, Creius), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of leadership, mastery, domestic animals and the constellations. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, intimidate and compel subjects (as well as psychically perceive, communicate with and command animals) at will. In addition, one can totally withstand the compulsions of others. One can even assume the form of any domestic animal, as well as anyone who has one's same astrological sign, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Krios' command over the essence of leadership, mastery, domestic animals and constellations
strengths: Psychically perceive, intimidate and compel subjects; perceive, communicate with and command animals
Totally withstand the compulsions of others
Assume the form of any DOMESTIC animal, or anyone who share's one's astrological sign
weaknesses: Cannot turn others into domestic animals, by touch, until the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 only extends to zodiac/constellation characters at the higher levels (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Quadruple
description: This is a support. As such it does nothing until it attaches to another power. It then quadruples the effects. This power is gained from using Enhancement: Triple. Enhancement: Triple changes into this power after several uses. Because of that anything that goes for Enhancement: Triple goes for this power. You can only attach this power to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to quadruple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Quadruple the effects. Quadruple Fireball!!!!
Anything that goes for Enhancement: Triple goes for this power. May be a con for some parts.
If used enough can quintuple the effects.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
What was useful tripled may not be useful quadrupled or pointless.
Must use Enhancement: Triple multiple times.

name: Poke Ball
description: Let's you catch people and have awesome battles.
summary: The ability to catch other people with poke balls
strengths: Use people to your advantage
Can use animals
Can capture any one
weaknesses: Have to get them when they are off gard
You can only have six at a time
Must be living

name: Liquid Repellant Shield
description: With this ability, you can repel liquids and stay dry. You can choose if your clothes also repel liquids. You repel paint, acids, corrosive liquids, water and most other liquids. The only thing you don't repel is sweat. The liquid is 1 millimeter away from you and drops of liquid that come in contact with the shield appear frictionless and hovers/slides off the psionic shield instead of sticking to it. You are still affected by the temperature and impact force of liquids. Can be turned off.
summary: The ability to repel liquids (including corrosive liquids, paint, and acids) and stay dry.
strengths: Repel liquids and stay dry.
Acids and corrosive liquids don't come in contact with you.
Never get wet paint on you again.
weaknesses: Only works with liquids.

name: Rain Stop
description: Now whenever it rains you can stop the rain while it's still in the air and it will stay in the air until you allow it to continue falling. You can keep the rain frozen in time for as long as you want and no new rain can fall while the rain is still in the air. Only you can allow the rain you stopped to fall.
summary: The ability to stop rain midfall
strengths: You can stop rain while it is falling
Only you can allow the rain to continue to fall
No new rain can fall while the rain is frozen in time
weaknesses: You cannot allow rain other people have frozen to continue to fall
Not much use in physical combat

name: Primate Permutation
description: With this power, you can turn into any primate of your choosing, be it prosimians, monkeys or even great and lesser apes. You will gain the physical body of that animal while retaining your conscience and thinking capacity. You will also gain any physical abilities of the animal you become, like the lemur's jump, the howler monkey's call, the Silver-back Gorilla's strength, the agility of a spider monkey (and other monkeys, as well), just to name a few.
summary: The ability to change into any primate you want.
strengths: Become the primate of your choice, and it's also reversible.
Gain the physical abilities and traits of that animal.
You can communicate with the rest of that animal's species, (smashing language barriers).
weaknesses: You can only turn into any primate you know; you might want to take up primatology, or be limited.
You can only gain the animal's ability when you turn into that animal.
You cannot talk to humans because your voicebox cannot create human sounds

name: Myth Power: Sirius' Service
description: Sirius (Sirios, Seirios), in Greek myth, was the god of the Dog Star and the scorching heat of midsummer. As such, channeling him allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking the effects of a summer day's intense heat, at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of dog (or weredog), at will (others, by touch). One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic dogs, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Sirius' command over the essence of the Dog Star and the scorching heat of midsummer
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking the intense heat of a summer day
Psychically perceive, communicate with, command and mimic dogs; turn self/others into dogs/weredogs
weaknesses: Pro #3 used, when used on others, always requires touch (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a dog-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot use star-based and dog-based parts of the power at the same time, until developed (NCN)

name: Spawn: Roman Armory
description: With this ability you are able to spawn roman armories, these armories are fully stocked with roman weapons, so any other weapon other than the roman culture (Greek swords,etc.)
summary: The ability to spawn unlimited amounts of roman armories.
strengths: Very strong weapons.
weaknesses: Some weapons are cursed...
They are very short swords or daggers.
Imperial Gold isn't always a good thing.

name: Aeon
description: The ability to summon and dismiss any of the eight Aeons from the game Final Fantasy X. The strength of the Aeons is equal to what the summoner is able to control, and the Aeons can be trained to improve their skills. If the Aeon dies, the summoner must wait 24 hours before the Aeon is able to be summoned again. The Aeon's overdrives must be charged by using the Aeons. When overdrive is used, it desummons the Aeon for the next 24 hours.
summary: The ability to summon the Aeons from final fantasy X.
strengths: Eight summons.
Aeons cannot be killed permanently.
Overdrives are the ultimate techniques.
weaknesses: Have to have power and skill to train Aeons to use their full potential.
After using overdrive or dieing, an Aeon is unuseable for 24 hours.
Must have knowledge from the Final Fantasy X game to use it.

name: Edible Cloud Amplification
description: This ability allows you to injest clouds and gain different boosts of energy. This all depends on the cloud type, though. For instance, a stratus cloud will boost your knowledge, while a cirrus cloud boosts your speed, and so on. More or less, eating the clouds will give you superhuman abilities. Also, you can eat the clouds from the ground. You just have to inhale a lot and have powerful lungs.
summary: The ability to eat clouds and gain different boosts of energy.
strengths: Superhuman abilities are given to those who eat the clouds.
Can give boosts in strength, speed, knowledge, etc.
You get something to eat all the time.
weaknesses: Some days don't have any clouds in the sky.
You run out of breath when using the power.
Must have powerful lungs to use the ability.

name: Master Of The Monkeys
description: When desired you are able to telepathically summon your personal army of 10000 monkeys to defeat your opponent.
summary: The ability to summon an army of monkeys at will.
strengths: You defeat people with your monkey army
You are able to call more monkeys to assist you from nearby zoos and jungles
Monkeys can help you with daily life e. G. Shopping, saving places/seats etc
weaknesses: The mokeys are evil and may turn against you.
You are resposible for keeping these monkeys alive and sheltered, which will be hard.
You have to clear up the monkey doo doo.

name: Metal Men Summon
description: With this power you can summon the members of the DC superhero team the Metal Men. The Metal Men are not under your control but will probably help you if you're fighting crime. You can summon any version of the Metal Men from the comics, TV show etc. When you're done you can just send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon the Metal Men
strengths: You can summon the Metal Men
They will probably help you
You can send them back when you're done
weaknesses: If you're a villain they probably won't help you unless you trick them

name: Human Gaming Device
description: This power allows you to hold any game cartridge in your body and gain interesting powers. If, say, you had to put it the game cartridge in your neck, just by looking at a DS game card would allow you to put it in and gain powers. If you had a pokemon game, you would get a pokemon based on your personality.
summary: The ability to put a game cartridge in your body
strengths: Gain powers through games
Do a bunch of crazy stuff
weaknesses: Game cartridges may not last long

name: Whistler
description: This power endows you with the awareness of the battle between good and evil and the access to crucial and helpful information for either the good or evil side. If the balance is tipped, your alignment will change to match the losing side and the only information you have access to is for them. However, you can only talk in cryptic messages, which sometimes make sense if one has all the elements to understand them. This can be troublesome if you alone cannot use the information you have.
summary: The ability to maintain the balance between good and evil by giving each side valuable information
strengths: You are a precious ally to your side, and a dangerous enemy to the other side.
You have access to many useful information, as well as to whom it will be useful and how.
If one side dominates the other, you are a light of hope to the other side.
weaknesses: As long as you exist, neither side will win the battle. So, you're a hindrance to your side as well.
You can only talk in cryptics, even if you're not giving a relevant piece of information.
If you help too much, you are likely to tip the balance to the other side and change alignment.

name: Construction Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any kind of construction vehicles. You can summon cranes, dump trucks, bulldozers etc. You also know how to operate them and you can unsummon them when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon any construction vehicles
strengths: You can summon construction vehicles
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: Just because you know how to operate them doesn't mean you'll have any place to operate them in

name: Skeletal Weapons
description: If you really wanna get brutal and nasty, you may want to let out your inner arsenal--which is made from your bones of course. For example, you can wield a sword that you can pull out from your knee cap or you can use nunchucks that are made with your upper arm bones.
summary: The ability to wield weapons made from your bones.
strengths: Hidden weapons that pass metal scans
weaknesses: It can really, REALLY hurt.

name: Transformation:Masked Detective
description: The user is able to transform into the mysterious Masked Detective when he or she puts on the overcoat of the first Masked Detective. When the user transforms into the Masked Detective, the user will gain all the knowledge as well as detective skills from previous detectives who use to hold the mantle
summary: The ability to transform into the Masked Detective a detective with an experience of more than a 150 years
strengths: Reduce crime rate
Finish cases faster
Good at finding evidence
weaknesses: Tend to believe in conspiracies more often

name: Cloud Of Fire Smoke
description: This ability can be blown by smoke that looks like fire in the air and make music appear and a person to be calm
summary: The ability to make people calm and happy
strengths: Happy feeling
Munchies
And smile a lot
weaknesses: Get munchies
Get tired

name: Musical Marionette
description: This ability involves a form of mass hypnosis, however it is still restricted by space and does not last very long. Essentially it creates a short, mini-musical around the wielder, forcing any within range to follow along with their whims in a jolly song and dance routine.
summary: The ability to spontaneously burst into song and dance, and everybody in a ten-meter radius joins in
strengths: Creates a great distraction
Humiliates enemies caught within range
Lifts moods
weaknesses: Not everyone can sing or dance
Can ruin a good night's sleep
Laryngitis

name: Flag Empowerment
description: The thing about Flag Empowerment is that, once you touch any colored state or even a country flag, you gain your own personal power. Example: If you touch an American flag, you'll have patriotic powers, Canadian flag - Electromagnetism.
summary: The ability to gain new abilities by touching any flag.
strengths: Touching any flag will grant you a new perspective by becoming a worldwide hero.
You can wear mini-flags as clothing and pins, drape a flag around you or use a flag as a cape
You can wear clothing with the motif of a flag.
weaknesses: If you touched a flag with a Pirate logo on it, you'll become corrupted.
If you touched a flag with a Nazi symbol on it, you'll become consumed with extreme hatred.

name: Severe Boomerangs
description: A person creates them from power of their mind. They appear in the person's hand, the person throws them at the target (or targets) causing the target or targets to have a headache, feel largely exhausted, and see 6 of the same person, or persons, with the whole dizzy feeling.
summary: The ability to project severe boomerangs
strengths: No need for guns when you have this deadly arsenal
Make Fools of Terrorists, Drug Lords, Dictators, and other deplorable Miscreants
Anything but ordinary boomerangs
weaknesses: People might get carried away using out of spite

name: Arm Duplication
description: With this power, you can make arms sprout from your body anywhere.
summary: The ability to duplicate your arms all over your body.
strengths: Do lots of things at once.
The arms are super-stretchy.
Dress up as a hand-covered monster for Halloween & save money.
weaknesses: You can only sprout arms on your body & nowhere else.
Con #1 also gives you a limited number of arms.
Practically useless in a battle.

name: Enhancement: Healing (B)
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. While attached, it changes the effect of the power to cause it to heal physical bodies instead of the original effect. Can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to change the effect of a power to healing physical bodies
strengths: Easy to do mass healings with Omni-Directional Blast.
Destructive powers can now have a second use.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
A fireball that heals might be a little odd.

name: Superhuman Summon
description: With this power you can summon any superhuman that you've ever met personally. Wether it be superpowered allies to fight crime. Or superpowered enemies to put them in prison or for combat practice. Or just superpowered people to show off your friends. You are not able to send the superhumans back unless they want to go back.
summary: The ability to summon any superhuman that you've ever met
strengths: You can summon any superhuman that you've ever met
Can summon superpowered help
Can summon superpowered enemies so you can put them in jail
weaknesses: You cannot send the back unless they want to go back
They might be angry at you for summoning them

name: Rise Of The Centaur
description: With this power you can turn into a centaur in order to fight or commit crimes. In centaur form you have powerful legs so you can run fast, jump high and have a powerful kick.
summary: The ability to turn into a centaur
strengths: You can turn into a centaur
You have powerful legs for running, jumping and kicking
weaknesses: You have a weakness for carrots and apples

name: Pheromone Immunity
description: Pheromones have abolutely no effect on someone with this power.
summary: The ability to be completely unaffected by pheromones
strengths: Can't be seduced with pheromones.
weaknesses: Colognes and perfumes are meaningless to you.

name: Interperson Teleportation
description: With this ability, you can teleport anybody to the location of anybody else. The only restriction is you can only teleport one person at a time. You can send anyone and anything that will move they are touching. Larger masses, such as vehicles, require more experience.
summary: The ability to teleport people to the location of other people.
strengths: Enter an environment only you can survive (equipment, powers, etc) and teleport enemies to you.
Travel to overseas friends.
Send someone else to a person's location.
weaknesses: Must have someone present at destination.
May be suspicious to some.
May be hard to focus on an individual if you do not know them well (appearance, name, etc).

name: One Handed
description: You can do anything you could do normally with two hands with only one hand, with your strength, speed, and dexterity boosting accordingly. Can do twice as many things as you could normally do with your hands at any given time. Using both your hands for the same thing causes your power to fade, although you can avoid this by thinking that you're doing two separate things (instead of thinking"I'm gonna lift it with two hands" think"I'm gonna lift a side with one hand and a side with the other").
summary: The ability to be a master at doing things with only one hand
strengths: Can do different things with one hand each, even that which should be impossible with only one hand
Not just physical strength; everything, even powers that are used through the hands, are affected
If you lose an arm, it won't ruin your life
weaknesses: You have to be able to mentally multi-task to use both hands
Must do a bit of thinking if attempting to use two-hands for the same thing
If both your arms are lost, this power becomes worthless

name: Raindrop Walking
description: With this power the user can enter a raindrop and exit through any other raindrop falling from the same rainstorm that they so choose. The transportation is instant, like stepping though a doorway, and you don't even have to step all the way though. When you only go partially though a pair of raindrops, say by just sticking your arm though, then the raindrops it entered and exited from will remain hanging in the air until the user pulls their arm back or steps all the way through.
summary: The ability to teleport though raindrops.
strengths: Travel quickly while it's raining.
Engage enemies from multiple, unpredictable directions.
weaknesses: Power only works while it's raining.
You will always get wet.
Can only enter and exit airborne raindrops.

name: Rise Of The Yeti
description: With this power, whenever you're in trouble, you can just into the super powerful Yeti of the Himalayans to fight crime.
summary: The ability to turn into a yeti at will.
strengths: you are super strong
You're always warm in yeti form because of all of that fur
weaknesses: People might mistake you for a monster and attack you

name: Negative Power Boost
description: This power is very similar to Negated Superman. However, instead of increasing your strength, durability and speed while giving you flight, this enhances the powers which still function. Powers are boosted exponentially, just like your stats with Negated Superman. When you use a functioning power, it will utilize the total available power boost, unless there are multiple powers in use, in which case they are boosted evenly.
summary: The ability to amplify your powers when other powers are negated.
strengths: Your enemies will fear blocking your powers.
Enhance your functioning powers when your others are blocked.
Pairs well with Negated Superman.
weaknesses: You need a few other powers.
When your powers return, your "boosts" go away.
If you lose all your powers, this power is useless.

name: Enhancement: Purifying (P)
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the power physically purifies what it affects. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to physically purify what a power affects
strengths: Purify water without expensive equipment.
Get rid of harmful parasites.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.

name: Cerulean Power Ring
description: The user is able to shoot bolts/beams of energy as well as constructs made out of the energy of pure friendship. The weakness of the cerulean power ring is the power of envy. This power ring also makes friendship amongst friends grow more and more. The giant cerulean diamond of friendship is used to recharge energy to all the rings across the galaxy. The ring is only given to people that are pure in their endeavor to make friends.
summary: The ability to use the mysterious cerulean power of friendship
strengths: Can make construct out of pure friendship energy
Can shoot bolts and beams of energy
Can form forcefields
weaknesses: Weak against the power of envy
Must recharge the ring

name: Goldworks: Anansi's Spider
description: An ancient African story is one of Anansi the Spider. Anansi asked the spirits to give him the power of storytelling. The spirits agreed to give the spider the power if he captured three trouble-makers: the Python, the Leopard, and the Hornet. After doing this, he was granted the power of storytelling, through the power of illusion. Anansi focused this gift into a small golden spider statue. The wielder of this gains the power of illusion, and the ability to walk on vertical surfaces.
summary: The ability to wield the Spider of Anansi
strengths: Casting illusions and wallcrawling
You can also cause the spider to vanish, while still using it's powers
The spider's powers protect it, so it cannot be destroyed
weaknesses: The spider can be stolen and used by others.
Illusions are still just illusions

name: Random Ability Activation
description: With this ability you can cause your powers to activate in a random order at will. This power can be turned off and on at will. The powers will activate in an unpredictable order so that no one would be able to predict your moves. The order of the powers that activate for a person are unable to be predicted unless probability manipulation is used. If an opponent copies this power it will be unable to be turned off for them.
summary: The ability to cause your abilities to activate in a random order.
strengths: Become unpredictable with your powers activating at random.
If this power is copied, your opponent will have their powers activate at random.
More than one power can become active at one time.
weaknesses: Unable to predict yourself which power you will have at what time.
Could be stuck with terrible powers for a length of time.
Probability manipulation can cause the unpredictable side of the power to not function.

name: Day Planner
description: This power isn't time travel,time frame erasing,time skipping or a schrodinger's cat affect. It's the ability to create a personal timeline that only temporarily connects with this one on the named day of your choice. Monday,Leap Day- any day on the calendar with the word day in it. You could live every saturday to every saturday. If you get bored with the day your living you can choose another. Someone who controls timelines could force you from your personal timeline. You will age normally.
summary: The ability to make all the days of the week you live any one day you choose.
strengths: See the far future by choosing Leap Day.
You love fireworks choose independence Day.
weaknesses: You could lose will track of important events that happen.
You can't hold a job. Your'e either very wealthy or homeless.

name: Tyr's Hand
description: In Norse mythology Tyr helped subdue Fenrir the giant wolf by putting his hand in the wolf's mouth so the wolf would allow them to bind it with an enchanted ribbon. You defeated the wolf who managed to escape by Loki's help and got the hand of Tyr out of it. You can now summon the wolf and have it fight for you anytime you want.
summary: The ability to control the hand of Tyr.
strengths: You have a giant wolf to help you
You can control the wolf
He works as a horse too
weaknesses: Pulling out a hand in the middle of battle might be a little odd.
He might turn on you.
Giving him baths is very hard.

name: Living Clothes
description: Clothing will only resemble actual living creatures if it is shaped like one. When it's not fed, the creature will hibernate until it is worn, at which point it becomes a parasite and feeds off of the host until they've eaten sufficiently. However, it will enhance body functions like respiration and immunity.
summary: The ability to turn clothing into living creatures
strengths: Clothing is still wearable
Will benefit the host while acting as a parasite
Each can have an ability given to it by its creator
weaknesses: Reduces Stamina when acting as a parasite
Feeds off of fabrics
Cannot be turned back into regular clothing

name: Stature Limiter
description: A person with this power can prevent anyone from achieving a height above your waist level. You are immune to this power. This is the dream of every egotistical or sadistic person. You can defeat opponents in the cheapest ways possible such as kicking in the face or stomping while they have a hard time trying to hit you since they can't stand up to move. You can use this when playing sports to always have a height advantage. If someone is naturally shorter than your waist they can move regularly
summary: The ability to make anyone around you lower their stature to below your waist level
strengths: Everyone bows before you
Win in sports with height advantage
You are hard to fight
weaknesses: Someone naturally short will be immune to this power (unless you lie down)
If you are naturally tall
You might have sadistic tendencies or arrogance

name: Interdimensional Bolt Monster
description: You need to read the power "Interdimensional Hand Monster" to understand this power. This is a similar power, but instead, it involves a crossbow. When you activate this ability, a crossbow will materialise in your hands. You start by preparing the crossbow to fire. You will be shooting nothing, but when you fire "the bolt of nothing", an orange spherical monster slips into our dimension. It will take the target into another dimension, with the same rules as the Hand Monster.
summary: The ability to fire a small monster using a special crossbow
strengths: Fire a small monster at a target by firing nothing.
The monster will pull the target into the dimesion it came from.
Crossbows are AWESOME!
weaknesses: Bounces off walls
Monster is small, so gigantic targets may not be an option.
Crossbows are hard to set up

name: Baconus Createus
description: You can finally have any type of bacon at any time.
summary: The ability to make bacon out of mid air
strengths: Good Bacon
weaknesses: You may not like Bacon.

name: Giraffe Mimicry
description: With this power you have all of the abilities of a giraffe including enhanced speed, the ability to elongate your neck, the ability to cause brown spots to appear all of your body (giraffes make the spots appear and disappear but whatever) and powerful legs for kicking.
summary: The ability to have all of the abilities of a giraffe
strengths: You have all of the abilities of a giraffe
weaknesses: You can't actually turn into a giraffe with this power

name: Rise Of The Omnidroid
description: With this power you can turn into the Omnidroid, a giant war machine that is constantly learning things about its surroundings and its opponents and using this knowledge to defeat it's enemies. In Omnidroid form you can shoot lasers from your eye and turn yourself into a giant buzz saw. You also have super strength.
summary: The ability to turn into the Omnidroid from the Incredibles
strengths: You can turn into the super smart Omnidroid
You can shoot lasers from your eye
Your super strong.
weaknesses: You are not invincible and can be defeated

name: Basilisk Summoning
description: This abillity is fun to use and control. With this ability, you can summon any of the characters in Basilisk. They will do what you want, fight for you and even die for you, and some of them will fall in love with you.
summary: The ability to summon and control the Basilisk characters
strengths: The description says it all
The Basilisk characters might fall in love with you, like Oboro.
You are the leader
weaknesses: There might be mutiny
Some of them will try to kill you
You cannot be bossy to them

name: Why So Serious? :D
description: You release an aerial chemical in the air that makes people's facial muscle tighten at mouth area to form a huge grinning smile. It'll be like having a permanent botox-injected smile.
summary: The ability to make people have a perma-grin smile.
strengths: Make people smile forever.
weaknesses: Will never know by face if someone is sad or angry.
Could make eating, drinking and talking difficult.

name: Robo Spiders
description: Have up too 10,000 spiders at one time. They come out of your hand. They are the size of a quarter and have cords for webs that conduct electricity. They can join together.
summary: The ability to summon and control robot mutant spiders
strengths: You can tie up your enemy in cord then electricute them
They are very fast
weaknesses: They can get squished easily because of their size

name: Myth Power: Styx Bond
description: Styx, in Greek myth, was the goddess of hatred, and Styx the Underworld River of Hate, by which the gods swore. As such, channeling her allows one to induce hatred at will. In addition, one is empowered by others' naturally occurring hate. Furthermore, one can subconsciously bend chance to his will, to fulfill any promise one makes, no matter what (in physical and mental capacity). And if others fail promises to the user, they instantly die (or are snatched up by the Furies into the underworld).
summary: The ability to channel Styx's command over the essence of hatred and the oath-binding Underworld River Styx
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, redirect, gain physical power from and negate hatred at will
Subconsicously manipulate chance to fulfill any promise in capacity (make it anywhere on time, etc)
If people go back on their word, they die, or get hoisted off to the Underworld (you choose)
weaknesses: Sometimes you can't choose to excuse broken promises
Can't apply Pro #2 to loved ones and allies until the higher levels (Con #1 becomes a real problem)
People with MythPowers based on Styx or Styx's Children (Cratos, Bia, Nike, Zelos) are immune

name: Playground Creation
description: Playgrounds are great. Kids love them, and they give parents a chance to catch their breath while still keeping a watchful eye. When you use this power, the selected space is cleared, and you then need to visualize the playground you want to create. The playgrounds DO NOT need to be realistic, but must still obey the laws of the universe, such as gravity.
summary: The ability to create any sort of playground.
strengths: Playgrounds are a great contribution to society.
Playgrounds can be removed at will, making for great temporary shelter.
weaknesses: Playgrounds can be removed against your will

name: Rise Of The Demon
description: With this power you can turn into a powerful fire breathing demon at will
summary: The ability to change into a demon at will
strengths: Scare enemies
Super strong
Breath fire
weaknesses: Sometimes the change happens unexpectedly and against your will
Sometimes the demon gains a mind of it's own

name: Pen Spawning
description: If you find yourself without a pen, you can automatically spawn one somewhere on you/in a pocket. Useful if you need to write something down. Doesn't provide paper.
summary: The ability to always have a pen
strengths: You always have a pen.
weaknesses: Doesn't provide paper.

name: Myth Power: Hygeia's Hand
description: Hygeia (Hygea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of good health and hygiene. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, repel and kill bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, at will. In addition, one can psychically produce a forcefield, which repels any projectile or attack with pathogens on it, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce a severe germophobia (fear of germs) in subjects, by touch, at will. One can even totally withstand pathogen-based illness and poisoning.
summary: The ability to channel Hygeia's command over the essence of good health and hygiene
strengths: Psychically perceive, repel and kill bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, at will
Psychically produce an anti-pathogen forcefield (keeps out nearly any physical attack) at will
Psychically turn foes into extreme germophobe; immunity to sickness, disease and poisoning
weaknesses: Sanitized and non-physical (energy-based, psychic) attacks can bypass anti-pathogen forcefield (NCN)
Cannot gain Immune Immortality (soul 'infects' ally, sneezed out as new body) until developed (NCN)
Medical/healing/restorative MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Detection Detection
description: Ever wondered if someone is using their powers to spy on you? With this power, you can sense when someone is using powers to obtain information about subjects within 25 kilometers of you. At first you only know when it is happening, but with practice you can detect users, acquired information, locations of users, powers used and more.
summary: The ability to detect detection powers.
strengths: Know when being spied upon with powers.
Large area of effect.
Works on targets no matter the range, provided they use a power within your effective range.
weaknesses: Less useful when inexperienced.
Information may not be useful to you.
Only affects detection powers; not other powers.

name: Nebula Manipulation
description: The user can generate and manipulate nebulas, multi-colored clouds of dust and ionized gases from where planets and stars are born. The nebulas themselves can be shot at foes to envelope them in a suffocating, burning dust cloud, as well as create small-scale planets and stars. These can be manipulated like the nebulas. Planets are essentially rocks with molten cores, while stars are of course burning balls of incredible nuclear energy. Needless to say, they make for powerful projectile attacks.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate nebulas, the clouds which form planets and stars.
strengths: Create beautiful, multicolored clouds of burning dust and gas
Create planets and stars of varying sizes from nebulas for various purposes
You're immune to the effects of the nebula (burning, suffocation, etc. )
weaknesses: Can only create enough nebula to fill the average ballroom, and are exhausted upon doing such a feat
You're not immune to the effects of the planets and stars you create

name: Whd's Xia
description: Youxia is the wandering force; she is a cane wielding, ethereal, godlike being capable of granting you your 25 most desired powers. These powers come at a price. You are forever her herald. She will dictate to you how your life will be led. You will be known only as Wuxia. You must entreaty her for each power you wish to possess, she must approve of the causes you fight for and the direction of your life.
summary: The ability to gain complex powers from the wandering force
strengths: You could have every one of your desired powers
If worthy of Youxia you receive much more than one power
Every 25 days you receive all 25 noble powers at once without asking for a full day
weaknesses: Does not grant basic powers (flight, strength, speed) specify the powers or Youxia canes you
Embarrass her or lose a fight or dishonoring your gifts gets you caned on the head & powers robbed
Youxia allows you to lose fights and power before she canes you then fights in you place

name: Sore Loser
description: Whenever any person is playing any game, you can force them to lose it. Anything from chess to lacrosse to a Battle of the Bands is game.
summary: The ability to make anybody lose in any game
strengths: People you hate can lose no matter what
weaknesses: Can go too far with it
Does not protect you from being beaten up

name: Reincarnation 5: Soul Link
description: This power has three good purposes. First, all those linked can mentally communicate. Second, they can each find each other unless they do not wish to be found. Thirdly, if one member of the group is still attached to the world, the others will be too. The dead are in the form of ghosts, unable to be seen by many outside the group. There is no limit to the number of people possible to put in this group. If the owner dies, they are all still connected, but they cannot get new members.
summary: The ability to link the souls of a team.
strengths: As long as one member's soul is still attached to the world, they all are.
Can all mentally communicate.
Can all find each other.
weaknesses: Need one member to remain attached to the world, if only through objects.
Useless without a few members.
If the owner of this power dies, they group can't get more members.

name: Myth Power: Nemesis Indignation
description: Nemesis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of divine indignation and retribution (hatred of, and punishment for, injustice). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' overall moral alignment (and past actions reflecting those morals), by touch or thought. In addition, one can psychically perceive the foe's most recent evil act, and inflict misfortune according to the act's severity, by touch. One can even psychically summon an indestructible, prehensile bullwhip at will.
summary: The ability to channel Nemesis' command over the essence of divine indignation and retribution
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' overall moral alignment (and past actions reflecting those morals)
Psychically perceive foe's most recent evil act, and inflict misfortune/harm based on act's severity
Psychically summon an indestructible, prehensile (grabbing) bullwhip at will
weaknesses: Only show foes their past evil actions, by touch/eye contact, to drive them mad when developed (NCN)
Presence does not intimidate evil foes, do not gain power against evil foes until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night-Shift, Zeus' Zenith and honestly-good moral alignment provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Phonos' Focus
description: Phonos (Phonus) and the Phonoi, in Greek myth, were the gods of murder, killing and slaughter. As such, channeling them allows one to generate a murderous impulse within others' minds, or quell this urge, by touch, word or thought. In addition, one gains a masterful knowledge of the arts of murder and assassination. One can even psychically perceive whenever a person is murdered in their radius, and who the murderer is (this radius is increased if one's loved ones are somehow involved).
summary: The ability to channel Phonos and the Phonoi's command over the essence of murder and the murder impulse
strengths: Fill subjects with the impulse to kill (and decide who the impulse is directed toward)
Quell the murder impulse within anyone (whether or not their impulse was caused by you)
Perceive any murder in radius (and see through the eyes of killers or their victims)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon common killing tools/weapons/implements until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Asclepius' Effect provides immunity allows one to disrupt this ability (NCN)
MythPower: Ker's Curse and MythPower: Thanatos' Threat provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons1)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Cheimon (Kheimon- Winter) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth winter weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally winter. Furthermore, one can withstand cold. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of winter at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth winter weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally winter; withstand cold
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of winter
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past winters until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL winter until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to cold/winter provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Oizys' Omen
description: Oizys, in Greek myth, was the goddess of misery, suffering, sadness and woe. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive, induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand feelings of sadness and suffering at will. In addition, one may gain physical power in the presence of 'natural' sadness, misery and suffering. Furthermore, one may withstand and negate happiness or sadness based abilities. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those currently feeling sad or miserable.
summary: The ability to channel Oizys' command over the essence of misery, sadness and woe
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand sadness at will; empowered by others' true sadness
Withstand and negate happiness or sadness based abilities
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those currently experiencing feelings of sadness
weaknesses: Cannot transfer one's own sadness onto others until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot choose to take on others' suffering or sadness until the higher levels (NCN)
Aniothability and sadness/grief/misery-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Closed Book Reading
description: You would have the power to read books which are closed. You could read any book without ever touching it.
summary: The ability to read closed books.
strengths: No tired arms or sore necks.
No page turning.
Read in secret.
weaknesses: Still read at a normal pace.
Not incredibly useful?
Can't see through anything else.

name: 4 To Go V2
description: With this power you can point at someone and say the name of a place or an address and the person will automatically do anything in their power to get to that place. You can cause villains to go to prisons or make people spend all their money on expensive plane tickets etc.
summary: The ability to make people go anywhere
strengths: You can make people go places
weaknesses: You have to point at them

name: Claymore: Terracotta Army
description: This gives you a set of claymores; with these claymores you can summon and command the terracotta army with your mind. The army consists of eight thousand soldiers, a hundred and thirty chariots, five hundred and twenty horses, and one hundred and fifty cavalry horses. In other words, you have a massive army, but they are not immortal. The claymore looks like William Wallis' claymore.
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can summon and command the terracotta army
strengths: You have a massive army.
The claymore can be used as a weapon
They are under you full command
weaknesses: you can only have one claymore ( no con negation )
They are not immortal
They can only kill spirits.

name: Craft Semivif Servants
description: When you use this power, you can painlessly cut parts from yourself (which will grow back in a day) to use as crafting materials to make semivif servants. Semivif look like stringless marionettes made of human body parts. They are neither dead or alive or undead, thus powers that affect living things or (un)dead things can't work on them. They never heal nor do healing powers affect them. They can be repaired. Semivif have the intelligence of a child but are very strong. They never fatigue.
summary: The ability to craft servants from your own body that aren't truly alive, dead or undead.
strengths: Undying, strong, tireless servants.
weaknesses: Commands must be kept simple.
You can't make new servants if you are always repairing the ones you have.
People may think this is a disgusting power and stay away from you.

name: 1000 Eyes
description: You are able to place your "eyeballs" anywhere in the world. They can then see anywhere or anything you wish. Perfect for gathering information, or just keeping an eye on things in general.
summary: The ability to place eyeballs anywhere you go, so you can see any location at any time.
strengths: Practically omnipresent
Can gather information about anyone anywhere
weaknesses: Eyeballs can be stolen
Have to physically place them places yourself

name: Artifact: Sica Shishikushiro
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a sword appears. You can split this sword into 15 copies and control them in anyway you want.
summary: The ability to summon a blade and clone it into 15 copies.
strengths: Can fight multiple people at the same time.
Can hit a target more than once.
Have extra weapons just in case one gets broken.
weaknesses: Takes concentration to control all of them at once.
You may have more swords than you know what to do with.

name: Thumb Drive
description: Sometimes, USB flash drives are referred to as "thumb drives." Well, with this ability, that's just what you'd have. Your fingers and thumb can temporarily change in shape to fit any removable storage port, including USB and firewire! You can copy data to and from each finger, storing a maximum of 200 TB (200,000 GB) per finger (that's about 50,000 movies). So, you'll never lose your precious docs, but be careful in the kitchen--cutting off even the tip of your finger makes that drive unusable.
summary: The ability to plug your fingers into any device and store data on them
strengths: You can store a crapload of data on your fingers (music, docs, movies, etc)
Nerds will find your data storing powers sexy
Your "special" movie collection is always readily available
weaknesses: Cutting of part of your finger kills that finger's storage capabilities
No protection from viruses
You need to keep your finger in the port to use it

name: Lazarus Egg
description: It has the ability to permanently heal the injuries of another, revitalize anyone's youth, and in many cases, resurrect the dead. For maximum efficiency, a side effect, unlikely however, was that it will make you clinically insane.
summary: The ability to use it for healing and extended life.
strengths: Could be a use for healing and resurrecting yourself and others.
weaknesses: It can make go you insane once you are healed or brought back from the dead.

name: Needle Grass
description: When this power is activated, every grass in your surrounding straightens up and becomes as hard and as sharp as a metallic needle. Fortunately for you, the grasses against which you're are pressing will soften so you can't get hurt. With enough experience, you can affect a specific area of grass with your power. It doesn't work on artificial turf.
summary: The ability to cause grasses to be as sharp as needles
strengths: Your enemies are going to hate fighting on a lawn
A perfect partner for a user with a plant growth inducing ability.
weaknesses: Urbanization makes areas of grass rarer, so you have to become more environmentally aware
Fighting against a flying enemy or a witherer

name: 50 Orbs Of Life'
description: You can summon 50 orbs that contain the power of 50 lives (that's 1 life per orb). The power in each orb is used to boost your other powers beyond their normal maximums. TABOO: You cannot use so much power from an orb that you kill the one from whom the orb draws its power otherwise you will lose all your powers and be banned from ever having powers again. NOTE: If you drain the majority of the power from one of the orbs (50%-99%), it takes one week for the orb to reach full power again.
summary: The ability to summon 50 orbs that contain the power of 50 lives in them
strengths: Have the power of 50 lives at your fingertips. May be con if you forget about the taboo.
Can use the power to temporarily boost your powers.
Orbs have full power after 8 hours unless 50%-99% of power was used.
weaknesses: Useless unless you have other powers.
If the person an orb drains from dies by some other cause, you do not get a new orb.
Con Negation and other alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Myth Power: Myiagros' Meaning
description: Myiagros (Myiagrus, Myagros, Myagrus, Myiagron, Myodes, Myiodes, Achor, Achoros, Achorus, Akhoros) in Greek myth, was the god of flies and mice. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command flies and mice at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a fly or mouse at will. Furthermore, one can project the illusory buzzing of flies or squeaking of mice into foes' minds, or ones' own mind (ie block telepathy), at will.
summary: The ability to channel Myiagros' command over the essence of flies and mice
strengths: Perceive, communicate with, command and mimic powers of flies and mice
Psychically project the buzzing of flies, squeaking of mice into foes minds (scare, distract, etc)
Psychically produce the buzzing of flies, squeaking of mice in one's own mind (block telepathy, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot astral-project a swarm of spirit-flies at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a swarm of flies at will (others, by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Fly-Swarm Immortality (spirit-flies released to form new body) until developed (NCN)

name: Prehensile Tail
description: This ability gives the user a tail. This tail is pretty much as good as a hand. When first obtained, the user will hear a deep voice asking what your tail will feel like. The most simple choices are; Scaly, Furry and Skin. This will not affect the power except. From fur, which allows the user to speak fluent gorilla.
summary: The ability to have a tail that acts like a hand.
strengths: Speak Gorilla!
Power can't be stolen!
You can swing from tree to tree, or lamp post to lamp post!
weaknesses: May be laughed at for having a tail.
Clothing problems...
Being shot at... More to shoot...

name: Hand Of Galochio
description: Upon summoning, a large hand will appear from the nearest body of water to assist you. It can grab and drown enemies, blast high-pressured water, push you out of the depths, turn to ice in cold weather, and do a bunch more.  If the moon phase is 'new', the Hand of Galochio will be extremely weak; if the moon phase is 'full', the Hand will be very powerful. You must be near water to perform the summon.
summary: The ability to summon a nonsentient hand made of water
strengths: Doesn't require concentration after summoning
Can appear from any source of water
Cannot be harmed by physical attacks
weaknesses: Must be near water to summon at all
Moon phase affects strength

name: Quartz Bridging
description: This power allows its user to generate a "bridge" or binding of quartz between any two objects. To bridge the two objects the user must be in physical contact with one or both objects. There is no upper or lower limit to the size of the two bridged objects. The quartz bridge can be strengthened b prolonged contact.
summary: The ability to bridge any two objects with a quartz binding
strengths: Bind object together
Create new paths or blockades with a touch
Incapacitate enemies by binding them to other objects
weaknesses: It takes a few second for the bridge to form
Physical contact is required

name: Celeb Shift
description: With this power you can turn into any famous person including athletes, writers, movie stars, singers, actors, producers, comedians, animators, artists, coaches, inventors, developers etc. As long as they're still alive when you're using the power
summary: The ability to turn into any celebrity
strengths: You can get into Hollywood parties
You can get into almost anything if you turn into the right person
weaknesses: People might realize that you're not the real deal

name: Conditional Immortality
description: You can't die, but this immortality comes with a price. You have to be the servant of a family until they deem that you served them well. Deeming that you have done well is only done by saying, "You have done the best work you can". Nothing more than or les than that. However, you have to serve seven families total before you're free to do as you like.
summary: The ability to have immortality at a price
strengths: You can't die.
weaknesses: You're someone else's servant at least seven times (depends on whether the person releases you).
Very specific phrase for release.
You could be serving for all of eternity for a family.

name: Were Hyena
description: When you are bitten by a cursed hyena, you can transform by laughing real hard by night (you cannot even stop yourself from doing it). You'll forever be a cannibalistic monster which terrorizes people, especially lovers.
summary: The ability to shape-shift into an anthropomorphic hyena.
strengths: You could mesmerise victims with your eyes or sometimes with your pheromones.
Become a blood-thirsty anti-hero or a sarcastic villain.
weaknesses: You can't stop youself from laughing real hard when transforming.
Can be a threat to both good and evil alike.

name: Bloodline (Unique Version)
description: This power reverses the powers when they are given to the inheritor except for itself. E.g. fire to ice, absorb to reflect. 2 cL of blood must be consumed for transfer. This power can only be used 10 times and you still have powers after transfer. Your powers are also unstealable and unmimicable. This power is unnegatable, but can be done against your will.
summary: The ability to pass along an opposite version of one's powers by way of blood
strengths: Different set of powers for inheritor.
Doesn't require much blood.
weaknesses: One power can have multiple opposites.
Vampires and dhampires.
This power could be altered.

name: Soleil (Sun)
description: One is able to control the power of the sun through the eyes using glasses as a medium to control the amount emitted. Power only for ladybug hybrids
summary: The ability to utilize solar energy from eyes utilizing glasses
strengths: Control the power of the sun
Reduce enemies to a crisp
Can destroy a continent
weaknesses: Need glasses in order to control power
If glasses are lost, so is loss in control
Can destroy a continent

name: Home Planet Shift
description: Whenever you use this power you are teleported to a lifeless part of your universe and you turn into an exact copy of your home planet with exact copies of all of the people and places from your home world. The clones are exactly identical to the originals, except there is no clone of you. You control all the clones and things that happen on your world. You can control what people think, change the weather and cause natural disasters etc. When you're done you're sent back home and changed back.
summary: The ability to turn into a copy of your home planet
strengths: You can turn into an exact copy of your home planet and you control everything that happens on you
When you're done you're turned back to normal and sent back to your real home planet
weaknesses: You're not actually controlling people or things just clones of them

name: White Rhabdomyocyte Mimicry
description: Also called White Skeletal Myocyte Mimicry. As a type of Myocyte Mimic, you have the power to contract your body heightwise: your body and limbs become much shorter and fatter. In your case, you need to use sugar to do so, or be in the presence of a Hepatocyte Mimic. Electricity can force you to use this power. Your contraction speed is fast, your contraction strength is high and your body is extremely powerful, but you are very fast to fatigue and produce lactic acid which blocks this power.
summary: The ability to contract your body heightwise and be extremely good at power exercises.
strengths: By contracting your body, you can pull yourself up or be short enough to enter through low passages.
Your body is very powerful, so you can excell at any power exercises.
If you find a way to lock your feet in place, you can pull things down by grabbing them.
weaknesses: Once contracted, you'll stay that way until you find a way to stretch yourself.
You need to have access to a source of sugar to contract your body.
Your body produces lactic acid which counteracts this power. You need oxygen to neutralize it.

name: Finger Head Squisher
description: You know that thing where you close one eye and hold up two fingers in front of your face so it looks (to you) like you're holding someone's head, and then you pretend to crush their head between your fingers? Well, with this power, when you do that, the person's head will actually get squished. You're essentially breaking the laws of 3 dimensional reality with this, but at least your fingers won't get all gooey from it.
summary: The ability to crush people's heads from afar with your fingers
strengths: Pretty simple concept, and easy to do
Requires little concentration
Who's gonna know it was you?
weaknesses: You have to use your fingers
It may be difficult to squish moving head targets
You may accidentally kill people with this power if you forget you have it

name: Myth Power: Muses' Mastery
description: The Titan Muses (Mousai/Mousae/Musae Titanides), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of various aspects of music. As such, channeling Melete (Practice), one can psychically perceive physical and mental flaws and errors, at will. Channeling Aiode (Aeode- Song), one can psychically access Perfect Pitch, and generate musical notes to manipulate matter, at will. Channeling Mneme (Memory), one can psychically record and replay any audio, as well as recalling lyrics to any song they hear, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Titan Muses and their command over various aspects of music
strengths: Psychically perceive physical and mental (ie logical and strategic) flaws and errors, at will
Psychically access Perfect Pitch, generate music notes to manipulate matter (ie F for Fire), at will
Psychically recall/remember any song lyrics one hears, record/play any audio one hears, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically practice (no physical strain, gain skills faster), until develop (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where music is playing, until developed (NCN)
Sonic/music/song-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Photo Op
description: Ever forgotten your camera at the worst time? Like when your new child has just been born? Anniversary? Birthday? Just need a picture to remember the moment? With this power all you have to do is make a rectangle with your fore-fingers and thumbs and say 'click! ' The picture will be stored in your subconsciousness until you decide to print it by slowly sliding one hand over the other, developing and printing it perfectly just as it should be.
summary: The ability to take a picture anywhere without a camera.
strengths: Portable camera with no extra weight on your person.
Can be set to color or black and white with a thought.
Infinite space and battery
weaknesses: No flash or zoom.
Must have still hands.
Only standard photo size.

name: The Keyblade
description: Just like Sora from Kingdom Hearts, you too can wield a keyblade. As long as you have a strong heart, the keyblade will remain with you. You can unlock any door, unlock any chest; you can also lock things up.
summary: The ability to wield and use a keyblade
strengths: Able to unlock and lock anything with the keyblade
weaknesses: Keyblade will find another master, if your heart becomes weak

name: Card Immunity
description: Any power that has to do with cards won't affect you. This includes both negative and benificial effects.
summary: The ability to be immune to cards and card-based powers
strengths: No more getting paper cuts from cards!
weaknesses: For some versions this power applies only to cards OR card-based powers.

name: The Phonebooth
description: Imagine you're watching something on TV, and you want to warn the main character about a scheme, or confuse her with a red herring. Where would the plot spiral off to? How would it conclude? What would become of the main characters? Pick up any phone while watching TV, dial the character's name, and these scenarios need be speculation no more. Uses any phone near the character, mobile or otherwise (or even cartoon, if it's an animated film. Conversation with Pumbaa anyone?).
summary: The ability to interact with characters in a movie/on TV using a phone.
strengths: A lot of fun, as you can send the plot spinning wildly off.
Can have a conversation with your favourite characters.
Non-permanent changes. Each viewing will be normal until you call in.
weaknesses: Could ruin the suspense if you warned the character of a plot twist.
Would REALLY annoy/confuse people in the cinema!

name: Twilight Power:Tactile Telepathy
description: Can see all the thoughts someone has ever had upon physical contact with them. The longer the contact, the more the user is able to see others' thoughts, and memories.
summary: The ability to read ALL thoughts.
strengths: Read every thought someones ever had.
weaknesses: Requires physical contact.
You may need bodyguards.

name: Thirteen Treasures: White Hilt
description: One of the 13 treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When drawn from its scabbard by a well born man, or a man of royal blood, this sword will burst into flames from the hilt to the tip.
summary: The ability to wield White-hilt, the sword of Rhydderch the Generous
strengths: Evil Princes, Queens or Kings will not be able to wield this sword.
weaknesses: You can only wield this sword if you are low-born.
If you are able to wield this sword, it will not be on fire.

name: Summon Clarent
description: Carent is known as the blade that killed King Arthur, but few know that it is Excalibur's twin. With this power, you can summon Clarent and use its many powers. Clarent can shoot fire, burn any creature cut with it and absorb the most painful memories of anything killed with it, then transfer those memories to its user. It is also indestructible and can fuse with Excalibur to create new Ley Gates which are used as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the world.
summary: The ability to summon Clarent, the ancient stone blade of Fire.
strengths: Control of Fire
Can create Ley Gates
The Sword is indestructible.
weaknesses: Absorb the most painful memories of killed enemies.
The sword is evil and may corrupt you.

name: Enhancement: Reflecting
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power reflect alterations done to it back to the alterer to affect their powers. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This power CANNOT affect other enhancements.
summary: The ability to make a power unalterable by reflecting alterations sent by others
strengths: Karma will annoy your enemies.
The power this is attached to is 'unalterable'.
Ran out of room in cons: this power affects all alterations, good and bad.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Cannot be used on other enhancements. This cannot be negated by Con Negation.

name: Twilight Bracelet
description: The Twilight Bracelet has many different abilities. Data Drain sends a beam from the bracelet that rewrites the opponent's data, making them weaker, and extracts the excess data as a virus core. Drain Arc lets you do this on multiple targets. Gate hacking lets you use the virus cores to open a gate and travel to a different area in space. Continued use of the bracelet causes infection, with strong side effects, but the infection disappears after periods when the bracelet is not used.
summary: The ability to have the Twilight Bracelet, and its powers from the DotHack// series.
strengths: Data Drain foes to make them significantly weaker, and gain their virus cores.
Data Drain can remove things like Immorality and Invulnerability,as well as other significant powers
Gate Hacking allows travel to areas that are usually restricted.
weaknesses: Data Drain can be resisted by strong foes. (Can be countered by causing Protect Break)
High levels of infection can cause a person to reduce in level, enter a coma, or even die.
Data Drain, when used on others that are weak, can leave them in a coma.

name: Meibomian Gland Cell Mimicry
description: By consuming or absorbing fat through your skin, you can create an oily substance inside your body. When you've produced enough (about three quarters of your body volume), you can burst open and spread it in all directions. If it touches any water-based substance, it will spread across the entire surface and prevent water from escaping or changing state. Note that exploding would undeniably cost you your own life. However, as long as you're still alive, you can undergo mitosis, that is cloning
summary: The ability to produce an oily substance which traps water and prevents its movements, and explode to release it.
strengths: Oil-covered water is much more difficult to move, especially through supernatural means.
It can trap water in all its states, absorbing moisture in the air or preventing ice from thawing.
You can duplicate yourself before one of you explodes in order to survive (recommended).

name: The Demon Bloodline
description:
Only a selective few have this power in my fictional saga Eternal Myths. It can:
1. utilize the same properties as The Ultimate Light, only demonic versions.
2. automatically gives the user wings and horns.
3. allows anyone who comes into contact with it's DNA to possess the Demon Bloodline.
summary: The ability to possess demonic powers and to control the darkness
strengths: said to be one of the most powerful power
who needs fear of heights when you got demon wings
weaknesses: powerful negative forces will corrupt you
lack of control can cause global destruction

name: Tetris Rain
description: With this power, you can cause tetris blocks to rain from the sky around you. The tetris blocks can be rotated and moved telepathically. You do not choose the type of tetris block, but you can determine the size of the block. You can make it rain more than one block at once, though it is harder to control that many blocks. Anything caught within a row of tetris blocks will be destroyed like the video game.
summary: The ability to cause tetris blocks to rain from the sky
strengths: You can move the tetris blocks telepathically when they are still in the sky
You can walk on the tetris blocks with no problem
If the blocks create a row, anything within that row is destroyed, even non-blocks
weaknesses: The tetris blocks are not homing and need to be controlled
You cannot choose the shape of the tetris block
The longer you use this power, the higher you need to keep climbing

name: Human Fortress
description: While you look normal on the outside, you actually have an internal structure made of stone, similar to a fortress with passageways and rooms. Doors and windows of any size can be opened anywhere on your body. Whenever you allow someone or something to enter, they automatically shrink to half an inch on their way through the door. And whenever someone or something comes out of the fortress, they automatically return to their real size.
summary: The ability to be a human-size stone fortress for your allies.
strengths: You can become a headquarters, bunker and home for your allies.
While you look alone, you actually have an army with you.
You can store a lot of things in your body: animals, furnitures, weapons, food,...
weaknesses: Your body is VERY heavy.
If you move too quickly, it feels like an earthquake inside you.

name: Genre Savvy
description: A person with this power knows every single plot twist in the book and will not fall for them. For example, they immediately know when someone is under mind control and can see through disguises immediately. In addition they can exploit any trope that they find to great success. For example, if they save someone that person will eventually help him/her later etc. For more examples on how to use this power go to tvtropes.com
summary: The ability to be incredibly genre savvy
strengths: Don't fall for stupid plot twists
Come up with ideas that work due to the use of tropes
Don't have to obey the rules of plot
weaknesses: Not everyone listens to you

name: Clay Monster
description: With this ability your entire body is made out of clay.  You can twist, bend, and stretch yourself just like when making a pot out of clay. Of course you'd have to immerse yourself in water.  As dry clay you can deliver solid strong punches. However if you fall from a fair distance; you'd shatter like a ceramic plate.
summary: The ability to have your body be made entirely out of clay,
strengths: Bend, twist and stretch yourself like wet clay.
Deliver solid strong punches as dry clay.
Immune to dry and wet. All they do is alternate your strengths and weaknesses.
weaknesses: As dry clay, you'll shatter falling from a long distance. (Best to be wet. )
As wet clay, don't possess full strength as if your dry clay.
Can not change from wet to dry clay. Need to rely on a proportioned water supply.

name: Old One Power: Azathoth
description: Azathoth, the blind and mindless monarch of the Outer Gods. You can control the nuclear chaos to create blasts of potentially unlimited power. Even more potent is your ability to summon and command the Lesser Outer Gods. Dumb as bugs, but if you can get them to understand, their potency is unmatched by anything on Earth. They themselves are invincible, but they will flee if exposed to too much pain. If you use a flute, you can command stellar phenomenon, and gain much more control of your power.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Azathoth
strengths: Your offensive power is unbelievable if the opponent can't block or divert it.
You can also summon GODS at will! Muhahaha! Unfortunately, while friendly, they're entirely muscle.
For once, the granter of your powers does not care AT ALL what you do. Just don't summon him.
weaknesses: Your vision clouds as you use your power, and it's uncontrollable in the first place.
The Lesser Other Gods are horror incarnate, and WILL destroy anything you love if you're not careful
Might become a LOG when you die, going insane and becoming utterly mindless. Or you just die.

name: The Krusader
description: The krusader is a combined element of a sword and shield, and it can be used for defensive purposes, but is also used as a offensive tool, but you can even slash your opponents with the krusader in an upward swing, spin it circularly around you knocking the foe up into the air if it connects, and/or slightly forward and delivers an open horizontal slice to your enemy. Can even deflect bullets and other projectiles.
summary: The ability to use it for protection and to slash your opponents.
strengths: Can use it for defence & offence.
weaknesses: None.

name: Page Ripper
description: A person with this power has the ability to peel off words or images off a surface and carry it to put on another surface. In addition they can make a copy by peeling layers off the image. The ripped off images or words can then be placed on other surfaces to be kept. The user of this power can also take images off of glass and the quality of the picture would be the same as that of normally seeing through the glass
summary: The ability to cut or copy images or words off a surface then paste them onto another surface
strengths: Steal the words from a book or steal an image from a piece of art leaving it blank
No need to have a copier or a camera
You can store a lot of images by folding them up and then releasing them
weaknesses: You would be tempted to steal/forge artwork with this power

name: Yokai: Raiju
description: In Japanese mythology, the Raiju was recognized as a beast that fell to the earth as a lightning bolt. A raiju may appear as a giant weasel or a blue and white wolf wrapped in lightning or fire. As a raiju you are able to bound through the air crashing down upon your victims with a thunderous aftermath. Your claws also act as small lightning strikes.
summary: The ability to undergo a transformation into a Japanese monster or spirit.
strengths: Very destructive.
Strike down those who oppose you.
Let out thunderous howls that cause enemies to go deaf.
weaknesses: Could wipe out loved ones or friends that are in the way.

name: Uv Lycanthropy
description: When a werewolf sees the moon, he/she changes. Moonlight is reflected sunlight, so it is safe to say that that person would be a werewolf in the daytime as well. In order to be human, the person would have to be in an area that is not accessable by sunlight or moonlight (no UV rays).
summary: The ability to change to a werewolf when exposed to ultraviolet radiation
strengths: Increased strength
Increased senses
FREAKIN FUR!
weaknesses: You're almost always a wolf
Life as a shut in is boring
Fleas

name: Neurotoxic Breath
description: Neurotoxic breath can do a number of things. You can manipulate it to paralyze, burn, freeze, melt, and even kill. This power is controlled so you don't accidentally melt somebody's eyes while walking down the street. But the effects are only momentary. So if you kill somebody, they will be revived in a matter of time, it depends on how much poison they have inhaled.
summary: The ability to emit poisons from your mouth when you exhale.
strengths: Great defensive power.
Great offensive power.
weaknesses: Only a range of 10 feet.
The effects are only momentary.

name: Heart Attack
description: You deliver a charge of energy that stops a persons heart. A human defibulator only your power stops the heart instead of re-starting it. You must hit their chest where the heart is in order for the power to work. Also, you can't re-charge their heart & save them, its mostly a killing power.
summary: The ability to stop someone's heart from beating
strengths: You're a heart breaker
weaknesses: Must touch a person's heart area
You're not a heart healer, you just kill

name: Boomerang Launch
