description: This ability you can run up and jump, to launch yourself at your enemy,in a spinning effect, in an arch shape (like a boomerang). If you miss the target, you will be flung back the other way, and have another chance to strike your target down, also while this power is in process, you're immune to the force of the impact, and any subsiding pain.
summary: The ability to launch yourself at your opponent, like a boomerang.
strengths: Launch yourself like a boomerang. (You will always end up back in the same spot. )
While power is active,the impact force, and subsiding pain, will be nullified.
If you miss the target, flinging yourself one way, have another chance, a second way.
weaknesses: When you use this power, only two chance to hit the target.
Is a physically draining power.
Does require a certain amount of fitness, to use without exhaustion.

name: Induce Tickling
description: Using your mind, you can excite your enemy's nerves to such an extent that they fall onto the ground in helpless laughter for as long as you concentrate on them. This power only works on one person at a time and will abruptly halt when it is used on another.
summary: The ability to disable your enemy from within
strengths: Humiliate your attacker
Good at birthday parties
Makes you the center of attention
weaknesses: Makes you far more sensitive to the same trick
Opponents will be more inclined to retaliate
Requires intense concentration

name: No Scent
description: With this you have no scent. Without this power the best that a person can do is try to mask their scent which doesn't always work in terms of hiding or tracking. The character, Kanna, in the manga, Inuyasha, has this power. It is in book 16 page 29.
summary: The ability to have no scent whatsoever
strengths: Can't be tracked by scent.
Never smell bad with this power.
Scent-based powers that make you smell a certain way have no effect on you.
weaknesses: Never smell good while having this power.
Can still be affected by other people's scents.

name: Water Sensing
description: You can sense where water is all over the world. You could also 'see' the water, kind of like x-ray vision. It appears as light blue lines with thickness depending on the amount of water. You know where water is all over the world in all its forms (ice, steam, mist etc) and know how much of it there is, where it is and how its being affected.
summary: The ability to sence water globally
strengths: Get some of the weather right
Won't hammer accidentally into a pipe
Just really cool if you like water
weaknesses: Not exactly dynamic
So you know where water is, then what?
If you don't turn it off, the information/blue glowing lines may drive you insane

name: Dollification
description: This power allows you to turn people into dolls. The type of doll is up to you so they could be plastic, plush, wood, etc. You can even turn them into puppets or action figures. They will still retain their physical appearance (mostly) but they will not be able to move so they can't use any powers that require movement. Effects can be reversed. Transformation is not instantaneous so it will take a few seconds and you'll need to concentrate so you will be vulnerable.
summary: The ability to turn people into living dolls
strengths: Give them to children
They won't be able to move or use powers that require movement
Your power will improve with practice, reducing time and concentration needed
weaknesses: Powerful psychics will still be able to use their powers
You can only transform one person at a time so if there is more than one enemy you're in trouble
May not be able to reverse effects if you are not adept enough

name: Lord Of Tunes
description: Broken your iPod, mp3 player, radio or computer? Well, now all you need is your mind to play tunes. This power lets the user play music in their head and broadcast it to make it sound like a radio.
summary: The ability to broadcast music
strengths: No need for eletricity.
Can take the place of sterios at the party
Completely controlable
weaknesses: Might bother other people.

name: Rise Of The Transformers
description: With this power you can turn into any Transformer from any kind of media (TV, comics, games etc.) You can even change into the triple changers in order to fight (or commit) crimes however the downside if you can only turn into their robot forms
summary: The ability to turn into any Transformer.
strengths: Transformers!!!
If you turn into a Decepticon or an Autobot, you don't turn good/evil
weaknesses: you cannot turn into their vehicle/alternate modes

name: Enhancement: Halved
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it reduces the power's potency/number of/size by half. Ex: Reducing potency to stun instead of kill. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. If you want to detach this power and attach it to another power it takes one hour to do so.
summary: The ability to halve a power's power
strengths: Your auto-kill powers can now stun.
Easier to capture instead of kill with your strongest power.
Used on an enemy's power with Enhancement Sharing.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time and has an insane reattach time of one hour.
Unaffected by Con Negation or similar powers.

name: Condition Change: Unneeded
description: By touching a superpowered being you automatically make all the powers they have at that time useless. This is because the powers can now only work when there is no call to use them. This in turn means that they are unable to use any of their powers unless they can't control them in the first place.
summary: The ability to make another being's powers require being unneeded in order to be used
strengths: Have a laugh while watching your opponent trying to use their powers.
Automatically affects all their powers.
weaknesses: Have to touch the other person. Also if the target has Ability Reflection.
Con Negation and altering powers have no effect on this power.
Automatically affects friends' powers too.

name: Pb: Body Build
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power-Boost. ' With this ability, all of your strength abilities are doubled in strength. If a superpower gives you different strengths for different situations, it simply doubles the intended effect.
summary: The ability to have all of your 'strength' superpowers doubled in strength.
strengths: Doubles the effectiveness of strength abilities.
weaknesses: If you don't have strength abilities.
Or superpowers at all.

name: Myth Power: Ponos' Punishment
description: Ponos (or Ponus), in Greek myth, was the god of back-breaking hard labor, and exhausting toil. As such, channeling him allows one to produce an aura at will, which has two effects. Primarily, it gifts the user with infinite stamina, by supernaturally "shedding" exhaustion; in addition, when in proximity of foes, the aura transfers the user's exhaustion on to any subjects present with hostile intent toward him. One can also psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally hard workers.
summary: The ability to channel Ponos' command over the essence of painful toil and back-breaking hard labor
strengths: Infinite stamina at will (immunity to fatigue and exhaustion; run at top speed as long as you want)
Gain all the health benefits of strenuous exercise and hard labor, while foes take the fatigue
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally hard workers (and workaholics)
weaknesses: Non-hard-workers may also be compelled, but ONLY to do hard labor in physical capacity (NCN)
People with Superhuman Durability, Superhuman Stamina, Invulnerability or the like are immune
People with MythPower: Eris' Enmity are immune to this ability

name: Power Of The Butterfly
description: The person with this power is able to develop beautiful butterfly wings that will enable them to fly and levitate as well as the ability to shrink into the size of a butterfly. They also have the ability to emit sleep or paralysis powder as a part of their defensive capabilities
summary: The ability to grow butterfly wings to fly as well as the ability to shrink to the size of a butterfly.
strengths: Has the ability to fly and levitate
Can shrink into the size of a butterfly to escape enemy detection
weaknesses: If the wings are damaged, flight is impossible until it recovers
No real combat powers to go head to head with enemies

name: Personality Absorber
description: Whenever someone's soul or astral body gets too close to you, you can completely absorb that person's consciousness into yours, leaving their original body as an empty shell. From now on, that person will manifest themself as one of your alternate personalities, keeping their thoughts, behaviour, memory, personality and superpower if they had one. The powers you acquired this way can only only be activated when their owner's personality emerges, therefore making your personality dormant
summary: The ability to absorb a person's psyche and manifest them as an alternate personality.
strengths: You can absorb superpowers!
Ghosts of deceased people can live again through you.
You can trap astral bodies.
weaknesses: You will develop a dissociative identity disorder.
You only have access to an absorbed power when the owner's personality takes control of your body.
People with Astral Projection could leave your body if they manage to take control of it.

name: Myth Power: Prometheus' Plan
description: Prometheus (Prometheos), in Greek myth, was the Titan god of forethought, or planning ahead. As such, channeling him allows one to induce and amplify meticulous thought and consideration in others (making subjects consider so deeply what could go wrong with their ideas that they cannot function). In addition, one may psychically perceive a subject's future plans by touch, word or thought. One may even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who are naturally meticulous thinkers.
summary: The ability to channel Prometheus' command over the essence of forethought
strengths: Induce and amplify extremely meticulous thought (foes become unable to function effectively)
Psychically perceive a subject's plans for the future by touch, word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally meticulous thinkers
weaknesses: People with mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory based MythPowers are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Iapetos' Scorn are immune to this ability
At the lower levels, this ability may affect one's personality

name: Myth Power: Coalemos' Code
description: Coalemos (Coalemus, Koalemos), in Greek myth, was the god of stupidity, ignorance and foolishness. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive subjects' intelligence (IQ) at will. In addition, one can psychically reduce subjects' intelligence (IQ), by touch. Furthermore, new knowledge erased from subjects' minds may be psychically absorbed and kept for oneself, while the rest is psychically discarded. One can withstand intelligence-reducing effects, which may be shared, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Coalemos' command over the essence of ignorance, stupidity and foolishness
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' IQs, at will; psychically reduce their IQs, by touch
New knowledge erased from subjects' minds may be absorbed and kept for oneself, at will
Withstand intelligence-reducing effects, which may be shared, by touch
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel stupid people until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically shift physics to adhere to 'Stupid Logic' until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Allergy Inducer
description: With this power you can cause people to be allergic to any food. You can only make people allergic to one thing each so you can't make a person allergic to everything. Additionally this power also only applies to food not liquids, pollen, air, animals etc. You are not able to cure a person's allergies once you infect them.
summary: The ability to cause people to be allergic to things
strengths: You can make people allergic to any food
weaknesses: You can't cure them
Only applies to food
One allergy per person

name: Animal Intimidation
description: All nonhumans that see someone with this power will immediately be intimidated and run in fear.
summary: The ability to cause animals to be intimidated and run away in fear upon seeing one
strengths: No animal will ever attack you if you have this power.
weaknesses: If you love animals, unfortunately this is always active (cannot be removed by Con Negation).

name: Power  Rating
description: You have to get the person to explain or demonstrate their power to you then you can have this power give it a rating from 1-5. For each level under 3 the power loses 25% of its full strength, 3 causes no change, and for each level over 3 the power is boosted by 50%. This power judges only based on the power, efficiency of the use of the power, and techniques of the power. If the person improves their use of the power they could possibly get its rating changed.
summary: The ability to strengthen or weaken a power based on the rating it is given
strengths: Could possibly double the strength of your friends' powers.
Could possibly halve the strength of your enemies' powers.
2 people who have the same power can get two different ratings because of how efficient they are.
weaknesses: This power won't be nice to your friends when judging their powers, it sticks to what you saw.
You cannot get your own powers judged.

name: Keratinocyte Mimicry
description: As a Keratinocyte Mimic, you have five abilities. First, you can absorb the melanin produced by Melanocyte Mimics to protect yourself from UV rays. Second, you can control the ratio of melanin produced by a Melanocyte Mimic. Third, you can become extremely flat and sturdy, while always dying in the process. Fourth, you can undergo mitosis, creating an identical version of yourself. And fifth, when under attack, you can send a signal which attracts any Leukocyte Mimics in a large area around you.
summary: The ability to become flat, extremely sturdy and die, absorb melanin and much more.
strengths: You can transform yourself into a shield.
You can clone yourself, which is good if you intend to use the third ability.
You can influence the melanin-producing ability of Melanocyte Mimics.
weaknesses: It is not recommended to use the third ability before using the fourth one.
You can attract any Leukocyte Mimics, including enemies.
If you can't die (not necessarily without coming back to life later), you can't use the third power.

name: Myth Power: Echo Echo
description: Echo (Ekho), in Greek myth, was the goddess of echoes. As such, channeling her allows one to perfectly mimic any sound at will, after hearing it once. In addition, with a touch, a word or a thought, one may afflict subjects with echolalia, in which they can neither speak BEFORE anybody else has spoken, nor be silent AFTER anybody else has spoken. Furthermore, when one speaks questions into echoing areas, the echoes will utter answers to those questions, rather than simply repeating the user.
summary: The ability to channel Echo's command over the essence of echoes
strengths: Perfect Sound/Vocal Mimicry (even numerous sounds at once); gain superhuman ventriloquism powers
Afflict subjects with echolalia (forced to repeat what others say; PERFECT for blackmail, etc)
When speaking questions into areas that echo, the echoes will utter answers to those questions
weaknesses: Pro #1 only applies to vocal powers (Sonic Scream, Psychic Persuasion, etc) at the higher levels
Cannot cause thoughts to loudly echo in subjects' minds (Psychic Echo) until the higher levels (NCN)
Mimesis and sound/noise/silence-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Expert Spoon Thrower
description: You can be more or less dangerous. With this power, any spoon can become a hurtful projectile. It gives you an intuitive sense of spoon-throwing spatial geometry, spoon-related aerodynamics and fluid dynamics, and spoon force absorption. In short, you can throw spoons like a real expert. The only drawback is you can only hit things with the bowl part of the spoon. And that it only works with spoons; it won't enhance your knife-throwing skills.
summary: The ability to be an expert at spoon throwing.
strengths: You can find spoons nearly everywhere!
Laddles are a type of spoon!
Sporks and Spives, being half-spoon, are affected by half this power.
weaknesses: It doesn't work with forks or knives.
You can only hit things with the bowl part of the spoon.
The spoons don't hardly come back once thrown.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Snap You're Bulletproof
description: With this power you can make people bullet proof by thinking of the person and snapping. The person's entire body then becomes bullet proof permanently.
summary: The ability to make people bullet proof
strengths: You can turn anybody completely bullet proof
weaknesses: You cannot make yourself bullet proof with this power
The person can still be hurt by arrows, darts and other weapons

name: Icicle Rain
description: With this power you can cause giant icicles to fall from the sky. The icicles are super sharp and fall extremely fast so they can cut through a person pretty easily.
summary: The ability to cause giant icicles to fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause giant icicles to fall from the sky
The icicles are super sharp and fall extremely fast
weaknesses: You might accidentally kill an innocent person

name: Dimensional Power Block
description: On the planet h7r43 in the center of the universe stands an ancient device of unknown origin.  You know how to give it a list of max 7 words.  When the device is activated it will then alter the very rules of existence in your dimension.  All powers that have any of these words in the name or description will stop working and can't be activated anymore. This effect will last for 7 days on planet h7r43. The effect can't be removed, altered or avoided by any power. There's no immunity against it.
summary: The ability to use a device that can disable powers in your dimension, based on keywords.
strengths: You now have a way to disable a series of powers from your multipowered foes.
Example keywords : mythpower, kystian, kinesis, mind, time, mimicry, pudding
After the 7 days the powers can be used again as if nothing happened.
weaknesses: The device is on the very distant planet h7r43. How will you get there and return?
A time traveler could avoid the 7 days. If one doesn't add the word "time" to the list.
It affects every power user without fail. Including you.

name: Backwards!
description: With this power you can make people speak backwards. Whenever the victim speaks their words will come out backwards (hello will come out as olleh etc.). You can make them speak backwards for as long as you want and then fix their speech later.
summary: The ability to make people speak backwards
strengths: You make people speak backwards
You can make them speak backwards for as long as you want then you can fix their speech patterns
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Flight Immunity
description: With this power you can resist going into the air against your will. You can not be levitated, picked up by someone, thrown, you can even stop air vehicles from taking off if you're on them against your will. You cannot be teleported into the air either but you can be pushed out of an air vehicle or a building.
summary: The ability to resist being sent into the air
strengths: You can resist being sent into the air
You cannot be levitated, thrown, picked up, be flown somewhere etc.
You cannot be teleported into the air
weaknesses: You can still be dropped from the air
Once you're already in the air you cannot force yourself to land unless flying on your own power

name: Accelerated Test Taking V2
description: With this power you can complete tests, quizes and questionares just by looking at them. You'll still get the same answers you would've gotten had you actually spent time on each question and looked them over.
summary: The ability to complete tests just by looking at them
strengths: You can take tests just by looking at them
You get the same answers you would've gotten anyway
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Queen/King Of The Wasp/Hornets
description: With this power you are in complete control of all wasps and hornets. They will do anything you say and you can understand what they are saying. You will also never be stung by a wasp or hornet.
summary: The ability to control wasps and hornets
strengths: You are the king or queen of wasps and hornets
They will sting your enemies
You will never be stung by a wasp or hornet
weaknesses: Does not work on bees or yellow jackets

name: United We Stand V2
description: With this power you can cause someone else's power levels to rise when you stand in a thirty foot radius of them. This happens whenever you're a thirty foot radius of someone with superpowers so its not a good power to have if you fight superpowered villains often.
summary: The ability to cause someone else's power levels to rise when you stand near them
strengths: You can raise the power levels of others
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off

name: Soul Vampirism
description: Instead of tradition vampirism, soul vampirism allows people to suck out peoples' souls. The vampire gets stronger from the process and the victim is turned into a vampire themselves. The new vampire however is a traditional vampire and has to feed off blood.
summary: The ability to suck out peoples' souls and feed off it
strengths: Doesn't have to depend on blood; can feed off souls
Doesn't need constant replenishment
weaknesses: Has to be human souls
The vampire is forever connected to the 'victim'

name: Staircase To Escalator
description: With this power you can change staircases into escalator (and vice versa). This could be useful if you like moving in upwards or downwards directions without actually moving.
summary: The ability to change staircases into escalators (and vice versa)
strengths: You can change staircases into escalators (and vice versa)
Laziness!
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Baysplosion V2
description: With this power you can cause explosions to appear in any movie whenever you want. Think a movie's too boring add an explosion into it. The characters will not react to the explosion and the objects and plot of the movies will not be affected in any way.
summary: The ability to cause explosions to appear in movies
strengths: You can cause explosions to appear in movies
weaknesses: The characters in the film will not react to the explosion
The explosion will do absolutely nothing to affect the plot of the film
Not much use in physical battle

name: Immunity Sharing
description: With this ability, you are able to share immunity to something with someone else. Any amount of people can be in this group and they all make each other immune to something once one of them becomes immune. However, should a member leave the group, all members lose that person's immunities. Power like Con Negation cannot fix the cons of this power. You can remove a person from the group at any time.
summary: The ability to share immunities.
strengths: Great if you have someone who has immunity-based superpowers; you all do.
Once one of you recovers from a disease, you are all immune.
Useful with other team-based abilities.
weaknesses: Someone in your group must have that immunity for you to attain it.
Can only give immunities resulting from powers; not the powers themselves.
People must agree to enter the group and can leave at any time.

name: Transformers: Wheelie
description: With this power you automatically have perfect aim whenever you are using any kind of slingshot. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that if you use it for prolonged periods of time (use a slingshot several times in a row) you will start to rhyme whenever you speak.
summary: The ability to have perfect aim when using a sling shot
strengths: You have perfect aim whenever you use a slingshot
weaknesses: You may start rhyming

name: Twimonds
description: Twimonds are specially created diamonds made out of Twilight Matter, the essence between light and darkness. These twimonds are small enough to fit in one's hands, dark purple and crystalline in appearance, but pack quite a punch. They are normally used for defense, as they can absorb and possibly reflect attacks from both light and darkness. The user may have a telekenetic control over them.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate twimonds.
strengths: The user can create up to ten twimonds at a time, which could protect them from harm.
With these, the user would be protected from attacks from darkness and light.
They can store up attacks over them and release them anyway they want.
weaknesses: While they can absorb darkness and light, they cannot reflect attacks from pure evil.
One could store up too much energy in their twimonds and cause them to explode.
Pure evil will go through the twimonds and into the user, possibly corrupting them.

name: Phone Stalling
description: If you are talking to someone on the phone, anyone wanting to engage you - such as talk to you or fight you - will stand in place tapping their foot and not take any other action, either until you finish the phonecall or until they decide to do something else not involving you in any way.
summary: The ability to make people wait patiently for you to finish talking on the phone
strengths: Can be used to avoid fights
Can take out en enemies while they're just standing there
Works on bluetooth devices provided they're connected to a phone
weaknesses: Might run out of battery or lose reception
Can't control it so it might affect people when you don't want it to.
People wanting to do something involving you such as filing taxes far away are still affected

name: Passive Clothing Empowerment
description: This ability allows the user to extend the effects of their abilities, particularly physical ones, to the items they wear. If you are immune to fire, so will your clothing. If you are bulletproof, your jacket will not get holes in it when fired at. The clothing, however, does not gain any powers or enhance your abilities in any way. The clothing has the same weaknesses as the one providing it with powers. The empowerment is instantaneous but fades just as quickly when clothing is removed.
summary: The ability to extend your abilities to your clothing.
strengths: Never accidentally destroy your clothing through use of powers again.
No longer need special equipment.
Some clothing may improve power use; clothing can now absorb sunlight for you, for instance.
weaknesses: The clothes do not gain any other power/s.
You are not additionally empowered in any way by your clothing.
Clothing is only empowered while actually worn.

name: Myth Power: Neaera's Need
description: Neaera (Neaira, Perseis, Perse), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sun and moon's risings. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate sunlight when the sun is out, and moonlight when the moon is out, at will. In addition, one can psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power and sustenance, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can even psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions).
summary: The ability to channel Neaera's command over the essence of the rising of the sun and the moon
strengths: Psychically manipulate sunlight when sun is out, moonlight when moon is out, at will
Psychically absorb sunlight and moonlight to gain physical power, as well as sustenance, at will
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
weaknesses: Cannot psychically teleport to any location the sun/moon is rising, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to past/future sunrises/moonrises, at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Helios' Help and Selene's Salute provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Usefulness Removal
description: This ability can make anything useless and pointless by removing all uses that a target has. By removing their usefulness, the victim will be just phase through thing. Since they are now useless, it is basically nothing but a waste of space. They do not even have a physical use. The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.
summary: The ability to remove the actual usefulness any weapons, powers, technology, etc
strengths: Remove any or all uses from anything
Superpowers are affected as well
weaknesses: The effects are only temporary.
The user can only use this ability on one thing at a time.

name: Jacket Fusion
description: With this power you can freely transform into a jacket that, when worn by someone else, gives them access to all of your powers and skills in addition to combining your strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance.   You are aware of everything that is happening while you are a jacket and can transform back at any time you wish, sliding off the wearer automatically.
summary: The ability to become a jacket that, when worn, conveys all of your powers, skills, and traits to the wearer.
strengths: Pool your strength with an ally.
Enhance someone who you know is better than you for the task at hand.
Share your strength with someone you know is weaker.
weaknesses: You are trusting yourself completely to another person.
In a fight, because you are covering someone else, you will be taking hits first.

name: Arceusforce: Icicle
description: The user of this ability can channel the cold heart of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Ice-type. The user's skin turns light blue, their irises turn white. Under their frigid guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of an Ice-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Ice attacks such as Ice Beam, Aurora Beam, Icicle Spear, Blizzard and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Ice form.
strengths: The user can resist other ice-based attacks.
Generation and manipulation of ice, cold and aurora for Ice attacks
weaknesses: The user is weak to fire, supernatural combat, mineral and metal-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. May need to be unlocked from the default form.
Ice is probably the weakest defensive type.

name: Default Form
description: With this power you can see a person's default or normal form. If the person is a shapeshifter you have the ability to see their normal form, if they're in disguise you can see what they look like normally, if they're hidden behind a hologram or mirage you can see through it. If a person is an extension or puppet of a third party force you can see that person. You can turn this power on and off. You can also cause a person to revert to their normal or default form.
summary: The ability to see a person's default/normal/true form and then make them return to it.
strengths: You can cause a person to revert to their normal form.
You can tell if a person is a shapeshifter.
If someone is being possessed by something you can see that thing.
weaknesses: Not good to use at costume parties.
Not much use in physical combat.

name: Ability To Manipulate Pimples
description: Control pimples to make your enemies ugly or remove them to give your allies flawless skin... You can cover yourself with indestructable pimples to use as armor.
summary: The ability to manipulate pimples so you can give yourself pimples to look older than you are
strengths: Make a popular guy ugly
Indestructable armor
Never suffer puberty
weaknesses: U look freaky and ugly while wearing armor
People will always bug you about their pimples

name: Midas' Touch Revamped
description: No, this is not your run-of-the-mill Midas' Touch, who'd want that? with this power, if you choose to do so, you can turn anything you touch into gold. Upon activation, an equivalent amount in mass of gold created is consumed from your own blood.
summary: The ability to Turn what you touch into gold at the expense of your own blood.
strengths: Gold, man. Gold.
You can turn anything into gold, even organic matter, so it may be lethal.
Easily concealable.
weaknesses: Must be in direct contact with the matter to be transformed.
Loss of blood might be dangerous if done in large quantities.
It is lethal, so accidents might happen.

name: Media Mastery (Sodenio)
description: You know all and can do all media-related tasks, including filming, artistry, directing, producing, management, being a spoeksperson etc.
summary: The ability to be skilled in media-related tasks
strengths: Can make movies easy and fast
Can film great shots
Can be great in all artist related things
weaknesses: Can make any ones pictures bad or ugly
Can make films, bad or good
Can control the outcome of TV shows

name: Summoning: Amaterasu
description: Amaterasu, the Sun Goddess. Her power is now yours. She can use a flame that will never extinguish until those she targets are burned to ashes.
summary: The ability to summon Amaterasu.
strengths: Flames.
Powerful flame attacks.
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Televangelism
description: Simply point to person and say, "The Lord wants you to give me money! " They will then give you all that they have, and go get more if you want them to.
summary: The ability to get money from people by saying "The Lord wants you to give me money! "
strengths: You have an unlimited supply of money as long as there are Christians around.
It's not CrackTart.
weaknesses: Not much use in combat.
Well, it's not CrackTart...

name: The Unforgiving Fist
description: Ever have the urge to punch someone?  Why hold back?  With this ability, each day you can punch ANYONE you want.  As long as you can walk up to them, you can punch them and you have all to gain from it.  No retaliation.  Just pure venting in one of our most primitive and satisfying ways!  Start punching today!
summary: The ability to punch anyone you want once every day with no consequences.
strengths: Road rage at stopped traffic lights
When you feel you deserved a C, not an F
The TPS reports can wait
weaknesses: Too much punching, too little negotiating
Becoming an angry, punching, hairy gorilla (at least figuratively)
Occasionally, you might feel guilty for punching someone.

name: Cloning Bite
description: Typically possessed by some insects and some arachnids, one with this ability must bite a living host. After a period of incubation, a dozen duplicates will emerge from each bite wound. If the duplicates are extracted before they are fully formed, they will die and won't be replaced. Humans and big animals are not usually meant to have this power as they need be able to open a wound with their teeth and find a big enough host to bring their clones to term. It won't work if the host is too small.
summary: The ability to clone yourself by biting a living being and having your clones emerge from the bite wound.
strengths: Fast and creepy way to reproduce yourself.
Since the human population is increasing, it's very easy to find a host.
The duplicates will be at the same metamorphosis stage as you when you bit the host.
weaknesses: Since the duplicates are identical to you, you all have the same weaknesses, especially pesticides.
You could disturb the balance of an ecosystem.
If you're a big animal, there won't be many situations where this power will be useable.

name: Myth Power: Notion Of The Nesoi
description: The Nesoi, in Greek myth, were the goddesses of islands. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions and natural phenomena on any island throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to sense the layout of any island at will (including any supposedly hidden features, such as treasure and magical landmarks). In addition, one may teleport to any island at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is on an island
summary: The ability to channel the Nesoi and their command over the essence of islands and island life
strengths: Knowledge of any island in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any island at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc. ) are enhanced for as long as you are on an island
weaknesses: Cannot alter an island's weather until the higher levels
Not every island is habitable
At the lower levels, stat enhancement gets weaker the further you are from the center of an island

name: Cat's Eyes
description: You can tap into the network of feline minds and see what they see. Can also see things that cats have seen by looking at the particular cat in the eye.
summary: The ability to see through the eyes of a cat, any cat.
strengths: Can solve crimes by looking in the eyes of feline "witnesses".
Can observe other people/events without being physically there.
weaknesses: Can only see things within the cat's vision range.
Empathic feedback: if the cat you're looking through gets hurt, you get hurt too.

name: Superhuman Olfaction
description: In comparison to other animals, humans are blind. A person with Superhuman Olfaction can enjoy a whole new spectrum of experience. Their sense of smell is as a scenthound's; 6 million times human strength. As such, they can track an object coonhound-style, draw minute details from scents, find food from miles away, and actually sort of smell the chemical mix that is fear. However, they are more sensitive to incapacitating smells, like sulfur or drying tar.
summary: The ability to possess an incredible sense of smell
strengths: 6 million times normal strength
Determine tiny details from a single whiff of the scene
Find food or track foes
weaknesses: May rely a bit too much on smell and not on other senses
Sensitive to unpleasant smells
Explaining to others how you know that the A-1 sauce is generic brand

name: Star Reclassification
description: With this power you could make the sun an O class star(a blue super-giant) or the lowest class, an M red dwarf. The planets automatically change orbit, so life on Earth is always safe. Life adapts to the new light spectrum. Plants survive under the new sunlight. All animals may just see infrared (if living under a red dwarf). The new sun, if a normally unstable star, is perfectly stable under this power.
summary: The ability to change a star's spectral class without harm to life on any planets.
strengths: Make a day on Earth last hundreds of hours or more.
Make a year last thousands of years or more.
A summer that last years.
weaknesses: Imagine winter that last a 100 years...
Sunlight fearing creatures will be a big problem when there's weeks of nighttime.

name: Zerg Mutation
description: The Zerg are the masters of biological warfare. With this power you can make any animal mutate and infect in the same way the Zerg do and have control over their hive mind. You can mutate any animal to make it fly, swim, tunnel or even mutate them into a form of hive building. The mutated animals can even produce acidic chemicals within their bodies. The mutation occurs rapidly and the animals can be mutated several times. Larva can be produced so you only need one of an animal to create an army
summary: The ability to make animals mutate in the same way as the Zerg.
strengths: Zerg army.
Can be used on any animal.
Hive mind lets you know everything your mutations know.
weaknesses: Can only be used on one species and can not be changed.
If you lose control over the hive mind they will most likely turn on you.
May take time to spawn and mutate your army to be large enough to take on other superpowers.

name: Luminescence
description: Luminescents can emit large amounts of pure white light- maximum around 100,000,000,000 candles' worth. This is enough to blind almost anything permanently and can almost be seen from space. It can be used as a beacon or offensive weapon.
summary: The ability to emit bright light
strengths: Homing signal extraordinaire
Blinding foes
Strobe light at concerts
weaknesses: May blind things you didn't want to blind
Really, really obvious
Cannot make other colors

name: Herbology
description: Herbology is the art of using and caring for magical plants. Anyone with this ability will have full knowledge of all sorts of magical plants and herbs. Also, they will possess a sort of magical green thumb. Whenever they plant a magical seed of any kind, it will grow faster than normal, growing to full size in a fourth of the time. The user can use these herbs for many things, suchs as breathing underwater, healing, or fire-starting.
summary: The ability to employ the art of herbology
strengths: Will have full knowedge of herbology (what they need to grow, where they can be found,etc. )
Other powers can be gained
weaknesses: Very hard to find magical plants
Caring for hundreds of herbs and plants

name: Holy Power: Soul Reap
description: With this power you can remove the soul of everyone around you by spinning the reaper scythe above your head. With this power you can easily save yourself when surrounded by enemies. This power is very useful because it doesn't wastes too much energy, but you might hurt innocents.
summary: The ability to remove the souls of everyone around you by spinning the Reaper Scythe
strengths: Perfect for escaping when surrounded by enemies.
Kill everyone around you in seconds.
Doesn't wastes too much energy.
weaknesses: You might hurt innocents.
Reaper only.

name: Moon Manipulation
description: Moon Manipulators get great advantages with this power. With it they control it's distances; making it farther away or extremly close. Control the ocean tides, affect the rocks, and even control the moon's gravity.
summary: The ability to control the moon.
strengths: Have a great view at night by making a full moon.
Make tidal waves for offense by pulling the moon closer.
Make night come faster.
weaknesses: Moving it too much will knock it out of orbit.
Changing the axis and creating dangerous climate.
If it's destroyed you have no power over it anymore.

name: The Sneaker Sneaked
description: The passive part of the power makes you aware of anyone who is sneaking up on you. You then have the choice to use the active part of the power, which is to sneak up on that person. It can happen in two ways. If they lost sight of you at that moment, you will be teleported in their blind spot, allowing you to sneak up on them. If they were watching you, your doppelganger takes your place while you are teleported and sneak up on them. You can decide if you want to appear far from or near them.
summary: The ability to sneak up on someone who is sneaking up on you.
strengths: Noone can ever sneak up on you by surprise.
It's creepy to follow someone from afar and they are suddenly right behind your back.
You are guaranteed to appear somewhere they can't see you, usually behind them.
weaknesses: If you use this power to sneak up on a sneaker and they also use it to sneak up on you.
If you don't have the means to attack or defend yourself, it could be dangerous to sneak up on them.

name: Self Absorption
description: Ever need a quick escape from the universe? With this power, you can absorb your own body, in the same way that a matter absorber would absorb other things, until there is nothing left. The effect would be similar to travelling into a black hole and you may come out in the other side of the universe, a completely different universe, or even a non-universe, like limbo. You could end up being 2 dimensional, 12 dimensional, 0 dimensional, or even -3 dimensional! Infinity's the limit.
summary: The ability to absorb yourself.
strengths: Escape from the universe quickly.
Can make it look like you are eating yourself.
weaknesses: Completely unpredictable.
Not necessarily voluntary.
Absolutely mind-boggling. Will probably end up going insane.

name: Trap Realm
description: You are a fighter for good and you have been fighting this evil creature possibly a demon, yet no matter what you do you'll never defeat him, but he's about to destroy all you know. Ah but you have this one time use power. You can trap him in a prison realm forever. No possible escape. Garenteed! However in order to trap him you must go in with him to lock the gate from the inside.
summary: The ability to trap the most powerful evil inside a prison realm forever.
strengths: Trap a nearly all powerful evil in a prison for all time.
Your name will live on to inspire heroes for generations.
Your world and all you care about will be saved from that particular Great Evil being.
weaknesses: All your powers are taken away when you shut the gates of this prison realm.
You can't get out because there is no escape for anyone. Not even you.
This Evil being will punish you forever because you put him there there's noone else to hurt.

name: Summon Shroudthought
description: Kyst has given shroudthoughts the appearance of blood soaked six-foot tall rag dolls. Shroudthought or just shrouds have the anti-telepathic power. They will target for death anyone with psionic powers first, you can't command them otherwise. A shroud won't even consider killing you if you don't have any psionic powers. Shrouds have the strength to rip apart man as if he were wet tissue paper. They can run 50 mph. They have standard kystian invulnerability. Shrouds are sneaky and clever.
summary: The ability to summon an anti-telepathic half-alive thing.
strengths: An anti-psionic flesh-ripping monster.
You are safe if you don't have any psionic powers.
weaknesses: A monster that will kill if you say the wrong thing-only if you are psionic.

name: Myth Power: Arete's Excellence
description: Arete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of excellence, virtue, honor, valor (bravery and courage) and prestige. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive subjects' morals, as well as the extent of their valor, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power from feeling fear, worry and doubt. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel experts; those considered the best at what they do (fighters, singers, scientists, artists, politicians, athletes, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Arete's command over the essence of virtue, excellence and valor
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' morals, and the extent of their valor (bravery/courage)
Gain physical power when one feels fear, worry or doubt (natural or projected)
Perceive, communicate with and compel those who are talented/experts/role models in their field
weaknesses: Pro #2 does not completely PREVENT the feeling of fear/dread/doubt until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 only uses one's own fear; No enhanced damage against dishonorable foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain enhancement of one's natural skills until developed (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Comos' Charisma
description: Comos (Comus, Komos), in Greek myth, was the god of revelry, celebration, merrymaking and festivity. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive communicate with and compel anyone born on the day of power use, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce an overwhelming urge to party, by touch. One can even psychically summon gifts, and weaponized party decorations, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Comos' command over the essence of revelry, merrymaking and festivity
strengths: Psychically perceive the dates/customs of any holiday/special event (even birthdays, etc) at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born on day of power use
Psychically induce overwhelming urge to party; summon random gifts and weaponized party favors
weaknesses: Cannot withstand fatigue and negative drinking/drug effects (shared by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot teleport/time travel to parties (and gain physical power at parties) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish party crashers to the Underworld until developed (NCN)

name: Civilian Zone
description: Creates a zone that promotes commonness. Advantages and disadvantages would be removed and the total power level of everyone inside would be divided equally. While inside the zone a person with no powers would be evenly matched with superman. For things, such as competitions, advantages given by superpowers, or from other means, would be lost or given to everyone within the competition.
summary: The ability to create a zone that promotes commonness.
strengths: Make it impossible for people to become overpowered.
Make competitions based on skill only.
Increase the power of weaker individuals.
weaknesses: Lose any advantages you would have with superpowers inside the zone.
Unable to become stronger or better than others while within the zone.
Could lose against foes you could normally beat effortlessly.

name: Human Fire Extinguisher
description: With this power, you can be like a human fire extinguisher (hence the name) and shoot fire retardant foam from your hands. The foam comes out rather quickly and with a lot of force, so it can also be used to injure enemies or push them away or into walls.
summary: The ability to shoot fire retardant foam from your hands
strengths: You can put out fires
You can injure your enemies
You never run out of foam
weaknesses: It doesn't hurt that much

name: Time To Duel!
description: You'll be able to summon Yugioh Monsters, like the cards from the game!   You'll have infinite lifepoints when using your powers against someone without the same powers, so you'll be able to take a bullet!   when dueling, you'll have real cards happen before you while your opponent will have the basic cards...
summary: The ability to summon monsters, use traps and spells from the Yugioh card game and they are real!
strengths: You'll be like Akiza from Yugioh 5Ds
You'll be the envy of other duelists
You can summon Obelisk the Tormentor!!!!!!!!
weaknesses: You won't have a duel challenge unless you meet someone else with the same power
You might accidentally kill someone
You need to draw the cards you want to use

name: Painsmith
description: You can take bones from a dead body or bodies and fuse them together to create a weapon made of bone. The weapon will have magical power based on the amount of physical pain the being(s) felt when they died. The sharpness of the weapon, if it is a bladed one, is based on the mental pain and anguish felt at death. The weapon will also have an independent mind of its own and in order to use the weapon, one must pass the weapon's test (test differs for each weapon).
summary: The ability to create weapons from the bones of dead beings that have power based on the pain felt at death
strengths: Beings tormented physically and mentally until they died yield up powerful weapons. May be a con.
Enemies may not pass the test needed to use one of the weapons.
As the creator of the weapon, you are the only one who does not need to pass the test to use it.
weaknesses: Beings who died happily in their sleep of old age will not yield up powerful weapons.
Seems like more of an evil power.
Friends may not be able to pass the weapon's test to use it.

name: Synesthesia
description: Synesthesia is a great gift. It allows the user to perceive sound as color. This lets them easily discern musical key, or see differing pitches as color, or even different timbres as different colors. This ability can prove a bit vexing if the user is asked to identify a red object while listening to a blue pitch, or if a sound is so loud it makes them go blind.
summary: The ability to have mildly crosswired senses
strengths: Easily identify key
Adds an extra dimension to perception of music
Really fun to have
weaknesses: Being blinded by sound
Considered a bit strange
Arguing with other synesthetes over perceived colors

name: Half Mummy
description: Someone with this power will have boosted physical strength and speed. They will also have bandages at various parts of their body that they can control and they will have an attractive appearance. They will also have boosted magical power for cursing other people and controlling sand. Also, they will be half-living and half-undead with a healing rate that is 3/4s that of a normal human's healing rate and they can never become dehydrated.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-mummy
strengths: People won't want to make you angry at them.
Best terrain to fight in is a desert. May be a con.
weaknesses: People might be scared of you. May be pro.

name: Arcana: 10 The Wheel Of Change
description: A person with this power is the bane of reliability. This power creates a aura around a person that cause everything to flux and change. Superpowers may become stronger or weaker, or change function entirely. People may become happy, sad, excited, scared, all emotions and thoughts in flux. Probability is warped as the unlikely becomes likely and vice versa. The only one immune it the person with this power themselves. This power is difficult to shut off- if it can be at all.
summary: The ability to cause things and people around you to be in constant flux.
strengths: Send your enemies into chaos.
Win money in Vegas.
weaknesses: Power also affects allies.
May empower enemies
Totally random

name: Power Backup
description: This power lets you burn to CD any power you have(including this one). All you do is hold a CD between your palms for 20 minutes and you've got a backup power. Make multiple copies of any power. A lost power(including this one) can be restored in 2 minutes by holding the CD between your hands. These CDs only work for you. Someone else with this power could detect them if he was 10 feet or closer. Your CDs can't be affected by any power-altering power. You can use rewritable CDs.
summary: The ability to store copies of your powers on CD
strengths: Make multiple copies and hide them anywhere you might go
Carry them with you
These power CD's work even if badly scratched.
weaknesses: You break the last copy of a power and you've just lost that power
You keep them all in one location and someone finds your stash
If you can't afford to buy blank CD's.

name: Condition Change: Life
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it works only when the user is saving another's life. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is saving someone's life
strengths: It will also replace Condition Change: Unneeded, if Unneeded was already on the power being altered.
Now the opponent has to help others.
weaknesses: Condition Change: Unneeded will replace this power, if this power was on the affected power first.

name: Lava Rain
description: With this power you can cause scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky wherever and whenever you want. The lava can burn through almost anything and once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear.
summary: The ability to cause lava to rain from the sky
strengths: You can make scolding hot molten lava to fall from the sky
The lava can burn through almost anything
weaknesses: You might harm innocent people
Once the lava hits the ground you cannot make it disappear

name: Myth Power: Arke's Arcana
description: Arke (Arce) in Greek myth, was the goddess of color, the rainbow's arching shape and the lost second rainbow, as well as the Messenger of the Titans. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will. In addition, one can arc colored light into a boomerang, or a bow for light arrows. Furthermore, one can use rainbows to walk on or teleport, as well as fly. One can even withstand effects based on the colors of the rainbow.
summary: The ability to channel Arke's command over the essence of color, the rainbow's arch and the lost second rainbow
strengths: Psychically perceive the entire color spectrum (including focusing in on certain colors) at will
Bend colored light into an arc (rainbow) shape, to use as a boomerang or a bow to shoot light arrows
Use rainbows to walk on, or for teleportation; fly (wings optional); gain Rainbow Immunity
weaknesses: Cannot psychically bend structures into a rainbow-arc shape until developed (NCN)
Cannot manipulate matter of the same color as one's clothes until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Titanomachy Rematch and MythPower: Thaumas' Theme provide immunity (NCN)

name: Puppet Alive
description: With this power you can bring puppets to life by pointing at them and saying "Rise Puppet! " then the puppet will come to life and be under your complete control. Since puppets generally don't have legs the puppets will be able to levitate and float around. You can use this power on as many puppets as you want but you can't turn them back to normal.
summary: The ability to cause puppets to come to life
strengths: You can have an army of puppet minions
You can have as many as you want
weaknesses: It only works on puppets
You have to say the spell

name: Myth Power: Oxylus' Option
description: Oxylus (Oxylos), in Greek myth, was the god of mountain forests. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically generate and manipulate plants indigenous to mountains at will. In addition, one may cast the illusion of being high on a mountain top at will. Furthermore, one gains adaptation to survive on any mountain (enhanced toughness, cold immunity, adapted respiration, etc), which may be shared by touch. One can even teleport (self or others) to or from any mountain in the Cosmos at will.
summary: The ability to channel Oxylus' command over the essence of mountain forests
strengths: Generate and manipulate mountain plants and trees at will; cast illusions of being on a mountaintop
Teleport to/survive on mountains (enhanced toughness and respiration, cold/wind immunity, etc)
Share Montane Adaptation (adaptation to survive mountain conditions) by a touch
weaknesses: Cannot turn subjects into trees indigenous to mountains with a touch until the higher levels (NCN)
People with agrokinetic MythPowers are immune to being turned into mountain trees
People with MythPower: Honor of the Ourea can resist being teleported to a mountain

name: Acid Generation
description: This ability can be manifested through touch or as a spray.
summary: The ability to generate acid.
strengths: You would be able to secrete an acid-like sweat from the pores of your body.
You could metabolize the acid into corrosive projectile beams and shoot them from your hands.
You would be able to form acidic brass knuckles to augment your punching power.
weaknesses: You would still be harmed by your own acidic projections.
It is possible to unintentionally harm someone.
People would want to stay away from you.

name: Zoading
description: This ability allows you to speed up computer loadings just by thinking, including downloads. This ability will work on any computer. Using the skill too much causes headache.
summary: The ability to speed up computer loadings.
strengths: You don't have to wait for that loading to finish
Speed up your download time
weaknesses: Causes headache if overused

name: Sickage Bender
description: You are able to make anyone sick with any cause but you are only able to make 1 person sick every 10 minutes and your able to make them be sick in any way you want
summary: The ability to turn anyone you want sick
strengths: You can give security guards a disease to get through gate a security guard is guarding
weaknesses: The time limit isn't the best so you have to use your power wisely

name: Myth Power: Penia's Penalty
description: Penia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of poverty, penury and neediness. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive how much money anybody has on them at any given time, at will. In addition, one can compel subjects to give away all of their money and valuable possessions to any person or organization that one desires. One can even compel foes to destroy their valuable items at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel the poor and the homeless at will.
summary: The ability to channel Penia's command over the essence of poverty, penury and the poor
strengths: Perceive how much money subjects have; perceive, communicate with and compel the poor/homeless
Compel subjects to give away their valuables at will (to you, friends, charity or the like)
Compel subjects to destroy their valuables at will
weaknesses: If people ever learn about your power, they'll likely expect you to help end poverty
People with MythPower: Plutos' Bounty are immune to this ability
People with MythPowers based on Penia's sisters are immune to this ability (and vice versa)

name: Army Of The Living Dead
description: You will be able to bring back the deceased as zombies under your control.
summary: The ability to control zombies
strengths: Have an army of walking corpses
weaknesses: Your army will rot & decompose
The smell of death

name: Pizza Maker
description: You can create pizza out of thin air. In battle, you can have a slice of pizza whenever you want.
summary: The ability to create pizza out of thin air
strengths: Tasty pizza whenever you want
weaknesses: You can't control the toppings

name: Demon Weapon Forging
description: The weapons are created by first combining the fang, claw, or scale with metal, then turning the resulting combination into a weapon by way of the arts of the blacksmith. The weapon has powers based on those of the demon from which the fang, claw, or scale came from. Fangs tend to give offensive powers, claws tend to give agility-based powers,and scales tend to give defensive powers. However, all of the fangs, claws and scales have to come from the same demon for any individual weapon.
summary: The ability to create mystic weapons from the fangs, claws, and/or scales of demons
strengths: Can create extremely powerful weapons.
Different demons give different powers to the weapons so it is good to experiment.
Demons might pay you to make them weapons if they feel they need or want one.
weaknesses: The number of powers is random but always at least one and no more than 5.

name: Chimpanzee Mimicry
description: With this power you gain all of the skills of a chimpanzee including enhanced agility and climbing skills, the ability to walk a tight rope flawlessly, opposable feet and the ability to hold up to 300 pounds in one hand.
summary: The ability to mimic the skills of a chimpanzee
strengths: You have all of the skills of a chimpanzee
weaknesses: You can't actually turn into a chimpanzee with this power

name: Myth Power: Paregoron's Paragon
description: Paregoron (Paregoros), in Greek myth, was the goddess of consolation, soothing words and coaxing words of encouragement. As such, channeling her allows one to intuitively discern how to speak to others in order to soothe, console and encourage them. In addition, one's touch amplifies the soothing effect. Furthermore, coaxing and encouraging others multiplies the effect of nearly any effort they put forth. One can even gain the same benefits when one receives words of encouragement from others.
summary: The ability to channel Paregoron's command over the essence of consolation, soothing words and coaxing
strengths: Psychically intuit how to speak to others to console/soothe/encourage them (amplified by a touch)
Coaxing and encouraging others amplifies the result of any effort they put forth
Receiving words of encouragement from others amplifies the result of any effort the user puts forth
weaknesses: Soothing words ease pain, and encouraging words speed healing only at the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use soothing words to calm rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use encouraging words to induce rage/trance-like mental states until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Old One Power: Nyarlathotep
description: Messenger of the Outer Gods, Nyarlathotep. While Nyarlathotep incarnates in various avatars known as "masks" to do the bidding of the other Outer Gods, you are limited to one body, but do gain his many forms. Many are useful for combat, but the more powerful your new shape, the more uncontrollable the destruction. You also gain his mastery of telepathic communication, though no mind-reading, and a genius mind geared towards long-reaching and complicated plans of manipulation.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the Outer God Nyarlathotep
strengths: Telepathy, limited shapeshifting (limited to 999 forms), and the brain power to use it.
Nyarlathotep also has plans and pawns EVERYWHERE, who will act favorably towards you.
If manipulation doesn't work, the shapeshifting can blast someone's sanity, and packs a punch.
weaknesses: Your descent into sadism and hatred is inevitable. There is no arguing or avoiding it.
On the best of days, Nyarlathotep considers you a valuable pawn. On the worst, an obstruction.
Unless they directly oppose you, other Old One Powers users can command you.

name: Decepticon Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Decepticon or Predacon from any continuity in order to help you commit crimes. You can summon as many as you want but keep in mind they're not under your control and will probably kill you first and ask questions later but on the off chance that they help you some of them are extremely powerful (Unicron, Galvatron) though some of them aren't that powerful (Cybertron Thundercracker, Lazerbeak)
summary: The ability to summon any of the Decepticons
strengths: You can summon any Decepticon/Predacon
Some of them are extremely powerful
weaknesses: They might kill you
If you're a hero they definitely will not help you

name: Coupon Authenticity
description: The ability to make other people believe that your expired or fake coupons are real and be able to use them to acquire things. Extremely unrealistic coupons may get noticed unless you attempt to persuade that they are real. People with psychic powers may be immune to this power. After you use the coupon, it might be hard to explain how you got whatever you used the coupon for.
summary: The ability to make expired or fake coupons real and useable.
strengths: Really good deals.
Trick people into giving you their stuff.
Those "free kiss" coupons.
weaknesses: If it's extremely unrealistic, it might get noticed.
Psychics are immune to this trick.
Explaining how you got so much stuff.

name: The Trollforce Master
description: This force can be used in two major ways. The first is for actual trolling. Besides being granted major manipulation and computer skills, the trollforce can be used to read minds and control computers. But it can also be used to create 'epic' real life 'trolls'. Though its preferred form is in standard psychic (particularly telepathic) powers and trickster magic. The catch is that it must be recharged through actual trolling if you use it for non-trolling.
summary: The ability to control the force behind trolling and Schadenfreude
strengths: Become a legend wherever you go, for bringing devestation through manipulation
Have the powers of Professor X and Mr. Mxyzptlk, particularly if you're just wreaking havoc
Manipulative and computer skills for free! The manipulation/computer powers are recharged easily
weaknesses: While the lighter effects may only require browsing the internet and enjoying the works of others,
The really dramatic stuff requires you to pull very epic (and hurtful) trolls
People will hate (and possibly even fear) you if you can't hide the way you charge your powers

name: Power Bait And Switch
description: With this power, you become aware when someone is going to steal, copy or duplicate one of your powers. You then have the ability to pick what power they get. If your only choice was this power or gravity manipulation, you could choose this power. Or if you had one of the worst top ten powers, you could choose that power. The power duplicator or power thief has no idea what you've done until they try to use their newly acquired power.
summary: The ability to choose what power is copied or stolen from you.
strengths: The worst superpowers are actually useful to you.
Save your best powers from theft or duplication.
weaknesses: If you don't have enough powers.
If you don't have the ability to copy powers yourself.

name: Snap....There Goes Your Career
description: If you want to end a celebrity's career, and stop their fame and fortune, snap your fingers and it will all go to hell for that person. If they have any ounce of fame or star power, they can be affected by this power; doesn't work if that person is already a washed up has-been.
summary: The ability to snap your fingers and end the career of any celebrity you want
strengths: You can end the career's of horrible celebrities
The better celebrities could get a chance a fame
You could get a chance at fame
weaknesses: You might end the career of an influential person
That person might commit suicide without fame
Doesn't work if their career already sucks...

name: Ars Goetia: Bael's Fury
description: The goetic demon king Bael is described as a chimera of a man, cat, and toad. The user is capable of transforming into this abomination along with immense strength and command over endless demonic hordes at their disposal.
summary: The ability to harness the demonic king's monstrous form.
strengths: Crush and swipe multiple targets.
A demonic king of hell. Can't get any better than this.
Prehensile tongue and cat/toad attributes.
weaknesses: Your monstrous appearance will frighten others and alert them to attack you.

name: Myth Power: Ecomene's Example
description: Ecomene (Oikoumene, Oecomene, Oecoumene, Ecoumene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the inhabited world. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. In addition, one can psychically teleport anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient subjects. One can even psychically tap into the collective unconscious (mental reserve of knowledge, thoughts, emotions, dreams, memories and raw psychic power) of the inhabited world at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ecomene's command over the essence of the inhabited world
strengths: Psychically perceive anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically teleport self/others anywhere on the planet inhabited by sentient beings
Psychically tap into the collective unconscious (psychic reservoir) of the inhabited world at will
weaknesses: Places for Pro #1 and Pro #2 require at least one sentient being at the target destination (NCN)
Pro #3 only allows enhancement of any psychic abilities one ALREADY possesses until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Demos' Demeanor, etc provides immunity (NCN)

name: Hunger Empowerment
description: With this power, breakfast is overrated. If you are hungry, you can gain super powers, like super strength, super speed, higher and farther jumping capacity, and super resilient skin. It also gives you a maddened psychology, doing anything for food. This power wears off if you eat anything.
summary: The ability to gain powers from being hungry
strengths: No breakfast, you carry a piano while running a marathon jumping 1 metre into the air while doing it
Doesn't matter how hungry you are, you still get the amount of powers.
Easily reversible with food, and you can trick your maddened self into doing stuff for food.
weaknesses: Maddened state, unpredictable.
Cannot stop you from dying of hunger.
You can easily be turned into a hunger slave.

name: Red Rain
description: You are able to create a burning crimson rainstorm that affects all things everywhere and can hit several times before disappearing.
summary: The ability to create red-colored raindrops that dissolve everything
strengths: No one is invulnerable to it, especally like golems and androids.
weaknesses: If it gets out of control, it'll try to dissolve everyone, even you might get burned by it.

name: Real World
description: Whoever has this power basically creates a field around the planet that they are currently inhabiting which makes all of those inside of it lose the ability to use super powers, and forget that super powers were ever anything more than fiction.
summary: The ability to negate all super powers
strengths: No evil super powered idiots running amuck
If you become aware of your powers you can shorten the field to only affect a certain area
weaknesses: No super powers.... For anyone........ Ever.
You have no idea that you have this power unless someone far enough away from you sends a message.

name: Increased Acrobatic Skill
description: Basically you will be the best urban ninja ever. Other freerunners will be jealous and you will give the circus people a big middle finger. It ranges from jumping high or long distances, increased speed to make the jump, and massive upper body strength.
summary: The ability to perform feats that would make any acrobat, freerunner, or traceur jealous
strengths: Good for escaping
Getting up buildings will be a breeze
Falling will be easier, just swing on something
weaknesses: Basically just for escaping
A good way to get to the fight but then just look dumb jumping around your enemy
Not strong or abnormally fast unless the purpose is for basically getting somewhere quicker

name: Transformers: Astrotrain
description: With this power you are able to summon and control a sentient version of Astrotrain's Astroforce, an army of drones that resemble trains. A side effect of this power allows you to turn your skin gray.
summary: The ability to summon and control the Astroforce
strengths: You can summon the Astroforce
You can turn your skin gray
weaknesses: The Astroforce isn't really that smart and are more likely to crash into each other than anything

name: Con Activation
description: With this ability, you can essentially negate Con Negation within 100 meters of you. All powers entering the area must now be restricted by their downsides and any person must suffer the consequences of normal power use. Since this does not negate, power protection powers offer little, if any, protection. It can be easily turned on and off at will.
summary: The ability to reactivate negated cons.
strengths: Stop heavily overpowered power combinations such as Bursts of Invinicibility + Con Negation.
Even affects powers entering the area, such as a Farslayer-based attack.
Easily turned on and off.
weaknesses: Affects you too; you had better have some other ways of dealing with the cons up your sleeve.
Limited range, at least without other powers. Naturally, this is vulnerable to Radius Distortion.
Is only effective against Con Negated powers.

name: Porcelain Secretion
description: You have the ability to secrete a unique variety of porcelain from any area of your body with pores. This porcelain is secreted as a liquid but hardens almost instantly on contact with air. It is heatproof and strong enough to withstand moderate impacts, as well as incredibly light-weight.
summary: The ability to secrete fast-harden porcelain from every pore of your body
strengths: Cutting weapons will just encounter and shatter a barrier of porcelain instead of cutting you.
Fire powers will have little to no effect on you.
Doesn't slow you down much.
weaknesses: If you secrete it from jointed areas of your body, your movement will be impeded.
It's not completely indestructible, and once it shatters you have to secrete more.
Squeezing porcelain out of your pores is fairly painful.

name: Bond
description: A bond connects two people. When the two bonded people are together, they gain incredible powers. Random for every one of them.
summary: The ability to bond with somebody.
strengths: Great tag team.
Great power.
weaknesses: If one of the bonded die, the others die too.

name: Panontic Arch:Panhydri
description: Panhydri,the entirely liquid dimension. You gain immunity to water pressure and dehydration. Your body acts as a sponge. You can soak up anything liquid. Your body acts a conduit to the panhydri dimension. You feel no effects of any liquid you soak up. Poisons,acids,liquid nitrogen won't affect you. You could absorb a liquid being by touch. You could in theory absorb the oceans of the world.
summary: The ability to gain powers the Panhydri dimension.
strengths: Immunity to liquid based attacks.
You can absorb water elemental types.
weaknesses: While you can explore the deepest areas of the ocean,you still need oxygen.

name: Weapon: Sword Of Tristain
description: With this sword, the user can heal themselves from any injury as long as they are fighting for love.   Poisons and anything that does continuous damage are only delayed, not permanently healed
summary: The ability to wield the sword that was used by Tristain
strengths: Almost invincible, except against poisons and the like
Sharp enough to slay dragons
weaknesses: If you are not fighting for love, then the effect is negated and the sword can break
Not a divine class or magic class weapon

name: Musical Brawl
description: Depending on the song itself the power can temporarily increase or decrease the fighters strength, speed, and reactions. The ability is very useful for fighters trained in hand-to-hand combat.
summary: The ability to fight within a rythem of a song the user is listening to.
strengths: Movements can be unpredictable
Possible chance of increased atributes within the duration of the song
Can enjoy music in a fight
weaknesses: Enemies can predict movements if they know of the song.
Power can not be active without music
Some music can effect the user in a negative way

name: Additional Pylons
description: Summon a floating pylon to any location that powers or fuels anything within its radius. The size of the pylon can be changed, but the radius of the power changes equal to the size. Larger pylons take more focus and control to summon. Pylon colors can be changed, but this has no effect on what it does. Pylons can be destroyed or unsummoned. Pylons cannot be summoned if another object is in the way.
summary: The ability to summon an unlimited number of Protoss Pylons.
strengths: Free energy or fuel.
Color and size can be controlled.
Unlimited amount.
weaknesses: Can be destroyed or unsummoned.
Radius of power is limited by the size of the pylon.
Will always need additional pylons to power new areas.

name: Crodo: Ban Hammer
description: Once the user of this hammer hits the selected target,it will be banned from earth either sending them to heaven or hell.
summary: The ability to wield a ban hammer.
strengths: Ban someone from earth.
weaknesses: Easy to dodge.

name: Two Headed Dragon Summon
description: With this power you can summon a two headed dragon that is under your complete control. The dragon has a quirk though (aside from the two head thing) one of it's heads breathes fire while the other one breathes ice. The dragon can also fly, is super strong and has extremely sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
summary: The ability to summon a two headed dragon
strengths: You can summon a two headed dragon.
One of its heads breathes fire while the other breathes ice.
It can fly is super strong and has really sharp teeth in both of its mouths.
weaknesses: You can only summon one so if it dies you loose this power.

name: Cyborg Summon
