description: With this power you can summon an army of cyborgs. There are hundreds of different kinds of cyborgs, each of them being half of a different machine. Such as half car half human cyborgs, half television half human cyborgs etc. You can summon up to ten of each kind of cyborg and they are all under your control. Each cyborg as has super strength, invulnerability and heat vision. When you're done with them you can send them back to wherever they came from.
summary: The ability to summon an army of cyborgs
strengths: You can summon an army of cyborgs
You can have up to ten of each kind of cyborg
weaknesses: The cyborgs might be reprogrammed
The cyborgs might be destroyed

name: Transformers: Bumblebee
description: With this power whenever you punch someone it will feel like they are being stung by something. You can turn this power on and off. A side effect of this power is that children often think that you are cool.
summary: The ability to cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
strengths: You can cause a stinging sensation when you punch someone
weaknesses: The sting isn't enough to defeat an enemy

name: Shakespearean Wordsmith
description: This infinitely useful power can make you seem clever and well-learned by quoting the works of Shakespeare (where such a quote relates to the unfolding situation). With each quote, whether by you or any other conversational participant, you (and any powers you may have) become stronger. Perfect for those moments when, as you lay dying, your Arch-Nemesis unwittingly quotes the second act of 'The Taming of the Shrew'. Boom.
summary: The ability to recall any quote from the complete works of Shakespeare and to derive power from them.
strengths: Shakespearean idioms have become so integrated in culture that holding a conversation requires them.
Makes one appear better educated and seem more well-read.
Invariably increases the epicness of any moment by up to 500%. Guaranteed.
weaknesses: Irrelevant quotes do not provide the same power boost as those pertaining to the situation.
Intellectually-challenged Arch-Enemies may not appreciate or understand your superior wit.
Those people who thought you were a bit weird before are going to be completely convinced of it now.

name: Chaneled Form: Sword
description: Normally a touch-type power(Ex: Death Touch) does not extend beyond the what you touch. However with this power, you can channel that power into the form of a sword. The sword is the length of a standard European shortsword and when it hits the target it does not cut, but instead goes through the target and the power's effect activates.
summary: The ability to channel a touch-type power into the form of a sword
strengths: Don't have to touch the target anymore.
weaknesses: Only 'tactile' or 'touch-type' powers.
Still a pretty small range.

name: Baka
description: Baka translates as stupid or foolish. This power works in a 100 metre radius and stupid or foolish is randomly chosen by the power itself. The effect lasts for 1 hour.
summary: The ability to make anyone absolutely stupid or foolish for an hour
strengths: You get to choose the target.
This power is great for a prank during a test.
weaknesses: The power chooses stupidity or foolishness.

name: Phone Fingers
description: All you need to do is make like you're holding a phone using your thumb and pinky finger, think of whoever you want to call, and boom, their phone will ring.  You can have a full conversation with perfect reception, and worldwide coverage. No dropped calls and no battery to worry about! When someone calls you, your fingers will ring--unless of course you have them on vibrate or silent mode. And to top it off, you can change your number to whatever you want (as long as it isn't already taken).
summary: The ability to call anyone just by holding your fingers in the shape of a phone.
strengths: Emergency calls during common situations like avalanches, meteor storms and stampedes of goats
Prank calling Santa Clause and Paris Hilton
Drunk dialing
weaknesses: You never have the excuse of "I couldn't find my phone"
You might look funny talking into your hand
Drunk dialing

name: Darkcalibur
description: With this power, you can possess Darkcalibur. Perhaps one of most disturbing powers, Darkcalibur is a very large, black-grayish silver sword in the stone attributed with evil magical powers or associated with the dark arts.  Thrust it and a dark, nocturnal beam comes out to damage your enemies.
summary: The ability to possess the Darkcalibur sword. It fires a powerful dark beam to damage your enemies.
strengths: None to be exact.
weaknesses: It can only be used by Evildoers.

name: Summon Kruai
description: Kruai are 6 and a half feet tall. They look like scaly monkeys. Kruai can shape their hatred of non-kystians into solid melee weapons of emotional energy. Impenetrable forcefield, anti-telepathy and psionic armor will block the attack. Someone who can absorb emotions will temporarily disrupt this power. The weapon will otherwise ignore armor and normal forcefields cutting through any solid foe. Kruai can lift 10 tons and run 40 mph. Kruai are summoned with regular weapons.
summary: The ability to summon a hate-based weaponsmaster Kystian.
strengths: The melee weapons can be anything. Whip, katana, pole arm,etc.
Kruai can use two weapons at the same time.
Kruai are summoned with weapons to deal with foes immune to its special ability.
weaknesses: Emotion-based powers can manipulate the weapons

name: Liquoromancy
description: This way of the seeing the future was first thought of by someone only known as WHD. This is how the power works. The number of shots you pour determines how many questions you can get a yes or no answer to and how many days you can see in the future. You have to down all the shots in rapid succession or you get no questions answered. Cheap or bad liquor reduces the chances to get a correct answer. Good moonshine or a aged liquor will give best chances to get a correct answer.
summary: The ability to see the know the future by pouring shots.
strengths: One question and one day into the future for each shot of liquor.
If you can't get drunk.
You can get your hands on some good moonshine or aged liquor.
weaknesses: You can't/won't drink liquor.
You're underaged.

name: Price Negotiator
description: With this power, you can negotiate the price of anything. While you might not get 50% off, you will always be successful at lowering the price to some degree. This works even at the grocery line, where the art of bartering has been lost completely. Sometimes you even get lucky and end up with 99% off!
summary: The ability to barter and haggle with anyone with guaranteed success
strengths: Get great deals on things you purchase
Black Friday deals are even cheaper
Save hundreds or potentially thousands of dollars
weaknesses: At the store, you might be "that guy"
No guarantees that your discount will be significant

name: Celtic Invocation: Nemetona
description: By invoking the power of Nemetona, the invoker may detect and locate places of power and sacredness, such as ley lines, sacred groves and springs, menhirs, etc. The invoker may also be able to create a sacred space, such as a circle of standing stones. Any invocations done within a sacred place created by the invoker can be strengthened or weakened, and the invoker may also strengthen or weaken the strength of natural sacred places. They can also allow or bar entry into such places.
summary: The ability to utilise the power of Nemetona, the Celtic goddess of sacred places.
strengths: Nothing can best you in a sacred space.
A hastily drawn circle can end up being a stronghold in your hands.
Find some important historic places without any effort.
weaknesses: Not much use offensively, or if not near a sacred space.
The creation of the sacred spaces are only available to the more powerful invokers.
Other users of Celtic Invocation: Nemetona, or those with the ability to pass through/destroy wards.

name: Myth Power: Ceraunobolia Strike
description: Ceraunobolia (Keraunobolia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the thunderbolt (simultaneous lightning flash and thunder crash). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate electricity at will, which simultaneously amplifies all ambient sound. In addition, one can absorb natural sound and electricity to gain physical power. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel those who are afraid of thunder and lightning, and teleport to the site of thunderbolt strikes
summary: The ability to channel Ceraunobolia's command over the essence of the thunderbolt
strengths: Psychically generate electricity, simultaneously amplifying all ambient sound into a sonic boom
Absorb sound and electricity to gain physical power at will; teleport to thunderbolt sites
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who fear thunder and lightning
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not automatically home in to strike only foes until developed (NCN)
Cannot cause sounds to automatically produce accompanying electricity until developed (NCN)
Electrokinesis, Electrical Immunity, MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and the like provide immunity

name: Myth Power: Memento Moros
description: Moros (Morus, Olethros, Olethrus), in Greek myth, was the god of doom, destructive forces and depression. As such, channeling him allows one to to perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death, at will (this may be shared by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists, and those fated to die soon. Furthermore, one can cause matter to wither and decay, by touch, at will. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Moros' command over the essence of depression and impending doom and destruction
strengths: Psychically perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death by touch (shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists and those fated to die soon
Wither/decay matter by touch; withstand Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers
weaknesses: Cannot project 'Doom Bolts' (matter-withering psychic energy) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only send foes through time to their fated time/place of death by touch at the higher levels (NCN)
Unpredictability and Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Sleeping
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power put whatever it hits into a sleeping state for 2 hours. Computers will shut off if hit. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power cause sleepiness in addition to other effects
strengths: Put what you hit to sleep.
Duration of sleep can be lengthened.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Affects allies too.

name: Enhancement: Unbreakable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the connections the power it is attached to unbreakable. This will only work for a power if the connection being made does NOT harm either side of the connection. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power's connection(s) unbreakable
strengths: No one can break the telepathic communication connections you make anymore!
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Does not help connections that drain, leech, or otherwise hurt one/both side(s) of the connection.

name: Rainbow Immunity
description: This ability allows one to resist any subject, object, projectile or attack colored with one or more colors of the rainbow. Green Lantern's green energy attacks, Kryptonite of any color, Cyclops' red optic blasts, Psylocke's purple (violet) telekinetic energy, Hellion's green telekinetic energy, etc. Even red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet colored SKIN reduces the effect of a foe's attacks. In addition, It doesn't disrupt, reduce or otherwise affect one's own color-based power.
summary: The ability to withstand anything colored with one or more colors of the rainbow
strengths: Immune to any effects pertaining to rainbow colors
Even SKIN colored with one or more rainbow colors reduces effects of a foe's attacks
Often doesn't negatively affect your own color based powers
weaknesses: At the lower levels, it might affect one's own color based powers
If it's permanently active (never wear clothes or touch items with colors from the rainbow)
Doesn't work on White Light, or any other non-rainbow colors

name: Chemical Reanimator
description: This power gives you retractable needles from your hands that can inject a glowing green liquid into a dying or dead person. There can be no brain damage. The reanimated will lose 10% of their IQ for each hour after their death. There can be a loss of basic civilized behavior -- even if you inject a dying person -- that causes loss of feeling guilt or lack of conscience. You could make someone zombie-like in behavior. These reanimated won't decay, age or heal.
summary: The ability to reanimate someone with a glowing green liquid.
strengths: A way to help someone cheat death. A horrible way, but still cheating death.
You can use this power on yourself if you're that desperate not to die.
weaknesses: You actually use this power on yourself.

name: Dr. Octagonapus
description: Make Dr. Octagonapus come to your location and fire his laser at your enemy, instantly annihilating them
summary: The ability to summon a tentacle man that shoots lasers at people
strengths: Your enemies are instantly destroyed.
weaknesses: You may get caught in the attack as well

name: Superpower Dispersal
description: This power only works on beings with multiple superpowers, including mimicked and stolen ones, and some of the ones which give multiple abilities. When used, they will lose all their powers save for a random one and the lost ones are given to the closest powerless beings, one ability each. The downside is you can only have one ability as well, including this one, but if you somehow acquire another one, there would be a chance that you lose this power due to the dispersion that will take place.
summary: The ability to scatter the abilities of a superpowered being, leaving them with only one.
strengths: In the case of some powers with multiple aspects, they will be split into atomic powers.
Great against the ones with a lot of abilities, power thieves and power duplicators.
weaknesses: You can only have one power, including this one. That pretty much means you only have this power.
Doesn't work on someone with Power Safety.

name: Opposite Sex Mirrors
description: These special mirrors let you see how you would look in your opposite sex! Even your clothes & other accessories are gender-bended in the reflection! However, your real gender hasn't actually changed.
summary: The ability to see your reflection in your opposite sex
strengths: See how you would look if you were born in your opposite sex.
Play the fun game of how clothes, shoes, & more will look in the reflections!
weaknesses: If you break these special mirrors, it's 14 years bad luck! (7 for each gender)
Androgynous things will still look exactly the same in the reflections... Boring!

name: Cat Speak
description: You can talk in, and understand the language of cats
summary: The ability to know the cat laugage
strengths: Ask cats for favors
Ask cats info
weaknesses: You cannot control Cats oly speak to them
You cannot speak dog

name: Transformer
description: You have a car that can Turboboost. Useful to fight bad guys and solve crimes. Can change into something small, so you can carry it with you in your pocket.
summary: The ability to have a flying car that can change into something small
strengths: Flying/jumping car
Can be changed into something small
weaknesses: Just two abilities, nothing more

name: Evolving Swarm
description: You can create a microbe that evolves so quickly it's descendants will evolve to human complexity in 3 months it's relatives will respect you as a god but will evolve to be able to hate you if it is good for it. Can create multiple evolving swarms if one hates you. They can copy any biological mechanism they get DNA from powers traits tricks to solving problems.
summary: The ability to create a microbe that evolves
strengths: The swarm(s) are good allies if you stay on their good side.
weaknesses: They may grow to hate you.
Thay can replicate any power from DNA if it's biological including this one.

name: Summoning: Thanatos
description: You can now summon the power of Thanatos, the god of death. He resembles a small child, and his personality is innocent. But don't let this fool you, he has the power to freeze anything to death.
summary: The ability to summon Thanatos.
strengths: Freeze things.
weaknesses: Might lose control.

name: Soul Incasement
description: You can create a cage made from a random person's soul encasing your victim. As a side effect, the cage slowly closes in on them, not harming their body, but crushing their soul.
summary: The ability to release a cage made of a random person's soul so powerful only another soul attack can escape
strengths: Defence against the enemy
weaknesses: Will give the enemy a most painful death
A random person dies from the soul exchange, so although there are many, it may kill a loved one

name: Taste Warp
description: With this power you can change the taste of any food this is good for making the disgusting food you're eating taste like pizza or something or to make the delicious food your enemies are eating taste like something gross
summary: The ability to change the tastes of any food
strengths: The pros are listed above
weaknesses: No use in combat

name: Gift: Stone
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using rock-based powers than other beings. Thus their rock- and stone-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of stone from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve rock-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at rock-based powers
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over stone as someone with this power.
Rock-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only rock-based powers now.

name: Snow Cat
description: Snow cats are white cats that are 3 to 4 feet tall, they  have the abilities of a normal cat and can make the temperature drop below zero.
summary: The ability to transform in to a Snow Cat at will.
strengths: You can make it freeze
You look very cute and cuddly
weaknesses: It takes about two hours to go back to being human.
They want to photograph you for lolcat pictures

name: Blessing Of Zhu Que
description: Is one of the four Chinese celestial beasts according to the Taoist five-elemental system,and is alternatively knows as the Vermilion Bird of the South. With it's blessings you will gain the ability to fly and be imbued with supernatural grace for as long as you are facing the direction south. The blessing will also grant you control of the element of fire.
summary: The ability to have the power of a bird when facing south.
strengths: Flight.
Grace.
Fire powers.
weaknesses: You must be facing south for your powers to activate.
Zhu-Que is not a pheonix, and you do not have the ability to resurrect after death.

name: Bob Omb Summon
description: With this power you can summon an unlimited amount of Bob-ombs from the Mario series. They are under your complete control and you can also control when they explode or prevent them from exploding. You can unsummon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Bob-ombs
strengths: You can summon an army of Bob-ombs
They are under your complete control
You can control when they explode
weaknesses: You can be hurt by the explosions

name: Nitric Acid Vision
description: It is similar to Heat Vision. You can use the highly corrosive strong mineral acid that shoots from your eyes. Before you shoot the Nitric Acid Vision your eyes are all Red Orange with no visible pupils, how high the tempature and the size is determined by you.
summary: The ability to shoot Nitric Acid from your eyes
strengths: Use it to melt doors, guns, fight foes, etc
A power that makes you very powerful
120 Yards Away for how far you can Fire It
weaknesses: Unable to Use if a foe that manipulate ice freezes you
If a foe can absorb nitric acid, or acids then the foe could use your own power on you
If a Foe Covered your eyes while you were using it, a explosion would happen

name: Millenium Fists
description: It doesn't matter if you're far or close, your arms and hands will flash and then you'll be able to throw a million punches to break through barriers, dizzy your opponent, and put them to sleep.
summary: The ability to endlessly fire off dozens of punches to knock out your opponent.
strengths: Might be great for Boxing, Wrestling, and Mixed Martial Arts
weaknesses: You can get cramps in your arms

name: Myth Power: Ate's Attitude
description: Ate, in Greek myth, was the goddess of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion (infatuation, blind folly, naivete, rash choices, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce false comfort, by touch. In addition, one can psychically act as a subject's conscience, by touch, word or thought; subjects will follow any naive or unwise suggestion one gives. One can even psychically take on one other deceptive ability (Shapeshifting, Illusion Casting, etc) to cause mischief with, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ate's command over the essence of evil, mischief, ruin and delusion
strengths: Induce false comfort by touch (subjects will trust you)
Act as a subject's conscience by touch, word or thought; they will take any detrimental suggestions
Take on one other mischievous, deceptive ability (Vocal Mimicry, Ventriloquism, Invisibility, etc)
weaknesses: Pro #3 only allows use of one extra deceptive/mischievous power at a time until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Thrasos' Thrill provide immunity (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Super Losers
description: This power will only work for people on the superpower list. Simply by interacting with another person's profile, you will eliminate all of their current powers. This power will only work on a user once and if they gain new superpowers afterward, they cannot be eliminated. If a user has an ability-canceling power, this power will not work, unless you have an ability-canceling-canceler power. A person can revive their superpowers with a soon-to-be created superpower Superrevival. Until then, bye!
summary: The ability to eliminate other superpowers
strengths: Eliminate others' superpowers
Unaffected by your own superpower
Really cool
weaknesses: Superpowers are revivable.
Really annoying

name: Stormsong (Storm Song)
description: This ability is the power to induce stormy weather or just unpleasant weather conditions around a foe (or a group of foes, or an area) by singing a song. This song is not a song of the user's choosing, but is innately known by the user; and once he/she produces it, the skies will darken, winds will whip up, rain will pour or any other desired weather effect for the user's pleasure. The user can even make a storm cell follow one particular person, or the like.
summary: The ability to produce a song which invokes changes to the weather
strengths: Start storms around foes (bestows foe with a great voice)
Increase or stop current storms at will
Make them follow foes around
weaknesses: If your voice doesn't improve (and it isn't good to start) and the power still requires singing
If your power can only start storms and not stop them (and can't make them worse/better)
Only cause storms native to the environment (sandstorms in the desert, hurricanes in Florida, etc. )

name: Myth Power: Harpies' Harassment
description: The Harpyiae (Harpyiai, Harpies), named Aello, Ocypete (Okypete), Celaeno (Kelaeno) and Podarge (Podarke, Podarce), in Greek myth, were the sister goddesses of powerful storm winds which snatch things away into the unknown. As such, channeling them allows one to generate, manipulate and resist tornado/hurricane-force winds at will. In addition, one may touch an object, attuning it to the winds, so the winds only retrieve/affect things one desires. One may even sprout powerful wings at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Harpyiae and their command over the essence of destructive storm winds
strengths: Generate, manipulate and withstand powerful storm winds (like tornadoes, hurricanes and typhoons)
Attune objects or subjects to the wind, so only desired things are picked up by the winds
Sprout superstrong, powerful wings for flight, or for combat
weaknesses: Cannot calm storm winds, only direct them (NCN)
Cannot generate winds, unless they are storm-force (NCN)
Strongest when used in groups of three or four; power cannot be shared until higher levels (NCN)

name: Spicy Flames
description: Ever felt that you breathed fire after eating something spicy, well now you will! After consuming something spicy, you'll begin to breathe flames from your mouth. The size and temperature of the flames depend on the spiciness of the food eaten, the duration of the power depends on the amount of food eaten. In addition, your mouth and nearby body parts (Head, Neck) are fireproof
summary: The ability to generate flames from consuming spicy foods.
strengths: Easy to activate and attack with.
If controlled, functional and practical outside of battle
Good party trick
weaknesses: Involuntary, once you eat something remotely spicy, you will start breathing fire
You might not like spicy food
Might hurt close friends and family if not careful

name: Taboo
description: The user of this power is able to trap their enemies in a special gourd if their enemies says their most frequent word or phrase once they are hit by a special golden rope attached on the user's arm . Enemies who figure out this power and remain silent, meaning they do not talk , will also be dragged into the gourd after 5 minutes . An enemy will be able to escape if he or she changes their frequent word to another word
summary: The ability to trap a person within a special gourd if he or she says their most frequent word
strengths: Most people dont know what their frequent word is
Can trap the people in the gourd indefinitely
weaknesses: Hard to touch people with the golden rope
People who know their favorite and think before they speak may be able to escape

name: Myth Power: Meiboia's Measure
description: Meiboia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of bees. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command bees at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a bee at will. Furthermore, one can generate sonic force, or hypnotic influence, from one's wings, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically convert liquids into edible honey, by touch. One can even psychically convert neutrals into a user-dominated hive mind, by touch, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Meiboia's command over the essence of bees
strengths: Perceive, communicate with, command and mimic powers of bees
Generate sonic or hypnotic effects from one's wings, convert liquids into honey (by touch), at will
Psychically assimilate neutrals into a user-dominated hive-mind, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot astral-project a hive of spirit-bees at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn into a swarm of bees at will (or generate beeswax from hands) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain Bee-Swarm Immortality (spirit-bees released to form new body) until developed (NCN)

name: Summon Pack Of Flickerspawn
description: Flickerspawn are from the Kyst dimension. There are six flickerspawn in a pack. A flickerspawn looks like a skeletal human remolded into a wolfish shape. A pack will see you as its master, but will attack anyone else unless commanded not to. Flickerspawn are as smart as dolphins and have a limited teleport ability with a 20-foot range. They are as strong as five normal men. They can be damaged or killed, but to hurt or kill one you have to hurt or kill each member of the pack simultaneously.
summary: The ability to summon a pack of half-alive things
strengths: Six in one summoning.
A teleport ability useful in combat.
Understand any command a dolphin would.
weaknesses: Can't understand what a dolphin wouldn't understand.
They're not bipedal, you still need help to carry loot from a robbery.

name: Communicate With Dogs
description: With this power you can speak to and be fully understood by canines. Also, you can comprehend exactly what a dog is saying. That means you can carry on a conversation with a dog or you will understand what the dog behind the fence is yelling(barking)about!
summary: The ability to speak to dogs and hear what they are saying
strengths: You will know which well Timmy is in.
You will know which food your pet likes best.
You can explain why chasing cars is a bad idea.
weaknesses: You'll hear French Poodles accents !!
Needy pooches that want to talk amd talk and talk
Bitchy lap dogs

name: Talent Of Weaving
description: This power may sound weak, but it is very powerful. You know all about sewing, knitting, weaving, and knots. You can weave grass into a rope or bark shreddings into a shelter roof. Your weavings are three times as strong as a normal one would be and they are more comfortable and durable. You can form a rope hammock in less than two minutes or a pillow in thirty seconds. You can knit or manipulate thread as well as with needles so weavings are done immenseley fast.
summary: The ability to have a natural mastery of weaving.
strengths: Description cant be shortened and pros cant be negated.
Usefull.
weaknesses: Power sacrifice can affect this.

name: Surprise Caller
description: You need to have a phone next to you to use this power. When you activate it, if anyone in the world is dialing another and nobody's picked up yet or if they've been put on hold, the phone next to you will intercept the call and ring. If you pick up, you'll be talking to the caller. You can't control which call the phone will intercept though. And it only works on calls which haven't been picked up yet or which have been put on hold.
summary: The ability to intercept the call of anyone in the world who's just dialed and is waiting for someone to pick up.
strengths: Intercept calls.
Answer in stead of the intended recipient.
A new form of prank call. Instead of calling strangers, they call you!
weaknesses: You can't control who will be on the other side of the line.
The call can still be traced to you.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: You Are What You Eat.
description: With this power you become like anything you are able to eat. This can range from plants to animals or even items that are normally not food. You will not directly turn into the object that you eat, but gain some of its characteristics. So if you somehow are able to eat a house, you would be able to open up your body and have dollhouse-like rooms inside you. You can only take on the characteristics of one thing at a time and can choose when the power activates.
summary: The ability to change your body so that you become like anything that you eat.
strengths: Gain the characteristics of whatever you eat.
Works on nonfood items as well.
Effect lasts for as long as you wish.
weaknesses: Need other powers to be able to eat non-food objects.
Can only gain the characteristics of one thing at a time.
Usefullness of this power depends on what you are able to eat.

name: Blow My Stack!
description: We've all been bullied some more than others, with this ability you gain superpowers how they bully you, like if they taunt you by saying "hey Superman! " Then you gain super strength, if they say "hey Speedy Gonzales! " Then you gain super speed, etc. It is not just verbal bullying either, if they chase you you gain super speed,etc.
summary: The ability to gain powers as another bullies you.
strengths: Bullying becomes a superpower
Verbal or Physical
weaknesses: If your that cool kid no one messes with.
You have to be fed up with them bullying you and then all their taunts become super powers.

name: Invent Mimicry
description: With this ability, you mimic what your inventions can do, like Benjamin Franklin would have electricity control.  Furthermore, when you get to this higher level of this power you are able to summon objects you created.
summary: The ability to mimic the things your inventions can do.
strengths: Mimic the things your inventions can do.
weaknesses: Some invention have no follow-up powers, like a keychain.
The invention has to be known by at least 13 people.
Con Negation and similar powers do not work.

name: Fork In The Road
description: With this power you can cause giant forks (either metal or plastic) to shoot out of roads. You can do this as many times and anywhere you want as long as it's on a road/highway/street/bridge. You can't make the forks go back into the ground so be careful where you use this power. If you have super strength or a bulldozer or something it is possible to remove the fork from the ground and throw it away somewhere.
summary: The ability to cause giant forks to come out of the ground
strengths: You can make giant forks shoot out of streets and roads
You can make the fork either metal or plastic
You can use this power as many time as you want
weaknesses: You can't make the fork go back into the ground
It only works on streets, roads, highways and bridges

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes6
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Hymenaios (Hymenaeus, Hymen- Marriage, the Wedding Ceremony and the Wedding Song), one can sense if a subject is destined to be married, to whom, and many other facts about people's marriages. In addition, one can psionically produce a wedding song that affects subjects based on their marital (marriage) status. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive and communicate with married people.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically perceive if a subject will ever get married, as well as to whom and other marriage info
Psionic Marriage Song (UNMARRIED: strengthen allies, weaken foes; MARRIED: damage foes, heal allies)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and (when developed) compel married subjects
weaknesses: Cannot form a positive psychic link with one's married spouse until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Forbidden Power:Limbo Teleport
description: Gives the user the ability to send an enemy to the limbo, the empty space between dimensions. If used too many times, there may be consequences.
summary: The ability to send an opponent to the limbo (not the game).
strengths: Instantly get rid of enemies.
They'll never come back.
weaknesses: If used over 5 times, the user will be teleported to the limbo as well.
A painful ritual will be performed to get this ability.

name: V.A.T.S.
description: Just like in the game Fallout 3, you can stop every one and target a body part. You only have a limited amount of time to use this, before it need to recharge
summary: The ability to stop some one and target a body part
strengths: You can stop and take your time,
Hit any part of the pody,
Give the person a Nut shot.
weaknesses: You have a limit
You can't move

name: X D Trapping Pit
description: You can create a volume expanding outside the boundaries of the three spatial dimensions and in the core of which dimensional travellers will fall if they travel through it. For example, if the volume is in the way of a wormhole traveller's or teleporter's "path", they will be pulled off and reappear in the core of the trap. If someone time travels while inside the volume, not only will they appear at its core, but they won't be able to travel outside the volume's period of existence.
summary: The ability to create an extradimensional pit trap, in which dimensional travellers can "fall".
strengths: If you place the core inside a prison cell, you can easily trap unwanted dimensional travellers.
It becomes tricky to use teleportation against the user.
You can trap time travellers inside a time period.
weaknesses: Don't fall into your own traps.
You can only trap someone if they venture outside the three spatial dimensions.

name: Small
description: With this ability you can do many things with the attributes of small. You can be very dificult to notice even if you're standing in front of someone. You can hide behind a needle or ride air currents. You can also manipulate small amounts of matter, such as a thread with the strength and precision of your regular body. All this is possible with you being the same size as you normally are.
summary: The ability to manipulate the attributes of small in yourself without bodily change
strengths: Cannot be shortened to top brief description only.
Useful.
Pros can't be taken away.
weaknesses: Can be beaten by power sacrifice.

name: Darthon!
description: By saying the words "Your party..." you are able to alter reality in an adventure, like if you said "Your party has just approched a fire", a fire will appear in front of you. To continue an adventure you can say something like, "My skin repels fire."
summary: The ability to start, continue, or end an adventure.
strengths: Start,continue, and end adventures.
weaknesses: You have to begin every sentence with, "Your party....... "
Can only be used in an adventure.

name: Rise Of The Cerberus V2
description: With this power you can turn into Cerberus the giant three headed Hellhound. All three of your heads have super sharp teeth and can breath fire that can melt through anything. You can also open up a portal to Hell/Underworld even when you're not in Cerberus mode.
summary: The ability to turn into the three headed hellhound
strengths: You can turn into Cerberus
You can open a portal to and from Hell
You can breathe fire
weaknesses: People might mistake you for the real Hellhound and attack you

name: Invisible Zombies
description: What's more dangerous than a zombie horde? Why, an invisible zombie horde, of course. This power lets the user summon hordes of invisible zombies. The zombies are under the command of the user. Anyone bitten will also become an invisible zombie. The typical zombie weaknesses apply, but they are harder to deal with because they are invisible. If the user dies they go berserk.
summary: The ability to create invisible zombies
strengths: Much more deadly than normal zombies
Your enemies never know if they killed all the zombies or not
The zombies obey the user of this power
weaknesses: Have to deal with a lot of zombies
If you die the invisible zombies will coninue rampaging

name: Locus Manipulator
description: When activated at a single point, the user can create a circle of energy which can be used for protection. When used for offence, two straight lines of energy, two two-dimensional circles that can be manipulated through the air, and a crashing of circles which would result in a large explosion due to the intersecting of lines.
summary: The ability to manipulate energy in the form of a geometric locus
strengths: you can control energy
no one would suspect this
Tron would be easy
weaknesses: one mess up and the explosion with leave you being peeled off the wallpaper by a couple of medics
you must be exact in your geometrical calculations
look before you shoot

name: Clothes Beam
description: With this ability, you will be able to instantly clothe anyone or anything. Clothe even inanimate objects.
summary: The ability to shoot a beam of light that instantly puts clothes on anyone or anything.
strengths: Never have to buy clothes.
Great for pranks.
No more ill-dressed people, homeless people or streakers.
weaknesses: Cannot choose what clothes appear.
May get odd looks.

name: Serath Blades
description: The blades are attached to a chain (God of War style but the chain is one not separate for each). The chain is made up of extremely sharp segments (that look like a winding staircase), these segments are extremely sharp, but are very flexible, and will fit into the users hand with ease. The chains can be twisted together to make it a double bladed staff: Moon Glaive.
summary: The ability to summon 2 serath blades.
strengths: No ammo required.
Good range and accuracy.
Powerful.
weaknesses: Can only reach so far.

name: Vacuum
description: Air is everywhere. A person with Vacuum can change that. They can drain all the air from an area and cause an implosion--but not by breathing in. Instead, they drain it into their bones via their hands. This lets them store it indefinitely. Then they can release it explosively in a single burst when they please. However, one with this ability must be careful--cracking a bone while it has gas in it causes an uncontrolled explosion that usually wrecks the surrounding tissue as it leaves.
summary: The ability to suck all the gas from an area and store it in your bones
strengths: Draining gas causes an implosion
Can explosively release gas you've stored
Opponents don't know which aspect you'll use--implode or explode
weaknesses: Limit to how much gas you can store
Breaking a bone while you have gas in it
Must use hands to absorb gas

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Dragon
description: You draw upon the power of the Dragon. You can transform into an eastern dragon, talk with eastern dragons, create an illusion of yourself as an elderly person, and create rain for a region.
summary: The ability to use the powers of the lunar calender's Dragon
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
Who's going to suspect an elderly man or woman of being a danger?
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Dragon. 1928, 1940, 1952, 1964, 1976, 1988, 2000, 2012, etc.

name: Omac Summon
description: With this power you can summon up to 12 OMACs like the ones featured in DC comics. These OMACs however are purely robot and not humans they will hunt down and destroy any person you want and you're not limited to just superhumans. The OMACs have all of the powers they have in comics including laser shooting, flight, super strength etc. When you're done you can just send them back to wherever they came from.
summary: The ability to summon OMACs
strengths: You can summon up to twelve OMACs
They will hunt down and destroy anybody you want them to
weaknesses: They can be destroyed

name: Robot Detector
description: With this power you can detect is somebody or something is a robot just by looking at them. The robot will look bright green to the person with this power thus signifying that it is a robot. This power does not work on shapeshifters taking the form of robots but it does work on alien robots.
summary: The ability to detect if somebody or something is a robot just by looking at them
strengths: You will know if there is a robot near you
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off so any robot you see will always look bright green to you

name: Information Purification
description: With this ability, the user can remove any supernatural effects from information at will. They can choose to remove only certain effects or simply make it completely mundane.
summary: The ability to remove supernatural effects from information.
strengths: With the help of other powers, protect yourself and others from Medusa-like enemies.
Counter enemy use of Information Enchantment.
One can choose to remove only some supernatural effects from a piece of information.
weaknesses: Enemies may link the supernatural effects of information together.
Only useful in non-mundane situations.
The effects may hit you before you can counter it, so you may need to have additional powers.

name: Witch Species: Straga
description: The straga were the mortal enemies of the benandanti, they could leave their bodies and enter the bodies of other animals, they could infect someone through touch causing their body to decay rapidly, they could also negate almost all non-physical abilities, (like mind-reading and things like that).
summary: The ability to have all the powers of a straga.
strengths: You can enter the mind of animals and see through their eyes.
You can kill someone just by touching them and their bodies will decay to nothing in a few hours.
You can stop other people's non-physical abilities.
weaknesses: You are the bad guy.
Any physical such as super-strength and causing physical like kinetic abilities you cannot effect.
And causing physical such as kinetic abilities you have no effect over.

name: X Slash
description: Using this power, anything you cut, gets cut in an X pattern. Depth and length of the X are determined by depth and length of original cut. This makes more blood flow out so that the person faints/dies faster. This power is automatic and will not turn off.
summary: The ability to make it look like something was cut in an X-pattern
strengths: Faster kills.
Works with anything that can slash or cut.
weaknesses: Have to spend more time and bandages to keep a captive alive.

name: Beta Cell Mimicry
description: This Mimicry belongs to the islets of Langerhans. You can produce insulin, which lowers the level of blood sugar, and amylin, which prevents nutrients from entering the bloodstream. You can inject a dose of any in anyone through touch. You can also force Hepatocyte, Myocyte and Adipocyte Mimics to store sugar (as fat for the third one), and stop Adipocyte Mimics from using their fat and Hepatocyte Mimics from releasing their sugar, but giving the latter the power to release sugar as fatty acid.
summary: The ability to produce and inject insulin and amylin, as well as trigger new abilities in other Cell Mimics.
strengths: You can help people suffering from hyperglycemia or type 1 diabetes.
You can give new abilities to Hepatocyte, Myocyte and Adipocyte (both white and brown) Mimics.
You can use the insulin and amylin you produce on yourself.
weaknesses: After a while, the body of those injected with insulin can counteract its effects.
It only works on humans and other species with a genome similar to human's, such as mice.
You can only undergo mitosis when united with all the other Mimics of the islets of Langerhans.

name: Rooster
description: With this power it's close to the power of the werewolf accept it's during the day and your can easily control the changes to fit your willpower. You morph into a hybrid form with the legs and spurs of a rooster you grow wings which help you run really fast. Plus you can create shock waves by crowing which acts as a good long range weapon. Your overall form will be mostly human though. Feet can grab things like hands and with the wings you can glide for short distances, fall great height safely
summary: The ability to crow Super sonic shock waves and take on a hybrid human/rooster form.
strengths: Super Sonic shock waves, annoy the neighbors every morning and controling the power.
Wings and legs help you run really fast, Glide and fall far without injury
Great balance and feet can be used like extra hands,Spurs on your feet act like peircing weapons.
weaknesses: You look like a chicken/man!
People think you may be tasty when fried and smothered in Bull's Eye.
Feathers are itchy.

name: Neck Elongater
description: With this power you can make your own neck or the necks of others longer or shorter. You can cause your enemies' necks to extend up to the sky where they will either die of lack of oxygen if fighting outisde or hit their head on the ceiling if fighting indoors. You can make your own neck longer in order to see over people or to reach things on high places.
summary: The ability to elongate your's and others' necks
strengths: You can make your own or others' necks longer or shorter
Hurt your enemies
See over people or reach things in high places
weaknesses: You will look weird with a long neck

name: Zephyr
description: This is a real peaceful ability. When the winds a rough, harsh, cruel and dangerous. Those who possess the zephyr ability can calm the wind becoming nice, gentle breeze's
summary: The ability to cause rough harsh winds, to be calm and gentle.
strengths: Cause rough winds to be gentle.
Can save lives in certain situations.
weaknesses: Not an ability used for combat.

name: Smoke Bubbles
description: This may be the weirdest ability yet. You can use this power when you're blowing a stream of silver/violet blue/blackish grey bubbles. If it's silver, it blows out concentrated acid, if it's violet/blue, it puts the opponent to sleep, and if it's blackish grey, it could even choke your enemy to death for a few seconds or minutes.
summary: The ability to fire a stream of greyish black bubbles which traps & chokes the opponent if they get caught in it.
strengths: You can even burp.
You can sneak your way into enemy hideouts using the silver one.
weaknesses: You might have to swollow some water, juices, soft drinks or even coffee for this ability to work.

name: Cipactli, The Primitive Earth
description: When activated, you transform into a gigantic, magnificent reptilian creature, part fish, part crocodile, part toad, with a saber-toothed mouth on each joint. While in this form, you can bless a land with fertility. You can also pull gigantic mouths made of rock out of the earth to devour an entire piece of land or sea. When closed, the mouths will form into hills, mountains or islands. Beware as creating those mouths sucks an huge amount of your energy.
summary: The ability to embody Cipactli, the creature from which the Earth was created.
strengths: You can create new pieces of land.
You can fertilize the earth on which you stand.
You can destroy a area you're not happy with.
weaknesses: You look quite ugly every time you use this power.
Using the destructive aspect of this power can severely tire your body.

name: Eye Shields
description: With this superpower, you can create invisible psionic shields that protect your eyes. They protect your eyes from things like dust, acid, toxic fumes, water, pencils, and rocks. The shields can withstand up to 50 pounds of pressure and allow oxygen to pass through. If the eye sheilds are hit with more than 50 pounds of force, the shields will disappear. You can summon the eye sheilds again. The power can be turned off. Does not protect eyes from blinding light.
summary: The ability to summon invisible shields that protect your eyes.
strengths: Protect your eyes from dust and toxic gases and other things.
Sheilds let in oxygen.
Can be turned off.
weaknesses: Limit of 50 pounds.
Does not protect your eyes from blinding light.

name: Hatred
description: Say you were stabbed in the back by your best friend and then he stole your wife and plotted to kill you, only when he tried to kill you, you activated this power. It would instantly give you so much strength and resistance to injury that would get Hollywood directors begging you to star in their horror flicks. You will die if you're not careful and don't treat your wounds immediately afterward. It's not really a power, more like a honed skill. Anyone with the will can pull it off.
summary: The ability to be fueled by your anger to settle a score.
strengths: Damage resistant
Strong
Terrifying to enemies. (why won't you die!? D: )
weaknesses: Can die, just takes a long time.
Treat your wounds or suffer for it.
Not really a super power, anyone can do it if they wanted to.

name: Dog Shift
description: This power changes you into a dog. The type of dog you change into will determine on your personality. Ex. If you're a tough cop with an angry attitude, German Shepard. If you're a sissy, a poodle. If you're a cute little baby, a puppy! However, you will have animal urges. You can switch to dog form any time you want, but you may be so happy in it you'll never want to change back. (I have nothing against cats or poodles.)
summary: The ability to change into a dog
strengths: Sniff around for fun
Run really fast
weaknesses: Doggy urges
Avoid cars
Bad news for cats

name: Mutation: Spike Shell
description: This mutation causes a shell with spines to form on your back. This increases your defensive capabilities significantly. Mutations increase spike and shell strength, as well as size.
summary: The ability to mutate to have a shell with spikes on the back
strengths: Increases offense and defense
Includes both.
weaknesses: Increases weight

name: Ghost Of The Past
description: The past ghost is a white-robed, androgynous figure of indeterminate age, with a head of blazing light reminiscent of a candle flame. This spirit grabs your hand, takes you far back into the past to show you what you were like, have been missing in your live and what you should never should do wrong.
summary: The ability to summon a sprit to let a person to view his/her past.
strengths: You and your past ghost see others and they cannot see you.
It could redeem a person
weaknesses: You cannot even talk to others while you are with the past spirit.

name: Mummy Spawn
description: With this power you can make angry brain eating mummies appear out of nowhere.
summary: The ability to make mummies appear out of nowhere
strengths: They want to eat enemy brains
They will not attack you
weaknesses: They might attack your allies

name: Jli Summon
description: With this power you can summon any member of the Justice League International. You can summon them at any time, but they are not under your control. So if you're a villain, they probably won't want to help you. When you're done with them, you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any member of Justice League International
strengths: You can summon any member of the JLI
You can send them back to their home universe when you're done with them
weaknesses: If you're a villain they won't want to help you

name: Thermovariance
description: If you have thermovariance, no one can get close to you. If they do, you raise their blood temperature.
summary: The ability to raise blood temperature
strengths: No one can touch you.
You are free from bondage (burning ropes and chains).
If you don't like someone, you don't have to get your hands dirty.
weaknesses: You can be reckless.
You can't touch your best friends or family.
You can destroy thousands.

name: Four Eyes
description: You have four eyes. Two eyes are in the normal spots and the other two are in the same spots on the opposite sides of the body. Ex. Back of hands, shoulders, elbows, etc. When the eyes are open you can see auras and your eyesight is improved so that you can see up to 1000m away.
summary: The ability to have four eyes
strengths: Not as obvious as an eye on the forehead (hopefully).
Can see auras and have improved eyesight.
Eyes could become more powerful in time.
weaknesses: Leaves easily-seen bumps where the eyes were.
Eyesight and aura seeing only when all the eyes are open.
Eyes have no use in a fight.

name: Exclusive Uniqueness
description: For reasons still unknown, the universe cannot acknowledge more than one of you, meaning that no one who intentionally looks like you can ever exist. So, any clone, shapeshifted version, doppelganger, look-alike of you disappears the moment they are created. The copies must have been created with the purpose of copying the user. If it was accidental or a coincidence, nothing happens. Same thing if you copy someone or something else's appearance, unless someone then tries to copy your new look.
summary: The ability to have only one of you in the whole universe.
strengths: Protection against shapeshifters and cloners.
Don't worry about impersonators.
A combo with Inverse Shapeshifting would be deadly.
weaknesses: Only works if your appearance is copied.
If you are split into copies of you (in which case the original you disappears), you cease to exist.

name: Exorcist
description: With this ability, your chest will open a hellish dimensional portal & summon impish demonic creatures into our world. They will do your bidding. They are strong, fast & clever. They become weak when around sacreligious  icons or take too much damage causing them to disappear in a cloud of brimstone dust. When your power is not in use, your strength is somewhat increased.
summary: The ability to create a dimesional portal from the chest & summon demons
strengths: Summon demonic minions
Imps are strong, fast & clever
Minor increase in strength
weaknesses: The creatures become weak & die when around holy powers
The creatures become weak & die when taking too much damage

name: Myth Power: Penthus' Penance
description: Penthus (Penthos), in Greek myth, was the god of grief (grieving), mourning, and lamentation (crying). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas, sorrows and regrets, at will. In addition, one can psychically suppress traumas, sorrows, grief and regrets of self and others at will. Furthermore, one can psychically induce uncontrollable crying, at will. One can even psychically teleport to the site of any intense psychological trauma, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Penthus' command over the essence of depression, grief, mourning and lamentation
strengths: Psychically perceive and remind subjects of past traumas/sorrows/regrets of others at will
Psychically uncontrollable crying by a touch, a word or a thought
Psychically teleport to the site of any intense trauma, at will
weaknesses: Cannot perceive, communicate with and compel unhappy/depressed/crying people until developed (NCN)
Pro #3 works best when combined with the perception-based part of Pro #1
Aniothability or sadness/grief/misery-based abilities provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ductal Cell Mimicry
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot bicarbonate and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Bicarbonate is a chemical substance which can either act as an acid or as a base in chemical reactions. The strong point of bicarbonate is its ability to dampen the acidity of acids and the basicity of bases. Additionally, you can create clones of yourself with the same powers.
summary: The ability to shoot bicarbonate, a chemical subtance which counters both acids and bases.
strengths: You can put a lid on the dangerous abilities of Parietal Cell Mimics and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics.
Duplicate yourself to outnumber a foe.
Become immune to any acid-based and base-based attacks.
weaknesses: If you shoot less bicarbonate than the quantity of acid or base, you can be overpowered.

name: The Heroes Curse
description: From the beginning to the end of your life, you will always be a hero. Whenever someone or something around you is in trouble, you will have to help them. At the end of your life, you must pass on The Heroes Curse to another. Life must always have a hero.
summary: The ability to always be a hero.
strengths: You will lead an incredible, adventurous life.
You will be a part of a long line of heroes.
You must, when you die, pass on The Heroes Curse
weaknesses: Always being a hero
You will always be getting sucked into some sort of adventure
Heroes usually die a dramatic, painful, yet heroic death

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Angels
description: The Angel, also recognized as the Malakhim, is the most common celestial being in the Angelic Hierarchy. The Angels are the ones most concerned with the affairs of living things. Within the category of angels, they have many functions as there are many different types. The Angels are mainly sent as messengers to mankind. Angels have been perceived as humans with a pair of white feathered wings.
summary: The ability to become the lowest ranking angel in the Angelic Hierarchy.
strengths: Utilize pure light as offense and defense.
Take off to the skies at magnificent speeds.
weaknesses: Limited amount of abilities.
Lowest order of angels in the hierarchy.

name: Superhuman Killing Intent
description: A person with this power has unnatural urgencies to kill and just seeing anyone can make them want to kill them even whey they know it is wrong. However if the user is strong willed they can focus this power for positive purposes. For example if they focus this on sports such as MMA and Boxing they can become unnaturally skilled, though it might be dangerous if things get out of hand. This power can override mind-control and mind-reading and the user can also sense the killing intent of others.
summary: The ability to have unnatural urgency to kill as well as easily gaining the physical capacity to do so
strengths: This ability lets you have the ability to learn deadly ways to kill people very fast
You can also sense when other people want to kill-it takes one to know one
If you have strong willpower you can focus this curse for positive purposes
weaknesses: If you don't have a strong will you might be tempted to kill people
You might find that you are hiding weapons on your person even when you don't think you are
You might have to stay in an asylum or chain yourself to prevent your desire to kill

name: Consumptive Psychometry
description: Anything that you eat, you will know the past events that have occurred to it (prior to it being eaten). When developed, you can learn something's past by just licking or biting it.
summary: The ability to know the past events that have occured to something by eating it
strengths: Forensics will be a lot easier, but it is definitely disgusting to eat a corpse.
Find out how hot dogs are REALLY made
Find out the Colonel's secret recipe and have the KFC food chain at your mercy
weaknesses: Sharp, pointy, foods will still hurt.
Eating a hamburger will give you knowledge of the lives of a cow and wheat from their perspective.

name: Collared Restraint
description: A restraint can be put on only if you have prior approval. The restraint will lower each power of the person it is on, to 1/10 of the original levels or to the point in which the person can control the power, whichever one is lower. The 'key' to take off the restraint differs for each person and is based on their personality. They will know what it is and the appearance of the restraint also differs for each person (and is based on their personality).
summary: The ability to put restraints on oneself and others that are attached to collars
strengths: Keeps your powers at a level in which you can use them.
Allies can now control powers that were uncontrollable.
weaknesses: No chance of restraining your enemies' power since they most likely won't give approval.
Affects all powers not just unstable ones.
The restraint will not change how much power you can use even if you become stronger.

name: Epic Stare
description: With this ability you can stare epicly at anyone. Enhances your popularity and your bad @$$ness.
summary: The ability to epicly stare.
strengths: Epic Stare!
weaknesses: None what so ever. It's the Epic Stare.

name: Enhancement: Untouchable
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the other power "untouchable". This, in effect, makes the other power unstealable, unmimicable, and unalterable. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. Unlike the other enhancements, you can only have one Enhancement: Untouchable at a time.
summary: The ability to have a superpower be untouchable.
strengths: One of your powers is unstealable.
One of your powers is unalterable.
One of your powers is unmimicable.
weaknesses: If attached to a power, will take a while before you are able to change the power it's attached to.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Can only have one at a time.

name: Adaptative Compatibility
description: On the one hand, when you donate your blood or one of your organs, the blood group and tissue type systems of the blood/graft change to match those of the receiver. On the other hand, when you receive someone else's blood or organ, its blood group and tissue type systems are changed to match yours. In the case you receive a contaminated blood or organ, such as a cancerous or an HIV positive one, they will only heal if your immunity system has what it takes to fight the disease.
summary: The ability to be a universal blood/organ donor and receiver.
strengths: If someone is in need of an organ transplant, you can be their savior.
If you're in need of an organ transplant, anyone else's organ can do.
Saves time from most of the compatibility tests.
weaknesses: Beware of risky organ transplants and blood transfusions.
If you donate an organ, you won't get a new one, with a few exceptions.

name: Body Blubber
description: Say" band bend" you can move your bad in ANY way Your foes will be confused.
summary: The ability to make your body bend and bind ,however long
strengths: Can stretch in unlimited ways
No pain when stretching
Can harden or soften in your control
weaknesses: Can tangle
Probably might loose control if too long
Can melt if in hot tepmuratures

name: End Dream
description: Has this ever happened to you? You're having a terrible nightmare, and you want to wake up, but it's just not happening? Well with this power you can instantly end any nightmare. You can also end dreams.
summary: The ability to stop any nightmare
strengths: Can end any nightmare (immunity to dream manipulation)
Can end any dream (wake up on time for work and the like; also works on daydreams)
If your power develops, can also end others' dreams
weaknesses: Sometime your power develops so you can only end OTHER people's dreams
Not quite the same as Lucid Dreaming (can't change dreams other than ENDING them)

name: Moon Creation/Destruction
description: This power lets you make extra moons for a planet. These moons have a stable orbit and won't crash into a planet being orbited. These moons will add extra hours to the day of a planet. These extra moons can be any type of moon(e. G. The ice-covered one around Jupiter). You can destroy these extra moons any time you choose. Extra moons won't be bigger than existing ones.
summary: The ability to make extra moons for a planet and destroy the new ones if need be.
strengths: Extra days to the calendar could mean extra holidays.
Extra resources in earth's orbit.
weaknesses: Extra days means extra work days.
The tides will be altered in unknown ways.

name: Enhancement: Giant
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it increases the physical size of the power's effects. Size increase maximum is 1000%. E.g. Toy Models to Real Items - A giant car. If stolen, the power this power is attached to permanently gains this powers effects, and this power is given to the thief. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to increase the size of the power's physical effect by attaching this power to it
strengths: Bigger powers means harder to avoid. Giant Fireball!
Limit isn't that bad. Lot of stuff you can make bigger.
Use on the cash multiplying power and you could get a giant stack of money.
weaknesses: Bigger isn't always better and this power only affects size, not potency or number of.
Power may be useless bigger or you may not want a power to be bigger (Timemaster70's kystians).
Useless by itself.

name: Biological Manipulation
description: With this, you can manipulate cells and DNA. You can heal injuries of any extent, cure diseases of any kind no matter how severe, change any physical deformation, change the actual genetic structure of living organisms, create clones, accelerate child growth, etc. A beginner can only affect through touch, but an advanced user can project beams. These beams you usually warp the air, making the beams partially visible. People may be enraged that you're using God's power.
summary: The ability to manipulate the aspects of living organisms.
strengths: Be a famous doctor
Can take away superpowers
People might worship you as a God
weaknesses: People might go into a rage by your presence
Can only take away superpowers embedded in the genes
Must know what you are doing

name: Meal Pass
description: With this ability, you never have to pay for food prepared for you at any restaurant in the world.  Be it the McD's drive-thru or the finest restaurant in the world, anything you order will be free of charge!
summary: The ability to order food at restaurants for free.
strengths: Eat for free for life
Take your friends out for dinner
Fine dining whenever you want
weaknesses: Having to go to the gym more often
People might want to take advantage of you

name: Lego Manipulation
description: With this you can make a fortress of Lego pieces and even create armour for yourself, for the joints of the armour you can manipulate the Legos to be more moveable and more flexible. You can also expel lego pieces as projectiles for attacking enemies and create boulders of solid Lego and throw it for a better chance of taking out more enemies at once.
summary: The ability to control, generate and absorb Lego pieces
strengths: It will give you enhanced durability and strength
Your attacks will be more deadly and powerful
With a constant build-up of Legos, you will not grow tired
weaknesses: The weight will give you slow reactions and slow speed
Creating boulders or other big projectiles will take away some energy

name: Drill Palm
description: When used, a mini drill will come out of the middle of your palm and you can use it to kill or drill up a wall... I don't know any other uses but you can think up some ideas.
summary: The ability to make drills come out of your palms
strengths: Hand drill.
Can be used any way you wish.
weaknesses: Sometimes you cannot control when it comes in and out.

name: Tickle Spot Detector
description:
The tickle power is cut off if the opponent manages to strike back at the superhero. 
The opponent is able to control whether he can be rendered helpless or not; its all based on his own effort. 
The tickle power can go through any clothing and also directed at anywhere in the body.
summary: The ability to discover the opponent's ticklish spot and concentrate the force of 100 people tickling that area.
strengths: You can render that opponent helpless, until they pass out.
You can get a good reputation by defeating the opponent with a simple move.
You get a good metaphysical experience.
weaknesses: You are vulnerable to repels.
You cannot move while inflicting the tickle attack.
It takes a short while to detect the tickle areas.

name: Dance Baaybe! Dance Defense
description: This is a defensive ability which unconditionally protects you from having any superpowered battle with anyone by means of simple escape, and all other sorts of super defenses, like invulnerability or teleportation. Unless the one who wishes to challenge you dances with their heels behind their neck, their forehead touching their buttocks, both their knees touching both of their elbows, and sticking their tongue out while singing their nation's national anthem, you cannot be attacked or harmed.
summary: The ability to be unconditionally protected against attack, assault, ambush, being hunted unless your enemy dances.
strengths: It is an ability that protects you as long as the enemy does not comply with the conditions.
You gain various abilities, like invulnerability, nonexistence, immortality and such to protect you.
You get a lot of fun out of this.
weaknesses: If your enemy manages to pull the stunt off.
If your enemy has 'Dance of Death', then you are in big trouble.

name: Myth Power: Angelia's Angle
description: Angelia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of news, tidings, messages, declarations and announcements. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive whenever good or bad news arises (for oneself or those to whom one is connected; loved ones, enemies, etc). In addition, one may psychically communicate with others, over long distances, as though the sender and intended recipient were right next to one another; one can also withstand Telepathy. One may even sprout wings and fly at will.
summary: The ability to channel Angelia's command over the essence of news, messages, announcements and declarations
strengths: Psychically perceive whenever news arises pertaining to self, loved ones, allies and foes
Psychically communicate with intended subjects, as though in person (Telepresence), at will
Withstand Telepathy; sprout wings and fly at will
weaknesses: Bad news (duh); cannot keep psychically prevent subjects from relaying news until developed (NCN)
Wings do not gain Superhuman Strength until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hermes' Hustle provides immunity (NCN)

name: Animal Power Gifting
description: This power may sound silly but think of it like this: If your pet got lost in the woods, wouldn't you be worried that they might die out there? Well, with this power you can give them super powers once you realize that they are lost. You can give them powers and when they come back, you can take the powers away.
summary: The ability to temparly give animals super powers no matter were they are
strengths: You don't have to worry as much about your pets.
Your dog can defend you better.
Your pet will be number one.
weaknesses: You can't use this power on humans or your self.

name: Myth Power: Eupraxia's Practice
description: Eupraxia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of success, especially that which results from good deeds. As such, channeling her allows one to gain increased fortune by doing good deeds (regardless of one's morals or one's attitude while doing the good deed). In addition, one can do enhanced damage to any foe who has done fewer good deeds than they have in the last 24 hours. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good fortune in the presence of those who wish for his success.
summary: The ability to channel Eupraxia's command over the essence of good deeds and success
strengths: Gain increased fortune (luck) by doing good deeds
Enhance damage done to foes by doing more good deeds than they do in a 24-hr period
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain good luck around subjects who wish for your success
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or communicate with the successful until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive how to bring about (or prevent) success until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ghost Of Bats
description: Everyone has potential psionic abilities. The Ghost of Bats can sink their teeth into any sentient being and drain psionic power. If a person already displays their power, telepathy, telekinesis, pyrokinesis etc. You rob them of their power. Stolen abilities last longer but potential psionic energy taste better.
summary: The ability to be a psionic vampire
strengths: Potentially gain a host of psionic, psychic abilities
Stealth; exist between the astral & physical plane, intangibility & phasing may be possible
Every psychic meal taste different & gives you an addictive rush so you never get bored
weaknesses: Unhinging your jaw and sinking your enlarged canines into people's skulls leaves brain dead victims
You will never eat normal food again; you only eat potential or existing mental power
In a few hours stolen mental abilities begins to fade & you begin to hunger for more graymatter

name: String Mimicry
description: This power allows a person to convert their body mass into strings. Strings can be stretched from the body, the strength of each string is as strong as the original person, and a person can purposefully transform only part of his/her body into strings. Strings can be as hard as diamond if the density is compressed. Strings can transfer sound and you can attach an "eye" to the tip to spy on people. The transformation is near instantaneous so you can create a string Kevlar suit on impact.
summary: The ability to transform your body into strings
strengths: Versatile power
Near instantaneous
You can control the change as well as compress strings to harden them
weaknesses: String volume can only be as much as your body
You must train to make the strings stronger and more dexterous
Spread attacks like fire and electricity

name: Regain Power
description: With this power you can regain 10 powers that you lost one way or another. The powers are regained with the same number of uses as when you lost them and minimal power as well as skill. Minimal power and skill meaning you're as weak and horrible at using the power. The uses part means that if the power had 10 uses and you used it 7 times before you lost it, then you regain it with 3 uses.
summary: The ability to regain up to ten lost powers
strengths: Regain 10 lost powers!
weaknesses: Same number of uses as when the power was lost.
Limit of 10 powers.
Con Negation and similar powers/effects do NOT affect this power.

name: Channelled Form: Bow And Arrow
description: Normally a touch-type power(Ex: Death Touch) does not extend beyond what you touch. However with this power, you can channel that power into the form of a bow and arrow. The bow is the size of a standard European longbow and when the arrow hits the target it does not pierce, but instead goes through the target and the power's effect activates.
summary: The ability to channel a tactile power into the form of a bow and arrow
strengths: Can give tactile powers a slightly longer range.
The arrows are fletched.
weaknesses: Tactile powers only.
Nothing other than a bow and arrow.

name: Pros Negation
description: Negate the pros of other powers, within a radius of 6 miles. This power is able to take away the usefulness of any power; it starts with your own, but eventually after you master it, you can take away the pros of other people's abilities if you know which person and ability to target.
summary: The ability to negate pros of powers.
strengths: Take away the usefulness of powers.
With enough practice you can negate the pros of abilities.
weaknesses: Still stupid, because without practice you can take away the pros of your own powers.
Like normal Negation, people can defend themselves against this.

name: Myth Power: Metis' Method
description: Metis, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of wisdom, wise counsel and prudence. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will, as well as withstand effects which reduce one's wise judgment. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with those one considers wise (or their spirit, if they've died), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive the future. One can even psychically compel subjects to do anything considered wise, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Metis' command over the essence of wisdom and wise counsel (good advice)
strengths: Psychically access superhuman wisdom, at will; withstand effects that can reduce one's wise judgment
