Psychically perceive and communicate with anyone one considers wise (if dead, contact their spirit)
Psychically perceive the future; psyhically compel subjects to do wise things, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon a psionic manifestation of one's conscience, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Gift: Animals
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using animal-based powers than other beings. Thus their animal-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of animals from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve animal-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at animal-based powers
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over animals as someone with this power.
Animal-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only animal-based powers now.

name: Acidic
description: The ability to become and control any acidic substance at will.  Would come in handy for almost any thing.  Want to be an acid, take your pick of one.
summary: The ability to control and become acidic substances
strengths: Go through anything
Won't get stuck in other form
Won't have to worry about contamination in other form
weaknesses: Noticable trail in other form
Hole in anything you touchin acid form
Can be countered with opposing basic

name: Rise Of The Ghostfreak
description: With this power you can turn into a ghost-like alien that resembles Ghostfreak from the 'Ben 10' Series.
summary: The ability to turn into a Ghostfreak like alien
strengths: Invisibility
Intangibility (possibly also the power of Possession)
Flight
weaknesses: You may lose control of this form and harm innocent people

name: Snap Win V2
description: With this poer you can cause any person other than yourself to win a bet by snapping and saying the person's name. It doesn't work if you are part of the bet but it works for any other person in the world unless they also have this power. This power can even bend the laws of physics if need be. You also can't pay or otherwise influence people to make bets that benefit you but if they do it on their own without any influence from you then this power can work on the bet.
summary: The ability to cause anybody to win a bet by snapping
strengths: You can cause anybody to win a bet
This power can even change the laws of physics
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself
You can't use this power on anybody with this power
You can't influence people to make bets that benefit you

name: Weapon: Arondite
description: The sword Arondite was wielded by Lancelot of King Arthur's fame. Wielding it, the user gains the knowledge to use any weapon expertly, even modern weapons. The sword is also very strong but is not a magical weapon.
summary: The ability to wield Lancelot's sword Arondite
strengths: Makes you skilled in all weapons when carried on person
weaknesses: All the flaws of Lancelot in the King Arthur legend
Is not in the magic class or divine class of weapons

name: Finger Tip Extend
description: A person with this ability is able to extend their finger-tips, to they point where they can pierce anything.  These fingers or when extended, spears, have some durability, but are able to break.
summary: The ability to extend your finger tips to the point where they can pierce anything.
strengths: Pierce anything.
weaknesses: It looks strange.

name: Master Drummer
description: With this power you will be able to play anything on any kind of drums. You can become a world famous drummer and make lots of money and be loved by people everywhere. You will also be really good at Rock Band.
summary: The ability to be a master drummer
strengths: You are a master drummer
You can be a world famous drummer
weaknesses: You aren't necessarily good at any other instruments
This power has almost no use in physical combat

name: Edible Everything
description: With this power you can make anything edible and taste like anything you want. For instance you're trapped on an island and all you have is sand, you can make the sand edible and taste like pizza and then eat it.
summary: The ability to make anything edible
strengths: You can make anything edible and taste like anything you want
weaknesses: Doesn't have much use in physical combat

name: Celtic Invocation: Samhain
description: By using this ability, the invoker can utilise all the powers Samhain gives. As the last harvest, Samhain allows the invoker to cause all ripe and ready plant life nearby to be harvested instantly, such as having the apples instantly picked, and the wheat scythed and sheaved. It also allows the invoker to summon and communicate with the spirits of the dead, but not control or command them. Finally, it allows the invoker to take away someone's life by wailing the targets name seven times
summary: The ability to channel the power of Samhain, the first day of winter and the beginning of the darker times.
strengths: Instant harvest. No need for any hard work.
Can talk with your departed family members and friends.
You'll be highly popular this day.
weaknesses: Only available once a year.
People may fear you taking away their life.
You'll be in high demand due to people wanting you to harvest their crops.

name: Face Thief
description: (This power is creepy and evil) with this power you steal the faces of any being you look at or touch, the Victims can be ether dead, living, animated or in history. You have hundreds of faces to choose from but you might loose your sanity since you stolen to many faces and need to do your history on your victims
summary: The ability to steal the face of others by looking at them or touching them
strengths: You have many faces to choose from
You are a wolf in sheep's clothing
Good for spies
weaknesses: You do not get there powers, memories, skills or Genetics
People will be afraid of you and some will try to kill you
This power is the evolved form of appearance alteration

name: Adamantoblast Mimicry
description: Also called Ameloblast Mimicry. You can secrete enamel and form it into any shape. Enamel is a type of bone and the hardest substance found in the human body. You can also telekinetically move substances containing calcium or phosphate within a short range and form tiny but extremely strong crystals out of them. Incorporate them into your enamel structures to make them even harder. However, no matter how hard it is, enamel can easily be dissolved by acids.
summary: The ability to secrete enamel of any shape and manipulate calcium and phosphate within a short range.
strengths: You can produce the hardest bones among the bone-producer Cellular Mimics.
You can use your own body (except your bones, see con 2) as a source of calcium and phosphate.
Since you can produce enamel, you can easily repair your own tooth enamel.
weaknesses: Your bone structures are extremely vulnerable to acid attacks.
You can't manipulate calcium nor phosphate that have already been integrated into bones.
And therefore, you can't telekinetically manipulate bones, including the ones you create.

name: Palenator
description: With this power you can cause your own or other people's skin to become extremely pale; almost the color of snow. This is useful if you're fighting a battle in snow and need to hide, or you can pretend to be a ghost and scare people. You can also make people think you're sick so you can get out of school, work or something else you don't want to do. When you're done, you can return to your normal complexion.
summary: The ability to cause your own or other people's skin to become pale
strengths: You can make your skin or other people's skin look pale
Good camouflage if you're fighting in snow
weaknesses: Not much use if you're found or if you're not fighting in snow

name: Text Messaging Telepathy
description: With this ability you can communicate with other minds just like any other telepath. However, your telepathy has a slight hitch. All the messages that you produce and receive will be expressed in TXT language, the shorthand "language" that texters use to communicate quickly.
summary: The ability to communicate in TXT telepathically
strengths: Most of the same capabilities of normal Telepathy
You can do it anytime you want.
You can also do it while you are asleep (called Dream Text Telepathy).
weaknesses: It may give you headaches to have to to deal with all that TXT all the time.
No visual illusions may be produced, except to physically depict spellings of text messages

name: Jumping Point
description: With this power you can make people jump by pointing at them. The person will jump for as long as you point at them even if they start to get tired. Once you stop pointing at them the person will stop jumping and will probably be out of energy if you've been making them jump for a while.
summary: The ability to make people jump by pointing at them
strengths: You can make people jump by pointing at them
You can make people tired
weaknesses: You have to be pointing at them or they'll stop jumping
They can still move while jumping

name: Myth Power: Ktisis' Ticket
description: Ktisis (Ctisis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of conquest, acquisition, possession and foundation of establishments. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive when any building was built or established, by touch. In addition, one can psychically 'claim' objects, by touch; one can telekinetically manipulate claimed objects, and psychically track them at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and channel knowledge, skills and powers of conquerors at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ktisis' command over the essence of conquest, acquisition, possession, foundation
strengths: Psychically perceive a building's founding date, by touch
Psychically 'claim' objects by touch; track and telekinetically manipulate claimed objects
Psychically perceive, communicate with and channel knowledge/skills/powers of conquerors
weaknesses: Cannot use Pro #1 to Time Travel to a building's founding date until the higher levels (NCN)
Larger objects are more difficult (and take longer) to 'claim' until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 does not apply to mental/physically 'claim' living subjects until developed (NCN)

name: Hellbound
description: If someone pisses you off, all you have to do is say: "Go to Hell! " and in 6 days, they will be pulled into the fiery pits. For those 6 days, they will be tortured, afraid, seeing shadow demons, become ill, feel hot temperatures, get scratch and bite marks, and pests and vermin swarming around them. Almost nothing can save them, be it faith and exorcism. They'll soon become suicidal and just that will open hell gates and spike tentacles, hot barbed chains and demon claws will drag them to hell.
summary: The ability to send someone to hell
strengths: Torture and get rid of the people you don't like by giving them the ultimate curse
For 6 days, they will have the worst days ever
weaknesses: Spell might be broken depending on how strong their faith is
Watch what you say to people cause you can't undo the spell

name: Nerf Gun Power Booster
description: With this power whenever you hold a Nerf Gun it will gain a much needed power boost. Its bullets instantly turn into armor piercing bullets that explode on contact, the gun itself will instantly blend in with its surroundings and gains the ability to shoot out tear gas and smoke bombs.
summary: The ability to give Nerf Guns a much needed power boost
strengths: You can give Nerf Guns a power boost
weaknesses: Only works with Nerf Guns
Happens whenever you hold a Nerf Gun

name: Ghost Of Dogs
description: Share space with a Dog of Existence. You have the ability to see & physically effect all forms & planes of existence. Pseudo-existent the Dog moves at sublight speeds precognitively reacting for you in an instant. Snatch people out of the Astral plane. Punch pure energy & intangibles. Eat shadows. His agenda is to defeat and consume all shadow & dark powers. A side effect of sharing space with the Dog you become a Werewolf. The Dog mastered combat in the past, present & future. Now, so have you.
summary: The ability to merge with Dog of Existence
strengths: You are master of every weapon & martial art in the past, present and future
forced to be a werewolf merged with a semi-visible paranormal super-wolf in your own image
The Ghost of Dogs is always watching your back, it never rests or sleeps
weaknesses: You cause a fight or flight reaction in all creatures. Including average & below average IQ humans
You eat grass to heal; eat horses & cows to live & pesky hard to control heightened senses
Eating normal shadows KO's a human. Eating dark/shadow powered people gives you their filthy powers.

name: Enhancement: Sos
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes a defensive power automatically activate when the user is losing. The defense power is activated slightly better than normal but drains the same amount of power as normal. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to have a defensive power automatically activate at slightly beyond full power when one is losing
strengths: Have some extra defense when you're losing.
Might give you the time needed to think of a strategy.
If the power normally requires concentration, now it doesn't.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only helps when you're losing...
Barrier Defiers and Barrier Melters.

name: Enhancement: Freezing
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached the other power's physical parts freeze anything they touch regardless of heat they are giving off. If stolen this power permanently affects the power it is attached to. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make the physical part of a power freeze anything it touches by attaching this power to it
strengths: Freeze your enemies and deal with them later.
Freezes anything. Freezing Hair Blades!
Note: This power, Enhancements: Flaming, and Electrifying affect physical blasts too. Forgot to put.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Power might be useless freezing or not be any better freezing.
Power's physical part has to touch the target to freeze it.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Hysteria
description: Hysteria is a weapon that takes the form of a small blacksmith's hammer. Its power isn't for combat against multiple people. When you tap someone with it, or hit them with it, it will produce a vibration that will ring through the target's ears. The sound will resemble that of a banshee's shriek. It is mostly effective when used against the head.
summary: The ability to summon Hysteria.
strengths: Disorientate people in combat, leaving them open for other attacks.
weaknesses: Isn't useful for fighting multiple people.

name: Generate Music
description: When you think real hard about a particular song or tune you can have that particular song play just by opening your mouth .
summary: The ability to have music play from your mouth just by thinking about the tune
strengths: You can play the song that you were thinking of for your friends.
You can entertain your friends with music anytime you chose.
No more uncomfortable silences during conversations.
weaknesses: You may be exploited only for your ability to make music.
Accidently playing a tune during a moment of silence.
Not knowing the name of a song that you just played when someone asks you.

name: Power Of Revenge
description: You can get revenge or just cause pain in anyone you want.  You can make them trip, hit their head or any other sick thing you can think of.
summary: The ability to get revenge or cause pain in others
strengths: Good way to get revenge
Tell your friends that you can tell future with this
weaknesses: May get bad guilt
May get in trouble somehow

name: Feng Shui Yo Yo
description: Most often referred to simply as 'killer yo-yo' it may looked harmless at first, but it can be tricky & lethal, you can use whatever trick is possible with the yo-yo such as the throw sleep, loop grab, whip off-string, freehand slam and zero-g swing. You can also transfom it into a variety of psychic weapons like a circular psychic buzzsaw comes out of it, a meteor hammer, or a morning star (mace). The yo-yo also flashes while it is being used.
summary: The ability to use it to cause the spool to strike your foes with it.
strengths: With the yo-yo, you can could excite the pain receptors in your foes.
The yo-yo could cause your victim to become stunned, or even killed.
weaknesses: None.

name: The Law Of Bounty
description: With this power, you can place a bounty on anyone, and cause bounty hunters to hunt them down. This power does not work on those who have done nothing wrong.
summary: The ability to place bounty on someone
strengths: Have a criminal dead without using your hands.
Can even place bounty on immortals
weaknesses: Does not work on those who've done nothing wrong.

name: Narnia Teleportation
description: With this power you can telport yourself and others to and from Narnia. If you're fighting a battle you could just send your enemy to Narnia and let the Narnians deal with him or you could go there and to just hang out.
summary: The ability to teleport yourself and others to Narnia
strengths: You can teleport yourself and others to Narnia
You can send your enemies to Narnia
weaknesses: Aslan might get angry at you for sending a bunch of villains to Narnia

name: Butterfly Grenades
description: A butterfly grenade is a small 2 kilogram anti-personnel submunition explosive device, it was so named because the thin lead outer shell which hinged open when the bomblet deployed gave it the superficial appearance of a large butterfly. Inside of this weapon is a brutal and lethal dose of typhoid, flash paper, methanol, quicksilver, caulk, smite, hci, ammonia and but if you throw it at your opponent which explodes and leaves them blurred, sickened, brink into insanity and slowly into death.
summary: The ability to throw them at your foes so that they will be stunned in many different ways.
strengths: This weapon might be for a greater use against dangerous opponents.
weaknesses: Will not work while they have a protective shield or armor.

name: Sangsue (Leech)
description: If you're a leech hybrid, you can use your mouth to drain the life energy from your victim
summary: The ability to drain life energy through sucking it with the mouth
strengths: Extend your lifespan
Do not need to be fed for 8 days after eating
The enemy will have shorter lifespan
weaknesses: Constant feeling of hunger
You have to eat every eight days or you die
Slow movement

name: Removable Animated Body Parts
description: This one is kind of gross, but sounds cool. What if you could harmlessly remove some of your body parts like limbs or organs & control them. Remove your eyes & ears & use them as communication recon. Or have your hand move about doing tasks for you. You'll have a mental link to your parts which will allow you to see & hear through them. Though doing this leaves you in a trance undefended & if your parts get injured, you still feel the pain.
summary: The ability to remove your body parts & make them animated
strengths: Harmlessly remove your body parts & control them
Have a psycic link to your body parts
weaknesses: The mental link leaves the rest of your body in a trance & undefended
If your limbs become injured, you still feel the pain

name: Tomacrow
description: The Tomacrow is a axe/hatchet like weapon that you can control and quickly throw it and it'll drop low at first, spiraling straight at your opponent, it can also split in two halves, can cut ropes and even churns up dirt when it flies close to the ground.
summary: The ability to use them to strike & throw it at your foes at will.
strengths: Those can only work on evildoers.
They will continue to deal extreme damages.
weaknesses: None

name: Usurpation: Demon
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp all powers of a single demonic entity, leaving it completely powerless in the process. Your appearance will change to reflect the demon whose powers have been borrowed for the time (i. E. : growing of claws, tails, horns,.. )
You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original demon. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random being who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single demonic entity.
strengths: Channel infernal powers without selling (or endangering) your immortal soul
Strike fear into the hearts of mortals
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your" powers
weaknesses: Depending on the strength of the demon, usurpation may only last a few minutes
Demons will try to kill you, unless you use the powers for nefarious evil deeds
Angels might consider you a demon yourself, or will try to recruit you to fight the demons

name: Bobcat Shadow Clone
description: You use the Shadow Clone power, creating up to 13 clones of you that die with one strong hit, and when they die, they turn into a fiery bobcat. The bobcats go after your enemies and then explode! It takes 1 hour to recharge if you use up all of your bobcat clones at once.
summary: The ability to create shadow clones that turn into exploding bobcats when they die.
strengths: You get 13 clones of you.
The clones turn into bobcats that attack your enemies.
You can control the clones.
weaknesses: The explosions from the bobcats may hurt you.
Innocent people might get hurt from your bobcats.
Only get 13 clones.

name: Whisper Point
description: With this power you can cause people to whisper instead of talking or yelling by pointing at them. This is useful if your enemy has discovered your secrets and is announcing them to the world you can point at him so he whispers so nobody can hear him and then beat him up later with a different power or something.
summary: The ability to make people whisper by pointing at them
strengths: You can make people whisper just by pointing at them
weaknesses: As soon as you stop pointing at them they continue talking at the volume they were talking at before

name: Acid Skin
description: The user turns their flesh into acid and can't be touched.
summary: The ability to turn one's flesh into acid
strengths: No one can touch you.
Weapons melt.
You can get what you want.
weaknesses: It's hard to control.
People will fear you.
Your bf/gf will be scared.

name: Muggle Protector
description: As long as they are in your vicinity, any being without superpowers will become immune to direct superpower effects. Having this immunity doesn't count as having a power, otherwise it would paradoxical. Someone with a magical artifact, even if they originally don't have any powers, doesn't count as being powerless. You are not protected by this ability because you have at least one power.
summary: The ability to protect powerless and depowered beings in your vicinity against superpower effects.
strengths: You can protect your loved ones when you're with them, so you don't have to worry about their safety
With experience, you can increase the maximum range of this power.
Protect the people who could get caught in the middle of a fight between you and another superhuman.
weaknesses: Passive ability. Though, with experience, you can control the range of the protection.
Your powers may not work against powerless or depowered foes if they are in the protection zone.
You are not protected and it only protects from direct superpower effects.

name: Mahoujutsu: Demonic Angel.
description: The final, and most dangerous, form of the Demonic Armor. You combine the raw force of the demons, and the pure light of the angels, into your body. Every one of your powers are boosted, including your strength and speed. This power is a last resort type, because the collision of two fighting forces will destroy your body after a while.
summary: The ability to turn into a Demonic Angel.
strengths: Incredible power
Incredible strength
Incredible speed
weaknesses: Will destroy you after a while

name: Ultimate Fighting Champion
description: You are the ultimate fighting machine, the best in the world. You know every form of fighting, from martial art to wrestling and many others fighting style that exists. Not just in real life, but also those in movies, TV shows, games etc. Have super karate moves and kung fu power. Comes with enhanced strength and senses, so you can fight blindfolded. You are very agile, have very good reflexes and can jump extremley high.
summary: The ability to use various fighting skills like a boss
strengths: Have great fighting skills, along with knowledge and training
Also includes fiction as a source of fighting styles
Total control when fighting
weaknesses: Can't do fictional things like energy beams
Might solve disputes by fighting.
Might draw unwanted attention

name: Rocket Fists
description: A person with this power can shoot their fists---literally detach them from their body by firing them like rockets. The user does not bleed or suffer any bodily harm as a result. The fists are remote controlled by the user's brain and can return to the user's hand at the user's choice. Through practice and training the user can increase the power of their fist punching---shooting.
summary: The ability to shoot your fist like rockets
strengths: Surprise Factor
The fists are remote controlled by your brain
Can make the fists spin for more effect
weaknesses: When shot you don't have the use of hands for a while

name: Tar Spit
description: The power grants you the ability to spit scalding hot tar at whatever or whoever you desire, as well as being destructive. Your spit can also reach amazing distances and cause much damage. Be warned that it can also burn you as well, if it touches your skin. The spit becomes rock hard (like tar) after it has cooled down compleatly.
summary: The ability to spit scalding hot tar
strengths: Spit also has distance
Quick and accessible
Spit balls fom hell
weaknesses: Not very hygenic
Can also burn yourself
Would take a long time to remove after cooling

name: Ut Scourge's Transformation
description: With this power you can turn into a giant, robotic, three headed fire breathing dragon. You are able to talk in any language while in robot dragon form but you cannot fly due to you not having wings. You do however have enhanced speed and strength. You can stay in dragon mode for as long as you want and all damage sustained in dragon mode transfers over to normal mode.
summary: The ability to turn into a robotic three headed fire breathing dragon
strengths: You can turn into a giant robot three headed fire breathing strong fast dragon
You can speak any language while in dragon mode
weaknesses: You can't fly

name: Ribbon Transformation
description: If you posess this ability, you can turn any part of your body into a long, ribbony thing. This would allow you to add extra appendages if you wanted to. Sort of like elastic skin, except more awesome.
summary: The ability to turn any part of your body into a ribbon or some ribbonlike substance.
strengths: You can grow as many arms and legs as you want.
You could strech yourself all around the world if you wanted to.
You would be the best person at catch in the whole world.
weaknesses: You can't make more flesh than you already have. You become thinner and weaker the more you strech.
You would probably trip over extra arms and legs, as you need to put them back consciously.

name: Guilty As Charged
description: The power to mentally create emotional distress (like guilt, depression and fear) in others.  Using this power too much can cause you to become overwhelmed with emotion.
summary: The ability to create emotional distress
strengths: Distracts enemies
Weakness to enemies
weaknesses: Too much can overwhelm your emotional feelings

name: G1 Warpath's Transformation
description: With this power you can turn into a powerful red tank in order to fight (or commit) crime. You are not an ordinary tank however as you can shoot lasers, explosive shells, sonic blasts and even acid from your gun. You are also stronger and faster than other tanks. You can also speak in tank mode.
summary: The ability to turn into a red tank
strengths: You are more powerful than normal tanks
You have a wide array of ammunition that you can use
weaknesses: You run out of ammo eventually and will have to restock
You are not invincible

name: Camo Skin
description: With this power you can make your skin look like army camo. This is useful if you're fighting in a forest or near a lot of dirt and plant life.
summary: The ability to make your skin army camouflaged
strengths: You can make your skin look like army camo
weaknesses: It doesn't give you any protection if you're found

name: Twilight Power: Mental Shield
description: This shield blocks powers having to do with the mind, Telepathy, Mind Control, etc.  The user can also expand the shield, starts at twenty yards, expands twenty yards per 200 uses. When the user expands the shield they gain a secondary shield around them personally. This power is useless against physical attacks.
summary: The ability to shield your mind.
strengths: Anti Mental Powers.
Shielding Allies.
Evolves to become stronger.
weaknesses: Physical Attacks.
People can leave the shield.
Slow ability evolution.

name: Vehicle Stop
description: WIth this power you can cause any vehicle to stop where it is as long as you're looking at the vehicle. You don't even have to be in a vehicle. If your enemy is trying to escape in a getaway car you can cause the car to stop or if you're being chased you can cause your pursuers to stop. If you're late for a flight and don't want the plane to take off you can simply stop it at the gate. You can allow the vehicles to move again whenever you want.
summary: The ability to prevent vehicles from moving
strengths: You can cause vehicles to stop
weaknesses: You might cause other vehicles to crash into the vehicle you stopped

name: Weapon: Treeslayer
description: Miraculously light for an axe of its size, the Treeslayer can cut cleanly through and/or destroy any tree or item with origins rooted in trees including, but not limited to trees, paper, metal forged with the heat coal with trees, magical spells which whose caster learned off paper scrolls and some types of wicker furniture. The wielder may also strike with the force of a tree against users of these products, which tree depending on the intent behind the blow.
summary: The ability to wield the Treeslayer, the bane of all tree-based products.
strengths: Can strike like a Dwarf Willow or with the force of a Giant Sequoia, without changing its weight.
Conditions to activate its powers can be numerous and met varyingly or creatively.
Functions also as a sharp, rather heavy axe against non-tree-associated things or people.
weaknesses: Wielder must know or correctly guess the target's link with trees to use the powers.
That link must have fewer than 4 transitions from an organic form of the tree (including coal/oil)
Fire renders the Treeslayer unusable, though it can fully regenerate in up to 6 months.

name: Chew Gum, Be Gum
description: When the person with this power eats a stick chewing gum, they gain the properties of chewing gum. They can stretch as well as well form objects with their body. Like chewing gum, under really hot temperatures they melt, and under frigid temperatures they can't stretch.
summary: The ability to become rubbery when the user its chewing gum
strengths: You are the long arm of the law
Can change shape into anything to better conceal yourself
Chewing gum can be found in any convenient store
weaknesses: Might be expensive if you dont by in bulk.
Extreme temperatures render this power ueless

name: Superhuman Cleanliness
description: Ain't nobody so sexy, you're just so fresh and clean. And you can stay clean forever with no effort. Your body will produce just enough oil to keep your skin smooth. Orange Oil that is! AND YOU CAN BREATH AEROSOL COMPUTER CLEANER. AND URINATE CLR! Your bodily functions also take care of themselves in the most clean way possible. So no more wiping! You are even resistant to filth-based attacks. So vomit kinetics, lotion mimics, bullets of frozen urine, and giant undulating poos can't hurt you.
summary: The ability to stay clean without bathing
strengths: Save CRAPloads of money on toilet paper (hahahahahah)
If you stood on your head and breathed you could probably make someone chilly
Resistance to Filth
weaknesses: People still get freaked out when you say you've never bathed in your life
On the rare occasion that you get sick, you would have very little immunity
Why would there be bullets of frozen urine? YOU CRAZY.

name: Summon Swiftslice Swarm
description: A swiftslice is related to a slitskin. There are 20 swiftslice in a swarm. A swiftslice looks like a 10-foot long seaweed/electrical cable fusion. Nothing will hurt them. A swarm has your IQ. A single swiftslice is as strong as two strong men. A swarm will never hurt or kill you and you can command it not to kill or hurt anyone else. A swiftslice has retractable blades from each end of its body. If seperated more than a mile from the swarm, a single swiftslice will become a mindless killer.
summary: The ability to a swarm of half-alive things.
strengths: A swarm of twenty.
A swarm with your IQ.
Think of them as worker bees.
weaknesses: If you're dumb.
There are stronger half-alive things.

name: Barnacle
description: With this ability you can create agressively spreading mutant barnacle-like creatures that quicky cover surrounding areas and people, trapping them. Also allows for the creation of single special barnacles that when attached to a target's head gives you control of them much like a puppeteer has control of a puppet. The target will move with little grace or control, like a zombie. This mind control is limited and only works on a few people at a time.
summary: The ability to create and spread mutant barnacles onto anything and anyone
strengths: Trap your enemies
Control a few people at a time
weaknesses: Barnacles(although mutated) die quickly out of water

name: Summon Thazo
description: Thazoes look like slugs reshaped into six-foot-tall bipedal foxes. Anyone with probability or prediction powers who gets within a hundred feet of a thazo will be affected by the thazo's limited range unpredictability, including a tychokinetic user. Thazoes can lift 8 tons and only train with melee weapons in Kyst. Once summoned, a thazo can of course learn any ranged weapon.
summary: The ability to summon a limited range probability-nulling kystian.
strengths: Another power will extend the sub-unpredictability power to 800 feet.
A melee weapon master.
Any melee weapons. Made of matter. Energy weapons. Psionic. You name it.
weaknesses: A thazo will never be as good enough with ranged weapons as with melee ones.

name: Flaming Hail
description: With this power you can cause giant balls of ice that are on fire to fall from the sky wherever you want. The flames do not melt the ice and the ice does not put out the fire, making this hail super dangerous. The hail is alo the size of a minivan. You cannot make the hail disappear once you create it.
summary: The ability to cause giant balls of ice that are on fire to fall from the sky
strengths: The can create giant flaming balls of ice
The hail is the size of a minivan
weaknesses: The hail might cause a lot of damage to buildings, vehicles, people etc.
You cannot make the hail disappear

name: Speech To Sign
description: With this power you can change powers that require some sort of spell or phrase to activate into powers that you can use sign language to activate. All you have to do is say the name of the power in sign language. The power can no longer be activated by speaking once you use this power on it.
summary: The ability to change powers you need word to activate to powers you need sign language to activate
strengths: If you're unable to speak this power opens up several new power opportunities for you
weaknesses: Once you use this power on another power the power can no longer be activated through speech

name: Condition Change: Chant
description: By touching another superpowered being you automatically make one power require a specific phrase to be spoken in order to be used. The affected being will always know the required phrase to use their power. The phrase is always chosen randomly. Ex: 'Let me heal you,' for an auto-death power.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user chants a short phrase
strengths: They have to chant the phrase every time they want to use the power.
If the phrase is "I am stupid, now kill me"!
You now know when they're going to use their power.
weaknesses: You have to touch them and it only affects one power at a time.
If the phrase is something like, "I am your ultimate enemy," or "You will now die"!
Con Negation and other alteration powers do not affect this power.

name: Trash Into Trees
description: With this, you can help the environment and hit people all at the same time! You would be the new Mother Nature.
summary: The ability to turn trash into trees.
strengths: No one can hate you for helping the environment.
Eight master weapon abilities come with the power.
Power becomes stronger the more you train and use it.
weaknesses: Have to carry stinky trash with you.
Most powerful in a landfill where no one will battle you.
Might hurt somebody or destroy a building if not well trained.

name: To Fyuron To Biographicon
description: When you say "Adeat", a bookmark and a collection of books that have biographies of anybody you've ever met appear. When you place the bookmark inside a book and slide it out, you can become a clone of the person the book belongs too. You can also completely become a person (thoughts, emotions, memories, personality, etc. ) for a full 10 minutes.
summary: The ability to summon a collection of books that can be used to copy anybody you've met.
strengths: Can copy the person's powers when you transform into them.
weaknesses: You can only be a person who's stronger than you for a few minutes.
If you ever completely become a person, you can never become them again.

name: Chuck Norris
description: Chuck Norris is known to the world as the strongest human evar. He has a power level of over 9000 which means that he and google are the 2nd most powerful things in the world. The only thing he cannot defeat is a ninja. We proved this in a googlefight that was broadcast all around the world.
summary: The ability to have the power of Chuck Norris
strengths: You're Chuck Norris
You're Chuck Norris
You're Chuck Norris
weaknesses: You cannot beat a ninja

name: Invinciblity Oil
description: You can get tough and slippery by oiling yourself up and gain vast superhuman strength, speed, agility, reflexes, stamina, and durability. When you are dry, you still maintain a slippery body and the same movesets, but when you apply some oil you receive many advantages such as sliding further on the ground, and your application of oil makes you glow for a short amount of time.
summary: The ability to douse yourself in oil to gain superhuman strength.
strengths: Bad guys will slip off of you.
weaknesses: You'll be vulnerable to fire when using it.

name: Blood Sugar Control
description: With this power you can raise or lower the blood sugar level of other people at whichever speed you want. When you stop using your power, the subject's level stays at the level you put it, unless sugar/medicine etc. is consumed by them. Maintaining your power will cause high blood sugar (hyperglycemia) and severe dehydration in your target, or deprivation of glucose/low blood sugar (hypoglycemia).
summary: The ability to control others' blood sugar levels
strengths: By lowering an enemy's blood sugar very quickly, you can make them faint or suffer anxiety attacks
By raising an enemy's blood sugar very quickly you can cause blurred vision and extreme fatigue
By maintaining extreme sugar levels, you can put others in comas or kill them
weaknesses: Medicine such as insulin can temporarily reverse your power's effects
You may be asked by lazy and forgetful diabetics to medicate them
People may treat your power as lame, until you make them faint or kill them

name: Enhancement: Quintuple
description: This is a support. This power does nothing until attached to another power and quintuples that powers effects. This power is gained by using Enhancement: Quadruple multiple times after which it changes into this power. Anything that goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to quintuple the effects of a power by attaching this power to it
strengths: Quintuple the effects of a power. Quintiple Fireballs!!!!!
What goes for Enhancement: Quadruple goes for this power. May be a con for some parts.
This is the highest of the multiplicative enhancements. (I'm lazy).
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
What was useful quadrupled may not be useful quintupled.
Must have Enhancement: Quadruple and use it.

name: Eye Glue
description: A person with this power can "glue" someone's eyes to only look at a fixed point which can be moved. For example, if someone was looking at a crate and you used this power, they would be unable to turn around and look at anything else besides the crate. If the crate is moved, the person is forced/dragged to move so that their eyes continue to stare at it. If something tries to go between the field of vision between the target and object, the target will fly/be dragged to look at the said object.
summary: The ability to "glue" someone's eyes to one point
strengths: Useful for practical jokes
Surprisingly useful for combat
Can also be used on yourself, so you can go after a flying object by being dragged along
weaknesses: The person can still move as long as they continue to look at the" glued" point
You need to have a lot of imagination to make this useful

name: Gates Of Heck
description: You may use this power to your advantage, but only when villains are in the agony of defeat or are dizzy. You can open a big fiery hole, and then uppercut, push, punch, or kick them into the devil's playground.
summary: The ability to open a fiery portal then banish an evildoer to the underworld
strengths: You don't have to kill any villain if they commit violent crimes
weaknesses: This power only works on Evildoers.

name: Zombie Maker
description: When you have this power you can change someone into a zombie by touch and fully control them. Those zombies are strong and hard to kill, but when killed, they can't recover.
summary: The ability to make someone into a zombie and control them.
strengths: Can make a zombie army.
Can fully control it.
Those zombies have the skills of the person from who they are made.
weaknesses: You must touch the person.
You can only control the zombies that you made
When you change someone into a zombie you can't change them back.

name: Twinkle Smile
description: No matter how dirty your teeth really are or how well you brush them, you can make people believe they are pearly white just by smiling and letting them glint. It doesn't have to be illuminated. Your teeth will even release flashes of light in total darkness.
summary: The ability to have your teeth sparkle whenever you smile.
strengths: If people see your teeth glitter, they will definitely think they are clean!
You look awesome!
weaknesses: It only works if you are smiling.
It's not a steady nor a constant source of light.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Delete This Tantrum Kick
description: Patada de berrinche (Tantrum Kick) in which you strike the opponent rapidly with multiple kicks to the face & torso which move faster than the eye can see. If you continue to strike them repeatly then they'll get K'oed to the ground.
summary: The ability to launch a flurry of kicks with rapid force.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Myth Power: Amphilogia's Ambush
description: Amphilogia (Amphillogia) and the Amphilogiae (Amphilogiai, Amphillogiae, Amphillogiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of dispute, debate controversy and other unclear words. As such, channeling them allows one to gain skill in using clever double-speak to outwit subjects. In addition, any statement one disagrees with may be converted into a psionic blast that may be turned back on whoever said it. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally argumentative people.
summary: The ability to channel Amphilogia and the Amphilogiae's command over the essence of dispute and disagreement
strengths: Gain skill in using clever double-speak to confuse and outwit subjects, and win arguments
Any subject one disagrees with may be turned into a psionic blast to harm the subject who spoke it
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel naturally controversial and argumentative people
weaknesses: Cannot make a subject forget their point in an argument, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot use Pro #2 to harm anyone other than the controversial speaker, until developed (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Usurpation: Inheritor
description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp the powers of a single being whose power are genetic in nature, leaving them completely powerless in the process. Clothing will change to reflect the person whose powers have been stripped for the moment. 

You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original owner. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random being who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.
summary: The ability to temporarily usurp all powers of a single being which are genetically inherited in one way or another
strengths: Surprise your opponent(s) with new powers
Knowledge what you can and can't do with "your " powers
weaknesses: If no Inheritor is in sight, the target is chosen at random
Random inheritor powers might be useless in your current situation

name: Odor Sight
description: All odors left behind can be "seen," allowing you to track down an object. No odors have the same color, and the color fades away when the odor fades away. Once you've mastered identifying smells, you can easily track down a certain something, like pie.
summary: The ability to see different smells and odors, using your eyes.
strengths: Allows to see odors human noses can't detect
Excellent for tracking
weaknesses: May clutter field of vision

name: Gift: Auras
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at controlling auras than other beings. Thus their aura-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of auras from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve aura-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at the control of auras
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over auras as someone with this power.
Aura-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only aura-based powers now.

name: Verity Song
description: The subject induces another person in a state of trance. During this trance, the holder of the power make him/her listen to a song: the person who undergoes this treatment takes a superpower, which depend on the text and the meaning of the song, but also the affinity for the song of who receive the power in this way. In other words, the subject associates a song to a person and in this way he/she give a power. This power will be activated whenever the person who acquired it listen to the song.
summary: The ability to give superpowers to other people by making them listen to a song.
strengths: You also have the ability to understand what could be the receiving's favourite song.
The most appreciated is the song, the most powerful will be the received power.
weaknesses: The power is not aviable on yourself.
The song that activate the received power must be listened entirely.

name: Kiss Of Fate
description: You would blow a kiss and an amazing giant red glowing bright heart that would seek out towards your opponent, thus causes them to feel all of the sins and fears that they have inflicted upon others, causing severe damage.
summary: The ability to sadistically give your enemies a kiss that will cause fear & pain.
strengths: The kiss can cause your foes to go into an unmovable shock.
weaknesses: Only works on evildoers.
Can only be used by women.

name: Electrified Hair
description: The electrical current will always be just high enough to electrocute whatever the hair touches and when using this power the user's hair will become yellow in color. The user of this power is the only one immune to the electricity.
summary: The ability to run an electrical current through one's hair to electrocute whatever it touches
strengths: Being able to manipulate your hair would be a good idea.
weaknesses: Very obvious that this power is in use.

name: 5 Stone Pillars
description: First, you'll punch the ground after which 5 pillars will erupt from the ground in a circle with a 5 metre radius. The centre of the circle can be anywhere within 10 metres of the user. Anyone or anything within the area that the pillars surrounds can have the powers sealed away.
summary: The ability to cause five stone pillars to appear and anything surrounded by the pillars can have its powers sealed
strengths: Enemies inside the circle can be depowered, unless they have powers that prevent sealing.
weaknesses: Can't use this if you have no fists.
The pillars disappear after 2 seconds.
Enemies who can move extremely quickly.

name: Snap You Pulled A Muscle
description: With this power you can make people pull their muscles by snapping and saying the muscle you want to be pulled. You don't have to say the scientific name for the muscle just shouting out "leg muscle" will do. The person will then be in pain and the pull will last as long as it takes for a normal pulled muscle to heal.
summary: The ability to cause people to pull their muscles by snapping
strengths: You can cause people to pull their own muscles
weaknesses: You have to be able to snap and say the name of the muscle

name: Transformers: Shockwave
description: With this power you are able to contemplate every situation and scenario logically, when making decisions you are not affected by emotions or personal bias but only by what makes the most logical sense. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that if you use it too much you start to actually lose your emotions.
summary: The ability to think through every situation logically
strengths: You are able to think through every situation logically
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You may start to lose your emotions

name: Tranform Into Dinosaur Hybrid
description: All traits grow to the size of the Utah Raptor body. Four sets of eyes #1 rattlesnake eyes for thermal vision #2 Cat eyes for night vision #3 Fly eyes for motion detection #4 Human eyes. Body, head, and skin of a Utah raptor. Tail of a stegosaurus. With human arms and hands. Keeping your own brain and consciousness while in this form. Maintain form indefinitely, could lead to savageness and loss of humanity.
summary: The ability to transform into Raptor Hybrid Creature
strengths: Able to use weapon's.
Fantastic eye sight.
Incredible speed, power, resilience
weaknesses: Freakish looking
Incredibly painful tranformation
Loss of humanity

name: Bio Ink Tattoos
description: By touching any individual (super or not) the super can inject biologically produced ink into the receivers skin. This ink then takes the shape of: 1. The true nature of the receiver in whatever symbolic form works best or 2. Whatever the super chooses to mark the receiver with. The ink will fade as the body absorbs it over time. However, it will last for a long time before fading.
summary: The ability to touch someone and tattoo their true nature in symbolic form at whim
strengths: Useful to mark targets/allies/etc
Could be used with magic to grant temporary boons
Really adds to the flare of any superhero/villan story
weaknesses: Not very useful to attack or defend with unless used with another power
Not permanent because of it's natural ink basis
Has to be used by touching the receiver. That means getting close

name: Photon Based Physiology
description: This changes your body to allow you to utilize light in your biological processes. Specifically, you gain the ability to convert light into energy for your body through photosynthesis, in addition to your normal ways for getting energy, like eating (as such, your entire body is tinged green from chloroplasts, particularly your hair). In addition, your nervous system no longer uses electrons; now, it utilizes photons, allowing it to work much, much faster and more efficiently than before.
summary: The ability to have a functioning body based around the usage of light.
strengths: Can use photosynthesis to continuously gain energy and stamina in a sunny environment
Reflexes and thought speed are pushed to extremes no electrical nervous system could hope to achieve
You glow in the dark due to all the light running through your body
weaknesses: Hard to hide in the dark
Extreme thinking speed can cause extreme impatience
Odd coloration may ostracize you from your peers

name: Dark Element: Dark Water
description: Dark water is one of the four Dark Elements, more evil versions of the four classical elements. Dark water, unlike water, is black and very sluggish moving like molasses or lava. When stepped into, it is hard to escape as this element is similar to quicksand. A large body of it will suck you down slowly and it is extremely hard to swim through. One who can use this power can create dark water out of water and manipulate dark water. They can even swim through it like it was regular water.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate dark water.
strengths: Create and manipulate the dark waters.
Trap and drown your enemies in large bodies or even waves of dark water.
You may swim through dark water like it was regular water.
weaknesses: Dark water is slow so it won't "chase" foes quickly and won't turn into waves that quickly.
In order to form dark water, you have to create it from an existing water source.
This power is very dark and can't be used for much good. Can't transmute entire oceans into this.

name: Claymore : Gold
description: (This claymore can torn things into gold ) the blade is made from Crown gold. The hilt is made from Damascus steel. This claymore can turn almost anything to gold except planets.
summary: The ability to possess a claymore that can torn things to gold
strengths: You are Midas without the physical contact part ( pro + con )
Turn your enemys ito gold
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore ( no con negation )
This claymore makes you hungry for gold
Any power that controls metal

name: Pointy Palm
description: These are different from other claws because you actually have sheaths for them in the palms of your hands, right at the bases of your fingers. They are each five inches long and curved, and they retract easily and effortlessly into your hands. They are made of super dense bone so they don't break easily and they are incredibly sharp.
summary: The ability to have claws that reside in the palms of your hands
strengths: Hang on to stuff. Very useful if you're falling off a building.
Slapping people across the face.
No bloody mess! No mutant healing factor required!
weaknesses: You can see the openings in the palms or your hands.
Making a fist could become difficult/annoying/painful if you accidentally stab yourself.
You'll probably destroy a lot of pens until you get your claws under control.

name: Myth Power: Ececheiria's Ace
description: Ececheiria (Echecheria, Ekhekheiria, Ekekheria), in Greek myth, was the goddess of armistice, truce (compromise) and cessation of hostilities. As such, channeling her allows one to instantly perceive fights, arguments or battles going on in the immediate area. In addition, one may immediately perceive a compromise that the conflicting parties will agree upon to stop fighting/arguing/warring. Furthermore, one may perceive any breakers of the truce, and inflict one random curse on them at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ececheria's command over the essence of armistice, truce and cessation of hostility
strengths: Perceive impending fights, arguments, disputes, feuds or wars
Perceive the perfect compromise to keep both sides happy
If either side reneges on the bargain/deal, they may be afflicted with a curse of the user's choice
weaknesses: Once a punishment is chosen, it's the same for every truce-breaker until next power use
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity provides immunity (NCN)

name: Reaper Claw: Final Stage
description: Unlike reaper claw 1&2 which have different abilities reaper claw: final stage only has one and that ability is total oblivion. When you activated reaper claw: final stage azrael the angel of death will appear and merge with you arm. I'll explain this part in the pros&cons and describe the merging in a comment. The attack is simple when it connects the opponent his body/soul/ and aura are completely destroyed and no power from neither heaven nor hell or earth can bring him/her back ever.
summary: The ability to completely obliterate your opponent
strengths: There are no good qualities to this power
It is a somewhat dark technique
And should only be used as a last resort
weaknesses: Unlike stage 1&2 there is no risk of injury however if overused your arm will die
To use this stage you must first master 1st and 2nd stage which will impress and befriend azreal
I listed this as a con because i don't know if befriending him is a good thing

name: Mini Mud Monsters
description: With some sticks & twigs & rocks & main ingredient: mud. You make a stick figure with rock as skull & a stone heart. Then cover in mud, zap it with some of your life force & it will come alive controlled by you. It'll take & form a monstrous appearance at action figure size. They will do your bidding until they "die" either by drying up or become to liquidy. They can put themselves back to gather though if damaged, but can't become bigger or combine with each other. You age when creating.
summary: The ability to make small humanoids out of mud
strengths: Have muddy homunculi under your control
They become more monster like after they become alive
They can reform themselves & heal if damaged
weaknesses: Can die by drying up or dissolving
Every creation you bring alive, drains some your life force

name: Hell's Helping Hand
description: To summon you must be a fire power master.  When you summon it any movement from your hands make "hells helping hand" do the same. The hand comes from Hell and is made of dead demons and magma. This power can go on and off any time.
summary: The ability to summon a firey hand from hell
strengths: Destroy enemies instantly
Does what your hands command it
Very powerful
weaknesses: Enemy must be within a 30 foot range to hit.
Not very effective on powerful people possessing holy aka light powers.
Comes out any time if your rage is very high

name: Miracle: Duplication Of Loaves
description: With this power you can't really duplicate loaves but you can encourage people to share more often so it looks like everyone has more. Against someone who feeds on negative emotions exposure to this ability hurts--akin to healing zombies.
summary: The ability to induce people to share more often
strengths: Help a Scrooge donate
"Sharing is Caring"
Hurts people who rely on negative emotions to win
weaknesses: No offensive capability (except hurting those who require negative emotions)

name: Ashes Ashes
description: With this power you can turn people into piles of ashes just by looking at them and saying "Ashes Ashes". Once they're a pile of ashes you cannot turn them back to human form and they pretty much die.
summary: The ability to turn people into a pile of ashes
strengths: You can turn your enemies into piles of ashes
weaknesses: You cannot turn them back
If you're mute this power has no effect

name: Movie For A Day
description: While not quite a day, this unorthodox power allows you to have your life mimic a movie; what genre it will be depends on the overall moment that it activates; if you're fighting someone will become a action movie, if you're swooning over someone a romantic film, if you're joking around or goofing off a comedy. However, this will only happen at any time for an indeterminate amount of time (i. E. Time in movies ranges from a week to years)
summary: The ability to have your life mimic a movie for an indeterminate amount of times.
strengths: Have your life mimic a Action, Adventure, Comedy, etc.
Get to experience things as a protagonist; usually gets the girl
For a while almost everything will be interesting
weaknesses: Not being able to control when the power activates.
The centre of any good film is conflict and drama.
Having your life mimic a horror movie (i. E. Activates while you're feeling scared, threatened)

name: Myth Power: Poros' Provision
description: Poros, in Greek myth, was the god of expediency, the tactics taken to provide for self and loved ones. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the needs and desires of one's loved ones (family and friends). In addition, one can psychically perceive the steps to take which will allow one to most efficiently achieve the means to provide what one's loved ones want. This includes the most efficient way to commit crimes without leaving evidence or getting caught.
summary: The ability to channel Poros command over the essence of expediency, contrivance and provision
strengths: Perceive the wants and desires of loved ones
Perceive the most efficient way to go about obtaining the desires of self, loved ones and allies
If one wants something only possible by crime, perceive how to efficiently get away with it
weaknesses: Planning efficiency grows with practice; no widescale planning until higher levels (no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Penia's Penalty are immune to this ability
People with justice/law/morals-based MythPowers can still sense your crimes

name: Osteoclast Mimicry
description: When your skin is in contact with a bone, it releases an acid which destroys its organic part. The skin then absorbs the dissolved minerals, such as calcium and phosphate, which you can either secrete or store inside your body. Note that you must be directly touching a bone to melt it. It won't work if you try using this power through the skin or a piece of clothing. Also, be careful of Osteoblast Mimics, as they can have control over your power.
summary: The ability to melt/digest bone tissue through direct touch, absorbing its minerals, such as calcium.
strengths: You can eat and digest bones for their calcium and other minerals.
If you have a Phasing ability, you can destroy bones through skins and clothes.
This ability can be strengthened by Osteoblast Mimics.
weaknesses: You can use it on your own skeleton, but it's really not recommended unless you can reform it.
You have to directly touch a bone to melt it.
This ability can be weakened by Osteoblast Mimics.

name: Red Rhabdomyocyte Mimicry
description: Also called Red Skeletal Myocyte Mimicry. As a type of Myocyte Mimic, you have the power to contract your body heightwise: your body and limbs become much shorter and fatter. In your case, you need to use fat and oxygen to do so, or be in the presence of an Adipocyte Mimic (fat provider) and an Erythrocyte Mimic (oxygen provider). Electricity can force you to use this power. Your contraction speed is slow and your contraction strength is low, but your body is very slow to fatigue.
summary: The ability to contract your body heightwise and be extremely good at endurance exercises.
strengths: By contracting your body, you can pull yourself up or be short enough to enter through low passages.
Your body is very slow to fatigue, so you can excell at any endurance exercises.
If you find a way to lock your feet in place, you can pull things down by grabbing them.
weaknesses: Once contracted, you'll stay that way until you find a way to stretch yourself.
You need to have access to a source of oxygen and a source of fat to contract your body.
You body is slow to contract and not very powerful.

name: Serpent Supreme Summon
description: With this power you can summon a Serpent Supreme. A serpent supreme is a snake that is about the size of an elephant, has green, nearly impenetrable skin. It has a long red forked tongue and two rows of sharp teeth. The only thing a serpent supreme can eat, however, are humans. If it eats anything else, it will die and you will lose this power. You can unsummon the snake whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon a serpent supreme
strengths: You can summon a serpent supreme and it is under your complete control
It is nearly invincible
You can unsummon it
weaknesses: You only get one
It only eats people if you feed it anything else it will die and you will lose this power

name: Laser Blood
description: Your blood is made of light. If you are cut it will pour out perpendicular to your skin. These lasers are very powerful and can ignite things and send people flying. When it hits your tissue it will be reabsorbed directly into your blood stream, making internal bleeding no longer a problem. You also have increased stamina due to the fact that your blood charges through you at the speed of freakin' light. The problem is, when you lose blood, you lose it pretty fast.
summary: The ability to bleed lasers
strengths: Awesome Weapon
Increased Stamina
Blood regenerates quickly
weaknesses: May be reluctant to use your power
Cannot be turned off
Pitiful band-aids cannot contain your mighty boo-boos

name: Myth Power: Rhea's Nurture
description: Rhea, in Greek myth, was the Titan goddess of flow, fertility and generation. As such, channeling her allows one to induce and manipulate fertility in soil, plants, animals and people (to make a sterile man virile, make a barren woman fertile, fertilize soil, etc). In addition, one can perceive his generations (if he will have children; their genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc). One can even manipulate flow (that of blood, water, mother's milk, energy, etc; at the higher levels, even time).
summary: The ability to channel Rhea's command over the essence of flow, fertility and generation (reproduction)
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce, and negate fertility at will; immune to Olympian MythPowers
Perceive one's past/future generations (location, genetic traits, thoughts, emotions, etc)
Manipulate flow of wind, water, milk, blood, energy, etc; at higher level, even time; gain Longevity
weaknesses: Cannot share Longevity, or gain/bestow Immortality until the highest levels (no Con Negation)
Also perceive barrenness/infertility/sterility, future/past adoptions, abortions and miscarriages
People with MythPower: Kronos' Craft are immune to this ability (and it doesn't allow time travel)

name: Alligator/Crocodile Summon
description: With this power you can summon and control alligators and crocodiles in order to fight or commit crime. The reptiles are under your complete control and can do anything a normal croc/gator could do. They have powerful jaws and extremely sharp teeth. They can jump far distances and breathe underwater.
summary: The ability to summon and control alligators and crocodiles
strengths: You can summon alligators and crocodiles
The animals will be under your complete control
There's no time limit
weaknesses: They are not super powered crocs/gators

name: Burning Hair
description: Your hair will be at such a high temperature when you use this power that the air around it will ignite. You are immune to heat and flames created or caused by this power. Your hair also turns red when using this power.
summary: The ability to cause one's hair to light on fire without actually burning
strengths: Enemies will not want to touch your hair.
weaknesses: Your clothes will still burn so you'll be naked if you use this power and your hair is too long.
Very obvious when in use.

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential1
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Asbetos (Asbetus- Burn) allows one to turn foes into clay statues by touch; as they are petrified, they will feel an agonizing burning, like they are being fired in a kiln. In addition, one is can withstand the same effects (heat, fire and petrifaction). Furthermore, one can negate others' heat/fire/petrifaction immunity by touch.
summary: The ability to channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
strengths: Turn foes into clay statues by touch; as they turn, they will feel like they are being burned alive
Totally withstand the effects of heat, fire and petrifcation
Negate the heat, fire and petrifaction immunity of others by touch
weaknesses: Cannot burn others without petrifying them until the higher levels
Cannot heal others' burn wounds, or prevent/reverse petrifaction until the higher levels (NCN)
People with earth/fire-based MythPowers are immune to this ability

name: Negated Superman
description: You gain flight, durability, speed, and strength enhancements whenever a power you have gained is negated, stolen, or lost. The amount of durability, speed, and strength exponentially increases for every power, plus one. If you can lift 5 pounds and lose three powers it would be 5 to the 4th exponent, so you could lift 625 pounds. It is plus one so that when you lose only one power this power is still squared in power.
summary: The ability to have powers with strength equal to the number of powers you have lost
strengths: Gain flight, durability, speed, and strength.
Will not be left superpowerless.
Grows exponentially equal to number of powers lost.
weaknesses: Only works when you lose powers (requires you have multiple abilities besides this one).
If you regain powers this power weakens.
Foes will simply learn to not negate your powers.

name: Ice Cream
description: With this ability you can just focus and make ice cream in the palm of your hands or in a different location. This power is limited to 3 tons every day, but still, you can totally bury someone in a mass of ice cream. This power also includes some freezing properties. You can summon any flavor ice cream you want, as long as you have tasted it before.
summary: The ability to create ice cream and shoot it at people
strengths: Freezing properties
Any flavor; you can also make money of this power
You can shoot it at people or summon it on top of them
weaknesses: Limited to 3 tons a day
You can't make it disappear, you'll have to eat it if you want it gone
People wll ask you for ice cream all the time

name: Sacrifice!
description: An evil twist to reality warping; to warp reality, you have to kill an animal. Different animals give you different amounts of power, with humans giving the most. The more drastic the change, the more valuable the animal has to be. Only one change at a time, but if you kill a human, you could do anything. However, if you hurt yourself, you can also bend reality, as it gives you a huge boost.
summary: The ability to warp reality with a sacrifice.
strengths: Warp reality to your will.
Serial killers will love this power.
Could sacrifice your enemy.
weaknesses: Need to kill.
Only one reality warp at a time.
Doesn't come with an offensive power.

name: Delete This Lightning Hammer
description: You could even charge up your right leg with static electricity and jump all the way in the air and then descend it onto the opponent and they will have a major concussion.
summary: The ability to charge your foot with electricity then jump up into the air and bring it down to crush your foe.
strengths: Your foe could have a maximum headache.
weaknesses: Not a very good idea to miss your attack on the enemy.

name: Hyperventilation
description: The ability to make others breathe really quickly on demand. They don't have to be anxious, nervous or coming from long durations of exercise. You just think it, or say it, and they'll start hyperventilating like it's nobody's business.
summary: The ability to make others breathe really quickly on demand
strengths: You can now make people hyperventilate whenever you want
weaknesses: People with asthma
People with bronchitis
People who don't need to breathe

name: 6 Trials
description: The six trials can be of any style and difficulty. Ex: riddle, obstacle course, quiz, etc. You get to choose them and if the person doesn't want to take the trials, they can't use your powers.
summary: The ability to have anyone who wants to use any of one's powers take six trials
strengths: A defense against mimics.
You get your choice of the trials.
The trials only have to be passed once (may be con).
weaknesses: Useless against stealing.
Even friends and allies have to take the trials.

name: Toxic Spit
description: With this power you can spit toxic waster from your mouth at your enemies. The wastes will burn or mutate your enemies and most likely kill them. The user of this power cannot be effected by his own toxins or any other toxic wastes.
summary: The ability to spit toxic waste
strengths: You can spit out toxic waste at your enemies
You cannot be effected by your own or other toxins
weaknesses: This power is useless against other people with this power

name: Perfect Umpire/Referee
description: With this power you always make the right call in any sporting event. You're automatically up to date with all the rules and know automaticalyl how and when to apply them. Also grants you knowledge of the required jargon.
summary: The ability to make perfect calls in any sport or competition
strengths: Be known as the best referee or umpire ever
You're never wrong when it comes to making a call
Valid for all sports and competitions
weaknesses: This power doesn't necessarily mean that no one will argue your calls

name: Conciousness Power Link
description: With this ability, you can attach your other powers to your consciousness, so you can use them if you switch bodies. However, your decendants cannot inherit them and they cannot be given to anyone else while in this state. The only power in your body and your consciousness at the same time is this power.
summary: The ability to attach your powers to your consciousness.
strengths: Keep your powers when you switch bodies.
As a side effect, your powers can't be mimicked.
If you have a power which can produce copies of your powers, you can have your powers in both ways.
weaknesses: Children cannot inherit your powers.
You cannot share your powers.
Con Negation and similar abilities do not work on this.

name: Living Laundromat
description: With this ability, you can clean clothes with your mind. You never have to go to the laundromat ever again. You can even clean the clothes you are wearing.
summary: The ability to clean clothes with your mind.
strengths: Clean clothes with your mind.
Save money.
Never go to the laundromat again.
weaknesses: You still have to fold the clothes.
You still have to organize your closet.
You still have to do other things.

name: Rhino Shift
description: This ability allows you to transform into a rhinoceros and in between. While in Rhino form, you have bullet-proof skin and a diamond ivory horn, but you aren't indestructible. While in hybrid form, you have super-strength and enhanced speed, but you lose a lot of intelligence.
summary: The ability to transform into a rhino and in between.
strengths: Bullet-proof skin and diamond ivory horn.
Cool muscles.
Eat grass.
weaknesses: Endangered species.
Lowered intelligence and eyesight.
Eat grass.

name: Secret Keeper
description: If you have this power, you will never be forced to reveal any secret you know, unless the person you are telling already knows. Right before you attempt to reveal the secret, you will forget completely about it. When you are no longer in the situation where you would reveal the secret, the memory of the secret comes back to you. This power works automatically for any secret you know.
summary: The ability to always keep secrets by forgetting them before you can reveal the secret.
strengths: Never accidentally reveal secrets again.
Not even torture can make you reveal the secret.
Would become a great government intel keeper.
weaknesses: Works without your control.
If you are tortured, you cannot give up the information.
May forget things temporarily that you want to remember

name: Author Power Negation
description: Annoyed at people abusing the power you made? Are they bringing them out of the context you intended? If so, this power is definitely for you. With this power, you can eliminate a particular instance of it. For instance, if you were using Form Replication, the author could stop you from changing/acquiring alternate forms, but still let you change between your disguise and normal form easily, or vice versa.
summary: The ability to negate select instances of the powers you created.
strengths: Stop abuse of the powers you made.
The creator of this power does not intend to use it to harm others, so you are safe.
You can negate a power in the normal fashion (but it takes more effort)
weaknesses: Cannot be altered by other powers. Thus, you cannot eliminate this con or other cons.
Useless to those who have not submitted powers to the superpower list.
Useless against powers you didn't create.

name: Lycanthropic Superiority
description: A lycanthrope with this power is of such a high level that other lycanthropes automatically do what they're told by the lycanthrope with this power. Due to the nature of this power, only a lycanthrope or part-lycanthrope can have this power. If two beings with this power try to give a command to the same being, the one who is more powerful gets their command followed first.
summary: The ability to give orders to lycanthropes and have the orders followed
strengths: You get servants who will follow your every command.
Works for lycanthropes, half-lycanthropes, and werepyres.
You're immune to the commands of someone else with this power, regardless of strength.
weaknesses: Lycanthropes are generally available only at the full moon.
Only works for the beings mentioned in the second pro.
You don't want to meet someone with this power who's more powerful.

name: Petulance
description: Everyone has pet peeves. So if you use this power on someone, every little thing will annoy & piss them off to the breaking point of extreme irritation, aggravation & frustration. Causing them to flip out. They'll either go berserk on something or someone or just become hysterically crazy.
