summary: The ability to induce extreme annoyance & frustration into someone
strengths: Induce P.O.ness x1000 in someone
Cause them to become a crazed berserking animal once they reach a breaking point
weaknesses: Don't want to be around once they go all psycho hopped up on PCP

name: Autobot Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Autobot or Maximal. Applicable to any show or continuity.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Autobots
strengths: You can summon any Autobot/Maximal from G1 Optimus Prime to Movie Jetfire and everybody else
weaknesses: They don't have to help you fight
You might loose them when they're in their alt modes (unless of course they're a dinobot)

name: Mind Fire
description: With this, you can set people's brains on fire. This causes extreme pain and death after about 3 or 4 seconds.
summary: The ability to set people's brains on fire
strengths: You can kill people quickly and painfully at the same time
weaknesses: There is no way to minimize the pain it kills people no matter what

name: Demonic Presence
description: Anyone you encounters will be intimidated/scared by you and believe that you are a demon. Also they will try to get rid of you with all conventional anti-demon methods. Ex: crosses, churches, etc.
summary: The ability to have a presence that is demonic
strengths: You may not have any enemies, just superstitious people who try to ward you away.
weaknesses: Someone has to know you really well in order for this power to not affect them.
People may think you're evil, even if you aren't.

name: Myth Power: Macaria's Whim
description: Macaria (Makaria), in Greek myth, was the goddess of a blessed death and afterlife. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive whether a subject's spirit goes to Heaven or Hell after they die. In addition, one may erase a foe's memories of any good deeds he has done in the past, at will, so he thinks he is a villain; from that point on, he will lead a life worthy of Hell. The same may even be done with allies (erasing memories of past sins, so from then on, they lead lives worthy of Heaven).
summary: The ability to channel Macaria's command over the essence of a blessed death and afterlife
strengths: Perceive whether a subject goes to Heaven or Hell after they die
Help allies lead lives worthy of blessedness; cause foes to lead lives worthy of condemnation
Withstand death/necromantic/underworld-based or infernal effects (Death Inducing, etc)
weaknesses: No Astral Eviction/Banishment or Astral Trapping until the higher levels (NCN)
No Astral Realm Perception, Astral Energy Perception or Psychopompism until the higher levels (NCN)
Immortals, Astral Trappers, etc; behavior-altering abilities can negate Pro #1 and #2

name: Black Enchanter
description: A person with dark or demonic based powers can use this ability to implant a portion of their power into an inanimate object. By doing this the object becomes a cursed artifact with demonic abilities of its own.
summary: The ability to only individuals with demonic or otherwise dark powers can use this ability.
strengths: The person becomes a dark enchanter using his own soul force to create demonic items.
The items become independent entities with their own unique abilities that they can trigger on their
weaknesses: The enchanter loses power for a short period of time because of the implantation.
Too much enchanting can leave the enchanter to weak to maintain living.

name: Myth Power: Astraeus' Ascension
description: Astraeus (Astraios), in Greek myth, was the god of the stars, starlight, planets and astrology. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically cast an illusion of stars in the night sky to mesmerize foes at will. In addition, one can also use this effect to psychically communicate with the stars, to divine past, present or future. Furthermore, one can psychically perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes. One can even gain physical power when one's sign is present in the night sky.
summary: The ability to channel Astraeus' command over the essence of stars, starlight, planets and astrology
strengths: Cast an illusion of stars, twinkling in the night sky, to psychically mesmerize foes
Pro #1 used on self allows one to speak to/listen to/observe the stars to divine past/present/future
Perceive subjects' zodiac signs and horoscopes; gain physical power when your sign is present
weaknesses: Cannot mimic a star (space-adapted flight, stellar energy generation, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain sustenance from stellar energy, or generate levitating 'stardust' until developed (NCN)
Sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Lava Hair
description: Your hair can be turned into lava and while it is in its lava state you can completely control its movement.
summary: The ability to turn one's hair into lava
strengths: Your hair is a weapon.
weaknesses: Very obvious when you're using this power.

name: Zombie Healing
description: Everyone has heard of healing, but this is healing with a twist. If you find a sick or injured person, you can make them a zombie which slowly heals and, when recovered, turns back to human. Also, if they bite someone, they become a zombie in a similar state. These zombies do not need sustenance and they can't be killed, unless completely destroyed. Further injuries prolong their condition, they are immune to disease and don't age whilst a zombie. You can control and talk with them anywhere.
summary: The ability to heal others by turning them into zombies that serve you.
strengths: Get servants.
Heal others.
People will pay to be your slave (temporarily).
weaknesses: You could start a pandemic.
If you die, they all turn back.
You have to talk for them.

name: Mad Props, Man!
description:
Say you want that Avatar machine, the ridiculous drilling machine from The Core, or any number of horror/thriller murder weapons; this is the power for you! 
The only requirements are that you have seen the movie the object was in from start to finish and somebody else within earshot has to know what you're talking about. You can summon any number of objects, but not duplicates of the same one. (However, you can get Jason's machete from Friday the 13th 1, 2, 3... As separate movie objects. )
summary: The ability to summon movie props in their fictionalized form.
strengths: Any identifiable tropes or movie physics apply to the right props.
Live out your favorite movie fantasies. (Sixteen Candles, Evil Dead, Roman Holiday, you name it! )
Be the Blockbuster and blow all others out of fandom.
weaknesses: Better make your friends watch some movies.
You cannot give the item powers it did not show in the movie.
You'll soon be a tired and cliche hero/villain/noir antihero.

name: Demon Transf. #3 Black Demon
description: Yeh, its cool. Let's get started: You are wearing an all black armor, wielding the 5th moon blade, and have black angel-like wings. Your strength, speed and all your other attributes are increased. The two greatest attacks you have are Inescapable Judgment and Time Hollow (will be additional powers as the description will not fit here).
summary: The ability to transform into a demon.
strengths: You are very strong, fast, etc.
You are very hard to kill.
weaknesses: Your great power comes from negative energy which starts collecting inside of you once you...
...transform. While you are fighting, it is converted into energy, but once you've won,...
...it will try to control you and turn you into a full demon. High will is required to resist.

name: Lilies Of Lilith
description: This is also knnown as 'Blessing of Lilith. ' Lilith is supposedly the mother of all demons and a vampire. The lily is her symbol. This power makes vampires slightly demonic and vice versa. You can with this power control shadows, other vampires/demons without regard for rank, and summon magical lilies. The lilies can explode like a mine, heal, and more. Your blood also becomes undrinkable to vampires unless you want them to drink it. All your attributes are also enhanced.
summary: The ability to utilize a vampire/demon only power given with Lilith's blessing
strengths: You have Lilith's blessing which means vampires/demons won't attack you.
Doesn't matter if you're a shinso or devil you can control anyone else of your race.
You also gain the special powers of the strongest of your race (Vampires-shinso, demons-devil).
weaknesses: This can only be used by vampires and demons.
If you're a vampire or demon facing someone with this power.
Don't ask where I got my information. (Neither pro nor con)

name: Disruptive Teleportation
description: This ability allows you to teleport but when you disappear and reappear, the space that you teleported from and to will be warped. Matter will be broken and air currents will be disturbed to and from. Anything you are touching will teleport with you and will not be warped.
summary: The ability to teleport while warping all space around you in the process.
strengths: A great way to travel.
A great way of killing someone fast.
As long as you're touching them, your possessions and loved ones are safe.
weaknesses: This power is more useful for villains.
You could accidently kill someone.
You could accidently break a prized possession if you're not touching it.

name: Hell's Mouth
description: As far as intimidation goes, this ability packs quite a punch. First off, one with this power can breathe fire (or superhot air), and their breath smells of brimstone and burning flesh. On top of that, the user can unleash a roar that sounds like the combined tormented screams, cries and wails of all the people in Hell (or destined for Hell); the user can also mimic any of their voices and when they use this power, their eyes turn red or yellow.
summary: The ability to use one's mouth as a link between here and Hell
strengths: The user is always feared (repel even evil spirits)
User looks into foes's eyes, foe can SEE into Hell (if he touches the foe, he can feel Hell's fire)
Only works on the damned (truly honestly religious people won't feel or hear a thing)
weaknesses: One with this ability is always feared.
The user may hear his own voice among the damned screaming (useful, but also terrifying)
The user may always have a brimstone-y taste in his mouth.

name: Horn Of Pandora
description: You can make a horn appear that causes chaos all around the globe. Yet when you stop playing, time is re-winded and all is undone. However you know what happened and remain on the location you were when the chaos started. In most cases the same place because a horn like that is hard to move. You can also take people with you to this chaotic version of the earth who are unaffected if they touch the horn when you start and stop playing. If they aren't around when you stop playing they vanquish.
summary: The ability to summon chaos and madness or make noise.
strengths: The perfect spy tool, break in learn the secrets and go back. You cannot get caught.
Force an enemy to touch the horn for just a split second and then stop playing. Problem solved.
When you own the Zone Zero Power you can retrieve people who where left behind in the chaos.
weaknesses: Blowing the horn requires great stamina.
You can lose friends if they dont touch the horn when you dont own a retrieving power.
If the horn is broken during the chaos, the chaos will last forever.

name: Myth Power: Phyge's Flight
description: Phyge, in Greek myth, was the goddess of flight (fleeing), escape, hiding, exile, banishment and refuge. As such, channeling her allows one to reactively adapt one's body to escape any system intended to bind, hold, imprison or contain. In addition, one gains psychic knowledge of how to escape any place (all exit and escape routes, etc). One even gains access to an extradimensional space; one may use it to seek refuge for oneself and allies, to store possessions, or to banish foes at will.
summary: The ability to channel Phyge's command over the essence of avoidance, flight, escape, exile, banishment and refuge
strengths: Reactively adapt one's body to escape any binding, seal, prison or containment
Psychic knowledge of all exit/escape routes in vicinity (when developed, applies to social settings)
Gain access to extradimensional space for storage, escape/refuge or banishment
weaknesses: Cannot physically deflect oncoming impacts by hand (Deflection) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only evade subjects' contact and individual senses (Imperceptibility) at the higher levels (NCN)
No Astral Eviction or Exorcism/Spirit Banishment until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Quick Flight V2
description: With this power you can make flying animals or people be able to fly at greater speeds To activate this power all you have to do is look at the person/animal and the next time they fly it will be at a greater speed than they usually fly at. When they land they will revert to their normal speed until you look at them again. You can turn this power on and off.
summary: The ability to make flying animals or people fly faster
strengths: You can make people or animals fly faster
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You have to be looking at the person/animal
Not much use in physical combat

name: Summoning: Basilisk
description: Basilisks are the Kings of Serpents, giant snakes with eyes that can paralyze people. It is rarely summoned, for fear its eyes will settle upon the summoner.
summary: The ability to summon a basilisk.
strengths: Paralyze people.
Summon Basilisk.
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Condition Change: Goodwill
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to make it work only when the power is being used to freely help others. "Freely" meaning that the user does NOT expect anything in exchange for what they're doing. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the power is being used to help someone else
strengths: You can make people who are cruel better people with this power.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch affects only one power.
Oppononent(s) with multiple powers.

name: Voracious Papilionoidea
description: When used, this ability creates a swarm of butterflies. These butterflies are carnivorous and will eat anything alive that's not you. You have very little (if any) control over the butterflies, barely enough to keep them from eating allies or bystanders. The coloration of the butterflies varies from person to person. The size of the swarm and the control over the butterflies depend on the person's experience with the power.
summary: The ability to summon a swarm of flesh-eating butterflies
strengths: They will eat the annoying people
Their size and the fact that they fly mean that they will be difficult to stop
They're like flying insectoid piranhas!
weaknesses: Insecticides
Bug-controlling powers
They might eat people you don't want them to eat..

name: Celtic Invocation: Beltane
description: Beltane is the festival of fertility and growth, and so are its powers given. The invoker can increase all fertility in the area, for soil, plants, animals and humans. They can also subtly increase the growth of plants in the area, increasing it by about five. They can also heal all non-lethal illnesses and wounds, in animals and humans. They can create feelings of lust and love, and for their final ability, can create a fire that when a hearth-fire is lit by it, brings good luck and happiness.
summary: The ability to use the power of Beltane, the first day of spring.
strengths: Everyone will love you, due to the overflow of power Beltane brings.
Plants and animals will be especially sensitve to your wants and needs and may obey you.
You'll be the life of the party!
weaknesses: Only available once a year.
Sometimes, the emotional aspect can get out of hand and affect the invoker severely.
You'll be in high demand due to people wanting you to ensure a good crop and herd.

name: Fibroblast Mimicry
description: As a Fibroblast Mimic, you can produce very long filaments of collagen that have the property to specifically stick to any person with a power from the Cellular series, including yourself. While the filaments can easily be broken by other people, they become much more resistant when they come into contact with a Cellular Mimic. Additionally, you can duplicate yourself into identical copies, though this process cannot be undone.
summary: The ability to shoot filaments that can easily trap and bind Cellular Mimics.
strengths: If your opponent has a power from the Cellular series.
You can create clones to outnumber and overpower an opponent.
The filaments are very light and can easily be carried away by the wind.
weaknesses: Don't accidentally trap yourself or a friend with your filaments.
If the filaments aren't touching you or Cellular Mimic, they become very fragile.
If your foe doesn't have a power from the Cellular Series.

name: Zap Cannon
description: You are able to create a shock out of any part of your body that can turn any substance into a cannon, that you are able to make fire mentally.
summary: The ability to zap any substance and it becomes a cannon(s).
strengths: Create cannons instantly.
weaknesses: Create them out of a bad material, like glass,etc.
They will need ammo.
They can be destroyed. No con negation or inconvience destroyer can be used.

name: Transformation: Ace Of Spades
description: The user is able to transform his or herself into the hero named the Ace of Spades. With this transformation, the user is able to gain the abilities of previous Ace of Spades as well as their memories during the time as a reincarnate of the Ace of Spade. To transform the user needs a special ace of spades card, that is more than meets the eye. The Ace of Spades uses throwing stars that resembles the ace of spades and has olympic level acrobatic skills and combat skills
summary: The ability to transform into a hero who uses Ace of Spades Motifs
strengths: Good at playing all form of card games that has an ace involved
Olympic level acrobat
Olympic level fighter
weaknesses: Cannot go head to head with powerhouses
No enhanced strength

name: Myth Power: Eunomia's Notice
description: Eunomia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of lawful conduct and following rules. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the law of whatever land they currently reside in (as well as bring said laws to others' minds at will). In addition, one can compel subjects to do nearly anything, so long as it is legal, as well as withstanding and negating illegal compulsions. One can even mark a foe as a target, by touch; if he breaks any laws, all neutrals in vicinity will turn on/attack him.
summary: The ability to channel Eunomia's command over the essence over good order and lawful behavior
strengths: Perceive the law of the land; remind others of them at will
Induce law-abiding compulsions (and negate law-breaking ones)
Mark a foe (by touch); if he breaks a law, or a moral convention, neutrals will turn against him
weaknesses: Only teleport self/others to lands with laws closely fitting one's morals at the higher levels (NCN)
Maybe feel bad about MAKING others do the right thing; Immoral compulsions fail automatically
Sin/injustice/corruption-based MythPowers and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provide immunity (NCN)

name: Zero's Scroll: Absorption
description: A highly useful, and very dangerous spell. Using this will allow you to absorb the energy and life of plants and animals, and even humans who you can overpower with your will. With this, you can use spells with less drain on yourself, and replenish your energy more easily. However, your body won't be cured, and will be burdened by the intruding energy.
summary: The ability to use Absorption.
strengths: Quickly replenish your energy.
Great for mages.
weaknesses: Affects your body, causing you to fatigue.
Hard to maintain.

name: Marked For Death
description: If you want someone dead, all you do is shake their hand & a crimson black pus-oozing rash will appear on their palm. A year from now, they will die unless they sacrifice everything they hold dear including shaking someone else's hand with the cursed hand. After that they must cut their own hand off & give it to you as "a pound of flesh" payment for the death curse to be lifted & transferred to the last person they shook hands with. Just hope they don't place it on your loved ones.
summary: The ability to put a death sentence on someone unless they give something to you
strengths: Torment someone that they will die unless they vow poverty life & deliver pound of flesh
weaknesses: Better hope they don't shake hands & pass the curse to your family & friends

name: Noel Organon
description: With this power you can extend and control harp strings from your fingers. The strings are near invisible to the human eye. The strings can slice through most objects easily. The user can make the strings vibrate when they are attached to something to create music. The music has the effect of causing paralysis in whoever feels the vibrations. The user can decide who gets paralyzed. Those affected are also paralyzed in the mind and will have a harder time thinking. Many strings can be made.
summary: The ability to create harp strings from your fingers.
strengths: Harp strings can slice through most objects.
Music causes paralysis in selected targets.
Can have as many strings as you are able to control.
weaknesses: Very difficult to control the strings precisely.
Sound powers could negate or reverse the music.
Those with enhanced sight could advoid the strings.

name: Rise Of The Jabberwock
description: With this power you can turn into the powerful Jabberwock from Carrol Lewis's book "Through the Looking Glass and What Alice Found There"
summary: The ability to turn into the Jabberwock at will
strengths: You can fly
You have strong teeth and claws
You can survive without your head (As seen on the Muppet Show)
weaknesses: The Jabberwock is really ugly

name: Myth Power: Thaumas' Theme
description: Thaumas, in Greek myth, was the god of wonder, astonishment and fascination (especially with the sea's sparkling, shining beauty and majesty). As such, channeling him allows one to survive underwater and swim well. In addition, one may give off a shiny, glinting aura, like light reflecting off the sea, at will, to mesmerize subjects. One may even induce an overwhelming, longing fascination with the sea (in which they only think about swimming, water, etc) among numerous other beneficial effects.
summary: The ability to channel Thaumas' command over the essence of wonder, astonishment and fascination with the sea
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater; produce a sparkly, mesmerizing aquatic aura
Induce overwhelming longing for the sea in others at will (all they think about is swimming/water)
Gain favor with all sea creatures; immunity to MythPowers based on Thaumas' children
weaknesses: Cannot teleport to magic water sites (Fountain of Youth, Atlantis etc) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only gain immunity to water/sea magic at the higher levels (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Megakaryocyte Mimicry
description: This power allows you to create clones of yourself, except they don't have Megakaryocyte Mimicry; it is replaced by Thrombocyte Mimicry. To create clones, you must lose parts of your body. They will regenerate and the separated parts will grow to become identical clones of you. Hepatocyte Mimics can boost your power if they want to.
summary: The ability to create clones with the power of Thrombocyte Mimicry by losing parts of your body.
strengths: Thrombocyte Mimics are very effective to create barriers and even more effective when they are many.
Hepatocyte Mimics can boost your power, allowing you to create clones more rapidly.
If you unwillingly lose parts of your body, they will regrow and the lost parts will become clones.
weaknesses: You don't gain the power of Thrombocyte Mimicry, only your clones do.
Your clones can't get the power of Megakaryocyte Mimicry; it is replaced by Thrombocyte Mimicry.
If not boosted, your powers of regeneration and clone creation are slow.

name: Qwop Inducing
description: With this power you can cause people to move like the QWOP guy. They will start to have weird awkward movements and it will take them a lot of practice before they can begin to move like a normal person again. You can reverse the affects of this power.
summary: The ability to make people move like the QWOP guy
strengths: You can make people move like the QWOP guy
You can reverse the affects of this power
weaknesses: Nothing really

name: Trojan Horse
description: It is as though you are hollow, and living within you is an army of tiny Greek soldiers from the time of the Trojan war. They enter and exit your body through doors strategically placed around your body, can speak your language, and see you as their commander. As such, they will follow your directives to the utmost of their ability and will offer you their advice whenever asked for it.   Greek heroes of the Trojan war, such as Achilles, Odysseus, and Agamemnon are among their number.
summary: The ability to contain an army of tiny soldiers from ancient Greece
strengths: You have a tiny army that is loyal to you and can be deployed at any time.
You have acess to advice not only some fine military leaders, but the worlds cleverest man.
They can learn and adapt to our time, given enough time.
weaknesses: The army only has acess to weapons and technology from ancient Greece.
The tactics and advice they give you are from the perspective of ancient Grecian warriors.
They will expect equal divition of loot from any "war" they fight in.

name: Quartz Breath
description: With this ability you will be able to exhale a cloud of gas that activates with the air to form quartz to trap your enemies in. Anyone trapped in the quartz remains in a state of suspended animation until they are freed. The gas has a delayed activation so you don't have quartz form in your esophagus
summary: The ability to exhale a gas that quickly solidifies into quartz
strengths: Trap enemies
Victims remain alive
Gas has delayed activation to prevent suffacation
weaknesses: Gas does not travel very far
Hard to control

name: Play Fetch
description: If your holding a stick and an opponent sees it you can make him or her behave as if s/he was a loyal pet dog of yours. If an opponent can shape shift or morph into a dog s/he will do so. This power stops working if your throwing arm gets tired,the stick breaks,you choose not to throw the stick,if you pretend to throw the stick or the stick is lost after you throw it. You can only affect a person once a day. This power will not work on anyone who is resistant or immune to mind control.
summary: The ability to make an opponent behave like a pet dog and play fetch the stick with you.
strengths: Give your worst enemy the mind of a loyal pet if only for a short time.
Sticks are free.
weaknesses: Someone immune to mind control.
You run out of sticks.
Your throwing arm gets a cramp.

name: Antimatter Mirror
description: The Antimatter Mirror is an object and is also a doorway to the dark, violent, opposite universe. Within dwells the name Sabra Deck Stun, an imprisoned ghost (resembling the eyebrows, vile yellow-greenish eyes, and the triangular lips with yellow/brown teeth surroned by silver smoke) who always speaks malevolently The mirror can even give you a glimpse of what we look like if we were evil.
summary: The ability to see what we look like if we are evil or travel in it to see what's different.
strengths: It's also a gateway to an evil dimension.
None.
weaknesses: Totally vile object to use.
If the mirror is broken and you are stuck in a dark evil universe you can't go back.

name: Proximity High
description: Just by being within a certain distance, people around you will become high. The drawback is you suffer by being in a constant high. Drugs work oppositely for you, they make you sober.
summary: The ability to make people go into an altered state of mind while in proximity
strengths: Makes people around you high
Can be used to disorientate
weaknesses: Costly if you want to be normal
People will be high around you
Hallucinations

name: Morbid Teleportation
description: Here's how it works. You die, your body decomposes. Then, you transfer to another dead body since your old one will be dust in a matter of seconds. You can wait in the body before bringing yourself back to life, even for centuries, and it reforms itself to look like you. Creepy and cool-looking. However, you need to be within 20 miles of a dead (human) body to make the jump. Or else, you die and... Well, you die. But as long as there are corpses nearby, you are practically immortal in a sense!
summary: The ability to teleport via corpses
strengths: You teleport via corpses, which is cool and freaky
You can wait centuries in a corpse
As long as a dead human is nearby, you are pretty much immortal. You just transfer to the other one.
weaknesses: You need to be near a body that is within 20 miles of you to transfer, or else you actually die

name: Myth Power: Pandora's Box
description: In Greek Myth, Pandora's Box is known to contain all the sins, wicked things and negativity about the natural world. This power lets you harness its capability. The user of this ability is capable of summoning the box at will and using it to do one of a few things. He can open it and release a spirit to possess or torment the foe. He can use the box to CAPTURE evil spirits, whether they belong in the box or not. Or he can release Hope to assist him in his time of need.
summary: The ability to channel the power contained within Pandora's Box
strengths: Summon Pandora's box at will
Can be used to release evil spirits which torment the foe (or drive him into sinful acts)
Can also be used to CAPTURE evil spirits (or release Hope to help you or allies)
weaknesses: Only a few evil spirits can be released at a time
Evil spirits that don't belong in the box may be hard to catch (and even harder to keep in)
If you do something particularly evil (or with evil intentions), Hope won't come out to help you

name: Amphibian Mimicry
description: Amphibians are one of the world's oldest groups of animals. They must be doing something right. An Amphibian Mimic can take on amphibian abilities, such as breathing underwater through their skin, webbed feet and hands, deadly poison generation (from poison dart frogs), a prehensile tongue, and some enhanced strength in the lower body. It, like Reptile Mimicry, is an all-or-nothing where all the aspects must be taken on at once, and it comes with some reduced intelligence.
summary: The ability to take on the characteristics of amphibians
strengths: Increased swimming ability + lower body strength
Prehensile tongue
Poison generation (poison dart frogs)
weaknesses: Must take on all aspects at once
Reduced intelligence when using
Slimy skin when using

name: Turkeytality
description: The move allows you to turn your opponents into turkey versions of themselves. Regardless, the regressed character's attire is basically a wild turkey version of the clothes he or she wore when fully-grown, complete with smaller versions of his or her accessories, the incarnation where the turkey would just walk around looking stupid and obliviously make a fool of themselves usually involving a humiliating action with a signature trait of theirs to drive the point home even in death.
summary: The ability to turn your foes into turkeys.
strengths: You can have yourself an early thanksgiving feast.
Might find it hysterical.
weaknesses: None, except for the foe you cast it on.

name: Sinless Gluttony
description: You can eat ANYHING--cardboard, metal, toxic waste, brussel sprouts, whatever.  Yes, even brussel sprouts will be edible!  They will all taste great and hard things like rocks and metal will be easy to eat.  Plus, you will never get sick and they will all be very nutritional.
summary: The ability to eat anything without getting sick (and it always tastes good).
strengths: Rocks are delicious and cheap
Save on the grocery bills
Get your daily nutritional needs by eating total crap
weaknesses: Eating important belongings
Eating poop--you can do it, but why would you?

name: Contact Binding
description: This power enables you to bind distinct living beings together by making them unable to separate the areas where their bodies are in contact. It even works if they are in contact through a thin layer of material. The user needs to keep concentrating on the contact zone for it to remain inseparable.
summary: The ability to render a contact zone between distinct living beings inseparable
strengths: Can be used to incapacitate.
Can affect more than two living beings.
Even works on you if desired.
weaknesses: Only works if there is contact when this power is activated.
Lasts until the user breaks his concentration.

name: Elemental Shrooms: Fire
description: When ingesting this mushroom gain the power of fire. You can manipulate,create,and even eat fire for energy. This power can be combined with one more elemental shrooms to make new elements for example fire and earth makes magma. With enough training you can turn your body into flames to fly and you gain immunity for fire.
summary: The ability to gain the element of fire by eating this mushroom
strengths: Can live of fire for substenance
Can be combined with other elemental shrooms
Burn stuff
weaknesses: Can only eat one more elemental shrooms
Going to the bathroom may burn the first time
Weak against water shroom users

name: Summon Madspawn
description: Kyst has given the madspawn the appearance of a crow made of blood-colored glass. Madspawn have kystian invulnerability. A madspawn is only as strong as a child, but what the 'bird' actually does is infect anyone it comes in physical contact with a mindless hatred towards all things non-kystian. The effect lasts for 20 minutes. Any foe made of solid matter can be infected. The anti-telepathic power and the kystian aura power are the only protection. Madspawn have a average IQ and will obey you.
summary: The ability to summon a flying half-alive thing.
strengths: A hate-spreading monster that can fly.
You can command one not to touch you.
A small target to hit in combat.
weaknesses: One of the weakest kystians.

name: Spydyr's Door
description: Thanks to Shadowulf1 and Josh for this idea. With this power, you are able to leave any place in style. No matter what you are doing or being done to, you will be able to exit in the coolest way ever.
summary: The ability to leave an area in a grand exit
strengths: Able to impress the ladies
Your reputation will be huge
Leaving in style
weaknesses: No offense whatsoever
Always have to leave first to make that good impression.
Leaving a public bathroom could get awkward.......

name: Make 'em  Sing And Dance
description: This power,also called The Glee Effect,mentally compels any foe or foes as soon as they can see you to dance and sing instead of walking and talking. If their not moving they will dance in one spot. Foes can defend themselves from your attacks but they must use dance moves to do so. Foes can attack you but will always dance when they do. This power stops working when you are no longer visible to any foes. Mute foes will still dance. Foes unable to walk will still sing.
summary: The ability to make a foe or foes sing and dance instead of talking and walking.
strengths: This is a kind of wild card power-it could be very useful against certain foes.
weaknesses: Any one who can resist mind control.
Any blind foe.
This is a kind of wild card power-it could utterly useless against the wrong foes.

name: Delete This Rise And Shine
description: It is a powerful one-hit variation where you have to rise up in the air, delivering an uppercut to the opponent, then instantly teleport to keep their head between your enemy's legs and keep a hold on the legs with their arms before flipping forward planting their feet and bridging back, completing a one-hit KO.
summary: The ability to unleash a powerful uppercut, then teleport to do a jackknife powerbomb.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: None.

name: Meme Power
description:
With this power you can summon any internet meme or viral video and apply it to real life. 

All memes haves their powers as stated by the meme. 

For example you can summon Shoop da Woop to fire a laser beam
summary: The ability to summon internet memes
strengths: Your power is Over 9000!
Rickroll people
You can even create memes yourself
weaknesses: The real world will be distorted everytime you use your power

name: Myth Power: Telesidromos' Tool
description: Telesidromos (Telesidromus), in Greek myth, was the god of horses' safety (especially during the Olympian games and other races). As such, channeling him allows one to absorb psychic energy from bravery, courage, determination, hope and similar positive emotion to form into a pseudo-sentient horse construct. In addition, the construct is immune to fear, as is the rider, when mounted. One can even ride the construct through space-time to/through a place designated one's "happy place", at will.
summary: The ability to channel Telesidromos' command over the essence of horses' safety
strengths: Form psychic energy from bravery/courage/determination/hope (of self/others) into a horse construct
Horse construct is immune to fear and fear effects, as is the rider (when mounted)
Ride horse construct to/through one's ideal happy place (via Teleportation, Time Travel, etc)
weaknesses: Horse construct cannot be reserved for self/allies (or multiplied) until the higher levels (NCN)
Only turn foe into horse under the user's hope-fueled control, by touch, at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige, MythPower: Artemis' Gift, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Super Chocolate
description: Useful for whenever you think "hmmm, I could really use some chocolate right now.... " *Poof! * Chocolate! Unfortunately, once something becomes chocolate, it cannot un-become chocolate.
summary: The ability to turn anything into chocolate.
strengths: Who doesn't love chocolate?
You can make rather awesome chocolate sculptures
Edible
weaknesses: Not so useful in a combat situation...
What if you don't like chocolate? :O

name: Myth Power: Bacchanalia
description: Dionysus (Dionysos, Bacchus, Bakkhos), in Greek myth, was the god of wine, drunkenness and festivity. As such, channeling him allows one to induce drunkenness (including euphoric drunken ecstasy, or the Bacchanalia, an uncontrollable drunken rage), as well as amplify, negate and withstand the same at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel wild partiers and the drunken. One can even psychically manipulate grapes, grape vines and other grape products, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dionysus' command over the essence of wine, drunkenness, revelry and debauchery
strengths: Psychically induce, amplify, reduce, negate and withstand inebriation (drunken intoxication)
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel wild partiers and the inebriated/intoxicated
Psychically generate and manipulate grapes, grape vines and other grape products at will
weaknesses: Cannot harness the Bacchanalia for oneself until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Lyssa's Lunacy, Berserker Rage, etc provide benefits to Pro #2
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Ghostly Pyrokinesis
description: The color of the fire is of a black and gray composition. The only thing it can actually burn are bodiless spirits.
summary: The ability to create and control flames that burn bodiless spirits
strengths: Spirits will either fear you or try to possess you (may be con).
weaknesses: The fire might look a bit creepy.
Will not harm physical objects or beings.

name: Gremlin Summon
description: With this power you can summon an infinite number of gremlins from their home dimension and make them do whatever you want. When you're done using them you can just send them back to their dimension.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Gremlins
strengths: You can summon an infinite amount of gremlins
When you're done with them you can just send them back to their dimension
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: .50 Caliber Tail
description: You have a mechanical scorpion-like tail, from which you can shoot bullets. You can control your tail simply with your mind. There's also a mechanical eye on the tail, which gives you very good aiming skills.
summary: The ability to have a scorpion tail from which you can shoot bullets.
strengths: You can always protect yourself.
weaknesses: Difficult to sit down.

name: Radio & T.V. Signal Control
description: With this ability you're like a human satellite, walking on the Earth instead of orbiting. You can control radio and television signals using your mind, controlling all radio and T.V. stations. On the radio, people will hear your thoughts and on T.V. they will watch your thoughts. Through enough understanding and experience of your power, you will soon have control over communication devices (e.g. the internet and phones).
summary: The ability to have control over radio and television signals.
strengths: Control what is broadcast on television and radio.
Are able to alter, erase, create, and control all signals via satellite.
Enough practice with this power, can learn to control communication devices.
weaknesses: Don't want to be controlling radio signals and 'think' something embarrassing.
Don't want to imagine an image while controlling television signals.

name: Myth Power: Philote's Affection
description: Philote (Philotes), in Greek myth, was the goddess of friendship, affection and sex (especially in an insidious, dangerous or deceptive sense). As such, channeling her allows one to befriend any neutral, by touch, word or thought. In addition, those one befriends will defend him as best they can, and are fiercely loyal. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and summon friends (true and befriended) at will. This also applies to anyone one sleeps with.
summary: The ability to channel Philote's command over the essence of friendship, affection and sex
strengths: Befriend any neutral (non-friend, non-enemy) by touch, word or thought, at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and summon friends at will
Power also applies to any past lovers (anybody one has dated, married, slept with/had sex with, etc)
weaknesses: Only psychically perceive/manipulate others' friendships/relationships at the higher levels (NCN)
Love/romance/sex-based MythPowers (or being the user's enemy) provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift provides immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Neikos' Nerve
description: Neikos (Neicos, Neicus) and the Neikea, in Greek myth, were the gods of quarreling, disagreement and feuding. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive and induce argument within any two or more subjects at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive what to say in order to prevent or stop any argument. One can even psychically cause nearly any subject to disagree with anything that one says, and feel compelled to feel or do the opposite (within physical and/or mental capability).
summary: The ability to channel Neikos and the Neikea's command over the essence of arguments, disagreement and feuds
strengths: Induce arguments (and perceive them, even sometimes before they occur)
Know how to prevent, stop or win any argument (even if you're wrong)
Cause people to disagree with you so strongly, they feel compelled to do or feel the opposite
weaknesses: Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide benefits to this ability (NCN)
Mind/thought/knowledge/intellect/memory-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Harmonia's Heart provides immunity (NCN)

name: Thief Target
description: This power can only be active if you stole it. If the person from whom you stole it tries to attack you, the attack will home in on you. This power also shuts down every form of defensive powers you have during the period the attack takes place. It only concerns attacks sent to you by the person from whom you stole it, not the one from whom that person stole it, if that's the case. It works as long as you don't lose this power. If you obtained it in any ways other than theft, nothing happens.
summary: The ability to attract and be open to every attack sent to you by the person from whom you stole this superpower.
strengths: If you obtained this power in any other way, this power's effect is inactive.
This is a power you'd want someone to steal from you! If it does, its effect stops for you.
You can still block attacks with muggle means and may still have control over your evasive powers.
weaknesses: It even hijacks and shuts down your powers that are supposed to cancel its effect.
You need to actually lose this power to stop its effect.
This power can still be mimicked, deleted, cancelled by someone else, etc.

name: Quicksilver
description: Turn anything into quicksilver. You don't need to see it, and includes people. You can even turn yourself into quicksilver, which kills you.
summary: The ability to turn anything into quicksilver.
strengths: You only need to think about something to make it quicksilver
You don't need to see it.
Even people.
weaknesses: You don't live if you make yourself quicksilver.
Your friends either.
Or pets.

name: Summoning: Laplace
description: The demon Laplace is an incredibly odd demon, with an amazing power. It knows everything that has ever happened, and everything that ever will happen. Some say it even knows the exact placement of every molecule and every atom in the universe. Using this, you can know your own future, and the future of others.
summary: The ability to summon Laplace.
strengths: Can know anyone's future.
weaknesses: Some people might go insane knowing such things.

name: Panontic Arch: Ghestia
description: Ghestia, dimension of cosmic heroes. This dimension gives you two versions of one power. Both only work if you're facing a villain. The first version gives you a 99% chance to defeat a single villain if you're the definition of a hero. The weaker version gives you a 75% chance if you can't be defined as a hero. Both versions give you some sort of victory over a single villain. Any chaos or probability powers can reduce the chances. Probability powers could increase the 75% to 99%, the maximum.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Ghestia dimension.
strengths: Heroically defeat a single villainous foe. A 99% chance.
You're a villain facing a fellow villain, you still get a 75% chance.
You will get some sort of victory over a villain.
weaknesses: The unpredictability power, any chaos power, any probability power.
There is a 1% chance of failure (if you are a hero), a 25% chance( if you are not a hero).
This power only works against villains.

name: Negate Gain
description: Unlike Negated Superman this power gives you something random, instead of strength. It could be another power or a weapon, even money or being teleported out of range. You can train to choose what you get but in the beginning, it is completely random.
summary: The ability to gain something good each time while your powers are negated.
strengths: Get something good.
weaknesses: Have to train to choose.
Might not be useful at the time.

name: Condition Change: Tactile
description: This power allows the user to change the condition(s) of activation so that the power also requires the user to touch what they are affecting with the power. This power is also tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require touching the target in order to activate
strengths: Now your opponent has to touch what they want to affect.
weaknesses: Cannot choose whether or not to use this power.
Automatically used when touching someone with a superpower.

name: Arrow To The Knee
description: Works on any person who you have seen; they receive a arrow, 2 feet long one inch wide, going through one of their knees. It enters through the kneecap and leaves through the back of the knee. It appears there without ever actually being fired and it is made of a solid piece of pure iron. Can be activated at will towards any applicable target and can be done as many times as desired.
summary: The ability to cause a arrow to appear in someones knee
strengths: Disable enemies so they can no longer be adventurers
Free arrows made of iron
May be used many times in succession
weaknesses: Must have seen the target in some form, before TV in person etc.
They may not have any "knees"
Don't control which leg gets the arrow

name: Myth Power: Opora's Opulence
description: Opora, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the time of the year when fruit are at their peak ripeness, and ready to be harvested. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically take subjects' abilities from their bodies, encasing them into a fruit-shaped construct to 'ripen'. In addition, one can psychically summon ripe fruit, as well as teleport to ripe-fruit-bearing locations at will. Furthermore, one can even psychically perceive time, counting down to nearly any event one desires, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Opora's command over the essence of the time for harvesting ripe fruit
strengths: Psychically take subjects' abilities, encasing them in a psionic fruit construct to 'ripen'
Psychically summon ripe fruit and teleport self/others to any location with ripe fruit at will
Psychically perceive time counting down to nearly any event (Countdown Chronopathy)
weaknesses: Pro #1 does not work on ordinary skills, until developed (NCN)
Pro #1 does not work on souls, unless combined with MythPower: Psyche's Smile (NCN)
Cannot time travel to fruit-harvest locations in the past or future, until developed (NCN)

name: Smell Animation
description: This power allows you to make anything you smell appear instantly. If you smell gasoline, you will have an infinite supply of gas for free! If you smell pie, you'll be able to hit your enemies with pie (same goes for bullets). The smell you smell will automatically be in your memory and you'll be able to summon it on command.
summary: The ability to make anything you smell appear.
strengths: Get infinite gas
Get infinite pie
weaknesses: Don't smell poop, for god's sake!

name: Snake Bite
description: This is the ability to create toxins in ones mouth that are spread into anything you bite. It comes with an auto-inmunity to ones own poison and the gravity of the poison may change depending on what the biter wants. One would also have retractable fangs to inject the poison better, which are also unbreakable. The only bad thing is that by itself it may be difficult to apply since most opponents won't let one bite them too easily.
summary: The ability to create toxins in ones mouth that are spread into anything you bite.
strengths: Auto-inmunity to poison
Retracktable and unbreakable fangs
Able to change the gravity of poison to ones will
weaknesses: Difficult to bite opponent
Needs to be combined with another power like increased agility.

name: Enhancement: Spider Silk
description: This is a support and useless on its own. When it is attached to a defensive power it makes the power act as if it is made of spider silk. Since spider silk is stronger than steel this means that the power will protect against anything as strong as or weaker than steel. If this power is stolen, it will permanently enhance the power it is attached to. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a defensive power act as if it is made of spider silk
strengths: This is a powerful defensive enhancemnt.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only attachable to defensive powers, no altering or con negating that.

name: Thrombocyte Mimicry
description: This power can only be activated after touching a collagen-based substance (your body doesn't count), a strongly negatively-charged surface (like glass) or someone else with this power activated. Your skin will become sticky and a little more elastic. You'll also grow a pair of arms and a pair of legs. You can also easily clot other people's wounds in this form, while yours clot in any form. You can deactivate this power at any time, but you'll then need to activate it the way described above.
summary: The ability to become sticky and grow arms and legs after being in contact with glass or collagen.
strengths: You can climb up walls and stick to ceilings.
You can heal faster and close other people's wounds through touch.
Check the description of Hepatocyte Mimicry to read about another ability you can have.
weaknesses: You'll gather dust very easily.
You need to find something with collagen or strongly charge a surface to activate this power.
When activated, you'll be in full spider-like monster form, no intermediate form.

name: Summon Pyk Cloud
description: Pyks are 1000 times smaller than nanites. A fog-like cloud of them numbers in the quadrillions. A pyk cloud will be dispersed by a strong wind or explosion, but individual pyks have a gathering instinct with a range of 5 miles. A cloud has a collective IQ and knowledge of sub-atomic manipulation. Anything nanite-sized or larger can be easily dismantled. Under super-powered magnification, a pyk looks like a demonic handy man. Pyks can't be merged with or absorbed by other kystians.
summary: The ability to summon a vast horde of picoscopic kystians.
strengths: Sub-atomic level manipulators of matter.
Makes nanotechnology crude-looking.
Picotechnology (or this power) has great uses still unthought of.
weaknesses: This power doesn't give you knowledge of sub-atomic manipulation.
You don't have knowledge of the sub-atomic physics.
Air powers, strong winds or explosions.

name: Weapon Strike: Vortex Bomb
description: This power is good for two reasons: Bombs come out of the sky and after the bombs explode, vortices pop out.
summary: The ability to drop bombs that relese vortices
strengths: Doubble effects
Vortex's and People Equal Dizziness
weaknesses: Collateral Damage

name: Kiss Of Death
description: This ability is perhaps a power that can make even the wimpiest, scrawny weakling superhuman a powerful femme fatale (or the male equivalent); by kissing your opponent, you channel death-force energy through yourself into the foe, killing them; even blowing a kiss in their direction can kill foes (if they don't move or otherwise try to blow the kiss); sometimes, this ability is accompanied by seductive powers like Hypnotic Beauty, so others won't try to avoid the kiss
summary: The ability to induce death by a kiss
strengths: If you have Hypnotic Charm or Hypnotic Beauty along with this power, no one will mind kissing you
If people don't know about your ability, then they won't try to avoid your kisses.
Get back at your ex
weaknesses: If you have poor control over the power, kissing loved ones can kill them
If your power is too strong, it can also work by people kissing you
You can't undo the killing if you feel remorse

name: Death Revelation
description: Usually, the violence of the death or just the shock of realizing what happened can cause the ghost or spirit to forget how they died, or even that they are dead. This can be troublesome to them as they can continue their everyday life and end up haunting places. This power allows you to see them and make them relive what happened to them. Beware that the second shock could very well cause them to evolve into something much worse, like a poltergeist or an avenging spirit.
summary: The ability to reveal to spirits and ghosts how they died.
strengths: You can help spirits remember how they died.
You can help ghosts realize they are dead.
You could help ghosts resolve their death and move on to the afterlife.
weaknesses: The shock of the revelation could give a wide array of powers to the ghost or spirit.

name: Ars Goetia: Fury Of Marchosias
description: The goetic demonic marquis Marchosias is a strong and excellent fighter. Being a demon of knowledge, he gives true answers to all questions. He is depicted as a wolf with griffin wings and a serpent's tail. Marchosias has thirty legions of demons under his command.
summary: The ability to acquire the abilities of the demonic marquis.
strengths: Excellent combat prowess as well as knowledge.
Fearsome appearance that instills fear into targets.
Virtually invincible.
weaknesses: Not fully invulnerable.

name: Charmed Summoning
description: With this power one is able to summon one, or all, of the Charmed Ones. Summoning only one sister takes little to no concentration but summoning all four sisters takes a great focus. The summoning only lasts for 48 hours so if your problem isn't taken care of by then, you will have to wait 24 hours before attempting another summoning.
summary: The ability to summon the Charmed Ones to help you fight foes.
strengths: Able to summon one or all four of the Charmed sisters for 48 hours.
They will do everything in their power to help you with your problems.
May even summon some major allies and villains, if the power is honed enough
weaknesses: The summoning only lasts for 48 hours & must wait 24 hours to summon them again after they are gone
Summoning all four sisters at once takes a lot of focus and energy.
They are unaware of their real-life celebrity status (crazed fan attacks!!!)

name: Event Planner
description: Fires, bombings, killings, you could recreate them. Along with other events that were believed to have happen.
summary: The ability to recreate events that were believed to have happen in history.
strengths: You are a great war enemy.
weaknesses: You kill innocent people.
Some events might get out of hand (World War 2).

name: Myth Power: Leucothea's Lore
description: Leucothea (Leukothea, Leucothoe, Leukothoe), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sailors. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, if one falls or is thrown, one is teleported on impact to the nearest safe body of water. One can also psychically access knowledge of sailing, at will. One can even psychically transform one's house into a divine flying indestructible ship of equal mass, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Leucothea's command over the essence of sailors
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater
Teleport to any safe body of water at will (and as a subconscious safety measure against falling)
Psychically access sailing knowledge, turn one's house into an indestructible flying ship, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically summon or teleport (self/others) to one's house-ship, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon anti-gravity floaties or super-gravity anchors until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Flabellum Euri/Australe
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a pair of fans appear. These fans have the special ability to heal a person's injuries as long as it has occured within 3 minutes. Has a spell that can completely heal a person. The full name of the arifact is Flabellum Euri and Flabellum Australe.
summary: The ability to summon a pair of fans that can be used to heal.
strengths: Can heal small wounds instantly.
weaknesses: Cannot heal injuries that have occured over 3 minutes ago.
The spell that can heal a person completely can only be used once a day.

name: Santa's Helper
description: Make a present of the size you want appear with a random thing inside. If you think about something really hard, it has a higher chance of being in the present.
summary: The ability to make a present of any size appear with a random thing in it.
strengths: Make a tower of presents and knock it down on someone.
Never have to buy presents.
weaknesses: It isn't always what you want.
If there is a nuke in it, you would explode.

name: Laugh At This!
description: With this ability, you can make anyone laughing at you have extreme nausea and vomit. Making them vomit will have them get laughed at for a change. It's payback time! This power can only be used on people who make fun of you. Typed words do not count.
summary: The ability to give people who are laughing at you have intense nausea and vomit.
strengths: Make anyone who is making fun of you have intense nausea and vomit.
They will be laughed at and you'll get the last laugh.
It's payback time!
weaknesses: Only works on those who are laughing at you.
Some people think the first con is a bad thing.
Typed words do not count.

name: Credit Taker
description: A person with this power has the ability to take the credit for any other individual's actions. They can selectively choose which actions to take credit for and people will automatically believe that you are the one who did it(even if it is impossible to prove). However, people who are directly related to the person who actually did the action are unaffected.
summary: The ability to take credit for other individuals' actions
strengths: Now, when you are at work, you can be the one who is always on top without even working
If Superman saved the world, you could get the credit for doing it (if you wanted)
You can take the credit for new inventions/ideas and get a Nobel Prize or some other award
weaknesses: You are not as great as people make out to be
Pro/Con-You can take the blame for other people's actions in order to save them
Some people still know that you didn't do it

name: Wolves To Werewolves
description: With this power you can turn ordinary wolves into much more powerful werewolves. But you don't have them under your control, unless the wolf was under your control when you used the power on it.
summary: The ability to turn regular wolves into monstrous werewolves
strengths: You can turn wolves into man eating super strong werewolves
You essentially create life (the human form of a werewolf)
weaknesses: They're not necessarily under your control
The human form of the werewolf has no ID or official evidence of existence

name: Planetation
description: The power to rearrange the planets so that maybe Jupiter is the closest ot the Sun.
summary: The ability to control the planets to rearrange them.
strengths: The atmosphere changes and it could make planets livable.
May create new life on planets.
You teleport to the planet you are moving.
weaknesses: Could destroy solar life.
Make the black hole expand.
When you teleport, that planet might not become livable ever.

name: Summon The 4 Horsemen
description: Pestilence, War, Famine, & Death. You can summon them to do your bidding. Bring chaos & apocalypse onto your enemies. Give them disease, make them turn on each other in bloody rage, starve them, or merely vaporize them dead. The Horsemen are under your control for a day, but once 24 hours are up & you haven't dismissed them, they are no longer subject to you & will continue the end of the world.
summary: The ability to bring about the bringers of the apocalypse
strengths: Control apocalypse for a day
Destroy your enemies in an armageddon way
weaknesses: Can only control them for 24 hours
If you haven't expelled them before time runs out, they will continue blood shed

name: Third Eye: Fear
description: This power is gained by never using the Third Eye power. The Third Eye power slowly turns into this power and the eye turns red. When your third eye is closed, people are scared of it opening, because when it does you turn into a demon. The demonic form is different for each person and using it slowly makes your body stronger from the demonic influence on your body. It also slowly makes you want to kill those whom you have hated at any given point in time regardless of relationship.
summary: The ability to cause fear in those around you because when your third eye opens you transform into a demon
strengths: An evolved form of Third Eye power.
Can turn into a demon and physically strong while human.
Can still use Third Eye powers.
weaknesses: Must have had Third Eye power and never opened the third eye up or used it.
Will want to kill those you have hated at any point in time.
Can't get the other formerly possible Third Eye evolutions.

name: Zodiac: Leo
description: By drawing the sign of Leo the Lion in the air 10 centimetres in front of your enemy you put them into a full berserker mode. Berserkers were ancient viking warriors who would go crazy, beat up enemies while ignoring all their wounds (because they can't feel the pain), and sometimes biting their own weapons.
summary: The ability to put an enemy into a berserker state by using the sign of Leo the Lion
strengths: Watch your enemy beat up their own allies.
State lasts for ten minutes.
weaknesses: They might still go after you.
You have to draw the sign of Leo.

name: Summoning: Shadow Of A Doubt
description: The Shadow of a Doubt is a curious demon. He possesses no strength and is an awful fighter, but he has the power of Doubt. He can cause people to doubt their abilities and lose faith in both themselves, and others. Doubt is the reason couples break up, athletes retire early, and is responsible for comrades turning on each other.
summary: The ability to summon Shadow of a Doubt.
strengths: Great against multiple people.
Psychological warfare.
weaknesses: Sucks in actual combat.

name: Myth Power: Androctasia Attacks
description: Androctasia (Androktasia) and the Androctasiae (Androctasiai, Androktasiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of manslaughter; slaughter in battle. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive when fights of any kind are about to break out, and if any fatalities are involved. In addition, one can psychically summon and communicate with spirits of those who died in battle. One can even psychically channel the knowledge, skills and abilities of relatives who died in battle.
summary: The ability to channel Androctasia and the Androctasiae's command over the essence of manslaughter in battle
strengths: Psychically perceive impending fights, as well as number and identity of fatalities
Psychically summon the ghosts/spirits of fallen warriors
Psychically channel knowledge/memories/skills/abilities from spirits of relatives who died in combat
weaknesses: Can only perceive past/present/future fatalities that result from a FIGHT(NCN)
Cannot COMPEL summoned spirits (best not to summon Attila the Hun or Genghis Kahn)
Only gain knowledge/memories/skills/abilities from spirits of people from one's bloodline (NCN)

name: Guilty Love
description: The object attaches and moves through the victim's body, and creates a thin membrane that slowly engulfs the victim. The membrane will then gradually shrink until the victim is crushed. Once the victim makes contact with the object, they instantly remember how and why they sacrificed it or feel guilt about it. The only weakness of the ability is that water dissolves the membrane.
summary: The ability to manifest objects the enemy has left behind, given up, or feels guilt toward.
strengths: Impervious to Physical Attack as long as they feel guilt
Can be reborn if their killer feels guilty about their death
weaknesses: Water dissolves the membrane of the object

name: 5 Faces Of Darkness
description: With this power you can turn into a Quintesson Judge or Alpha Quintesson. As a Quintesson Judge you have five different personalities and you have above average intelligence and are good at making plans. You also can control any Sharkticons or Allicons if you come across them. As Alpha Quintesson you also have five distinct personalities and are smart with the added addition of being able to create new planets however you can't control drones.
summary: The ability to turn into a Quintesson
strengths: You can turn into a Quintesson Judge or Alpha Quintesson
You will have above average intelligence no matter which form you're in (aside from maybe your norm)
You can create planets (but not people) or control Sharkticons and Allicons (but not summon them)
weaknesses: You might start arguing with yourself

name: Beverage Vision
description: With this power you can shoot drinks (soda, juices, milk) out of your eyes and into cups or people's faces. You can shoot two different drinks (one out of each eye) out and blind enemies by shooting in their eyes or have a nice refreshing drink. You can change the temperature of the drink with your mind as well so can you shoot hot coffee and burn people or ice cold water and wake people up.
summary: The ability to shoot drinks out of your eyes
strengths: You can shoot beverages out of your eyes
You can change the temperature of the drinks
weaknesses: Shooting hot drinks out of your eyes hurts

name: Zombie Heroes V2
description: With this power you can summon zombie versions of any superhero that are under your complete control. You can summon as many zombies as you want and you can unsummon it whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon zombie versions of superheroes that are under your complete control
strengths: You can summon as many zombie heroes as you want that are under your complete control
weaknesses: They might accidentally harm innocent people

name: Rose Manipulation
description: A sub ability of botanokinesis, the user can manipulate roses making them into weapons, armour or walls. Rose manipulation can include the entire rose bush.
summary: The ability to manipulatie roses
strengths: Roses are naturally sharp so they make good weapons
Rose walls are good since the rose wall will be sharp
Roses can be made out of thin air so good for romance
weaknesses: Can only be used if someone has botanokinesis
Pyrokinesis will burn the roses
Roses may be dog roses so that won't be good in romantic situation

name: Summon Sludge Tree
description: A sludge tree is a kystian-a norr relative. It looks like a hunchback/tree fusion with bone as bark. Nothing will hurt them. They can lift 1000 pounds. They will hate any non-kystian and will freely interpret any given command. Sludge trees have a flesh-like tube coming from their back and going to one of their arms. This arm has a toothless mouth in the palm. This mouth can vomit up to 30 feet a slime that will liquify anything made of carbon. Their only weakness is the fact they can't run.
summary: The ability to summon a liquid-spraying half-alive thing.
strengths: With the right powers, you could make a sludge tree as fast as the Flash.
Carbon liquifying vomit.
weaknesses: The hateful servant waiting for you to say the wrong thing problem.
Most people can just run away from them.

name: Attention Grabber
description: Did you ever want to be the center of attention? With Attention Grabber, you will get all the attention you could ever possibly want. Simply put, this power makes it impossible for people to ignore your presence and actions if you are within sight distance and/or earshot of them.
summary: The ability to never be ignored
strengths: Everyone will listen to your ideas.
People will always notice your sense of style.
You would make a good politician (if you have the required speaking skills and charisma).
weaknesses: People constantly staring at you can get irratating.
Odds are people will avoid even being near you now.
Stealth is completely impossible for you.

name: Super Squad: Limbo Limbs
description: You can bend your bones like they are made of rubber! Owned by fictional superhero "Partay Game".
summary: The ability to bend your body into unbelievable things!
strengths: Great at limbo.
Easy to dodge attacks.
Lasts 1 hour!
weaknesses: Only lasts one hour.
3 uses per day.
If you come out of the superpower when twisted weirdly, you break all your bones and die.

name: Weapon Strike: Fire Bow
description: With this power, you can summon thousands of flaming arrows. The arrows turn to pure flames on impact.
summary: The ability to control thousands of flaming arrows.
strengths: Fire arrows
weaknesses: Water

name: Delete This Revolver Corkscrew
description: You can lunge forward during the technique, spinning in a cork-screw manner with your feet leading towards the opponent, but once the technique hits once and causes knockdown on hit.
summary: The ability to spin in the air sideways which knocks your opponent away.
strengths: Could even do it in a tornado sideways airbourne style.
weaknesses: Your body can get twisted.

name: Art Style: Dark Theater Masks
description: When the masks are summoned a ghostly body will come from the mask and depending on the facial expression thats how that certain mask will act. The masks are anger, sorrow, happy, lazy, brave, and scared. There are probably more but those are yet to be discovered.
summary: The ability to control masks as puppets
strengths: Very powerful
Can double team an opponent
Attacks can be timed and combined
weaknesses: The most that was ever summoned was 5
You have to have a good relationship with all masks or they could turn on you

name: Enhancement: Holy
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power more effective at harming evil beings and healing pure-hearted beings. This power cannot be attached to powers that are evil in origin. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power more pure than normal
strengths: Pure-hearted allies.
100% evil enemies.
Objects are affected also if the attached-to power could affect them originally.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Evil allies.
Pure-hearted enemies.

name: Transformers: Fortress Maximus
description: With this power you cause large powerful guns to appear on your legs. The legs shoot high powered lasers that can destroy almost any material. The guns can also fold down to form protective armor over your lower legs. A side effect of this power causes you to become taller when you use this power.
summary: The ability to have large guns on your legs
strengths: You have large powerful guns on your legs
You can summon and unsummon the guns whenever you want
The guns can form protective armor for your lower legs
weaknesses: The guns are hard to control due to their size and placement

name: Myth Power: Narcissus' Curse
description: Narcissus, in Greek myth, was a mortal youth so vain that the goddess Nemesis cursed him to fall in love with his reflection in a pond. As such, channeling this ability, one can inflict similar vanity on foes, consuming them with the thought of themselves. If they get their hands on a mirror, you'll not soon be able to relieve them of it. This even overrules their desire to eat, to drink, to sleep, until they waste away to nothing and die of either starvation, dehydration, or your merciful hand.
summary: The ability to inflict the vanity of Narcissus on foes
strengths: Make foes consumed in the thought of their own looks (even if they aren't good looking)
They refuse to eat, drink, sleep or fight unless they have a mirror or reflective surface with them
They eventually die or something like that.
weaknesses: If they manage somehow to fight and maintain a rapport with a mirror
If the curse is broken (by some act of divinity)
They can get so bothersome ("Who's a beautiful person? You are! Oh, yes you are! ")

name: Artifact: Oculus Corvinus
description: When you say "Adeat", six small spy satellites appear. They can be sent anywhere in the world and can be used to gather information.
summary: The ability to summon six small spy satellites.
strengths: Are small and hard to notice.
Can give info on things such as name, age, height, etc.
weaknesses: Can still be noticed.
Has no combat purposes.

name: Penny Touch
description: With this power, with your touch, you can change anything into pennies as long as it was bought or sold or has a definite value.   For example, you can't turn a human into pennies, but if a person declares of his own volition his/her price, they can be turned into pennies.   This ability is not always activated.   If all the pennies of a particular object is gathered into one location and touched again, then the pennies will reform into the object.
summary: The ability to selectively turn things with your touch into its respective value in pennies
strengths: Exact Change
Turn enemy robots into pennies
You can split something into pennies then reform them later
weaknesses: Too many pennies can overwhelm you.
Will attract many people who want to pick up pennies.

name: Forced Counting
description: You could throw a handful or a whole box of jelly beans on the ground and tell someone to count them. Their mind will then be set to figure out how many there are, so they will undoubtedly start counting them. It works with any set of objects as long as they are in the surrounding area of your target and can be seen and counted. If they don't have the decency of mind to remove or mark what they already counted, they may end up taking more time than necessary or even loop forever.
summary: The ability to force someone to count the number of objects in a given set.
strengths: Great diversion. They will only think about counting what you asked them to count.
Put very similar objects in a circle and watch them loop while they count.
weaknesses: If they are prevented to see what they have to count, their mind will be released from counting.
Instant Counting

name: Red Monster
description: With this power you can transform youself into a huge red man/ape. You'll become any size between your current size up to fourty feet tall. Your strength and other abilities are amplified to match your new size, your weaknesses are nearly eliminated, meaning if a gun kills a human it will take a rocket grenade to hurt the man ape. You'll turn red and your skin will thicken. Claws on your hands become razor sharp. Your feet will grasp like hands do.
summary: The ability to transform into a huge red man/ape beast
strengths: Get bigger and all you abilities get amplified, Plus become like an ape. Red color is cool
You CAN control the transformations, remain in either form as long as you wish.
You keep your mind as it always is, no matter what you look like. And you can still talk.
weaknesses: Cities are too cramped when you're big. Things get destroyed easily arround you.
People may fear or hate you unnessesarily. It may take awhile to get used to sensory overload.
You CAN still be killed. It just takes bigger weapons.

name: Myth Power: Horme's Handiwork
description: Horme (Hormes), in Greek myth, was the goddess of energetic activity, hard work, eagerness and impulse. As such, channeling her allows one to have infinite stamina (may be shared by touch); one is immune to unnatural sleep and the like, but not from natural sleep, if one desires. In addition, one can gain physical power from the excitement and intense emotions of others. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, and compel naturally eager, impulsive, spontaneous and excitable people.
summary: The ability to channel Horme's command over the essence of energetic activity, hard work, eagerness and impulse
