strengths: You always turn maps the right way up.
You can orient yourself if you're lost.
You know exactly what direction to go to find polar bears.
weaknesses: Strong magnets give you a headache.
You have to turn your bed to face north.
Fear of the equator.

name: Condition Change: Sight
description: When the holder of this power touches another superpowered being, they cause one power to only work on what that being can see with their physical eyes.
summary: The ability to make power only work on what one can see
strengths: This power affecting a shapeshifter.
The being must use their physical eyes, not astral eyes, not psychic eyes, PHYSICAL eyes only.
weaknesses: Must touch the other being.
Only affects one power at a time.

name: Siren's Song (Siren Song)
description: One with this ability has the superhuman ability to produce a subliminally seductive song. It will work as long as the subject is within earshot, and surpasses any mental barriers that otherwise would pose a problem for the user. However, one caveat prevents this from being as effective as a typical hypnotic song (or even MythPower: Siren's Song); it only works on males. Males of any species, regardless of language, but only males. Females often will not even hear it, let alone respond to it.
summary: The ability to produce a male-oriented song of sexuality and psychic domination
strengths: Produce a beautiful hypnotic song (perfect for seduction, or to convey a psychic compulsion)
Bypasses nearly any barrier, including language, age (if you desire) and species
Any man will be putty in your hands (regardless of sexual orientation)
weaknesses: It's the original siren's song (only works on males)
Females will not be affected AT ALL (if particularly girly, they can hear it and it annoys them)
Great singing voice, but anytime you sing, it'll be hypnotic in capacity (until REALLY developed)

name: Celtic Invocation: Habetrot
description: By calling on the power of Habetrot, the invoker may weave thread from anything. Fire, light, wool, flax, gold, shadow, etc. Those items woven out of 'unnatural' thread have obvious properties, for example, shadow clothing allows the wearer to blend into darkness. However, normal thread can be given unique properties also, especially regarding health and healing. Those who wear the clothing spun and woven by someone who uses this ability never get sick, and heal at ten times the normal rate.
summary: The ability to call on the power of Habetrot, a Celtic goddess of spinning.
strengths: The clothing you wear can be a weapon.
No need to spend so much money on brands now.
Make great gifts for friends and family!
weaknesses: The powers only work through thread spun and woven by the invoker.
Not much offensive use-only the objects made have use.
One must always be aware of fashion and it's constant changes.

name: Myth Power: Poena's Payback
description: Poena (Poene, Poine) and the Poenae (Poinai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of revenge, vengeance, retaliation and punishment/penalty for wrongs.  As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive subjects who have wronged him (and what they did). In addition, with a touch, one can afflict subjects with misfortune until they ask for and receive forgiveness. Furthermore, any injury foes directly inflict will be automatically inflicted back on them (when developed, damage increases).
summary: The ability to channel Poena and the Poenae's command over the essence of revenge, retaliation and punishment
strengths: Perceive those who have offended you (and how they offended you)
Afflict foes with misfortune by touch, until they ask for (and receive) forgiveness
If the foe attempts to directly inflict harm on one, the injury will show up on the foe instead
weaknesses: May become consumed with anger and vengeful thoughts
Only psychically perceive, communicate with and compel grudge-holders at the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: 1 Year Of True Life
description: At any point in your life you may activate this power. If you do then exactly one year later, to the second, you will die. But in that time-frame you will live more than most people do in their entire lives. Everything you try will succeed, everything you do will be exemplary, and every word you speak will be remembered. During that year no other will be your equal, and when you die it will be gloriously.
summary: The ability to live fully for one year.
strengths: Live one perfect year.
Enact change that will outlive you.
Make your life one to be remembered.
weaknesses: You will die.
How much can you really do in just one year?
Enough to give up the rest of your life for?

name: Condition Change: Objects
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of another power so that it only works when used on or to make inanimate objects. No using the power on anything that used to be alive. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only on inanimate objects
strengths: Enemies can't use powers directly on you anymore.
weaknesses: You need to touch the being.

name: Myth Power: Selene's Salute
description: Selene (Mene), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the moon and moonlight. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate and manipulate moonlight, at will. In addition, one can absorb natural moonlight to gain physical power (and sustenance), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically propel oneself in flight, at will. One can also psychically propel oneself into outer space, at will (and survive its conditions). One can even psychically turn into an entity of moonlight, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Selene's command over the essence of the moon and moonlight
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate moonlight; gain physical power, sustenance from moonlight
Fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions
Transform into an entity of pure moonlight, at will; psychically induce madness, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Cannot cast illusions of moon's course (rising/setting, phases, eclipse, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot banish foes to the moon, by touch, or open portals to the moon, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically project vision anywhere moon shines, by touch, until developed (NCN)

name: Exploding Candy
description: Think that candy is harmless? Well, think again.  A person that controls this power can materialize candies that can explode in 3 different ways: 1. Physical contact; 2. Saliva contact; 3. Delayed fuse.   The explosion creates a blast radius of destruction(non-lethal to biological creatures). The biological creatures hit with the candy are forced to taste a "flavor explosion." It can be bitter, sweet, sour, or any combination of flavors that are already invented, and that you have tasted.
summary: The ability to create sweets that explode
strengths: Join the Dark Side, we have candy(Seriously, free candies if you like excessive sweetness/sour)
Make your enemies taste the "bitterness" of defeat while you munch on the "sweetness" of victory
You can make any flavor that you have already tasted
weaknesses: Property destruction
If your enemy really likes the flavor you just threw
You must have tasted a flavor to use it-I know what you're probably thinking

name: Lefty Power
description: With this power, you have super strength but only in your left arm and hand. Your right hand remains however strong it was before you got this power.
summary: The ability to be super strong but only with your left arm and hand
strengths: You are super strong.
weaknesses: Your right hand is not super strong.

name: Marked Kiss Of Death
description: I know it was you.  You broke my heart.  I cannot bring myself to kill you myself, but with this kiss, I mark you for death.  Upon seeing you, all others from this point on will feel compelled to hate you, to harm you, to ripe you to pieces, to want to destroy you.  Even if they cannot reach you themselves,they will call on others to get you and cheer them on.  Even those loved ones with the will to resist cannot help but feel satisfaction upon seeing you suffer.  You schmuck!
summary: The ability to kiss someone, marking him for death, thereby compelling others to kill him
strengths: Let others do your dirty work for you
Sit back and watch the show
weaknesses: Must kiss them on the lips
Hope you don't kiss your mother with that mouth

name: Sea Monster Control
description: With this power you can have complete control over any sea monster as long as you've seen it or a picture or depiction of it. The mind control only activates when you are within one hundred miles of the monster. When you are within range you will instantly know that there is a sea monster within range and you can take control of it.
summary: The ability to control any sea monster
strengths: You can take control of any sea monster
weaknesses: You have to be within one hundred miles of it
You have to have seen it or a picture or depiction of it before
If there are no sea monsters in your universe or on your planet this power is useless

name: Moon Blade 5th: Void Black
description: A completely black blade. By pointing at the target, you can open a portal at the tip of the sword (about a meter in area) to suck all souls in its vicinity. If a target is killed with this sword, his soul is trapped inside, and can only be released through a long ritual.
summary: The ability to create a soul eater sword.
strengths: Powerful sword that allows for killing multiple enemies.
The captured souls will have it pretty rough in there (torturing).
Can be used with any other moon blades.
weaknesses: *CAUTION* Can also take your soul if you cannot control it.
Be careful not to touch your allies with it.

name: Water To Soda
description: With this power you can turn water into any type of soda. This power works with both fresh water and salt water and you can turn any amount of water into any soda. So you can change an entire ocean into Coca Cola or just a cup of water in Pepsi or any other amount of water and soda.
summary: The ability to turn water into any type of soda
strengths: You can turn any amount of water into any type of soda
weaknesses: You cannot change the soda back into water

name: Myth Power: Aponia's Apathy
description: Aponia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of ease and leisure; freedom from toil. As such, channeling her allows one to never be asked to do anything that one would consider too tedious, stressful or difficult. In addition, if one voluntarily takes on a task (within one's physical or mental capacity), one's body will act of its own accord, completing every step perfectly, with no need for one to put forth conscious effort. One can even withstand pain or exhaustion from any effort one puts forth.
summary: The ability to channel Aponia's command over the essence of ease and leisure
strengths: Never be asked to do anything one sees as too tedious, too time-consuming or too difficult
If one takes on a task within physical/mental capability, one's body takes over and does it exactly
Never feel pain/exhaustion from any effort one puts forth (Infinite Stamina)
weaknesses: Use Pro #1 sparingly; still can feel pain from attacks and physical damage (NCN)
Cannot psychically reduce force/resistance, by touch, to ease effort of work until developed (NCN)
Work/effort/force/strength-based MythPowers allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)

name: Shinchintetsu Jizaikon
description: When you say "Adeat", a staff appears. This staff can increase in size and length.
summary: The ability to summon a staff that can grow longer and bigger.
strengths: The bigger and longer it is, the stronger it is.
Can be used to attack enemies that are far away.
weaknesses: Hard to control when too large and/or long.
Enemies can see it coming.

name: Myth Power: Glaucus' Glance
description: Glaucus (Glaukos), in Greek myth, was the god of seafarers (sailors, fishermen, divers and castaways), the shore's shallow waters and shipwreck. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, one gains numerous seafaring skills. One can even psychically generate and manipulate a magic herb that may be smelled or chewed for different effects.
summary: The ability to channel Glaucus' command over the essence of seafarers, shallow waters on the shore and shipwreck
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and teleport to any body of water at will; skill in fishing, sailing and diving
Psychically generate and manipulate magic herb; smell= psychic insight, chew= aquatic transformation
weaknesses: Part 3 of Pro #3 produces a RANDOM Aquatic Transformation until developed (NCN)
Cannot give self a mermaid tail at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Aquatic/water/sea/ocean-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Super Jaws
description: This power allows you to create and make your jaw bigger. It also allows for the creation of other jaws on any part of the body. Also allows for the increased size and strength of the jaws.
summary: The ability to make your jaw bigger, or create jaws.
strengths: Will have big jaw
Can create other jaws
Can crunch down almost anything
weaknesses: Can only create up to three jaws at once unless had more practice with the power and experinece
Jaws will become extremely heavy and massive
Jaws hurt when increasing size and strength.

name: Independent Eyes
description: If you need to keep an eye on someone while watching your surrounding, this power will help you a lot. Just keep an eye on that person and watch your surrounding with the other. You can also cross your eyes without struggling. There is a complete independency between your eyes, both horizontally and vertically.
summary: The ability to have eyes that move independently.
strengths: Magic pictures are a piece of cake for you.
Freak people out with your chameleon-like stare.
Cross your eyes with extreme ease.
weaknesses: It screws with your depth perception.
At first, your brain will keep overlapping the images perceived by your eyes.
Your eyes can't turn further to the edge of their orbit than a normal human eye.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Summoning: Susanoo
description: Susanoo, brother of Amaterasu Tsukuyomi, god of storms. He can control fierce winds and terrifying lightning.
summary: The ability to summon Susanoo.
strengths: Summon Susanoo.
Power of wind and lightning
weaknesses: Same as all Summons.

name: Felis Transformation
description: This ability can let you transform into a cat with abilities better than any other cat. Like the cat's claws are bigger and sharp as knives. Its teeth are like razors. You can jump higher and longer. And have you ever seen a cat get out of cracks underneath doors and stuff? Well, with this superpower you can get through a very small opening easily.
summary: The ability to turn into any kind of housecat and have its natural abilities amplified
strengths: Cats are cute
I just thought it was pretty cool
weaknesses: Cats are kind of easy to kill since they're small

name: Myth Power: Satyromania
description: The Satyrs, in Greek myth, were the randy gods of wilderness fertility. As such, channeling them allows one to communicate with animals as though by normal conversation, tempt subjects into unleashing their wild sides, and sing, dance and play music entrancingly (especially on panpipes). Natural features also respond to your emotions (fires growing in intensity, winds stirring up, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Satyrs and their command over the essence of wilderness fertility
strengths: Speak to animals
Your music, dancing and singing inspires loosening of inhibitions and heightened sexuality
Nature responds to your emotions
weaknesses: Entrancing singing, dancing and music-playing makes people ADORE you (not always a good thing)
People with MythPower: Nympholepsy are extremely attracted to you
Cannot actually control animals (just communicate to them, and they understand you, and vice versa)

name: Poker Chips
description: With this power you have several controls over poker chips. You can summon and levitate poker chips that you own. You can also turn poker chips into what they are worth, such as turning a 100$ poker chip into 100 dollars. This can work in reverse as well as you can turn inanimate objects into detailed poker chips with designs based on the object you transformed. If the poker chips are lost in a bet then the new owner of the chips can change the chips into their value, but not back into a chip.
summary: The ability to have poker chip based powers.
strengths: Have control over poker chips that you own.
Turn poker chips into their real world value.
Turn inanimate objects into detailed poker chips.
weaknesses: Only works on poker chips that you own.
If poker chips are lost in a bet you do not have control over them.
If you are a bad gambler.

name: Condition Change: Ordinary
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when used on those without powers. Cannot be used on a power already affected by Condition Change: Super. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when used on those without powers
strengths: Now those with powers can't affect you with the affected power.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.
Opponents with multiple powers.

name: Myth Power: Dial Diallage
description: Diallage, in Greek myth, was the goddess of reconciliation; making up and making amends after a conflict. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive when subjects are in conflict, and why. In addition, one may mix or swap two or more conflicting subjects' personalities, by touch. Furthermore, one may erase subjects' negative memories/feelings about each other, by touch. One may even reveal subjects' POSITIVE memories/feelings about each other, by touch, so they can resolve their differences.
summary: The ability to channel Diallage's command over the essence of reconciliation and conflict resolution
strengths: Psychically perceive when subjects are angry with one another (and why)
Psychically switch subjects' personalities, by touch, so they can walk a mile in each others' shoes
Psychically erase subjects' negative memories/feelings; reveal subjects' positive memories/feelings
weaknesses: Cannot travel in time to prevent/resolve conflicts until developed (NCN)
Pro #2 is temporary (ending after all conflicting parties resolve their differences) until developed
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Piemaker
description: The Piemaker ability lets you make pies that give superpowers to the eater, depending on the special ingredient. Putting gold in a pie could give you the Midas Touch, putting stones in a pie could give you Rock Skin. You are also immune to poisons, or anything that could kill you as long as it is in a pie.
summary: The ability to make superpowered pie
strengths: You can have any superpower you want.
You can give anyone else a superpowered pie.
You are immune to death or injury by anything pie-related.
weaknesses: Pests may eat the pie, and get superpowers.
The pies may poison other people. Arsenic Pie is okay for you, but not for others.
It kinda sucks if you cannot cook.

name: Summon Joyeuse
description: Joyeuse is the least famous of the four swords of power. Its abilities include moving earth and turning enemies to stone with one cut. It is indestructible and can fuse with its twin, Durendal, to create new Ley Gates which act as portals to other Ley Gate locations around the worlds.
summary: The ability to summon Joyeuse , the ancient sword of Earth.
strengths: Control earth
Turn enemies to stone
Create Ley Gates.
weaknesses: Must be fused with Joyeuse to summone Ley Gates.

name: Myth Power: Pact Of The Potamoi
description: The Potamoi, in Greek myth, were the gods and goddesses of rivers. As such, channeling them allows one to selectively perceive present and future weather conditions and natural phenomena at any river throughout the Cosmos. One may also use this power to sense the layout of any river at will (including any supposedly hidden features, such as treasure and magical landmarks). In addition, one may teleport to any river at will, and one's attributes are enhanced as long as one is in or on a river.
summary: The ability to channel the Potamoi and their command over the essence of rivers
strengths: Knowledge of any river in existence (location, layout, present/future weather conditions, etc. )
Teleport to any river at will
Stats (strength, durability, reflexes, etc. ) are enhanced for as long as you are in or on a river
weaknesses: Cannot alter an river's weather until the higher levels
Not every river is habitable
At the lower levels, stat enhancement gets weaker the further you are from a river

name: Zzz Strength
description: With this power as soon as you fall asleep you gain super strength and invulnerability. So if somebody tries to attack you in your sleep they will have a hard time doing it and if you sleep walk you will destroy everything in your path. You also have strength and invulnerability in your dreams. When you wake up, however, you lose these powers.
summary: The ability to have super strength and invulnerability but only when you sleep
strengths: You become super strong while sleeping
You are invulnerable
You're strong and invulnerable in your dreams too
weaknesses: When you wake up you don't have these powers anymore
You might destroy things in your sleep

name: Eye Of  Heck
description: Using this ability you can send someone's soul directly into the fires of heck by looking them directly in the eye. While they are in heck every second of torture will feel like a year or decade instead. Once their soul is in heck you have two choices. 1 return their soul to their body after five seconds. 2 leave their soul in heck for the rest of eternity and keep their body as your loyal slave.
summary: The ability to send someone's soul to heck by looking them directly in the eye
strengths: Paralyze your enemies
Break the minds of the weak hearted.
If you're evil, create an army of souless minions
weaknesses: Never look in a mirror and activate this power... Ever
You have to make direct eye contact
Jack Card Spirits

name: Blood Scythe 1 Form The Reaper
description: Calling out the name causes a shaft to appear in your hand. The shaft is held parallel to the body. The blade of the scythe unfolds from the top of the shaft, goes behind your head and hits your shoulder. The scythe then absorbs enough blood to function. In the 1st form, the blood is concentrated on the blade, making it bigger, thicker, and adding spikes to it. It can be used to defend or attack.
summary: The ability to summon a Blood Scythe
strengths: Great Damage.
Good defence at long range.
weaknesses: Hurts you during the summoning phase.
Bad defence in cose range.

name: Gate: Eight Gates
description: With this power you can create eight gates that are nearly indestructible. The gates are 5 metres by 2 metres and can only be destroyed by dropping ten gallons of arsenic on them. You cannot change the size of the gates. You cannot have more than eight gates out at a time and have to destroy all of them before creating more. This power is unaffected by Con Negation.
summary: The ability to create eight near-indestructible gates
strengths: "The best offense is a good defense. "
weaknesses: Can only have a maximum of eight gates at any time.
Gates can still be destroyed.

name: Sword Of Ultimate Pain!
description: With this ability, you can summon the sword of pain. The sword of pain extremely sharp sword that inflicts lasting physical pain as well as temporary emotional pain. The wounds might heal, but the physical pain lasts for a year. During that time, your foes will develop tolerance to that pain. After a year, they will be so sensitive to physical pain that a gentle breeze will feel like pain to them. They will be teased at by a troll only they could see and continually be more emotionally sensitive
summary: The ability to summon the sword of pain that inflicts lasting pain and leaves foes extremely sensitive to pain.
strengths: Make your enemies feel the worst pain possible.
When they get wounded, they will also feel emotional pain.
After one year, they will know what true pain is (not just physical)
weaknesses: Emotional pain only last for a few minutes at the beginning, and forever at the end.
Have to wait one year for them to feel the ultimate emotional pain.
Do NOT get cut with your own sword!

name: Myth Power: Chrysothemis' Care
description: Chrysothemis (Khrysothemis, Acacallis, Akakallis), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the "golden custom"; the harvest festival. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically wipe subjects' minds of current knowledge, by touch, causing them to think like farmers of old. In addition, one can psychically teleport to any farm, at will, as well as gaining physical power when on a farm. One can even psychically summon Golden Tamarisk pastries, at will, to heal allies who eat them, and poison foes.
summary: The ability to channel Chrysothemis' command over the essence of the harvest festival
strengths: Psychically wipe subjects' minds of present day knowledge, so they assume ancient farming roles
Psychically teleport self and others to any farm; gain physical power on a farm, or in a crop field
Summon irresistibly delicious Golden Tamarisk pastries to heal self/allies and poison foes
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive/manipulate crop plants (grain, wheat, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot act as a living scarecrow (psychically repel any flying object/subject) until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Hurt Locker
description: Damage done to you, including total destruction, is transferred to the nearest locker in a one-mile radius when you activate this power. As soon as this locker is destroyed, the next nearest locker is affected. This power won't transfer the effects of reality alteration that simulate damage or total destruction. You still feel pain. Any damage that actually wouldn't damage or destroy a locker like stinging insects won't be transferred.
summary: The ability to transfer any damage done to you to the nearest locker.
strengths: Survive anything that would destroy a locker.
weaknesses: Hurt by anything that wouldn't hurt a locker.
If you're a hero, you have to pay for any destroyed lockers and what was in them.
You're not close enough to any lockers or you run out of lockers to transfer damage to.

name: Copper Crown
description: The Copper Crown is a powerful, mystical and very dangerous object which is worn upon the head. It confers the ability to fire pinkish flames from it and attack anything and everything in its path. With each victim, its power increases. At a point when it becomes powerful enough, the crown can animate all its copper statue victims into a mindless, obedient zombie-like army at your control.
summary: The ability to use it turn people in shiny red-orange statue zombies.
strengths: It can erase memories.
It can read and control minds (anyone within the sound of the voice of the one wearing the crown).
weaknesses: It is weak against fire and electric types.

name: Supermaid
description: Did you forget to clean your room? Did you turn the blender on without the top and make a huge mess in the kitchen? Or did a huge ball of chocolate pudding somehow explode in your house then? Don't worry you can clean any mess in mere minutes with this amazing ability because no mess is too messy for the Supermaid!
summary: The ability to clean any mess with ease
strengths: Never have to worry about cleaning troubles
You will rarely get sick due to lack of germs around you.
weaknesses: May become a germaphobe
You will have the impulse to clean everything.

name: Soul Picture
description: If you take a person's picture 5 minutes (or less) before they die, will allow you to transfer their soul to the photograph upon death. Taking a ghost's picture, will transfer it to the picture immidiately. The old type camera is to be used, the one that instantly makes a picture for you. Note, the camera just marks the soul for entrapment, it does not actually kill the person.
summary: The ability to trap someone's soul in a photograph.
strengths: Allows you to save a person from completely leaving this world.
Allows you to trap an evil soul.
ALlows you to see person's time on death (can turn off) while looking through a camera at them.
weaknesses: Unless you can make artificial bodies for souls.
If someone sees that you take pictures, and then people die, questions might be asked.

name: Half Nekomata
description: Someone with this power will have claws, catlike ears, and 2 tails. They will also have higher physical speed, reflexes and magical power than most humans. They will also be able to steal power from spirits in times of great need and can become invisible when they want.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-nekomata
strengths: Most people cannot hit you in a fight.
Note: Nekomata can also be called Bakeneko (Ghost Cat).
weaknesses: Most Yokai and other mythical creatures will consider you to be inferior.

name: Dark World
description: This power allows for one to cover the world in darkness and chaos beasts gain strength from darkness.
summary: The ability to cover an entire world in darkness
strengths: Make an entire world dark
Can give chaos beasts strength
Gives one power over the world
weaknesses: Once covered in darkness, you can not return it to its former state

name: Snow Stop
description: With this power you can stop snowing from falling to the ground while it is in the air. You can keep the snow frozen in time for as long as you want and while it's stuck in the air no new snow can fall. Only you can unfreeze the snow and allow it to fall to the ground.
summary: The ability to stop snow midfall
strengths: You can freeze snow in the air for as long as you want
Only you can allow the snow to continue to fall
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Society Degredation
description: At will, an event will cause the whole of civilization to become less advanced in science, philosophy, and morality. This leads open the chance for the user to become a leader with their knowledge as it would be advanced compared to the rest of the world. Something will physically happen for society to degrade, such as a terrible plague or famine, a devastating war, some crazy fanatic religious destruction of knowledge, or a virus that hijacks all known electronics and destroys them.
summary: The ability to intellectually and morally downgrade society
strengths: You soon become the smartest and most advanced person on Earth
You can easily rule the world with the knowledge you already have
You could be long remembered as a great teacher to all mankind
weaknesses: People become mean, stupid, and ignorant
If you overuse it, people may become so stupid they will never learn anything from you
It would be hard to find a good friend or start a relationship with everyone being idiots and jerks.

name: Candy Ring
description: One day, you find a ring pop. Upon putting it on your hand, you find that it is a faulty green lantern ring that someone made as a joke. However, it still functions and lets you do virtually anything that a normal green lantern can do. The only problem is that it can only do stuff that involves candy. This is the oath: In sweetest day, in sourest night. Candy will be this ring's might. Let those that devour candy on sight, Come and bite.
summary: The ability to do anything as long as it involves candy when you have the ring
strengths: Gives you all the powers of a Green Lantern-except it involves candy
You are not limited by color
You can eat the candy(not very nutritious though) and the ring pop cannot disappear
weaknesses: People can eat your attacks
Your costume is sticky candy so you have to shower all the time and its weird wearing a ring pop
You must say the oath on above

name: Super Pinky Strength
description: Non-dominant hand's pinky is super strong. (If you're right-handed, your left pinky is the strong one and vice versa. )
summary: The ability to have super stength, in one pinky.
strengths: Can pick up the heaviest of objects.
Can legitimately "beat the living c**p" out of someone with your PINKY!
Can't be taken away,but can gain you other super powers:severly beat up another super powered person
weaknesses: Its your pinky. Does it need to be explained that much?
It only applies for that one pinky.
You break the pinky, you're doomed.

name: Base Immunity
description: No base will ever hurt someone with this power. Note: bases as in acids and bases, not baseball bases.
summary: The ability to be unaffected by bases of any kind and strength
strengths: Enemies who only have powers based on bases.
weaknesses: Acids can still hurt you.

name: Demonic Resonance
description: The resonance wil only work if the person has hatred in the heart. The more hatred they have the more powerful of a demon they will become. Appearances change dependant on the person becoming a demon.
summary: The ability to resonate with a person in such a way that they turn into a demon
strengths: Better against heroes than villains, usually.
Can make heroes hated and feared by the superstitious.
weaknesses: Never ever use this against a villain.
Can't use this on yourself.

name: Rise Of The Fiskerton Phantom
description: With this power you can turn into the Fiskerton Phantom. You are four feet tall with primate and cat like features. You have advanced climbing skills and have superhuman strength. You have also have sharp teeth and claws. You have advanced night vision as well. You retain your ability to speak, your personality and your intelligence while in this form.
summary: The ability to turn into the Fiskerton Phantom
strengths: You can turn into the Fiskerton Phantom
weaknesses: You might get hunted due to being a monster

name: Jodo Shinshu: Middle Path
description: Going to either side of the extremes is not always a good thing and balance is generally best. Someone with this power has realized that and will be able to make others be more balanced in what they do/are. This works for all qualities, not just mental ones. Physical and spiritual ones can be changed too. Only one quality can be changed at a time and there is a recharge time of one hour between each use.
summary: The ability to get qualities of a person to go down the middle path instead of towards extremes
strengths: You can make troublemakers more mature.
Someone with this power will most likely get rid of fully evil beings.
If you have this power you will definitely be neutral in as many things as possible (may be con).
weaknesses: Using this on a pacifist will make them more violent.
It's always a 50-50 blend of the two qualities altered.
Someone with this power will most likely get rid of fully good beings.

name: Boot To The Face
description: Have you ever been so annoyed you wanted to put a boot to someone's face? Well, with this power, you can summon a boot that'll slam into someone's face until you are satisfied.
summary: The ability to summon a Boot to the Face.
strengths: Boot to the Face anyone.
weaknesses: What bad sides? It's a Boot to the Face.

name: Induced Suction
description: This power enables you to give any opened container, that you are touching, the property to draw anything in it as if by a vacuum. Everything presented in front of the opening will be attracted. The suction stops automatically if the container is full, if its opening is obstructed or if you lose contact with the container. The suction force depends on the size of the container and the size of its opening. The bigger they are, the stronger the force is.
summary: The ability to suck anything inside a container
strengths: Its saves a lot of effort to put your stuff in a container.
You can use it to simply attract objects towards you.
Capture any creatures small enough to enter the container.
weaknesses: You can be sucked too if you're careless.
Heavy or fixed objects can resist the suction force if it's too weak.

name: Myth Power: Ananke's Answer
description: Ananke (Anance), in Greek myth, was the goddess of compulsion, necessity and inevitability. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically compel subjects, or bestow others' voices with compulsive power, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive the future, which may be shared, by touch. Furthermore, one can withstand compulsions and probability manipulation, and evade Precognition. One can even psychically negate compulsions, probability manipulation and Precognition, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Ananke's command over the essence of compulsion, necessity and inevitability
strengths: Psychically compel subjects, or bestow others' voices with compulsive power at will
Psychically perceive the future (Precognition), which may be shared, by touch
Withstand and psychically negate compulsions, probability manipulation and Precognition
weaknesses: Cannot seal a foreseen event as unavoidable (destined to happen) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Kronos' Craft allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tessen Control
description: A tessen is a Japanese war fan. It's basically an ordinary Japanese fan you see in the hand of a geisha or upper-class woman with metal rods put in at select points and on the outside covering. It can be used to stab in its closed form and slash in its open form. It was generally carried on the battlefield and in areas that the samurai were not allowed to carry obvious weapons, such as katana or naginata, in the first place. Someone with this power can control the movement(s) of nearby tessen.
summary: The ability to control a type of Japanese war fans
strengths: Can control a weapon that has dual purposes.
A reenactment of an ancient Japanese court will have plenty of tessen.
A tessen could be considered a type of 'blade' since it can slash.
weaknesses: Most people don't carry around tessen.
Calling a tessen a 'blade' is really stretching the definition of a blade.

name: Condition Change: Plains
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is on a plain. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is on a plain
strengths: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near plains.
NOTE: I do mean plain as in 'a grassy plain' and NOT the metal birds humans fly in.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Summon Leviathan V2
description: With this power you can summon the robotic crab like monster from the movie Atlantis. It can operate on land, water and air. It has large claw like arms that can crush ships and presumably people. It is under your complete control. You can send it back whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon the robotic crablike monster from the movie Atlantis
strengths: You can summon a robot crab minion
Its under your complete control
You can unsummon it
weaknesses: It can be destroyed

name: Fat/Famine
description: With this power, you touch someone who is either obese or very thin and they soon become opposite weight of what they are in 3 days. If overweight, they will start to shed pounds instantly, even if they eat a lot, until they are anorexically thin and look like a living skeleton with saggy skin flaps. For a thin person, the smallest 0 calorie foods will make them gain 50 lbs. Even if they don't eat, they still gain 5-10 lbs. and grow more morbidly obese. Healthy weight could go either way.
summary: The ability to make someone obese or skeletally thin
strengths: Make either fat or skinny person become opposite weight
weaknesses: It's really a cursing power

name: Weapon: Durendal
description: Durendal is a holy weapon wielded by Roland. With this weapon, you can attack unholy foes and cause divine punishment on evil in the form of lightning. It can be stolen and used by others and it cannot be destroyed by mortal or magical means. Holy weapons are downgraded versions of divine weapons and equal in capacity to magic class weapons
summary: The ability to wield Durendal
strengths: Holy Type Weapon
It has infinite durability cannot be broken by normal magic or physical force
weaknesses: Like many other weapons this weapon can be stolen
Can be destroyed by divine power

name: Fourth Amendment
description: Nothing you own can ever be taken from you by anyone. If someone tries to take something of yours, they will be electrically shocked into unconsciousness.
summary: The ability to be defended against having your stuff taken
strengths: No more robbers stealing your stuff
You never lose money
You never lose yourself (emotionally, mentally, physically)
weaknesses: You never lose your virginity (assuming you're a virgin)
You can never get rid of anything you have

name: No Pain Receptors
description: You feel no physical pain. At all. This is because your pain receptors don't exist, driving your pain threshold off the charts. This power doesn't apply to emotional pain.
summary: The ability to have no pain receptors
strengths: No more pain, which can be a very annoying distraction.
Show off to people randomly.
weaknesses: No pain, no gain.
Pain is a warning system, so you don't discover injuries until the tunnel vision kicks in.

name: Sarsakinesis
description: This power allows you to create and manipulate rootbeer with your mind. You may move rootbeer, like you have hydrokinesis but with only rootbeer, with your mind. You can divinate the present or future by looking into a puddle/full can of rootbeer. Rootbeer heals your injuries and illnesses when you drink it. You can make rootbeer adhesive, acidic, hardening, frothy, poisonous or freezing.
summary: The ability to manipulate rootbeer with your mind
strengths: Regenerate by drinking rootbeer
Manipulate rootbeer ultimately
Rootbeer is good
weaknesses: If you don't like rootbeer
It may take time to master all of the types of manipulation

name: Boulder Rain V2
description: With this power you can make boulders fall from the sky. However unlike the original Boulder Rain power these boulders are not round and therefore cannot roll once they hit the ground. You can make them any other shape you want so you can build fortresses, statues or just crush people or things.
summary: The ability to cause boulders to fall from the sky
strengths: You can make boulders fall from the sky
You can build fortresses out of the boulders
You can crush enemy fortresses
weaknesses: They are not round so they will not roll once they hit the ground

name: Smite Deflection
description: Have you secured a place in life such that the only things you have to fear are the inscrutable gods above? With Smite Deflection you don't even have to fear them anymore. Any action from a divine being with the intent to harm you or your way of life will just slide off and hit someone else instead. Plagues, lightning bolts, inexplicable instances of bad luck, being turned into a monster, being given the urge to have sex with a bull; all of these things and more will just hit someone else.
summary: The ability to push a divine attack off on someone else
strengths: You have nothing to fear from gods.
Gods can't just keep trying without risking hitting their followers.
If gods ever try to destroy the world, that buck will get passed to another world.
weaknesses: You are just pushing the smites off on other people.
A god might whip their followers into an angry mob after your head.

name: Checkerboard Pattern
description: This power allows you to project a red and black checkerboard pattern from your feet, up to any size you want, before locking it down. Anyone caught on the pattern when it is locked down is trapped on it, and is moved to the closest open starting position. They will then have to play a game of checkers, acting and moving only as the pieces they represent can, until only one side remains. Anyone "jumped" during the game is rendered unconscious until the end of the game.
summary: The ability to move people as though they were pieces on a checkers board.
strengths: Tie up pursuers and villains in long games.
Keep violent situations from escalating.
weaknesses: Only really works as a delay tactic.

name: Four Word Death
description: Say a word to your intended victim. After this you will be rendered mute, but after that person hears the word you said three more times they will drop dead. You will not be able to speak until after the victim's death.
summary: The ability to cause someone to die after hearing a word 4 times.
strengths: Kill someone stealthily, and in a way that can not be traced back to you.
weaknesses: You are mute for however long in takes for your victim to die.
Your intended victim must be able to hear.

name: Death Metal Muse
description: You are the Muse the other Muses kicked out of the band. Your divine music was so extremely dark and brooding that anyone who could hear it and was just far enough away to understand your lyrics dropped dead. You do need a least one decent size speaker and a electric guitar to drop people dead. Your divine power will magically power enough both.
summary: The ability to play music so brutally people will drop dead.
strengths: Death metal fans will adore you!
Death metal fans might not care about all dropping dead part!
weaknesses: You can never have a concert.
Your music kills people-thousands if you pack a stadium.

name: The Power Of Grammar
description: There are some powers out there which are well-written, immaculately presented, and generally a joy to read. There are some, however, which aren't. Use this power to re-establish grammar's reign by decreasing an ability's strength depending on how many errors it has in its description. For example, if it's barely legible you can cancel it out, but if it has only one misplaced apostrophe, you can bring it down to about 95% of its full glory. Right, now to check this description for mistakes...
summary: The ability to decrease the strength of a power in proportion to the amount of errors in its description.
strengths: Has the potential to really even up an unfair fight.
Seen the first sentence of Self-Existence Manipulation?
Encourages good spelling and punctuation. And we all need more of *them* in our lives. :P
weaknesses: Get a reputation for being 'that self-obsessed grammatical one'.
Something along the lines of SuperModerator could combat it...
Descriptivists. 'Nuff said.

name: Zodiac: Pisces
description: By drawing the sign of Pisces the Fishes in the air, you create 1 fish that bestows a random power upon those whom it touches. The fish looks slightly holographic and can swim through the air. The fish can look like any type of living or extinct fish. You get to choose the species.
summary: The ability to create fishes that bestow random powers by drawing the sign of Pisces the Fishes
strengths: Can give powers to those who want them.
You get to choose the species of fish.
weaknesses: The power is always random...
Have to draw the sign of Pisces each time you want to create 1 fish.

name: Instantly Zombies Once Dead
description: With this power you can put a curse on a living person which makes them become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die. You can put this curse on up to ten people after that you lose this power. If the person you curse is immortal it has no effect on them unless you can find a way to negate their immortality. Once they are zombies they act as normal zombies (they have a desire for brains, their limbs can come off easily, they can't be killed etc. )
summary: The ability to cause people to become zombies that are under your control as soon as they die
strengths: You can put a curse on people which causes them to become zombies that are under your control
weaknesses: You can only curse at most ten people
The zombies might eat innocent people's brains

name: Internal Organ Intangibility
description: This power allows your organs to pass through objects, such as the skin, however the skin does not possess this ability. The user can apply this power to specific organs. This way you could remove your intestines and strangle someone with them, or throw your stomach in someone's face. You could detach your organs and use your skin as a parachute. There are tons of awesome, totally disgusting things you can do. Attacks can be avoided much like normal phasing, but the skin still takes damage.
summary: The ability to make internal organs phase through objects
strengths: Quite versatile
Can freak people out
weaknesses: Really Gross
Skin still takes damage

name: Healer 1: Seizure Negation
description: This ability absorbs electricity from any seizures with range, preventing new one and stopping existing ones. This works for any kind of seizure. The absorbed electricity can be used for the possessor's own purposes. If you have additional electricity-manipulating powers, this provides another source of power to use. It can be deactivated if so desired. The longer you have this power, the greater the range (1 meter each year).
summary: The ability to block and end seizures within a certain radius around you.
strengths: Save people from seizures, fits, etc.
Has a base range of 25 kilometers. This increases with time.
Can be deactivated at will (for whatever reason).
weaknesses: Cannot save people outside the current radius.
Do not get as much energy as some other electricity-absorbing powers.
Unlike other healing powers, it cannot heal wounds or other ailments.

name: Ghost Annihilating Soags
description: Saogs are anti-matter versions of ghosts but can interact with normal non-ectoplasmic matter without harm. It's contact with ectoplasm that that causes saogs to explode. This contact also causes the ectoplasmic being to explode at the same time. Just like matter and anti-matter.
summary: The ability to summon beings made of anti-ectoplasm.
strengths: Protection from ghosts
Saogs have ghost like powers of flying and phasing.
Soags are anti-ectoplasm so not affected by ectoplasm control powers.
weaknesses: Ectoplasm in any form will make a soag explode. Ectoplasmic weapons will work.
Saogs don't have the power of possession.

name: Bug Pathy
description: One could be the king of the insect world with this power. You could talk to insects and insects could talk to you. You might request them to help you in a battle but they have different personalities and some may say "U not the boss of me." But one could only talk to INSECTS not to arachnids or crustaceans.
summary: The ability to communicate with insects.
strengths: Talk to insects
Insects could talk to you
Understand how they feel
weaknesses: Some may not join in your battle or leave you in the midst of battle
You may hear several insects screaming in night markets as they are being fried.
They might disturb you.

name: Methanogenesis
description: A form of anaerobic respiration, the possessor of this ability is able to survive in oxygen-poor environments by using carbon dioxide as the electron acceptor in cellular respiration rather than oxygen. While not as efficient as aerobic respiration, it will allow the person to survive. As aerobic respiration has carbon dioxide as its byproduct, methanogenesis' byproduct is methane gas. Might also breathe in side-products and/or smells.
summary: The ability to breathe in Carbon Dioxide and exhale methane
strengths: Allows survival in oxygen-poor environments
Good for survival in enclosed spaces, e.g. sealed in by your foe
Collect the methane for fuel
weaknesses: None.

name: Crazy Hair
description: Never have a bad hair day again.  Losing a little bit up top?  Not any more!  Take control of that bed head, 100% of the time.
summary: The ability to control your hair color, length, volume, and style to exactly how you want it.
strengths: Never have a bad hair day
Always look good up top
No more expensive hair cuts
weaknesses: Your hair stylist will miss you

name: Delete This Ard Whirlwind Kick
description: You can proceed on to deliver a barrage of freezing hurricane kicks, horizontally across anywhere and then finish them off with a final, most damaging frosting hurricane kick to freeze them solid and they'll shatter when they hit the ground.
summary: The ability to send the opponent to the edge with an Icy Hurricane Kick.
strengths: The move can also pass through projectiles and also wears them out.
weaknesses: None.

name: Usurpation: Upgrade
description: This power gives you several "upgrades" to your Usurpation power(s): Usually you need either line of sight or have to gain powers at random. With this power, however, you can choose to usurp the powers of a being whose power you have usurped before. Usurpation will last longer and will steadily increase the more experience you have gained, you will also know when Usurpation will end. Finally, you also gain the power to usurp more than one being's powers.
summary: The ability to be skilled with your "Usurpation" powers.
strengths: May choose to borrow powers from previously usurped beings
Duration of "Usurpation" is increased and you will know when it will end
Multi-Usurpation will become available
weaknesses: Completely useless without any Usurpation powers

name: Razor Skin
description: Denticles are the tooth-like structures on a shark's skin. When rubbed toward the tail, they are perfectly smooth; when stroked upwards, they act as sandpaper. A person with Razor Skin also has these, but in much greater density. So when they are "rubbed the wrong way", they can strip flesh to the bone and smooth steel. Unfortunately, this ability cannot be turned off. The denticles face downwards; if they are stroked downwards, there is no effect.
summary: The ability to possess a denticled skin
strengths: Skin like sandpaper on steroids
Can flay flesh easily
Razor punches
weaknesses: Involuntary
May forget and seriously hurt someone
Perfectly smooth if rubbed from head to toe

name: Knuckle Bump Explosion
description: This power is very simple and easy to use. Simply knuckle-bump with another human and an explosion will occur at the point of impact. The size and force of the blast depends on how much focus the user has and how much energy they exert. The user is always shielded from the explosion, and if they concentrate they can shield the other person as well.
summary: The ability to create explosions by doing a knuckle-bump with another person.
strengths: Can blow people and things up with a simple greeting
Always protected from your own blasts
Epic fist bumps
weaknesses: Difficult to use in battle
Very hard to use for anything other than area destruction
May accidentally kill your friends

name: Summoning: Avatar Of Zeus
description: In Greek mythology, Zeus was king of the gods, in command of electricity. Using this, you can summon a small portion of his power in the form of an avatar. A large humanoid beast made of pure energy and cackling with electricity will follow your command.
summary: The ability to summon Avatar of Zeus.
strengths: Summon an Avatar of Zeus.
weaknesses: Hard to use.

name: Never End The Superpower List
description: With this power, the Superpower List will never end and it will be hooked up to the universal database; whenever someone in any universe thinks of a power, it will be added to the List. The universal database is the same as those of Akasha Viewing and Akasha Mastery.
summary: The ability to make it so the Superpower List never ends
strengths: You get really good ideas about powers
The Superpower List willl never end
You will know what powers everybody is thinking about
weaknesses: No combat usage
I don't see any way this could help you
Sometimes you don't wan't to know what powers others are thinking about.

name: 4 To Go
description: With this people you can make people have an overwhelming urge to go anywhere you want. You can make them fall off a cliff, make them walk into a containment cell, make them come to you, if they have a car then you can make them drive you somewhere. You can do all of this and more just by saying the person's first and last name and the place you want them to go.
summary: The ability to cause people to want to go somewhere
strengths: You make people want to go somewhere
weaknesses: They don't necessarily go there they just really want to
You need to know their first and last name

name: Odour Whisperer
description: With this power, you see odours as if they were ghosts. They appear as coloured, gaseous spirits to you, clear as day. How good the smell is dictates the mental alignment of the odour; good smells are benevolent and handsome/beautiful, the bad smells are ghastly and twisted figures, and evil/bad. They will tell you how they were created, and they can attach themselves to you so that you can bring them along with you. Some may be your friend for life, or your worst nightmare.
summary: The ability to see, interact and speak with odours
strengths: Communicate with, see and carry sentient, living smell.
If it is a good smell, the scent is benevolent.
Detect who farted... Good for blackmail.
weaknesses: Some smells aren't so good
The bad smells are evil/bad
There are some smells you should not know about.

name: Acultomancy
description: Acultomancy can tell the future, and other things, through small pointy pieces of metal. It specializes in the question "Where". Acultomancers put(or hold) needles on a flat surface. After thinking about what they want to find, the needles will spin and point in the direction of the thing. Compasses are used often for convenience. Acultomancers can find almost anything, and often have an inborn sense of direction. Better Acultomancers can find things faster, or more easily.
summary: The ability to divine information through needles
strengths: Never lose your keys again!
Make use of a compass.
weaknesses: You have to carry needles... Ouch..
Can't tell you many things outside of "Where"

name: Myth Power: Cacia's Corruption
description: Cacia (Kakia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of sin, vice, immorality, weak morals and corruption. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive sinful thoughts and acts (including what sin affects a subject most) at will. In addition, one can psychically cast illusions pertaining to which of the Seven Deadly Sins affects a subject most. One can even psychically replicate oneself six times, at will, for a total of seven bodies (each representing one of the Seven Deadly Sins).
summary: The ability to channel Cacia's command over the essence of vice, sinfulness and corruption
strengths: Psychically perceive sin (in thoughts and actions) at will
Psychically cast illusions, which target subjects based on the Deadly Sin that affects them most
Psychically replicate six times (seven total bodies; one for each Deadly Sin)
weaknesses: Replicates don't gain powers based on their sin (compulsion, etc) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Nyx's Night Shift and MythPower: Eris' Enmity provide immunity (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Tail Limb
description: With this power, you have an added limb: a tail. With a tail, you could use it to hold yourself upon tree branches and swing away, etc. Of course, as with any other limb, you have to exercise it to grow more muscular and have more strength. This applies to the tail too.
summary: The ability to have a tail limb.
strengths: Can use it to swing from branches and hold yourself up.
Spinning while jumping gives you more airtime.
weaknesses: Inconvenient when sitting.

name: Financial Constraints
description: With this power, the more money you have, the stronger and more healthy you are. You will stay alive so long as you have even one piece of currency, assuming that it is worth anything. The opposite is also true: you will immediately die the second you lose your last bit of money.
summary: The ability to tie your health and strength to the amount of money you possess.
strengths: If you're rich then you are super strong and eternally youthful.
Even if you're middle class you are still immortal.
weaknesses: If you're poor, then you are unhealthy and weak.
If money becomes worthless, you crumble to dust.
If the market crashes, then so do you.

name: Rotting Blood
description: You can choose whether or not to use this power on anything, however when you want things to rot, EVERYTHING organic your blood touches will rot not just what you want to rot. Your body is the only thing immune to this effect.
summary: The ability to have one's blood rot what it touches
strengths: Enemies will fear making you bleed.
Other powers that allow you to recover blood rapidly.
weaknesses: More for villains than allies.
Can't control the rate of rotting.

name: Zman Box Shields
description: With this superpower, you can have boxlike transparent shields. The shield only permits objects that move below a certain speed to enter. Because you need air, the speed limit can only be set at 3mph or higher. The only way to get past the sheild is to move slower than 3mph.
summary: The ability to have boxlike transparent shields that protect you from objects that move faster than a certain speed
strengths: Shields
Protected from fast things
Defying/altering the shields takes more time than passing them at 3mph
weaknesses: Shield allows slow enough objects to enter.
Speed limit of shield is 3mph or higher because you need to breathe.
Sheilds are boxlike.

name: Indigestibility
description: With this ability, you can not be digested when eaten by another being, whether if swallowed whole or in bites. Immune to digestive acids and enzymes, you will pass through the digestive tract unharmed. This power works best if swallowed whole by something really big. Chunks of you could rejoin together if paired with regenerative abilities. Most digestive tracts are anaerobic, so depending on other powers, you may have to hold your breath or have an air supply.
summary: The ability to be indigestible
strengths: Don't really have to worry about being eaten
weaknesses: The egress may be icky

name: Dinosaur Virus
description: With this power you can scratch or bite a animal and, over the course of several hours, that creature will transform into a dinosaur. From then on any animal that the new dinosaur bites or scratches will also become a dinosaur, so long as it doesn't die. They become dinosaurs completely, with nothing remaining of their pre-dinosaur mind. Creatures will only become dinosaurs that are within their size range. Small animals will become smaller dinosaurs, big animals will become bigger dinosaurs.
summary: The ability to unleash a virus that turns modern animals into dinosaurs.
strengths: It's like a zombie plague, but with dinosaurs.
Bring back dinosaurs to the modern era.
Like with any virus a vaccine is posible.
weaknesses: You do not control the dinosaurs.
You are not immune to the dinosaur virus. If you are bitten you'll become a dinosaur.
Like with any virus a vaccine is posible.

name: Song Of The Past
description: This power allows the user to, when listening to a piece of music, travel back in time to any moment where they had heard that music previously. The time travel is only mental, and your present mind will replace that of your past self at the moment you listened to the music.
summary: The ability to travel back to any moment where you heard a song.
strengths: Travel back to whatever moment you heard a song.
weaknesses: You must be listening to a piece of music to use this power.
You must remember a previous instance of listening to this music to travel back to it.

name: Spirit Possession
description: You become a ghost lightning rod, meaning you can attract spirits & have them possess you. This makes you stronger. Downside is it only lasts an hour & only three spirits can possess you. Also, an evil spirit might possess & control you.
summary: The ability to become possessed by spirits, becoming stronger.
strengths: Virtually talk to the dead
Become stronger
weaknesses: Only be possessed for a hour
Only three spirits can possess you
An evil spirit might try to take control over you

name: Summon Slaypassion
description: The slaypassion. Visually, a half-dressed hot babe. Mentally, cheerful homicidal killer. They carry pistols or a rifle, but can lift 5 tons. They run as fast as cheetahs and a have a fly's reaction time. They can jump 30 feet straight up or 60 feet lengthwise. They are expert acrobats. They never show their hatred for non-kystians. They smile when they kill. They like who summoned them. If for some reason one can't join you in fight, she will cheer you on. "K-I-L-L. H-I-M. Kill him! "

description: You can create a deadly hailstorm that affects all things everywhere, can even send down shards of barraging hail that fall down both horizontally & diagonally.
summary: The ability to call fourth a long lasting hailstorm.
strengths: The attack lasts for a prolonged period of time.
As you would expect this power is devastating to opponents caught in it.
weaknesses: It will not affect fire/magma type enemies.

name: Poison Dart Strike V1 Mortals
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they can only hurt mortals (i. E. Normal people with no super human abilities) these poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze people for up to twenty minutes while you attack them or rob them
weaknesses: Only works for twenty minutes though you can shoot them with numerous darts at a time
Doesn't work on people with super powers

name: Touch From Hell
description: Anything that come contact with the user's palm will be set ablaze, even if the object touched is something that shouldn't burn, such as seawater. Only the user's limbs are unaffected by this.
summary: The ability to set anything ablaze just by touching them.
strengths: Touch anything you hate and watch them burn.
Has some entertainment value.
weaknesses: Everyone will panick with you around.
Anything that's set ablaze is irreversible.
No touching yourself (rubbing your tummy)

name: Game Physics: Mario
description: By mimicking Mario, you will have a hard head, 3 lives and mushrooms as power-ups.
summary: The ability to mimic Mario's physics.
strengths: A Hard Head.
3 lives.
Powerups
weaknesses: 3 lives only.
Turtles and muffins kill you.

name: Myth Power: Palaemon's Playtime
description: Palaemon (Palaimon), in Greek myth, was the god of ports and harbors. As such, channeling him allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can teleport to any body of water at will. Furthermore, if one falls or is thrown, one is teleported on impact into an extradimensional 'Harbor Space' at will. One can also step into the Harbor Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will. One can even psychically perceive impending dangers (storms, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Palaemon's command over the essence of safe ports and harbors
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater
Travel into customizable 'Harbor Space', and use it for shelter/storage/capture or Teleportation
Psychically perceive impending dangers (attackers, poison, storms, etc) at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access boating/sailing/fishing knowledge until developed (NCN)
Cannot gain favor with sea creatures or turn vehicles into boats, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Automatic favor with sea creatures (mythical or not) means they LOVE you

name: Barbed Wire
description: With this power you can turn any kind of wire into barbed wire. Including electrical wire, trip wires etc. This power also works in revers so you can turn your new barbed wire back and turn normal barbed wire into normal wire.
summary: The ability to turn normal wire into barbed wire
strengths: You can turn any kind of wire into barbed wire
You can turn any kind of barbed wire into normal wire
weaknesses: You can only make barbs appear on wires

name: Macrophage Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). You enter combat mode as soon as you encounter a foe (or any kind of human-sized obstacles). In this mode, you can stick to them and absorb them into your body, destroying them. In the case of living foes, you'll assimilate their cells into your skin. When you encounter a Leukocyte Mimic who recognizes them as their foe's, you can make them enter combat mode too, if they haven't yet.
summary: The ability to stick to/absorb foes, assimilate their cells and make other Leukocyte Mimics go into combat mode.
strengths: Unlike Dendritic Cell Mimic, you can still stick to and absorb foes while in combat mode.
Your body will stick to foes on a molecular level, making it hard for them to get away from you.
You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.
weaknesses: As soon as you touch a foe's body, you'll get stuck to them until you manage to absorb them.
Unlike Dendritic Cell Mimic, you don't gain any abilities that enhance your mobility.
Once you're in combat mode, you're stuck in this mode.

name: Sedation And Murder
description: With this ability, you can seduce victims into a sleepy state and then have the choice to murder them by removing all brain functions. The ability also has control over limited emotions, such as love, hate, or a neutral friendship.
summary: The ability to seduce victims to be  safe around you and then shut off their brain functions, therefore killing the
strengths: force a person you have a crush on to love you
kill any enemy, no matter how much stronger
fix a screwed up relationship
weaknesses: the ability could backfire and kill you
you could unconciously kill a loved one

name: Forced Transformation Use
description: Don't you hate those powers that force you to become something else? Well now you can use those forms you have been forced to take on as though they were originally transformations you were able to naturally use. You can also as a side effect of this power use your original form.
summary: The ability to use forms one was forced to become
strengths: Being transformed against your will can now help you gain new identities.
You can still use your original form for ID purposes.
The gained forms will never age or change looks from what the other people intended them to be like.
weaknesses: No use if you have shapeshifting, immutability, and a few other powers.
Only works if you're transformed against your will.

name: Zombification
description: Also called Zombification Inducing, Zombifying, Zombie Conversion or Living-Undead Conversion is the ability to convert the living into undead, via physical contact. With a touch, the subjects soul is ejected; the body rapidly undergoes decomposition, to the degree of the user's choosing. The mind is reduced to the lowest possible intelligence required to function, and linked to the mind of the user. When the process is finished, the soul returns and the subject is a zombie.
summary: The ability to convert living subjects into zombies by touch
strengths: Convert foes into zombies (often reversible)
They obey your every command, and cannot even be PSYCHICALLY compelled to harm you
If returned to normal, they have no recollection of being zombified
weaknesses: Zombification only works with a touch (or a bite from one who was zombified)
At the lower levels it may be uncontrollable (either it can't be turned off or can't be reversed)
Only allows communication with (and domination of) those zombified with THIS power

name: Fire Flower
description: These flowers are able to spew fire, similar to a flamethrower, but these are shorter and spew more fire.
summary: The ability to turn normal flowers into flowers that spew fire.
strengths: This fire burns through most things.
weaknesses: The fire doesn't burn through everything.
This power is negated if close to someone with Water Flower.

name: Phone Head
description: Those who own this power can call people's phones by 1.) thinking of their number and 2.) talking to them with their thoughts. The user of this power needs good thought control, or they might say what they didn't mean to or call the wrong number.
summary: The ability to call people in your head
strengths: Have a conversation in your head with people (now that sounds funny)!
You don't look like you're just talking to yourself all the time.
Call people in the middle of that boring math class!
weaknesses: Still need phone numbers and can't text people.
You could end up with that song "867-5309" by Tommy Tutone stuck in your head.
Wandering thoughts. If you're a guy, you should probably call hot girls on a regular phone.

name: Myth Power: Prowess Of Palioxis
description: Palioxis, in Greek myth, was the goddess of retreat and fleeing pursuit. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive the location, number and identity of any foe pursuing him, and avoid them with instincts like a prey animal. In addition, one may surpass the speed of any pursuer. At the higher levels, one may even cause a pursuer to slow down, as well as communicate with, and transform into, any animal considered a prey animal.
summary: The ability to channel Palioxis' command over the essence of retreat and backrush
strengths: Perceive the location, identity and number of one's pursuers
Gain prey instinct (even when the power is otherwise not in use)
Slow down pursuers and transform into a prey animal at the higher bands
weaknesses: Some prey animals are also considered predatory animals (may get confusing)
Cannot COMPEL prey animals until the higher bands
People with MythPower: Laelaps' Pursuit  are immune to this ability

name: Myth Power: Dike's Decision
description: Dike (Dice, Dikaiosyne, Dikaeosyne, Dicaeosyne), in Greek myth, was the goddess of justice, fairness and rights established by law. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically subjects' guilt/innocence in criminal situations, based on the law, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive a subject's chance of being a repeat-offender, by touch; if over fifty percent, the subject can be banished to an extradimensional prison. One can even summon an indestructible weapon at will.
summary: The ability to channel Dike's command over the essence of justice, fair judgment and rights established by law
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' guilt or innocence of crimes, at will
Psychically perceive criminals' chances of repeat-offense; banish high-risk criminals
Psychically summon a powerful, indestructible sword and/or club (can only harm criminals) at will
weaknesses: Cannot perceive past/future crimes (just ones in progress) until developed (NCN)
The definition of a crime shifts according to jurisdiction of one's location (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Harmonia's Heart
description: Harmonia (Homonoia, Hermione), in Greek myth, was the goddess of harmony, agreement and unanimity. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically induce harmony between any two or more subjects (quelling arguments, getting subjects to work together, etc), at will. In addition, one can psychically compel neutral subjects to agree with nearly anything one says, at will. One can even psychically attune oneself to the auras of others, to mimic their voices, appearances and skills, etc, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Harmonia's command over the essence of harmony, agreement and unanimity (oneness of mind)
strengths: Psychically induce agreement, harmony and cooperation/teamwork, at will
Psychically compel neutrals to agree with nearly anything one says, at will
Psychically attune oneself to the auras of others to mimic their traits, at will
weaknesses: Cannot use harmonic resonance to break matter apart, by touch or proximity, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and MythPower: Ares' Wrath allow one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and MythPower: Nerve of the Neikea provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Zelos' Rivalry
description: Zelos, in Greek myth, was the god of zeal, emulation, rivalry and envy, especially in matters of competition. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the location, thoughts and emotions of anyone he is jealous/envious of, as well as anyone who is jealous/envious of him (like rivals). In addition, one can perceive a foe's strategic weakness in competition. Furthermore, the more dedicated one is to a cause, the easier it is to catch on to skills pertaining to that cause (sports, etc).
summary: The ability to channel Zelos' command over the essence of rivalry, emulation, jealousy and zealotry
strengths: Psychically perceive location/thoughts/emotions of rivals/enemies/admirers/haters

The more dedicated you are to a cause, the easier it is to catch onto skills related to that cause
weaknesses: Success Auto-Training only works with PRACTICE (and does not apply to superpowers; no Con Negation)
People with MythPower: Philote's Affection are immune to this ability

name: Dark Powers: Book Of Corruption
description: With this power you can summon the book of corruption. It teaches most of the Dark Powers, including the ones with Summon, Transform, Curse and Awakening type powers. This book also gives it's user the power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name, which cant be write in any human language. There are only 13 of those books in the entire multiverse. This book is for villains only.
