strengths: Gives you access to all the other Dark Powers.
Gives you a bonus power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name.
weaknesses: This power is really rare, you probably would be the only person in the multiverse with this power.
This book corrupts your soul too, turning you evil.

name: Human Energy Container
description: As long as this power is active, any energy that your body absorbs or wastes is gathered in your stomach area. If a threshold is reached, your body has the potential to blow up if all this energy is released at once. Fortunately for you, this power prevents that by containing it, but that is true as long as you keep it active. So, you're a real human bomb, and the trigger is turning this power off. Oh, and a normal body doesn't usually survive its own explosion.
summary: The ability to build up and contain so much energy you blow up if this power no longer takes effect.
strengths: You're the nightmare of every power negators/stealers. And they're yours too!
If you have or one has an appropriate power, you or they could tap into your energy reserve.
If you have an appropriate power, you could explode at least twice!
weaknesses: Once you explode, you'll need to gather energy to blow up again. That is, if you're still alive!
You'll usually die when you explode.
You'll usually explode when you die.

name: Myth Power: Momos' Mockery
description: Momos (Momus), in Greek myth, was the god of mockery, blame, ridicule, scorn, complaint and harsh criticism. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind. In addition, one gains a superhuman ranting ability in which one reveals the foes' deepest, innermost thoughts, feelings and secrets aloud, without even knowing it. One can even psychically cause matter to take damage, by mocking flaws in its physical or chemical structure, at will.

strengths: Psychically perceive flaws, weaknesses and shortcomings of any kind
Superhuman ranting ability that subconsciously reveals foe's innermost secrets

strengths: If you're a vampire hunter, you know who to slay
weaknesses: You can't turn this power off

name: 1st Law Of Kyst: Existence
description: "No changes can be made to the metaphysical state of anything. " A sphere half a mile in diameter surrounds you. Within this sphere, no power works if it changes non-living to living, animate to inanimate, alive to dead(zombie), alive to undead(vampire), dead to undead, undead to dead, dead to alive, undead to alive, mortal to immortal, immortal to mortal or non-divine to divine. This a hybrid dimensional/reality power. This power will stop you or anyone else from using life unmaking power.

name: Ars Goetia: Beleth's Might

Beleth is capable of projecting hellfire that clears through targets with ease. When Beleth appears, all kind of music is heard before him.

strengths: Manage the terrible king's strength.
Hellfire not only incinerates the flesh but the soul also.
weaknesses: A single gaze will strike fear in innocents(possiblity of heart attacks).

name: Morphing Time
description: All you have to do is some silly dance and the morphing will begin. Being a ranger comes with a ranger issued weapon, zord and bright coloured silly looking costume.  Depending on which ranger you pick, you will also have a special ability that matches the colour and animal you choose.

weaknesses: You're going to be attacked by misformed mutants pretty much every week.

weaknesses: The snake can die

name: 2 D 3 D Switch
description: This power allows you to switch between 2D and 3D. This lets you slip under doors or fall through a gutter. You can bring people into 2D, but you must keep touching them to keep then in 2D. You can die while 2D, and you can also be stuck in 2D if you stay in it for longer then fifteen hours.

You can't kill people by 2Ding them

name: Myth Power: Call To Convalesce
description: Aceso (Akeso) and Telesphoros (Telesphorus, Acesis, Akesis), in Greek myth, were goddess and god counterparts (respectively) of the start and completion of convalescence (natural recovery). As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive and communicate with ill/injured subjects at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate the speed of the healing process at will. One can even psychically transfer illness and injury to/from oneself and other subjects, by touch.

name: Spring Legs

Avoid enemy attacks easily
Ninja-like agility
weaknesses: Springs could get tangled up
Springs could get caught on something

name: Myth Power: Doris' Delight
description: Doris, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the mingling of freshwater and salt water, which makes for ripe breeding grounds for fish. As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater. In addition, one can psychically manipulate water, at will. Furthermore, one can change fresh water into salt water, by touch, at will. One can also teleport to any body of water (fresh or salt) at will. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, replicate and command fish, at will.

strengths: You can control anybody who has a beard or mustache
weaknesses: You can't control them if they have superpowers

name: Summon Head Of Medusa
description: With this power you can summon the head of the Mythical Gorgon, Medusa. You can use her decapitated head to petrify your enemies. You cannot reverse the effects of the head and if you look at it yourself you will turn to stone.

name: Denim
description: With this power you can turn any article of clothing or any piece of cloth into denim. You can have jean sweatshirts, jean sweatpants, jean sweat rags etc. Once you turn things denim though you can't change it back.

strengths: Can create copies of yourself
Enhance your power with recombining
Extra arms
weaknesses: If separate body is destroyed, main body is  destroyed

Weak to Fire

name: Muppet Power Newsman's Curse
description: Have you ever watched the Muppet Show and seen those Muppet Newsflash sketches and thought "Hah whatever that guy is reporting about falls on his head that's hilarious! "? Well on the off chance that you have, with this power you can do that too. Now whenever you talk about something it will fall from the sky onto your head. For example if you're talking to your friend about lotteries or large amounts of cash, large amounts of cash will fall on you. This power does not work on people.

weaknesses: This power does not work with people

name: Snap Slap Fight

name: Unsummoning
description: With this power you can unsummon any thing that you've ever summoned using some sort of summoning/teleportation power. Even if you no longer have the power you used to summon it. However if you no longer have the power you used to summon the object when you send it back you can never resummon it.

name: Transformers: Inferno
description: With this power you can shoot rockets from your hand. The rockets blow up as soon as they hit anything causing a good amount of damage and chaos. And the rockets are on fire! The fire doesn't actually do much except for look really cool and maybe provide some light. A side effect of this power causes you to want to become a fireman; how this is reconciled with the whole flaming rocket thing is up to the user.

strengths: You can shoot rockets from your hands

name: Arceusforce: Zap
description: The user of this ability can channel the crackling rage of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Electric-type. The user's skin turns yellow and their irises turn orange. Under their electrical guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of an Electric-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Electric attacks such as Thunderbolt, Thunder Wave, Thunder, Zap Cannon and more.

weaknesses: The user is weak to earth-based attacks.

name: Arial Rebound
description: This is the ability to rebound off of artificial platforms in the air like a pinball building up speed for a cannonball strike at your enemies. It workes by jumping in the air and creating a temporary platform to support your weight and using it to get higher then creating another at the apex of your jump at the desired angel and using that to amplify your flight. This can be repeated as many times as necessary to reach the desired destination or velocity for an attack.

name: Spatial Occupation Generation

The user on the other hand, can move them. These objects/materials can be quite durable as well

They cannot be physically moved
Manipulate space by limiting it

name: Doctor Mario's Megavitamins
description: Megavitamins calls pills are. A game where the character named Dr. Mario throws Megavitamins (special Pills) in a bottle. Doctor Mario's Megavitamins is the ability to launch those Megavitamin pills.

name: Reincarnation 3: Object
description: This power allows the user to put an "anchor" into an object. This allows your soul to remain on earth unless all anchors are destroyed. However, to do this, you need to "link" someone else to the anchor. It will then become an anchor when they die. However, they have to agree to this for it to work. Save the lives of others while doing this.

Losing your body with no way of reviving or interacting with the outside world.

name: Superpower List Eraser
description: You can erase other people's powers off the superpower list, so you can put yours into existance under your name. I thought that was explanatory in the overview. You can also use any language you want in your power description and it can be longer than 500 characters.

You are basically an admin

name: Water To Blood
description: With this power you can turn any amount of water into undrinkable blood; this doesn't just apply to normal humans; this blood is also undrinkable to vampires and other blood-drinkers, and will cause even them to fall sick if they try to ingest it. Hes a very good power creator, (Claps twice)

name: I'm Rubber And Your Glue
description: With this ability, anything that someone says about you immediately becomes true about them. name: Member's Only Duplication
description: When activated, this power allows you to duplicate the powers, skills, and abilities of anyone in the universe who is, at that time, wearing a Member's Only jacket.  You are also able to know the locatation and identity of any person currently wearing a member's only jacket, or sense if a person near you ever owned one.  The power only works if you are wearing your Member's Only Jacket
summary: The ability to have the abilities of anyone wearing a Member's Only jacket
strengths: You belong to an exclusive club
You look sharp
Lot's of people have purchased them indicating a wide skill set to borrow from
weaknesses: Most Member's Only jackets are now hidden in the back of the closet, long forgotten.
Do you really want the abilities of someone who still wears one?
Use of power gives an involuntary feeling of arrogance and superiority

name: Portal Of The Pearl
description: The rounder that the pearl was the longer the portal will last, the larger the pearl the larger the portal, and the rarer the coloring of the pearl (gold is rarer than pink for example) the more stable the portal is and more places it can take you.
summary: The ability to summon a portal by crushing a pearl under one's foot
strengths: You can go pretty much anywhere you want with this power.
weaknesses: You have to destroy an extremely valuable object.
Rare-colored pearls can be hard to find.

name: Myth Power: Goof Of Gelos
description: Gelos (Gelus), in Greek myth, was the god of laughter. As such, channeling him allows to psychically perceive how to make nearly any subject laugh with humor, jokes and comedy routines. In addition, one can recall any existing comedic material at will. Furthermore, one can induce uncontrollable laughter by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel comedians (those who are humorous/comedic/funny or who like to joke and play pranks).
summary: The ability to channel Gelos' command over the essence of laughter
strengths: Perceive how to make nearly anybody laugh; perceive and recall existing jokes and comedic routines
Induce uncontrollable laughter by a touch, a word or a thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel comedians/jokers and pranksters
weaknesses: Cannot exhibit Cartoon Physics or gain power from natural laughter until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot cast a "Constant Laughter Illusion" or produce a Sonic Laugh until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Sophrosyne's Solace and humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Tabliope's Gambit
description: Tabliope, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the gamble; gambling and games of chance. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically summon playing cards and dice; one gains skill in using cards to divine the future, like Tarot cards. In addition, one can channel kinetic energy through cards, to use them as throwing blades or explosives. One can even use a roll of the dice to induce a random effect on reality; the number indicated by a dice roll is the time (in sec/min/hrs) the effect lasts.
summary: The ability to channel Tabliope's command over the essence of the gamble, and games of risk and random chance
strengths: Psychically summon playing cards and dice; gain skill in using playing cards like Tarot cards
Channel kinetic force through playing cards, to use them as throwing blades or explosives
Randomly manipulate reality/probability with a dice roll; never helps foes, or harms self/allies
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or manipulate probability until the higher levels (NCN)
Psychic manipulation of probability NEVER affects SUMMONED cards or dice (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: Freezing Kiss Of Death
description: You would blow an icy kiss in the direction of your opponent, freezing them solid, but it can affect them in many ways, like if they are in a frozen state, their heart can be seen beating at an abnormally fast rate in their chest for a few seconds before it bursts, could fall over and shatter upon contact with the floor, leaving it in a mess of ice and bones, or you can give your enemy a kiss on the cheek, that'll instantly turn them into an icy statue which explodes.
summary: The ability to blow a kiss that would freeze your opponent.
strengths: You could do it sadistically, like exhaling an icy mist at your opponent which freezes them dead.
weaknesses: This power can only work for females.

name: Condition Change: Calm
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user is calm. Cannot be used on a power that has already been affected by a Condition Change that requires a different mood. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require the user being calm in order to activate
strengths: Infuriate your opponent and they can't use their power.
Use this power on an opponent with no emotions for the best results.
weaknesses: If your opponent is always calm and collected.
You have to touch them first.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Fuujin
description: You can summon the fan of Fuujin, a mighty metal fan that can summon tornadoes and winds that are able to cut through stuff. Boosts the power of air elementals.
summary: The ability to use the fan of Fuujin.
strengths: Control over wind.
Strong boost to air elementals.
weaknesses: Can be too powerful for some people.
If overused, you might kill yourself.

name: The $1 Genie Power
description: You're a dollar store genie. You can make three wishes a day for anything costing a $1 or less. You have to speak your wish. You can wish for a speck of a precious metal or a bit of diamond. You could wish for something priceless as in meaning it has no value. A damaged book. You could wish for a nice sports car if someone somewhere in the world was actually selling one for a $1 or a house for a $1 or a gold ring for a $1.
summary: The ability to make wishes for anything a $1 or less.
strengths: There are countless useful and needed things for a $1 or less.
Somewhere in the world someone might be selling a house for a $1.
Lots of stuff is sold for the symbolical price of $1.
weaknesses: One ounce of gold take five to six months to wish for.
No one in the world is selling a house for a $1.

name: Chiropractic Swarm
description: You can have your spine crawl out of your body as a centipede like monster you control that spits corrosive spinal fluids. As it roams, after about 14 minutes you grow a new spine and regain conciousness. That spine can be a monster as well.
summary: The ability to eject your spine from your body as a living monster you control.
strengths: You can regenerate an infinite amount af spines.
They fit in tight spaces.
They can crawl up walls
weaknesses: You are unconcious and vulnerable until you regenarate.

name: Elf Spawn
description: With this power you can spawn elves and you have complete control over them you can make them do whatever you want wether it be build toys, walk the dog, play golf with you or fight off bad guys for you.
summary: The ability to spawn elves
strengths: You can spawn elves and make them do whatever you want
weaknesses: They're not very strong so making them fight off bad guys might not be so effective

name: Mood Ring V3
description: If you're angry, your hair will turn bright red (and I mean real red). If you're sad, it'll turn light blue. If you're happy, it'll turn blonde or brown (depending upon your original hair color). If you're in love, it'll turn purple. If you're excited, it'll be black with streaks in every color of the rainbow.
summary: The ability to change your hair color based on your mood
strengths: Possible to gain a new power whenever your hair changes color
If you're uncertain whether or not you're in love, look in a mirror
weaknesses: Obvious when you're using it

name: Manikin Slave
description: First, you would conjure the manikin(s). The manikins are loyal to you and are under your command.
summary: The ability to control manikins.
strengths: Servants
Loyal
weaknesses: Creepy

name: Shared Energy Pool
description: Chi, mana, psychic energy, etc. Any energy that someone in the group is able to use is put into the collective pool of energy. Any person in the group can utilize the energies that their own powers allow them to use. People can only be added to or subtracted from the group by someone with a copy of this power. A being can only be added to the group if they want to be added.
summary: The ability to have a pool of energy that is shared between a group of beings
strengths: Allies can now use powers longer than they originally could.
Allies who can drain power from enemies.
The power levels of the shared pool is everyone's power levels added together.
weaknesses: You'll run out of power faster than before if you had the highest levels of power originally.
If one person in the group runs out of power, everyone runs out of power.

name: Power Banning
description: When thirteen people with this ability work together, they can ban an ability from existence. There is no defense against this, but at least it cannot target one person. Unfortunately, this only applies to the current universe/realm it is performed in. The group selects a leader to channel it through, but he does not do the banning. The leader must have it legitimately and nobody in the group can have acquired this pwoer from the leader. However, the group is not exempt from the change.
summary: The ability to erase a superpower from existence as a group of 13.
strengths: Eliminate overpowered powers.
Universal, no defense.
This power is immune to itself.
weaknesses: If anyone in the group dies, all effects are reversed instantly until rebanned.
This power cannot have it's cons removed by any power.
The leader must have this legitimately (i. E. No mimicry).

name: Allergen Immunity
description: WIth this power you are immune to allergies. You cannot get any allergies and you lose the ones you already had when you get this power. You can't even get allergies through Allergen Inducer or any other non-natural means.
summary: The ability to be immune to allergies
strengths: You are immune to any allergies
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes2
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling the Elder Eros (Procreation) allows one to manipulate sexual arousal and induce an overwhelming urge to have sex (for the sake of bearing offspring) in any animal species by touch, word or thought. In addition, one can perceive and manipulate reproductive sexual capacity (in oneself and others) at will. Furthermore, one can enhance or reduce sexual attributes (in self and others) at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically manipulate sexual arousal and induce an overwhelming urge to reproduce
Psychically perceive and manipulate sexual capacity (the ability to reproduce) of self/others
Enhance or reduce sexual attributes (breasts, etc) in self/others
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or communicate with well-endowed subjects until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Removable Limbs To Weapons
description: With this power you can remove any part of your body (arm, leg, ear, thumb etc. ) and turn it into any kind of weapon. As long as the body part is not destroyed while in weapon form you will feel no pain and continue to live even if it is your head or some other vital body part.
summary: The ability to be able to remove parts of your body and turn them into weapons
strengths: You can remove your body parts and turn them into weapons
As long as the body part is not destroyed while in weapon form you feel no pain and continue to live
weaknesses: If the body part is destroyed in weapon form you feel immense pain and no longer have that body part

name: Pancreatic Acinar Cell Mimicry
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot enzymes and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Enzymes are catalysts, i.e. each one greatly enhances a specific chemical reaction. Yours can increase the action of bases over various substances, such as fat, proteins, sugar, starch, DNA and RNA. Unfortunately, your enzymes can't do anything outside a basic environment and you are not immune to the effects of bases. In addition to this power, you can undergo mitosis.
summary: The ability to shoot pancreatic digestive enzymes.
strengths: You can accelerate and increase the action of bases over various substances.
You can increase the potency of Ductal Cell Mimicry.
Dissolve and digest any kind of organic thing.
weaknesses: Your enzymes only work when mixed with a base.
You are not immune to the effects of bases, especially if they are enhanced by your powers.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons2)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Eiar (Ear- Spring) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth spring weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally spring. Furthermore, one can withstand electricity. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of spring at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth spring weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally spring; withstand electricity
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of spring
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past springs until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL spring until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to electricity/spring provide immunity (NCN)

name: Remote Explosive Max Pulse
description: The ability to explode biological/non-biological lifeforms/objects from a small or great distance, but still within the user reach, approximately 100 metres. May be very dangerous if not uncontrollable, since this ability is greatly affected by emotions. For example, if someone is having a breakdown or having a crush on someone, he or she may activate this ability when their heart rate is at it's maximum. Must be focused if want to explode desired objects.
summary: The ability to explode things from a distance when heart rate reaches it's maximum.
strengths: Can explode landmines for safety purposes.
Can make explosion without being detected or harmed.
Can get revenge on your enemies.
weaknesses: Can kill someone instantly.
Can set houses on fire or destroy them.
Gets tired after using for numerous time.

name: Blood Scythe 2 Form The Wheel
description: The blood from the blade flows to the end of the handle, and transforms into a blade the same shape and size as the main blade of the scythe, except it is facing a different way. Now, the scythe can be thrown at opponents, and it will spin as it flies.
summary: The ability to transform the blood scythe
strengths: Great range weapon.
Strong attack.
Boomerang-like capabilities.
weaknesses: Difficult to use in close combat, for fear of being hit by one of the blades.

name: Enhancement: Range
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it increases the effective range of the other power by 2. 5 times. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to increase the effective range of a power
strengths: A power with a range of 100 metres ends up with a range of 250 metres.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.

name: Myth Power: Sophrosyne's Solace
description: Sophrosyne, in Greek myth, was the goddess of self-control (self-discipline), temperance (restraint), discretion and sobriety. As such, channeling her allows one to resist any domination of one's body, mind or spirit. In addition, one gains superhuman patience, willpower and resilience (to resist any temptation or attempt at seduction, and come back from psychological trauma), is rendered immune to ALL compulsions, and cannot be intoxicated by drugs or alcoholic beverages.
summary: The ability to channel Sophrosyne's command over the essence of self-control, restraint, discretion and sobriety
strengths: Cannot be dominated by any force other than TRUE Omnipotence (which is HIGHLY unlikely)
Superhuman Patience, Willpower and Resilience; Immunity to ALL compulsions and intoxication
Discipline the body to do acrobatic feats, go longer without food/water/sleep, and assist metabolism
weaknesses: Often cannot share Compulsion/Domination Immunity, by touch until the higher levels
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Train of Erotes (rivals)
MythPower: Bacchanalia (rivals)

name: Monarch Harlequin Wings
description: Only at nighttime when the wing sprout from your back you can fly that allows you to control navigation & guidance leaving a glittering trail.
summary: The ability to have greenish glowing butterfly like wings.
strengths: Can use those wings to fire tiny spark-like projectiles by flapping them.
weaknesses: Those wings can only grow at night and they can sprout back down by daytime.

name: Feminization
description: Someone affected by this power will become more feminine in both mind and body. They will start to act like how they think a proper girl acts. Their body will also slim out into an hourglass body-shape and they will gain a fully feminine body (legs, abdomen, arms, etc). Males affected by this power will stil act like men, but more camp.
summary: The ability to cause someone to become more feminine
strengths: They will be unaware that they are changing until pointed out.
weaknesses: Can be reversed, but only by other powers.

name: Mercury Emesis
description: You can spew liquid metal up to 6ft at will. It can poison your enemies and make all sorts of cool weaponry and sculptures made of mercury. You will not choke. You will not die. However, it could give you a nasty gag reflex. You also have to master it or it will harden in your mouth (if held in long enough before release).
summary: The ability to project liquid mercury from your mouth at will
strengths: Immunity to mercury poisoning
Easy gifts and entertainment (If you're creepy like that)
Kill your enemies ruthlessly.
weaknesses: You could drown in your sleep if you can't control it
If this is involuntary, could make for very awkward social situations

name: Snap You're A Vehicle
description: With this power you can turn people into vehicles by snapping and saying the person's name and the desired vehicle Ex: "John Doe, Motorcycle" The person loses all sentience when in vehicle form but you can turn them back by snapping and saying what you said before in reverse Ex: "Motorcycle, John Doe". All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode so its an easy way to defeat powerful enemies just tun them into vehicles and crash them a couple of times before turning the back.
summary: The ability to turn people into vehicles by snapping
strengths: You can anybody into any vehicle.
Once in vehicle mode they lose all sentience so you can ride them or use them to attack people.
All damage sustained in vehicle mode transfers to human mode.
weaknesses: If they get destroyed in vehicle mode they die.

name: Celtic Invocation: Cailleach
description: Those with the invocation can, by tapping a fist, staff or other object against the ground three times, summon a storm common to the winter in the area. According to the climate, it may be a monsoon, a hurricane, a blizzard or a thunderstorm. The invoker may also be able to freeze objects, to call ice and frost by chanting, and to lay curses upon people or objects. These curses may cause instant death, illness, misfortune, pain, or any other negative, destructive effect.
summary: The ability to invoke the power of the Cailleach, the Gaelic goddess of winter and destruction.
strengths: One of the most destructive invocations. The invoker will become winter personified in person.
The invoker's powers are stronger in late autumn to early spring.
Highly respected among the Invokers and people whose powers involve cold and destruction.
weaknesses: The invoker's powers are weaker from early spring to late autumn.
Those who have power over heat, light and fire.
The storms affect all people, including friends and family.

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta4
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phaethon (Phaithon, Phaiton, Dios, Dion- Planet Jupiter) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Jupiter's patron, Zeus, to resist and benefit from his domains (sky and weather, fate, royal power, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Jupiter (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Jovian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Jupiter's patron god, Zeus; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Jupiter at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Jupiter-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Planet Eater
description: With this power you become a giant, big enough to eat planets and every time you eat a planet you get a new power this is more of a Super Villain power than a Super Hero power
summary: The ability to gain powers by eating planets
strengths: Gain new powers by just eating (planets)
weaknesses: Kills billions of people unless it's an uninhabited planet
Dwarf planets (like Pluto) don't work
Eventually you'll run out of planets and have to travel to a different galaxy

name: The Kyst Dimension
description: The Kyst dimension is where the norr, slitskins and other half-alive things like them come from. This power manifests as a 100-foot-radius ring of green-black primordial ooze that surrounds you and moves with you as if it were your shadow. If you're pushed to the ground, the ooze will flow around you. Anyone making contact with the ooze will instantly become enveloped and banished to the Kyst dimension. If they can't escape, they face hordes of half-alives that won't stop until they're dead.
summary: The ability to banish someone to the Kyst dimension.
strengths: Banishment to an ultra-nightmarish world.
Your own ooze can't affect you.
weaknesses: Anyone who flies.
Dimensional travelers.
Someone with a phasing power.

name: Racist Reversal
description: With this power you create a constant aura that turns people into the race that they are most racist against. It affects anyone in your range of sight even if you can not directly see them. If the people around you are not racist or are racist against their own race then nothing happens. People could change races multiple times if their racism changes to a different race.
summary: The ability to turn people into the race that they are most racist against.
strengths: Cure to racism.
People can experience being a new race.
Teach them that everyone is equal by making them like those they are racist against.
weaknesses: Always active.
Permanent.
May affect yourself.

name: Soquidkinesis
description: A soquid is a state of matter between a solid and a liquid. This ability allows you to control soquids with your mind. You can control magma (but not lava), slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, honey, a Wendy's Frosty, and anything else that is a soquid. A soquid shares properties of both solids and liquids. 50% solid, 50% liquid. You can only move magma at less than 1 mph. You can only control soquids. If the soquid magma solidifies (and it will), you can't control it.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate and control soquids.
strengths: You can mentally control soquids.
You have complete control over soquids.
Control slushies, peanut butter, semi-melted glass, and magma (not lava).
weaknesses: Can only control soquids. Lava is a liquid.
People who can manipulate solids and/or liquids can still slightly manipulate soquids.

name: Mermaid Friend
description: Mermaids love to party and sing, so it's great anytime  you feel like having fun.
summary: The ability to summon mermaids.
strengths: Having someone to hangout with all the time.
weaknesses: You have to be in or near water for it to work.

name: Suicidal Immunity
description: With this power you will be unable to kill yourself. No matter what you do to yourself (shoot yourself, hang yourself, jump off a cliff etc. ) you will come out completely unscathed. This power even applies if you pay someone to kill you.
summary: The ability to be unable to take your own life
strengths: You are unable to cause yourself to die
weaknesses: If you're suicidal (which of course is not a good thing to be) this power is not the one for you

name: Sh33
description: With this superpower, you know how to make SH33. You make it and when injected(or drank), can allow you to survive without water for a day. Just one dose a day and you'll never need water again. It has to be kept at a constant 40 degrees fahrenheit or below. Above 40 F, it decomposes into SH46, causing extreme thirst and temporarily increased need for water(more than normal) when used. SH33 has a distinct green-yellow glow that glows in the dark. When it glows less and becomes yellow.
summary: The ability to make and use it to survive without water forever.
strengths: Make SH33 and survive without water.
Each dose lasts 24 hours.
A dose a day and you'll never need water again.
weaknesses: It must be kept at a constant 40 F or it'll decompose into SH46.
SH46 causes extreme thirst.
Someone might want to sabatage the SH33 project and hide it from the public.

name: Myth Power: Enyo's Laugh
description: Enyo, in Greek myth, was the goddess of violence and bloodshed. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive violence and bloodshed in one's proximity at will. In addition, one gains physical power from inflicting pain and injury on others; the more blood drawn, or pain inflicted, the better. One can also transfer wounds from one's own body to others' bodies, by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people.
summary: The ability to channel Enyo's command over the essence of violence and bloodshed
strengths: Psychically perceive violence and bloodshed at will (when developed, extends into past and future)
Gain physical power from inflicting harm; transfer one's wounds onto others by touch word or thought
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel particularly violent people
weaknesses: Cannot induce violent behavior in neutrals by touch until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Eirene's Elegance provides immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Condition Change: Festival
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation for a power so that it only works when there is a festival ocurring in the world. It doesn't matter where the festival is, what is being celebrated, or who is celebrating. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when there is a festival somewhere in the world
strengths: You can most likely predict when your enemy can use their powers.
weaknesses: Have to touch and each touch affects only one power.
There are probably lots of esoteric festivals in this world alone.

name: Melanocyte Mimicry
description: You can produce sacks of melanin inside your body that migrate toward your hands. There are two types of melanin that you will produce: a dark brown/black one (harmlessly absorbs UV rays and converts them into heat) and a yellow-redish one (changes when exposed to UV rays and may damage the DNA if it does). Your body synthesizes the same ratio of the two types, which depends on your skin, hair and eye color. You can also undergo mitosis when a Keratinocyte Mimic near you is undergoing mitosis.
summary: The ability to produce melanin.
strengths: Use the dark melanin to protect yourself or others from UV radiations.
You can duplicate yourself in the presence of Keratinocyte Mimics who are undergoing mitosis.
You can pierce the sacks to spray the melanin on you or others.
weaknesses: You can only duplicate yourself when Keratinocyte Mimics duplicate themselves as well.
Keratinocyte Mimics can influence the ratio between the two melanin types you produce.
You must produce DNA-damaging melanin when using this ability if the ratio forces you to.

name: Road Rage
description: With this ability, you can cause any car that's PISSIN YOU OFF to get the hell out of the way.  They will magically be forced to move out of your way, and, if you want, you can give them the finger while doing it.  Basically, this will satisfy any road rage you might have.
summary: The ability to force any car (or cars) out of your way at any given time.  Includes rush hour!
strengths: Get place faster
You're never late because of traffic
Rush hour is a fun time
weaknesses: You might force an ambulance to wait

name: Myth Power: Anaideia's Anger
description: Anaideia (Anaidea, Anaidia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of disrespect, mercilessness, shamelessness and unforgiveness. As such, channeling her allows one to speak and act nearly however one likes; people will not retaliate, no matter how rude, hurtful, vulgar, profane, obscene or disrespectful. In addition, one when holding a grudge, going against a foe one does not respect or when one's foe is down (pleading for mercy). One can even psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely.
summary: The ability to channel Anaideia's command over the essence of disrespect, ruthlessness and unforgiveness
strengths: Do nearly whatever you like (even if it breaks the law), and nobody will retaliate
Gain physical power when holding a grudge, fighting a foe one doesn't respect, or when he is down
Psychically compel subjects by talking to them rudely (yelling, insults, cursing, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot get away with physical abuse, rape or murder until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Eleos' Empathy allows one to withstand and negate this ability (NCN)
Law/order/justice based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Sentinel
description: You can grow an eye on any part of your body in several seconds, and than remove it with your thoughts. You can always know, what is behind you. Or above you. Or under you.
summary: The ability to grow an eye on any part of your body.
strengths: Seeing everything around you
Recognize your enemy before the attack
Quite fun to show eyes on your sole or your elbow to your friends.
weaknesses: Too conspicouos, anyone can see that your not an avarage human being.
Having clothes over the part of your body where you want the eye to be

name: Spore Releaser
description: With this superpower, you can shoot spores from any part of your body. These spores turn into any fungi of your choosing. The fungi doesn't have to be real, but you have to have a clear image of it in your head. Be warned, as this power can randomly activate with strong emotions. If used too much in a 1-hour time period, the user's energy will be severely taxed. Also, this power works best in damp, dark places.
summary: The ability to shoot spores from yourself which turn into any type of fungi imaginable.
strengths: Neverending supply of mushrooms equals never-ending supply of food. (donut mushroom! )
You can make the fungi ANYTHING you want.
Endless supply of fungi-weaponry.
weaknesses: It's emotionally triggered.
You will dry out if you stay in the sun too long.
If you're not careful, you could accidentally pulverise an ally with an avalanch of fungi.

name: Uv Stick Grenade
description: The UV Stick Grenade consists of an explosive flashlight head, on top of a hollow lead handle. A pull cord runs from the detonator inside the head to a porcelain ball that is held in place by a detachable screw cap on the base of the handle. They are designed to stun normal opponents and disintegrate vampires.
summary: The ability to use it to emit bright explosions to you foes.
strengths: It would blind the enemy for five seconds
It desintegrates a vampire in an instant.
weaknesses: None

name: Tick
description: You turn into a tick. You climb onto someone with powers, bite them and with each drop of blood you drink you gain one of their powers. If you bite a person with only one super power you basically just get stronger within the restrictions of the power you've stolen.
summary: The ability to become a tick and steal the powers of all you bite.
strengths: You can take any power you can get.
Not many people will even notice you're on them.
It doesnt take much blood to steal a power.
weaknesses: You have to become a tick first, then try to get on them.
If someone sees you in tick form they can kill you with one good foot squashing.
Unless you're a vampire, who likes to drink blood. Yuck!

name: Bird Caller
description: With this power you can mimic any bird call perfectly. So perfectly that birds and cats might start running/flying towards you thinking your a bird.
summary: The ability to be able to imitate any bird call perfectly
strengths: You can attract birds and cats
You can mimic any bird call perfectly
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You might be allergic to cats or birds

name: Marks Of Master And Servant
description: The master will be marked with 'M's on their palms and the servant(s) will be marked with 'S's. The biggest significance though is that the servant(s) must each take into their body at least 1 drop of blood a day from their master or die. The master can order around the servant(s) for that reason. In order to get rid of this curse the servant must willingly do 500 things for their master without doing them in order to free themself of the curse.
summary: The ability to create an explosion in an area that turns everyone into a master or a servant
strengths: Possibilty of turning your enemies into the servants of your allies.
50% chance of being marked as a servant or a master. Exceptions in cons.
Chance of being marked as either a servant or master can only be changed by the cons.
weaknesses: This power will not make those with Slavery Immunity into servants. Con 1 is negated only by con 2.
The user of this power is automatically marked as a servant if caught in the explosion.
Possibility of turning your allies into the servants of your enemies.

name: "Speak Humans!" V2
description: With this power you can give humans the ability to speak to animals. They will be able to speak to any fish, bird, mammal, reptile, insect, amphibian etc. And understand what the animals are saying as well.
summary: The ability to give humans the ability to speak any animal language
strengths: You can give humans the ability to speak to animals
weaknesses: You can't use this power on yourself

name: Infernal Demons
description: Demons and spirits can contact you from the underworld, another plane of existence or wherever they come from. In return for releasing them, they will offer you something as a reward. You can accept or reject the offer, or you may make an counter-offer. You'll have a gut feeling where and when they will spawn. No traces/evidence will be left to implicate you for the spawning of the creatures, they will not remember you set them free. You yourself can also choose to not remember this.
summary: The ability to release demons and spirits if they offer you something
strengths: No evidence to implicate you, even you can forget if you want to; despite memory powers
Creatures come in different shapes and forms (hands, animals, human-like) and have their own powers
You can choose when you want to hear offers, so you don't hear them all the time.
weaknesses: They have to obey the agreement, but after fullfillment, they don't disappear
Each demon has it's own personality and attitude. They might turn on you if you're not careful.
They can be destroyed or exorcised

name: Hot Tub Effect
description: Never take a cold bath again! You could immeidatley turn any pool into a hot tub, and make any water so unbearably hot and bubbly that it scalds the foe!
summary: The ability to create a stream of bubbles or churning warm water when fingers placed in water.
strengths: Hot tubs! No more cold water!
Bubbles!
Boil a foe alive!
weaknesses: Nice relaxing tub can become a horrible bubbly mess!
Boiling yourself alive.

name: Myth Power: Geras' Guard
description: Geras, in Greek myth, was the god of old age, its associated conditions and the elderly (old). As such, channeling him to allows one to age, and yet never suffer or die from old age or geriatric conditions. In addition, one can psychically age subjects (physically and/or mentally), at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with anyone older than middle age (senior citizens, etc), at will.  One can even psychically generate a forcefield that works on the elderly (old).
summary: The ability to channel Geras' command over the essence of old age, the old and geriatric conditions
strengths: Gain Graceful Aging (never die of old age or associated geriatric conditions)
Psychically age subjects (mentally and/or physically), at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and generate a forcefield against the old, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically trade bodies/minds with the old, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically convert one's old age into physical power, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hebe's Hedge and other time/age-based powers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Enhancement: Perverted
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power more effective at healing evil beings and harming pure-hearted beings. This power cannot be attached to powers that are good in origin. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power more evil than normal
strengths: Pure-hearted enemies.
100% evil allies.
Objects are affected also if the attached-to power could affect them originally.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Evil enemies.
Pure-hearted allies.

name: No Aura
description: Normally a living being has an energy field that they give off. This is known as an aura. Most beings can only suppress or hide their aura with concentration. However, like Kanna from 'Inuyasha' (her powers are based on emptiness and she carries a mirror that has powers of its own) you have no aura.
summary: The ability to have no aura
strengths: People cannot track you by aura since you have don't have one.
Aura manipulators will not like you.
NOTE: It is because Kanna is based on emptiness that she has no aura. You don't have to be like her.
weaknesses: Largest irregularity a living being can have.
Can't have a beneficial aura.
Might become similar to Kanna. Might be a pro as she has a few nice powers.

name: The Chocolate Touch
description: Similar to King Midas's Mida Touch but instead of turning things gold, you turn them into chocolate. Also unlike the Midas Touch, you can reverse the effects of this power, but you cannot turn it off. For instance, if you hug your mom she automatically turns to chocolate, but you can quickly turn her back so it doesn't matter.
summary: The ability to turn anything into chocolate just by touching it
strengths: You can turn anything into chocolate.
You can reverse the effects of this power
weaknesses: You can't turn this power off
If you're allergic to chocolate this is bad

name: Infinity Sword: Sulk
description: The Infinity Sword is one sword that can transform into an unknown amount of different other swords, each with unique abilities and appearances. Sulk appears to be a regular steel claymore, but has the ability to feed off negative emotions. Whenever near people who are sad, angry or such, the user grows stronger.
summary: The ability to use Sulk.
strengths: Gain power near negative emotions.
weaknesses: Only uses negative emotions.

name: Puppet Power
description: With this power you can turn people into puppet versions of themselves and control them
summary: The ability to turn people into puppet versions of themselves
strengths: Turn your enemies into puppets so they can't cause any more harm
weaknesses: Once you turn a person into a puppet you can't turn them back

name: Enhancement: Duration
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's duration 50% longer than normal. This includes ALL durations: usage and cooldown times. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to increase the duration of time that a power works
strengths: Can surprise opponent by using a power longer than they thought you could.
Con: some powers are just plain useless even with longer durations
Con: Powers you don't want to have longer durations, such as a power used to curse, used on oneself.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Will not affect powers in which the duration it works is important to how it works (May be a pro).
Only helps on powers with limits on how long they can be used.

name: Clairgustance
description: Just by concentrating a moment, you can taste the rainbow or anything else to which you set your mind. This power draws the essence of the substance out of the spiritual or ethereal realms straight to your taste buds!
summary: The ability to psychically taste anything.
strengths: Find that the world is delicious.
Make dieting far easier.
Science
weaknesses: Bad tastes

name: Temporary Nylon Ligaments
description: Ligaments are a type of tissue that connects bones to other bones. With this ability, you can temporarily turn your ligaments as strong as nylon. You can turn this ability off at any time. You can't be pulled apart too easily. Your bones can still break. This power only last for 5 hours or less. When this power is activated, your ligaments do not stretch and you can't move as much.
summary: The ability to temporarily make your ligaments as strong as nylon.
strengths: Temporarily have ligaments as strong as nylon.
Can't be pulled apart as easily.
Power can be turned off at any time.
weaknesses: Can't move as much because power prevents ligaments from stretching.
Power last for 5 hours or less.
Your bones can still break.

name: Lymph Manipulation
description: A person with this power can control lymph at the cellular level. This means that they can control the immune system of anything as well as use it like blood manipulation. With this power you can cure many diseases as well as cause symptoms of disease. In addition you can also trigger or stop allergies in people.
summary: The ability to manipulate lymph at the cellular level
strengths: Can use to cure people from edema and stop allergies
Can also cause edema and allergies including anaphylactic shock
Can use similar to blood manipulation
weaknesses: Lymph is less common than blood ie less to manipulate
Need to study how lymph works

name: Independant Action
description: This is less of a power for you, and more a power for anything you summon with magic. With this power any creature you summon will persist in this realm for up to three days after you have been killed. More if they can find another source of Mana to draw from.
summary: The ability to have your summoned minions persist after your death.
strengths: Have your minions stick around after you die.
Have them put your plans into action or take revenge on your killer.
They may find a way to revive you.
weaknesses: You will be dead.
This power could make certain beings harder to controll.

name: Song Stealer
description: This power allows you to remove any musical piece in existence from reality past and present. For example, if you removed Beethoven's 3rd Symphony, it would be as if he had never composed the song. The entire song, both in performed and written form, would then be transferred into your memory in its entirety. A byproduct of this superpower is that you will be able to play or sing stolen songs perfectly. However, you would play or sing any other songs only as you normally would.
summary: The ability to remove any musical piece from history and transfer it into your memory
strengths: Become known as a master musician (if you're not worried about stealing others' music)
Get rid of the songs you hate
A vicious counter to any musically-based superpower
weaknesses: You can't directly return any stolen songs to history (you can still play/reveal the melodies)
The songs you hate that you get rid of will be stuck in your mind forever
You might accidentally change a major part of history by removing important songs

name: Transformation: V
description: The person who has acquired the Guy Fawkes mask is able to transform into the vigilante V. When the person becomes V, he or she gains Olympic level reflexes, increased strength, incredible mental capacity and not to mention experience and knowledge of former "V's"
summary: The ability to transform into the vigilante V
strengths: Olympic level strength, reflexes
Has knowledge on every field of study
weaknesses: He or she does not necesarily fight for the good or bad.

name: Pain?
description: With this power you have the ability to know if the person you're talking to is in emotional or physical pain and you also know exactly how to help them. You also know what to do to worsen their pain if you decide to be a jerk.
summary: The ability to know if someone is in pain
strengths: You know if someone is in pain
You know how to help them
You know what to do to make their pain worse
weaknesses: You have to be talking to the person to know if they're in pain or not

name: Pokethulhupower: Pokenomicon
description: Ever played pokethuhlu? It's a parody of the pokemon anf cthulhu rpgs. With this power you get a pokenomicon, with all the pokethulhu in (fanmade and official)
summary: The ability to know all pokethulhu via a special book
strengths: Know all pokethulhu
weaknesses: As a magic book, it can be destroyed by supremely powerful weapons
Need shining Dodecahedrons to capture them (d12 dice will do)

description: With this power you can turn yourself into a Spartan Warrior. You have enhanced strength, stamina, durability and fighting skills. You can also summon Spartan armor and weapons.
summary: The ability to turn into a Spartan Warrior
strengths: You can turn yourself into a Spartan Warrior
weaknesses: You can still be killed

name: Chihuahua Summoner
description: Summon 3 Super evolved assassin Chihuahua's that upon death disappear and can be re summoned after a 12 hour recharge period. These Chihuahua's are the same size but speak English, and are trained with knives and small arms. They have paws that morph into hand with three fingers and one thumb. They are good assassins because after a kill they can trot out without raising suspicion. They obey your commands even if they are not happy about it or give you some sarcastic remark.
summary: The ability to summon assassin Chihuahua's
strengths: Cute killers
Die but return in 12 hours
Obedient-ish
weaknesses: Small
Not good for general fighting
All assinations must be suprise attacks.

name: Summon Snickerdoodles
description: Ability to summon the best tasting snickerdoodles.
summary: The ability to summon snickerdoodles.
strengths: Snickerdoodles taste good.
weaknesses: THERE IS NOTHING BAD WITH SNICKERDOODLES.

name: Anubis Shift
description: With this power you can shape shift into Anubis at will. You can speak Egyptian and understand Egyptian. You don't get his powers, memories or skills. You will be worshiped as long as you are in this form, though you'll smell of corpses. Lastly, dogs will like you.
summary: The ability to shape shift into Anubis at will
strengths: You speak and understand Egyptian
Dogs like you
Scare people to death
weaknesses: You don't have his powers
You don't have his memories
You don't have his skills

name: Arcana 12: The Hanged Man
description: You may use this power to gain knowledge. You simply need to state a question and your power will supply you with the information required. Information gained by this power is always true, thorough and useful. However, using this power permanently removes one or more of your memories. The more obscure or valuable the information, the more precious or large the memory taken will be. If you regain the lost memory, you lose the knowledge gained, even if the information was stored or written down.
summary: The ability to sacrifice memories for knowledge.
strengths: You can gain knowledge of almost anything.
This power is nigh-impossible to trick or block.
weaknesses: The harder the knowledge would have been to obtain, the greater the memory loss.
You may forget why you sought to obtain the information.

name: Arcana 15: The Devil
description: With this power, you can cut down to the deepest part of a persons personality and cause them to indulge in whatever their most basic desire is. They will attempt to do whatever that is as much as possible until this power runs its course. Of course, their deepest desire may not be negative. A charitable person may end up giving away everything they own, but the urge is always complete and overwhelming. This power can spread from person to person whenever someone affected speaks to anyone.
summary: The ability to cause people to act on their innermost urges.
strengths: Reduce small towns to utter chaos as people abandon their responsibilities.
Easily access forbidden areas.
Discover people's innermost secrets and desires.
weaknesses: You may end up unleashing to much chaos.
Some desires may end up negatively impacting you, such as somone who deeply desires violence.
Emotional manipulation powers can cancel or redirect this effect.

name: Fragmentation!
description: Does it suck living in a crappy neighborhood? With fragmentation, that's a thing of the past. You can use this superpower to dismantle any group or gang as long as their within a 20 mile radius. They will forget that the group existed and then forget that they were going to beat up people "for fun". Then they would just be individuals. Corrupt cops as well? Make the bad cops forget that they were part of the police force, and break apart from the rest of the police force. New groups might form.
summary: The ability to make any gang or group not know each other, forget their last idea, and break apart
strengths: Break up any group within a 20 mile radius.
They'll forget their evil goals.
Disorganize the bad people and make neighborhoods safer.
weaknesses: Superpower might be used for evil.
Have to be in a 20 mile radius.
New groups might form.

name: Claymore : Sand
description: (This claymore is fun ) the blade is made from Hiduminium. You can only control sand. You have to be near sand.
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can only contral sand
strengths: You are sandman with a claymore
Barry people in sand
You can make a sand castle
weaknesses: You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
Any power that uses water
Any power that uses fire

name: The Big Squeeze
description: Anywhere, anytime, as long as you can get within grabbing distance, you can grab any ass.  Nobody will try to stop you and there will be no negative consequences--just cheek in hand.  As an added bonus, the person whose butt you're squeezing will be happier as a result.
summary: The ability to grab anyone's ass without permission.
strengths: The beach
Making people happier
Everyone wins!
weaknesses: Don't get too frisky--you're only covered for the squeeze

name: Prayer To The Dragon, Dagiozzi
description: You have to enter a state of perfect peace (not Heaven!) as you pray. It goes like this: "Aumento, dea del mare, Aumento, drago della giustizia, La mia lingua ti chiama. Benedizioni tuo elargire indegni, Abbiamo bisogno di forza tua, Ci protegga, Esiliatore del male. " What's lame is that you have to pronounce it in native Italian.
summary: The ability to summon the holy guardian from the depths.
strengths: Dagiozzi is a sea goddess. What's not cool about that?
She will follow almost every bidding, but your intentions must be pure.
She can swim, fly, walk, and is 35 feet tall. And you can ride on her. Wee!
weaknesses: If you're not Italian.
She's a goddess, so pervert her and die!
It has a duration of one day, and a cooldown of two, so don't get into any trouble for two days.

name: Pheromone Detection
description: Pheromones are produced by animals (mainly insects) and plants to communicate between them. Even humans produce some. There are alarm pheromones, food trail pheromones, sex pheromones... It is considered the sixth sense of animals.
summary: The ability to detect pheromones of all animals.
strengths: Allows you to discover a large amount of informations about an animal just by smelling it.
Detect the presence of animals.
weaknesses: Humans produce less pheromones than other animals.
You need to smell to discover informations.

name: Summon Kekig
description: Kekigs look like a six foot tall fusion a chimpanzee and wolverine. They do have sharp teeth and claws. They are summoned with weapons and armor. Kekigs can see astral and invisible beings. Kekigs need armor because they have the ability to grab phased, intangible or ghostly beings as if those beings were solid. Kekigs lose invulnerability while holding onto someone. Kekigs can run 35 mph and lift 5 tons.
summary: The ability to summon a Kystian designed to fight the intangible
strengths: Your foe with the phasing power is in for a nasty surprise.
The armor a kekig wears offers really great protection against conventional weaponry
weaknesses: Armor or not, invulnerability is temporarily lost when fighting the intangible

name: Greater Kystian Morph #5
description: A zyl, a giant hummingbird-like kystian with a 50-foot wingspan. You can fly at mach 10. You can hover in place and choose to generate a 300-mph fire storm with a radius of 300 feet. You can just generate 300-mph winds if you choose to do that. The fire storm has a temperature of 1500 degrees. You have slow-motion vision.
summary: The ability to become a unsummonable giant hummingbird kystian.
strengths: You fly at mach 10.
You can choose to create a 300-mph fire storm around your body.
weaknesses: A giant form that you can't use everywhere.

name: Diary Of A Madman
description: You have a never-ending book that contains the entries of any people you choose. This book can be used to know what others are thinking, but it comes with a serious price (dramatic pause) YOUR SANITY! (Dun, Dun, Dum! ) If you have too many people in the book, their thoughts start to haunt your mind and you lose track of who you are, thus driving you to insanity.
summary: The ability to have a person's diary/journal entries appear in this book of yours
strengths: Track what certain people are doing.
You can give the book to someone you know would abuse this (MuaHaHa! )
If it fills up, the book automatically makes 10-20 more pages
weaknesses: Lose you sanity, and sense of self

name: Rise Of The Skeleton Archer
description: With this power you can turn into a Skeleton Archer. A Skeleton Archer is a ten foot tall skeleton with a bow and an unlimited amount of arrows to go with it. The Skeleton Archer's weakness in that it burns when it is in the light so you can only use this power in dark places or at night.
summary: The ability to turn into a skeleton archer
strengths: All of the pros are mentioned above
weaknesses: All of the cons are mentioned above

name: Word Power
description: This ability is passive. If an ability is a phrase, it will depend on the letter count of the longest word in the power's name (but only ones that count in Scrabble) multiplied by the number of letters in the power name. The power's scrabble value times the number of letters in the power's name divided by the number of words in the power is equal to the boost given. Try it.
summary: The ability to enhance another power you possess depending on its value in Scrabble.
strengths: You don't need to be good at math to have this.
If you have a powerful move that has a long name, it's better.
weaknesses: You can't use this on others.
The boost will last for a day and have a cooldown of another.

name: Vouivre Hair
description: You permanently have an extremely long, flying, razor-toothed and fire-breathing serpentine creature attached to the back of your head. While resting, it is disguised as very long uncuttable hair, but if it feels threatened, it will instantly morph back into the dragon-like creature to attack and defend itself--and you--on the same occasion. While it will never attack you, you still need to tame it if you want to have some control over it.
summary: The ability to have a serpentine creature on the back of your head, disguised as your hair
strengths: Excellent defense and attack mechanism
You can fly on its back
It will never attack you.
weaknesses: If untamed, it won't differentiate friends from foes.
If it is too violent, it can injure your neck, or worse, break it.
You are stuck with very long hair for the rest of your life.

name: Immortal Urn
description: It is unclear where the urn came from, but what is known is that of one's heart is placed inside he or she will be immortal as long as their hear is inside. After that time, any injury will heal instantly and only ash will spill from the wounds. Person remains the same age they were when the heart was placed inside. Person can travel as far away from the urn as they want which makes hiding it easier to hide the urn.
summary: The ability to become immortal if your heart is placed into the urn.
strengths: You're immortal as long as your heart is inside.
Urn can be hidden and you can go anywhere.
No pain when injured and healing is quick.
weaknesses: You have no added strength or speed so there's that. You will look as pale as a dead person.
Your body, excactly as it was when you become immortal so if you're fat, thin, whatever you're stuck
If someone find your urn, they can enslave you if they want, until you get it back. Or they kill you

name: Bunny God
description: Bunny God gives you the power to control every bunny on Earth, including toys and dead ones. Only bunbun my toy bunny can withstand the effects and override your power for he is the true bunny god and maintains balance and order in the bunny universe.
summary: The ability to control every bunny on Earth
strengths: Make your toy bunny come to life
Win bunny competitions by getting your bunny to hop over the hurdles
weaknesses: Not complete control

name: Frostbite
description: This power gives one the ability to bite someone and cause them to freeze.
summary: The ability to give a bite that makes someone freeze
strengths: Can freeze people
Can instantly freeze them or slowly take your time
Their reaction time is slower
weaknesses: No love bites
Watch out for who you are biting.
You might freeze yourself if you bite yourself (e.g. tongue).

name: Depreciating Touch
description: This ability gives you the power to lower the value of anything you can touch. It works regardless of which place of business you use it in on any item displayed for sale. While the quality and durability of the item will be unaffected, to others it will appear to be in some intangible way subpar and of defective quality. The longer you are in contact with an object, the less valuable it becomes.
summary: The ability to make everything you touch less valuable.
strengths: Get insane deals on anything you could possibly want.
Resturants usually just throw out defective food, so you can eat for free!
The longer you occupy a house or apartment, the lower your rent becomes.
weaknesses: You will never have a profitable garage sale.
Carrying around physical money will be a pointless exercise in futility (Digital money is fine)
You will realize the satisfaction of owning expensive things is nothing more than a hollow sham.

name: Forced Snake Head Hands
description: With this power you can turn other people's hands into snake heads. The snakes have indestructible skin, sharp fangs and a poison tipped tongue. The snakes are also under your control so you can turn your enemy's hands into snake heads and then cause the snakes to bite your enemy, poisoning and eventually killing him. Additionally only you can turn the snakes back into hands.
summary: The ability to turn other people's hands into snake heads and have complete control over the snake heads
strengths: You can turn other people's hands into snake heads
You have complete control over the snake heads
Only you can turn the heads back into hands
weaknesses: You cannot turn your own hands into snake heads

name: Name Dropping
description: Whenever someone names your superpower (besides you, of course) that power gets stronger! So, if you had super strength, you would get much stronger every time someone said 'super strength. '
summary: The ability to boost your other powers when someone says its name
strengths: Major boosts to powers you already have.
Effects itself, making it double its own powers, thus doubling gains again.
Boost is temporary (see con 1)
weaknesses: Involuntary, so if you had something that fed on your lifeforce it could get dangerous.
Requires other powers to be useful.
Boost is temporary

name: Ally Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any of your friends and if they have any you get all of their powers. You also retain all of your intelligence and personality. You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into any of your friends
strengths: You can turn into any of your friends
You retain your intelligence level and personality
You can stay in ally mode for as long as you want
weaknesses: You can only turn into people who are your friends

name: Mace Hand(S)
description: With this power you can turn your hands into maces. You start off by only being able to turn your left hand into a mace but if you train a lot you will eventually be able to turn your right hand into one too
summary: The ability to turn your left hand and if you have enough practice your right hand into maces
strengths: You can turn your hands into maces
weaknesses: If you're not a lefty the training process can be hard and annoying

name: Being: Blood Warrior
description: Blood warriors are excepetional warriors made by Hades, they are Omni-creatures capable of becoming more and more powerful by every victim they absorb gaining all statistics and abilities then adding it to their own, having 2 blades for hands and 2 blades on their elbow,they can be fearsome opponents,however although being very intellectual they also absorb the sickness or disorder and even personality creating another split personality,this may cause insanity in the worst degree
summary: The ability to transform into a blood warrior
strengths: Become an Omni-Creature
Very smart
weaknesses: May be absorbed by the transformation itself making you insane
Also absorb's sickness,disorders,personality etc.

name: Defense Action Detection
description: A user of this power knows when one of their powers is being used defensively. Something hits their forcefield? They know where it was, what it was and how powerful it was. If invulnerable, they'll get all sorts of knowledge about bullets hitting them. If you are the "creator" of a group's defense, you will sense when they are taking damage.
summary: The ability to sense when one of your powers is being used defensively,
strengths: Using Pack Invulnerability (of your own creation), you can sense when an ally is attacked.
Get detailed information about threats being stopped by your powers, including their effectiveness.
Works for all powers used defensively.
weaknesses: Provides no defense itself.
Useless without other powers.
You need to learn how to use the acquired information effectively.

name: Jewelakinesis

They are not under your control

name: Tooth Bullets
description: With this power you can shoot your teeth out of your mouth at high speed, as though they were fired from a gun. They can be shot individually, or all at once like a shotgun blast. Shooting teeth is not painful, and a perfectly new tooth grows back almost immediately.
summary: The ability to shoot your teeth out of your mouth.
strengths: Shoot out cavities to be replaced with new teeth.
Have a weapon you can carry anywhere, with effectivly unlimited ammo.
weaknesses: Make sure to smile wide when you shoot so the teeth don't shred your lips.
If you don't take care of your bullets they become weaker.

name: Snowcat
description: A snowcat is a enclosed-cab, truck-sized, fully tracked vehicle designed to move on snow. It's treads are designed to move across soft ground such as snow or peat bog easily. The cap is very well heated and warm. They are usually filled with a plow on the front because they're commonly used for maintaining ski trails.   While in snowcat form, your front windshield acts as your eyes (good because they're designed to not ice up) and your numbed to the cold. You also don't need gasoline to run.
summary: The ability to transform into a snowcat.
strengths: Turn into a big vehicle.
Shelter people from the cold with your heated interior.
Easily cross snow.
weaknesses: Not the fasted vehicles, snowcats.

name: Arcana 13: Death
description: At any point in time, you may die. Upon your death, you become an intangible, invisible spirit creature and maintain all of your normal powers. At any time following your death, you may chose to return to a physical life. Your new body is any age of your choosing. However, your new body is always slightly different from your old one, with variations in appearance, ethnicity and even gender. You may also suffer from mental changes, though you maintain your basic personality.
summary: The ability to take an early death.
strengths: You can avoid attacks by simply dying.
Death is mostly an inconvience for you.
You can spy on or enter contained areas as a spirit.
weaknesses: While in spirit form, abilities and attacks that affect spirits or souls will affect you.
Using this ability often can result in extreme changes in physical form and personality.
You may have difficulty with psychopomps and other creatures of death.

name: Fickle Genie
description: This power allows the user to summon a genie that will grant the user three of their wishes. However, you will not be able to simply make three wishes. You will need to make 1000 different wishes of the genie, of which it will choose three at random to grant.   Anyone you allow may use the genie, but only one person may use the genie at once. You can not have 1000 different people each make one individual wish. Likewise, you can not cheat by wishing for different increments of one thing.
summary: The ability to summon a genie that will grant 3 wishes out of 1000.
strengths: The genie is all powerful, and will always grant three of your wishes.
weaknesses: Long start up time. You must repeat 1000 wishes to the genie for every three it grants.
Some people may not have that many wishes.
Every wish must be different.

name: Vampire Ring
description: The ring possesses people. The first person who puts on the ring turns into a vampire. They can never take it off. They are given the powers of immortality, bringing other vampires to them and controlling them, shape-shifting, super strength and gaining power when they drink blood. However, it makes the wearer completely insane.
summary: The ability to call for a ring that turns you into a vampire and summon vampires to you
strengths: Control other vampires
Immortality
Shape-shifting
weaknesses: Go completely insane
Can never take it off

name: Forced Crocodiling
description: This power requires you to concentrate on someone to use this power on them. Someone affected by this power will only be able to speak in their native language. If they have more than one native language, they will use a random one among the ones they know. Don't underestimate this power's might! It is common to have someone use another language when they want to tell something secret to someone when other people are watching.
summary: The ability to force someone to use their native language when they speak.
strengths: Expose secrets when people are using an other language than their native one to tell secrets.
