Make someone's in-laws believe they're talking behind their back when they use their mother tongue.
Offend Esperantists by having one of their own "crocodile" during an esperantist convention.
weaknesses: Not much use if the targeted person only knows their native language.
Not much use if the targeted person uses their native language everytime.
Not much use if the targeted person doesn't want to speak.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Enhancement:  Light
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's creations feel lightier. This is accomplished by decreasing the general effects of gravity. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is enhanced permanently.
summary: The ability to make a super power's creations feel lighter
strengths: Less effort to move something your power creates.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Weaker hits if you throw the creation.

name: Folie A Deux
description: This power doesn't protect you from mind readers, but they sure would take a huge risk violating your mind, especially if you have a severe mental illness. Every time someone pokes into your brain for too long, this power kicks in and uses the opening they made into your psyche to alter theirs, reproducing every mental disorder you have. It works even better if they struggle to make sense of your mind. This power won't work if your mental illness is healed or negated by another power.
summary: The ability to share your mental disorders with anyone who probes your mind.
strengths: You can make mind readers crazy, stressed, depressed, delusional, paranoid, etc.
The longer they take to read your mind, the more likely this power will suceed.
weaknesses: You need to suffer from a mental illness yourself.
You can't affect someone who sporadically reads your mind.
Only mental disorders recognized by the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM).

name: Red Paper Clip
description: A person with this power can instinctively sense what people need and what they have within a fairly large radius. After activating this power you focus on an object you want then a map will form in your head to conduct the trades. In addition the trades would be mutually beneficial so you don't need to feel guilty about it. For example, you can trade a laser pointer to a rich man who desperately needs it for a meeting and get a huge cash reward. Then it turns out that pen made him more money.
summary: The ability to detect and create a chain of trades within a fairly large radius
strengths: Go from something unwanted to something amazing.
Become rich.
Fairly large radius with which to apply this power---can cover most large cities.
weaknesses: The objects you trade for can get stolen.
Making a mistake can get you something of lesser value.
Does not account for travelling expenses.

name: Compendium O Useless Knowledge
description: You simply know every random fact in the universe. The speed of glacier degradation in the arctic, the mating call of the African Water Buffalo, how to speak a language so old that no remnants of it are available in modern history, and so much more. But none of it is worth anything in present day life.
summary: The ability to know every useless fact in the universe.
strengths: You just KNOW random facts.
The knowledge is automatic, and requires no activation
Finally, you know what the word "floccinaucinihilipilification' means!
weaknesses: You don't know any useful facts, just useless ones.
Knowing the innermost thoughts of the creepy cat lady down the street
Knowing what slugs think about being sprinkled with salt, isn't very useful in a fight

name: The Never Blink
description: Torture your enemies by preventing them from blinking as long as you want. Watch their eyes water and become dry as they beg you for mercy! You can't blink either without breaking the effecting.
summary: The ability to control when people blink
strengths: Cause severe eye damage to your enemies
Bring the strongest to their knees
weaknesses: Have to stare into the eyes of the victim

name: Delete This Volcano Uppercut
description: It is a special maneuver, performed by you, that lifts your opponents up with a powerful awesome blow with an illusion of magma around your fist.
summary: The ability to rise up in the air and deliver an uppercut with an illusion of magma flowing through it.
strengths: It doesn't burn them, but rather knocks them out hard.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Condition Change: Body
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on the user's physical body. The arms, legs, tail, wings, and head(s) are not defined by this power as part of the body. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different body part. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require being used on one's own body in order to work
strengths: Now all you have to do is avoid getting hit with anything from the body.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Namazu
description: Namazu in myth was a giant catfish who could summon earthquakes. You now possess Namazu's arm guard, one made of metal and scales, with a catfish emblem on it. While wearing these you command the earth, and can even summon earthquakes.
summary: The ability to possess a piece of armor with geokinetic attributes
strengths: Command earth
Summon earthquakes
weaknesses: Hard to control
Will devour your soul if overused

name: Alien Control V2
description: With this power you can have complete control over aliens no matter how far away they are from Earth. You can cause them to come to you but if they are very far away from you it will take them a very long time to get to you so you're better off taking control of aliens that are close to you.
summary: The ability to control aliens no matter where they are in the universe
strengths: You can take control over all aliens
weaknesses: If they're far away it will take them a long time to get to you

name: Monotissue Morph
description: You remain bipedal but can become all heart muscle, skin, eyeballs,etc. You can still see and hear. You're all eyes(360 degree sight),all lung and you can't be strangled. Solid heart muscle and you have extra toughness. Of course each form has a weakness. Blinded easier,you can't hold your breathe against gases and a giant heart is going to be easier to hear.
summary: The ability to turn your entire body into one type of tissue or one part of your body.
strengths: Each tissue-morph or organ-morph will have a unique advantage.
weaknesses: Each form has a unique weakness.

name: 5 Faces Of Darkness V2
description: With this power you can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson, you can change your form at will, can summon all kinds of alien technologies. You can also make peace with any alien species.
summary: The ability to turn into a Quintesson from the Shattered Glass Universe
strengths: You can turn into a Shattered Glass Quintesson
You can change your form at will
You can make peace with any alien species
weaknesses: You can't turn into positive universe Quintessons

name: Zeakinesis
description: One with this ability has full control over gains, such as, cereal, caryopsis, grasses. One with this ability only, but does not have full, Plant Manipulation; being that one only controls a certain type(s). One would have a huge advantage in areas such as wheat fields, but other than that, one has little use of this power.
summary: The ability to mentally manipulate grains
strengths: Control a whole field, which can be miles.
Grains are abundant
weaknesses: Being in an area not having grains.
Not Plant Manipulation.

name: Green Man
description: You are the ultimate ecologist. When you touch something, you will be able to change it in some way that makes it eco-friendly! You can change a gasoline powered car into an electrically powered car, or an oil drilling plant into a wind farm! This ability works especially well on things that harm the environment, but it does apply to anything you can touch.
summary: The ability to change anything into an eco-friendly alternative.
strengths: You can help save the world!
And cut down on gas prices!
weaknesses: Not much use in combat
Must be able to touch your target

name: Attach!
description: In order to use this power you must point out to the two objects you want to attach and say ATTACH! After doing this, the objects will fly one to each other. If one of the objects cannot move, only the other will.  While flying, the objects cannot be stopped, once they are united they cannot be separated unless you say so or with extreme strength.
summary: The ability to attach two things that were separated.
strengths: You can attach people or living beings.
You can move anything regardless of size or weight.
You can also attach yourself to anything.
weaknesses: Attaches can only be made in pairs.
Attached objects are not unseparable.
Need to point and south in order to use the power.

name: Panontic Arch: Xichia
description: Xichia, the dimension of cosmic killers. The first power is to keep dead anyone you killed directly. Shot, stabbed, laser eye blast, etc. Bullets count. Grenades and bombs don't. Death traps don't count either. A death caused by this power can't be undone or reversed. Divine beings and those who have a power to come back to life are unaffected by this power. The second power is to come back to life if killed unless you were killed by someone with the first power.
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Xichia dimension.
strengths: A power to revive yourself from the dead.
Non-divine foes and those who can't come back to life will avoid you.
If you were a divine being and had an already existing resurrection ability.
weaknesses: The first part of this power cancels out the second part.

name: Full Metal Alchemist: Alphonse
description: The ability to be bound to an object, such as controlling a TV by giving up your body to inhabit the TV. One with mastery of this ability could create bodies and have control over them.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of Alphonse in Full Metal Alchemist.
strengths: Take over an object.
weaknesses: One body at a time.
Like Alphonse you could lose your body.
Only with mastery you can create bodies.

name: Intelligent Super Panda Summon
description: With this power you can summon a super smart panda who wants to become a superhero. In addition to being super smart the panda has super strength, really sharp claws and teeth, can eat though almost anything and enhanced agility. The panda is not under your control but if you're a good guy he will help you because he wants to be a superhero. However if somebody calls the panda a bear or a panda bear the panda will go berserk and try to kill them. Also if the panda dies you lose this power.
summary: The ability to summon a super smart panda who want to become a superhero
strengths: You can summon a super smart superhero wannabe panda
He has some other cool skills
He'll help you if you're a good guy
weaknesses: If somebody calls him a bear he will go berserk and try to kill them
If he dies you lose this power unless you figure out how to bring him back to life
You cannot unsummon him

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta2
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Phosphoros (Eosphoros, Hesperos, Aphrodition - Planet Venus) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Venus' patron, Aphrodite, to resist and benefit from her domains (love, charm, beauty, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Venus (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Venusian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Venus' patron goddess, Aphrodite; resist and benefit from her domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Venus at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Venus-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Four Eyes: Aura Changer
description: This power is gained by using the aura seeing part of the Four Eyes power. The Four Eyes power will slowly turn into this power. Whenever you have all of your eyes immersed in an aura, you absorb a tiny bit. This allows you to transform into that person at will. You can mix and match parts, but you cannot use superhuman powers or memories that they have.
summary: The ability to absorb auras through all of one's eyes and transform into the aura's source
strengths: Can transform and mix and match at will.
You can still use the other Four Eyes powers.
This is an evolved form of Four Eyes.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and use the aura seeing most of the time.
Must have all four eyes in the aura.
You cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions anymore.

name: G1 Trypticon's Transformation
description: With this power, you can turn into a city just like the giant Decepticon Citybot Trypticon. In city mode, you act like a normal city, albeit a smaller one that you can use as a storage for your things or a hideout for your allies and friends. You can still speak in city mode and you have a defense mode, meaning you can have lasers sprout out of every building and giant walls rise up from the ground. Note: when you turn back to human mode, the items you were storing vanish until you turn back.
summary: The ability to turn into a city
strengths: You can store stuff or help your allies hide in your city mode
You can shoot lasers from your buildings
You can still speak to the people and see what is going on in your city mode
weaknesses: You cannot turn back to human mode if you're in defense mode
You can't turn back when you have people inside you

name: Summon Slitskin
description: A slitskin looks like a 30-foot-long earthworm made from twisted flesh. Slitskins instinctively hate anything not half-alive. A slitskin lacks any intelligence. You can only unsummon it. Slitskins are strong enough to break through 20-foot thick concrete walls. Nothing will hurt them. A slitskin's skin is constantly splitting open and sealing itself. The only way to kill one is to stop the healing (it falls apart). Stopping the splitting will unsummon it.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive wormlike thing.
strengths: A good power for a desperate situation.
The threat of using this power may be enough to win.
weaknesses: You're in a situation bad enough to have to use this power.

name: Cement
description: With this power you can project balls of cement that explode upon impact at your enemies feet. This will glue them to the ground or any other surfaces
summary: The ability to glue people to the ground with cement
strengths: Glue your enemies to any surface
weaknesses: The cement is not invincible and can be broken

name: Emergency Weapons Lender
description: In an emergency, the kystian weapon trader will lend you one weapon for everyone on your side in a fight. The weapons won't require ammo and will be idiot-proof to use. The weapons will vanish back to Kyst when they are no longer needed. The weapons will also vanish if any of them fall into the hands of your foes. A long drawn out fight will trigger one of the kyst emergency powers.
summary: The ability to summon the kystian weapon trader in an emergency.
strengths: Need to arm 100 henchmen with blaster rifles? No problem.
You summon the weapon trader, Kyst doesn't.
weaknesses: If there's a disagreement over the definition of emergency.

name: Summon Femt Cloud
description: Femts. Look like teenage sisters of nans. Femts are a million times smaller nans and a cloud numbers in the octillions. Femts can take matter apart but can also make AB matter. AB matter has properties a million times stronger than normal matter. Heat conductivity is actually more than a million. AB matter is unaffected by temperatures high as 10 billion degrees. Tensile strength and material hardness would be a million times stronger. A femt cloud moves at 5 mph.
summary: The ability to summon a mistlike cloud of femtoscopic kystians.
strengths: A exotic matter battle suit could be build for you.
This power is the closest thing to actual femtotechnology.
weaknesses: Femts have the same weakness as nans and pyks.

name: Bugger Armada
description: SPOILERS for anyone who has not read the book: With this power you can summon the Buggers from Ender's Game. You can summon as many as you want, but you have to summon a Hive Queen first, as the Buggers operate on a hive mind and are controlled by the Hive Queen (which is under your control). You can summon and unsummon them as you please.
summary: The ability to summon the Buggers from the Ender's Game series
strengths: You can summon the Buggers
They are under your control
weaknesses: They can be killed
They're apparently pretty scary

name: Unillamas
description: With this power you can summon up to 30 Unillamas. Unillamas are basically giant llamas that have one horn on their heads. They have enhanced speed and strength and the horn can pierce almost any material. The Unillams also have super spit that can blind people if it hits them in the eye. The Unillamas are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon giant one horned llamas
strengths: You can summon up to 30 Unillamas that are under your complete control
They are super strong and fast and their horn can pierce through almost anything
Their super spit can blind people
weaknesses: They can be killed
They eat a lot

name: Oxygen Store : Iron Smash
description: Special breathing puts oxygen into sacs in the cells of your body, to store for later. This is important, because the next part of the power will stop them from getting some of the oxygen they need. The haemoglobin in your blood gives up its iron, and sends it to whatever body part you want. The part of the body turns grey and heavy. You may have an iron fist, able to smash most objects or bad guys. And every special breath you do, you gain 1 hour of no-breathing.
summary: The ability to tranfer iron into a part of the body.
strengths: Every time you breathe in to fill the sacs, you gain an extra hour of holding your breath.
Iron fist, iron foot, iron chest, iron head, etc.
Reversible, so your body return to normal after the oxygen reserves have been used up.
weaknesses: Your body part isn't made of iron, it's just iron mixed in with it. It's still partially vulnerable.
No full iron body, requires too much iron.
Normal breathing won't fill the sacs to full potential; It's a breathing that needs concentration.

name: Blindness
description: You will be able make people go blind for a month. The only thing is you have to look at them in the eye for the power to work.
summary: The ability to cause blindness
strengths: Make your enemies go blind for a month
weaknesses: Only lasts for a month
Have to have eye to eye contact
Have to be careful not blind your allies

name: Victor Frankenstein Knowledge
description: Victor Frankenstein is the legendary scientist that brought to life what would be known as Frankenstein's monster. You gain his masterful knowledge of science, particularly in chemistry and anatomy. Along with his vast knowledge you gain an understanding of the secret of animation. You can create life from corpses or parts of corpses by running any electrical current through the corpse.
summary: The ability to have access to all the knowledge of Victor Frankenstein.
strengths: Knowledge of chemistry and anatomy.
Gain the secret of animation.
Bring corpses to life.
weaknesses: Need corpses and eletrical currents to create life.
The animated corpses may not be friendly.
You may appear to be evil and this power could lead to your downfall.

name: Zippers
description: With this power, simply picture that something has a zipper on it, grab the tab, and pull. When you do, the object or person will "zip up" or "unzip" as if they were really cloth being held together by a zipper. Kill and destroy by unzipping. Heal and repair by zipping things up.
summary: The ability to "zip up" and "unzip" people and objects
strengths: "Unzip" enemies or obstacles blocking your path.
Fix what's broken by "zipping up" wounds, cracks, and breaks.
Make a door anywhere you like.
weaknesses: You must physically grasp the visualized zipper to "zip" anything.

name: Candy Beam
description: Like the infamous Majin Buu, you can fire a beam that turns anything or anyone on the recieving end into a delicious sugary treat of your choosing. It is sometimes reversable in case you hit someone with it by mistake. Also this power doesn't necessarily need to come with a pink antenna on your head, instead you can fire the beam from your eyes or hands. The beam will still be pink though.
summary: The ability to fire a beam that turns people and objects into candy.
strengths: Eat your enemies!
Candy you like whenever you want
weaknesses: Candy is bad for you in large quantities
Beam can be deflected or reflected back at you
Don't take on Majin Buu (or Uub) with this power alone, you'll lose!

name: Chau Mackuho
description: When someone chants "the lament demon surrounds us all," the user slowly turns into a monstrous creature of unknown power. Stage 1. The users eyes turn dark violet and strange symbols appear all over his or her body. Stage 2. The user grows taller, gets fangs and the whole body turns rock solid and black purple. Stage 3. The user gets more rugged and buffed, becomes insane and looks more monstrous. Stage 4. Unknown
summary: The ability to transform into a hideous and powerful monster.
strengths: You become better at everything.
Normal strength goes up ten fold
You become unstoppable and are not affected by emotions.
weaknesses: You become more insane day after day.
You lose control over your body/sentience at stage 3
Becomes unstoppable and are not affected by emotions

name: Transformers: Thundercracker
description: With this power you can summon Action Master Thundercracker's Solo Mission Jet Plane (yes that's really what it's called). The SMJP (nope still sounds stupid) is small plane that can shrink down ans turn into an indestructible armor exo-suit. In plane mode it can travel at incredibly high speeds and withstand enormous G-forces dues to its flexible duraflex metal coating. A side effect of this power is that whenever you jump you cause a thunder clap.
summary: The ability to summon the Solo Mission Jet Plane
strengths: You can summon the Solo Mission Jet Plane (as seen on TV)
It can turn into an indestructible battle armor
Something about flexible duraflex
weaknesses: It has a stupid name

name: Rolling Stone
description: When you tumble, you turn into a boulder of twice your size with appropriate weight. While you are a boulder you are immune to damage that would not destroy a boulder, feel no pain, but at the same time can not move on your own. Like a real rock, you must rely on outside force if you wish to keep rolling after your initial tumble. You can change back at any point.
summary: The ability to become a boulder when you tumble.
strengths: Become a boulder and roll at things.
You become a rock, so there's no need to eat, breath, drink, or feel pain while in boulder form.
Despite not having any means to, you still comprehend things going on around you in boulder form.
weaknesses: You're a rock, so you can't move on your own after the initial rolling force of the tumble.
You must be able to tumble to use this power.

name: Piercing Elbows
description: This power gives the user elbows which are as sharp and as hard as diamod. They can be used to pierce almost all armour and could be very useful, both offensively and defensively.
summary: The ability to have extremely sharp elbows.
strengths: Pierce armour.
Pierce jugular veins.
Block attacks.
weaknesses: Awkward.
Giving a friend a friendly nudge could be fatal.

name: Melody Rhapsody
description: With this ability you can cause people to sing what they are feeling, thinking or are talking.
summary: The ability to cause people to sing instead of talk.
strengths: Amusing entertainment.
weaknesses: Some people probably shouldn't sing at all.

name: The Last Laugh
description: You can use it by releasing a light-greenish puffball projectile at your opponent's mouth and they'll start to laugh endlessly. The effect of it is when they laugh hard they'll expand like a huge balloon before exploding into pieces. The second effect is your opponent will soon go totally irreversibly mad. You also say this quote after finishing your enemy "He/She who laughs last, laughs dead".
summary: The ability to unleash a lethal mind altering laughing gas that causes the opponent to explode like a balloon.
strengths: Can put your serious opponent into an severe laugher.
weaknesses: None.

name: Summon Agony One
description: Agony Ones look like bipedal hyenas. While in Kyst Agony Ones record every second of agony of a fallen foe of Kyst. Agony Ones can play back this recorded agony onto other beings. Agony Ones have finite memory of recorded agony so at some point you will have to unsummon it so it can record new material. Agony Ones can lift 5 tons and run 45 mph, they have a IQ of 200.
summary: The ability to summon a pain inducing kystian.
strengths: Your foes won't go to Kyst, let an Agony One do the next best thing.
Agony Ones can run down the fastest normal human.
Agony Ones can lift trucks and throw trucks.
weaknesses: Anyone immune to the effects of pain
Finite pain inducing ability; have to return to Kyst to recharge

name: 2nd Key Of Death
description: The first key controls half of mankind, while this controls the other half. The keys have different ways of killing though; with this, their skin, muscle, and bone disintegrate rapidly, even their soul begins to disappear. Then, that body and the soul are re-created in the underworld.
summary: The ability to summon a second key of death.
strengths: Good if you are a lazy murderer.
weaknesses: It is a very small key, that you can lose.
Might have the wrong key for the killing someone.

name: Quick Drive
description: With this power you can cause cars to go faster this is very useful if you're participating in a car race to make your car drive faster than the others or when you're in traffic to cause all of the cars in front of you to go faster
summary: The ability to make cars go faster
strengths: Clear traffic
Win races
weaknesses: Might cause car crashes if you cause cars to go too fast

name: Poison Water
description: The water will be as deadly as a wandering spider's poison. The poison effect will last for 24 hours or until the living being the water touched is dead, whichever comes first.
summary: The ability to make any water one touches poisonous to the next person it touches
strengths: You can always have a poison ready.
You are always immune to the poison effect.
weaknesses: You cannot use atmospheric water (humidity) for this power.

name: Myth Power: Acratos' Action
description: Acratos (Acratus, Akratos, Acratopotes, Akratopotes), in Greek myth, was the god of unmixed wine and incontinence (lack of self control, with drinking). As such, channeling him allows one to psychically summon undiluted wine, at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate wine at will. Furthermore, one can psychically empower wine, by touch, to draw subjects like a beacon, and psychically compel anyone who drinks it. One can even withstand wine intoxication (and share immunity by touch).
summary: The ability to channel Acratos' command over the essence of making and drinking unmixed wine, and incontinence
strengths: Psychically summon unmixed wine at will; psychically manipulate unmixed wine at will
Psychically empower undiluted wine, by touch, to attract subjects; compel anyone who drinks it
Withstand intoxication by ANY wine, mixed or not, which may be shared by touch
weaknesses: None of the above applies to beer, or any other liqueur/liquor; ONLY wine (NCN)
Cannot disrupt urinary/bowel function (induce incontinence in foes' bladders/bowels) by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Bacchanalia allows one to withstand (and disrupt) this ability (NCN)

name: Mr. Bubbles
description: With this ability, you can create large, opaque thought bubbles over people's heads, just like you see in the comics. Everyone can see the bubbles, except the person whose head they are over. You can only create one bubble at a time, but they can say anything you want. All you have to do is think about what you want the bubble to say. No one else will know who is doing it or suspect that it's you.
summary: The ability to create thought bubbles over people's heads.
strengths: Entertainment factor.
Instant pick-me-up if you're having a bad day.
Blackmail.
weaknesses: You could be caught if you concentrate too hard.
Thought bubbles may accidentally state your OWN thoughts.
Lack of sleep from doing this all the time.

name: Parazoan Shot
description: It shoots sponge so you can bounce on it or land on it for safety
summary: The ability to shoot a sponge substance from your hands
strengths: FUN
Safety
Bouncey
weaknesses: Might miss target

name: Summon Nylda
description: Nylda look like a 40-foot-long mix of praying mantis, millipede and horseshoe crab. They have ultrasonic hearing, an ability to produce a large cloud of deadly hydrogen cyanide, slow motion vision (it can see a hummingbird's wings in slow motion), a lightning-fast arm strike/grab and cuprumo-kinesis (manipulation of copper). It can build up to a speed of 90 mph. It has average intelligence and can pull 600 tons. It isn't made to use weapons, but it could carry things for you.
summary: The ability to summon a poisonous-gas-using kystian.
strengths: A hydrogen cyanide attack.
A lightning-fast arm strike.
It can drag 600 tons.
weaknesses: It can't use weapons.
You need space if you're not going to unsummon it.

name: Power Transfering
description: Ever get stuck in a situation where some superpowers you have have more power, but the superpower you need to use is too weak. With this superpower, you can transfer some or most of the energy from other powers you own to other powers. For example, let's say your hydrokinesis and technopathy is strong, but your superspeed is too weak for you to save someone far away in time. You could remove some of the energy from technopathy and hydrokinesis to make your superspeed more powerful.
summary: The ability to transfer power(energy) from some of your superpowers to other superpowers you own.
strengths: Transfer energy from some superpowers to other superpowers.
You can strengthen other superpowers.
It is temporary, so other powers aren't inherently changed
weaknesses: The superpowers you use to power other powers temporarily become weaker.
You can't use this to get rid of unwanted superpowers. It only makes them weaker.

name: Statue Pose
description: This power is useful for evasion. Strike a pose and at your will instantly turn your body into a stone statue. The level of detail in this form is reduced, like the removal eyelashes and smoother skin and hair, to look more convincing and unrecognisable. The catch is you cannot move or use other powers and the longer you remain as a statue the harder it is to reverse. Remain in this form for a few hours and it becomes permanent leaving you alive as an unmovable statue until you are destroyed.
summary: The ability to become a statue by striking a pose
strengths: Very convincing
Excellent for evasive strategies
Works with your will so you can strike poses without transforming by accident
weaknesses: Cannot move or use other powers while in affect, leaving you vulnerable
Remain a statue too long and transformation becomes permanent
Being stuck as a statue means you remain alive until you are destroyed

name: Superacid Rain
description: You can summon superacid rain from the sky that destroys everything and everybody. You can control the degree and the duration of the rain, and you can control in what area it hits the surface - you can limit it to hit one object or enemy.
summary: The ability to summon superacid rain that corrodes everything and everyone in a minute
strengths: Destruction from the sky
Destroys buildings, too - almost nowhere to hide
weaknesses: It doesn't look so cute when you use it
Bad effect on the environment

name: Snap Win V1
description: With this power you have complet control over who wins a sporting event. There are two ways that you can make a team win, either say the sport, the opposing team and the team you want to win and then snap ("Basketball, Jazz, Knicks") or if you're watching the game either live or on TV you can just say the name of the team you want to win and then snap.
summary: The ability to cause any team to win a sporting event
strengths: You choose who wins sporting events
Works for any sports (even the Olympics)
You can make money by placing bets on the team you choose to win
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Name Killer
description: The moment anyone knows your birth name they drop dead. You can kill people by simply stating "We haven't introduced ourselves, I'm. " They can hear your name be said, but the moment they know of your existence as well, they become dead. It is pretty simple actually, and works with all languages including brail, sign language, and extraterrestrial (but you have to learn them first). You like to wear sunglasses, be mysterious, and are "bad" at public speaking. You are completely unknown to gov't.
summary: The ability to instantly kill people who know your birth name
strengths: All your enemies must avoid learning about you, and unknown to all governments
You can kill entire populations by saying your birth name on television/internet (Its not Ian)
It happens to be a very embarrasing name, so this ability prevents humiliation
weaknesses: Your weakness are many, including windowless/soundproof jail cells and blind/deaf people
It only works on sentient beings that are capable of understanding names and existance
You can never have close friends without having to be called by your annoying nicknames

name: Rose Poison
description: This ability allows the user to manipulate the growth of roses with different kinds of deadly poisons and effects, and, with practice, may be able to heal yourself or the person you wish to heal with roses. You can choose when the person will die when the poison is in their blood.
summary: The ability to manipulate roses with poisonous thorns
strengths: the poison effects can't hurt you.
able to heal yourself or anyone.
kill a person in an Instant or slow death. your choice.
weaknesses: Can't hurt the innocent or the ability will be reduced by half until the next full moon

name: Alcohol Muscles
description: The more alcohol you drink the stronger you get. Strength begins with the first drink 1 and ends when you sober up. Works with any alchohol.
summary: The ability to gain super strength through alchohol
strengths: Impress the ladies
The power source is in your liver, so no liver damage
weaknesses: Still get drunk, and hungover
Alcohol could still make you fat

name: Ghost Of The Present
description: The present ghost is a gentle jolly giant with dark brown curls, wears a fur-lined green robe and on his head a holly wreath set with shining icicles, carries a large torch made to resemble a cornucopia, appears accompanied by a great feast, has the power to change his size to fit into any space and also wears a scabbard with no sword in it which represents peace on Earth. The spirit can transport a person by swirling his torch around to let them see who they have hurt most.
summary: The ability to summon a spirit to let anyone know what is going on in the present time.
strengths: You and your present spirit see all those around you and all of them cannot see you.
weaknesses: The present spirit will only exist on earth year during a holiday.
The ghost reveals to you that he has 2 vile children chained under his robe named ignorance & want.
The spirit warns you to beware forcreating want & need

name: Vehicle Alive
description: With this power you can make any vehicle come to life by pointing at it and saying "Live! " The vehicle will then come to life and gain the ability to move on its own, think, see, hear, feel, speak and smell. Though the vehicle will not gain a face or any other human like features. You are not able to remove the life from the vehicle; you must completely destroy it to get rid of it.
summary: The ability to bring vehicles to life
strengths: You can bring vehicles to life
weaknesses: You can't "kill" the vehicle unless you completely destroy it

name: Effervescence
description: This ability is quite a whimsical one to have. It allows the user to do numerous things pertaining to bubbles. It allows the user to make liquids bubble at will with/without heating them (which can cause numerous problems with a foe's blood circulation), it allows the user to generate and manipulate bubbles of breathable air (underwater, or anywhere else that has air and moisture), as well as assuming a form composed of bubbles, similar to Water Mimicry.
summary: The ability to produce numerous "bubbly" effects
strengths: Everyone loves bubbles
Generate/control bubbles, cause liquids to bubble (with OR without heating it)
Assume a bubbly form that can reconstitute if any of the bubbles pop
weaknesses: Superhero alias sucks (Bubbles, Bubble Buddy, Bubblebutt, et. al)
Vulnerable to Hydrokinesis
Strong winds are not your friend

name: Rpg Vision
description: With this you can shoot two rocket-propelled grenades from your eyes at a time.
summary: The ability to shoot two rocket propelled greanades from your eyes.
strengths: Long ranged destruction.
weaknesses: The explosion is massive so it requires complete control.
As accurate as your normal accuracy (better have Superhuman Accuracy, or...)

name: Common Sense Detection
description: Ever wondered how ironic it is that "common sense" is rare? With this power, you can detect the amount of common sense a person has, who has it, what conclusions it has brought them to, who needs it and how it is currently being used. The maximum range is 100 kilometers for most functions, but you will need physical contact to see past uses of common sense.
summary: The ability to detect common sense.
strengths: Prevent Darwin Award-type activity in friends.
May be useful if you lack common sense.
Could provide useful information on complete strangers.
weaknesses: Need physical contact for some functions.
Range of all non-contact functions limited to 100 kilometers.
Limited usefulness.

name: Spermatozoon Mimicry
description: This power is always active and only useable by a male. You'll have a very long and powerful tail you can use it to fly in the air. It's also very effective to swim underwater. Your body depends entirely on the nutrients present inside you, so you won't need to breathe while submerged. However, using your tail requires a lot of nutrients and you'll die if you run out of it, so you must feed yourself very frequently. Also, this power prevents you from being seen as a foe by other Cellular Mimics.
summary: The ability to have a tail that allows you to fly and swim.
strengths: You have a very powerful tail which you can swim and fly with.
While underwater, you won't need to breathe.
To fill up on nutrients, you can eat (slow method) or inject yourself with nutrients (instantaneous)
weaknesses: Useless if you are a female.
Unless this power is cancelled, you can't get rid of your tail.
You depend on nutrients to live. If you run out, you must be injected with nutrients or you'll die.

name: Stereo
description: With this power you have a floating boom box follow you around and play any song you want all you have to do is think of the song you want it to play. You can also you use the boom box as a recording device to record things and then have it play it later. The boom box is always one foot behind you and floats seven feet off of the ground. You cannot make the boom box disappear but you can make it stop playing music.
summary: The ability to have a floating boom box follow you around and play any song you want
strengths: You have a floating boom box that play any song you want
You can use it to record things
weaknesses: You can't make it disappear
It is always a foot behind you and seven feet off of the ground

name: Natural Killer Cell Mimicry
description: As a Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers. You can also recognize friends who are being controlled by another party or infected by an illness. When you do, you spontaneously go into combat mode, where you will destroy that friend's cells through touch and feel the urge to do so. Fortunately, because of this power's potency, you also have the power to inhibit your own killing power, as long as you resist your own urges, as well as other Natural Killer Cell Mimics' killing power.
summary: The ability to kill cells through touch, but only those of friends who are infected/controlled by a foe.
strengths: None of your friends are going to be controlled (for long)!
You can tell if a friend is being controlled (unless they are controlled by another friend).
You can inhibit other Naturel Killer Cell Mimics' killing power (friends of foes).
weaknesses: You feel the urge to kill your friends if you find out that they are being controlled or are ill.
You can duplicate yourself to outnumber your own friends.
You need to fight against your own urges to avoid killing your own friends.

name: Transformers: Ratchet
description: With this power you can summon a one box component similar to the one Ratchet uses occasionally. The box has wheels and can be controlled remotely through your brain. It comes equipped with a high powered gun, an operating table and plenty of medical supplies. A side effect of this power is that you become an expert in medicine.
summary: The ability to be able to summon a one box component
strengths: You can summon a one box component
You know a great deal about medicine
weaknesses: If the component is destroyed you need to Wait an hour before you can summon a new one

name: Crocodile Tears
description: One with this ability is a very dangerous person indeed. By activating this ability, they will begin to cry (or otherwise display distress, depending on which their mind determines will be more believable). When others come up to the user, feeling sorry for him, his power builds up within. And if the subject gets within radius, the user's power is capped off and sends him into a berserker rage to attack that person.
summary: The ability to feign sadness or distress and gain power from the sympathy felt toward you
strengths: Your tears or other show of distress is convincing
Your power builds up the more people feel sympathy for you
This power is released in the form of a powerful berserker rage that pwns enemies
weaknesses: If nobody cares about your troubles
If the power isn't accompanied by the berserker rage part
Fool me once, shame on you, fool me twice, shame on me.

name: Which Ever Way The Winds Blows
description: You can use any object or objects to choose what you'll do. A coin, cards, dice, a random number generator. Anything else that works. Every time you do this you'll be be immune to any control powers that affect behavior, body, mind, spirit, soul or powers for a day for each time you make a decision this way. If you refuse to go with random chance, you lose a day of immunity. Any lost object can be easily replaced or made(e. G. Homemade dice), your power just works through it.
summary: The ability to let random chance control what you do and nothing else.
strengths: Immunity to control powers.
You can buy, make or steal whatever object(s) you to make the power work.
weaknesses: Some things shouldn't be left to random chance.
If you can't agreed with what random chance chose for you, lose a day of immunity.

name: Spawn: Roman Shelters
description: You are able to spawn spacious, comfortable shelters based on their pantheon.  Each will have different features for each deity it was based on.  Bacchus's will have a party room, Minerva's will have a library,etc.  Each will have at least 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a kitchen, a bookshelf with exclusive knowledge of Roman gods, heroes, adventures and everything in between.
summary: The ability to spawn a roman shelter based on their pantheon
strengths: If you get lost at night and you want rest.
Very comfortable and spacious.
weaknesses: Somethings are just scary (Timor's cabin)
Some will force you to do dangerous things (fighting arena in Mar's cabin)
They are not protected on the outside.

name: Baby Talk
description: Also called Baby Communication, Infantile Communication, Baby Omnilingualism, Infantile Omnilingualism or Babyspeak, this is the psychic ability to communicate with and understand babies, and for them to understand YOU. One with this ability can easily translate all the hiccups, burbles, gurgles, coos, whines, cries and giggles of a baby (regardless of species), and can also speak this language (or speak their normal voice, and empathically translate it into signals the baby can understand)
summary: The ability to psychically communicate with babies
strengths: Understand babies
They understand you
If power develops, you can exert mental control to COMMAND babies
weaknesses: Sometimes only extends to babies of YOUR race
Sometimes takes a while to learn baby language of another species
Baby minds are less developed so it may harm them if your influence over them is TOO strong

name: Moon Teleportation
description: With this power you can teleport to any planet's moon. The moon doesn't have to be in solar system but it has to be in your universe. This power does not allow you to breathe in space so getting a power that allows you to might be helpful.
summary: The ability to teleport to any planet's moon
strengths: You can teleport to any planet's moon
The moon can be in a different solar system
weaknesses: The moon has to be in your universe
This power does not allow you breathe in space

name: Heat Meals
description: Someone with this ability would be able to heat any meal with his hands. This includes things requiring a toaster, oven, or microwave to prepare. It's perfect for someone in a hurry.
summary: The ability to heat meals with your hands
strengths: Heat/microwave any meal with just your hands
Perfect for anyone in a hurry
weaknesses: Pretty much useless in other situations
Works only on food

name: Night Time
description: With this power you control when the sun sets making the day longer or shorter
summary: The ability to make the sun set whenever you want it to
strengths: Make the sun set whenever you want
Make the sun STAY down as long as you want
When the sun sets, the moon automatically rises
weaknesses: Can only be used to make the sun go down or stay down (can't make it rise)
If you make the sun stay down on ONE side of the earth, it scorches ANOTHER side of the earth
Doesn't control time

name: Third Eye.
description: The third eye is on the forehead. Eyesight is improved to be able to see up to one mile away and see things moving at less than 680 meters per second. The sight bonus lasts only while the third eye is open.
summary: The ability to have a third eye and better eyesight
strengths: Can see better.
Get a third eye.
Third eye could possibly become better.
weaknesses: Third eye is very obvious.
People will be scared of you.
Eyesight only lasts while third eye is open and if you lose it your eyesight is normal.

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Dominions
description: The Dominions, also known as Hashmallim, regulate the duties of lower-ranking angels. They also preside over nations. Their appearance is described as a divinely beautiful humans with a pair of feathered wings. The Dominions may also be described as wielding orbs of light which are fastened to their swords or scepters.
summary: The ability to become an angel from the Second Sphere.
strengths: Preside over nations and countries ensuring righteous order.
Regulate laws and the tasks of subordinate angels.
Use orbs of light as a means of offense and defense.
weaknesses: Rarely making yourself visible to humans.

name: Zombie: Summon 10 Zombies
description: With this power, you can summon an army of zombies. You can summon up to 10 zombies per day. When they bite/scratch someone, their victim is infected and you get another zombie!
summary: The ability to summon up to 10 zombies per day.
strengths: If they have a leathal blow they will still do what's commanded
When they bite/scratch someone, hell! You got another zombie!
Zombies rock
weaknesses: They stink
They're ugly
They rot

name: Simultaneous Speech
description: You have to activate your power while concentrating on a precise person. As long as you keep your concentration, every time that person says something, you will say the exact same thing with your own voice. You will also copy that person's volume, speech rate, pitch, accent and verbal tics as long as they are within your limits of competence. You can use your power wherever that person might be.
summary: The ability to simultaneously say what someone else says.
strengths: If you're a bad singer, you can gain experience by copying a good singer.
Discover what anyone is talking about behind your back.
Get private or confidential information by choosing the right person.
weaknesses: You can only copy one person at a time.
If that person is having a conversation, what you say will hardly make sense.
You will look funny talking nonsense to yourself.

name: 4 D Movies V2
description: With this power you can place a curse on someone that causes them to feel the exact same things a character in a movie feels. All you have to do is the same the name of the movie, character and the person you're cursing. Then you have to play the movie and whenever the character feels something the person will as well. If the character dies in the movie the person dies as well.
summary: The ability to cause people to feel things that characters feel in movies
strengths: You can place a curse on people that allows them to feel the same things as movie characters
weaknesses: You are not immune to this power so people can use it on you

name: Cartoon Power: G1 Cliffjumper
description: With this power you can make giant powerful gun come out of nowhere like Cliffjumper was somehow able to do in the old G1 Transformers cartoons
summary: The ability to make giant guns appear out of nowhere
strengths: You always have a giant gun
weaknesses: They're heavy
You can't make the giant guns disappear

name: Forced World Hopping
description: You can basically force an enemy to bounce though every world they have ever imagined. This means supernatural, oddball worlds(Ex. Soccer and football combined is the only sport), etc. This will continue until they run out of possible worlds. Daydreamed worlds count for this power as do ones seen in actual dreams while sleeping. They can only get out of a world by finding a tiny 20 centimeter tall oni and catching him.
summary: The ability to force an enemy to travel through every world that they can possibly imagine
strengths: Trap an enemy for a long period of time.
If the world has a storyline the enemy has to go through that storyline before escaping.
weaknesses: Only helps with imaginative enemies.
Dimension-traveling enemies can still escape.
Can't alter power in any way to make it more powerful.

name: Myth Power: Train Of Erotes3
description: The Erotes, in Greek myth, were the gods of various aspects of love and relationships. As such, channeling Hedylogos (Hedylogus- Flattery, Sweet-Talk, Compliments and Wooing) allows one to compel subjects by sweet-talking them; complimenting them and offering them flattery. In addition, one's breath will always sound, smell and taste intoxicatingly sweet. One can even cause a foe's mouth to continually generate sugar, by touch; if he stops talking, his throat will fill with sugar, choking him.
summary: The ability to channel the Erotes' command over the essence of love, sexuality and relationships
strengths: Psychically compel subjects by offering flattery, compliments and sweet talk; withstand compulsion
One's breath sounds/smells/tastes intoxicatingly sweet (if desired, subjects can become addicted)
Induce Oral Sugar Generation in foes by touch; if foe stops talking, they risk choking
weaknesses: Cannot use flattery to raise a foe's blood sugar until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Aphrodisia, MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Oath of Ouranos provide immunity
Empathic Backlash or similar emotion-resistant abilities provide immunity

name: Countdown Clock
description: With this power you can have a clock that only you can see follow you around. The clock is counting down until the second you die so when you use this power you can figure out when you're going to die and how much time you have left.
summary: The ability to have a large clock follow you that counts down to the second you die
strengths: You have a clock that pretty much tells you when you're going to die
weaknesses: Sometimes knowing when you're going to die is not a good thing
You can't unsummon the clock

name: Monster In Your Closet
description: With this power you can make any monster from the movie Monsters Inc appear in any closet in the planet that you're on when you use the power. The monsters are not under your control and are free to do whatever they want, scare, befriend, freak out, play bowling etc. You also don't control when they go back to their world as they can do it whenever they want just by walking back into the closet that they came though.
summary: The ability to make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in anybody's closet
strengths: You can make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in any closet on the planet that you're on
weaknesses: The monsters are not under your control

name: Snap Your Head Explodes
description: With this power you can make people's heads explode by snapping, thinking about them and saying "Head Explosion! " then no matter where the person is or what he is doing his head will explode. If you are near the person you cannot be hurt by the explosion. There is no way to reverse the affects of this power.
summary: The ability to make people's heads explode when you snap
strengths: You can make people's head explode
You are immune to the explosion
weaknesses: There is no way to reverse this power
You have to be able to snap and say "Head Explosion"

name: Freezing Hair
description: The temperature of anything touhing your hair will decrease to below the freezing point of water and your hair will turn blue while using this power. You are immune to the cold created by this power.
summary: The ability to cause one's hair to freeze what it touches
strengths: Enemies will never want to grab your hair.
weaknesses: Very obvious when you're using this power.

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Lust
description: By gaining the abilities of Lust you become a symbol of beauty, and sexuality. As the saying goes, don't judge a book by its cover, you become highly intelligent, and easily deceive others. Your fingers can extend to the point of, well, there is no length limit, but your fingers can pierce anything.
summary: The ability to gain the abilities of Lust.
strengths: Symbol of beauty and sexuality.
Highly Intelligent.
Deceive others.
weaknesses: As in Dante's Inferno, fiery winds and fire are very effective.
You expect everyone's love to come to you, being very lustful.

name: Allergen Inducer V2
description: With this power you can cause people to be allergic to anything. You can make them allergic to air, food, water or anything else but you can only give one allergy per person. You also can't cure them of their allergies once you give it to them.
summary: The ability to make people allergic to anything
strengths: You can make people allergic to anything
weaknesses: You can only give a person one allergy
You can't cure them of their allergies

name: Theatre Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character from any play that you've seen. The character you summon will look exactly like the actor that plays them but will act like the character that they're playing. The characters are not under you control and they can be unsummoned whenever you like.
summary: The ability to summon any character from any play
strengths: You can summon any character from any play that you yourself have seen
They look like the actor that plays them so you may be able to use that to your advantage somehow
weaknesses: They're not under your control
Only plays that you've seen

name: Panontic Arch:Ergi
description: Ergi,the universe of raw energies where matter can't exist. You're immune to temperatures high as 11 billion degrees. Energy attacks can't hurt you. You can disrupt the strong nuclear force in a object by touch. Cold/ice attacks will do extra damage to you. Freezing temperatures for you will start at 60 degrees.
summary: The ability to gain powers the Ergi dimension.
strengths: Immune to extremely high temperatures.
Immune to energy attacks.
You can disrupt the strong nuclear force by touch.
weaknesses: Cold and ice attacks hurt you more.
You freeze at 60 degrees or less.

name: Enhancement: Anti Immunity
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it gives immunity to the defenses provided by that power to another being. Ex: Indirect Total Immunity, Impact Shield, Author's Immunity, etc. You can only have one copy of this power at a time. The other power cannot have other Enhancements attached. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to be immune to the defenses provided by a power
strengths: Don't have to deal with annoying immunity or shield powers.
Con: Cannot be shared with other people not even with Enhancement Sharing.
Con: Have to have the defensive power yourself.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Cannot be used on a power that was acquired using another power. Ex: Acquired using Ability Theft.
Con Negation and other alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Myth Power: Ker's Curse
description: Ker (Cer) and the Keres (Ceres), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of painful, cruel and violent death. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive violent death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died violently. Furthermore, one can perceive and mimic, by a paralyzing touch, foes' most feared mode of death. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Ker and the Keres' command over the essence of painful, cruel and violent death
strengths: Psychically perceive past, present and future violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died violent deaths
Perceive and mimic, by touch, foe's most feared mode of violent death; withstand necromantic effects
weaknesses: Cannot generate wings to fly until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot summon fairy/pixie-like Avatars of the Keres to attack foes until the higher levels (NCN)
Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: Know Nothing
description: This power make everyone forget everything other than basic motor skills. This power dosen't work on family members
summary: The ability to make everyone dumb
strengths: You can look like you are super smart
win smart comps
weaknesses: family is still smart

name: Past Climate Change
description: With this power you can change the weather in the past such as preventing past hurricanes or creating more snow days in your past
summary: The ability to change the weather in the past
strengths: Can change the past for the better
weaknesses: Meddling with the past can have disastrous effects on the present

name: Myth Power: Horae (Seasons4)
description: These Horae (Horai- Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the four seasons; winter, spring, summer and fall. As such, channeling Phthinophoron (Autumn/Fall) allows one to psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn weather at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere where it is naturally autumn. Furthermore, one can withstand wind. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the four seasons
strengths: Psychically manipulate the seasons to bring forth autumn/fall weather at will
Psychically perceive and teleport to anywhere it is naturally autumn; withstand wind
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone born in the season of autumn
weaknesses: Cannot psychically Time Travel to future/past autumns until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically manipulate time during NATURAL autumn until developed (NCN)
Olympian MythPowers and elemental MythPowers related to wind/autumn provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Nekomata
description: Nekomata, meaning Forked Cat. It is a cat with two tails, but other than that appears to be a normal cat. It has the power to raise the dead if it walks over a corpse. They are tricky creatures to use, because even master summoners can't stop their whimsical nature. They are great companions, however, if you can befriend them.
summary: The ability to summon a Nekomata.
strengths: Raise the dead.
Useful companion
weaknesses: Hard to master.
Incredibly hard to impose your will upon.

name: Bug Enlarger
description: With this power you can make bugs as big as you want and when you make them bigger they're under your control. Depending on what types of bugs you enlarge you can have soldiers that: fly, can jump long distances, are super strong, can walk on walls etc.
summary: The ability to make bugs giant sized
strengths: You can have an army of giant mind controlled bugs
You can take over the world with your giant bug army
weaknesses: No spiders
The bugs can be killed

name: Myth Power: Fertility Force1
description: The phallic companions of Priapus, in Greek myth, were the gods of fertility. As such, channeling Tychon (Tykhon- sexual fortune; fertility, virility, sexual endowment), one gains favor with the plant and animal kingdoms; they will not attack/harm the user (even by compulsion), in exchange for enhancing their fertility. In addition, one can psychically perceive the right thing to say, to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding, at will. One can even psychically weaponize phallic items, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Priapus' companions' command over the essence of fertility
strengths: Favor with plant/animal kingdoms; they will assist/protect/fight for, and refuse to harm, the user
Psychically perceive the right thing to say to charm neutrals into doing one's bidding (Lucky Charm)
Psychically weaponize phallic items (ie enlarge and empower a baseball bat) at will
weaknesses: Cannot enhance one's own virility/fertility or sexual attributes, until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon, communicate with or share senses with plants/animals (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Bloons Tower Defense Summon
description: Using this power, you can summon any of the towers from any of the Bloons Tower Defense series of games. You cannot, however, summon any of the Bloons. The towers are 3D, and throw real objects at any target. You have complete control over the actions of the towers. However, you cannot upgrade the towers. You also cannot summon the Road Spikes, Monkey Glue, or Pineapples.
summary: The ability to summon any tower from the Bloons Tower Defense series of games.
strengths: Summon BTD towers to do your bidding.
Can use the towers to defend yourself and your friends.
Complete control over the towers.
weaknesses: Only one tower at a time.
You cannot summon any of the upgraded towers.
The bomb towers have a bigger explosion than you think.

name: Act Your Age
description: Ever wanted to relive your glory days? Need to get cranky, hunker down and get some work done? Or do you just wanna crap your pants and have someone take care of you? This power covers all of that. If you feel serious and sophisticated, you go to your 30's. Feel like partying? Teens. In a nurturing, parenting mood? 40's or 50's. Lazy? Toddler/Senior Citizen, your choice. The change is instant and the results are always satisfactory.
summary: The ability to physically change age depending on mood
strengths: Relive the best times of your life
People will never be confused about how you feel
Basically Immortality
weaknesses: The Law of Exponents:
Getting cranky will make you an old geezer, make your hip hurt, and make you even crankier
Drunk people tend to act like 5-year olds, and drunk 5-year olds tend to die of alcohol poisoning

name: Love Boost
description: When you see someone you love you can move extremely fast and gain super strength.
summary: The ability to move fast and be super strong when you see the one you love.
strengths: Can protect your lover.
weaknesses: Might crush her/him if you're not careful.

name: Mr/Mrs. N
description: A Ninja, Nicki Minaj, etc. With even practice and patience their abilities you possess are even stronger.
summary: The ability to gain the abilities of any one person who's name starts with N.
strengths: Ninja's.
weaknesses: How many great people in they world have a name that starts with N.

name: Vampire Slayer
description: With this power, you will have the power of the Vampire Slayer, one Joss Whedon's greatest creations. (this power is not mine, all credit goes to Joss)
summary: The ability to have the strength and skill of Buffy Summers
strengths: Fight Vampires with super strength
Have Witch best friend
Hang out with Xander!
weaknesses: Can still be killed (although new Slayer gets called to take your place)

name: Continental Drift
description: Someone who holds this power can control where the continents are. They can revert the continents back to their positon of Pangaea if they so wish. Any postion of the continents is no problem for the user of this power. User(s) of this power have no control over terrain.
summary: The ability to control the postion(s) of the continent(s)
strengths: Make the continents into Pangaea once again to easily take over the world.
weaknesses: Only continents, no terrain.

name: Coffin Teleportation
description: With this ability, you can teleport out of any coffin automatically. Whether the coffin is open or closed, you teleport out of the coffin. This power is always on when you are alive and is off when you die. If for some reason you were to become alive again, this power reactivates itself. This is an unstealable superpower. You can't teleport into a coffin or teleport from coffin to coffin.
summary: The ability to automatically teleport out of a coffin.
strengths: Can teleport out of a coffin automatically.
The superpower is unstealable.
This power is always active when you are alive.
weaknesses: Can not teleport from coffin to coffin or into a coffin.
Have to wait five minutes to automatically teleport out of a coffin.
This superpower is deactivated (but not gone) when you die.

name: Pokemon Ranger
description: You can summon a Pokemon species if a that species acted kind toward you.
summary: The ability to summon Pokemon minions for every friendly Pokemon you have ever met.
strengths: They are your minion.
weaknesses: Cannot summon unless they have shown you kindness

name: Head Wing
description: With this power you can sprout different kinds of wings from the sides of your head. You get different powers depending on what kind of wings you sprout. If you sprout angel wings you can teleport to Heaven, if you sprout butterfly wings you can shrink down to the size of a butterfly, if you sprout fairy wings you have limited knowledge of magic and magic spells. If you sprout dragon wings you can shoot fire from the wings. Bird wings allow you to fly normally, bat wings make you grow fangs etc.
summary: The ability to sprout wings from the sides or your head
strengths: You can gain different powers by sprouting different kinds of wings from your head
You can make the wings disappear if you want
weaknesses: They have to sprout from your head

name: Flying Solo
description: With this power whenever you use this power to fly every member of your species will disappear until you stop flying with this power. People only disappear when you fly using this power. If you fly using any other power or by external means (airplane, jetpack, dragon, giant bird etc. ) nobody will disappear.
summary: The ability to make every member of your species disappear when you fly
strengths: You can make everybody disappear when you fly using this power
Easily make clean get aways by flying and making your pursuers disappear until you land far away
weaknesses: People only disappear if you fly by using this power

name: Myth Power: Boule's Bonus
description: Boule, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the council; a group of people who help make decisions in society. As such, channeling her allows one to summon nearly anybody one chooses, as astral-projection copies, to offer advice and information, at will. In addition, to avoid potential harm, or to avoid exposing one's ability, one may move into an extradimensional 'Council Space', at will. One may even step into the Council Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Boule's command over the essence of the council
strengths: Summon astral-projection copies of nearly anyone (famous, etc) to offer advice/information at will
Travel into a customizable 'Council Space' to avoid danger, or avoid exposing one's ability
Use 'Council Space' for Teleportation (time passes much slower in Council Space)
weaknesses: Only travel to Council Space when one feels subconscious need for help until developed (NCN)
Cannot bring others into (or trap foes within) the Council Space until developed (NCN)
Astral Council Members can only offer knowledge from their real-life counterpart's perspective (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Electryone's Alarm
description: Electryone (Electryona, Elektryone, Electryo, Elektryo, Alectrona, Alektrona), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the waking sense, that stirs men from sleep. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can psychically negate altered mental states (unconsciousness etc), by touch, or proximity (psychically generating sunlight), at will. Furthermore, one can withstand them. One can even psychically project a sonic rooster crow, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Electryone's command over the essence of the waking sense
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand altered mind states (intoxication, etc)
Psychically negate altered mental states, by touch, or proximity (generating sunlight), at will
Psychically project a sonic rooster crow, at will
weaknesses: Cannot fly, propel oneself into outer space and survive its conditions, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to one's past/future wakings, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Helios' Help provides negation (NCN)

name: Heat Sharing
description: In a hot environment, a user of this power can absorb heat and while they cannot store it, it is made available to other users of the power. This could be used for simple warmth or blasts of extreme heat. You are not immune to extreme temperatures, but by sharing the heat you can tolerate a variety of temperatures. Heat or cold may be used by appropriate secondary powers such as Heat Eater directly.
summary: The ability to share thermal energy with other users of this power.
strengths: Enduring a heatwave while foreign friends shiver in winter? Cool yourself off while warming them.
Protect yourself from temperature extremes.
Use heat or cold as a weapon.
weaknesses: Someone must be accepting/donating heat to use this power.
Useless if you are the only one with this power.
Cannot store heat, neither are you immune to extreme temperatures.

name: Power Of Toast
description: With this super power you can create toast in thin air and control them to do your bidding also when they are alive please are still able to eat them with the same toast flavor
summary: The ability to create toast in thin air and if you choose bring toast to life and make them do your bidding
strengths: Eat as much toast as you want
Make toast attack your enemys
Make toast give bad guys wedgies
weaknesses: Toast poeple can still eat them with the same flavor
If it rains your toast falls apart
The toast might attack you if you miss use them

name: Batman Incorporated Summon
description: With this power you can summon any former or current member of Batman Incorporated. They will not be under your command unless you have a power that does otherwise, so they will fight for what they believe is right.
summary: The ability to summon members of Batman Incorporated.
strengths: Summon a large group that excels at combat.
weaknesses: They do their best work in the dark.

name: Own Cask Of Ancient Winters
description: One of the most power items in the marvel universe, the cask of ancient winters once opened, it summons a very strong blizzard that has the strength of 1 thousand furious winters.
summary: The ability to possess a powerful ice item.
strengths: Power ice weapon.
weaknesses: Anyone may open it.

name: Poison Dart Strike V2 Supers
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from you hands but they can only effect supers (people with super powers) these darts paralyze the victim for up to twenty minutes
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze anybody with super powers
weaknesses: Does not work on mortals

name: Killer Flower
description: With this power, killing flowers sore carbon monoxide, killing anyone that breathes it.
summary: The ability to turn ordinary glowers into killing flowers.
strengths: Your greatest weapon is a flower.
weaknesses: Kill people close to you.

name: Delete This Treme Blender Kick
description: The extreme blender kick (Patada extrema de Licuadora) is a special attack with various names. You can jump out and, while rotating both of your legs in the air, move accross anywhere in sight and kick your opponents a thousand or a million times. It sucks your enemies into it, causing them to explode violently.
summary: The ability to execute a tornado kick using both legs and suck your opponents into it. Can hit them multiple times.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: None.

name: Wigglousus
description: You will feel like jello, unable to move faster. Which is good when you want to dodge someone.
summary: The ability to make someone feel like they are in a slab of jello
strengths: Stops people from harming you.
It's funny.
Ummmm. Other things.
weaknesses: It drains your energy.
It's not always useful.
Makes you feel like you've eaten black jello.

name: Summon Diamondizers
description: Diamondizers look like porcupine quills. The pointy end is the stinger. The flat end has a tiny face. Each crawls on ten legs and can climb like a spider. You summon 20 of them. Their hive mind is somewhat stupid. The venom of a diamondizer triggers a limited carbon manipulation effect. It causes a living carbon-based life form to become a lump of diamond. This effect is permanent. A average person running can outrun a diamondizer. These kystians have infrared vision and sonar.
summary: The ability to summon a limited carbon manipulating kystian swarm.
strengths: Turn living carbon-based life forms into valuable gems.
You get 20 in a regular summoning. 380 of them if you have a another power.
These kystians can climb above a victim to drop on him.
weaknesses: Powers that give immunity to the venom or undo its effect.
These kystians don't work in well in certain locations.

name: Bloodline.
description: This is the sister power to Bloodlines. For as you can give your powers only once through blood and it is through your willingness the powers are stronger. Your powers are also unstealable and unmimicable and you still have your powers after giving them. You get to choose which powers to give and can also choose transfer techniques. However, in order to give your powers you have to give 1 cup of your blood. This power is also unnegatable, but does not protect your other powers.
summary: The ability to willingly transfer one's powers only once through blood.
strengths: You have to willingly give the blood to that specific person.
This power is unnegatable.
You can choose what to give.
weaknesses: Can only give powers once so have to be careful on who to give one's powers to.
Have to give to a son or daughter the same way as anyone else.
It has to be approximately 1 cup of blood consumed, no other way.

name: Author's Power Charge
description: If you have created a lot of good powers which just don't seem strong enough at times, this is the power for you. With it, each owner, including those using mimicry, will boost your powers to the next exponent. If you lose this power, you lose the boosts. If someone is immune to this power, your powers will only affect them to the same extent as they would at their normal power level. Con Negation and similar powers do not work with this.
summary: The ability to boost the powers you created depending on number of owners.
strengths: If you have created a lot of popular powers, this is a good choice.
If the powers you made need a boost, this is a useful power for you.
Works even if someone is mimics a power you made.
weaknesses: Need to have that power, at least through mimicry.
If someone stops mimicing the power, you lose that exponent.
If this power is negated, stolen, etc, you lose the boosts.

name: Condiment Rain
description: With this power you can turn rain into any condiment like ketchup, mustard, relish etc. You can only turn rain that has already started to fall into condiments you can't do it whenever you want.
summary: The ability to turn rain into various condiments
strengths: You can turn rain into various condiments
weaknesses: You can only use this power when it is raining

name: Gastric Chief Cell Mimicry
description: You can grow flesh appendages from anywhere on your body to shoot enzymes and retract them when you don't need them anymore. Enzymes are catalysts, i.e. each one greatly enhances a specific chemical reaction. Yours can increase the action of acids over proteins and lipids.
