So, the mix of acid and your enzymes greatly increases the acid's property to break down most organic compounds. Unfortunately, your enzymes alone can't do anything on their own. And you are not immune to the effects of acid.
summary: The ability to shoot gastric digestive enzymes.
strengths: You can accelerate and increase the action of acid over fat and proteins.
You can increase the deadliness of Parietal Cell Mimicry.
Dissolve and digest any kind of organic thing.
weaknesses: Your enzymes only work when mixed with an acid.
You are not immune to the effects of acids, especially if they are enhanced by your powers.
You can't duplicate yourself.

name: Beyblade Wave
description: You will be able to create a total of 50 Beyblades and hurl all of them in one direction at once. Usefull to hit many enemies or slow down pursuers
summary: The ability to create a wave of metal tops and through them in one direction.
strengths: Can hit many opponents
weaknesses: Can be deflected
Damage dealty is limited

name: Medical Side Effect Denial
description: Ever had medication with nasty side effects? With this power, you can choose to nullify them. You may also choose to merely reduce the side effects or experience them normally. You could, for instance, block a side effect causing hair loss, but allow it to remove body hair. You could also allow a medication make you lose or gain weight without impediment.
summary: The ability to avoid medical side effects of choice.
strengths: Also applies to medical conditions, but the primary effects will always affect you.
Also applies to non-medicinal drugs such as alcohol.
Eliminate most of the problems of medication and possibly benefit yourself.
weaknesses: Even with this power, it's best to avoid needing medication if you can.
May arouse suspicion in certain circles.
Limited to the normal side effects resulting from medication.

name: Cactus Mimic
description: You can convert your body into cactus so you can store water. You can also shoot poison covered spikes out of your body.
summary: The ability to convert your body into a cactus form.
strengths: Store lots of extra water
Shoot spines
weaknesses: Flammable

name: Myth Power: Horkos' Pledge
description: Horkos (Horcos, Horcus), in Greek myth, was the god of oaths, promises, pledges and punishment for perjury. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive, by touch or thought, any promise that a subject has made or received, and whether that promise was kept (including one's own promises). In addition, one can perceive lies. One can even afflict liars and oath-breakers with misfortunes associated with the promise they broke, or the lie they told, until the offense is either avenged or forgiven.
summary: The ability to channel Horkos' command over the essence of oaths, promises, pledges and the punishment of perjury
strengths: Perceive when promises have been made (and what the promise entails)
Perceive when lies have been told or deception is afoot
Afflict liars/oath-breakers with crime-based punishment (a liar begins vomiting uncontrollably, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot perceive promises (and lies) before OR after one's own lifetime until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Styx Bond provides immunity (NCN)
MythPower: Eris' Enmity and Duplicity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Rise Of Cthulhu
description: With this power you can turn into the might Cthulhu in order to fight crime.
summary: The ability to turn into Cthulhu
strengths: You have all of the powers of Cthulhu
weaknesses: You are extremely evil, big and hideous

name: Artifact: Signum Bioregens
description: When you say "Adeat", the power of this artifact activates. Whenever you kiss someone on the lips, you can transform into them (and even copy their powers).
summary: The ability to transform into anyone by kissing them on the lips.
strengths: Nobody will notice the difference between you and the person you're copying.
weaknesses: The kiss MUST be on the lips.
Can't copy certain powers.

name: Ashes Ashes V2
description: With this power you can turn any item into a pile of ashes by pointing at it and saying "Ashes" three times. The item will then be permanently turned into a pile of ashes.
summary: The ability to turn any item into a pile of ashes
strengths: You can turn any item into a pile of ashes
weaknesses: This power does not work on people or animals
You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Enhancement: Anti Enhancing
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power neutralize or dampen enhancements for 5 hours on what it affects in addition to other effects. Enhancements are defined as anything that makes something better in some way for this power. This power can only be attached to one power at a time and takes 3 hours to reattach. If this power is stolen, it permanently enhances the power it is attached to.
summary: The ability to make a power neutralize enhancements
strengths: Enemies who love to enhance themselves.
Neutralizes enhancements longer than a battle lasts.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time. Has an insane reattach time.
Unaffected by Con Negation and similar powers. Also unaffected by time-based powers.

name: Condition Change: Angry
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user is angry. Cannot be used on a power that has already been affected by a Condition Change that requires a different mood. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require the user being angry in order to activate
strengths: An opponent who is always calm.
Use this power on an opponent with no emotions for the best results.
This will be fun to watch.
weaknesses: If your opponent is always angry.
You have to touch them first.

name: Leather Jacket
description: Have you ever noticed that everyone that wheres a leather jacket looks cool? Well with this power you can create as many as you want instantly so you always look cool.
summary: The ability to create stylish leather jackets instantly
strengths: Always have a jacket
Always look good
Can start you own buisness selling jackets and make millions without having to buy the materials
weaknesses: If leather jackets ever go out of style the power is useless (like that will ever happen)

name: Enhancement: Corrupting
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, the other makes those whom it affects evil. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power corrupt what it hits in addition to its other effects
strengths: Gain evil 'allies'.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Really only useful for the evil.
'Allies' may turn on you.

name: Vehicle Rain
description: With this power you can cause up to ten different vehicles fall from the sky everyday. It can be any kind of vehicle you want including space ships, boats, bikes, planes, cars, trucks etc. As long as they exist in the real world. You can cause the vehicles to fall anywhere so you cause trucks or submarines to fall on your enemies or cause a sports car to fall on top of your old jalopy and have a sweet new ride. You cannot make the new vehicles disappear.
summary: The ability to make vehicles fall from the sky
strengths: You can cause any type of vehicle to fall from the sky anywhere you want
weaknesses: You can only make ten vehicles fall per day
You can't make the vehicles disappear

name: Rise Of The Super Gator
description: With this power you can turn into a super gator. In gator form you can fly, breathe fire, you have super strength, super sharp teeth and bullet proof scales. You can stay in gator form as long as you want and you retain your intelligence, personality and ability to speak.
summary: The ability to turn into a super gator
strengths: You can turn into a super gator
weaknesses: Though you are bullet proof you are not invincible

name: Myth Power: Ceraon's Cup
description: Ceraon (Keraon), in Greek myth, was the god of mixing wine and drinking. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and summon drinks at will, as well as gaining skill in mixing drinks. In addition, one can turn harmful liquids (acids, poisons, etc) into harmless drinks, or turn drinks into harmful liquids, medical remedies, etc, by touch. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from drinking beverages (healthy is better). One can even psychically manipulate beverages, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Ceraon's command over the essence of mixing wine and drinking
strengths: Psychically perceive and summon drinks at will; gain skill in mixing drinks
Turn harmful liquids into harmless drinks (or turn drinks into harmful liquids or medicines) at will
Gain physical power from drinking beverages; psychically manipulate beverages (like hydrokinesis)
weaknesses: Cannot drink infinitely until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and compel drinkers until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Wraith
description: A Wraith is a ghost, who as a human held an incredible amount of rage and hatred. A Wraith is a malevolent spirit who will steal the life of anyone you hate. However, if the Wraith can't steal the life of the one you hate, it will come back and steal your life instead.
summary: The ability to summon a Wraith.
strengths: Kill basically anyone you feel hatred towards.
weaknesses: Will steal your own life if it fails for some reason.

name: Delete This Iple Scissors Kick
description: You might like the idea of kicking the opponent up to a thousand or million times, but performing this move can be quite dangerous when performed incorrectly.
summary: The ability to perform a somersault with a series of multiple kicks to the opponent's head & face.
strengths: Could even ruin a villain's good looks.
weaknesses: You can get extreme cramps.

name: Venom
description: You can spray a poisonous venom that you can make mildly poisionous to deadly.  Your own venom can't hurt you.  So leave the mace at home!
summary: The ability to spray toxic venom.
strengths: Kicking unruly people's asses with your venom
People won't want to mess with you
weaknesses: You might scare some people

name: Ripening
description: With this ability, you can make fruits, vegetables and seeds mature sooner, or, on the contrary, make them unripe once again. It doesn't work on animals or plants.
summary: The ability to make fruits and vegetables ripe or unripe.
strengths: Useful for a greengrocer.
Make a rotten fruit edible once again.
weaknesses: Useless for a non-greengrocer.

name: Koolaid Creation
description: This ability allows you to create any type of koolaid that you can imagine. This will definitely come in handy in the worst-case scenarios where you may not have remembered to make koolaid, such as in the living room, at school, or fighting some sort of demonic entity.
summary: The ability to create any flavor of Koolaid imaginable.
strengths: Black cherry, grape, watermelon, lemon, but mostly black cherry.
Adding water is not required.
Even when you find yourself in the worst-case scenarios, you can still say 'Oh yeah! '
weaknesses: Definitely no cons about Koolaid.

name: Halitosis
description: With Halitosis you can make someone's breath go from "Dear God, its like little baby angels prancing around a waterfall of peppermint gumdrops! " to "Dear God, here's $1,000! Go buy as many tic-tacs as you possibly can!! " Oh, they can do whatever they want to freshen it, but it will eventually go back to the level at which you set it. This also works vice versa, it also works on you. So ruin someone's reputation, and seduce people with your sexy breath. For you are THE GOD OF FRESHNESS!
summary: The ability to increase or decrease the freshness of someone's breath
strengths: Seduce people with good breath
Threaten people with crap breath
Ruin Reputations!
weaknesses: May develop a slight god complex
If someone catches you freshening their breath, they might think you're a tool

name: Ultimate Rapping Ability
description:
With this ability, your rap ability will change from hysterical to incomparable. Ex: If you usually make 5 word rhymes, you can now rhyme like this.. 

I've Spit the Table of Elements Yes I mean every single Component,
Sent back the Competition and I have a need for Opponents,
Murdered rappers with reputation and I saved my Condolensce,
Lyricist with Education and I've Perfected my Performance

Now isn't that great? You know you want to be a master rapper.
summary: The ability to be a master of the Rap Genre.
strengths: Diss Eminem, Ludacris, KRS-One, Etc.
Easily diss your friends.
weaknesses: Rap battles get boring.

name: For Someone's Honor
description: This ability turns you into what is for all intents and purposes a slave. However, servitude empowers you with strength, speed, regeneration, and an immunity to mind attacks and mental detection while you fulfill your master's command. Your oath of loyalty can only be given if you truly want to, so choose carefully. Once sworn, the only way to break the bond is either the master's death or your death (immortality and other powers can change this. )

name: Hell's Candy Maker
description: Demonic hard sweets,fudge,toffee,licorice,chocolate and any other candies. Any demonic candies you create will walk,talk and bite. Licorice demons might be able to strangle. name: Musical Bones

However, the strength increase is such that a demon formed from 100 spirits can beat 2 demons, one with 99 spirits the other with 1 spirit, with power to spare. That will not change, even though the purer the spirits sacrificed, the weaker the demon will be; the more corrupted the spirits, the stronger the demon. name: Yelling Point
description: With this power you can make people start yelling uncontrollably as long as your pointing at the person. As soon as you stop pointing at the person they will return to speaking at whatever volume they were speaking at before you pointed at them. description: This power gives you natural skill in woodcraft. You can carve wood easily into weapons, traps, or other things. If you are lost in the woods, then you can easily make five wooden spears in two minutes or a bow in one. You have a natural sense of what wood is strong and how to get it. You never get splinters and your hands won't turn coarse from working. You can even make a shelter from wood with youre bare hands and can smooth it by gently rubbing it.

name: Goldworks: Sword Of Essence

Its powers are vast and mostly unknown, but it's best understood and most powerful ability is to drink and control essences. Whenever this sword stabs a living thing, it absorbs its essence. This causes the wielder to become stronger. The wielder can also channel the absorbed essence in different ways. The essence appears as a energy-like smoke or dust.

description: You enter one of the two paths of Mahoujutsu. You become a demon, boosting your strength and demon enormously, but losing your soul in the process.
summary: The ability to become a demon.
strengths: Incredible strength.
Ultimate Defense.
weaknesses: Loss of Soul.

name: Rise Of Unicron
description: With this power you can turn into the Dark God of Cybertron, Unicron. You can transform into a planet, eat planets, you're huge, super strong, have a cool goatee, have hundreds of Transformer sized minions that you can summon and thousands of Mini-Con Dead End drones. However while Unicron you have random surges of evil and might accidentally kill somebody or eat an innocent planet or your home planet.
summary: The ability to turn into Unicron
strengths: You are Unicron
You have thousands of minions that you can summon
You're huge
weaknesses: You have random surges of evil

name: Summon Draja
description: A draja looks like a 5-foot-tall walking mix of at least ten different things. No two are alike. A draja is only strong enough to lift 250 pounds. Their reflexes are as fast as a human's. IQ is low genius. There are humans faster than a draja. A draja's ability is to mimic any special ability of a fellow kystian, any fellow kystian that exist in Kyst.  Only one power at a time can be used but that power can be switched at will. Draja can be merged with other kystians but can't absorb a madspawn.
summary: The ability to summon the most versatile kystian.
strengths: A draja can have the special abilities of any other kystian that exist.
A draja has the IQ to plan what abilities to use if you don't have the IQ to.
There is a power to make a draja faster and stronger.
weaknesses: You don't have the power to make draja faster and stronger.

name: 50/50 Superpower Granting
description: With this power the person has a 50 percent chance of granting a person superpowers or upgrading a person's superpower and a 50 percent chance of killing them. They can use it anywhere, as long as they know the person's name an have an image of the person they can activate this power.
summary: The ability to either give a person superpowers or kill them
strengths: You can use this power and bet on your luck
As long as you have a visual image and know the person's name you can use it
You can use it multiple times on the same person
weaknesses: You have 50 percent chance to kill someone who you wanted to give superpowers to
You have 50 percent chance to give superpowers to someone who you wanted to kill
Numerous powerups on the same person that wants to kill you

name: G1 Bombshell's Transformation
description: WIth this power you have all of the powers of the Insecticon Bombshell meaning you can turn into a robotic rhinoceros beetle that has super strength and can shoot mind control shells from it's forehead onto any machine and have complete control over it. However you cannot create thousands of clones of yourself like the original Bombshell.
summary: The ability to turn into a robotic rhinoceros beetle
strengths: You can turn into a giant robotic rhinoceros beetle
You have super strength
You can control all kinds of machines
weaknesses: You have to be able to hit the machine with a mind control shell in order to control itq
Your powers do not carry over into your human form
You cannot create thousands of clones of yourself

name: Zodiac: Lunar: Monkey
description: You draw upon the power of the Monkey. You can transform into a monkey, talk with monkeys, and use any limb as though it was your good arm or hand. In other words, you are ambidextrous with your arms, hands, legs, and feet.
summary: The ability to use the power of the lunar calender's Monkey
strengths: Full moon gives full power.
All your limbs are useful for holding items.
weaknesses: New moon gives no power.
Can only use if born in a year of the Monkey. 1920, 1932, 1944, 1956, 1968, 1980, 1992, 2004, etc.

name: Condition Change: Jungles
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a jungle. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is in a jungle
strengths: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near jungles.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Situation Intensifier
description: So you're watching the news and you see a report that a ship has gone out of control, boring. Well, at the snap of your finger, the news gets a live report that the ship is a damaged military vessel carrying a large amount of dangerous chemical and personnel, and that it has been hijacked by terrorists. Still not intense enough for you? Snap your fingers again and the news gets a new report that the ship and its cargo are going to crash into a dam that will contaminate all the rivers in America.
summary: The ability to make any bad situation worse.
strengths: Useful if you are a superhero in need of a job, a news reporter in a slow news day, or a terrorist.
weaknesses: If you use it too much, you might cause armageddon... Or worse
You don't know how bad the situation could get
You have to be able to snap, and know where, when, and what event is taking place.

name: Myth Power: Tartarus' Torment
description: Tartarus (or Tartaros), in Greek myth, was the god of the stormy, chaotic hell-pit by the same name. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive and communicate with demons and other evil spirits at will. In addition, one can actually make physical contact with said spirits at will. Furthermore, one can affect said spirits to either banish them (ie exorcising demons, warding them off, etc) or prevent them from entering the mortal realm. One can even invoke visions of Tartarus with a touch.
summary: The ability to channel Tartatus' command over the essence of the stormy, chaotic hell-pit
strengths: Perceive and communicate with demons and evil spirits; induce visions of Tartarus with a touch
Physically touch them at will (making one immune to demonic possession in the process)
Banish them, ward them off, seal them within the Underworld, or trap them in the Mortal Realm
weaknesses: Cannot compel evil spirits until the higher levels; hard to compel stronger ones (no Con Negation)
You can only withstand possession for as long as this power is in use
People with death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers can disrupt this ability

name: Hammer Time
description: The power allows you become invincible while dancing. Only works for awesome dances.
summary: The ability to become an invincible dancing machine
strengths: Great for professional breakdancers
Can be used for prolonged invincibility
Can be used in space
weaknesses: Dancing may become addictive
Can no longer commit suicide whilst dancing

name: Name Power: Sabbac
description: Satan, Aym, Beelzebub, Belial, Asmodeus, and Createis. Like Captain Marvel, saying the name transforms you and bestows upon you their gifts; however, you are the only one who can use this power!
summary: The ability to transform into a demonic powerhouse.
strengths: Possess infernal magic to use on your enemies
Breathe fire
weaknesses: Saying the name again
You become evil

name: Delete This Frosting Upper
description: When your fist becomes surrounded by a light-bluish aura, you can powerfully uppercut your enemy and then they'll be frozen and shattered when they hit the ground.
summary: The ability to uppercut and freeze your opponent at the same time.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Key Finder
description: Sick and tired of getting frustrated because you can't find those god damn keys.  DO NOT FEAR! The Key Finder ability is here. With this power, you'll never again lose track of your keys.  Only works on finding your keys and no-one else's. This ability tracks down your keys, if they have been either lost or stolen.
summary: The ability to never lose track of those car keys.
strengths: Find those keys.
Never again be frustrated, by misplacing your keys.
Also works on keys, if they have been stolen, and not misplaced.
weaknesses: Only works for your keys.
Lame ability. (But at least I won't get frustrated anymore. )

name: Popcorn Machine
description: This is perfect for movie night. With this power, you are like a walking popcorn machine. All you have to do is focus on the word "popcorn", and you will hear the air around you sizzle and pop. After the popping stops, popcorn begins to materialize in front of you. You can also superheat the popcorn to turn it into a explosion of kernels and fire to burn and confuse your enemies. Unfortunately, you might be ostracized for having such a strange power.
summary: The ability to create popcorn out of thin air
strengths: You can create popcorn
You can make an explosive popcorn bomb
Food is always readily accessible
weaknesses: This is a strange power
You might be ostracized for having this power
All that popcorn might be hazardous to your health

name: Anti Encasement
description: This is an defensive power that makes it where whenever you are encased an opening or tunnel is created providing for a way to get out. This power is always active, even after death, and automatically activates when ever you become trapped. The opening or tunnel does not take any energy from the user to make and even the hardest materials will be opened by this power. Does not work unless you are completely closed in.
summary: The ability to never be encased such as in a coffin or underground.
strengths: Will not have to fear being buried alive and suffocating.
Works on anything you are trapped inside.
If youre immortal never be trapped underground again.
weaknesses: Works after you die so your family will have hard time burying you.
Does not work if you are not completely closed in.
Would break anything you get inside, even if you do not want it to.

name: Cookiekinesis
description: Make cookie dough of any flavor appear and come to life!
summary: The ability to manipulate cookie dough
strengths: Cookie dough of any flavor
Sweet and powerful ally
Instant snack at any time!
weaknesses: Nothing! Cookies!

name: Here Kitty Kitty
description: With it, you can release a lethal cat that runs full-speed to maul the opponent into several pieces.
summary: The ability to summon a killer cat that runs full-speed to scratch your foe to pieces.
strengths: Might be good for mauling evil mice.
weaknesses: The cat you summoned will be afraid of dogs.

name: Reaper Claw: 2nd Stage
description: Unlike reaper claw: 1st stage which deals damage to the soul. 2nd stage can damage and/or control the three base forms of a person. These are as follows: body, soul and aura. The body consists of the physical form and the mind. When activated, the 2nd stage allows you to control or damage everything pertaining to that person's body. For info on the soul, see 1st stage. The aura is a person's source of power, and the 2nd stage allows you to control it/steal it or dispel it leaving them powerless.
summary: The ability to split a person into the three base forms
strengths: There are no good qualities to this power
It is a somewhat dark technique
And should only be used as a last resort
weaknesses: 2nd stage has an even higher chance of injury if used improperly than 1st stage
To master this power, you must first completely master the reaper claw: 1st stage
As always there is a chance of angering azrael the angel of death

name: Musicality
description: Someone with this power has the compulsive need to express their feelings with song and dance. They're fantastic singers and dancers. They've mastered every musical instrument. When they burst into song, music appears around them created by their Musicality and they've got the ability to easily and always successfully improvise a full song relating to that moment in time. The person's songs also reflect their taste in music and people around them can't help but be the backup singers/dancers.
summary: The ability to burst into song and dance in moments of strong emotion.
strengths: Life would be more exciting.
People trust you.
Everyone can join in
weaknesses: You wouldn't be able to lie. You need to express you're true feelings.
Nightmare if you've a hangover.
Can't exactly save the day with it.

name: Symbol: The Dreamer
description: You were born with the gift of the Dreamer. You are creative and someone who has brilliant ideas, but you are usually too weak to act on these ideas. The Dreamers are gifted with an active mind, and cursed with a weak body.
summary: The ability to use the Dreamer
strengths: Brilliant idealist.
Someone very creative.
weaknesses: Bad at sports and athletics.
Your body is naturally weak.

name: Sand Castle
description: You can make a giant sand castle out of surrounding sand. It can be destroyed but you can always build it back up again.
summary: The ability to make a castle out of sand.
strengths: Never be homeless
Win every sand castle contest
weaknesses: Can be turned into mud by a lot of water

name: Wheeled Limbs
description: You can create self-propelled wheels on your body in any number and any configuration you want. Become a human car, motorcycle or unicycle. This power also gives you an acute sense of balance on wheels and an extreme resistance to speed. These wheels have a high resistance to damage, and in case of a flat tire, making the wheel disappear and reappear will repair it.
summary: The ability to create wheels on your body and rotate them at tremendous speed.
strengths: Easily reach superhuman speed.
You can be used a human vehicle.
Wheels can be used shields or punching gloves.
weaknesses: Your human body can be harmed or killed in accidents.

name: Adhesive Secretion
description: Cryanoacrylate, a.k.a. Crazy Glue, has nothing on an Adhesive Secreter's natural glue. It is at least 10 times stronger, and highly resistant to water and abrasive materials. It can also be produced in large quantities (floods of glue from the lower arms)or in minimal amounts (a single dot). However, it is very weak against strong acids, and the Secreter is completely immune to its effects.
summary: The ability to produce a powerful glue from your skin
strengths: Be an amazing construction worker
Restrain the very strong
Can be used as a very effective defense or offense
weaknesses: Strong acids are extremely effective against it
Can run out of glue
Strength of glue dependent on your physical health

name: 10 Plagues
description: For 10 days, you can have the God power Moses was instructed to use on Egypt. Day 1:Blood water Day 2:overrun of frogs Day 3:lice & fleas Day 4:wild beasts attack Day 5:pestilence on livestock Day 6:covered in boils Day 7:hail of fire Day 8:swarm of locusts Day 9:darkness falls Day 10: the firstborn child dies.
summary: The ability to recreate the 10 plagues of Egypt
strengths: Be a modern day Moses
weaknesses: Better know what Passover is

name: Zero's Scroll: Wolf Seal
description: Once in Zero's travels he happened upon a werewolf, in his human form. The man begged Zero to end his life and the curse. Zero created a new spell to help the man, called the Wolf Seal. It seals any curses, including Lycanthropy. The Wolf Seal can only be removed by powerful curse spells, or by the person it seals if he wills it to. If unsealed the curses will affect the target again.
summary: The ability to remove supernatural curses
strengths: Cure werewolves and other people under curses
weaknesses: Hard to use
Not an offensive spell at all

name: Pandora Pearl
description: The pandora pearl is a large crimson orb that, when someone possesses it unleashed many terrible things on mankind including seeing a future of someone's death, control & corrupt everything, It might also give you invisibility & reads minds, and it can malevolently twist and mutate your body and mind, and prolonged his life well beyond its natural limits. It can also give people ills, toils and sickness, and many other terrible things.
summary: The ability to disrupt everything and see a vision of your future death.
strengths: The only good thing about it is to hope you throw the pearl into a volcano.
weaknesses: It will try to dominate you forever.
It does not grant you new life, but that the you or someone uses it until life your life ends.

name: Delete This Shameless
description: You can lunge towards your opponent, catch their right/left arm in a leg scissor, and then wrap their hands around the opponent's face, pulling the opponent's head backwards. You begin to spin, raising the enemy in a helicopter-like fashion. A tornado builds up around you and you send your opponent flying. Then, you grab your opponent as they fall, and apply a stunner to finish them off.
summary: The ability to do a mid-air spinning crossface, then do a stunner to knock out your opponent.
strengths: Your enemies will be screaming in agony while using this move.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Water Bottle
description: With this power you can control and create the clear plastic used to make water bottles. The denisty of the plastic can be changed to make plastic as hard or soft as you need. If the plastic encloses an area, the area can be filled with water. The plastic can also be formed into water spouts that can spray out water at varying pressures. The water created can be hot or cold but you can not create steam or ice. Masters could even turn into the plastic themselves.
summary: The ability to have powers based off of a water bottle.
strengths: Will never be thirsty.
The clear plastic of the bottles can be shaped into different things.
Can fill an enclosed area with water or create water spouts.
weaknesses: Have to create plastic first before you can create water.
No water control after the water has been created.
Can not make steam or ice.

name: Hyponesioer
description: Hyponesioer is the ability to turn water into jelly. To do this, you must have a hand position (e.g. hand in a fist or stretched out). You have to focus on the water and all the particles in the water will stick together to turn into jelly. Trick: If you put your favorite squash in a bowl and use your power, you can have free jelly!
summary: The ability to turn water into jelly
strengths: Get to turn any water into jelly.
Trick your friends
Teach friends how to do it.
weaknesses: If you use your power on a friend, they could suffocate
If you use it on the weather, it could rain jelly.
That's it :)

name: Enhancement: Armor Piercing
description: This is a support and useless on its own. When it is attached to another power it makes the power pierce through armor. For this power, armor is defined as anything directly physically touching the skin. This does NOT work on shields. This means that force fields have to be touching the enemy's skin or this doesn't work. If someone tries to steal this power, it permanently makes the attached power armor piercing and gives this power to the thief. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power pierce through armor by attaching this power to it
strengths: Enemies' physical armor is useless.
You still have this power if stolen (kind of).
Could possibly make this power pierce through more things by using it.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
The 'armor' must be touching the skin.
Might not want a power to be armor-piercing or might be useless as armor-piercing.

name: Condition Change: Snap
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to requiring the user to snap their fingers to use the power. One use per snap and uses cannot be stockpiled. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only after the user has snapped their fingers
strengths: An opponent with no fingers. Gruesome but still works.
Tying your opponent's fingers together.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and affects only one power per touch.

name: G1 Perceptor's Transformation
description: In the original Transformers Generation 1 cartoon, the Autobot scientist Perceptor displayed a number of abilities in his alt mode (giant microscope): a telescope & microscope function, a laser shooting function and using the treads on the bottom of the microscope(vehicle function).
summary: The ability to turn into a microscope/telescope/laser cannon/vehicle
strengths: You have all of the abilities of Perceptor's alt mode
If you use the laser shooting function and the vehicle function at the same time you're like a tank
weaknesses: You don't have Perceptor's super brain

name: Transformation: Apache
description: The user is able to transform into a ancient Native American warrior named Apache, using a mystical axe that once belonged to the first Apache. Once the user transforms into Apache, he or she gains all the experience from previous Apaches
summary: The ability to transform into the warrior of the land, named Apache
strengths: Great fighting experience
Axe is made of a mystical metal
Has the knowledge of the shamans
weaknesses: Might get ridiculed

name: Meteor Stop
description: With this power you can freeze meteors in the air as they are falling causing them to be stuck in the sky until you want them to fall. While the meteor is stuck in the sky it cannot be destroyed and no new meteors can fall to earth thus making it the best protection against meteor showers.
summary: The ability to stop meteors midfall
strengths: You can stop meteors from falling to Earth
Only you can decide when the meteor falls
No new meteors can fall to Earth while the meteor is stuck
weaknesses: Only applies to meteors
You do not decide where it lands

name: Execution Of The Immortals
description: Using this power is a gamble. Activating this power upon an immortal will kill him or her, but somewhere else in the world, 5 other mortals will die along with the immortal. Not only that, using this power will give you nightmares starring those who the power killed.
summary: The ability to kill an immortal
strengths: Kill immortals
The power backfiring on you is only 10%
weaknesses: May give you nightmares
Kills 5 other innocents

name: Fandom Manipulation
description: The obsession of the fanboy or fangirl can be anything. A singer,a book series,a movie series,tv series or anything else that incites rabid fandom. The new obsession doesn't give new knowledge so a twilight fangirl suddenly a star trek fangirl will spend as much time possible learning everything about star trek. A new fandom obsession is permanent.
summary: The ability to change the obsession of a fanboy or fangirl.
strengths: End careers of annoying teen singers.
Make authors of stupid book series lose money.
No more chuck norris fanboys.
weaknesses: This power is naturally permanent but can be reversed by other powers.

name: Covered Eye
description: Anytime someone with this power covers one or more of their eyes, the eyes that are uncovered have their abilities/powers boosted by 50% for each eye that is covered. You can only cover the eye with something that is not part of your body. Ex: An eyepatch will work but not your hand.
summary: The ability to by covering an eye, boost the abilities of one's other eyes
strengths: The more eyes covered the better this power works.
If your uncovered eye(s) have no powers then your eyesight will be boosted.
weaknesses: This works best if you have more than two eyes.
Need to always have one eye uncovered for this poer to work.

name: Condition Change: Weapons
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on weapons. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different type of object. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require being used on a weapon in order to work
strengths: Now all you have to do is avoid being hit with a weapon.
If you have an opponent who hates using weapons.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.
Opponents who keep armories full of weapons.

name: Snap You're A Robot
description: With this power you can turn people into robot version of themselves just by snapping and thinking of the person as a robot. Once in robot form the person is under your control. The robot has super strength and a vast knowledge of other robots and technology which you can use to your advantage.
summary: The ability to turn people into robot versions of themselves
strengths: You can turn people into robots
The robot is under your complete control
The robot is super strong and has a vast knowledge of robots and other technology
weaknesses: You cannot turn the robot back into a human
If you're unable to snap this power is useless

name: Chain Link Hits
description: Each time you hit something you can make the damage of the final hit be exponentially more powerful based on the number of previous hits, but you also have to yell, '(insert number of hits)-Chain-Linked (insert type of hit). This power can only be gained by punching one rock 1000 times full force.
summary: The ability to boost the power of a punch, kick, or other type of attack based on the number of hits beforehand
strengths: The force of the final hit is equal to the original force raised to the power of the number of hits.
weaknesses: How many giant rocks are out there? And no, the Earth does not count as the rock for this power.
Maximum number of hits for the linked hits is 100.
Only the final hit is boosted and hitting something else restarts the count.

name: Myth Power: Iambe's Impulse
description: Iambe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of ribald humor (dirty jokes) and iambic pentameter poetic verse. As such, channeling her allows one to brand foes with a rhyme, dirty joke or iambic pentameter verse (each line composed of ten rhythmic syllables) by touch; they will enter a trance, endlessly repeating the branded phrase (and abandoning all else). In addition, one gains power in the presence of a dirty joke or iambic poem stanza. One can even cast magic spells phrased in iambic pentameter.
summary: The ability to channel Iambe's command over the essence of scurrilous, ribald humor and iambic pentameter poetry
strengths: Brand foes with a rhyme/dirty joke/iambic verse, which they repeat endlessly, abandoning all else
Become more powerful every time you read/write/hear/say a dirty joke or an iambic poem stanza
Cast nearly any magical spell, if phrased in iambic pentameter (more powerful if it rhymes)
weaknesses: Cannot psychically recall every rhyme/dirty joke/iambic verse in existence until developed (NCN)
Pro #1 is temporary (cannot be turned off at will; must wear off) until the highr levels (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers, MythPower: Demeter's Touch, etc provide immunity (NCN)

name: Acid Sweat
description: With this power you can turn your sweat into acid which can melt through almost anything. The acid cannot burn through your skin and has no adverse affects to you at all but it can burn through other people's skin. This power can be turned on and off so you're not constantly melting things when you sweat.
summary: The ability to turn your sweat into acid
strengths: You can turn your sweat into acid
The acid has no affect on you
You can turn this power off if you want
weaknesses: It only happens when you sweat so if you want to burn something you have to work up a sweat

name: Rise Of The Gorgon
description: With this power you can turn into a Gorgon like Medusa. In Gorgon form you can turn people into stone just by looking at them and you have snake hair that can bite people. You are also stronger than a normal human.
summary: The ability to turn into a gorgon
strengths: You can turn people to stone.
You have snake like hair that can bite people.
You are super strong.
weaknesses: While in gorgon form you cannot turn off the petrifying gaze.

name: Teen Titans Summon
description: With this power you can summon any DC superhero who has ever been a member of any version of the Teen Titans from the comics, tv shows or movies. They are not under your control but they might help you if you're a good guy. You can keep them in your universe for as long as you want and then send them back.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Teen Titans from any comic, movie or tv show
strengths: You can summon any of the Teen Titans
weaknesses: They are not under your control

name: Think Vampiric Sheep
description: With this power you can turn any object into a vampiric sheep. These vampiric sheep are under your complete control and you can even turn them back into the object they originally were when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to turn any object into a vampiric sheep
strengths: You can turn any object into a vampire sheep
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They crave human flesh and blood

name: 12 Car 2 Bike Motorcade
description: With this power you can summon your own security motorcade. The motorcade consists of twelve bullet proof cars each with five armed security guards in it and two motorcycles each with one armed guard on it. The men can only leave their vehicles if they think you are in danger while you are in one of the cars. You summon and unsummon the motorcade whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon your own motorcade consisting of 12 cars with 5 armed men in each car
strengths: You can summon a security motorcade consisting of 12 cars, 2 bikes and 62 armed men
weaknesses: The men can only leave their vehicles if they sense that you are in danger while you are in the car

name: Myth Power: Triptolemus' Trade
description: Triptolemus (Triptolemos), in Greek myth, was the god of sowing grain seeds, milling wheat and the Eleusinian Mysteries. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically teleport to anywhere with fertile soil, at will. In addition, one can psychically attune to fertile soil, at will, to receive psychic insight. Furthermore, one can psychically reduce nearly any object to seeds, by touch, which rapidly grow copies of that object, when planted. One can even produce a crushing mill-force at will.
summary: The ability to channel Triptolemus' command over the essence of farming, milling and the Eleusinian Mysteries
strengths: Psychically perceive and teleport to any location with fertile soil, at will
Gain psychic insight from fertile soil, at will; reduce matter to seeds, which grow copies of matter
Psychically produce a powerful, psionic 'mill-force' to crush and grind matter, at will
weaknesses: Cannot gain physical power from by standing on fertile soil, until developed (NCN)
Cannot summon an indestructible flying chariot, driven by immortal dragons, until developed (NCN)
Agricultural/economic/cooking/food-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Soul Up
description: After a soul has been removed from a victim's body, Soul Up allows one to use the soul's essence to increase the power of any other ability the person may have.
summary: The ability to use a harvested soul to power up ones abilities
strengths: More power
weaknesses: Dependence on souls to become stronger
Soul lust
Boost is temporary

name: Myth Power: Astra Planeta3
description: The Astra Planeta (Astra, Asteres) in Greek myth, were the gods of the five Wandering Stars (Planets). As such, channeling Pyroeis (Mesonyx, Areios, Areius- Planet Mars) allows one to fly, as well as gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mars. In addition, one can psychically generate an aura mimicking Martian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will. One even gains favor with Mars' patron, Ares, to resist and benefit from his domains (war, combat, rage, violence, bloodshed, etc).
summary: The ability to channel the Astra Planeta and their command over the essence of the planets
strengths: Gain flight; gain adaptation to survive in space, and on Mars (physical change voluntary)
Psychically generate an aura mimicking Martian gravity, weather and air conditions, at will
Gain favor with Mars' patron god, Ares; resist and benefit from his domains
weaknesses: Cannot teleport self to Mars at will (others by touch) until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate Mars-patterned forcefield (or project Pro #2 onto others) until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Ares' Wrath and sun/moon/sky/celestial-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Delphinos' Delve
description: Delphinos (Delphinus, Delphin), in Greek myth, was the god of dolphins. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command dolphins at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a dolphin at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of dolphin (or weredolphin) at will (others by touch). One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location with dolphins or distressed water-goers at will.
summary: The ability to channel Delphinos' command over the essence of dolphins
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic dolphins at will
Transform oneself into any species of dolphin (or weredolphin) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with dolphins or distressed water-goers at will
weaknesses: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent dolphin-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Myth Power: Path Of Palikoi
description: The Palikoi (Palicoi), in Greek myth, were the twin gods of geysers and thermal springs. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive and superheat water, at will. In addition, one can psychically manipulate boiling water (including forming it into a barrier that protects against bodily, mental and spiritual domination), at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport to anywhere with geysers or thermal springs, at will. One can even withstand heat and intense water pressure.
summary: The ability to channel the Palikoi and their command over the essence of geysers and thermal springs
strengths: Psychically perceive and superheat (boil) water, and manipulate superheated (boiling) water, at will
Form boiling water into a barrier that prevents bodily, mental and spiritual domination, at will
Teleport anywhere with geysers/thermal springs at will; Withstand heat and intense water pressure
weaknesses: Cannot heal oneself (or share power, to heal others) with boiling water, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically boil the blood of foes, at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith and MythPower: Hephaestus' Forge provide immunity and negation (NCN)

name: Pants/Skirt Length Changing
description: By moving your hands down underneath your hips, you can magically make your pants or skirt or your dress longer until your legs are completely covered. Or you can do the opposite by moving your hands up from your feet to your hips.
summary: The ability to change the length of your pants or skirt
strengths: Short pants/skirts can become long pants/skirts & vice versa.
This superpower will work on any skirt, dress, or pair of pants you wear!
A way to warm up your legs!
weaknesses: Doesn't work if you're not wearing the clothing.
You can't change the length of other people's pants, dresses, or skirts.
Making your pants/dress/skirt way too long may cause you to trip over your own clothing!

name: Dead Water
description: With this power, you can touch any body of water and remove its ability to nourish. The water will appear and feel complete normal, but it will no longer quench thirst or allow plants to grow. Any living thing that tries to survive on only water under the effects of this ability will die of dehydration, for it no longer supports life.
summary: The ability to remove the nourishing aspects of water.
strengths: Keep your pool clean without chlorinating it.
weaknesses: Don't use it on the oceon.
Or on, you know, water supplies.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours10)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Hesperis (Evening Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when evening hits. One can also psychically compel subjects to stop working/laboring, at will. One can even psychically teleport foes to the Evening Star (Venus), by striking them, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when evening hits
Psychically compel subjects to stop working, teleport foes to Venus by striking them, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically reduce light to 1/6 brightness, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically teleport to any location where it is evening, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically time travel to past/future evenings, until developed (NCN)

name: To Keep Pikmins From Earth
description: The ability to take Pikmins from the earth and send it your way. Pikmins look like plants, when they are long out of the ground or soil a flower that replaces your resume will appear. Each Pikmin has its color with the ability or own characteristic in each of them, are poisonous Pikmins, Pikmins covered rocks, etc. In the official videogames the Pikmins never hurt their leader that sends. For more information, go to this web address: http://pikmin3. Nintendo. Com/es/
summary: The ability to take Pikmins from the earth and send it your way
strengths: We do not know how many Pikmins you can take
You can send your dog to do what you want
Pikmins of this super power does not hurt you
weaknesses: Pikmins of this superpower can die
We do not know how many dogs you can take
If many Pikmin would not know how to undo

name: Seams From The Imagination
description: With this you can do super soft toys, clothes, sewing costumes and all you can imagine just imagine using sewing materials
summary: The ability to make the seams to imagine cloth, wool and other sewing materials
strengths: You can create the stuffed animals and clothes you want
If you want to reuse the material in a garment or fabric to create something else, you can
You can cosplay real good suits
weaknesses: Only you used to make seams
Not a superpower that serves to cope or defend someone

name: Bow Of Asura
description: (This bow looks like the recurve bow ) the bow and arrow are mad from Persian ironwood. The string is made from horses hair. The arrow head looks like the Persian arrowhead. The bow can kill any giant with one shot
summary: The ability to kill any giant with one shot
strengths: You have a cool bow
Killing giants is fun (pro & con )
You are every giant slayer's best friend
weaknesses: Any power that controls wood
The bow breaks
You need a sharp eye

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours07)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Sponde (Libation, Offering Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when liquids fall. One can also psychically teleport to any location with falling liquid (rain, waterfalls, etc), at will. One can even psychically 'offer' things for gain, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when liquids fall (ie rain, sweat, blood)
Psychically teleport to any location with falling liquid, 'sacrifice' to gain powers, at will
weaknesses: One 'offering' bestows one sacrifice-based ability, which only lasts one power use (NCN)
Cannot psychically sacrifice intangible traits (senses, emotions, skills, etc) until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically recall anything sacrificed (or past 'sacrifice' powers), until developed (NCN)

name: Dagger Of Cain
description: (This dagger is the first weapon ever created ) this dagger is made from jaw of a bear. This dagger can kill all most anything. Know your history
summary: The ability to possess the first weapon
strengths: You possess the first weapon
This dagger can kill almost anything
Hereos and villans will be afraid of you (pro + con)
weaknesses: You are cursed with the mark of Cain
If you don't kill with the dagger you will get sick and die ( no con negation)
The more you kill the more evil you become

name: Claymore : Tsunami
description: (This claymore can cause a tsunami) This claymore looks like the french naval cutlass but it is a claymore. The claymore is made from magnalium. You have to be near water or in the sea and you have to stab it. The tsunumi will be random.
summary: The ability to cause a tsunami by stabbing water with a claymore
strengths: You can destroy cities and islands (pro & con)
You are every surfer's best friend
You are every villain's worst enemy
weaknesses: You have to be near a body of water or in it
You can only have one claymore (no con negation)
This claymore is powerless on the ground

name: Self Seer
description: This power lets you experience the world from any version of you that exists. The user concentrates, and focuses on any version of themselves they want to channel, such as their future self, a clone of them, or an alternate universe version of themselves. The user can see through their eyes, hear with their ears, and otherwise perceive the things their alternate self is perceiving.
summary: The ability to perceive reality from any version of yourself.
strengths: You can learn about your future from your future self's experiences
You'll have the equivalent of a perfect memory, by reliving everything you experienced in the past
If two versions of yourself are aware of each other, they can read each others minds and essentially communicate telepathically.
weaknesses: If a version of you dies while you are channeling them, it can be painful and distressing.
You could get terribly jealous if a version of you has a better life than you.

name: Shape Shifting To Summoning
description: With this power you can change any shape shifting power in your arsenal into an ability to summon whatever it was you were able to shape shift into. This power only works for specific shape shifting powers that allow you to shape shift into a limited number of specific things.  You are also able to control whatever it is you are now able to summon.
summary: The ability to change shape shifting powers into summoning powers
strengths: You can change your shape shifting powers into summoning powers
You can control whatever it is that you summon
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power
This power does not work with generic shape shifting abilities

name: Indecisive Paralysis
description: Concentrate the essence of your whole being into a blast of raw energy that will stun anyone that stands in it's way.  If a target is hit by the raw energy they will see every possible outcome to every possible action that they will ever do.  This overloads the target's brain, meaning that they will be paralyzed permanently due to the fact that they cannot decide what to do.   They will then die because their basic needs are not met e.g. Hunger, thirst, any form of human contact.
summary: The ability to paralyze anyone due to indecisiveness.
strengths: You can do this to any person that you want.
The persons death will be slow but painless.
weaknesses: Requires immense concentration and skill
If you send, even the smallest part of the energy blast into yourself, you will be paralyzed.

name: Conceptual Sword
description: The ability to imprint the properties of an imagined sword onto any object. You can imagine a sword in your mind and then use an object as that sword. Objects will gain the exact weight and sharpness of the sword, allowing chairs, eyeglasses, brooms, and even fire trucks to be swung with ease as a weapon.
summary: The ability to Imprint the properties of an imagined sword upon any object.
strengths: Affected objects are as light as the visualized sword and are just as sharp.
You can use buildings as weapons against giant monsters and cut them cleanly in half somehow.
Literally anything is a weapon against anything; just imagine a sword or other melee weapons, grab an object, and give it a swing.
weaknesses: You can cause incredible harm to yourself and others. You're using BUILDINGS.
This power is negated once it leaves your hand, and may only be extended once you obtain a Power Imprinting support power.

name: Death Spiral
description: When this power is activated, you can drastically raise or lower the kinetic output of objects in your vicinity. Examples include bullets, which you can modify to raze down walls as they pass, hence the name, "Death Spiral."
summary: The ability to control the destructive power of objects.
strengths: If you master control of this ability (which is hard!) you are almost invincible.
You get a heightened sense of surroundings.
weaknesses: Places a great deal of strain on the wielder's body if used beyond limits.
Can't control other types of energy.

name: Aeternus
description:
Aeternus is the ability to move back and forth between ages that have already been lived. This enables users to have incredibly long lifespans, seemingly immortal lifespans. 
However, moving back to a previous age is considerably painful and the user should stay in that form for quite some time.
summary: The ability to move back and forth between ages that have already been lived.
strengths: You get an incredibly long, almost immortal, lifespan.
You can take on different forms of yourself, allowing "shapeshifting", to an extent.
You can do what you want, when you want and then just change forms.
weaknesses: It's painful to transform into a previous age.
New users who aren't experienced, may become "stuck" in a form.
Users personality may change to whatever it was like at the chosen age.

name: Acid Saliva
description: Just like Aliens, your saliva can be highly caustic too! You can create acidic spit that dissolves almost anything.  You will be immune to your own saliva.  So when the going gets tough, start spitting!
summary: The ability to create highly acidic saliva when you want.
strengths: Great for self defense
Breaking out of jail or handcuffs
You can make your saliva normal, too.
weaknesses: You might get thirsty with all that spitting

name: Whale Transformation
description: This power allows you to turn into a whale. Any whale. Although a killer whale is a dolphin you can transform into it. With training you can transform into a whale 10 times faster, stronger, heaver, and all whales will look up to you as their leader.
summary: The ability to transform into a whale
strengths: You can swim for long periods underwater
weaknesses: Sometimes you can't control this power

name: Demon Face
description: With your red skin, red eyes, and black horns, no wonder you were highly feared 1,000 years ago. You can control fire, have amazing strength and speed, a certain "charm" that helps you sedate your enemies, and nearly impenetrable skin. You have a sensitivity to direct sunlight, but not like that will cramp your style!
summary: The ability to have the traits of a demon.
strengths: You never have to worry about a halloween costume again.
Getting a date is easier than before.
You'll never get a paper cut again.
weaknesses: The Catholic community might come after you a little bit.
It's REALLY hard to hold a secret identity for long.
Now it looks like you're eternally sunburnt.

name: Edible Transformation
description: For example, if you ate a cow, you could turn into a cow, if you ate half a cow, you would turn half cow, half human. This power does not work with things that were not once living. Also, if you eat a cow that has to pee, when you eat it, you will also have to pee. Works with all living beings
summary: The ability to change your form by eating
strengths: Be anything alive you want
You don't have to eat anything you don't want to, or anything at all for that matter
Change your identity after theft
weaknesses: You can no longer eat plants
You have to eat everything alive

name: Gender Change
description:
With this ability you can change the gender of any creture with two genders, animals and people.
During this process for example converting a male to female Testosterone converts to estrogen, sperm converts to ovum, genitalia changes too. Basically all reroductive organs to suit the gender.
summary: The ability to change the gender of any creature with two genders.
strengths: Not a painful process.
weaknesses: Personality traits and physical apperance remain the same.

name: Delete This Terra Tempest
description: You can float up about head level and a brownish aura forms on the gesture of your hands. After a very long pause, you can raise twenty falling stalagtites from the air and it's very damaging to the opponent.
summary: The ability to summon twenty falling stalagtites that hit all enemies everywhere.
strengths: combo
weaknesses: combo

name: Fingerprint Copy
description: Using this ability, you can copy any person's fingerprints just by making skin contact with them. Using this, you can plant false fingerprints, gain access to top secret files, and even more.
summary: The ability to copy fingerprints.
strengths: Copy fingerprints.
weaknesses: No good for combat.

name: Rise Of The Cyclops
description: With this power you can turn into a super strong one eyed cyclops in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into a cyclops
strengths: You have super strength
You have bullet proof skin
weaknesses: Your skin is not invulnerable
People might attack you thinking you're a threat

name: Random Bananas!!!
description: You can create bananas whenever the situation calls for it. They come in whatever quantity you like, in any stage of development that you like. If you like, you can even summon just the peels, to trip up enemies, or just for laughs.
summary: The ability to randomly create bananas.
strengths: Randomness!
Bananas!
Banana-Peel-Slippy Goodness
weaknesses: You can't get rid of the bananas once they exist (might get harassed by monkeys)
Beginners might accidentally create more bananas than they planned for!
Beginners might accidentally only create rotten bananas, or only banana peels...

name: Enhancement: Others
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it allows a power that under normal conditions affects only oneself to also be able to affect other beings. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to allow a power that normally affects only oneself to affect others
strengths: Shapeshifters will love this.
weaknesses: Useless without another power. Enhancement Sharing will not affect this power.
Will not affect reality bending or existence changing powers.
Cannot be affected by Con Negation or other Enhancements.

name: Seven Sins
description:
The ability to possess all seven sins.
Greed, Gluttony, Lust, Wrath, Envy, Sloth and Pride.
This power you 'cast' a sin onto any soul and they will commit that sin to its most sinful potential.
E.g Lust-the victim will crave and act out sexual desires and fantasies. Sloth-the victim will just relax, rest and desire to not do anything at all.
summary: The ability to possess all seven sins.
strengths: Can cast all seven sins onto anybody at once.
weaknesses: Casting envy on someone already jealous of you.
This ability can obviously and easily cause you to sin. (if you didn't want to sin.)

name: Territorial Omnistupidity
description: This ability targets logical thoughts, knowledge, sensory perception (normal or extra), and precognition of other people 300 miles around you by becoming absolutely stupid like a drooling monkey yourself. This ability is the exact opposite of Omniscience.
summary: The ability to make others stupid around you by becoming stupid yourself
strengths: Doesn't need strategy
Absolutely swift. They won't know what hit them
Very useful against people who "know it all"
weaknesses: You become stupid yourself
God knows what will happen to all of you

name: 2 Spinning Rings
description: You can create 2 rings that slowly spin around you. The rings will meet at the front and back of your chest and make an X. The rings cannot be moved from where they are located but you can choose what material they are made out of. The radius for the rings is always 1 metre.
summary: The ability to create 2 rings that slowly spin around the holder of this power
strengths: Not much use for combat.
weaknesses: More likely to be used only to look cool.

name: Myth Power: Shades Of Graiae
description: The Graiae (Graeae, Graiai), named Enyo, Deino (Dino) and Pemphredo (Pephredo, Persis) in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the gray of the sea (gray clouds, gray mist, gray sea foam) and the gray of old age. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically generate and manipulate gray clouds at will. In addition, one can psychically summon blinding gray mists at will. Furthermore, one can psychically generate and manipulate gray sea foam at will. One can even turn self/others old at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Graiae and their command over the essence of the gray of the sea
strengths: Psychically generate and manipulate (stand/ride on, etc) gray clouds, summon blinding gray mists
Psychically generate and manipulate gray sea foam at will; psychically turn self/others old at will
Choose one eye with which to receive psychic visions, one tooth with which to detect lies, at will
weaknesses: Cannot turn self into a swan at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot turn self into sea foam/mist at will (others by touch), until developed (NCN)
Cannot show OTHERS the past/present/future by Foamy-Water Scrying until developed (NCN)

name: Stench Of Fear
description: You can smell fear, coming from any living object.
summary: The ability to smell fear.
strengths: You're scared, and I know it!
Good for bullies.
weaknesses: Pretty useless actually.

name: Happy Life
description: The ability to be happy all the time
summary: The ability to be happy all the time
strengths: Fun person to be around
Optimistic and enthusiastic
Difficult moments in life won't affect you (mother dies)
weaknesses: Can't feel the other emotions such as sadness
Being too happy will make you look crazy

name: Lesser Kystian Morph
description: You will become invulnerable if you weren't before. You will gain the weakness of the kystian you've become, unless you have Kyst Law #6. You can become a group of kystians (ex. Flickerspawn pack) though it takes time to learn how to exist that way. You retain all your other powers. If you have the Enhanced Kystian Abilities power, then it now affects you. You don't become half-alive. If you're a guy, you stay a guy if you become a slaypassion.
summary: The ability to become any summonable kystian.
strengths: Learn about ultra tech weapons (the weapons trader).
Be incredibly good-looking (slaypassion).
Banish someone to Kyst (Yuru).
weaknesses: Takes time and practice to be a group of kystians.

name: Duke 1006
description:
The Duke 1006 is a most fatal and mystical weapon that blends qualities of a claymore and a flintlock, it is very long and can fire a massive arc-like projectile at your foe. This attack damages A LOT! 
!
summary: The ability to use it to fire slashing projectiles.
strengths: Can become both like Zorro & Billy the Kid.
weaknesses: None.

name: Scorpion Tail Fingers
description: The strength of your venom is good enough to kill or at least paralyze a living creature you sting. Your tail-fingers can be easily crushed. Your tail-fingers have a weaker connection to your hand. Changing your fingers takes a instant.
summary: The ability to turn one or more of your fingers into scorpion tails.
strengths: Paralyze or kill someone.
weaknesses: Tail-fingers are boneless and can be crushed quite easily.

name: Fashion Sense
description: While the name may come across as humorous, it is no joke. It allows one to perceive information about clothes for various purposes. For example, you could get an intuitive sense of what you should wear that day, as a form of psychic weather forecasting. You could also attune yourself to a type of clothing to track anyone wearing that type of clothes. In addition, you can perceive flaws in clothes (untied shoe laces, etc.) and use them to your advantage in fights.
summary: The ability to perceive information about clothing, fashion and style
strengths: Discern what you should wear that day as a way to predict the weather and other future events
Attune yourself to an article clothing, and track anyone wearing it (blue skirt, boots, etc. )
Sense clothing flaws, use them to your advantage in fights
weaknesses: Often comes off as being a "girl" power
If you go by a superhero name, it's gonna suck
Armor is hard to read as far as flaws go (requires more concentration)

name: Gift: Sealing
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using seal-based powers than other beings. Thus their seal(marks)-based and sealing powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to undo their seals. However, someone with this power can only recieve seal-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at seal-based powers
strengths: Almost no one is as good at sealing away other things as someone with this power.
Seals are slightly better.
'Sealing' as in 'sealed into a scroll'.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the 'undo' aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only seal-based powers now.

name: Ruche (Hive)
description: You can transform into one of four types of Bee Hybrids. Honey Bee for Speed, Bumble Bee for Defense, Hornet For Power and Wasp for Honey Manipulation.
summary: The ability to transform between four species of bees
strengths: All four forms are incredibly fast
Wasp Form can create anything from honey
Honey Bee is small and get by larger opponents
weaknesses: Bumble Bee has slow reflexes
Hornet has little defense
Wasp has no physical protection

name: Ability Cancellation
description: This power is always active. As long as you have it, all your powers are cancelled, including any powers or curses that have been given to you by an external source. They are NOT removed, just deactivated. As it acts as a cover, if someone tries to indiscriminately copy or steal any of your powers, this one will automatically be the first one they'll get, effectively cancelling their own powers and preventing them from getting any other ones. To avoid a paradox, this power is not cancellable.
summary: The ability to permanently cancel your own abilities.
strengths: You will become the nightmare of every power replicator. And never be afraid of curses anymore.
You'll be happy to cancel other powers that have permanent side effects, like altering your look.
This power cannot be cancelled. (Is it really a pro? )
weaknesses: You can't use any of your powers.
You become a normal human being.
This power can be copied/removed/stolen. (Is it really a con? )

name: Sin Re Animator
description: The sins you commit generate energy that builds up a pool of energy. You can use this energy to re-animate any once living being that could have understood the idea of sin. Sin re-animates can build up a energy pool of their own. This sin energy can heal or regrow limbs. Sin re-animates don't age normally. A sin re-animates age a year if s/he does something virtuous. You can use this power on yourself if you're dying.
summary: The ability to re-animate newly dead beings using sin energy.
strengths: Perfect power for amoral people.
Being totally evil isn't a requirement for this power.
weaknesses: These re-animates can age if they behave the wrong way.

name: Summon Kaszi
description: A kaszi looks like a 10 foot tall sharped tooth kangaroo with a scorpion tail. It does have weapons. It can every five minutes create in its pouch a two foot tall non self-replicating version of itself. This version vanishes in a day. You command any mini-kaszi. The full sized kazsi can jump 40 feet and hop 40 mph. A mini-kaszi can jump 8 feet high and hop 8 mph. A mini-kaszi can use small pistols. The venom,strong as VX nerve gas,is the same strength for either kaszi.
summary: The ability to summon a limited self-replicating kystian.
strengths: Everyday you could have 288 mini-kaszi to command. 1 kaszi.
Everyday you could have 5472 mini-kaszi to command. 19 kaszi.
weaknesses: Someone uses a power to block a kaszi's pouch;no self-replication.

name: Celtic Invocation: Accasbel
description: By invoking the power of Accasbel, the invoker can do many things involving alcohol and its effects. They can turn the ingredients needed to make a type of alcohol into the drink, for example, hops and barely for beer, or grapes to wine. They can also invoke a sense of delusion and drunkenness in a target, and cure people of it too. Expert users can even add special 'ingredients' into the alcohol, such as emotions or memories, or make a drink everlasting, such as a bottomless bottle of vodka.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Accasbel, the Irish god of alcohol and taverns.
strengths: Alcohol and its effects are under your domain.
You never have to bother buying it yourself- you're your own still.
You'll be very popular at parties.
weaknesses: The invoker is not immune to the effects of alcohol or other users of this ability.
Only the most masterful users can create everlasting alcohol or add emotions to the alcohol.
Those with abilities that make them immune to alcohol or mental manipulation.

name: Backwards V2
description: With this power you can make people do everything backwards. They'll talk backwards, walk backwards, wear their clothes backwards, point their weapons backwards etc. You can use this on as many people as you want and reverse the effects when you're done.
summary: The ability to make people do everything backwards
strengths: Make people do things backwards
weaknesses: If the person normally did everything backwards they'll do everything the right way

name: Chaotic Mipedian
description: You can turn into any mipedian from the chaotic TV show. Transforming takes a lot of energy and concentration. When you're tired or unconscious you revert back to a human.
summary: The ability to turn into any mipedian from the chaotic card game or TV show
strengths: You can use any attack the mipedian can do
Survive in the desert
Turn invisible
weaknesses: Might be slow in cold climates

name: Mahoujutsu: Demonic Armor
description: Covers you in your own custom armor made out of a demon's soul. The longer you are in it, the closer you come to changing into a demon.
summary: The ability to summon demons to coat you in armor.
strengths: Strong armor.
Powerful attacks.
weaknesses: Can turn into a demon.
Can corrupt you.

name: Gate: 40 Rods Of Light
description: Must have Gates: Eight Gates in order to get this power. When this power is activated each gate fires a 1 metre rod of light from each corner and its center. The rods can then be used to entrap enemies by making a cage. The rods are of the 'visible' light spectrum.
summary: The ability to have the gates fire rods of light
strengths: Adds some offensive power to Gate: Eight Gates.
weaknesses: Must have Gate: Eight Gates.
Position that rods are fired from cannot be changed.

A reversed gas still tends to rise or sink in the air based on its density in the same way as its normal version.
