name: Parasitic Negotiation
description: With this power, you can communicate with human parasites; head lice, tics, fleas etc. You also gain good diplomatic skills with this power. Instead of killing the parasites, you can strike deals with them. You may ask them to take less blood, or slow breeding down, in return for you not killing them. It also works with not-really parasitic creatures, like mosquitoes. You can make the air around you as forbidden air-space, in return for not swatting them. You can regulate tape worms as well!
summary: The ability to strike deals with parasites
strengths: Have friendly parasites living on/in your body. HARMONY WITH HEAD LICE!
Communicate with parasites on other people as well.
Generate mosquito-free zones.
weaknesses: You have to promise something in return, and if you break it, they go back to their nasty selves.
People might try to kill them, despite your protesting.
Human parasites only.

name: Color Identifier
description: You have the great option of knowing what the exact color is of a car, shoes, T-shirt, etc. You want to know the color of something, then touch it with one of your hands or both hands and you'll find out at the blink of an eye what the exact color is. You won't just know that something is crimson, but also the variation or different shade, such as Harvard crimson.
summary: The ability to see the name of a color by touching the t shirt, car, etc by touching it with your hands
strengths: You can know your buying the car of the exact color you want
It's a passive power so people can't get hurt compared to if you have optic blasts
Its something you can control so playing basketball, and other things won't be inconvenient
weaknesses: For something involving multiple colors you have to touch the item repeatedly to know all colors
Not a visible physical power so you can't use it to end a argument of what color something is
You could cheat if something involves answering a question of what color is this car, t shirt, etc

name: Seeing Gibberish
description: With this ability you can cause others to view any wrriten words as an unreadable mess or in other words, gibberish. Affected people will not be able to read anything.
summary: The ability to cause others to view any written words as gibberish
strengths: Confuse enemies
weaknesses: Affected have a hard time writing

name: Condition Change: Forests
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a forest. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is in a forest
strengths: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near forests.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Religious Power Boost
description: With this power, your powers get boosted depending on how strongly you believe in a religion. If you are religious at all, this will give a boost; if agnostic, you'll get a slight boost and for atheists there is no boost.
summary: The ability to boost religion-based powers based on your own faith.
strengths: If religious, your religion-based powers are boosted.
You can further your faith's cause with your amplified powers.
You can even follow any religion and get a boost.
weaknesses: If atheist, your religion-based powers are the same (not boosted).
No powers can eliminate the con of this superpower.
If you have no religion-based superpowers.

name: Vomiting Bulbs
description: While thinking about someone, you can vomit a light bulb with their name on it. The light bulb will remain lit as long as this person is alive, its colour will vary according to their situation. You will also know where that person is, and even communicate with them. If the light bulb is broken, you will lose all contact. You can eat the light bulb after use to store it. While holding the light bulb, that person will not be able to harm you. You can vomit any numbers of light bulbs.
summary: The ability to vomit light bulbs that give you information about people
strengths: You can know where is anyone.
While holding a light bulb that person cannot harm you.
Can talk to anyone no matter how far they are.
weaknesses: Have to vomit and eat light bulbs.
You only can make one light bulb for each person.
Light bulbs only work while you hold them.

name: Zord Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Power Ranger Zord from any of the shows or movies. The Zords are under your complete control and you can summon as many as you want. You can also summon whole teams of Zords and make them form Megazords to fight for you. Once your done with them you can just send them back to wherever they came from.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Power Ranger Zords
strengths: You can summon Zords
The Zords are under your complete control
You can make them form Megazords
weaknesses: They can be destroyed

name: Rat Control/Mutation
description: With this power you can control and mutate any species of rat. When you mutate it, it becomes six feet tall gains super strength, sharper teeth and it can spit poison it can also launch its claw at people like some sort of projectile and have new claws grow in right after. Its tail also becomes super sharp and the rat can use it as a sword. When you're done with the rat you can just unmutate it and send it away.
summary: The ability to control and mutate any species of rat
strengths: You can control and mutate any species of rat
When you're done you can unmutate the rat and send it away
weaknesses: Only works for rats not mice or any other rodent

name: Call Of Cthulhu
description: With this power, all you need do is pick up a phone and say "Call Cthulhu" into the receiver. Within seconds, the Great Old One will pick up the phone, and you can talk to him. He will respond to you and act as if you might have been an old friend of his from school.
summary: The ability to call Cthulhu from any phone
strengths: You get to talk to Cthulhu
I'm sure Cthulhu knows a lot more than you do, and he might share that knowledge if you're nice
If you're really nice, and Cthulhu is in a good mood, he might just unleash his hell on your enemies
weaknesses: Cthulhu might be busy, and he probably doesn't like being interrupted
You may go insane from the knowledge he bestows upon you
You probably shouldn't make jokes at his expense

name: U.C.S.
description: This power is more of a curse because it's shapeshifting with two twists. 1/You cannot control which form you transform into but they will only be human forms. And 2/You shapeshift every few seconds from the moment that you are born and so on even after you die (if you do die. ) This is great for being a spy or thief however no one will know or love you. You're new bodies may have different skin color, eye color, hair color, voice tone, biological age, gender and various other qualities.
summary: The ability to uncontrollably and continuously shapeshift into different human forms.
strengths: Be the best spy since your fingerprints/features will continuously change.
Become immortal since you will keep shifting to another form that could be younger.
Regenerate from any physical injuries. (Not while something like a bullet is stuck inside of you)
weaknesses: You can never be loved, known or remembered (Since you can't control the power. )
You might turn into a 115 year old and die.
If you are completely obliterated, you're dead since no one can survive that.

name: Double Double Speak Speak
description: With this power you can cause people to repeat every single word they say. This isn't real useful except for that it annoys the speaker and anyone listening to them talk. You can undo this.
summary: The ability to make people say every word twice
strengths: You can make people repeat every single word they say
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Kiss Me Deadly
description: You can gain the ability to poison people through a kiss, you can even poison your weapons by breathing on them.
summary: The ability to poison anything in your path, by kissing or touching whatever they came into contact with.
strengths: You could even exhale a poisonous mist at your foe, which kills them.
weaknesses: It can only work for females.

name: Demon Fury
description: Super speed, strength, stamina, acrobatics, and pain. You get covered in energy. Good news is, it's hard to break through, bad news it hurts like a b! #$%@. People will fear you and you get healed by this energy. It also shortens your lifespan because of it's healing factor. This energy actually burns your skin so if you didn't have that healing factor you'd look like a burn victim from the Chicago fire. Also ghostly unbreakable bones float over you.
summary: The ability to have the power of a 2nd form tailed beast from naruto
strengths: Super strong and super fast
Super agile and don't get tire easily
Heals
weaknesses: Burns you
Shortens your lifespan
Control is difficult when you use it at high levels.

name: Multiple Personality
description: Are you bored? Have a fun conversation with Frank, the grumpy old man in your head who refers to you as a whippersnapper. Or maybe Ferdinand, the former Chancellor of the Prussian Empire, to discuss the pros and cons of your newest stock portfolio.
summary: The ability to have a party, but in your head!
strengths: Never lonely
Have skills and knowledge of your other self
weaknesses: Posible to get commited to an asylum
You talk to your self

name: Fist Scanner V2
description: With this power you can know the heigh, length and width of something just by pointing your fist at it.
summary: The ability to know the exact measurements of any object just by pointing your fist at it
strengths: You can know the exact measurements of something just by pointing your fist at it
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Rise Of The Mummy
description: With this power you can turn into the mummy from Wizards of Waverly Place in order to fight crime. This means you can turn people into your minions and trap them in hieroglyphs
summary: The ability to turn into a mind controlling mummy
strengths: You can control any number of people
You can store them in hieroglyphs when you're not using them
weaknesses: You have a strong addiction to cookie dough ice cream
If your gauze gets unwrapped you automatically turn back into your human form and lose this power

name: Myth Power: Eusebia's Sapience
description: Eusebia (Eusebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of piety, duty and filial respect. As such, channeling her allows one to strengthen one's connection to deities of one's same moral alignment for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity, by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Eusebia's command over the essence of piety, duty and filial respect
strengths: Psychically strengthen connection to deities of similar moral alignment, regardless of pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel pious people/people of faith
Psychically inflict pain/injury on atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious at will
weaknesses: When active, cannot use MythPower: Dyssebia's Defiance or other anti-divine abilities (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive, communicate with and heal loved ones until the higher levels (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summon Kystian Guns Trader
description: The Kyst dimension keeps all the weapons of any fallen foes who dared try and invade it. The corpse-like weapon merchant you summon with this power will trade you one in exchange for a thinking non-kystian being. As for the weapons, think of the Men in Black movies or the Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy books, but Star Wars or Star Trek will work too. A weapon will be explained and if it needs ammo of some kind you will be given enough. Your trade could be a thinking clone of someone.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive weapon dealer.
strengths: High-speed nucleoannihilator pistol. It annihilates-good enough.
The assault ultraeliminator. It eliminates-do you need to know more?
A variable gravitic exploder. It explodes using gravity. Enough said.
weaknesses: A one for one trade.

name: Summon Yuru
description: Yuru look like badly out of focus humanoids. They seem to warp and distort space wherever they stand. Yuru can send someone to Kyst by sight or touch. This can affect someone visible in this universe but partly existing in another universe, e.g. the astral plane. Yuru are summoned with weapons. Two pistols, a melee weapon and a rifle. If the weapons are lost somehow, yuru are still strong enough to lift 20 tons. Yuru see perfectly well despite what they look like.
summary: The ability to summon a dimension-warping kystian.
strengths: Dimensional banishment, energy weapons and inhuman strength.
Foes that have never encountered them will think gaze-based powers are useless.
Give a yuru the power to see the invisible.
weaknesses: Reality anchoring or some other power that someone will think of.

name: Creepy Clone
description: You can clone an evil version of yourself and let the clone do your chorus/work for you. You can decide if and which of your powers the clone posesses.
summary: The ability to clone an evil clone of yourself
strengths: You have your very own clone living your life and you can do whatever you want to do!
You can grant the clone powers and take them away from the clone.
Only 1 clone at any given time.
weaknesses: The clone is evil.
The clone may turn people against you.
The clone may have an obsession to rule the world.

name: Sunproof Skin
description: No longer with this power would you have to put on sunscreen, and wait 20 minutes before going to the pool, beach, etc. You don't have to worry about getting sunburned, and you can save money since you don't have to buy sunscreen.
summary: The ability to not get sunburned
strengths: No having to put on sunscreen before going to beach, pool, etc
Your skin can't get sunburned from the sun
Unless as a gift or present for someone else you don't have to buy sunscreen anymore
weaknesses: You can still get skin diseases
You are still vulnerable to sweating, heatstrokes, and other problems scorching days can produce

name: Golf Cart
description: You can summon golf carts of any model, size,etc.
summary: The ability to summon golf carts.
strengths: Its a way of transportation.
weaknesses: Golf carts really aren't that fast........

name: Enhancement: Radioactive
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power act like it is radioactive. E. G. Physical-based powers give off radiation that only you are immune to, and mental powers feel like they are giving off radioactive 'particles'. Potency is set at beta radiation. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced. This can only be attached to one power at a time.
summary: The ability to make a power act radioactive by attaching this power to it
strengths: Makes mind-based powers act like they are radioactive.
You are immune to the 'radiation' this power gives off.
Potency is at a good level.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can still be damaged by other radiation.
Might not want a power to be radioactive.

name: Herbology: Immemor Arbor
description: While the Immemor Arbor may be beautiful, its fruits are bittersweet. It looks to be a normal tree, with thorned blue flowers sprouting from the branches. The tree gets its name from the toxin within the flowers. The toxin grants its victims temporary superhuman strength, speed, agility, and reflexes, it also causes total memory loss. The toxin begins to kill after the superhuman abilities wear off.
summary: The ability to summon an Immemor Arbor
strengths: The toxin can be separated into a poison, a superhuman serum, and a memory loss potion.
The flowers and their toxins can be very valuable.
The other parts of the tree (the bark, wood, leaves) all have their own properties.
weaknesses: This ability can be hard to discover without herbology, let alone use it properly.

name: Summon Carnallure
description: Carnallures are cousins of the norrs. If you die or they hurt you, they're unsummoned. They grudgingly accept they can't harm or kill you. Everyone else is fair game. Their favorite killing method is to look like a good looking human to lure a victim to his/her slow and painful death. A carnallure's real form is a 6-foot tall column of quivering flesh-like substance. Nothing will hurt them. They are strong as four normal men. Seeing them shape change is the only way to kill them.
summary: The ability to summon a shapeshifting half-alive thing.
strengths: A majority (?) of people are safe from them.
They won't hurt or kill you.
A shapeshifting (if somewhat Hannibal Lecter like) helper.
weaknesses: You've summoned a shapeshifting serial killer to this world.

name: Mimic Slave
description: This power can only be active if you copied it. If the person from whom you copied it gives you an order, you will be forced to obey them. This power also prevents you from having any bad feelings, intentions or opinion about that person. You only take orders from the person from whom you directly copied it, not the one from whom that person copied it, if that's the case. It works as long as they don't lose their power. If you obtained it in any ways other than duplication, nothing happens.
summary: The ability to obey and not to want to harm or kill the person from whom you duplicated this superpower.
strengths: If you obtained this power in any other way, you don't have to obey anyone.
You can command anyone who copies this power from you, even if you already have a master yourself.
If your master loses their ability, they will also lose their power on you.
weaknesses: If they recover it (not through copy nor by stealing someone else's), they can control you again.
You should not copy this ability and it's useless if noone duplicates it from you.
This power can still be stolen, deleted, cancelled, etc.

name: Poison Dart Strike V4 Spirits
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from your hands but they can only hurt spirits (ghosts, angels, demons etc. ) these poison darts will paralyze the victim for about twenty minutes after they pass through them but after twenty minutes the spirit will probably seek vengeance on you.
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze spirits for up to twenty minutes
weaknesses: As soon as the spirit is free they will most likely kill you

name: Obelisk The Tormentor
description: This power is something you should cherish, you have great power but at risk you have to bind your very soul to the god. You have all of his powers and memories
summary: The ability to turn into Obelisk the Tormentor from Yu-Gi-Oh
strengths: Your strength is four thousand times stronger when you are in this form
You are the Epitome of all evil
You are immortal in this form
weaknesses: You are not a god you just look like him
You look scary and evil
You have to pray to Obelisk the Tormentor

name: Delete This Ocd
description: not a superpower
summary: The ability to be obsessed over details
strengths: Have OCD
It makes it easier to make friends.
weaknesses: You worry too much

name: Apoco Blast
description: This is a very serious and powerful attack that involves the utmost concentration, willpower, and inner strengh to unleash. What happens is that you take in energy from the universe around you, add in your own plus your strengh and willpower, and unleash an apocolyptic blast of pure energy that destroy a world of any size. The one deadly backdraw is that the person who used it is also eliminated with the blast.
summary: The ability to destroy any world in a single, concentrated blast
strengths: Completely destroys a planet.
weaknesses: Destroys the user completely

name: Cheap Summoner
description: The ability to instantly summon half of any object to your general location. Once half is summoned, you cannot simply summon the other half because you would only end up with half of the remaining half or a forth of the original. You cannot unsummon an object to return it to its original structure. You are able to choose which half is summoned.
summary: The ability to summon half of an object.
strengths: Some is better than none.
Cutting things in half.
If you have twice what you need of something, you can summon the half you need.
weaknesses: Don't summon living things. They dont like being cut in half.
Summoning unstable items can have bad side effects.
Would need two of everything for this power to be useful.

name: Summoning: Recall
description: Can send summons back to where they were summoned from, or return people from certain places that you summoned then to.
summary: The ability to recall any summons.
strengths: Can return summons, or people.
Easy to use.
weaknesses: No use in actual combat.

name: Old One Power: Zalgo
description: Zalgo is the god of and source of a force that we have no name for save Zalgo, created by the interaction of the hivemind called "Anonymous" with the forces of the Old Ones. Zalgo's force causes corruption, mutation, insanity, hatred, violence, and death. Fully unrestrained, it would cause the apocalypse. You can control this force and use it to achieve virtually any effect of corruption. While Zalgo is presently sealed from this universe, you can contact him. He is very intelligent.
summary: The ability to channel the power of the (Old One? ) Zalgo
strengths: You can control (very loosely) the beasts that result from life + Zalgo force.
The Zalgo force works on inanimate objects too. A building might have impossible architecture.
Zalgo himself can be contacted, may provide useful advice, and protect you from his apocalypse.
weaknesses: The force cannot move through walls, believe it or not. It can move through openings, though.
There is essentially no beneficial use of your power, except selectively killing evil.
Zalgo will be in your head, trying to get you to help break down the wall keeping him out of reality

name: Glutton's Jaw
description: With this power you can consume anything with one bite by morphing your jaw to any size you can manage. This power also has the side effect of applying pressure to whatever you eat while it is in your digestive system so that you do not explode from eating something too large. Most people with this power could only eat things up to the size of an airplane.
summary: The ability to consume almost anything with one bite.
strengths: Eat things you could not before.
Consume things before they can harm you.
Great party trick.
weaknesses: Without other powers, only eating the size of an airplane is obtainable.
You may not be able to digest the things that you eat.
Using the bathroom after eating something the size of an airplane.

name: Myth Power: Telete's Test
description: Telete, in Greek myth, was the goddess of initiation into mystery rites, such as cults and secret societies. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive the locations of meeting places for cults and secret societies. In addition, one may psychically perceive, communicate and compel members of secret societies and cults. Furthermore, one may inscribe arcane symbols on matter by touch; only the user, and subjects chosen by him, may interact with inscribed objects or subjects.
summary: The ability to channel Telete's command over the essence of mystic initiation
strengths: Psychically perceive the locatons of meeting places for cults and secret societies
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel secret society/cult members
Inscribe matter with cryptic symbols; only the user and chosen subjects can sense/interact with them
weaknesses: Only encode speech/writing into a special language for user and chosen subjects at the higher levels
Cannot decipher arcane/occult language to cast arcane/occult spells until the higher levels (NCN)
People with MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to this ability

name: Fovea Displacement
description: A fovea (plural foveae) is a small area inside each eye responsible for sharp central vision. Usually, when you look at something, you can pick out its details only if it's in the center of your visual field. Otherwise, it's just a blur. This power allows you to shift your two foveae so you can pick out details of things that you're not directly looking at. However, a human fovea is usually deprived of rod cells, so this power is useless in a situation where there's not enough light.
summary: The ability to change the position of your foveae.
strengths: Freak out people by being aware of your surrounding without moving your eyes or your head.
weaknesses: You can see something if it's in your visual field.
This power is useless in dim lights.

name: Head Needles
description: Shoot needles out of your head. They are poisonous.
summary: The ability to shoot needles out of your head
strengths: Deadly assassination
Thin hard-to-see needles
weaknesses: Could look weird
May hurt your head
Could hit yourself

name: Celeb Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any famous person who ever lived. You can get into parties, get free stuff, make celebrities look bad, scare people by turning into dead celebrities etc. You can stay in celebrity mode for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into any celebrity who ever lived
strengths: You can turn into any celebrity dead or alive
weaknesses: People might realize that you're not the real deal

name: Avatar Summon V2
description: (If you like the Legend of Korra the animated series then this power is for you) with this power you  Can summon any of the sixty one characters that is from the series. You can only summon one character at a time. Know your history
summary: The ability to summon any character from the Legend of Korra the animated series
strengths: You can summon any of the sixty one characters
You will meet the decedents of aangs avatar group
They will teach you many things
weaknesses: Amon will try to stripe you of your power
Summoning teams and armies will be hard
You can only summon one character at a time (no Con Negation)

name: Sixshooter
description: With this power you can cause five extra gun barrels to pop out of any normal gun. Each extra barrel holds six bullets and is operated by the same trigger as the original barrel.
summary: The ability to cause five extra guns pop out of any normal gun
strengths: You can five extra gun barrels to pop out of any normal gun
Each of the extra guns can hold up to six bullets
weaknesses: You can still run out of bullets

name: Playing Possum
description: This power allows you to stop your heart and make you skin cold just like a real corpse. You will look and feel dead, then reawaken at will.
summary: The ability to stop heart and actually seem dead.
strengths: Can pretend to be dead if someone is trying to kill you.
Can wake up anytime you want.
weaknesses: Can only stay dead for a maxium of four hours.
If harmed during fake death, then you will stay dead.

name: Imaginary Friendship
description: This power binds you to someone (You can't choose who) and allows you to see anything they imagine and make it real. However, the subject's mind has a noticeable affect on yours. If they're childish or immature, so are you, etc. Only the subject can see you, unless they want someone else to see you as well. The power runs out when the subject dies (and then you die) or decides to let you go (in which case you are free, and retain the power, only not bound to a single individual)
summary: The ability to turn someone else's imagination into reality.
strengths: A close friendship with whoever you're bound to.
Because of the effect on your mentality, anything they imagine is fun for you to create
If you're manipulative enough, you could get the subject to imagine whatever you want
weaknesses: Potential death
Having to be bound to one person, unable to interact with anyone else, unless the person wills it
You're basically a slave

name: Living Sponge
description: You will be able suck up any liquid like a sponge. However, your skin will not have holes like a real sponge.
summary: The ability to suck up any liquid just by touching it like sponge.
strengths: Can clean up a mess easily.
weaknesses: Have a limited ability to suck up free liquids (none contained within other things)
Cannot swim or will became to heavy to move (if you can't control it).
Will swell up if to much liquid.

name: Rise Of The Talking Monkey
description: With this power you can turn into a super smart talking monkey in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into a talking monkey
strengths: You're super smart in this form
You're a monkey!
weaknesses: You might get put in a zoo

name: Delete This Ultra Backbreaker
description: You could grab your opponent lifting them in mid-air, flying upwards, hooking both hands around the opponent's back then taunt your enemy and break them in half, shattering their spine using both knees.
summary: The ability to lift your foe up in the air, fly up then slam their backs with your knees.
strengths: Your foe might not able to walk again.
weaknesses: None.

name: Snap You're Lonely
description: With this power whenever you snap and say "Lonely (insert person's name)" that person will instantly be overwhelmed by a feeling of loneliness. Additionally people will stop talking to and hanging out with that person. You can reverse the affects of this power by saying "(insert person's name) lonely. "
summary: The ability to make people lonely
strengths: You can make people lonely
You can use this power on yourself if you want people to stop talking to you
You can reverse the affects of this power
weaknesses: You can't just make a person feel lonely or just make people stop talking to a person

name: Mutant Frog Summon
description: With this power you can summon mutant frogs that are seven feet tall, have horns and can shoot lasers from their eyes. The mutant frogs also have very powerful legs and they can jump long distances. They are under your complete control and when you're done with them you can send them to a pocket dimension where they will wait until you need them again. You can only summon three mutant frogs at a time but if one dies you can promptly summon another one to take its place.
summary: The ability to summon mutant frogs
strengths: You can summon mutant frogs
You have complete control over the frogs
The frogs are seven feet tall and can shoot lasers
weaknesses: The frogs are not invincible
You can only summon three of them at a time

name: Myth Power: Kraipale's Credit
description: Kraipale (Craipale), in Greek myth, was the goddess of crapulence; the consequences of overindulgence (eating or drinking too much, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to induce, amplify, reduce or negate hangover and stomachache, by touch. In addition, one can eat and drink infinitely if one desires (never getting full, and passing on feelings of stomachache, drunkenness and hangover to foes). One can even mimic hangover symptoms (headache, nausea, etc) to use as superpowers at will.
summary: The ability to channel Kraipale's command over the essence of the hangover and other consequences of overindulgence
strengths: Induce, amplify, reduce and negate hangover/stomachache by touch
Eat infinitely, if desired; never get full, pass stomacheache/drunkenness/hangover onto foe
Mimic hangover symptoms to use as superpowers (headache=psionic blast, etc)
weaknesses: Stomach aches suck; Hangovers suck even worse
Cannot summon a chalice of healthy Hangover-Free wine to drink until the higher levels (NCN)
Wine/festivity-based MythPowers provide immunity

name: Axis
description: With this power, you basically are the axis of the earth. Wherever you go on the planet, the earth will spin beneath you. This grants you tremendous power to reshape the earth. Moving to the equator will cause the earth's climate to constantly shift throughout the year. Moving to the exact top or bottom of the earth will do away with seasons altogether. Anyone with this ability will likely be exiled to the north or south pole.

strengths: You can cause any person to fall from the sky
weaknesses: You cannot unsummon the person with this power
The person is not under your control and won't necessarily help you

name: Dolls Eye Contact
description: The user of this ability is able to place the mind/spirit of a person who looks into the persons eyes. The body left behind can be controlled like a puppet by the user, since it has no consciousness. The doll at first will just be blank. But when the persons mind/spirit enters it, it will gain the look of that person. The persons aware of what's going on as well. This can only be used on one person each time, since it requires focus to control the body and the person trapped in the doll.
summary: The ability to place a persons mind into a doll
strengths: User can control the persons body, making it fight for him/her
Able to switch minds with him/herself and the person, still retaining their powers
When the victims mind is destroyed, the body is a permanent puppet so the user can use another doll
weaknesses: Person who's caught eyesight with user falls into a 5 second trance, allowing someone to save them
This can be avoided when wearing glasses or another way to not look into the users eyes
If the doll is destroyed but not the mind, it will return to its own body

name: Teenager's Invulnerability
description: During adolescence, the frontal lobe is under development and as a result, judgement of the consequences of one's actions is often poor. This power compensates by providing immunity while in this dangerous state. It will not work if you are of sound mind during this phase, but may activate if the same mentality arises at another time.
summary: The ability to be invulnerable to physical harm in adolescence.
strengths: Rode a bike down a hill, lost control and slammed into a concrete wall? No problem (for you).
The judgement of risk/reward is now truly an afterthought.
Even protects against things outside your control, effectively insuring you reach adulthood.
weaknesses: Cons cannot be removed by another power.
Only works while in this judgement-deprived state.
Does not protect you against diseases and still leaves you fertile.

name: Myth Power: Course Of Chronoi 2
description: The Chronoi (Khronoi, Times), in Greek myth, were the gods of past, present and future. As such, channeling Enestos (Enestus- Present), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically receive insights from the present, at will. One can also psychically pause subjects' perception of the present, by touch, word or thought. One can also psychically summon past and/or future targets to the present, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Chronoi and their command over the essence of past, present and future
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically preceive updates about the present, freeze subjects' senses in the present moment
Psychically summon past/future targets to the present, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically remove memories/negate visions of the past, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically bestow visions of the present, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically remove ability to plan for/negate visions of the future, until developed (NCN)

name: White Lotus Amulet
description: A person who is good in nature and comes into possession of the mystical white lotus amulet will be granted superhuman strength, reflexes and the ability to sense danger and evil when he or she rubs the amulet. For some reason, the amulet only bestow powers to those of Asian descent
summary: The ability to be granted powers from the magical white lotus amulet
strengths: Can take on most powerhouses
weaknesses: Must continue to be on the side of good to use it
User will be rendered powerless within five minutes if someone seperates the amulet from the user

name: Pregnancy Control
description: The ability to control whether a woman becomes pregnant and what the results of the pregnancy will be.
summary: The ability to control pregnancy and whether a woman becomes pregnant.
strengths: You could have a say in whether a woman becomes pregnant or not
No need for birth control
weaknesses: Doesn't help with preventing STD's

name: Rhinos To Unicorns
description: With this power, you can transform any rhinoceros into a mythical unicorn, as long as the rhino still has its horns.
summary: The ability to turn rhinos into unicorns
strengths: Can make lots of money selling unicorns
weaknesses: Have to spend lots of money to buy the rhinos

name: Ultimate Disc Jockey
description: Okay, so with this ability, you can make exquisite symphonic super electronic BEATS. In addition to this ever-so-awesome ability, you have the ability to make funky flows on records.
summary: The ability to make exquisite beats.
strengths: Bring back Hip-Hop.
weaknesses: You still can't rap.

name: Easy Open Destroyer
description: When you use this power on a container with an easy-open system, the next person who tries to open it will break whatever usually made it so easy to open. So, they could tear the corner of a sachet and the tear will be very close to open the bag, but it won't. They could pull on the tab of a beverage can and the tab will break. They could pull off the seal of a bottle top and a portion of it will stay in their hand. They could open a zipper bag and the slider will either get stuck or break.
summary: The ability to weaken easy-open systems, such as sachet corners or soda can tabs
strengths: You will be a major havok wreaker and bring intense frustration to your victims.
With experience, you can infect someone so they temporarily break every easy-open system they touch.
You could weaken every beer can in a mall during sport seasons.
weaknesses: You can only affect containers with systems designed to be easily opened.
Using adequate tools, anyone can manage to open the affected container.

name: Solid Muck
description: Can only be used if near any mud/muck. Pushing and pulling the muck with your power will cause it to turn solid. You can then control it at your will, but if it gets wet, it will turn back into liquid.
summary: The ability to turn mud/muck into solid ground
strengths: It's invincible to fire and electric
weaknesses: The harder the muck, the harder it is to control
Vulnerable to water

name: Myth Power: Britomartis' Best
description: Britomartis (Dictynna, Diktynna, Dicte, Dikte), in Greek myth, was the goddess of nets, for hunting, fishing and fowling. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with animals that are hunted in one's vicinity (for food, sport, etc). In addition, one can psychically summon nets, of various sizes and types (razor, electrified, butterfly, fish etc) at will. One can even psychically store any subject one captures in a net, in a pocket dimension.
summary: The ability to channel Britomartis' command over the essence of nets used for hunting, fishing and fowling
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with game animals
Psychically summon nets of various sizes, types and utilities (electrified, razor, etc) at will
Psychically store any net-captured subjects in a pocket dimension, at will
weaknesses: Cannot compel hunters or command game animals until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically replicate net-captured subjects, and compel the replicates, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith, Hand of the Harvest and Artemis' Art provides immunity (NCN)

name: Tacokinesis
description: Anytime, anywhere, with the snap of your fingers, a large taco materializes in front of you.
summary: The ability to summon up large tacos
strengths: They're not crappy Taco Bell tacos. They're the best tacos you've ever tasted
Tacos summoned are larger the hungrier you are
weaknesses: You don't get to pick the kind, it's always a beef taco
Tacos summoned are smaller the fuller you are

name: Weapon: Blutsauger
description:
Blutsauger gains more power the more blood it devours and the wielder's hands feed blood to this sword at a rate dependent on the user and the hunger of the sword. The power boosts the users body and the sword's magical power. Blood from open wounds made by this sword will continue to flow from the wound to the sword unless bandaged. If this sword is blocked then it will create a shockwave that disrupts the blocker's balance and causes lacerations. 

User becomes a pseudovampire when in use.
summary: The ability to wield the cursed vampire sword Blutsauger
strengths: Unblockable and once hit, its only a matter of time before enemy's blood drains completely
Gets more magical power the more blood it drains and gives the user a boost
User has simple vampiric abilities like superstrength without the weaknesses
weaknesses: If opponent can dodge your sword
You become a host to this sword when using it (Time limit if you want to stay human)
If you go over 1/3 of your own blood, if you let go of the sword you will die

name: Rise Of The Unicronians
description: With this power you can turn into any Unicronian (a minion of Unicron) that is not a Transformer. You cannot turn into any of the Cybertronian minions of Unicron because they are covered by Rise Of The Transformers. You still have some pretty powerful forms such as Hook, Line and Sinker, Carcass and the Piranacons. You can stay in these forms for as long as you want and Unicron will have no control over you whatsoever (unless of course he actually brainwashes you or something).
summary: The ability to turn into any of the non transformer unicronians
strengths: You can turn into any non-Cybertronian Unicronian
Unicron has no control over you unless he brainwashes you
weaknesses: You can't turn into any Cybertronians with this power

name: Tint
description: With this power you can change everything to a single color and everything will turn that color, people, the sky, objects, animals, everything. You can change the color as many times as you want and to make it normal again you just have to shout out "Normal".
summary: The ability to cause the entire world to be one color
strengths: You can change everything in the world to one color
weaknesses: It all or nothing you can't turn certain things certain colors and other things other colors

name: Troll Feeder
description: You can make someone inclined to respond to a troll, no matter how obvious. In addition, you can make someone plain irritable, and initiate fights between people. However, some people with a strict mindset take a bit more time and energy to affect with this power. Anyone highly resistant to any kind of mind control will very easily wave away your powers, especially if their power is resistance to any kind of mind control.
summary: The ability to make someone inclined to respond to trolling/insults.
strengths: Great for starting fights between to enemies that normally get along.
You can make people break up if you wish.
Instant success at trolling!
weaknesses: You might be seen as a villain.
If you look too smug, people might get suspicious.
You can only remove your own-induced irritableness, not natural irritableness

name: Super Sniff
description: Hypersensitive smelling ability, enabling you to pick out individual smells (odors) from a distance.
summary: The ability to smell distinct odors from a distance.
strengths: You can track anyone from a distance without having to listen to or look at them.
You can impress your girl by noticing she's using a different perfume.
weaknesses: You're not immune to bad odors

name: Cold Blood
description: You have the basic ability to start pumping out reptilian blood cells in your body, giving you cold blood. It takes roughly 3-5 miniutes for all your blood to become cold (the warm blood cells need to die first) You need to sleep for 4 months straight to get your blood back to normal. :-(
summary: The ability to change your blood in your body from warm blood to cold blood.
strengths: People with heat-sensing powers can't feel you.
In fact, any heat-sensing device can't detect you.
You get a free forked tongue BTW.
weaknesses: You can't get warm unless it's hot weather.
This power will only wear off after hibernation.
Too much cold kills you.

name: Ultimate Zombie
description: This ability allows you to be the Blade of the zombies. You will be able to survive anything short of destruction of the brain stem. You can go without food, water or air, allowing you to walk on the ocean floor (zombies don't float). You'll be stronger too, can't be compelled by someone with power over zombies, can't be bitten by them or transformed into them. You won't have any of their weaknesses and you stay in the same human form.
summary: The ability to have a zombie's strengths, while having none of their weaknesses
strengths: You are safe from other zombies and people that can control them.
you are invulnerable to starvation, dehydration, asphyxiation and aging.
You stay in your human form and have no zombie weaknessess
weaknesses: Never experience what's it like as a zombie
Can't blend in with zombies

name: Brain Eater V2
description: With this power you can gain people's memories and knowledge when you eat their brains. It doesn't matter how long the person's been dead this power will always work when you eat someone's brain but you only keep their memories and knowledge for twenty four hours after eating the brain.
summary: The ability to gain people's memories and knowledge when you eat their brains
strengths: You can gain people's memories and knowledge when you eat their brains
weaknesses: You only have the memories and knowledge for twenty four hours
Brains probably don't taste so good

name: Foe Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn into any person that you don't like. When you do this you gain all of their powers and skills while keeping all of your knowledge, intelligence level and personality. You can stay in foe mode for as long as you like.
summary: The ability to turn into anybody that you don't like
strengths: You can turn into anybody that you don't like
You gain all of their powers and abilities
You retain your personality and intelligence
weaknesses: If you don't have any enemies this power does nothing for you

name: Party Cat
description: At will, you can force nearby individuals to party -- within a km radius of your location. You can only party if others are nearby. All party supplies are summoned magically. Supplies never run out. Also, you are the life of the party.
summary: The ability to generate a party whenever possible
strengths: Can party whenever
Life of the party
weaknesses: People will get sick of partying nonstop
You must party whenever possible
Neighbors complain about you wherever you live

name: Condition Change: Shield
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on shields. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different type of object. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require being used on a shield in order to work
strengths: Now all you have to do is avoid being hit with a shield.
If you have an opponent who hates using shields.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.
Opponents who keep armories full of shields.

name: Film Revolution
description: Let's say you have a negative (for the young ones who don't know what a negative film is in photography, Google and Wikipedia are your friends) and you want to develop pictures out of them. Obviously, stores that still use this obsolete argentic technology are extremely rare, so it's a near impossible task... unless you have this power! With it, you can create the corresponding silver-based pictures without any complicated equipment and dangerous chemicals.
summary: The ability to create photographs out of negative films.
strengths: You are the savior of all grandmas and grandpas who still own negative films but can't develop them.
Film photography is a very reliable technology to create high-quality pictures.
You can create photographs in any sizes.
weaknesses: Digital photography overthrew analog photography, so negative films can only be found in attics.
You can only create photographs out the negatives.
Negatives are very sensitive to light and can be destroyed if you're not careful.
tags: was edited as it was too similar to another power

name: Myth Power: Hestia's Hearth
description: Hestia, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the home, the hearth (ie fireplace) fire, domestic life and architecture. As such, channeling her allows one to sense the location, layout and condition of any building at will. In addition, one may perceive and communicate with loved ones at will; one gains physical power to help loved ones in need. One may also do chores without tiring, and for each done by hand, another is done by divine intervention. One can even generate and manipulate fire at will.
summary: The ability to channel Hestia's command  over the essence of home, the hearth, domesticity, family and architecture
strengths: Psychically perceive the location/layout/condition of any building (including one's home) at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and gain physical power to help loved ones/allies at will
Do chores without tiring; for each chore, another is done by divine intervention; gain Pyrokinesis
weaknesses: Cannot channel knowledge/skills/abilities of loved ones until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot perceive a building's history or project sight within its structure until higher levels (NCN)
Cannot alter the structure of one's home until the highest levels (NCN)

name: Enhancement:  Heavy
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power's creations feel heavier. This is accomplished by increasing the general effects of gravity. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is enhanced permanently.
summary: The ability to make a super power's creations feel heavier
strengths: When used in conjunction with Enhancement Sharing.
Harder hits since you need to use more power to lift the creation.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Can only be attached to one power at a time.
Everything the power creates is heavier than normal.

name: Gladiatorial Entertainment
description: Gladiatorial entertainment is both a mental and physical ability. Those viewing the deaths see no harm in the deaths and even cheer. The power also increases the users strength and stamina to further please the crowds.
summary: The ability to entertain others with the gruesome deaths of your foes.
strengths: Increase to strength and stamina
Witnesses will express the necessity of the killing
weaknesses: The authorities won't always be present

name: Rise Of The Hippocamp
description: With this power you can turn into the mythical hippocamp; a half horse half fish creature from Greek Mythology. As a hippocamp you can breath underwater (fresh and salt) and on land, swim at great speed and have enhanced strength. You can stay in hippocamp form for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to turn into a hippocamp
strengths: You can turn into the mythical hippocamp
You can breathe underwater
You can stay in hippocamp mode for as long as you want
weaknesses: You can't walk on land due to not having feet

name: Word/Number Solidification
description: With this power, all you have to do is say a word or number, and it becomes solid, letters, digits, & all! Each letter or digit becomes a solid shape once you say the right word or number. You can then use the solid symbols as toys, shields, weapons, or whatever.
summary: The ability to make words or numbers you say solid
strengths: Create solid symbols with your own voice.
You can also rearrange the symbols to spell anagrams of the word or number.
The louder your voice, the bigger & harder the symbols.
weaknesses: Be careful! If the symbols become solid over your head, then they could fall on you & hurt you!
After a certain time period, the solid symbols melt away.
Bigger, harder symbols will be more difficult to lift, unless you have super strength!

name: The Pinocchio Theory
description: You can cast it on a foe by releasing a tannish mist through your index finger which is pointing at your opponent of course. Then, all of a sudden, the person starts to look and feel strange, their nose starting to grow straight across, but they don't know they are lying since their nose isn't growing really fast.
summary: The ability to cast a spell on a person that causes their nose to grow straight if they lie.
strengths: A good thing for utter humiliation.
weaknesses: None.
Well maybe except for the villain that you cast it on.

name: Super Smell
description: The ability to emit any odor for an undetermined amount of time.
summary: The ability to emit any odor
strengths: To create confusion or divert an adversary.
To escape from tracker dogs.
To form an attractive perfume or smell cleaned.
weaknesses: Your nose is not immune to bad odors.

name: Itch Inducing
description: If induced by a touch, it is called a Pruritic Touch; if induced by a thought it is just called Itch Inducing. Either way, the user of this ability can cause an itching sensation in nearby living beings. This itching can be varied in intensity at will as well, rangning from maybe a mosquito bite to a continuous, maddening itch that isn't easily relieved. This ability may also include the capability to SUPPRESS itching sensations as well (called Itch Negation).
summary: The ability to induce itching of varying intensity
strengths: Distract foes with annoying itch
Easily control the intensity of the induced itch
Negate itches at will (even itches not caused by you)
weaknesses: If you cause itching randomly (no control over the power)
If you can't stop the itching
If you can only INCREASE itching sensation (not start it or stop it)

name: Freezing Blood
description: This power only works when the blood is outside of your body and is at the user's will. The blood will go down to the temperature of 0 degrees centigrade to freeze what it touches. You are immune to the cold created with this power.
summary: The ability to have what one's blood touches freeze.
strengths: If you're bleeding, it is bad for your enemies.
weaknesses: You need to lose blood to use this power.

name: Muppet Power Kermit's Speech
description: With this power you will be able to give an inspirational speech whenever you want on any topic. Your friend just got dumped by his girlfriend inspire him to get her back, your friend fail a test inspire him to study harder next time. You can use this power as many times as you like and it works for anything. You might even end up inspiring yourself. A side effect of this power is that you are able to play the banjo with great skill.
summary: The ability to give inspirational speeches whenever you want on any subject
strengths: You can give an inspiring speech whenever you want
You can play the banjo
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
They might not be inspired by your speech

name: Instant Dryer
description: With this power you can make things become dry just by looking at them. Just took a shower but don't have to time to dry off just look at yourself and you'll be dry, need some clothes from the washing machine but don't have time to put them in the dryer just look at them. You cannot use this power on larger bodies of water or other liquids to dry them up.
summary: The ability to make thing dry by looking at them
strengths: You can make things dry just by looking at them
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You can't dry up large bodies of water

name: Drug Test
description: With this power you can instantly detect if a person is using drugs and what type of drug they are using. You can turn this power on and off. You will not know if the person was given a prescription to use said drug or not.
summary: The ability to know if a person is using drugs and what drug they are using
strengths: You can detect if a person is using drugs
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: You have no way of knowing whether or not the person was given a prescription for the drugs

name: Mystic Beard
description: You can control the movement of your long, thick beard that can snap the length of it through the air like a whip (the tip of which moves faster than the speed of sound), wrap your foe around it like a chain, can bind persons or objects with it as if it were rope, and can stiffing it like a pointed sword.
summary: The ability to use your beard as a lethal weapon.
strengths: If the beard is cut, it can grow back really fast.
weaknesses: Can be dangerous to wrap around and lift heavy objects.

name: Master Of Lava Lamps
description: Do you have an undying obsession with lava lamps? Or do you ever just wish your lava lamp would heat up quicker so you can be dazzled and amazed sooner? If you answered yes to any of the above, then whether you're an amateur lava lamp user or an avid collector of exquisite lamp pieces, this is the power for you. With this power, you can control lava lamps with your mind. Make them hot, make them cold, launch them at people, or explode them... The ball's in your court, O lover of lamps.
summary: The ability to telekinetically control lava lamps.
strengths: Makeshift lava lamp bombs -- molten lava lamp fluids can be quite deadly
Excellent way to start a conversation while at Spencer's gifts
Everybody loves lava lamps, therefore, everyone will love YOU.
weaknesses: Only limited to lava lamps
Requires a lava lamp to be within 1 mile of you

name: 1 Key Of Element
description: With this power you can unlock any elemental door that approaches you. By unlocking the door you unlock all knowledge of it.
summary: The ability to summon a key to unlock a door of elements.
strengths: Master 1 element.
weaknesses: Useless without a power to summon an element door.
Just one element.

name: Condition Change: Armor
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it can only be used on armor. This power will not affect a power already affected by another Condition Change that requires a different type of object. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power require being used on armor in order to work
strengths: Now all you have to do is avoid letting your opponent have armor.
If you have an opponent who hates using armor.
weaknesses: Have to touch the opponent and each touch affects only one power.
An opponent with multiple powers.
Opponents who keep armories full of armor.

name: Cactus Plant Shift
description: With this power you can turn any plant into a cactus just by looking at the desired plant and saying "You'd look better as a cactus. " You can turn any kind of plant into any kind of cactus. The cactus will be the same size as the plant so if you use this power on a big tree you get a big cactus and vice versa for grass and small flowers. This power can be used on cactuses to turn them into different kinds of cactuses as well. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn any plant into a cactus
strengths: You can turn any type of plant into any type of cactus

The plants remain the same size in cactus mode
weaknesses: The plants remain the same size in cactus mode
You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Cursed Artifact: Glasses
description: Only individuals with the Black Soul Enchanter ability who have placed their soul into a pair of glasses can create this. The glasses become a cursed artifact that become active only when worn by someone. The glasses possess the malevolent ability to cause immediate blindness to all that take them off. This is done by causing the eyelids of the wearer to fuse shut upon removal. Any attempts to correct this fusion, or cut the eyelids open causes them to fuse to the eyeball itself.
summary: The ability to create cursed glasses that make the wearer go blind
strengths: Can cause blindness in enemies who wear them.
weaknesses: Nothing differentiates them from regular glasses.
Can cause accidental blindness to friends who wear them

name: First Person Power
description: For example, if someone tries to say "See that guy over there? He's stupid," he'd end up saying "See me over here? I'm stupid. " He wouldn't notice it.

strengths: Kinda hilarious
weaknesses: Not very useful

name: Balance
description: Passively changing to a bad cop when incredibly annoyed, the power of balance allows a passive personality to emerge, who has a minor ability of enhancement, meaning that aspects of the normal personality are increaced including strength, speed etc The dominant can comminicate with the passive through reflections. the dominant and passive do not share their superpowers but the bad cop can use their enhancement power when passive to boost the superpowers of the other. The two have different names
summary: The ability to change from a good cop personality to a bad cop personality.
strengths: Enhanced superpowers.
Always have someone watching your back.
you never get lonely.
weaknesses: The bad cop can be patronising and mean and therefore get you into trouble
You become uncontrollable.
people may think you are a skitso.

name: Cat Breed Shift V2
description: With this power you can turn any wild/jungle cat into any kind of domestic house cat. The affects of this power are irreversible.
summary: The ability to change jungle/wild cats into domestic house cats
strengths: You can change jungle/wild cats into domestic house cats
weaknesses: The affects of this power are irreversible

name: Half Troll
description: Someone with this power has a higher resistance to physical and magical attacks, but is more susceptible to psychic/mental attacks. Also, they have a high regenerative factor that allows them to recover from most injuries within an hour, as well as higher physical strength.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-troll
strengths: Most magical and physical attacks you can shrug off with ease making you a great tank.
weaknesses: Mental attacks will be your greatest weakness.

name: Malleus Maleficarum
description: (Malleus Maleficarum is Latin for Hammer of the Witches) this power will teach you and give the knowledge on how to kill and torture witches. You need to know the history of the Salem witch trials and Malleus Maleficarum. This power is sadistic and it was made during the Salem witch trials
summary: The ability to gain knowledge on how to kill and torture witches
strengths: All forms of torture and weapons are in your disposal
All pagans and witches will fear you
weaknesses: You will go to jail or die or be attacked by the ghost rider

You will be hated by good and evil

name: Poison Dart Strike V6 Aliens
description: With this power you can shoot poison darts from both of your hands. The darts only affect aliens from planets other than the one that you live on. The darts paralyze the victim for twenty minutes so that you can capture, injure or kill them. Once the twenty minutes are up the victim unfreezes.
summary: The ability to shoot poison darts from your hands
strengths: You can paralyze aliens for up to twenty minutes
You can shoot them as many times as you want
weaknesses: Only affects aliens
Once they unfreeze they might try to kill you

name: Peep Duplication Army
description: Ever wanted to have your own army of candy? Well, all you have to do is to flick your fingers, and voila, a Peep appears. This Peep duplicates every 10 minutes, and the Peeps that it produces duplicates every 20 minutes. You can a) Eat them.  b) Command them to melt on top of a person.

strengths: A whole army of Peeps at your command
Extreme sugar high.
weaknesses: Peeps take a long time to duplicate
Will create a sticky mess.

name: Doomsday Panontic Arch

One can also psychically become imperceptible (except to those who can sense the future), at will. One can also psychically launch subjects into the near/distant future, by touch, at will.

strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically perceive the future (and become imperceptible, except in future-tense) at will
Psychically project subjects into the future, by touch, at will
weaknesses: Precognitive Imperceptibility is useless against those who can perceive the future (NCN)
Cannot psychically time-travel to the future, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically summon a future version of yourself to the present, until developed (NCN)

name: Transformers; Prowl
description: With this power you can turn any vehicle that you are operating into a police car. Chasing an enemy? Running late for an appointment? Turn you car into a police car to eliminate traffic. Want to park anywhere? Police car. Want people to drive really slowly and cautiously around you? Police car.
summary: The ability to turn any vehicle into a police car
strengths: You can turn any vehicle that you are operating into a police car
weaknesses: Only vehicles that you are operating
You might get in trouble with the actual police

name: Curtainkinesis
description: You can control curtains. They can soar through the sky, free of horrid curtain rods.

Lots of privacy
Curtains are cool

name: Pregnancy Beam
description: With this power, all you have to do is point at the desired women (must be capable of giving birth) and she will instantly get impregnated with a baby. Both men and women can use this ability. The period of pregnancy for a women zapped with the pregnancy beam will only be 4-5 months (the children do all the growing in half the time. Children born by pregnancy beam will mature and learn twice as fast as any other child. Women will experience no pain from giving birth to a pregnancy beam baby.

Children born by pregnancy beam will mature and learn faster
Women have no pain in giving birth

name: Dance Of Death
description: With this ability, your dancing skills are so unbelievably horrible that they are actually lethal, anything and everything that sees you dance dies in 5 minutes after suffering the following symptoms: loss of eyesight, clumsiness, and eventually insanity. This applies only to people and other living things that can see you. And never ever dance on TV or you will cause the deaths of millions.

strengths: The ultimate weapon!
You can get virtually anything through threats: "Give me your money or I WILL DANCE."
Evil Laugh here

You kill things on a semi-regular basis
No non-lethal aspects of this power

name: Rainbow Armpits
description: The uses that don't make this suck: 1. There is the same chance for there be a pot of gold at the end of where the rainbow hits as you winning the lottery. 2. You can blind people with the spectrum of light. 3. Rainbows are active all the time. Hooray.

strengths: Surprise factor
weaknesses: I'm sure you can think of some

name: Inflict Norwegian Scabies
description: Body mites by the millions will burrow deep into the skin of someone targeted by this power. As they burrow into the victim's flesh they will leave eggs and feces causing the victim to scratch uncontrollably. The victim's skin will develop sores and grow calloused and thick-especially his hands. Scales of dead skin will fall from his body like snow. Infectious snow. You yourself are immune to Norwegian Scabies. Only affects humans who don't have any kind of disease resistance or immunity.

strengths: Your victims if uncured will be in isolation for who knows how long.
Your victims if cured will avoid you.
weaknesses: Only affects humans.
Doesn't affect anyone who is in someway immune to disease.
Victims are infectious.

name: Beeromancy
description: This ability answers a yes or no question. You pour a beer into a glass. You must watch until the last drop of beer has gone in then you know the answer to a yes or no question. The glass you pick becomes your 'crystal ball'. You can't dump out the beer,you have to drink it and pour another beer to answer a new question. This power doesn't work with non-alcoholic beers. Beer with high alcoholic content increases the chances of a correct answer.

strengths: A thirst quenching way to see the future.
The POOF! Beer power will let make the best beer possible.
weaknesses: You don't have a power to avoid getting drunk.
You're underage.
You've given up drinking.

name: Cheerleading
description: With the clap of your hands, you can make any specific individual feel good. If a little girl was crying, you could applaud her and erase the sadness from her mind. Cheering is another method of doing this. This power will only work if the specific individual hears the applause or cheer.

strengths: You can spread happiness.
Erase sadness, grief, pain, etc.
weaknesses: Only works if the individual HEARS the applause or cheer.
Sometimes sadness can be a good thing.

name: Fluffy Bunny
description: You just scream "Super fluffy bunny power! " and whap! You're the hot pink bunny of your dreams. Of course, you're still the same size of a regular bunny, but you can shoot hot pink lasers out of your eyes.

strengths: You can run really fast as a bunny
You can spy on people
weaknesses: If you accidentally scream "Super hot pink bunny power! " during school.

name: Pollution Port
description: Pollution is everywhere in the air, in the forms of gas, smoke, and smog. Any polluted area can be a potential teleportation area for you. This power allows you to teleport to any area with polluted air; this can be used to escape enemies, or to teleport to clean up the environment. Plus, you are immune to the effects of the pollution when you teleport. However, you can only teleport to areas of high AIR pollution; which applies to most large cities and towns.

You are immune to the effects of pollution
Escape from enemies or clean the environment... The choice is yours
weaknesses: You can only teleport to areas of high AIR pollution

Cool to show off

description: This power lets you shoot your soul out (which is green) and put it into a Stitchpunk (a sack puppet). You are currently dead while you have your soul out. But you can transfer your soul back into your body. This will help through getting into hard to reach areas or do other fun stuff. But you will still get hurt as a Stitchpunk but it won't be painful. Just your body will be damaged.

Work out with a pencil
Won't feel pain

name: Squid Powers
description: After being bitten by a radioactive squid, you have gained several considerable abilities. You can breathe underwater, turn your arms into extendable tentacles, shoot ink from your wrists, and even shapeshift into a squid.

"You can have anything you can carry. " "No problem! " *Picks up house and walks away*

name: Flicker

name: Multi Headed Swung Object
description: There is a large category of hand-held objects with a handle, such as hammers, whips, swords, knives, tennis rackets, shovels, axes, mallets, etc. When the power user holds one by its handle and makes a swinging movement, the body of the object will suddenly multiply while moving at the same speed as its original version would move. weaknesses: If the object is a container, its contents won't multiply, only the container does.

name: Forced Suicidal Immunity
description: With this power you can cause other people to be unable to kill themselves. No matter what that person will do to themselves they will not be able to die, it even applies if the person pays someone else to kill them. You cannot reverse the effects of this power.

strengths: You can make people immune to suicide
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the effects of this power

name: Forced Kenny Mc Cormick Morph
description: You have the ability to change someone into Kenny and watch them be killed in under thirty minutes. Your victim is stripped of any powers that would ensure his survival. Nothing he does will save himself. Mice will carry off any remains after your victim's horrible death. Once you kenny-morph someone you have to wait until the first Kenny is dead before using your power again.

weaknesses: You can make only one Kenny at a time.

name: Myth Power: Dyssebia's Defiance
description: Dyssebia (Dyssebeia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of impiety, disrespect for deities/divinities and atheism. As such, channeling her allows one to prevent deities from contacting oneself for as long as the power is in use. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel those who honestly hate, deny or mock/disrespect divinity (regardless of mental defenses). One can even psychically inflict harm on those who honestly believe in, love and respect divinity, by touch.

strengths: Psychically prevent contact with any deities, regardless of moral alignment or pantheon
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel atheists, agnostics, and the irreligious

When you pull the trigger, the bulb opens at a fast speed into petals releasing a vortex stored at its center that has the sucking force of a black hole. Anything sucked into it's center, including living things, are condensed into a marble. Once in marble form you can alter its form and personality by adding or removing traits. Release the sphere by pulling on the trigger once and concentrating.

You will gain amazing evil thoughts all of the time and be immune to fear inducers. Sometimes will project into a death stare and/or an uneasy aura if it's powerful enough.

As such, channeling her allows one to psychically perceive and teleport to any meadow or pasture, at will. In addition, one can psychically instill an overwhelming fear of wide open spaces at will. Furthermore one can psychically manipulate the ground of any meadow or pasture, at will. There is a NAIL named Hipotank how cool of a name is that

In order to have this power, you must exist in the real world, since having it in super hero land can sometimes come off as needlessly skeptical and stops the story altogether.   Examples include the one time I thought it was pretty weird that I said this won't work in real life. That seems out of place.

The further away from the initial state the soup is taken, however, be it density, velocity or whatever, the more energy it takes to use, and the more tired the user becomes.

strengths: Ever seen the 'parting of the soup' scene in Bruce Almighty? That's now you, my friend!

This ability is an instant cast ability that frees the user from their own boundaries allowing them to release their emotions upon their target with ease and control.
