strengths: Heal wounds using rice.
Sense everything around you that has rice in it.
Never go hungry.
weaknesses: Soy sauce.
Third world countries.
You'd probably need to carry some rice with you due to it not being everywhere.

name: Greater Kystian Morph #7
description: The uba. A perfect fusion of elephant, rhino, whale and sauropod dinosaur. You're 400 feet long, your tail is 80 feet of that. Your trunk is 80 feet long. Your tusks are 120 feet long. Your horn is 30 feet long. You stand 80 feet high at the shoulder. You can temporarily stand upright. You weigh 2100 tons. You possess a limited geokinesis that lets you strengthen the earth under you. You're strong enough to pull 16000 tons. You can emit sonar and hear subsonically.
summary: The ability to become the biggest land-bound unsummonable kystian.
strengths: Be a giant rampaging monster. As fast as a real rampaging elephant.
You can strengthen the earth under yourself.
You have a giant prehensile limb, tusks and horn.
weaknesses: You are only as fast as a real rampaging elephant.
There will be locations where you can't become this kystian.

name: Summon Hira
description: The Kyst dimension can slow down or speed up its flow of time. It links with hira that you summon to this dimension. Hira can speed up so fast that the effect is like the Supertime power. Hira are immune to any damage, except that done by someone possessing a time-based power. A hira looks like a sexless translucent human. Hira are as strong as four normal humans. You have to watch what you command them to do.
summary: The ability to summon a half-alive thing linked to the Kyst flow of time.
strengths: A kystian that can strike at any foes before they have a chance to blink.
The first con below could be eliminated with the right powers.
weaknesses: A man of normal strength with a time-based power could easily destroy one.
They will find ways to act against you, unless you have the right powers.

name: The Phantom Tollbooth
description: With this power you can summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to travel to the Kingdom of Knowledge. You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want and send it away when you're done with it. Once you send it away however you cannot bring it back and you lose this power. Alternatively if this power is stolen from you somehow the tollbooth disappears as well.
summary: The ability to summon the Phantom Tollbooth and use it to go to the Kingdom
strengths: You can send yourself and others into the Kingdom of Knowledge
You can keep the tollbooth for as long as you want
weaknesses: Once you unsummon the Tollbooth you can never bring it back
If this power is stolen from you, you lose the tollbooth as well

name: Gate: Singularity
description: You must have Gate: 40 Rods of Darkness in order to get this power. When this power is activated the rods 'unroll' into flat 'plates' and form a cube around the target area, then in a split second a singularity forms and disappears absorbing everything in the area and spitting it out somewhere else. If the cage is destroyed, you will most likely be absorbed also as the cage protects everything outside of it from being absorbed.
summary: The ability to open a singularity in a cage of darkness for a split second
strengths: Cage protects all outside of it.
Only one area is damaged.
weaknesses: Must have gate: 40 rods of darkness to get this power. Unaffected by Con Negation.
Someone destroying the cage when the singularity forms.

name: Phantom Pirate
description: Change into the ghost of a pirate lord and summon a gostly pirate band and ship and create gostly pirate weapons
summary: The ability to turn in to the ghost of a evil pirate lord
strengths: Scare your enermies silly
Command a army of dead pirates
weaknesses: You will be seen as a freak and your loved ones will be scared of you

name: Think Mouthless
description: Have you ever thought about how people would look without their mouths? Well now whenever you think about that the mouthless person you were thinking about will actually lose their mouth as in their mouth will disappear from their face. This power does not cause a large gaping hole to appear on the person's face rather their is skin where the person's mouth used to be. The person cannot talk and has to breathe through his/her nose and you cannot bring their mouth back.
summary: The ability to cause people's mouths to disappear just by thinking about it
strengths: You can cause people to lose their mouths just by thinking about them not having mouths
weaknesses: You cannot bring their mouth back

name: Muppet Power Beauregard 2011
description: With this power you can survive without food or water for up to 12 years, without losing any strength or stamina. However the longer you use this power, the dumber you get; until you stop using it. Once you stop using the power, you slowly gain your intelligence back until you regain it fully; after not using the power for the same amount of time you used the power in the first place.
summary: The ability to survive without food or water for up to 12 years
strengths: You can survive for up to 12 years without food or water
You don't lose any strength or stamina
weaknesses: The longer you use this power the dumber you get

name: Mother's Lullaby
description: Has your mother ever sung a special lullaby to you as a child with this ability if you sing it you'll turn back into a child.
summary: The ability to become a child again
strengths: Enternal youth
Be a child
Immortality
weaknesses: If your mother never sung a lullaby to you
You lose your powers
Starting school again!

name: Myth Power: Polemos' Pull
description: Polemos (Polemus), in Greek myth, was the god of civil war and civil battle (war and battle between two parts of the same nation). As such, channeling him allows one to perceive past, present and future civil war at will. In addition, one can psychically summon objects, items and weapons from past, present and future civil wars at will. Furthermore, one can time travel to any civil war in history. One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and compel civil war veterans and experts.
summary: The ability to channel Polemos' command over the essence of civil war and civil battle
strengths: Psychically perceive past/present/future civil war (even alternate dimensions, when developed)
Psychically summon objects/items/weapons from past/present/future civil wars at will
Time Travel to any civil war; perceive, communicate with and compel civil war vets and experts
weaknesses: Civil wars on distant planets/in distant galazies are much harder to perceive (NCN)
Cannot psychically channel the spirits of dead civil war vets until the higher levels (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power from this ability (NCN)

name: Spider Eggs
description: With this power you can touch someone anywhere on their body and plant spider eggs underneath that persons skin. The eggs with grow under the skin like typical spider eggs, resulting in bumps resembling pimples on your victim. Left alone the eggs will hatch and the bump will burst, allowing the baby spiders to come swarming out of the hole. If someone attempts to pop the bump the eggs hatch immediately, to the same end.
summary: The ability to place spider eggs under someones skin.
strengths: Bring an urban legend to life.
Get revenge in the most disgusting way possible.
Increse the spider population.
weaknesses: The eggs develop like normal spider eggs, so you'll have to wait a while.

name: Myth Power: Hail Halia
description: Halia (Alia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the sea's salt water (also called 'brine'). As such, channeling her allows one to swim well and survive underwater, which may be shared, by touch. In addition, one can psychically turn any liquid into salt water, as well as psychically manipulate salt water, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport oneself and others to any body of salt water at will. One can even turn oneself and others into a form composed of salt water, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Halia's command over the essence of the sea's salt water
strengths: Swim well and survive underwater (may be shared by touch); psychically mimic salt water at will
Psychically transmute any liquid into salt water; psychically manipulate salt water at will
Psychically teleport to any body of salt water, transform self and others into salt water, at will
weaknesses: No immunity to dehydration from drinking salt water until developed (NCN)
Cannot manipulate salt or water separate from one another (only manipulate salt water) (NCN)
Cannot psychically communicate with salt water creatures until developed (NCN)

name: Tree Turner
description: With this ability you can turn people into trees.
summary: The ability to turn people into trees
strengths: You can turn people into trees.
weaknesses: People might confuse you with Captian Planet.

name: Arceusforce: Stone
description: The user of this ability can channel the solid rock will of the Pokegod, Arceus, taking the form of its Rock-type. The user's skin turns brown, their irises turn tan and their pupils turn gray. Under their rocky guise, the user has the resistances, weaknesses and immunities of a Rock-type Pokemon, translated to real world equivalents. They are also able to channel and manipulate many Rock attacks such as Rock Slide, Power Gem, Head Smash, Stone Edge and more.
summary: The ability to channel the power of Arceus's Rock form.
strengths: The user can resist fire, wind, poison, and raw energy-based attacks,
Generation and manipulation of rock used for Rock attacks.
To perform Rock attacks, the user's body usually turns into a rock form.
weaknesses: The user is weak to water, plant, supernatural combat, earth and metal-based attacks.
This power may be too powerful for the user. Might also require to be unlocked from the default form

name: Greater Kystian Morph #3
description: Become a zelet from emergency power #6. A 650-foot hybrid of a whale and a squid. Each of your eight limbs can lift 1500 tons. Your flight is telekinetic in nature. If flight is lost, you can still crawl on the ground. You have telescopic vision and sonar. Your speed in the air is 550 mph, in space 5500 mph and on land 20 mph. If you can build a weapon big enough to use, you can use one in this form. Deactivating this power causes unconsciousness.
summary: The ability to become a unsummonable flying kystian.
strengths: Be a giant flying monster.
If you can make a weapon big enough to use as this monster, you can use it.
You can fly into space.
weaknesses: You need a pal to help when you switch off of this form.

name: G1 Grimlock's Transformation
description: With this power you can turn into a fire breathing robot T-Rex in order to fight crime or just roast marshmallows with your fiery breath./
summary: The ability to transform into a fire breathing robot T-Rex
strengths: You can breath fire
Robots are cool
Dinosaurs are cool
weaknesses: Your weakness is water

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #2
description: Kyst may feel your teammates or/and henchmen, the normal number of kystians you can summon, plus the forty extra ones It can summon aren't doing the job. Kyst can call up on a squad, platoon, company or battalion of kystians armed to the teeth. A squad is 16, a platoon is 60, a company is 250 and a battalion is 1000. What Kyst summons depends on the space available and the situation you're in. If a platoon or more is summoned, you get control of one squad. Any summoned help vanishes if unneeded.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call for armed backup.
strengths: A battalion of ultra tech armed soldiers (if needed).
At least 16 of them.
weaknesses: A battalion could level a building or city block.
Only stay as long as a battle is in progress.

name: Zodiac: Aries
description: By drawing the sign of Aries the Ram in the air, you can make your enemy think the only way to defeat you is to ram their head into you. You have to draw the sign of Aries twenty centimetres in front of the person. Each drawing affects one person for two minutes.
summary: The ability to make your opponent ram things with their head by drawing the sign of Aries the Ram
strengths: Sit back and watch as your opponent hurts themself running into things.
Your opponent is going to groan in pain.
Opponent will forget about their powers for the 2 minutes, guaranteed.
weaknesses: Only lasts for 2 minutes.
A faster opponent.
Have to draw the sign of Aries.

name: Whoopsie
description: With this power, you can make anyone within a 10-meter radius want to go to the bathroom.
summary: The ability to make people want to go to the bathroom
strengths: No need for contact
Can distract opponent in whole fight
You choose targets
weaknesses: Opponent must have eaten at least 10 hours ago

name: Monstrorient
description: The victim of this power will seek out ways to change into a monster. A mindless zombie will be a acceptable transformation. The transformed victim will try to avoid anyone or anything that would reverse the transformation. The range of this power is 500 feet.
summary: The ability to make a normal human want to become a monster.
strengths: The perfect power for a contagious monster.
weaknesses: The range is only 500 feet.

name: Delete This Thor's Hammer
description: Thor from Norse Mythology is the god of thunder, who had a hammer only the pure of heart could lift and was very powerful. With this ability you can use it. However if you lose the purity in your heart it will kill you. Goes good with Loki's Staff.

strengths: Always have a weapon
Can control thunder
Only you can wield it
weaknesses: If you lose your pure heart you lose it
Slows you down when running away
Using it can kill you

name: The Alex Silencer
description: If you are like me, then you also hate mary sue powers. With this power, you get the ability to cancel any of alexander121793's powers that he has created or will ever create. Even if he says they cant be canceled, this power will cancel them in some shape or manner that I deem fit in the comments sections.
summary: The ability to cancel any of alexander121793 and other related created powers.
strengths: No more powers that magically have adapting powers
To stop powers getting other powers
To stop people from making their powers too powerful
weaknesses: It only works on alexander121793's powers and other related powers
That I actually have to type alexander121793, just so he doesn't find some loopholes
If I truly have to redo all of this......... *puppy eyes... *

name: Delete This Fearsome Cannon
description: You could try to pummel your foe in the stomach, only take it a step further by continuing doing it five times with a series of blows. Then, grab the opponent by their arms, flip, and perform a powerful missile kick on the opponent's upper-torso.
summary: The ability to punch your foe in the stomach 5 times, then send them flying with a missile kick.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Balding Ray
description: Fires a ray that makes people bald
summary: The ability to make people bald
strengths: Only one with awsome hair
Makes a good distraction
Shaolin monks will love you
weaknesses: You are the only one with awsome hair
Actors will sue you

name: Lotion Mimicry
description: Never underestimate the power of topical medicine. This power gives you most of the benefits of Water Mimicry, but with additional health-related applications.  Furthermore, as the only lotion-based superpower, this automatically comes with lotionkinesis, the ability to mentally manipulate other lotion-like materials. Become an unstoppable force of skincare cosmetic medicine!
summary: The ability to convert all of your cells into an opaque emulsion of water and oils
strengths: Absorb damage, hide, wrap around foes the same as a water mimic
Transform into ointments that are appropriate for each situation
Soft to the touch, not to mention smelling nice
weaknesses: Can't stay in lotion form for too long, or the oils in your body will start to go rancid
Lotion form easily picks up particles in the air, so cleaning out your body will become a hassle
It's really unnerving to talk to people without any discernible facial features

name: Antibacteriakinesis
description:
Users of antibacteriakinesis never worry about washing their hands, as they have the ability to generate an endless amount of antibacterial soap through sheer force of will! 

Advanced users develop the ability to psychokinetically manipulate said substance. Which might have some use I guess.
summary: The ability to create and manipulate antibacterial soap with your mind.
strengths: Neverending supply of antibacterial soap!
You can be the most cleanest!
Did I mention how germ-free you'll be!
weaknesses: There aren't any. Free soap.

name: Kangaroo Pouch
description: With this power, you have a huge pocket on your stomach. Just tear it open to have access to it. And when you're done, just close it and the opening will disappear. You can open the pouch from anywhere on your stomach area. The pouch is very elastic, so you can stretch it to be as big as you want. It is also very solid so it can't be opened if you don't want to. However, the things you put inside don't disappear into another dimension or anything.
summary: The ability to have a very elastic pouch on the stomach where you can store things.
strengths: You can store many many things in your body as long as you can stretch the pouch over them.
You can put your baby inside, just like kangaroos. Just don't forget to leave an opening for air.
Your stomach area is invulnerable to lacerations.
weaknesses: If you carry too much, you'll have trouble walking.
Your stomach will look suspiciously misshapen.
Good luck finding clothes to cover your stomach when it's huge.

name: Reincarnation 7: Phylactery
description: A normal phylactery gives a lich their immortality. Someone with this power can make a different version, preventing ageing and enabling resurrection through corpses. It also contains your powers, channelling them through you, so no power can affect them without effecting the phylactery. When you gain new powers, you have to touch your phylactery to put your new powers in it. If it is destroyed, it can be replaced, but you lose your stored powers except this one.
summary: The ability to make a phylactery capable of protecting protecting powers.
strengths: Stored powers cannot be affected unless your phylactery is targeted.
You are immortal -you don't age, you resurrect and new bodies don't degrade.
All stored powers slowly increase over time.
weaknesses: If you die without a replacement phylactery, your death is permanent.
If your phylactery is destroyed, you lose the stored powers.
Stored powers can only be affected in a positive way by your other powers.

name: Condition Change: Money
description: By touching another superpowered being, you force to have to spend money to use one of their powers. It works at a rate of 1 US dollar per 1% of power for the power. They don't pay you to use the power, they go to a store or restaurant to spend the money. 1 random power is affected each time you touch them.
summary: The ability to make a person spend money to use their power
strengths: Watching an opponent try to acquire as much money as possible to use their power.
They have to spend the money each time they want to use a part of their power's power, not per use.
They can't spend the money at a business they own.
weaknesses: A rich opponent.
This power is tactile and affects one power.
Enemies with multiple powers need to be touched multiple times.

name: Killing Jar V2
description: With this power you can summon a jar that kills anybody other than yourself when they touch it with their skin. If the person is wearing gloves or something else on their hand they will be unaffected by the jar. The jar is also unbreakable and you can unsummon it whenever you want.
summary: The ability to have a jar that causes people to die when they touch it
strengths: You can summon a jar that causes people to die when they touch it
You are immune to the jar
The jar cannot break
weaknesses: It kills anybody if they touch it with their skin

name: The Power Of Tardiness
description: With this power, no matter how well you plan you'll always be late. Work, a date, making it to an appointment on time. Trivial or important, you'll be late. There is a benefit. If an attack has less than a 100% chance of hitting you, the attack will miss you. You'll never be near a bomb with a timer when it goes off. Your actual reflexes don't matter. You could be a klutz. You could be standing still. You might survive even if you're unconscious. Attacks need to have a 100% certainty to hit you.
summary: The ability to never be on time.
strengths: 99% chance to avoid attacks.
Bombs with timers aren't threats.
You probably picked a lot skills from all the jobs you held. See con #2
weaknesses: Nuclear bombs will still affect you with fallout.
You can't hold a steady job.
Other superheroes will think you're lazy and unreliable and won't want to work with you.

name: Celtic Invocation: Blodeuwedd
description: By invoking the power of Blodeuwedd, the invoker can manipulate flower-bearing plants, can cause flowers to grow from nothing using their blood, and can even make animate structures and figures from flowers. The invoker may also have minor powers of restoration and healing, invoking the Maiden aspect of the goddess. While unable to heal anything above a small but deep gash or ease a small amount of pain in a human, the power is especially effective on flowering plants, and can even revive them.
summary: The ability to invoke the power of the Welsh goddess Blodeuwedd, the godess of flowers, and the Maiden.
strengths: Flowers are everywhere, and so is your power.
Expert users can even use flowers to manipulate emotions, by using the language of flowers.
The more you use this power, the more beautiful you become as you take on the aspect of flowers.
weaknesses: Some of your flower structures may become homocidal towards you.
Healing and restoration is only ever really effective for plants.
Your powers can be bound if you're surrounded by nine specific flowers.

name: 3 Headed Gorilla Summon
description: With this power you can summon a 3 headed gorilla. The gorilla is super strong (strong than an average ape) is an adept climber and is super agile. The 3 headed gorilla is also super smart (three brains are better than two which is better than one) so it can speak any language. The gorilla is under your complete control and you can unsummon him whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon a 3 headed gorilla
strengths: You can summon a 3 headed gorilla
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: It can be killed

name: 3 To Get Ready V2
description: With this power whenever you're ready for something but everyone else is not yet ready for whatever event you're going to you can just snap your fingers and they'll be ready too.
summary: The ability to make other people get ready for something
strengths: You can get people ready for things faster
weaknesses: You have to be ready already

name: Ut Optimus Prime's Transform
description: With this power you can turn into a flying fire truck that also just happens to have giant cannons on it. You can shoot bursts of water at high velocity, shoot lasers, fly, and land on enemies to crush them.
summary: The ability to turn into a flying fire truck
strengths: You can turn into a flying fire truck
You have massive cannons
weaknesses: All damage sustained in flying fire truck mode is transfered over to human mode

name: Myth Power: Freedom's Freestyle
description: Eleutherios (Eleutherius) and Eleutheria, in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of freedom, liberty and liberation. As such, channeling them allows one to gain the skill and flexibility of an expert escape artist. In addition, one can psychically release subjects from physical bindings, psychic compulsions or spells/curses, by touch. One can also totally withstand compulsions. One can even psychically release subjects' inhibitions (impulse and motion control) by touch.
summary: The ability to channel Eleutherios and Eleutheria's command over the essence of freedom, liberty and liberation
strengths: Gain the skill and flexibility of a master escape artist (Escape Artistry)
Psychically free subjects of physical restraint (even armor/clothes), compulsions and spells at will
Psychically release subjects' inhibitions (impulse and motion control) at will
weaknesses: Cannot reactively adapt to escape physical/mental/spiritual/magic bindings until developed (NCN)
Cannot temporarily free one's spirit/soul (Astral Projection) at will until developed (NCN)
Cannot free others' spirits/souls by touch (Astral Eviction) by touch until developed (NCN)

name: Zombie Mind Conversion
description: One with this ability does not turn people into zombies, but instead causes them to act like zombies; use it on self and friends to give zombies the impression of being one of them; inflict it permanently on foes, so you have a right to kill them (cause, well, they'll act like a zombie); at the higher levels, use it on zombies to make them act civilized

strengths: Make zombies think you're one of them to avoid attack (at higher levels make zombies act civilized)
Make foes permanently act zombie-like (no risk of conversion)
Great with necromantic and other death related powers
weaknesses: At the lower levels, the effect may be temporary
At the lower levels, the effect may be permanent
Cannot CONTROL zombies or zombified minds with this power

name: Condition Change: Dance
description: A power affected by this power now requires its user to do a specific dance in order to activate. The user of the affected power will always know what dance is required for the power. The dance is always chosen randomly. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only after its user has done a specific dance
strengths: They have to dance each time they want to use the power.

If they have low physical speed and the dance has a fast tempo.
weaknesses: You have to touch the target and only one power is affected at a time.
If the opponent has multiple powers.
If they get a dance that lasts two seconds.

name: Food Alive
description: With this power you can cause food to come to life. When you this power on a food they will grow a face and be able to talk, however they will not grow limbs and will have no way of moving around unless you move them or stick Mr. Potato Head pieces into it. You cannot choose what kind of personality the food gets when it comes to life and you cannot make inanimate again. The food will die if it becomes spoiled or if it is eaten. You cannot bring drinks or condiments to life with this power.
summary: The ability to bring food to life
strengths: You can bring food to life
Scare someone by making their food come to life right when they're about to eat it
You can make them mobile by sticking Mr. Potato Head parts into them
weaknesses: You don't choose their personality
Not much use in physical combat

name: Summoning: Doom Scroll
description: The Doom Scroll, an ancient leather scroll that contains the dates of all major disasters, natural and otherwise, past and future. To summon it, you barely need any energy, but to open it, someone must willingly give their life to the Scroll.
summary: The ability to summon the Doom Scroll.
strengths: Learn of disasters and prepare for them.
weaknesses: Demands a soul sacrifice to be opened.

name: Snake Head Hands
description: With this power you can turn your hands into snake heads. Your snake heads have sharp teeth and a venomous bite. The snake heads are also invincible so you can use them as shields. You can turn your snake heads back into normal hands when you're done.
summary: The ability to turn your hands into snake heads
strengths: You can turn your hands into snake heads
The snakes are invincible
They have a poisonous bite
weaknesses: If you keep your hands as snake heads for long periods of time you'll have to feed the snakes

name: Albinonator
description: With this power you can turn any animal into an albion version of itself. As an albino they are worth more as albinos are rare. You control them if you have Albino Control. Or you can hide an animal by making its fur white and hiding it in snow or a pile of sugar or salt or something.
summary: The ability to make animals albino
strengths: You can make animals albinos
weaknesses: You can't make humans albinos

name: Scp Foundation
description: With this ability, you can summon anything from the SCP Foundation. You could use the SCP's, their technology or even the researchers. However, you cannot always control your summons.

The researchers may be helpful to certain projects.

name: Delete This In Eagle Powerbomb
description: You would take off into the sky and fly across towards your opponent while both in mid-air, lift them up and slam the foe directly on the ground.

Micheal Jackson draws his strength from thousands of fans
Very effective against classical musicians

name: Moon Eater

You can then place the opponent in a cobra clutch and lift them into the air by their neck before jumping backwards, falling face down or into a sitting position, driving the opponent back first way down to the ground.
