strengths: A strong sword.
weaknesses: Needs a direct hit.

name: Condition Change: Light
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user is touching light. At least 25% of the body must be in light. Will not affect a power already affected by Condition Change: Darkness. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when its user is touched by light
strengths: Just need to keep your opponent's body in total darkness.
Fighting during night.
weaknesses: Must touch opponent and each touch affects one power.
Light controllers

name: Rise Of The Mutant Frog
description: WIth this power you can turn into a mutant frog that is seven feet tall, has horns and shoots lasers out of its eyes. You also have super powerful legs for jumping and kicking things.
summary: The ability to turn into a mutant frog
strengths: You can turn into a mutant frog
You can shoot lasers from your eyes
You are super strong
weaknesses: You are not invincible and if you die in frog form you die in human form as well

name: Xena's Armor
description: The mystical warrior armor of the warrior princess of Xena is only given to females that are strong at heart and brave. Xena's armor gives the armor's wearer super human strength, flight, limited invulnerability and a adamant throwing ring. Xena's armor only weakness is very strong magic
summary: The ability to wear the mystical armor of the warrior princess Xena
strengths: Can combat crime ranging from small to large crimes
Can go head to head with most powerhouses
weaknesses: The armor losses its invulnerability properties when the armor is hit with magic based attacks

name: Kyst Dimension Downpour
description: You can rain a green-black ooze from above. If someone is caught in this ooze downpour, they are banished to the Kyst dimension. The ooze will pool on the ground. Anyone standing in it will be enveloped and will be banished to the Kyst dimension. This power needs open air no lower than 300 feet off the ground and a minimum clear area around you of at least 200 feet, but it doesn't go beyond a 1000 feet. You are immune to this power. You need the Kyst Dimension power to use this power.
summary: The ability to make it rain down a dimension banishing ooze.
strengths: This power deals with those who fly.
A 1000 foot radius.
weaknesses: Dimensional travelers.
Anyone who could become intangible.

name: Demonic Weaponry: Void
description: Void is a dangerous Demonic Weaponry. It overpowers the user's will, transforming him or her into a soulless shell for Void to manipulate. Void is a living sword. It resembles a plain katana, but it's hilt has a single red eye on it. It's power is one of Nullification. It can nullify any power it comes into contact with.
summary: The ability to use and be Void.
strengths: Power nullification.
weaknesses: Lose your soul.
Become a empty shell.

name: Tickle Immunity
description: With this power, you are completely unticklish. This power is active all the time, so your friends and family can't get a good laugh out of you no matter how hard they try. In fact, as a safety feature, you don't laugh at all when someone is tickling you, even if you hear a funny joke or something. This power also works when machines are tickling you. You can only turn this power off by wearing a wool sweater.
summary: The ability to not be ticklish.
strengths: Never be ticklish.
Always win tickle fights.
Defeat dumb enemies who use tickling as their ultimate weapon.
weaknesses: Never get a good laugh while being tickled.
People may make fun of you by tickling you and cracking jokes at the same time.
On chilly nights, have to choose between a cozy wool sweater, and your tickle immunity.

name: Screen Chest
description: With this power you can turn your chest into any type of screen. Television, computer, video phone, handheld gaming device etc. Turning your chest into a screen causes no adverse affects to your health or body and the screen works just as it normally would on a device. You also have the necessary accessories for the screens such as remote controls, keyboards etc.
summary: The ability to turn your chest into any kind of screen
strengths: You can turn your chest into a screen
You get the accessories you need for the screens
The screens do not cause an adverse effect on your health
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Summoning: Hat Of The Hatter
description: The Mad Hatter, an odd being who is completely and totally mad. Using this summons his hat for you to wear. This will slowly force you to insanity if you don't remove it after a while, but will also boost your intelligence.
summary: The ability to summon the Hat of the Hatter.
strengths: Boost of intelligence.
Wear Hat of the Hatter.
weaknesses: Will drive you to insanity.

name: Soylentgreeniztion
description: You get a human-sized pile of tasteless but nutritious green wafers. You start with this power requiring touch to turn a dead human into wafers. With practice you can turn dead animals or zombies in wafers. You can use the power at range. You can affect up 10 dead bodies at once. Zombie wafers have less nutritional value but are free of any zombie causing diseases. Dead animals will only give a animal-sized pile of wafers. You can make soylent green chips,pretzels,etc instead of wafers.
summary: The ability to turn a dead body into tasteless but nutritious green wafers.
strengths: Stop a zombie horde and make somewhat nutritious food.
Depose of dead bodies or road kill... And make nutritious food.
weaknesses: Soylent green is people.
And worse... Soylent green is zombies.

name: Happy Fun Ball Generation
description: A person with this power has the ability to create happy fun ball at will. Happy fun ball has all of the abilities as shown on the "commercial". Play with Happy Fun Ball responsibly.
summary: The ability to create happy fun balls at will
strengths: Create Happy Fun Ball
Can be used as a weapon
weaknesses: Cannot use on concrete
Happy fun ball is extremely volatile
Do not laugh at happy fun ball

name: Myth Power: Homage To Homados
description: Homados (Homadus), in Greek myth, was the god of battle-noise, uproar and the din of conflict (clanging weapons, etc). As such, channeling him allows one to cast an illusion of that same war noise, which drowns out conversation and sonic abilities (Sonic Scream, Psychic Persuasion, etc). It may also be used to enrage subjects in radius, making them hostile and violent until they can no longer hear it. One can even produce a cloud of (non-illusory) battle-noise at will, to fight foes.
summary: The ability to channel Homados' command over the essence of uproar and battle noise
strengths: Battle noise drowns out conversation (and sound-based effects) and distracts concentration
Battle noise may be used to enrage all neutrals in radius (until they can no longer hear it)
Produce a rushing, thrashing, whirling Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to literally fight foes
weaknesses: Cannot use Battle-Noise Sound Cloud to stand or ride/fly on until the higher levels (NCN)
Sonic Immunity, Sonic Absorption and/or Protected Hearing provide immunity (NCN)
Combat/war/violence/bloodshed/destruction-based MythPowers provide power with this ability (NCN)

name: Condition Change: Blood
description: This power allows the user to change the condition(s) of activation so that the power also requires the user to drink the blood of who they are affecting with the power. This power is also tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power also require drunk blood in order to activate the power
strengths: Now your opponent has to drink the blood of what they want to affect.
If what the person wants to affect has no blood.
weaknesses: Have to touch the target.

name: Rise Of The Two Headed Monster
description: With this power you turn into a seven foot tall black hairy monster with two heads in order to fight crime
summary: The ability to turn into a monster with two heads
strengths: Two heads are better than one
You're really intimidating
You can jump high enough to dunk on a ten foot tall basket ball hoop
weaknesses: You will definitely be attacked because you look evil

name: Lactokinesis
description: You control any type of milk, which means you can make it levitate, coagulate it to make cheese, fermentate it to make yoghurt...
summary: The ability to control milk.
strengths: Free ice cream!
Expel the milk from woman's breasts in the street AT WILL!
weaknesses: You can't create milk, just control it.
Pretty useless, huh?

name: Condition Change: 6th Sense
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that it works only on what the user is able to feel with their sixth sense. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only on what the user can feel with their sixth sense
strengths: Opponents with barely any sixth sense.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch affects only one power.
Opponents who have a really good sixth sense.
Will not work on those with no sixth sense.

name: Frankenstein
description: Pieced together from other body parts and organs like a Frankenstein creature, you can absorb other people's organs into your own body. This extends your life and gives you complete health. Also makes you stronger. Almost immortal.
summary: The ability to harvest other people's organs  into your own body.
strengths: Near immortality.
Increased strength.
weaknesses: You have kill and harvest other people's organs.

name: Acne Remover
description: With this power you can cure yourself and others of acne, no creams or other types of medication required. All you have to do is point at the person or yourself and say "Acne be gone" and all the person's pimples and zits disappear. The person can however get acne again, but a person with this power can never get acne again once they cure it.
summary: The ability to cure people of acne
strengths: You can get rid of your own or other people's acne
You can never get acne again if you have this power
weaknesses: You have to point at them and say "Acne be gone"
If the person you cure doesn't get this power they can still get acne again

name: Summoning: Asylum
description: My personal creation, Asylum. Asylum was a fortress in Hell, containing the souls of the insane. It resembles a modern day insane asylum, but it is surrounded by giant obsidian walls. Using this summon doesn't summon the Fortress to you, but rather summons those you target to the Asylum, where they will stay until the die or you recall them. This only works on evil people.
summary: The ability to summon the Fortress Asylum.
strengths: Can send people to the Asylum.
Only works on evil people.
weaknesses: Only works on evil people.
Extremely hard to use.

name: Defender Of Comedy
description: When someone tells a bad joke a tomato appears in your hand, which you may then chuck at the offending joker. This tomato will always find its mark (the face) even if it is physically impossible for it to do so. After being hit by the tomato, the jokester is inexplicably hilarious for the following twenty-four hours and anything they do will inspire raucous laughters.
summary: The ability to always have a tomato on hand for when someone tells a bad joke
strengths: Make bad comedians funny.
Drive someone to madness by making everyone laugh at them.
Make yourself hilarious for a day.
weaknesses: The victim may go out and commit a crime during their funny period.
The tomato will only appear when someone tells an unfunny joke.

name: Delete This Redemption Day
description: This power involves you hooking each of your opponent's legs in one of their arms and draping the opponent over mid-air, at this point you would hook the arms of the opponent with their legs securing the hold. As this move involves the use of it airborne, the quickly switch to the variation of a belly-to-belly piledriver, you can hold the opponent upside down in a belly-to-belly position, then falls to a kneeling position. As the enemy falls, the opponent's head is driven into the ground.
summary: The ability to submit your opponent in mid-air then switch to piledrive them.
strengths: This can be one day used in future pro wrestling.
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Condition Change: Sad
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation so that the power can only be used when the user is sad. Cannot be used on a power that has already been affected by a Condition Change that requires a different mood. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is sad
strengths: Now your opponent has to be sad in order to use their power.
weaknesses: It's horrible watching people crying, which is what the target will probably end up doing.
Have to touch the target of this power.

name: Condition Change: Deserts
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power to work only when the user is in a desert. Cannot be used on a power already affected by a Condition Change requiring another type of terrain. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when the user is in a desert
strengths: Just make sure you don't fight anywhere near deserts.
weaknesses: Have to touch opponent and each touch only affects one power.

name: Technical Pacifist Curse
description: A person with this power is unable to kill anyone ever, indirectly or directly. However, they are still able to hurt people. This person could also be the ultimate sadist because they know that they really can't kill anyone in the end. This power is a form of reality manipulation.
summary: The ability to not be able to kill anyone
strengths: You can now use all of those dangerous powers without killing anyone
You now can use 100% of your power without fear of endangering someone
weaknesses: You can't kill anyone
You can become insane and keep beating up someone because they just won't die
If someone cancels this power and you kill someone

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #4
description: This emergency power like all emergency powers works independently or with the other emergency powers. Kyst will call for the big guns. 40-foot long ultra tech guns carried by bipedal dinosaur-like kystians who stand 130-feet tall called thathans. The weapons have a direct range of 5 miles and indirect range of 40 miles. A hit will leave a crater a mile wide and half a mile deep. Kyst can call a fireteam (4), a squad (8) or a platoon (25) of them. Any thathan will disappear when not needed.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call the big guns for support.
strengths: Destroy armies.
Giant monsters with giant guns.
weaknesses: You can't command even one of them.
Kyst will need space to use this power.

name: Limited Magic
description: As the title suggests, your power is limited by twenty uses. Once you use all of these you will blow up rivaling the explosion of the Atomic Bomb. You can do anything: create planets, make yourself a god, or just do something simple like killing a human being. You may only use your power once a day.
summary: The ability to unleash 20 of the most powerful spells, after which you explode
strengths: You can do anything
weaknesses: Your death resulting in a massive explosion

name: Detach Head
description: This ability allows you to detach your head and keep it alive. Reattachment is also possible if it is returned to the neck within 24 hours.
summary: The ability to detach your head from your body and keep it alive
strengths: Place your head in a strategic location for surveillance
Head and body stay alive (even if cut off forcefully)
Always have a "Headless Horseman" costume at the ready for Halloween
weaknesses: Your head cannot be reattached after 24 hours
Head can still be damaged by smashing, bullets, etc.

name: Virus: Fungamonus
description: The user of this ability will most surely be hated. The proper name of this virus is Fungamonus Sudorificus Flatulens Cloaca-Emesis, and it is not at all pleasant one to have. Carriers lose all control of their bodily functions, including farting, burping, sneezing, sweating, bowel movements, vomiting and release of odor in the body. The afflicted, as one can imagine, become social pariahs AT LEAST for the duration of their illness.
summary: The ability to release a quite embarrassing, disgusting virus
strengths: Release a virus that disrupts perfectly-normal body functions
Afflict foes with bad gas, irritable bowel syndrome, lactose intolerance, explosive diarrhea, etc.
VERY embarrassing (affects only people you want it to, and render allies immune)
weaknesses: The clean-up is horrendous (use this power from far away to avoid being blamed)
If people know YOU'RE the one with the ability, you're gonna get it
If people are already sick, people won't notice much of a difference

name: Make A Kystian
description: You get 300 lbs of material every time you use this power. You can't use the power again until you use the material or it is destroyed or it is lost. You can make one or as many kystians as you can. Make them too small and get kystians with a hive IQ. You'll have to balance speed and strength. No superkystian. You can give your creatures sub-powers based on your powers. There is a maximum of 5 powers. There are off limit powers. Your creatures can walk,slither,swim or/and fly.
summary: The ability to make a kystian of your own.
strengths: Make a really good creature and Kyst will mass produce it.
Any appearance is possible. Off limit power have no affect on appearance.
weaknesses: Off limit powers include are mythic,holy,unholy,time travel,time reversal.
Elemental body powers and cartoon based powers are off limits.
Any other powers that might be questionable for a kystian creature to have.

name: Chibification
description: A chibi is a human four inches tall that dies after four years with this power you can change people into chibis and do whatever you want with them!
summary: The ability to change people into chibis
strengths: Chibis
weaknesses: Permanent

name: Delete This The Rabbit Hole
description: You could hold your opponent them upside down by the waist, then leap into the air in a sitting position with the opponent's head between your legs and set them up for a spinning piledriver, but once activated you'll glow & turn into a ball which dissolves into a vortex and slam the opponent head hard into the ground that causes massive damage.
summary: The ability to put your opponent in a spinning piledriver and then turn into a vortex to slam them.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Cheesy Demons
description: Create any sort of demon possessed cheese. Cheddar,limburger,etc. Cheese demons remain demons if reduced to crumbs. They just become more demons. Hard cheese demons can actually hurt someone or at least knock them unconscious. Fondue demons will be able to burn someone. Some cheese demons like vieux boulogne demons will be detectable by their smell before being seen. Cheese demons can't be mass exorcised.
summary: The ability to create cheesy demons.
strengths: Hard cheese demons can possibly knock someone unconscious.
Fondue demons can burn someone.
A demon wheel of cheese becomes hundreds of little demons if reduced to pieces.
weaknesses: Someone who summons mice and rats.
Smelly cheese demons will give themselves away.

name: Lawn Gnome Power
description: With this power you can turn people into lawn gnome versions of themselves. When they are a lawn gnome they cannot do anything at all and (depending on how good looking the person is) they can make good lawn decorations.
summary: The ability to turn people into lawn gnomes
strengths: You can turn enemies into lawn gnomes to make them less dangerous
weaknesses: If you ever decide to turn them back that person will probably be angry at you

name: G Cell Mimicry
description: You can produce gastrin, a hormone which stimulates digestion. You can inject a dose in anyone through touch, forcing their body to begin digestion, even when they haven't eaten anything yet. In addition to this aspect, you can mentally activate the shooting power of Parietal Cell and Gastric Chief Cell Mimics and mentally control their aim. You can also enhance the secretion ability of Pancreatic Acinar Cell Mimics.
summary: The ability to produce and inject gastrin, and mentally activate the powers of some Cellular Mimics.
strengths: Forcing someone to digest on an empty stomach can cause severe ulcers.
Kill a Parietal Cell Mimic with their own hydrochloric acid.
Take control of foes', or even allies', Parietal Cell or Gastric Chief Cell Mimicry.
weaknesses: Parietal Cell Mimics could create new appendages to attack you with acid.
You are not immune to the effects of your targets' secretions.

name: Condition Change: Darkness
description: This power changes the condition(s) of activation of a power so that the power only works when the user is in the shadows. At least 25% of the body must be in shadows. Will not affect a power already affected by Condition Change: Light. This power is tactile.
summary: The ability to make a power work only when its user is in the shadows
strengths: Just need to keep your opponent's body completely in light.
Fighting during the day.
weaknesses: Must touch opponent and each touch affects one power.
Shadow controllers

name: B Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers: an elastic body, the power to clone yourself while in combat mode and the power to distinguish friends from foes on a molecular level. While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. In combat mode, you will keep creating floating Y-shaped objects that strongly stick to foes. When stuck to a foe, they will attract other friend Leukocyte Mimics and will boost their killing powers.
summary: The ability to produce and release airborne Y-shaped objects that strongly stick to foes and hinder their moves.
strengths: You can tell friends from foes on a molecular level, meaning you can't be fooled by shapeshifters.
You can tag foes by sticking Ys to them. It will attract friends with a Leukocyte-Mimicry power.
In the presence of a friend Hepatocyte Mimic, the Ys will bore holes in a foe's body.
weaknesses: You cannot enter combat mode by yourself with this power alone.
You can't return yourself to normal mode and your ability remains active in combat mode.
If you don't have a friend Leukocyte Mimic or Hepatocyte Mimic, you can't kill a foe.

name: Acid Breath V2
description: With this power you can breathe corrosive acid from your nose. Whenever your breathe out through your nose you will melt anything near your nose. You cannot be hurt by your nose acid.
summary: The ability to breathe corrosive acid
strengths: You can breathe acid out through your nose
weaknesses: You melt things whenever you breathe out through your nose
Breathing from your mouth does nothing acidwise

name: Zombie Ninja Summon
description: With this power you can summon zombies with all of the skills and abilities of your average stereotypical ninja. Enhanced senses and agility, a black belt in several forms of karate, being able to wield swords, nun-chucks and ninja stars with ease and being able to move without making any noise. They're also undead so they have a craving for brains, smell horrible and can't be killed. The three ninja zombies are under your complete control and you can unsummon them whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon three zombie ninjas
strengths: You can summon three zombie ninjas
They have all of the attributes of a zombie and a ninja
They are under your complete control
weaknesses: They smell bad
Sometimes they fall apart

name: Suction Cups
description: With this power you can create suction cups all over your body whenever you want. The suction cups give you the ability to stick to anything for up to sixty minutes unless you replace the suction cup.
summary: The ability to create suction cups all over your body
strengths: You can generate suction cups all over your body
You can stick to stuff
weaknesses: You can only use a suction cup for up to an hour before it looses its stickiness

name: Hockey Scythe
description: With this power you can turn any hockey stick into a scythe. All you have to do it be holding a hockey stick and say "Scythe! ". You cannot reverse the affects of this power.
summary: The ability to turn hockey sticks into scythes
strengths: You can turn hockey sticks into scythes
weaknesses: You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Bird Species Shift
description: With this power you can change the species of birds. You change a canary into a hawk, a cardinal into an eagle. You can change the species of a single bird as many times as you want and you can also use this power on as many birds as you want.
summary: The ability to change the species of birds
strengths: You can change the species of any kind of bird
You can change the species of a single bird as many times as you want
You can change the species of as many birds as you want
weaknesses: The birds are not under your control
It only works on birds

name: Rise Of Gossamer
description: With this power you can turn into Gossamer. Gossamer is a giant red furry monster with sharp claws and tennis shoes on his feet. In this form you are super strong, are always warm due to your fur and have super sharp claws and big feet for stepping on your enemies. You retain your intelligence, personality but not your ability to speak in this form.
summary: The ability to turn into Gossamer
strengths: You can turn into Gossamer
You have super strength, fur, sharp claws and big feet
weaknesses: You cannot talk

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Coat
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This coat will fit any brave man who should choose to put it on. Cowards attempting to wear this coat will either find it ridiculously large or painfully small.
summary: The ability to wear the coat of Padarn Red-Coat
strengths: You'll be able to find out whether you are a coward by trying this coat on.
Toasty warm.
Lovely shade of red.
weaknesses: The coat not fitting would hurt your pride.
It's basically just a regular coat.

name: Myth Power: Phocus' Focus
description: Phocus (Phocos, Phokos), in Greek myth, was the god of seals. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and command seals at will. In addition, one can psychically mimic the features and abilities of a seal at will. Furthermore, one can transform oneself into any species of seal (or wereseal, or selkie) at will (others by touch), among other phocine abilities. One can even psychically teleport oneself and/or others to any location that is home to seals at will.
summary: The ability to channel Phocus' command over the essence of seals
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate, command and mimic seals at will
Transform oneself into any species of seal (or wereseal or selkie) at will; others, by touch
Psychically teleport self/others to any location with seals, cast illusion of seal barking, at will
weaknesses: Part 2 of Pro #2 requires touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot astral-project a water-independent seal-spirit at will, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Poseidon's Prestige and MythPower: Amphitrite's Amity provide immunity (NCN)

name: Open Pet Tank
description: When you acquire this power, a special glass tank appears in front of you. This tank has the ability to inter-dimensionally share an object with two places: The outside world and inside the tank. Say you have a lizard that is really hard to look after. When you put the lizard in this tank, it will be both inside the tank and in the wild. The lizard will eat, drink and be in the wild while you can watch over it. You can pick it up, and the glass will serve as a shield against predators.
summary: The ability to keep a pet while it's in the wild
strengths: Follow the pet in the wild in 3rd person perspective.
It can get whatever it needs.
You can interact with the pet, and the glass appears to momentarily protect it in the wild
weaknesses: If you pick it up, it may think "WHAT JUST HAPPENED?!!! Where am I? "
Not much owner-pet bonding can happen unless you pick it up and interact with it a lot.
Bad if something disrupts the inter-dimensional displacement.

name: Skeptic Vibe
description: You give off a vibe that makes the supernatural (psychics, ghosts, cryptids, aliens, witches, faith healers) extremely uncomfortable, to the point where anything supernatural avoids you and the area you're in.
summary: The ability to give off a vibe that makes the supernatural avoid you.
strengths: Never have to worry about supernatural threats.
Drive off the supernatural with your mere presence.
weaknesses: You will never encounter anything supernatural.

name: Birds To Airplanes
description: With this power you can turn any type of bird into any type of airplane but you cannot turn that airplane back into a bird
summary: The ability to turn birds into airplanes
strengths: You can have a lot of airplanes
weaknesses: You can't do much with the airplanes unless you are a pilot or you can get your hands on one
You might accidentally make a certain type of bird endangered or even extinct

name: Obsessive Compulsive
description: If you are attacked by an enemy, this ability is a great defense. Instead of hurting this person their attack bonuses back on them making them obsessed over a thing or action, even a personal trait long enough for you get away or capture them, example making a person count every breath they take and trying repeat the same number every minute or something.
summary: The ability to make someone obsess over something or some act for a length of time.
strengths: Great defence mechanism. Distraction helps you gets past enemy and capture suspects.
Make people look like fools in battle. Free House cleaning. Perfect cooking everytime.
weaknesses: You could find yourself spending too time tormenting people.
You could get a victims killed if battling in large numbers.
You could make someone become obsessed for the rest of their life.

name: Strength Of Joy
description: With this power, you gain a low level of reality manipulation.- the control over reality through your thoughts. However, this ability is tied directly to the happiness of you and others around you. If people around you are extremely happy, your power will be very high, and you'll be capable of great feats. However, if you or many others around you are depressed, not only will your speed, strength, Etc. Be lower, your other powers will lose their strength also.
summary: The ability to impose your will on reality through happiness.
strengths: When happy, you are very powerful.
If you are a naturally happy person, you will be extremely strong.
If you are social/surround yourself with friends, you will also be strong.
weaknesses: When sad, you will be drastically weaker.
Once your sadness reaches a certain level. Your life will be in danger.

name: Loaded
description: With this power you can know exactly how much ammo any given weapon has just by looking at it.
summary: The ability to know how much ammo any weapon has just by looking at it
strengths: You can know how much ammo a weapon has just by looking at it
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat if you're not fighting someone with a gun
You need to be able to see the weapon

name: Rip Van Winkle
description: Like Washington Irving's character, you will go into a deep hibernation for century. You will have a protective force field around you & all your fuctions will slow down. Meaning you won't need to breath much or need nutrition & all other involuntary functions will be taken care of. But most of all, you won't age. When 100 years have passed, you will awaken without atrophy.
summary: The ability to go into suspended animation for a century
strengths: Be able to live 100 years without aging
Be protected by a force field
All bodily functions & needs will be taken care of
weaknesses: Your family & friends will probably not be alive 100 years from now
You missed out on what happend for 100 years since you went into hibernation

name: The Spiller
description: With this power, you can spill any liquid that's been placed in some type of container. Be it a coffee mug, semi-truck, or your neighbor's toilet, all that's required is a thought... And *sploosh*. While it seems limiting at first, there are TONS of possibilities awaiting the owner of this power. Co-worker not cooperating? Coffee burns! Drunk guy hitting on your girl? Party foul! And if you play your cards right, you might just become the next fast food lawsuit jackpot winner.
summary: The ability to spill any liquid that has been placed in a container.
strengths: Eliminate drunk ass-bandits and annoying co-workers
Never get shut out playing beer pong. They'll be too drunk to notice their cup spilled by itself!
Might be fun while giving blood.
weaknesses: While showing off, you might spill pecious beverages such as beer or liquid uranium
You're useless with no contained liquids nearby
Doesn't work on organic containers like people or kittens

name: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
description: If you have to sleep next to someone who snores loudly, you can turn their snoring into holographic imitative words like 'Zzzzzzz' (or 'Kkhhh', if you have to sleep next to Donald Duck). They will be silent and fun to watch.
summary: The ability to turn snoring into holographic imitative words.
strengths: No more sleepless nights beside a snoring partner.
Surely the last power on the list.
Fun to watch.
weaknesses: Other unpleasant noises can still keep you awake.

name: Yoko Factor
description: When you are dealing with a group of people, such as friends, allies, teammates, family,... , you are able to spill out the secrets they are keeping from the others. You know exactly what to say to affect them and how to say it to upset them, either in a sadisticly calm way or even a charmingly nasty way. The biggest risk is that they turn their anger against you, but at least the damage has been done as they won't easily trust each other from now on.
summary: The ability to bring up nasty secrets among groups of friends, effectively breaking them up.
strengths: You can disband whole groups of people.
You can learn other people's embarrassing secrets.
weaknesses: People could forgive themselves, in which case your intervention reinforced their bonds.
People could beat you to stop you from revealing any more secrets.

name: Take Out Menu
description: You have a magic take-out menu that allows you to order any cooked food that you have eaten before. To order the food, you must pay the cheapest amount that has been paid for the food for you to eat in the past (ingredients if it was made at home). The food can only be eaten by the one who ordered it and only one meal can be ordered at any one time.
summary: The ability to order any food that you have eaten before for the same price.
strengths: Any food you want at any time.
Possibility of free food.
Food cannot be stolen.
weaknesses: Have to pay to get better food.
Cannot feed those who are hungry around you.
May become fat.

name: Holy Power: Shield Grenade
description: With this power you can focus a massive amount of chaos energy on your shield and then throw the shield on your target, causing it to create a gigantic explosion of pure destruction, destroying everything and everyone in great distance. This ability is really, really powerful but it is as dangerous as strong. You might kill a lot of people if you use this power on the wrong place, so be careful. Only an Avenger can use this power.
summary: The ability to focus a massive amount of chaotic energy on the Avenger Shield and throw it, causing an explosion.
strengths: Cause a lot of destruction.
You can easily destroy a whole army of enemies using this power.
You can use this power from a safe distance by throwing the shield on enemies that are far away.
weaknesses: You might hurt a lot of innocent people.
Wastes a lot of energy, and takes a few second to get all the Chaos Energy required for this attack.

name: Maximum Fart
description: This power is able to generate huge amounts of sonic energy by farting. This 'gassy' new ability has a variety of uses. You can use it to fly, create concussive or disintegrating energy blasts, create force-fields, shatter certain materials by using different wavelengths of sound, or cause your enemies to become disoriented, nauseous, or even unconscious. You can even use your own stomach-wind to let you move very fast.
summary: The ability to inadvertently let out a massive sonic feedback Flatulence.
strengths: This might cause your opponents to faint or vomit.
weaknesses: If you get near a campfire, an inferno, or a wildfire it'll destroy everything within city blocks.

name: Meat Vision
description: Create meat whenever you want! Feed the poor! Make a meat mobile! Do what ever you want, You the god of meat.
summary: The ability to create meat upon will.
strengths: Feed the power
Meat weapontry
Meat Mobile
weaknesses: Rotten Meat
Tired of meat
Vegatarians family and friends

name: Diabolus Ex Machina
description: With this power you have the evil twin of the Deus Ex Machina power. Truly the Devil in the Machine everything will become much worse for everyone else and if not careful you.   This power activates either when you shout Diabolus Ex Machina or when you die.   This will cause an unnatural phenomenon to happen that will make everything worse(or worse in comparison according to you).  When you die unnaturally, ultimate bad luck occurs and the universe ends in a big bang.
summary: The ability to solve any tragedy while creating another tragedy that is much bigger
strengths: Everyone wants to keep you alive
Everyone gets hit with this ability
Bad look may be twisted good luck
weaknesses: This power makes everything worse
Everyone else will hate you
Crazy cultists will try to kill you

name: Garden Master
description: Zen gardens, vegetable gardens, flower garden, etc. Someone with this power can have any kind of garden they want and maintain that garden perfectly without any help because this power gives them full knowledge of how to do so.
summary: The ability to have full knowledge of how to make and maintain a garden of any plants/style one wants
strengths: You can have the most beautiful garden on the block!
Grow all your own vegetables and spend less money on groceries.
weaknesses: Only gives knowledge, no control like Mythpower: Demeter's Touch or something similar

name: Kyst: Emergency Power #5
description: Vanthu -- bipeds that look like offspring of a whale and a elephant. Kyst will send for up to a thousand (space permitting). Weapons could be energy, hyperkinetic or reality negating. Damage will be direct rapid-fire with a range of 15 to 20 miles. Kyst will give you one vanthu to command. This vanthu will have the best weapon.
summary: The ability to have Kyst call for up to 1000 big guns.
strengths: You get one to command.
Yours will have the best weapon.
This adds to Emergency Power #4
weaknesses: This is an emergency power, vanthu vanish when not needed.

name: Quintesson Robot Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Quintesson robot (Sharkticons, Allicons, Overcharge) from any Transformers continuity. Though due to them being evil drones, they may need some reprogramming before they'll listen to you. When you're done with them, you can just send them back to whatever Universe they came from.
summary: The ability to summon any robot from Quintessa
strengths: You can summon as many Quintesson robots as you want
They are very powerful
Once you're done with them you can just send them back to whatever universe they came from
weaknesses: You might need to reprogram them before they'll work for you
They might get distracted and eat a car instead of what you told them to do

name: Dantes Scroll
description: Derrick Dante has caused many troubles for many gods. Absorbing many avatars powers. Every time he grows stronger. So the gods developed a scroll that could summon Dante at anytime in case one of the gods were in trouble. He does not like being summoned however his level of "avatar" kills is so great the gods needed a way to keep him in check. This has worked so far but only time will tell if they made the right choice.
summary: The ability to gods from many religions came together to find a way to stop Derrick Dante
strengths: Having Dante at your beckon call
Having an artifact that the gods made
Enormouse amounts of power
weaknesses: Partly an egyptian god item
If it falls into the wrong hands things will go to hell

name: Lyric Database
description: With this power you know the lyrics to every single song ever made
summary: The ability to know the lyrics of every single song ever made
strengths: You know the lyrics to every song
You're good at karaoke
weaknesses: You don't necessarily have a good singing voice with this power
No use if battle

name: 4th Key Of Death
description: With this power you are able to summon the 4th key of Death, able over controlling the death of races that are beyond the humans knowledge. By pointing the key at them, body's skin,muscle and bone unwind (like the way it is in Fullmetal Alchemist brotherhood) and then their remains teleport to the underworld, leaving them to Hades' wrath.
summary: The ability to be able to summon a key that controls the death of extra-terrestials.
strengths: Control the death of "aliens".
weaknesses: Aliens aren't that common to see.
Must be pointing the key at them.
It is a small key, that you could lose.

name: Designated Drunkard
description: With this ability, you can make yourself completely drunk or completely sober, or anywhere in between.  If you want that perfect buzz, you've got it.  Big presentation?  Relax without the whiskey flask.  Your BAC actually changes when using this power, so when it's time to drive home, you can instantly make yourself sober!  Features include a cruise control, where your BAC stays at one level until you decide otherwise, and auto-soberization, where your body stops you from getting TOO drunk.
summary: The ability to control how intoxicated you are.
strengths: Drink like a champ
Be a cheap date--just raise your drunkenness after the first beer
The perfect buzz all night long
weaknesses: Break-ups
It may be TOO easy to become drunk
Drunkenness as a magic bullet for life's problems!

name: Label Transformation
description: With this power, you can transform into any high school label like a nerd, goth, jock, gangster, prep, redneck, ect. If you wanted to transform into a goth, for example, your typical outfit will become black with accessories like chains, many piercings, and long black arm warmers. Your hair will turn black and you will be able to think like a goth and act like a goth. By the way, just because I use the word "like" a lot, it dosen't mean that I'm a prep.
summary: The ability to transform into any high school label
strengths: If you dislike your label, you can become one that interests you
Being able to sneek into an awsome party for preps only
Pass a test with the mind of a nerd. (Like me ^_^)
weaknesses: You may not like the label you turn into (I would hate being a prep)
The transformation only lasts for three hours
Side effects may cause drowsiness, loss of taste, and constipation.

name: Mega Evil Laugh
description: Lets face it, a supervillain can have all the power they want, but if they are going to sound like a little girl when you laugh, well, lets just say that you wont last long if your looking for fear from people. So with this power you can have the ultimate evil laugh of your choice. And no this isnt a voice power. You can make your laugh echo, really loud, etc.
summary: The ability to give yourself an awesome evil laugh
strengths: Awesome laugh
Might be scary
weaknesses: Only works with laughs
Might backfire fo those with a bad sense of a good laugh

name: Spirit Of Christmas
description: You naturally spread the Christmas spirit to everyone around you, causing peace on Earth and the will to give. You can use Christmas magic to cause people's Christmas wishes to come true. Also, being the embodiment of Christmas allows you to become iconic Christmas figures, such as Santa, Frosty, and Jack Frost. Merry Christmas!
summary: The ability to become the embodiment of Christmas.
strengths: Spread the Christmas Spirit to those around you.
Cause Christmas miracles to happen.
Become iconic Christmas figures.
weaknesses: Weakens for those who would do evil.
Weakens the further away from Christmas day.
Weakens for those who do not know the true meaning of Christmas.

name: Petrifying Hair
description: Anything your hair touches it will turn to stone except for you. While this power is in use your hair will turn brown.
summary: The ability to cause one's hair to petrify what it touches
strengths: Enemies will never want to touch your hair again.
weaknesses: Very obvious when you use this power.

name: Cop Detector
description: With this power you can detect if there is a police officer near you or somebody near you is an undercover cop. The person will automatically have yellowish glow in your eyes and you a faint beeping will go off in your head if there is a cop near you that you can't see.
summary: The ability to know if somebody is a cop
strengths: You will know if there is a police officer near you
weaknesses: The beeping might get annoying
You can't turn this power off
Only works for police officers not any law enforcement officer (FBI, CIA etc. )

name: Yeti Control
description: With this power you have control overt the furry super strong cryptid the Yeti
summary: The ability to control yetis
strengths: You can make the yeti fight battles for you
You can scare people away for you
He can carry you places when you're to lazy to walk
weaknesses: This power only works on yetis
If there is no yeti near you when you use this power it might take a while for the yeti to get to yo

name: Contact High
description: Allows you to make people high just by touching them.
summary: The ability to make people high
strengths: Makes people high
Prevents people from doing evil things
weaknesses: You are always high

name: The Alien Mummy Curse
description: With this power you can turn into a alien made of living bandages that resembles Benmummy from the 'Ben 10' series.
summary: The ability to turn into an alien mummy
strengths: Limited stretching
Limited regeneration
Super strength
weaknesses: May burst into flames near fire
Might blow away from a gust of wind

name: Rise Of The Muppets
description: With this power you can turn into any of the Muppets from the Muppet tv shows, movies, commercials, tv specials and anything else they've appeared in. You can turn into any Muppet aside from the Muppet Monsters and you are an actual living thing and not a puppet. In Muppet form you retain your intelligence and personality but if you turn into a Muppet that cannot speak you will be unable to speak as well. You also grown or shrink in order to accomodate the Muppet's height.
summary: The ability to turn into any of the Muppets
strengths: You can turn into any Muppet aside from the Muppet Monsters
You retain your intelligence level and personality
You are an actual living being
weaknesses: Doesn't apply to Muppet Monsters
Doesn't apply to Sesame Street characters or Fraggle Rock characters
You might lose your ability to speak depending on who you turn into

name: Bicycle Summoning
description: By simply snapping your fingers you reach into another plane and pull a bicycle into your current reality. You may not choose details and the bicycles are permanent.
summary: The ability to summon bicycles at the snap of your fingers.
strengths: Fun for the family.
Summon many and use them as obstacles.
You would be an awesome bike shop owner.
weaknesses: They would pile up after a while.
You might get a child's bike.
You must be able to snap your fingers.

name: French Fries
description: You can turn any potato you see into french fries by touching it.
summary: The ability to turn any potato into french fries
strengths: Instant french fries
Get rid of any ugly potatoes
weaknesses: Might not taste good

name: Onigiri Transformation
description: An onigiri is a ball of plain rice, usually wrapped in seaweed, shaped into a triangle or an oval. When you are hugged or when you hug a person of the opposite sex or when you are weakened, you'll transform into a small onigiri. You can still talk in this form and can move to some degree (actually, a more precise word is waggle). You can't transform back at will. You'll only change back after a short random amount of time. If you are eaten in onigiri form, you'll remain in that form and die.
summary: The ability to change into an onigiri when you are hugged by a person of the opposite sex or when you feel weak.
strengths: Onigiris are cute and popular!
If an ally is starving.
You become more easily portable.
weaknesses: An onigiri is not a fruit.
You'll die if you are eaten.
You'll remain in onigiri form if you die.
tags: was edited as it was not really a superpower

name: Myth Power: Eunostos' Know How
description: Eunostos (Eunostus, Promylaea), in Greek myth, was the goddess of flour mills, and grain silos. As such, channeling her allows one to cause any container one holds to produce any desired amount of flour at will (as long as physical contact is maintained). In addition, with a touch, one can establish an empty building as a 'silo space', which may be used for infinite storage, or imprisoning foes. One can even cause foes to sink into the ground, which will grind them painfully into useable flour.
summary: The ability to channel Eunostos' command over the essence of flour mills and grain silos
strengths: Cause any container to pour forth as much flour as one desires, at will (with  maintained contact)
Turn any empty building into infinite-storage 'silo spaces' by touch; teleport between them at will
Cause foes to sink into the ground; the ground will grind them up into cooking flour
weaknesses: Pro #1 and 3 do not apply to living things until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot use one's silo space to access a dimension of infinite grain until the higher levels (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Panontic Arch:Kyriona
description: Kyriona where sentient plants run around and mindless animals are rooted in the ground. You can summon 300 plant beings from Kryiona. These beings can be smart as the smartest human. You gain the power to turn a animal(including humans) mindless and sessile. A victim would first have his feet become rootlike,his legs fuse together then over a five day period he gradually become mindless.
summary: The ability to gain powers the Kyriona dimension.
strengths: 300 plant beings to serve as helpers.
Plant beings can reproduce.
You can turn animals into non-sentient immobile plantlike things.
weaknesses: Plant beings are still subject to plant affecting powers.

name: Spit Machine Gun
description: You can spit at a rate of 20 lugies per second. You can shoot up to a mile and your aim will be pretty good. Great for obliterating people in spitting contests. Plus, you have endless saliva.
summary: The ability to spit like a machine gun.
strengths: Spitting contests.
Drive-by spittings.
People who find spitting sexy.
weaknesses: People who don't find spitting sexy.

name: Lamp Maker
description: With this power, you can make/remove lamps out of thin air. Then, you can command them to do your bidding. Unfortunately though, they short out in water and they can't move much, but you can decide what kind of lamp they are. You can control lamps that aren't made by you, but you can't remove them. Also only 50 lamps can be controlled at a time.
summary: The ability to make lamps and control them with your mind
strengths: Lamp armies
Don't need to get up and flip a switch to turn lamps off.
Fun at electronic stores.
weaknesses: Short out in water
Break easy
Lamps can't move

name: Zodiac: Aquarius
description: By drawing the sign of Aquarius the Water Bearer,you make the target want to drink as much water as possible. Pure water will be their first choice, but water in any form will work for them. Only works for 1 hour and you have to draw the sign 3 centimeters away from their face.
summary: The ability to make a person want to get as much water in their body as possible
strengths: They might bite their allies to get water.
weaknesses: Be careful! Blood contains water!

name: Motorboat
description: Motorboating is when you put your face between a set of boobs and blow!  With this ability you can motorboat whenever you see a great set of jugs!  And they always enjoy it.
summary: The ability to motorboat anyone you want!
strengths: MOTORBOATING
weaknesses: NOTHING

name: One Word Text Resistance
description: Nobody likes one worded text messages. "Ok. " "Sure. " "Yeah. " "Haha. " "Lol". They imply that the person you're texting is not fully focused on the conversation. With this ability, a person is able to completely ignore these rude messages with a clean conscience.
summary: The ability to ignore people who send you one worded text messages
strengths: You don't have to talk to people who obviously don't want to talk to you.
People will eventually get the message and start actually paying attention to conversations with you
You are able to ignore annoying people without feeling bad about it.
weaknesses: Your friends might not like you very much if you keep ignoring their texts.
As a result of #1, you will be alone.
Which would be really lonely for you:(

name: The Curse Of The Rose
description: This ability allows the user to give someone a curse that they live as long as the rose lives and that during that time the person ages quickly and they die horribly
summary: The ability to give people the curse of the rose
strengths: Curse someone
They live as long as the rose
Horrible death

Someone with rose manipulation
Doesnt affect gods

name: "Tap Dance!"
description: With this power you can make anybody tap dance just by thinking of the person and saying: "Tap dance!" After that, the selected person will start tap dancing uncontrollably, until you say "Stop!"
summary: The ability to make people tap dance
strengths: You can make people tap dance
You can make enemies start tap dancing during a fight
weaknesses: They can still attack you while tap dancing

name: Regulatory T Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). When you encounter a friendly Leukocyte Mimic in combat mode, you'll enter combat mode as well. In this mode, you gain the power to stun, reverse to normal or even kill friendly Leukocyte Mimics who are in combat mode. You'll also strip friendly Dendritic Cell and Macrophage Mimics off foes' cells they've assimilated.
summary: The ability to stun, reverse to normal or even kill friendly Leukocyte Mimics in combat mode.
strengths: You can get rid of the unwanted clones in combat mode of friendly Leukocyte Mimics.
You can use your killing power on your own clones.
If a friend Leukocyte Mimic is controlled to attack their own friends, you can stop them.
weaknesses: Your clones can use their killing power on you.
If you are controlled to attack your own friends with Leukocyte-Mimicry powers.
Your killing power can only be used on your own friends.

name: Green Lantern Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon any character who has been a Green Lantern in a Green Lantern parody. You can summon Shrek or Kermit the Frog from Mad Magazine's spoof or Big Bird from MAD TV show's spoof. Or any other character from a spoof.
summary: The ability to summon characters who have been Green Lanterns in parodies
strengths: You can summon any character who has been a Green Lantern in a spoof
They are not under your control
weaknesses: You can't summon any actual Green Lanterns

name: Curse Of The Ginosaji
description: The Ginosaji is a slow steady, relentless, force that will continuously chase and hit its target with a spoon until he/she/it dies. It cannot be seen by anyone other than the target and the user of this power. It is invincible and immortal however it is very slow. It has unlimited stamina and if the target gets 10 feet away from it it will teleport next to the person. Also it has an unlimited number of spoons.
summary: The ability to summon a Ginosaji to follow anyone you want
strengths: Slow slow death for your enemies
Your enemies will become terrified of spoons
weaknesses: Once you summon it it cannot be unsummoned
Can only be used for evil purposes
If you accidentally use it on yourself

name: Sumo Growth
description: You're born with this power and you must hold your breath for 60 sec. Then, this power shows up and it is inexhaustible. It makes you enormously strong and fat. It's a defense mechanism that can't be stolen or absorbed by opponents. It protects you from getting hurt by enemies. It never ends, even when you sleep. This power makes you slower and you have to eat a lot.
summary: The ability to make your body becomes very thick and strong
strengths: Never allows you to be hurt
Never ending
Controllable

Immortal
Continuous access to food

name: Cheerleading Harpies
description: With this power you can summon a team of cheerleaders that will cheer for whatever you do (fighting, playing sports, doing homework, eating, sleeping etc. ) however when you're attacked the cheerleaders will suddenly turn into a bunch of harpies (half bird half woman creatures) who want to protect you. Once the threat to you is gone they will revert to cheerleader form and continue cheering for you.

strengths: You have a bunch of hot cheerleaders cheering for you
You have a bunch of harpies as body guards
weaknesses: Their cheering might get a bit annoying
You cannot unsummon them

name: Silly Putty Man
description: At will you can change into Silly Putty Man or Woman. You gain all the characteristics of Silly Putty, you can bounce, stretch, flow like a slow moving liquid.
summary: The ability to change into Silly Putty.
strengths: Can get through tight places.
Ability to bounce high, to gain access to high places.
weaknesses: Heavy impacts will cause you to shatter.
Any type of alcohol changes you into a gum like substance.

name: Captcha Mancy
description: All one must do to use this power is to ask a question to any reCAPTCHA and then click the "get new challenge" button. You will be able to divine the answer to your question from the resulting CAPTCHA code.
summary: The ability to divine answers from CAPTCHA codes
strengths: Get the answer to any question in just two words.
weaknesses: You must have a computer to use your power.

name: Poxifier
description: With this power you can give people the chicken pox. The chicken pox that you give people can be cured but you can give it to people more than once so once somebody cures it you can give it to them again. You can even use this power on people who've already had normal chicken pox and people who've been vaccinated against normal pox.
summary: The ability to give people chicken pox
strengths: You can give people chicken pox
You can give it to people more than once
weaknesses: Your chicken pox can be cured

name: God Phone V3
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods and Goddesses of Egyptian Mythology. The Gods are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for summoning them they might want to help you. You can not send them back unless they want to go back.

You can't send them back unless the want to be sent back

name: Zombie Breath
description: This power enables you to breathe out a lingering cloud of an extremely noxious poison, causing those who inhale sufficient quantities (about 10 seconds at full strength) it to die a wretched, painful, vomiting death. Within 3 hours, the victims rise as Zombies under your mental control. While not particularly intelligent, they are able to follow basic commands. These are true, voodoo-style zombies, not the flesh-eating living dead. Survivors of the initial breath attack are sick for days.
summary: The ability to turn people into the undead with your breath
strengths: Generate your own loyal army of the undead.
Make your undead enemies do humiliating things
Think of the money you save on health care for your undead minions
weaknesses: This power gives you permanent halitosis
While greatly slowed down, decay is not stopped, so your servents eventually fall apart and smell
These stupid zombies can misinterprete confusing or complex orders.

name: Myth Power: Hand Of The Harvest
description: Carmanor (Karmanor) and his granddaughter Carme (Karme), in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of the field's summer harvest. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically cut through plant matter at will. In addition, one may psychically disrupt plant-based abilities, by touch. Furthermore, one can withstand (and gain physical power in) hot/summer-like conditions. One may even summon indestructible farming implements (pitchfork, scythe, sickle, hoe, etc) at will.
summary: The ability to channel Carmanor and Carme's command over the essence of harvesting
strengths: Psychically cut through plant matter (fruits/vegetables, wood, cardboard, paper, etc) at will

name: Crodo: Big Head Gun
description: Big-Head guns looks like normal guns,but when you hit someone,there head becomes bigger and bigger until it explodes.
summary: The ability to wield a big-head gun.
strengths: Very violent way of death.
weaknesses: You need a head shot.
Evidence.

name: Myth Power: Carpos' Caper
description: Carpos (Carpus, Karpos) and the Carpoi (Karpoi), in Greek myth, were the gods of fruits of the earth, including the fruits of the fields (grain and the like). As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate fruit, grain and fruit- and grain-bearing plants, at will. In addition, one can gain physical power from eating fruits and farm-grown crops. One can even psychically compel subjects to gorge out on fruit and grain by touch, word or thought.

strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate fruits/grain and fruit/grain plants
Enhanced stats from eating fruits and wheat/grains; developed, psychically mimic fruit/grain at will
Compel subjects to gorge out on fruit/vegetables/grain (abandoning all else)
weaknesses: Cannot root subjects to the ground, sprouting various fruits/grain, by touch until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate supernatural fruit (even from body of self/others), until developed (NCN)

name: Spontaneous Hair Growth
description: This ability gives power to make any amount of hair grow quickly and spontaneously on the body of yourself or others
summary: The ability to make a large amount of hair grow spontaneously on yourself or others

name: Myth Power: Eileithyia's Labor
description: Eileithyia (Eilethyia, Eilethyia, Ilithyia, Eleutho) and the Eileithyiae (Eileithyiai, Eilethyiae, Eilethyiai), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of pregnancy, labor and childbirth. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive when a female subject is pregnant and many other facts about women's pregnancies. In addition, one may induce or delay birth labor at will. One may even induce or amplify labor pains on any female; males may be afflicted with the proportionate version of the same pain.
summary: The ability to channel Eileithyia and the Eileithyiae's command over the essence of pregnancy, labor and childbirth
strengths: Perceive information about any female's pregancy, labor and childbirth (including self, if female)

name: 503   Over Quota
description: Somewhere out there is a universe without superheroes! This is where all the inspiration for powers comes from. Every now and then they use their inter dimensional technology to view the superpower list universe. With this power you can prevent them from viewing the universe for a random amount of time.
summary: The ability to temporarily disable the superpower list from another universe
strengths: Absolutley stops everything, temporarily
No seriously nothing can happen
I mean it. NOTHING
weaknesses: You have to be outside the superpowerlistuniverse to use it
Kind of pointless since nothing inside the universe changes once deactivated

name: Clairalience
description: This power makes you become a "psychic bloodhound". By smelling objects that were close to or touched by a missing person & getting scent of their psychic impression, you can psychically track them down following the ESP scent. The downside of this power is getting a strong psychic scent of an object & how far the person is before losing their scent. Also you are just using your psychic scent of smell so you can't actually see where the person is, just the ESP scent.
summary: The ability to psychically smell & track a person
strengths: Become a psychic bounty hunter
weaknesses: Have to have an object that was close to the person to get a good enough scent
The person can't be to far away or the scent becomes hazy & faded
Don't actually see anything except the psychic scent

name: Liquid Water
description: This power turns the solid and gas forms of H2O into its liquid form. It does this by changing the temperature of the H2O to be between 0 degrees Celsius and 100 degrees Celsius. While this power is being used, the H2O will be unable to change back to its solid or gas forms. When this power is turned off, the H2O will gain or lose heat like normal. This power does not give other control over the H2O.
summary: The ability to turn H2O into a liquid.
strengths: Melt ice.
Condense steam.
Keep water at the same temperature.
weaknesses: Not very useful.
Cannot control water in other ways.
Have to let water turn back to ice or steam on its own.

name: Looney Tunes Gun
description: It's a firearm (e. G. Shotgun, rifle, pistol) that, instead of shooting actual bullets, fires a huge puff of smoke and sparks that incinerates enemy clothes, leaves large amounts of ash and soot, and can cause first degree burns.  Also can be loaded with a tiny flag that says "Bang! ", which can also be loaded with a miniature explosive that results in the same effect.
summary: The ability to own a gun that doesnt kill, but shoots
strengths: Non lethal, good to make a distraction
Dazes enemies and leaves them disorientated and possibly blind for a few moments
Good for pranks too.
weaknesses: Non lethal
Short range (it litteraly wont fire unless you are a few feet away from the target)

name: Myth Power: Demokratia's Demand
description: Demokratia (Democratia), in Greek myth, was the goddess of democracy. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive subjects' moral alignments as psionic 'votes'. If the evil 'votes' outnumber the good, then foes suffer bad luck; if the good 'votes' outnumber the evil, then self and allies gain good luck. In addition, psychic compulsion and reversal of moral alignment is automatically negated in one's presence. One can even psychically teleport to anywhere democracy is being exercised, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Demokratia's command over the essence of democracy
strengths: Psychically perceive subjects' moral alignments as 'votes'; use 'votes' to bestow good/bad luck
Psychic compulsion and reversal of moral alignment automatically fails in one's presence

Cannot enhance the force behind subjects' voices until developed (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Panontic Arch: Harulli
description: Harulli, the flesh-eating dimension. You gain the power to strip a living thing of their flesh as if invisible creatures were attacking. You gain the ability to be immune to any powers that affect DNA, cells, blood or flesh, excluding this power (PA :Harulli).
summary: The ability to gain powers from the Harulli dimension.
strengths: Strip a foe of their flesh.
Immunity to biokinesis and similar powers.
weaknesses: This power is its own weakness.

name: Transformers: Impactor
description: you can turn your hand into a harpoon, which you can then use to cut/stab people/things or shoot out of your wrist in order to damage people/things. An unfortunate side effect of this power is that you start to become a bit of a jerk/anti-hero.
summary: The ability to turn your hand into a harpoon
strengths: You can turn your hand into a harpoon
You can launch said harpoon from your arm
weaknesses: You become a jerk/anti-hero

name: Enhancement: Last
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached it makes the power the last one in line to be stolen. Can only be attached to one power at a time.

strengths: Protect your most valuable power from being stolen.
If the attached power is the only power left other than this one, this power detaches and is stolen.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
If all your other powers are equally valuable.

name: Extreme Knot Maker
description: Ever get tired of having knots in your laces or bending over to retie them. Well say goodbye to that dismal moment. Extreme Knot Maker lets you make any knot known to man with extreme speed and ease. Figure eight, pretzel, Apache chief pipe smoking ritual knot, you got them all, so long as mankind has made them before.

strengths: Tie your shoes with ease
Go rock climbing with confidence you won't die
Break the world record for knot tying with time to spare
weaknesses: Nearly useless in fighting
Limited to the knots known to mankind

name: Intestinal Teleportation
description: With this power you could easily decimate an army. All you have to do is push yourself into someone's belly and concentrate on the person whose belly you would like to come out of. This can be done with individual limbs or the whole body. You will naturally find it very easy to rend flesh in the abdomen, but this does not apply to any other part of the body. The wound you cause may not always be lethal, but it usually is. You can also use this on yourself as a last ditch effort.
summary: The ability to teleport between people's intestines
strengths: Range is Unlimited
Effect is TERRIFYING
Much easier to tear flesh
weaknesses: Always feeling gross
Cannot go anywhere where there aren't people
Two people must be mortally wounded with every use

name: Summon Ibaeth
description: Ibaeth are 20 feet long and look half-monkey and half rattlesnake. The monkey half has feline features, vertical eyes and whiskers. The rattle of a ibaeth actually vibrates like a tuning fork. This vibration causes loss of balance and disorientation to anything with a nervous system within 200 feet. Sealed armor or immunity to vibration powers will protect against this. Additionally, ibaeths have cat claws, sharp teeth and night vision. Ibaeths can slither along at 15 mph. It will have a gun.
summary: The ability to summon a half-monkey half-snake kystian.
strengths: A ibaeth can unbalance foes and cause disorientation.
Claws and sharp teeth.
Not quite as strong as a slitskin.
weaknesses: Someone in a sealed suit of armor or equivalent of.
Someone with immunity to vibration powers.

name: Avenging Musician
description: With this power you can resurrect, summon the spirit of, or emulate (play with the same skill of) any dead musician of your choice. S/he will only remain alive for a short while.

description: A person with this power can turn anything stale. For example, they can make food, air and water stale. Of course, this would make your enemies very paranoid when eating. But, this is not it. The user can turn ANYTHING stale, even people's thought processes. Essentially, you can force people to only think of stale ideas, using this power.

name: Crodo: Vacuum Ball
description: Vacuum balls suck up any kind of dirt near them.  Anything it sucks up comes out on another universe.

weaknesses: You don't control what it sucks up.

name: Myth Power: Pompe's Procession
description: Pompe, in Greek myth, was the goddess of religious procession and ceremony. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically access the customs and traditions of every religion, religious sect and cult in existence. In addition, one may perceive the religious beliefs of others at will. Furthermore, one may psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those who share one's religious/spiritual views. One may even do physical and mental harm, by a touch, to those who do not.
summary: The ability to channel Pompe's command over the essence of religious procession
strengths: Psychically access all knowledge of existing religions, religious sects and cults
Psychically perceive others' religious views at will; harm those with differing religious views
Psychically perceive, communicate with and share senses with those with similar religious views

name: Unforgettable Voice
description: A person with this power can make whatever they say unforgettable. Whenever anyone else listens to the user's voice they will never forget what you said. This also works if the voice is spread through electronic media including microphones, recording devices, and through the internet.
summary: The ability to make whatever you say unforgettable
strengths: Can be used to become a great public speaker or singer
Useful to study with
Your insults hurt a lot since no one can forget them
weaknesses: Cannot turn off--so be careful what you say
Does not improve the quality of your voice

name: Pose Mastery
description: With this power you gain complete mastery of the pose, with the ability to seamlessly transition from one pose to the next without breaking stride such that even the most mundane tasks, such as walking your dog, become overdramatic and fabulous.

name: Useless
description: This power does absolutely nothing. It is not affected by any other power, and cannot be copied, or negated by any other individual other than the one who possesses it. name: 9 Element Masters' Seal
description: The nine elements are fire, water, earth, wind, ice, lightning, metal, wood, and sound. All the elements have to have someone who has mastered them in order for this power to work and one person can only stand in for one element at most.
summary: The ability to seal away any being/object so long as eight element masters are assisting one
strengths: You can stand in for one of the elements (only ONE).
weaknesses: You need to have everyone and it should be hard to get all eight people.

name: Drunk People Language
description: You can understand slurred speech and any nonsense drunk people shout. You can also speak the same way drunk people do, without needing to get drunk or act drunk, though it doesn't mean drunk people will understand you. Similarly, understanding them doesn't mean they will cooperate or answer your questions.

strengths: Help lost drunk people.
If you can act, you can actually convince people you are drunk.
Make fun of policemen when they make you blow in a breathalyzer.

description: With this power you can make people yawn by pointing at them. I happens whenever you point at someone and they don't stop yawning until you stop pointing at them.

strengths: You can make people yawn
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
They stop yawning when you stop pointing at them

name: "Jell O" Demons
description: Anything made by the company "Jell-o"(like "Jell-o" jell-o, or "Jell-o" pudding) you can turn into evil demons who obey your every command. You can also summon "Jell-o" demons out of nowhere. Your demons can envelope anything, to kill someone, to save someone, to carry something, etc. Your demons' essence is trapped inside of their gooey body, so they can't be exorcised (or popssess someone). The only way to kill or get rid of them is to completely obliterate them, or for you to unsummon them
summary: The ability to create demons from anything the company "Jell-o" makes
strengths: Giant, tasty, evil minions
If anyone else tries to eat the Jellos, the eater will instantly die
weaknesses: They can't possess someone
They can't go through forcefields

name: Myth Power: Phthonos' Theory
description: Phthonos (Phthonus), in Greek myth, was the god of jealousy, envy and resentment, especially in matters of love. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of enemies and loved ones (relatives/friend/allies) at will. In addition, one can perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel those who are naturally envious, jealous and possessive. One may even mimic the superhuman abilities/skills/capabilities of rivals when in radius of them.
summary: The ability to channel Phthonos' command over the essence of jealousy, envy and resentment
strengths: Perceive the thoughts, emotions, actions and locations of loved ones and enemies at will
Perceive, communicate with, share senses with and compel the envious, jealous and possessive
Mimic the powers and skills of rivals at will
weaknesses: Mimicry of powers/abilities/skills/talents lasts only an hour after leaving rival's presence (NCN)
People with MythPower: Nike's Knowledge and MythPower: Zeus' Zenith are immune to this ability
People with MythPower: Nemesis Indignation and MythPower: Aphrodisia are immune to this ability

name: Tele Apathy
description:
Tele-Apathic people couldn't care less about you or your problems. While many people display versions of this power in their everyday lives, Tele-Apathics (or "Shmanners" for convenience) have a super-humanly extended range. 

Famous shmanners include Peter Petrelli, who, despite having time travel, didn't care enough to stop time whenever attacked. Also D. L. Hawkins, a phaser who doesn't mind being shot point blank from the front.
summary: The ability to not care from far away.
strengths: It's a lot less stressful than other powers
weaknesses: You could die
Whoops, I mean you will die

name: Telephone Telepathy
description: People hear you all the time where ever you are in a kind of telepathic transmission. Even people on the other side of the world can hear you.

strengths: Your Girlfriend won't need to be jealous
People will know you are alive
Everybody can be your alibi if you would be accused for a crime
weaknesses: No personal integrity
The world will hear you when you're sick
Sometimes it can be embarrasing

name: Guitar Hero
description: Electric energy builds up in your hands and enters your guitar pick. When you strum with the guitar pick, it releases that energy into the strings, and travels up the strings until it exits through the headstock. You can use the energy to power up electronics or to shock your opponents.
summary: The ability to shoot lightning out of your guitar head
strengths: The better at playing the guitar you are, the stronger the electric force will be
Your guitar also works as a conductor, absorbing electricity and amplifying your own
weaknesses: The worse at playing the guitar you are, the weaker the electric force will be
The electricity will backfire if you attempt to shock someone who is better at playing the guitar

name: Billymayskinesis
description: Hi, Billy Mays here with Billymayskinesis with this power you can do anything I can, sell anything to anyone, grow a beard, and so much more! For just two easy payments of $19.99 this power can be yours.

Grow a beard instantly
