name: T Helper Cell Mimicry
description: As a type of Leukocyte Mimic, you have all their standard powers (cf. Other Leukocyte Mimics to know which ones). While cloning, you can decide if the new clone stays in combat mode or reverses to normal mode. When you encounter a foe, you spontaneously go into combat mode. In combat mode, you can attract other Leukocyte Mimics, as well as activate those who recognize the same foe as you and boost the powers of Macrophage Mimics.
summary: The ability to attract other Leukocyte Mimics and make them go into combat mode.
strengths: You can make T Cell and B Cell Mimics, who can't enter combat mode alone, enter it.

name: Delete This Torture Typhoon
description: You can place your opponent face-up across your own shoulders before hooking the head with one hand and a leg with the other. You then pull down on both ends to flex the opponent's back, lift the opponent up in a fireman's carry across your shoulders, throw the opponent's legs out in front of them to spin them out while they simultaneously fall backwards, driving their head into the ground in style of a DDT.
summary: The ability to put your opponent in a backbreaker rack, then go for a twirling finishing DDT.
strengths: Your foe will be in a whirlwind of pain.
weaknesses: None.

name: Myth Power: Talas' Tale
description: Talas, in Greek myth, was the goddess of unfortunate love (breakups, heartbreak, etc). As such, channeling her allows one to summon, by touch, a subject's 'Heart Object'. In addition, one may use it to perceive a subject's soulmate, and various negative aspects of their love life. Furthermore, one can manipulate it by touch to affect relationships at will (tearing it in two breaks up two lovers, and breaks single subjects' hearts; smashing it to the ground kills a subject, or their lover).
summary: The ability to channel Talas' command over the essence of unfortunate love and unfortunate relationships
strengths: Psychically summon a subject's Heart Object (a heart shaped object composed of love energy) by touch
Use it to perceive a subject's true love/soulmate (and various negative aspects of one's love life)
Manipulate a subject's Heart Object to manipulate love, life and relationships

name: Myth Power: Chloris' Claim
description: Chloris (Khloris), in Greek myth, was the goddess of flowers. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically manipulate flowers and flowering plants, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel subjects wearing flowers or flower patterns, at will. One can also mimic the powers of flowering plants (photosynthesis, producing roots, thorns, leaves, flower-based pheromones and toxins, etc) at will. One even gains favor with (thus, total immunity to) the winds.
summary: The ability to channel Chloris' command over the essence of flowers
strengths: Psychically manipulate flowers/flower plants; perceive, communicate with and compel flower-wearers

Gain favor with (immunity to the negative effects of) the winds

name: Summon Nitra
description: A nitra is a upright monster that looks like the offspring of pterodactyl and a sea anemone. It can fly 10 mph,run 30 mph and is strong enough to cut through titanium. It has long talons on the end of its wings/arms. It has the ability to only exist for its summoner and a sentient target of attack. It can't affect or be affected in any way by other beings or creatures when in that state. If its summoner is rendered unconscious a nitra dies instantly if in that state.
summary: The ability to summon a limited existing kystian.
strengths: A kystian that can literally only exist to kill.
You can make this kystian undetectable to its target. Invisible,silent,etc.
The target of a nitra is the only being that can affect it with or without powers.
weaknesses: If you're made unconscious any nitras you have could die.
A nitra can only go after one target in its limited existence state.

name: Babality
description: Step 1.  Raise your fist high in the air.  Step 2.   Watch and cackle maniacally (or smile heroically) as your opponent is instantaneously transformed into a helpless, crying baby.

weaknesses: You could end up getting stuck with the kid.

name: Myth Power: Trochilus' Trend
description: Trochilus (Trochilos, Trokhilos), in Greek myth, was the god of the watermill's mill-wheel, used to drive the millstone that grinds grain or corn husks into flour. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically perceive and manipulate flour, and any plant that is used to make flour. In addition, one can psychically perceive and manipulate any mechanism considered to be a wheel. Furthermore, one may even produce a psionic millstone grinding effect on anything within one's vision range at will.

strengths: Psychically perceive and manipulate flour; perceive, communicate and control flour-yielding plants

Produce a psionic millstone grinding effect to crush or grind nearly anything one can see
weaknesses: Only produce a mill effect on bodies of water to produce electricity at the higher levels (NCN)
Pro #3 ALWAYS requires seeing target; cannot be used on humans/animals until the higher levels (NCN)

name: Fwoosh
description: Have you ever been doing something and you just thought, 'How much funner would this be if I could make a Fwoosh sound while I did it? ' Well, with this power, you can make a Fwoosh sound whenever you do anything, without faking it. You can Fwoosh when you do paperwork, when you eat, even when you slap someone.

strengths: Make a Fwoosh sound effect at will.
weaknesses: None.

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Knife
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. This knife will multiply into enough knives to be used by 24 men.

Arm your friends!
weaknesses: Not enough knives for 25 men.

Your every child's friend
Never go hungry again
weaknesses: Toothaches
Children will beg you for candy
Parents

name: Myth Power: Hecateros' Hoedown
description: Hecateros (Hecaterus, Hekateros), in Greek myth, was the god of the rustic 'hekateris' dance. As such, channeling him allows one to move one's hands at Superhuman Speed, and with Superhuman Reflexes, at will. In addition, one can psychically access skill in 'combat dancing', at will. One can also psychically produce music, which compels subjects to perform a perfectly-coordinated dance routine, at will. One can even psychically launch foes literally into orbit, with a kick to the rump, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Hecateros' command over the essence of the rustic dance
strengths: Move one's hands at Superhuman Speed and with Superhuman Reflexes, at will
Psychically access combative dancing skill; produce a song, which compels subjects to dance, at will
Psychically launch foes into orbit, with a kick to the butt, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically manipulate subjects' hands, at will, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically amplify power of self/allies by joining hands, until developed (NCN)
Humor/entertainment-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Jack Bauer Power
description: When using Jack Bauer Power, you will gain the abilities of Jack Bauer. This means you will become an expert in fire arms, close range combat, strategic thinking and being a badass. In addition, you have the ability to call in SWAT teams and have phone calls with the president whenever you want.
summary: The ability to gain the powers of Jack Bauer for 24 hours
strengths: You're an expert in fire arms, close range combat and strategic thinking
Talking with the president is pretty cool
You're an expert at torture
weaknesses: Everyone with any kind of authority over you will suddenly become really annoying
You will probably spend most of your time having to kill terrorists
No bathroom breaks

name: Greater Kystian Morph #4
description: The aqusho. A five-mile-long anthropomorphic snake. You use telekinetic flight. It takes time to build up to your full speed of 60000 mph but takes lesser time to slow down. You can lift 1.4 million tons. You have telescopic vision times 1000 magnification, can sense electrical fields in a 500-mile radius and see in total darkness. When you first change, you first gain TK flight, then morph into a human-sized aqusho growing into your full size in 5 minutes.
summary: The ability to become a 5-mile-long unsummonable kystian.
strengths: Smash up the planet or a fleet of starships ( the main reason why Kyst made the aqusho).
Escape from prison (yes, using this power to do so is overkill but it is fun).
You can lift 2,800,000,000 pounds.
weaknesses: Annoying heroes with the right powers might stop you from changing and having fun.

name: Brain Spikes
description: This power lets you grow many spike or horn from your head at any moment. You can grow as many as you want at a time. The horns are unbreakable. The horns can also hold electric charges. They can be used for many different things. You can help or hurt people with this power. You will be a superhero or villain, so have fun.
summary: The ability to grow brain horns.
strengths: Hurt people.
Look cool and bad.
Make a lot of money.
weaknesses: Hurt people.
Superhero chance low.
They weigh a lot.

name: Flower Mimicry (Flower Form)
description: You can become a flower whenever you want to. This form can last as long as you want, and happens almost instantly. And you are very convincing as a flower.
summary: The ability to become a flower.
strengths: You can hide easily.
You are pretty.
weaknesses: As a flower, you can't talk or move, and you can be controlled by Agrokinesis
You might get trampled (you ARE just a flower)
Bugs always trying to pollinate you...

name: Jump 2: Powerless.
description: Annoyed with super powers? With this ability, you can move to a reality where all powers cease to function. This includes object-based powers. However, you leave an "anchor" in your last universe, which will enable you to return at will to the place, age and reality you left.
summary: The ability to jump to a reality where powers are impossible.
strengths: Upon return, you are the same age, power level, etc as when you left.
If you aren't the one entering this world, you will still be able to return.
Good prison for enemies.
weaknesses: You lose your powers too.
Lasting effects from powers are erased (could be a pro).
If you were too dependent on your powers, you would be a sitting duck.

name: The Oronox Elixir
description: Oronox is a liquid that can give a person immortality or permanent death. Drinking this bottle is a gamble, if you were to drink it and it gave you permanent death, you will die, and can never be reincarnated. Few get lucky and are rewarded with immortality. Being good-hearted raises the chance of awarding you immortality. Being rich and greedy raises the chance of you being punished with death.
summary: The ability to summon a bottle of Oronox
strengths: Chance of being immortal
weaknesses: Chance of being punished with permanent death.

name: Werewolf Summon
description: With this power you can summon werewolves and if you're lucky they'll help you do things. But they'll probably just eat you unless you also have werewolf control.
summary: The ability to summon werewolves
strengths: You can summon werewolves
weaknesses: They mitght eat you

name: Eye Popper
description: You simply take off all your clothes. They will be so amazed at how underdeveloped you are their eyes will burst.
summary: The ability to blow up people's eyes
strengths: Run around naked, all the time!
weaknesses: Never gonna get laid, ever!

name: Rise Of The Nornorajus
description: With this power you can turn into a Nornorajus, a small,cute looking creature that when angered goes berserk. It has sharp claws and teeth and is super agile and strong. It can climb almost any surface at enhanced speed. When you are angered while in Nornorajus mode you lose control over yourself and become a savage beast attacking anything that moves.
summary: The ability to turn into a Nornorajus
strengths: You can cause enemies to let their guard down with your cuteness
You have sharp claws and teeth, super strength, super agility and enhanced climbing abilities
weaknesses: If you get angry you lose control over yourself
You are unable to talk in Nornorajus mode

name: Bigfoot Control
description: With this power you have complete control of the elusive cryptid, Bigfoot
summary: The ability to control Bigfoot
strengths: You can make him fight for you
You can bring him in for show and tell
You can use him to reach things for you that are in high places
weaknesses: He might not be near you when using this power so it will take awhile for him to get to you

name: Mascot Conjuring
description: Think of a mascot and it will appear before as a unaging flesh and blood being. It won't need food or water. It might have powers(e. G. Kool Aid Man, Lucky the Leprechaun). It will do its best to help you. You can unconjure it anytime. Mascots you conjure can be conjured by other people with this power.. Your jolly green giant could fight another jolly green giant. You can conjure a new mascot every day until you run out of mascots to conjure.
summary: The ability to conjure mascots of a corporate or sports variety.
strengths: Jolly green giant, Lucky the Leprechaun, Tony the Tiger, Chester Cheeto.
Conjured mascots don't need food or water.
Conjured mascots are immortal.
weaknesses: Pillsbury doughboy, helping hand, geicko gecko, keebler elves, Snap, Crackle and Pop.
Eventually you'll run out of good mascots to conjure.

name: Tarentule (Tarantula)
description: If you're a tarantula hybrid, you can produce a web substance that slowly kills your prey
summary: The ability to produce venomous web
strengths: You don't have to do a lot
A meal that doesn't fight back
And you can torture it as it slowly dies
weaknesses: You're screwed if it can suddenly burst from your web
You can't hang from web substance
You as vulnerable to it as your victim

name: Zzzzz Xylophone
description: With this power you can summon a xylophone. One touch and anyone who hears it falls asleep.
summary: The ability to summon a xylophone that can put others to sleep.
strengths: Put people to sleep.
weaknesses: You could fall asleep.
No drumsticks.

name: Hollower
description: With this power you can make anything hollow. Just point at the object and say "Hollow" and the object will instantly be hollowed out. You cannot use this power on living beings.
summary: The ability to make things hollow
strengths: You can make things hollow
weaknesses: You cannot use this power on living beings

name: Baseball Bat Arms
description: With this power you can turn your arms into baseball bats. You can do it with both arms and you can choose between metal and wood or you have one wooden bat arm and one metal bat arm at the same time. You can keep your arms in bat mode for as long as you want, but if one of the bats are cut off or broken in half, your arm is cut off or broken in half so be careful.
summary: The ability to turn your arms into baseball bats
strengths: You can turn your arms into either metal or wooden baseball bats
You can keep them in bat mode for as long as you want
weaknesses: All damage sustained in bat mode transfers over to arm mode

name: Srs Bsns
description: With this person you can make anybody remain complete serious for up to twenty four hours. The person will not be able to laugh, tell a joke or make fun of anything.
summary: The ability to make somebody complete serious for a whole twenty four hours
strengths: You can make people complete serious for up to twenty four hours
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat unless you're fighting the Joker or something

name: Max Hair
description: With this power you can cause your hair to grow as long as you want. You cannot make the hair become shorter again with this power.
summary: The ability to cause your hair to grow longer
strengths: You can make your hair to grow longer
weaknesses: You can't make it grow shorter

name: Kirby's Cellphone
description: With this power you can have Kirby's cellphone from Kirby and the Amazing Mirror. The phone allows you to summon four Kirby clones, green, red, yellow and Shadow Kirby. You can use the phone whenever you want. You cannot unsummon the Kirby's but eventually they will wander off and disappear on their own.
summary: The ability to have Kirby's cellphone
strengths: You can have Kirby's cellphone
You can summon four Kirby clones
weaknesses: The clones are not under your control
They're not very useful if there are no Kirby enemies around for them to inhale
Sometimes they'll wander off even when you still need them

name: Vixen Force
description: Vixen force is the ability to call a force of vixens to aid you in any way you need,with just a whistle or a snap of your fingers.
summary: The ability to call a force of vixens to aid you.
strengths: You get extra soldiers for you battle force.
weaknesses: They may not understand you.

name: Rise Of The Ogre
description: With this power you can turn into an ogre. In ogre form you grow (or shrink) to seven feet tall and weight four hundred pounds. You can jump high, have super strength and a massive appetite. Unfortunately while in ogre form you are very sluggish and slow and can be easily distracted by food.
summary: The ability to turn into an ogre
strengths: You can turn into ogre
You have super strength and you can jump high
weaknesses: You are sluggish
You can be easily distracted by food

name: Albino Skin Changing
description: The power of albino skin changing allows the user to make their skin brighter. The weakness of this power is that your skin becomes less resistant to UV rays, but it helps with stealth, and it can be used to fight vampires.
summary: The ability to adjust your skin to shades of white
strengths: Blending in to bright environments
Can be used to fight vampires
Incredible stealth
weaknesses: Less resistant to UV rays
Must have sunscreen or be in a dark area

name: Myth Power: Muses' Message5
description: The Muses (Mousai, Mousae, Musae), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of knowledge, sciences, the arts and inspiration. As such, channeling Melpomene (Tragedy) allows one to psychically access knowledge of all tragic works, at will. In addition, one can psychically travel into any tragic story world, at will. One can also psychically summon objects and characters from tragic story worlds, at will. One can even psychically drain happiness, by touch, and psychically compel 'sad' subjects, at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Muses' command over the essence of knowledge, inspiration and art
strengths: Psychically access knowledge of tragic works, at will
Psychically travel into (and summon objects/characters from) tragic story worlds, at will
Psychically drain happiness, by touch, and compel 'sad' subjects, at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically disrupt creativity (or negate ideas), by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically perceive subject's ideas until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Apollo's Gift may cause bossy attitude toward the user (NCN)

name: Sinkhole
description: This ability allows  it's user to generate a sinkhole anywhere on any surface. Created sinkholes defy gravity and will pull in materials around it. Placing a sinkhole on a thin surface can create a sort of passage through it. These sinkholes can hinder your opponents of completely swallow them up. Stronger materials require more power to create sinkholes in them.
summary: The ability to create a gravitational sinkhole on any surface
strengths: Trap your enemies
Sinkholes can defy gravity
weaknesses: Sinkholes cannot move once created
Larger Sinkholes can rage out of control.

name: Myth Power: Horae (Hours03)
description: These Horae (Horai, Hours), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of the hours of the day. As such, channeling Musica (Musia, Mousika- Music, Study Hour), one can psychically perceive the passage of time, at will. In addition, one can withstand temporal effects. Furthermore, one can psychically regenerate, and gain physical power, when one hears music. One can also psychically convert subjects' voices into music, at will. One can even psychically access an extradimensional 'Study Space', at will.
summary: The ability to channel the Horae and their command over the essence of the hours of the day
strengths: Psychically perceive the passage of time, at will; withstand temporal effects
Psychically regenerate and gain physical power when one hears music
Psychically convert subjects' voices into music, access an extradimensional 'Study Space', at will
weaknesses: Cannot psychically access Speedreading and Superhuman Memory, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically generate music lyrics to compel subjects, until developed (NCN)
Cannot psychically generate music to cast lyric-based illusions, until developed (NCN)

name: Traveler's Curse
description: You know someone can leap through time, speed up time, slow time down, or stop time. You can curse this person. From now on each time they use their power they will be sick to their stomach and throw up. It gets worse and worse each time after until they just cant stand it.
summary: The ability to make time travelers increasingly sick with each leap through time.
strengths: Make time travelers sick.
It gets worse each time they use their power.
Eventually they stop using their power.
weaknesses: Stupid or stubborn time travelers will either die from sickness or kill themselves.

name: Killer Smile
description: Gives the user the ability to do a really terrifying shark-like smile, it does this by sharpening the users teeth and making them into feral points and contorting your expression into a horrific smile. In the process also giving the user gills and or scales to make them look kind of fish-like.   It is best used to warn off enemies or to creep them out.
summary: The ability to grow Shark-like Teeth
strengths: Gives you the most awesome creepy smile ever.
You'll become a very fast swimmer.
You can become a menacing half-human-half-shark beast.
weaknesses: The smile only works if your mouth is open.
You can't be a Mer-shark.
You have to be near water before you go into shark beast form or you will dry up.

name: Gift: Hair
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using hair-based powers than other beings. Thus their hair-based powers are stronger than most other being's powers and it is harder to take control of hair from them. However, someone with this power can only recieve hair-based powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at hair-based powers
strengths: Almost no one has as good control over hair as someone with this power.
Hair-based powers are boosted slightly.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the control aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only hair-based powers now.

name: Summon Sackboy
description: You can summon a Sackboy from Little Big Planet to be your friend and to aid you. The Sackboy has access to its popit allowing you to change its costume and to use the items from Little Big Planet. You can use the Little Big Planet materials to create objects just as you would in the game. You can also give your Sackboy the power ups from the game like the jet pack and the paintinator.
summary: The ability to summon a Sackboy from Little Big Planet.
strengths: Change your Sackboy's costume.
Build objects just as you would in Little Big Planet.
Give your Sackboy power ups.
weaknesses: Sackboy's have weaknesses to fire, electricity, sharp objects, and poisonus gases.
Restricted to only what you could make from Little Big Planet.
Sackboy's hate negativity.

name: Snap You're A Salt Pillar
description: With this power you can turn people into pillars of salt just by snapping, saying the persons name and the word salt. Keep in mind that you cannot turn people back into people once they become salt and the salt is edible.
summary: The ability to turn people into pillars of salt by snapping
strengths: You can turn your enemies into salt
It's edible salt
weaknesses: You can't turn them back into people
Too much salt is not good for you

name: Four Eyes: Servants
description: This is gained by having the Four Eyes power and having the normal and lower/left eyes open. The Four Eyes power slowly turns into this power. Anyone who takes a good look into all of your eyes will become your servant. They will have complete adoration and love with anything in regards to you. However, if the person has a strong will they can resist or break the effects of this power. In addition, your eyes become really sensitve to anything that physically touches them excluding you and light.
summary: The ability to make anyone who looks into all four eyes one's servant
strengths: You can choose to make the person a loving and adoring servant.
Can still use Four Eyes powers.
This is a Four Eyes evolution.
weaknesses: Must have Four Eyes power and have only the two normal and lower/left eyes open.
The person must take a good look into all four eyes.
Cannot get the other Four Eyes evolutions.

name: Too Damn Hot
description: Want to make someone's ice-cream melt? Then just say those three special words "Too Damn Hot" and it becomes so sunny their ice-cream will melt in less than 30 seconds.
summary: The ability to make the weather very sunny.
strengths: You can make someone's ice-cream melt!
You can give people heat-stroke!
You are not Immune!
weaknesses: Oh wait, did I say that right? Whoopsie :)
You too might get heat-stroke.
Say goodbye to your ice-cream.

name: Celtic Invocation: Aibell
description: By calling on the powers of Aibell, the invoker may use a stringed musical instrument (harp, violin, guitar, etc), or their voice to play/sing people to death. They, however, must know the song of death. They may also sing/play leaves and stones into golems/automatons, and give them various tasks, but mainly domestic ones like cleaning.
summary: The ability to use the power of Aibell, an Irish Faerie Queen
strengths: If you know the songs, you'll be feared everywhere.
Sing up some servants in a minute or two.
Open your mouth and people will flee.
weaknesses: They may never lie. Lying temporarily strips them of their abilities.
If you don't know the songs needed.
If you can't sing, or your instruments are broker.

name: Palmar Mouths
description: A person who obtains this ability instantly grows small mouths on the palms of both of their hands. The mouths have super sharp teeth and a knife like tongue which you can stick out of the mouths to use as weapons. The mouths also act as small portals to a pocket dimension so they can eat anything and it will just go to the pocket dimension and not insid of you. You cannot turn this power off so you always have the small hands on your palms.
summary: The ability to have mouths on the palms of your hands
strengths: You have two mouths with super sharp teeth and knife like tongues on your hands
They can eat anything and it all goes to a small pocket dimension
weaknesses: You cannot turn this power off
You probably shouldn't high five people anymore
Holding hands might also be a problem

name: Spl Mimicry 2: Myself's Work
description: You automatically gain this power once you gain a legitimate copy of any of Myself's creations. Normally, this would be useless, but since you gain all powers in this series just by acquiring one, it can be used as a tool to gain any benefits the series has to offer. Unfortunately, no power can eliminate this powers' cons. The effects of this power are not dependent on it; if you get this and acquire the rest of the series, you will retain it even if you lose this one.
summary: The ability to gain this power, provided you possess one of Myself's powers legitimately.
strengths: Gain the entire series.
Have this automatically even if you only have one of Myself's creations legitimately.
The effects of this power are not dependent on this power.
weaknesses: Useless without a profile on the Superpower List.
Can only gain this power legitimately, through this powers' effects or through this series.
Other powers (e. G. Con Negation) cannot eliminate the cons of this power.

name: Shoe Manipulation
description: With this power you can change the size and design of shoes. You can change sandals into boots or into cleats or any other kind of shoe or you can just change the colors or brands of your shoes or someone else's.
summary: The ability to change the size and design of shoes
strengths: You can change the size and style of shoes
weaknesses: You can only manipulate shoes nothing else

name: Summon Goshosi Swarm
description: Goshosi look like a mix of mouse and goblin of folklore. They are 2 inches high. A swarm has hive IQ. A swarm must phase in and out as a group. A swarm is summoned with miniaturized rifles. Utterly useless for fighting but useful for sabotage. A goshosi physically can't do more damage than a kitten but it can lift 850 times its own body weight. A swarm retains hive IQ when all twenty members of the swarm are less then 500 feet apart from each other.
summary: The ability to summon a swarm of phasing kystians.
strengths: A swarm working together can lift just over one ton.
A phasing kystian.
Great little saboteurs.
weaknesses: A swarm must phase as a group
Kill one and the swarm is useless

name: Eyeball Splosion
description: With this power you make people's eyeballs explode by thinking about them and saying "I wish your eyes would explode! " Both of the victim's eyes will explode destroying every thing in a few feet. You cannot limit the explosion to one eye or a greater distance. You can also not use this power on yourself or anybody else who has this power.
summary: The ability to make people's eyeballs explode
strengths: You can cause people's eyes to explode
You are immune to this power even if it is used by another person
weaknesses: You cannot you this power on somebody else who has this power
You cannot make the explosion smaller

name: God Phone V7
description: With this power you can summon the gods and goddesses of the Aztecs. They are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for summoning them they might help you. If not they'll probably just destroy you. You can not unsummon them unless they want to be sent back.
summary: The ability to summon the gods of the Aztecs
strengths: You can summon the gods and goddesses of the Aztecs
They might help you
weaknesses: They might destroy you
They can only be sent back if they want to be sent back

name: Cholesterol Manipulation
description:
Dwight: Through concentration, I can raise and lower my cholesterol at will. 
Pam: Why would you wanna raise your cholesterol? 
Dwight: So I can lower it
summary: The ability to raise and lower your cholesterol at will
strengths: You can remain at a healthy level of cholesterol
weaknesses: Takes concentration and time to master

name: Race Alter
description: This ability allows you to change your race. If your race is white, then you can change to black, asian or inuit. This way, if you're black and being hunted down by the KKK, change to white and you're safe. With your skin color also changed, you become a stereotype version of your new race.
summary: The ability to change your race
strengths: Not be racist
Be good at basketball, martial arts, etc.
weaknesses: KKK
People may know your other forms

name: Pb: Ignition
description: 'PB' stands for 'Power Boost'. With this ability, all of your fire abilities are doubled in effectiveness, including strength, concentration, et cetera.
summary: The ability to have all of your fire abilities doubled in effectiveness.
strengths: Doubles the effectiveness of fire abilities (power, concentration needed, etc. ).
weaknesses: If you don't have fire abilities.
Or any abilities at all.

name: Smurf Summon
description: As most people know, Smurfs are small blue humanoids that wear white caps and white clothes, and use the word 'smurf' for every other word in their vocabulary. They can tame animals to ride on, and Pap can even do magic! With this power, you can summon any of the Smurfs whenever you want, and for whatever purpose you want, whether it be to fight crime, make them do stuff for you or just to hang out with them. And each of them has a personality or a skill set for any need you can possibly have.
summary: The ability to summon smurfs
strengths: You can summon any of the smurfs, as many as you want and for as long as you want
Each has a different skill set and/or personality (never get bored, always have help)
Papa Smurf can do (and teach) magic; he and the rest of the smurfs are very smart and resourceful
weaknesses: They are rather small (be careful to make sure they don't get lost, stolen or smooshed)
Their Smurf song might get annoying

name: X Ray Move
description: This power is physiclly one often the most painful physical move for a certain Superpower. You can perform an X-Ray move of your choice, and cause your enemy's bones to crack, break, or snap. Even the skull if you wanted to. But, theres 2 catches. One: You have to be in pain in order to perform an X-Ray Move. And two: You can only crack, break, or snap 2-3 bones per X-ray move.
summary: The ability to break bones from a certain body part like in Mortal Kombat
strengths: Can be painful to your enemy.
Cracks, breaks, or snaps your enemie's bones.
Can be very deadly if you have another Power to mix in.
weaknesses: You have to be in a certain amount of pain in order to perform an X-Ray Move.
Can only be used once unless you get hurt more.
If your enemy has this power. That would hurt a lot.

name: Tomatosis
description:
With this ability, you can summon up small handfuls of tomatoes with a wish and a flick of the wrist. 

Inexperienced users often create tomatoes at inconvenient times, or make too many tomatoes, but as their skill grows they can grow perfectly ripe fields of pre-ketchup. 

Of course, pushing the limits may cause the user to run out of tomatoes until they can be restocked in the tomato dimension. 

Oh, and it doesn't work if you're wet.
summary: The ability to grow tomatoes out of thin air.
strengths: Free food.
Feed the hungry.
Entertain guests in your parlor.
weaknesses: Difficult to control.
Somewhat limited supply.
Won't work in water.

name: Mohawk Grenade
description: Ever seen the WoW commericals about this? Well with this ability you get to turn people into the man who made the A-team and kicked Rocky's butt in Rocky 3.
summary: The ability to turn people into Mr. T
strengths: You get a wicked Mohawk
Able to box like a professional
Become a excellent driver
weaknesses: Always have to say "I PITY DA FOOL" when you start talking
Can never smile again
Always looking down on people

name: Lo Z: Majora's Mask Of Revenge
description: This is a mask when put on allows you to transform into any of the Zelda Dungeon main bosses.... This can span any of the zelda games. This means you could transform into someone like Fyrus, Stallord, or Blizzeta from Twilight Princess to someone older like Volvagia or King Dodongo or Bongo Bongo
summary: The ability to transform into any Zelda Dungeon Final Boss
strengths: You gain their powers and strengths
You can transform into a monster
To turn back to yourself take off the mask
weaknesses: You gain their weakneses also (King Dodongo's to bombs)
Its a mask so have to put on to transform.. If forced off by enemy (song or rip off) you change back
You can only do a main dungeon boss from any Zelda Game (no Ganon, yes Phantom Ganon))

name: Eggsy's Gift
description: Eggsy's Gift is the ability to turn already existing light particles (photons) into pink and white colored light particles. This ability also allows the creation of Ccicken eggs from nowhere. These eggs are extremely nutritious, but, if dropped or thrown, they will explode in a large mess.
summary: The ability to turn light particles into pink and white light particles, and create chicken eggs out of nowhere.
strengths: Never go hungry
Create sparkles :D
Throwing eggs at people
weaknesses: Useless in most situations
Eggs explode
Hardly anyone else has such a "gift"

name: Snap Uncontrolled Fire Breath
description: With this power you can give someone uncontrolled fire breath, it's pretty much just giving someone Uncontrollable Fire Breathing but changed to fit the in the title bar. You can only give this power to up to two people at a time and the person cannot open his mouth without shooting flames out of it. They won't be able to eat, talk or even breathe through their mout without shooting flames everywhere. You can remove the curse from them whenever you want and give it to a new person.
summary: The ability to give someone uncontrollable fire breathing by snapping
strengths: You can cause people to shoot flames from their mouth whenever they talk
weaknesses: You can only give it to up to two people at a time
It's plenty bad for the person you give it to

name: "Breakdance!" V2
description: With this power whenever you start breakdancing you will be surrounded by an unbreakable forcefield. If you're about to be attacked or being attacked you just start breakdancing and you're safe. This power does not teach you how to break dance.
summary: The ability to be surrounded by an unbreakable force field when your breakdance
strengths: You can be surrounded by a forcefield whenever you start to breakdance

When you're at it, you'll jump level to your opponent's head while parallel to the ground, applying a three-quarter facelock, and then slam their head to the ground while behind their backs.
summary: The ability to use a sleeper hold, then do a jumping cutter behind your opponent's back.
strengths: a fight combo is not a power
weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Myth Power: Wonder Of Wine
description: Oenos (Oinos, Oenus, Hedyoenos, Hedyoinos, Hedyoenus) and Oene (Oine), in Greek myth, were god and goddess counterparts (respectively) of wine. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically recall knowledge of wines (making, tasting, etc) at will. In addition, one may withstand wine's alcoholic effects. Furthermore, one may psychically manipulate wine like a hydrokinetic manipulates water. One may also psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone with wine in their systems.
summary: The ability to channel Oenos and Oene's command over the essence of wine
strengths: Learn everything there is to know about wine; entirely resist the alcoholic effects of wine
Psychically manipulate wine like a hydrokinetic manipulates water
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel anyone with wine in their system (even a taste)
weaknesses: Cannot manipulate wine within a living body until the HIGHEST levels (NCN)
None of the above applies to beer, or any other liqueur/liquor; just wine (NCN)
People with MythPower: Bacchanalia are immune to (and can disrupt) this ability

name: Superpowerless
description: With this power, it is impossible to gain or use a superpower in any way. This includes the "Superpowerless superpower. " So, because the Superpowerless super power would no longer apply, you CAN have/use superpowers. This power would then apply again. The cycle repeats itself.
summary: The ability to never have any superpowers, including this power.
strengths: None.
weaknesses: Walking paradox.
Bloody stupid power.

name: As The Table Turns
description: You can summon a table with a thought to put your foe in an unconscious state and/or you could summon 5 more tables, putting them in a horizontal order to crash your opponent with a Sitdown Powerbomb.
summary: The ability to summon a wooden table to put your opponent through.
strengths: Your enemy can be filled with painful splinters after you done it.
weaknesses: None.

name: Roman To Greek
description: Turn Fauns into Satyrs, a temple of Jupiter into a temple of Zeus, and much more.
summary: The ability to turn anything Roman, Greek.
strengths: Turn anything Roman, Greek.
weaknesses: It is basically the same thing.
You may not encounter many Roman things in your life.
The effect can not be reversed.

name: X Tinction
description: With this power you can cause entire species of animals to go extinct. You just have to shout the name of the animal and then say the word extinct and every single member of the species will instantly die. You cannot reverse the affects of this power. You cannot use this power on humans or aliens.
summary: The ability to cause entire species to go extinct
strengths: You can cause any species to go extinct
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat
You cannot use this power on humans or aliens
You cannot reverse the affects of this power

name: Transformers: Sparkeater
description: With this power you can summon a Sparkeater from the comic series More Than Meets the Eye by James Roberts. The Sparkeater feeds off of machines and could be directed to eat humans and other living beings as well. The Sparkeater is under your control though it is also extremely unstable and needs to be kept under constant supervision. If it is shot with any kind of energy weapon it will explode in a massive explosion. You can unsummon the Sparkeater whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon a Sparkeater
strengths: You can summon a Sparkeater
It is under your control
weaknesses: It has to be kept under constant supervision

name: 1337 Sp34k
description: You now can understand Leet. No matter how 'Leet' they may speak, you will understand.
summary: The ability to understand Leet Speak.
strengths: Understand Leet Speak.
weaknesses: Side effects include dizziness, headaches, and a desire to strangle Leet Speakers

name: Release The Bogus!
description: No matter where you come from, anyone who has this power could be mistaken as a beach-going teenager from the 80s. Attacks include "Totally radical", "Wipe out", "Crunch time", and, of course, "RELEASE THE BOGUS"
summary: The ability to unleash a myriad of surfer-dude-type attacks
strengths: It comes with the ability to surf like a pro
The waves are at your command for total hang time!
It's totally tubular, dude!
weaknesses: If you don't want to look dated, this power isn't for you
Surfing abilities are negated if you lose your "cool"
Might make people laugh at you

name: Hell's Baker
description: You've the powers of a infernal baker. You can create demon possessed cakes,loaves of bread,brownies,etc. Your demonic baked goods will grow arms and legs. They'll have sharp teeth. They can talk. Baked good demons are still baked goods. They can go stale losing speed and agility. They possess no toughness at all, except maybe for certain types of hard breads. Baked good demons are the easiest demon to exorcise.
summary: The ability to create demon possessed baked goods.
strengths: Scare junk food eaters,"The cupcakes tried to eat me! "
A foe may laugh at one evil brownie but a horde of them will shut him up.
weaknesses: Summoners of real demons will laugh at you.
Bizarre powers aren't for everyone.

name: Myth Power: Cyamites' Cipher
description: Cyamites (Kyamites), in Greek myth, was the god of beans and bean-plants. As such, channeling him allows one to gain skill in growing, cultivating and cooking with beans. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate beans and bean-plants, at will. Furthermore, one can gain physical power from eating beans. One can also psychically compel subjects to gorge out on beans by touch, word or thought. One can even psychically induce flatulence, by touch, word or thought.
summary: The ability to channel Cyamites' command over the essence of beans
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and manipulate beans and bean plants
Gain skill in cultivating and cooking with beans; gain physical power from eating beans
Psychically compel subjects to gorge out on beans (abandoning all else); induce flatulence
weaknesses: Cannot turn people into beanstalks, or their weight in beans, by touch, until developed (NCN)
Cannot generate supernatural beans (even from body of self/others), until developed (NCN)
Plant/animal/nature-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Soul Eater:  Franken Stein
description: Proffesor Franken Stein, was a great meister, allowing one great abilities. The first allows you to supercharge your attacks, by resonating with your soul you could really put your soul into your attacks (Soul Menace). Not only that, but you can control and change your soul at will, matching it with a partner, to make your attacks stronger.
summary: The ability to use Franken Stein's abilities from Soul eater.
strengths: Soul Menace.
Maniuplating your soul.
weaknesses: You may have a sudden urge to dissect everybody that comes your way.....
There is a almost certain chance that you will be consumed by madness....

name: Kystian Aura
description: This aura affects any kystian that may want to hurt or kill you. You need the powers Summon Slitskin and Summon Norr to make this power work. Any kystians will regard you as one of them (if intelligent enough) or simply ignore you (ex. Slitskin). This power will work on any kystians not summoned by you. There are two drawbacks to this power. Living things will avoid you - if they can't, they will show distress. No one alive will like you - if someone alive dislikes you, then they will hate you.
summary: The ability to have an aura that will make kystian things not hate you.
strengths: No more hostile half-alive servants.
Another person's kystian will refuse to hurt or kill you.
weaknesses: Your only friends are unnatural things from another dimension.
This power may cause angry mobs to chase after you.

name: ""1st Power""
description: I actually know someone who has this power. It's ME! HahahHAHahjah! But honestly, this is just a lame attempt at a joke. Please have mercy on me! And yes the space between 1 and st is necessary. Also, if you decide to approve this, could you decapitalize that S? Thank You.
summary: The ability to create the first power on the list when viewed alphabetically
strengths: You can make a lame joke and feel good about yourself for a little while
weaknesses: If it gets rejected, you'll cry yourself to sleep

name: Albino Control
description: With this power you can control completely white animals to do your bidding
summary: The ability to control Albino Animals
strengths: You have an army of Albino animals
You can sell said animals for a good price as Albinos are rare
weaknesses: If there are no Albinos near you it may take a while for them to get to you

name: Gallium Touch
description: With Gallium touch, you can turn any inanimate item or object into Gallium metal at will. Turn garbage into Gallium. Turn plastics into Gallium.
summary: The ability to turn any inanimate object into Gallium metal.
strengths: Turn any inanimate object into Gallium
weaknesses: Gallium is not overly useful

name: Bored To Death
description: This ability can make you so terribly boring that the people who listen at your words actually die from boredom. For this ability the word "bored" means : "To make weary by being dull, repetitive, or tedious".  So this has nothing to do with drilling holes in people. Nor does it mean that you form a hole by drilling, digging, or burrowing.  And with the word "die" it means that they cease living. And maybe also that they experience an agony or suffering, but only in the form of extreme boredom.
summary: The ability to make people die from boredom
strengths: Your words will have a lasting effect on your audience.
They will never invite you to make a speech.
Your power is usefull at mass suicide events.
weaknesses: Not the fastest way to release people from their burden of life.
No one would dare to hear you out, even if you have something usefull to say.
Did you really read the full description, or were you succesfully bored?

name: Myth Power: Potter's Potential4
description: The Ceramic Daemons (Potter's Daemons, Daimones Keramikoi, Daemones Ceramicoi), in Greek myth, were the gods who plagued the craftsman and potter. As such, channeling Syntrobos (Syntrobus, Syntribos, Syntribus- Shatter) allows one to turn foes into clay statues by touch; as soon as they finish petrifying, they explode into clay shrapnel. In addition, one can explode oneself into clay shrapnel at will. Furthermore, one can withstand and negate petrifaction and involuntary separation abilities.
summary: The ability to channel the Ceramic Daemons' command over the essence of pottery and ceramics
strengths: Turn foes into clay statues by touch; after they turn, they explode into a spray of clay shrapnel
Cause oneself to explode into clay shrapnel (can also reform at will, which heals all injuries)
Totally withstand the effects of petrifaction and separation type powers (vaporization, etc)
weaknesses: Cannot explode non-petrified stone structures until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot restore exploded/petrified subjects at the higher levels (NCN)
People with earth-based MythPowers are immune to the direct effects of this ability

name: 8 Headed Snake:Yamata No Orochi
description: Someone with this power can at will turn into a giant 8-headed, 8-tailed snake. They become so powerful and cunning while in this form that not even the most powerful warriors dare to challenge them, only beings with power equal to or greater than that of a god's. The only way to gain this power you must bathe in the blood of 1000 pure-hearted maidens.
summary: The ability to use power similar to that of the Japanese snake Yamata-no-Orochi
strengths: Most beings won't dare to challenge you.
Con: No other power can get rid of this powers cons. Ever.
Fun Fact: Orochimaru was named after Yamata-no-Orochi
weaknesses: Beware of sake while in snake form as it smells good to you and is your greatest weakness (to con 2)
(from con1)as you can easily get drunk and will automatically want to drink any sake put before you.

description: With this power you can control the amount of facial hair that people have. You can make your own or someone else's beard or moustache longer or bushier or make them shorter or thinner.

strengths: You can control the amount of facial hair that people have
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: 100 Summon
description: With this power you can cause any person with any type of summoning power to (only) be able to summon 100 of the item/creature/person that they can summon. Sometimes this can be a good thing if the power normally only allows the user to summon ten of something using this power will up that amount to 100. However if the power usually grants the user the ability to summon an unlimited amount of something this power will limit it to only 100 of the item. You cannot reverse the affects of this power
summary: The ability to cause people with summoning powers only be able to summon 100 of the item
strengths: You can cause a summoning power to (only) be to summon 100 of the item
You can use this power on yourself or as many people as you wanr

Your butt will be invincible!

description: You have the ability to teleport from one side of the sheet of toilet paper to the other side. If it breaks you will only teleport till that break point. Works with 1 ply and 2 ply, so no worries.

strengths: You can escape bullies.
You can teepee somes house with ease and never get caught.
Noone exppects you to have this power till you use it.

name: Bride's Curse
description: This ability is a bit out there. If you (a man) have powers you cannot control, you can pass these powers onto any woman, but only the night of her wedding. There is a ritualist chant to be performed and after that the powers pass to her. She will have the powers with complete control over them.
summary: The ability to transfer uncontrollable powers to a woman on her wedding night.
strengths: You can pass on all powers you can't control; doesn't work for those you control
If you find a worthy woman, she could be a future ally.
You could steal them back WITH control
weaknesses: You must be close by, within 50 feet of the woman at the right moment.
Can only be done on her wedding night, If you get caught, she may kill from fear or anger.

name: Run Away Bagels

make everyone around you jealous
never have to dish out money for breakfast

the bagel has to be eaten within a 2 hour time frame

description: With this power you can teleport yourself and others to Planet Koozebane from the Muppet Show. This power does not allow you to breathe in space so being able to would be good if you didn't want to die when you use this power. There are also several strange creatures on Koozebane most of them a relatively harmless and can be brought back to Earth as pets or to sell to zoos. This power does allow you to get yourself and others back to your home planet.

Good with Jelly Vision
weaknesses: If you're allergic to peanuts this is a bad power for you

name: Muppet Power Sweetum's Strength
description: With this power you can have the strength of the Muppet Monster, Sweetums. You can lift cars and break holes through walls but you are unable to harm animals. Another side effect of this power is you grow a lot of hair and when you cut it, it just grows right back two days later.

strengths: You have the strength of Sweetums
You have long hair

If you cut your long hair it just grows back two days later

name: Myth Power: Theoria's Therapy
description: Theoria, in Greek myth, was the goddess of festival embassy; celebrating holidays, going to festivals and theater. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically generate colorful blasts of explosive energy, at will. In addition, if used on holidays, they take on holiday-based effects. Furthermore, one can psychically summon a theater mask to one's face, to withstand illusions etc, at will. One can even psychically summon a theater mask to subjects' faces, by touch, to dominate them, at will.

strengths: Psychically generate colorful blasts of energy (which take on colors/themed effects on holidays)

name: Canimageirkinesis
description:
This power is useful if the supervillain tends to have armies of guard dogs, but can be downright evil in the hands of those who hate dogs. 

Topping the list of PETA's "most hated powers" list, its limits are unknown, but are assumed to only affect the genus Canis, but not Chupacabras. 

An ongoing debate in the Canimageirkinesis community is whether or not it can be used against Cerberus. The issue being whether Cerberus is a dog demon, or a demon that happens to look like a dog
summary: The ability to set dogs on fire.
strengths: Take out wolves from a helicopter.
Set those annoying yappy dogs aflame with your mind.
Piss off PETA.
weaknesses: Not useful on anything but the genus Canis.
Doesn't work on Chupacabras.

name: 10 Least Wanted
description: The holder of this ability can have the top 10 least wanted powers on the Superpower List. You can suppress any or all of the 10 powers.

strengths: You have 10 powers
You don't have to use those powers
Most people have no powers
weaknesses: You have 10 powers that suck so bad they are least wanted

name: Slush Pup Pi E Summon
description: From the creator of CrackTart comes Slush Puppie Summon. You can summon any item which has been officially sanctioned to bear the Slush Puppie logo of the hat and shirt-wearing cartoon dog holding one of his products. To summon one, you must shout "Slush Puppie summon! " The larger and more complex it is, the longer you must hold the final "o" sound in "summon. " Holding it for a minute can summon a company truck. Whatever you think is most likely to be in the summoned container is what it has.
summary: The ability to summon anything with the official Slush Puppie logo on it.
strengths: Have Slush Puppie products whenever you want.
There's no limit to how many you can summon.
Hold it long enough and you can bring factories, people wearing products, or even the dog himself.

It may be embaraassing to use this power, and it is impossible to do it quietly.

name: Summon Antikyst
description: Kystians are strange beings that inhabit the dimension of Kyst. One with this ability summons the bane of Kystian existence, the Antikyst. It is immune to all their attacks (even treating their superstrength like normal strength), and capable of negating their powers when in close enough proximity to them. In addition, it can harm them at a touch (and if touch is maintained, it can zap them from existence). The Antikyst is an eight-foot-tall humanoid with skin patterned like the depths of space.
summary: The ability to summon a being that is designed solely for the destruction of Kyst and the Kystians
strengths: Summon an Antikyst which can withstand and negate Kystian abilities (and harms Kystians at a touch)
If touch is maintained with Kystians long enough, they are obliterated from existence
Its presence, when in the dimension of Kyst, acts like a cancer, killing/destroying all it touches
weaknesses: Cannot perceive/sense/locate and teleport to the location of Kyst/Kystians until the higher levels
The Antikyst cannot absorb/steal or mimic Kystian abilities until the higher levels
The Antikyst cannot steal strength from Kystians until the higher levels

name: Fountain Head
description: This power allows you to pour any type of drink from your head by turning your head sideways. The drink comes out of your ear (minus the earwax) Whenever you turn your head sideways. This power is always turned on so if you do not want a drink, do not tilt your head.

strengths: Drinks when you want.
Any type of drink.
Never worry about being thirsty
weaknesses: Drinks leaking out of your ears when you tilt your head.

People may not want to drink your ear liquids.

name: Smoke Burps
description: Whenever you burp, you emit smoke from your mouth. With practice, different kinds/amounts of smoke can be produced.

strengths: Ability to smoke screen stuff like a ninja

No need for a fog machine for your band

name: Summon Alot
description: The Alot is an imaginary creature that is a mix between a bear, a yak and a pug that you can summon into reality. The Alot can be made out of many different substances, such as Alot of Fire, or Alot of Mist (like elemental familiars, but not limited to elements). You can summon as many Alots as you wish and unsummon them at will. The Alots will be friendly towards you and help you but they have their own free will.

strengths: Can Summon Alot to help you.

name: Delete This Merciless Cross
description: Firstly, you can grab your foe's shoulders from behind and kick deep into their lower back. Secondly, grab their wrists from behind and push them upward, snapping their shoulders. And thirdly, place your opponent in between their own legs, lift your enemy, hold both their arms in a cross position, and finally run or fall to your knees and throw your foe onto the ground back/neck first.

weaknesses: a fight combo is not a power

name: Condition Change: Right Hand

name: Werewolves To Wolves

weaknesses: The wolf is not under your control

name: Inedibility
description: You are virtually protected from being eaten. First, you emit a very foul odor, which should repel your predators. If that's not enough, your flesh has an abominable taste, which should definitely dissuade your enemies from eating you after taking a first bite out of you.

strengths: You can safely venture among carnivorous animals.

This item appears very similar to a normal bell; however once it chimes three times it opens a small portal. KILL TROLLS

description: With this power you can turn into a Beavecoon in order to fight crime now I know what you're probably thinking "How can turning into a creature with the head of a beaver and the rump of a raccoon be useful in battle?
